translation_verse: Dɛ baa yoɡ o bihaah tɛ nomɛl kɛŋɔ yom aa, baa o te ŋwɛnɛ ta ó dɔ o te kɛŋɔ, ba yon ta baala ŋwɛnɛ baa dɔ ba te la.

english_verse: If she doesn't please the man who bought her to be his wife, he must let her be bought back. He cannot sell her to foreigners; this would break the contract he made with her.
translation_verse: Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa yawɔ kɛ o fe ɛ o haah la aa on nyin kpa aa, ó berɔ tɛ o nɛra dɛ́ lɛ o suuɡa. O bɛ on yoɡ tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra dɛkalkɛ o neɡro.

english_verse: If he selects her as a wife for his son, he must treat her as his own daughter.
translation_verse: Dɛ naate lawɔ tɛ o bibaa ɡe aa, a chɛ kɛ ó den kpɔɔ ɛ o bihaah.

english_verse: If the man later marries another woman, he must continue to provide food and clothing for the one he bought and to treat her as a wife.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ baa la berɔ kpɔ hanɛɛte ja o nɛ aa, a chɛ kɛ ó teŋɛ dɛɛ tɛ hanomoa la kondikwa ne yal, o ne wɛɛ chɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: If he fails to do any of these things, she must be given her freedom without paying for it. Murder and Other Violent Crimes The Lord said:
translation_verse: Baa la ta wone ɛ a ɡɛ kombele atoro nɔ dɛɛ tɛ haah la aa, o dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó kaa waa wola suuɡa bɛlbwaa bɔ tɛo. Dɔŋa kpoora Mmarare

english_verse: But if you did not intend to kill someone, and I, the Lord, let it happen anyway, you may run for safety to a place that I have set aside.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o laa saahna, Korowii we-ɛɛlaa yaa, ó chwa kaa bela maa lea cheɡ heya, ásɛ o dɔ o nyu.

english_verse: If you plan in advance to murder someone, there's no escape, not even by holding on to my altar. You will be dragged off and killed.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ nomɛlbwa dɔ o dɔŋ liire dɛ ka kpoo waa, hale o chwao ka marɛ n saraha kon la dɛ́ dɔ o nyu kwaraa naa, hé lawɔ le, ásɛ dɛ ka kpoo.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for kidnapping. If you sell the person you kidnapped, or if you are caught with that person, the penalty is death.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa ɡuɡri o dɔŋ dɛ lawɔ ka yoɡ, kɛɛ dɛ o ta lɔ o nɔn ta ba lawɔ waa, kpoe chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for cursing your father or mother.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa taah o nya kɛɛ o mɛɛ la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.

english_verse: and later has to use a stick when walking outside, you must pay for the loss of time and do what you can to help until the injury is completely healed. That's your only responsibility.
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ ba won ir kpɔ daŋɡbala valɛ le buse naa, ba bɛ naate la waa lɔɔ la deŋne tɛr. Kɛ ó cha weela te la o chɔe la bini ka tel kɛŋɔ waa dɔ bokpeɡa. A chɛ kɛ ó berɛ chao dɛɛ tɛo kwaa waa paŋa o weela ta chɔe bini la ɡe bwa.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for beating to death any of your slaves.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ yombaa kɛɛ yomhaah, dɛ kpɔ daa lɔɔ o sewɛ buɡ ta la chɛ kɛ bá tɛr o deŋne.

english_verse: However, if the slave lives a few days after the beating, you are not to be punished. After all, you have already lost the services of that slave who was your property.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o wono dɔ bokpeɡa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ kɛɛ tɔpera anɛ naa, ate a ta chɛ kɛ ó dɔ deŋnetɛra, dɛkalkɛ o ɡbaɡba suuɡa nee o yawɔ.

english_verse: Suppose a pregnant woman suffers a miscarriage as the result of an injury caused by someone who is fighting. If she isn't badly hurt, the one who injured her must pay whatever fine her husband demands and the judges approve.
translation_verse: A balɔ kɛŋɔ baala banɛ dɛ yo, asɛ bɛl koni ka lɔ tekpoŋri o piɡri lolɛ dɛ waane ta a habɔɔ balaa, naate la chɛ kɛŋɔ haah la jaa yoɡu ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ nyin, ne ɡɛ nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la ɡe aa tɛ ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: But if she is seriously injured, the payment will be life for life,
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ nɛn doe bol aa, he ɡe doo bol. Dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, bá kpo o ɡe.

english_verse: If you hit one of your slaves and cause the loss of an eye, the slave must be set free.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ yomhaah kɛɛ yombaa dɛ lɔ o siwi ta o chɔɡ la, o siwi la nomanta, ó kaa pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: The same law applies if you knock out a slave's tooth—the slave goes free.
translation_verse: Dɛ o yom nyenee o fome aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó kaa.

english_verse: A bull that kills someone with its horns must be killed and its meat destroyed, but the owner of the bull isn't responsible for the death.
translation_verse: Dɛ nabal chuɡe baa kɛɛ haah o sewaa, a chɛ kɛ bá foɡre nao la bwea kpo. A ta chɛ kɛ bá chwe o ol, nao te la ɡe ta chɛ kɛ bá tɛr o deŋne.

english_verse: Suppose you own a bull that has been in the habit of attacking people, but you have refused to keep it fenced in. If that bull kills someone, both you and the bull must be put to death by stoning.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ɡɛɛ nao la ɛɛ chuɡe nɛra asɛ ba ɡel kon te jemɛ, o vɛh o lawa dɛ do leɡ bini o kpo haah kɛɛ baa laa, a chɛ kɛ bá foɡre nao la kpo, dɛ́ kpo o dɔɔ la ɡe ja.

english_verse: pieces of silver for the loss of the slave, and the bull must be killed by stoning.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ a chɛ kɛ nao te la bɔ komɛl dɛ́ charɛ o nyu aa, ɡɛ bwa baa dɛ nyin laanee bá maɡɛ tɛo ó bɔ.

english_verse: This same law applies if the bull gores someone's son or daughter.
translation_verse: Mmara beŋkpoŋ nɔɔ lole dɛ tɛ nao waa chuɡe bihaah kɛɛ bibaa bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Suppose someone's ox or donkey is killed by falling into an open pit that you dug or left uncovered on your property.
translation_verse: Nomɛl pili bɔluŋ, kɛɛ dɛ kwii o kwiu dɛ vɛh o ta tɔe, asɛ nabal kɛɛ keeɡo ka le o bini dɛ sewaa,

english_verse: You must pay for the dead animal, and it becomes yours.
translation_verse: naate la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ kon la kem tɛ o dɔɔ ásɛ o ɛ o kon.

english_verse: If your bull kills someone else's, yours must be sold. Then the money from your bull and the meat from the dead bull must be divided equally between you and the other owner.
translation_verse: Nomɛl nabal chuɡe o dɔŋ kon kpo aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá yoɡ onɔ la o siwi taa lole la, ásɛ dɛ bɔne o suuɡa tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ́ berɛ bɔne onɔ la ɡe waa sewa la ol bini kɛrɛdɛ tɛ dɔŋa.

english_verse: If you refuse to fence in a bull that is known to attack others, you must replace any animal it kills, but the dead animal will belong to you.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ba jemɛ ɡɛ nao la waa kɛŋɔ, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ chuɡri kwaa wubwa asɛ ba bol kon te be o vɛh o teɡa dɛ do leɡ bini naa, a chɛ kɛ kon te la nyin bɛl chiɡ onɔ la waa sewa la naa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ onsewe la.”

english_verse: If you steal an ox and slaughter or sell it, you must replace it with five oxen; if you steal a sheep and slaughter it or sell it, you must replace it with four sheep.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa ŋwɛ nao kɛɛ pee dɛ kpo kɛɛ dɛ yoɡu waa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ nae anue, kɛɛ dɛ bɔ peera anaarɛ chiɡ pee la naa ta.

english_verse: If you allow any of your animals to stray from your property and graze in someone else's field or vineyard, you must repay the damage from the best part of your own harvest of grapes and grain.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ kondɛɛra la dibɔr, dɛ ɡela a ka jo bɛl koo ta kɛɛ daa koo ta, dɛ ka di o bini kwaa la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ o ɡbabir koo kondikwa kɛɛ daa nɔna aa ɛa kɛrɛdɛ la bɔ o dɔŋ la kem.

english_verse: If you carelessly let a fire spread from your property to someone else's, you must pay the owner for any crops or fields destroyed by the fire.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn do nii o koo ta asɛ a fuh ka jo nomɛl koo ta, dɛ fuh mea baa koma bil kɛɛ anɔ la a taa cheɡa kɛɛ dɛ koo la bwa sekwaraa naa, nɛn waa do nii la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ a bwa kem.

english_verse: Suppose a neighbor asks you to keep some silver or other valuables, and they are stolen from your house. If the thief is caught, the thief must repay double.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl kpɔ suuɡapoŋa kɛɛ laala ane tɛ o dɔŋ ŋɔ o cheɡ, asɛ a ba kɛŋɔ ba ŋwɛa asɛ ba lawɛ ŋwɛɛ la aa, ó bɔ a bele anɛ.

english_verse: Suppose a neighbor who is going to be away asks you to keep a donkey or an ox or a sheep or some other animal, and it dies or gets injured or is stolen while no one is looking.
translation_verse: Nomɛl kpɔ keeɡo kɛɛ nao kɛɛ pee dɛ kondɛɛre bɛlbwa tɛ o dɔŋ o nyiŋi o ta dɛɛ tɛo, asɛ a ba kɛŋɔ o sewɔ kɛɛ dɛ bolee ba doo, kɛɛ lawaa nomɛl ba lawɔ bɛlbwa sie aa wola toole bela aa,

english_verse: If you swear with me as your witness that you did not harm the animal, you do not have to replace it. Your word is enough.
translation_verse: ba nɛra banɛ la bwa la Korowii sie, ásɛ naate waa dɛ nyiŋi kon la ta la ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ kon la toole o be. Kon te la chɛ kɛ ó no a mun ɡɛ, ate komɛlbwa toole naate bɔ tɛo kpa.

english_verse: But if the animal was stolen while in your care, you must replace it.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ a berɔ ba kɛŋɔ onee ŋwɛ o dɔŋ la kondɛɛre la aa, a chɛ kɛ ó nyin bɛl chiɡ o naa ta tɛo.

english_verse: If the animal was attacked and killed by a wild animal, and you can show the remains of the dead animal to its owner, you do not have to replace it.
translation_verse: Dɛ kpɔɡ bini ol ɡee chweo waa, ó kpɔ bela waa kaa la ka baɡle á ɛ danseɛ. O bɛ bɛl nyin cheɡ o naa ta kpa.

english_verse: Suppose you borrow an animal from a neighbor, and it gets injured or dies while the neighbor isn't around. Then you must replace it.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn kemɛ o dɔŋ kondɛɛre, asɛ a ka ba kɛŋɔ ba doo bol kɛɛ o sewɛ dɛ kon te la toole bela aa, a chɛ kɛ ó nyin bɛl chiɡ o naa ta tɛ kon te la.

english_verse: But if something happens to the animal while the owner is present, you do not have to replace it. If you had leased the animal, the money you paid the owner will cover any harm done to it. Laws for Everyday Life The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ kon te la siwi ta waa yaa, nɛn waa kemɛ kondɛɛre la ta komɛl bɔe dɔe dɛ́ tɛo kpa. Dɛ hanaa kon te la kpɔ hane aa, suuɡa waa lɛ la dɛ chiɡ kondɛɛre la kem bɔe naa ta. Mmarare aa chɔ le tɛ Israel tena

english_verse: Suppose a young woman has never had sex and isn't engaged. If a man talks her into having sex, he must pay the bride price and marry her.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa neɡre bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ, o nɛra ɡe ta sɛɛh kɛŋɔ o ne baa bɛlbwa so mɔɔ o lawɔ chɔ la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ o bwara wa, ásɛ o den ɛ o haah.

english_verse: But if her father refuses to let her marry the man, the bride price must still be paid.
translation_verse: A balɔ kɛŋɔ haah la mɛɛ ta sɛɛh kɛ o kpɔɔ tɛo waa, a chɛ kɛ baa la bɔ suuɡa aa chɛa dɛ chɔ le tɛ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ nyin suuɡa.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for witchcraft.
translation_verse: Haah bɛlbwa waa dɛɛ ɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for having sex with an animal.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ kondɛɛre chɔ kɛ baa ne haah la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for offering sacrifices to any god except me.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ voɡ bɛlbwa, dɛ ɡel men Korowii la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.

english_verse: Do not mistreat or abuse foreigners who live among you. Remember, you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ berɛ nɛŋhɔɔh hɔhɔrɔwa doe kɛɛ dɛɛ fiiɡu, dɛkalkɛ he ɡe fa ɛ hɔɔhra Ijipt harɛ ta ka.

english_verse: Do not mistreat widows or orphans.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ berɛ luhaahna kɛɛ bilalbii fiiɡa.

english_verse: If you do, they will beg for my help, and I will come to their rescue.
translation_verse: He fiɡ ba asɛ ba wi no men Korowii aa, mɛɛ cha baa.

english_verse: In fact, I will get so angry that I will kill your men and make widows of their wives and orphans of their children.
translation_verse: Ásɛ n baah di he nɛɛ kohona he serewe laa ta. He haahna ɛɛ ɛ luhaahnaa, ásɛ he bii ɡe berɛ bilalbii.

english_verse: Don't charge interest when you lend money to any of my people who are in need.
translation_verse: A hiah n nɛra baa ɛ he bini bane nɔ bɛlbwa he kemɔ suuɡa aa, he bɛ a nee kpɔ dawɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ kemɛ suuɡa yon dɛɛ ɛ la.

english_verse: Before sunset you must return any coat taken as security for a loan,
translation_verse: He lɛ he dɔŋ yal cheɡ awɔba aa, berɛ o kon tɛo mɔɔ wee le harɛ,

english_verse: because that is the only cover the poor have when they sleep at night. I am a merciful God, and when they call out to me, I will come to help them.
translation_verse: o ɡboo ken ɛ yal waa dɔa dɛ́ kpɔ tɔ. A ba ɡɛ naa, bɔkwaa wɛɛ ba dɔe dɛ́ kpɔ tɔ chɔɔ? O wio no men Korowii aa, mɛɛ no o bee, dɛ́ chao dɛkalkɛ n dɔ tedoma dɛ tɛ nɛra.

english_verse: Don't speak evil of me or of the ruler of your people.
translation_verse: He bɛ nɛnhɛlwobol bol yaɡɛ men Korowii kɛɛ dɛ́ taah he harɛ nomoa.

english_verse: Don't fail to give me the offerings of grain and wine that belong to me. Dedicate to me your first-born sons
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he mea ne sen kɛɛ ɔleve noo ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ saŋ aa chɛa ta. Hé lawɛ he bibanloɡla ba tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: and the first-born of your cattle and sheep. Let the animals stay with their mothers for seven days, then on the eighth day give them to me, your God.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ he nae ne peera bwa ta. Hé ɡel a do a nyare be yawanyoa, ásɛ tɔpenuatoro ta la, hé kpɔa ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: You are my chosen people, so don't eat the meat of any of your livestock that was killed by a wild animal. Instead, feed the meat to dogs.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ hé ɛ n nɛra haa do ɡoroŋ. Anomanta, he bɛ ol kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡaa aa kpoo la dɛɛ chwe. Nyootenaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔa tɛ.”

english_verse: Always tell the truth in court, even if everyone else is dishonest and stands in the way of justice.
translation_verse: He bɛ nɛndamanta nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛ́ ɡee ɛ wechɔɡa. He dɛ di waane danseɛ kɔɔto aa, he bɛ nɛndamanta nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛ́ berɛ waa la sie.

english_verse: And don't favor the poor, simply because they are poor.
translation_verse: He bɛ nomɛl nyae waa koh dɛ́ sune o nɛɛ kɔɔto.

english_verse: If you find an ox or a donkey that has wandered off, take it back where it belongs, even if the owner is your enemy.
translation_verse: He na he dɔm nao kɛɛ keeɡo o yeŋe jo dɛɛ kaa laa, hé takapɔ dɛ́ lawɔ ba tɛo.

english_verse: If a donkey is overloaded and falls down, you must do what you can to help, even if it belongs to someone who doesn't like you.
translation_verse: He na he dɔŋ waa haeh keeɡo o chole bone ɛɡɛ o nɛ aa, he bɛ on ɡarɛ ta kaa. He takapɔ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ chao.

english_verse: Make sure that the poor are given equal justice in court.
translation_verse: He bɛ nɛn nyae waa koh dɛ́ pao bolchɔɡe kɔɔto.

english_verse: Don't bring false charges against anyone or sentence an innocent person to death. I won't forgive you if you do.
translation_verse: He bɛ nyosone teŋe dawɛ nɛn nɛ. He bɛ nɛn waa wola waane bini jemɛ, kɛɛ nɛn o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ bolchɔɡe pa dɛ́ kpoo. Maa nomɛlbwa waa di bolchɔɡe la bwaraa kpɔ kɛo.

english_verse: Don't mistreat foreigners. You were foreigners in Egypt, and you know what it is like. Laws for the Sabbath The Lord said:
translation_verse: He bɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra hɔhɔrɔwa dɛɛ ɛ. He ɡbabir jemɛ ɡɛ hɔɔh wa aa doa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ɡɛɛ he faa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra Ijipt harɛ ta. Ona Tɔpere Mmarare

english_verse: Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
translation_verse: Bene anumɛlee chɛ kɛ hé parɛ dɛ́ kpɔ he kooni kondikwa,

english_verse: but let the land rest during the seventh year. The poor are to eat what they want from your fields, vineyards, and olive trees during that year, and when they have all they want from your fields, leave the rest for wild animals.
translation_verse: kɛ bennuanɛ ta te, hé ɡel harɛ la chɔ, he bɛ on parɛ. Anee dɛ́ ɡel nyaara baa lɔ he bini la ɡe dɔ anɔ la aa lee bela la di, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini ola ɡe dɔ a kar dɛ́ di. Hé ɛ ɡɛ tenten he daa kooni nɔna ne ɔleve daa nɔna bwa ta.

english_verse: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.
translation_verse: Tɔpera anumɛlee hé dɔ kɛ he ɛ toma, kɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee ta te, he bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ, ásɛ he nabala ne keeɡore ne nɛndɔɔla baa lol ba he deremi dɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ɡe won dɔ bɔr onɛ.

english_verse: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names. Three Annual Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Hé do sie dɛ́ ɛ wobɛlbwa maa bol he be nɔ. He bɛ voɡare dɛɛ tomɛ. He bɛ ɡel ba no a sɔna kwaraa he nyoo. Benanyoa Tɔpejena atoro ane wa

english_verse: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.
translation_verse: He bɛ komɛlbwa baa kpo ɛ saraha chal kpɔ ja komɛlbwa iisi aa lɔ o ta tɛ mɛ. Ola baa kpoora n tɔpejena ta noorare ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé cheɡa tɔɔ per a ta.

english_verse: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.
translation_verse: Ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa har ta kɛɛ dɛ ɛ hambara he harɛ la ta. Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa mkpajaŋ tentenee.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Hé di Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen la he koo kondikonloɡla ne. Hé di Koo Kondikwaa Nyoa Boara Tɔpejen la, benanyoa la aa ba kaa o jaɡa he yon boa he kooni kondikwaa bwa nyoa ba cheɡ dem la ta.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: Kera atoroo chɛ kɛ baa bɛlbwa ba men Nemenɛ Korowii sie benanyoa bɛlbwa ɡɛ tɔpejena nɔ ta, dɛ́ ba tom mɛ.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: Hé di tɔpejena atoro benanyoa bɛlbwa n sɔn ta.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: Hé di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole A Ta Tɔpejen la. Tɔpera anuanɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ hé di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta ɡɛ maa do heyaa la. Hé di tɔpejen nɔ tɔpera maa lea cheɡ tɛ heyaa ta Abib korobie la ta, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ korobie la taa he le Ijipt harɛ ta. Bɛlbwa bɛ nɔŋɡbala kpɔ ba n sie.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he koo kondikonloɡla ba men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la Dea. He bɛ bombie daa o nya elnee ne. Nyobaɡa ne webaɡla ane wa

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no, n dɛ tomɛ n nyundua torome ó tɔ he sie dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ, dɛ́ ba he ne bela maa kwaara tɛ heya.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no wobɛlbwa waa bol he be. He bɛ lwɛmkpeɡ ɛ, he ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ aa, waa he bwaraa kpɔ kɛ heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee chiɡ n naa ta.

english_verse: If you faithfully obey him, I will be a fierce enemy of your enemies.
translation_verse: Dɛ he cheɡ deŋne o be kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la maa bola bwa naa, mɛɛ hah he dɔmaa, n ne baa jo ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: N nyundua torome ɛɛ tɔ he siee, dɛ́ ba he ne Amɔre ne Hiti, ne Pɛrɛs ne Keenan ne Hivi, dɛ Jebus tena harɛ ta. Mɛɛ kpo ba bwaa harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.
translation_verse: He bɛ ba voɡare dɛɛ tomɛ a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ ba we-ɛɛla taa. Hé paɡre a ne ba bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura la bwa burbur ken.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Dɛ hɛɛ teŋɔ dɛɛ tomɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔɔ yaa, mɛɛ swee heyaa andɛɛɡaa he kondikwa ne he neerare dɛ weela bwa ta.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo ɔmee kohona chole he dɔma nɛ, ásɛ harɛ bɛlbwa ta tena haa ka chem ba bwa wili. Mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma bwa berɛ habɔɔ, dɛ́ chwa kaa.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo jeŋibotoola tɔ he sie, dɛ́ doŋi Hivi ne Keenan dɛ Hiti tena le he ŋwɛnɛre ta.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ɡbo ta laa mɛɛ ba ba doŋa, dɛkalkɛ a ba ɡɛ naa, harɛ la dɛ ba pɛɛ chɔe, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa warɛ he nɛ.

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: Tama tamaa mɛɛ ba ba doŋa le he sie ka tel kɛŋɔ haa ba warɛ kohona, dɛ́ won kpɔ harɛ la.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jwɛh le Mposwɛm la ta ka le Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ka le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ kaa Yufretis Moo la ta. Mɛɛ kpɔ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta bela laanee do he nɔn ta, ásɛ he doŋ ba le he sie.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Hé ne ban, kɛɛ ba voɡa bɛ fɔo bɛlbwa fɔwɛ.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel ba so he harɛ la ta, ásɛ a che ba nɛɛ he ba ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa, dɛkalkɛ ba voɡare toma la ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ baa harɛ heyaa bela ken.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “He ne Arɔn ne Nadab ne Abihu dɛ Israel nomonome fifraanuanɛ la teeh bwe ba n be. Hé che bojaŋ tama dɛɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Mosis aa la nɛra la be dɛ ka bol Korowii waa ne o Mmarare bwa ba be la, ba bwa kpɔ taa beŋkpoŋ sɛh ŋɔ, “Wobɛlbwa Korowii aa bol la, yaa ɛɔ.”

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Mosis chwerɛ komɛlbwa Korowii aa bola. Tɔ aa dɛ per chɔmbibii la, o iro dɛ kwaa saraha kon tɛ Korowii bwe la lɔɡa, dɛ paaɡe bwea fi dɛ anɛ a che tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɛ o tomɛ Israel bonɔɔna ba ka fuh kwaa ɛ saraha, dɛ kpoo nabali ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛo.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Mosis kpɔ kwaa la chale la pera do loɡa bini, asɛ dɛ kpɔ a kar la merɛ saraha kon la ta.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Ate, dɛ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Tɔn la kure baɡle nɛra la. Ba bwa sɛh ŋɔ, “Yáa ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii aa ŋɔa laanee, yaa dɛɛ teŋɛ a taa.”

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Belaa o berɛ kpɔ chal la merɛ nɛra la nɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Chal nɔɔ ɡela fɔo he ne Korowii aa fɔwa dɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta la won che tɛ heya.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis ne Arɔn ne Nadab dɛ Abihu ne Israel nomonome fifraanuanɛ la bwa teeh kaa bwe la doa,

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: dɛ ka na Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la. Harɛ waa cheɡɛ o ta la ɛ bobɛl baa mao bwea ne o ir nyundua, dɛ do ɡereŋ kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡe baa dɛ yerɔ safaaya la, dɛ ɛ burum kɛŋɔ nyundua ken.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ta Israel nomonome la wobɛlbwa ɛɛ. Ba na Korowii dɛ ta so le dɛ di kwaa dɛ nyɔ sen.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Teeh ba bwe nɔ doa, dɛ́ ba soŋni n be bonɔ. Mɛɛ tɛɛ bwepɛle maa chwerɛ me Mmarare haa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta, ásɛ nɛra la ka hweli dɛ́ jemɛ waa maa do ba a ta.”

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis ne Josua waa dɛ chao la kpɔ ba te le kaa Korowii be bwe la doa.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Mosis aa dɛ ba lee kaa la o ŋɔ nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ kpa yaa bonɔ ka tel kɛŋɔ yaa berɛ ba he be. Arɔn ne Hur aa lɔ he be nɔ, hé bini bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, hé kpɔ la ba be.”

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Mosis aa dɛ teeh Sinai Bwejen la, bam baa bɔle o bwa,

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: asɛ Korowii jirima tɔ o bwa. Tɔpera anumɛl dɛ bam la ta bɔle bwe la bwa ɡɛ, asɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee ta la, Korowii bol waa le bam la ta dɛ yerɛ Mosis.

english_verse: blue, purple, and red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: ne jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm ne yadɛɛɡa ampoŋa dɛ booh pona,

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: “Ŋɔ Israel tena la be bɛ́lbwa ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ. Henee chɛ kɛ he lɛ saraha kwaa la ɡɛ bɛlbwa bambile aa lawa kɛ ó kpɔ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Koŋkɛɛla haa lɛ le ba be laanee suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ ayaawa,

english_verse: tanned ram skins; fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: ne pebala tɔne baa doa konswɛɛma, ne mpo nae tɔne dɛ akaasia daa,

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;
translation_verse: ne ɔleve noo baa kpɔ do kandea ta, ne konsɔɔhsoma baa kpɔ koo noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do nɛn sɔfore ta, ne anɔ la baa kpɔ koo daawiile ta dɛ́ fuah,

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Gel ba ɛ Tɛnte Dea waa do ɡoroŋ tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n ba so ba bini.

english_verse: The lamp on the top and those at the end of each of its six branches must be made so as to shine toward the front of the lampstand.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ ɛ kandere anuanɛ dɛ́ kpɔa chɔŋre kandea daa la ta aa chaah bela o sie aa chaɡa.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛ o bini ne o baŋ bwa, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ suuɡaswɛm bar o nyoo.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Ɛ suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡa ken, dɛ́ kpɔ marɛ o nakpale anaarɛ la ta, anɛ do o baŋ bɛl, ásɛ anɛ ɡe do baŋ bɛl.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Kpɔ akaasia kwaa dajaŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Kpɔ daa la su nɔnloɡa aa lɔ Daka la baŋne anɛ la ta bá won kpɔ dɛɛ cheo.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Kerobim la beŋkpoŋ chɔŋɛ o baŋ bɛl, ásɛ bɛl ɡe do baŋ bɛl. Kombeŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛ he kpɔ kwaa Kerobim la ne daka la tɔ la bwa.

english_verse: The creatures must face each other with their wings spread over the chest.
translation_verse: Kerobim la chɛ kɛŋɔ á sie ɡba dɔŋa daka la doa, a kena paɡri kaa nyundua dɛɛ cheme dɔŋa dɛɛ tɔ o tɔ la ta.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Kpɔ bwepɛle anɛ maa kpɔ tɛɛ la do Daka la bini dɛ́ kpɔ o tɔ la tɔ.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: N ne he Danseɛ Daka la doa Kerobim la baah taa mɛɛ ba he chema, dɛ́ kpɔ me Mmarare bwa tɛɛ hé kpɔ tɛ Israel tena. Teebur baa kpɔ paanoo dawɛ o ta Korowii sie

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Ɛ kon o paɡri del aa do kɛŋɔ nɔmpaa del baro, dɛ́ ɛ suuɡaswɛm dawɛ o ɡe ta bar.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Ɛ suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡa anaarɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ marɛ o loŋkoni ta o nakpale la bɔr bela.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Kpɔ akaasia kwaa dajaŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara bá kpɔ dɛɛ che teebur la.

english_verse: with three branches on each of its two sides.
translation_verse: Ɛo ó dɔ kpala anumɛl. Atoro do baŋ bɛl ásɛ atoro ɡe do baŋ bɛl.

english_verse: There are to be three decorative almond blossoms on each branch
translation_verse: Numoli do kɛŋɔ daa baa dɛ yerɔ almɔn fee dɛ ɛ atotoro, dɛ́ do kpale bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: and four on the stem.
translation_verse: Ásɛ anaarɛ ɡe do kandea daa la tenten ta.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Kandea daa la ne o kpala ne o fee la bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ suuɡaswɛm beŋkpoŋ la kwaara.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: O kon baa kpɔ dɛɛ fee ŋwɛn la doŋa ne o loɡbakorɔre bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ á ɛ suuɡaswɛm tenten.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɛa ɡɛ tenten maa baɡle bwejen la doa la.”

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɛnte Dea doonyoa bela la, kpɔ jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe nyarɛ pateesan, dɛ́ ɡel nɛn waa dɔ kwaa sɔeh wejema ɛ kwaa dawɛ o ta, dɛ́ kpɔ saɡɛ o ta.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: A ɡɛ pateesanre fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la bwa chɛ kɛ á ɛ kɛrɛdɛ. A jaŋne ɛ naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue, a paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale anumɛl.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ jisepondɛɛɡe ne jiseburum ne jisekɔl dɛ jiseswɛm sɔh pateesanre fi, dɛ́ ɡel nɛn waa dɔ kwaa sɔeh wejema ɛ Kerobim dawɛ a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa Tɛnte Dea waa ɛ n dobɔr tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Nyarɛ a bini anue pɛ dɔŋa, ásɛ dɛ ɛ anue la ɡɛ tenten.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Kpɔ pateesanre la anue pɛ dɔŋa á ɛ beŋkpoŋ, ásɛ dɛ pɛ anumɛl la kar la ɡe á ɛ beŋkpoŋ. Kpɛwɛ pateesan numɛlte la ó do Tɛnte Dea la doonyoa bela.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Kpɔ pebal tɔne baa doa konswɛɛma tɔ tɛnte la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne bɔlo ja.

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Kpɔ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ waa ɛ bela maa lole dɛ kpɔ he wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ heyaa la tɔ o ta Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ta.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kpɔ akaasia daa ɛ dachiɡri dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa n Tɛnte Dea la.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: dɛ́ ɛ suuɡapoŋa loɡa fifraanaarɛ do a mune. O nakpale anɛ la bɛlbwa dɔ beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Paaɡe dachiɡri anumɛl o wee cholibɔr bela,

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: O loŋkoni anɛ dachiɡri nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa lawɛ o dɔŋ le mun ta, dɛ́ ka su nɔnloɡ beŋkpoŋ ta nyundua. Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ anɛ la bwa.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel dachiɡri la ɛ anuatoro ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa fi dɛ anumɛl, ásɛ suuɡapoŋa loɡa anɛ do daa bɛlbwa mun ta.

english_verse: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Dola haa dawɔ baah ta la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó won le o baŋ bɛl ba kaa baŋ bɛl nyoa ta.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ dachiɡri la bwara, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɛ nɔnloɡa á lawɛ doli la kpoŋe. Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ doli la ɡe.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Gɛ maa chaɡle bwejen la doa laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ he baŋre n Tɛnte Dea la.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Kpɔ teebur la ba cheɡ pateesan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera n Tɛnte Dea la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kandea daa la ɡe cheɡ o baŋ bɛl weekaŋle harɛbɔr.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Kpɔ paateesan la saɡɛ bune la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ o habɔɔ. Pateesan laanee dɛ́ pere Boɡoroŋ la le Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ta.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Ɛ suuɡaswɛm bune aa lawɛ pateesan nɔ kpoŋe, dɛ́ ɛ akaasia dachiɡri anue haa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, ásɛ dɛ ɛ ayaawa loɡa anue haa kpɔ do a mune ta.”

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Kpɔ daa la su nɔnloɡa aa lɔ saraha kon la baŋne anɛ la ta bá kpɔ dɛɛ cheo.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ayaawa ɛ o kwaa bwa, o loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ pa o tɔɔ, ne soofire ne loɡa baa do chal kɛɛ nee a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o ta, ne bune baa kpɔ toh ola dɛ kwaa baa kpɔ dɛɛ buh nii.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Daa chɛ kɛ he kpɔ kwaa saraha kon la, dɛ́ ɡel o bini chɔ bɔɔ ɡɛ tenten maa chaɡle bwejen la doa la. Korowii Tɛnte Dea dembaah wa

translation_verse: Do Israel tena bá kpɔ ɔleve nodɛɛɡa baa harama ba tɛɛ he do numoli aa lɔ kandea daa la ta la ta, ásɛ a won hɔe dɛ bɛ dɛɛ dime bwa.

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: ásɛ dachiɡri la ɛ fifraanɛ, ayaawa loɡa fifraanɛ do a mune ta. Bune aa lawɛ dachiɡri la kpoŋe la bwa chɛ kɛ he kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ɛ a bwara.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Dembaah doonyoa bela la chɛ kɛ ó dɔ pateesan o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale fifraatoro, bá kpɔ jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe sɔɔh. Ásɛ nɛn waa dɔ kwaa nyara wejema ɛa dawɛ a ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔ dachiɡri anaarɛ loɡa anaarɛ do a mune ta.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: N Tɛnte Dea la bini kwaa kar aa jaa ba kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ o bini toma ne kwaa baa kpɔa baŋro, ne anɔ la baa kpɔa baŋre dembaah bela bwa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ ayaawa ɛa. Noo baa kpɔ do kandea daa ta

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: N Dea Cheremibɔr pateesan waa lɔ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la habɔɔ la, Arɔn ne o bibaalaa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá nyiŋi kandere la ta aa hɔ Korowii sie le jɔmɔra ba le chɔɔ bwa. Gɛ waa nɔ chɛ kɛ á ɛ Mmara dɛ́ chɔ le tɛ Israel tena ne ba naanar baa ka ba bwa.”

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Gel bá kpɔ he dɔɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala Nadab ne Abihu ne Eliasa dɛ Itama le Israel tena bini, ásɛ ba ɛ sɔfore dɛɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ baala bwa maa tɛɛ ba kwaa nyara wejema la be ŋɔ, ba nyarɛ laala baa kpɔ do Arɔn baa kpɔ doo sɔfore dii ta, ásɛ o won dɛɛ tom mɛ kɛ sɔfo.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Laala haa nyarɛ laanee, kon waa dawɛ o bambile ta ne batakaarebora, ne batakaarejaŋ ne onɔ la baa sɔɔh ó do mun ta, ne yal baa kpɔ vɔwɛ nyu dɛ kiriso waa kpɔ dɛɛ vɔwɛ chara. Gɛ laala aa do ɡoroŋ nɔɔ baa ba nyara tɛ he dɔɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala, ásɛ ba ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ mɛ kɛ sɔfore.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Gel ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne jiseburum ne jisekɔl, ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe ɛa. Sɔfonomoa batakaarebora efɔd

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: ne suuɡaswɛm tenten jɔɡrɔre anɛ aa ɡaɡre dɔŋa dɛ́ do kɛ ŋwɛn ken, dɛ́ kpɔ lawɛ bwedɛɛɡa cheɡbɔra la ta. Sɔfonomoa kon waa dɛ dawɛ bambile ta

english_verse: and engrave on each of them the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: A bwa ɛ bwea fi dɛ anɛ, beŋkpoŋ che tɛ Jekɔb bibaala la bɛlbwa. Ɛ bɛlbwa sɔn dawɛ ó che tɛ o dea.

english_verse: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.
translation_verse: Ɛ kon waa dawɛ Sɔfonomoa la bambile ta, ó kpɔ dɛɛ jemɛ waa aa wera dɛɛ le Korowii be, nɛn waa dɔ o wejemaa chɛ kɛ ó ɛo. Ɛo kɛŋɔ batakaarebora efɔd la siwi baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe sɔɔh la ken.

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: Naarɛte la ɛ bwe waa ɛ solmen dɛɛ nyɛɡle baa yerɔ kresolet, ne bwelwɛɛ onis dɛ bwelwɛɛ waa dɛ nyɛɡle baa yerɔ jasepa. Cheɡa suuɡaswɛm kwaa la ta á lawa kpoŋe.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jɔɡrɔre la nyoo kar la ɡe lawɛ cheɡbɔra anɛ la ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ ó lawɛ batakaarebora efɔd la vaama ta dɛɛ ba o siebɔr.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛmburumee chɛ kɛŋɔ he kpɔ lawɛ nɔnloɡa aa lɔ kon waa dawɛ o bambile la ta dɛ́ ba nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o batakaarebora efɔd la ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ o bɛ batakaare la ta ba le.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: Batakaarejaŋ waa do ásɛ ombora la ɛɛ dawɛ o ta la, jiseburum ɡbosoroo nee chɛ kɛŋɔ he sɔɔh,

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ pere o baah ta ó ɛ o nyu bɔr. A chɛ kɛŋɔ bá sɔh o nyu bɔr nyoa la bar kɛrɛdɛ o bɛ won kɛɛ.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: He do suuɡaswɛm dorɔŋre aa, dɛ he do konɡuleɡule la bɛl ɡe, ásɛ a do ɡɛ bar o nyoa cheme.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Arɔn aa baa ɛ sɔfore toma men Korowii sie laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do a ɡɛ batakaare nɔ. O ba dɛ ba men Korowii sie Boɡoroŋ bela dɛ berɛ dɛɛ le aa, baa no dorɔŋre la sii, ásɛ Arɔn bɛ ba sewɛ.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten kwaa kon waa do kpɛlɛntɛŋ dɛ́ ɛ dawɛ o ta ŋɔ, kon baa lea cheg tɛ korowii o do goroŋ.

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ŋwɛmburum do o ta dɛ́ kpɔ ka vɔwɛ yal baa kpɔa vɔwɛ o nyu la ta, ásɛ o do ɡbɛrɛ la sie.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ dawɛ Arɔn tile taa ásɛ dɛ Israel tena kpɔ ba saraha kwaa bɛlbwa soo siwi ba tɛ mɛ dɛ ba koni a ta naa, bolchɔɡe la ba dawɛ Arɔn nɛ. Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba o tile ta dawa saŋ bɛlbwa ásɛ n lɛ ba saraha kwaa la.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: Nyarɛ batakaare Arɔn aa doa mun ta la siwi ne kirisopaŋa, dɛ yal tɛ Arɔn bibaala bá kpɔ vɔwɛ ba nyuune, á tɛɛ ba jirima ne duure.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Haa kpɔ laala nɔ do he dɔɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala tonɛ la, hé fuɡe noo do ba nyuune ta dɛ́ kpɔ ba sɔfo toma do ba nɔn ta. Ɛɛ ba bá do ɡoroŋ dɛ́ won dɛɛ ɛ n toma kɛŋɔ sɔfore.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa nyarɛ yapeene baa doa mun ta, le chara ta ba hwie ta dɛɛ tɔ ba mune ta.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Arɔn ne o bibaala chɛ kɛŋɔ báa do laala nɔ saŋ bɛlbwa baa jo n Dea Cheremibɔr bela, kɛɛ dɛ la kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta dɛ́ ka tomɛ Boɡoroŋ bela, dɛ bɛ bolchɔɡe ba di dɛ́ serewe. Gɛ waa nɔɔ chɛ kɛ á chɔ le tɛ Arɔn ne o naanar saŋ bɛlbwa.”

english_verse: ) The Lord said:
translation_verse: Do o bibaala la batakaarejaŋ la dɔŋa,

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Teŋe nabal baŋa ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɔpere bɛlbwa tɔpera anuanɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe he wechɔɡa. Ɛ ɡɛ dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ saraha kon la ta, ásɛ dɛ ɛ ɔleve noo la ane do o ta o do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: kpɔ mea aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ iisi aa wola toole a ta ɛ paanoo, ne anɔ la baa do noo a ta dɛ anɔ la aa do kɛ biskeeti ken mɔɔ dɛ do noo a ta.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Kpɔa do wɛɡrɛ bini dɛ́ lawɛ kondɛɛre la ja dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala la ba n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela dɛ́ sɔ ba ne.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Do Arɔn o sɔfore laala la. Batakaare waa doo mun ta ne batakaarejaŋ, ne batakaarebora efɔd la ne kon waa dawɛ o bambile ta. Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kiriso baa sɔh kwaa do o ta kɛrɛdɛ la vɔwɛ batakaarebora la ta.

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ fuɡe noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do ba sɔfore ta la ane do o nyu ta.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Lawɛ nabale la ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela, ásɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nyu ta.

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: Teŋe o baŋa men Korowii sie n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bɔr bela.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ noni ɛ nao la chal la ane ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe saraha kon la loŋkoni ta la ta, dɛ́ fuɡe a kar ta saraha kon la mun ta.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Nao la te bwa la, fuh o ol ne o tɔn ne o tea bini kwaa bwa bela baa soɡa la dahara. O ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha kon.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Lawɛ pebal la beŋkpoŋ ba, ásɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nyu ta.

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Teŋe o baŋa ásɛ dɛ ɛ o chal la ta saraha kon la baŋne bwa ta.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Mɔne a bini dɛ́ yaɡle o tea bini kwaa ne o nakpale, dɛ́ kpɔa ja o nyu ne anɔ la aa kaa la bwa ta.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ fuh o bwa saraha kon la ta. A ɛ saraha kon baa dɛ fuh o bwa o sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Berɛ kpɔ penɛɛte la ɡe ba, ásɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nyu ta.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Teŋe o baŋa dɛ ɛ o chal la ane leɡe Arɔn ne o bibaala diɡ deŋna nyoo, ne ba diɡ nonibala dɛ ba diɡ nanibala ta. Ásɛ dɛ ɛ chal la ta saraha kon la baŋne la bwa ta.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Berɛ kpɔ chal la aa lɔ saraha kon la ta la ane, ásɛ dɛ fuɡe noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do ba sɔfore ta la ane do Arɔn nyu ne o laala ta, dɛ́ berɛ do ane o bibaala la ɡe nyuune ta, dɛ́ ɛ merɛ ba ɡe laala ta. Gɛɛ dɛ ɡel o ne o bibaala la ne ba laala bwa do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: Kpɔ pee la no ne anɔ la aa lɔ o muŋɡo ta bwa, ne o noyal ne o pwɛ bela waa wera, ne o kporombie anɛ ne noorare aa ja a ta bwa dɛ o nadiɡ hwi.

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Kpɔa do Arɔn ne o bibaala nɔɔra ta, ásɛ ba ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa men Korowii sie.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Berɛ lɛ saraha kwaa la ba be, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ja anɔ la baa fuah la ta, dɛ́ fuah saraha kon la ta. A ɛ saraha baa fuh a bwa a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Haa kpɔ pebal la bambile dɛ kpɔ ɛ we-ɛɛle ba do Arɔn sɔfore toma ta tonɛ la, ɡɔɔro nyundua dɛ́ viiɡu men Korowii sie, ásɛ o berɛ he dibɔr.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: O bibaa bɛlbwa waa ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ ɛ sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó do laala la tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ bá ɛo we-ɛɛla o won jo n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini ka ɛ toma Boɡoroŋ bela.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: Kpɔ pebal la baa kpɔ doo sɔfore toma ta la, dɛ́ daalo bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: N Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa belaa chɛ kɛŋɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala la chwe pee la ol la ne paanoo aa lɔ wɛɡrɛ bini la.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Bá di ɡɛ saraha kwaa baa kpɔa ɛ we-ɛɛla dɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa dɛ lee ba cheɡ ba ɛ sɔfore dɛ do ɡoroŋ la. A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛmpɛɛ bɛlbwa dia, dɛkalkɛ a do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Dɛ ol la kɛɛ paanoo baa kpɔa ɛ we-ɛɛla nɔ ane kao tɔɔ per a ta naa, a ta chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa dia, hé fuah dɛkalkɛ a do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: Hé ɛ wobɛlbwa maa do heyaa nɔ tɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala la, dɛ́ kpɔ tɔpera anuanɛ ɛ we-ɛɛla do ba sɔfore toma ta.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Tɔpera anuanɛɛ he kpɔ laa doŋa kpɔ saraha kon la ta ó do ɡoroŋ. Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ ó won do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ komɛlbwa waa leɡo la ɡe do ɡoroŋ. Tɔpere bɛlbwa sarahare

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Teŋe penɛɛte la ɡe baŋa ɛ saraha wee aa baa jo la, dɛ́ kpɔ mea saraha ne sen saraha dɛ ɔleve noo ja o ta ɡɛ tenten fuh ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ. A ɛ saraha baa fuh a bwa a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr la ne saraha kon la do ɡoroŋ, dɛ́ ɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala ɡe ba do ɡoroŋ dɛ́ ɛ sɔfore dɛ́ɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ do he Israel tena binii, ásɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: Baa jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ, n kpɔ ba le Ijipt harɛ n ne ba so. Menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.”

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: He bɛ a chaa bɛlbwa ɛ tɛ he te. Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ a do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Mix four liters of olive oil with the following costly spices: six kilograms of myrrh, three kilograms of cinnamon, three kilograms of cane, and six kilograms of cassia. Measure these according to the official standards. Then use this sacred mixture
translation_verse: Kpɔ noo nɛn waa dɔ konsɔɔhsoma wejema aa ɛa koo dɛ́ ɛa noo a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices, and the large bowl with its stand.
translation_verse: ne kon baa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta, ne o loɡa bwa dɛ loɡbajen ne kon waa chɔŋɛ o ta la.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ akaasia daa kwaa kon baa dɛɛ fuh daawiile o ta tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.
translation_verse: Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛ o nyundua ne o baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta ne nyeɡlare la ta, dɛ́ ɛ ane ɡe bar o nyoo.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ nɔnloɡa anɛ do o nyoo la lɔɡa bɔr. Anɛ do baŋ bɛl ásɛ anɛ ɡe do baŋ bɛl dɛ́ lawɛ dajaŋa baa kpɔ dɛɛ cheo.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Kwaa akaasia dajaŋa ásɛ dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.

translation_verse: Anee Mosis ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, saŋ bɛlbwaa he yon ŋɔ n tɔ nɛra nɔ sie dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa, kɛ nɛn waa ja n nɛɛ la te he ta ɡelɛ mɛɛ jemɔ. He berɔ ŋɔ he jem mɛ kɛrɛdɛ he sie ɛɛ lɛ n nɛ.

translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ, “N ne hɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee. Mɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa a dɔŋa aa wola harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa chiɡe ka he bwa siwi ta. Nɛra he ne baa soɡa la ɛɛ nao ɡɛ men Korowii, we-ɛɛla maa lɔ he bini dɛɛ ɛ la aa ɔma kohona.

translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, dɛ he sie lɛ n nɛ aa, n dɛ soŋe he ja ya nɛɛ kaa. A lole kɛ ba deŋne kpeɡri, kɛ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ yaa ɛ he nɛra.”

translation_verse: He bɛ buni bɛlbwa kpɔ ɛ voɡ dɛɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta fini nɔ ta. Mɛɛ doŋi Amɔre ne Keenan ne Hiti ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena he siwi taa dɛ́ le harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ he ne nɛra haa dɛ la ka so ba harɛ ta nɔ bɛ fɔo bɛlbwa fɔwɛ, ásɛ a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ bel bɛl, dɛ́ chɔ tɛ heya.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Hé paɡre bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare, ne bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura dɛ voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa la.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ he ne ba bɛ fɔo bɛlbwa fɔwɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba kpɔ ba te tɛ ba voɡa la kɛŋɔ baa dɛ bɔ jwamane ken asɛ dɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛa, baa yerɛ heyaa ásɛ he di ane.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.

translation_verse: Hé kpɔ tɔpera anumɛl ɛ toma, ásɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee hé onɛ o ta. Dɛ kooni para saŋ kɛɛ kwaa koma saŋee yoo, a chɛ kɛ hé onɛ.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Hé di Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen la he meloɡla ne, dɛ́ di Koo Kondikwaa Nyoa Boara Tɔpejen benanyoa la aa baa kaa o jaɡa la.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ doŋi harɛre nɛra baa lɔ he siee, dɛ́ kpɔ ba harɛre ja he kon ta o berɛ do kan. Hé iro dɛɛ ba men Korowii sie kera atoro la aa, nomɛlbwa aa lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ba yo heyaa dɛ́ lɛ he harɛ.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: Hé dɛ ba kon kpoe ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, he bɛ komɛlbwa iisi aa koo o ta kpɔ ja. He bɛ ɡel Galekaa kondikwaa haa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha la ka tɔɔ per a ta.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he koo kondikonloɡla aa wera kohona ba tɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la Dea. He bɛ bombie daa o nya elnee ne.”
