translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kon baa fuh saraha kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la ba cheɡ n Dea Cheremibɔr la sie,

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ loɡbajen la ba cheɡ Cheremibɔr bela ne saraha kon la baah ta, dɛ́ do nee o bini.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Kpɔ dachiɡri ne pateesanre ke dembaah la bar, dɛ́ kpɔ o doonyoa pateesan la ba do o ta.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Kpɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala ba n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela, ásɛ dɛ sɔ ba ne.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Kpɔ laala aa do ɡoroŋ do Arɔn, ásɛ dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ́ leo cheɡ ó do ɡoroŋ tɛ men Korowii, dɛ́ won ɛ sɔfo dɛɛ tom mɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Berɛ kpɔ o bibaala ɡe ba, dɛ́ ba do ba batakaarejaŋa la.

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Mosis ɛ wobɛlbwa ɡɛ tenten Korowii aa doo la.

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba baŋre Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bennɛɛte, korobiloɡle la tɔpere waa tɔ sie la ta.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: O kpɔ bwepɛle anɛ la do Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la bini, dɛ kpɔ daa la su kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡa la baa kpɔ dɛɛ cheo la, dɛ kpɔ o tɔ la tɔ o ta.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Belaa o kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela, dɛ kpɔ pateesan la saɡɛ Daka la sie ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: O kpɔ teebur la ɡe ba cheɡ Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela, weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera pateesan la sie.

english_verse: after which the bread was set on the table.
translation_verse: Dɛ kpɔ paanoo la ɡe ka dawɛ o ta Korowii sie, ɡɛ waa doo ŋɔ o ɛ la.

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ kpɔ kandere la chɔŋɛ o ta Korowii sie ɡɛ waa doo la.

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ fuh daawiile aa sɔɔh aa soma kohona o ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ kpɔ pateesan la saɡɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la doonyoa.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: O kpɔ kon baa fuh saraha kwaa o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ɡe ba cheɡ Korowii Tɛnte Dea waa ɛ o Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela, asɛ dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah ne mea saraha ba tɛ Korowii ɡɛ waa doo la.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: O kpɔ loɡbajen la cheɡ Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la ne saraha kon la baah ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ nee do o bini,

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn ne o bibaala ɛɛ sarame ba nɔɔra ne nakpale o ta.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Saŋ te bɛlbwa baa jo Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela, kɛɛ dɛ la saraha kon la jwɛɛh la, ɡɛɛ ba sarame nɔɔra ne nakpale o ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Belaa bam la ba tɔ Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la bwa, asɛ Korowii jirima su o Tɛnte Dea la bini.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Israel tena vala bwa bini la, bam la baa le Korowii Tɛnte Dea la ta naa, ɡɛɛ ba won vala.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ bam la ta bela leɛ yaa, baa won kaa.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Israel tena vala bwa bini la, Korowii bam la dɛ do Korowii Tɛnte Dea la nyundua baa nao, asɛ jwaana ɡe o do kɛŋɔ nii.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Náate kpɔ nɔn dawɛ saraha kon baa fuuh la nyu ta, ásɛ kon la che o naa ta lɛ o wechɔɡa waa dɛ soŋ mɛ tɛo.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ó teŋe nabal la baŋa n sie bela, ásɛ Arɔn bibaala sɔfore la ɛ chal la merɛ saraha kon waa lɔ n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa la bɔr la ta. Bá ɛ merɛ o baŋre anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Náate swe ol la tɔn ásɛ dɛ kpero.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Ásɛ sɔfore la kpɔ daa do nii aa lɔ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta,

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Naate yaɡle ol la tea bini kwa ne o nakpale la, ásɛ sɔfo la fuh a bwa nii la ta. Anɔɔ ɛ saraha ba yon fuh o bwa o sɔɔh ɛɛ do som men Korowii be.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa saraha kon ɛ kondɛɛre kɛŋɔ pee, kɛɛ booh naa, o ɛ ombal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Naate la teŋe o baŋa saraha kon weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera n sie. Ásɛ Arɔn bibaala baa ɛ sɔfore la ɛ chal la merɛ saraha kon la baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ó yaɡle o tea bini kwa ne o nakpale, ásɛ sɔfo la fuh a bwa nii la ta. Anɔɔ ɛ saraha ba yon fuh o bwa o sɔɔh ɛɛ do som men Korowii be.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: Dɛ saraha kon baa fuuh la ɛ kena te aa, naate kpɔ kulukuku kɛɛ borɔnoma.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Sɔfo la kpɔ kon la kaa saraha kon la ta, dɛ́ tor o nyu ta nii la ta ó fuh, ásɛ dɛ kpoŋo o chal la bwa hwaah ta saraha kon la baŋ bɛl.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Ó laa o cheɡpɔrɔ la kpɔ viɡri saraha kon wee leebɔr bela baa pa tɔɔ dɛɛ ta la.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ lawɛ o kena dɛ́ pere o bini anɛ, dɛ bɛ ɡel o cha ta. Ásɛ sɔfo la fuuh nii la ta. Anɔ nɔɔ ɛ saraha ba yon fuh o bwa o sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.”

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa kpɔ mea saraha dɛɛ ba n tɛɛ yaa, ó nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ́ fuɡe noo do a ta, dɛ́ ɛ daawiile ja a ta.

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Dɛ́ kpɔ ba tɛ Arɔn bibaala sɔfore la. Ásɛ sɔfo la ka fuah saraha kon la ta, á baɡle kɛŋɔ a bwaa n lɛ. Anɔɔ ɛ saraha ba yon fuah a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som men Korowii be.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Men baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha kar la ɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kwa. A do ɡoroŋ kohona dɛ ɛ kwaa baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha dɛ tɛ mɛ la bini ane.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: Dɛ a ɛ mea baa wɔɔra kɛŋɔ paanoo dɛ kpɔa ba ɛ mea saraha aa, a chɛ kɛ he namɛ mea la a kper kɛrɛdɛ iisi aa wola toole a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ noo koo a ta, kɛɛ dɛ biskeeti ɡee yaa, kpɔ noo fɔɡa.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: He mea saraha la, dɛ he chɔŋa nii ta dɛ hala aa, a chɛ kɛ a ɛ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ ba do no iisi aa wola toole a ta.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Kuuɡi a bini, ásɛ dɛ fuɡe noo do a ta. A ɛ mea saraha.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Dɛ he mea saraha la ɛ kwaa haa daala aa, a chɛ kɛ he nama á kper kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ do noo a ta.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Mea saraha baa ɛa ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛre nɔ ta la, hé kpɔ ba men Korowii sie dɛ́ kpɔ ka tɛ sɔfo la, ásɛ o ɡe kpɔ kaa saraha kon la ta.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la ɛɛ kpɔ kwaa la anee le a ta, dɛ́ fuah saraha kon la ta, á baɡle kɛŋɔ n lɛ a bwa. Anɔɔ ɛ saraha ba yon fuah a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som men Korowii be.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Men baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha la kar ɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kwa. A do ɡoroŋ kohona dɛ ɛ kwaa baa kpɔa ɛ saraha dɛ fuh tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Mea saraha nomɛlbwa aa ɛ tɛ mɛ la ta chɛ kɛ iisi do a ta. Bɛ iisi kɛɛ tooh do mea haa kpɔ ba fuh ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ la ta.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won ba a ne kɛŋɔ he yon kpɔ kondikonloɡla baa tɛ mɛ bena bɛlbwa kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la. Kɛ bɛ an fuh o ta kɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be la.

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Do yar mea saraha bwa ta á baɡle he ne Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la fɔo. A chɛ kɛ yar do saraha bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Dɛ he kpɔ meloɡla dɛɛ ba ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, kpɔ an wɔɔra baa peɡra kɛɛ dɛ nama.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Kpɔ noo do a ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma ja a ta. A ɛ mea saraha.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la ɛɛ kpɔ mea baa peɡra ne noo la anee, dɛ́ kpɔ daawiile la bwa ja, dɛ́ fuah saraha kon la ta, á baɡle kɛŋɔ n lɛ a bwa. Anɔɔ ɛ saraha ba yon fuah a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.”

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa kpɔ nao ba, dɛ́ ba ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ mɛ naa, ó lawɛ ombal kɛɛ onnee waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, dɛ́ kpɔ ba n sie.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Naate la waa dɛ ba ba ɛ saraha la kpɔ o nɔn dawɛ nao la nyu ta, dɛ́ teŋe o baŋa n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bɔr bela n sie. Ásɛ Arɔn bibaala sɔfore la ɛ chal la merɛ saraha kon la baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides,
translation_verse: Deŋnesɔɔhna saraha nao la pera haa fuh tɛ mɛ laanee o noyal bwa,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne o kporombie dɛ noorare aa tɔ a ta bwa, ne o pwɛ bela waa wera la.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Ásɛ Arɔn bibaala la fuah ja anɔ la aa lɔ saraha kon la ta dɛɛ fuh la ta. Anɔɔ ɛ saraha ba yon fuah a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som men Korowii be.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl lawɛ pee kɛɛ booh dɛɛ ba ba ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ mɛ naa, ó lawɛ ombal kɛɛ onnee waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Dɛ pebie nee o ba naa, ó kpɔ ba n sie,

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nyu ta, dɛ́ teŋe o baŋa n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bɔr bela. Ásɛ Arɔn bibaala la ɛ chal la merɛ saraha kon la baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne o kporombie anɛ ne noorare aa tɔ a ta, ne o pwɛ bela waa wera, dɛ laa a ne o kporombie la bwa laa kpɔ a pɛ dɔŋa nɛ.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la fuah saraha kon la ta bela kɛŋɔ mea saraha baa fuah dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: Booh ɡee naate lawɛ dɛ ba ɛ saraha aa, o kpɔ ba n sie.

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Naate la kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nyu ta, dɛ́ teŋe o baŋa n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bɔr bela. Ásɛ sɔfore la ɛ o chal la merɛ saraha kon la baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne o kporombie anɛ ne noorare aa tɔ a ta, ne o pwɛ waa wera, dɛ laa o kporombie la bwa laa kpɔ a pɛ dɔŋa nɛ.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la fuah saraha kon la ta bela, kɛŋɔ mea saraha baa fuah dɛɛ tɛ men Korowii a sɔɔh ɛɛ do n som kohona la. Ol la noorare bwa ɛ n kwa, bá fuah.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: A ɛ Mmara dɛ́ chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba bwa. Bobɛlbwa haa lole bwa, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé di ol noo kɛɛ o chal.”

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ o nonii do chal la ta, dɛ́ ɛ ane merɛ pateesan waa lɔ n Tɛnte Dea la sie kera anuanɛ n sie.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ nɔn dawɛ bombal la nyu ta, dɛ́ teŋe o baŋa bela baa kpo kwaa dɛɛ fuah la bɔr n sie. Anɔ nɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ásɛ sɔfo la kpɔ o nonii do chal la ta, dɛ́ ɛ ane ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe kon baa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta la loŋkoni ta. Ásɛ dɛ fuɡe a kabora la ta o mun ta.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: ó ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo waa maa do ba ŋɔ ba bɛ ɛ la bini bɛlbwa ta dɛ o laa saahnaa, waa aa chɛ kɛ o ɛ laanee nɔ.

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɛ Sɔfonomoa ɛa aa, o ɡelɔ nɛra la bwa di bolchɔɡe. A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó lawɛ nabal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ mɛ o wechɔɡa la wa.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Ó lawɛ nabal la ba n sie n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bɔr bela, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nyu ta, dɛ́ teŋe o baŋa n sie.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Sɔfo nomoa la kpɔ nabal la chal ane kaa n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ásɛ sɔfo la ɛ chal la ane ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma o ta la loŋkoni ta dɛ do n sie n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini la. Chal la kar la, ó le dɛ́ ka fuɡa ta o mun ta n doonyoa bela.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: ne nao la kar te bwa chɛ kɛ sɔfo la kpɔ le kaa bela baa soɡa la dahara baa ɛo o do wer dɛ fuɡe tɔɔ kaa ta la. Ásɛ dɛ mar nii dɛ fuuh.

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Dɛ ba berɔ ba na kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa aa, bá bwa pɛ dɛ lawɛ nabal ba n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bɔr bela, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ ba wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Nomonome baa chɔ ba nyoo la kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ nao la nyu ta n sie, ásɛ mɔɔ dɛ teŋe o baŋa bela.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Sɔfonomoa la kpɔ nao la chal la ane kaa n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini,

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ o nonii do chal la ta, dɛ́ ɛ ane ta pateesan waa lɔ bela la sie kera anuanɛ n sie.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la kpɔ chal la ane ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma o ta la loŋkoni la ta n sie, n Dea Cheremibɔr bela. Dɛ́ fuɡe chal la kabora ka ta kon baa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta la mun ta, n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bɔr bela.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ nao la kaa bela baa soɡa la dahara, dɛ́ ka fuuh kɛŋɔ waa fuh loɡla kon la. Anɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha aa kpɔ Israel tena bwa wechɔɡa kɛ ba.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɛ o berɔ ba na kɛŋɔ o ɛ wechɔɡa aa, a chɛ kɛ o lawɛ bombal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ saraha.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ásɛ sɔfo la kpɔ o nonii do chal la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe kon baa dɛ fuh saraha o ta la loŋkoni ta. Ásɛ dɛ fuɡe a kabora ta o mun ta.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ o noo la bwa, ásɛ dɛ fuah saraha kon la ta ɡɛ baa ɛa dɛɛ fuh deŋnesɔɔhna saraha kwaa la. Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ, dɛ́ soŋe naate la wechɔɡa n be, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛo.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: Dɛ dansaa bɛlbwa ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo waa maa do ba ŋɔ ba bɛ ɛ la bini bɛlbwa ta dɛ o laa saahna aa, dɛ o di bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɛ o berɔ ba na kɛ o ɛ wechɔɡa aa, a chɛ kɛ o lawɛ bohnee waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ saraha o wechɔɡa la wa.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ nɔn dawɛ bohnee la nyu ta, dɛ́ teŋe o baŋa bela baa dɛ kpo saraha kwaa dɛɛ fuah la.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Ó laa o noo la bwa kpɔ, ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha kon noo la, ásɛ sɔfo la fuah saraha kon la ta a sɔɔh do som men Korowii be. Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ, dɛ́ soŋe naate wechɔɡa la n be, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛo.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Dɛ pebie ɡee naate dɔ dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ o wechɔɡa saraha aa, ó lawɛ onnee waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nyu ta, dɛ́ teŋe o baŋa bela baa kpo kwaa dɛɛ fuah la bɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ásɛ sɔfo la kpɔ nonii do chal la ta, dɛ́ ɛ ane ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe kon baa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta la loŋkoni ta. Ásɛ dɛ fuɡe a kabora la ta o mun ta.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ó laa o noo la bwa kpɔ, ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha kon noo la, ásɛ sɔfo la kpɔ ja kwaa baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha dɛ́ fuah tɛ mɛ la ta. Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ, dɛ́ soŋe naate wechɔɡa waa ɛa n be ásɛ n kpɔ kɛo.”

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa leɡe doŋa aa dɛ le nɛn bwara ta, komɛlbwa aa ɡela doŋa do naate nɛɛ dɛ o ta nae, a habɔɔ dɛ berɛ ba na naa, dɛ o di bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Kɛɛ nomɛlbwa piɡro ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɛ waanee, wedɛɛɡa kɛɛ wechɔɡa, kɛɛ anɔ la bɛlbwa waa piɡra ŋwɛɛ dɛ berɛ ba lii la, dɛ o di bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ waa nɔ bini bɛlbwa bolchɔɡe la, ó bol ɡɛ wechɔɡa la nɛra baah ta,

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: dɛ́ lawɛ pelor kɛɛ bohlor le o kondɛɛra bini ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ sɔfo la kpɔ soŋe naate wechɔɡa n be, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛo.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Ó kpɔa ba tɛ sɔfo la, ásɛ o tɔ sie kpɔ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kon la ɛ mɔɔ. Ó menɛ o baŋa dɛ bɛ o nyu la tor le,

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ kpɔ chal la ane ɛ saraha kon la keŋkeŋ. Ásɛ dɛ fuɡe chal la kabora la ta saraha kon la mun ta. Anɔɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Dɛ waa won dɔ kulukuku bii anɛ kɛɛ borɔnoma bii anɛ la aa, ó kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ɛ kuruwa del ba ɛ o wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha. O bɛ noo kɛɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma ane bɛlbwa do a ta, dɛkalkɛ a ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ ba tɛ sɔfo la ásɛ o ɛ men la nɔn del á baɡle kɛŋɔ n lɛ a bwa. Ásɛ dɛ fuah saraha kon la ta ja saraha kwaa baa kpɔa ba tɛ mɛ la ta. Anɔɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ bini bɛlbwa naate aa ɛa la, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛo. Men la kar ɛ sɔfo la kwa ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ mea saraha la.” Bolchɔɡe dii saraha wa

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: “Dɛ nomɛlbwa ɛ wechɔɡa o ta kwaa a fe aa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ ɡɛ aa chɛa dɛ o laa saahna aa, ó lawɛ pebal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ o wechɔɡa kem. O yoɡ chɛ kɛ ó do ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la aa doa. O ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Ásɛ sɔfo la kpɔ o yapepoŋ waa doo mun ta ne o batakaarejaŋ ompoŋ do, dɛ́ laa tɔɔ la pa le saraha kon la bini bil o keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: Kɛɛ dɛ komɛl ɡe nyoɡrɔ o kpaah o ta kasinteŋ dii, kɛɛ dɛ ŋwɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ waane ta, kɛɛ dɛ wechɔɡa aa do kɛŋɔ anɔ bini bɛlbwaa yoo,

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: “Awola baa fuɡe noo do Arɔn nyu ta dɛ ɛo Sɔfonomoa la, o ne o bibaala kpɔ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ ba tɛ mɛ. Men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ɛ kuruwa del ba ɛ mea saraha tɛ mɛ, ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛa tɔperee te bwa la. Bá kpɔ a pera ɛ chɔɔbɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ a kar ɡe ɛ jɔmɔra.

english_verse: In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong. Daily Sacrifices (Exodus
translation_verse: Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe a ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ bɛlbwa naate aa ɛa dɛ di bolchɔɡe n be la ásɛ n kpɔ kɛo.” Saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah wa

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa waa le sɔfore dea la dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ o di ane. A do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Dɛ vii nee ba daa ol la aa, bá paɡro. Dɛ buni kon ɡee yaa, bá kwiu kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ kpɔ nee yaɡlo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: “Do Arɔn ne o bibaala kɛŋɔ ŋwɛnɛre aa chɔ le tɛ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah laanee nɔ. A chɛ kɛ kwaa la dawɛ kafola waa lɔ saraha kon la ta awola la bwa tɔɔ ba per, dɛ́ ɡel nii la ɛɛ hɔ dɛ bɛ dime bwa.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ ka laa laala waa doa la foo bil dɛ́ kpɔ anfala do, ásɛ dɛ ba kpɔ tɔɔ la le ka ta bela baa soɡa la dahara bela baa ɛo o do wer.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ba ɡel nii la ɛɛ hɔ saraha kon la ta dɛ bɛ dime bwa. Chɔɔ bɛlbwa la, a chɛ kɛ sɔfo la pa daa do nii la ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah la dawɛ a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha noorare la ɡe ja a ta fuh.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nii la chɛ kɛ aa hɔ saraha kon la ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ bɛ dime bwa.” Mea saraha wa

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛre aa chɔ le tɛ mea saraha la ɡee nɔ. Arɔn bibaala la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ ba n sie saraha kon la sie ba tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la bɛl ɛ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo ja a ta nɔndel, dɛ́ kpɔ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dawɛ mea saraha kwaa la bwa ta, dɛ́ fuah saraha kon la ta, á baɡle kɛŋɔ a bwa ɛ n kwa a sɔɔh ɛɛ do men Korowii som.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Anee n kpɔ tɛ sɔfore kɛŋɔ ba dibɔr dɛ le saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la ta. A do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ne bolchɔɡe dii saraha ken.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Anɔ ɛ waa dɛ chɔ tɛ Arɔn bibaala ne o naanar bibaala baa ka ba saŋ bɛlbwa. Banee dɔ dibɔr saraha kwaa baa kpɔ ba fuah la ta. Nɛmpɛɛ kɛɛ komɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te leɡa la, dɛ o dɔ wa.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ,
