translation_verse: Bá kpɔ noo koo a ta ásɛ dɛ hala, dɛ́ mɔne a bini dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ mea saraha a sɔɔh aa soma kohona dɛɛ lɛ men Korowii sie.

english_verse: Each of Aaron's descendants who is ordained as a priest must perform this ceremony and make sure that the bread is completely burned on the altar. None of it may be eaten! Sacrifices for Sin (Leviticus
translation_verse: Mea saraha bɛlbwa sɔfo aa ɛ tɛ mɛ la ta dii doe, fuih chɛ kɛ ba fuh a bwa.” Wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha wa

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: “Ŋɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala be ŋɔ, ŋwɛnɛre aa chɔ le tɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha laanee nɔ. Wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kon la chɛ kɛ ba teŋe o baŋa n sie, bela baa kpo kwaa dɛɛ fuah la. O ɛ saraha waa do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Sɔfo waa kpɔ saraha kon tɛ Korowii la, onee dɛ́ diu. A chɛ kɛ o diu bela waa do ɡoroŋ n Dea Cheremibɔr la dembaah.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Nɛmpɛɛ kɛɛ komɛlbwa leɡe ol la aa, o dɔ wa. O chal ɡe ta yal kon ta naa, naate chɛ kɛ o chɛɡɔ bela do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Kɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha komɛlbwa baa kpɔ o chal jo n Dea Cheremibɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe wechɔɡa n be Boɡoroŋ bela la te ta chɛ kɛ ba dia. Fuih chɛ kɛ ba fuah.”

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la fuh noorare la saraha kon la ta ɡɛ baa fuh saraha kwaa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la. A ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Naate la kpɔ kwaa la bɛlbwa bini beŋkpoŋ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ ba tɛ men Korowii la ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ. Sɔfo la waa kpɔ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha chal merɛ laanee dɔa.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Dɛ ol la leɡe komɛlbwa waa kah doŋa aa, he bɛ di. A chɛ kɛ ba fuuh. Ol waa wola wera ne dii la, nomɛlbwa waa wola doŋa kaeh la te won dii.

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛre aa chɔ le tɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha ɡee nɔ. A do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ba teŋe kon la baŋa bela baa dɛ teŋe saraha kwaa baŋa dɛɛ fuah la, ásɛ dɛ ɛ chal la ane merɛ saraha kon la baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: O noorare la bwa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ tɛ mɛ. O muŋɡo noo la ne o noyal waa lɔ o tea bini bwa,

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Baa te bɛlbwa waa le sɔfore dea la te won a dii. Kɛ bɔr waa do ɡoroŋee chɛ a dii, a do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: Webeŋkpoŋii lɔ bolchɔɡe dii ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ta. Sɔfo waa kpɔ a ɡɛ kwaa la ka soŋe naate la wechɔɡa n be laanee dɔ a kar la.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Kondɛɛre bɛlbwa sɔfo la aa kpɔ fuh ɛ saraha tɛ nomɛl la, o tɔn la ɛ sɔfo la kon.

english_verse: just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me.
translation_verse: Mea saraha bɛlbwa baa wɔɔra kɛɛ dɛ daala, dɛ hala ɡee ba hala aa, a ɛ sɔfo la waa kpɔ ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ la kwa.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Asɛ mea saraha te bɛlbwa aa ɛ men baa kpɔ noo koo a ta, kɛɛ dɛ noo toole a ta noo, a ɛ Arɔn bibaala baa ɛ sɔfore la bwa kwa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá bwa bɔna kɛrɛdɛ. Deŋnesɔɔhna saraha wa

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛre aa chɔ le tɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha aa chɛ kɛ ba kpɔ tɛ mɛ laanee nɔ.

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Dɛ jam sarahaa yaa, naate kpɔ men baa kpɔ noo koo a ta iisi aa wola toole a ta dɛ́ wɔɔra. Dɛ biskeeti ɡee yaa, bɛ iisi a ta do dɛ́ kpɔ noo fɔɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta, dɛ́ charama kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ kpɔ a bwa ba jam saraha kon la ta.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Deŋnesɔɔhna saraha ol la ta chɛ kɛ tɔɔ per o ta, bá diu awola tenten baa kpoo la.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Kɛɛ dɛ saraha la ɛ nyobaɡa saraha kɛɛ o ɡbabir bambile ta saraha aa, bá dia awola tenten. Dɛ ane kao tɔɔ per a ta naa, ba won a dii.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ saraha ol waa di tɔpera atoro nɔ la, maa o saraha waa baa ɛ la lɛɛ ba. Dɛ aa were dɛɛ su men Korowii siwi kpa. N kia. Waa naate aa koh a waa ba ɛ saraha la berɔ dawɛ o nɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ ol nɔ la ɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛraa.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa berɔ leɡe doŋa kon bɛlbwa, dɛ nɛwɛnyini be pera doŋa bɛlbwaa kɛɛ ola aa wola were ne dii kɛɛ anɔ la baa kia dɛ ba di n deŋnesɔɔhna saraha ol la bɛl la, ba bɛ on kure ja o nɛra nɛɛ kpa.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He bɛ nae, ne peera kɛɛ boohna noorare dɛɛ di.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Ol bɛlbwa waa sewa ta baŋa kɛɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡe aa kpoo la, baa won kpɔ o noo la ɛ wepɛɛ ane, kɛ he bɛ di.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa di ol baa kpɔ ba ɛ saraha dɛ fuh tɛ mɛ noo la, bá pero le o nɛra bini.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Bobɛlbwa haa ka so bwa, he bɛ jumbie kɛɛ ol bɛlbwa chal di.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa di chal la chɛ kɛ bá pero le o nɛra bini.”

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Naate ɡbaɡba kpɔ kon la noo ne o bambile ba tɛ mɛ. Ó kpɔ ba che saraha kon la sie, dɛ́ ɡɔɔ o bambile la dɛ́ viiɡu nyundua n sie.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la fuh noo la saraha kon la ta, kɛ o bambile la te, Arɔn ne o bibaala konee.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Sɔfo waa kpɔ chal la ne noo la ɛ saraha laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ o dɔ o diɡ hwii la.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Deŋnesɔɔhna saraha Israel tena aa ɛ bwa la, n le o bambile maa ŋɔa baa ɡɔɔro nyundua dɛ viiɡu n sie, ne o hwii la cheɡ á ɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala dibɔr saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la Israel tena saraha kwaa ta.”

english_verse: These are the ceremonies for sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessing or his forgiveness, as well as the ceremonies for those sacrifices that demand a payment and for the sacrifices that are offered when priests are ordained.
translation_verse: Waa aa chɔ le tɛ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah, ne mea saraha ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ne bolchɔɡe dii saraha, ne nɛn sɔfore ta doe saraha, dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha laanee la.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Sinai Bwejen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta belaa Korowii kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ tɛ Mosis awola tenten waa do Israel tena ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba saraha kwaa baa tɛo la.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ kpɔ pee la bambile waa ɛ o dibɔr la, dɛ ɡɔɔro nyundua dɛ viiɡu Korowii sie ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala ne ba sɔfo batakaani, ne noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do ba sɔfore ta, ne nabal baa kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ne pebala anɛ dɛ paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta wɛɡrɛ la ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa,

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ yerɛ Israel tena la bwa cheme bela.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together,
translation_verse: Mosis ɛ ɡɛ bwa Korowii aa doo la, asɛ nɛra la bwa ba cheme Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela.

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa maa dɛ ba ɛɛ bonɔ taraken nɔɔ Korowii do mɛ ŋɔ n ɛ.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis lawɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala ba sie bela dɛ sɔ ba ne, dɛ laa ba doŋa bwa kpɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: Dɛ kpɔ batakaare baa dɛ doo mun ta ne onjaŋ la do Arɔn, dɛ kpɔ o kiriso vɔwɛ o chara. Dɛ berɛ kpɔ batakaarebora efɔd la doo, dɛ lawɛ kon baa nyarɔ kwaa do o ta kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ do batakaarebora efɔd la nyoo la vɔwɛ Arɔn chara a che kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: O berɔ kpɔ kon baa dɛ dawɔ bambile ta la do Arɔn, asɛ dɛ kpɔ Urim ne Tumim la do o bini.

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ kpɔ ɡbɛrɛjen la pi Arɔn, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kon waa do pɛmpɛŋ dɛ do ɡoroŋ la vɔwɛ pɛl ɡbɛrɛ la sie, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Name Mosis kpɔ noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do ba sɔfore ta la, dɛ ɛ merɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la ne o koŋkwaa bwa ta a do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: O merɛ noo la kera anuanɛ saraha kon la ne o koŋkwaa bwa ta, loɡa ne loɡbajen ne kon waa dɛ chɔŋɛ o ta. O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ lea cheɡ a bwa do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: O berɔ fuɡe noo la ane do Arɔn nyu ta, dɛ leo cheɡ o do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ lawɛ Arɔn bibaala la ba che o sie, dɛ do ba batakaani Arɔn aa dɛ doo mun ta la dɔŋa, dɛ kpɔ kirisore vɔwɛ ba chara dɛ kpɔ yale vɔwɛ ba nyuune ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Mosis lawɛ nabal baa kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha la ba, asɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kpɔ ba nɔɔra dawɛ o nyu ta.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis teŋe o baŋa dɛ kpɔ nonii ɛ o chal la ane merɛ kwaa aa paaɡe saraha kon la loŋkoni ta, dɛ leo cheɡ o do ɡoroŋ. Asɛ dɛ berɛ fuɡe chal la kar do saraha kon la mun ta. O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ laa doŋa kpɔ saraha kon la ta o do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ kpɔ o noyal bwa ne o pwɛ bela waa wera, ne o kporombie anɛ la dɛ a noorare bwa, dɛ fuah saraha kon la ta.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Nao la kar te bwa la, o fuh o ol bwa ne o tɔn ne o tea bini kwaa bwa bela baa soɡa la dahara, ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ kpɔ pebal baa kpɔ ɛ saraha dɛ fuuh la ba, asɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kpɔ ba nɔɔra dawɛ o nyu ta.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis teŋe o baŋa dɛ ɛ o chal merɛ saraha kon la baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: O yaɡle o tea bini kwaa ne o nakpale, dɛ fuh ane ol la bwa saraha kon la ta, dɛ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuh o bwa o sɔɔh ɛɛ do som Korowii be ɡɛ waa do Mosis la.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis berɛ kpɔ penɛɛte baa kpɔa dɛɛ do nɛn sɔfore ta la ɡe ba, asɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nyu ta.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Mosis teŋe pee la baŋa asɛ dɛ kpɔ chal la ane ɛ Arɔn diɡ deŋne nyoa, ne o diɡ nonibal dɛ o diɡ nanibal ta.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: O berɔ ɡel Arɔn bibaala la ba che o sie, o kpɔ chal la ane ɛ ba diɡ deŋna nyoo ne ba diɡ nonibala ne ba diɡ nanibala ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ chal la kabora merɛ saraha kon la baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: O kpɔ o no, ne anɔ la aa lɔ o muŋɡo ta bwa ne o noyal ne o pwɛ bela waa wera, ne o kporombie anɛ ne a noorare aa lɔ a ta dɛ o nadiɡ hwi.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ kpɔ paanoo beŋkpoŋ le wɛɡrɛ baa do paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe dɛ che Korowii sie la bini, ne paanoo baa do noo a ta mɔɔ dɛ wɔɔra ne biskeeti, dɛ kpɔa dawɛ noorare bɔra la ne o diɡ hwii la ta.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: O kpɔa do Arɔn ne o bibaala nɔɔra ta, asɛ ba ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa Korowii sie.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ lɛ saraha kwaa la ba be, dɛ kpɔa dawɛ anɔ la ta dɛ fuh a bwa saraha kon la ta, a ɛ saraha baa ɛa dɛɛ do nɛn sɔfore ta a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som Korowii be.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɛ o kpɔ noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do ba sɔfore ta, ne chal la ane le saraha kon la ta dɛ ɛ merɛ Arɔn laala ta, dɛ o bibaala la ɡe kwaa ta. O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ le Arɔn ne o laala ne o bibaala la ɡe ne ba laala cheɡ ba do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Mosis ŋɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala be ŋɔ, “Hé daa ol la Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa, dɛ́ kpɔ paanoo aa lɔ wɛɡrɛ bini ba kpɔ dɛɛ do heyaa sɔfore ta la ane ja, dɛ́ dia bela ɡɛ maa do heyaa ŋɔ he dia la.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Anɔ yaa ɛa fini nɔ, Korowiirii do yaa ŋɔ ya kpɔ soŋe he wechɔɡa.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Hé soŋni Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa tɔpera anuanɛ chɔɔ ne jwaana, ásɛ dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera o be. He vɛh ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ ŋɔ n bol he be la aa, sewaa hɛɛ ba sewa.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Arɔn ne o bibaala ɡe ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ do ba la.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Tɔpenuatoro wee baa do ba sɔfore toma ta tonɛ la, Mosis yerɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala ne Israel nomonome bwa cheme.

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: Mosis ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ nabale ne pebal a bini bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii ba Korowii sie. Ásɛ nao la ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kon, ásɛ pee la ɡe hé kpɔ ɛ saraha baa fuuh.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Ásɛ he ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ bá nyin bombal ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ne nabale waa di benanyoa ne pee waa di benanyoa, a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii la ba ɛ saraha baa fuah,

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: ne nabal dɛ pebal ba ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ Korowii. Bá kpɔ noo koo mea saraha ta dɛ́ kpɔa ja ba tɛ Korowii. Hé ɛ ɡɛ dɛkalkɛ fini Korowii dɛ́ ba he be.”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ komɛlbwa Mosis aa do ba la bwa ba Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa, asɛ nɛra la bwa suuh tel dɛ ba che Korowii sie.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Anee Mosis ŋɔ, “Anɔ bwaa Korowii do heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ ɛ á che a ta he won na o jirima.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: O berɔ ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kwa, ne saraha kwaa haa fuah la ba saraha kon la ta ba soŋe he ne nɛra la bwa wechɔɡa. Kpɔ nɛra la saraha kwaa la ɡe ba soŋe ba wechɔɡa tɛɛ ba ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Arɔn ba saraha kon la ta dɛ ba teŋe nabale la baŋa ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ kpɔ soŋe o wechɔɡa.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Asɛ o bibaala kpɔ chal la ba tɛo, o kpɔ nonii do a ta dɛ ɛ ane ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe saraha kon la loŋkoni ta la ta. Dɛ fuɡe chal la kabora ta saraha kon la mun ta.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: O fuh kon la noorare ne o kporombie dɛ o pwɛ bela waa wera la saraha kon la ta ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Kɛ o ol la kar ne o tɔn la te, ó le ane bela baa soɡa la dahara dɛ ka fuah.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Asɛ o teŋe o ɡbabir kon baa fuuh ɛ saraha la baŋa. O bibaala kpɔ chal la tɛo o kpɔa merɛ saraha kon baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Ba kper ol la dɛ kpɔ o nyu la ja dɛɛ tɛo beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, asɛ o fuh a bwa saraha kon la ta.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: O yaɡle o tea bini kwaa bwa ne o nakpale, asɛ dɛ kpɔa ja dawɛ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah, a do saraha kon la ta la.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Belaa Arɔn kpɔ saraha aa ɛ nɛra la ɡe kwaa ba. O lawɛ booh waa ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kon la, dɛ teŋe o baŋa ɛ saraha ɡɛ waa ɛ loɡla kon la.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: O kpɔ saraha kon baa fuuh la ɡe ba, dɛ ba ɛo ɡɛ aa chɔ le kɛ baa ɛa la.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: O berɔ kpɔ mea saraha la ɡe ba, dɛ ɛ nɔndel dɛ pɛ fuah kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta, ane saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah chɔɔ bɛlbwa la bwa.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: O teŋe nabal la ne pebal la baŋa dɛ kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ nɛra la. O bibaala ɛ a chale la ba tɛo, asɛ o ɛ merɛ saraha kon la baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Arɔn kpɔ nao la ne pee la noorare, ne o muŋɡo noo ne o noyal, ne o kporombie dɛ o pwɛ bela waa wera la,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Arɔn berɔ kpɔ ola la bambili ne a nadiɡ hwie la, dɛ ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa Korowii sie ɡɛ Mosis aa do ba la.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Asɛ Arɔn ɡɔɔ o nɔɔra dɛ soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba. Waa ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ne saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha la tonɛ la, asɛ o tu ba harɛ.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis ne Arɔn jo Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la bini. Baa bera le buse la, ba soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ nɛra la, asɛ Korowii jirima chaah nɛra la bwa nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ɡel nii le dɛ ba fuh saraha kwaa la ne a noorare la bwa nyaam ken saraha kon la ta. Nɛra la bwa aa naa la, ba kpɔ silɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛ ɡuŋi dɛ kpɔ sie piiɡi harɛ.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Arɔn bibaala Nadab ne Abihu kpɔ ba ɡbaɡba kwaa baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma a bini ba buh nii, dɛ fuah tɛ Korowii dɛ jo Korowii kii nɛ kɛŋɔ baa wola an aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ la.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ nii le buɡ la ta, o sie bela dɛ ba fuuh ba, ba bwa serewe.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis ŋɔ Arɔn be kɛŋɔ anɔ waa Korowii fa bol ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa dɛ ba n sie bwa la mɛɛ ɡeloo ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ. Baa dɛɛ duu mɛ nɛra la bwa siwi taa.” Asɛ Arɔn hel.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Belaa Mosis yerɛ baala banɛ bane baa dɛ yer ba Mesael ne Ɛlsafan. Arɔn mɛɛ bie Usiel biirii ban. O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ba bonɔ dɛ́ ba che he nimanar le Korowii Dea sie bonɔ, dɛ́ kaa bane bela yaa soɡa nɔ dahara ka ta.”

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Belaa o ŋɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala Eliasa ne Itama be ŋɔ, “He bɛ he batakaani kɛɛ á baɡle kɛŋɔ he dɛ ɛ lwe. Hé lee he nyuune. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, hɛɛ serewoo ásɛ Korowii baah di nɛra nɔ bwa nɛ. Kɛ he lolanar ne Israel tena te bwa dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ lwe, nii Korowii aa ɡela a ba kpoo ɡɛ nɛra nɔ wa.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: He bɛ Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela le kaa bobɛlbwa, ásɛ dɛ ba serewe. Dɛkalkɛ Korowii noo aa do ɡoroŋ ba fuɡe do he nyuune ta dɛ do heyaa sɔfore ta la lɔ he nɛ.” Anomanta, ba ɛ ɡɛ Mosis aa bola la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “He ne he bibaala nɔ bɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé nyɔ seŋkpeɡa dɛ́ kpɔ ba n sie n Dea Cheremibɔr nɔ bini. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, serewaa hɛɛ ba serewa. Gɛ waa nɔ chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba saŋ bɛlbwa bwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé pere kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ le anɔ la aa wola ɡoroŋ doe ta, ne kwaa doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta le anɔ la doŋa aa lɔ o ta,

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ chaɡle Israel tena mmarare maa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba la bwa ta.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis ŋɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala Eliasa ne Itama baa kaa la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ mea saraha baa fuh ane tɛ Korowii la kar ɛ kondikwa, dɛ bɛ iisi a ta do ásɛ dɛ dia saraha kon la keŋkeŋ, dɛkalkɛ a do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Bela waa do ɡoroŋee chɛ kɛ hé dia, dɛkalkɛ anee ɛ he ne he bibaala bɔr haa dɔa dɛɛ le saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta. Gɛɛ Korowii do mɛ ŋɔ ń ŋɔ he be.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Bá kpɔ o hwii ne o bambile la ja a noorare bɔra baa fuah la ta, dɛ́ ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa Korowii sie, anee dɛ́ ɛ he ne he bibaala dibɔra saŋ bɛlbwa ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Mosis pɛɛ booh baa kpɔa ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha la wa, asɛ dɛ no kɛŋɔ ba fuuh. Belaa o baah di Arɔn bibaala Eliasa ne Itama baa kaa la nɛ dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Ɛrɛɛ he ta wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kon la ka dii Korowii Dea nɔɔ? O do ɡoroŋ kohona ba kpɔ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ soŋe nɛra la wechɔɡa Korowii sie ó kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Haa wola dɔe kpɔ o chal la ba jo Korowii Dea Boɡoroŋ la ta nɔ, a chɛ kɛ he fee bá dia bela ɡɛ maa do heyaa la.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Asɛ Arɔn chaŋe Mosis ŋɔ, “Fini baa baa ɛ ba wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ne saraha baa fuah tɛ Korowii asɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ puu mɛ nɔ, dɛ n di wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kwaa nɔ ane fini naa, a fe ɛɛ do Korowii somee kenɛ?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Mosis aa no ɡɛ la, o baah sɔɔhnɔ.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: Ola a nafikoko aa pera, a di kwa dɛ berɛ won uɡa dɛ dia la, anee wera ne dii.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: bá ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Ola aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé di laanee nɔ.

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Ate habɔɔ, koŋɡaahla aa dɔ naa anaarɛ dɛ dawɛ la te bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ hé kia.

english_verse: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa kpɔ bɛl lale la, a chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala. Dɛ naate kah doŋa ɡe ka tel jɔmɔra. Aa were tɛ heya.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: ne ɡer ne taŋɡar ne deabie, ne sɛɡrɛbɛdom dɛ karaŋɡboŋa.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Anee ɛ ola aa dɛ huuh kɛɛ dɛɛ tuuɡi tea ta aa wola were tɛ heyaa ne dii. Nomɛlbwa bɛl aa sewɛ o ka leɡo la, kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: A bini bɛl le vii bini naa, komɛlbwa aa lɔ vii la bini la kah doŋa. A chɛ kɛ hé paɡre vii la ɡe.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Kondikwaa bɛlbwa baa dia a ɡɛ vii nɔ bini nee bɛlbwa ane aa leɡa la, dɛ a kah doŋa. Asɛ komɛlbwa aa ɛ nee kwaa dɛɛ jo nyoa la ɡe kah doŋa.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa sese o ol aa leɡo la kah doŋa. Dɛ kon baa dɛ mar nii o bini kɛɛ vii baa dɛ daa o ne kondikwa kwaraa yoo, a chɛ kɛ bá paɡre a bwa. A ɛ kwaa doŋa aa lɔ a ta dɛ tɛ heya.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Dɛ nee nyuune ta kɛɛ kɔlɔŋ bini nee yaa, a ɡbo wer. Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa leɡe kon la lale la, o kah doŋa.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Dɛ kon la lale leɡe kondwee aa, dɛ a ta wer, doŋa bɛlbwa toole a ta.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ba kpɔ kondwee la senɛ nee ta, asɛ kon la lale la bɛl le a ta naa, dɛ aa were tɛ heyaa kpa.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɛ ol waa wera kɛ he diu la ɡee sewa aa, nomɛlbwa waa leɡe o lale la kah doŋa dɛ ka tel jɔmɔra.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ konlale la ol la, a chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala. Naate kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra. Asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa ka kpɔ o lale la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala, o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra ɡe.

english_verse: Don't eat any of those disgusting little creatures that crawl or walk close to the ground.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa dɛ huuh kɛɛ dɛɛ tuuɡi tea ta kɛɛ dɛ dɔ nakpale anaarɛ kɛɛ nakpale aa wara la bwa, hé kia.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bɛlbwa di, dɛ́ ba kah doŋa. He bɛ a nɛɛ che kɛɛ dɛ koh a wa, dɛ́ ba kah doŋa.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta hé ba ɛ n nɛra, anomanta, hé do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ maa do ɡoroŋ la.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: Hé pere kwaa aa wera ne dii le anɔ la aa wola were ne dii ta. Ola ane lole dɛ do wer ne dii ane ɡe aa were ne dii.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: ó ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Haah kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa laa, dɛ o kah doŋa tɔpera anuanɛ ɡɛ tenten o yon kah doŋa o bochɔɡa saŋ la.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Tɔpenuatoro wee la, bá teŋe bie la pen.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Dɛ bihaah ɡee o lolɛ aa, yawanyoa anɛɛ wɛɛ ba doŋa kaeh kɛŋɔ o bochɔɡa saŋ la. Wɛɛ berɔ kah doŋa tɔpera fifraanumɛl dɛ anumɛl mɔɔ ba laa o doŋa la kpɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Tɔpere baa laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛɛ habɔɔ la, dɛ bibaalee kɛɛ bihaahnee yaa, haah la ɛɛ kpɔ pebie waa di benanyoa ba tɛ sɔfo n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela, ásɛ o kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah tɛ men Korowii, kɛɛ dɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ɡe yaa, ó kpɔ borɔnoma kɛɛ kulukuku ba.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la ɛɛ kpɔ naate saraha kwaa laanee ba n sie, dɛ́ ba fuah soŋe o wechɔɡa tɛo, ásɛ o chal aa fuɡo doŋa la bwa le o nɛ. Anɔɔ ɛ waa aa chɔ le dɛ tɛ haah bɛlbwa waa lolɛ baa kɛɛ haah la kɛŋɔ o ɛ.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah la aa won dɔ pebie aa, ó nyin borɔnomare anɛ kɛɛ kulukukure anɛ dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl ɛ saraha baa fuh tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ onɔ la ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha. Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe naate wechɔɡa n be, ásɛ o doŋa bwa le o nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ,

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Bwadabii weela kɛŋɔ ɔr kɛɛ kure, kɛɛ wee foɡra aa dɛ ba wona ɛ weela aa bu lawɛ nɛn aa, bá kpɔ naate ka baɡle Arɔn kɛɛ o bibaala baa ɛ sɔfore la bini bɛl.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Sɔfo la nyiŋi ŋwɛr la dɛ pona aa lɔ o ta la too, asɛ ŋwɛr la yɛ kaa bini naa, amɔ dɛ bwadabii weechɔɡa aa dɛ buu. Sɔfo la ɛɛ ŋɔ weela la ɛ weela aa dɛ bu nomanta, naate la kah doŋa.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ŋwɛr la bini too dɛ o ta yɛɛ kaa bini pona la ɡe ta toe yaa, ate sɔfo la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó pere naate le o bala bini tɔpera anuanɛ.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanɛ wee la baa tel aa, sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋu ja. O baa nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ ŋwɛr la ta do ɡɛ o fa aa doa, o ta yɛɛ kaa sie naa, ó pero le o bala bini tɔpera anuanɛ ja.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Tɔpera anuanɛ la baa tel ja o ba nyiŋu dɛ na kɛŋɔ o sie chɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ o ta yɛɛrɛ ɡe aa, sɔfo la ɛɛ ŋɔɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛɛ kpa, kur pɛɛpɛɛ. A ɡɛ nɛn la ka chɛɡɛ o laala, ásɛ o doŋa bwa le o nɛ.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: O berɔ ba nyiŋu dɛ kur la yɛo waa, ó ŋɔ naate kah doŋa. A ɛ weechɔɡa aa dɛ bu.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa bwadabii weebuula aa lɔ o nɛɛ la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá lawɔ ba sɔfo sie.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: O baa nyiŋu na dɛ ɔr la too asɛ pona aa lɔ o sie la ɡe to o bini la beɡre ŋwɛr aa,

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: wɛɛ berɔɔ nyiŋu. Dɛ o nao kɛŋɔ weela la lawɛ o bwadabii bwa kpelaa, ó ŋɔ naate be ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛ. O bwadabii bwa aa toa nomanta, amɔ dɛ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋu, dɛ o na ŋwɛr kpelaa, ó ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa. Ŋwɛr waa pila la dɛ́ chaɡle kɛŋɔ a ɛ weechɔɡa aa dɛ bu.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: ásɛ o kwaa nyiŋu ja. Dɛ ŋwɛr la buɡ too waa, ásɛ sɔfo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: asɛ o buɡ la to kɛɛ dɛ swɛɛraa, a chɛ kɛ naate kpɔ o te ka chaɡle sɔfo.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Sɔfo la nyiŋu dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ o buɡ la kaa bini asɛ pona aa lɔ o bini ɡe to aa, ó ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa. A ɛ weebuula dɛ ba ɛ ɔr la buɡ ta.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ sɔfo la nyiŋi naate dɛ pona aa toa toole o ta, o ta berɛ kaa bini o sie chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ ó pero le o nɛra bini tɔpera anuanɛ.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Dɛ o buɡ la berɔ yɛɛraa, sɔfo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa. A ɛ weebuula.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ buɡ la ta, do ɡɛ waa doa o ta yɛɛraa, dɛ ɔr la pɛl la ɡboo. Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: Dɛ nii ɡee fuh nomɛl asɛ o ŋwɛr la chɛchɛr dɛ to kɛɛ dɛ swɛɛraa,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: sɔfo la nyiŋu. O baa nyiŋu dɛ na kɛŋɔ pona aa lɔ o ta la too asɛ o buɡ la kaa bini naa, amɔ dɛ weebuula baa jo o ta. Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ pona aa lɔ o ta la ta toe asɛ o buɡ la ɡe ta bini kaalɛ o sie chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ sɔfo la pero le o nɛra bini tɔpera anuanɛ.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋu. O baa na kɛŋɔ ŋwɛr la yɛo waa, ó ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa. A ɛ bwadabii weebuula.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ buɡ la ta, do ɡɛ waa doa, o ta yɛɛrɛ o sie chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, amɔ dɛ nii laanee ɡela a ba ɡɛ. Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ naate be ŋɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ. O ɛ nii la fuih pɛl ɡbo.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa kɛɛ haah ŋwɛr aa ɛ o nyu kɛɛ o taŋɡbaɡre la,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: a chɛ kɛŋɔ sɔfo ba nyiŋu na ɡɛ waa doa. Ŋwɛr la kaa bini asɛ o bini pona ɛ solmen a ta berɛ warɛ kpa aa, dɛ bwadabii weebuula kɛŋɔ masakurkur aa dɛ we nyu kɛɛ taŋɡbaɡre laanee. Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Kɛɛ dɛ sɔfo la baa nyiŋu dɛ na kɛ ŋwɛr la ta bini kaalɛ, o pona sie chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, ó pere naate le o nɛra bini tɔpera anuanɛ.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋi ŋwɛr la. O baa nyiŋi dɛ o ta yɛɛrɛ, o pona ɡe ta solmen ɛɛ dɛ kaa bini naa,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: naate la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá fonɛ o ŋwɛr la bɔr bar. Sɔfo la ɛɛ berɔɔ pero le o nɛra bini tɔpera anuanɛ ja.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Tɔpera anuanɛ la baa tel ja aa, sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó nyiŋi ŋwɛr la ja. O nao kɛŋɔ o ta yɛɛrɛ kaa bini bɛlbwa naa, ó ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o ta doŋa bɛlbwa kaeh. Náate la chɛɡɛ o laala, dɛ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: sɔfo la berɛ nyiŋu ja. Dɛ ŋwɛr la yɛo kpela aa, sɔfo la bɛ berɛ nyiŋi na kɛŋɔ pona aa ɛ solmen lɔ o ta kɛɛ a toole o ta kpa. Ó den ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: Dɛ akaba lɔ baa kɛɛ haah nɛ aa,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó nyiŋi naate dɛ́ na. Dɛ kompoŋa la ta denɛ to kpelkpel ɡɛ naa, amɔ dɛ bwadabii weepɛɛ, doŋa toole naate nɛ.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Dɛ o tile bɔr ɡe ɡboo ɡbaa aa, doŋa toole o nɛ.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Sɔfo la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó nyiŋi ŋwɛr la. O baa nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ o swɛɛrɔ dɛ to kɛŋɔ weebuula aa,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɔ ɡɛ weebuula nɔ la chɛ kɛŋɔ wɛ́ɛ do laalajɛɡle, dɛ bɛ o nyumpona lee dɛ́ kpɔ kon tɔ o nyoa ásɛ dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, ‘N kah doŋa! N kah doŋa!’

english_verse: and if the mildew has spread in that time, he will say, “This is unclean
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, o baa nyiŋi ja dɛ kwaa la ta lɔ kon la ta dɛ yɛɛraa, a ɛ konchɔɡa dɛ ɡel kon la kah doŋa.

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ sɔfo la fuh kon la, konfɔɔla aa yɛɛra jo o ta la wa.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the mildew hasn't spread,
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ sɔfo la baa nyiŋi dɛ konfɔɔla la ta kon la ta yɛɛraa,

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: ó ŋɔ bá ka chɛɡɛ kon la dɛ́ kwaaro bil bokɛre tɔpera anuanɛ ja.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ baa chɛɡɛ kon la, sɔfo la ɛɛ nyiŋuu na ja. Dɛ o ta do ɡɛ waa doa, hale dɛ o ta yɛɛrɛ kwaraa ɡe aa, doŋa ta lɔ o ta. Dɛ o sie kɛɛ o habɔɔ bɛlbwa taa a lɛɡre aa, fuih chɛ kɛ ba fuuh.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Ba berɔ naa kon la ta naa, amɔ dɛ yɛɛraa a yɛɛ. Fuih chɛ kɛ bá den fuh kon la.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Ba chɛɡɛ kon la asɛ konfɔɔla aa lɔ o ta la bwa kaalaa, a chɛ kɛ bá kwaa chɛɡɔ nɛɛtena, dɛ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o ta kpa.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: ó ŋɔ ba nyin jumbii anɛ aa wera ne dii, ne peleme daa ne jiseswɛm, dɛ hesɔp daa ba tɛ weela te baa dɛ ba o doŋa laa dɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ la.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la ɡel ba dɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ do vii bini, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jumbii la bɛl ba chaɡɛ vii la ta dɛ́ kpoo.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ onɔ la waa wola on kpoe la ne peleme daa la, ne jiseswɛm la ne hesɔp daa la bwa pɛ su jumbie baa kpoo la chal la ta,

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ ɛ chal la merɛ naate weebuula aa lɔ o nɛɛ baa ba o doŋa laa dɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ la kera anuanɛ, dɛ́ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛɛ kpa. Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jumbie waa wola on kpoe la ta kpɔɡ bini ó ir kaa.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Nɛn baa laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛɛ la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala, dɛ́ fonɛ o pona bwa ta dɛ́ sɔ ne, ásɛ o doŋa le o nɛ. Anɔ habɔɔ, wɛɛ wono berɛ ba bela baa soɡa la, kɛ a chɛ kɛ o so o tɛnte dea dahara tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, a chɛ kɛ ó berɛ fonɛ o nyu, ne tampona ne sikoŋpona dɛ o bwara pona te bwa. Ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, ásɛ doŋa la bwa den le o nɛɛ kwaraa.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: Tɔ aa per tɔpenuatoro wee la, ó lawɛ pebali anɛ ne pelor aa di benanyoa, a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii la, ne men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruware atoro noo aa koo a ta, dɛ noo pɛrɛntoa fah.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Sɔfo waa baɡle kɛŋɔ doŋa toole naate nɛɛ la ɛɛ kpɔ o ne ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwaa ba men Korowii sie, n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ásɛ sɔfo la lawɛ pebali la bɛl dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa fah la ja, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha. Ó ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa n sie.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Ó teŋe pee la baŋa boɡoroŋ bela baa dɛ kpoo wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kwaa ne saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la. Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ, dɛkalkɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kwaa la ɛ sɔfo la kwa. A ɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Sɔ́fo la kpɔ bolchɔɡe dii saraha pee la chal la ane ɛ naate baa laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ la diɡ deŋne nyoa, ne o diɡ nonibal dɛ o nadiɡ nanibal ta.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Sɔ́fo la berɛ kpɔ noo la ane dɛ́ fuɡe do o ɡbabir ɡal nɔmpaa ta,

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ o diɡ noni do a ta, dɛ́ ɛ ane merɛ n sie bela kera anuanɛ.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ noo aa ka o nɔmpaa bini la ane dawɛ chal o fa aa kpɔa ɛ naate la diɡ deŋne nyoa, ne o diɡ nonibal dɛ o nadiɡ nanibal ta la ta.

english_verse: and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Dɛ́ kpɔ o ne mea saraha la pɛ ka fuah saraha kon la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe o wechɔɡa n be. Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ ásɛ o doŋa le o nɛ.

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ borɔnomare anɛ kɛɛ kulukukure anɛ a bini bɛlbwa waa dɛ ba wona dɔ ba, dɛ́ kpɔ beŋkpoŋ ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ bɛl la ɡe che tɛ saraha kon baa fuah.

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ naate kpɔa ba sɔfo be tɔpenuatoro wee la ta n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela n sie, ásɛ o kpɔ laa o doŋa kpɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ teŋe bolchɔɡe dii saraha pee la baŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ chal la ane ɛ naate la baa dɛ ba doŋa laa dɛ́ kpɔ o nɛɛ la diɡ deŋne nyoa, ne o diɡ nonibal dɛ o nadiɡ nanibal ta.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Sɔ́fo la fuɡe noo la ane do o ɡbabir ɡal nɔmpaa ta,

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ kpɔ o diɡ nonii ɛ ane merɛ n sie bela kera anuanɛ.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Ó berɛ ɛ noo la ane dawɛ bɔra o fa aa ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha kon chal merɛ la ɡɛ tenten. Naate la diɡ deŋne nyoa ne diɡ nonibal dɛ o diɡ nanibal ta.

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: beŋkpoŋ che tɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bɛl la ɡe ɛ saraha baa fuah, dɛ́ kpɔ mea saraha la ja a ta. Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ che naate baa laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ la naa ta soŋe o wechɔɡa n sie ń kpɔ kɛo.”

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Anee ɛ Mmarare aa chɔ le dɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɔ bwadabii weebuula waa wola won dɔ kwaa waa kpɔ ɛ saraha ɡɛ aa chɛa, ásɛ doŋa bɛlbwa le o nɛ. Konfɔɔla aa lɔ deremi ta

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ,

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: “Dɛ he jo Keenan harɛ maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ ó ɛ he kon la ta, asɛ nomɛl na kɛŋɔ n kpɔ konfɔɔla aa won bui ta dem bɛl danjwɛɛ ta naa,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: dem te la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó la sɔfo be ka ŋɔ o na konfɔɔla ane o dem.

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ó nyiŋi konfɔɔla la danjwɛɛ ta dɛ́ na, dɛ a ɛo kɛŋɔ papo-lwɛɛ kɛɛ dɛ swɛɛ dɛ di jo danjwɛɛ la ta naa,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: a chɛ kɛ sɔfo la le dem la bini dɛ́ ba laa o doonyoa ɡbera tɔ tɔpera anuanɛ.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋi dem la. O baa nyiŋi dɛ konfɔɔla la diu jo danjwɛɛ la ta kaa sie kohona naa,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Anɔ habɔɔ, a chɛ kɛ ó sɛh dem la bini danjwɛɛ bwa ta, ásɛ dɛ chea ka ta bwɛɛ la dahara bela.

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bwefala ba su anɔ la baa cheɡa ka ta la naa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ tefala kwaa maa o bwa.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: a chɛ kɛ sɔfo la berɛ la dɛ́ ka nyiŋi na. O kaa nyiŋi dɛ a berɔ dawɛ danjwɛɛ la sie ta naa, dɛ a ɛ konfɔɔla dɛɛ chɔɡ dem la, anomanta, dem la kah doŋa.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá kuuɡi dem la te bwa, o bwea ne daa ne teera baa kpɔa maalo bwa, dɛ́ paa le bwɛɛ la dahara bela.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa jo dem baa koh konfɔɔla la wa dɛ tɔ o ɡbera la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa ka chɔ kɛɛ dɛ́ di kondikwaa dem la bini la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ba maa dem la asɛ a habɔɔ sɔfo la ba nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ konfɔɔla la ta dii jo aa, wɛɛ ŋɔɔ doŋa toole o ta, dɛkalkɛ konfɔɔla la toole o ta kpa.

english_verse: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.
translation_verse: Kwaa waa kpɔ laa dem la doŋa laa kpɔ laanee jumbii anɛ, ne peleme daa ane ne jiseswɛm dɛ hesɔp da.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Sɔfo la ɡel ba dɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ do vii bini, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jumbii la bɛl chaɡɛ vii la ta dɛ́ kpoo.

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ jumbie la chal ne nee la, ne jumbie o siwi taa lole, ne sida ne hesɔp daa la dɛ jiseswɛm la laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ dem la ta kpɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jumbie o siwi aa lole la le ka ta kpɔɡ bini ó ir kaa. Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ dem la ta ó berɛ do wer.”

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.

translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe kon naate aa soɡe o ta la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra. Nomɛlbwa waa ka kpɔ komɛlbwa a ɡɛ nɛn la aa soɡe o ta la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, dɛ o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.

translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa a ɡɛ nɛn nɔ aa leɡo dɛ o ta nɔɔra samɛ mɔɔ la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, naate la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.

translation_verse: Dɛ vii ɡee naate leɡaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá paɡro. Dɛ komɛlbwa sese baa kpɔ daa ɛo ɡee yaa, a chɛ kɛ bá looru.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: Ba chah nomɛl waa do ɡɛ naa, tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ naate won laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛ. A chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala, dɛ́ dɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ ba tɛo ó sɔ, dɛ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Ásɛ tɔpenuatoro wee ta la, ó kpɔ kulukukure anɛ kɛɛ borɔnoma bii anɛ ba, n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela men Korowii sie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba tɛ sɔfo.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la kpɔa dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bɛl la ɡe ɛ saraha baa fuah. Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe naate la weela tɛo n sie dɛ́ laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɛ komɛl kɛŋɔ yal kɛɛ dɛ oltɔn taa o bane la jo aa, a chɛ kɛ bá chɛɡɔ, o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.

translation_verse: Dɛ baa la ne haah chɔɔ waa, a chɛ kɛ bá bwa sɔ ne. Ba bwa kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah bwara chɔɡɔ aa, dɛ o kah doŋa tɔpera anuanɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa leɡo la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Dɛ kon naate aa chɔ o ta kɛɛ dɛɛ so o taa nɛn leɡe aa, naate kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah la bochɔɡa ta leɛ mɔɔ baa lawɔ ka chɔ aa, dɛ baa la ɡe kah doŋa tɔpera anuanɛ, o kwaa waa chɔ a ta la ɡe bwa kah doŋa.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa leɡo la kah doŋa. A chɛ kɛ naate chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne. O kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Dɛ chal la fuɡo tonɛ o dɔ chaah naa, ó so tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ, dɛ doŋa la le o nɛ.

translation_verse: Tɔpenuatoro wee ta la, ó kpɔ kulukukure anɛ kɛɛ borɔnomare bii anɛ ba tɛ sɔfo la n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la kpɔ beŋkpoŋ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ bɛl la ɡe ó kpɔ ɛ saraha baa fuah. Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe naate la doŋa waa kaah la tɛo n sie.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: Anɔɔ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel Israel tena laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ doŋa waa ta, dɛ bɛ doŋa kpɔ kah n Tɛnte Dea waa lɔ he bini la dɛ́ ba serewe.”

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ he dɔɔ Arɔn be kɛŋɔ, o bɛ pateesan waa tɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la habɔɔ jo kaa bela N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la aa lole la warawara, dɛ́ ba sewɛ. Dɛkalkɛ Daka la tɔ doa belaa n che dɛɛ ba he be bam ta.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Dɛ wɛɛ won jo Korowii Dea belaa, atane ó kpo nabale dɛ́ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ne pebal dɛ́ ɛ saraha baa fuuh tɛ mɛ la mɔɔ.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Israel tena la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá tɛ Arɔn bombala anɛ ó kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ pebal waa kpɔ ɛ saraha baa fuah la.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Árɔn tɔ sie kpɔ nabale la ba ó ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe o ne o dem tena wechɔɡa, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ lawɛ boohna anɛ la ba n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela n sie.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Dɛ́ bil daa ásɛ beŋkpoŋ ɛ n kon, nɛɛte la ɡe ɛ onɔ la baa kpɔ nɛra la bwa wechɔɡa dawɛ o nyu ta.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Árɔn kpo booh baa bil daa o ɛ n kon la, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ásɛ booh baa bil daa dɛ lawɔ ba kpɔ nɛra la bwa wechɔɡa dawɛ o nyu ta la, bá lawɛ o ne o siwi ba n sie, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Arɔn chɛ kɛ ó lawɛ nabale la waa kpɔ ba ɛ o ɡbabir wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ soŋe o ne o dem tena wechɔɡa name, dɛ́ teŋe o baŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha la.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ kon buh nii le saraha kon la ta n sie, dɛ́ ɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma ba nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ nɔndela anɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ jo ba Boɡoroŋ Tenten pateesan la habɔɔ.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ daawiile la do nii la ta n sie bela, ásɛ a chuu la bɔle N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la ta, ásɛ o bɛ o tɔ la na dɛ́ ba sewɛ.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ nonii ɛ nao la chal la ane merɛ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la ta o sie, dɛ́ berɛ merɛ ane ɡe o sie tenten kera anuanɛ.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, ó kpɔ booh la, dɛ́ kpo ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ nɛra la, dɛ́ kpɔ o chal la ba pateesan la habɔɔ, dɛ́ ɛa ɡɛ tenten waa ɛ nao la chal la. Ó merɛ ane N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la ta, dɛ́ merɛ ane ɡe o sie bela.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ, dɛ́ fee doŋa ne deŋnekpeɡ, ne wechɔɡa bɛlbwa soo siwi Israel tena aa ɛa bwa ta Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela. A chɛ kɛ ó ɛ ɡɛ tenten n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini ɡe, waa cheɡɛ a baah ta nomanta, a bwaa kah doŋa.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ berɔɔ le ba saraha kon la ta bela n sie, dɛ́ ba laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ o ta. A chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ nao la chal la ane ne booh la chal ane, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe saraha kon la loŋkoni bwa ta.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Arɔn laa ba doŋa kpɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela, ne n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini dɛ saraha kon la ta tonaa, a chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ booh la o siwi aa lole la ba che n sie.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ booh la nyu ta, ásɛ dɛ bol Israel tena chɔɡre, ba wechɔɡa ne ba deŋnekpeɡ bwa baa ɛa dɛ ta o nyu ta, dɛ́ kpɔ do nomɛl nɔn ta, ásɛ o teɡɔ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Naate la ɛɛ kpɔɔ ka ta harɛ nomɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta, ásɛ ba wechɔɡa bwa dawɛ booh la nɛ ó kpɔ kaa.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ó ka sɔ nee bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ laalafala do. Ásɛ dɛ le ka kpɔ o ne Israel tena saraha kwaa baa fuah la fuh, dɛ́ soŋe o ne Israel tena bwa wechɔɡa, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ó berɛ kpɔ ol waa kpɔa ɛ saraha la noo ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ fuah saraha kon la ta.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Naate la ɡe waa kpɔ booh la kaa ka ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ nee mɔɔ dɛ́ ba bela baa soɡa la.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Naate waa fuah la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ nee mɔɔ dɛ́ berɛ ba bela baa soɡa la.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Mmarare nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ á chɔ le tɛ heyaa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Korobinuanɛ te la tɔpera fi ta, a chɛ kɛ hé vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ, Israel te kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he binii yoo,

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ awola tɔpere laanee baa ba he wechɔɡa bwa soŋa, ásɛ dɛ laa he doŋa kpɔ he nɛ. Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba ɡela wechɔɡa bɛlbwa aa he nɛɛ do kpa men Korowii sie.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: O ɛ tɔpere haa onɛ o ta dɛɛ vɔwɛ nyoa. Á ɛ Mmara dɛ́ chɔ tɛ heyaa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: dɛ́ ɛ we-ɛɛla Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela ne n Dea Cheremibɔr bini dɛ saraha kon la ta, dɛ́ laa sɔfore la ne Israel tena la wechɔɡa bwa kpɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Mmarare nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Bena bɛlbwa, kerabeŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛ bá soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa bwa ń kpɔ kɛ ba.” Asɛ ba ɛ a bwa ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis ŋɔ ba ɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: “Kpɔ waa maa dɛ ba he be bola nɔ tɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ Israel tena bwa.

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: dɛ o ta kpɔe ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa, dɛ ba kpo ɛ saraha n sie tɛ mɛ naa, dɛ o fuɡe chal ta dɛ di bolchɔɡe. Maa naate laanee kure ja n nɛra nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba ɡela Israel tena baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha kpɔɡ bini taraken nɔ ɡel a ɛɛ. Bá kpɔa ba sɔfo be n Dea Cheremibɔr bela n sie ba ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la tonaa, ó ɛ a chale merɛ men Korowii saraha kon la ta, n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela, dɛ́ fuh a noorare, ásɛ a sɔɔh do n som kohona.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: Berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ Israel te bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe ba bini dɛɛ nyin ó ɛ saraha baa fuah, kɛɛ saraha te bɛlbwa,

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: dɛ o ta a ne n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa balɛ ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ bá pere naate le o nɛra bini.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Israel te, kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he bini dɛɛ di ol chal la, n sie ɛɛ beɡre naate nɛɛ dɛ́ pero le o nɛra bini.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa o siwi aa lole la mkpa lɔ o chal ta, a waa n kpɔ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ soŋe he wechɔɡa saraha kon ta la. Chal laanee bá kpɔ soŋe nɛn wechɔɡa dɛɛ tɛo wɛɛ dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: That's also why I have forbidden you to eat blood.
translation_verse: A waa n ŋɔ he Israel tena ne nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe he bini bɛlbwa bɛ chal di la.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Israel te bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he bini dɛ la kpaah bɔr ka kpo ol, kɛɛ jumbie waa wera ne dii la, ó teŋe o baŋa o chal bwa le, dɛ́ ɛ teera tɔ a ta,

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ komɛlbwa mkpa lɔ o chal ta. A waa n ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ bɛlbwa bɛ ol ne o chal di la. Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ ɡɛ la, mɛɛ pero le n nɛra bini.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ bwɛɛlembie kɛɛ hɔɔh dɛ di ol waa sewa, kɛɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡe aa lawɔ o ka kpɔ o kabora ba di la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne. O kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra mɔɔ o doŋa la bwa le o nɛ.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ naate ta o laala chɛɡɛ dɛ sɔ ne aa, wɛɛ dɔ a waa.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
