english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ Ijipt tena he fa aa soɡe ba bini la, ne Keenan tena maa dɛ kaa he ne ba bini nɔ. He bɛ ba we-ɛɛla la kpɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ do heyaa bwa ta. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Bɛ he mɛɛ haah lawɛ chɔ. A ba ɡɛ naa, dɛ duure bɛlbwa toole he ne he mɛɛ baah ta.

english_verse: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter
translation_verse: Dɛ́ɛ berɛ he bibaa bihaah kɛɛ he bihaah ɡe bihaah lawɛ chɔ. A ɛ sihihwa dɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Dɛ́ɛ berɛ he nyawee kɛɛ nyajen lawa ka chɔ. He nya lole tentenee.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Bɛ haah nyin dɛ berɛ ka nyin o bie ɡe. Dɛɛ berɛ o bibaa bihaah, kɛɛ o bihaah ɡe bihaah nyina. Ba ɛ haah la lolanar tenten. A ɛ wedoŋa.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Dɛ he haah ta soɡe le o ta sewɛ mɔɔ naa, dɛɛ berɛ o nime kɛɛ nahaah moe dɛ́ ja o nɛ dɛ́ lawɔ chɔ, a ba ɡɛ naa, baa toŋroo.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: Bɛ haah lawɛ chɔ o bochɔɡa saŋ. Gɛ saŋ dɛ o ta lɔ doŋa ta.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Bɛ he dɔŋ haah lawɛ chɔ dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah he bwa.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Bɛ he bie bɛlbwa lawɛ tɛ bá kpo ɛ saraha tɛ voɡ Molɛk. Dɛɛ berɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔ sɔn chɔɡ ɡɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Bɛ he bandɔŋ lawɛ chɔ baa ne haah. A ɛ waa baa kia.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: He bɛ he te kpɔ do ɡɛ waa nɔ bɛlbwa ta dɛ́ kah doŋa. Gɛɛ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ maa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ heyaa nɔ ta ɛ, asɛ dɛ kah doŋa mɛɛ ba ba doŋa le o ta la.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Ba we-ɛɛla chɔɡ harɛ la ɡba o doŋ dɛ ba deŋnetɛra ne o ta asɛ o lee ba tɛ.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ ɡɛɛ nɛra baa tɔ sie ba so harɛ nɔ ta la we-ɛɛla chɔɡ harɛ la o doŋ la.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Hé ɡe baa chɔɡ harɛ la aa, wɛɛ le heyaa tɛ ɡɛ waa le nɛra baa tɔ he sie tɛ la.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin, dɛ bɛ nɛra baa tɔ sie ba so harɛ nɔ ta la we-ɛɛla maa kia la ta teŋɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah he te. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii bol Mosis be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: ó ŋɔ Israel tena la bwa be ŋɔ, “Hé do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, n do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: He bɛ he liire charɛ dɛ́ kaa tomɛ voɡa kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ bune ɛ voɡa dɛɛ toma. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Hé ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha dɛɛ ba n tɛɛ yaa, he ɛa ŋwɛnɛ aa chɛa ta, ásɛ a do wer tɛ mɛ ń lɛ.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Awola tenten haa kpo ol la ne tɔɔ aa per o ta laanee o do wer ne dii. Kɛ dɛ o pera kao ba le tɔpetooro wee ta naa, a chɛ kɛ bá fuuh.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa di ol la tɔpetooro wee la, maa o saraha waa ɛa tɛ mɛ laanee lɛ. A ɛ waa maa kia.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ ol la chɛ kɛ bá tɛr o deŋne, dɛkalkɛ o chɔɡ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ men Korowii. A chɛ kɛ ba pere naate le o nɛra bini.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: He dɛ komɛ he koo kondikwaa aa, he bɛ anɔ la aa lɔ koo nyoa tenten la komɛ. Hɛ́ɛ berɛ anɔ la aa leera la ɡe pa dɛɛ ja.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ berɛ he daa kooni nɔna aa ka mun lee kɛɛ a taa ka daa ta la ta dalwe dɛ́ tɔɔra. Hé ɡela tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ne nyaara he ne baa soɡa la. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: He bɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛ. He bɛ nyosone dɛɛ teŋe. He bɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ neɡre.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: He bɛ n sɔn kpɔ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ waa aa ɛ nyosone, dɛ́ chɔɡ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ sɔndɛɛɡe la. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ berɛ he dɔŋa faahra, kɛɛ dɛ́ ŋwɛo. He bɛ ɡel nɛn ɛ he toma ásɛ he di o kem tɔɔ per a ta.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, dɛ bɛ amumu taah kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ komɛl bil nyoŋe sie ó lɔ na dɛ́ chole.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi dɛɛ pa waa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta. Naate ɛ nyaaraa, he bɛ o nɛɛ sune, he bɛ suuɡa te ɡe siebɔr nyiŋi. Kpɔ kasinteŋ pa he dɔŋ bole.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: He bɛ he dɔŋa waa kpɔ ɡaaɡe dɛ́ teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛ. Dɛ seo nyoa he dɔŋ che naa, bɛ on chɔɡ. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: Dɛ́ɛ berɛ he dɔŋ haeh. La o be ka diu kasinteŋ, ásɛ o wechɔɡa bɛ he nɛɛ dawɛ.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Bɛ he dɔŋ wechɔɡa waa ɛa la kpɔ do he bambile bini dɛ́ ɡe bɔɔ a kem. Hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa kɛ he ɡbaɡba. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ n waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta. He bɛ ɡel he kondɛɛra aa wola siwi beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ jwee dɔŋa. He bɛ kondwee aa wola siwi beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ pɛ du harɛ beŋkpoŋ ta. He bɛ yal baa kpɔ jisepondɛɛɡe ne pee pona sɔh la tɔ.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa lawɛ yomhaah baa lawɔ tɛ baa waa wola o bwara waa ɛɛ mɔɔ ka chɔ, dɛ ba ta o nyu kem bɔe o dɔ o te mɔɔ naa, a chɛ kɛ bá tɛr ba deŋne. Ba bɛ ban kpo dɛkalkɛ haah la ta ɛ nɛndɔɔle.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la kpɔ pebal la, dɛ́ soŋe naate wechɔɡa waa ɛa tɛo n sie, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛo.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Bennaarɛ ta la, dɛ a bwa wer dɛ ɛ men Korowii kwa, hé kpɔ ɛ saraha kpɛɛ n sɔndɛɛɡe la.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔ ŋwɛnɛ name, dɛ́ di daa la nɔna bennue te la ta. Gɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ he daa won nɔnɛ kohona tɛ heya. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: He bɛ ol ne o chal di. Hɛ́ɛ berɛ he te kpɔe dɛ do voɡra kɛɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla soo siwi bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: He bɛ lala waa koh, dɛ́ mɔne he bwara kɛɛ dɛ́ do he bwadabii ɡwine. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: He bɛ he bihaahna chɔɡ baa bɔ jwamane. He dɛ ɛɛ ba ɡɛ naa, aa bu harɛ la bwaa, dɛ́ ɡel chɔɡre warɛ o ta.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ di n Ona Tɔpera la, ásɛ dɛ ɡel duure do bela haa dɛ tom mɛ la. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ berɛ nɛra baa dɔ daabii ba ne lala ɛɛ bol waa be la. He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he kpɔ doŋa dɛɛ kah he te. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jirima dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa hwɛɛhra, ásɛ dɛɛ duu ba, dɛ́ɛ duu men Korowii haa dɛ́ tom mɛ ɡe. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ berɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe he harɛ ta hɔhɔrɔwa dɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ he bala Israel tena, dɛ́ɛ nyin ba wa kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba. He na kɛŋɔ he ɡbabir fa ɛ hɔɔhra Ijipt harɛ ta ka. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ kwaa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ maɡɛ kwaa maɡɛ ɡɛ a bɛlbwa aa chɛa. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n kpɔ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba la.

english_verse: and I command you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ́ do heyaa bwa ta. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He bini bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he bini, dɛ lawɛ o bie bɛlbwa ɛ saraha ba kpo tɛ voɡ Molɛk la chɛ kɛ bwɛɛ la ta tena foɡro bwea kpo.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: N sie ɛɛ beɡre naate nɛɛ dɛ́ pero le o nɛra bini, dɛkalkɛ lawa waa lawɛ o bie tɛ Molɛk la ɡelɔ o kpɔ doŋa kah n Dea, dɛ chɔɡ n sɔndɛɛɡe waa do ɡoroŋ la.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Dɛ bwɛɛla ɡe na naate dɛ laa sie kpɔ ba ta on kpoe yaa,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: n ɡbabir ɛɛ kpɔ sibeɡraa ta naate la ne o lolanar bwa nɛɛ, dɛ́ pere ba ne ba nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ dɛ vɛh n toma dɛ kaa tomɛ Molɛk la bwa le ba nɛra bini.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh n toma dɛɛ la nɛn waa dɔ daabii dɛɛ yerɛ lala be la, n sie ɛɛ beɡre o nɛɛ dɛ́ pero le o nɛra bini.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Hé laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ he nɛɛ dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛ menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Hé lawɛ me Mmarare bini kpoŋe dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a bwa ta, dɛkalkɛ menee Korowii, menee ɡela he do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa taah o mɛɛ kɛɛ o nya la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo. Naate wechɔɡa ɡure o nyu ta.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Dɛ baa nyin o dɔŋ haah naa, dɛ ba bwa bɔ jwamane, a chɛ kɛ bá kpo baa la ne haah la bwa.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ o mɛɛ haah o ne o chɔ la lawɛ o mɛɛ sie teɡɛ harɛ. Baa la ne haah la bwa chɛ kpoe. Ba sewɔ ɡe aa, ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa waa lawɛ o bie haah o ne o chɔ la chɛ kɛ bá kpo ba bwa. Ba ɛ waa aa wola were, ba sewɔ ɡe aa, ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Dɛ baa lawɛ o bandɔŋ chɔ kɛŋɔ baa ne haah naa, a ɛ waa baa kia, a chɛ kɛ bá kpoo ba. Ba sewɔ ɡe aa, ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Dɛ baa mo haah ne o nya bwa naa, a ɛ wedoŋa. Ba nɛra batoro la bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá fuuh ba, ásɛ a ɡɛ wedoŋa nɔ le he bini.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah ɡe kpɔ o te tɛ ol o ne o chɔ baa ne haa naa, a chɛ kɛ bá kpo o ne ol la bwa. Ba sewɔ ɡe aa, ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Dɛ baa lawɛ o nyawee kɛɛ nyajen kɛɛ o nyaana chɔ aa, a ɛ sihihwa dɛ chɔɡ lola, nɛra banɛ la bwa chɛ deŋnetɛra.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ do heyaa bwa ta, ásɛ harɛ maa kpɔ heyaa dɛɛ ba o ta ba soŋni nɔ bɛ heyaa ba le tɛ.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: He bɛ nɛra la maa dɛ ba doŋa he sie he kpɔ ba harɛ la da ba kpɔ, ba kpoŋe da waa wola were waa n kii ba.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: N baɡɛ heyaa nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ ba harɛɛ tɛ heya hé so o ta o den ɛ he kon, harɛpare ondɛɛɡe. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n le heyaa korɛ harɛre nɛra bwa bini la.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé do ɡoroŋ dɛ́ che tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii n do ɡoroŋ, asɛ dɛ le heyaa cheɡ harɛre nɛra bwa bini, dɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Baa kɛɛ haah bɛlbwa waa dɔ daabii dɛɛ bol waa lala be dɛ do he bini la chɛ kɛŋɔ hé foɡro bwea kpo. Naate seo ɡe dɛ ɡure o nyu ta.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Arɔn bibaala sɔfore la be kɛŋɔ dɛ bɛl lole sewaa, o bɛ o te kpɔ dɛɛ jo o lole la lwe we-ɛɛla ta, dɛ́ kah doŋa,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: kɛɛ nimambihaah waa wola yalɛ mɔɔ o ne o ta so dembeŋkpoŋ ta wɛɛ nyiŋu.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ o te jo o lolanar baa yala we-ɛɛla ta dɛ́ kah doŋa.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Sɔfo bɛlbwa bɛ o nyu fonɛ kɛɛ dɛ kuu o tampona dɛ́ mɔne o bwara á baɡle kɛ o dɛ ɛ lwe.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do ɡoroŋ dɛ́ che tɛ Korowii dɛ bɛ o sɔndɛɛɡe la chɔɡ. Dɛkalkɛ onee kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah a ɛ kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɛ Korowii kwaa la baa tɛo.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛ sɔfo mo haah waa bɔ jwamane dɛ kah doŋa kɛɛ haah o jaa aa vɛoh. Dɛkalkɛ sɔfore ɛ nɛra baa do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Nɛra la ɛɛ nyiŋi sɔfore kɛŋɔ nɛra baa do ɡoroŋ, banee kpɔ saraha kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ baa tɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la. Onee Korowii, o do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɡel o nɛra ɡe ɛɛ do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Dɛ sɔfo bihaah dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛ kah doŋa aa, dɛ o mɛɛ wɛɛ do sihiih la. A chɛ kɛ bá fuuh.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: Sɔfo baa leo o bala bini dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ ɛo Sɔfonomoa dɛ doo laala la ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel o nyumpona loromi kɛɛ ó kɛɛ o laala á baɡle kɛ o lɔ lwe ta.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: Sɔfonomoa la bɛ bela nɛn aa sewa dɛ chɔ la jo. O ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe hale dɛ o mɛɛ kɛɛ o nyaa sewa oo, ó ka jo o be dɛ́ kah doŋa,

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: kɛɛ dɛ́ le Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ Dea ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel o kah doŋa, dɛkalkɛ ba fuɡe noo do o nyu ta dɛ ɛo Sɔfonomoa tɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ. Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Haah waa wola baa jemɛ bwa laanee chɛ kɛ ó mo.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: O bɛ luhaah kɛɛ haah o jaa aa vɛoh, kɛɛ haah waa ɛ jwamane te dɛ kah doŋa mo. O dea waa le o ta haah waa wola baa jemɛ bwa laanee chɛ kɛ ó mo.

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ dɛ ɡel o bɛ doŋa kpɔ kah o bii o nɛra bini. Korowiirii leo o do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa waa di kirihiah ta a ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɔe. Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ nyoŋe kɛɛ boobi, kɛɛ o bobɛl aa di kirihiah,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: ne onɔ la o nɔn kɛɛ o nakpala aa sewa,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: ne chacha te kɛɛ kiribi te, ne nɛn waa dɔ siweela te bwa soo siwi kɛɛ bwadabii weela kɛŋɔ ŋwɛra aa dɛ wi ne, kɛɛ o lure aa chɔɡa.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: kɛ o kirihiah dii nomanta, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó suuh tel pateesan la á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ bɛne saraha kon laanee, dɛ́ ba kpɔ doŋa kah o bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ la. Korowiirii ɡela a do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔɔ Mosis bol Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ Israel tena bwa be.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: “Ŋɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala be kɛŋɔ, bá nyiŋi Israel tena saraha aa do ɡoroŋ ba yon kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ la ta kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ n sɔndɛɛɡe waa do ɡoroŋ la chɔɡ. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: Berɛ ŋɔ ba be kɛŋɔ, ba naanar baa ka ba la bini bɛlbwa waa kah doŋa dɛ ɡarɛ ba Israel tena saraha aa do ɡoroŋ ba kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ la jwɛɛh la, bá bara naate n sie bala. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Arɔn naanar bini bɛlbwa bwadabii weebuula aa lɔ o nɛ, kɛɛ o bwara aa won bala saŋ bɛlbwa la ta chɛ kɛ ó di saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la, nemenɛ a ɡɛ doŋa le o nɛɛ mɔɔ. O berɔ leɡe komɛlbwa konlale aa kpɔ doŋa kaoh, kɛɛ nomɛlbwa o bwara aa won bala saŋ bɛlbwa,

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: kɛɛ dɛ leɡe kontuuɡi waa ɡela o kah doŋa, kɛɛ dɛ nɛnee yoo, kɛɛ komɛlbwa waa ɡel ó kah doŋa bwa la, nemenɛ doŋa la le o nɛɛ mɔɔ.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Wee aa le harɛ la, dɛ naate doŋa bwa le o nɛ, ásɛ mɔɔ o won di saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛkalkɛ a ɛ sɔfo la kondikwa.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛ ó di konlale waa kaa piu, kɛɛ onɔ la kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡe aa lawɔ á che a ta ó kah doŋa. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Sɔfore bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la maa do ba a ta, dɛ bɛ sie laa kpɔ a ta, dɛ́ di bolchɔɡe dɛ́ ba sewɛ. Menee Korowii, menee lee ba cheɡ dɛ ɡel ba do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ sɔfo yawɛ yom aa, o won ɡɛ kwaa la dii, ɡɛɛ nɛndɔɔle baa lolɔ dem bela ɡe won a dii.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Sɔfo bɛlbwa bihaah waa ka yalɛ nɛmpɛɛ waa wola sɔfo ɛɛ la, ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ó di saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ nɔ.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Kɛ sɔfo bɛlbwa bihaah o jaa aa sewa kɛɛ dɛ vɛoh dɛ o ta bii dɔe, asɛ dɛ berɛ ba so o mɛɛ be wɛɛ nyiŋu kɛ o bechale saŋ la, o dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó di kondikwaa bɛlbwa aa ɛ o mɛɛ kwaa la. Kɛ nɛmpɛɛ waa wola ŋwɛnɛ dɔe la te ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó dia.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa bɛ kon waa di kirihiah kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii, dɛkalkɛ maa lɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin tɛo.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Sɔfore la ta chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ doŋa kah Israel tena saraha aa do ɡoroŋ ba kpɔ ba ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la,

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: dɛ́ ɡel nɛra baa wola ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ba dia la di. Sɔfore baa laa sie kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta la ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra di bolchɔɡe, dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra. Menee Korowii, men ɡela a do ɡoroŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: ó bol Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ Israel tena bwa be ŋɔ, “He bini bɛlbwa, kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he bini kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah la, dɛɛ ba ba tɛ mɛ dɛ nyobaɡa chuɡra saraha kɛɛ saraha aa le o bambile taa yaa,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa lawɛ kondɛɛre ba ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha dɛɛ ba bá tɛ men Korowii aa, dɛ nyobaɡa chuɡra kɛɛ saraha aa le o bambile taa yoo, naate ɡel a ɡɛ kondɛɛre la su siwi dɛ bɛ kirihiah bɛlbwa di.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Saraha aa le he bambile ta la te, hɛɛ won kpɔ nao kɛɛ pee o bobɛl aa di kirihiah kɛɛ dɛ mule ba. Kɛ waa were tɛ nyobaɡa chuɡra saraha.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Kondɛɛre lur waa mala, kɛɛ dɛ paɡraa ba paɡra kɛɛ teŋa ba teŋo woo, he bɛ kwaa aa do ɡɛ nɔ kpɔ ɛ saraha he harɛre ta.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡɛ kondɛɛre nɔ bɛlbwa lɛ le nɛŋhɔɔh be ba ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ. Waa were dɛɛ su men Korowii siwi kɛ ń lɛo, o bobɛl aa di kirihiah la nomanta.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Dɛ nao, pee kɛɛ booh lolɔ aa, o bie la chɛ kɛ ó do o nya lɔɡa tɔpera anuanɛ. Le tɔpenuatoro wee dɛɛ kaa la, o wer kɛŋɔ he won kpɔ ɛ saraha ba fuuh tɛ men Korowii.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: He bɛ nao kɛɛ pee ne o bie bwa pɛ teŋe a baŋa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jam kwaa dɛɛ ba saraha ɛɛ tɛ mɛ naa, hé ɛa ɡɛ aa chɛa dɛ́ won su siwi ń lɛa.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ hé di o bwa awola tenten. Hɛ́ɛ berɛ o pera ɡela tɔɔ per o ta. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: “Anɔɔ ɛ n tɔpejena maa lea cheɡ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé bwa cheme dɛ́ɛ tom mɛ a ta. Ona Tɔpere wa

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Tɔpera anumɛlee lole kɛ hé kpɔ ɛ he tomare, kɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee la ɛ Ona Tɔpere. O ɛ tɔpere hé bwa aa cheme dɛ́ɛ tom mɛ o ta. He bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ o ta bobɛlbwa haa soɡa, o ɛ Ona Tɔpere dɛ tɛ Korowii. Galekaa ne Paanoo Baa Wola Iisi A Ta Do Tɔpejena

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: He bɛ toma ɛ awola tɔpere la ta, o ɛ Wechɔɡa Soŋa Korowii Be Ó Kpɔ Kɛ Tɔpejen. Awola tɔpere laanee bá soŋe he wechɔɡa men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la be, ń kpɔ dɛɛ kɛ heya.

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Korobiloɡle la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ, wee aa dɛɛ le harɛ la, hé pa Galekaa Tɔpejen la dii mun n sɔn ta.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: A ɡɛ tɔpera anuanɛ nɔ bwa taa chɛ kɛ bɛ́lbwa kpɔ o saraha baa fuah bá tɛ mɛ. Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, a chɛ kɛ hé berɛ cheme dɛ́ tom mɛ, kɛ bɛlbwa bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Dɛ he baa tel harɛ maa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ heyaa la ta, asɛ hɛɛ komɛ he koo kondikwa aa, hé kpɔ mea vɔwa del aa ɛ loɡla kwaa la ka tɛ sɔfo.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ mea saraha men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ kuruware anɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ noo koo a ta ja fuh tɛ mɛ. A ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuh a bwa a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be. Dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ sen pɛrɛntoa beŋkpoŋ ne fah ɛ sen saraha ja a ta.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: He bɛ paanoo bɛlbwa kɛɛ mefala anwɔɔra kɛɛ aŋhuuhne chwe, nemenɛ awola tenten haa ɛ saraha nɔ ba tɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la mɔɔ. Gɛ waa nɔɔ chɛ kɛ á chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba bwa, bobɛlbwa haa soɡa. Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen dii

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: He bɛ toma bɛlbwa sese ɛ. Gɛ waa nɔ chɛ kɛ á chɔ le tɛ he ne naanar baa kaa ba bobɛlbwa haa soɡa.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: Hé kure yawanyoa anuanɛ dɛ́ le awola sɔfore la aa ka kpɔ mea vɔwa del ba ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ la ta.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ paanobire anɛnɛ le dem bɛlbwa ta ba ɛ saraha baa ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa men Korowii sie, a ɛ kondikonloɡla saraha tɛ mɛ. Men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ kuruware anɛ iisi aa lɔ a ta laanee hé kpɔ wɔɔra.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Pebali anuanɛ a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ, ne pebala anɛ a bini bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii chɛ kɛ hé lawɛ ja paanoo la ta ɛ saraha. Baa fuah tɛ men Korowii dɛ́ kpɔ mea sarahare ne sen saraha la ja a ta. A ɛ saraha baa fuah a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Hé berɛ kpɔ bombal ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ pebiiri anɛ bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa ɡe ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Sɔ́fo la kpɔ kondikonloɡla paanoo la ne pebiiri anɛ la, dɛ́ ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa n sie ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ. Anee ɛ saraha aa do ɡoroŋ kohona ba ɛa dɛɛ tɛ men Korowii a ɛ sɔfore la kwa.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la chɛ kɛ hé ɡel he tomare bwa bil, dɛ́ cheme dɛ́ tom mɛ. A chɛ kɛ á ɛ waa aa chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba bobɛlbwa haa soɡa.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: He dɛ komɛ he koo kondikwa aa, he bɛ anɔ la aa lɔ koo nyoa tenten la komɛ. He bɛ anɔ la aa leera la ɡe kuuh dɛɛ ja. He ɡela tɛ nyaara ne hɔɔhra. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.” Bɛle Hoeh Tɔpejen dii

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Korobie anuanɛ nɔ ta, o tɔpera fi ɛ Wechɔɡa Soŋa Korowii Be Ó Kpɔ Kɛ Tɔpejen. Hé bwa vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ́ cheme, dɛ́ tom mɛ awola tɔpere, dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ba tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: O ɛ Ona Tɔpere tɛ heya, a chɛ kɛŋɔ nómɛlbwa vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ́ onɛ o ta. Ó pa mun le korobie la tɔpera anuanaarɛ wee aa jo la ta, dɛ́ ba o tɔpera fi ta jɔmɔra.” Kukure Tɔpejen dii

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Korobie anuanɛ la tɔpera fi dɛ anue taa Kukure Tɔpejen dii ɛɛ pa mun. Tɔpera anuanɛɛ baa diu.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, hé cheme dɛ́ tom mɛ dɛ́ ɡel he tomare bwa bil.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ kwaa haa fuah ɛ saraha tɔpera anuanɛ la bwa ba tɛ mɛ, ásɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, hé bwa cheme dɛ́ tom mɛ dɛ́ fuh saraha kwaa tɛ mɛ. A ɡɛ tɔpere laanee dɛ́ ka mun he tɔpejen chema la ta, anomanta, hé ɡel he tomare bwa bil.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: Anɔɔ n tɔpejena maa lea cheɡ kɛŋɔ hé cheme dɛ́ɛ tom mɛ a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah ba tɛ mɛ. Saraha kwaa baa fuah ne mea sarahare dɛ sen sarahare te bɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ tɔpejena nɔ bɛlbwa ta laanee la.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Gɛ saraha kwaa nɔ ja Ona Tɔpere saraha kwaa ne koŋkɛɛla, ne nyobaɡa chuɡra sarahare dɛ sarahare aa le he bambile ta haa kpɔ baa tɛ men Korowii bwa ta.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: Anomanta, korobinuanɛ tɔpera fi dɛ anue haa ba komɛ he kooni kondikwaa tonɛ la, hé di Kukure Tɔpejen nɔ tɔpera anuanɛ. Tɔpere waa tɔ sie la ɛ Ona Tɔpere, asɛ tɔpenuatoro la ɡe, hé onɛ o ta.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Hé di ɡɛ tɔpejen nɔ bena bɛlbwa tɔpera anuanɛ. Gɛ waa nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ á chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba bwa. Hɛ́ɛ diu korobie anuanɛ ta.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Israel tena bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ so kukure lɔɡre tɔpera anuanɛ,

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: ásɛ he naanar jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii ɡela Israel tena so kukure lɔɡre ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.”

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do Mosis baɡle Israel tena tɔpejena Korowii aa lea cheɡ ŋɔ baa dia la.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpo o dɔŋ kondɛɛre la chɛ kɛ ó nyin bɛl ba chiɡ o naa ta. Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa kpo o dɔŋ la te chɛ kɛ bá kpo o ɡe.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: bá kpɔ ɔleve nodɛɛɡa baa harama kɛrɛdɛ ba tɛo ó kpɔ dɛɛ do kandea daa la bini, ásɛ o kandere che le dɛɛ hɔ dɛ bɛ dime bwa.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kandere aa lɔ kandea daa la baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɡbo ɛo o che Korowii sie la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá nyiŋa aa hɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Kpɔ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ ɛ paanoo fi dɛ anɛ. Kuruware anɛɛ chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ ɛ paanoo la beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Kpɔ paanoo la bil teebur waa cheɡɛ Korowii sie ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛo la ta. A chɛ kɛ hé bila bɔre anɛ, anumɛl teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ do baŋ bɛl, ásɛ anumɛl ɡe do baŋ bɛl ɡɛ tenten.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Baŋ bɛlbwa ta la, ɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma bil a jwɛh a ɛ saraha kwaa baa fuh cheɡ paanoo la naa ta tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Arɔn che Israel tena naa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ paanoo la baa bil Korowii sie Ona Tɔpere bɛlbwa ta. Ó teŋɛ dɛ́ kpɔa baa bil Korowii sie ɡɛ, á ɛ fɔo Korowii ne Israel tena aa fɔwa o do n ne ba baah ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Paanoo la ɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kwa aa chɛ kɛ bá dia bela waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛ paanoo laanee ɛ saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona, dɛ le saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ tɛ Korowii dɛ ɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala dibɔr la ta. Nɛnhɛl we-ɛɛla te bwea foɡra

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Dɛ o nya sɔne Sɛlomet, Dibri waa le Dan dea biee on. Sɛlomet bie la ɛ nɛnhɛlwa dɛ taah Korowii, asɛ ba lawɔ ba Mosis sie,

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: dɛ lawɔ do dea dɛɛ kpa waa Korowii aa ŋɔ bá ɛo.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Hé lawɛ baa waa bol nɛnhɛlwobol la le kaa bela haa soɡa la dahara. Nomɛlbwa waa noa kɛŋɔ o bol mɛ nɛnhɛlwobol la, bá kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nyu ta, ásɛ nɛra la bwa foɡro bwea kpo.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá kpo nomɛlbwa waa bol men Korowii nɛnhɛlwobol la. Israel tee kɛɛ nɛŋhɔɔhree yoo, a chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra la bwa foɡre naate bwea kpo.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpo o dɔŋ la chɛ kɛ bá kpo o ɡe,

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa do o dɔŋ bol la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá do o ɡe bol bɔ kem.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Mmara beŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛ ó chɔ le tɛ deela ne hɔɔhra bwa. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.’ ”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Mosis aa bol anɔ baɡle Israel tena la, ba kpɔ baa la le kaa bela baa soɡa la dahara, dɛ ka foɡro bwea kpo. Gɛɛ a do Israel tena la ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ yoɡ harɛ kɛɛ dɛ yawɛ dɛɛ le he dɔŋ be naa, nyiŋi bene haa dɔa dɛ́ kpɔ parɛ harɛ la mɔɔ dɛ́ di o yoɡ. Gɛ del haa parɛ la taa chɛ kɛ hé nyiŋi dɛ́ yawɛ.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol waa Mosis be Sinai Bwejen la ta dɛ ŋɔ

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ benanyoa waa teŋa fifraanue nɔ, a ta chɛ kɛ hé du komɛlbwa he kooni ta, kɛɛ hé komɛ anɔ la a ɡbo aa lea, kɛɛ dɛ́ chaa ɡrepo daa nɔna haa wola a nyoo kuure dɛ kwaara cheɡ.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: ó ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He baa tel harɛ maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la ta naa, hé koh men Korowii wa, dɛ́ ɡel harɛ la ɡbabir dɔ ona saŋ bɛl tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: ne he kondɛɛre dɛ kpɔɡ bini ola aa lɔ harɛ la ta te bwa dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ dia. Komɛlbwa aa le harɛ la ta bwa, ba won a dii. Benanyoa baa berɛ kwaa dɛɛ tɛ a tena

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: O naara kɛɛ o naara ɡe bie, kɛɛ o lole tenten bini bɛlbwa ɛɛ won bɔ o nyu kem dɛ́ lɛo. Dɛ o ɡbabir ɡee bera ba dɔ suuɡa aa, wɛɛ won bɔ o nyu kem la, dɛ́ lɛ o te.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ la habɔɔ, korobie anuanɛ tɔpera fi ta la, hé ɡel ba hoh bɛla harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa. O ɛ Wechɔɡa Soŋa Korowii Be Ó Kpɔ Kɛ Tɔpejen, a chɛ kɛ bá hoh bɛla harɛ la ta.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ bena nɔ ta, nomɛlbwa kon waa yawa le o dɔŋ be chɛ kɛ ó berɛ kaa o dɔɔ be.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Dɛ naate dɛ yawɛ harɛ la ó biɡri o nɔn ta naa, a chɛ kɛ yoɡ la kaa nyundua, kɛ dɛ tɔpere la aa jaŋne doe ba naa, amɔ yoɡ la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ba harɛ. Dɛkalkɛ kondikwaa aa le harɛ la ta ɡboo o yoɡ dɛɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ́ɛ berɛ dɔŋa faahra. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Harɛ la ɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa tɛ heyaa he di ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ so bosɔɔhna ta.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Bɛl ɛɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘Bena waa teŋa nuanɛ yaa wola komɛlbwa kooni ta due kɛɛ yaa wola daa nɔna chaa nɔ, dɛ bɔkwaa yaa ba dɔe dɛ diɔ?’

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la do wer kohona bennumɛl la ta, ásɛ kondikwaa aa le o ta ba la won tel heya bene atoro.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Haa parɛ bennuatoro ta la, bennumɛl kondikwaa la ane ta ɛɛ kao, dɛ́ tel heyaa ka tel saŋ haa berɛ ba komɛ bennuanaarɛ kwa.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ berɛ harɛ yoɡa tɛ nɛn o den ɛ o kon kwara, dɛkalkɛ he ɡbabir kon laa. Men Korowii konee. He do kɛŋɔ hɔɔhra dɛɛ nyiŋi o ta.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa baa yoɡ harɛ tɛo la, ó jemɛ kɛŋɔ harɛ te la dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ó berɛ ba lɛ o kon.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Dɛ he bini bɛl nyao dɛɛ yoɡ o kondɔɔh kon bɛl aa, o lole tenten lɛ yawɛ.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Naate la ta lole bɛlbwa dɔe o yawɛ kon la dɛ berɛ ba dɔ suuɡa aa, ó kpɔ kon la ɛ o ɡbabir kon.

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛmpɛɛ yawa aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔɔ kem, dɛ harɛɛ yaa, ɡɛ naate fe aa parɔ ka tel mɔɔ bodia benanyoa tel la, ó bɔɔ o kem ɡɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ kon te la aa suuɡaa dɔ dɛ́ kpɔ lɛ o kon la tenaa, ó do naate nɔn ta ka tel bodia benanyoa la ta mɔɔ kon te la lɛ o kon.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl yoɡ dem waa lɔ bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛjen baro ta naa, o berɔ dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ berɛ bɔ o kem, dɛ́ lɛ o kon benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ naate ta wone bɔ kem la dɛ lɛ dem la benanyoa beŋkpoŋ la tenten ta naa, o ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ ó won lɛ kpa. O berɛ naate waa yawa la ne o naanar kon, baa wola berɛ kpɔ kon te kon tɛo kpa. Hale bodia bena la ta.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Deene aa lɔ bwɛjeɡre ta baa wola danjwɛjen bɛlbwa mae bara la tena te dɔ ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ́ bɔ a kem dɛ́ berɛ lɛ. Bodia bena la ɡe telaa, naate la won kon te kon kpɔe dɛ tɛo.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena te dɔ ŋwɛnɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ bɔ ba deene baa yoɡa ba bwɛɛre ta kem dɛ́ lɛ.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɛ Lewi dea te dɔ dem bwɛjena nɔ bɛlbwa ta dɛ yoɡ, o ta wone berɛ bɔ o kem dɛ lɛ aa, naate waa yawa la chɛ kɛ ó berɛ kon la tɛ bodia benanyoa la ta. Dɛkalkɛ deremi baa dɔa ba bwɛjena ta laanee ɛ ba ɡe kondɔɔh tenten Israel tena bini.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kondɛɛra dibɔra aa bar Lewi dea tena bwɛɛre dahare la ta chɛ kɛ ba yoɡa. A ɛ ba kondɔɔh aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ a le ba nɔn ta saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: He dɔŋ Israel te soɡe he baah dɛ nya o ta suuɡa dɔe dɛ́ cha o te naa, hé chao kɛŋɔ haa cha hɔɔh he ne waa soɡa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ o ta won so he baah ta.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Suuɡa bɛlbwa haa kemɔ la, hɛɛ berɛ a nee bɛlbwa kpɔe dɛ́ chɔŋɛ a ta, ɡɛɛ aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ yoɡ dawɛ kondikwaa haa yoɡ tɛo ta.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Men Korowiirii bola, menee le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ Keenan harɛ tɛ heyaa o ɛ he kon, dɛ ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: He dɔŋ Israel te nyao dɛɛ nyin o yoɡ o te tɛɛ kɛŋɔ yom aa, a ta chɛ kɛ hé ɡel o ɛ toma kɛŋɔ yom.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Gel ó so kɛŋɔ nɛn waa ba dɛ ɛ toma hɛɛ bɔɔ kem, kɛɛ hɔɔh waa bala dɛ ba so tama, dɛɛ tomɛ ka tel bodia benanyoa la ta.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ nɔɔ naate ne o bii ɛɛ ba ba lolanar be kaala, dɛ́ ka so ba kondɔɔh ta.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Israel tena aa ɛ n bonɔɔna n kpɔ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta ba nomanta, a ta chɛ kɛ bá yoɡ ba kɛŋɔ yoma.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Hé ɔmɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ban fiiɡi.

english_verse: If you want slaves, buy them from other nations
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ nyin yoma aa, hɛɛ won yaɡ ba le harɛre aa bar heyaa la ta.

english_verse: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won yawɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa baa so he bini tama, dɛ́ loɡle he harɛ ta bii bá ɛ he nɛndɔɔla. Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ he kondɔɔh,

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ ba do he bii ɡe nɔn ta kɛŋɔ he kapɛrɛ kwa, ásɛ baa tom ba dɛ ka tel saŋ baa ba serewe. Kɛ hɛɛ berɛ he bala Israel tena fiiɡa.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛŋhɔɔh waa soɡe he bini dɔ suuɡa, asɛ he bini bɛl nya dɛ yoɡ o te tɛo kɛŋɔ yom kɛɛ dɛ tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra la lolanar bini bɛlbwa naa,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: o ta dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ bá lɛo ba o nɛra bini. O lolanar bini bɛl ɛɛ won bɔ o nyu kem la dɛ́ lɛo.

english_verse: by paying your owner for the number of years you would still be a slave before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: O ne naate waa yawɔ la kure saŋ waa yoɡ o te tɛo dɛ ka tel bodia benanyoa la ta. A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔɔ ɡɛ haa kpɔ nɛn o ɛ toma tɛɛ bene waa ɛ toma, he yon bɔɔ kem la.

english_verse: The longer the time until then, the more you will have to pay.
translation_verse: Dɛ a ka tama mɔɔ bodia benanyoa la tel aa, he nyiŋi dɛ́ bɔ suuɡa tama aa chɛa tɛo dɛ́ lɛ o te.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Nɛŋhɔɔh la nyiŋi naate kɛ o bonɔɔ waa kpɔɔ dɛɛ bɔɔ kem benanyoa bɛlbwa ken. Nyiŋi kɛŋɔ haa on fiiɡa bɛlbwaa fiiɡi.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, o ta wone lɛ o te dɛ ta do nɛn waa yawɔ la lɔɡa aa, o ne o bii bwa dɛ dɔ ba te bodia benanyoa la ta,

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ n bonɔɔnaa Israel tena n laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.”

english_verse: I am the Lord your God! So don't make or worship idols or images.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ voɡa kɛɛ kon haa sɛoh kɛɛ bwe kpɔ pa dɛɛ tomɔ. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ di n Ona Tɔpera la, ásɛ dɛ ɡel duure do n Dea bela. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: mɛɛ ɡeloo bwaala nɛ o saŋ ta kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ harɛ la ɛ kondikwaa kohona, daa haa dua he kooni ta ɡe bwa won nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo hé dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna harɛ la ta, ásɛ dɛ he chɔɔɡɔ kwaraa naa, nomɛlbwa aa won ba aah heya. Mɛɛ le kpɔɡ bini ola aa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa nee. Haa laa ɡbɔɡa ɡee no kpa.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo hé ti he dɔma dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ,

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he mun ya kohona, ásɛ n ne he fɔo yaa fɔwɛ la che.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ so he be n Tɛnte Dea la binii. Maa habɔɔ berɛ kpo heyaa bwa.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ, dɛ́ ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ he ɡe ɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, ásɛ he bɛ yoma ɛ tɛɛ ba kpa. Menee le heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa ta, dɛ́ ɡel a le he baŋa he paŋi dɛɛ valɛ la. Deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ deŋnetɛra

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: dɛ vɛh me Mmarare ne n waa ta teŋa, dɛ chɔɡ fɔo n ne haa fɔwa la aa,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: mɛɛ kpɔ ɔmee tenten ne bambiteŋa ne weela aa ba he nɛɛ he chah kahonɛ, ne bɔwɔrɔba aa kpɔ nyoŋa ba ta he nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ heya. Hɛɛ du kondikwa he kooni ta pɛɛpɛɛ, he dɔmaa dɛ́ ba dia.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: N sie ɛɛ beɡre he nɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he dɔma pɔ he nɛ, dɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he nɛ. Ɔmee kohona nomanta, hɛɛ dɛɛ chwaaɡoo dɛ nomɛlbwa aa heyaa doŋi.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Hale anɔ bwa habɔɔ dɛ haa n be no aa, mɛɛ berɔ ja he deŋnetɛra ta bele anuanɛ.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ he deŋnekpeɡ mbarafo we-ɛɛla bwaa, maa ɡel bwaala nɛ, ásɛ harɛ bwa hol dɛ́ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ buni ken.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: He koeh bwa dɛ ba pɛɛ ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ kondikwaa bɛlbwa ɛɛ chɔɡ he harɛ la taa, ásɛ daa ɡe aa nɔnɛ.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: He ta teŋɛ he deŋnekpeɡ la ta haa n waa ta teŋaa, mɛɛ berɔɔ ja he deŋnetɛra la ta bele anuanɛ.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ba jo he bini, dɛ́ ba kpoo he bii, dɛ́ chɔɡ he kondɛɛra bwa soo siwi. He bini tamaa kenii dɛɛ ba kae, anomanta, he ŋwɛnɛre ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Laa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta he nɛ, chɔɡa haa chɔɡ n ne he fɔo la wa. He dɛ nyin he nyuune dɛ chwa kaa bwɛɛre ta kaa sɔh aa, mɛɛ kpɔ weechɔɡaa ba ta he nɛ. Anɔ taa aa ba cheɡa hé kpɔ he te do he dɔma nɔɔra ta, ásɛ dɛɛ tom ba.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo kondikwaa waa do kpeɡri, ásɛ haahna fi pɛ wɔɔ he paanoo bwa kombeŋkpoŋ baa kpɔa dɛɛ wɔɔ paanoo bini. Baa maɡa tɛ heya he di haa vaɡre.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: ate mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia kohonaa ba ta he nɛ, dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne bele anuanɛ ɡwa wubwa la.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Lɔr la nomanta, hɛɛ chwe he bibaala ne he bihaahna olaa.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ bela haa dɛ tomɛ voɡa a do deŋɡarere dor laanee, ne he daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma fuih bɔra, ásɛ dɛ boa he lala nyoa dawɛ he voɡa aa wola mkpa bɛlbwa dɔe la ta, dɛ́ berɛ habɔɔ kpo heya.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ he bwɛjena ne bela haa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la bwaa. Ásɛ he sarahare haa fuah dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la, n sie aa a sɔɔh taa lɛ kpa.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Gɛ maa chɔɡ harɛ la ɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma baa ba so o ta la bambile chɔɡ kohona.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Kɛ he te, mɛɛ ɡeloo he peɡre, dɛ́ ka so nɛra bane harɛre ta. Laa nee mɛɛ ba heyaa doŋa, ásɛ dɛ paɡre he bwɛjena a berɛ dimɡbeeni.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ so harɛ la ta nomanta, wɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ ásɛ dɛ ɡe di Ona Tɔpera saŋ haa soɡe o ta he ta ɡelɛ o won onɛ la.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ ka lɔ dɔŋaa, dɛ́ choɡli dɛ nomɛlbwa ta he nɛɛ teŋɛ. Haa won che he dɔma bɛlbwa sie he ne ba yo.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Nɛra bane harɛre taa hɛɛ ba serewa, ásɛ ba huɡe heya.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Hé banɔ la haa ba ka dɛ́ do he dɔma harɛre ta la, he ne he naawa wechɔɡa nomanta, aa hiah heyaa.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel n baah di ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ka ta ba dɔma harɛ ta ŋɔ ba ka bela. Ba baa charɛ ba liire dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ aa,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: belaa mɛɛ ba ń lii n fɔo n ne Jekɔb ne Aesek dɛ Abraham aa fɔwa la wa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ harɛ maa baɡ ba nyoa la tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba bwa ɛɛ chwao le harɛ la ta, ásɛ o chɔ pɛɛ dɛ́ onɛ ɡɛ aa chɛa. Ásɛ dɛ bɔ ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la bwa kem, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh me Mmarare ta teŋa.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba ta lɔ ba dɔma harɛre ta kwaraa naa, maa ban ɡel, mɛɛ chɔɡ baa kɛŋɔ baa chɔɡ n ne ba fɔo yaa fɔwa la. Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ koh ba waa, dɛ́ lii n ne ba naawa fɔo yaa fɔwa la. Gɛ maa ɡela harɛre na n kpeɡri, dɛ lawɛ n nɛra le Ijipt harɛ ba siwi ta la wa. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Anɔɔ ɛ Mmarare Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ Sinai Bwejen la ta dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: “Kpɔ waa maa dɛ ba bola nɔ tɛ Israel tena. Dɛ nomɛl kpɔ nɛn tɛ Korowii dɛ́ kpɔ pur nyobaɡa aa, suuɡa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá bɔ o nyu ta ó dɔ o te laanee

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: Banomonome ɡe baa ɡwaa bene fifraanumɛl la, suuɡapoŋa fi dɛ anue, ásɛ haahna baa ɡwaa bene fifraanumɛl la ɡe suuɡapoŋa fi.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Kondikwaa bɛlbwa aa le harɛ la ta dɛ ɛ mea kɛɛ daa nɔna la, a chɛ kɛ he bɔne a bɛlbwa bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋa ba tɛ men Korowii. A ɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: Ba bɛ ondoŋ kpɔ charɛ ondɛɛɡe kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ondɛɛɡe charɛ ondoŋ. A ba ɡɛ naa, dɛ a bwa berɛ Korowii kwa dɛ do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn waa baɡɛ nyoa la ɛ nomɛl waa wola won dɔ suuɡa dɛ́ bɔ ɡɛ baa teŋa bil nɔ naa, ó lawɛ o nɛn la ba sɔfo sie, ásɛ o nyiŋi suuɡa aa chɛ kɛ ó bɔ la ta tɛo ó bɔ.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: Dɛ naate nyobaɡa kon la ɛ kondɛɛre waa wera kɛ ba kpɔ ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ ɡɛ kondɛɛre la do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o ɛ kondɛɛre waa wola were kɛ ba kpɔ ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ naate kpɔ ka chaɡle sɔfo.

english_verse: If you promise a house to me, a priest will set the price, whatever the condition of the house.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn kpɔ o dem tɛ ŋɔ o ɛ men Korowii kon aa, sɔfoo chɛ kɛŋɔ ó baɡle o wer ne o wer bɛ doe bwa dɛ́ baɡle o yoɡ. Gɛ bwa waa baɡle la, dɛ o yoɡii.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn kpɔ o harɛ pera tɛ men Korowii aa, kondwee baa du harɛ la taa baa ba cheɡa, dɛ́ chaɡle harɛ la yoɡ. Mea kuruware fi bɛlbwa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanue.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Dɛ naate kpɔɔ tɛ mɛ a bena baa berɛ bɛlbwa kon dɛɛ tɛo la ta naa, a chɛ kɛ yoɡ la che ɡɛ.

english_verse: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ a habɔɔ, o berɔ kpɔ tɛ mɛ naa, sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó na bene aa kaa mɔɔ ba berɛ bɛlbwa kon dɛɛ tɛo o ta la, dɛ́ ɡel o yoɡ ba harɛ tama.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Benanyoa baa berɛ bɛlbwa kon dɛɛ tɛo la telo aa, wɛɛ do ɡoroŋee dɛ́ berɛ n kon dɛ́ do sɔfore la nɔn ta.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn yawɛ harɛ waa wola ba dem kon pera ɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ mɛ naa,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó na yoɡ waa chɛa dɛ́ teŋe, dɛ́ ka tel a bena baa berɛ bɛlbwa kon dɛɛ tɛo la ta, ásɛ naate la bɔ yoɡ baa teŋa la awola tɔpere la tenten. Suuɡa waa bɔ la ɛ men Korowii kwa.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ benanyoa la ta la, a chɛ kɛ naate berɛ harɛ la tɛ kon te waa yawa dɛ le o be la.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Gɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea a ɛ suuɡa bwejeɡre fifraanɛ la taa baa ba nyiŋa, dɛ́ baɡle komɛlbwa yoɡ.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa bɛ kondɛɛre biloɡle kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ a ɛ n kwaa wubwa. Dɛ nao kɛɛ peerii yoo, o ɛ n kon.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ ó yoɡ kɛɛ dɛ berɛ yawɛ kon waa kpɔa ba tɛ mɛ dɛ ku n nɔn la. Dɛ nɛnee kɛɛ kondɛɛre kɛɛ harɛɛ yoo, o do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ mɛ, dɛ ɛ n kon pi.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn kwaraa ba kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta naa, nɛn aa won berɛ yawɔ kpa. Kpoe dena chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ó berɛ yawɛ a bini bɛlbwa naa, a chɛ kɛ ó bɔ yoɡ baa teŋa bil la, ásɛ dɛ bɔne yoɡ la bini bɔre anue, dɛ́ bɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ja a ta.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Kondɛɛre bɛlbwa bini onɔ la waa ja fi la do ɡoroŋ, dɛ ɛ men Korowii kon. Haa dɛɛ kura la, hé kpɔ konswɛm pe o bwara á chaɡle kɛ o ɛ n kon.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛ kondɛɛre te la chale a bini, dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl charɛ o dɔŋ. O ɛ ɡɛ naa, kondɛɛre anɛ la bwa ɛɛ berɔ ɛ men Korowii kwa dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won berɛ yawa kpa.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Mmarare nɔɔ Korowii che Mosis nɛɛ Sinai Bwejen ta, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta la, ba soɡe Sinai Bwejen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta. Ba soɡa bini bennɛɛte korobie waa teŋa nɛɛ o tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, Korowii bol waa Mosis be o Dea Cheremibɔr bela dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: Hé ne Árɔn kur ba ɡɛ. Hé kure le baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ dɛ́ won la laa.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Mosis ne Arɔn kpɔ ɡɛ nɛra baa kpɔ ba sɔna tɛɛ ba la,

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ yerɛ Israel tena bwa cheme korobinɛɛte la tɔpere waa tɔ sie la ta. Nɛra la yerɛ ba deene ne ba lolanar sɔna a baɡle bela baa lea, asɛ ba chwerɛ baala baa di bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ la sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa,

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Israel tena la ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken, ɡɛ tenten Korowii aa do Mosis la.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Kɛ Léwi dea tena la te baŋre ba tɛnte deene bar n Tɛnte Dea la, ásɛ n bandia bɛ Israel tena la bwa nɛɛ ba. Lewi dea tena laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ báa nyiŋi n Tɛnte Dea la bwa ta.”

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena te, ba ta ban kure ja a ɡɛ deene la baala nɛ.

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii fa ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Bɛ Lewi dea tena te kure á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔ baa ja ba bala Israel tena baa kur ba la nɛ.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ n Tɛnte Dea la kaa bobɛl la, Lewi dea tena laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ bá foromu. Dɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá baŋro ɡe aa, banee dɔ o baŋra. Nomɛlbwa waa wola dea la ta jae bɛne belaa, bá kpoo.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Israel tena la bɛlbwa baŋre o tɛnte dea bela o ɡbaɡba dea tena aa soɡa, dɛ́ pa ba ɡbaɡba dea fraŋkaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ,

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: “A chɛ kɛŋɔ Israel tena la baŋre ba tɛnte deene bar n Dea Cheremibɔr, ba ne o baah tɛr tama. Nómɛlbwa so o dea fraŋkaa jwɛh, bela o dea tena fraŋkaare aa lole.”

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue, lafraanumɛl fifraanue.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Israel tena baa kure ba deene nɛra bwa laanee la. Dɛ he kpɔ debele atotoro baa kura la dɛ ja dɔŋa nɛ aa, ba bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa lafraanumɛl dɛ batoro lafraanue fifraanue.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la, Lewi dea tena te, ba ta ban kure ja Israel deene la nɛ.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la, ɡɛɛ Israel tena la ɛ. Dea bɛlbwa vɔrɔwe o sobɔr bela o fraŋkaa aa paa. Dɛ ba dɛ nyin ira dɛ́ kaa bofale ɡe aa, ɡɛ tentenee bɛlbwa ne o dea ne o lolanar jemɛ ba bɔr dɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ valɛ.

english_verse: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
translation_verse: Arɔn dɔ bibaala banaarɛ. Banee Nadab waa ɛ binomoa, ne Abihu ne Eliasa dɛ Itama.

english_verse: were the ones to be ordained as priests.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba fuɡe no do ba nyuune ta dɛ ɛɛ ba sɔfore.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Kɛ Nadab ne Abihu kpɔ ba ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ buh nii aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ fuh ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii, Sinai Bwejen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, asɛ o kpoo ba. Ba ta bii dɔe, anomanta, dɛ Eliasa ne Itama ɡboo ja ba mɛɛ Arɔn nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ sɔfore toma. Lewi dea tena lee bá cha sɔfore

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
translation_verse: Le Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ́ kpɔ sɔfore toma la do ba nɔn ta. Nomɛlbwa waa wola sɔfo ɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ sɔfo toma la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo.”

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol waa Mosis be Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: “Kure Lewi dea tena ne ba lolanar bwa. Kure baala bwa, le bechale baa dɔ korobie beŋkpoŋ ka tel banomonome ta.”

english_verse: So Moses obeyed and counted them.
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis kur ba ɡɛ Korowii aa doo ŋɔ ó ɛ la.

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Lewi bibaalaa nɔ, Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari.

english_verse: Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔn dea biirii nɔ, Libni ne Simee.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohat ɡe dea biirii nɔ, Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Merari dea biirii nɔ, Maali ne Musi. Kenii Lewi dea tena ne ba lolanar waa do.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Gɛsɔn dea biirii Libni ne Simee tena.

english_verse: The Gershonites, under the leadership of Eliasaph son of Lael, were to camp on the west side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔn naanar bwa nomoa waa tɔ ba sie laanee Lael bibaa Eliasaf.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: N Dea Cheremibɔr toma baa kpɔa do ba nɔn ta laanee kɛŋɔ, báa nyiŋi o ne kwaa baa kpɔa bɔle o bini ne baŋ, dɛ o doonyoa pateesan la ta,

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: ne pateesanre aa bar bela dembaah la ne saraha kon la, ne pateesan waa tɔ dembaah la doonyoa, ne o ŋwɛɛra ta. Gɛ bwa aa chɛ kɛ bá ɛ anɔ bwa lɔ ba nɔn ta.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Kohat dea biirii Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.
