english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Ba tomaa kɛŋɔ báa nyiŋi Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ta, ne teebur ne kandea daa ne kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta la, ne koŋkwaa sɔfore aa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela, ne pateesan waa tɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ta. Gɛ bwa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ kwaa nɔ bwa ɛ toma lɔ ba nɔn ta.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Dɛ sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Eliasaa Lewi dea tena la nomoa. Onee ba le o chɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma Boɡoroŋ bela nyoa.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Merari dea biirii Maali ne Musi tena.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Abihail bibaa Suriel ɛ Merari dea bii bwa nomoa. Banee chɛ kɛ bá baŋre ba tɛnte deene Korowii Tɛnte Dea la habɔɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Mosis ne Arɔn ne o bibaala chɛ kɛ bá baŋre ba tɛnte deene Korowii Tɛnte Dea la sie wee leebɔr. Banee dɛɛ ba báa ɛ Boɡoroŋ bela toma, dɛ́ɛ tɛ Israel tena bwa. Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ Mosis toma ne sɔfo Arɔn toma la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena Mosis ne Arɔn aa kur ba ɡɛ Korowii aa do ba dɛ le bibaala baa di korobie beŋkpoŋ ta kaa banomonome ta la lɔ baala kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Kure Israel deene bibanloɡla baa di korobie beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ kaa la pɛ, dɛ́ chwerɛ ba bwa sɔna.

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: Le Lewi dea tena la tɛ mɛ bá chiɡ Israel biloɡla naa ta. Ba kondɛɛra ɡe ɛ n kwa dɛ chiɡ Israel tena bwa kondɛɛra aa loɡla la naa ta. Menee Korowii.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: “Lewi dea tena ne ba kondɛɛra bwa chɛ kɛ bá ɛ n kwa, dɛ́ chiɡ Israel tena bibanloɡla naa ta. Ba kondɛɛra la ɡe chiɡ Israel tena kondɛɛra biloɡla naa ta. Menee Korowii.

english_verse: But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra
translation_verse: Israel tena bibanloɡla aa ɡwaa Lewi dea baala lafraanɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ batoro nɔ,

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: bá kpɔ suuɡapoŋa anue charɛ bɛlbwa nyu, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea a ɛ suuɡa bwejeɡre fifraanɛ la.

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ nɛra baa ɡwaala la suuɡa tɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala.”

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la tɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ,

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kohat naanar la tomaa kɛŋɔ, báa nyiŋi kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ tenten ta, n Dea Cheremibɔr bela.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: Dɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ bá ir kaa bofale aa, Arɔn ne o bibaalaa chɛ kɛ bá jo dɛ́ ka laa pateesan waa saɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, kpɔ dɛ́ kpɔ tɔ o ta.

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne la bɔle pateesan la ta. Dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ yal waa ɛ burum tenten bɔle o ta, ásɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheo la suuɡi nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o loŋkoni la ta.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: Bá paɡri yaburum bɛl bɔle teebur Korowii paanoo aa dɛ dawɛ o ta la ta, dɛ́ pa tafolabɔtɔre ne loɡa ne lerwe baa dɛ do sen a bini, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ saraha dawɛ bela. Paanoo la baa yon kpɔ dawɛ o ta la chɛ kɛ ó ta dawɛ bela.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Bá kpɔ yaburum bɛl bɔle kandea daa la ne o kandere la ta, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ kwaa o ŋwɛɛra la, ne o loɡbakorɔre ne loŋa baa kpɔ noo dɛɛ do a bini, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ do kandere la ta.

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Ásɛ ba kpɔ mpo nae tɔne dɛ fɔrɔwe kandea la ne o kwaa bwa, dɛ́ kpɔ dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ chea la ta.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Bá kpɔ yaburum bɛl paɡri bɔle suuɡaswɛm kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la, dɛ́ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne bɔle, ásɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheo la suuɡi nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o loŋkoni la ta.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Bá kpɔ yaburum bɛl fɔrɔwe koŋkwaa bwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma Boɡoroŋ bela la, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne bɔle a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ chea la ta.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: Bá laa tɔɔ aa lɔ saraha kon baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo la pa, dɛ́ kpɔ yakɔl bɔle o ta.

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ pa koŋkwaa bwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma saraha kon la ta. Anee kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii, ne bune baa kpɔ toh ola, ne soofire, ne loɡa baa do chal kɛɛ nee a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ, dɛ́ kpɔa chɔŋɛ o ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne la bɔle a ta. Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheo la suuɡi nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o loŋkoni ta la.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ ba ira kaa bofale, asɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala tɔ laala aa do ɡoroŋ ne kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma la ta tonaa, mɔɔ Kohat naanar ká kpɔ che kaa. Kɛ ba bɛ a ɡɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la leɡe, ásɛ dɛ ba sewɛ. Banee dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ bá che n Dea Cheremibɔr laala ne o koŋkwaa bwa.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: Arɔn bibaa Eliasaa dɛɛ ba wɛɛ nyiŋi noo baa kpɔ dɛɛ choŋi kandere, ne daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, ne tɔpere bɛlbwa mea saraha, ne noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do nɛn sɔfore ta. Onee chɛ kɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi n Tɛnte Dea la ne o laala ne o koŋkwaa bwa ɡe ta.”

english_verse: The Kohathites must not go near or even look at the sacred objects until Aaron and his sons have covered those objects. If they do, their entire clan will be wiped out. So make sure that Aaron and his sons go into the tent with them and tell them what to carry. The Duties of the Gershonite Clans
translation_verse: Kohat naanar ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá jo, dɛ́ nyiŋi kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la, á ba ɛ kɛ baa kpɔ sie keŋkeŋnaa nyiŋi dɛ́ ba serewe.” Lewi dea bii baa ɛ Gɛsɔn dea tena

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ báa che n Tɛnte Dea waa ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr la pateesanre, ne kwaa baa kpɔa bɔle o bini, ne mpo nae tɔne baa kpɔa bɔle o baŋ, ne pateesan waa tɔ n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa la,

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: ne dembaah pateesanre aa bar n Tɛnte Dea la ne kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, ne pateesan waa tɔ dembaah doonyoa bela, ne a ŋwɛɛra ne koŋkwaa bwa baa dɛ ɛ ane toma bela. Gɛ bwa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ kwaa nɔ bwa ɛ toma lɔ Gɛsɔn dea tena nɔn ta.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Toma Gɛsɔn dea tena aa dɛ ba baa ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr laanee la. Sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Itamaa chɛ kɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ ba toma bwa ta.” Lewi dea bii baa ɛ Merari dea tena

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Ba toma baa ɛ belaa kɛŋɔ, bá che daa baa kpɔa baŋre n Dea Cheremibɔr la, o dachiɡri ne loɡa aa lɔ a mune dɛ a doli bwa,

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: ne dembaah dachiɡri ne a loɡa aa lɔ a mune, ne kwaa baa kpɔa baŋre tɛnte la ne ŋwɛɛra ne koŋkwaa bwa ne komɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ ɛ toma. Yerɛ baa bɛlbwa, dɛ́ kpɔ o bone waa dɛ ba cheɡa do o nɔn ta.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Toma Merari dea tena aa dɛ ba báa ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr laanee la. Sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Itamaa chɛ kɛ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ báa ɛ toma.” Lewi dea tena kura

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Ba baɡle nomɛlbwa o toma ne bone waa dɛɛ che, ɡɛ tenten maa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ do ba la. Gɛɛ aa do ba kure ba bwa ɡɛ maa do Mosis la.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Haahna ne baala bwa baa do ɡɛ la, bá le ba ne dahara, ásɛ ba bɛ doŋa ba kpɔ kah bela haa soɡa n do he baah ta la.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: “Ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, Dɛ haah kɛɛ baa ɛ o dɔŋ bɛl wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta naa, dɛ o jo men Korowii nɛ. Naate di bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ó bol wechɔɡa waa ɛa la, dɛ́ bɔ kwaa baa lɛo la bwa, dɛ́ berɛ bɔne anɔ la waa bɔa la bini bele anue, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ja a ta tɛo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Dɛ naate waa ɛo wechɔɡa la sewaa, a chɛ kɛ ó bɔ tɛ o lole tenten. Dɛ o ta ɡɛ nɛn dɔe yaa, a ɛ men Korowii kwa. Ó bɔ tɛ sɔfo la dɛ́ kpɔ pebal ja, ásɛ sɔfo la kpɔ soŋe naate wechɔɡa n be ń kpɔ kɛo.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa kwaa waa kpɔ ba tɛ sɔfo ɛ sɔfo la kwa. Haah waa le o jaa habɔɔ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: dɛ o jaa la baa dɔ a liire kɛŋɔ haah la kah doŋa dɛɛ meeraa, hale dɛ o ta doŋa kaeh yoo,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: a chɛ kɛ báa la kpɔ o haah la la sɔfo be, dɛ́ che haah la naa ta, dɛ́ nyin men aa kpera kuruwa beŋkpoŋ, dɛ bɛ noo kɛɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma baa dɛ fuah a ta do, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɛ mea saraha dɛ tɛ meera. A ɛ saraha aa dɛ baɡle kɛ nɛn di bolchɔɡe kɛɛ o ta bolchɔɡe dii.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la chɛ kɛŋɔ, ó kpɔ haah la ba che men Korowii sie,

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ ɛ vii bini nee aa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛ́ ɛ n Tɛnte Dea bela harɛ teera, dɛ́ kpɔ do nee la ta, ásɛ a do kpeli.

english_verse: Next, he will remove her veil, then hand her the barley offering, and say, “If you have been faithful to your husband, this water won't harm you. But if you have been unfaithful, it will bring down the Lord's curse—you will never be able to give birth to a child, and everyone will curse your name.” Then the woman will answer, “If I am guilty, let it happen just as you say.”
translation_verse: Kórowii ɡel nee nɔ aa dɛ ba nyotaahna ne nɔ jo he bwara, dɛ́ ɡel he hwie serewe, dɛ́ do jeɡre, he tea su.’ Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, a chɛ kɛ haah la ŋɔ, ‘N sɛh ɡɛ. Kórowii ɡel á ɛ ɡɛ!’

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó chwerɛ nyotaahna waa la dawɛ kon ta, dɛ́ yaɡla do nee aa do kpeli la ta,

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: dɛ́ ɡel haah la nyɔ nekpela la aa dɛ ba nyotaahna ne o nɛɛ bala la, ásɛ a jooɡo dɛ́ ɡel o bwara nyɛɡo kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Ásɛ sɔfo la laa meera mea saraha la lɛ haah la nɔn ta, dɛ́ ɡɔɔra nyundua men Korowii sie, dɛ́ kpɔ kaa kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta,

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: dɛ́ ɛ mea la nɔndel, dɛ́ fuah bela tɛ men Korowii, name dɛ́ ɡel haah la nyɔ nee la.

english_verse: If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people.
translation_verse: Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ o le o jaa habɔɔ kpela dɛ ka chɔ banfale dɛ kah doŋa dɛ nyɔ nee la aa, aa jooɡoo, dɛ́ ɡel o bwara nyɛɡo kɛrɛdɛ o tea su, o hwie serewe dɛ́ do jeɡre, ásɛ o nɛra na kɛŋɔ nyotaahna lawɔ.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah la ta doŋa kaeh o tea too te naa, baa tao tɔɔ, o ta bolchɔɡee dii kpa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ lolɛ.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: kɛɛ dɛ baa dɔ liire kɛŋɔ o haah le o habɔɔ dɛ ka chɔ banfale dɛɛ meeraa, sɔ́fo la ɡel ó ba che men Korowii sie, dɛ́ teŋɛ waa bwa Mmara la aa baɡla la ta.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Baa la te aa bolchɔɡee di a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, dɛ haah la di bolchɔɡe aa, o ɡboo dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra o wechɔɡa la wa.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Dɛ haah kɛɛ baa dɛ nyin kɛ o baɡɛ nyoa dɛ́ kpɔ o te tɛ men Korowii kɛŋɔ Nasiri te aa,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: amɔ te, o bɛ ɡrepo daa nɔna baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen ne seŋkpeɡa bɛlbwa nyɔ. O bɛ sennyɛɡa baa kpɔ ɡrepo nɔna kɛɛ seŋkpeɡa bɛlbwa ɛa la nyɔ. O bɛ ɡrepo nɔnlwɛɛ kɛɛ daa nɔna aa hola di, dɛ bɛ a nee ɡe nyɔ.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: O bɛ nɛn waa sewa jwɛɛh la saŋ waa kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ la bwa.

english_verse: not even that of your father, mother, brother, or sister. That would make you unclean. Your hair is the sign that you are dedicated to me, so remain holy.
translation_verse: Le saŋ waa pere o te dɛ kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ la bwa la, o do ɡoroŋ tɛ men Korowii.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: Dɛ Nasiri te siwi pa nomɛl nɛɛ o sewaa o kah doŋa, ó so ka tel tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ fonɛ o nyu ne o tampona, ate dɛ doŋa waa kaah laanee o sɔ ta la.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ásɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, ó lawɛ borɔnomare anɛ kɛɛ kulukukure bii anɛ ba tɛ sɔfo, n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ jumbie la bɛl ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ nɛɛte la ɡe ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe naate wechɔɡa tɛo n be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɛ wechɔɡa dawɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ o siwi aa pa o nɛɛ o sewɛ la. Ó laa doŋa bwa kpɔ o nyu ta awola tenten dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ó berɛ kwaa kpɔ o te tɛ men Korowii kɛŋɔ Nasiri te, kɛ ó kpɔ pebale waa di benanyoa ba ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha tɛ mɛ. Tɔpera la o fa aa baɡɛ nyoa la ta jae kpa, dɛkalkɛ a taa o kah doŋa la.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: Saŋ nɛn aa kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ kɛ Nasiri te la baa ɡaraa, a chɛ kɛ bá kpɔɔ ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela,

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: ásɛ o kpɔ saraha kwaa ba tɛ mɛ. Anee pebal waa di benanyoa waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne pelor waa di benanyoa waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ pebal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Ó kpɔ mea sarahare ne sen sarahare ne paanoo wɛɡrɛ del iisi aa wola toole a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ do noo a ta, ne biskeeti baa kpɔ noo koo a ta dɛ́ kpɔ ba.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la kpɔa ba men Korowii sie ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ne saraha baa dɛ fuah tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ a ɡɛ Nasiri te la ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa, dɛ́ ba fonɛ o nyumpona waa kpɔ o te tɛ men Korowii dɛ ŋɔ waa an fonɛ la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ nyumpona la do deŋnesɔɔhna saraha nii la ta.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: Nasiri te la aa fonɛ o nyumpona tonɛ la, sɔfo la kpɔ pebal vam baa daalo ne paanoo ane soo siwi baa dɛ do noo a ta, ne biskeeti baa wola iisi a bɛlbwa ta doe beŋkpoŋa le wɛɡrɛ la bini do o nɔn ta.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Ásɛ sɔfo la berɛ laa lɛ, dɛ́ ɡɔɔra nyundua, dɛ́ viiɡa men Korowii sie, a ɛ saraha aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɛ sɔfo la kwa, ane pee la bambile baa ɡɔɔro nyundua, ne o hwii baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha la. A ɡɛ waa nɔ habɔɔ la, Nasiri te la dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó nyɔ sen.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: ó bol Arɔn ne o bibaala be kɛŋɔ kenii chɛ kɛ bá swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel tena,

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: “Kórowii kwaa he kwa, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ.

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Ó nyiŋi he nɛɛ, dɛ́ na he sum.

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Ó ɛ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa deŋnesɔɔhna.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala ɛɛ ba sweera tɛ Israel tena, ásɛ n ɡel ba na som.”

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Asɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ nomonome la ba fa aa lee ba le ba deene ne lolanar bini ba kure nɛra la ɛ sarahare.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: “Lɛ kwaa baa kpɔ ba ɛ toma n Dea Cheremibɔr bela la. Kpɔa tɛ Lewi dea tena la, ɡɛ ba bini bɛlbwa toma aa doa.”

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis lɛ kwaa la bwa, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena la.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: Dɛ kpɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo la anaarɛ ne nabala anuatoro tɛ Merari dea tena, dɛ le ɡɛ ba toma aa doa. Sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Itamaa ba sitɔɔ.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Kɛ Mosis ta Kohat dea tena te tɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la, anee ba kpɔ do ba nɔn ta, baa dawa vam.

english_verse: kilograms, according to the official standards;
translation_verse: ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha,

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanaarɛ wee la, Gedeɔne bibaa Abidanee kpɔ o kwaa be. Bɛnjamen dea o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa Mosis aa jo Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela, o ne Korowii bol waa la, o dɛ no taa la dɛɛ le Kerobim la baah ta. Ba sɛah chɔŋɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la doa. Belaa Korowii do dɛ bol waa o be.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Ŋɔ Arɔn be kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ kandea daa la ne o kandere anuanɛ la ba cheɡ, ásɛ a sie chaɡɛ boɡoroŋ bela dɛ́ won chaahna kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Gɛ baa ɛ kandea daa la, suuɡaswɛm ɡbosoo nee ba loɡɔ, le o mun ta kaa o numoli aa do kɛ daa fee la ta. Gɛ tenten Korowii aa baɡle Mosis laanee o ɛo. Lewi dea tena lee cheɡ tɛ Korowii

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: The Levites must be acceptable to me before they begin working at the sacred tent. So separate them from the rest of the Israelites
translation_verse: “Lawɛ Lewi dea tena le ba dɔŋa Israel tena la bini, dɛ́ sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta dɛ́ lee ba cheɡ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Gel ba kpɔ nabale ba, dɛ́ kpɔ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta ɛ mea saraha ja o ta. Berɛ lɛ nabale la bɛl ja, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Yerɛ Israel tena la bwa cheme, dɛ́ ɡel Lewi dea tena la ba che n Dea Cheremibɔr la sie.

english_verse: where the people will place their hands on them.
translation_verse: Ba Lewi dea tena la ne men Korowii sie, ásɛ Israel tena la kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: Arɔn chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ Lewi dea tena ba kɛŋɔ saraha kwaa Israel tena aa ba a ne, ásɛ o ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ saraha baa ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa n sie ken, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛ́ won ɛ men Korowii toma.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena la aa kpɔ nɔɔra darawe nae la nyuune ta tonɛ la, bá kpɔ beŋkpoŋ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ mɛ, asɛ dɛ kpɔ nɛɛte la ɡe ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe Lewi dea tena wechɔɡa n be tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: Gel Lewi dea tena la che Arɔn ne o bibaala sie, ásɛ he kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ saraha kwaa baa ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa n sie ken.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Gɛ we-ɛɛla nɔ taa aa ba cheɡa he le Lewi dea tena le Israel tena baa kaa la bini tɛ mɛ, ásɛ ba ɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Sɔ Lewi dea tena la doŋa ta, bá do ɡoroŋ, dɛ́ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ saraha kwaa baa ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa n sie. He tonaa, a chɛ kɛ ba ba n Dea Cheremibɔr bela, dɛ́ ba ɛ ba toma.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ n fa aa kpo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla la taa n le Israel tena bibanloɡla, hale ba kondɛɛra biloɡla bwa, ba ɛ n kwa.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: N kpɔ Lewi dea tena nɔ chiɡ Israel tena bibanloɡla naa ta.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Israel tena bwa bini la, Lewi dea tenaa n kpɔ do Arɔn ne o bibaala nɔn ta baa cha ba, dɛ́ che Israel tena naa ta dɛɛ ɛ toma n Dea Cheremibɔr bela. Bá soŋe ba wechɔɡa men Korowii be dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, ásɛ dɛ bɛlbwa la Boɡoroŋ la jwɛɛh kwara naa, weechɔɡa bɛlbwa bɛ on pu.”

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la, ɡɛɛ o ne Arɔn dɛ Israel tena bwa ɛ Lewi dea tena la.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena la sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta dɛ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ chɛɡɛ ba laala. Asɛ Arɔn ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ saraha kwaa baa ɡɔɔra nyundua, dɛ viiɡa Korowii sie ken, dɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa tɛɛ ba, dɛ sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta ba do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Baa ɛ ɡɛ tonɛ la, Lewi dea tena pa mun kaa ɛ toma Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela, asɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala ɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ. Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis ŋɔ bá ɛ Lewi dea tena la, ɡɛɛ ba ɛ.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: A ɡe habɔɔ la, wɛɛ cha o bala n Dea Cheremibɔr bela, kɛ o bɛ toma la lɛ dawɛ o nɛ. Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ Lewi dea tena toma baa dɛ ba ɛɛ do ba nɔn ta.”

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Mosis aa kpɔ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta, bennɛɛte korobie beŋkpoŋ ta la, Korowii bol waa o be Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: to say to the people, “Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: “Ŋɔ Israel tena la be baa di Galekaa Tɔpejen la o saŋ ta.

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: anee ba di ɡɛ tɔpejen la Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, korobie waa tɔ sie, tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta jɔmɔra wee aa le harɛ la. Ba ɛ wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ tenten Korowii aa do Mosis la.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Ba bini bane ta wone di Galekaa Tɔpejen la awola, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba leɡe nomɛl waa sewa dɛ kah doŋa. Anomanta, ba la Mosis ne Arɔn be awola tenten,

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Ya ta wone di tɔpere la doŋa yaa kaah dɛ le nomɛl aa sewa ya leɡo la wa. Kɛ bɔkwaa dɛɛ tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ, ya ne yabala Israel tena la bwa aa wola won pɛ kpɔ ya saraha kwaa saŋ nɔ ta ba tɛ Korowii ɔ?”

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Hé che bonɔ ásɛ n la ka no le Korowii be, ɡɛ waa do mɛ he waa nɔ wa.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: “Gel Israel tena la no kɛŋɔ, dɛ ba bini bɛlbwa kɛɛ ba naanar bɛlbwa leɡe nɛn waa sewa dɛ kah doŋa, kɛɛ dɛ bobɛlee ba kaa ba ta wone di Galekaa Tɔpejen la aa,

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: a chɛ kɛ bá diu korobinɛɛte tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta jɔmɔra wee aa le harɛ. Bá kpɔ pebie ja papojeɡre ane aa do nyɛɡre ne paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe ta dɛ́ di.

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: Ba bɛ ane kpɔ cheɡ tɔɔ per a ta, ba bɛ pebie la hoɡa ɡe bɛlbwa paɡre. Bá di Galekaa Tɔpejen la aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ teŋɛ o we-ɛɛla bwa ta.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa ta doŋa kaeh, o ta bobɛlbwa ɡe kaalɛ dɛ saah vɛh tɔpejen la dii yaa, baa naatee kure ja n nɛra nɛɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta o saraha kwaa kpɔe ba tɛ men Korowii a saŋ ta. Naate nyin waa dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ chɛ deŋnetɛra.

english_verse: As soon as the sacred tent was set up, a thick cloud appeared and covered it. The cloud was there each day, and during the night, a fire could be seen in it.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ aa ɛ, dɛ bam la baa tɔ o ta webaŋa ɡe aa, jwaana dɛ o berɔ do kɛŋɔ nii ken.

english_verse: The Lord used this cloud to tell the Israelites when to move their camp and where to set it up again. As long as the cloud covered the tent, the Israelites did not break camp. But when the cloud moved, they followed it, and wherever it stopped, they camped and stayed there,
translation_verse: Saŋ te bɛlbwa bam la aa tɔ o nyundua bela biɡri la, Israel tena la dɛ no ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ baɡ ba dɛ so dɛɛ biɡri.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Tɔpera anɛ kɛɛ korobie kɛɛ benanyoaa bam la ɛɛ ba Korowii Tɛnte Dea la nyundua tɔe ka tel aa, ba dɛ so bela. Kɛ awola waa den le o ta la, dɛ ba iro teŋɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: “Gel bá kpɔ suuɡapoŋa loɡɛ bɛle anɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ hoh dɛɛ yerɛ Israel tena ba chema bini, ne ba ira dɛ́ kaa bofale ta.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba hoh bɛle anɛ la bwa naa, nɛra la bwa chɛ kɛ bá cheme he sie n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Bɛla beŋkpoŋii ba hoh aa, dɛ Israel deene nomonomee chɛ kɛ bá ba cheme he sie.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: O baa si nɛɛtena aa, nɛra baa soɡe Korowii Dea la weekaŋle harɛbɔr denaa ta la ɡe ir teŋɛ. Bɛle sii laanee dɛɛ baɡle ba ira dɛ́ kaa.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra la bwa yera dɛ cheme ɡee yaa, bɛle la sii korɛ.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Arɔn bibaala sɔfore la ɡboo chɛ kɛŋɔ baa hoh bɛle la. A ɛ Mmara dɛ chɔ le tɛ ba naanar baa ka ba bwa.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba kaa jo ba harɛ ta, asɛ ba dɔma ba puu ba dɛɛ yo aa, bá hoh bɛle la. Men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la ɛɛ lii ba waa, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Ba sie baa lɛ ba benanyoa ne Korobifala Tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ dɛɛ dia ta naa, bá hoah bela baa kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah, ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha dɛɛ ba la, ásɛ a chɔ le dɛɛ lii ba n wa. Menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.” Israel tena Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ira dɛ́ kaa

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta bennɛɛte korobie anɛ, tɔpera fifraanɛ habɔɔ la, bam la le Korowii Tɛnte Dea la nyundua bela.

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Ate, Israel tena la le Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, ba ɡaaɡa dɛ so dɛɛ ir bwa bini la, bam la berɔ ka che Paran pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Belaa ba pa mun ir, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ do ba la.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Juda dea ne deene aa ja ba nɛɛ tɔ sie, ba ne ba fraŋkaa. Asɛ Aminadab bibaa Naasɔn ɛ ba sitɔɔ.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Suar bibaa Nɛtanɛl ɡe chɔ Isaaka dea tena nyoa.

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: Hɛlɔn bibaa Eliab ɡe chɔ Sebulon dea tena nyoa.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Asɛ ba foromi Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bwa dɛ kpɛrɛwo, asɛ Gɛsɔn ne Merari dea tena la chea dɛ teŋɛ.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Rubin dea tena ne deene aa ja ba nɛ ɡee ira teŋɛ, ba ne ba fraŋkaa. Asɛ Sɛdor bibaa Elisur ɛ ba sitɔɔ.

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Surisadai bibaa Sɛlomeɛl ɡee chɔ Simeon dea tena nyoa.

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Asɛ Dewɛl bibaa Eliasaf chɔ Gad dea tena nyoa.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Kohat dea tena laanee cheɡɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bini laala aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɡe teŋɛ. Gɛrsɔn ne Merari dea tena la dɛ baŋre Korowii Tɛnte Dea la mɔɔ Kohat naanar yon tel bela.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Efrem dea tena ne deene aa ja ba nɛɛ ɡe le dɛ kpoŋe ba fraŋkaa teŋɛ. Asɛ Amihud bibaa Elisama ɛ ba sitɔɔ.

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Pedasur bibaa Gamaleɛl ɡee chɔ Manasɛ dea tena nyoa.

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: Asɛ Gedeɔne bibaa Abidan chɔ Bɛnjamen dea tena nyoa.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Dan dea tena ne deene baa ja ba nɛɛ ɡe ka Israel tena la bwa mun ta, dɛ kpoŋe ba fraŋkaa. Banee yon ka mun ásɛ ba dɔma bɛ won dɔ bɔr dɛ́ le bobɛlbwa ba yoo ba. Asɛ Amisadai bibaa Ahiesa ɛ ba sitɔɔ.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Okran bibaa Paɡiel ɡee chɔ Aasa dea tena nyoa.

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: Asɛ Enan bibaa Ahiraa chɔ Naftale dea tena nyoa.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Israel tena vala baa valɔ la, ɡɛɛ ba valɔ denaa ta.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Dɛ Mosis helabaa sɔne Jetro dɛ ɛ Midian te. O bibaa sɔne Hobab. Awola bɛl, Mosis ŋɔ Hobab be ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ ba ira kaa harɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ yaa la ta. O baɡɛ yaa nyoa ŋɔ bela ɛɛ do werii tɛ yaa. Yaa ka nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛɛ, anomanta, ɡel ya ne he kaa.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Anee Hobab chaŋe ŋɔ, “Akai, maa la. Mɛɛ berɔɔ kaa n harɛ ta n nɛra be.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Ate Mosis ŋɔ, “N poori, bɛ kaa ɡel yaa. Henee jemɛ bɔra aa wera ya ka baŋre ya tɛnte deene, dɛ́ so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ ta. Hɛɛ won nyin bodɛɛɡe tɛ yaa.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh ya ne he kaa laa, kondɛɛɡa Korowii aa ka tɛ yaa la, yaa tɛɛ anee.”

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba pa mun valɛ le Sinai Bwejen la ta, dɛ valɛ tɔpera atoro. Lewi dea tena cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la tɔ ba sie tɔpera atoro, dɛɛ ɡaaɡe bela waa dɔ tɛɛ ba bá so.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la tɔ sie baa kaa la, Mosis yon ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ir tɔ ya sie! Lɔ he dɔma bwa peɡre, ɡel ba bwa chwa le he sie!”

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa baa ka choɡ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, Mosis yon berɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, berɛ ba ja he nɛra Israel tena kaɡboŋa baa wola won kur ba nɛ.”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: A kaa ba kɛŋɔ Israel tena la dɛ naɡre ba wenaale wa, asɛ a chole Korowii deŋne ta. Waa noa la, bwaawee lawɔ, o ɡel nii le bela baa soɡa la, dɛ chɔɡ o baŋ bɛl.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Belaa ba wi no Mosis, asɛ o soŋe Korowii nii la dime.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba pa bela sɔn Tabera, dɛkalkɛŋɔ belaa Korowii ɡel nii le dɛ ba fuh. Chayambwibwi Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Israel tena

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra bane baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ lɔ ba bini ba ne baa kaa, ba pɛla lawɛ kondikwaa tenten. Asɛ Israel tena la ɛɛ wi kohona ŋɔ, “Leperaa yaa ba ola dɔe dɛ́ chwe o?

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ lii pɛŋa yaa dɔa pɛɛpɛɛ dɛɛ chwe Ijipt harɛ ta, ne kwaane baa dɛ yera kokumba ne kɛɛne, ne ɡaabu ne jende, dɛ kwaane baa dɛ yera ɡaalek.

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Taraken komɛlbwa pɛla aa yaa dɔ, komɛlbwa toole yá di ka ja maana nɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: The manna was like small whitish seeds
translation_verse: Maana la do kɛŋɔ boyubi waa toa.

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis pɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, bɔkwa waa he kpɔ ɡɛ wahala nɔ dawɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛɛ ken ɔ? Bɔkwaa n ɛ dɛ jo he nɛɛ, he kpɔ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ waa bwa dawɛ n nɛɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.
translation_verse: Menee kpoŋe ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa teene dɛ lol ba kɛɛ? Ɛrɛɛ he ŋɔ ń nɔɡ ba kɛ haah ne bie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛ haa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa dɛ ŋwɛɛ ja a ta la ta nɔɔ?

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: N ɡbo aa won kpoŋe ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa, ba ɡwaa n nɛ.

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Dɛ kenii hɛɛ ba men ɛɛ te naa, den kpo mɛ taraken. Dɛ n we-ɛɛla su he siwi te naa, bɛ ɡel n do le ásɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ba di mɛ.”

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tuu ba, n ne he ba bol waa bela. Mɛɛ ɡeloo n Doma waa lɔ he Mosis nɛɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ kpeɡri la ba so ba nɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe lɛɛ waa aa ɡwaa he nɛɛ la ane, ásɛ a bɛ he ɡbo nɛɛ dawɛ.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ nɛra la be bá sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta, dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ Korowii be pera dɛɛ kpa kere. Hɛɛ dɔ olaa chwe. Korowii no he wii kɛŋɔ he fa aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta la dɛ a wer tɛ heya, he dɔ ola dɛɛ chwe taeh, kɛ taraken te haa dɔe dɛɛ chwe kpa. Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ tɛ heyaa olaa hɛɛ chwe name.

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ chwea korobibir bwaa a ba lawɛ heya, dɛ́ pe heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he vɛh Korowii, onee ja he nɛɛ he soɡa bini. Kɛ he wi o siwi ta ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwaa ɡela ya le Ijipt harɛ te nɔ?’ ”

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: Dɛ ya kpoo ya peera ne nae, hale pɛŋa aa lɔ mpo bini bwa kwaraa naa, aa tel baa yaa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.”
translation_verse: Korowii chaŋe Mosis ŋɔ, “N kpeɡri aa won tel ɡɛ kɛɛ? Hɛɛ nao name kɛŋɔ waa maa bola la ɛ kpela kɛɛ a ɛ nyosone.”

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomonome la banɛ ta nomonome fifraanuanɛ la nɛɛ jae dɛ ba Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela dɛ te so ba tɛnte deene bini bela baa soɡa la. Banee Eldad ne Medad. Korowii Doma la kaa so ba ɡe nɛɛ kpeɡri ne bela baa lole la, asɛ ba bol Korowii wa.

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: Dɛ Nun bibaa Josua le o bonɔɔne saŋ bwa dɛ teŋɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛɛ chao. O ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ Mosis, ɡel bá ka kah ba, bá ɡel bola!”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Anee Mosis ŋɔ, “He meerɔ dɛɛ tɛ mɛ kɛɛ? N te fe dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡel o Doma ba so o nɛra bwa nɛ, ásɛ ba won dɛɛ bol o waa o kpeɡri ne.”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ peu bɛl ta, dɛ kpɔ chayambwibwire le mpo nyoa, dɛ ba perɛ bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la. A dawɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ kaa nyundua dɛ ɛ naɡale atoro, dɛ chɔ kaa bobɛlbwa kaa bojaŋ.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Ba taa lɔ ola la ta dɛɛ chwe aa wola tonɛ la, Korowii baah di ba nɛ, asɛ o kpɔ weechɔɡa ane ba ta ba nɛ.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do ba pa bela sɔn Kebrɔt Hataava, dɛkalkɛŋɔ belaa ba bini banɔ la ba pɛla aa dɔ kondikwaa tenten la serewe, ba huɡ ba.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Buɡ la ta, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Miriam be ŋɔ, “He nɛra batoro la bwa le ba n Dea Cheremibɔr bela.” Asɛ ba bwa le kaa.

english_verse: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.
translation_verse: Korowii cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua ta, dɛ tu ba che o Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela, dɛ yerɛ Arɔn ne Miriam, asɛ ba le ba che sie.

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “Hé no n waa nɔ, Dɛ n keame lɔ he bini naa, chaahna taa n che dɛ kpɔ n te dɛɛ baɡlo, dɛɛ bol waa o be deera ta.

english_verse: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.”
translation_verse: N ne o bol wa dɔŋa be, a bini chɔ kɛrɛdɛ, wobobeela laa. O dɛ na ɡɛ maa doa kɛrɛdɛ. Ɛrɛ waa haa wola ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ he bol n bonɔɔ Mosis waa nɔɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left
translation_verse: Korowii baah di ba nɛɛ kohona, dɛ kaa ɡel ba.

translation_verse: Waa tom ba ŋɔ bá ka sɔh nyiŋi Keenan harɛ la, o ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ́ kaa deŋɡarere harɛ la ta.

translation_verse: Toroma la berɔ ba Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Israel tena la bwa be Kades waa lɔ Paran pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta. Dɛ ba bol waa baa kaa na la Israel tena la bwa be, dɛ kpɔ harɛ la ta daa nɔna la baɡ ba.

english_verse: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.

translation_verse: Ɛrɛ waa Korowii kpɔ yaa dɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta ásɛ ba ba kpoo yaa nɔɔ? Baa lawɛ ya haahna ne biirii kaa. Ya berɔ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta fe ta bɔ naa?”

translation_verse: Asɛ ba ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ yá le nomoa waa tɔ ya sie, dɛ́ berɛ kaa ya ne Ijipt harɛ ta.”

english_verse: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡaeh lɛ Korowii nɛɛ dɛ vɛoh. He bɛ harɛ la ta nɛra ɡe ɔmɛ. Yaa wono pɔ ba nɛ, kwaa baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ a ta la toole kpa. Korowii teŋɛ ya nɛ, he bɛ ban ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: The crowd threatened to stone Moses and Aaron to death. But just then, the Lord appeared in a cloud at the sacred tent. Moses Prays for the People
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, nɛra la bwa bolɔ ŋɔ baa foɡre Josua ne Kaleb bweaa kpo. Belaa Korowii jirima ba o Dea Cheremibɔr bela, Israel tena la bwa na.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I have done great things for these people, and they still reject me by refusing to believe in my power.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo nɛra nɔ ɛɛ ba n nyubaah nyiŋa ɡela ɔ? Ba teŋɔ dɛɛ vɛɛh mɛ ŋɔ baa men yarada, hale n nyokpowe-ɛɛla maa ɛa ba bini la bwa habɔɔ.

english_verse: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.”
translation_verse: Weechɔɡaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta ba nɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba, kɛ he te, mɛɛ ɡeloo he mun ya kohona dɛ́ warɛ, dɛ́ do kpeɡri ɡwaa ba ɡɛ n fe aa ŋɔa mɛɛ ɛɛ ba la.”

english_verse: that you love to show mercy and kindness. And you said that you are very patient, but that you will punish everyone guilty of doing wrong—not only them but their children and grandchildren as well.

english_verse: You are merciful, and you treat people better than they deserve. So please forgive these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.

english_verse: But as surely as I live and my power has no limit,

translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ,

translation_verse: He te, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ taa hɛɛ ba serewa.

translation_verse: Baala baa laŋa dɛ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la bwa bini, Nun bibaa Josua ne Jefune bibaa Kaleb ɡboo kaa baa wola serewɛ.

translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices,

translation_verse: Waa ɛ Korowii nɛnhɛla dɛ chɔɡ o Mmarare nomanta, naate ta chɛ kɛ bá kuro ja o nɛra bini kpa. O wechɔɡa dawɛ o nɛ.” Nɛn waa chɔɡ Ona Tɔpere kpoe

english_verse: Once, while the Israelites were traveling through the desert, a man was caught gathering firewood on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Israel tena taa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela la, ba na baa bɛl wɛɛ nyin damara Ona Tɔpere ta.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the people to take that man outside the camp and stone him to death!”
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ chɛ kpoe. A chɛ kɛ Israel tena la bwa lawɔ kaa bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dahara, dɛ́ ka foɡro bwea kpo.”

english_verse: So he was killed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Tassels on the People's Clothes
translation_verse: Ate, ba bwa den lawɔ le dahara dɛ ka foɡro bwea kpo, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la. Jɔɔra nyara dɛ do batakaarere nyoo

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Sew tassels onto the bottom edge of your clothes and tie a blue string to each tassel.
translation_verse: ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He ne he naanar baa ka ba bwa, a chɛ kɛ hé nyarɛ jɔɔra dɛɛ do he batakaarere nyoo. Hé pɛrɛ ŋwɛn waa ɛ burum dɛ́ do jɔɔra la bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛɛ lii o Mmarare waa do heyaa a ta la bwa ta, dɛ do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God who led you out of Egypt.”
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ waa le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta ŋɔ hé baa tomɔ la. Onee Korowii.”

english_verse: Korah son of Izhar was a Levite from the Kohathite clan. One day he called together Dathan, Abiram, and On from the Reuben tribe, and the four of them decided to rebel against Moses. So they asked
translation_verse: dɛ ɛ Mosis dɔm. Ba ja baala lafraanɛ fifraanue bane baa lee ba ba ɛ nomonnyuune nomɛlbwa jemɛ ba wa, asɛ ba chɔ Israel tena bwa nyoa.

english_verse: and Aaron and said, “Why do you think you're so much better than everyone else? We're part of the Lord's holy people, and he's with all of us. What makes you think you're the only ones in charge?”
translation_verse: Ba pɛo dɛ la Mosis ne Arɔn be dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ɡwaa nomɛlbwa kɛɛ? Israel te bɛlbwa ɛ Korowii nɛra, o ja ya bwa nɛ. Ɛrɛɛ he ɡbo ɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ɡwaa Korowii nɛra bwa nɔɔ?”

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.
translation_verse: Mosis aa no ɡɛ la, o kpɔ o sie pi harɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii.

english_verse: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.
translation_verse: Belaa o ŋɔ Kora ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa be ŋɔ, “Kere chɔɔ Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo yá jemɛ naate waa ɛ o nɛn, dɛ́ ɡel naate ba o sie. Nomɛlbwa waa leo laanee dɛɛ ba wona la o sie.

english_verse: Korah, here is what you and your followers must do: Get some fire pans, fill them with coals and incense, and place them near the sacred tent. And the man the Lord chooses will be his priest. Korah, this time you Levites have gone too far!
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ do nii a ta kere, dɛ́ kpɔ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma do a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ka cheɡ Korowii sie bela. Yaa na naate Korowii aa leo o ɛ o kon. He Lewi dea tena te dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ɡwaa nomɛlbwa kohona!”

english_verse: You know that the God of Israel has chosen you Levites from all Israel to serve him by being in charge of the sacred tent and by helping the community to worship in the proper way. What more do you want?
translation_verse: Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa pere heyaa le he bala Israel tena bini, dɛ kpɔ heyaa bɛno ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ɛ o Tɛnte Dea la toma, dɛ́ berɛ che Israel tena bwa sie, dɛ́ cha ba baa tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ aa chɛa la, a ɡbo ta maɡraa?

english_verse: The Lord has given you a special responsibility, and now, Korah, you think you should also be his priest.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ he ne he bala Lewi dea tena bwa bɛne o te, kɛ taraken he berɔ dɛɛ nyin sɔfore ɡe dɛ di ja.

english_verse: You and your followers have rebelled against the Lord, not against Aaron.
translation_verse: Korowiirii he ne he bala baa teŋɛ he nɛɛ pɛ nyoa dɛɛ ɛo dɔm la. Arɔn te laa, asɛ hɛɛ naɡre o wa.”

english_verse: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they sent back this message: “We won't come!
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis yerɛ Eliab bibaala Datan ne Abiram ŋɔ bá ba, asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Yaa ba.

english_verse: It's bad enough that you took us from our rich farmland in Egypt to let us die here in the desert. Now you also want to boss us around!
translation_verse: Kpɔe haa kpɔ yaa le Ijipt harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ta, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ba ba kpoo yaa ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bonɔ ta maɡraa? Gɛɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ di kpeɡri ya nɛ aa?

english_verse: Moses was very angry and said to the Lord, “Don't listen to these men! I haven't done anything wrong to them. I haven't taken as much as a donkey.”
translation_verse: Belaa Mosis baah di ba nɛɛ kohona dɛ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n poori, bɛ ba saraha kwaa baa kpɔ ba tɛɛ lɛ! N ta komɛlbwa waa ɛ konjeɡa kɛŋɔ keeɡo kwaraa ba be lɛɛ, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ n ɛ ba bini bɛl wechɔɡa.”

english_verse: Then he said to Korah, “Tomorrow you and your followers must go with Aaron to the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Mosis ŋɔ Kora be ŋɔ, “Kere he ne he bala baa ja he nɛɛ la bwa ba Korowii sie, Arɔn ɡe ɛɛ ba bɛlee.

english_verse: The next day the men placed incense and coals in their fire pans and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nomɛlbwa kpɔ o kon, dɛ buh nii dɛ kpɔ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma do a ta dɛ kpɔ ba, asɛ ba ne Mosis ne Arɔn che Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Korah had convinced the rest of the Israelites to rebel against their two leaders. When that happened, the Lord appeared in all his glory
translation_verse: Kora aa yerɛ o bala baa wara la bwa cheme Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela la, Korowii jirima balɔ, nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa na.

english_verse: and said to Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Get away from the rest of the Israelites so I can kill them at once!”
translation_verse: “Hé pere he te le ɡɛ nɛra nɔ nɛ, ásɛ n won kpoo ba, ba waa den tonɛ buɡ nɔ ta.”

english_verse: But the two men bowed down and prayed, “Our God, you gave these people life. Why would you punish everyone here when only one man has sinned?”
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis ne Arɔn kpɔ ba sie pi harɛ dɛ do lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, nɛwɛnyina bwa mkpa lɔ he be, dɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, hɛɛ koh a waa he baah di ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa nɛ aa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered Moses,
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Tell the people to stay away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
translation_verse: “Ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ bá laa ba tɛnte deene laa kpɔ Kora ne Datan dɛ Abiram kwaa jwɛh.”

english_verse: Moses walked over to Dathan and Abiram, and the other leaders of Israel followed.
translation_verse: Belaa Mosis den ir la Datan ne Abiram be, asɛ Israel nomonome la teŋɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses warned the people, “Get away from the tents of these sinful men! Don't touch anything that belongs to them or you'll be wiped out.”
translation_verse: O kah nɛra baa cheme bela la ŋɔ, “Hé laa he te kpɔ nɛnchɔɡa nɔ tɛnte deene jwɛh! He bɛ ba komɛlbwa leɡe, ásɛ ba wechɔɡa maah heya, ásɛ he ne ba bwa bɛ pɛ serewe.”

english_verse: Moses said to the crowd, “The Lord has chosen me and told me to do these things—it wasn't my idea. And here's how you will know:
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Anɔ taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba liire ne laa mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, kɛ Korowiirii tom mɛ.

english_verse: If these men die a natural death, it means the Lord hasn't chosen me.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ sewɔ ɡɛ nɛra bwa aa dɛ sewɛ, ba seo ta koraa, amɔ te Korowii laa tom mɛ.

english_verse: But suppose the Lord does something that has never been done before. For example, what if a huge crack appears in the ground, and these men and their families fall into it and are buried alive, together with everything they own? Then you will know they have turned their backs on the Lord!”
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ waane aa wola chiɡe ka bwa ta, dɛ ɡel harɛ pere asɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ne ba komɛlbwa baa dɔa jo kaa harɛ bini ba serewe aa, anee hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ baala nɔ ɛ Korowii sisawa.”

english_verse: As soon as Moses said this, the ground under the men opened up
translation_verse: Mosis aa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa tonɛ la, belaa harɛ baa cheɡɛ o ta la den pere,

english_verse: and swallowed them alive, together with their families and everything they owned. Then the ground closed back up, and they were gone.
translation_verse: Ba joɔ kaa harɛ bini dɛ ba siwi ta lole, a den do kɛŋɔ baa huɡ ba ken, ba ne ba komɛlbwa baa dɔa. Harɛ nyoorɔ tɔ ba nɛ, ba nyoɡre kwaraa.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites heard their screams, so they ran off, shouting, “We don't want that to happen to us!”
translation_verse: Nɛra la aa joa dɛɛ kaa harɛ bini dɛɛ wi la, Israel tena baa lɔ baah bela chwao dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ chwa! Harɛ dɛ ba pera ya ɡe jo o bini kaa.”

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent a fire that burned up the
translation_verse: Asɛ nii le Korowii be, dɛ ba fuh nɛra lafraanɛ fifraanue baa dɛ fuh daawiile la bwa.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron's son Eleazar to take the fire pans from the smoldering fire and scatter the coals. The pans are now sacred,
translation_verse: “Ŋɔ sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Eliasa be ŋɔ ó laa kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ fuh daawiile la le kwaa aa dɛ fuh la ta, dɛ́ fuɡe a hɔla ka ta bojaŋ. A do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: because they were used for offering incense to me. Have them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar. Those men died because of their sin, and now their fire pans will become a warning for the rest of the community.”
translation_verse: Kwaa nɛra la aa kpoŋaa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ fuh daawiile a ta dɛ serewe la, hé lɔɔra a paɡri dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ tɔ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta. A te do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba kpɔa baa fuh daawiile Korowii sie. Hé ɡel a ɡɛ kwaa baa lɔɔra dɛ tɔ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta nɔ do le dɛ́ ja Israel tena bwa.”

english_verse: Eleazar collected the pans and had them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar,
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do sɔfo Eliasa lɔɔ ayaawa kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ fuh daawiile baala baa fuah la aa kpɔa ba dɛ serewe la, ba kpɔ dɛɛ tɔ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta,

english_verse: just as the Lord had told Moses. The pans were a warning to the Israelites that only Aaron's descendants would be allowed to offer incense to the Lord. Anyone else who tried to would be punished like Korah and his followers. The Israelites Rebel and Are Punished
translation_verse: ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ baɡle Eliasa la. Anɔɔ dɛ́ ja Israel tena kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola Arɔn naa mun leɛ ta chɛ kɛ ó la Korowii sie ka fuh daawiile. Bɛlbwa ɛ ɡɛ naa, Kora ne o bala waa aa puu ba laanee wɛɛ ba nae.

english_verse: The next day the people of Israel again complained against Moses and Aaron, “The two of you killed some of the Lord's people!”
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, Israel tena la bwa berɔ naɡre Mosis ne Arɔn waa ŋɔ, “He nɛra banɛ nɔɔ kpoo Korowii nɛra la.”

english_verse: As the people crowded around them, Moses and Aaron turned toward the sacred tent, and the Lord appeared in his glory in the cloud covering the tent.
translation_verse: Israel tena la aa pɛa dɛɛ naɡre waa Mosis ne Arɔn be la, ba berɛ sie ta Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela, buɡ la ta, ba na kɛŋɔ bam la baa tɔ o ta, asɛ Korowii jirima tɔ o bwa.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron walked to the front of the tent,
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis ne Arɔn la ka che Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la sie,

english_verse: where the Lord said to them,
translation_verse: asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Stand back! I am going to wipe out these Israelites once and for all.” They immediately bowed down and prayed.
translation_verse: “Hé laa he te kpɔ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bini, ásɛ n won kpoo ba buɡ nɔ ta ba waa tonɛ.” Asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn kpɔ ba sie pi harɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron, “Grab your fire pan and fill it with hot coals from the altar. Put incense in it, then quickly take it to where the people are and offer it to the Lord, so they can be forgiven. The Lord is very angry, and people have already started dying!”
translation_verse: Belaa Mosis ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile o bini la dɛ́ do ane o ta, dɛ́ buh nii le saraha kon la ta do o ta. Ɛ warane kpɔ kaa nɛra la baah ta, dɛ́ ka soŋe ba wechɔɡa Korowii be ó kpɔ kɛ ba. Korowii baah di ba nɛ, weechɔɡa la pa mun ba bini.”

english_verse: Aaron walked back and stood with Moses at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Weechɔɡa la nyoa aa sɔɔhna la, Arɔn berɛ kaa Mosis be Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Place these sticks in the tent right in front of the sacred chest where I appear to you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ daŋɡbale la ka bil n Dea Cheremibɔr, N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie bela maa dɛ cheme heyaa la.

english_verse: I will then choose a man to be my priest, and his stick will sprout. After that happens, I won't have to listen to any more complaints about you.
translation_verse: Naate máa leo ó ɛ sɔfo la, o daŋɡbala la ɛɛ moɡɛ papoonii, ásɛ n teŋe saŋ bɛlbwa naɡra Israel tena aa dɛ naɡre he waa a pe mɛ la ta.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had commanded, and they gave him the walking sticks from the twelve tribal leaders, including Aaron's from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be, asɛ ba nomonnyuune la kpɔ daŋɡbale fi dɛ anɛ tɛo, bɛlbwa kon beŋkpoŋ. Dɛ Arɔn ɡe kon jao.

english_verse: Moses took them and placed them in the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis pa ka teɡli Korowii Tɛnte Dea, O Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie.

english_verse: The next day when Moses went into the tent, flowers and almonds were already growing on Aaron's stick.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, Mosis kaa jo Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela, dɛ Arɔn daŋɡbala waa cheɡa tɛ Lewi dea tena la moɡɛ papooni, hale dɛ fe, dɛ nɔnɛ daa bɛl nɔna baa dɛ yera almɔn.

english_verse: Moses brought the twelve sticks out of the tent and showed them to the people. Each of the leaders found his own and took it.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis pa daŋɡbale la bwa aa lɔ Korowii sie bela la le dɛ ba baɡle Israel tena la, asɛ nomoa bɛlbwa ba nyiŋi dɛ kpɔ o kon.

english_verse: But the Lord told Moses, “Put Aaron's stick back! Let it stay near the sacred chest as a warning to anyone who might think of rebelling. If these people don't stop their grumbling about me, I will wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kpɔ Arɔn daŋɡbala la ka tel N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, ó do le dɛɛ baɡle lwɛmkpeɡ tena wa. Anee dɛ́ teŋe n waa baa dɛ naɡre nɔ ta dɛ bɛ serewe.”

english_verse: Moses did what he was told.
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis ɛ ɡɛ tenten Korowii aa doo la bwa.

english_verse: The Israelites cried out to Moses, “We're done for
translation_verse: Ate, Israel tena la ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Amɔ te, yaa serewoo! Ya waa bwa tonɔ kwaraa!

english_verse: and doomed if we even go near the sacred tent!”
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa bɛne Korowii Tɛnte Dea la kwaraa ɛɛ sewɔɔ. Ya bwa dɛ ba tona!”

english_verse: No one else is allowed to take care of the sacred tent or do anything connected with it.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá ba ja he nɛ, dɛɛ ɛ toma bɛlbwa sese aa lɔ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela. Kɛ nɛmpɛɛ bɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ba bela haa lole la.

english_verse: I alone chose the Levites from all the other tribes to belong to me, and I have given them to you as your helpers.
translation_verse: Men Korowii ɡbabirii le he bala Lewi dea tena le Israel tena bini, dɛ́ kpɔ ba tɛɛ, ásɛ ba kpɔ ba te che tɛ mɛ dɛɛ ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela toma.

english_verse: But only you and your sons can serve as priests at the altar and in the most holy place. Your work as priests is a gift from me, and anyone else who tries to do that work must be put to death. The Priests' Share of Offerings Given to the Lord (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: He ne he bibaala la ɡboo chɛ kɛ hé ɛ sɔfore toma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta ne pateesan la bini toma. N kpɔ sɔfore toma la dɛɛ kɛ heya. Nɛmpɛɛ bɛlbwa waa ba Boɡoroŋ la jwɛɛh la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.” Saraha kwaa aa ɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena kwa

english_verse: You are allowed to eat the meat of those animals, just as you can eat the choice ribs and the right hind leg of the special sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ola la kabora chɛ kɛ a ɛ he kwa, ɡɛ ba yon kpɔ a bambili ne a nadiɡ hwie ɛ saraha dɛ́ ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa men Korowii sie a ɛ he kwaa la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron: I have put you in charge of the sacred gifts and sacrifices that the Israelites bring to me. And from now on, you, your sons, and your descendants will receive part of the sacrifices for sin, as well as part of the grain sacrifices, and the sacrifices to make things right. Your share of these sacrifices will be the parts not burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Heyaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha baa wola an fuih a do ɡoroŋ kohona la bwa. Koŋkɛɛla bwa baa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ a do ɡoroŋ kohona la, hale dɛ mea saraha, kɛɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, kɛɛ bolchɔɡe dii sarahaa yoo, a ɛ he ne he bibaala dibɔr.

english_verse: Since these things are sacred, they must be eaten near the sacred tent, but only men are allowed to eat them.
translation_verse: Hé dia kɛŋɔ kwaa aa wera dɛ do ɡoroŋ kohona. Baa bɛlbwa won ane dii. A chɛ kɛ hé jemɛ kɛ a ɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona.

english_verse: You will also receive part of the special gifts and offerings that the Israelites bring to me. Any member of your family who is clean and acceptable for worship can eat these things.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa jaa dɛ ɛ he dibɔr laanee nɔ. Kwaa ba yon kwaa ane cheɡ dɛ́ le saraha kwaa bwa Israel tena yon kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ ɡɔɔra men Korowii sie la, n kpɔa tɛ he ne he bibaala ne bihaahna, á ɛ he dibɔr saŋ bɛlbwa. He dem nɛn bɛlbwa waa wola doŋa kaeh won a dii.

english_verse: For example, when the Israelites bring me the first batches of oil, wine, and grain, you can have the best parts of those gifts.
translation_verse: Kondikonloɡla ane kɛŋɔ ɔleve noo aa wera ne senfala aa wera dɛ meloɡla baa kpɔa baa tɛ men Korowii laanee n kpɔ tɛ heya.

english_verse: And the first part of the crops from their fields and vineyards also belongs to you. The people will offer this to me, then anyone in your family who is clean may have some of it.
translation_verse: Konloɡla ane bɛlbwa aa le harɛ la ta ba kpɔ ba tɛ men Korowii la bwa ɛ he kwa. He dem nɛn bɛlbwa waa wola doŋa kaeh won a dii.

english_verse: Everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me will now belong to you.
translation_verse: Israel harɛ ta komɛlbwa baa kpɔ ba ó ɛ men Korowii ɡbo kon la ɛ he kwa.

english_verse: The first-born son in every Israelite family, as well as the first-born males of their flocks and herds, belong to me. But every first-born son and first-born donkey must be bought back from me.
translation_verse: Israel tena bibanloɡla ne ba konaatena biloɡla ambala baa kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ la ɛ he kwa. Kɛ bibanloɡla ne konaatena baa kia biloɡla ambala te, a chɛ kɛ hé ɡel ba charɛ a nyuune.

english_verse: The price for a first-born son who is at least one month old will be five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Bibanloɡle waa di korobie la, hé kpɔ suuɡapoŋa anue charɛ o nyu, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea bela aa ɛ suuɡa bwejeɡre fifraanɛ la.

english_verse: However, all first-born cattle, sheep, and goats belong to me and cannot be bought back. Splatter their blood on the altar and send their fat up in smoke, so I can smell it and be pleased.
translation_verse: Nao kɛɛ pee, kɛɛ booh biloɡle waa ɛ ombal te, he bɛ a nyuune charɛ. A te ɛ n kwa. Hé kpɔ a chale merɛ saraha kon la ta, ásɛ dɛ fuh a noorare la kɛŋɔ saraha baa dɛ fuah. A sɔɔh ɛɛ do men Korowii somee.

english_verse: From now on, the sacred offerings that the Israelites give to me will belong to you, your sons, and your daughters. This is my promise to you and your descendants, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ bwa Israel tena aa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ he yon le ane cheɡ la, n kpɔɔ tɛ he ne he bibaala ne bihaahna á ɛ he dibɔr saŋ bɛlbwa. A ɛ fɔo dɛ chɔ le waa wola chɔɡ bwa dɛ tɛ n ne hen ne he naanar bwa.”

english_verse: You will not receive any land in Israel as your own. I am the Lord, and I will give you whatever you need. What the Levites Receive The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Haa dibɔr bɛlbwa Israel harɛ la taa dɔ ó ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon. Menee he dibɔr ne he kapɛrɛ.

english_verse: Ten percent of the Israelites' crops and one out of every ten of their newborn animals belong to me. But I am giving all this to the Levites as their pay for the work they do at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena te, Israel tena kwaa baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ baa tɛ mɛ laanee n kpɔ tɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ ba kapɛrɛ, toma baa dɛ ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela nomanta.

english_verse: They are the only ones allowed to work at the tent, and they must not let anyone else come near it. Those who do come near must be put to death, and the Levites will also be punished. This law will never change. Since the Levites won't be given any land in Israel as their own,
translation_verse: Lewi dea tenaa chɛ kɛŋɔ báa ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela toma, ásɛ dɛ toma ane ta aŋwɛnɛ ta kpɔe yaa, banee dɛ́ dɔ a deŋnetɛra le n be. A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ chɔ lee dɛɛ la, hale naanar baa ka ba bwa bini. Ba te ta kapɛrɛ bɛlbwa dɔe Israel tena bini.

english_verse: they will be given the crops and newborn animals that the Israelites offer to me. What the Levites Must Give
translation_verse: Israel tena kwaa baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ baa tɛ mɛ laanee ɛ ba kapɛrɛ. A waa n ŋɔ ba te ta kapɛrɛ bɛlbwa dɔe Israel tena bini la.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ

english_verse: to say to the Levites: When you receive from the people of Israel ten percent of their crops and newborn animals, you must offer a tenth of that to me.
translation_verse: ó bol Lewi dea tena la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he dɔ dibɔr bɔrbeŋkpoŋ la le kwaa Israel tena aa bɔne a bini fi la ta naa, hé ɡe bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ men Korowii a ɛ saraha tɛo.

english_verse: Just as the Israelites give me part of their grain and wine, you must set aside part of what you receive
translation_verse: He saraha ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ mea aa le pɛla ta, kɛɛ ɡrepo daa nɔna baa harame a nee la ken tɛ heya.

english_verse: After you have dedicated the best parts to me, you can eat the rest, just as the Israelites eat part of their grain and wine after offering them to me.
translation_verse: Berɛ ŋɔ Lewi dea tena la be ŋɔ, ‘Hé kpɔ a bini andɛɛɡa ne anɔ la aa do ɡoroŋ ba tɛ mɛ naa, aa doo kɛŋɔ mea aa le pɛla ta kɛɛ ɡrepo daa nɔna baa harame a nee la ken tɛ heya.

english_verse: Your share may be eaten anywhere by anyone in your family, because it is your pay for working at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: He Lewi dea tena ne nɛra baa lɔ he dem, ɛɛ won di a kabora bobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ a ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela toma haa dɛ ɛ la kembɔr.

english_verse: You won't be punished for eating it, as long as you have already offered the best parts to me. The gifts and sacrifices brought by the people must remain sacred, and if you eat any part of them before they are offered to me, you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Dɛ he pɛne a bini andɛɛɡa ba tɛ men Korowii aa, haa bolchɔɡee di a bɔr. Haa doŋaa kpɔ kah kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ Israel tena aa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha la, ásɛ dɛ bɛ serewe.’ ”
