After you take it out, sprinkle it with the water that purifies. Everything else should only be sprinkled with the water. Do all of this, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
translation_verse: ne kwaa nii aa wola won ɛa wobɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ do nii ta mɔɔ a doŋa le a ta. Hé berɛ kpɔ do nee baa kpɔa sɔ kon doŋa dɛɛ ta la ta. Komɛlbwa ɡe waa wola nii wone la, hé kpɔ do nee la ta.

english_verse: Wash your clothes on the seventh day, and after that, you will be clean and may return to the camp.” Everything Taken from the Midianites Is Divided
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, hé chɛɡɛ he laala dɛ́ laa he te kpɔ doŋa bɛlbwa ta ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛa la, ásɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ won jo he sobɔr bela.” Laa ta kwaa bɔna

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: From the half that belongs to the soldiers, set aside for the Lord one out of every
translation_verse: Hé lɛa le ba kwaa baa dɔ la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛ sɔfo Eliasa á ɛ men Korowii kwa.

english_verse: So we want to give the Lord all the gold jewelry we took from the Midianites. It's our gift to him for watching over us and our troops.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya kpɔ jam kwaa dɛɛ ba ba tɛ Korowii. Suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare ya bini bɛlbwa aa dɔa, ne baŋere ne jɔɡrɔre, ne noniseɡa ne deŋna kwa dɛ baŋa kwaare, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe ya wechɔɡa Korowii be.”

english_verse: women and gave them to Eleazar to be dedicated to the Lord. Then from the half that belonged to the people, Moses set aside one out of every
translation_verse: Laa tena laala baa kaa yo dɛ dɔ la lɔ peera kaɡboŋa lafraanumɛl fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue,

english_verse: and listed everything that had been taken from the Midianites. The list included
translation_verse: dɛ haahna kaɡboŋa lafraatoro dɛ banɛ baa wola baala chɔe bwa.

english_verse: and said, “Sir, we have counted our troops, and not one soldier is missing.
translation_verse: dɛ ka ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔna baa kure laa tena baa lɔ ya nɔn ta, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta nyoɡrɛ.

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar accepted the jewelry from the commanders,
translation_verse: Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa lɛ suuɡaswɛm la baa kpɔa ɛ koŋkwaare la.

english_verse: This did not include the things that the soldiers had kept for themselves.
translation_verse: Anɔ la laa tena la bɛlbwa aa kpɔa la te, a ɛ ba kwa.

english_verse: except Caleb and Joshua. They remained faithful to the Lord,
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Kenis te Jefune bibaa Kaleb, ne Nun bibaa Josua, banee teŋɛ men Korowii nɛɛ ba bambile bwa ne.’

english_verse: then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others.
translation_verse: dɛ Korowii sɔɔh harɛ la nɛra kpeɡri nyoa mɔɔ he laa berɛ aa, dɛ he ɛ waa aa wera tɛ Korowii ne Israel tena, dɛ Korowii sɛoh kɛ harɛ la ɛ he kon.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland.
translation_verse: Rubin ne Gad dea tena kondɛɛra warɔ taeh. Ba nao kɛ Jasa ne Gelead harɛre wer ne kwaa dɛɛra.

english_verse: So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said,
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba la Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa dɛ ba Israel tena nomonome be dɛ ka ŋɔ,

english_verse: “The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep,
translation_verse: Korowii aa sɔɔh a nɛra kpeɡri nyoa dɛ lɛ tɛ ya Israel tena la wer ne kwaa dɛɛra, he bonɔɔna ɡe, ya dɔ kondɛɛra.

english_verse: would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own?”
translation_verse: Ya dɛ soŋe he kpɔ harɛ la tɛ yaa ó ɛ ya kon, dɛ bɛ ɡel ya le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ.”

english_verse: Moses answered: You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle?
translation_verse: Anee Mosis ŋɔ Gad ne Rubin dea tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé bala dɛ kaa laa, asɛ he te so bonɔ naa?

english_verse: If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them.
translation_verse: He bɛ he bala Israel tena bwara hwah harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la ta kaala wa.

english_verse: This is exactly what happened when I sent your ancestors from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land.
translation_verse: Kenii he naawa faa ɛ ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ Kades Baanea, asɛ n tom ba ŋɔ bá ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.

english_verse: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.
translation_verse: Ba laŋɔ ka tel Ɛskɔl Fɛlembɔjen ta dɛ ka na harɛ la, dɛ ba hwah ba bala Israel tena la bwara, harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la ta laŋa.

english_verse: The Lord became very angry.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii baah di awola o ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Anee Mosis ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ vɔwɛ ntoa Korowii sie dɛ́ ka yo,

english_verse: but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for
translation_verse: Korowii baah di Israel tena la nɛ, asɛ dɛ ɡel ba ɡaaɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta bene fifraanaarɛ, ka tel kɛŋɔ a ɡɛ nɛra la ka pa bwa baa ɛ wechɔɡa la aa baa he.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Mosis kpɔ Gelead tɛ Makir naanar baa ɛ Manasɛ dea tena la asɛ ba so bela.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: Taraken, he iro kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra dɛ chiɡ he naawa naa ta, dɛɛ ba ɡela Korowii baah di kohona Israel tena nɛ.

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Dɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpoo waa, wɛɛ ɡel baa ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ taa ja, dɛ heyaa ɡela o chɔɡ ba ta la.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Ate, ba suuh tel Mosis dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya do leɡa bonɔ tɛ ya peera, ásɛ dɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛjena tɛ ya haahna ne bii.

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: Israel tena la bɛlbwa ɛɛ dɔ bɔr waa ɛ o konee mɔɔ ya laa berɛ kaa ya soŋnibɔra.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Yaa bobɛlbwaa lɛ le ba be Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ le kpa, ya dɔ ya bɔr Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr bela.”

english_verse: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things,
translation_verse: dɛ́ bwa vɔwɛ ntoa, dɛ́ le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la ka tel kɛ waa doŋi he dɔma he sie,

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: Dɛ he vɛoh he ta ɡɛ ɛɛ yaa, dɛ he ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, aa ɡure he nyu taa.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: Hé vɔrɔwe bwɛɛre tɛ he haahna ne bii, dɛ́ ɛ leɡa tɛ he peera, ásɛ dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ haa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ hɛɛ ɛo la ta.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Ate, Gad ne Rubin dea tena la ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ya dɔɔ, he bonɔɔna ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa bola laanee.

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ya haahna ne bii, ne peera dɛ nae ɛɛ ka Gelead bwɛjena nɔ taa.

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛ he bonɔɔna, baa bɛlbwa waa vɔwɛ ntoa dɛ la laa la ɛɛ le Jɔɔdan Moo baŋee, ásɛ Korowii tɔ ya sie yá ka yo ɡɛ haa ŋɔa la.”

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ Gad ne Rubin dea tena, baa bɛlbwa vɔwɛ ntoa he ne o le Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ Korowii sie, dɛ ka yo dɛ sɔɔh harɛ la nɛra kpeɡri nyoa aa, hé kpɔ Gelead harɛ tɛɛ ba ó ɛ ba kon.

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: Kɛ ba ta ntoa vɔwɛ he ne ba le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ aa, ate a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá dɔ Keenan harɛ la pera ɡɛ haa dɛ ba dɔe la.”

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Asɛ Gad ne Rubin dea tena la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he bonɔɔna ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa laanee.

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: Yaa vɔwɛ ntoa tɔ Korowii siee, dɛ́ ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la kaa Keenan harɛ ta, kɛ kondɔɔh yaa dɔa la te ɛɛ ka Jɔɔdan wee leebɔr baŋ bonɔɔ.”

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis kpɔ Amɔre Kooro Sihon, ne Basan tena Kooro Ɔɡ harɛre baa dɛ di kora a ta, ne a bwɛjena ne bwɛɛre aa bara bwa tɛ Gad ne Rubin dea tena, dɛ Josef bibaa Manasɛ dea pera tena.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Gad dea tena la kwaarɔ vɔrɔwe bwɛjena Debɔn ne Atarɔt dɛ Arowa,

english_verse: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
translation_verse: ne Bɛt Nimra dɛ Bɛt Haran, dɛ ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara dɛ do leɡa a ta tɛ ba peera ɡe.

english_verse: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation_verse: Rubin dea tena la ɡe kwaarɔ vɔrɔwe Hɛsbɔn ne Eleale dɛ Kiriataim

english_verse: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
translation_verse: ne Nɛbo dɛ Baal Meɔn, ba berɔ beɡre ɡɛ sɔna nɔ. Ba kwaarɔ vɔrɔwe Sibma ɡe, dɛ berɛ kwaa pa bwɛjena baa kwaara vɔrɔwe la ɡe sɔna.

english_verse: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.
translation_verse: Manasɛ bibaa Makir naanar la Gelead dɛ ka yo Amɔre tena ba fa aa lɔ bela dɛ doŋ ba.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Manasɛ naa Jɛɛ kaa yo lɛ bela bwɛjeɡre ane dɛɛ yera Havɔt Jɛɛ.

english_verse: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_verse: Asɛ Nɔba yo lɛ Kenat ne bwɛjeɡre aa baro dɛ kpɔ o sɔn Nɔba paa.

english_verse: As Israel traveled from Egypt under the command of Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Gɛ Mosis ne Arɔn aa kpɔ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ tɔ ba sie ba valɛ denaa ta laanee teŋa nɔ.

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: Korowii do Mosis o chwerɛ ɡɛ baa soɡa dɛɛ ir ba vala bini bwa. Kenii ba so dɛɛ ir.

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Israel tena la le Rameses dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene Sukot.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: Dɛ ir Sukot dɛ ka so Etaam, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la nyoa.

english_verse: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ ir Etaam dɛ laa berɛ ba Pi Haherɔt waa lɔ Baal Sefon wee leebɔr, dɛ ka so bɛne Miɡdol.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: Dɛ ir Pi Haherɔt dɛ kpɔ mpo ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta. Ba valɛ tɔpera atoro Etaam pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta dɛ ka so Mara.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Dɛ ir Elim dɛ ka so Mposwɛm nyoa.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Dɛ ir Mposwɛm nyoa dɛ ka so Sen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.
translation_verse: Dɛ ir Alus dɛ ka so Refidim. Ba ta nee bela dɔe dɛ nyɔ.

english_verse: They left Rephidim and finally reached the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Dɛ ir Refidim dɛ ka so Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.

english_verse: When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
translation_verse: Dɛ ir Kades dɛ ka so Hɔr Bwejen ta, o lɔ Edom harɛ jwɛh ta.

english_verse: That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month,
translation_verse: Hɔr Bwejen taa sɔfo Arɔn sewɛ korobinue tɔpeloɡle ta, bene fifraanaarɛ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta la ta.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋee Keenan harɛ ta Kooro Arad no kɛŋɔ Israel tena dɛ ba. Dɛ o soɡe Keenan harɛ ta weekaŋle harɛbɔr.

english_verse: and finally in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Dɛ ir Abarim Bwejena bɔr dɛ ka so Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta, asɛ Jeriko do baŋ bɛl.

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo la ta, Jeriko aa lɔ baŋ bɛl la, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ

english_verse: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan,
translation_verse: ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “He ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le dɛ jo Keenan harɛ ta naa,

translation_verse: hé doŋi bela tena baa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa le. Hé chɔɡ ba voɡa baa sɛah ne anɔ la baa loɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡ bela baa chema dɛɛ toma bwa.

english_verse: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ harɛ la ó ɛ he kon dɛ́ so o ta, n kpɔɔ tɛ heya.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Hé che bie tae ta dɛ́ bɔne harɛ la. Dea o nɛra aa wara la, hé ɡel ba bɔr do kan, banɔ la baa wola warɛ la, hé tɛɛ ba onjeɡa. Dɛ ba ta bie la aa, bela bwa aa chole la, ɛ he bɔr. Hé bɔna denaa ta.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: Dɛ he ta bela tena la doŋe le aa, banɔ la haa ɡel ba ba so la ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ daa waa dɛ ba he siwi tɔɡa, kɛɛ sɔɔh waa tɔɡɛ he kuɡri la ken. Baa tɛ heyaa waa, harɛ haa dɛ ba o ta soɡa la ta.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: He ta ban doŋe le aa, mɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa ɡɛ maa liira kɛ mɛɛ chɔɡ baa la.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
translation_verse: ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he tel Keenan harɛ baa dɛ ba bɔna ó ɛ he kon la ta naa, bá do jwɛhre nɔ.

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh la le Sin pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Edom harɛ jwɛh ta. Wee leebɔr ɡe le Yar Mpo ta kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr,

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: dɛ́ teŋɛ kaa bela baa kpɔa dɛɛ kaa Akrabim weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ́ kaa Sin, dɛ́ le bela kaa Kades Baanea weekaŋle harɛbɔr. Dɛ́ le bela kaa Hasar Adaar dɛ́ kaa Asmɔn.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Belaa wɛɛ ba ɡola le Asmɔn dɛ́ kaa Ijipt Fɛlembɔjen jwɛh ta, dɛ́ ka jaɡɛ Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta.

english_verse: The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Wee cholibɔr jwɛh la, Mɛdetereenea Mpo nyoa ɛ́ he jwɛh.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh ɡe teŋɔ le Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta kaa Hɔr Bwejen ta,

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: dɛ́ le Hɔr Bwejen ta kaa Lebo Hamat. Ásɛ jwɛh la chɔ kaa Sedad.

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: Weekaŋle nyundua pera jwɛh la le Sedad kaa Sifron dɛ́ ka jaɡɛ Hasar Enan.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: Wee leebɔr jwɛh la, teŋe le Hasar Enan kaa Sɛfam,

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: ásɛ jwɛh la le Sɛfam dɛ́ kaa Ribla waa lɔ Ain wee leebɔr, dɛ́ kpoŋe wili kaa Galilia Moo nyoa wee leebɔr.

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: Jwɛh la ɛɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Moo la taa, dɛ́ ka jaɡɛ Yar Mpo ta. Gɛɛ he harɛ jwɛhre la ɛɛ ba doe.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Harɛ laanee la, Korowii ŋɔ hé che bie tae ta, dɛ́ bɔne tɛ deene anuanaarɛ ne pera ó ɛ ba kon,

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: Rubin ne Gad dea tena, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena dɔ ba bɔr.

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: Gɛ deene anɛ nɔ ne Manasɛ dea pera tena la dɔ ba bɔr Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr, Jeriko do baŋ bɛl.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: “Baala baa dɛ́ ba harɛ la bɔna tɛ heyaa laanee sɔfo Eliasa ne Nun bibaa Josua.

english_verse: One leader from each tribe will help them,
translation_verse: Le dea bɛlbwa nomoa, ásɛ ba cha dɛ́ bɔne harɛ la.

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Banɔɔ Korowii le ŋɔ bá bɔne Keenan harɛ la tɛ Israel tena la.

english_verse: to say to them: When you receive your tribal lands, you must give towns and pastures to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Do Israel tena la dɛ́ ŋɔ bwɛjena baa dɔ la, bá tɛ Lewi dea tena la ane bá so a ta. Bwɛɛre la dahare harɛre ɡe ɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra.

english_verse: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.
translation_verse: Ásɛ bwɛɛre la ɛ ba kwa, a dahare harɛre la ɛ́ ba nae ne peera dɛ kondɛɛra aa kaa la bwa dibɔr.

english_verse: The pasture around each of these towns must be in the shape of a square, with the town itself in the center. The pasture is to measure
translation_verse: Bwɛɛre la wee leebɔra, hé maɡɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa atoro, wee cholibɔr kaɡboŋa atoro, weekaŋle harɛbɔr kaɡboŋa atoro, ásɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɡe naɡale kaɡboŋa atoro, ásɛ bwɛɛ la do baah ta. Gɛ bɔra nɔɔ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra. Bwɛjena nɛra aa ka so a ta dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu

english_verse: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites
translation_verse: Bwɛjena anumɛl haa kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena la ɛ bwɛɛre dɛ nomɛl kpo o dɔŋ aa, o chwa ka so bɛl ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu. Hé tɛɛ ba bwɛɛre fifraanaarɛ dɛ anɛ ja a ta.

english_verse: Since the towns for the Levites must come from Israel's own tribal lands, the larger tribes will give more towns than the smaller ones. The Safe Towns (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Bwɛɛre Israel deene la aa dɔ harɛ la ta la, hé kpɔ ane tɛ Lewi dea tena la. Banɔ la ba bwɛɛre aa wara la, hé lɛ bwɛɛre kohona le ba be, ásɛ banɔ la ba bwɛɛre aa wola warɛ la, hé lɛ bwɛɛre tamaa ken le ba be.”

english_verse: by one of the victim's relatives. He will take revengefor his relative's death as soon as he finds you.
translation_verse: Naate baa kpoo la lole tenten kaa pu nɛn waa kpo o lole laa, a chɛ kɛ ó kpo naate bɔ kem.

english_verse: There are to be six of these Safe Towns,
translation_verse: Bwɛɛre nɛra aa chwa ka so a ta dɛɛ dɔ ba nyuune la ɛ anumɛl.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan,
translation_verse: ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé le Jɔɔdan Moo la kaa Keenan harɛ ta naa,

english_verse: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.
translation_verse: hé le bwɛɛre ane cheɡ, ásɛ dɛ nomɛl ta saahnɛ kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so bɛl ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.

english_verse: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.
translation_verse: Gɛ bwɛɛre laanee dɛ́ lɛ nɛn nyu le nɛn waa kpoo la nɛra nɔn ta, ásɛ ba bɛ won dɔ bɔr kpoo bɔ kem dɛ nɛra ta cheme dɛ bol o wa.

english_verse: three on each side of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Hé le bwɛɛre atoro Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ bonɔ cheɡ, ásɛ Keenan harɛ ta ɡe atoro.

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Bwɛɛre anumɛl la ɛ bwɛɛre Israel tena ne nɛŋhɔɔhra ne nomɛlbwa ba ne waa soɡa, dɛ bɛl ta saahnɛ kpo nɛn aa, ó chwa ka so bela dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl kpoŋe daa waa dɛ ba wona kpo nɛn, asɛ dɛ kpɔ lɔ o dɔŋ o sewaa, naate kpo nɛn. Kpoe chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpo o ɡe.

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: kɛɛ dɛ ume nɔn lɔɔ dɛ kpoo waa, o kpo nɛn, o di bolchɔɡe. Naate baa kpoo la nɛn dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó kpo ɡɛ nɛn la bɔ kem, dɛ o nao waa.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: nɛra baa bol waa la che ɡɛ Mmara nɔ ta, dɛ́ bol ɡɛ nɛn waa wola saahnɛ kpo o dɔŋ, ne o dɔŋ waa dɛ nyinu dɛ kpo la wa.

english_verse: But if you ever leave the Safe Town
translation_verse: Dɛ naate waa kpo nɛn la berɔ le bwɛɛ waa chwaa ka so o ta,

english_verse: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.
translation_verse: asɛ naate waa sewa la nɛn waa dɛ nyin ɡɛ nɛn la dɛ́ kpoo bɔ kem la ka nao dɛ kpoo waa, o ta bolchɔɡe dii.

english_verse: You must stay inside the town until the high priest dies; only then can you go back home.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó so bwɛɛ waa chwaa kaa la ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ Sɔfonomoa waa lole ɡɛ saŋ la aa sewa mɔɔ ɡɛ nɛn la won kaa bwɛɛ waa le o ta.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpo nɛn la, dɛ baa kpoo waa, á che o nyoa wobol ta mɔɔ ba won kpoo. A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá che danseɛ te beŋkpoŋ nyoa wobol ta dɛ́ kpo nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!
translation_verse: He bɛ suuɡa lɛ le nomɛlbwa waa kpo nɛn a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo la be, dɛ́ kpɔ o nyu kɛo.

english_verse: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: He bɛ suuɡa lɛ dɛ́ ɡel nomɛlbwa waa chwa ka so a ɡɛ bwɛɛre la ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu la berɛ kaa o bwɛ, dɛ Sɔfonomoa waa lole ɡɛ saŋ la ta sewɛ.

english_verse: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel
translation_verse: Josef naanar baa ɛ Manasɛ dea pera naa Makir bibaa Gelead la Mosis ne Israel sitɔɔla ne deene nomonome be dɛ ka ŋɔ,

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.
translation_verse: “Korowii aa do heyaa ŋɔ hé che bie tae ta, dɛ́ bɔne harɛ la tɛ ya Israel tena ya so o ta la, o berɔ ŋɔ hé kpɔ ya dɔɔ Selofehad harɛ tɛ o bihaahna.

english_verse: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.
translation_verse: Dɛ a kaa ba kɛŋɔ ba yalɛ deene nɔ ane ta naa, ba kapɛrɛ la ɛɛ ɛ deene la kwaa, dɛ ya kapɛrɛ peraa lea la.

english_verse: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.”
translation_verse: Dɛ benanyoa nomɛl kon lɔ nomɛl be Israel tena yon berɛ tɛo la telaa, ba bɔr la ɛɛ le ya naawa kon taa, dɛ́ ka ja dea baa yalɛ o ta la kon ta.”

english_verse: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.
translation_verse: Asɛ Mosis che waa Korowii aa doo a ta la ta dɛ ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Waa Josef naanar la aa dɛ bol la ɛ kpela.

english_verse: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa bera do Selofehad bihaahna a ta laanee kɛŋɔ, baa yalɛ nomɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin ba mɛɛ dea la ta.

english_verse: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.
translation_verse: Israel dea bɛlbwa harɛ waa dɔa la bɛ o dɔŋ dea kon ta ka ja, nomɛlbwa kpɔ o naa harɛ ó ɛ o kon.

english_verse: In the future, any daughter who inherits land must marry someone from her own tribe. Israel's tribal land is never to be passed from one tribe to another.
translation_verse: Dea bɛlbwa harɛ bɛ o dɔŋ kon ta ka ja, dea bɛlbwa kpɔ o kon.”

english_verse: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons
translation_verse: Selofehad bihaahna laanee, Maala ne Tirsa ne Hoɡla ne Milka dɛ Nowa. Ba yalɛ ba mɛɛ naaranar.

english_verse: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.
translation_verse: Ba yalɛ Josef bibaa Manasɛ dea la ta, asɛ ba harɛ baa dɔa la ka ba mɛɛ lolanar harɛ ta.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Mmarare ne waa Korowii aa kpɔa che Mosis nɛɛ dɛ tɛ Israel tena laanee. Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta, asɛ Jeriko do baŋ bɛl la taa Korowii bola.

english_verse: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.

translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ waa chɔ he sie nɔ, hé kaa dɛ́ ka kpɔ. Harɛ nɔɔ n baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ he naawa, Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb dɛ ba naanar baa ka ba la.’ ” Mosis le sitɔɔla

translation_verse: Gɛɛ n kpɔ wobɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ do he nɔn ta. Toroma baa sɔah ka nyiŋi harɛ

translation_verse: He naɡre waa he tɛnte deene bini dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii hah yaa, a waa ɡela o le ya ne Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ kpɔ yaa ba do Amɔre tena nɔn ta ásɛ ba kpoo yaa.

english_verse: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.
translation_verse: Mosis fa ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “He ɡwaa n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ n ɡbo won tɔ he sie.

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: Ó ɡel he ya ɡɛ bele kaɡboŋ, dɛ́ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heya, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɛrɛɛ n ɡbo ɛɛ ba wona kpoŋe heyaa dɛ́ nyiŋi he waa bini ne waa aa dawɛ he nɛɛ dɛɛ tɛ heya ɔ?

translation_verse: Anee n kpɔ wejerema ne nɛra baa dɛ no waa mun ba waa dɔ nyɛl dɛ le dea bɛlbwa bini, dɛ kpɔ ba chɔ he nyoa. Bane chɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa nyoo, bane chɔ lafare nyoo, bane ɡe chɔ fifraanunue nyoo, asɛ bane ɡe chɔ nɛra fifi nyoo. Dɛ le bane ɡe baa nyiŋi deene la bɛlbwa waa ta.

translation_verse: he bɛ nɛra siebɔr dɛɛ nyiŋi. Hɛ́ɛ no nomɛlbwa waa kɛrɛdɛ. Bechale ne nomonome bwa, hé nyiŋi ba bwa waa bini kɛrɛdɛ. He bɛ nomɛlbwa siebɔr ɔmɛ, Korowii ɛɛ che he nɛɛ dɛ́ pa bole. Dɛ waane bola kpeɡri tɛ heya aa, bá ba a ne n sie ásɛ n bola.’

translation_verse: Onee tɔ he sie he vala bini, dɛ kpɔ nii dɛɛ tɔ he sie jwaana, dɛ kpɔ bam ɡe dɛɛ tɔ he sie webaŋa, dɛ nyin bela haa dɛɛ chɔ, dɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: Asɛ ya ir le Sinai Bwejen ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ ya be la, dɛ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ waa do kan kohona dɛ do ɔma la ta, dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Amɔre tena deŋɡarere harɛ he fa aa naa la ta dɛ ka tel Kades Baanea.

english_verse: and I told you, “We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.”
translation_verse: Hé na, Korowii kpɔ harɛ la do he nɔn ta. Hé teeh ka kpɔ, ɡɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ aa ŋɔ he be la. He bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ.’

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Ate, he bwa ba n be dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Gel ya tomɛ nɛra ba tɔ ya sie, dɛ́ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la ba tɛ yaa, ásɛ ya jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ ne bwɛɛre yaa dɛ́ ba a ta kpɔe waa dɛ́ ba ŋɔ ya be.’

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Gɛ liire la wer tɛ mɛ, anomanta, n le dea bɛlbwa bini nɛmbeŋkpoŋ, ba ɛ nɛra fi dɛ banɛ.

english_verse: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ deŋɡarere la dor dɛ ka le Ɛskɔl Fɛlembɔjen ta dɛ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la,

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: dɛ kpɔ daa nɔna ane le bela harɛ la ta ba baɡle yaa dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Harɛdɛɛɡee Korowii kpɔ tɛ yaa la.’

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Kɛ haa nyin bela laŋa, anomanta, he ta Korowii nyoa wobol noɛ.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Leperaa yaa ba chaɡa ɔ? Ya bala baa laŋa ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la ŋɔ, nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta bwara kpeɡri, ba kpeɡo ɡe kohona dɛ ɡwaa yaa. Ba bwɛjena, ba ma danjwɛkpeɡa a kaa nyundua bara, nomɛlbwa aa wola won dɔ bɔr jo a ta. Dɛ ba na Anak naanar bela, ba kpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ.’

english_verse: Then I said, “Don't worry!
translation_verse: Anee men Mosis ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr.

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ tɔ he siee yo tɛ heya, ɡɛ waa ɛa Ijipt harɛ ta he na la.

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: Hé berɔ na ɡɛ waa ɛa tɛ heyaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta ja, ɡɛ waa kpɔ heyaa kɛŋɔ mɛɛ yon kpɔ o bie la. O kpɔ heyaa le bela bwa dɔŋ haa lea dɛ ba tel bonɔ nɔ.’

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, he ta Korowii yaradae.

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: Korowii aa no ɡɛ haa dɛ naɡre o waa la, o baah diu asɛ o ŋwɛɛ ntam ŋɔ,

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: ‘Nɛra nɔ te kapa wechɔɡa aa su ba nɔ bini bɛlbwa aa harɛpare ondɛɛɡe maa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ba naawa la aa belaa la,

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: nemenɛ Jefune bibaa Kaleb laanee dɛɛ ba bela laŋa ó ɛ o kon. Mɛɛ kpɔ harɛ la waa kaa valɛ o ta laanee tɛ o ne o naanar, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o teŋɛ men Korowii nɛɛ o bambile bwa ne.’

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: He Israel te waa anomanta, Korowii baah fa di men Mosis nɛɛ o ŋɔ, ‘He ɡba kwara aa harɛ la taa la.

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Nun bibaa Josua waa dɛ chae laanee dɛɛ ba bela tela. Anomanta, doo ɡbemba dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee dɛɛ ba he sie tɔe he ka kpɔ harɛ la ɛ he kon.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: He bechale haa ŋɔa baa laɡ ba laa taa baa wola wechɔɡa ne wedɛɛɡa jemɛ mɔɔ la, banee dɛɛ ba harɛ la ta tela. Banee mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ ó ɛ ba kon.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Anee he ŋɔ men Mosis be ŋɔ, ‘Ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ. Yaa ka yoo baa ɡɛ Korowii aa do yaa la.’ Asɛ bɛlbwa kpɔ o dɔmkwa, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ deŋɡarere baah yoi ken pwɛre.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Ŋɔ ba be, n ta ba nɛɛ jae, ba bɛ la ka yo. Gɛ laa aa ba dɔma ɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ.’

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: N bol he be he ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ he ta Korowii waa waa bola la ta teŋɛ dɛ teeh kaa deŋɡarere la ta.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Belaa Amɔre tena baa soɡe bela la le ba tɔ he nɛ, dɛ ɡbaa heyaa kɛŋɔ toohna, dɛ kpoo heyaa le Sɛɛ ka tel Hɔrma.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: ‘He biɡri deŋɡarere la bɔr to, anomanta, hé kpɔ sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: A ka tama hé ka kpɔ he lolanar baa ɛ Esɔ naanar dɛ do Sɛɛ harɛ jwɛh ta kaa. Baa dɛɛ ɔmɛ heyaa, kɛ hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: He bɛ yoi kpɔ puu ba, maa ɡel he dɔ ba harɛ la naɡale del ɡba. N dɔɔ kpɔ bela tɛ Esɔ naanar.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Hé yawɛ kondikwa ba be dɛɛ di, dɛ́ yawɛ nee ɡe dɛɛ nyɔ.’

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya kpɔ Esɔ naanar baa lɔ Sɛɛ harɛ la ta, dɛ ɡel Araba ŋwɛnɛ waa kaa Elat ne Eseɔn Gɛba, dɛ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa kaa Moab harɛ ta la.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Bela ɡe la, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ Moab tena baa ɛ Lɔt naanar nɔ baah muɡli he ba yo. N kpɔ bwɛjen Ar tɛɛ ba ŋɔ ó ɛ ba kon baa di o kpeɡri. Anomanta, maa heyaa ba harɛ nɔ peraa tɛ hé di o kpeɡri.’ ”

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: Nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Emi tenaa fa soɡe Ar bela. Ba kpeɡo dɛ warɛ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ Anak tena ken.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Gɛ Anak tena nɔ, dɛ ba fa dɛ yer ba Refa tena. Moab tena dɛ yer ba Emi tena.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɛ Hɔr tena ɡee fa soɡe Sɛɛ, asɛ Esɔ naanar ba doŋ ba bela, ba kpoo ba dɛ so ba buɡ ta, ɡɛ Israel tena aa ɛa harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kon la ta.

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: “Asɛ Korowii berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé ir kaa dɛ́ ka le Sɛrɛd Fɛlembɔjen la.’ Anee ya ka le ɡɛ fɛlembɔjen la dɛ kaa o baŋ.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: Ba laa tena la bwa aa serewa tonɛ la,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: ‘Fini hé ir, dɛ́ valɛ ka ɡarɛ Ar waa lɔ Moab jwɛh ta la,

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: kɛ dɛ he tel Amɔn tena harɛ ta naa, he bɛ ba baah muɡli dɛ́ ba puu ba yo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ maa ɡel he dɔ ba harɛ la pera ó ɛ he kon bwa. N kpɔɔ tɛ Lɔt naanar kɛ ó ɛ ba harɛ.’

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: Gɛ harɛ nɔ, dɛ nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Refa tenaa fa soɡe o ta. Amɔn tena dɛ yer ba Samsum tena.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛ ɡɛ tenten tɛ Esɔ naanar baa soɡe Sɛɛ ɡe. O kpoo Hɔr tena ba siwi ta, dɛ ɡel ba so ba buɡ ta ba le fini.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Avi tena baa soɡe bwɛjeɡre ane ta ka tel Gasa ɡe faa na. Nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Kaftɔ tena aa le Kaftɔ dɛɛ ba la, ba kpoo ba dɛ so ba buɡ ta. Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon yoi dɛ́ pɔ o nɛ

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: Yaa kpɔ Moab harɛ ta ba kaa habɔɔ la, Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, ‘Hé ir, dɛ́ kpɔ he te dɛ́ ka le Aanɔn Moo la. Hé no! N kpɔ Sihon waa ɛ Amɔre kooro dɛ so Hɛsbɔn ne o harɛ do he nɔn ta. Hé ka pa mun dɛ́ lɛ harɛ la dɔɔh ásɛ dɛ yoo laa.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Fini tɔpere nɔ, mɛɛ pa munii dɛ́ ɡel harɛre bwa nɛra baa no he waa la ɛɛ ɔmɛ kohona, dɛ́ kpɔ ɔmee ne bochela ta ba nɛ.’

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: Anomanta, n tomɛ toroma le Kedemɔt pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta Kooro Sihon be Hɛsbɔn bansɔɔh wobol ne dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: ‘Gel ya kpɔ he harɛ la ta ba kaa. Ŋwɛnɛ taa yaa ba kpɔe, yaa bobɛlbwaa bɛɡɛ.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: ɡɛɛ Esɔ naanar baa soɡe Sɛɛ, ne Moab tena baa soɡe Ar ɛ yaa. Ya dɛ kaa ka le Jɔɔdan Moo dɛ kaa harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ta.’

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘N kpɔ Kooro Sihon ne o harɛ nɛra bwa do he nɔn ta. Hé pu sie yoo ba dɛ́ lɛ harɛ la.’

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Sihon ne o laa tena bwa le dɛɛ ba ba yo yaa bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jahas.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laa nɔn kpɔ o nɛɛ ya kpoo o ne o bibaala ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa.

english_verse: Then we captured and destroyed every town in Sihon's kingdom, killing everyone,
translation_verse: Ya lɛ o bwɛɛre bwa dɛ chɔɡa, dɛ kpoo baala ne haahna dɛ bechale bwa. Ya ta ɡelɛ nomɛlbwa won dɔ bɔr chwa.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laa nɔn kpɔ ba nɛɛ tɛ yaa, le bwɛɛ Arowa waa chɔ Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen la doa, dɛ berɛ kpɔ bwɛɛ bɛl waa chɔ o bini, hale dɛ kaa bwɛɛ Gelead, bɛlbwa ta wone dɔ kpeɡri kɛ yan.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ya ta Amɔn tena harɛ ta bɛnɛ, Jabɔk Moo nyoa bwɛɛre ne bwɛɛre aa lɔ deŋɡarere dor ɡe, ya ta a bɛlbwa bɛnɛ. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la kah yaa a wa.”

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Dɛɛ berɛ o ɔma, n kpɔ o ne o nɛra ne harɛ la bwa do he nɔn ta. Ɛo ɡɛ haa ɛ Amɔre Kooro Sihon o fa aa dɛ di kora Hɛsbɔn la.’

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Ya chɔɡ a ɡɛ bwɛɛre la bwa, dɛ kpoo baala ne haahna dɛ bechale bwa kwaraa, ɡɛ yaa ɛ Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon harɛ ta la.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do ya lɛ Jɔɔdan baŋ wee leebɔr harɛ la le Amɔre tena koranar banɛ, Sihon ne Ɔɡ nɔn ta. Harɛ la chɔɔ le Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta dɛ ka tel Hɛmɔn Bwejen ta.

english_verse: Mount Hermon is called Mount Sirion by the people of Sidon, and it is called Mount Senir by the Amorites.
translation_verse: Hɛmɔn Bwejen nɔ, Sidon tena dɛ yerɔ Sereɔn, Amɔre tena ɡee yerɔ Senir.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Ya lɛ bwɛɛre aa lɔ harɛ aa chɔa kaa la bwa, ne Gelead ne Basan harɛ dɛ ka tel wee leebɔr bwɛɛre ane baa dɛ yera Saleka ne Edrei, Basan Kooro Ɔɡ faa di kora a ta bwa.

english_verse: King Og was the last of the Rephaim, and his coffin is in the town of Rabbah in Ammon. It is made of hard black rock and is four meters long and almost two meters wide. The Land East of the Jordan River Is Divided (Numbers
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Ɔɡ ɡboo fa baa ka Refa tena baa kpeɡa la bini. Bunii ba kpɔ ɛ o mpa, dɛ o jaŋne ɛ naɡale fi dɛ atoro ne tama, o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale anumɛl. Mpa la ta lɔ Amɔn tena bwɛɛ Raba la ta, dɛ ba le fini.” Israel harɛ la bɔna

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: Hé cha he bala la ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii aa tɛɛ ba bɔr bá so dɛ́ onɛ, ɡɛ waa tɛ heyaa nɔ, ba ɡe dɔ harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o do Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ le. A habɔɔ la, bɛlbwa ɛɛ won kaa harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta ja.’

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, n soŋe Korowii sibeɡra ne ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: ‘Nemenɛ Korowii, he pa mun dɛ kpɔ he kan ne he kpeɡri haa dɔa baɡle men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ. Komɛlbwa toole nyundua kɛɛ harɛ dɛ́ won ɛ wejena nɔ dɔŋa.

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe, le n ne Jɔɔdan Moo nɔ baŋ n ka na harɛdɛɛɡe la, ne deŋɡarere harɛ dɛ Lɛbanɔn harɛ la.’

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: He nomanta, Korowii bandia ta lɔ n nɛ o ta n wesoŋa la noɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘He fele! Dɛɛ berɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ n be bola kpa.

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Kɛ kaa ka teeh Pesɡa Bwejen kaa o nyundujaɡla dɛ́ nyiŋi bar. Nyiŋi harɛ la aa lɔ Jɔɔdan baŋ la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nee la baŋ te, haa le.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ waa la do Josua nɔn ta dɛ́ doo ɡbemba ó dɔ bokpeɡa, dɛkalkɛ onee dɛ́ tɔ nɛra nɔ sie dɛ́ kpɔ ba le nee la baŋ, bá ka lɛ harɛ la haa dɛ ba o nae la dɛ́ so o ta.’

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya soɡe fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, asɛ ya sie dawɛ Bɛt Peɔ ta baŋ bɛl.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé no Mmarare bwa maa dɛ ba heyaa baɡla nɔ. Hé teŋɛ a ta dɛ́ dɔ he nyu ásɛ dɛ ka kpɔ harɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: He bɛ wobɛlbwa kpɔ ja waa maa do heyaa a ta la ta, he bɛ ane ɡe laa kpɔ. Hé lawɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ bini.

english_verse: You saw how he killed everyone who worshiped the god Baal Peor.
translation_verse: Hé ɡbabir na ɡɛ Korowii aa ɛa Peɔ Bwejen ta siwi ne. O kpoo he bini banɔ la baa dɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal la.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: Kɛ he banɔ la haa kpɔ he te pɛl Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la te ta lole fini.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: A bwaa kɛŋɔ hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ, hɛɛ berɛ waa haa naa la soeh. Hé bola baɡle he bii ne he naanar.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ haa cheɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ sie Sinai Bwejen ta asɛ o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Yerɛ nɛra la bwa ba cheme n sie bá ba no n waa dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ baa duu mɛ. Gel ba ka so harɛ la ta bwa dɛ́ bol baɡle ba bii ne ba naanar ba ɡe ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.’

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Hé bol ba be ɡɛ chuu kohona ne baama aa bira kpirkpir ane aa tɔa, ninlao ɛɛ hɔ a bini dɛɛ kaa nyundua, ɡɛ saŋ he fa aa cheɡɛ bwejen la lɔɡa la wa,

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: ne ɡɛ haa no Korowii taa nii la ta wɛɛ bol waa he be, kɛ dɛ haa on na la wa.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: O bol he be he ne o fɔo la ta teŋa wa. Mmarare fi waa chwera dawɛ bwepɛle anɛ ta dɛ ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta la.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ɡɛ saŋ ŋɔ ń baɡle heyaa Mmarare aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé teŋɛ a ta harɛ haa dɛ la ka le Jɔɔdan Moo la dɛ́ ka lɛ so o ta la wa.” Voɡa toma jae wa

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “A ɡɛ saŋ haa no Korowii taa nii la ta Sinai Bwejen ta la, he ta komɛlbwa nae, anomanta, he nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: ásɛ he pɛla bɛ wechɔɡa ba lawɛ dɛ́ sɛh komɛl o le nɛn kɛɛ haah,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel he pɛla ba lawɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie ne weweela, ásɛ he ba duura dɛ́ toma. Harɛre ane nɛraa Korowii ŋɔ baa toma, he te laa.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: He waa ɡela Korowii baah di n nɛɛ o ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, maa Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ waa wera o kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la taa la la.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ sewɛ harɛ nɔ taa, maa Jɔɔdan Moo baŋee le. Heyaa dɛɛ ba he le dɛ́ ka so bela harɛdɛɛɡe ompare la ta ó ɛ he kon.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ fɔo he ne Korowii aa fɔwa la waa soh. He bɛ komɛlbwa kwaa dɛ tomɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa do heyaa la.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Korowii do kɛŋɔ ninlao ken dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa, o dɛ mee. Anomanta, he Israel tena ne waa won pɛ dɛ he ɡelo dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡaa.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River and settle down in the land. Then in the years to come, you will have children, and they will give you grandchildren. After many years, you might lose your sense of right and wrong and make idols, even though the Lord your God hates them. So I am giving you fair warning today, and I call the earth and the sky as witnesses. If you ever make idols, the Lord will be angry, and you won't have long to live, because the Lord will let you be wiped out.
translation_verse: Harɛ ne nyundua ɛ n danseɛ fini, dɛ he kaa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ n waa nɔ ta harɛ haa dɛ ba Jɔɔdan Moo lee dɛ́ ka so o ta la ta naa, hee hɛɛ ba hee le harɛ la ta. Haa belaa so biɡri, he bwa ɛɛ heo kwaraa.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ́ ba heyaa lɔe peɡre ja harɛre ta, he bini tama banee dɛ́ ba ka.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Bela haa ka so la te, hɛɛ tomɛ voɡa nɛwɛnyini aa ɛa, daa ne bwea aa wola na, aa waa no, aa kwaa di aa wola sɔɔh ɡe no.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛ wahala nɔ bwa ba he nɛ aa, he siwi ɛɛ beɡroo ásɛ he ba Korowii be dɛ́ baa duuru.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: O dɛ na nɛn sum, waa nɔnee laa kpɔ he nɛɛ bwa á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa. Waa fɔo o ne he naawa aa fɔwa o ŋwɛɛ o waa laanee soh bwa.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Voɡ bɛl wono che nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta dɛ lawɛ o nɛra le nɛra bane harɛ ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa ɛa tɛ heyaa ɡɛ saŋ haa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta la kaa? O cheɡɛ o kpeɡri waa kana kohona la ne hɔhɔrɔwa ne laa ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla dɛ waa aa do ɔma ta, dɛ lawɛ heyaa le.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ he no o taa dɛ le nyundua, dɛ chaɡle heyaa anɔ la aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ. Dɛ ɡel he na o nii waa dɛ lawɛ kohona harɛ nɔ ta, asɛ dɛ ɡel he no o taa le nii la ta.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Nyina waa dɛ nyin he naawa nomanta, o le heyaa tɛ o te dɛ che o kpeɡri kohona waa dɔa ta dɛ ɡbaɡba ja he nɛɛ dɛ le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: O doŋi nɛra le ba harɛre ta, banɔ la baa kana dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa heya, dɛ kpɔ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ kapɛrɛ kwa, ɡɛ aa doa fini nɔ.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ lii dɛ bɛ soh kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ di kora nyundua ne harɛ ta bwa, komɛlbwa toole dɛ ka ja Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa maa dɛ bol he be fini nɔ ta, ásɛ a do wer tɛ he ne he bii ne naanar baa ka ba, ásɛ he won so harɛ waa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la ta saŋ bɛlbwa.” Bwɛjena nɛra aa ka so a ta dɛ́ dɔ ba nyuune

english_verse: Moses said, “People of Israel, you must set aside the following three towns east of the Jordan River as Safe Towns: Bezer in the desert highlands belonging to the Reuben tribe; Ramoth in Gilead, belonging to the Gad tribe; and Golan in Bashan, belonging to the Manasseh tribe. If you kill a neighbor without meaning to, and if you had not been angry with that person, you can run to one of these towns and find safety.” The Second Speech: Moses Tells What the Lord Demands Israel at Beth-Peor
translation_verse: A ɡɛ bwɛjena laanee, Bɛsa waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta dɛ le Rubin dea harɛ ta, ne Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta dɛ le Gad dea harɛ ta, dɛ Golan o ɡe aa lɔ Basan harɛ ta dɛ le Manasɛ dea tena harɛ ta. Korowii Mmarare waa kpɔa tɛ Israel tena

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: dɛ ba lɔ Fɛlembɔjen bɛl waa chɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr dɛ bɛne Bɛt Peɔ. Amɔre Kooro Sihon fa aa di kora Hɛsbɔn asɛ Mosis ne Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta ba yoo dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ la harɛ.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: O ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ ba bwa aa ɛ Amɔre tena koranar dɛ do Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr la harɛree ba lɛ.

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Harɛ la chɔɔ le Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen la doa bwɛɛ Arowa ta dɛ ka le Sereɔn Bwejen baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Hɛmɔn la ta,

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: ne harɛ waa chɔ Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ wee leebɔr bwa ka tel weekaŋle harɛbɔr Yar Mpo ta dɛ kaa Pesɡa Bwejen la lɔɡa.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mosis cheme Israel tena bwa dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé no waa maa dɛ ba bola fini nɔ kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta. A ɛ Korowii Mmarare waa kpɔa tɛ heya.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: He bɛ nɛn kpo.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Sinai Bwejen taa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ne ya fɔwɛ fɔo.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Sinai Bwejen la doaa Korowii che nii ta bol waa he be he siwi ta.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Dɛ n cheɡɛ he ne Korowii baah ta ɡɛ saŋ dɛ baɡle heyaa o waa bini he ɔmɛ nii la. He ta bwe la teehnɛ. O bolɔ ŋɔ,

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: ‘Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, n le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta somanjiri dii ta la.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ ka ja n nɛ.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: He bɛ komɛlbwa waa lɔ nyundua kɛɛ harɛ ta, hale nee bini bɛlbwa chaa ɛ.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: He bɛ an dɛɛ ɡuŋi a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ tomaa. Dɛkalkɛŋɔ menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, n dɛ mee. N dɛ tɛr banɔ la baa hah mɛ deŋne. Hale dɛ́ kpoŋe ka tel ba naanar bele batoro kɛɛ banaarɛ baa ka ba la nɛ,

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: dɛɛ nyin banɔ la baa nyin mɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ men Mmarare ta la wa. Hale dɛ́ kpoŋe ka tel ba naanar bele kaɡboŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: He bɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ wesale bɛlbwa ta. Mɛɛ tɛr naate waa dɛ ŋwɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ la deŋnee.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Tɔpera anumɛlee he dɔ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ he toma bɛlbwa,

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: kɛ tɔpenuanɛte la ɛ Ona Tɔpere tɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ. O telaa, he bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ o ta. He ne he bibaala ne bihaahna kɛɛ bonɔɔna, kɛɛ toli bɛlbwa bɛ toma ɛ. Hale he nae ne keeɡore, ne kondɛɛre te bɛlbwa, dɛ hɔɔhra kwaraa baa lɔ he deremi bɛ toma ɛ. Gɛ aa ɛ bonɔɔ kɛɛ tolo waa lɔ he sie la ɡe won dɔ bɔr onɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ onɛ la.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: Hé duu he nyare ne he mɛɛnanar, ɡɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la aa do heyaa la. Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he dɔ mkpajaŋ, wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ heya harɛ maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: He bɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛ.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ Korowii che nii ta dɛ bol takpeɡ ne baama aa bira kpirkpir bini bwe la ta he bwa be la, o ta wobɛlbwa kpɔe ja a ta ɡɛ saŋ. Dɛ chwera bwepɛle anɛ ta dɛ kpɔ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Haa no taa la le bwejen la bɔr bela nii la aa dɛ hɔ biro la ta la, he dea nomonnyuune dɛ nomonome baa jaa bwa ba n be,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡelɔ ya na o jirima ne ɡɛ waa do kan, ya no o taa nii la ta. Fini ya nao kɛŋɔ Korowii bol waa nɛn be naa, naate ta won o nyu dɔe dɛ́ ta so le.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Aah bɔkwaa ɡela ya berɛ jo seo ta jaɔ? Dɛ ya berɔ ba no Korowii taa ja aa, nidamanta aa do ɔma la dɛ ba yaa fuih ya serewe.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini besoo no Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa wobol le nii ta kɛ yan, dɛ ta dɔ o nyu dɛ so le nɔ?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Hen Mosis, la dɛ́ ka no waa bwa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ ba bola, dɛ́ ba ŋɔ ya be. Yaa noo dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.’

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Korowii no ɡɛ haa bola la dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N no ɡɛ nɛra la aa bol he be la, anɔ la bwa baa bola la wer.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba pɛla fe ɛɛ lawɔɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ duu mɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa bwa ta naa, ba ne ba naanar wobɛlbwa fe ɛɛ maɡroo tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: La ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá berɛ ka jo ba tɛnte deene bini.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Ásɛ a ka n ne hen Mosis ɡbo bonɔ, ásɛ n bol men Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ ba ban doe a ta bwa la he be, ka bol baɡ ba ásɛ ba kaa ɛa harɛ maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ka so o ta la ta.’ ”

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa do heyaa a ta la taa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé do sie, ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu á chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ dɔ mkpajaŋ harɛ haa dɛ la ka so o ta la.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Mmarare Korowii aa do mɛ ŋɔ ń baɡle heyaa laanee mɛɛ ba heyaa baɡla nɔ. Hé kaa do sie a ta, harɛ haa dɛ ba o ta kaala ka so la ta.

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Hé ne he bii ne naanar bwa ɔmɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, dɛ́ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ ta, ásɛ he won so biɡri.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé noa dɛ́ kaa teŋɛ a ta, ásɛ a do wer kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ tɛ heya. Anee dɛ́ ɡel hé ya kohona harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ta, ɡɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ aa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé no. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ habɔɔ, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Hé nyin Korowii he bambile bwa, he hweera ne he bokpeɡa bwa ne.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔa baɡle he bii. Hɛ́ɛ dalawe a ta, he dem soɡa bini ne ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa haa dɛ kaa, hale he chɔe ne he ira bini bwa.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔa ɛ kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡ do he nɔɔra, dɛ́ kpɔa vɔwɛ he tili ta ásɛ aa lii heya.

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Hé chwera dawɛ he deene ɡbeni daa ne he deremi ɡbeni ta.” Deŋnekpeɡ tena jae

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii kpɔ heyaa ka tel harɛ waa baɡɛ he naawa, Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb nyoa kɛ wɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta, bwɛjena aa wera he laa vɔrɔwa,

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: ne deene kondɛɛɡa aa sua he laa nyina do, ne buli haa wola an kwii, ne daa kooni ne ɔleve kooni he laa dua, asɛ he di kwaa dɛ vaɡɛ aa,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ Korowii waa soh. Onee le he ne Ijipt harɛ he fa aa di somanjiri o ta la.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ duu Korowii dɛ́ɛ tomɛ o ɡbo, dɛɛ baɡɛ nyoa o sɔn ta.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: He bɛ komɛlbwa nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛ tomɔ, he bɛ harɛre aa bar heyaa nɔ voɡare tomɛ.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o do he baah ta nɔ dɛ mee. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, wɛɛ kpɔ o bandiaa ba chɔɡ heyaa kɛŋɔ nii ken le harɛ la ta.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: He bɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ daah na ɡɛ haa daahno na Maasa la.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ mmarare waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la bwa ta.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Kerekere dɛ he naanar bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ŋɔ yaa teŋɛ Mmarare nɔ ta nɔɔ?’

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: He ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Ya fa dɛ di somanjiri Ijipt kooro harɛ ta, asɛ Korowii che o kpeɡri ta dɛ le ya ne bela.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Ya siwi ta, Korowii ɡelɔ nyokpowaa ne wejena aa do ɔma kohona chole Ijipt harɛ ta, ne kooro ne o dem tena bwa nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Kɛ ya te, o le ya ne bela dɛ ba tɛ yaa harɛ waa baɡɛ ya naawa nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ yaa la.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya do sie Mmarare waa kpɔa tɛ yaa nɔ ta naa, anee dɛ́ ɡel o tea too ya nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ Mmarare waa baɡle heyaa dɛ kpɔ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta.

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa kpɔa do he nɔn ta la, hé chɔɡ ba bwa. He bɛ ba sum na dɛ́ tomɛ ba voɡare ɡe, a do kɛŋɔ bela dɛ́ lawɛ heya.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii laa nɔn kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ ɡel he pɔ ba nɛ aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpoo ba kwaraa. Hé ne ba bɛ fɔo fɔwɛ, he bɛ ba sum ɡe na.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Gɛ laa aa, baa berɛ he bii liiree baa wola Korowii nɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ́ kaa tomɛ voɡa, ásɛ o baah di he nɛɛ dɛ́ den kpoo heyaa warane.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Waa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛɛ ba laanee kɛŋɔ, hé paɡre bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛ fuah dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare, dɛ́ kuuɡi bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura la, dɛ́ teŋni voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa la ta, dɛ́ fuh ba voɡare.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛŋɔ he do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ. Onee le heyaa cheɡ tɛ o te le harɛre nɛra bwa bini, dɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ o nɛra he waa ɛɛ su o siwi.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Nyina waa dɛ nyin heyaa la, ne o baɡa waa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa la waa o che o kpeɡri ta lɛ heyaa le Ijipt kooro nɔn ta ne somanjiri dii waa dɛ do heyaa a ta la ta.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole o habɔɔ. O waa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ teŋɛ o fɔo waa fɔwa, dɛ kpɔ o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe baɡle banɔ la baa dɛ nyin o wa, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta la naanar bele kaɡboŋ baa ba lol ba la.

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: Kɛ banɔ la baa haoh la te, wɛ́ɛ tɛr ba deŋnee waa wola kpɔ hɛlɛ kwaraa.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ swee heyaa andɛɛɡaa ɡwaa harɛ nɔ ta nɛra, bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ɡwaa heyaa kondɔɔh ta, he bini baala ne haahna bɛlbwa toole waa wola lolɛ, hale he kondɛɛra kwara.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Hɛɛ berɛ ɡɛ voɡare la bɛlbwa ne he deremi bala, ɡɛ laa aa, he ne a bwa ɛɛ cheo tɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii chɔɡ heya. A ɛ kondoŋa he kia, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii lea cheɡ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡaa.”

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ nyin heyaa dɛ́ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa, dɛ́ ɡel he mun ya kohona. Wɛɛ ɡeloo he loɡle, he kooni kwaa kɛŋɔ mea ne ɡrepore ne ɔlevere bwa do wer, ásɛ he kondɛɛra ɡe ya. A ɡɛ hɛɛra nɔ bwaa wɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ heyaa harɛ la waa ŋwɛɛra baɡle he naawa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa la ta.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Dɛ he no ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ teŋɛ a ta kasinteŋ ne naa, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ ɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛ́ kpoŋe o fɔo la bini, dɛ́ɛ nyin he waa ɡɛ waa ŋwɛɛra baɡle he naawa la.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛɛ dɛ́ le weela bɛlbwa ta. Waa ɡel weechɔɡa haa naa Ijipt harɛ ta la ba he nɛ. Nɛra baa hah heyaa la nɛɛ wɛɛ ba kpɔe ta.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: He bɛ dɛɛ bol kɛŋɔ, ‘Nɛra nɔ sii ya nɛ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won doŋ ba ɔ?’

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: He bɛ ban ɔmɛ, hé lii ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa ɛ Ijipt kooro ne o harɛ nɛra bwa la.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Hé lii hɔhɔrɔwa ne nyokpowaa ne kpeɡri, ne bokpeɡa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa ɛ Ijipt tena dɛ lawɛ heyaa le la. Gɛ tentenee wɛɛ ba nɛra haa dɛ ɔm ba taraken nɔ ɛɛ.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ ɡeloo jeŋibotoola jo ba bini, hale dɛ́ kpoo ba bini banɔ la baa kaa sɔh dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba dɔ ba nyu la kwara.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he bɛ ban ɔmɛ. Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ lɔ he baah ta, o kan o waa do ɔma kohona.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Tama tamaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ ba ba doŋa ta, haa ba bwa kerabeŋkpoŋii kpoo. A ba ɡɛ naa, kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛɛ aah heya.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Ba koranar ɡe la, wɛɛ kpɔ baa do he lɔɡa, ásɛ he kpoo ba le harɛ nɔ ta ba waa tonɛ. Nomɛlbwa aa won che he sie, hɛɛ chɔɡ ba bwaa.
