english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Hé fuh ba voɡare, he bɛ ɡel he pɛla lawɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm aa lɔ a ta la ásɛ dɛ ba kpɔa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a do kɛŋɔ bela, dɛ́ won lawɛ heya. Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kii.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ Mmarare maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta kɛrɛdɛ. Ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu, hé mun ya dɛ́ won jo harɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa la ta dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ he kon.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ lɔr kpo heyaa he pwɛr he te, asɛ o tɛ heyaa kondikwaa ane baa dɛ yera maana la he di, kondikwaa he ne he naawa aa wola an jemɛ bwa. O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ ɡel he jemɛ kɛŋɔ kondikwaa ɡbo laa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn mkpa. Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol la bwa ɡe dɛ tɛ nɛn mkpa.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ, ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ tɛr o bie deŋne la, ɡɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ ɡe ɛɛ ɛ heya.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé teŋɛ waa la Korowii aa dɛ do heyaa la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛo.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ kaa he ne harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ta. Nenabɔɔne aa dɛ palɛ ɡboo o bwa. Neerare bulo dɛɛ le o ta, ɡɛɛ ane palɛ dɛɛ jo felembɔjena ta, ane ɡe palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ deŋɡarere dor.

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kondikwaa ne komɛlbwa ɡe aa heyaa nya bela. Ba dɔ bune dɛɛ le bela bwea la ta, asɛ a deŋɡarere ɡe taa baa kwi suuɡa te bɛlbwa.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Dɛ he baa di kwaa dɛ vaɡre aa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, harɛpare ondɛɛɡe waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la wa.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ haa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la waa soh, dɛ́ ba vɛh o Mmarare maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: He baa di kwaa dɛɛ vaɡre, dɛ do he dedɛɛɡa dɛ so a bini,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: asɛ he nae ne peera ne suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ komɛlbwa ya aa,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: he bɛ he te maŋkura dɛ́ ba soh Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta somanjiri dii ta la wa.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: Onee tɔ he sie dɛ kpɔ heyaa kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ waa kana dɛ do ɔma, nyɔɡre ne hwel ne harɛkonchɔɡa, ne nɔrɔme aa lɔ o ta la. Onee ɡela nee le bwe ta dɛ tɛ heyaa he nyɔ la.

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: O tɛ heyaa maana he di pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, kondikwaa he naawa aa wola an jemɛ bwa. Nee ne kondikwaa nyae nɔɔ o kpɔ daah heyaa na, asɛ wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ heyaa he daahna dɛ na la habɔɔ.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, he bɛ ba lii kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ne he bokpeɡa taa a che he dɔ kwa.

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Hé lii Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee tɛ heyaa wejema he kondɔɔh dɔe ta. Anee ɡela o nyoa waa baɡɛ he naawa la chɔ le ba le fini la.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: kɛŋɔ harɛre ane nɛra waa tɔ he sie dɛ kpoo ba la. Dɛ he ta o waa noɛ yaa, ɡɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ ba heyaa ɛɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Israel tena hɛ́ɛ no, fini hɛ́ɛ le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ harɛ taa dɛ́ ka doŋi harɛre nɛra baa kana dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa heya. Ba dɔ bwɛjena dɛ ma danjwɛkpeɡa a kaa nyundua bara.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Ba ɛ nɛra bane baa do kpeɡri dɛ kpeɡ kohona baa yer ba Anak tena la. He ɡbabir jemɔ dɛ no ɡɛ ba yon ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che Anak tena sie la.’

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Kɛ he te, hé jemɛ kpela kɛŋɔ fini Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɛ́ tɔ he sie le moo la baŋ. O do kɛŋɔ nii naa dɛ chɔɡ kwaa la, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ. Hɛ́ɛ doŋ baa le, dɛ́ kpoo ba warane ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.

english_verse: After the Lord helps you wipe out these nations and conquer their land, don't think he did it because you are such good people. You aren't good—you are stubborn! No, the Lord is going to help you, because the nations that live there are evil, and because he wants to keep the promise he made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. When Israel Made an Idol (Exodus
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé no a mun kɛŋɔ he nɛndɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa laa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ koh kpɔ ɡɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la ɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ ŋɔ ó ɛ he kon. A waa laa, he ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ nɛra.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Hé lii ɡɛ saŋ haa ɛ Korowii o baah di pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ ɛo deŋnekpeɡ dɛ le ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ ba tel bonɔ la.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Sinai Bwejen la lɔɡaa he ɡel o baah di kohona kɛŋɔ o fee kpoo heya.

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Tu le bonɔ kaa warane, he nɛra haa le ba ne Ijipt harɛ ta ba la ɛ wechɔɡa. Ba deno le waa maa do ba a ta la ta dɛ ɛ voɡ dɛɛ tomɔ.’

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘N na nɛra nɔ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ tena kohona!

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Gel mɛ ń kpoo ba ásɛ ba sɔn den he harɛ nɔ ta. Ásɛ n ɛɛ harɛ bir nɛra mɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel hé warɛ dɛ́ do kpeɡri ɡwaa ba.’

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Anee men Mosis laa berɛ dɛ tu, dɛ kpoŋe bwepɛle anɛ la fɔo la aa lɔ a ta la, dɛ nii la ta dɛ lawɛ bwejen la ta.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: N nao kɛŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɛɛ kohona. He ɛ voɡ o le nabale dɛ tɛ he te. He deno laa he te kpɔ ŋwɛnɛre Korowii aa do heyaa la ta.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n kpɔ bwepɛle anɛ la ɡo harɛ a bwa paɡre wɛjɛwɛjɛ ken he siwi ta.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Korowii baah fa di Arɔn ɡba nɛɛ ɡɛ saŋ taeh kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡoo, asɛ n soŋe tɛ o ɡe ɡɛ.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ kpɔ nabale haa ɛo o ɛ wechɔɡa tɛ heyaa la do nii ta, asɛ dɛ paɡro dɛ namɔ o ɛ mohooh ken, dɛ pa ta nee bɛl waa pala le bwejen la ta.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee he berɛ ɡel Korowii baah di Tabera ne Maasa, dɛ Kebrɔt Hataava.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ Korowii aa le he ne Kades Baanea la, O ŋɔ, ‘Hé kaa dɛ́ ka kpɔ harɛ la maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la so ó ɛ he kon.’ Kɛ he le Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ habɔɔ he ta on yaradae, he ta duure kpɔe tɛo.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Le ɡɛ saŋ maa jemɛ heyaa bwaa he le ɛ Korowii lwɛmkpeɡ.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Anomanta, n kpɔ n sie pi harɛ Korowii sie ɡɛ tɔpera fifraanaarɛ la ta webaŋa ne jwaana bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n nao kɛŋɔ o dɛ nyin o chɔɡ heya.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: N soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ, ‘Nemenɛ Korowii haa dɛ di komɛlbwa kpeɡri, n poori bɛ he nɛra haa kpɔ he kpeɡri waa kana dɛ lɛɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la chɔɡ ta.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he sie dawɛ he bonɔɔna Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb nɛ, ásɛ dɛ laa sie kpɔ nɛra nɔ deŋnekpeɡ ne ba nyubinikpeɡ dɛ ba wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Gɛ laa aa, harɛ haa lawɛ yaa le o ta la nɛra ɛɛ ŋɔɔ, he ta wone kpɔ he nɛra kaa harɛ haa baɡ ba nyoa la ta, dɛ ka kpoo ba pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, haeh haa hah ba la wa.

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ba ɛ he nɛra, he kapɛrɛ diile haa kpɔ he kpeɡri waa kana ne he bokpeɡa dɛ lee ba tɛ he te.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: “Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Mosis be a ɡɛ saŋ ja ŋɔ, ‘Sɛh bwepɛle anɛ á do kɛŋɔ wubwa kwaa la. Berɛ kwaa daa daka ja a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ teeh bwejen la ba n be.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: Ásɛ n chwerɛ waa n fa aa chwera dawɛ anɔ la haa laa paɡre la, ásɛ he kpɔ do daka la bini.’

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Ate, n kpɔ akaasia daa dɛ kwaa daka la, dɛ berɛ sɛh bwea la a do kɛŋɔ wubwa kwaa la ken, dɛ kpɔa teeh bwejen la.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ka chwerɛ waa o fa aa chwera dawɛ wubwa la, Mmarare fi o fa aa cheɡɛ nii ta bol he be bwe la ta, ɡɛ saŋ haa chema la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: Ate, n berɛ kpɔa tu dɛ ba kpɔ do daka la bini ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ la. A ta lɔ o bini ba le fini.”

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ duu Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, hé tomɔ. Hé kpɔ he te pɛlo, o ɡbo sɔn taa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ŋwɛɛ.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra bane lole baa yer ba Jaakan tena. Israel tena baa tel ba buli ta dɛ so bela. Ba ir bela dɛ ba Mosera. Belaa sɔfo Arɔn sewɛ ba huɡo. O bibaa Eliasa ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ ɛ sɔfo.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ba le bela dɛ kaa Gudɡuda, dɛ berɛ le bela kaa Jotbata. Nenabɔɔne ɡboo bela bwa.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋee Korowii le Lewi dea tena ŋɔ baa nyiŋi O Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ta, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ sɔfore dɛ́ che o sɔn ta dɛɛ swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra. A ta chɔ ɡɛ ba le fini.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Kaa dɛ́ ka tɔ nɛra la sie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛ maa ŋwɛɛraa baɡle ba naawa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba, bá ka so ó ɛ ba kon la ta.’ ” Korowii ɔma

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Israel tena, waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin dɛ le he be taraken laanee kɛŋɔ, hɛ́ɛ ɔmɔ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o waa bwa ta, dɛ́ nyinu dɛ́ɛ tomɔ he bambile ne he hweera bwa ne,

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ berɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne o waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta fini nɔ, ásɛ a chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Nyundua ne harɛ ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta bwa ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kwa.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Kɛ he naawa ɡbosoo nɛɛ Korowii kpɔ sie dawɛ kɛ wɛɛ nyin baa, dɛ berɛ le he nɛra haa ɛ ba naanar nɔ harɛre nɛra bwa bini, dɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ o nɛra ɡɛ aa doa fini nɔ.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ɡel he tea to ásɛ dɛ bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kpa.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɡwaa voɡa bwa, onee dɔɔranar bwa Dɔɔ, O kan, o waa do ɔma kohona. Waa nɛn siebɔr nyiŋi, haa won yawɔ sen ɡe.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: O dɛ nyiŋi bilalbii ne luhaahna kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ nyin nɛŋhɔɔhra ɡe ba kondikwaa dii ne ba yale tɔe bini.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ɡe nyin hɔɔhra wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɡe fa ɛ hɔɔhra Ijipt harɛ ta ka.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛro, onee Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o ɛ wejena aa do ɔma kohona he na ka la.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ta.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Fini, hé lii dɛ́ berɛ ta sie na waa Korowii aa ɛa dɛ baɡle heya. Heyaa, he bii laa. Hé na ɡɛ Korowii wa aa dɔ nyɛl, ne o kan ne o kpeɡri,

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: dɛ nyokpowaa waa kpɔa ɛ Ijipt kooro ne harɛ la bwa nɛra.

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: He na waa waa ɛ Ijipt laa tena ne ba jaɡre, ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛla la. Gɛ saŋ baa ti heyaa ka tel Mposwɛm la ta dɛ bwa ka nee ta kwaraa la,

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: ne ɡɛ waa ɛa tɛ heyaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ba tel bonɔ nɔ.

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: He na waa waa kpɔa ɛ Eliab bibaala Datan ne Abiram baa le Rubin dea, ɡɛ waa ɡela harɛ pere asɛ ba ne ba haahna ne bii, ne ba tɛnte deene ne ba bonɔɔna dɛ ba kondɛɛra bwa jo kaa harɛ bini he baah ta la.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: He siwi na wejena nɔ Korowii aa ɛa bwa sekwaraa.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ Mmarare nɔ bwa maa dɛ do heyaa fini nɔ ta, ásɛ dɛ won ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la, dɛ́ ka kpɔ harɛ la so,

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpajaŋ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe, Korowii aa ŋwɛɛ o waa he naawa be ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ba ne ba naanar la.

english_verse: It's better land than you had in Egypt, where you had to struggle just to water your crops.
translation_verse: Harɛ haa dɛ kaa o ta la ta doe kɛŋɔ Ijipt harɛ haa le o ta la. Ijipt harɛ he yon du kwaa dɛ́ pere nee bɔra tɛa dɛ́ dɔ nee dɛɛ do a ta la.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Harɛ haa dɛ ba Jɔɔdan ɡala ka so o ta nɔ ɛ bwejena ne nenabɔjena harɛ bwaala aa dɛ nɛ o ta.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: O ɛ harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa dɛ nyiŋi o ta saŋ te bɛlbwa, o siwi lɔ o ta tɔpere bɛlbwa ka tel benanyoa aa ba cheme.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ he teŋɛ Korowii Mmarare maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta, dɛ nyin Korowii dɛ tomɔ he bambile ne he hweera bwa ne naa,

english_verse: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.
translation_verse: dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he kondɛɛra dɔ kpɔɡa di, he ɡe dɔ kondikwaa di dɛɛ vaɡɛ.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ berɛ he te laa dɛ́ kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ dɛ́ kaa tomɛ voɡa dɛ́ɛ ɡuŋa.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Ásɛ Korowii baah bɛ he nɛɛ di, dɛ́ ɡel bwaala ɡel nɛɛ hwel che he kooni kondikwaa chɔɡ, ásɛ he serewe le harɛdɛɛɡe waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ waa nɔ do he nyuune ne bambili bini dɛɛ liira, hé ɛa kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡ dɛ́ kpɔ do nɔɔra, dɛ́ kpɔa vɔwɛ hé tili ta á ɛ waa chɔ dɛ́ɛ lii heya.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Hé bol baɡle he bii, hɛ́ɛ bola he dem soɡa ne he vala bini. He chɔe ne ira bini bwa, hɛ́ɛ bol a wa.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Hé chwera dawɛ he deene ɡbeni daa ta ne he ɡbeni ta,

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: ásɛ he ne he bii dɔ mkpajaŋ harɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa la ta. Gɛ nyundua aa saɡa biɡri la, ɡɛɛ he ɡe ɛɛ ba biɡra harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Dɛ he no waa maa dɛ do heya a ta nɔ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ teŋɛ a ta kasinteŋ ne, dɛ nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ dɛ duuru, dɛ kpɔ he te pɛlo waa,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: ate Korowii ɛɛ doŋi harɛre aa lɔ he sie la bwa nɛra baa wara dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa heyaa laanee ta, ásɛ he ka kpɔ ba harɛre la so.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Bobɛlbwa haa kpɔ kaa la ɛɛ ɛ he konee. He harɛ ɛɛ le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la taa, dɛ́ kaa Lɛbanɔn dɛ́ berɛ le Yufretis Moo ta dɛ́ kaa wee cholibɔr Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che he sie. Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo bobɛlbwa haa kpɔ la nɛra ɛɛ ɔmɛ heyaa kohona, ásɛ a ka ɡɛ, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: Fini n kpɔ andɛɛɡa sweera ne nyotaahna dɛɛ bil he sie.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Dɛ hé no Korowii waa nɔ dɛ teŋɛ a ta naa, hɛɛ dɔ andɛɛɡaa,

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: kɛ dɛ he vɛoh dɛ laa he te kpɔ a ta dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa tenaa, amɔ te nyotaahna ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii baa tel he ne harɛ haa dɛ́ la ka kpɔ so la ta naa, hé bol wedɛɛɡa waa Geresim Bwejen ta, dɛ́ berɛ bol nyotaahna waa Ebal Bwejen la ɡe ta.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Gɛ bwejena nɔ lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo ŋwɛnɛ wee cholibɔr, Araba Fɛlembɔjen bela Keenan tena aa soɡa harɛ ta. A bɛne More dajena Gelɡal sideŋ.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: He dɛ ba Jɔɔdan Moo la lee dɛ́ ka kpɔ harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ he so o ta la ta. He kaa kpɔ dɛ so o ta naa,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare la bwa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta.”

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ hé baa tel harɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé so o ta la aa, Mmarare aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé teŋɛ a ta laanee kɛŋɔ,

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: hé ka chɔɡ nɛra haa dɛ la ka doŋ ba le harɛ la ta la voɡtubɔra aa lɔ bwejena ne deŋɡarere ne daa lɔɡre la bwa sekwara.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Hé kuuɡi bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare, dɛ́ paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura la. Dɛ́ berɛ fuh ba voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa, dɛ́ huɡri voɡa baa ɛa cheɡ dɛɛ toma la, dɛ́ chɔɡ a bwa le bela a waa bwa le kwara.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: He bɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɛ nɔ dɛɛ tomɛ ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa la.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: He harɛre la baa do kan asɛ bela haa chema dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la do jaŋne aa, saŋ bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la, hɛɛ wonoo kpoo nae kɛɛ peera Korowii aa tɛ heyaa la, ásɛ dɛ chwe ola la he deremi ɡɛ maa ŋɔ he be la.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ won dia ɡɛ haa dɛ di kweɡli ne ahre, hale nɛra baa kah doŋa ne banɔ la baa wola doŋa kaeh Korowii be pera bwa.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: He bɛ an di, ásɛ a chiɡ he ne he bii ba taa dɛ ba bala la kɛrɛdɛ. He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he dɛ ɛ waa aa wera Korowii be.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Ásɛ he kpɔ ol la ne chal la bwa ɛ saraha bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛ fuah dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la, dɛ́ fuɡe ol la bɛl ɡe chal ta bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ fuah la, ásɛ dɛ di ol la te.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ waa maa ŋɔ he be bwa ta, ásɛ a chiɡ he ne he bii ba taa dɛ ba bala bwa kɛrɛdɛ, ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ be.

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ chɔɡ harɛre haa dɛ la ka so a ta la nɛra dɛ ɡel he so a ta naa,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ŋwɛnɛre baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡare la ba nyiŋi, dɛ́ ɡe ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta, a do kɛŋɔ bela, dɛ́ lawɛ heya.

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: He bɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ tomɛ ŋwɛnɛ baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛ tomɛ ba voɡa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba dɛ ɛ kii waa bwa soo siwi Korowii aa haah. Hale ba kpoo ba bibaala ne bihaahna dɛ fuuh ba dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: Hé do sie dɛ́ ɛ waa maa do heyaa a ta nɔ, he bɛ waane kpɔ ja a ta, he bɛ ane ɡe laa kpɔ le a ta.”

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: asɛ waa waa bola la ɛ kpela, asɛ o ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel ya tomɛ voɡfala’ aa,

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: he bɛ a ɡɛ nɛn la be no. Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ dɛ daah heyaa, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ he dɛ nyinu he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ne kɛɛ.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ hé teŋɛ, onee chɛ kɛ hé ɔmɛ. Hé teŋɛ o waa ta dɛɛ duuru, hé tomɔ dɛ́ kpɔ he te pɛlo.

english_verse: because he rescued you from slavery in Egypt. If a prophet tells you to disobey the Lord your God and to stop worshiping him, then that prophet is evil and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Keame nyosonteŋni kɛɛ nɛn waa won deera mun baɡla la chɛ kpoe, o baɡle heyaa waa a ɡel he ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ le Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o le he ne somanjiri dii ta Ijipt harɛ ta la habɔɔ, dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he laa he te kpɔ waa haa dɛ teŋɛ a ta la aa, hé kpoo dɛ́ le ɡɛ liichɔɡa la ne he bini.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Ásɛ Israel tena bwa no dɛ́ ɔmɛ, ásɛ bɛlbwa bɛ a ɡɛ wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ nɔ ta ba kpɔ kpa.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: Dɛ he baa no bwɛɛre Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa tɛ heyaa ŋɔ he so a ta la bɛl,

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: ɡɛ hiribi nɛra nɔ iro dɛɛ neɡre nɛra ŋɔ baa tomɛ voɡfala aa,

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: hé bɔɔ dɛ́ nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ ɡɛɛ kpela kɛŋɔ wedoŋa aa do ken chiɡ he bini naa,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: hé kpoo ɡɛ bwɛɛ la tena bwa, dɛ́ chɔɡ bwɛɛ la bwa kwara, hale kondɛɛra aa lɔ bela bwa.

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡɛ kwaa la bɛlbwa ba kpɔ, ásɛ a ba ɛ musu tɛ heya, ásɛ Korowii baah bɛ hé nɛɛ ba di. Ó na he sum, dɛ́ dɔ tedoma tɛ heya, dɛ́ ɡel he ya kohona ɡɛ waa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa la,

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ he dɛ no Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ deŋna waa, dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa bwa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta, dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa toɡra o be.”

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: He ɛ Korowii nɛra dɛ do ɡoroŋ, onee le heyaa le harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa bini dɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ o ɡbaɡba nɛra he wa ɛɛ su o siwi.

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Jumbii aa wera ne dii la, hé dia.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Ol te bɛlbwa waa dɔ nafikoko a baah pere, asɛ o di kwaa dɛ́ berɛ won uɡa dɛ́ chwea la, anee chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ di.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Ola a nafikoko baah aa wola pere kɛɛ aa wola uɡe dɛɛ chwe la te, hɛ́ɛ berɛ a dii. Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ berɛ nyoɡma, ne chooma ne aah di. A lole kɛŋɔ a uɡo dɛɛ chwe te, kɛ a nafikoko baah ta pere, aa were ne dii.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ berɛ parakoo ɡe dii, o nafikoko baah pero te kɛ waa kwaa di dɛ́ berɛ won uɡa dɛ́ chwe. Hɛ́ɛ berɛ a dii a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ leɡe a lalaa.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Nee bini kwaa ɡe, anɔ la aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé di laanee anɔ la aa dɔ pɛɡa ne kena,

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: kɛ a bini bɛlbwa waa wola kaaɡa ne pɛɡa dɔe la, aa were ne dii.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: Koŋɡaahla aa dɛ ɡah te bɛlbwa aa were, he bɛ an di.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Kɛ koŋɡaahla aa wera ne dii la, hé dia.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: He bɛ ol waa sewa ta baŋa la di. Hé kpɔ tɛ nɛra baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra dɛ so he baah ta. Gɛ laa ɡe aa, hé yoɡ tɛ nɛn waa wola he nɛɛ jae. He ɛ Korowii nɛra dɛ do ɡoroŋ. He bɛ pebie kɛɛ bombie daa o nya elnee ne.” Kwaa bini bɔna bɔre fi

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Bena bɛlbwa koo kwaa haa dɔ la, hé bɔne a bini bɔre fi dɛ laa bɔrbeŋkpoŋ kwaa cheɡ.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he mea ne sen ne ɔleve noo haa bɔne a bini bɔre fi la bɔrbeŋkpoŋ, ne nao ne pee dɛ booh biloɡla kaa bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ he tomɔ la, ásɛ dɛ ka dia o sie bela. Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ɛ duu Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Dɛ bela ne he dem jaŋne kohona haa won che kwaa Korowii aa chae he dɔ la kaa bela aa,

english_verse: then sell this part and take the money there instead.
translation_verse: amɔ te yoɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡa la la bela Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa lea tɛ heya la.

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Dɛ́ kpɔ yawɛ komɛlbwa he pɛla aa lawa, nao kɛɛ pee kɛɛ sen, ásɛ he ne he dem tena bwa pɛ dia bela Korowii sie, dɛ́ kpɔ lɛ he sie.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Hé bɛ Lewi dea tena baa lɔ hé baah ta baa wola harɛ dɔe dɛ́ parɛ la vɔmɛ.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Bene atoro bɛlbwa ta la, he bɔne he koo kwaa bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ cheɡ he bwɛɛre ta bela baa dɛ cheɡ kwa.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena la ta harɛ dɔe dɛ́ di o ta, anomanta, ɡɛ kondikwaa la ɛ ba ne hɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna baa lɔ he baah ta la kwa. Anee ba ɡee ba dii dɛ vaɡɛ, ásɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa he toma haa dɛ ɛa ta.”

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: Dɛ a hiah he bini bɛl bwɛɛ bɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la ta naa, he bɛ nyubinikpeɡ ɛ dɛ́ vɛh o chae.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Kenii chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ. Nomɛlbwa o dɔŋ Israel te aa kemɛ suuɡa o be la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel á ta. O bɛ suuɡa la lɛ kpa bwa. Korowii ɡbabirii tɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Dɛ hɔɔh te di he kem aa lɛ, kɛ he bini bɛl te di o dɔŋ kem aa, wɛɛ berɛ lɛɛ.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ swee heyaa andɛɛɡaa, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la. Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ baa kemɛ suuɡa he bee, kɛ he te aa ba bee la ka kemɛ bwa. Gɛ ɡee hɛɛ ba kpeɡri dii harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra nɛ, harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra te aa won di kpeɡri he nɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: Hé ta tea, dɛ́ kemɔ anɔ la aa telu.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Dɛ benanyoa nɛn aa di he kem he ɡel a ta la dɛ tel, asɛ nomɛl ba dɛ ba kemɛ suuɡa he be naa, bɛ koh kɛŋɔ ɡɛ tɔpere la dɛ tel dɛ́ vɔmɔ. Bɛ ɡel ɡɛ liichɔɡa nɔ ba he nyu bini, ásɛ o bɛ ba wi no Korowii ta he nɛ, á ba ɛ wechɔɡa tɛɛ.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Bɛ on nyubinikpeɡ ɛ, ta tea dɛ́ kpɔ tɛo pɛɛpɛɛ, ásɛ Korowii ɡel he dɔ andɛɛɡa wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ ta.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Dɛ kondɛɛre la bɛlbwa di kirihiah o nakpala kɛɛ o sibie kɛɛ o bobɛl aa, he bɛ on kpɔ ka ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Dɛ he tɛo ŋwɛnɛ aa, bɛ ɡel o kaa pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Tɛo he peera ne boohna ne mea dɛ sen haa dɔa la ane. Tɛo ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa ɡela he dɔ andɛɛɡa la.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Dɛ a ɛo kɛŋɔ he yom la ŋɔ waa he bee le, kɛ o dɛ nyin he ne he bii wa, he dɛ ɛo kɛrɛdɛ naa,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: lawɛ o deŋne marɛ he dea ɡbera dɛ́ forɔ, ó ɛ he nɛndɔɔle saŋ bɛlbwa hale o serewe bena. Dɛ haahnee yaa, ɛ o ɡe ɡɛ.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Hé le he nae ne peera biloɡla aa ɛ ambala la cheɡ, a ɛ Korowii kwa. He bɛ he nae biloɡla kpɔ parɛ, he bɛ peera biloɡla ɡe pona fonɛ.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la, belaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ne he haahna ne bii la ane bena bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ka kpoora dɛ́ dia Korowii sie.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Hé kpoo he dem, dɛ́ diu kɛŋɔ ɡɛ he yon la kpaah bɔr, dɛ́ ka kpo kweɡla kɛɛ ah dɛɛ dia la. Hale banɔ la baa kah doŋa, ne banɔ la baa wola doŋa kaeh Korowii be pera la bwa ɛɛ wonoo di.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: He bɛ a chale la te daa dɛɛ di, hé fuɡa ta kɛŋɔ nee ken.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Abib korobie la ta Korowii sɔn ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ korobie la taa o lɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ jwaana bɛl.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ waa ɡbo ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpa dɛ́ ka kpɔ harɛ la Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la. Voɡare ane toma

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Tɔpera anumɛl aa tɔ sie la, he bɛ paanoo baa do iisi a ta di, ásɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee la he bɛ toma ɛ. Hé bwa cheme dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.” Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen dii

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: He bɛlbwa lawɛ o pee kɛɛ nao le o kondɛɛra bini, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ la bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen saraha tɛ Korowii o sɔn ta.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: He bɛ Galekaa kondɛɛre la kpo bwɛɛ bɛlbwa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ bwɛɛ waa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ tomɔ o ta la ɡbo ta. Belaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ kpoa, jɔmɔra wee aa baa jo la, ɡɛ korobie la ne tɔpere haa kpɔa dɛ le Ijipt harɛ ta la.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Hé daa ol la, dɛ́ so bela haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la dɛ́ chwe, ásɛ tɔɔ perɔ chɔa he kaa bela haa soɡa.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: He bɛ bwe kpɔ pa dɛ́ɛ tomɔ. Korowii kii ɡɛ kwaa la.”

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: He bɛ voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa paaɡe ja kon haa ɛo dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ta.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you start your grain harvest,
translation_verse: Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Hé kure yawanyoa anuanɛ le awola tɔpere haa pa mun komɛ mea la.

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Hé ne he bii, ne he bonɔɔna, ne toli ne Lewi dea tena, ne hɔɔhra ne bilalbii, dɛ luhaahna baa lɔ he bwɛɛre la ta bwa pɛ, dɛ́ lɛ sie bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: nomɛlbwa nyiŋi ɡɛ Korowii aa swee andɛɛɡa tɛo o dɔ la ta dɛ́ tɛ.” Sitɔɔla lee bá nyiŋi dɛɛ bol nɛra wa

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: Benanyoa bɛlbwa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ baa bɛlbwa la bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la, dɛ́ ka tomɔ kera atoro. Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen la ne Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen ne Kukure Tɔpejen la ta. Nomɛlbwa bɛ nɔŋɡbayeeɡa ne bela la,

english_verse: After you are settled in the towns that you will receive from the Lord your God, the people in each town must appoint judges and other officers. Those of you that become judges must be completely fair when you make legal decisions, even if someone important is involved. Don't take bribes to give unfair decisions. Bribes keep people who are wise from seeing the truth and turn honest people into liars.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ bol waa kasinteŋ dɛ bɛ a sie laa dɛɛ berɛ. He bɛ nɛra siebɔr dɛɛ nyiŋi, he bɛ ɡel baa yawɛ heyaa sen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ dɛ berɛ waa sie, dɛ berɛ ɡel nɛn waa jemɛ waa o waa dɔ kasinteŋ la ɛɛ teŋe nyosone.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ nao kɛɛ pee waa di kirihiah kpɔ ka ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ. O kii ɡɛ kwaa la.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: Dɛ he baa no ɡɛ waa nɔ naa, hé nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ wechɔɡa la chiɡ Israel harɛ ta naa, ba kii.

english_verse: But you will need two or three witnesses—one witness isn't enough to prove a person guilty. Get rid of those who are guilty of such evil. Take them outside your town gates and everyone must stone them to death. But the witnesses must be the first to throw stones. Difficult Cases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɛ a ba ɡɛ naa, danseɛ tena la tɔ sie kpɔ bwea foɡro mɔɔ nomɛlbwa teŋɛ. Gɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ taa hɛɛ ba wona laa ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ kpɔ he bini. Waa bola kɔɔto

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Ásɛ nomɛlbwa no dɛ́ ɔmɛ dɛ bɛ bansua waa aa do ɡɛ la dɔŋa ba ɛ kpa.” Kooro lee wa

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa tel harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ he dɔ dɛ so o ta dɛ lii kɛŋɔ, he chiɡ kooro wɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ harɛre aa bar heyaa nɔ naa,

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ na onɔ la Korowii aa leo. A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ he bini bɛl. He bɛ hɔɔh kpɔ, hé kpɔ Israel te.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Kooro la bɛ jaɡre kohona nyin, o bɛ ɡel nɛra la Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ́ ka yawɛ jaɡre, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ŋɔ o nɛra bɛ berɛ la Ijipt harɛ ta kpa.

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Kooro la bɛ haahna mo warɛ, a ba ɡɛ naa, waa sie Korowii waa taa do. O bɛ kondɔɔh kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋa kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm kohona nyin.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Dɛ naate baa so kara ta naa, o nyiŋi Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore la be, dɛ́ lɛ Korowii tɔn la dɛ́ nyiŋi o ta dɛ́ chwerɛ bɛl.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel wɛɛ paŋɔ, wɛɛ kuro saŋ te bɛlbwa o soɡa bini bwa. Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba ɡela ó jemɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la duura kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa waa bola a do tɔn la bini.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel ó jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ta o bala Israel tena ɡwaalɛ. O bɛ tɔn la waa la ane laa kpɔ, dɛ bɛ ane ɡe kpɔ ja, ásɛ a ɡel o ne o naanar di kora dɛɛ biɡri Israel harɛ ta.”

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tomɛ n keamee ó ba bol n waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba ɡɛ maa tomɛ nɔ. Ba ɡbaɡba dwee binii wɛɛ ba lee. Mɛɛ kpɔ n waa tɛo, ásɛ o bol anɔ la bwa maa doo bwa baɡ ba.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Gɛ del ba bala la aa dɛ dɔ la, ɡɛ tentenee chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡe dɔ, hale dɛ suuɡaa o dɔ le o mɛɛ kɛɛ o nya kwaa waa yoɡa ta noo.” We-ɛɛla ane aa ɛ kii wa

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore la aa Israel harɛ la peraa dɔ, kɛ baa di koŋkɛɛla ne kwaa haa kpɔ ba ɛ saraha dɛ fuah dɛɛ tɛ Korowii laanee.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Dɛ he kpɔ nao kɛɛ pee ɛ saraha aa, sɔfore la di bɔree o vam ne o kaŋe dɛ o tea bini kwa.

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: Banee bera chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ he mea aa tɔ sie ne he senfala, ne ɔleve noo dɛ peera pona he yon tɔ sie fona bena bɛlbwa la tɛ,

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ne ba naanaree Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ le he deene la bwa bini ŋɔ bá che o sɔn ta, dɛ́ɛ ɛ o toma saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: Lewi dea te bɛlbwa waa so Israel harɛ bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta dɛ nyin aa, wɛɛ won ba bela Korowii aa lea cheɡ ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ bela la,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ ɛ sɔfo dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma kɛŋɔ ɡɛ ba bala Lewi dea tena la aa dɛ ɛ bela la.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he tel harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta naa, he bɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la ba chaa, dɛ́ hweli ba wedoŋa ŋwɛnɛre la. Korowii kia taeh.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ wedoŋa nɔ, a ɡɛ kii we-ɛɛla nɔ waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ tɔ he sie, dɛ doŋi ɡɛ harɛre nɛra baa dɛ ɛa dɛ do he sie la.

english_verse: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things! A Prophet like Moses Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé waa do kaih Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ be.” Korowii tomɛ o keame bɛl

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra haa doŋ ba la dɛ no nɛra baa dɛ voɡɛ dɛɛ ɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla la wa. Kɛ he te, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ta heyaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛ he ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ tomɛ o keamee ó ba bol o waa dɛɛ tɛ heya ɡɛ waa tom mɛ nɔ. He ɡbaɡba dwee binii wɛɛ ba o lee. A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no o wobol.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Gɛ awola haa cheme Sinai Bwejen la lɔɡa dɛ soŋe Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ ɡel yá no Korowii taa kɛɛ dɛ́ na nijena nɔ dɔŋa kpa, ɡɛ laa aa, yaa serewoo.’

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Gɛ baa bola nɔ wer.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛl ta n waa waa cheɡɛ n sɔn ta dɛ bol ta teŋaa, naate deŋnee mɛɛ ba tɛra.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɛ keame bɛl ɡe baah suu ŋɔ wɛɛ che n sɔn taa dɛ́ bol waa maa wola on a ta doe, kɛɛ keame waa che voɡ bɛlbwa sɔn ta, dɛ́ bol waane la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo.’

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Hɛɛ dɛɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii nyoa wobol laa ɔ?’

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ keame cheɡɛ Korowii sɔn ta dɛ bol waa asɛ a ta ɡɛ ɛɛ yaa, amɔ te dɛ Korowii nyoa wobol laa. O ɡbaɡba kpeɡri taa o che dɛ bol. He bɛ ɡɛ nɛn la ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: haa dɛ teŋɛ mmarare nɔ bwa maa do heyaa fini nɔ ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ dɛɛ valɛ o ŋwɛnɛre ta la nomanta, hé le bwɛjena atoro cheɡ ja.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ chɔɡ nɛra haa dɛ la ka kpɔ ba harɛre so a ta nɔ, asɛ he ka kpɔ ba bwɛɛre ne deremi so naa,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: A kaa ba kɛŋɔ, dɛ nomɛl ne o dɔŋ la kɔr bini dɛ ka teŋe da, asɛ kpanfɛbii la fome le o daa ta dɛ ka ŋwɛnɛ o dɔŋ la o sewɛ aa, onɔ la chwa kaa ɡɛ bwɛjen la bɛl ta, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Dɛ he le bwɛjen beŋkpoŋ ɡbo aa, a baah la ɛɛ do jaŋnee, ásɛ nɛn waa sewa la nɛra won ti naate waa wola saahnɛ kpo o dɔŋ la, dɛ́ kpɔ bandia ka kpoo, kɛ dɛ o ta chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ waa n doe ŋɔ he le bwɛjena atoro cheɡ la.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: He ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ chale ba fuɡe ta harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ kɛŋɔ kapɛrɛ kon la ta, ásɛ dɛ bɛ nɛŋkpoa bolchɔɡe ba di.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ nomɛl hah o dɔŋ, dɛ bɛɛlo dɛ ka lɔɔro kpo, dɛ chwa kaa bwɛjen la bɛl ta naa,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: bwɛɛ la naate aa le o ta la nomonome tomɛ toroma bá la ka kpɔɔ ba, ásɛ ba kpɔɔ do nɛn waa sewa la lolanar nɔn ta bá kpoo bɔ kem.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: He bɛ o sum na, ásɛ a chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ. Gɛɛ dɛ le nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ ba kpoo la bolchɔɡe dii le Israel harɛ ta.

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ ŋɔ he ka so o ta la, saŋ la tena kpɔ bwea pa ba jwɛhre ta. He kon haa dɔ la, he bɛ bwea aa pa he ne he dɔŋ jwɛh ta la huɡri ta.” Danseɛ dii

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ aa won di danseɛ nomɛl wedoŋa kɛɛ wechɔɡa waa ɛa ta, ásɛ ba pao bolchɔɡe a maɡre. A chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra banɛ kɛɛ batoro di danseɛ mɔɔ.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl di dansewea dɛɛ dawɛ nomɛl nɛ aa,

english_verse: then both you and the accused must be taken to the court at the place where the Lord is worshiped. There the priests and judges will find out if you are lying or telling the truth. If you are lying and the accused is innocent,
translation_verse: ásɛ nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ danseɛ te la ɛ nyosonteŋni dɛ di dansewea dɛɛ dawɛ o dɔŋ nɛ aa,

english_verse: then you will be punished without mercy. You will receive the same punishment the accused would have received if found guilty, whether it means losing an eye, a tooth, a hand, a foot, or even your life. Israel, the crime of telling lies in court must be punished. And when people hear what happens to witnesses that lie, everyone else who testifies in court will tell the truth.
translation_verse: He bɛ nomɛlbwa sum dɛɛ na, dɛ he kpo nɛn aa, a nyoa hɛɛ ba kae. He fome he dɔŋ siwi aa, bá fome he ɡe kon, he ku he dɔŋ nyen aa, bá ku he ɡe kon, he teŋe he dɔŋ nɔn aa, bá teŋe he ɡe kon, he teŋe he dɔŋ nakpala aa, bá teŋe he ɡe kon.”

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kaa cheme he dɔma laa ta, asɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ dɔma la torɔɡore baa vɔwɛ jaɡre pɛla la warɔ ɡwaa heya aa, he bɛ ban ɔmɛ. Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta la ɛɛ che he mun taa.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ ba laa yoi yaa, sɔfo ba che he laa tena la sie, dɛ́ bol waa baɡ ba ŋɔ,

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: ‘Israel tena, fini he ne he dɔma dɛ ba yoi, anomanta, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr, he bɛ ɡel he bwara ɛɛ sa, he bɛ ban ɔmɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ne Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔɔ dɛɛ kaa dɛ́ ka yoo ba, hɛɛ yoo le.’

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Ásɛ laa sitɔɔla la ŋɔ laa tena la be ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ bɛlbwa do demfale o ta on pile dɛ ka so o ta mɔɔ naa, ó berɛ kaa dem. Dɛ ɡɛ laa o kaa ka laa la ta naa, nɛnfalee dɛ́ pili dea la, dɛ́ so o ta.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Dɛ he bini bɛl ɡe du daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen waa wola an chaarɛ bwa naa, o ɡe berɛ kaa dem. Dɛ ɡɛ laa o ka laa la ta naa, nomɛlee dɛ́ chaara dɛ́ nyɔ a sen.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ dɛ nomɛl ɡe nyin haah dɛ haah la ta o dea balɛ mɔɔ naa, o kaa dem dɛ́ ka mo o haah la. Gɛ laa dɛ o ka laa la ta naa, nomɛl ɛɛ kpɔ haah laanee mo.’

english_verse: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.
translation_verse: Sitɔɔla la teŋɛ dɛ bol ja ŋɔ, ‘Hé bini bɛlbwa o bwara aa yɔra wɛɛ ɔmɛ la, kaa dem dɛ bɛ ba kpɔ maah o bala.’

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Nomonome la bol waa tonaa, bá le laa sitɔɔla bá chɔ ba nyoa.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ hé so o ta la te, he bɛ hweera kon te bɛlbwa ɡel a bwɛɛre ta.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Hé kpoo a bwa, Hiti ne Amɔre ne Keenan tena, ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena. Hé ɛ ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa do heyaa la.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.

translation_verse: Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba he te laa dɛ́ kpɔ nɛŋkpoa haa wola a wobɛlbwa jemɛ bolchɔɡe dii ta, a ɡɛ ɛ waa aa wera Korowii be.” Haahna baa laɡ ba laa ta moe wa

translation_verse: Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ne he dɔma cheme laa ta, asɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kpɔ ba do he nɔn ta asɛ he laɡ ba yoma aa,

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ haa on nyin kpa aa, kpɔ o bwara kɛo. Bɛ on yoɡ lɛ suuɡa, bɛ on ɛ kɛ yom, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee chemo.” Bibanloɡla kapɛrɛ dii wa

A Son Who Rebels Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé tɛ bie waa ɛ nomoa la bele anɛ, hale dɛ he chanche la bie laa kwaraa noo. A ɡɛ bie laanee o mɛɛ bonɔmbie, anomanta, biloɡle dibɔr chɛo. Bibaa o deŋne aa kpeɡa wa

translation_verse: Ásɛ bwɛɛ la baala foɡro bwea kpo, dɛ́ le ɡɛ wechɔɡa la le he bini. Ásɛ Israel tena bwa no dɛ́ ɔmɛ.” Mmarare ane ɡe wa

translation_verse: Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛl ɛ wechɔɡa a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo, asɛ ba kpoo dɛ kpɔɔ ka saɡɛ daa ta naa,

translation_verse: he bɛ ɡel o saɡɛ daa la ta tɔɔ per. Hé nyiŋi dɛ́ huɡo awola tenten, ásɛ dɛ bɛ doŋa ba kah harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ he so o ta la. Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii taah nomɛlbwa waa saɡɛ daa ta sewɛ.”

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he na he dɔŋ nao kɛɛ pee o nyoɡre dɛɛ kaa laa, bɛ sie laa kpɔ, lawɔ ka tɛo.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ne kon te la jaŋne kɛɛ dɛ haa kon te jemaa, lawɔ kaa he dem. Ásɛ dɛ kon te ba dɛ bɔɔ o wa aa, hé kpɔ tɛo.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ he dɔŋ keeɡo kɛɛ o yal kɛɛ komɛlbwa waa ɛ he dɔŋ kon dɛ nyoɡre, bɛ sie laa kpɔ.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys that carry heavy loads can stumble and fall, and be unable to get up by themselves. So as you walk along the road, help anyone who is trying to get an ox or donkey back on its feet. Don't Pretend To Be the Opposite Sex Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔŋ keeɡo kɛɛ nao cholo chɔ ŋwɛnɛ baah ta naa, bɛ sie laa kpɔ o nɛɛ dɛ ɡarɔ ta kaa, chao dɛ́ horo che chiŋ.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Haah ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do baa laala, ɡɛɛ baa ɡe aa wola chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do haah kwa. Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kii ɡɛ.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɛ he do dea aa, ɛ kon bar sal la nyoa, ásɛ a bɛ ba kɛŋɔ nomɛl teeh sal la, dɛ́ le nyundua bela dɛ́ ba le harɛ sewɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ waa do he nyoa.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Bɛ komɛlbwa du ja daa haa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen la ta koo beŋkpoŋ ta. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa won di kwaa la bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: Bɛ daa vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl nao ne keeɡo á parɛ.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: Bɛ yal baa kpɔ pee pona ne yabi pɛ sɔh la tɔ.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nyarɛ jɔɔra do he yal haa dɛ tɔ la nyoo anaarɛ la bwa ta.” Baa ne haah yal chɔɡa wa

translation_verse: dɛ kpɔ sɔnchɔɡe dawɛ o nɛɛ ŋɔ, he ta haah la pue, o jemɛ baala aa,

translation_verse: Ásɛ haah la mɛɛ ŋɔ nomonome la be ŋɔ, ‘N kpɔ n bihaah nɔ tɛ baa ŋɔ o mo kɛ waa on nyin kpa.

translation_verse: Ásɛ bwɛɛ la nomonome la tɛr baa la deŋne,

translation_verse: dɛ́ yoɡu lɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa tɛ haah la mɛɛ, sɔnchɔɡe waa kpɔa dawɛ Israel tolo waa wola baa jemɛ bwa la wa. Ó ta moo dɛ bɛ on vɛh, nemenɛ seo.

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: ate bá lawɛ haah la ka so o mɛɛ dem doonyoa, ásɛ o bwɛɛ baala foɡro bwea kpo, dɛ́ le ɡɛ wechɔɡa la ne Israel harɛ ta. O ɛ sihihwa kɛŋɔ waa soɡe o mɛɛ dem dɛ bɔ jwamane la.

translation_verse: Dɛ he na baa dɛ o lawɛ o dɔŋ haah chɔ aa, hé kpo baa la ne haah la bwa, dɛ́ le ɡɛ wechɔɡa la ne Israel harɛ ta.

translation_verse: hé kpɔ ba nɛra banɛ la bwa kaa bwɛɛ la doonyoa dɛ́ ka foɡ ba bwea kpo. Haah la kpoe munii kɛŋɔ, o ta lɔŋɔre doe soŋe lɛɛ, bwɛɛ bini ɡee. Baa la kwaa munii kɛŋɔ, o chɔɡ o dɔŋ haah. Gɛɛ dɛ́ le ɡɛ wechɔɡa la ne Israel harɛ ta.

translation_verse: Dɛ he na baa o ɡuɡri tolo waa wola baa jemɛ, asɛ ba ta on kpɔe tɛ yal o ne o chɔ aa,

translation_verse: Sɛmbie ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ja Korowii nɛra bini, hale o naanar baa teŋa bele fi ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá ja Korowii nɛra bini.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Amɔn tena kɛɛ Moab tena, hale ba naanar baa teŋa bele fi aa won ja Korowii nɛra bini.

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, ba vɔmɛ heyaa nee ne kondikwa. Beɔ bibaa Balam, waa le Pɛtɔ dɛ do Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta la, ba kaa bɔɔ paa ŋɔ ó ba taah heya.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa dɛ nyin heyaa nomanta, o ta sie doe Balam wesoŋa la ta dɛ berɛ ɡel taahna la berɛ andɛɛɡa tɛ heya.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: He ne ba bɛ chamene di saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.

translation_verse: He bɛ nɛra baa dɛ yer ba Edom tena hah, he lolanaree dɔŋa. Gɛɛ Ijipt tena ɡe, he bɛ ba ɡe hah, he fa soɡe ba harɛ ta kɛ hɔɔhra ka.

translation_verse: Le ba naanar baa teŋa bele batoro ta, dɛɛ kaa la ken ɛɛ ba ja Korowii nɛra nɛɛ.” Bela nɛra aa soɡa wedoŋa we-ɛɛla

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kaa baŋre he tɛnte deene bobɛl dɛ́ ka yo he dɔma aa, hé laa he te kpɔ waa aa ɡel hé kah doŋa ta.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Dɛ he bini bɛl chɔɔ dɛ dee o bwara ba naa, a ɛ doŋa wa. Ó le he bini dɛ́ ka so he habɔɔ.

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: Hé nyin kon haa kpɔ dɛɛ forɛ bɔɔ do he be, ásɛ dɛ dahara dɛ le heya aa, hé kpɔ forɛ bɔɔ dɛ́ la do dɛ tɔ a ta.

english_verse: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave. Runaway Slaves from Other Countries Moses said:
translation_verse: A munii kɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ lɔ he baah ta dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he pɔ he dɔma nɛ. Anomanta, hé ɡel bela haa cheme la do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ Korowii bɛ doŋa bɛlbwa he nɛɛ na, dɛ ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo heya.” Mmarare ane ɡe wa

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛl yom chwao dɛ ba marɛ naa, bɛ on lawɛ ka tɛ o dɔɔ kpa.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: O dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ó so he bwɛɛre la bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin ta. Kɛ bɛ on fiiɡi.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: Israel baa kɛɛ haah bɛlbwa bɛ ɡel voɡ kpɔɔ ó do o toma ta dɛɛ bɔ jwamane.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: Dɛ he tɛ he dɔŋ Israel te suuɡa kɛɛ kondikwaa o kemaa, hale komɛlbwa a fe aa chɛ a nee lɛɛ la, bɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: He dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ he lɛ hɔɔh te kon haa kpɔa kemɔ la ne. Kɛ he dɔŋ Israel tee yaa, ŋwɛnɛ toole kɛ he lɛ, ásɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sweere andɛɛɡa komɛlbwa haa ɛ harɛ haa dɛ la ka so o ta la ta.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: Dɛ he baɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nyoa aa, chuɡra warane ásɛ a bɛ wechɔɡa ba berɛ tɛɛ. A ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ lɛo le he be.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ta nyoa baɡaa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa le he nyoa la, nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɛa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee ta tea dɛ baɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nyoa.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: Dɛ he jo he dɔŋ bɛl daa koo ta naa, di daa la nɔna bɛlbwa ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin, kɛ bɛ ane kpɔ do he pur bini.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee dɛ he tel he dɔŋ mea koo ta naa, kpɔ nɔn kuuɡi ane, bɛ kere kpɔ jo a ta.”

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: Mosis ŋɔ, “Dɛ baa bɛlbwa mo haah asɛ dɛ berɛ ba na sihihwaane o nɛ, o pɛla le o nɛɛ wɛɛ nyin dɛ́ vɛoh waa, ó chwerɛ tɔn tɛo dɛ́ le o ne o dem.

english_verse: Later she married another man,
translation_verse: Dɛ haah la berɔ ka yalɛ banfale,

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: o jaloɡle la aa won moo, doŋa waa kpɔa dawɛ haah la nɛɛ la wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii kii ɡɛ. He bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ la harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ kɛ he kon la ta.
