english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɛ baa bɛlbwa mo haah dɛ a ta benanyoa dɔe yaa, he bɛ o ne laa la, he bɛ wobɛlbwa kpɔ do o nɔn ta. Hé ɡel o so dem o ne o haah lɛ ba sie.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ o dɔŋ bokpeɡa ne, dɛ ɛo o yom kɛɛ dɛ yoɡu he na la, o chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpoo, ásɛ ɡɛ wechɔɡa la le Israel harɛ ta.

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: Dɛ bwadabii weechɔɡa ane le he nɛ aa, do sie dɛ́ pɛɛ a waa Lewi dea sɔfore la be. N bol ba be, anomanta, ɡɛ baa ŋɔ he be la, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Hé lii ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa ɛa tɛ Miriam ŋwɛnɛ baah ta, ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔŋ kemɛ komɛl dɛ lɛ yal cheɡ awɔba aa, bɛ o dea jo dɛ́ ka kpɔ yal la.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: Che buse ásɛ o ɡbaɡba kpɔ le ba tɛɛ.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Bɔr dɛ jo aa, berɛ kpɔ o yal ka tɛo ásɛ o kpɔ tɔ chɔ. Wɛɛ jaamee á baɡle kɛŋɔ he ɛ wedɛɛɡa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ be.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: He bɛ nyaa kɛɛ nomɛl aa hiaoh o ɛ he toma tɛɛ la faah, hale dɛ he bini Israel tee yoo dɛ hɔɔhre o so he bwɛɛ yoo.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Tɔpebir toma waa ɛ tɛɛ la, bɔɔ kem dɛ bɛ ɡel wee jo a ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a hiaoh, a taa o sie dawɛ. Dɛ he ta on tɛɛ yaa, wɛɛ wiu no Korowii ta he nɛ, ásɛ a ɛ wechɔɡa tɛɛ.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: He bɛ nomɛlbwa ba kpo o bie wechɔɡa waa ɛa wa. Gɛɛ he bɛ bie ɡe ba kpo o mɛɛ wechɔɡa wa. Bɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó sewɛ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa wa.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Hé lii kɛŋɔ he fa di somanjiri Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ lɛ heyaa le bela. A waa ɡela mɛɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé ɛ ɡɛ la.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Dɛ he komɛ koo kondikwa dɛ soh ane waa bela aa, he bɛ ka kpɔ kpa. Hé ɡela tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna, ásɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ ta.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Dɛ he chaa ɔleve aa, he bɛ beŋkpoŋa aa kaa saɡre la kuuh, hé ɡela tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Dɛ he la he daa kooni ta dɛ ka chaa a nɔna aa, he bɛ la ka kuuh kpa. Hé ɡela tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Hé lii kɛŋɔ he fa di somanjiri Ijipt harɛ ta ka, a waa n do heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ la.”

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: Dɛ bolchɔɡe te la chɛ lɔɔra aa, nomoa waa bol waa la ɡel ó chɔ harɛ, ásɛ ba lɔɔro chweema ne o siwi ta. O wechɔɡa waa ɛa la taa a chɛ kɛ bá nyiŋi dɛ́ lɔɔro.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Aa ɡwaala kwaraa la kera fifraanaarɛ, a bɛ ɡɛ ɡwaa ásɛ a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ o te ta nɛn ɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: He bɛ nabal waa dɛ ɛ toma he koo ta la nyoa vɔwɛ, dɛ́ ŋɔ o bɛ kwaa di.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ jaa la aa sewa la nime kɛɛ o dɔɔ ŋɔ waa haah laanee mo aa, haah la kpɔ kaa bwɛɛ la doonyoa ka bil bwɛɛ la nomonome sie dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘N jaa nime kɛɛ o dɔɔ ŋɔ waa men mo, ásɛ n jabene la sɔn ka Israel harɛ nɔ ta. Waa nyin kɛ o ɛɛ mɛ dɔɔ kɛɛ nime haah we-ɛɛla.’

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Ásɛ nomonome la yerɛ baa la dɛ́ bol waa baɡlo. Dɛ o ta cheɡɔ ŋɔ, waa on nyin aa,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: haah la laa ɡɛ baa la naŋɡawa beŋkpoŋ foo nomonome la sie ta bela, dɛ́ ta nentane ta o sie ta dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Anɔɔ ba kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ baa waa wola nyin kɛ o dɔɔ kɛɛ nime dɔ dwee.’

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ásɛ baa yerɛ baa la bii Israel harɛ ta ŋɔ, ‘Baa la ba fa aa laa o naŋɡawa beŋkpoŋ foo la bii.’

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: Dɛ baala banɛ dɛ yo asɛ bɛl haah ba dɛ ba cha o jaa, dɛ lawɛ o jaa dɔŋ la lur aa,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: hé teŋe o nɔn la ta, dɛ bɛ o sum na.

english_verse: Don't try to cheat people by having two sets of weights or measures, one to get more when you are buying, and the other to give less when you are selling.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ kon haa kpɔ maɡɛ kwaa dem ɡe, he bɛ ɡel bɛl do kan ɡwaa bɛl.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ hé di kasinteŋ kwaa maɡa ta, ásɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ tɛ heyaa mkpajaŋ harɛ waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kii nɛn waa wola kasinteŋ di dɛɛ faah nɛra.

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: Hé lii waa Amalɛk tena aa kpɔa ɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Gɛ baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ dɛ ba pu heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ he koɔh dɛ ɡwɛɡre, asɛ ba kpoo banɔ la baa ka mun ta la.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii baa kpɔ harɛ la tɛ heyaa dɛ kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛɛ he dɔma baa bar heyaa cheme nɔ be pera aa, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ kpoo Amalɛk tena la bwa, dɛ́ he ba ásɛ ba waa tonɛ. He bɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ soh!”

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kaa jo harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ kapɛrɛ kon la ta naa,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: hé bini bɛlbwa do kwaa waa para harɛ la ta konloɡla wɛɡrɛ del, dɛ́ kpɔ la bela Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa le tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ ka tɛ sɔfo waa so bela ɡɛ saŋ la dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Fini n cheɡɛ bonɔ dɛ bol dɛɛ baɡle Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ be kɛŋɔ, n tel harɛ waa ŋwɛɛ o waa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ya naawa la ta.’

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la ɛɛ lɛ wɛɡrɛ la ne kwaa laanee, dɛ́ kpɔ cheɡ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ saraha kon la sie.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: Ásɛ name he che bela dɛ́ bol Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sie ŋɔ, ‘N nabaa fa ɛ Aram te dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, nɛra tamaa kenii o kpɔ dɛ ka so Ijipt harɛ ta, kɛ ba baa warɛ kohona, dɛ ɛ harɛbir nɛra dɛ dɔ kpeɡri ɡe ja.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Ijipt tena la fiiɡi yaa dɛ ɡel ya ɛ tomkpeɡa dɛ na wahala.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Anee ya wi no Korowii ya naawa aa dɛ tomɔ la, asɛ o no ya be. O na ɡɛ baa dɛ do yaa tomkpeɡa ta ne wahala yaa lɔ a ta.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: O kpɔ yaa ba harɛpare ondɛɛɡe nɔ ta dɛ ba kpɔ tɛ yaa.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n kpɔ harɛ Korowii aa tɛ mɛ koo konloɡla ba.’ Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ wɛɡrɛ la ne kwaa la cheɡ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sie dɛ́ ɡuŋi o sie.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ásɛ he ne Lewi dea tena ne hɔɔhra baa lɔ he baah la sie lɛ kondɛɛɡa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa tɛ he ne he dem tena la wa.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: Bene atoro bɛlbwa he bɔne he koo kwaa bini bɔre fi, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ Lewi dea tena ne hɔɔhra ne bilalbii dɛ luhaahna baa soɡe he baah la, ásɛ ba bwa dɔ di dɛ vaɡre. He ɛ ɡɛ tonaa,

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: he ŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ be ŋɔ, ‘Komɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛ ń bɔne a bini bɔre fi la, n kpɔ a bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ Lewi dea tena ne hɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna ɡɛ haa do mɛ la, bɛlbwa ta n be kae. N ta he Mmara kone, n ta a waa soɛh.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ maa lɔ lwe ta dɛɛ wi la n ta bɔrbeŋkpoŋ kpɔe, ɡɛɛ maa wola ane kpɔe dɛ kah doŋa. N ta ane bɛlbwa ɡe kpɔe ɛ wobɛlbwa tɛ lala. N no Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ nɔ wa.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, che he sobɔr waa lɔ nyundua ba sie ne harɛ, dɛ́ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ he nɛra Israel tena, harɛ haa tɛ yaa ɡɛ haa ŋwɛɛ ntam, dɛ baɡɛ ya naawa nyoa harɛpare ondɛɛɡe nɔ.’ ” Korowii Mmarare ta teŋa

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Fini tɔpere nɔ, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ dɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ta. He teŋɛ a ta kɛrɛdɛ he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ne.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Fini he bolɔ ŋɔ, Korowiirii hɛɛ ba toma dɛ́ɛ valɛ o ŋwɛnɛre ta, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne waa waa do heyaa a ta dɛ́ɛ duuru.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Fini Korowii sɛoh kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba nɛraa heya he waa ɛɛ su o siwi, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa wubwa la, dɛ ŋɔ hé teŋɛ o waa waa do heyaa a ta,

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: dɛ berɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡɔɔ heyaa dɛ́ ɡel he sɔn le ɡwaa harɛre nɛra waa ta ba bwa. Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo he do ɡoroŋ tɛo, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Mosis ne Israel nomonome do Israel tena ŋɔ, “Hé teŋɛ ɡɛ Mmarare nɔ bwa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Ásɛ he ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ bela. He bɛ buni kpɔ ɛ o toma.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Bwea baa wola an sɛɛh nee chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la. O taa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé fuh kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Hé ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha bela, dɛ́ di dɛ́ lɛ sie Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sie.

english_verse: Don't forget to write out a copy of these laws on the stone slabs that you are going to set up. Make sure that the writing is easy to read. Curses on Those Who Disobey
translation_verse: Hé chwerɛ Mmara la bini waa bwa dawɛ bwea la haa kpɔ paaɡe la ta á chɔ kɛrɛdɛ.” Taahna aa lɔ deŋnekpeɡ waa ɛɛ ta

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Mosis ne Lewi dea sɔfore la ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Israel tena, hé hel dɛ́ no! Hé lii kɛŋɔ he ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nɛra.

english_verse: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé do sie o be dɛ́ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne waa waa do heyaa mɛɛ do heyaa a ta fini nɔ ta.”

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Mosis do Israel tena la awola tenten ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ he bwɛɛre ne he koonii.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ heya dɛ́ tɛ heyaa lol, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he kooni do wer, ásɛ he kondɛɛra kɛŋɔ nae ne peera ya.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ cha heyaa hé dɔ mea haa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa, ásɛ dɛ dɔa kohona.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ berɔɔ cha heyaa wobɛlbwa haa ɛ ta.

english_verse: The Lord will help you defeat your enemies and make them scatter in all directions.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ pɔ he dɔma nɛɛ tɛ heya. Baa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ beŋkpoŋ taa dɛ́ ba yo heya, kɛ wɛɛ ɡeloo ba chwa peɡre.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ cha heyaa he toma taa, ásɛ he dɔndɔŋre su mea. Wɛɛ cha heyaa harɛ waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ taa.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Dɛ he no Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa dɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa waa dɛ bol ta naa, wɛɛ kpɔ heyaa cheɡ kɛ o nɛra he do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: A ba ɡɛ naa, harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii le heyaa kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba nɛraa heya, ásɛ dɛ ɔmɛ heya.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ tɛ heyaa biirii taeh, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa nae kohona, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ɡel he dɔ koo kondikwaa kohona, harɛ waa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa la ta.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ pili nyundua dɛ́ nɛ bwaala saŋ waa wera ta, dɛ́ kpɔ cha he toma ásɛ he dɔ dɛ́ kpɔ ane cha harɛre ane ɡe, he te aa wola ba bee la ka kemɛ bwa.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Dɛ he teŋɛ o waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta naa, wɛɛ ɛ heyaa sitɔɔla harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ. Haa ba nɛɛ teŋɛ bwa, he wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii haa wola harɛɛ lɔ bwa.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ he baa serewe aa, jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola di he ola nomɛlbwa aa wola an doŋi ta.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Anɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ deŋnetɛra Korowii aa ŋɔa wɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta he nɛɛ la danseɛ, dɛ́ chɔ tɛ he ne he naanar saŋ bɛlbwa,

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ta Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa noɛ dɛ teŋɛ o waa ne o Mmarare ta naa, taahna maa bol a waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ ba he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡure he nyu ta.

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ berɔɔ taah he bwɛɛre ne he koonii.

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ taah mea haa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Korowii taahna ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa he bii dɔe bini, ne koo kwaa ne nae dɛ peera yae ta.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: He toma ne wobɛlbwa haa ɛ la, Korowii taahna ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ he vɛh Korowii aa, wɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡaa ta he nɛ, he berɛ wili dɛɛ na waa wobɛlbwa haa dɛɛ ɛ ta, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa chɔɡ heyaa warane kwaraa.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: Ásɛ he dɔma berɛ pɔ he nɛ. Hɛɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ beŋkpoŋii ŋɔ he ka yoo ba, kɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ berɔɔ nyin bɔr kpɔ dɛ́ chwa peɡre jo harɛ nɔ ta bwa.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ɔɡra ne ŋwɛra aa ba Ijipt tena nɛɛ la dɔŋa chole he nɛ, haa wola won chah.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: Dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he liire chɔɡ, hé nyoŋe ásɛ he tea bini ɡe chɔɡ.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ dɛɛ laɡre bɔree webaŋa kɛŋɔ nyoŋa ken haa wola bɔree na. Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ ɡe aa heyaa kɛrɛdɛɛ chiɡ bwa. Baa lɔɔ heyaa dɛ́ pa he laala kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa ken, nomɛlbwa aa wola lee do dɛ́ cha heya.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: Nɛn ɛɛ ɛ haah bwara waa, kɛ nomɛlee dɛ́ berɛ moo. Hɛɛ ma deaa, ásɛ nomɛl laa lɛ he be haa wola o binii dɔ chɔ. Hɛɛ du daa haa a nɔnaa dɔ di.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ he nawee kpo he siwi ta haa wola o olii dɔ chwe, dɛ́ teɡɛ he keeɡore dɛɛ kaa he siwi na haa an dɔ kpa. Dɛ́ berɛ lawɛ he peera tɛ he dɔma nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ lɛa tɛɛ.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ he bibaala ne bihaahnaa he che dɛɛ nyiŋi bá yoɡ ba kɛŋɔ yoma, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛfale ta, ásɛ he siwi swɛɛ hɛɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ he bii ɛɛ bao á ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Kwaa haa koh dɛ́ para la, harɛ bɛl tenaa dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba kpɔa kaa ka di, ásɛ a ka he ne tɔpere bɛlbwa wahala ne fiiɡa.

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: Hɔhɔrɔwa haa na la ɛɛ berɛɛ choɡlaa.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ŋwɛra aa dɛ we haa wola won chaah chole he nɛ, ɔɡra ɔɡre le he nyu ta ba ta he napaala ta.”

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Wɛɛ kpɔ he ne he kooroo kaa harɛ he ne he naawa aa wola bela jemɛ, ásɛ he kaa tomɛ voɡa, kwaa baa kpɔ daa ne bwea ɛa.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Harɛre Korowii aa lɔ heyaa peɡre a ta la, bela tena nyoa ɛɛ kpo he waa, hé berɛ wesoma tena baa di he loro.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ parɔɔ taeh kɛ kondikwaa tamaa kenii hɛɛ ba dɔe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tontombɛɛ dɛɛ ba a dii.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ parɛ daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen koonii, kɛ haa a nɔnaa dɔ chaa, haa a senee dɔ nyɔ dɛkalkɛŋɔ dudule ɛɛ chɔɡaa.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ dɔ ɔleve he harɛ taa ɡa, kɛ haa a noo dɔe ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a nɔna dɛ ba chaara lee.

english_verse: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahnaa kɛ baa he biirii ɛ, baa berɛ nɛra bane yomaa.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Daa ne kondikwaa haa du la, tontombɛ ɛɛ chɔɡ a bwaa.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Hɔɔhra baa so he bini la ɛɛ nao dɛɛ dɛɡ, dɛɛ di kpeɡri he nɛ, ásɛ he te na dɛɛ kaa mun ta.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Baa dɔ suuɡaa ásɛ he kaa kemɛ, kɛ he te aa anee dɔ dɛ kem ba bwa, ba den ɛ he nomonome dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Wekpeɡa maa bol a waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ ba he nɛɛ, dɛ́ ka he nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ he bwa aa serewa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ta Korowii waa noɛ. He ta o Mmarare waa do heyaa a ta la ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ta silɛɛ ne bambidɛɛɡe kpɔe tomɛ Korowii saŋ waa ɡela he do wer wobɛlbwa ta la.

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he tomɛ he dɔma waa dɛ ba ɡela ba yo heya, ásɛ dɛ lawɛ heyaa yoma hé paŋɛ komɛlbwa. Haa kwaa dɔ di, haa nee ɡee dɔ nyɔ. Hɛɛ so mumɡbalee ba do heya hɛɛ tom ba. Hɛɛ di somanjirii ka tel kɛŋɔ haa serewe.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra haa wola ba wobol no, le harɛ jaɡa dɛ́ ba he nɛɛ wɔrɔbe nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kee yon ba ta la.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: Ba ɛ harɛre nɛra ba siwi aa kpeɡa, baa wola nomoa duu kɛɛ baa wola bechala sum na.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma tɔ heyaa do bwɛjena waa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la bwa ta, ásɛ he lɔ harɛ. Ásɛ danjwɛkpeɡa haa maa bara dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta la choɡli.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: Tɔe baa tɔ heyaa do dɛ so bar heyaa hɛɛ na wahala la nomanta, lɔr ɛɛ kpo heyaa, ásɛ he chwe he ɡbaɡba bilola.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: O ɡbaɡba bilole ol waa dɛ chwe la, waa o nime kɛɛ o dɔɔ kɛɛ o haah kɛɛ o bii baa kaa laanee tɛ. Wahala ba dɔma la aa tɔ ba do baa na la nomanta.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: Dɛ he ta duure kpɔe tɛ Korowii kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ no waa bwa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔ, dɛ ɔmɛ o jirima ne o sɔnjen la aa,

english_verse: he will punish you and your descendants with incurable diseases,
translation_verse: wɛɛ kpɔ weechɔɡa ne wekpeɡa haa wola won na a nyoa bwaa ba ta he ne he naanar nɛ.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kpɔ weela bwa soo siwi ne wekpeɡa waa wola an chwerɛ do Mmara Tɔn nɔ binii ba ta he nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ haa serewe.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ warɔɔ kɛŋɔ weweela, kɛ dɛ he ta Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa ta teŋɛ aa, he bini tamaa kenii dɛ́ ba ka.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii tea aa too he waa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo he do wer, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ɡel he ya la, ɡɛ tentenee o tea ɛɛ ba toora he chɔɡa dɛ ta wa, dɛ́ chuɡri heyaa le harɛ haa dɛ la ka so o ta nɔ ta.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ lɔ heyaa peɡre harɛre ta bobɛlbwa kaa o jaɡa, ásɛ he kaa tomɛ kwaa baa kpɔ daa ne bwea ɛa. Voɡa he ne he naawa aa wola an jemɛ bwa.

english_verse: You will live in constant fear of death.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ so seo nyoa saŋ te bɛlbwaa dɛɛ ɔmɛ webaŋa ne jwaana, dɛ́ so tɛ seo.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Ɔmee waa aa lɔ he bambile ta la ne waa haa dɛ ba nae nomanta, dɛ chɔɔbɔree yaa, hɛɛ ŋɔɔ, ‘Dɛ jɔmɔraa fe sɛ?’ Asɛ dɛ jɔmɔra ɡee yaa, he ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ chɔɔbɔree fe sɛ?’

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ heyaa do stiimaere bini, dɛ́ kaa he ne Ijipt harɛ ta. Kɛ onee fa ŋɔ he be ŋɔ haa belaa tire kpa la. Ásɛ he yoɡ he te tɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ yoma ba vɛh he yawa.”

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Haa ba bonɔ la, Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ baa yo yaa asɛ ya pɔ ba nɛ,

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: dɛ lɛ ba harɛre dɛ bɔne tɛ Rubin ne Gad deene tena, dɛ Manasɛ dea la pera nɛra.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé do sie fɔo nɔ ta ásɛ wobɛlbwa haa ɛ la chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: He na voɡa aa ɛ kii kwaa ba kpɔ daa ne bwea ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ suuɡaswɛm ɛa.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ he nɛra haa cheɡɛ bonɔ fini nɔ, baa kɛɛ haah kɛɛ lolanar, kɛɛ dea bɛl tena aa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ tomaa ɡel dɛ́ ka tomɛ harɛ bɛl voɡa. Ásɛ a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ daa lur aa pama le dɛ nɔnɛ nɔnchɔɡa dɛ he diu waa he sewɛ la.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Haa dɛ no ntam nɔ bini waa nɔ, nomɛlbwa bɛ o liire ba ɛ kɛŋɔ o na som dɛɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ́ kpɔ o ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛ aa maɡre tɛo. Anee dɛ́ ɡel Israel tena bwa dɔ deŋnetɛra.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nyotaahna waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔɔ dawɛ o nɛɛ he Israel deene bwa siwi ta, ɡɛ waa baɡle a waa Korowii Fɔo Tɔn la bini.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: He bii ne he naanar baa ka ba ne hɔɔhra baa le bojaŋa ɛɛ na weela ne ɡɛ Korowii aa chɔɡ he harɛ nɔɔ.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: He harɛ ɛɛ chɔɡoo komɛlbwa aa wola won le o ta. Jebɔrɔwe ne yaree dɛɛ ba chura ta o ta. Haa won du komɛlbwa, kpɔɡa kwaraa aa won le o ta. Ásɛ he harɛ la do kɛŋɔ Sodom ne Gomoora ne Adma dɛ Seboiim, Korowii aa kpɔ bandia chɔɡa la.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛ waa Korowii baah di kohona o ɛ harɛ nɔ ken nɔɔ?’

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Waa la bwaa kɛŋɔ, ‘Korowii ba naawa aa dɛ tomɔ o le ba ne Ijipt harɛ ta ba la chɔɡ fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: Ba kaa tomɛ voɡa baa wola an tomɛ bwa, voɡa Korowii aa kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ an tomɛ la.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Bandia kohona nee Korowii ir ba le ba harɛ ta, dɛ ba taɡ ba ta hɔɔhra harɛ ta, ba ta do bela ba le fini la.’

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: Waane lole Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa wola yaa baɡlɛ dɛ kpɔ sɔh yaa, kɛ o pili o Mmara waa bini ásɛ ya ne ya naanar baa ka ba la ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena be ja ŋɔ, “N tɛ heyaa webele anɛ, ɡɛ haa ɛ dɛ́ na som, ne waa aa ba taahna ne he nɛ. Dɛ anɔ bwa baa chiɡ asɛ Korowii lɔ heyaa peɡre harɛre ta naa, belaa hɛɛ ba webele anɛ maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la liira.

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ne he naanar berɔ ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ be, dɛ no o waa maa dɛ do heyaa fini nɔ ta he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ne naa,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Hale dɛ harɛ jaɡaa he peɡre ka do kwaraa naa, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ boa he nyoa, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: Ásɛ he berɛ ba kpɔ harɛ he naawa fa aa soɡe o ta wubwa la so ó ɛ he kon. Wɛɛ berɔɔ ɡel he do wer dɛ́ warɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ he naawa fa aa doa la.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ tɛ he ne he naanar bambidɛɛɡee, ásɛ hɛɛ nyinu he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ne, ásɛ dɛ ta so harɛ la ta dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ taahna la bwaa ta he dɔma baa hah heyaa dɛɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa la nɛ,

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: ásɛ he berɛ ba no Korowii waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare la ta ja.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo he do wer wobɛlbwa haa ɛ ta, dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ bii ne kondɛɛra kohona, he koo kondikwaa ɡe ɛ kohona. Korowii sie ɛɛ lɛ he nɛɛ ja, ásɛ dɛ ɡel he do wer wobɛlbwa ta, ɡɛ o fe aa liira tɛ he naawa la,

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: dɛ he teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa aa lɔ o Mmarare Tɔn nɔ bini nɔ ta, dɛ kpɔ he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ba o be naa.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: Korowii waa nɔ maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ aa kpeɡe kohona, a toole bojaŋ ɡe.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: A toole nyundua ásɛ he bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ la nyundua dɛ́ ka kpɔ ba ya no dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta nɔ?’

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Kɛɛ mpo baŋ ásɛ he bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ ka kpɔ ba tɛ yaa ásɛ ya teŋɛ a ta nɔ?’

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Waa la pu heyaa tonɛ. A lɔ he nyoo hɛɛ bola kɛɛ he bambile ta kwara, anomanta, hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: Fini tɔpere nɔ, n kpɔ wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa, mkpa ne seo dɛɛ bil he sie, onɔ la bwa haa kpɔ.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Nyundua ne harɛ ɛ danseɛ fini kɛŋɔ n tɛ heyaa mkpa ne seo, dɛ som Korowii aa dɛ tɛ ne taahna. Kɛ hé kpɔ a bini bɛl. Hé kpɔ mkpa.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: He nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, dɛ́ teŋɛ o waa ta kasinteŋ ne, dɛ́ kpɔ he te pɛlo, ásɛ he ne he naanar biɡri harɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ he naawa Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb la ta.”

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Mosis teŋɔ dɛ bol waa baɡle Israel tena ja.

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Hé che kiŋkiŋ, he bɛ ɔmɛ. Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɡbaɡba ɛɛ che he mun taa. Waa he jwɛɛh le, waa heyaa ta.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis yerɛ Josua dɛ bol o be Israel tena la bwa siwi ta ŋɔ, “Che kiŋkiŋ, bɛ ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee dɛɛ ba nɛra nɔ sie tɔe, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ka so harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa la ta.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ tɔ he siee dɛ́ ja he nɛ, anomanta, bɛ ɡel he bwara hwah, bɛ ɔmɛ.” Korowii Mmara la kura

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis chwerɛ Korowii Mmara la dɛ kpɔ do Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore la ne Israel nomonome la nɔn ta. Sɔfore laanee dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka o ne Israel tena fɔo baa fɔwa ba chwerɛ dɛ kpɔ do o bini la ta.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: A ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ taa he naanar baa wola Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa noɛ bwa la che dɛ́ no. Ásɛ dɛ jemɛ waa la ta teŋa harɛ baa dɛ ba Jɔɔdan Moo ɡala dɛ́ ka so o ta la ta.” Korowii bol Israel tena deŋnekpeɡ wa

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Tɔpere waa kaa he sewɛ la aa kanɛ kpa, anomanta, yerɛ Josua ba n Dea Cheremibɔr nɔ bini, ásɛ n kpɔ n waa bwa do o nɔn ta.” Anee Mosis ne Josua la Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii che bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua bini, dɛ ba ba be dɛ ba che doonyoa bela.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Aa biɡri bɛlbwa ásɛ he chɔ he banɔn ta. A ba ɡɛ naa, nɛra haa tɔ ba sie nɔ ɛɛ chɔɡ fɔo n ne baa fɔwa laanee. Baa le n habɔɔ, dɛ́ ka tomɛ harɛ baa dɛ ba o ta joe nɔ voɡaa.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: A ba ɡɛ naa, n baah ɛɛ di ba nɛɛ, ásɛ n laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ ba chɔɡ. Wechɔɡa ne wahala ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ taeh, ásɛ ba sɛh ŋɔ, ‘Waa nɔ aa pu yaa nɔ, Korowii ya fa aa dɛ tomɔ la laa nɔn kpɔ ya nɛ.’

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ, waa baa ɛa a ɛ wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ baa bera kaa tomɛ voɡa la wa.”

english_verse: Moses and Joshua, I am going to give you the words to a new song. Write them down and teach the song to the Israelites. If they learn it, they will know what I want them to do, and so they will have no excuse for not obeying me.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Josua be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba heyaa yel baɡla, he chwerɛ bil, dɛ́ kpɔ baɡle Israel tena, ásɛ a ɛ waa dɛ́ chɔ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ, Mɛɛ kpɔ baa kaa harɛpare ondɛɛɡe maa baɡɛ ba naawa o waa la ta. Baa dɔ kondikwaa bɛlbwa baa dɛ nyinii dɛ́ di ba bwara sɔɔh ba. Kɛ ane a bwa, baa ka le n habɔɔ, dɛ́ ka tomɛ voɡa. Baa vɛɛh mɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ fɔo n ne baa fɔwa la.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Ásɛ wekpeɡa ba ba nɛɛ taeh, kɛ ba taa teŋɔɔ dɛ́ ɡo yel la, ásɛ a ɛ waa dɛ́ chɔ tɛɛ ba. Taraken kwara, n jemɛ liire baa dɛ lii mɔɔ mɛɛ ba ba ne harɛ maa baɡ ba nyoa la ta kaala.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Mosis chwerɛ yel la dɛ baɡle Israel tena la.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Josua mɛɛ sɔne Nun. Korowii ŋɔ, “Josua, che kiŋkiŋ, bɛ ɔmɛ. Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he tɔ Israel tena sie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛ maa baɡ ba nyoa la ta.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Mosis chwerɛ Korowii Mmarare la do tɔn ta tonɛ, dɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ o ta wobɛlbwa ɡelɛ.

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Waa tona la, o ŋɔ Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ta be ŋɔ,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Hé lɛ tɔn nɔ, Korowii Mmarare lɔ o ta. Hé kpɔ bil O Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka nɔ jwɛh, ásɛ o do bela dɛɛ lii ba ɡɛ baa so kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Mosis ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “N jemɛ he lwɛmkpeɡ ne he habɔɔ bera dɛ́ kpo Korowii wa. Hale n ne haa lole n ta sewɛ mɔɔ nɔ, he fa berɛ habɔɔ kpo Korowii. Hɛ́ɛ ɛo ɡwaa ɡɛ n seo habɔɔ.

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he yerɛ he deene la nomonome, ne banɔ la baa chɔ he nyoa ba cheme n sie, ásɛ n bol waa nɔ bwa tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ yerɛ nyundua ne harɛ a chɔ dɛ́ ɛ danseɛ.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ n seo habɔɔ la, baa ɛ nɛnchɔɡaa dɛ́ vɛh waa maa bola baɡ ba bwa dɛ chwerɛ bil la. Aa ba la sie la, baa na wekpeɡaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa ɛ waa Korowii aa kia, ásɛ o baah di.” Mosis yel la

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Ate, Mosis baɡle yel la bini waa tɛ Israel tena bwa baa chema la ba no.

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: N webaɡla ɛɛ ba he bee kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ wiri, n wobol do kɛŋɔ chɔɔlen mɛn, ne bwaala wira waa ɡela kpɔɡa ɛɛ le la.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Korowii sɔnee mɛɛ ba yera, ásɛ o nɛra kpɔ duure tɛo o kan waa doa wa!

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.
translation_verse: O do kɛŋɔ Bwetal dɛɛ lɛ yaa, o wobɛlbwa toɡrɔ dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ. Waa nyosone teŋe, waa aa maɡra dɛ toɡree wɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: He waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, he ta chɛɛ kɛ he ɛ o nɛra wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne nyosonteŋna ɡbo. He kpɔ sihiih kpo he te.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Korowii hɛɛ ɛ ken aa, nɛra haa ɡɛna haa wola liire dɔe. He mɛɛ, onee ta heya dɛ ɡel he ɛ harɛbir nɛra.

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: Hé lii fafa la, nɛra baa lole ɡɛ saŋ la. Hé bɔɔ he nɛmbena ba baɡle waa aa chiɡa. Hé bɔɔ ba bá baɡle saŋ la waa he be.

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowiirii tɛ harɛre nɛra ba harɛre. Onee nyiŋa dɛ jemɛ bela Israel tena aa so, dɛ tɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nyundua torome wɛɛ daah ba.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ Jekɔb naanar te, Korowii ɡbaɡba lee ba dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ o nɛra.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: Korowii na ba baa ɡaaɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, harɛ waa chɔ pɛɛ olchɔɡa sii ɡbo tɔ bela peujena ɛɛ ta bela. O tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba ken.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyiŋ ba kɛŋɔ kee yon dɛɛ baɡle o bii ira, dɛ́ ir kpɔ kena tɔ a nɛɛ a bɛ ba le la, ɡɛɛ o ɛ Israel tena.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: Korowii ɡboo tɔ o nɛra sie, voɡ bɛlbwa ta o nɛɛ jae.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ ba won kpɔ bwea dor dɛ kaa, dɛ di kwaa baa dua harɛ la ta. Asɛ dɛ berɛ dɔ tooh bwea la baah di, dɛ ɡel ba ɔleve daa baa dua bwea harɛ la ta do wer.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Ba dɔ nae ne boohna elnee kohona, ba peera ne boohna ne nae do wer, dɛ dɔ Basan harɛ pebala aa wera tɛɛ ba la ane. Ba dɔ mendɛɛɡa ne sen baa dɛ nyin dɛɛ nyɔ.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ tomɛ harɛre ane voɡa aa ɛ kii kwa, a ɡel Korowii baah di banɛ, wechɔɡa haa ɛa la ɡelɔ o baah di.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: He kpoo kwaa tɛ daabii yaa wola an na, voɡfala he naawa aa wola an jemɛ, voɡa he Israel tena aa wola sie a be doe ka.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: He soh Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o do kɛŋɔ Bwetal dɛɛ lɛ heyaa kohona, naate waa tɛ heyaa mkpa la wa.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: Korowii na ɡɛ waa nɔ o baah di, o laa sie kpɔ he bibaala ne bihaahna nɛ,

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ, maa ban chaŋe. Mɛɛ nao ɡɛ aa chiɡ heya, lwɛmkpeɡ tena haa wola kasinteŋ bol.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Ba ɡelɔ mɛɛ meeh voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe hɛɛ toma la, n bwaawee ir ba voɡpuune nɛ. Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ bɔweela nɛra baa wola ban kure dɛɛ ja n nɛra nɛɛ la nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he bwaawee ir harɛ o nɛra aa ɡɛna nɛ.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: N bwaawee ɛɛ iruu kɛŋɔ ninlao, dɛ́ fuh komɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta. Aa fuuh tel harɛ bini ne bwejena mune bwa.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ wahala kohonaa ta he nɛ, mɛɛ kpɔ n hɛma bwaa ta heya.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Lɔr ɛɛ kpo heyaa kohona he ɡwaŋre dɛ serewe, weechɔɡaa dɛɛ ba heyaa kpoora. Mɛɛ ɡeloo kpɔɡ bini ola lawɛ heya, domkpuli choɡe heya.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: N fe ŋɔ mɛɛ lɔ he bwaa peɡre, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ he waa lii kpa.

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ lii kɛŋɔ he dɔma bɛ ba te ba maŋkura dɛ́ ŋɔ banee pɔ n nɛra nɛ, kɛ dɛ menee wona ɛ ɡɛ.’

english_verse: People of Israel, that's what the Lord has said to you. But you don't have good sense, and you never listen to advice.
translation_verse: Israel tena ɛ nɛra haa wola liire dɔe, he ta wejema dɔe kwaraa.

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii waa ɛ he Bwetal dɛɛ lɛ heyaa la laa le he habɔɔ aa, ɛrɛɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ fe ɛɛ ba wona doŋi nɛra kaɡboŋ, kɛɛ nɛra banɛ won doŋi nɛra kaɡboŋa fiɔ?

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: He dɔma jemɔ kɛŋɔ he voɡa ta voɡa ɛɛ, a ta doe kɛŋɔ Korowii waa do kɛ Bwetal Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Ya dɔma la wechɔɡa do kɛŋɔ Sodom ne Gomoora tena wechɔɡa ken. Ba do kɛŋɔ daa nɔna baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen, dɛ do kpeli dɛɛ kpo ɡe.

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ sen dɛɛ kpo kɛŋɔ harɛkonchɔɡe aa dɛ kpo la.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ lii anɔ la bwa dɔma la aa ɛa, dɛɛ kpa saŋ waa wera ta, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛr ba deŋne.

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ tɔ a peɡee, wɛɛ bɔ ba a kemee. Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba ba chole, ba chɔɡa tɔpere dɛ tel.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ lɛ o nɛraa ɡɛ saŋ ba bokpeɡa aa ba tonɛ. Wɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɔɔ, ɡɛ saŋ baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó cha ba.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ bɔɔ o nɛraa ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa voɡjena haa kpɔ he hwɛɡa dawɛ a nɛɛ la dɔɔ?’

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ, ‘He fa kpoo kwaa aa do noo tɛa, dɛ tɛa sen a nyɔ. Hé ɡel a ba cha heyaa taraken nɔ, a chwa ba lɛ heya.’

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Men, n ɡbosoo Korowii, voɡ bɛlbwa toole. Menee dɛɛ chɔɡ, dɛɛ tɛ mkpa, menee dɛɛ do nɛn bol, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ chah naate. Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Maa dɔa ɛ Korowii maa wola sewɛ nɔ, n ir nɔn dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: kɛŋɔ mɛɛ sar n tokobi waa dɛ nyɛɡle laanee dɛ́ ba pa bole. Dɛ́ bɔ n dɔma kem, dɛ́ tɛr banɔ la baa hah mɛ deŋne.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: N hɛma ɛɛ jo ba chal taa, ásɛ n tokobii ɡe kpoo banɔ la baa dɛ tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ. Maa nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ ɡel, banɔ la baa do ba bola, ne banɔ la baa laɡ ba bwa ɛɛ sewɔɔ.’

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra, hé pu Korowii nɛra hɛɡre. Korowii dɛ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ kpoo o nɛra deŋne. O dɛ bɔ ba dɔma kem dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ kpɔ o nɛra wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ ba.”

english_verse: Moses spoke the words of the song so that all the Israelites could hear, and Joshua helped him. When Moses had finished,
translation_verse: Mosis aa baɡle waa aa lɔ Korowii yel la bini tɛ nɛra la tonɛ la,

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta fini nɔ taa. Hé kpɔ do he bii ásɛ ba ɡee teŋɛ Korowii webaɡla la ta kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔ ta wepuu ɛɛ, a ɛ waa haa che a ta dɛ́ dɔ he nyu. Hé teŋɛ a ta, aa ɡeloo he dɔ mkpajaŋ harɛ waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ hɛɛ la dɛ ka so o ta la ta.” Mosis aa dɛ ba sewa Nɛbo Bwejen ta wa

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: A wola tenten la, Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “La Abarim Bwejen waa lɔ Moab harɛ ta o ne Jeriko sie ɡba dɔŋa la ta. Teeh kaa Nɛbo Bwejen doa dɛ́ nyiŋi harɛ la waa chɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ bela la, Keenan harɛɛ, onee mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ Israel tena la.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Bwejen la taa hɛɛ ba sewa dɛ́ kaa he naawa be, kɛŋɔ he dɔɔ Arɔn aa sewɛ Hɔr Bwejen ta dɛ kaa o naawa be la.

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: A munii kɛŋɔ he bwa ta duure kpɔe tɛ mɛ Israel tena la bwa sie, ɡɛ saŋ he fa aa lɔ Mɛreba nee waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bobɛl baa yerɔ Sin la.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ na harɛ maa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ Israel tena la ɡɛ waa chɔ bojaŋee, kɛ haa belaa tire.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Gɛ Mosis waa ɛ Korowii nɛn aa swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel tena mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ laanee nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “Korowii le Sinai Bwejen ta ba ya be, o ɛɡɔ le Edom kɛŋɔ wee ken, dɛ́ chaah o nɛra nɛɛ Paran bwe ta. Nyundua toroma kaɡboŋa fi ja o nɛ, ninlao do o diɡ bɔr.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Kpelaa, Korowii dɛ nyin o nɛra, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ banɔ la baa lɔ o be pera nɛ. Ba bwa ɛɛ ɡuŋi he siee dɛɛ no he wa.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ teŋɛ Mmara Mosis aa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ta, o ɛ ya harɛ nɔ kpaŋjoɡo yaa dɔa.

english_verse: Then you and your leaders made the Lord your king.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛ Israel tena Kooro ɡɛ saŋ Israel deene ne ba nomonome fa aa chema la.

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: Mosis bol Rubin dea tena waa ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡel Rubin dea tena bɛ he, a lole kɛŋɔ baa kanɛ te.’

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: O bol Juda dea tena ɡe waa ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, no ba wii baa wia dɛɛ nyin chae. Gel ba ne deene aa kaa la dɔ nyopɛo. Yo tɛɛ ba, ásɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta.’

english_verse: At Massah and Meribah Spring, the Lord tested you, tribe of Levi. You were faithful, and so the priesthood belongs to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: O bol Lewi dea tena ɡe waa ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, he cheɡɛ he nɛndɛɛɡa Lewi dea tena nɛ Urim ne Tumim ta, dɛ pili ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin baɡ ba, dɛ daah ba na Maasa, asɛ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ ba ɛ kasinteŋ tena Mɛreba nee ta.

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: Banee lawɛ he waa bini kpoŋe ɡwaa ba nyare ne mɛɛnanar, ne ba dɔɔranar kɛɛ biirere. Ba teŋɛ he waa ta dɛɛ di kasinteŋ he fɔo he ne baa fɔwa la ta.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: Báa dɛɛ baɡle he nɛra he Mmara ta teŋa taa, dɛ́ kpoo jam kwaa dɛɛ tɛɛ he saraha kon la ta.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel ba dea tena do kpeɡri. Gel ba wobɛlbwa baa dɛ ɛ su he siwi. Chɔɡ ba dɔma dɛ bɛ ɡel ba ir kpa bwa.’

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡe, o bol ba waa ŋɔ, ‘Dea nɔ tenaa Korowii ɛɛ nyin, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ. O dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ do ba baah ta.’

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: O bol Josef dea tena ɡe waa ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, ɡel bwaala nɛ ba harɛ ta o do wer. Ásɛ nee bule dɛɛ le harɛ bini ó do sɔne.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel ba dɔ kwaa baa di le bwea aa lole le saŋ la ba le fini la lɔɡre.

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: Tɛɛ ba harɛ kondɛɛɡa aa lɔ o ta. N Naa Korowii, he fa bol waa le dawii aa dɛ lawɛ nii Sinai Bwejen ta, asɛ wedɛɛɡa su he bwa. Gel Josef dea tena na som, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee dɔɔranar la bwa sitɔɔ.

english_verse: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.
translation_verse: O kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nabal ken, o nyeɡlare do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini nao. O nyeɡlare laanee Manasɛ dea nɛra kaɡboŋ bokpeɡa, Efrem dea nɛra ɡe kaɡboŋa fi bokpeɡa. A nee wɛɛ chuɡe harɛre nɛra, dɛ taɡ ba kaa tel harɛ jaɡa.’

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Baa yerɛ hɔɔhraa dɛɛ ba bwejen baa ɛ saraha aa wera dɛɛ tɛɛ la ta. Baa dɔ kondɔɔh le mpo ne o nyoa hɛŋle taa.’

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ Gad dea tena be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡel he dɔ harɛ kohona. Anomanta, hé kpɛɛro. He dea nɔ do kɛŋɔ nyujente waa dɛ toɡri ola nɔɔra ne nyuune.

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ harɛ la bodɛɛɡe, nomombɔree ba kpɔ. Ba teŋɛ Korowii waa ne o Mmarare ta, ɡɛ saŋ Israel nomonome fa aa chema la.’

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Dan dea ɡe la, o ŋɔ, ‘Dan dea tena do kɛŋɔ nyujente bie. O jaoh le Basan harɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Naftale dea ɡe, o ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡelɔ he na som taeh. He kpɔ harɛ waa chɔa le Galilia Moo weekaŋle harɛbɔr.’

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: O ŋɔ Aasa dea tena ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡel he waa su siwi he bala bwa bini, Korowii ɡel he harɛ do wer tɛ ɔleve daa.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Gel ba kpɔ bune kaɡre ba bwɛɛre doonyoo a do kpeɡri. Bɛ ɡel wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ba ba nɛ.’

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ. O lɔ nyundua kohona dɛ che o kpeɡri ta bol dɛɛ tɛ heya. O cheɡɛ baama ta dɛ baa cha heya.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ lɛ heya, o nɔn waa do kpeɡri laanee o kpɔ dɛɛ cha heya. Wɛɛ doŋi he dɔmaa le he sie dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé chɔɡ ba!”

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Jekɔb naanar, bosɔɔhna taa hɛɛ ba soɡa. Harɛ mea ne sen aa lɔ o ta asɛ mɛn ɛɛ ta dɛɛ pwe harɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Israel tena, he na som to. Nomɛlbwa ta heyaa tele, he ɛ nɛra Korowii aa lɛ heya. O ɡbaɡbaa he ɡbemɡbe ne he tokobi. Onee dɛ́ lɛ heya dɛ́ ɡel he yo le. He dɔma ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi he siee, dɛɛ soŋe ŋɔ he sune ba nɛ, ásɛ he tiɡri ba nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Mosis berɔ le Moab deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta, dɛ ka teeh Nɛbo Bwejen dɛ kaa Pesɡa Bwejen doa. Jeriko lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ wee cholibɔr. Asɛ Korowii baɡlo harɛ waa kpɔ Israel tena dɛɛ ba o ta la bwa. O nao le Gelead dɛ kpoŋe ka le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛ waa kpɔa tɛ Dan dea tena la,

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: ne Naftale ne Efrem ne Manasɛ dɛ Juda deene harɛ, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta wee cholibɔr.

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ baɡlo harɛ la tenten waa chɔa kaa Nɛɡɛv weekaŋle harɛbɔr Jeriko Fɛlembɔjen, dɛ ka le bwɛɛ Soar harɛ ta.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Harɛ nɔɔ n kpɔ baɡɛ Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb nyoa, ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba naanar la. N ɡelɔ hɛɛ nao te, kɛ maa ɡel he tel o ta.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis sewɛ Moab harɛ ta bela ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa waa ɡel o la harɛ la ta la.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Korowii huɡo fɛlembɔjen bɛl waa lɔ Moab harɛ ta, bwɛɛ Bɛt Peɔ sideŋ. Kɛ le ɡɛ saŋ dɛ ba le fini nomɛlbwa aa bela yiso o ŋwam aa chɔa jemɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Israel tena la ɛ o lwe tɔpera fifraatoro Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Nun bibaa Josua ɡe dɔ wejema kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Mosis leo ŋɔ ó chiɡ o naa ta. Dɛ Israel tena la dɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ Josua la ta dɛɛ no o be.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Mosis habɔɔ la, Korowii keame bɛlbwa ta berɛ le Israel kɛŋɔ on kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o ne Korowii dɛ bol wa.

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: Korowii ta o keame bɛlbwa ɡe nɛɛ cheɡɛ dɛ ɛ nyokpowaa kɛŋɔ anɔ la waa ɡela Mosis ɛa Ijipt kooro ne o nɛra baa chɔ o harɛ nyoa, ne Ijipt harɛ la bwa ta la.

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Korowii keame bɛlbwa aa wola wone ɛ wejena ne waa aa do ɔma kɛŋɔ Mosis aa ɛa Israel tena la siwi ta la.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis seo habɔɔ la, Korowii ŋɔ Nun bibaa Josua, o fa aa dɛ cha Mosis la be ŋɔ,

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: “Josua, n bonɔɔ Mosis sewɔ, anomanta, he ne Israel tena kpɔ he te dɛ́ ir ɡale kaa Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ harɛ maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.
translation_verse: Gɛ n fa aa baɡɛ Mosis nyoa laanee kɛŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ harɛ la bobɛlbwa haa kpɔ o ta laanee tɛ heya.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: He harɛ la nyoa ɛɛ le weekaŋle harɛbɔr pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la taa, dɛ́ kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr Lɛbanɔn bwejena ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Yufretis Moo ta wee leebɔr, dɛ́ kaa Hiti tena harɛ ta bwa, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa wee cholibɔr Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta.”

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won pɔ he nɛɛ wobɛlbwa ta he soɡa bini. Gɛ maa ja Mosis nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba he ɡe nɛɛ jae maa wola habɔɔ le bwa.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel waa aa lɔ mmarare tɔn la bini paŋɛ saŋ te bɛlbwa. Dɛɛ kuro chɔɔ ne jwaana dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa aa lɔ o bini taa. Anee dɛ́ ɡel wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ heya, he won ka so harɛ la ta.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Bɛ soh kɛŋɔ maa ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ dɔ bambile la! Bɛ ɔmɛ, bɛ ɡel he bwara ɡe yɔr. Men, Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, n teŋɛ he nɛɛ bobɛlbwa haa kaa.”

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Ate, Josua ŋɔ ba bini nomonome be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Hé valɛ Israel tena be bela bwa baa soɡa, dɛ́ ɡel ba no kɛŋɔ kerele ɡbosoo yaa le Jɔɔdan Moo baŋee, dɛ́ ka lɛ harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa ŋɔ he kpɔ la. Anomanta, he nyin kondikwaa cheɡ.”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Josua ŋɔ Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena bane be ŋɔ,

english_verse: The Lord's servant Moses said that the Lord our God has given you land here on the east side of the Jordan River, where you could live in peace. Your wives and children and your animals can stay here in the land Moses gave you. But all of you that can serve in our army must pick up your weapons and lead the men of the other tribes across the Jordan River. They are your relatives, so you must help them
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ɡel he haahna ne bii ne he kondɛɛra te ka harɛ Mosis aa bɔna tɛ heyaa Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr la ta bela, ásɛ he laa tena kpɔ ba te dɛ́ tɔ sie ɛɡɛ Moo la le he bala Israel tena la nɛ, dɛ́ ka cha ba,

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii aa ɡela ba bwara sɔɔh ba ɡɛ waa ɛa tɛ heyaa la, ka tel kɛŋɔ ba ɡe aa kaa dɔ harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛɛ baa la. Mɔɔ he berɛ kaa he ɡbaɡba harɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa o do Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr la ta.”

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Anee ba ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Yaa ɛ wobɛlbwa haa bol ya be nɔɔ, dɛ́ la bobɛlbwa ɡe haa tomɛ yaa.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ waa wola he waa taa teŋɛ la, kpoe yaa ba o kpoe. He te che kiŋkiŋ, dɔ bambile!”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Dɛ Israel tena la bwa cheme bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sitim dɛ so bela. Asɛ Josua sɔh dɛ le ba bini baala banɛ dɛ tom ba ŋɔ, “Hé ka sɔh nyiŋi Keenan harɛ dɛ́ na ɡɛ waa doa, bwɛjen Jeriko te fanfa.” Asɛ ba sɔh dɛ la bela, dɛ ka choɡ hanjwamane Rahab.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Dɛ Jeriko kooro noɔ kɛŋɔ Israel tena bane sɔɔh ba jo bwɛɛ la ta awola jwaana la ne, dɛ́ ba sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Israel baala la ka chɔ jwaana la, Rahab teehnɔ la ba be dea la doa,

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
