translation_verse: Ya no ɡɛ Korowii aa ɡela Mposwɛm teŋe, asɛ he won le o baŋ ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, dɛ berɛ no kpoe haa kpoo Amɔre tena koranar banɛ Sihon ne Ɔɡ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛ bwa kwaraa la.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Yaa no ɡɛ la, ya jum jaoh ya bambile chɔɡ ɡɛ haa ɛa la wa. Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee nyundua ne harɛ bwa kooro.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Rahab berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ dɛ ba dɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo Jeriko tena aa, baa na o ne o lolanar sumii ɡɛ waa na ba sum la. Dɛ ŋɔ ba ɛ we-ɛɛle bɛl ásɛ o na dɛ́ yarada kɛŋɔ

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: baa baɡɔ nyoa kɛŋɔ baa lɛ o nya ne o mɛɛ ne o nimambii dɛ ba biirere nyuu ba bɛ ban kpoo.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Anee nɛra la baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ, “Dɛ ya ta waa yaa bola la ta teŋaa, Korowii kpoo yaa. Dɛ he ta yaa leɛ tɛ tenaa, ya ɡee nyiŋuu dɛ bɛ ɡel bá kpo he ne he nɛn bɛlbwa awola Korowii aa kpɔ he harɛ nɔ do ya nɔn ta la.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Dɛ dea Rahab aa lɔ o ta la, ba ma bwɛjen la danjwɛɛ choŋi o ta. Anomanta, Rahab cheɡɛ dea la tokoro ta dɛ vɔwɛ ɡboɡbii ba ta harɛ, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Israel baala la be ŋɔ báa won che o ta dɛ́ tu bwɛjen la dahara.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Haah la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ka sɔh deŋɡarere nɔ ta, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ ti heyaa la bɛ heyaa na. Hé sɔh bela tɔpera atoro ka tel saŋ baa berɛ ba, ásɛ he kaa bela haa lea ba.”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Ate, haah la sɛh dɛ ta ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa. Baa kaala tonɛ la, o kpɔ ŋwɛnswɛm la vɔwɛ tokoro la ta.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Israel baala la aa kaala la, ba kaa sɔh deŋɡarere la ta tɔpera atoro ɡɛ haah la aa baɡla la. Kooro nɛra la ɡe kaa ɡaaɡe ba bɔr harɛ la ta bwa ba ta ban nae, dɛ laa berɛ ba Jeriko.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Ate, nɛra baa sɔah dɛ ka nyiŋi harɛ la le deŋɡarere la ta, dɛ ka ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le, dɛ kaa bela baa lea. Baa laŋa la, ba kaa bol Josua be waa baa kaa na bwa.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya nao kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ harɛ la bwa do ya nɔn ta. Bela tena bwa jum jah ya wa.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Ate, tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Josua ne Israel tena la le Sitim dɛ ka so Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa tama mɔɔ dɛ ɛɡɛ le o baŋ.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Tɔpera atoro habɔɔ la, nomonome la valɛ ba be bela baa soɡa la,

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: Haa ŋwɛnɛ la ta jemɛ, banee dɛɛ ba he sie tɔe, dɛ́ baɡle heyaa bela haa kpɔ. He bɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la dɛɛ bɛne, hé ɡel dɛ ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa atoro ta he ne o baah ta.”

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Josua ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé laa he te kpɔ doŋa bɛlbwa ta dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ, kere Korowii ɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa tɛ heya.”

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Josua ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la che, dɛ́ tɔ sie nɛra la teŋɛ.” Asɛ ba kpɔ che dɛ tɔ ba sie.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Finii mɛɛ ba mun pae dɛ́ ɡel Israel tena bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee ba sitɔɔ, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ n ja he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ n fa aa ja Mosis nɛɛ la.”

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ sɔfore baa cheɡɛ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la be ŋɔ, ‘Haa dɛɛ jo Jɔɔdan Moo nee la ta la, hé den che bela, dɛ bɛ sie kaa.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Anee Josua yerɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ, “Hé ba, dɛ́ ba no waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol.

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Anɔ taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la ja he nɛ, dɛ́ doŋi nɛra baa soɡe harɛ waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé ka so o ta he sie, baa yer ba Keenan ne Hiti ne Hivi ne Pɛrɛs ne Girɡasi ne Amɔre dɛ Jebus tena la.

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Dɛ koo kwaa koma saŋee, asɛ moo la su halalaa ken. Sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Daka la aa kaa tel nee la nyoa la, ba napaala ne o leɡa dɛ o teŋo,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la valɛ harɛpɛɛ ta, Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ la bini dɛ ka jaɡɛ che, asɛ nɛra la bwa sekwaraa kpɔ harɛpɛɛ la ta ba bɛɡ ba dɛ le o baŋ.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Israel tena la bwa sekwaraa aa ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le la, Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: dɛ́ ŋɔ bá la bela tenten sɔfore la aa cheɡɛ Korowii Fɔo Daka la nenabɔɔ la baah ta, ásɛ bɛlbwa ka kpɔ bwe beŋkpoŋ ka bil bela baa dɛ ba chɔe jwaana nɔ ne.”

english_verse: Joshua chose twelve men; then he called them together
translation_verse: Ate, Josua yerɛ baala waa lee ba le Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ bɛlbwa ta la,

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ “Hé berɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ la baah ta bela sɔfore la aa cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, ásɛ bɛlbwa ka kpɔ bwe beŋkpoŋ dawɛ o vam á che tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: ásɛ he ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘A cheɡɔ dɛ tɛ saŋ bɛl baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Jɔɔdan Moo dɛ ba bonɔ la, moo la teŋo ba valɛ o baah harɛpɛɛ ta dɛ le.’ Anomanta, bwea nɔɔ ya Israel tena kpɔ dɛɛ lii ɡɛ waa nɔ á chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Israel tena ɛ ɡɛ Josua aa do ba ŋɔ ba ɛ la. Dea bɛlbwa kpɔ bwe beŋkpoŋ a ɛ bwea fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ le Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ la baah ta, dɛ che tɛ Israel deene la bɛlbwa, asɛ ba kpɔ ka bil bela baa soɡa.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Josua ɡe kaa kpɔ bwefala fi dɛ anɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la nenabɔɔ baah ta, dɛ kpɔ paaɡe bela sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la fa aa cheɡa la. A ta cheɡɛ bela ba le fini.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Korobie waa tɔ sie, o tɔpera fi taa ba le Jɔɔdan Moo la, dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gelɡal. O lɔ bwɛjen Jeriko harɛ jwɛh wee leebɔr.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Gelɡal belaa Josua ɡel ba kpɔ bwea fi dɛ anɛ la baa paa le Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ baah ta la tɛo o kpɔ paaɡe.

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Israel tena la be ja ŋɔ, “Kerekere dɛ he bii ba dɛ bɔɔ heya bwea nɔ mun aa,

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Hé berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɡelɔ Jɔɔdan Moo teŋe ya won ɛɡɛ le o baŋ ɡɛ waa ɡela Mposwɛm teŋe tɛ ya naawa la.

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: Korowii ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ o kpeɡri kan, ásɛ hɛɛ duu Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.’ ”

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Amɔre tena baa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la wee cholibɔr koranar, ne Keenan tena baa lɔ Mɛdetereenea Mpo nyoa koranar aa noa kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡelɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la teŋe, asɛ Israel tena won ɛɡɛ le o baŋ la, ba jum jaoh, ba hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ kɛŋɔ ba ne Israel tena aa won yo.

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Gel bá kpɔ kwɛrboɔ loɡɛ keri, dɛ́ teŋni Israel tena baa wola ba pena teŋne la pena.”

english_verse: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.
translation_verse: Asɛ Josua ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la. O kpɔ kwɛrboɔ loɡɛ keri dɛ teŋni ba pena, bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Penteŋ Deŋɡare ta.

english_verse: This had to be done, because none of Israel's baby boys had been circumcised during the
translation_verse: A ɡɛ baala baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ nɔ, dɛ ba ta ba bii pena teŋni, ba habɔɔ biirii Josua teŋni pena.

english_verse: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.
translation_verse: Josua ɡelɔ ba teŋni nɛra la bwa pena, asɛ dɛ ɡel ba so ba buɡ ta bela ka tel kɛŋɔ ŋwɛra la aa tona.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “N laa yoma haa ɛa Ijipt harɛ ta la sihiih kpɔ he sie ta fini.” Anomanta, ba dɛ yerɛ bela Gelɡal dɛ ba le fini.

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Israel tena kaa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so Gelɡal, o bɛne bwɛjen Jeriko harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta. Dɛ ba dɔ Galekaa Tɔpejen dɛɛ ba dii korobie la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta jɔmɔra.

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Baa dena di Keenan harɛ kondikwaa la habɔɔ, maana ta leere ba dɔ ane di kpa. Harɛ la ta kondikwaa ɡboo baa ka.

english_verse: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, “Are you on our side or on our enemies' side?”
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, Josua ne Israel tena dɛ bɛne bwɛjen Jeriko, asɛ o na baa bɛl o kpoŋe kere dɛ che o sie. Josua la o be dɛ ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ya bini bɛlee hen kɛɛ ya dɔmee hen ɔ?”

english_verse: “Neither,” he answered. “I am here because I am the commander of the Lord's army.” Joshua fell to his knees and bowed down to the ground. “I am your servant,” he said. “Tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Asɛ baa la chaŋe ŋɔ, “N toole a bɛlbwa bini, Korowiirii lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ba tɔ o laa tena sie, asɛ n ba nɔ.” Ate, Josua ɡuŋu dɛ duuru ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ he bonɔɔ ɛ tɛɛ nɔ?”

english_verse: “Take off your sandals,” the commander answered. “This is a holy place.” So Joshua took off his sandals.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii laa sitɔɔ la ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Laa he naŋɡawa foo, bela haa cheɡa nɔ do ɡoroŋ.” Ate, Josua laa o naŋɡawa la foo.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Jericho had been locking the gates in their town wall because they were afraid of the Israelites. No one could go out or come in.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Jeriko tena koh Israel tena waa dɛ laa ɡbeni baa kpɔ a ta dɛɛ jo bwɛɛ la ta kaɡre tɔ ba nɛ. Nomɛlbwa aa won le bwɛɛ la ta kɛɛ dɛ́ jo bela.

english_verse: Take along the sacred chest and tell seven priests to walk in front of it, carrying trumpets. But on the seventh day, march slowly around the town seven times while the priests blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Gel sɔfore banuanɛ kpɔ pebal nyeɡle bɛle tɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie. Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, he ne he laa tena valɛ bar bwɛjen la kera anuanɛ, ásɛ sɔfore la ɛɛ hoh bɛle la.

english_verse: Then the priests will blast on their trumpets, and everyone else will shout. The wall will fall down, and your soldiers can go straight in from every side.
translation_verse: Bɛlhoohla la ɛ dɛ́ hoh ba bɛle la kohona, ásɛ nɛra la bwa ɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre kohona. Danjwɛɛ baa mao bar bwɛɛ la ɛɛ choɡluu, ásɛ nomɛlbwa den jo bwɛjen la ta.”

english_verse: Joshua called the priests together and said, “Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Nun bibaa Josua yerɛ sɔfore la dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la che, ásɛ he bini banuanɛ ɡe kpɔ bɛle tɔ o sie.”

english_verse: They obeyed Joshua's orders and carried the chest once around the town before returning to camp for the night.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Josua do sɔfore la, asɛ ba che Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la dɛ bar bwɛjen la cheme kera beŋkpoŋ, dɛ berɛ laa berɛ kaa bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dɛ ka chɔ.

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanɛ te la ta la, ba iro valɛ bar bwɛjen la ɡɛ ba yon dɛɛ ɛ la. Awola ɡboo ba valɛ bar bwɛjen la kera anuanɛ.

english_verse: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua yelled: Get ready to shout! The Lord will let you capture this town.
translation_verse: Baa bara kera anuanɛ ta la, sɔfore la hoh ba bɛle la, asɛ Josua ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé do lɔŋɔre! Korowii kpɔ bwɛjen nɔ do he nɔn ta!

english_verse: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord. The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.
translation_verse: Hé paɡre bwɛjen la kwaraa, ásɛ dɛ le komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta cheɡ tɛ Korowii. Hanjwamane Rahab ne o nɛra baa lɔ o dem te, he bɛ ban wobɛlbwa ɛ. Onee lɛ nɛra yaa tom ba ŋɔ bá ba sɔh nyiŋi bwɛjen nɔ la sɔh.

english_verse: The silver and gold and everything made of bronze and iron belong to the Lord and must be put in his treasury. Be careful to follow these instructions, because if you see something you want and take it, the Lord will destroy Israel. And it will be all your fault.
translation_verse: Kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne ayaawa dɛ bune ɛa la te, a do ɡoroŋ kohona tɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ ba tɛo o Dea bela baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.”

english_verse: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.
translation_verse: Bɛle la aa sia la, nɛra la do lɔŋɔre kohona asɛ danjwɛɛ baa maa bar bwɛjen la den kuuɡi kwaraa. Ate, laa tena la den jo bwɛjen la ta dɛ lɛ bwɛɛ la bwa dɔɔh.

english_verse: After Jericho was destroyed, Joshua warned the people, “Someday a man will rebuild Jericho, but the Lord will put a curse on him, and the man's oldest son will die when he starts to build the town wall. And by the time he finishes the wall and puts gates in it, all his children will be dead.”
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Jeriko paɡra bini la, Josua ŋwɛɛ ntam kɛŋɔ Korowii taah nomɛlbwa waa berɛ ba vɔrɔwe Jeriko ja. “Nomɛlbwa waa ba pe bwɛjen la mun la, o bibanloɡle sewɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa ba cheɡ o doonyoo la, o bibambechala sewɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Joshua in everything he did, and Joshua was famous everywhere in Canaan.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Korowii ja Josua nɛ dɛ ɡel o sɔn le harɛ la ta bwa.

english_verse: The Lord had said that everything in Jericho belonged to him. But Achan from the Judah tribe took some of the things from Jericho for himself. And so the Lord was angry with the Israelites, because one of them had disobeyed him.
translation_verse: Israel tena la ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii waa ŋɔa ba bɛ kpɔ la ta. Baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Akan, o mɛɛ sɔne Kaami. Kaami ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Simri, asɛ o nabaa sɔne Sɛra, o le Juda dea. A ɡɛ Akan nɔɔ kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii waa ŋɔa ba bɛ kpɔ la, asɛ a che a ta Korowii baah di ba nɛɛ kohona la.

english_verse: Joshua and the leaders of Israel tore their clothes and put dirt on their heads to show their sorrow. They lay facedown on the ground in front of the sacred chest until sunset.
translation_verse: Ate, Josua kɛɛ laala waa doa la, dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, dɛ chɔ bela ka tel jɔmɔra. Israel nomonome la ɡe ɛ ɡɛ, ba ne Josua bwa ɛ teera do ba nyuune ta a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba loo kuu.

english_verse: Then Joshua said: Our Lord, did you bring us across the Jordan River just so the Amorites could destroy us? This wouldn't have happened if we had agreed to stay on the other side of the Jordan.
translation_verse: Asɛ Josua ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he le ya ne Jɔɔdan Moo nɔ baŋ bonɔ dɛ ba do Amɔre tena nɔn ta bá kpoo yaa nɔɔ? Ya fe ta soɡe Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ le fe bɔ.

english_verse: I don't even know what to say to you, since Israel's army has turned and run from the enemy.
translation_verse: Korowii, n ta ɡɛ bwa maa bol nae kpa. Israel tena dɔma teŋɛ ba nɛ ba laa berɛ.

english_verse: Everyone will think you weren't strong enough to protect your people. Now the Canaanites and everyone else who lives in the land will surround us and wipe us out.
translation_verse: Keenan tena ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa ɛɛ no waa nɔɔ, dɛ́ ba bar yaa, dɛ́ kpoo yaa, dɛ́ ɡel ya sɔn nyoɡre harɛ nɔ ta. Ɛrɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he sɔn kan ɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord answered: Stop lying there on the ground! Get up!
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Ir che! Ɛrɛɛ he kpɔ sie pi harɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: I said everything in Jericho belonged to me and had to be destroyed. But the Israelites have kept some of the things for themselves. They stole from me and hid what they took. Then they lied about it.
translation_verse: Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa, ba chɔɡ n ne ba fɔo yaa fɔwa n do ba ŋɔ baa teŋɛ a ta la ta. Ba kpɔ kwaa maa ŋɔa ba le cheɡ tɛ mɛ la ane. Ba ŋwɛa dɛ teŋe nyosone, dɛ paa ja ba laala ta.

english_verse: What they stole was supposed to be destroyed, and now Israel itself must be destroyed. I cannot help you anymore until you do exactly what I have said. That's why Israel turns and runs from its enemies instead of standing up to them.
translation_verse: Anɔ waa Israel tena aa wola won che ba dɔma sie la. A chɛ kɛ bá sewɛ ba wechɔɡa la wa. Maa he nɛɛ ja kpa, nemenɛ he chɔɡ kwaa maa ŋɔa he le cheɡ tɛ mɛ, a do he be la bwa.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel, “Tomorrow you will meet with the Lord your God, so make yourselves acceptable to worship him. The Lord says that you have taken things that should have been destroyed. You won't be able to stand up to your enemies until you get rid of those things.
translation_verse: Ir la nɛra la be, dɛ́ ka sɔ ba doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ ta. Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá sɔ ba doŋa ta dɛɛ kpa kere. Ŋɔ men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la ŋɔ, kwaa maa ŋɔa he le cheɡ mɛ la lɔ he be. Haa won che he dɔma sie dɛ he ta a ne leɛ.

english_verse: “Tomorrow morning everyone must gather near the place of worship. You will come forward tribe by tribe, and the Lord will show which tribe is guilty. Next, the clans in that tribe must come forward, and the Lord will show which clan is guilty. The families in that clan must come, and the Lord will point out the guilty family. Finally, the men in that family must come,
translation_verse: Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ chɔɔbɔr, denaa bɛlbwa tena ba n sie, dea bɛlbwa men Korowii aa lawɛ la, bá le ba n sie, dɛ́ le denaa ta ba n sie lolanar ta, ásɛ lolanar bɛlbwa nɛra maa lawɛ la, bá ba n sie beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa.

english_verse: and the Lord will show who stole what should have been destroyed. That man must be put to death, his body burned, and his possessions thrown into the fire. He has done a terrible thing by breaking the sacred agreement that the Lord made with Israel.”
translation_verse: Naate maa lawɔ ŋɔ kwaa maa ŋɔa ba le cheɡ mɛ la lɔ o be la chɛ kɛŋɔ, bá fuh o ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa. O chɔɡ n fɔo n ne baa fɔwa la, dɛ ɛ sihihwa Israel harɛ ta.”

english_verse: Joshua got up early the next morning and brought each tribe to the place of worship, where the Lord showed that the Judah tribe was guilty.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Josua ɡelɔ Israel tena la le denaa bɛlbwa tena ba Korowii sie, asɛ a ba kɛŋɔ Juda dea tenaa o lawɛ.

english_verse: Then Joshua brought the clans of Judah to the Lord, and the Lord showed that the Zerah clan was guilty. One by one he brought the leader of each family in the Zerah clan to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Zabdi's family was guilty.
translation_verse: Ate, Juda dea tena le dɛ ba che sie, asɛ Korowii lawɛ Sɛra tena. Asɛ o ɡel Sɛra tena ba o sie lolanar ta, asɛ o lawɛ Simri dem tena.

english_verse: Finally, Joshua brought each man in Zabdi's family to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Achan was the guilty one.
translation_verse: Asɛ Josua ɡel Simri ne o lolanar le ba che beŋkpoŋa, asɛ Korowii lawɛ Akan, o mɛɛ sɔne Kaami. Kaami mɛɛ sɔne Simri, Simri ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Sɛra, dɛ le Juda dea.

english_verse: “Achan,” Joshua said, “the Lord God of Israel has decided that you are guilty. So tell me what you did, and don't try to hide anything.”
translation_verse: Anee Josua ŋɔ Akan be ŋɔ, “N bie, ɔmɛ Korowii, kpɔ duure tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la, dɛ́ bol he wechɔɡa haa ɛa la, dɛ bɛ nyosone teŋe. Bol wobɛlbwa haa ɛa, bɛ kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.”

english_verse: “It's true,” Achan answered. “I sinned and disobeyed the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Asɛ Akan ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, n ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la nɛ. Waa maa ɛa laanee nɔ.

english_verse: They brought them back and put them in front of the sacred chest, so Joshua and the rest of the Israelites could see them.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ kwaa la le tɛnte dea la bini, dɛ kpɔ ba tɛ Josua ne Israel tena la bwa, dɛ kpɔa bil Korowii sie.

english_verse: Then everyone took Achan and the things he had stolen to Trouble Valley. They also took along his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys, and sheep, his tent, and everything else that belonged to him.
translation_verse: Ate, Josua ne Israel tena la lawɛ Akan, dɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la ne batakaare la ne suuɡaswɛm bwe, ne o bii bwa ne o nae ne keeɡore ne peera, dɛ o tɛnte Dea ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa bwa, dɛ kpɔ ba ne a bwa kaa Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen bini.

english_verse: Joshua said, “Achan, you caused us a lot of trouble. Now the Lord is paying you back with the same kind of trouble.” The people of Israel then stoned to death Achan and his family. They made a fire and burned the bodies, together with what Achan had stolen, and all his possessions.
translation_verse: Asɛ Josua bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he tɛ yaa waa ken? Fini he ne Korowii ɛɛ dɔɔ taeh.” Israel tena bwa foɡro bwea dɛ kpoo, dɛ foɡre ba kabora, dɛ pɛ fuh ba bwa.

english_verse: They covered the remains with a big pile of rocks, which is still there. Then the Lord stopped being angry with Israel. That's how the place came to be called Trouble Valley.
translation_verse: Ba pa bwea dawɛ Akan nɛɛ a daŋɛ kohona, a ta chɔ le ba le fini. Asɛ Korowii baah waa dia kohona la sɔɔh. A waa baa yerɛ bela Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen saŋ la bwa ba le fini la.

english_verse: The rest of the army will come with me and attack near the gate. When the people of Ai come out to fight, we'll run away and let them chase us. They will think we are running from them just like the first time. But when we've let them chase us far enough away,
translation_verse: Baa chwao ti yaa ka tel kɛŋɔ yaa kpɔ ba le bwɛjen la ta. Baa ŋɔɔ, ‘Israel tena la berɔ chwa dɛɛ kaa ɡɛ ba fa aa ɛa la.’ Dɛ ya baa chwa le ba be tonaa,

english_verse: Then set it on fire, as the Lord has told us to do. Those are your orders,
translation_verse: Hé baa lɛ bwɛjen la tonaa, hé kpaa nii do o ta. Hé no waa maa do heyaa a ta nɔ kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: Early the next morning he got his troops ready to move out, and he and the other leaders of Israel led them to Ai.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Josua yerɛ o laa tena la cheme, o ne Israel nomonome tɔ ba sie ba valɛ kaa bwɛjen Ai ta.

english_verse: Now all his troops were in place. Part of the army was in the camp to the north of Ai, and the others were hiding to the west, ready to make a surprise attack. That night, Joshua went into the valley.
translation_verse: Josua kpɔ laa tena la, bɛlbwa ka che o chebɔr, banɔ la baa wara la lɔ bwɛjen la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ba bini tama la ɡe sɔh dɛ chɔ bwɛjen la wee cholibɔr. Josua kaa chɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini awola jwaana la ne.

english_verse: So he called out every man in Ai to go after Joshua's troops. They all rushed out to chase the Israelite army, and they left the town gates wide open. Not one man was left in Ai or in Bethel. Joshua let the men of Ai chase him and his army farther and farther away from Ai.
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa ta bwɛjen Ai ne Bɛtel kae baa wola leɛ dɛ ti Israel tena. Ba ɡel bwɛjen la o chɔ pɛɛ dɛ ti ba kaa. Baa bɛlbwa toole o ta dɛ́ yo kpa.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord told Joshua, “Point your sword at the town of Ai, because now I am going to help you defeat it!” As soon as Joshua pointed his sword at the town,
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Tɛr he lampea la pa bwɛjen Ai ta, he nɔn taa mɛɛ ba bwɛɛ la kpɔe dɛ́ do.” Asɛ Josua tɛr o lampea pa Ai.

english_verse: the soldiers who had been hiding jumped up and ran into the town. They captured it and set it on fire.
translation_verse: Josua aa ɛ ɡɛ la, laa tena baa sɔah dɛɛ kpa la leɔ warane dɛ ka jo bwɛjen la ta dɛ lɛ o bwa dɔɔh, dɛ kpaa nii do o ta.

english_verse: When Joshua and his troops saw smoke rising from the town, they knew that the other part of their army had captured it. So they turned and attacked. The men of Ai looked back and saw smoke rising from their town. But they could not escape, because the soldiers they had been chasing had suddenly turned and started fighting.
translation_verse: Josua ne Israel tena la bwaa naa kɛŋɔ laa tena baa kaa sɔh chɔ dɛɛ kpa la kaa lɛ bwɛjen la dɔɔh asɛ chuu tɛr dɛɛ le o ta la, ba laa berɛ dɛɛ kpoo ba.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the other Israelite soldiers had come from the town and attacked the men of Ai from the rear. The Israelites captured the king of Ai and brought him to Joshua. They also chased the rest of the men of Ai into the desert and killed them. The Israelite army went back to Ai and killed everyone there.
translation_verse: Israel tena aa ti bwɛjen Ai tena dɛ ka kpoo ba kooni ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta tonɛ la, ba berɔ la bwɛjen Ai ta ɡe dɛ ka kpoo nɛra baa ka o bini bwa.

english_verse: Joshua made sure every building in Ai was burned to the ground. He told his men to kill the king of Ai and hang his body on a tree. Then at sunset he told the Israelites to take down the body, throw it in the gateway of the town, and cover it with a big pile of rocks. translation_verse: O ɡelɔ ba saɡɛ bwɛjen Ai kooro daa ta, ka tel jɔmɔra. Wee aa baa jo la, o ɡelɔ ba fooru dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta Ai doonyojen baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ jo bwɛɛ la ta la. Ba pa bwea dawɛ o nɛɛ a daŋɛ, dɛ ta chɔ bela ba le fini. Korowii Mmara kura Ebal Bwejen ta

english_verse: The people of Gibeon had also heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.
translation_verse: Gebeɔn tena aa no ɡɛ Josua ne Israel tena aa ɛ bwɛjena Jeriko ne Ai la,

english_verse: So they decided that some of their men should pretend to be messengers to Israel from a faraway country. The men put worn-out bags on their donkeys and found some old wineskins that had cracked and had been sewn back together.
translation_verse: ba kpɔ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ dɔ ba nyu. Ba nyin bɔɡtɔ bena do kondikwa, dɛ kpɔ ola tɔmbena dɛ nyarɛ loŋa baa kpɔ sen do a ta dɛ vɔrɔwe choɡ keeɡore.

english_verse: Their sandals were old and patched, and their clothes were worn out. They even took along some dry and crumbly bread.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ naŋɡaobena aa kɛɛra baa nyara do, dɛ pa laala jɛɡle do. Dɛ paanoo baa kpoŋa la bwa holɔ dɛ kɔlɔme.

english_verse: Then they went to the Israelite camp at Gilgal, where they said to Joshua and the men of Israel, “We have come from a country that is far from here. Please make a peace treaty with us.”
translation_verse: Belaa nɛra la la Josua ne Israel tena la be bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gelɡal. Ate, Gebeɔn tena la ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ya le bojaŋ harɛ bɛl ta, ya dɛ nyin kɛ ya ne he fɔwɛ darame fɔo.”

english_verse: We are your servants, and we live far from here. We came because the Lord your God is so famous. We heard what the Lord did in Egypt
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ, “Bojaŋ harɛ bɛl taa he bonɔɔna le, noe ya no Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la wa. Ya no wejena waa ɛa Ijipt harɛ ta,

english_verse: and what he did to those two Amorite kings on the other side of the Jordan: King Og of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, and King Sihon of Heshbon.
translation_verse: ne ɡɛ waa ɛ Amɔre tena koranar banɛ bane Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr. Kooro Sihon o fa aa soɡe bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn, ne Kooro Ɔɡ o ɡe fa aa ɛ kooro Basan harɛ ta, dɛ so bwɛjen Astarɔt ta.

english_verse: Our leaders and everyone who lives in our country told us to meet with you and tell you that all of us are your servants. They said to ask you to make a peace treaty with our people. They told us to be sure and take along enough food for our journey.
translation_verse: A waa ya harɛ ta nomonome ne nɛra baa lɔ ya harɛ la ta bwa ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ, ‘Yá kpɔ kondikwa do ya be ya vala la bini, dɛ́ ba bol ya harɛ nɔ waa baɡle heya kɛŋɔ he bonɔɔnaa yan. Ásɛ ya ne he fɔwɛ darame fɔo.’

english_verse: See this dry, crumbly bread of ours? It was hot out of the oven when we packed the food on the day we left our homes.
translation_verse: Hé na ya paanoo, dɛ a wɔrɔbe ya kpɔ do ya bone bini dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta, taraken a holɔ dɛ kɔlɔme.

english_verse: These cracked wineskins were new when we filled them, and our clothes and sandals are worn out because we have traveled so far.
translation_verse: Ola tɔne yaa do sen a bini nɔ, dɛ anfalaa, kɛ hé nyiŋi na ɡɛ aa doa taraken, a bwa kɛɛrɔ. Ya laala ne naŋɡaware yaa doa bwa kɛɛrɔ, jaŋne ŋwɛnɛ la aa doa nomanta.”

english_verse: The Israelites tried some of the food, but they did not ask the Lord if he wanted them to make a treaty.
translation_verse: Josua ne Israel tena ta Korowii bɔɔrɛ no kɛŋɔ ba sɛh ba ne ba fɔwɛ ba fɔo la.

english_verse: So Joshua made a peace treaty with the messengers and promised that Israel would not kill their people. Israel's leaders swore that Israel would keep this promise.
translation_verse: Asɛ Josua ne Gebeɔn tena la fɔwɛ darame fɔo kɛŋɔ waa ban kpoo, asɛ Israel nomonome la ɡe ŋwɛɛ ntam dawɛ waa la ta.

english_verse: A couple of days later, the Israelites found out that these people actually lived in the nearby towns of Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-Jearim. So the Israelites left the place where they had camped and arrived at the four towns two days later.
translation_verse: Belaa Israel tena la ir chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa nɛra la be, tɔpera atoroo ba kpɔ jo ba bwɛjena la ta. Bwɛjena laanee Gebeɔn ne Kefira ne Beɛrɔt dɛ Kiriat Jearim.

english_verse: But they did not attack the towns, because the Israelite leaders had sworn in the name of the Lord that they would let these people live. The Israelites complained about their leaders' decision not to attack,
translation_verse: Israel tena la ta ban kpoorɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba nomonome ne ba fa tɔ sie fɔwɛ darame fɔo Israel tena Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta. Dɛ Israel tena la dɛ naɡre ba nomonome la waa kɛŋɔ baa ɛ ɡɛ la.

english_verse: but the leaders reminded them, “We promised these people in the name of the Lord God of Israel that we would let them live, so we must not harm them. If we break our promise, God will punish us. We'll let them live, but we'll make them cut wood and carry water for our people.”
translation_verse: Ba berɔ ŋɔ, “Bá so, kɛ baa teŋni daa dɛ che nee dɛɛ tɛ Israel tena bwa.” Asɛ ba no waa nomonome la aa kpɔa baɡ ba nyoa la ta.

english_verse: Joshua told some of his soldiers, “I want to meet with the Gibeonite leaders. Bring them here.” When the Gibeonites came, Joshua said, “You live close to us. Why did you lie by claiming you lived far away?
translation_verse: Ate, Josua yerɛ Gebeɔn tena la bwa cheme dɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he ba neɡre yaa ŋɔ he le bojaŋ, jaah dɛ he le ya mee lɔɡa bonɔ tenten nɔɔ?

english_verse: So now you are under a curse, and from now on your people will have to send workers to cut wood and carry water for the place of worship.”
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa haa ɛa nɔ, Korowii taah heya, haa ba he ba dɔ he nyu dɛɛ di pɛɛpɛɛ kpa bwa. Le fini dɛɛ kaa hɛ́ɛ dɛɛ teŋni daa, dɛ́ che nee dɛɛ la Korowii Dea.”

english_verse: The Gibeonites answered, “The Lord your God told his servant Moses that you were to kill everyone who lives here and take their land for yourselves. We were afraid you would kill us, and so we tricked you into making a peace treaty. But we agreed to be your servants,
translation_verse: Asɛ Gebeɔn tena la ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, yan yaa ɛ he bonɔɔna, ya noɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii aa do o bonɔɔ Mosis ŋɔ ó kpɔ harɛ nɔ bwa tɛ he Israel tena, ásɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra baa soɡe o ta bwa le he sie nomanta, ɔmee lawɛ yaa ɡɛ yaa ɛ dɛ́ dɔ ya nyu, a waa ya ɛ ɡɛ la.

english_verse: and you are strong enough to do anything to us that you want. We just ask you to do what seems right.”
translation_verse: Yanee la, ya lɔ he nɔn ta, anɔ la bwa aa wera kɛ hé ɛ yaa la, hé ɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua did not let the Israelites kill the Gibeonites,
translation_verse: Josua lɛɛ ba Israel tena nɔn ta, ba ta ban kpoorɛ.

english_verse: but he did tell the Gibeonites that they would have to be servants of the nation of Israel. They would have to cut firewood and bring it for the priests to use for burning sacrifices on the Lord's altar, wherever the Lord decided the altar would be. The Gibeonites would also have to carry water for the priests. And that is still the work of the Gibeonites.
translation_verse: Le awola tɔpere la ba le fini, ɡɛɛ Gebeɔn tena ɛɛ teŋni daa, dɛ che nee dɛɛ tɛ Israel tena, dɛ kpɔ ane dɛɛ la saraha kon la ta bobɛlbwa Korowii aa baɡ ba.

english_verse: King Adonizedek of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured and destroyed the town of Ai, and then killed its king as he had done at Jericho. He also learned that the Gibeonites had signed a peace treaty with Israel.
translation_verse: A kaa ba kɛ Kooro Adoni Sɛdɛk o fa aa di kora Jerusalam noɔ kɛŋɔ Josua ne o nɛra kaa yo bwɛjen Ai, dɛ chɔɡo kwaraa. Gɛ tenten Josua aa ɛ bwɛjen Jeriko tena ne o kooro la, ne ɡɛ Gebeɔn tena aa la Israel tena be ba ne ba ka fɔwɛ darame fɔo dɛ so bɛne ba la.

english_verse: This frightened Adonizedek and his people. They knew that Gibeon was a large town, as big as the towns that had kings, and even bigger than the town of Ai had been. And all of the men of Gibeon were warriors.
translation_verse: Ɔmee chole Kooro Adoni Sɛdɛk ne o nɛra nɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Gebeɔn ɛ bwɛjen dɛ ɛ koobwɛɛre la bini bɛl, dɛ do kan ɡwaa bwɛjen Ai, o nɛra ɡe jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: So Adonizedek sent messages to the kings of four other towns: King Hoham of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King Debir of Eglon. The messages said,
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Adoni Sɛdɛk kpɔ kala tɛ Hɛbrɔn Kooro Hoham ne Jaamut Kooro Piram, ne Lakes Kooro Jafia dɛ Ɛɡlɔn Kooro Debir ŋɔ,

english_verse: “The Gibeonites have signed a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelites. Come and help me attack Gibeon!”
translation_verse: “Hé ba cha mɛ ń ka yo bwɛjen Gebeɔn tena. Ba ne Josua ne o nɛra Israel tena kaa fɔwɛ darame fɔo.”

english_verse: the Gibeonites sent a message to the Israelite camp at Gilgal: “Joshua, please come and rescue us! The Amorite kings from the hill country have joined together and are attacking us. We are your servants, so don't let us down. Please hurry!”
translation_verse: Belaa Gebeɔn tena den tomɛ nɛra Josua ne o nɛra Israel tena be bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gelɡal la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, Amɔre harɛ koranar baa lɔ deŋɡarere bwɛɛre ta bwa lɔɔ pɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba laa tena dɛɛ ba ba yo yaa, anomanta, kpɔ he nɛra ba warane dɛ́ ba cha he bonɔɔna, dɛ́ lɛ yaa ta.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army, including his best warriors, left Gilgal.
translation_verse: Ate, Josua kpɔ o laa tena bwa, banɔ la baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le Gelɡal.

english_verse: “Joshua,” the Lord said, “don't be afraid of the Amorites. They will run away when you attack, and I will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ ba ɔma, n dɔɔ kpɔ ba do he nɔn ta. Ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che he sie.”

english_verse: Joshua marched all night from Gilgal to Gibeon and made a surprise attack on the Amorite camp.
translation_verse: Josua ne o laa tena valɔ jwaana la ne bwa le Gelɡal ba bwɛjen Gebeɔn ta, dɛ ka piɡri Amɔre tena bela baa soɡa, dɛ yoo ba.

english_verse: The Lord made the enemy panic, and the Israelites started killing them right and left. They chased the Amorite troops up the road to Beth-Horon and kept on killing them, until they reached the towns of Azekah and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii den ɡel Amɔre tena la wili Israel laa tena la sie, asɛ ba pɔ ba nɛɛ kohona dɛ kpoo ba Gebeɔn. Israel tena ti ba kaa bwɛɛ Bɛt Hɔrɔn ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ teŋɛ kpoo ba kaa bwɛɛre Aseka ne Makeda.

english_verse: And while these troops were going down through Beth-Horon Pass, the Lord made huge hailstones fall on them all the way to Azekah. More of the enemy soldiers died from the hail than from the Israelite weapons.
translation_verse: Amɔre tena la aa chwaa tɔ Israel tena laa tena sie dɛ ka tel Bɛt Hɔrɔn dɛɛ kaa Aseka la, Korowii ɡelɔ dombwea lee ba nɛɛ kohona asɛ ba ɡalɡa bwa serewe ɡwaa ɡɛ Israel tena la aa kpoo ba la kwara.

english_verse: The Lord was helping the Israelites defeat the Amorites that day. So about noon, Joshua prayed to the Lord loud enough for the Israelites to hear: “Our Lord, make the sun stop in the sky over Gibeon, and the moon stand still over Aijalon Valley.” So the sun and the moon stopped and stood still until Israel defeated its enemies. This poem can be found in The Book of Jashar. The sun stood still and didn't go down for about a whole day.
translation_verse: Anee wee che bobeŋkpoŋ, korobie ɡe ta che bobeŋkpoŋ, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ Israel tena aa kpoo ba dɔma la tonɛ. Gɛɛ a do ba chwerɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ do tɔn baa dɛ yerɔ Jashar Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Wee cheɡɛ nyufala o ta harɛ lee tɔpebir bwa la.”

english_verse: Never before and never since has the Lord done anything like that for someone who prayed. The Lord was really fighting for Israel.
translation_verse: Waa nɔ dɔŋa ta chiɡe saŋ bɛlbwa bwa, kɛɛ Korowii no nɛwɛnyini wesoŋa ken bwa. Kasinteŋ, dɛ Korowiirii fa yoa dɛɛ tɛ Israel tena.

english_verse: After the battle, Joshua and the Israelites went back to their camp at Gilgal. Joshua Kills the Five Enemy Kings
translation_verse: Laa la aa tona la, Josua ne o laa tena bwa berɔ kaa Gelɡal bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so la. Amɔre koranar banue kpoora

english_verse: While the enemy soldiers were running from the Israelites, the five enemy kings ran away and hid in a cave near Makkedah.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ la, Amɔre koranar banue la chwao ka sɔh Makeda bwebɔɔ bɛl bini.

english_verse: Joshua's soldiers told him, “The five kings have been found in a cave near Makkedah.”
translation_verse: Dɛ Josua noɔ kɛŋɔ ba ŋɔ koranar banue la chwao ka sɔh bwebɔɔ bini Makeda,

english_verse: Joshua answered, “Roll some big stones over the mouth of the cave and leave a few soldiers to guard it.
translation_verse: asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé ɡbili bwejena ba tɔ bwebɔɔ la nyoa, dɛ́ le n nɛra la bane bá che dɛɛ daah bela.

english_verse: But you and everyone else must keep going after the enemy troops, because they will be safe if they reach their walled towns. Don't let them get away! The Lord our God is helping us get rid of them.”
translation_verse: Hé ɡbabir bɛ bela che. Hé ti he dɔma la, he bɛ ban ɡel. Hé teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ɛ yoo ba, he bɛ ɡel ba dɔ bɔr ba jo ba bwɛjena ta. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la laa nɔn kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ ba do he nɔn ta.”

english_verse: So Joshua and the Israelites almost wiped out the enemy soldiers. Only a few safely reached their walled towns.
translation_verse: Josua ne Israel tena la kpoo nɛra la ɡalɡa bwa. Tamaa kenii baa ka dɛ won tel ba bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara ta.

english_verse: The Israelite army returned to their camp at Makkedah, where Joshua was waiting for them. No one around there dared say anything bad about the Israelites.
translation_verse: Laa tena la bwa berɔ ba Josua be Makeda bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la sɔnɔnɔɔ ken. Nomɛlbwa ta liire kɛ wɛɛ bol Israel tena wechɔɡe bɛlbwaa harɛ la ta kpa.

english_verse: Joshua told his soldiers, “Now, move the rocks from the entrance to the cave and bring those five kings to me.”
translation_verse: Ate Josua ŋɔ, “Hé ka ɡbili bwea la le bwebɔɔ la nyoa, dɛ́ lawɛ koranar banue la ba tɛ mɛ.”

english_verse: The soldiers opened the entrance to the cave and brought out the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
translation_verse: Ate, ba ka ɡbili bwea la le bɔɔ la nyoa, dɛ lawɛ a ɡɛ koranar baa le Jerusalam ne Hɛbrɔn ne Jaamut ne Lakes, dɛ Ɛɡlɔn le bwebɔɔ la bini.

english_verse: After Joshua had called the army together, he forced the five kings to lie down on the ground. Then he called his officers forward and told them, “You fought these kings along with me, so put your feet on their necks.” The officers did this,
translation_verse: Baa laɡ ba le ba tɛ Josua la, o yerɛ Israel tena la ne laa nomonome la bwa cheme, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ he nakpale ɛɡre a ɡɛ koranar nɔ baŋare ta.” Ate, koranar la le dɛ ba chɔ harɛ, ba kpɔ ba nakpale ɛɡre ba baŋare ta.

english_verse: and Joshua continued, “Don't ever be afraid or discouraged. Be brave and strong. This is what the Lord will do to all your enemies.”
translation_verse: Josua berɛ ŋɔ laa nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ berɛ ɔma, he bɛ ɡel he bambile ɡe chɔɡ. Hé che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ dɔ bambile. Kenii Korowii ɛɛ ba he dɔma bwa he ne baa dɛ ba yoi ɛɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua killed the five kings and told his men to hang each body on a tree. Then at sunset
translation_verse: Ate, Josua kpoo koranar la, dɛ kpɔ ba saɡre daa anue ta, ba saɡre ɡɛ naa, dɛ ka tel jɔmɔra.

english_verse: he told some of his troops, “Take the bodies down and throw them into the cave where the kings were found. Cover the entrance to the cave with big rocks.” Joshua's troops obeyed his orders, and those rocks are still there. Joshua Continues the Fighting
translation_verse: Wee aa dɛ ba joe la, o ɡelɔ ba ka laa ba kpɔ le daa baa saɡre a ta la ta, dɛ paa ba ka ta bwebɔɔ ba fa aa chwaa ka sɔh o bini la bini. Bwea baa ɡbila tɔ bwebɔɔ la nyoa kan kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ta tɔ o nyoa ba le fini.

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Makkedah and attacked the town of Libnah.
translation_verse: Ate, Josua ne o laa tena kpɔ le Makeda, dɛ ka pu bwɛjen Lebna dɛ ka yo nɛra baa lɔ o ɡe ta.

english_verse: The Lord let them capture the town and its king, and they killed the king and everyone else, just as they had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Korowii cheɡɛ Josua ne o laa tena mun ta, dɛ kpɔ bwɛjen la ne o kooro do ba nɔn ta. Ba kpoo nɛra baa lɔ o ta bwa, nomɛlbwa ta kae. Gɛ baa ɛ bwɛjen Jeriko kooro laanee ba ɛ kooro la ɡe.

english_verse: Joshua then led his army to Lachish, and they set up camp around the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Josua ne o laa tena berɔ kpɔ le Lebna ɡe, dɛ kpɔ ka pu bwɛjen Lakes tena, dɛ ka bar ba dɛ yoo ba.

english_verse: and the next day the Lord let them capture the town. They killed everyone, as they had done at Libnah.
translation_verse: Tɔpera anɛ habɔɔ la, Korowii laa nɔn kpɔ bwɛjen Lakes tena ne o nɛra bwa nɛ, asɛ Josua ne o laa tena kpoo ba bwa sekwaraa ɡɛ waa ɛ Lebna la.

english_verse: From Lachish, Joshua took his troops to Eglon, where they set up camp surrounding the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Josua ne o laa tena berɔ kpɔ le Lakes ka pu bwɛjen Ɛɡlɔn tena dɛ ka bar ba ɡe dɛ yoo ba.

english_verse: captured it that same day, then killed everyone, as they had done at Lachish.
translation_verse: Ba wono ka pɔ bwɛjen Ɛɡlɔn ne o nɛra bwa nɛɛ awola tenten dɛ kpoo ba bwa, dɛ ɛ bela kɛŋɔ baa ɛ Lakes la ken.

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Eglon and attacked Hebron.
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ kpɔ le bwɛjen Ɛɡlɔn ka pu bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn ne o nɛra dɛ ka yo ba ɡe.

english_verse: They captured the town and the nearby villages, then killed everyone, including the king. They destroyed Hebron in the same way they had destroyed Eglon.
translation_verse: Ba pɔ ba ɡe nɛɛ dɛ kpoo ba ne ba kooro bwa, dɛ ka yo ba bwɛjeɡre nɛra dɛ kpoo ba bwa, nomɛlbwa ta kae, dɛ ɛ bela kɛŋɔ baa ɛ bwɛjen Ɛɡlɔn la ken.

english_verse: Joshua and the Israelite army turned and attacked Debir.
translation_verse: Josua ne o laa tena la berɔ laa berɛ dɛ ba yo bwɛjen Debir tena ɡe.

english_verse: They captured the town, and its nearby villages. Then they destroyed Debir and killed its king, together with everyone else, just as they had done with Hebron and Libnah.
translation_verse: Ba pɔ bwɛjen Debir kooro ne o nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛ ka yo bela bwɛjeɡre bwa dɛ kpoo a nɛra bwa kwaraa, nomɛlbwa ta kae. Gɛ baa ɛ bwɛjen Debir ne o kooro la, ɡɛ tentenee ba ɛ Hɛbrɔn ne Lebna koranar ɡe.

english_verse: Joshua captured towns everywhere in the land: In the central hill country and the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert and the region that slopes down toward the Dead Sea. Whenever he captured a town, he would kill the king and everyone else, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
translation_verse: Josua pɔ harɛre la bwa nɛ, bwɛɛre aa lɔ deŋɡarere ta ne Nɛɡɛv, ne anɔ la aa lɔ wee cholibɔr, ne anɔ la aa lɔ mpo nyoa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ne anɔ la aa chɔ bwea lɔɡre ne a koranar bwa. Nomɛlbwa ta o nyu dɔe. Ba kpo hweera kon te bɛlbwa. Gɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa doo laanee o ɛ.

english_verse: Joshua wiped out towns from Kadesh-Barnea to Gaza, everywhere in the region of Goshen, and as far north as Gibeon.
translation_verse: Josua pɔ harɛre ane baa dɛ yera Kades Baanea dɛ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Gasa ne Gosen harɛ ta, dɛ ka tel bwɛjen Gebeɔn ne o harɛre aa baro cheme ta.

english_verse: The Lord fought on Israel's side, so Joshua and the Israelite army were able to capture these kings and take their land. They fought one battle after another, then they went back to their camp at Gilgal after capturing all that land.
translation_verse: Anɔ habɔɔ la, Josua ne o laa tena bwa kaa Gelɡal bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dɛ ka so.

english_verse: King Jabin of Hazor heard about Joshua's victories, so he sent messages to many nearby kings and asked them to join him in fighting Israel. He sent these messages to King Jobab of Madon, the kings of Shimron and Achshaph,
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Jabin dɛ di kora Hasɔ. O baa no kɛŋɔ Josua ne o nɛra Israel tena pɔ harɛre nɛɛ warɛ, asɛ o ɡel koranar bane kɛŋɔ Jobab waa ɛ Madɔn kooro ne Simron dɛ Aksaf ɡe no a wa.

english_verse: the kings in the northern hill country and in the Jordan River valley south of Lake Galilee, and the kings in the foothills and in Naphath-Dor to the west.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ koranar baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr deŋɡarere ta dɛ do Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta, ne Galilia Moo weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ne banɔ la baa lɔ deŋɡarere lɔɡre, ne banɔ la baa lɔ mpo nyoa weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ bɛne bwɛjen Dɔr, nɛra ɡe no dɛ ba chao.

english_verse: He sent messages to the Canaanite kings in the east and the west, to the Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, and Jebusite kings in the hill country, and to the Hivite kings in the region of Mizpah, near the foot of Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Kooro Jabin berɔ ɡel Keenan tena baa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋne anɛ la bwa no. Amɔre ne Hiti ne Pɛrɛs dɛ Jebus tena baa soɡe bela deŋɡarere ta, ne Hivi tena baa soɡe Hɛmɔn Bwejen lɔɡa dɛ do Mispa harɛ ta.

english_verse: The kings and their armies went to Merom Pond, where they set up camp, and got ready to fight Israel. It seemed as though there were more soldiers and horses and chariots than there are grains of sand on a beach.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ koranar nɔ bwa kpɔ ba laa tena pɛ, dɛ baŋre ba tɛnte deene nee Mɛrɔm nyoa, dɛ́ yo Israel tena.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't let them frighten you! I'll help you defeat them, and by this time tomorrow they will be dead. When you attack, the first thing you have to do is to cripple their horses. Then after the battle is over, burn their chariots.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ berɛ ɔma, kere saŋ nɔ bɔr, mɛɛ kpɔ baa do he Israel tena nɔn taa hé kpoo ba. Hé ɛ dɛ́ chaa ba jaɡre la nadɛɛne, dɛ́ fuh kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army made a surprise attack against the enemy camp at Merom Pond
translation_verse: Ba ne jara dɛ Josua ne o laa tena bwa deno ba lɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ Mɛrɔm nee la nyoa bela,

english_verse: Up to this time, the king of Hazor had controlled the kingdoms that had joined together to attack Israel, so Joshua led his army back and captured Hazor. They killed its king
translation_verse: Dɛ bwɛjen Hasɔɔ ɛ harɛre aa lɔ bela bwa bwɛjen. Josua berɔ ba o ta ɡɛ saŋ dɛ ba yo ba ɡe, dɛ kpo bela kooro kere ne.

english_verse: and everyone else, then they set the town on fire.
translation_verse: Ba kpo nomɛlbwa waa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta, bɛlbwa ta kae, dɛ fuh bwɛɛ la ɡe bwa.

english_verse: Joshua and his army took control of the northern and southern hill country, the foothills to the west, the Southern Desert, the whole region of Goshen, and the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Josua ne o laa tena yoo dɛ kpɔ harɛ la bwa, deŋɡarere ne bwea lɔɡre bwɛɛre, anɔ la aa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua ne weekaŋle harɛbɔr harɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ bwa ta. Le Gosen harɛ dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta bwa.

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he wanted the towns in this region destroyed and their people killed without mercy. That's why the Lord made the people in the towns stubborn and determined to fight Israel. The only town that signed a peace treaty with Israel was the Hivite town of Gibeon. The Israelite army captured the rest of the towns in battle.
translation_verse: Korowiirii saahna dɛ ɡel ba bambile do kpeɡri ba ka pu Israel tena yo, ásɛ Israel tena bɛ ba sum na, dɛ́ kpoo ba dɛ́ he ba. Gɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ Mosis be la.

english_verse: During this same time, Joshua and his army killed the Anakim from the northern and southern hill country. They also destroyed the towns where the Anakim had lived, including Hebron, Debir, and Anab.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la ta la, Josua kaa kpoo Anak tena baa soɡe deŋɡarere ta, dɛ kpoŋe le bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Hɛbrɔn ne Debir dɛ Anab, dɛ deŋɡarere bwɛɛre aa lɔ Juda ne Israel harɛ ta. Gɛ nɛra nɔ kpeɡo taeh.

english_verse: There were not any Anakim left in the regions where the Israelites lived, although there were still some in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Anak tena nɔ bɛlbwa ta Israel harɛ ta kae. Nemenɛ bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Gasa ne Gat dɛ Asdɔdee tamaa bane ka.

english_verse: That's how Joshua captured the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and Joshua divided it up among the tribes. Finally, there was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Josua yoo lɛ ɡɛ harɛ la bwa, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ o bonɔɔ Mosis be la. O bɔna tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la, asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o bɔr. A habɔɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ba harɛ la ta, bɛlbwa ta yoi kpa.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he and the people of Israel had defeated two kings east of the Jordan River. These kings had ruled the region from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, including the eastern side of the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Koranar Israel tena aa yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ lɛ ba harɛre laanee nɔ. Harɛre la le Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr, dɛ le Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen dɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Hɛmɔn Bwejen weekaŋle nyundua. Koranar banɛɛ ba yo dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: The first king that Moses and the Israelites defeated was an Amorite, King Sihon of Heshbon. The southern border of his kingdom ran down the middle of the Arnon River gorge, taking in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the gorge. The Jabbok River separated Sihon's kingdom from the Ammonites on the east. Then the Jabbok turned west and became his northern border, so his kingdom included the southern half of the region of Gilead.
translation_verse: Kooro la bɛl sɔne Sihon, Amɔre tena kooroo wɛɛ di kora bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn. O harɛ nyoa le bwɛjen Arowa, o lɔ Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen nyoa, dɛ le fɛlembɔjen la baah ta dɛ kaa Jabɔk Moo waa ɛ Amɔn tena harɛ jwɛh ta. Gelead harɛ pera ɡe ja o ta.

english_verse: Sihon also controlled the eastern side of the Jordan River valley from Lake Galilee south to Beth-Jeshimoth and the Dead Sea. In addition to these regions, he ruled the town called Slopes of Mount Pisgah and the land south of there at the foot of the hill.
translation_verse: O harɛ la teŋɔ ba le Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen la ta, dɛ le Galilia Moo weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ kaa Bɛt Jɛsemɔt harɛ ta, o lɔ Yar Mpo wee leebɔr. Dɛ kpoŋe kaa Pesɡa Bwejen lɔɡa.

english_verse: Next, Moses and the Israelites defeated King Og of Bashan, who lived in the town of Ashtaroth part of each year and in Edrei the rest of the year. Og was one of the last of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: Basan Kooro Ɔɡ harɛ ja a ta. O ɛ Refa tena kooro waa ka mun dɛ di kora bwɛjena Astarɔt ne Edrei ta.

english_verse: His kingdom stretched north to Mount Hermon, east to the town of Salecah, and included the land of Bashan as far west as the borders of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah. He also ruled the northern half of Gilead.
translation_verse: O harɛ la pera berɔ le Hɛmɔn Bwejen ta, dɛ kaa bobɛla baa dɛ yera Saleka ne Basan bwa, dɛ kpoŋe ka le Gesur ne Maaka harɛre jwɛh ta. Dɛ́ berɛ kpoŋe le Gelead harɛ pera dɛ́ kaa Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon harɛ jwɛh ta.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, had led the people of Israel in defeating Sihon and Og. Then Moses gave their land to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.
translation_verse: Mosis ne Israel tena la kpoo ba, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ɡɛ harɛ la tɛ Israel deene atoro ŋɔ bá kpɔ. Banee Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera bane.

english_verse: Many years later, the Lord told Joshua: Now you are very old, but there is still a lot of land that Israel has not yet taken.
translation_verse: Josua baa hwɛɛh kɛrɛdɛ. Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Taraken he hwɛɛhrɔ kohona, kɛ a ta ka harɛre warɛ kɛŋɔ Israel tena yo dɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Moses had already given land east of the Jordan River to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis tɔ sie kpɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr harɛ tɛ Rubin ne Gad dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena la bane, ásɛ o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.

english_verse: This region stretched north from the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, and included the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley. It covered the flatlands of Medeba north of Dibon,
translation_verse: Harɛ la chɔɔ ka le Arowa, o lɔ Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen la nyoa ne bwɛjen bɛl waa lɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini dɛ kpɔ harɛpɛɛ bɛl waa chɔa le Medeba dɛ kaa Debɔn.

english_verse: and took in the towns that had belonged to Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon. Some of these towns were as far east as the Ammonite border.
translation_verse: Harɛ la le Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon waa di kora Hɛsbɔn la bwɛjena bwa ta, dɛ ka le Amɔn tena harɛ jwɛh ta,

english_verse: However, the Israelites did not force the people of Geshur and Maacah to leave, and they still live there among the Israelites. Why Moses Did Not Give Land to the Levi Tribe
translation_verse: Israel tena ta Gesur tena ne Maaka tena te doŋe, bane ba ta pɛo so dɛ ba le fini.

english_verse: Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord God of Israel had told them, “Instead of land, you will receive the sacrifices offered at my altar.” The Land Moses Gave to the Reuben Tribe
translation_verse: Mosis ta Lewi dea tena la te harɛ tɛɛ, kwaa nɛra aa kpɔ ba fuh ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ bá dɔ. Gɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ Mosis be la.

english_verse: Moses gave land to each of the clans in the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Mosis kpɔ harɛ la pera tɛ Rubin dea tena kɛŋɔ ó ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.

english_verse: Their land started in the south at the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, took in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley, and went as far north as the flatlands around Medeba.
translation_verse: Ba harɛ nyoa le Arowa, o lɔ Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen la nyoa dɛ kaa bwɛjen waa lɔ fɛlembɔjen la baah ta, dɛ kpɔ harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa dɛ ka ɡarɛ bwɛjen Medeba,

english_verse: The Amorite King Sihon had lived in Heshbon and had ruled the towns in the flatlands. Now Heshbon belonged to Reuben, and so did the following towns in the flatlands: Dibon, Bamoth-Baal, Beth-Baal-Meon, Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath, Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-Shahar on the hill in the valley, Beth-Peor, Slopes of Mount Pisgah, and Beth-Jeshimoth. Moses defeated Sihon and killed him and the Midianite chiefs who ruled parts of his kingdom for him. Their names were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: ne bwɛjena aa lɔ harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta bwa, ne Amɔre Kooro Sihon o fa aa di kora bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn ka la harɛre bwa. Mosis yo Kooro Sihon ne Midian koranar bane baa dɛ yer ba Evi ne Rekem ne Sor ne Hur dɛ Reba dɛ pɔ ba nɛ. Dɛ Midian koranar la bwa ɛ koojeɡre dɛ do Kooro Sihon lɔɡa ba ne o nyoa pɛ harɛ la ta.

english_verse: The Israelites also killed Balaam the son of Beor, who had been a fortuneteller.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa jaa Israel tena la kpoo ba laa ta la, ba bini bɛlee Balam, o mɛɛ sɔne Beɔ. Dɛ a ɡɛ Balam nɔ ɛ voɡre.

english_verse: This region with its towns and villages was the land for the Reuben tribe, and the Jordan River was its western border. The Land Moses Gave to the Gad Tribe
translation_verse: Jɔɔdan Moo wee cholibɔree ɛ Rubin dea tena harɛ jwɛh ta. Bwɛjena ne bwɛjeɡre aa lɔ bela laanee Mosis kpɔ tɛ Rubin dea tena o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.

english_verse: Moses also gave land to each of the clans in the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Harɛ la pera Mosis aa kpɔa tɛ Gad dea tena ɡe ŋɔ ó ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon laanee nɔ,

english_verse: The land given to Gad stretched from Heshbon in the south to Ramath-Mizpeh and Betonim in the north, and even further north to Mahanaim and Lidebor.
translation_verse: dɛ́ le bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn dɛ́ kaa bwɛjena Ramat Mispa ne Bɛtɔnem, dɛ́ berɛ le bwɛjen Mahanaim dɛ́ kaa Debir harɛ ta.

english_verse: Gad also received the eastern half of the Jordan River valley, which had been ruled by King Sihon of Heshbon. This territory stretched as far north as Lake Galilee, and included the towns of Beth-Haram, Beth-Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon.
translation_verse: Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta ɡe, bwɛjena Bɛt Haram ne Bɛt Nimra ne Sukot dɛ Safɔn, dɛ Kooro Sihon waa di kora bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn la harɛ bwa. Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr, harɛ la teŋɔ kaa Galilia Moo nyoa.

english_verse: These regions with their towns and villages were given to the Gad tribe. The Land Moses Gave to Half the Manasseh Tribe
translation_verse: Bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre nɔ ɛ Gad dea tena kapɛrɛ kwa.

english_verse: Moses gave land east of the Jordan River to half of the clans from the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Dɛ Mosis kpɔ harɛ la pera tɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena la ɡe o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.

english_verse: That was how Moses divided up the Moab Plains to the east of Jericho on the other side of the Jordan River, so these two and a half tribes would have land of their own.
translation_verse: Harɛ Mosis aa bɔna tɛ Israel tena o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon, ɡɛ saŋ waa lɔ bwɛjen Jeriko wee leebɔr ne Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta, ɡɛ saŋ waa tel Moab harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa ta laanee la.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord had promised that he would always provide for them.
translation_verse: Kɛ Lewi dea tena la te, Mosis ta ban harɛ tɛɛ o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon. O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ kwaa nɛra aa kpɔ ba ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la peraa dɛɛ ba ba kwaa ɛɛ.

english_verse: One day while the Israelites were still camped at Gilgal, Caleb the son of Jephunneh went to talk with Joshua. Caleb belonged to the Kenaz clan, and many other people from the Judah tribe went with Caleb. He told Joshua: You know that back in Kadesh-Barnea the Lord talked to his prophet Moses about you and me.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, Juda dea tena bane ne Kaleb, baa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ Jefune o ɛ Kenis te iro, dɛ la Josua be Gelɡal, asɛ Kaleb ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Lii ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ Kades Baanea asɛ Korowii bol n ne he waa baɡle Mosis waa ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ waa ya be la.

english_verse: The other spies said things that made our people afraid, but I completely trusted the Lord God.
translation_verse: Nɛra n ne baa laŋa la ɡelɔ ya nɛra la bwara yɔr baa ɔmɛ, kɛ n te, dɛ n dɛ yarada Korowii kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The same day I came back, Moses told me, “Since you were faithful to the Lord God, I promise that the places where you went as a spy will belong to you and your descendants forever.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, awola tɔpere la, Mosis ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡ mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Harɛ haa laŋa ka valɛ o ta la ɛɛ ɛ he ne he bii kapɛrɛ konee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛkalkɛ he yarada Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la bambile bwa ne.’

english_verse: I'm just as strong today as I was then, and I can still fight as well in battle.
translation_verse: n ta kpeɡri fini kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ Mosis aa tom mɛ la. N ta kpeɡri dɛ́ won la laa kɛŋɔ wubwa la ken.

english_verse: So I'm asking you for the hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You were there. You heard the other spies talk about that part of the hill country and the large, walled towns where the Anakim live. But maybe the Lord will help me take their land, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dɛ soŋe kɛ hé kpɔ deŋɡarere harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa baɡ mɛ nyoa awola tɔpere la tɛ mɛ fini. He ɡbabir noɔ kɛŋɔ Anak tena baa kpeɡa kohona lɔ harɛ la ta, asɛ ba bwɛjena do kan ba ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara. Kɛ dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ n mun ta naa, mɛɛ won doŋ ba le, ɡɛ waa bola la.”

english_verse: Joshua prayed that God would help Caleb, then he gave Hebron to Caleb and his descendants.
translation_verse: Ate, Josua swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Jefune bibaa Kaleb, dɛ kpɔ bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn tɛo ŋɔ ó ɛ o kapɛrɛ kon.

english_verse: And Hebron still belongs to Caleb's descendants, because he was faithful to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Kaleb yarada Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ o bambile bwa ne kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, Korowii kpɔ bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn tɛo. O naanar ta soɡe bela ba le fini.

english_verse: Hebron used to be called Arba's Town, because Arba had been one of the greatest of the Anakim. There was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Ba fa dɛ yerɛ Hɛbrɔn, bwɛjen Aaba. Dɛ Aaba ɛ nɛnjen tenten Anak tena la bini. Ate, deŋnesɔɔhna berɛ ba harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Judah's southern border started at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Harɛ la jwɛh le Yar Mpo nyoa weekaŋle harɛbɔr,

english_verse: As it went west from there, it ran south of Scorpion Pass to Zin, and then came up from the south to Kadesh-Barnea. It continued past Hezron up to Addar, turned toward Karka,
translation_verse: dɛ chɔ kaa ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ Akrabim Bwejen baah ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Sin pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ kaa Kades Baanea weekaŋle harɛbɔr. O kaa ɡarɛ Hɛsrɔn dɛ kaa Adaar a bwa aa ɛ bwɛjena, dɛ berɛ ɡoŋe kaa bwɛjen Kaaka ta.

english_verse: and ran along to Azmon. After that, it followed the Egyptian Gorge and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was also Israel's southern border.
translation_verse: Harɛ la berɔ chɔ ka le bwɛjen Asmɔn dɛ ka chiɡ nenabɔjeɡa bɛl waa lɔ Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta, dɛ ka jaɡɛ Mɛdetereenea Mpo la nyoa. Belaa ɛ Juda dea tena harɛ jwɛh, weekaŋle harɛbɔr.

english_verse: Judah's eastern border ran the full length of the Dead Sea. The northern border started at the northern end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Harɛ la wee leebɔr jwɛh le Yar Mpo la ta dɛ kpoŋe kaa Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa. O weekaŋle nyundua jwɛh ɡe le Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa,

english_verse: From there it went west up to Beth-Hoglah, continued north of Beth-Arabah, and went up to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: dɛ chɔ kaa Bɛt Hoɡla, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Bɛt Araba weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ ka le Bohan ŋwam ta. Dɛ Rubin biee a ɡɛ Bohan nɔ.

english_verse: From there, it went to Trouble Valley and Debir, then turned north and went to Gilgal, which is on the north side of the valley across from Adummim Pass. It continued on to Enshemesh, Enrogel,
translation_verse: Harɛ la jwɛh le bela kaa Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Debir, dɛ berɛ ɡole kpɔ weekaŋle nyundua dɛ kaa Gelɡal, o sie aa chaɡɛ bobɛl ŋwɛnɛ aa chɔa dɛ kaa Adumim Bwejen weekaŋle harɛbɔr fɛlembɔjen la baŋ. Dɛ kpoŋe le Ɛn Sɛmɛs nee nyoa dɛ ka tel Ɛn Roɡel nyoa.

english_verse: and up through Hinnom Valley on the land sloping south from Jerusalem. The city of Jerusalem itself belonged to the Jebusites. Next, the border went up to the top of the mountain on the west side of Hinnom Valley and at the north end of Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: O berɔ chɔ kaa Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ kaa Jebus tena bwɛjen Jerusalam weekaŋle harɛbɔr. Jwɛh la le bela dɛ kpɔ deŋɡare bɛl waa lɔ Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen doa wee cholibɔr, dɛ berɛ kaa Refaim Fɛlembɔjen ta weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.

english_verse: At the top of the mountain it turned and went to Nephtoah Spring and then to the ruins on Mount Ephron. From there, it went to Baalah, which is now called Kiriath-Jearim.
translation_verse: Jwɛh la berɔ le deŋɡare la ta dɛ chɔ kaa Neftoa bule ta, dɛ kpɔ bwɛɛre ane aa chɔa bɛne Efron Bwejen la, dɛ ɡole kaa bwɛjen Baala.

english_verse: From Baalah the northern border curved west to Mount Seir and then ran along the northern ridge of Mount Jearim, where Chesalon is located. Then it went down to Beth-Shemesh and over to Timnah.
translation_verse: O berɔ ɡole kpɔ Baala wee cholibɔr dɛ kaa Sɛɛ Bwejen waa lɔ Edom harɛ ta, dɛ kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera Jearim Bwejen ta, dɛ kaa bwɛjen Bɛt Sɛmɛs dɛ ka ɡarɛ bwɛjen Temna.

english_verse: It continued along to the hillside north of Ekron, curved around to Shikkeron, and then went to Mount Baalah. After going to Jabneel, the border finally ended at the Mediterranean Sea,
translation_verse: Jwɛh la nyoa berɔ ka fɛrɛ Ekron deŋɡare weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ berɛ chaɡɛ kaa Sekerɔn Bwejen dɛ ka ɡarɛ Baala Bwejen, dɛ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Jabneel. O nyoa kaa jaɡɛ Mɛdetereenea Mpo la nyoa.

english_verse: Next, Caleb started a war with the town of Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.
translation_verse: O le bela dɛ ka yo bwɛjen Kiriat Sɛfa tena.

english_verse: Joshua gave Caleb some land among the people of Judah, as God had told him to do. Caleb's share was Hebron, which at that time was known as Arba's Town, because Arba was the famous ancestor of the Anakim.
translation_verse: Jefune bibaa Kaleb waa le Juda dea tena bini la dɔ harɛ la pera, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Josua la. Bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn waa ɛ Aaba kon laanee ba kpɔ tɛ Kaleb. Anak tena nabaalee a ɡɛ Aaba nɔ.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah, Zanoah, En-Gannim, Tappuah, Enam, Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah, Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim.
translation_verse: Kaleb doŋi Anak naanar baa soɡe bela la bwa le bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn la ta. Dɛ nɛmbele batoro baa ɛ Anak tenaa lɔ bela. Banee Sɛsae ne Ahiman dɛ Talmai tena.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdalgad, Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel, Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon, Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish, Gederoth, Beth-Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Asɛ Kaleb ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa won yo Kiriat Sɛfa dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ la, mɛɛ lawɛ n bihaah Aksaa tɛo ó mo.”

english_verse: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What's bothering you?”
translation_verse: Baa ɛ ba hanfalwaa tonɛ la, Otniel ŋɔ Aksa be ŋɔ ó ka ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ó tɛo harɛ. Waa la o mɛɛ Kaleb be dɛ tu o keeɡo ta la, o mɛɛ den bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ń ɛ tɛɛ nɔ?”

english_verse: She answered, “I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so I really need some spring-fed ponds for a water supply.” Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds, named Higher Pond and Lower Pond. Towns in Judah's Land
translation_verse: Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi n nɛ. He tɛ mɛ harɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ Nɛɡɛv. Tɛ mɛ bela nee aa bula dɛɛ le ɡe.” Asɛ o ka tɛo harɛ nee aa bula dɛɛ le o ta. Bɛl do nyunduabɔr, bɛl do harɛbɔr pera.

english_verse: The following is a list of the towns in each region given to the Judah clans:
translation_verse: Harɛ Juda dea bii ne ba lolanar aa dɔa ó ɛ ba kon laanee nɔ.

english_verse: The first region was located in the Southern Desert along the border with Edom, and it had the following
translation_verse: ne Lebaot ne Silhim ne Ain dɛ Remɔn. A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.

english_verse: The second region was located in the northern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: ne Saaraim ne Aditaim ne Gɛdɛra dɛ Gɛdɛrɔtaim. A ɡe lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre bwa.

english_verse: The third region was located in the southern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: ne Gɛdɛrɔt ne Bɛt Daɡɔn ne Naama dɛ Makeda. A lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anumɛl, a ne a bwɛjeɡre bwa.

english_verse: The twelfth region was located in the desert along the Dead Sea, and it had the following six towns with their surrounding villages: Beth-Arabah, Middin, Secacah, Nibshan, Salt Town, and En-Gedi. The Jebusites
translation_verse: ne Nibsan, ba dɛ yerɔ Yar Bwɛjen dɛ Ɛn Gedi. A bwa lɔ bwɛjena anumɛl, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.

english_verse: The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem, and the people of the Judah tribe could not capture the city and get rid of them. That's why Jebusites still live in Jerusalem along with the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Juda dea tena la ta wone doŋi Jebus tena baa soɡe Jerusalam la, ba ne ba bwa ta soɡe bela ba le fini.

english_verse: The following is a description of the land that was divided among the clans of the Ephraim tribe. Their southern border started at Ataroth-Addar and went west to Upper Beth-Horon
translation_verse: Harɛ Efrem dea tena aa dɔa lolanar ta laanee nɔ. Ba harɛ baa dɔa o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon la jwɛh le bwɛjen Atarɔt Adaa wee leebɔr dɛ kaa Bɛt Hɔrɔn harɛ nyunduabɔr,

english_verse: Ephraim also had some towns and villages that were inside Manasseh's tribal land.
translation_verse: Bwɛjena ne bwɛjeɡre ane aa lɔ Manasɛ dea tena harɛ jwɛh ta ɡe jao, kɛ ba kpɔɔ ja Efrem dea tena.

english_verse: Ephraim could not force the Canaanites out of Gezer, so there are still some Canaanites who live there among the Israelites. But now these Canaanites have to work as slaves for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Efrem dea tena la ta Keenan tena baa soɡe Gɛsa la doŋe le bela. Anomanta, ba ne ba bwa pɛo so dɛ ba le fini. Kɛ Efrem dea tena la ɡelɔ baa ɛ toma kɛŋɔ ba yoma ken.

english_verse: The land of the Manasseh tribe went from its northern border with the Asher tribe south to Michmethath, which is to the east of Shechem. The southern border started there, but curved even farther south to include the people who lived around Tappuah Spring.
translation_verse: Manasɛ dea tena harɛ le Aasa dea tena harɛ ta dɛ kaa bwɛjen Mekmɛtat, Sɛkem wee leebɔr. Harɛ la jwɛh chɔɔ kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ che bela kaa bela nɛra bane aa soɡa baa yerɛ bela Ɛn Tapua.

english_verse: The town of Tappuah was on Manasseh's border with Ephraim. Although the land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, the town itself belonged to Ephraim.
translation_verse: Manasɛ dea tenaa dɔ Tapua harɛ la, kɛ Tapua bwɛdaa waa lɔ ba harɛ jwɛh ta la te ɛ Efrem dea tena kon.

english_verse: Then the border went west to the Kanah Gorge and ran along the northern edge of the gorge to the Mediterranean Sea. The land south of the gorge belonged to Ephraim. And even though there were a few towns that belonged to Ephraim north of the gorge, the land north of the gorge belonged to Manasseh. The western border of Manasseh was the Mediterranean Sea, and the tribe shared a border with the Asher tribe on the northwest and with the Issachar tribe on the northeast.
translation_verse: Efrem dea tena harɛ lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ Manasɛ dea tena kon do weekaŋle nyunduabɔr. Manasɛ dea tena harɛ kaa chiɡ Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta, ba ne Aasa dea tena harɛ jwɛh ta do weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, asɛ ba ne Isaaka dea tena jwɛh ɡe do wee leebɔr.

english_verse: Manasseh was supposed to have the following towns with their surrounding villages inside the borders of Issachar's and Asher's tribal lands: Beth-Shan, Ibleam, Endor, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, which is also called Naphath.
translation_verse: Isaaka dea tena harɛ ne Aasa dea tena harɛ ta la, Manasɛ dea tena dɔ bwɛjena. Anee Bɛt San ne Ibleam ne Dɔr ne Ɛndɔr ne Taanak ne Meɡido dɛ a bwɛɛre aa bara.

english_verse: But the people of Manasseh could not capture these towns, so the Canaanites kept on living in them.
translation_verse: Manasɛ dea tena la ta wone doŋi nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjena la ta, anomanta, Keenan tena la kwaarɔ so bela.

english_verse: When the Israelites grew stronger, they made the Canaanites in these towns work as their slaves, though they never did force them to leave. Joseph's Descendants Ask for More Land
translation_verse: A habɔɔ Israel tena aa baa do kpeɡri la, ba ta Keenan tena la bwa doŋe. Ba ɡelɔ ba so dɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: One day the Joseph tribes came to Joshua and asked, “Why didn't you give us more land? The Lord has always been kind to us, and we have too many people for this small region.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Josef naanar ir la Josua be dɛ ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he tɛ yaa harɛ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ɡbo o ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon nɔɔ? Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ yaa, dɛ́ ɡel ya warɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua replied, “If there's not enough room for you in the hill country of Ephraim, then go into the forest that belonged to the Perizzites and the Rephaim. Clear out the trees and make more room for yourselves there.”
translation_verse: Anee Josua chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ he warɔ asɛ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ la aa kanɛ tɛ heya aa, hé kaa Pɛrɛs ne Refa tena kɔne la bini, dɛ́ ka parɛ bela dɛ́ so.”

english_verse: “Even if we do that,” they answered, “there still won't be enough land for us in the hill country. And we can't move down into Jezreel Valley, because the Canaanites who live in Beth-Shan and in other parts of the valley have iron chariots.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Josef dea bii la ŋɔ, “Deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa la aa kanɛ tɛ yaa, kɛ Keenan tena baa soɡe harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa ta la, ba dɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ba vɔwa dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre, ba ne Bɛt San tena ne o bwɛɛre aa baro, dɛ banɔ la baa soɡe Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen la ta bwa.”

english_verse: “Your tribes do have a lot of people,” Joshua admitted. “I'll give you more land. Your tribes are powerful,
translation_verse: Josua ŋɔ Efrem ne Manasɛ deene tena la be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, he warɔ, dɛ do kpeɡri ɡe kohona. Hɛɛ dɔ bɛlee

english_verse: so you can have the rest of the hill country, but it's a forest, and you'll have to cut down the trees and clear the land. You can also have Jezreel Valley. Even though the Canaanites there are strong and have iron chariots, you can force them to leave the valley.”
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ deŋɡarere harɛ waa ɛ kɔr la ɡe ja. Hé teŋni kɔr la daa la, dɛ́ parɔ kaa sie. A lole kɛŋɔ Keenan tena dɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ba vɔwa pɛl jaɡre dɛ do kpeɡri te, kɛ hɛɛ won doŋ ba le.”

english_verse: After Israel had captured the land, they met at Shiloh and set up the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Israel tena aa yo harɛ la tonɛ la, ba bwa kaa cheme bwɛjen Silo ta, belaa sɔfore la ne ba bala baŋre Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr,
