english_verse: Just before the men left camp, Joshua repeated their orders: “Explore the land and write a description of it. Then come back to Shiloh, and I will find out from the Lord how to divide the land.”
translation_verse: Ate, nɛra la chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ kaa harɛ la ta ɡɛ Josua aa do ba la. Mɔɔ baa kaa la, o dalawe waa la ta ja ŋɔ, “Hé ka ɡaaɡe harɛ la ta, dɛ́ chwerɛ ɡɛ o waa aa doa ba tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n bil daa Korowii sie Silo bonɔ tɛ heya.”

english_verse: The men left and went across the land, dividing it into seven regions. They wrote down a description of each region, town by town, and returned to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra la kaa, dɛ ka ɡaaɡe harɛ la bwa ta, dɛ chwerɛ wobɛlbwa ɡɛ báa bɔne bwɛɛ bɛlbwa waa lɔ o ta bele anuanɛ, dɛ berɛ ba Josua be Silo bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la.

english_verse: Joshua found out from the Lord how to divide the land, and he told the tribes what the Lord had decided. Benjamin's Land
translation_verse: Ate, o bil daa Korowii sie Silo bela tɛɛ ba, asɛ dɛ bɔne harɛ la tɛ Israel deene aa kaa la. Bɛnjamen dea tena harɛ baa dɔa

english_verse: Benjamin was the first tribe chosen to receive land. The region for its clans lay between the Judah tribe on the south and the Joseph tribes on the north.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen dea lolanaree tɔ sie dɔ ba harɛ. O chɔ Juda dea tena harɛ ne Josef naanar harɛ baah ta.

english_verse: Benjamin's northern border started at the Jordan River and went up the ridge north of Jericho, then on west into the hill country as far as the Beth-Aven Desert.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen dea harɛ la jwɛh pa mun le Jɔɔdan Moo weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ kaa Jeriko weekaŋle nyunduabɔr deŋɡarere harɛ ta, dɛ ba jaɡɛ Bɛt Avɛn pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth, Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah, Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah, Zelah, Haeleph, Gibeah, Kiriath-Jearim, and Jerusalem, which is also called Jebusite Town. These regions are the tribal lands of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Jwɛh la berɔ kpɔ bobɛl dɛ ba kpɔ bwe la wee cholibɔr, dɛ berɛ kpɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ kaa Kiriat Baal, waa ɛ Juda dea tena harɛ ta. Ba jwɛh waa lɔ wee cholibɔr laanee la.

english_verse: Benjamin's southern border started at the edge of Kiriath-Jearim and went east to the ruins and on to Nephtoah Spring.
translation_verse: O weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh ɡe kpɔ bwɛjen Kiriat Jearim dahare wee cholibɔr, asɛ ba jwɛh ba jaɡɛ Neftoa bule ta.

english_verse: From there it went to the bottom of the hill at the northern end of Rephaim Valley. The other side of this hill faces Hinnom Valley, which is on the land that slopes south from Jerusalem. The border went down through Hinnom Valley until it reached Enrogel.
translation_verse: Harɛ la jwɛh berɔ le bela dɛ kpɔ bwejen bɛl lɔɡa o sie aa chaɡɛ Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta, o lɔ Refaim Fɛlembɔjen weekaŋle nyunduabɔr. Dɛ kpoŋe kaa Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta dɛ kaa Jebus tena bwɛjen Jerusalam harɛbɔr, weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ kaa Ɛn Roɡel nee nyoa.

english_verse: At Enrogel the border curved north and went to Enshemesh and on east to Geliloth, which is across the valley from Adummim Pass. Then it went down to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: O berɔ ɡole kpɔ weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ kaa Ɛn Sɛmɛs nee nyoa, ne Gelilɔt o sie aa chaɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa Adumim, dɛ che bela kaa Rubin bibaa Bohan ŋwam ta.

english_verse: The border ran along the hillside north of Beth-Arabah, then down into the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: O berɔ kpɔ Bɛt Araba weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Moo Fɛlembɔjen bini.

english_verse: Inside the valley it went south as far as the northern hillside of Beth-Hoglah. The last section of the border went from there to the northern end of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ kpɔ Bɛt Hoɡla harɛbɔr weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ ba le Yar Mpo la ta bela Jɔɔdan Moo la aa baa su o ta. Belaa ɛ harɛ la weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh ta.

english_verse: The Jordan River itself was Benjamin's eastern border. These were the borders of Benjamin's tribal land, where the clans of Benjamin lived.
translation_verse: Jɔɔdan Moo laanee ba wee leebɔr harɛ jwɛh ta. Gɛɛ harɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena kapɛrɛ kon baa bɔna lolanar ta la jwɛhre la bwa waa do.

english_verse: One region of Benjamin's tribal land had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Those towns were Jericho, Beth-Hoglah, Emek-Keziz, Beth-Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel, Avvim, Parah, Ophrah, Chephar-Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba.
translation_verse: ne Kefa Amɔne ne Ofni dɛ Geba. A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.

english_verse: Simeon was the second tribe chosen to receive land, and the region for its clans was inside Judah's borders.
translation_verse: Simeon dea tena lolanar harɛ ɡee teŋa nɛɛ ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba. Harɛ baa dɔa la lɔ Juda dea tena harɛ baah ta.

english_verse: In one region of Simeon's tribal land there were the following
translation_verse: ne Bɛt Lebaot dɛ Sarohen. A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ atoro, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.

english_verse: and continued north to Gath-Hepher, Ethkazin, and Rimmonah, where it curved toward Neah
translation_verse: O teŋɔ kpɔ wee leebɔr ɡɛ dɛ kaa bwɛjena Gat Hɛfa ne Ɛt Kasin, dɛ ka le Remɔn dɛ che bela ɡole kaa Nea.

english_verse: In another region, Simeon had the following four towns with their surrounding villages: Enrimmon, Tachan, Ether, and Ashan.
translation_verse: Ane ɡee Ain ne Remɔn ne Ɛta dɛ Asan, a ɡe lɔ bwɛjena anaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre,

english_verse: Simeon's land also included all the other towns and villages as far south as Baalath-Beer, which is also called Ramah of the South.
translation_verse: ne bwɛjeɡre aa bara dɛ kpoŋe ka le Baalat Beɛ, o do weekaŋle harɛbɔr. Simeon dea tena lolanar harɛ baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon laanee la.

english_verse: Simeon's tribal land was actually inside Judah's territory. Judah had received too much land for the number of people in its tribe, so part of Judah's land was given to Simeon. Zebulun's Land
translation_verse: Dɛ Juda dea tena harɛ baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la kan kohona to, asɛ ba pere o pera ja Simeon dea tena kon ta o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon. Sebulon dea tena harɛ baa dɔa

english_verse: and became the northern border. Then it curved south around Hannathon and went as far west as Iphtahel Valley.
translation_verse: Jwɛh la le bela dɛ ɡole kpɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ kaa bwɛjen Hanatɔn, dɛ ka jaɡɛ Ifta Ɛl Fɛlembɔjen ta.

english_verse: Zebulun had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Some of these were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Jiralah, and Bethlehem.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa jaa ɡee Katat ne Nahalal ne Simron ne Idala dɛ Bɛtlɛham. A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath, Debirath, Kishion, Ebez, Remeth, En-Gannim, Enhaddah, Beth-Pazzez, Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth-Shemesh. Asher's Land
translation_verse: Gɛ bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre lɔ Sebulon dea tena lolanar harɛ baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon la ta. Isaaka dea tena harɛ baa dɔa

english_verse: Issachar was the fourth tribe chosen to receive land. The northern border for its clans went from Mount Tabor east to the Jordan River. Their land included the following
translation_verse: Gɛ bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre lɔ Isaaka dea tena lolanar harɛ, baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon la ta. Aasa dea tena harɛ baa dɔa

english_verse: then east to Beth-Dagon. On the southeast, Asher shared a border with Zebulun along the Iphtahel Valley. On the eastern side their border ran north to Beth-Emek, went east of Cabul, and then on to Neiel,
translation_verse: Jwɛh la berɔ kpɔ wee leebɔr, dɛ chɔ kaa bwɛjena Bɛt Daɡɔn, dɛ ka tel Sebulon ne Ifta Ɛl Fɛlembɔjen ta. O berɔ kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ kaa bwɛjena Bɛt Ɛmɛk ne Neyɛl, dɛ teŋɛ kpɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr kaa Kabul,

english_verse: Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, and as far north as the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: ne Ɛbrɔn ne Rehob ne Hamɔn ne Kana, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Sidon.

english_verse: Then it turned west to become the northern border and went to Ramah and the fortress-city of Tyre. Near Tyre it turned toward Hosah and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Gɛ bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre nɔ lɔ Aasa dea tena lolanar harɛ baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon la ta. Naftale dea tena harɛ baa dɔa

english_verse: The Naphtali clans received this region as their tribal land, and it included
translation_verse: Gɛ bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre nɔɔ ba kpɔ tɛ Naftale dea tena lolanar a ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwa. Dan dea tena harɛ baa dɔa

english_verse: These Safe Towns were set up, so that if Israelites or even foreigners who lived in Israel accidentally killed someone, they could run to one of these towns. There they would be safe until a trial could be held, even if one of the victim's relatives came looking for revenge.
translation_verse: Gɛ bwɛjena nɔɔ Korowii che Mosis nɛɛ ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ bá le cheɡ, ásɛ dɛ ba bini bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe ba bini ta saahnɛ kpo nɛn baa nyinu dɛ́ kpo aa, ó chwa ka so a ta. Asɛ naate waa dɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo bɔ kem la bɛ on kpo, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ ɡɛ bwɛjen waa chwaa ka so o ta la tena bwaa chema, dɛ́ nyiŋi naate waa kpo nɛn la waa bini mɔɔ.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Joshua:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ,

english_verse: When Moses was still alive, I commanded him to tell the Israelites about the Safe Towns. Now you tell them that it is time to set up these towns.
translation_verse: “Ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ bá le bwɛjena nɛra aa chwa ka so a ta, dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu cheɡ, ɡɛ maa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ bol he be la,

english_verse: One of the victim's relatives might come to the town, looking for revenge. But the town leaders must not simply hand over the person accused of murder. After all, the accused and the victim had been neighbors, not enemies.
translation_verse: Naate waa dɛ nyin dɛ́ kpoo bɔ kem la tiu la bela aa, bwɛjen la tena bɛ nɛn baa lɛo so la le tɛo, saahna waa wola saahnɛ dɛ kpo o dɔŋ la wa.

english_verse: The citizens of that Safe Town must come together and hold a trial. They may decide that the victim was killed accidentally and that the accused is not guilty of murder. Everyone found not guilty must still live in the Safe Town until the high priest dies. Then they can go back to their own towns and their homes that they had to leave behind.
translation_verse: Bwɛɛ la tena ɡel ó so bela ka tel kɛŋɔ baa cheme, dɛ́ nyiŋi naate waa kpo nɛn dɛ chwa ba ba be la waa bini. Sɔfo nomoa waa soɡe le ɡɛ saŋ la ɡe chɛ kɛ ó sewɛ mɔɔ naate waa kpo nɛn la won dɔ bɔr kaa bwɛɛ waa le o ta ba.”

english_verse: The Israelites decided that the following three towns west of the Jordan River would be Safe Towns: Kedesh in Galilee in Naphtali's hill country, Shechem in Ephraim's hill country, and Kiriath-Arba in Judah's hill country. Kiriath-Arba is now called Hebron.
translation_verse: Asɛ Israel tena la le bwɛjen Kedes waa lɔ Galilia harɛ dɛ do Naftale dea deŋɡarere ta. Dɛ le bwɛjen Sɛkem waa lɔ Efrem dea tena harɛ deŋɡarere ta, dɛ bwɛjen Kiriat Aaba, o do Juda dea tena harɛ deŋɡarere ta.

english_verse: The Israelites had already decided on the following three towns east of the Jordan River: Bezer in the desert flatlands of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead, which was a town that belonged to Gad, and Golan in Bashan, which belonged to Manasseh.
translation_verse: Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr pera, deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa bwɛjen Jeriko wee leebɔr ɡe, ba le bwɛjen Bɛsa waa lɔ Rubin dea harɛ ta ne bwɛjen Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ, o lɔ Gad dea tena harɛ ta, dɛ bwɛjen Golan waa lɔ Basan harɛ, o ɡe aa lɔ Manasɛ dea tena harɛ ta.

english_verse: While the Israelites were still camped at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, the family leaders of the Levi tribe went to speak to the priest Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders of the other Israelite tribes. The leaders of Levi said, “The Lord told Moses that you have to give us towns and provide pastures for our animals.”
translation_verse: dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Korowii cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ hé tɛ yaa bwɛjena ya so, ne bɔra ya kondɛɛra aa dɛɛ di.” Gɛ saŋee Israel tena la bwa baŋre ba tɛnte deene, dɛ ta so Silo waa lɔ Keenan harɛ ta bela la.

english_verse: Since the Lord had said this, the leaders of the other Israelite tribes agreed to give some of the towns and pastures from their tribal lands to Levi.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Israel tena la tɛ Lewi dea tena la bwɛjena ane, ne ba kondɛɛra dibɔra, dɛ le ba harɛre ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la.

english_verse: The leaders asked the Lord to show them in what order the clans of Levi would be given towns, and which towns each clan would receive. The Kohath clans were first. The descendants of Aaron, Israel's first priest, were given
translation_verse: Kohat dea tena lolanar baa le Lewi deaa ba tɔ sie tɛ bwɛɛre. Asɛ Lewi dea tena baa le sɔfo Arɔn luɡe ta ɡe, ba tɛɛ ba bwɛjena fi dɛ atoro dɛ le Juda ne Simeon dɛ Bɛnjamen deene harɛre ta.

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he would show the Israelites which towns and pastures to give to the clans of Levi, and he did. Towns from Judah, Simeon, Benjamin
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do Israel tena la bɔne bwɛjena ne kondɛɛra dibɔra tɛ Lewi dea tena la, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ bol ba be la.

english_verse: The descendants of Aaron from the Kohath clans of Levi were priests, and they were chosen to receive towns first. They were given
translation_verse: Arɔn naanar baa ɛ sɔfore bwɛjena baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la lɔ fi dɛ atoro, ane a kondɛɛra dibɔra.

english_verse: The clans of Levi that were descendants of Gershon received
translation_verse: Gɛsɔn dea lolanar bwɛjena baa dɔa lɔ fi dɛ atoro, a ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra.

english_verse: The Lord gave the Israelites the land he had promised their ancestors, and they captured it and settled in it.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do Korowii kpɔ harɛ waa baɡɛ Israel tena nyoa ŋɔ, wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ba naawa la tɛɛ ba, asɛ ba ka kpɔ o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon dɛ so o ta.

english_verse: There still were enemies around Israel, but the Lord kept his promise to let his people live in peace. And whenever the Israelites did have to go to war, no enemy could defeat them. The Lord always helped Israel win.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ɡɛ waa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa la. Ba dɔma bɛlbwa ta wone che ba sie, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii cha ba ba won dɛɛ pɔ ba dɔma bwa nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord promised to do many good things for Israel, and he kept his promise every time.
translation_verse: Korowii ta nyoa waa baɡɛ Israel tena la bɛlbwa tae, o teŋɛ a bwa ta.

english_verse: Joshua held a meeting with the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh, and he told them:
translation_verse: Josua yerɛ Rubin ne Gad deene, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera nɛra cheme,

english_verse: You have obeyed every command of the Lord your God and of his servant Moses. And you have done everything I've told you to do. It's taken a long time, but you have stayed and helped your relatives.
translation_verse: Le saŋ la bwa dɛ ba le fini, he ta he bala Israel tena chae ɡelɛ. He ta waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la bɛlbwa vɛɛh.

english_verse: The Lord promised to give peace to your relatives, and that's what he has done. Now it's time for you to go back to your own homes in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa ɡela he bala la dɔ bosɔɔhna ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la nomanta, hé berɛ kaa harɛre Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr la ta.

english_verse: Moses taught you to love the Lord your God, to be faithful to him, and to worship and obey him with your whole heart and with all your strength. So be very careful to do everything Moses commanded.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ Mmara Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa do heyaa a ta la soh. O ŋɔ hé nyin N Naa Korowii dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ta, dɛɛ tomɔ he bambile bwa, ne he hweera bwa ne.”

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh reached the western side of the Jordan River valley and built a huge altar there beside the river. When the rest of the Israelites heard what these tribes had done,
translation_verse: Israel tena kabora la aa noa kɛŋɔ Rubin ne Gad, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera deene la ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii Gelilɔt ba harɛ ta la,

english_verse: the Israelite men met at Shiloh to get ready to attack the two and a half tribes.
translation_verse: ba bwa chemo Silo bela kɛŋɔ ba la ka puu ba yo.

english_verse: But first they sent a priest, Phinehas the son of Eleazar, to talk with the two and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Israel tena la tomɛ sɔfo Eliasa bibaa Fenehas a ɡɛ deene la nɛra be, Gelead harɛ ta bela.

english_verse: Each of the ten tribes at Shiloh sent the leader of one of its families along with Phinehas.
translation_verse: Israel tena la le baala fi le dea bɛlbwa ta ja Fenehas nɛ. Ba ɛ nomonnyuune dɛ chɔ dea lolanar nyoo, dɛ le Israel deene kabora la bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: Phinehas and these leaders went to Gilead and met with the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. They said:
translation_verse: Asɛ ba la Gelead harɛ ta bela Rubin ne Gad deene, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera la be ka ŋɔ,

english_verse: All of the Lord's people have gathered together and have sent us to find out why you are unfaithful to our God. You have turned your backs on the Lord by building that altar. Why are you rebelling against him?
translation_verse: “Ya cheɡɛ Korowii nɛra naa ta dɛɛ bɔɔ heya kɛŋɔ, Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ wechɔɡa aa do ken nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona le o habɔɔ dɛ́ ka ma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ he te nɔ? He vɛh o nɛɛ teŋa.

english_verse: Wasn't our people's sin at Peor terrible enough for you? The Lord punished us by sending a horrible sickness that killed many of us, and we still suffer because of that sin.
translation_verse: Ya wechɔɡa yaa ɛ Korowii Peɔ ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe o tɛr ya deŋne la ɡbo ta maɡraa? A lole kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ weechɔɡa ba ta ya nɛɛ te, kɛ ya ta charɛ, wechɔɡa la ta lɔ ya nɛɛ dɛ ba le fini.

english_verse: Now you are turning your backs on the Lord again. If you don't stop rebelling against the Lord at once, he will be angry with the whole nation.
translation_verse: He laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ taraken ja aa? He vɛoh fini naa, kere o baah ɛɛ di Israel tena bwa nɛɛ.

english_verse: If you don't think your land is a fit place to serve God, then move across the Jordan and live with us in the Lord's own land, where his sacred tent is located. But don't rebel against the Lord our God or against us by building another altar besides the Lord's own altar.
translation_verse: Dɛ hé dɛ lii kɛ he harɛ baa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la kah doŋa aa, hé le Jɔɔdan baŋ, dɛ́ ba so harɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea aa lɔ o ta nɔ. He bɛ sie laa kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ yaa berɛ dɔma, dɛ́ ma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ he te ja Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ kon nɔ ta.

english_verse: Don't you remember what happened when Achan was unfaithful and took some of the things that belonged to God? This made God angry with the entire nation. Achan died because he sinned, but he also caused the death of many others.
translation_verse: Hé lii ɡɛ saŋ Sɛra bibaa Akan aa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii la wa. Korowii baah ta Israel tena bwa nɛɛ dii o tɛr ba deŋne aa? Akan ɡbo laa sewa o wechɔɡa wa.”

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh answered:
translation_verse: Asɛ Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera la chaŋe ŋɔ,

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God! We ask him to be our witness, because he knows whether or not we were rebellious or unfaithful when we built that altar. If we were unfaithful, then we pray that God won't rescue us today. Let us tell you why we built that altar,
translation_verse: “Ya dɛ soŋe Nemenɛ Korowii waa do kpeɡri, ásɛ o ɛ ya danseɛ, ásɛ Israel tena jemɛ kɛŋɔ saraha kon yaa mao tɛ ya te nɔ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, kɛɛ dɛ vɛɛh ya vɛoh waa, ó bɛ yaa ɡel fini.

english_verse: and we ask the Lord to punish us if we are lying. We didn't build it so we could turn our backs on the Lord. We didn't even build it so we could offer animal or grain sacrifices to please the Lord or ask his blessing.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya ɛo deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ ma ya ɡbaɡba saraha kon dɛɛ fuh kwaa o ta, kɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ mea saraha kɛɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha o ta naa, Korowii ɡbaɡba tɛr ya deŋne.

english_verse: That's why we decided to build the altar. It isn't for offering sacrifices, not even sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: A waa ya ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel ya pa mun ma saraha kon, kɛ dɛ fuh kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha kɛɛ dɛɛ kpoo kwaa o ta waa laa.’

english_verse: Phinehas and the clan leaders were pleased when they heard the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh explain why they had built the altar. Then Phinehas told them, “Today we know that the Lord is helping us. You have not been unfaithful to him, and this means that the Lord will not be angry with us.”
translation_verse: Ate, sɔfo Eliasa bibaa Fenehas ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ya jemɔ name kɛŋɔ Korowii ja ya nɛɛ fini, he ta he te laa kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ waa nɔ ta, he lɛ Israel tena bwa nyu le tɛra Korowii fe aa tɛr he deŋne la ta.”

english_verse: Phinehas and the clan leaders left Gilead and went back to Canaan to tell the Israelites about their meeting with the Reuben and Gad tribes.
translation_verse: Belaa sɔfo Eliasa bibaa Fenehas, ne nomonome baa ja o nɛɛ la le Gelead harɛ bela baa cheme Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea tena la, dɛ ba Keenan harɛ ta dɛ ba bol Israel tena la be.

english_verse: The Israelites were happy and praised God. There was no more talk about going to war and wiping out the tribes of Reuben and Gad.
translation_verse: Israel tena kabora aa no waa la la, ba sie lɛo dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii. Ba ta berɛ lii kɛŋɔ baa vɔrɔwe laa, dɛ́ ka chɔɡ harɛ Rubin ne Gad deene aa soɡe o ta laanee kpa.

english_verse: The people of Reuben and Gad named the altar “A Reminder to Us All That the Lord Is Our God.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Rubin ne Gad deene tena ŋɔ, “Saraha kon nɔ ɛ danseɛ tɛ ya bwa kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ya dɔɔ.” Asɛ dɛ pa o sɔn “Danseɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord let Israel live in peace with its neighbors for a long time, and Joshua lived to a ripe old age.
translation_verse: Korowii baa ɡel Israel tena dɔ ba te ba dɔma nɔn ta biɡri, dɛ Josua hwɛɛhrɔ kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: One day he called a meeting of the leaders of the tribes of Israel, including the old men, the judges, and the officials. Then he told them: I am now very old.
translation_verse: anomanta, Josua yerɛ Israel tena, ne nomonome bwa dɛ nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole cheme dɛ ŋɔ, “Taraken, n hwɛɛhrɔ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: You have seen how the Lord your God fought for you and helped you defeat the nations who lived in this land.
translation_verse: Hé ɡbabir na ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa koh he waa dɛ ɛ harɛre nɛra ba fa aa soɡe bonɔ. Dɛ on Korowiirii yoa dɛɛ tɛ heya.

english_verse: There are still some nations left, but the Lord has promised you their land. So when you attack them, he will make them run away. I have already divided their land among your tribes, as I did with the land of the nations I defeated between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma chwa le he sie. Wɛɛ doŋ baa tɔ sie, ásɛ he ka kpɔ ba harɛ la ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ teŋɛ nyobaɡa nɔ taa, dɛ́ doŋi harɛre nɛra ba taa ka o ta la.

english_verse: Be sure that you carefully obey everything written in The Book of the Law of Moses and do exactly what it says.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ waa Mosis aa chwera do Korowii Mmara tɔn la bini la, dɛ bɛ ba koni.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with the nations that live around you. Don't worship their gods or pray to their idols or make promises in the names of their gods.
translation_verse: Hé laa he te kpɔ harɛre nɛra baa kaa he ne ba so nɔ nɛ, he bɛ ba voɡare sɔna dɛɛ yerɛ kɛɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛra. He bɛ an tomɛ, he bɛ an ɡuŋi ɡe.

english_verse: Be as faithful to the Lord as you have always been.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he te pɛl Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la kiŋkiŋ, ɡɛ haa ɛa dɛ ba le fini nɔ.

english_verse: When you attacked powerful nations, the Lord made them run away, and no one has ever been able to stand up to you.
translation_verse: Korowii doŋi harɛre aa kana dɛ do kpeɡri nɛra le he sie, ba le fini bɛlbwa ta wone ba che he sie kpa.

english_verse: Any one of you can defeat a thousand enemy soldiers, because the Lord God fights for you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: He bini beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ won doŋi kɛɛ dɛ́ pɔ laa tena kaɡboŋ nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee yoa dɛɛ tɛ heya, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.

english_verse: Be sure to always love the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la wa.

english_verse: Don't ever turn your backs on him by marrying people from the nations that are left in the land. Don't even make friends with them. I tell you that if you are friendly with those nations, the Lord won't chase them away when you attack. Instead, they'll be like a trap for your feet, a whip on your back, and thorns in your eyes. And finally, none of you will be left in this good land that the Lord has given you.
translation_verse: ate he jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa he sie tɔ dɛ́ doŋ ba tɛ heyaa kpa. Baa doo kɛŋɔ bela ken dɛ́ tɛ heya, ne chweremi dɛɛ cha he nyaŋ ta, dɛ sɔɔhne aa tɔɡre he sibie, ka tel kɛŋɔ he bwa aa serewa le harɛdɛɛɡe nɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa nɔ ta.”

english_verse: I will soon die, as everyone must. But deep in your hearts you know that the Lord has kept every promise he ever made to you. Not one of them has been broken.
translation_verse: Josua ŋɔ, “N tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ n sewɛ. Hé bwa jemɛ he bambile ne he liire bwa bini kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ wedɛɛɡa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la bwa ɛɔ beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.

english_verse: Yes, when the Lord makes a promise, he does what he has promised. But when he makes a threat, he will also do what he has threatened. The Lord is our God. He gave us this wonderful land and made an agreement with us that we would worship only him. But if you worship other gods, it will make the Lord furious. He will start getting rid of you, and soon not one of you will be left in this good land that he has given you.
translation_verse: Dɛ he koni fɔo he ne Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa fɔwa o do heyaa a ta la, dɛ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa dɛɛ ɡuŋa aa, o baah ɛɛ di he nɛɛ kohonaa, ásɛ he serewe le harɛdɛɛɡe waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa nɔ ta.”

english_verse: Joshua called the tribes of Israel together for a meeting at Shechem. He asked the leaders, including the old men, the judges, and the officials, to come up and stand near the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Josua berɔ yerɛ Israel deene la bwa, ba nomonome la ne nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole bwa cheme bwɛjen Sɛkem. Baa tel bela la, o yerɛ ba bwa ka che Korowii sie.

english_verse: Then Joshua told everyone to listen to this message from the Lord, the God of Israel: Long ago your ancestors lived on the other side of the Euphrates River, and they worshiped other gods. This continued until the time of your ancestor Terah and his two sons, Abraham and Nahor.
translation_verse: Asɛ Josua ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowii ya Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘A saŋ la, he nabaala fa soɡe Yufretis Moo la baŋ le dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa. Ba bini bɛlee Tɛɛra waa ɛ Abraham ne Neehɔ bwa mɛɛ.

english_verse: But I brought Abraham across the Euphrates River and led him through the land of Canaan. I blessed him by giving him Isaac, the first in a line of many descendants.
translation_verse: Asɛ n lawɛ he nabaa Abraham le Yufretis Moo la baŋ bela, dɛ tɔ o sie ba o ne Keenan harɛ ta, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo o dɔ naanar warɛ. O lolɛ Aesek,

english_verse: Then I gave Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country of Mount Seir, but your ancestor Jacob and his children went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: asɛ Aesek lolɛ Jekɔb ne Esɔ. N kpɔ Edom deŋɡarere harɛ tɛ Esɔ, asɛ Jekɔb te ne o bibaala kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.

english_verse: Later I sent Moses and his brother Aaron to help your people, and I made all those horrible things happen to the Egyptians. I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, but the Egyptians got in their chariots and on their horses and chased your ancestors, catching up with them at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Maa lawɛ he naawa le Ijipt harɛ la, asɛ Ijipt tena so torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre ta, ne laa tena baa soɡe jaɡre ta ti ba ka tel Mposwɛm ta.

english_verse: Your people cried to me for help, so I put a dark cloud between them and the Egyptians. Then I opened up the sea and let your people walk across on dry ground. But when the Egyptians tried to follow, I commanded the sea to swallow them, and they drowned while you watched. You lived in the desert for a long time,
translation_verse: Ba wio no men Korowii ŋɔ ń cha ba, asɛ n ɡel bɔr bir ba ne Ijipt tena la baah ta. Anee n ɡel mpo la nee su ba bɔle ba nɛ. He ɡbabir na ɡɛ maa ɛ Ijipt tena la. Asɛ he so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ biɡri taeh.

english_verse: then I brought you into the land east of the Jordan River. The Amorites were living there, and they fought you. But with my help, you defeated them, wiped them out, and took their land.
translation_verse: N ba he ne Amɔre tena harɛ waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr la ta. He ne ba yoo, asɛ n che he mun ta he pɔ ba nɛ, asɛ he ka kpɔ ba harɛ la ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.

english_verse: King Balak decided that his nation Moab would go to war against you, so he asked Balaam to come and put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Dɛ Sepɔ bibaa Balak di kora Moab harɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ. O kpɔ o te dɛ ka yo Israel tena, dɛ ɡel Beɔ bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Balam no kɛŋɔ ó ba dɛ́ ba taah heya.

english_verse: But I wouldn't listen to Balaam, and I rescued you by making him bless you instead of curse you.
translation_verse: Kɛ n ta sɛɛh o taah heya, n ɡelɔ o swee heyaa andɛɛɡa kohona, dɛ lɛ heyaa le o nɔn ta.

english_verse: You crossed the Jordan River and came to Jericho. The rulers of Jericho fought you, and so did the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. I helped you defeat them all.
translation_verse: Asɛ he le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ dɛ ba bwɛjen Jeriko ta. Jeriko tena yo heya, ɡɛɛ Amɔre tena ɡe ne Pɛrɛs ne Keenan ne Hiti ne Girɡasi ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena ɡe yo heya, kɛ n ɡelɔ he pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Your enemies ran from you, but not because you had swords and bows and arrows. I made your enemies panic and run away, as I had done with the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ jeŋibotoola tɔ he sie dɛ ba doŋ ba, bane Amɔre tena koranar banɛ la. Hɛma ne keri laa he kpɔ yoo ba.

english_verse: You didn't have to work for this land—I gave it to you. Now you live in towns you didn't build, and you eat grapes and olives from vineyards and trees you didn't plant.
translation_verse: N tɛ heyaa harɛ haa wola o ta koɛh, dɛ so bwɛjena aa wera haa wola an vɔrɔwɛ ta, dɛ di daa kooni ne ɔleve kooni nɔna haa wola an due.’ ”

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Worship the Lord, obey him, and always be faithful. Get rid of the idols your ancestors worshiped when they lived on the other side of the Euphrates River and in Egypt.
translation_verse: Asɛ Josua berɛ ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ kasinteŋ ne. Hé pa he naawa voɡa baa toma Yufretis Moo la baŋ le ne Ijipt harɛ ta la ta, ásɛ dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡbo.

english_verse: But if you don't want to worship the Lord, then choose here and now! Will you worship the same idols your ancestors did? Or since you're living on land that once belonged to the Amorites, maybe you'll worship their gods. I won't. My family and I are going to worship and obey the Lord!
translation_verse: Dɛ a ta maɡrɛ he be kɛŋɔ hé tomɛ Korowii aa, amɔ te hé le fini nyin kon haa tomɛ. Dɛ he naawa voɡare baa toma moo la baŋ le kɛɛ Amɔre tena haa soɡe ba harɛ ta taraken nɔ voɡaree yoo. N te ne n dem tena te, yaa tomɛ Korowiirii.”

english_verse: The people answered: We could never worship other gods or stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Anee ba ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ ya ɡel o toma, dɛ́ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa.

english_verse: The Lord is our God. We were slaves in Egypt as our ancestors had been, but we saw the Lord work miracles to set our people free and to bring us out of Egypt. Even though other nations were all around us, the Lord protected us wherever we went.
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔɔ le ya ne ya naawa le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ya ɛ yoma bela. Ya na nyokpowaa kohona waa ɛa. O kpɔ nɔn tɔ ya nɛɛ ya vala bini bwa, ne harɛre yaa kpɔ a ta bwa.

english_verse: And when we fought the Amorites and the other nations that lived in this land, the Lord made them run away. Yes, we will worship and obey the Lord, because the Lord is our God.
translation_verse: Onee doŋi harɛre nɛra bwa ya sie, ne Amɔre tena bwa ba fa aa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta la. Ya ɡee tomɔɔ, onee Korowii aa chɛ kɛŋɔ yá tomɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua said: The Lord is fearsome; he is the one true God, and I don't think you are able to worship and obey him in the ways he demands. You would have to be completely faithful, and if you sin or rebel, he won't let you get away with it.
translation_verse: Ate, Josua ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “He ken aa won tomɛ Korowii, o do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ we bwara. Waa he kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe ne he wechɔɡaa kpɔ kɛ heya.

english_verse: If you turn your backs on the Lord and worship the gods of other nations, the Lord will turn against you. He will make terrible things happen to you and wipe you out, even though he had been good to you before.
translation_verse: He bɛ Korowii toma ɡel, dɛ́ kaa tomɛ harɛre ane voɡa. A lole kɛŋɔ o fa ɛ wedɛɛɡa tɛ heya te, o bandia ɛɛ ir he nɛɛ ó tɛr he deŋne ka tel kɛŋɔ waa chɔɡ heyaa kwaraa.”

english_verse: But the people shouted, “We won't worship any other gods. We will worship and obey only the Lord!”
translation_verse: Asɛ Nɛra la bwa ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Akai! Korowiirii yaa ba toma.”

english_verse: Joshua said, “You have heard yourselves say that you will worship and obey the Lord. Isn't that true?” “Yes, it's true,” they answered.
translation_verse: Anee Josua ŋɔ, “Heyaa he ɡbaɡba danseɛ kɛŋɔ haa le Korowii cheɡ ŋɔ onee hɛ́ɛ ba toma nɔ.” Ba ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, ya ɛ ya ɡbaɡba danseɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua said, “But you still have some idols, like those the other nations worship. Get rid of your idols! You must decide once and for all that you really want to obey the Lord God of Israel.”
translation_verse: Josua ŋɔ, “Amɔ te hé pa harɛre ane voɡare aa lɔ he be la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ he bambili bwa tɛ Korowii he Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la.”

english_verse: The people said, “The Lord is our God, and we will worship and obey only him.”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɡboo yaa ba toma, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ waa waa do yaa a ta la ta.”

english_verse: Joshua helped Israel make an agreement with the Lord that day at Shechem. Joshua made laws for Israel
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Josua ne Israel tena la fɔwɛ fɔo Sɛkem bela baa chema la, asɛ o berɛ kpɔ mmarare ane báa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: and wrote them down in The Book of the Law of God. Then he set up a large stone under the oak tree at the place of worship in Shechem
translation_verse: Josua chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ do Korowii Mmara tɔn bini, dɛ berɛ kpɔ bwe damanta bɛl pa dajen bɛl mun, Korowii boɡoroŋ la jwɛh.

english_verse: and told the people, “Look at this stone. It has heard everything that the Lord has said to us. Our God can call this stone as a witness if we ever reject him.”
translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé na, bwe nɔɔ ɛ ya bwa danseɛ, o no wobɛlbwa Korowii aa bol ya be. Wɛɛ ɛ danseɛɛ, dɛ he baa le habɔɔ ŋɔ haa Korowii tomɛ kpa aa, o le heyaa tɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua sent everyone back to their homes. Joshua, Joseph, and Eleazar Are Buried
translation_verse: Asɛ Josua ta ba ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa kaa ba harɛre ta. Josua seo wa

english_verse: Not long afterwards, the Lord's servant Joshua died at the age of
translation_verse: Anɔ habɔɔ la, Korowii bonɔɔ Josua baa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ Nun baa sewɛ. Dɛ o di bene lafa dɛ fi.

english_verse: The Israelites buried him in his own land at Timnath-Serah, north of Mount Gaash in the hill country of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ba huɡo o ɡbaɡba harɛ ta Timnat Sera. O lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere ta, dɛ do Gaas Bwejen weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.

english_verse: As long as Joshua lived, Israel worshiped and obeyed the Lord. There were other leaders old enough to remember everything that the Lord had done for Israel. And for as long as these men lived, Israel continued to worship and obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel tena la tomɛ Korowii le ɡɛ saŋ Josua ne baa lole bwa. Waa sewa habɔɔ kwaraa la, dɛ ba ta teŋɔ dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ nomonoma baa ja Josua nɛ dɛ na nyokpowaa Korowii aa ɛa tɛ Israel tena la bwa ta lole.

english_verse: When the people of Israel left Egypt, they brought the bones of Joseph along with them. They took the bones to the town of Shechem and buried them in the field that Jacob had bought for
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, ba kpɔ Josef hoɡa kaa dɛ ka huɡe Sɛkem. Harɛ Jekɔb aa yawa le Sɛkem bibaa Hamɔ bibaala be suuɡapoŋa lafa la ta. Harɛ la baa ɛ Josef naanar kapɛrɛ kon.

english_verse: When Eleazar the priest died, he was buried in the hill country of Ephraim on a hill that belonged to his son Phinehas.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Eliasa ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo bwɛjen Gebea harɛ waa ɛ o bibaa Fenehas kon ta. O lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta.

english_verse: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the Lord, “Which of our tribes should attack the Canaanites first?”
translation_verse: Josua seo habɔɔ la, Israel tena soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Ya deene nɔ, bamewaa dɛ́ tɔ ya sie yá ka yo Keenan tena ba harɛ ta nɔ?”

english_verse: The people of Judah went to their relatives, the Simeon tribe, and said, “Canaanites live in the land God gave us. Help us fight them, and we will help you.” Troops from Simeon came to help Judah.
translation_verse: Belaa Juda dea tena ŋɔ ba lolanar Simeon dea tena be ŋɔ, “Harɛ la bela Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ yaa la, Keenan tena soɡe o ta. Hé ba ja ya nɛɛ yá ka yoo ba.” Anomanta, Simeon dea tena ne Juda dea tena pɛo dɛ la ka yoo ba.

english_verse: After that, they attacked the Canaanites who lived at Hebron, defeating the three clans called Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. At that time, Hebron was called Kiriath-Arba.
translation_verse: Ba berɔ ka pu Keenan tena baa soɡe bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn la yo, dɛ pɔ Sɛsae ne Ahiman dɛ Talmai deene tena nɛ. Otniel yo bwɛjen Debir tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ

english_verse: The king tried to escape, but soldiers from Judah caught him. They cut off his thumbs and big toes,
translation_verse: Kooro la chwao kaa, asɛ ba tiu dɛ ka lawɔ, dɛ teŋe o nonibala ne o nanibala.

english_verse: They attacked Jerusalem, captured it, killed everyone who lived there, and then burned it to the ground.
translation_verse: Juda dea tena kaa yo Jerusalam tena ɡe, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ. Ba kpoo nɛra baa lɔ o ta dɛ fuuh.

english_verse: Judah's army fought the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, the Southern Desert, and the foothills to the west.
translation_verse: Baa le bela la, ba kaa yo Keenan tena baa soɡe deŋɡarere harɛ ne bwejena lɔɡre, dɛ Nɛɡɛv waa ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ dɛ chɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr.

english_verse: From Hebron, Judah's army went to attack Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.
translation_verse: Baa le bela la, ba berɔ la ka pu bwɛjen Debir tena ɡe yo.

english_verse: Caleb told his troops, “The man who captures Kiriath-Sepher can marry my daughter Achsah.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Kaleb ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa won yo Kiriat Sɛfa dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ la, mɛɛ lawɛ n bihaah Aksaa tɛo ó mo.”

english_verse: Caleb's nephew Othniel captured Kiriath-Sepher, so Caleb let him marry Achsah. Othniel was the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.
translation_verse: Kaleb nime Kenas bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Otniel laanee wona ka yo bwɛɛ la dɛ pɔ ba nɛ. Anomanta, Kaleb lawɛ o bihaah la tɛo o mo.

english_verse: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked, “What's bothering you?”
translation_verse: Baa ɛ ba hanfalwaa tonɛ la, o jaa Otniel ŋɔ, “Ka soŋe he mɛɛ ó tɛɛ harɛ.” Asɛ o kpɔ o keeɡo dɛ kaa. Waa laŋa la o mɛɛ bɔɔro kon waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: She answered, “I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so please give me some spring-fed ponds for a water supply.” Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds named Higher Pond and Lower Pond.
translation_verse: Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi n nɛ. He tɛ mɛ harɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ Nɛɡɛv. Tɛ mɛ bela nee aa bula dɛɛ le ɡe.” Asɛ o ka tɛo harɛ nee aa bula dɛɛ le o ta. Bɛl do nyunduabɔr, bɛl do harɛbɔr pera.

english_verse: The people who belonged to the Kenite clan were the descendants of the father-in-law of Moses. They left Jericho with the people of Judah and settled near Arad in the Southern Desert of Judah not far from the Amalekites.
translation_verse: Mosis helabaa naanar Ken tena le Jeriko, dɛ ba ja Juda dea tena nɛɛ ba ka so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɛra bini waa lɔ Nɛɡɛv, dɛ bɛne bwɛɛ Arad.

english_verse: Judah's army helped Simeon's army attack the Canaanites who lived at Zephath. They completely destroyed the town and renamed it Hormah.
translation_verse: Belaa Juda dea tena ne ba lolanar Simeon dea tena pɛ ka yo Keenan tena baa soɡe Sɛfat, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ. Ba chɔɡ bwɛɛ la kwaraa, dɛ pa o sɔn Hɔrma.

english_verse: The Lord helped the army of Judah capture Gaza, Ashkelon, Ekron, and the land near those towns. They also took the hill country. But the people who lived in the valleys had iron chariots, so Judah was not able to make them leave or to take their land.
translation_verse: Korowii cha Juda dea tena ba pɔ deŋɡarere harɛ tena nɛ, kɛ ba ta wone doŋi bwɛɛre aa chɔ harɛ deŋɡarere aa wola toole a ta la te nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba dɔ bune kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre la ane.

english_verse: The tribe of Judah gave the town of Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had told them to do. Caleb defeated the three Anakim clans and took over the town. The Benjamin Tribe Does Not Capture Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn tɛ Kaleb, ɡɛ Mosis aa bola la, asɛ o doŋi Anak tena deene atoro nɛra baa lɔ bela la.

english_verse: The Jebusites were living in Jerusalem, and the Benjamin tribe did not defeat them or capture the town. That's why Jebusites still live in Jerusalem along with the people of Benjamin. The Ephraim and Manasseh Tribes Capture Bethel
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡe ta wone doŋi Jebus tena baa soɡe bwɛjen Jerusalam, anomanta, ba bwa pɛo so le ɡɛ saŋ bwa ba le fini.

english_verse: While the spies were watching the town, a man came out, and they told him, “If you show us how our army can get into the town, we will make sure that you aren't harmed.”
translation_verse: asɛ nɛra la na baa bɛl kɛ waa le bwɛjen la ta dɛɛ ba. Asɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Chaɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa ɛ dɛ́ won jo bwɛjen nɔ bini, ásɛ ya bɛ hen wobɛlbwa ɛ.”

english_verse: The man showed them, and the two Israelite tribes attacked Bethel, killing everyone except the man and his family. The two tribes made the man and his family leave,
translation_verse: Anomanta, o baɡ ba, ba jo o bini dɛ ka kpoo bela tena bwa, dɛ ɡel baa la ne o dem nɛra ɡbo.

english_verse: so they went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a town. He named the town Luz, and that is still its name. Israel Does Not Get Rid of All the Canaanites
translation_verse: Baa la la Hiti harɛ ta dɛ ka vɔrɔwe bwɛ, dɛ pa o sɔn Lus. Ba ta dɛ yerɔ ɡɛ ba le fini.

english_verse: The Ephraim tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites lived there with Israelites all around them.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Efrem tena aa wola Keenan tena doŋe le Gɛsa, asɛ ba ne ba pɛ so bela.

english_verse: The Zebulun tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Kitron and Nahalol, and the Canaanites stayed there with Israelites around them. But the people of Zebulun did force the Canaanites into slave labor.
translation_verse: Sebulon dea tena ta Keenan tena baa soɡe bwɛjena Ketrɔn ne Nahalal doŋe. Ba ne ba pɛo so, kɛ tomkpeɡaa ba ɡel baa ɛ.

english_verse: The Naphtali tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Beth-Shemesh and Beth-Anath, but they did force the Canaanites into slave labor. The Naphtali tribe lived with Canaanites around them.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Naftale dea tena ta Keenan tena baa soɡe bwɛjena Bɛt Sɛmɛs ne Bɛt Anat la doŋe, kɛ tomkpeɡaa ba ɡel baa ɛ. Ba ɡe soɡe Keenan tena la baah ta.

english_verse: The Amorites were strong enough to keep the tribe of Dan from settling in the valleys, so Dan had to stay in the hill country.
translation_verse: Amɔre tena chaɡle ba kpeɡri, ba ta ɡelɛ Dan dea tena so bela waa wera, dɛ ɡel ba ka so deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta. Ba ta ɡelɛ ba tu ba so harɛ aa chɔa kaa deŋɡarere aa wola toole a ta la ta.

english_verse: The Amorites on Mount Heres and in Aijalon and Shaalbim were also determined to stay. Later on, as Ephraim and Manasseh grew more powerful, they forced those Amorites into slave labor. The Amorite-Edomite Border
translation_verse: Amɔre tena la sie beɡrɔ ba ta so Heres Bwejen ne Aejalɔn dɛ Saalabim ta. Kɛ Josef dea tena baa dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ ɡel baa ɛ tomkpeɡa.

english_verse: The old Amorite-Edomite border used to go from Sela through Scorpion Pass into the hill country.
translation_verse: Amɔre tena jwɛh chɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ Akrabim Bwejena baah ta dɛ ka ɡarɛ Sela.

english_verse: The Lord's angel went from Gilgal to Bochim and gave the Israelites this message from the Lord: I promised your ancestors that I would give this land to their families, and I brought your people here from Egypt. We made an agreement that I promised never to break,
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome le bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Gelɡal dɛ ba bol waa Bokim tena be ŋɔ, “Menee lɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ba he ne harɛ maa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa kɛŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa la ta la. N bol he be ŋɔ maa fɔo n ne haa fɔwa laanee chɔɡ bwa.

english_verse: and you promised not to make any peace treaties with the other nations that live in the land. Besides that, you agreed to tear down the altars where they sacrifice to their idols. Why haven't you kept your promise?
translation_verse: N ŋɔ he ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta la bɛ fɔo bɛlbwa fɔwɛ, dɛ́ kuuɡi kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡa la. Kɛ he ta waa maa do heyaa a ta la noɛ. Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: And so, I'll stop helping you defeat your enemies. Instead, they will be there to trap you into worshiping their idols.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dɛ bol he be kɛŋɔ maa ban doŋi tɛ heya. Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba berɛ sɔɔhne dɛɛ tɔɡre heya, ásɛ ba voɡa ɡe berɛ do kɛŋɔ baa harɛ heyaa bela.”

english_verse: and they offered sacrifices to the Lord. From then on, they called that place “Crying.” Israel Stops Worshiping the Lord
translation_verse: A waa ba pa bela sɔn Bokim. Ba kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii bela. Josua seo wa

english_verse: Joshua had been faithful to the Lord. And after Joshua sent the Israelites to take the land they had been promised, they remained faithful to the Lord until Joshua died at the age of
translation_verse: Ba huɡo harɛ baa bɔna o dɔ la ta, Timnat Heres waa lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta, Gaas Bwejen weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.

english_verse: After a while the people of Joshua's generation died, and the next generation did not know the Lord or any of the things he had done for Israel.
translation_verse: Josua ne o nɛra la kapa aa baa serewe la, bane ɡe iro dɛ baa jemɛ kɛ Korowii lole, á ba ɛ kɛ baa na waa waa ɛa tɛ Israel tena laanee.

english_verse: with the Israelites that he let other nations raid Israel and steal their crops and other possessions. Enemies were everywhere, and the Lord always let them defeat Israel in battle. The Lord had warned Israel he would do this, and now the Israelites were miserable. The Lord Chooses Leaders for Israel
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa Israel tena aa ka yo laa la, Korowii yon laa nɔn kpɔ ba nɛ, asɛ ba dɔma pɔ ba nɛɛ ɡɛ waa ŋwɛɛra la. Dɛ ba waa sum kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: From time to time, the Lord would choose special leaders known as judges. These judges would lead the Israelites into battle and defeat the enemies that made raids on them.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii tɛɛ ba sitɔɔla, asɛ ba lɛɛ ba le nɛra ba yon ba lɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ pa ba laala la nɔn ta.

english_verse: In years gone by, the Israelites had been faithful to the Lord, but now they were quick to be unfaithful and to refuse even to listen to these judges. The Israelites disobeyed the Lord, and instead of worshiping him, they worshiped other gods.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba vɛh sitɔɔla la be noe, dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛ voɡa dɛɛ toma. Ba ta doe kɛŋɔ ba naawa ba fa aa dɛ no Korowii wa dɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa do ba a ta la ta. Ba vɛh o ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋa buɡ ta.

english_verse: When enemies made life miserable for the Israelites, the Lord felt sorry for them. He would choose a judge and help that judge rescue Israel from its enemies. The Lord was kind to Israel as long as that judge lived.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa Korowii aa tɛɛ ba sitɔɔ la, o dɛ chao dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta ɡɛ saŋ sitɔɔ la taa soɡe le la. Korowii dɔ tedoma dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, wii baa dɛ wi hɔhɔrɔwa nɛra aa dɛ ɛɛ ba la wa.

english_verse: But afterwards, the Israelites would become even more sinful than their ancestors had been. The Israelites were stubborn—they simply would not stop worshiping other gods or following their teachings. The Lord Lets Enemies Test Israel
translation_verse: Kɛ sitɔɔ la baa sewaa, dɛ ba berɔ kaa ba webena aa ɡwaa ba naawa kwaa la, dɛ kaa teŋɛ voɡare nɛɛ dɛɛ toma. Baa nyin ba ɡel ba wechɔɡa ne ba deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with Israel and said: The Israelites have broken the agreement I made with their ancestors. They won't obey me,
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii baah di Israel tena nɛɛ o ŋɔ, “Chɔɡa nɛra nɔ aa chɔɡ fɔo n ne ba naawa aa fɔwa dɛ vɛh n waa noe nɔ,

english_verse: so I'll stop helping them defeat their enemies. Israel still had a lot of enemies when Joshua died,
translation_verse: maa harɛre nɛra Josua aa sewa ɡel ba laanee doŋi le ba harɛre ta tɛɛ ba kpa.

english_verse: and I'm going to let those enemies stay. I'll use them to test Israel, because then I can find out if Israel will worship and obey me as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔɔ daah Israel tena na kɛ baa dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ dɛɛ tom mɛ, ɡɛ ba naawa fa aa dɛ ɛ la kɛɛ.”

english_verse: That's why the Lord had not let Joshua get rid of those enemy nations all at once.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do Korowii ɡel nɛra la bane ka harɛ la ta, o ta ban kpɔe do Josua nɔn ta o doŋ ba le harɛ la ta kera beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: And the Lord had another reason for letting these enemies stay. The Israelites needed to learn how to fight in war, just as their ancestors had done. Each new generation would have to learn by fighting
translation_verse: A ɡbo waa o ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ kpɔ daah Israel tena naanar baa wola laa laŋɛ ka la, ásɛ ba jemɛ laa wa.

english_verse: the Philistines and their five rulers, as well as the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites that lived in the Lebanon Mountains from Mount Baal-Hermon to Hamath Pass.
translation_verse: Nɛra waa ɡel ba laanee Filisti tena koranar banue, ne Keenan tena bwa, ne Sidon ne Hivi tena baa soɡe Lɛbanɔn bwejena ta, dɛ kpoŋe le Baal Hɛmɔn ka tel Lebo Hamat.

english_verse: Moses had told the Israelites what the Lord had commanded them to do, and now the Lord was using these nations to find out if Israel would obey.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra laanee Korowii ɡel ba so, dɛ́ kpɔ daah Israel tena, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ do ba naawa la taa yaa.

english_verse: But they refused. And some of them even married Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who lived all around them. That's how they started worshiping foreign gods. Othniel
translation_verse: Ba mo ba bihaahna dɛ lawɛ ba bihaahna tɛ ba ɡe ba mo, dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa. Otniel wa

english_verse: The Israelites sinned against the Lord by forgetting him and worshiping idols of Baal and Astarte.
translation_verse: Israel tena la ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ. Ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa Baalre ne Asera.

english_verse: This made the Lord angry, so he let Israel be defeated by King Cushan Rishathaim of northern Syria, who ruled Israel eight years and made everyone pay taxes.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii baah di ba nɛɛ kohona dɛ kpɔ ba do Mɛsopoteemea Kooro Kusan Risataim nɔn ta, asɛ ba tomɔ bene anuatoro.

english_verse: The Israelites begged the Lord for help, and so he chose Othniel to rescue them. Othniel was the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba wio yerɛ Korowii, asɛ o le Kenas bibaa Otniel o ba lɛɛ ba. Dɛ Kaleb nimee on.

english_verse: and Israel was at peace until Othniel died about
translation_verse: Anomanta, deŋnesɔɔhna ba Israel harɛ ta bene fifraanaarɛ mɔɔ Otniel sewɛ. Ehud wa

english_verse: Once more the Israelites started disobeying the Lord. So he let them be defeated by King Eglon of Moab,
translation_verse: Israel tena berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ja, asɛ o ɡel Moab Kooro Ɛɡlɔn ɛɛ di kpeɡri ba nɛ.

english_verse: who had joined forces with the Ammonites and the Amalekites to attack Israel. Eglon and his army captured Jericho.
translation_verse: O yerɛ Amɔn ne Amalɛk tena ja o nɛra nɛɛ ba ka yo Israel tena dɛ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ Jeriko ta.

english_verse: Then he ruled Israel for
translation_verse: Israel tena tomɛ Moab Kooro Ɛɡlɔn bene fi dɛ anuatoro.

english_verse: Ehud and some other Israelites took the taxes to Eglon, who was a very fat man. As soon as they gave the taxes to Eglon, Ehud said it was time to go home.
translation_verse: Ehud aa kpɔ kwaa la ka tɛ kooro la, o ɡelɔ baala baa cheɡɛ kwaa la ka doo, dɛ laa berɛ kaa dem.

english_verse: Ehud went with the other Israelites as far as the statues at Gilgal. Then he turned back and went upstairs to the room where Eglon had his throne. Ehud said, “Your Majesty, I need to talk with you in private.” Eglon replied, “Don't say anything yet!” His officials left the room, and Eglon stood up as Ehud came closer. “Yes,” Ehud said, “I have a message for you from God!”
translation_verse: Ate, Ehud suuh bɛno, dɛ o ɡbo soɡe saldoa bela waa dɛ lɛ peu la dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔ waane le Korowii be dɛɛ ba he tɛɛ.” Kooro aa ira le o kara ta la,

english_verse: Ehud pulled out the dagger with his left hand and shoved it so far into Eglon's stomach
translation_verse: Ehud kpɔ nɔŋɡal dɛ laa tokobi la tɛr le o diɡ kɛɡra ta, dɛ kpɔ tɔɡɛ kooro tea.

english_verse: and left. When the king's officials came back and saw that the doors were locked, they said, “The king is probably inside relieving himself.”
translation_verse: Waa kaala tonɛ la, kooro bonɔɔna la balɔ dɛ ba na kɛŋɔ kooro sobɔr ɡbeni la bwa kaɡrɔ. Dɛ ba liiree kɛŋɔ o ken kaa dahara.

english_verse: They stood there waiting until they felt foolish, but Eglon still didn't open the doors. Finally, they unlocked the doors and found King Eglon lying dead on the floor.
translation_verse: Ba cheɡɛ bela biɡri, dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ kooro ɛɛ ya ɡberaa. Waa wola ya la, ba lii kɛŋɔ ba dɛ ɛ bechawa, dɛ kpɔ safoa laa ɡbera la ya, dɛ na kɛŋɔ ba nomoa sewɔ chɔ.

english_verse: But by that time, Ehud had already escaped past the statues. Ehud went to the town of Seirah
translation_verse: Kooro bonɔɔna la aa cheɡɛ bela la, dɛ Ehud te le bela dɛ chwa kpɔ voɡa la bɔr kaa Sɛɛra biɡri.

english_verse: in the hill country of Ephraim and started blowing a trumpet as a signal to call the Israelites together. When they came, he shouted, “Follow me! The Lord will help us defeat the Moabites.” The Israelites followed Ehud down to the Jordan valley, and they captured the places where people cross the river on the way to Moab. They would not let anyone go across,
translation_verse: O do ba ŋɔ, “Hé teŋɛ n nɛ, Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heyaa le Moab tena baa ɛ he dɔma nɔn taa.” Anomanta, ba teŋɛ Ehud nɛɛ dɛ kaa bɔra baa kpɔ a ta dɛɛ ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo dɛ kaa Moab harɛ ta la dɛ ka tɔɔɡa. Ba ta ɡelɛ nomɛlbwa ɡale moo la.

english_verse: Moab was so badly defeated that it was a long time before they were strong enough to attack Israel again. And Israel was at peace for
translation_verse: Le awola tɔpere dɛɛ kaa la, Israel tena dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna bene fifraanuatoro, asɛ Moab tena ɛɛ tom ba. Samɡa wa

english_verse: Shamgar the son of Anath was the next to rescue Israel. In one battle, he used a sharp wooden pole to kill
translation_verse: Ehud aa bala habɔɔ la, Anat bibaa Samɡa ɡe kpoo Filisti tena lafraanumɛl daa waa seɡre o nyoa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ teɡɛ o nae la ne. O ɡe jao dɛ lɛ Israel tena.

english_verse: After the death of Ehud, the Israelites again started disobeying the Lord.
translation_verse: Ehud aa sewa habɔɔ la, Israel tena berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ja.

english_verse: So the Lord let the Canaanite King Jabin of Hazor conquer Israel. Sisera, the commander of Jabin's army, lived in Harosheth-Ha-Goiim.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii kpɔ ba do Keenan Kooro Jabin waa di kora bwɛjen Hasɔ nɔn ta. Kooro Jabin laa nomoa sɔne Sisera, dɛ so bwɛɛ Harɔsɛt Haɡoyim ta.

english_verse: “Stand at the entrance to the tent,” Sisera told her. “If someone comes by and asks if anyone is inside, tell them ‘No.’ ”
translation_verse: Sisera ŋɔ Jael be ŋɔ, “Ir che tɛnte doonyoa bela. Dɛ nomɛl baa bɔɔ ŋɔ nɛn lɔ bonɔ naa, he ŋɔ ɔɔhɔh.”

english_verse: Deborah the wife of Lappidoth was a prophet and a leader of Israel during those days.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah bɛl sɔne Dɛbora dɛ ɛ Korowii keame, dɛ ɛ Israel tena sitɔɔ ɡɛ saŋ. O jaa sɔne Lapedɔt.

english_verse: She would sit under Deborah's Palm Tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, where Israelites would come and ask her to settle their legal cases.
translation_verse: Dɛ bambi daa bɛl cheɡɛ Rama ne Bɛtel baah ta Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta baa yerɔ Dɛbora Bambi wɛɛ so o mun, asɛ Israel tena yon la o be o bol ba waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: One day, Barak the son of Abinoam was in Kedesh in Naphtali, and Deborah sent word for him to come and talk with her. When he arrived, she said: I have a message for you from the Lord God of Israel! You are to get together an army of
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, Dɛbora ɡelɔ ba ka yerɛ Abinoam bibaa Barak waa le bwɛɛ Kedes o do Naftale harɛ ta o ba, asɛ o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ ń ŋɔ he be hé ka kpɔ Naftale ne Sebulon deene baala kaɡboŋa fi ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ tɔ ba sie kaa Tabɔ Bwejen ta.

english_verse: The Lord will trick Sisera into coming out to fight you at the Kishon River. Sisera will be leading King Jabin's army as usual, and they will have their chariots, but the Lord has promised to help you defeat them.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ba Kooro Jabin laa nomoa Sisera ne torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la ne o laa tena nee Kesɔn Moo la nyoa, ásɛ dɛ ɡel he pɔ ba nɛ.”

english_verse: “All right, I'll go!” she replied. “But I'm warning you that the Lord is going to let a woman defeat Sisera, and no one will honor you for winning the battle.” Deborah and Barak left for Kedesh,
translation_verse: Dɛbora ɡe ŋɔ, “A wer, n ne hɛɛ kaaloo. Kɛ ŋwɛnɛ yaa dɛ ba kaala nɔ, he laa dɛ dɔ sɔn o ta. Haahnee Korowii ɛɛ ba ɡela o pɔ Sisera nɛ.” Anomanta, Dɛbora ja Barak nɛɛ ba kaa Kedes.

english_verse: At this time, Heber of the Kenite clan was living near the village of Oak in Zaanannim, not far from Kedesh. The Kenites were descendants of Hobab, the father-in-law of Moses, but Heber had moved and had set up his tents away from the rest of the clan.
translation_verse: Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Heba dɛ ɛ Ken te. O le o nɛra bini dɛ ka baŋre o tɛnte dea dajen bɛl waa cheɡɛ Saananim dɛ bɛne Kedes mun. Ken tena nɔ ɛ Mosis menchoro Hobab naanar.

english_verse: When Sisera learned that Barak had led an army to Mount Tabor,
translation_verse: Baa bol Sisera be ŋɔ Abinoam bibaa Barak kaa Tabɔ Bwejen ta la,

english_verse: Deborah shouted, “Barak, it's time to attack Sisera! Because today the Lord is going to help you defeat him. In fact, the Lord has already gone on ahead to fight for you.” Barak led his
translation_verse: Dɛbora ŋɔ Barak be ŋɔ, “Kaa! Fini tɔpere nɔɔ Korowii kpɔ Sisera do he nɔn ta hé pɔ o nɛ. Korowii te tɔ he sie kaa.” Anomanta, Barak ne o laa tena kaɡboŋa fi la tuo le Tabɔ Bwejen doa ba harɛ.

english_verse: And during the battle, the Lord confused Sisera, his chariot drivers, and his whole army. Everyone was so afraid of Barak and his army, that even Sisera jumped down from his chariot and tried to escape.
translation_verse: Barak aa dɛ tel Sisera be la, Korowii yoo tɛ Israel tena ba pɔ Sisera ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛla la bwa, ne o laa tena nɛɛ ba wili, asɛ Sisera tu le o bune kon waa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ pɛl jaaɡɔ la dɛ kpɔ nakpale ta chwa kaa.

english_verse: Barak's forces went after Sisera's chariots and army as far as Harosheth-Ha-Goiim. Sisera's entire army was wiped out.
translation_verse: Kɛ Barak ti kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore la ne laa tena la ka tel Harɔsɛt Haɡoyim. Ba kpoo Sisera laa tena la bwa kere ne, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.

english_verse: Only Sisera escaped. He ran to Heber's camp, because Heber and his family had a peace treaty with the king of Hazor. Sisera went to the tent that belonged to Jael, Heber's wife.
translation_verse: Dɛ Sisera te kpɔ nakpale ta, dɛ chwa kaa Ken te Heba haah Jael tɛnte bɔr, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Hasɔ Kooro Jabin ne Ken te Heba dem tena som.

english_verse: She came out to greet him and said, “Come in, sir! Please come on in. Don't be afraid.” After they had gone inside, Sisera lay down, and Jael covered him with a blanket.
translation_verse: Jael le buse ka cheme Sisera dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ ba nomoa, den dɛɛ ba. Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma.” Anomanta, o jo o tɛnte dea la bini, asɛ o kpɔ yal bɔlo.

english_verse: “Could I have a little water?” he asked. “I'm thirsty.” Jael opened a leather bottle and poured him some milk, then she covered him back up.
translation_verse: Sisera ŋɔ, “Nyɔɡre dɛ kpo mɛ, n dɛ soŋe, tɛ mɛ nee ń nyɔ.” O kpɔ oltɔn loŋ ne na-elne tɛo o nyɔ, dɛ kwaa kon tɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: Sisera was exhausted and soon fell fast asleep. Jael took a hammer and drove a tent-peg through his head into the ground, and he died.
translation_verse: Koeh kohona nomanta, Sisera chɔ dom kwaraa, asɛ Heba haah Jael kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ baŋre tɛnte la bɛl ne hamba, dɛ ɛ bɔeeh dɛ kpɔ kon la jaɡɛ o lwɛɛma ta, dɛ kpaa do o ka marɛ harɛ o sewɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Barak had been following Sisera, and Jael went out to meet him. “The man you're looking for is inside,” she said. “Come in and I'll show him to you.” They went inside, and there was Sisera—dead and stretched out with a tent-peg through his skull.
translation_verse: Barak ti Sisera dɛɛ ba, asɛ Jael le buse ka chemo dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ ba, mɛɛ chaɡle nɛn haa dɛ ɡaaɡe o bɔr nɔɔ.” Anomanta, o ne Jael jo tɛnte la bini, o na kɛ ba kpɔ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ baŋre tɛnte jaɡɛ o lwɛɛma ta marɛ harɛ o sewɛ.

english_verse: That same day God defeated the Canaanite King Jabin while the Israelites looked on, and his army was no longer powerful enough to attack the Israelites.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɡelɔ kpeɡri Keenan harɛ Kooro Jabin aa dɔa la nyoa sɔɔh Israel tena bwa siwi ta.

english_verse: Jabin grew weaker while the Israelites kept growing stronger, until at last the Israelites destroyed him.
translation_verse: Israel tena berɔ ba dɔ kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ Keenan tena Kooro Jabin nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ baa kpoo.

english_verse: After the battle was over that day, Deborah and Barak sang this song:
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la Dɛbora ne Abinoam bibaa Barak ɡo yel nɔ dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: We praise you, Lord! Our soldiers volunteered, ready to follow you.
translation_verse: “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii! Israel sitɔɔla tɔ sie dɛɛ la laa, ásɛ ba nɛra ɡe kpɔ ba te tɛ silɛɛ ne.

english_verse: Listen, kings and rulers, while I sing for the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Koranar, nɛra haa dɛ nyiŋi harɛre ta, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no! Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ Korowii. Yelsomaa mɛɛ ba ɡoe tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, God of Israel, when you came from Seir, where the Edomites live,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, haa le Sɛɛ Bwejen ta Edom harɛ ta la, harɛ jiɡro baama tɔ, asɛ bwaala nee fuɡe le nyundua.

english_verse: rain poured from the sky, the earth trembled, and mountains shook.
translation_verse: Bwejena jiɡro hen Korowii waa ɛ Sinai Bwejen dɔɔ sie, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la bala ta.

english_verse: In the time of Shamgar son of Anath, and now again in Jael's time, roads were too dangerous for caravans. Travelers had to take the back roads,
translation_verse: Anat bibaa Samɡa bere saŋ la, Jael ɡe aa lole la, nɛra vɛh ŋwɛnɛjena ta kpɔe, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛbie ta.

english_verse: and villagers couldn't work in their fields. Then Deborah took command, protecting Israel as a mother protects her children.
translation_verse: Nɛra tama banee ka Israel bwɛjeɡre ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ men Dɛbora aa bala dɛ berɛ Israel tena nya.

english_verse: The Israelites worshiped other gods, and the gates of their towns were then attacked. But they had no shields or spears to fight with.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la, laa ba bwɛɛre la ta. Baala kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ baa lɔ harɛ la ta, bɛlbwa ta lampea kɛɛ dɔmkon bɛlbwa kpoŋe.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, and I am grateful for those leaders and soldiers who volunteered.
translation_verse: N bambile lɔ sitɔɔla baa lɔ Israel harɛ nɛ, nɛra baa kpɔ silɛɛ le ba te cheɡ la. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: Listen, everyone! Whether you ride a donkey with a padded saddle or have to walk.
translation_verse: Hé no, he banɔ la haa soɡe keeɡopoŋa ta, dɛ so kwaa baa paa dawɛ a ta, ne he banɔ la haa dɛ valɛ nakpale ta.

english_verse: Even those who carry water to the animals will tell you, “The Lord has won victories, and so has Israel.” Then the Lord's people marched down to the town gates
translation_verse: Hé no nɛra baa dɛ ɡo yela ɡbɔɡa aa dɛ le buli ta, dɛɛ baɡle Korowii laa waa yoa dɛ pɔ nɛra nɛ, ne Israel banyoola ɡe yoi baa yoa. Asɛ Korowii nɛra valɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ le ba bwɛjena ta dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: The Lord's people who were left joined with their leaders and fought at my side.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii nɛra baa kaa la ba ja ba nomonome la nɛ, Korowii nɛra la ba n be dɛ ba ja banyoola la nɛ.

english_verse: Troops came from Ephraim, where Amalekites once lived. Others came from Benjamin; officers and leaders came from Machir and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Bane le Efrem dea harɛ ta dɛ le Amalɛk tena luɡe ta, bane le Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta dɛ ba, laa sitɔɔla le Makir harɛ ne Sebulon dea harɛ ta dɛ ba.

english_verse: The rulers of Issachar came along with Deborah, and Issachar followed Barak into the valley. But the tribe of Reuben was no help at all!
translation_verse: Isaaka dea nomonome ja Dɛbora nɛ, ba ja Barak nɛɛ dɛ chwa jo fɛlembɔjen la bini. Rubin dea tena te bini peɡro, ba ta wone la.

english_verse: Reuben, why did you stay among your sheep pens? Was it to listen to shepherds whistling for their sheep? No one could figure out why Reuben wouldn't come.
translation_verse: Bɔkwa waa he ta so peera nɔ baah nɔ? Peteɡra la foola baa foola dɛɛ yerɛ ba peera laanee hɛɛ no kɛɛ? Rubin dea tena bini peɡro, ba ta wone la.

english_verse: The people of Gilead stayed across the Jordan. Why did the tribe of Dan remain on their ships and the tribe of Asher stay along the coast near the harbors?
translation_verse: Gelead tena soɡe Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ, asɛ Dan dea tena ta do bela stiimaere aa dɛ chuɡe. Aasa dea tena ɡe ka mpo nyoa dɛ den so bela.

english_verse: But soldiers of Zebulun and Naphtali risked their lives to attack the enemy.
translation_verse: Sebulon ne Naftale dea tena kpɔ ba nyu charɛ seo dɛ do laa ta.

english_verse: Canaanite kings fought us at Taanach by the stream near Megiddo— but they couldn't rob us of our silver.
translation_verse: Koranar balɔ dɛ ba yo, Keenan harɛ ta koranar balɔ dɛ ba yo. Ba baa yo Taanak waa bɛne nenabɔɔ Meɡido, kɛ ba ta wone kpɔ suuɡapoŋa kɛɛ komɛlbwa laa la ta.

english_verse: From their pathways in the sky the stars fought Sisera,
translation_verse: Hale weweela kwara aa lɔ nyundua, iro dɛɛ yo Sisera.

english_verse: and his soldiers were swept away by the ancient Kishon River. I will march on and be brave.
translation_verse: Kesɔn Moo palɛ laa tena kaa, Kesɔn Moo waa lole saŋ la bwa lɔ ba kaa. Mɛɛ kaa bambikpeɡ nee!

english_verse: The Lord's angel said, “Put a curse on Meroz Town! Its people refused to help the Lord fight his powerful enemies.”
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Taah Mɛrɔs bwɛ, dɛ́ taah nɛra baa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta kohona. Ba ta Korowii ba chae. Ba ta leɛ dɛ ba yo Korowii dɔma ba bwara aa kpeɡa.’

english_verse: But honor Jael, the wife of Heber from the Kenite clan. Give more honor to her than to any other woman who lives in tents. Yes, give more honor to her than to any other woman.
translation_verse: Haah waa na som bwaa Jael, Ken te Heba haah. Onee na som haahna baa soɡe tɛnte deene bini bwa nɛ.

english_verse: Sisera asked for water, but Jael gave him milk— cream in a fancy cup.
translation_verse: Sisera soŋe nee Jael be, o tɛo na-elne o nyɔ. Numol o fe aa chɛ nɛnjena binii o do na-elne aa soma tɛo.

english_verse: She reached for a tent-peg and held a hammer in her right hand. And with a blow to the head, she crushed his skull.
translation_verse: Jael kpɔ nɔŋɡal kpɔ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ baŋre tɛnte la, dɛ kpɔ nɔndiɡ kpɔ hamba, dɛ kpɔ lɔ Sisera lwɛɛma, dɛ laa o nyu paɡre.

english_verse: Sisera sank to his knees and fell dead at her feet.
translation_verse: Jael naa lɔɡree o chole. Waa chola la belaa o sewɛ dɛ sɔɔh chɔ.

english_verse: Sisera's mother looked out through her window. “Why is he taking so long?” she asked. “Why haven't we heard his chariots coming?”
translation_verse: Sisera nya cheɡɛ tokoro ta dɛ nyiŋi bojaŋ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ Sisera biɡri o ta balɛ mɔɔ nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ yaa wola torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la ɡbɔɡa noɛ mɔɔ nɔɔ?’

english_verse: “Sisera and his troops are finding treasures to bring back— a woman, or maybe two, for each man, and beautiful dresses for those women to wear.”
translation_verse: ‘Ba ken pa laa ta kwaa dɛɛ bɔna, baa bɛlbwa dɔ haah beŋkpoŋ kɛɛ banɛ, Sisera ɡe dɔ laaladɛɛɡa baa sɔh kwaa dawɛ a ta, haahna laaladɛɛɡa aa wera dɛ́ ba tɛ mɛ. Anɔ bwa ɛ kwaa baa paa laa ta.’

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that all your enemies will die like Sisera. But let everyone who loves you shine brightly like the sun at dawn. Midian Steals Everything from Israel There was peace in Israel for about
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel he dɔma bwa serewe, Kɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyini la, ɡel ba dɔ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ wee yon le kpeɡri nɛɛ la.” Ate, deŋnesɔɔhna ba harɛ la ta bene fifraanaarɛ.

english_verse: Then once again the Israelites started disobeying the Lord, so he let the nation of Midian control Israel for seven years.
translation_verse: Israel tena berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ja, asɛ o kpɔ ba do Midian tena nɔn ta ba di kpeɡri ba nɛɛ bene anuanɛ.

english_verse: Every time the Israelites planted crops, the Midianites invaded Israel together with the Amalekites and other eastern nations.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa Israel tena la aa parɛ ba kooni dɛ du kwaa la, ɡɛɛ Midian ne Amalɛk tena dɛ harɛre aa lɔ wee leebɔr nɛra yon ka jo harɛ la ta dɛ́ lɛ dɔɔh.

english_verse: They rode in on their camels, set up their tents, and then let their livestock eat the crops as far as the town of Gaza. The Midianites stole food, sheep, cattle, and donkeys. Like a swarm of locusts, they could not be counted, and they ruined the land wherever they went.
translation_verse: Ba cheɡɛ ba tɛnte deene ba ne ba kondɛɛra fuɡe le aa, ba do kɛŋɔ tontombɛ ken. Haa won kure ba ne ba nyoɡmare. Ba dɛ so harɛ la ta dɛ́ chɔɡ ba kwaa bwa.

english_verse: The Midianites took almost everything that belonged to the Israelites, and the Israelites begged the Lord for help.
translation_verse: Israel tena aa wia no Korowii Midian tena waa la,

english_verse: I am your God, and I told you not to worship Amorite gods, even though you are living in the land of the Amorites. But you refused to listen. The Lord Chooses Gideon
translation_verse: N ŋɔ he be kɛŋɔ menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ. He bɛ Amɔre tena haa soɡe ba harɛ ta voɡare la dɛɛ tomɛ. Kɛ he vɛh n waa la noe.”

english_verse: One day an angel from the Lord went to the town of Ophrah and sat down under the big tree that belonged to Joash, a member of the Abiezer clan. Joash's son Gideon was nearby, threshing grain in a shallow pit, where he could not be seen by the Midianites.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, Korowii nyundua torome baa so dajen bɛl mun bwɛɛ Ofra. Gɛ daa la ɛ Abeɛsa te baa dɛ yerɔ Joas kon. Dɛ o bibaa Gedeɔn sɔɔh dɛɛ lɔ mea daa la mun bobɛl baa dɛ harame daa nɔna baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen, ásɛ Midian tena la bɛ on na.

english_verse: The angel appeared and spoke to Gideon, “The Lord is helping you, and you are a strong warrior.”
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome la kpɔ o te baɡle Gedeɔn, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Banyoo, Korowii ja he nɛ.”

english_verse: Gideon answered, “Please don't take this wrong, but if the Lord is helping us, then why have all of these awful things happened? We've heard how the Lord performed miracles and rescued our ancestors from Egypt. But those things happened long ago. Now the Lord has abandoned us to the Midianites.”
translation_verse: Anee o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, dɛ Korowii ja ya nɛ aa, ɛrɛɛ anɔ bwa berɛ pu yaa nɔɔ? Nyokpowaa ya naawa aa bol a waa baɡle yaa ŋɔ Korowii ɛa dɛ lɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la, ɛrɛɛ waa wola ane ɛɛ ya ɡe na nɔɔ? Taraken o ta yaa, dɛ kpɔ yaa do Midian tena nɔn ta.”

english_verse: Then the Lord himself said, “Gideon, you will be strong, because I am giving you the power to rescue Israel from the Midianites.”
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ɡbabir ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gedeɔn, menee dɛɛ tomɛ. Kpɔ bokpeɡa haa dɔa la ka lɛ Israel tena le Midian tena nɔn ta.”

english_verse: Gideon replied, “But how can I rescue Israel? My clan is the weakest one in Manasseh, and everyone else in my family is more important than I am.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Gedeɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won lɛɛ baɔ? Manasɛ dea tena bini la, n dem nɛraa ɡwɛɡra, asɛ n lolanar ɡe be pera la, n toole wobɛlbwa bini.”

english_verse: “Gideon,” the Lord answered, “you can rescue Israel because I am going to help you! Defeating the Midianites will be as easy as beating up one man.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ ásɛ he kpoo Midian tena bwa, kɛŋɔ haa yo nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ken.”

english_verse: Gideon said, “It's hard to believe that I'm actually talking to the Lord. Please do something so I'll know that you really are the Lord.
translation_verse: Anee Gedeɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ he sie lɛ n nɛ aa, ɛ waane ásɛ n jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee dɛɛ bol waa n be nɔ.

english_verse: And wait here until I bring you an offering.” “All right, I'll wait,” the Lord answered.
translation_verse: N poori so bonɔ ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba saraha kwaa ne ba tɛɛ.” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ soo ka tel kɛŋɔ haa ba.”

english_verse: Gideon went home and killed a young goat, then started boiling the meat. Next, he opened a big sack of flour and made it into thin bread. When the meat was done, he put it in a basket and poured the broth into a clay cooking pot. He took the meat, the broth, and the bread and placed them under the big tree.
translation_verse: Gedeɔn kaa kpo bohlor dɛ daalo, dɛ kpɔ men kuruware fi ɛ paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta. O pa ola la do wɛɡrɛ bini, asɛ dɛ fuɡe yooma la do vii bini, dɛ kpɔ ba tɛo dajen la mun.

english_verse: God's angel said, “Gideon, put the meat and the bread on this rock, and pour the broth over them.” Gideon did as he was told.
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ ola la ne paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta la ba chɔŋɛ bwe nɔ ta, dɛ́ fuɡe yooma la do ola la ta.” Asɛ Gedeɔn ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: The angel was holding a walking stick, and he touched the meat and the bread with the end of the stick. Flames jumped from the rock and burned up the meat and the bread. When Gideon looked, the angel was gone.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii nyundua torome la kpoŋe daŋɡbala bɛl. O kpɔ daŋɡbala la nyoa leɡe ola la ne paanoo la, asɛ nii le bwe la ta dɛ fuh ola la ne paanoo la bwa. Asɛ Korowii nyundua torome la den nyoɡre le o sie kaa.

english_verse: Gideon realized that he had seen one of the Lord's angels. “Oh!” he moaned. “Now I'm going to die.”
translation_verse: Gedeɔn aa baa na kɛŋɔ Korowii nyundua toromee la, o do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ, “Ei! Nemenɛ Korowii, n ne he nyundua torome sie ɡba dɔŋa.”

english_verse: “Calm down!” the Lord told Gideon. “There's nothing to be afraid of. You're not going to die.”
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Sɔɔh bwara! Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, haa sewa ba.”

english_verse: Gideon built an altar for worshiping the Lord and called it “The Lord Calms Our Fears.” It still stands there in Ophrah, a town in the territory of the Abiezer clan. Gideon Tears Down Baal's Altar
translation_verse: Anomanta, Gedeɔn ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii bela dɛ pa o sɔn ŋɔ, ‘Korowiirii Deŋnesɔɔhna’. Kpoŋe ba le fini, kon la ta cheɡɛ Abeɛsa dea tena bwɛɛ Ofra.

english_verse: That night the Lord spoke to Gideon again: Get your father's second-best bull, the one that's seven years old. Use it to pull down the altar where your father worships Baal and cut down the sacred pole next to the altar.
translation_verse: Awola jwaana la tenten Korowii ŋɔ Gedeɔn be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ he mɛɛ nabal, ne nabal bɛl waa di bene anuanɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ ka ɛ we-ɛɛla, dɛ́ kuuɡi kon he mɛɛ aa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Baal, ásɛ dɛ teŋe voɡhaah Asera dajaŋ waa cheɡɛ o jwɛɛh la ta,

english_verse: Then build an altar for worshiping me on the highest part of the hill where your town is built. Use layers of stones for my altar, not just a pile of rocks. Cut up the wood from the pole, make a fire, kill the bull, and burn it as a sacrifice to me.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ pa bwea darawe dɔŋa nɛ, dɛ́ ɛ saraha kon waa chɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la deŋɡare nɔ doa. Kpɔ voɡ Asera daa haa teŋa ta la dawɛ saraha kon la ta, dɛ́ fuh nabal nɛɛte la, dɛ́ ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.”

english_verse: Gideon chose ten of his servants to help him, and they did everything God had said. But since Gideon was afraid of his family and the other people in Ophrah, he did it all at night.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Gedeɔn kpɔ o bonɔɔna la bini fi dɛ ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa bol o be la. Kɛ waa dɛ ɔmɛ o dem nɛra ne bwɛɛ la baala la nomanta, o ta an webaŋa ɛɛ dɛ ɛa jwaana.

english_verse: When the people of the town got up the next morning, they saw that Baal's altar had been knocked over, and the sacred pole next to it had been cut down. Then they noticed the new altar covered with the remains of the sacrificed bull.
translation_verse: Bwɛɛ la tena aa ira chɔɔ la, ba nao kɛŋɔ ba kuuɡi voɡ Baal saraha kon la, dɛ teŋe voɡ Asera dajaŋ waa cheɡɛ o jwɛɛh la, dɛ berɛ fuh nabal nɛɛte saraha konfale la ta.

english_verse: “Who could have done such a thing?” they asked. And they kept on asking, until finally someone told them, “Gideon the son of Joash did it.”
translation_verse: Anee baa bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Umee baa ɛ ken nɔɔ?” Ba nyiŋi waa la ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ Joas bibaa Gedeɔnee ɛa.
