english_verse: I just want to talk with you.” “All right,” she told him, “go ahead.”
translation_verse: dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Waanee mɛɛ ba bá bol he be.” Ate, Batsiiba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa yɔ?”

english_verse: “You know that I was king for a little while,” Adonijah replied. “And everyone in Israel accepted me as their ruler. But the Lord wanted my brother to be king, so now things have changed.
translation_verse: Anee Adonija ŋɔ, “He jemɔ kɛŋɔ kora la fa ɛ n kon, n nɛɛ Israel tena bwa sie dawɛ kɛŋɔ menee dɛ́ ɛ ba kooro. Kɛ waa la sie berɔ, asɛ a ɛ kɛŋɔ n nime di, dɛkalkɛ Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ.

english_verse: Would you do me a favor?” “What do you want?” Bathsheba asked.
translation_verse: Taraken, kombeŋkpoŋii mɛɛ soŋe dɛ́ le he be, kɛ bɛ men vɔmɛ.” Anee Batsiiba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa yɔ?”

english_verse: “Please ask Solomon to let me marry Abishag. He won't say no to you.”
translation_verse: Adonija ŋɔ, “Soŋe Kooro Solomɔn tɛ mɛ ásɛ o kpɔ Abisaɡ, Sunem te la tɛ mɛ ń mo. N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he bolaa, wɛɛ sɛoh.”

english_verse: “All right,” she said. “I'll ask him.”
translation_verse: Ate, Batsiiba chaŋe ŋɔ, “A wer, mɛɛ soŋe kooroo tɛɛ.”

english_verse: When Bathsheba went to see Solomon, he stood up to meet her, then bowed low. He sat back down and had another throne brought in, so his mother could sit at his right side.
translation_verse: Ate, Batsiiba la Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ o dɛ la ka bol Adonija waa la tɛo. Kooro iro ka chemo, dɛ ɡuŋu harɛ dɛ berɛ ka so o kookara ta. Ba kpɔ kookara bɛl ɡe ka cheɡ kooro nomombɔr diɡ ta, asɛ o nya ka so o ta.

english_verse: Bathsheba sat down and then asked, “Would you do me a small favor?” Solomon replied, “Mother, just tell me what you want, and I will do it.”
translation_verse: Batsiiba ŋɔ, “Wejeɡa bɛl nee n ba dɛ́ ba soŋe, bɛ men vɔmɛ.” Anee kooro ŋɔ, “N nya bol, maa hen vɔmɛ.”

english_verse: “Allow your brother Adonijah to marry Abishag,” she answered.
translation_verse: Asɛ Batsiiba ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin he lawɛ Sunem tolo Abisaɡ tɛ he dɔɔ Adonija ó mo.”

english_verse: Solomon said: What? Let my older brother marry Abishag? You may as well ask me to let him rule the kingdom! And why don't you ask such favors for Abiathar and Joab?
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Solomɔn chaŋe o nya ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ soŋe Abisaɡ Sunem te nɔ dɛɛ tɛ Adonija ó mo nɔɔ? Den bol kora la waa ɡe tɛo, on ɡee n dɔɔ. Bol tɛ o ne sɔfo Abiata ne Seruya bibaa Joab, dɛkalkɛ ba bwa teŋɛ o nɛ.”

english_verse: I swear in the name of the Lord that Adonijah will die because he asked for this! If he doesn't, I pray that God will severely punish me.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro ŋwɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ Adonija ta o nyu kpɔe bol o wesoŋa nɔ wa aa, Korowii tɛr n deŋne kohona ɡɛ bwa aa chɛa.

english_verse: The Lord made me king in my father's place and promised that the kings of Israel would come from my family. Yes, I swear by the living Lord that Adonijah will die today.
translation_verse: N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole dɛ kpɔ mɛ chiɡ n mɛɛ Devid buɡ ta kiŋkiŋ kɛŋɔ kooro, dɛ tɛ n ne n naanar ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la, a chɛ kɛ bá kpo Adonija fini ɡbo.”

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “go kill Adonijah.” So Adonijah died. Abiathar Is Sent Back Home
translation_verse: Anomanta, Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ka kpo Adonija. Sɔfo Abiata lawa dɛ́ kaa harɛfale ta ne Joab seo wa

english_verse: Solomon sent for Abiathar the priest and said: Abiathar, go back home to Anathoth! You ought to be killed too, but I won't do it now. When my father David was king, you were in charge of the sacred chest, and you went through a lot of hard times with my father.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn ŋɔ Sɔfo Abiata be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kaa he bwɛ, Anatɔt harɛ ta. He chɛ kpoe, kɛ maa hen kpo taraken, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ n mɛɛ Devid aa ɛ kooro la, dɛ henee dɛɛ che Nemenɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, dɛ berɛ na wahala n mɛɛ aa naa la ane.”

english_verse: But I won't let you be a priest of the Lord anymore. And so the promise that the Lord had made at Shiloh about the family of Eli came true. Joab Is Killed
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do Kooro Solomɔn le Abiata sɔfore dii ta, dɛ ɡel waa Korowii aa bola Silo, a ɛ sɔfo Eli dem waa la ɛ kpela.

english_verse: Joab had not helped Absalom try to become king, but he had helped Adonijah. So when Joab learned that Adonijah had been killed, he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.
translation_verse: Joab aa wola Absalɔm chae o di kora dɛ cha Adonija la, waa noa kɛŋɔ ba kpo Adonija la, o chwao ka jo Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bini, dɛ ka lawɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare dɛ paaɡe kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta loŋkoni la kpoŋe.

english_verse: When Solomon heard about this, he sent someone to ask Joab, “Why did you run to the altar?” Joab sent back his answer, “I was afraid of you, and I ran to the Lord for protection.” Then Solomon shouted, “Benaiah, go kill Joab!”
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn noɔ kɛŋɔ Joab chwao ka marɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bini. Anomanta, o do Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ŋɔ, “La ka kpo Joab!”

english_verse: Benaiah went to the sacred tent and yelled, “Joab, the king orders you to come out!” “No!” Joab answered. “Kill me right here.” Benaiah went back and told Solomon what Joab had said.
translation_verse: Asɛ Bɛnaya la Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela dɛ ka ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ “Kooro ŋɔ, ‘Le ba.’ ” Anee o ŋɔ, “Akai, bonɔɔ mɛɛ ba sewa.” Ate, Bɛnaya berɛ kaa kooro be dɛ ka ŋɔ waa Joab aa bola la.

english_verse: Solomon replied: Do what Joab said. Kill him and bury him! Then my family and I won't be responsible for what he did to Abner the commander of Israel's army and to Amasa the commander of Judah's army. He killed those innocent men without my father knowing about it. Both of them were better men than Joab. Now the Lord will make him pay for those murders.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ bɔɔ kem nɛra waa kpoo ba la waa, dɛkalkɛ o le n mɛɛ habɔɔ dɛ ka yo nɛra banɛ dɛ kpoo ba kere ne. Banee, Nɛr bibaa Abna waa ɛ Israel laa sitɔɔ, ne Jɛta bibaa Amasa o ɡe aa ɛ Juda laa sitɔɔ. Dɛ ɡɛ nɛra la do kaih dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ɡwaalo.

english_verse: Benaiah went back and killed Joab. His body was taken away and buried near his home in the desert.
translation_verse: Asɛ Bɛnaya berɛ la Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela, dɛ ka kpo Joab dɛ kpɔɔ le ka huɡe o ɡbaɡba dem pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Solomon put Benaiah in Joab's place as army commander, and he put Zadok in Abiathar's place as priest. Shimei Is Killed
translation_verse: Kooro kpɔ Bɛnaya chiɡ Joab naa ta kɛŋɔ laa sitɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ Sadɔk chiɡ sɔfo Abiata ɡe naa ta. Simei seo wa

english_verse: Solomon sent for Shimei and said, “Build a house here in Jerusalem and live in it. But whatever you do, don't leave the city!
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba ka yerɛ Simei ba tɛo, asɛ o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ma dem Jerusalam bonɔ dɛ so, dɛ bɛ bobɛlbwa kaa.

english_verse: If you ever cross Kidron Valley and leave Jerusalem, you will be killed. And it will be your own fault.”
translation_verse: Awola haa le Jerusalam, dɛ́ ka ɡale Kedrɔn nenabɔjen la, jemɛ kɛŋɔ he sewee, dɛ he ɡbaɡbaa nyin he seo.”

english_verse: “That's fair, Your Majesty,” Shimei answered. “I'll do that.” So Shimei lived in Jerusalem from then on.
translation_verse: Asɛ Simei chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, waa haa bola nɔ wer, men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa bola laanee.” Anomanta, o soɡe Jerusalam biɡri.

english_verse: About three years later, two of Shimei's servants ran off to King Achish in Gath. When Shimei found out where they were,
translation_verse: Bene atoro habɔɔ la, Simei yoma bini banɛ bane chwao ka do Maaka bie Kooro Akis be Gat, asɛ Simei aa noa kɛŋɔ ba lɔ Gat la,

english_verse: Someone told Solomon that Shimei had gone to Gath and was back.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn aa noa kɛŋɔ Simei le Jerusalam kaa Gat dɛ berɛ ba la,

english_verse: Solomon sent for him and said: Shimei, you promised in the name of the Lord that you would never leave Jerusalem. I warned you that you would die if you did. You agreed that this was fair, didn't you?
translation_verse: o tomɔ ba ka yerɔ asɛ o bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N ta hen kaeh dɛ ɡel he ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ awola haa le Jerusalam dɛ́ kaa bobɛlbwa la, jemɛ kɛŋɔ he sewee, asɛ he ŋɔ he noɔ la aa?

english_verse: You have disobeyed me and have broken the promise you made to the Lord.
translation_verse: Aah ɛrɛ waa haa wola ɡɛ haa ŋwɛɛra baɡle Korowii la ta teŋɛ, dɛ vɛh waa maa doe a ta nɔɔ?

english_verse: I know you remember all the cruel things you did to my father David. Now the Lord is going to punish you for what you did.
translation_verse: He ɡbabir jemɛ chɔɡre haa di n mɛɛ Kooro Devid. Korowii ɛɛ tɛr he deŋne a waa.

english_verse: But the Lord will bless me and make my father's kingdom strong forever.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ɛɛ swee mɛ andɛɛɡaa, dɛ́ ɡel n mɛɛ Kooro Devid kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “kill Shimei.” So Shimei died. Solomon was now in complete control of his kingdom.
translation_verse: Asɛ kooro yerɛ Bɛnaya ŋɔ ó ba lawɛ Simei le buse dɛ́ ka kpoo. Ásɛ name te kora la che Solomɔn nɔn ta kiŋkiŋ ken.

english_verse: At that time, there was no temple for worshiping the Lord, and everyone offered sacrifices at the local shrines.
translation_verse: Baa wola Korowii Dea mae mɔɔ la, dɛ deŋɡarere taa baa ɛ sarahare.

english_verse: I'll also give you what you didn't ask for. You'll be rich and respected as long as you live, and you'll be greater than any other king.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔ tɛɛ anɔ la ɡe haa wola soŋɛɛ, mɛɛ tɛɛ suuɡa ne jirima kohonaa he soɡa bini bwa he dɔŋ aa wola lee do koranar bwa bini.

english_verse: Solomon loved the Lord and followed his father David's instructions, but Solomon also offered sacrifices and burned incense at the shrines.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Devid aa ŋɔa la ta, dɛ baɡle nyina waa dɛ nyin Korowii, kɛ dɛ deŋɡarere baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa doree o ɡe ɛɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma dɛɛ ɛ sarahare.

english_verse: One night while Solomon was in Gibeon, the Lord God appeared to him in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Waa lɔ Gebeɔn bela la, Korowii ba o be jwaana deera ta dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baɡle komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin ásɛ n kpɔ tɛɛ.”

english_verse: Solomon answered: My father David, your servant, was honest and did what you commanded. You were always loyal to him, and you gave him a son who is now king.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “He nyin n mɛɛ Kooro Devid waa ɛ he bonɔɔ kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ, o waa toɡrɔ o tea ɡe to. He teŋɛ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ta, dɛ tɛo bibaa o chiɡ o naa ta, dɛɛ di kora fini nɔ.

english_verse: Lord God, I'm your servant, and you've made me king in my father's place. But I'm very young and know so little about being a leader.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he ɡelɔ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ chiɡ n mɛɛ naa ta dɛɛ di kora. Kɛ n nɔn ta kao, maa n sie ne habɔɔ jemɛ.

english_verse: And now I must rule your chosen people, even though there are too many of them to count.
translation_verse: He bonɔɔ ja nɛndamanta haa lee ba tɛ he te baa wola nyoa dɔe bini bonɔ.

english_verse: Please make me wise and teach me the difference between right and wrong. Then I will know how to rule your people. If you don't, there is no way I could rule this great nation of yours.
translation_verse: Anomanta, tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ wejema, dɛ́ ɡel n jemɛ wechɔɡa ne wedɛɛɡa. Ɛrɛɛ n ɡbo ɛɛ ba wona nyiŋi he nɛra baa wara ken nɔ nɛɔ?”

english_verse: God said: Solomon, I'm pleased that you asked for this. You could have asked to live a long time or to be rich. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom to make right decisions.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ haa soŋa haa wola mkpajaŋ kɛɛ he ɡbaɡba kondɔɔh soŋɛ kɛɛ he dɔma serewe, kɛ dɛ soŋe wejema dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne nɔ,

english_verse: If you obey me and follow my commands, as your father David did, I'll let you live a long time.
translation_verse: Dɛ hɛɛ dɛɛ yarada mɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ta kɛ he mɛɛ Kooro Devid aa ɛa la aa, mɛɛ tɛɛ mkpajaŋee.”

english_verse: Solomon woke up and realized that God had spoken to him in the dream. He went back to Jerusalem and stood in front of the sacred chest, where he offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. Then Solomon gave a feast for his officials. Solomon Makes a Difficult Decision
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Solomɔn har dom ta dɛ na kɛŋɔ deeraa o dee. Asɛ o ba Jerusalam dɛ la ka che Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, dɛ fuh kwaa ɛ saraha ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ Korowii. A habɔɔ, o ɛ kondikonjena, dɛ ta nɔn yerɛ o nomonome bwa. Kooro Solomɔn pa bole bɛl aŋwɛnɛ ta

english_verse: One day two women came to King Solomon,
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, hanjwamanere banɛ bane lawɛ dɔŋa ba Kooro Solomɔn be.

english_verse: and one of them said: Your Majesty, this woman and I live in the same house. Not long ago my baby was born at home,
translation_verse: Beŋkpoŋ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro kaforachɛ, n ne n dɔŋ nɔɔ pɛa so dembeŋkpoŋ ta. N lolɛ bibaa o siwi ta.

english_verse: and three days later her baby was born. Nobody else was there with us.
translation_verse: Maa lola tɔpetooro wee la, o ɡe lolɛ bibaa. Nomɛlbwa ta ya nɛɛ jae dem bela, ya ɡboo.

english_verse: One night while we were all asleep, she rolled over on her baby, and he died.
translation_verse: Ya bwa aa chɔa jwaana la, o ɡbilo ɛɡɛ o bie nɛɛ o sewɛ.

english_verse: Then while I was still asleep, she got up and took my son out of my bed. She put him in her bed, then she put her dead baby next to me.
translation_verse: Jwaana la ne la, o iro dɛ ba kpɔ n bie la ka bil o jwɛh, dɛ kpɔ o kon waa sewa la ba bil n jwɛh.

english_verse: In the morning when I got up to feed my son, I saw that he was dead. But when I looked at him in the light, I knew he wasn't my son.
translation_verse: Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ n kpɔɔ ŋɔ o ɔr dɛ o sewɔ. Maa kpɔɔ le bochaah ta dɛ peseo la, dɛ n bie la laa.”

english_verse: “No!” the other woman shouted. “He was your son. My baby is alive!” “The dead baby is yours,” the first woman yelled. “Mine is alive!” They argued back and forth in front of Solomon,
translation_verse: Ate, hanɛɛte la ŋɔ, “Akai, n bie siwii lole la, he konee sewa la.” Sitɔ te la ɡe ŋɔ, “Akai, he konee sewa la, n kon siwii lole la.” Gɛɛ ba tɔŋle waa la kooro siwi ta.

english_verse: Someone bring me a sword.” A sword was brought, and Solomon ordered,
translation_verse: Kooro berɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la be ŋɔ, “Hé tɛ mɛ kere.” Asɛ ba kpɔ kere ba tɛo.

english_verse: “Cut the baby in half! That way each of you can have part of him.”
translation_verse: Anee o ŋɔ, “Hé pere bie waa wola sewɛ la bini dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl tɛ onɔ, dɛ kpɔ bɛl tɛ onɔ ɡe.”

english_verse: “Please don't kill my son,” the baby's mother screamed. “Your Majesty, I love him very much, but give him to her. Just don't kill him.” The other woman shouted, “Go ahead and cut him in half. Then neither of us will have the baby.”
translation_verse: Belaa haah la o bie aa ɛ onɔ la waa wola sewɛ la tea domɔ o ŋɔ, “Akai, N naa kooro, he bɛ on kpo, he kpɔɔ tɛ n dɔŋ la.” Nɛɛte la ŋɔ, “A wer ɡa, waa won ɛ he kon kɛɛ n kon, bɔne o bini tɛ yaa!”

english_verse: Solomon said, “Don't kill the baby.” Then he pointed to the first woman, “She is his real mother. Give the baby to her.”
translation_verse: Ate, kooro la ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ bie la tɛ haah waa ŋɔa ya bɛ on kpo la, bie la nyaa.”

english_verse: Everyone in Israel was amazed when they heard how Solomon had made his decision. They realized that God had given him wisdom to judge fairly.
translation_verse: Israel tena bwa aa no ɡɛ Kooro Solomɔn aa pa bole la, a ɛɛ ba nyokpoa, ba na kɛŋɔ Korowiirii tɛo wejema o kpɔ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta la.

english_verse: Solomon chose twelve regional officers, who took turns bringing food for him and his household. Each officer provided food from his region for one month of the year.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn le nomonome fi dɛ banɛ ba chɔ harɛre nyoo Israel bwa. Ba tomaa kɛŋɔ bá lɛ kondikwaa le nɛra be baa tɛ kooro ne o dem tena. Nomonome la bɛlbwa dɔ korobie beŋkpoŋ dɛ́ kpɔ kondikwa ba tɛ kooro benanyoa bɛlbwa.

english_verse: These were the twelve officers: The son of Hur was in charge of the hill country of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra la sɔnaa teŋa nɔ, Bɛn Hur chɔ a ɡɛ kondikwaa la waa ta deŋɡarere harɛ bwɛɛre aa lɔ Efrem harɛ.

english_verse: The son of Deker was in charge of the towns of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-Shemesh, and Elon-Beth-Hanan.
translation_verse: Bɛn Deka chɔ bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Makas ne Saalabim ne Bɛt Sɛmɛs dɛ Ɛlɔn Bɛt Hanan nyoa.

english_verse: The son of Abinadab was in charge of Naphath-Dor and was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath.
translation_verse: Bɛn Abinadab chɔ Nafɔt Dɔr harɛ bwa nyoa, dɛ o mo Kooro Solomɔn bihaah baa dɛ yerɔ Tafat.

english_verse: The son of Geber was in charge of the town of Ramoth in Gilead and the villages in Gilead belonging to the family of Jair, a descendant of Manasseh. He was also in charge of the region of Argob in Bashan, which had
translation_verse: Bɛn Gɛba chɔ bwɛjen Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta nyoa, dɛ Jɛɛ dea tena, o ɛ Manasɛ naa, bwɛɛre aa lɔ bela, ne Aaɡob harɛ waa lɔ Basan. A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fifraanumɛl baa ma danjwɛjena bara, dɛ kpɔ ayaawa kwaa a doonyoo bune.

english_verse: Ahinadab son of Iddo was in charge of the territory of Mahanaim.
translation_verse: Ido bibaa Ahinadab chɔ Mahanaim harɛ nyoa.

english_verse: Ahimaaz was in charge of the territory of Naphtali and was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath.
translation_verse: Ahimas chɔ Naftale harɛ nyoa. Dɛ o mo Kooro Solomɔn bihaah baa dɛ yerɔ Basemat.

english_verse: Baana son of Hushai was in charge of the territory of Asher and the town of Bealoth.
translation_verse: Husai bibaa Baana chɔ Aasa harɛ ne bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Bealɔt nyoa.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah was in charge of the territory of Issachar.
translation_verse: Parua bibaa Jehosafat chɔ Isaaka dea harɛ nyoa.

english_verse: Shimei son of Ela was in charge of the territory of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ela bibaa Simei chɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ nyoa.

english_verse: Geber son of Uri was in charge of Gilead, where King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan had lived. And one officer was in charge of the territory of Judah. The Size of Solomon's Kingdom
translation_verse: Uri bibaa Gɛba chɔ Gelead harɛ nyoa. Bela fa ɛ Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ harɛre. Dɛ Gɛba ɡboo dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta. Kooro Solomɔn kondɔɔh ne o kora dii

english_verse: Solomon ruled every kingdom between the Euphrates River and the land of the Philistines down to Egypt. These kingdoms paid him taxes as long as he lived.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn harɛ waa di kora o ta la le Yufretis Moo ta, dɛ kaa Filisti tena harɛ, dɛ ka le Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta. Dɛ ɡɛ harɛre la bwa nɛra kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa baa tɛo, dɛ kpɔ ba te do o lɔɡa ɡɛ saŋ waa di kora bwa.

english_verse: Solomon ruled the whole region west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and he was at peace with all of the countries around him.
translation_verse: Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ bwa taa Solomɔn di kora. Le Tifsa teŋe kaa wee cholibɔr ka tel Bwɛjen Gasa, dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna lɔ harɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: Everyone living in Israel, from the town of Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, was safe as long as Solomon lived. Each family sat undisturbed beneath its own grape vines and fig trees.
translation_verse: O ta aa soɡe le la, dɛ nɛra baa soɡe Juda ne Israel harɛ bwa ta ɡɛ saŋ lɔ bosɔɔhna ta. Le Dan dea harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ́ ba kaa Beɛseeba o ɡe aa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr. Dɛ dea bɛlbwa nɛra dɔ bosɔɔhna, dɛ dɔ fiɡ ne ɡrepo daa kooni.

english_verse: Each of the twelve regional officers brought food to Solomon and his household for one month of the year. They provided everything he needed,
translation_verse: Nomonome fi dɛ banɛ baa lɛ kondikwaa baa tɛ Kooro Solomɔn ne o dem tena korobie bɛlbwa la, ba a ne baa tɛ o ne nɛra baa ba o be baa di kondikwaa bwa. Ba ta ɡelɛ kondikwa ɛɛ paŋɔ.

english_verse: Solomon was brilliant. God had blessed him with insight and understanding.
translation_verse: Korowii tɛ Kooro Solomɔn wejema ne waa mun noe kohona aa wola nyoa dɔe kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.

english_verse: He was wiser than anyone else in the world, including the wisest people of the east and of Egypt. He was even wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Mahol's three sons, Heman, Calcol, and Darda. Solomon became famous in every country around Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Dɛ o jemɛ waa ɡwaa nomɛlbwa. O ɡwaa Etan waa ɛ Esera te ne Mahɔl bibaala Heman ne Kalkol dɛ Daada. O sɔn leɔ kohona harɛre aa bar ba la bwa ta.

english_verse: He could talk about all kinds of plants, from large trees to small bushes, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.
translation_verse: Dɛ o jemɛ daa ne kpɔɡa waa kɛrɛdɛ, hale o baɡle peleme daa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn dɛ hesɔp aa moɡa tɔ danjwɛɛre ta, ne ola ne jumbii ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh dɛ pɛŋa bwa wa.

english_verse: Kings all over the world heard about Solomon's wisdom and sent people to listen to him teach.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa no o wejema waa dɔa wa, dɛ tomɛ nɛra ba la o be kaa no.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre had always been friends with Solomon's father David. When Hiram learned that Solomon was king, he sent some of his officials to meet with Solomon.
translation_verse: Dɛ Taaya Kooro Hiram chamenatee Kooro Devid, anomanta, waa noa kɛŋɔ ba cheɡ Solomɔn kora o so o mɛɛ Kooro Devid buɡ ta la, o tomɛ o nomonome ba ba na Kooro Solomɔn.

english_verse: The Lord God promised my father that when his son became king, he would build a temple for worshiping the Lord. So I've decided to do that.
translation_verse: N ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ ń do dea tɛ Korowii, ɡɛ waa ŋɔ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, ‘He bie maa ba ɡel o so he buɡ ta dɛ́ di kora laanee dɛ́ do n Dea tɛ mɛ’ la.

english_verse: I'd like you to send your workers to cut down cedar trees in Lebanon for me. I will pay them whatever you say and will even have my workers help them. We both know that your workers are more experienced than anyone else at cutting lumber.
translation_verse: Anomanta, cha mɛ dɛ́ ɡel he nɛra ka teŋe peleme daa le Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta tɛ mɛ. Mɛɛ ɡeloo n nɛra ba ja he nɛra nɛ, ásɛ n bɔ he nɛra la kem ɡɛ bwa haa baɡle. He ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ta daa teŋa wejema dɔe ka ja he nɛra baa le bwɛjen Sidon ta nɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Hiram was so happy when he heard Solomon's request that he said, “I am grateful that the Lord gave David such a wise son to be king of that great nation!”
translation_verse: Kooro Hiram aa no Kooro Solomɔn kala nɔ la, o sie lɛo kohona o ŋɔ, “Fini, Korowii chɛ kpɛɛra kɛŋɔ waa tɛ Kooro Devid bibaa waa jemɛ waa ŋɔ ó nyiŋi Israel harɛ damanta nɔ ta nɔ.”

english_verse: Then he sent back his answer: I received your message and will give you all the cedar and pine logs you need.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ ɡe tomɛ nɛra Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “N no he wesoŋa la, mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin la bwaa dɛ tɛɛ peleme daa ne dadɛɛɡe te bɛlbwa.

english_verse: My workers will carry them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea. They will tie the logs together and float them along the coast to wherever you want them. Then they will untie the logs, and your workers can take them from there. To pay for the logs, you can provide the grain I need for my household.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo n nɛra le a ne Lɛbanɔn harɛ dɛ́ ba a ne mpo nyoa, dɛ́ ba vɔrɔwa pɛ dɛ́ taɡɛ do nee ta ba tɛɛ bela haa dɛ nyin, ásɛ dɛ pura he nɛra ba kpɔ kaa. Waa n ɡe aa dɛ nyin laanee kɛŋɔ he ɡe ba tɛ mɛ kondikwa ń tɛ n dem tena.”

english_verse: The Lord kept his promise and made Solomon wise. Hiram and Solomon signed a treaty and never went to war against each other. Solomon's Workers
translation_verse: Korowii tɛ Kooro Solomɔn wejema ɡɛ waa bola la. O ne Kooro Hiram baah do wer, asɛ ba fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔo.

english_verse: He ordered the workers to cut and shape large blocks of good stone for the foundation of the temple.
translation_verse: Kooro do tom-ɛɛra la ba pɛɡre bwedɛɛɡa dɛ kwaa a bwara dɛ́ kpɔ pa Korowii Dea la mun.

english_verse: Solomon's and Hiram's men worked with men from the city of Gebal, and together they got the stones and logs ready for the temple.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn ne Kooro Hiram, dɛ nɛra baa le bwɛjen Gebal, dɛ dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema kwaa bwea ne daa baa kpɔ do Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: The windows were narrow on the outside but wide on the inside.
translation_verse: Tokorore aa lɔ Dea la ta la sie jeɡre o habɔɔ, asɛ o bini ɡe la, a ka do paɡri.

english_verse: Solomon put them next to each other in the most holy place. Their wings were spread out and reached across the room.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba kpɔa cheɡ dɔŋa jwɛh Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela. Ba ɛa a kena anɛ nyoo ɛɛ chuɡe danjwɛ, asɛ anɛ ɡe ba cheme dea la baah ta.

english_verse: The roof of the temple was made out of beams and cedar boards. The workers finished building the outside of the temple.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn ma Korowii Dea la tonɛ, dɛ kpɔ doli ne peleme daa tɔɔ.

english_verse: Along the sides and back of the temple, there were three levels of storage rooms. The rooms on the bottom level were just over two meters wide, the rooms on the middle level were over two and a half meters wide, and those on the top level were just over three meters wide. There were ledges on the outside of the temple that supported the beams of the storage rooms, so that nothing was built into the temple walls.
translation_verse: Deene aa lɔ harɛbɔr la paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, asɛ baah ta deene la ɡe paɡri ɛ naɡale anuanaarɛ, nyundua kwaa la ɡe paɡri ɛ naɡale fi ne tama. Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba bɛ bɔɔne ba foɡre Korowii Dea la danjwɛɛ ta la, ba kpɔ doli ɡo Korowii Dea la danjwɛɛ la ta a le baŋ, dɛ do deene la chɔŋre a ta.

english_verse: Solomon did not want the noise of hammers and axes to be heard at the place where the temple was being built. So he gave orders for the workers to shape the blocks of stone at the quarry.
translation_verse: Ba pɛɡre bwea baa kpɔ ma Korowii Dea la dɛ kwaara bela baa dɛ kwia mɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ ba, ɡɛ aa ɛ ba bɛ hambare ne kpanfɛre kɛɛ buni bɛlbwa ɡbɔɡa no Korowii Dea la bela.

english_verse: Storage rooms just over two meters high were all around the temple, and they were attached to the temple by cedar beams.
translation_verse: O do deene sarawe Korowii Dea la bar, dea la bɛlbwa jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, asɛ peleme daa doli le Korowii Dea la ta dɛ lawa kpoŋe.

english_verse: The Lord told Solomon:
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ,

english_verse: The floor of the temple was made out of pine, and the walls were lined with cedar from floor to ceiling.
translation_verse: O kpɔ dadɛɛɡa ane soo siwi sam le harɛ dɛ kpɔ peleme daa marɛ danjwɛɛ le harɛ ka le o nyundua baa ɡoo la bwa.

translation_verse: Ane a bwa, Israel Kooro Jɛroboam ta charɛ le o wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre la ta, dɛ teŋɛ le sɔfore bwa soo siwi baa lɔ bela dɛ ɛɛ ba kerekpoŋra voɡare aa lɔ deŋɡarere la ta. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o kpoŋe voɡ kere la, dɛ o cheɡo.

english_verse: This sinful thing led to the downfall of his kingdom.
translation_verse: Gɛ wechɔɡa nɔɔ ba Kooro Jɛroboam dem ne o kora chɔɡa ne harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: About the same time, Abijah son of Jeroboam got sick.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Jɛroboam bibaa Abija bwara dɛ weo,

english_verse: Jeroboam told his wife: Disguise yourself so no one will know you're my wife, then go to Shiloh, where the prophet Ahijah lives. Take him ten loaves of bread, some small cakes, and honey, and ask him what will happen to our son. He can tell you, because he's the one who told me I would become king.
translation_verse: Kpɔ paanoo fi, ne kwaa baa kpɔ noo koo a ta dɛ wɔɔra la ane, ne tooh loŋ del la o be, ɡɛ bwa aa dɛ ba bie la chiɡa la, wɛɛ baɡlee.”

english_verse: She got ready and left for Ahijah's house in Shiloh. Ahijah was now old and blind,
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro haah la ir dɛ ɛ ɡɛ kooro aa bola la, dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta la Silo Korowii keame Ahija be o dem. Dɛ Ahija hwɛɛhrɔ, waa na kɛrɛdɛ kpa.

english_verse: But when Ahijah heard her walking up to the door, he said: Come in! I know you're Jeroboam's wife—why are you pretending to be someone else? I have some bad news for you.
translation_verse: Korowii keame Ahija aa no Kooro Jɛroboam haah la nakpale sii o doonyoa la, o ŋɔ, “Kooro Jɛroboam haah dɛ ba. Ɛrɛɛ he beɡre he te ɡɛ nɔɔ? N dɔ waane dɛ bol he be, kɛ a ta amanesoma ɛɛ.

english_verse: Give your husband this message from the Lord God of Israel: “Jeroboam, you know that I, the Lord, chose you over anyone else to be the leader of my people Israel.
translation_verse: La ka ŋɔ Kooro Jɛroboam be ŋɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Menee lee le n nɛra Israel tena bini dɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ tɔ ba sie.

english_verse: I even took David's kingdom away from his family and gave it to you. But you are not like my servant David. He always obeyed me and did what was right.
translation_verse: Menee laa Kooro Devid dem kora la pere dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ, kɛ he ta doe kɛŋɔ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devid waa teŋɛ men Mmarare ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ o bambile bwa ne dɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ too n tea ɡbo la.

english_verse: “You have made me very angry by rejecting me and making idols out of gold. Jeroboam, you have done more evil things than any king before you.
translation_verse: He ɛ wechɔɡa kohona dɛ ɡwaa banɔ la baa tɔ he sie bwa. He ɛ voɡa, dɛ kpɔ kwaa ɛ voɡa muɡli n baah, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ.

english_verse: “Because of this, I will destroy your family by killing every man and boy in it, whether slave or free. I will wipe out your family, just as fire burns up trash.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ chɔɡ he koraa dɛ́ kpoo he bibaala, ne bechale ne nomonome baa lɔ Israel harɛ ta bwa, yoma ne banɔ la baa dɛ di ba nyuune bwa. Mɛɛ fuh he demii kɛŋɔ baa dɛ fuh kondoŋa a bwa yon tonɛ la ken.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel will mourn at his funeral. But he will be the last one from Jeroboam's family to receive a proper burial, because he's the only one the Lord God of Israel is pleased with.
translation_verse: Israel tena bwa ɛɛ ɛ o lwee dɛ́ huɡo. O ɡboo ɛ Kooro Jɛroboam nɛn baa dɛ ba huɡa, dɛkalkɛ Kooro Jɛroboam dem nɛra bwa bini, o ɡbo nɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la sie ɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will soon choose a new king of Israel, who will destroy Jeroboam's family. And I mean very soon.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ ba kooro lee Israel tena bini dɛ́ tɛ o te fini, dɛ chɔɡ Kooro Jɛroboam kora.

english_verse: The people of Israel have made the Lord angry by setting up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. So the Lord will punish them until they shake like grass in a stream. He will take them out of the land he gave to their ancestors, then scatter them as far away as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ tɛr Israel tena deŋnee, ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa pa nee ta dɛɛ yiiɡi la ken. Wɛɛ chuɡri baa le harɛdɛɛɡe nɔ waa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa nɔ taa, dɛ́ lɔ ba peɡre Yufretis Moo baŋ le. Ba kpɔ voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa paaɡe dɛ kpɔ muɡli o baah.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem, the city where the Lord had chosen to be worshiped. His mother Naamah was from Ammon.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Jɛroboam haah la ir dɛ le kaa o bwɛɛ Tirsa. Waa dena dɛɛ tel dem dɛ bie la dɛ sewɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel came and mourned at his funeral, just as the Lord's servant Ahijah had said. Jeroboam Dies
translation_verse: Israel tena bwa ɛ o lwe dɛ huɡo ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔ keame Ahija nɛɛ bol la.

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including the battles he won, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Kooro Jɛroboam bwara waa bwa, ne ɡɛ waa yoa, ne o kora dii waa bwa do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: The people of Judah disobeyed the Lord and made him even angrier than their ancestors had.
translation_verse: Juda harɛ ta nɛra ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, a che a ta Korowii bandia ir ba nɛ. Dɛ ba kwaa la ɡwaa anɔ la ba naawa aa ɛa la kwara.

english_verse: They also built their own local shrines and stone images of foreign gods, and they set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ba ɡe cheɡ voɡa deŋɡarere ta, dɛ paaɡe bwea, dɛ kpɔ voɡ Asera dajaŋa paaɡe deŋɡare bɛlbwa ta ne dajen bɛlbwa mun.

english_verse: Even worse, they allowed prostitutes at the shrines, and followed the disgusting customs of the foreign nations that the Lord had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Hale dɛ baala dɛ bɔ jwamane voɡare mune harɛ la ta. Juda harɛ ta tena jo kii we-ɛɛla bwa soo siwi nɛra ba fa aa lɔ bela dɛɛ ɛa mɔɔ Korowii doŋ ba le dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la ta.

english_verse: After Rehoboam had been king for four years, King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam aa di kora bene anue ta la, Ijipt Kooro baa dɛ yerɔ Sisak baa yo Jerusalam tena.

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔ ayaawa dɛ ɛ ane chiɡ suuɡaswɛm kwaa la naa ta, dɛ kpɔ do nɛra baa dɛ so koodem la doonyoa dɛɛ daah bela la nomonome nɔn ta ŋɔ báa nyiŋi a ta.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he was finished.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa kooro aa la Korowii Dea la, nɛra baa dɛ daah bela yon kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe la kpoŋe, ásɛ a habɔɔ ba yon kpɔ ka cheɡ dea baa dɛ cheɡa a bini la ta.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam kora dii saŋ waa aa bera chiɡ la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: He and Jeroboam were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Dɛ yoi ta chɔ Kooro Rɛhoboam ne Kooro Jɛroboam baah ta.

english_verse: Rehoboam's mother Naamah was from Ammon, but when Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Abijam then became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam sewɔ asɛ ba huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. O nya sɔne Naama, dɛ Amɔn tee. Asɛ o bibaa Abija ba chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta dɛ di kora.

english_verse: His own grandmother Maacah had made an idol of Asherah, and Asa took it and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: O ir o naa Maaka haŋkora ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, o ɛ voɡ Asera daa aa ɛ kii kwaa la. Kooro Asa teŋni daa la dɛ fuah Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta.

english_verse: Abijam became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa Abija di kora Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to strengthen the town of Ramah. Then he used these same stones and wood to fortify the town of Geba in the territory of Benjamin and the town of Mizpah.
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Asa do Juda tena bwa ŋɔ bá la, dɛ́ ka che bwea ne daa Kooro Baasa aa kpɔa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ Rama la. Anee Kooro Asa kpɔ ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛjena Geba ne Mispa aa lɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta. O ta nomɛlbwa ɡelɛ Juda harɛ, bɛlbwa laŋɔ ka pa daa la ane.

english_verse: Abijam did not truly obey the Lord his God as his ancestor David had done. Instead, he was sinful just like his father Rehoboam.
translation_verse: O ɡe ɛ o mɛɛ wechɔɡa la dɔŋa. O ta o bambile bwa kpɔe tɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid aa ɛa la.

english_verse: David had always obeyed the Lord's commands by doing right, except in the case of Uriah. And since Abijam was David's great-grandson, the Lord kept Jerusalem safe and let Abijam have a son who would be the next king.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid ɛ waa aa wera Korowii be, o ta wobɛlbwa Korowii aa doo a ta kone o soɡa bini bwa. Atane Uria Hiti te la ɡbo waa ta.

english_verse: The war that had broken out between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continued during the time that Abijam was king. Everything else Abijam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Kooro Abija bwara waa bwa do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. Dɛ yoi lɔ o ne Kooro Jɛroboam baah ta.

english_verse: Abijam died and was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Asa became king. King Asa of Judah (
translation_verse: Kooro Abija sewɔ ba huɡo o naawa huɡribɔr Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Asɛ o bibaa Asa chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora. Juda Kooro Asa

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: O kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm ne kwaa bwa o ne o mɛɛ aa dɔa dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta la ba Korowii Dea.

english_verse: Asa was always at war with King Baasha of Israel.
translation_verse: Dɛ yoi lɔ Kooro Asa ne Israel Kooro Baasa baah ba kora dii saŋ bwa ta.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord, as David had done.
translation_verse: Kooro Asa ɛ waa aa wera Korowii be, ɡɛ o nabaa Kooro Devid aa ɛa la.

english_verse: Asa became king of Judah in the twentieth year of Jeroboam's rule in Israel,
translation_verse: Kooro Jɛroboam aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ taa Kooro Asa di kora Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: He forced the prostitutes at the shrines to leave the country, and he got rid of the idols his ancestors had made.
translation_verse: O doŋi nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamane voɡare mun harɛ la ta, dɛ huɡri voɡa o naawa aa ɛa la bwa ta.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was completely faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ Kooro Asa ta bela voɡtoroma aa soɡa dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa bwa chɔɡɛ le Israel harɛ ta te, kɛ dɛ o bambile cheɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ o soɡa bini bwa.

english_verse: One time, Baasha invaded Judah and captured the town of Ramah. He started making the town stronger, so he could put troops there to stop people from going in and out of Judah.
translation_verse: Kooro Baasa kpɔ laa tena ka lɔ tɔ Juda Kooro Asa nɛ dɛ pɔ o nɛ, dɛ ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Rama, ásɛ bɛlbwa bɛ won le Juda harɛ ta kaa kɛɛ dɛ́ ba jo bela.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. He gave it to some of his officials and sent them to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Kooro Asa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm bwa aa kaa, dɛ do deene baa kpɔ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛɛ cheɡ koodem bela, dɛ Korowii Dea la tomɛ nomonome ba kpɔ ka tɛ Kooro Bɛn Hadad. Dɛ Kooro Hadad mɛɛ sɔne Tabrimɔn, o nabaa ɡe ɛ Aram Kooro Heseɔn dɛɛ di kora Damaskɔs.

english_verse: “Our fathers signed a peace treaty. Why don't we do the same thing? This silver and gold is a present for you. So, would you please break your treaty with Baasha and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: Kooro Asa ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, ɡɛ ya naawa fa aa ɛa la. N kpɔ koŋkɛɛla aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, á ɛ fɔo dɛ́ chɔɡ he ne Israel Kooro Baasa fɔo la taraken, ásɛ o ne he laa tena le n harɛ nɔ ta kaa.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, and Abel-Bethmaacah, and the territories of Chinneroth and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Kooro Bɛn Hadad no Kooro Asa be, dɛ tomɛ o laa sitɔɔla ba ka yo Israel harɛ bwɛɛre. Ba pɔ bwɛɛre baa dɛ yera Ijon ne Dan dɛ Ebel Bɛt Maaka ne harɛ waa chɔa kaa Galilia Moo bwa dɛ Naftale dea harɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he left Ramah and went back to Tirzah.
translation_verse: Kooro Baasa aa no ɡɛ la, o ɡel danjwɛɛ la mae dɛ bar Rama dɛ ka so Tirsa.

english_verse: Everything else Asa did while he was king, including his victories and the towns he rebuilt, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. When he got older, he had a foot disease.
translation_verse: Waa Kooro Asa aa ɛa o kora dii ta, ne bwɛɛre waa ma danjwɛɛ bara, ne laa waa yoa dɛ pɔ nɛra nɛɛ la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. O hwɛɛhra bini la, o we nakpaweela ane soo siwi.

english_verse: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Asa's second year as king of Judah, and he ruled two years.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene anɛ taa Kooro Jɛroboam bibaa Nadab di kora Israel harɛ ta. O di kora bene anɛ.

english_verse: Nadab disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of his father, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Gɛ o mɛɛ aa ɛa laanee o ɡe ɛ, o ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛ ɡel Israel tena bwa ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: The Lord's prophet Ahijah had earlier said, “Not one man or boy in Jeroboam's family will be left alive.” And, as soon as Baasha became king, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family,
translation_verse: Kooro Baasa aa baa di kora la, o kpoo Kooro Jɛroboam dem tena bwa. O ta Kooro Jɛroboam nɛn bɛlbwa ɡelɛ o so le, o kpoo ba bwa, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Ahija waa ɛ Silo te nɛɛ dɛ bol la.

english_verse: because Jeroboam had made the Lord God of Israel angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔ chiɡo dɛkalkɛ Kooro Jɛroboam ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ muɡli Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la baah.

english_verse: Everything else Nadab did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Waa Kooro Nadab aa ɛa o kora dii ta ne anɔ la waa ɛa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: King Asa of Judah and King Baasha of Israel were always at war. King Baasha of Israel
translation_verse: Dɛ yoi lɔ Kooro Asa ne Israel Kooro Baasa baah ta ba kora dii saŋ bwa. Israel Kooro Baasa

english_verse: Baasha son of Ahijah became king of Israel in Asa's third year as king of Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Bentooro te ta Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ taa Ahija bibaa Baasa di Israel kora dɛ so Tirsa. O di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ.

english_verse: Baasha also disobeyed the Lord by acting like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, o kpɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ŋwɛnɛ la ta, ɡɛ waa ɡela Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa la.

english_verse: Nobody knew who you were until I, the Lord, chose you to be the leader of my people Israel. And now you're acting exactly like Jeroboam by causing the Israelites to sin. What you've done has made me so angry
translation_verse: “He fa toole wobɛlbwa bini, n lawɛ ba ŋɔ he baa nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛ, kɛ he kpɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ŋwɛnɛre la ta dɛ ɡel n nɛra Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ muɡli n baah.

english_verse: that I will destroy you and your family, just as I did the family of Jeroboam.
translation_verse: Gɛ maa ɛ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam dem la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba hen Kooro Baasa ne he dem tena chɔɡa.

english_verse: Dogs will eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.
translation_verse: He nɛnnɔn te bɛlbwa waa sewɛ bwɛjen la bini la, nyootenaa dɛ́ di ba ola, ásɛ jumbii di banɔ la ɡe baa serewe kpɔɡ bini la ola.”

english_verse: Baasha made the Lord very angry, and that's why the Lord gave Jehu this message for Baasha and his family. Baasha constantly disobeyed the Lord by following Jeroboam's sinful example—but even worse, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family! Everything else Baasha did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah became king. King Elah of Israel
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o keame bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jehu nɛɛ bol wa, Hanani bibaalee on. Keame Jehu baa bol Korowii wa Kooro Baasa ne o dem tena be, wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ muɡli on Korowii baah kɛŋɔ Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, ne kpoe waa kpo o ne o dem tena bwa la wa. Israel Kooro Ɛla

english_verse: Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel after Asa had been king of Judah for
translation_verse: Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ dɛ anumɛl taa Kooro Baasa bibaa Ɛla di kora Israel harɛ ta. O soɡe Tirsa bene anɛ.

english_verse: Omri did more evil things than any king before him.
translation_verse: Kooro Omri ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡwaa koranar baa tɔ sie la bwa.

english_verse: Zimri commanded half of Elah's chariots, and he made plans to kill Elah. One day, Elah was in Tirzah, getting drunk at the home of Arza, his prime minister,
translation_verse: Kooro Ɛla bonɔɔ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Simri, dɛ onee dɛɛ nyiŋi kooro kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre ane ta. O ɛ kooro dɔm. Dɛ Kooro Ɛla lɔ nomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Arsa dem dɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ. Dɛ Aasaa dɛɛ nyiŋi koodem waa lɔ bwɛjen Tirsa ta.

english_verse: when Zimri went there and killed Elah. So Zimri became king in the twenty-seventh year of Asa's rule in Judah.
translation_verse: Ate, Simri ka jo koodem bela dɛ lɔ Kooro Ɛla kpo, dɛ kpɔ kora la di. Bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ ta Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ taa o kpoo.

english_verse: As soon as Zimri became king, he killed everyone in Baasha's family. Not one man or boy in his family was left alive—even his close friends were killed.
translation_verse: Waa dena ba di kora la, o kpoo Kooro Baasa dem tena bwa. O ta baa bɛlbwa ɡelɛ, hale o lole kɛɛ o dam.

english_verse: Baasha's family was completely wiped out, just as the Lord's prophet Jehu had warned.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Jehu nɛɛ bol Kooro Baasa waa la, Simri kpo Kooro Baasa ne o dem tena bwa,

english_verse: Everything else Elah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Zimri of Israel
translation_verse: Waa Kooro Ɛla aa ɛa o kora dii ta bwa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. Israel Kooro Simri

english_verse: Zimri became king of Israel in Asa's twenty-seventh year as king of Judah, but he ruled only seven days from Tirzah. Israel's army was camped near Gibbethon in Philistia under the command of Omri. The soldiers heard that Zimri had killed Elah, and they made Omri their king that same day.
translation_verse: Israel laa tena la aa noa kɛŋɔ Kooro Simri ɛ Kooro Ɛla dɔm dɛ kpoo la, ba bwa kpɔ ba laa sitɔɔ baa dɛ yerɔ Omri cheɡ Israel harɛ ta kooro awola tenten, bela baa soɡa la.

english_verse: At once, Omri and his army marched to Tirzah and attacked.
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Omri ne Israel laa tena baa ja o nɛɛ bwa le Gebɛtɔn dɛ ba lɛ Tirsa dɔɔh.

english_verse: When Zimri saw that the town was captured, he ran into the strongest part of the palace and killed himself by setting it on fire.
translation_verse: Kooro Simri aa naa kɛ ba kpɔ bwɛjen la, o kaa jo dekpeɡ waa lɔ koodem bela dɛ kpaa nii do o ta, o ne o dem la bwa fuh kwaraa,

english_verse: Zimri had disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ŋwɛnɛ la dɔŋ ta dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a che a ta Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa la wa.

english_verse: Everything else Zimri did while he was king, including his rebellion against Elah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Omri of Israel
translation_verse: Kooro Simri bwara waa ne dɔm waa ɛa bwa, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. Israel Kooro Omri

english_verse: After Zimri died, some of the Israelites wanted Tibni son of Ginath to be king, but others wanted Omri.
translation_verse: Israel tena bini pero anɛ, bane teŋɛ Ginat bibaa Tibni nɛ, dɛ fe ɛɛ chiɡu kora. Banɔ la baa kaa la ɡe teŋɛ Kooro Omri nɛ.

english_verse: in the thirty-first year of Asa's rule in Judah. Omri ruled Israel for twelve years. The first six years he ruled from Tirzah,
translation_verse: Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ beŋkpoŋ taa Kooro Omri di kora Israel harɛ ta. O di kora bene fi dɛ anɛ. O soɡe Tirsa bene anumɛl o kara la ta.

english_verse: He acted just like Jeroboam and made the Lord God of Israel angry by causing the Israelites to sin and to worship idols.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa kpɔ o ta, ne wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa, ba ɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe a di Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ baah la, ɡɛɛ Kooro Omri ɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Everything else Omri did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Kooro Omri kora dii saŋ ne waa waa ɛa bwa, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Omri died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Ahab became king. King Ahab of Israel
translation_verse: Kooro Omri sewɔ ba huɡo Samaria, asɛ o bibaa Ahab chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora. Israel Kooro Ahab

english_verse: Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Asa's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro taa Kooro Omri bibaa Kooro Ahab di kora Israel harɛ ta. O di kora Israel harɛ, dɛ so Samaria bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ.

english_verse: Ahab did more things to disobey the Lord than any king before him.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡwaa koranar baa tɔ sie la.

english_verse: He acted just like Jeroboam. Even worse, he married Jezebel the daughter of King Ethbaal of Sidon and started worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: O ta ɡelɛ a jaɡɛ bela dɛ ɡe ɛ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam wechɔɡa la dɔŋa. O berɔ mo Sidon Kooro Etbaal bihaah Jɛsɛbɛl dɛ pa mun dɛɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal.

english_verse: Ahab built an altar and temple for Baal in Samaria
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab ma voɡ Baal dea Samaria, dɛ ɛ kon baa fuh saraha o ta dea la bini tɛo.

english_verse: and set up a sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. Ahab did more to make the Lord God of Israel angry than any king of Israel before him.
translation_verse: O pa voɡ Asera dajaŋ. O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ muɡli Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la baah ɡwaa ɡɛ Israel koranar baa tɔ sie la aa ɛa.

english_verse: While Ahab was king, a man from Bethel named Hiel rebuilt the town of Jericho. But while Hiel was laying the foundation for the town wall, his oldest son Abiram died. And while he was finishing the gates, his youngest son Segub died. This happened just as the Lord had told Joshua to say many years ago.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab saŋee baa bɛl waa le Bɛtel baa yerɔ Heɛl kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen Jeriko. O bibanloɡle baa dɛ yerɔ Abiramee o kpɔ pa danjwɛɛ la mun, dɛ kpɔ o bibaa bechala Seɡub ɡe ma bwɛɛ la doonyoo, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Nun bibaa Josua nɛɛ bola la.

english_verse: Elijah was a prophet from Tishbe in Gilead. One day he went to King Ahab and said, “I'm a servant of the living Lord, the God of Israel. And I swear in his name that it won't rain until I say so. There won't even be any dew on the ground.”
translation_verse: Korowii keame bɛl fa lole baa yerɔ Elaeja, o ɛ Tisbe te dɛ le Gelead harɛ ta. Awola bɛl, o la Kooro Ahab be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N cheɡɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa Israel tena ɛɛ tomɔ sɔn ta dɛɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ mɛn aa ta, bwaala ɡe aa nɛɛ ba bene aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba nɔ ta, nemenɛ a le n nyoa mɔɔ.”

english_verse: Later, the Lord said to Elijah,
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ Elaeja be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Leave and go across the Jordan River so you can hide near Cherith Creek.
translation_verse: “Ir le bonɔ kaa Kerit Fɛlembɔjen waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr ka sɔh.

english_verse: You can drink water from the creek, and eat the food I've told the ravens to bring you.”
translation_verse: Hɛɛ dɔ nee dɛɛ nyɔ. N do ɡaahɡaahre ŋɔ á baa tɛɛ kondikwa.”

english_verse: Ravens brought him bread and meat twice a day, and he drank water from the creek.
translation_verse: Gaahɡaahre kpɔ paanoo ne ola kaa tɛo chɔɔ ne jwaana. Dɛ o dɔ nee ɡe dɛɛ nyɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini.

english_verse: But after a while, it dried up because there was no rain. Elijah Helps a Widow in Zarephath
translation_verse: Aa dɛ biɡri bwaala aa wola nɛ la, nee la hweehrɔ. Elaeja ne Sarefat luhaah bɛl wa

english_verse: The Lord told Elijah,
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Elaeja be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Go to the town of Zarephath in Sidon and live there. I've told a widow in that town to give you food.”
translation_verse: “Ir kaa Sarefat, o bɛne bwɛjen Sidon dɛ́ ka so bela. Luhaah bɛl lɔ bela, n doo ŋɔ wɛɛ tɛɛ kondikwa.”

english_verse: When Elijah came near the town gate of Zarephath, he saw a widow gathering sticks for a fire. “Would you please bring me a cup of water?” he asked.
translation_verse: Asɛ o ir kaa Sarefat. Waa dɛ tel bwɛɛ la doonyoa la, dɛ luhaah bɛl lɔ bela dɛɛ nyin damara. Anee Elaeja ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe, ka ɛ nee tama ba tɛ mɛ ń nyɔ.”

english_verse: As she left to get it, he asked, “Would you also please bring me a piece of bread?”
translation_verse: Haah la aa dɛ kaa ka ɛ nee la, Elaeja berɛ ŋɔ, “Mɔn paanoo tama ja ba tɛ mɛ.”

english_verse: The widow answered, “In the name of the living Lord your God, I swear that I don't have any bread. All I have is a handful of flour and a little olive oil. I'm on my way home now with these few sticks to cook what I have for my son and me. After that, we will starve to death.”
translation_verse: Anee haah la ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o do le saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ n ta paanoo dɔe, men tama ne noo tama anee ka vii bini, n ba dɛɛ ba ba nyin daa dɛ́ ka ɛ n ne n bie di. A habɔɔ dɛ́ so lɔr sewɛ.”

english_verse: Elijah said, “Everything will be fine. Do what you said. Go home and fix something for you and your son. But first, please make a small piece of bread and bring it to me.
translation_verse: Anee Elaeja ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel a we he nɛ, he te kaa dɛ́ ka ɛ he kondikwaa la. Kɛ tɔ sie ɛ ane ba tɛ mɛ mɔɔ, dɛ́ ɛ he ne he bie la kwa.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has promised that your jar of flour won't run out and your bottle of oil won't dry up before he sends rain for the crops.”
translation_verse: Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Men aa lɔ vii la bini la aa tonɛ bwa, ɡɛɛ noo la ɡe aa wola tonɛ, ka tel saŋ maa dɛ ba ɡela bwaala nɛ kondikwaa ba.’ ”

english_verse: The widow went home and did exactly what Elijah had told her. She and Elijah and her family had enough food for a long time.
translation_verse: Luhaah la kaa ɛ ɡɛ Elaeja aa bola la, ate ba ne Elaeja dɔ kondikwaa dem bela dɛɛ di tɔpere bɛlbwa.

english_verse: The Lord kept the promise that his prophet Elijah had made, and she did not run out of flour or oil. Elijah Brings a Boy Back to Life
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa bol Elaeja be la, men la ta vii la bini tonɛ bwa, ɡɛɛ noo la ɡe aa wola tonɛ.

english_verse: Several days later, the son of the woman who owned the house got sick, and he kept getting worse, until finally he died.
translation_verse: A baa tel saŋ bɛl luhaah la bibaa bwara ɛɛ weo. A baa ɡwaa asɛ o sewɛ.

english_verse: The woman shouted at Elijah, “What have I done to you? I thought you were God's prophet. Did you come here to cause the death of my son as a reminder that I've sinned against God?”
translation_verse: Anee luhaah la ŋɔ Elaeja be ŋɔ, “Korowii keame, bɔkwa waa he ɛɛ mɛ ken? He balɔ dɛ́ ba lii mɛ n wechɔɡa maa ɛa wa dɛ́ kpo n bie kɛɛ?”

english_verse: “Bring me your son,” Elijah said. Then he took the boy from her arms and carried him upstairs to the room where he was staying. Elijah laid the boy on his bed
translation_verse: Elaeja ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he bie la ba tɛ mɛ,” dɛ lɛ bie la o be, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa abrɔsane doa dea o ɡbaɡba Elaeja aa soɡa la, dɛ kpɔɔ ka bil mpa ta.

english_verse: and prayed, “Lord God, why did you do such a terrible thing to this woman? She's letting me stay here, and now you've let her son die.”
translation_verse: Elaeja kpɔ takpeɡ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, bɔkwa sibeɡraa he kpɔ ba ta luhaah maa baa so o be nɔ dɛ ɡel o bie sewɛ ken?”

english_verse: Elijah stretched himself out over the boy three times, while praying, “Lord God, bring this boy back to life!”
translation_verse: Belaa Elaeja ka pi bie la nɛɛ kera atoro, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, n poori ɡel bie nɔ berɛ dɔ mkpa.”

english_verse: The Lord answered Elijah's prayer, and the boy started breathing again.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii no Elaeja wesoŋa la, bie la ir, dɛ berɛ dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: Elijah picked him up and carried him downstairs. He gave the boy to his mother and said, “Look, your son is alive.”
translation_verse: Elaeja kpɔ bie la tu ba o nya be, dɛ ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, he bie la iro.” Dɛ kpɔɔ tɛo.

english_verse: “You are God's prophet!” the woman replied. “Now I know that you really do speak for the Lord.”
translation_verse: Luhaah la chaŋe Elaeja ŋɔ, “Anɔ taa n jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii keamee hen, Korowii waa aa dɛ le he nyoa la ɛ kpela.”

english_verse: At that time Obadiah was in charge of Ahab's palace, but he faithfully worshiped the Lord. In fact, when Jezebel was trying to kill the Lord's prophets, Obadiah hid
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Ahab haah Jɛsɛbɛl ɡelɔ ba kpoo Korowii keamere. Asɛ Obadia kpɔ Korowii keamere lafa ka sɔh bwebɔɔne anɛ bini, dɛɛ tɛɛ ba nee ne kondikwa. O bɔne ba bini, fifraanunue ba do bɔɔ beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa bini.

english_verse: and said, “We have to find something for our horses and mules to eat. If we don't, we will have to kill them. Let's look around every creek and spring in the country for some grass.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Obadia be ŋɔ, “Yá ka ɡaaɡe harɛ nɔ bwa ta, neerare nyuune ne fɛlembɔɔne bwa ta, ya ken ɛɛ dɔ kpɔɡaa ba tɛ ya jaɡre ne keeɡore nɔ, ásɛ ya bɛ an kpoo.”

english_verse: You go one way, and I'll go the other.” Then they left in separate directions.
translation_verse: Ba pere ba bini, Kooro Ahab chaɡɛ harɛ la baŋ bɛl, Obadia ɡe chaɡɛ baŋ bɛl.

english_verse: As Obadiah was walking along, he met Elijah. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down, and asked, “Elijah, is it really you?”
translation_verse: Obadia aa dɛ kaa la, o kaa cheme Elaeja dɛ jemɔ, asɛ o ɡuŋu dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ Elaeja, henee nɔ naa?”

english_verse: Obadiah replied: King Ahab would kill me if I told him that. And I haven't even done anything wrong.
translation_verse: Obadia ŋɔ, “Wechɔɡa besoo n ɛ asɛ he le men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ dɛɛ tɛ Kooro Ahab ó kpo mɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: I swear to you in the name of the living Lord your God that the king has looked everywhere for you. He sent people to look in every country, and when they couldn't find you, he made the leader of each country swear that you were not in that country.
translation_verse: N ŋwɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o do le nɔ kɛŋɔ, kooro ɡelɔ ba ka ɡaaɡe he bɔr harɛre bwa ta. Bobɛlbwa toole baa wola he bɔr ɡaaɡɛ. Bobɛlbwa nomoa ŋɔ o ta hen nae o harɛ ta naa, Kooro Ahab yon ɡel o ŋwɛɛ ntam kɛŋɔ o ta hen nae.

english_verse: Do you really want me to tell him you're here?
translation_verse: Taraken he dɛ nyin ń la ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ he lɔ bonɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: What if the Lord's Spirit takes you away as soon as I leave? When Ahab comes to get you, he won't find you. Then he will surely kill me. I have worshiped the Lord since I was a boy.
translation_verse: Dɛ n kaalɔ Korowii Doma la kpɔe kaa bobɛl, asɛ n ka ŋɔ o be o ta hen ba nae yaa, wɛɛ kpo mɛɛ. Men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ, n bechale saŋ bwaa n yarada Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: Elijah said, “I'm a servant of the living Lord All-Powerful, and I swear in his name that I will meet with Ahab today.”
translation_verse: Belaa Elaeja ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa mɛɛ tomɔ nɔ kɛŋɔ, fini mɛɛ kpɔ n tenee ka baɡle Kooro Ahab.”

english_verse: Obadiah left and told Ahab where to find Elijah. Ahab went to meet Elijah,
translation_verse: Ate, Obadia la dɛ ka ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be, asɛ o ba dɛ ba na Elaeja.

english_verse: and when he saw him, Ahab shouted, “There you are, the biggest troublemaker in Israel!”
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab aa baa na Elaeja la, Kooro ŋɔ, “Nɛn haa ba waa ne ba ta Israel harɛ ta laanee nɔ naa!”

english_verse: Elijah answered: You're the troublemaker—not me! You and your family have disobeyed the Lord's commands by worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Elaeja ŋɔ, “N laa ba waa ne Israel harɛ nɔ ta, he ne he mɛɛ dem nɛraa. Heyaa vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa dɛ kaa teŋɛ voɡa Baalre nɛ.

english_verse: Ahab got everyone together, then they went to meet Elijah on Mount Carmel.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Ahab tomɛ nɛra ba valɛ Israel harɛ ta bwa, ba yerɛ Israel tena ne Baal voɡ tena la bwa ba cheme Kaamɛl Bwejen doa.

english_verse: Elijah stood in front of them and said, “How much longer will you try to have things both ways? If the Lord is God, worship him! But if Baal is God, worship him!” The people did not say a word.
translation_verse: Belaa Elaeja ka che Israel tena la bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin he kpɔ nyiŋi webele anɛ nɔ bini nɔ? Dɛ Korowii ɡwaa Baal aa, hé tomɛ Korowii, dɛ Baal ɡe ɡwaa Korowii aa, hé tomɛ Baal.” Kɛ nɛra la ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ.

english_verse: Then Elijah continued: I am the Lord's only prophet, but Baal has
translation_verse: Elaeja ŋɔ, “N ɡboo Korowii keame waa kaa, kɛ voɡ Baal te dɔ voɡ tena lafraanaarɛ fifraanue.

english_verse: Bring us two bulls. Baal's prophets can take one of them, kill it, and cut it into pieces. Then they can put the meat on the wood without lighting the fire. I will do the same thing with the other bull, and I won't light a fire under it either.
translation_verse: Hé tɛ yaa nabala anɛ, ásɛ Baal voɡ tena la kpo bɛl dɛ chɛwɔ dawɛ daa ta, dɛ bɛ nii a ta do. N ɡe ɛ onɔ la waa kaa la ɡɛ, maa niinii do.

english_verse: The prophets of Baal will pray to their god, and I will pray to the Lord. The one who answers by starting the fire is God. “That's a good idea,” everyone agreed.
translation_verse: Ásɛ Baal voɡ tena la soŋe ba voɡ, ásɛ n ɡe soŋe Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ. Bɛl la o kon aa do nii o kwaa ta la, onee chɛ kɛŋɔ yaa tomɔ.” Ate, nɛra la bwa sɛh, dɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ wer.”

english_verse: Elijah said to Baal's prophets, “There are more of you, so you go first. Pick out a bull and get it ready, but don't light the fire. Then pray to your god.”
translation_verse: Elaeja yerɛ Baal voɡ tena la dɛ ŋɔ, “Haa wara nɔ, hé tɔ sie kpɔ nabal nɔ bɛl dɛ kwaaro, he bɛ nii o ta do, dɛ́ soŋe voɡ Baal.”

english_verse: They chose their bull, then they got it ready and prayed to Baal all morning, asking him to start the fire. They danced around the altar and shouted, “Answer us, Baal!” But there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ate, ba lawɛ nao baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la, dɛ ɛo dɛ soŋe voɡ Baal ɡwɛeh le chɔɔbɔr ka tel webaŋa wee aa baa tel nyufala. Dɛɛ ŋɔ, “N naa Baal, no yaa ɔ.” Ba sao bar kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la, ba ta wobɛlbwa nae, ba ta wobɛlbwa ɡe noɛ.

english_verse: At noon, Elijah began making fun of them. “Pray louder!” he said. “Baal must be a god. Maybe he's daydreaming or using the toilet or traveling somewhere. Or maybe he's asleep, and you have to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Wee aa baa tel nyufala la, Elaeja mam ba, dɛ di ba loro ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ yerɔ kohona, o ɛ voɡ kɛrɛdɛ, o ken ta dɛ lii, kɛɛ o ken kaa bobɛl. O ka lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta. O ken ka chɔ dom, a chɛ kɛ he ka chumu.”

english_verse: The prophets kept shouting louder and louder, and they cut themselves with swords and knives until they were bleeding. This was the way they worshiped,
translation_verse: Baal voɡ tena la soŋo kohona takpeɡ ne, dɛ kpɔ tokobie ne keri dɛɛ mɔne ba bwara. Dɛ ba nawee waa baa ɛa dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa laanee ɡɛ, asɛ chal ɛɛ pal ba.

english_verse: and they kept it up until time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no answer of any kind.
translation_verse: Ba teŋɔ soŋe ka tel kɛŋɔ webaŋa aa baa ɡarɛ, kɛ o ta ban chaŋɛ, ba ta wobɛlbwa ɡe noɛ.

english_verse: Then he used twelve stones to build an altar in honor of the Lord. Each stone stood for one of the tribes of Israel, which was the name the Lord had given to their ancestor Jacob. Elijah dug a ditch around the altar, large enough to hold about
translation_verse: O kpɔ bwea la dɛ berɛ ɛ saraha kon la Korowii sɔn ta, dɛ ɡel ba kwi bɔɔ waa won nee ɡalɔŋre atoro lɛɛ baro.

english_verse: He placed the wood on the altar, then they cut the bull into pieces and laid the meat on the wood. He told the people, “Fill four large jars with water and pour it over the meat and the wood.” After they did this,
translation_verse: O pa daa dawɛ saraha kon la ta, dɛ kpo nabal la dɛ chɛwɔ dawɛ daa la ta. Dɛ ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé dɔ nee do polviine anaarɛ bini á su, ásɛ dɛ ɛ nee la ta ola la ne daa la ta.”

english_verse: he told them to do it two more times. They did exactly as he said
translation_verse: O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ do nee ja.” Asɛ ba ɛ ɡɛ. O berɛ ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ ɛ ɡɛ toorotena ja.” Asɛ ba ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: until finally, the water ran down the altar and filled the ditch.
translation_verse: Nee la palɔ jo bɔɔ waa ɡela ba kwi bar saraha kon la o su.

english_verse: When it was time for the evening sacrifice, Elijah prayed: Our Lord, you are the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel. Now, prove that you are the God of this nation, and that I, your servant, have done this at your command.
translation_verse: Saŋ aa tela Elaeja ɛ saraha la, o kaa che saraha kon la jwɛh dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb baa ɛ ya naawa aa tomɛ, fini ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la. Dɛ́ berɛ ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ he bonɔɔnee men, hen do mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ waa nɔ bwa.

english_verse: Please answer me, so these people will know that you are the Lord God, and that you will turn their hearts back to you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, chaŋ mɛ ásɛ nɛra nɔ jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee Korowii, he laɡ ba dɛɛ ba he be.”

english_verse: The Lord immediately sent fire, and it burned up the sacrifice, the wood, and the stones. It scorched the ground everywhere around the altar and dried up every drop of water in the ditch.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ɡel nii ba le saraha kwaa la ta, dɛ fuh a ne daa la ne bwea dɛ harɛ la bwa, nee aa lɔ bɔɔ la bini ɡe hweeh.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what had happened, they all bowed down and shouted, “The Lord is God! The Lord is God!”
translation_verse: Nɛra la aa na ɡɛ la, ba cholo dɛ kpɔ sie piiɡi harɛ, dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Korowiirii ya Dɔɔ! O ɡbosoroo chɛ toma!”

english_verse: Just then, Elijah said, “Grab the prophets of Baal! Don't let any of them get away.” So the people captured the prophets and took them to Kishon River, where Elijah killed every one of them. It Starts To Rain
translation_verse: Elaeja do nɛra la ŋɔ, “Hé lawɛ Baal voɡ tena la, he bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa dɔ bɔr chwa!” Ba lawɛ ba bwa asɛ Elaeja ɡel ba kpɔ ba kaa Kesɔn Fɛlembɔjen bini ka kpoo ba.

english_verse: Elijah told Ahab, “Get something to eat and drink. I hear a heavy rain coming.”
translation_verse: Elaeja ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Kaa dɛ́ ka di kwa name, n no bwaala jiɡra kohona.”

english_verse: Ahab left, but Elijah climbed back to the top of Mount Carmel. Then he stooped down with his face almost to the ground
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab aa kaa kwaa dii la, Elaeja berɔ teeh kaa Kaamɛl Bwejen doa dɛ ka boŋɛ dɛ kpɔ o nyu do o naa baah.

english_verse: and said to his servant, “Look toward the sea.” The servant left. And when he came back, he said, “I looked, but I didn't see anything.” Elijah told him to look seven more times.
translation_verse: Elaeja ŋɔ o bonɔɔ be ŋɔ, “La ka che dɛ́ nyiŋi mpo ta.” Ate, o bonɔɔ la la dɛ berɛ ba o be dɛ́ ba ŋɔ, “N ta komɛlbwa nae.” Kera anuanɛ bwaa o ŋɔ bonɔɔ la be ŋɔ ó la mpo ta ka nyiŋi.

english_verse: After the seventh time the servant replied, “I see a small cloud coming this way. But it's no bigger than a fist.” Elijah told him, “Tell Ahab to get his chariot ready and start home now. Otherwise, the rain will stop him.”
translation_verse: Kera anuanɛ ta la, bonɔɔ la baa ŋɔ, “N na bam jeɡaa bɛl kɛŋɔ nɛn nɔn wɛɛ le mpo ta.” Anee Elaeja ŋɔ, “La ka ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, ‘Ɛ warane kpɔ he torɔɡo ha vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔ la dɛ kaa dem, ásɛ bwaala bɛ hen ba kpo.’ ”

english_verse: A few minutes later, it got very cloudy and windy, and rain started pouring down. So Elijah wrapped his coat around himself, and the Lord gave him strength to run all the way to Jezreel. Ahab followed in his chariot.
translation_verse: Korowii tɛ Elaeja kpeɡri bɛl o kwaa o yal vɔwɛ chara kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ won takapɔ chwa tɔ Kooro Ahab jaaɡɔ la sie dɛ kaa Jesreel.

english_verse: Ahab told his wife Jezebel what Elijah had done and that he had killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab bol o haah Jɛsɛbɛl be ɡɛ Elaeja aa ɛa bwa, ne ɡɛ waa kpɔ tokobii kpo Baal voɡ tena la.

english_verse: She sent a message to Elijah: “You killed my prophets. Now I'm going to kill you! I pray that the gods will punish me even more severely if I don't do it by this time tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Anee o haah la tomɛ torome Elaeja be ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ kere saŋ nɔ dɛ n ta hen kpoe kɛŋɔ haa kpoo voɡ tena la aa, voɡare la kpo mɛ.”

english_verse: Elijah was afraid when he got her message, and he ran to the town of Beersheba in Judah. He left his servant there,
translation_verse: Elaeja ɔmɔ, dɛ kpɔ o bonɔɔ chwa kaa Beɛseeba waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔ o nyu. O baa ɡel o bonɔɔ la bela,

english_verse: then walked another whole day into the desert. Finally, he came to a large bush and sat down in its shade. He begged the Lord, “I've had enough. Just let me die! I'm no better off than my ancestors.”
translation_verse: dɛ valɛ tɔpebir kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta. O kaa so chunchule ta daa bɛl mun, dɛ soŋe seo tɛ o te kɛŋɔ o fee sewɛ. O soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, name te a maɡre ɡɛ, ɡel ń sewɛ. N ta n naawa baa serewa la ɡwaalɛ.”

english_verse: Then he lay down in the shade and fell asleep. Suddenly an angel woke him up and said, “Get up and eat.”
translation_verse: O chɔ daa la mun chɔ dom. Buɡ la ta, nyundua torome den ba leɡo dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ di kwa.”

english_verse: Elijah looked around, and by his head was a jar of water and some baked bread. He sat up, ate and drank, then lay down and went back to sleep.
translation_verse: Elaeja iro nyiŋi dɛ na paanoo ne loŋ bɛl ne nee o nyu bɔr, dɛ kpɔ di dɛ nyɔ nee la, dɛ berɛ kwaa chɔ ja.

english_verse: So Elijah sat up and ate and drank. The food and water made him strong enough to walk
translation_verse: Asɛ o ir di kwaa la, dɛ nyɔ ne. Kondikwaa la chao dɛ tɛo bokpeɡa o won valɛ tɔpera fifraanaarɛ chɔɔ ne jwaana, dɛ kaa Korowii Sinai Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la bɔr.

english_verse: and he spent the night there in a cave. The Lord Appears to Elijah While Elijah was on Mount Sinai, the Lord asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: Waa tel bela la, o kaa jo bwebɔɔ bini chɔ jwaana. Korowii ba Elaeja be Belaa Korowii bol waa Elaeja be ŋɔ, “Elaeja, bɔkwaa hɛɛ ɛ bonɔ nɔ?”

english_verse: He answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, he ɡboo mɛɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛ Israel tena chɔɡ he ne ba fɔo la, dɛ paɡre kwaa baa ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛɛ la, dɛ berɛ kpoo he keamere bwa tokobie ne. N ɡboo kaa baa nyin n ɡe dɛ́ kpo.”

english_verse: “Go out and stand on the mountain,” the Lord replied. “I want you to be there when I pass by.” All at once, a strong wind shook the mountain and shattered the rocks. But the Lord was not in the wind. Next, there was an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Le ka che bwe la doa n sie. Asɛ men Korowii teŋe ba kaa.” Asɛ peu o nyoa aa kpeɡa tɔ o sie, dɛ paɡre deŋɡarere, dɛ peɡri bweɡuŋe. Kɛ dɛ Korowii toole peu la bini. Peu la aa taa tonɛ la, harɛ jiɡro, kɛ dɛ Korowii toole harɛ waa jiɡra la ta.

english_verse: Then there was a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. Finally, there was a gentle breeze,
translation_verse: Harɛ jiɡra la ɡe habɔɔ la, nii balɔ. Kɛ dɛ Korowii toole nii la ta. Nii la ɡe habɔɔ, taa bɛl leɔ bɔeeh ken.

english_verse: and when Elijah heard it, he covered his face with his coat. He went out and stood at the entrance to the cave. A voice asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: Elaeja aa no taa la la, o kpɔ batakaare tɔ sie dɛ le bwebɔɔ la bini ba che o nyoa. Asɛ taa bɛl le dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Elaeja, bɔkwaa hɛɛ ɛ bonɔ nɔ?”

english_verse: Elijah answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii waa ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, he ɡboo mɛɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛ Israel tena chɔɡ he ne ba fɔo la, dɛ paɡre kwaa baa ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛɛ la, dɛ berɛ kpoo he keamere bwa tokobie ne. N ɡboo kaa, baa nyin n ɡe dɛ́ kpo.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Elijah, you can go back to the desert near Damascus. And when you get there, appoint Hazael to be king of Syria.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Berɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta ba la, dɛ́ kaa Damaskɔs pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta. He tel bela aa, kpɔ noo fuɡe do Hasael nyu ta, dɛ́ cheɡo Siiria harɛ ta kooro.

english_verse: Then appoint Jehu son of Nimshi to be king of Israel, and Elisha son of Shaphat to take your place as my prophet.
translation_verse: Berɛ la Israel harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ane fuɡe do Nimsi bibaa Jehu ɡe nyu ta, dɛ́ cheɡo Israel harɛ ta kooro, ásɛ dɛ fuɡe ane do Safat bibaa Elaesa waa le Ebel Mehola la ɡe nyu ta, ásɛ o ɛ keame chiɡ he naa ta.

english_verse: Hazael will start killing the people who worship Baal. Jehu will kill those who escape from Hazael, and Elisha will kill those who escape from Jehu.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa chwa le Hasael kpoe nyoa la, Jehuu dɛ́ kpoo. Elaesa ɡee dɛ́ kpo banɔ la Jehu aa wola ban dɔ kpo la.

english_verse: Elijah left and found Elisha plowing a field with a pair of oxen. There were eleven other men in front of him, and each one was also plowing with a pair of oxen. Elijah went over and put his own coat on Elisha.
translation_verse: Ate, Elaeja le bela dɛɛ kaa, waa dɛ kaa la, o kaa na Safat bibaa Elaesa ne nɛra baa kpɔ daa dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ. Dɛ a lɔ bele fi dɛ anɛ, asɛ o teŋɛ fi dɛ anɛ te la nɛ. Asɛ Elaeja la Elaesa be dɛ ka foo o batakaare ta o nɛ.

english_verse: Elisha stopped plowing and ran after him. “Let me kiss my parents goodbye, then I'll go with you,” he said. “You can go,” Elijah said. “But remember what I've done for you.”
translation_verse: Elaesa ɡel nae la dɛ chwa teŋɛ Elaeja nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Gel ń ka kal n nya ne n mɛɛ dɛ́ ba n ne he kaa.” Anee Elaeja ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ won berɛ kaa, kɛ lii anɔ la bwa maa ɛa tɛɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha left and took his oxen with him. He killed them and boiled them over a fire he had made with the wood from his plow. He gave the meat to the people who were with him, and they ate it. Then he left with Elijah and became his assistant.
translation_verse: Asɛ Elaesa laa berɛ dɛ kpoo nae waa teŋɛ a nɛɛ la, dɛ fuh daa waa kpɔa dawɛ nae anɛ nɛɛ aa parɛ la, dɛ daa ola la tɛ nɛra la ba chwe. Asɛ o ka teŋɛ Elaeja nɛɛ dɛɛ chao.

english_verse: They dressed in sackcloth and put ropes on their heads, then they went to Ahab and said, “Your servant Benhadad asks you to let him live.” “Is he still alive?” Ahab asked. “Benhadad is like a brother to me.”
translation_verse: Ate, ba kpɔ lweyale mile chara dɛ kpɔ ɡboɡbie vɔrɔwe nyuune, dɛ la Israel Kooro Ahab be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔ Kooro Bɛn Hadad dɛ soŋe ŋɔ he ɡel ó dɔ o nyu.” Anee Israel Kooro Ahab chaŋe ŋɔ, “N lolee, o ta lole naa?”

english_verse: Benhadad sent a messenger to tell King Ahab of Israel,
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Bɛn Hadad tomɛ toroma Israel Kooro Ahab be o bwɛjen Samaria ta ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” Ahab replied, “everything I have is yours, including me.”

english_verse: Later, Benhadad sent another messenger to say to Ahab, “I already told you to give me your silver and gold, your wives, and your children.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab toroma la berɔ ba dɛ ba ŋɔ waa Kooro Bɛn Hadad aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, “N tomɛ toroma he be ŋɔ he kpɔ he suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne he haahna ne bii bwa tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: But tomorrow at this time, I will send my officials into your city to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will take everything else that you own.”
translation_verse: Kere saŋ nɔ, mɛɛ tomɛ n nomonomee bá ba nyiŋi he koodem ne he nomonome deremi, dɛ́ pa kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bɛlbwa baa naa.”

english_verse: “Don't listen to him!” they answered. “You don't have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Asɛ nomonome la ŋɔ, “Bɛ no, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ sɛh a taa tɛo.”

english_verse: So Ahab sent someone to tell Benhadad, “Your Majesty, I'll give you my silver and gold, and even my wives and children. But I won't let you have anything else.” When Benhadad got his answer,
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Bɛn Hadad toroma la be ŋɔ, “Hé ka ŋɔ n dɔɔ kooro be ŋɔ anɔ la o fa aa bola la n sɛoh, kɛ taraken kwaa nɔ te, maa sɛh.” Toroma la berɛ kaa dɛ ka bol Kooro Bɛn Hadad be.

english_verse: he replied, “I'll completely destroy Samaria! There won't even be enough of it left for my soldiers to carry back in their hands. If I don't do it, I pray that the gods will punish me terribly.”
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Bɛn Hadad berɛ tomɛ nɛra Kooro Ahab be dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ n ta ɡelɛ ba chɔɡ Samaria kwaraa naa, voɡare la tɛr n deŋne kohona.”

english_verse: At that very moment, a prophet ran up to Ahab and said, “You can see that Benhadad's army is very strong. But the Lord has promised to help you defeat them today. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.”
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa la, dɛ Korowii keame bɛl ba Israel Kooro Ahab be dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii ŋɔ kɛ he na laa tena baa wara nɔ kenɛ? Mɛɛ kpɔ baa do he nɔn taa fini, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”

english_verse: “Who will fight the battle?” Ahab asked. The prophet answered, “The young bodyguards who serve the district officials.” “But who will lead them into battle?” Ahab asked. “You will!” the prophet replied.
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Ahab ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ tɔ n sie ń ka yoo baɔ?” Korowii keame la ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ laa tena bechale baa lɔ laa sitɔɔla lɔɡa harɛ nɔ ta nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa.” Anee Kooro Ahab berɛ ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ pa yoi la mun ɔ?” Korowii keame la ŋɔ, “Henee dɛ́ pa laa la mun.”

english_verse: At noon, King Ahab and his Israelite army marched out of Samaria, with the young soldiers in front. King Benhadad of Syria and the
translation_verse: Israel laa tena bechale baa lɔ laa sitɔɔla lɔɡa harɛ la ta laanee tɔ sie le. Dɛ Kooro Bɛn Hadad ɡe tomɛ nɛra ba tɔ sie ka nyiŋi, asɛ ba ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Laa tena bane le Samaria dɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: and each of them attacked and killed an enemy soldier. The rest of the Syrian army turned and ran, and the Israelites went after them. Benhadad and some others escaped on horses,

english_verse: Meanwhile, Benhadad's officials went to him and explained: Israel's gods are mountain gods. We fought Israel's army in the hills, and that's why they defeated us. But if we fight them on flat land, there's no way we can lose.
