translation_verse: Dɛ kooro fa bol waa Korowii keame Elaesa bonɔɔ Gehasi be ŋɔ, “Baɡ mɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla bwa Elaesa aa ɛa.”

english_verse: While Gehazi was telling him that Elisha had brought a dead boy back to life, the woman and her son arrived. “Here's the boy, Your Majesty,” Gehazi said. “And this is his mother.”
translation_verse: Gehasi aa dena dɛɛ bol kooro be ɡɛ Elaesa aa chum bibaa bɛl seo ta la, dɛ haah la Elaesa aa chum o bibaa seo ta la, deno baa soŋe kooro ŋɔ, ó berɛ kpɔ o dem ne o harɛ tɛo. Gehasi ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, haah laanee la, o bie Elaesa aa ɡela o berɛ dɔ mkpa la ɡee la.”

english_verse: Some time later Elisha went to the capital city of Damascus to visit King Benhadad of Syria, who was sick. And when Benhadad was told he was there,
translation_verse: Korowii keame Elaesa la bwɛjen Damaskɔs dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad bwara dɛ weo. Kooro Bɛn Hadad aa noa kɛŋɔ o ba bela la,

english_verse: Hazael left with forty camel loads of the best things made in Damascus as a gift for Elisha. He found the prophet and said, “Your servant, King Benhadad, wants to know if he will get well.”
translation_verse: Ate, Hasael kpɔ kondɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi baa dɛ ɛa Damaskɔs choɡ nyoɡmare fifraanaarɛ dɛ ka kɛ Elaesa. O laŋɔ dɛ ka che o sie dɛ ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔ Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad tom mɛ ŋɔ n bɔɔ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɡbaŋre o weela la taa yaa?”

english_verse: “Tell him he will,” Elisha said to Hazael. “But the Lord has already told me that Benhadad will definitely die.”
translation_verse: Elaesa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡbaŋroo te, kɛ kasinteŋ, Korowii pili a bini baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ sewɔɔ.”

english_verse: Elisha stared at him until Hazael was embarrassed, then Elisha began crying.
translation_verse: Asɛ Elaesa kpɔ sie pa Hasael nɛɛ dɛ nyiŋu jeiih ken, sihiih kpo Hasael. Ate, buɡ la ta, Elaesa pa mun dɛɛ wi.

english_verse: “Sir, why are you crying?” Hazael asked. Elisha answered, “Because I know the terrible things you will do to the people of Israel. You will burn down their walled cities and slaughter their young men. You will even crush the heads of their babies and rip open their pregnant women.”
translation_verse: Anee Hasael ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ wi nɔɔ?” Elaesa ŋɔ, “N jemɛ wechɔɡa haa dɛ ba Israel tena ɛɛ. Hɛ́ɛ fuh ba bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara laanee. Dɛ́ kpoo ba bonɔɔna keri ne, dɛ́ tiɡri ba bechale nɛɛ do harɛ, dɛ́ ya ba tekpoŋra teene keri ne.”

english_verse: “How could I ever do anything like that?” Hazael replied. “I'm only a servant and don't have that kind of power.” “Hazael, the Lord has told me that you will be the next king of Syria.”
translation_verse: Anee Hasael bɔɔ ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔ, n ɡee ume maa wola toole wobɛlbwa bini kɛ nyoate, ásɛ n won ɛ ɡɛ wejena nɔ dɔŋa ɔ?” Elaesa chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii ɡelɔ n jemɛ kɛŋɔ, henee dɛ́ chiɡ Kooro Bɛn Hadad naa ta di kora Siiria harɛ ta.”

english_verse: Hazael went back to Benhadad and told him, “Elisha said that you will get well.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Hasael berɛ kaa Kooro Bɛn Hadad be, asɛ o pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa Elaesa bol he be nɔ?” Hasael chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ ɡbaŋroo.”

english_verse: But the very next day, Hazael got a thick blanket; he soaked it in water and held it over Benhadad's face until he died. Hazael then became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Kɛ tɔ aa pera la, Hasael kpɔ yatɔɡ pweh ne, dɛ kpɔ tɔ Kooro Bɛn Hadad siebɔr asɛ o sewɛ. Asɛ o chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora Siiria harɛ ta. Juda Kooro Jehoram

english_verse: While Jehoram was king, the people of Edom rebelled and chose their own king.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoram aa di kora saŋee Edom tena vɛh o toma, dɛ ka chiɡ ba kooro.

english_verse: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah in Joram's fifth year as king of Israel, while Jehoshaphat was still king of Judah.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab bibaa Joram aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene anue taa Jehosafat bibaa Jehoram ba di kora Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: Jehoram disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He married Ahab's daughter and was as sinful as Ahab's family and the kings of Israel.
translation_verse: O teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta. Dɛ o mo Kooro Ahab bihaah, anomanta, o ɛ wechɔɡa Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena aa ɛa la dɔŋa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord refused to destroy Judah, because he had promised his servant David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ Korowii koh o bonɔɔ Kooro Devid waa dɛ ŋɔ waa Juda harɛɛ chɔɡ. Dɛ Korowii baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ Kooro Devid naanar la bini bɛlee dɛ́ di kora Jerusalam saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: years old when he became king, and he ruled from Jerusalem for only one year. His mother was Athaliah, a granddaughter of King Omri of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba le fini, Edom tena vɛh Juda kooro toma. Gɛ saŋee bwɛjen Lebna tena ɡe vɛh o toma.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoram did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoram bwara waa kabora ne waa waa ɛa bwa la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Jehoram died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Ahaziah then became king. King Ahaziah of Judah (
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoram baa sewɛ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba ka huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Asɛ o bibaa Ahasia chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora. Juda Kooro Ahasia

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah in the twelfth year of Joram's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Ahab bibaa Joram aa di kora Israel harɛ bene fi dɛ anɛ ta la, a taa Jehoram bibaa Ahasia di kora Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: Since Ahaziah was related to Ahab's family, he acted just like them and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahasia aa ɛ Kooro Ahab lole nomanta, o teŋɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta dɛ di kora la ta, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Kooro Ahab dem tena aa ɛa la.

english_verse: Ahaziah went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Kooro Ahasia ne Israel Kooro Joram pɛ nyoa ka yo Siiria Kooro Hasael Ramɔt Gelead. Yoi la ta la, Siiria laa tena do Kooro Joram bol.

english_verse: so he went to the town of Jezreel to recover. Ahaziah went there to visit him.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Kooro Joram laa berɛ ba bwɛjen Jesreel dɛ baa chah, asɛ Kooro Ahasia la bela dɛ ka nao o bol baa doo la wa.

english_verse: One day, Elisha called for one of the other prophets and said: Take this bottle of olive oil and get ready to go to the town of Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, Korowii keame Elaesa yerɛ Korowii keamere bane baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ la bɛl dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gbaa he batakaare kaa nyundua dɛ́ vɔwɛ kiriso, dɛ́ kpɔ noo nɔ aa lɔ loŋ nɔ bini nɔ la Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta.

english_verse: When you get there, find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Take him to a place where the two of you can be alone,
translation_verse: He tel belaa, ɡaaɡe Jehosafat bibaa Jehu, o nabaa aa ɛ Nimsi bɔr. La o be, dɛ́ yerɔ le o bala bini he ne o jo kaa dea bini,

english_verse: then pour olive oil on his head to show that he is the new king. Say to him, “The Lord has chosen you to be king of Israel.” Then leave quickly—don't wait around for anything!
translation_verse: dɛ́ fuɡe noo la do o nyu ta dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘On Korowiirii fuɡe noo dɛɛ do he nyu ta, dɛɛ cheɡe kora Israel harɛ ta.’ ” Ásɛ he ya ɡbera, dɛ chwa le warane, dɛɛ berɛ cheɡa.

english_verse: The young prophet left for Ramoth.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii keame bechala la ir, dɛ la Ramɔt Gelead.

english_verse: When he arrived, the army officers were meeting together. “Sir, I have a message for you,” he said. “For which one of us?” Jehu asked. “You, sir,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: Waa tel bela la, o na laa nomonome baa pɛa so. O yerɛ Jehu dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, n poori n dɔ kala bɛl dɛ bol he be.” Anee Jehu bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Ya bini umeo?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, n poori, henee.”

english_verse: So Jehu got up and went inside. The prophet poured olive oil on Jehu's head and told him: The Lord God of Israel has this message for you: “I am the Lord, and I have chosen you to be king of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Asɛ Jehu ir o ne o jo dea, Korowii keame la ka fuɡe noo la do o nyu ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Men Korowiirii fuɡe noo do he nyu ta, dɛɛ cheɡe kora ta n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.

english_verse: I want you to wipe out the family of Ahab, so Jezebel will be punished for killing the prophets and my other servants.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ he kpo he dɔɔ Kooro Ahab luɡe nɛra, dɛ́ he ba kwaraa, ásɛ n bɔ Jɛsɛbɛl kem n keamere ne n bonɔɔna waa kpoo ba la wa.

english_verse: His whole family must be destroyed, just like the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɛ Ahab lolanaree kɛŋɔ Israel Kooro Jɛroboam, ne Ahija bibaa Kooro Baasa lolanar ken.

english_verse: As for Jezebel, her body will be eaten by dogs in the town of Jezreel. There won't be enough left of her to bury.” Then the young prophet opened the door and ran out.
translation_verse: Kɛ Jɛsɛbɛl te, nyootenaa dɛɛ ba o ola dii bwɛjen Jesreel bwɛdaa ta. Nomɛlbwa aa o huɡa ba.’ ” Ate, Korowii keame la laa ɡbera ya dɛ chwa kaa.

english_verse: Jehu went back to his officers, and one of them asked, “What did that crazy prophet want? Is everything all right?” “You know him and how he talks,” Jehu answered.
translation_verse: Jehu aa le buse dɛ la o nomondɔŋa la be la, asɛ bɛl pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa choɡla te la ba he be ba ɛɔ? Wobɛlbwa maɡraa?” O chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He ɡbabir jemɔ, dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ bol wa.”

english_verse: “No, we don't. What did he say?” they asked. “He had a message from the Lord,” Jehu replied. “He said that the Lord has chosen me to be the next king of Israel.”
translation_verse: Anee ba ŋɔ, “Nyosone yaa jemɛ, bol ya be.” Ate Jehu ŋɔ, “Waa waa bol n be laanee nɔ, ‘Waa Korowii aa bol n be laanee kɛŋɔ, ń fuɡe noo do he nyu ta dɛ́ cheɡe kora Israel harɛ ta.’ ”

english_verse: They quickly grabbed their coats and spread them out on the steps where Jehu was standing. Someone blew a trumpet, and everyone shouted, “Jehu is king!” Jehu Kills Joram and Ahaziah
translation_verse: Buɡ la ta, ba ir ɛ warane, dɛ wur ba batakaani, dɛ kpɔ pa kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛ jo dea la, asɛ Jehu valɛ a ta. Dɛ hoh bɛle dɛ moo ŋɔ, “Jehu di kora.” Israel Kooro Joram kpoe

english_verse: When the guard in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men riding up, he shouted to the king, “I see a large group of men coming this way.” Joram ordered, “Send someone out to ask them if this is a friendly visit.”
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl waa dɛ daah Jesreel cheɡɛ dejaŋ doa dɛ na Kooro Jehu ne o laa tena aa dɛ ba, asɛ o do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N na laa tena bane aa dɛ ba.” Anee Kooro Joram ŋɔ, “Tomɛ nomɛl ó so jaaɡɔ ta dɛ́ ka bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, ‘A somaa?’ ”

english_verse: One of the soldiers rode out and said to Jehu, “King Joram wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just stay behind me with the rest of my troops!” About the same time the guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back.”
translation_verse: Ate, torome la kpɔ jaaɡɔ dɛ ka bɔɔ Kooro Jehu ŋɔ, “Kooro ŋɔ n bɔɔre ŋɔ a somaa?” Kooro Jehu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna dɛ ɛɔ? Ba kaa n habɔɔ ka che.” Nɛn waa cheɡɛ jɛŋla la doa dɛɛ daah bwɛɛ la ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “Torome la tel Kooro Jehu ne o nɛra la be, kɛ o berɔ ka ja ba nɛ, waa berɛ dɛɛ ba kpa.”

english_verse: So Joram sent out another rider, who rode up to Jehu and said, “The king wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just get behind me with the rest of my troops!”
translation_verse: Asɛ kooro la berɛ tomɛ torome bɛl ja o so jaaɡɔ ta, dɛ la ka bɔɔro waa la tenten. Waa tel ba be la, o ŋɔ, “Kooro ŋɔ, ‘A somaa?’ ” Ate, Kooro Jehu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna dɛ ɛɔ? Ba kaa n habɔɔ ka che.”

english_verse: The guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back either. Wait a minute! That one man is a reckless chariot driver—it must be Jehu!”
translation_verse: Ate, nɛn waa dɛ daah bwɛɛ la berɛ ŋɔ, “Torome la telo kɛ waa berɛ dɛɛ ba kpa. Nɛn waa tɔ ba sie baa ba la le Nimsi naa Kooro Jehu. O soɡe torɔɡo bini dɛɛ ba, dɛ le choɡla te.”

english_verse: Joram commanded, “Get my chariot ready.” Then he and Ahaziah got in their chariots and rode out to meet Jehu. They all met on the land that had belonged to Naboth.
translation_verse: Kooro Joram ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ torɔɡo maa vɔwa dɛɛ pɛl jaaɡɔ la vɔwɛ warane.” Baa tona la, asɛ Kooro Joram waa ɛ Israel harɛ kooro ne Juda Kooro Ahasia bɛlbwa kpɔ o torɔɡo, dɛ ka cheme Kooro Jehu. Ba kaa chemo harɛ waa ɛ Jesreel te baa yerɔ Nabɔt koo ta.

english_verse: Joram asked, “Jehu, is this a peaceful visit?” “How can there be peace?” Jehu asked. “Your mother Jezebel has caused everyone to worship idols and practice witchcraft.”
translation_verse: Kooro Joram aa na Kooro Jehu la, o bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Kooro Jehu, a somaa?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ɛɛ ba wona do le nɔ? He nya Jɛsɛbɛl ɡelɔ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ tomɛ voɡa dɛɛ ɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla.”

english_verse: “Ahaziah, let's get out of here!” Joram yelled. “It's a trap!” As Joram tried to escape,
translation_verse: Kooro Joram laa o jaaɡɔ sie berɛ, dɛ ŋɔ Ahasia be ŋɔ, “Gel yá le bonɔ warane, o dɛ neɡre yaa.”

english_verse: Jehu shot an arrow. It hit Joram between his shoulders, then it went through his heart and came out his chest. He fell over dead in his chariot.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Jehu laa o to ne hɛm kpɔ dɛ ta yaɡɛ Kooro Joram nyaŋ o vah ba le o tom ta, asɛ o sewɛ chɔ o torɔɡo bini.

english_verse: Jehu commanded his assistant Bidkar, “Get Joram's body and throw it in the field that Naboth once owned. Do you remember when you and I used to ride side by side behind Joram's father Ahab? It was then that the Lord swore to Ahab that he would be punished in the same field where he had killed Naboth and his sons. So throw Joram's body there, just as the Lord said.”
translation_verse: ‘N na Nabɔt ne o bii kpoe nɔ wa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛ mɛɛ bɔɔ a kemee ɡɛ harɛ nɔ tenten ta. Gɔɔro, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka ta koo nɔ ta ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.’ ” Juda Kooro Ahasia kpoe

english_verse: Ahaziah saw all of this happen and tried to escape to the town of Beth-Haggan, but Jehu caught up with him and shouted, “Kill him too!” So his troops shot Ahaziah with an arrow while he was on the road to Gur near Ibleam. He went as far as Megiddo, where he died.
translation_verse: Juda harɛ Kooro Ahasia aa na ɡɛ la, o chwao kpɔ o torɔɡo la, dɛ lawɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Bɛt Haɡan ta. Asɛ Kooro Jehu tiu dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre o laa tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpo o ɡe.” Ba do Kooro Ahasia bol ɡɛ saŋ waa cheɡɛ o torɔɡo la bini, asɛ jaɡre la tɛɡre torɔɡo la, dɛ chwa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa kaa bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Gur, waa bɛne Ibleam. Kɛ o berɔ won teŋɛ chwa kaa bwɛjen Meɡido ta, dɛ ka sewɛ bela.

english_verse: Ahaziah's officers put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried him beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: Asɛ o bonɔɔna kpɔɔ do torɔɡo la bini, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Jerusalam baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta, dɛ ka huɡo o naawa lalbɔɔ bini.

english_verse: Ahaziah had become king of Judah in the eleventh year of the rule of Ahab's son Joram. Jehu Kills Jezebel
translation_verse: Kooro Ahab bibaa Joram aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ taa Kooro Ahasia di kora Juda harɛ ta. Haŋkooro Jɛsɛbɛl kpoe

english_verse: Jehu headed toward Jezreel, and when Jezebel heard he was coming, she put on eye shadow and brushed her hair. Then she stood at the window, waiting for him to arrive.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Jehu la Jesreel. Jɛsɛbɛl aa no o bala waa la, o do jeemina dɛ ɛ o nyumpona a do wer. O laa dejaŋ waa soɡe o bini tokoro pili dɛɛ kpao.

english_verse: As he walked through the city gate, she shouted down to him, “Why did you come here, you murderer? To kill the king? You're no better than Zimri!”
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu aa baa tel bwɛɛ la doonyojen ta la, Jɛsɛbɛl ŋɔ, “He ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne naa? Nɛŋkpoa te bɛl le! Henee Simri waa kpo o dɔɔ la!”

english_verse: He looked up toward the window and asked, “Is anyone up there on my side?” A few palace workers stuck their heads out of a window,
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Jehu ha sie dɛ nao tokoro ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Umee ja n nɛɔ?” Asɛ nomonome banɛ kɛɛ batoro baa lɔ koodem bela ba fɔɡɛ ba lure baa daah kooro haahna ba sie ne harɛ dɛɛ nyiŋu.

english_verse: and Jehu shouted, “Throw her out the window!” They threw her down, and her blood splattered on the walls and on the horses that trampled her body.
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Jehu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé lawɔ dɛ́ kpɔɔ viɡri harɛ.” Asɛ ba lawɛ Jɛsɛbɛl viɡri harɛ, o chal yaɡre danjwɛɛ ne jaɡre la, asɛ a tiɡru do harɛ.

english_verse: Jehu left to get something to eat and drink. Then he told some workers, “Even though she was evil, she was a king's daughter, so make sure she has a proper burial.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Jehu jo koodem bela, dɛ ka di kwaa dɛ nyɔ sen. Dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ka kpɔ haah baa taahno la dɛ́ ka kwaaro, o fa ɛ koobie, hé nyiŋi dɛ́ huɡo kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: But when they went out to bury her body, they found only her skull, her hands, and her feet.
translation_verse: Baa laŋa ŋɔ ba ka kpɔɔ ka huɡe la, ba ta o bobɛlbwa nae ka ja o nyuhoɡ ne nakpahoɡa dɛ o nɔnhoɡa nɛ.

english_verse: They reported this to Jehu, and he said, “The Lord told Elijah the prophet that Jezebel's body would be eaten by dogs right here in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Ate, ba la dɛ ka ŋɔ Kooro Jehu be. Asɛ o ŋɔ, “A ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Elaeja Tisbe te nɛɛ dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Jesreel harɛ taa nyootena ɛɛ ba Jɛsɛbɛl ola dii la ɛ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: And he warned that her bones would be spread all over the ground like manure, so that no one could tell who it was.”
translation_verse: O hoɡa ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ bena aa chɔ puldoa ken do harɛ la ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola o jema ba.’ ”

english_verse: Your town is strong, and you're protected by chariots and an armed cavalry. And I know that King Ahab's descendants live there with you. So as soon as you read this letter,
translation_verse: “Kooro Ahab bii lɔ he be, asɛ he dɔ torɔɡore, ne jaɡre dɛ dɔmkwa, asɛ ba ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar he bwɛjen o do kpeɡri. Dɛ tɔn nɔ tel he be naa,

english_verse: choose the best person for the job and make him the next king. Then be prepared to defend Ahab's family.
translation_verse: hé nyiŋi he dɔɔ bii la bini onɔ la waa maɡra o waa do wer, ásɛ he kpɔɔ so o mɛɛ buɡ ta ó di kora, ásɛ he che o mun ta dɛ́ yo dɛɛ tɛo.”

english_verse: The officials and leaders read the letters and were very frightened. They said to each other, “Jehu has already killed King Joram and King Ahaziah! We have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Baa kure tɔn la, ba ɔmɔ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro Joram ne Kooro Ahasia kwaraa ta wone che Kooro Jehu sie, ɛrɛɛ ya te ɛɛ ba wona ɔ?”

english_verse: The prime minister, the mayor of the city, as well as the other leaders and Ahab's supporters, sent this answer to Jehu, “We are your servants, Your Majesty, and we will do whatever you tell us. But it's not our place to choose someone to be king. You do what you think is best.”
translation_verse: Koodem bela nomoa, ne onɔ la waa dɛ nyiŋi bwɛjen la ta, ne nomonnyuune ne nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Kooro Ahab bii nɛɛ tomɔ ba ka ŋɔ Kooro Jehu be ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔnaa yan, wobɛlbwa haa bol ya be la, yaa ɛo. Yaa kooro bɛlbwa cheɡa ba, ɛ ɡɛ bwa aa maɡra tɛɛ.”

english_verse: Jehu then wrote another letter which said, “If you are on my side and will obey me, then prove it. Bring me the heads of the descendants of Ahab! And be here in Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” The
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Jehu berɛ chwerɛ tɔn nɛɛte ja ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ja n nɛɛ dɛɛ no n waa tenaa, hé kpɔ Kooro Ahab bibaala nyuune ba tɛ mɛ Jesreel kere saŋ nɔ bɔr.” Dɛ Kooro Ahab bibaala fifraanuanɛ la lɔ bwɛjen Samaria nomonnyuune la be baa nyiŋi ba nɛ.

english_verse: When Jehu was told what had happened, he said, “Put the heads in two piles at the city gate, and leave them there until morning.”
translation_verse: Torome la aa bala la, o ŋɔ Kooro Jehu be kɛŋɔ, nɛra bane kpɔ kooro naanar nyuune la ba Jesreel. Asɛ Kooro Jehu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá pa darawe dɔŋa nɛɛ bɔre anɛ bwɛjen la doonyojen bela, á chɔ ka tel kere chɔɔ.

english_verse: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood where everyone could hear him, and he said, “You people are not guilty of anything. I'm the one who plotted against Joram and had him killed. But who killed all these men?
translation_verse: Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Kooro Jehu le buse dɛ ba che bwɛɛ la tena bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ta bolchɔɡe dii, menee vɔrɔwe Kooro Joram vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo. Aah umee kpoo banɔ bwa ɡeɔ?

english_verse: Listen to me. Everything the Lord's servant Elijah promised about Ahab's family will come true.”
translation_verse: Anɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Kooro Ahab dem nɛra waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Elaeja nɛɛ dɛ bol la bwa ɛ kpela.”

english_verse: Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu kpoo Kooro Ahab dem nɛra baa kaa dɛ do Jesreel bwa, ne o nomonjena ne o daamanar dɛ voɡra bwa. O ta o nomɛlbwa ɡelɛ. Kooro Ahasia lolanar kpoora

english_verse: Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered. “We're going to visit his family.”
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu cheme Juda Kooro Ahasia lolanar bini bane bela, asɛ dɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Heyaa bamewa ɔ?” Ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Kooro Ahasia lolanaree yan. Ya dɛ la Jesreel ka chɔɔ haŋkooro Jɛsɛbɛl bii ne o lolanar bwa.”

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Jehu said to his officers. So they grabbed them and led them to the well near the shepherds' meeting place, where they killed all
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Jehu do o nɛra baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé laɡ ba dɛ bɛ ban kpoo!” Asɛ ba laɡ ba, dɛ ba lɔ nɛra fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ. Ba kpoo ba bwa Bɛt Ɛkɛd bela bule bɛl bɔr, bɛlbwa ta kae. Kooro Ahab lolanar kabora kpoora

english_verse: As Jehu went on, he saw Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him, then said, “Jehonadab, I'm on your side. Are you on mine?” “Yes, I am.” “Then give me your hand,” Jehu answered. He helped Jehonadab into his chariot
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu aa le bela ɡe dɛɛ kaa la, o cheme Rekab bibaa Jɛhɔnadab. Asɛ Kooro Jehu jaamo dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N ne he liire bwa beŋkpoŋ, hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ kɛɛ?” Jɛhɔnadab chaŋe ŋɔ, “N sɛh ɡɛ.” Kooro Jehu ŋɔ, “Dɛ ɡɛɛ tenaa ɡwaa mɛ.” Asɛ ba ɡwa dɔŋa, Jehu chao dɛ lawɔ o teeh torɔɡo waa soɡe o bini la.

english_verse: and said, “Come with me and see how faithful I am to the Lord.” They rode together in Jehu's chariot
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya kaa ásɛ he ka na ɡɛ Korowii waa aa lɔ n bini kɛrɛdɛ.” Asɛ ba bwa che Kooro Jehu torɔɡo la bini, dɛ kaa bwɛjen Samaria.

english_verse: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah. Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
translation_verse: Baa tel Samaria la, Kooro Jehu kpoo Kooro Ahab nɛra baa kaa dɛ do bela la bwa. Beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Elaeja nɛɛ dɛ bol la. Voɡ Baal toroma kpoora

english_verse: Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said: King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Jehu yerɛ Samaria tena bwa cheme dɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro Ahab tomɛ voɡ Baal tama, kɛ n te ɛɛ tomɔɔ kohona.

english_verse: I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed. But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal.
translation_verse: Hé yerɛ Baal voɡra ne o kerekpoŋra ne o keamere bwa ba. He bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa ka, n dɔ sarahajen dɛɛ ba ɛɛ tɛ Baal. Nomɛlbwa waa wola balɛ la aa o nyuu dɔ.” Kɛ dɛ neɡra ŋwɛnɛɛ Kooro Jehu ɛɛ kpɔ, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal bwa.

english_verse: He said, “Announce a day of worship for Baal!” After the day had been announced,
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu ŋɔ, “Hé bol dɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛ ya le tɔpere yaa cheme cheɡ dɛ́ tomɛ voɡ Baal.” Asɛ ba bol.

english_verse: Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Jehu tomɛ nɛra Israel harɛ ta bwa, asɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal bwa la, bɛlbwa toole waa wola laŋɛ. Ba bwa kaa su voɡ Baal dea, le doonyoa kaa bini bwa.

english_verse: Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Jehu ŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi kon voɡ batakaani aa lɔ o bini be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ batakaani ba tɛ Baal toroma bwa.” Asɛ o ka pa batakaani la ba tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, “Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.”
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu ne Rekab bibaa Jɛhɔnadab jo Baal dea bela. Kooro Jehu ŋɔ voɡ Baal toroma la be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi he bini dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ Korowii toroma toole he bini, voɡ Baal toroma ɡboo he bwa.”

english_verse: As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu aa dena ka ɛ saraha baa fuah la tonɛ la, o baa do nɛra baa cheɡɛ buse dɛɛ daah ne nomonome la ŋɔ, “Hé la ka kpoo ba, he bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa dɔ bɔr chwa.” Anomanta, ba kaa kpoo ba keri ne, dɛ pa ba lala ta buse, dɛ jo voɡ Baal dea la bini kaa,

english_verse: and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it
translation_verse: dɛ kpɔ bwe baa pao ɛ voɡ dɛɛ tomɔ la le dea la bini dɛ fuuh.

english_verse: and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba paɡre voɡ Baal bwe la, dɛ kuuɡi o dea la dɛ kpɔ bela berɛ bembɔɔ dɛ ba le fini.

english_verse: But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o ta teŋɛ Kooro Jɛroboam wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ la ta, suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔa ɛ nabali a che bwɛɛre anɛ ane baa dɛ yera Bɛtel ne Dan la.

english_verse: Later the Lord said, “Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.”
translation_verse: A habɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Jehu be ŋɔ, “He ɛ ɡɛ maa ŋɔa he chɔɡ Kooro Ahab naanar bwa, anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar ɛ koranar ka tel naanar bele banaarɛ baa ka ba nɛ, dɛɛ di kora Israel harɛ ta.”

english_verse: But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do. Jehu Dies
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, Kooro Jehu ta Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la mmarare ta teŋɛ o bambile bwa ne, dɛ teŋɛ wechɔɡa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la ta. Kooro Jehu seo

english_verse: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ Korowii pa mun dɛ ɡel Israel harɛ mule, Siiria Kooro Hasael yoo ba, dɛ lɛ ba harɛ la bobɛla,

english_verse: of the regions of Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan River and north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River. This was the land where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh had once lived.
translation_verse: le Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr harɛ dɛ kaa Arowa weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ kaa Aanɔn Moo ta, dɛ kpɔ Gelead harɛ bwa ne Basan, bela Gad ne Rubin deene, dɛ Manasɛ wee leebɔr dea tena aa soɡa bwa.

english_verse: Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu bwara waa kar ne anɔ la waa wona ɛ bwa, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Jehu died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu sewɔ ba huɡo Samaria, asɛ o bibaa Jehoahas chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ lampeare ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta, a ɛ Kooro Devid kwaa ba kpɔ cheɡ Korowii Dea la tɛ laa sitɔɔla la.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Name sɔfo Jehoiada ka lawɛ Joas le buse, dɛ kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ piu, dɛ kpɔ fɔo baa fɔwa dɛ che o ta dɛɛ di kora harɛ la ta do o nɔn ta. Dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora ta, asɛ ba lɔ kpaŋa dɛ moo ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ!”

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah. Jehoiada Makes Joash King of Judah (
translation_verse: Jehoseba kpɔ Joas sɔh Korowii Dea bela bene anumɛl, ɡɛ saŋ haŋkooro Atalia aa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta la.

english_verse: Joash was only seven years old when this happened.
translation_verse: Kooro Joas aa di kora Juda harɛ dɛ o dɔ bene anuanɛ.

english_verse: Joash son of Ahaziah had hidden in the Lord's temple six years. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the king's special bodyguards and the commanders of the palace guards. They met him at the temple, and he asked them to make a promise in the name of the Lord. Then he brought out Joash
translation_verse: Joas lawa ka sɔh bene anuanɛ habɔɔ la, sɔfo Jehoiada ɡelɔ ba yerɛ laa sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi laa tena baa dɛ daah kooro, ne laa tena baa dɛ daah koodem. Asɛ o ɡel ba ba bane o be Korowii Dea, o ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo ba ŋwɛɛ ntam Korowii Dea bela. O kpɔ Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas baɡ ba.

english_verse: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.
translation_verse: O do ba ŋɔ, “Gɛ maa dɛ nyin kɛ he ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, he balɔ dɛɛ ba ba daah Korowii Dea Ona Tɔpere aa, he bini bele batoro ba daah koodem,

english_verse: Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.
translation_verse: bele batoro ɡe ka so doonyoa baa dɛ yerɔ Sur la nyoa, ásɛ bele batoro ɡe ɛɛ daah doonyoa waa lɔ koodem doonyoa habɔɔ la.

english_verse: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.
translation_verse: Nɛmbele banɛ baa wola la ka daah Ona Tɔpere la bwa ka so Korowii Dea dɛɛ daah kooro.

english_verse: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he dɔmkwaa kpoŋe dɛ́ che bar kooro, dɛ́ so o jwɛh bobɛlbwa waa kaa. Ásɛ nomɛlbwa ba dɛ kaa kooro jwɛh aa, hé kpoo.”

english_verse: Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.
translation_verse: Ate, o ɡel nɛra baa dɛ daah la bɛlbwa kpoŋe o dɔmkon ba che Korowii Dea, ne saraha kon la sie, dɛ bar Kooro Joas.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns, which was the usual place for the king. The singers and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the people were celebrating and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: O baa na kɛŋɔ kooro la cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la sie pila bɛl jwɛh ɡɛ ba nawee wa aa doa. Asɛ laa sitɔɔla ne bɛlhoohla che kooro jwɛh. Asɛ harɛ la ta nomɛlbwa sie lɛ, baa hoh bɛle. Belaa haŋkooro Atalia laa o batakaare kɛɛ a baɡle kɛ o baah diu kohona, dɛ ŋɔ, “He bwa lee mɛ tɛ! He ɛɛ mɛ dɔm!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Kill her! But don't do it anywhere near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops and kill anyone who is with her!”
translation_verse: Dɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa nyin kɛ bá kpo Atalia Korowii Dea bɔr bela, anomanta, o do laa sitɔɔla la ŋɔ, “Hé lawɔ le laa tena nɔ baah ta, dɛ́ kpo nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛ ó ba lɛo.”

english_verse: So the commanders dragged her to the gate where horses are led into the palace, and they killed her there.
translation_verse: Ate, ba tɛɡro le, dɛ kpoo Jaɡre Doonyoa, bela jaɡre aa cheɡa dɛɛ jo koodem la ta. Jehoiada mmara waa chara

english_verse: Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars. After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Harɛ la ta nɛra bwa la voɡ Baal dea, dɛ ka paɡre kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo, ne voɡare aa lɔ dea la bini bwa kwaraa. Dɛ lawɛ o kerekpoŋri baa dɛ yerɔ Matan, dɛ kpoo kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la sie. Asɛ sɔfo Jehoiada ɡel nɛra baa dɛ daah la ka che dɛɛ daah Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Jehoiada ɡelɔ laa sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi laa tena baa dɛ daah kooro, ne laa tena baa dɛ daah koodem, ne harɛ la ta nɛra bwa kpɔ kooro la le Korowii Dea bela, dɛ kpɔɔ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah la aa dɛ kpɔ o ta, dɛ ba o ne koodem o ba so kookara ta.

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Asɛ harɛ la ta nɛra bwa sie lɛ, bwɛjen la sɔɔh, kpoe baa kpo haŋkooro Atalia koodem la wa.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord.
translation_verse: Kooro Joas ɛ waa aa dɛ too Korowii tea, dɛkalkɛ sɔfo Jehoiada baɡlo wa.

english_verse: Joash became king of Judah in Jehu's seventh year as king of Israel, and he ruled
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu aa di kora Israel harɛ bene anuanɛ taa Kooro Joas di kora Juda harɛ ta. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanaarɛ. O nya sɔne Sebea, dɛ le bwɛjen Beɛseeba.

english_verse: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
translation_verse: Bolchɔɡe dii saraha ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha suuɡa te, baa a te kpɔe baa do daka la bini, a te ɛ sɔfore la kwa.

english_verse: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Kɛ Kooro Joas ta ɡelɛ ba chɔɡ bɔra voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ ba voɡa, asɛ ba ta teŋɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma bela.

english_verse: One day, Joash said to the priests, “Collect all the money that has been given to the Lord's temple, whether from taxes or gifts,
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, Kooro Joas ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Hé lɛ suuɡare baa dɛ ba a ne baa ɛ sarahare Korowii Dea la bwa. Anɔ la baa dɛ ba a ne tɔpere bɛlbwa, ne deŋnesɔɔhna kwaa ne an la aa le bambile bini ba kpɔ dɛɛ ba bwa.

english_verse: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule,
translation_verse: Kɛ Kooro Joas aa di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro la, dɛ sɔfore la ta Korowii Dea la bobɛlbwa kwaarɛ mɔɔ.

english_verse: Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, o yerɛ sɔfo Jehoiada ne sɔfore baa jaa la dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ haa wola Korowii Dea la kwaa nɔɔ? Le fini dɛɛ kaa, he bɛ suuɡare dɛɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ cheɡ suuɡa la be kpa, he ba a ne bá kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la.”

english_verse: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
translation_verse: Asɛ sɔfore la sɛh kɛŋɔ baa suuɡaa lɛ le nɛra la be, ba ɡbaɡba ɡe aa Korowii Dea laanee kwaa.

english_verse: Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box.
translation_verse: Asɛ sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ daka bɛl dɛ forɛ o tɔ bɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ ka cheɡ kon baa kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la jwɛh, doonyoa baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ jo Korowii Dea la diɡ bɔr. Sɔfore baa dɛ daah ɡɛ doonyoa la, yon kpɔ suuɡare nɛra aa dɛ ba a ne Korowii Dea bela la bwa do o bini.

english_verse: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.
translation_verse: Ba nao kɛŋɔ suuɡa warɛ o bini naa, koodem karake ne Sɔfonomoa yon ba kure dɛ́ pa do pure bini.

english_verse: Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers,
translation_verse: Ba kuro dɛ jemɛ a nyoa aa, ba yon kpɔ do nɛra baa lee ba baa nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea toma la nɔn ta. Ba yon kpɔ a ne bɔ kapenta tena ne mamaala baa dɛ kwaa Korowii Dea la,

english_verse: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
translation_verse: ne nɛra baa dɛ peɡri bwea, ne anɔ la baa kpɔ yawɛ daa, ne bwea baa sɛah dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la, dɛ ane bɛlbwa ɡe aa jaa.

english_verse: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.
translation_verse: Ba ta suuɡa la bɛlbwa kpɔe bɔ suuɡapoŋ loɡa, ne loɡa baa do chal kɛɛ nee a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ kwaa ta, ne bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ menɛ kandere ŋwɛɛra ne bɛle, kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm komɛlbwa, kɛɛ suuɡapoŋ dɛ cheɡ Korowii Dea bela.

english_verse: The men in charge were honest, so no one had to keep track of the money.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ suuɡa la tɛ baa ɛ toma la ta soɡe ba ne tom-ɛɛra la bu nkontaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba ɛ toma la kɛrɛdɛ ba waa dɔ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ dɛ Siiria Kooro Hasael ne o laa tena laŋɔ ka yo bwɛjen Gat tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Jerusalam dɛ́ fe ba yo ba ɡe.

english_verse: So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Joas kpɔ kondɛɛɡa aa do ɡoroŋ o ne o naawa koranar Jehosafat, ne Jehoram dɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Ahasia aa kpɔa do Korowii nɔn ta, dɛ kpɔ o kwaa ja dɛ suuɡaswɛm aa lɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini Korowii Dea ne koodem bwa, ka kɛ Kooro Hasael, asɛ o ɡel Jerusalam tena ba yoi.

english_verse: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa Kooro Joas aa ɛa ɡɛ saŋ waa dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_verse: O nomonome baa kpoo ba la bɛl sɔne Josabad, o mɛɛ sɔne Simiat, dɛ Jehosabad, o ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Soma. Kooro Joas aa sewa la, ba huɡo o naawa lalbɔɔ bini Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, asɛ o bibaa Amasea ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.

english_verse: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash's rule in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled
translation_verse: Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro taa Kooro Jehu bibaa Kooro Jehoahas di kora Israel harɛ ta. Dɛ bwɛjen Samariaa o so, dɛ di kora bene fi dɛ anuanɛ.

english_verse: and said, “Open the window facing east.” When it was open, Elisha shouted, “Now shoot!” Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, “That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.”
translation_verse: Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ kooro la be ŋɔ, “Laa wee leebɔr tokoro nɔ pili.” Asɛ o laa pili. Elaesa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ta hɛm la.” Asɛ kooro la ta hɛm la ta. Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ, “Henee cheɡa tɛ Korowii hɛm waa che o ta dɛ́ ɡel he pɔ Siiria tena nɛ. Hɛɛ yoo ba bwɛjen Afɛk waa lɔ Siiria harɛ taa, ka tel kɛŋɔ haa pɔ ba nɛ kwaraa ken.”

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoahas teŋɛ waa Kooro Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena che a ta ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ la ta, o ta an ɡelɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii baah di Israel tena nɛɛ taeh, asɛ o kpɔ ba do Siiria Kooro Hasael, ne o bibaa Bɛn Hadad lɔɡa biɡri.

english_verse: Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoahas soŋe Korowii a wa, asɛ o no. Dɛ Korowii na fiiɡa Siiria kooro aa dɛ fiiɡi Israel tena kohona.

english_verse: by sending Israel a leader who rescued them from the Syrians, and the Israelites lived in peace as they had before.
translation_verse: Korowii le nɛn tɛ Israel tena, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le Siiria tena lɔɡa, ba berɛ so deŋnesɔɔhna ta ɡɛ ba fa aa soɡa wubwa la.

english_verse: Jehoash became king of Israel in the thirty-seventh year of Joash's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Kooro Joas aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ taa Kooro Jehoahas bibaa Kooro Jehoas di kora Israel harɛ ta. O soɡe Samaria di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa ɡe Kooro Jehoahas aa ɛa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash became king. King Jehoash of Israel
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoahas baa sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo bela baa huɡe o naawa bwɛjen Samaria. Asɛ o bibaa Jehoas chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora. Israel Kooro Jehoas

english_verse: “Grab a bow and some arrows,” Elisha told him, “and hold them in your hand.” Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ Israel kooro la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ to la kpoŋe.” Asɛ o kpɔ kpoŋe, asɛ Elaesa kpɔ o nɔɔra dawɛ o nɔɔra ta.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by doing just like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoas ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛ teŋɛ wechɔɡa Kooro Jɛroboam waa ɛ Nɛbat bibaa waa waa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la ta.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa Kooro Jehoas aa ɛa ne laa o ne Juda Kooro Amasea aa yoa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king. Elisha the Prophet Dies
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoas sewɔ dɛ ka chɔ o naawa Israel koranar hoɡa ta Samaria. Asɛ o bibaa Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora. Elaesa seo wa

english_verse: Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, “Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you?”
translation_verse: Korowii keame Elaesa bwara weo, a taa o che dɛ sewɛ. Asɛ Israel Kooro Jehoas la dɛ ka nao dɛ wi baɡlo dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ! N dɔɔ! Nɛn waa cheɡɛ Israel tena habɔɔ!”

english_verse: Elisha said, “Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them.” Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ hɛma aa kaa la lɔ harɛ.” Asɛ kooro la kpɔ hɛma la lɔ harɛ kera atoro dɛ ɡel.

english_verse: Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, “If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.”
translation_verse: Korowii keame Elaesa baah di kooro la nɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ he fee kpɔ lɔ harɛ kera anue kɛɛ kera anumɛl, dɛ́ fee won pɔ Siiria tena nɛɛ kwaraa dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, kɛ kera atoro ɡboo hɛɛ ba wona pɔ ba nɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha died and was buried. Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii keame Elaesa baa sewɛ asɛ ba huɡo. Dɛ benanyoa bɛlbwa, Moab tena yon lɔ ba tɔ Israel tena nɛɛ dɛ́ kah ba kwa, dɛ́ berɛ kaa warane.

english_verse: Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up. Israel Defeats Syria
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, dɛ Israel tena dɛ huɡe nomɛl, asɛ dɛ na Moab nɛnlaa bane baa dɛ ba ba kah ba kwa. Anee Israel tena la kpɔ chɔɔ la ta bwebɔɔ baa huɡe Elaesa o bini la, dɛ chwa kaa. Chɔɔ la aa dena ka leɡe Elaesa hoɡa la, o berɔ dɔ mkpa dɛ ir che o naa ta. Israel ne Siiria tena laa yoi

english_verse: Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Siiria Kooro Hasael fiiɡi Israel tena, ɡɛ saŋ bwa Kooro Jehoahas fa aa di kora Israel harɛ ta la,

english_verse: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.
translation_verse: kɛ Korowii dɔ tedoma ba nɛ dɛ na ba sum, fɔo o ne ba naawa Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb aa fɔwa la wa. Ba le fini, waa nyin kɛŋɔ ó chɔɡ ba, kɛɛ dɛ́ doŋ ba le o sie.

english_verse: Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria.
translation_verse: Siiria Kooro Hasael baa sewɛ, asɛ o bibaa Bɛn Hadad chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.

english_verse: King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Asɛ Israel Kooro Jehoas waa ɛ Kooro Jehoahas bibaa la, berɛ ba lɛ Israel harɛ ta bwɛjena Kooro Bɛn Hadad be. Dɛ ɡɛ saŋ o mɛɛ Jehoahas aa di kora laanee ba lɛ Israel bwɛjena la. Kera atoro bwaa Kooro Jehoas ne o laa tena ka yo Siiria tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher.
translation_verse: Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ yoo lɛ Israel harɛ o jwɛhre aa lɔ Hamat waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ kaa Yar Mpo waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr. Dɛ ɡɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la che o keame Jona nɛɛ dɛ bol. Jona le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Gat Hɛfa, o mɛɛ sɔne Amitai.

english_verse: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoahas bibaa Jehoas aa di kora Israel harɛ bennɛɛte taa Kooro Joas bibaa Amasea di kora Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ. Wechɔɡa Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa a che a ta Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la, o ta an ɡelɛ.

english_verse: Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David.
translation_verse: Kooro Amasea ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, kɛ dɛ a ta o nabaa Kooro Devid kwaa tele. Wobɛlbwa ta la, dɛ o dɛ teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Joas aa ɛa ta.

english_verse: Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: O ta ɡelɛ ba chɔɡ bɔra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la, asɛ ba ta kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛɛ fuh daawiile bela.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.
translation_verse: Kooro Amasea kora aa baa che kiŋkiŋ name la, o kpoo nomonome baa kpo o mɛɛ o fa aa di kora la.

english_verse: But the children of those officers were not killed. The Lord had commanded in the Law of Moses that only the people who sinned were to be punished, not their parents or children.
translation_verse: Kɛ o ta ɡɛ nomonome la bii kpoorɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa chwera Mosis Mmara la ta kɛŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kɛɛ nya ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa won kpɔ kpo o bie, bii ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa won kpɔ kpo mɛɛ kɛɛ nya. Nɛn o ɡbabir aa ɛ wechɔɡa laanee chɛ kɛ ó sewɛ o wechɔɡa wa.”

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. Go ahead and celebrate—but stay at home. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na, he fa yo Edom tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, he nyu bini do he som, ɡel a maɡre he ne dɛ́ so he dem. Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin waa ba dawɛ ya nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ he kora ne Juda tena nɔɔ?”

english_verse: One day, Amaziah sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, Kooro Amasea tomɛ toroma Israel Kooro Jehoas be dɛ ŋɔ, “Ba chem mɛ ásɛ ya yo laa.”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back this reply: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Anee Juda Kooro Amasea tomɛ toroma Israel Kooro Jehoas be, dɛ sɛɡlo ŋɔ, “Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta jabalnadaŋɛ bɛlee fa ira, dɛ ka ŋɔ bela dajen bɛl be ŋɔ, ‘Kpɔ he bihaah tɛ mɛ ń tɛ n bie ó mo.’ Asɛ kpɔɡ bini ol bɛl ɡe ir, dɛ ba tiɡri jabalnadaŋɛ la ta dɛ laa kuuɡi.

english_verse: But Amaziah refused to listen. So Jehoash and his troops marched to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Kooro Amasea ta a mun noɛ, anomanta, Israel Kooro Jehoas kpɔ laa tena ba ne Kooro Amasea ne o laa tena ka cheme Bɛt Sɛmɛs waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ yo.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Israel laa tena pɔ Juda laa tena nɛ, asɛ ba chwa peɡre kaa ba bwɛɛre.

english_verse: and Jehoash captured Amaziah. Jehoash then marched to Jerusalem and broke down the city wall from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate, a section nearly
translation_verse: Israel Kooro Jehoas lawɛ Juda Kooro Amasea, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ka kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa baro la. Ba kuuɡu le Efrem Doonyoa ka tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Loŋkora Doonyoa. O jaŋne ɛɛ ɛ naɡale lafraanumɛlee.

english_verse: He took the gold and silver, as well as everything of value from the Lord's temple and the king's treasury. He took hostages, then returned to Samaria.
translation_verse: Kooro Jɛhoas pa suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne kwaa aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne koodem bela laala a yoɡ aa do kpeɡri kaa Samaria. O lawɛ nɛra ɡe ja kaa.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he defeated King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Waa Kooro Jehoas aa ɛa ja, ne laa o ne Juda Kooro Amasea a yoa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: After his death the people of Judah made his son Azariah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Ate, Juda tena bwa lawɛ Kooro Amasea bibaa Ussia, o chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta dɛ di kora, dɛ o di bene fi dɛ anumɛl.

english_verse: Azariah was the one who later recaptured and rebuilt the town of Elath. King Jeroboam the Second of Israel
translation_verse: Onee yoa dɛ berɛ lɛ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Elat tɛ Juda tena dɛ kwaa vɔrɔwo, o mɛɛ Kooro Amasea seo habɔɔ. Israel Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ

english_verse: Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel in the fifteenth year of Amaziah's rule in Judah. Jeroboam ruled
translation_verse: Kooro Amasea aa di kora Juda harɛ bene fi dɛ anue taa Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ ba di kora Israel harɛ ta. O soɡe Samaria di kora bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: The Lord helped Jeroboam do this because he had seen how terribly the Israelites were suffering, whether slave or free, and no one was left to help them.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii na wahala kohona Israel tena aa lɔ a ta, deheɛre ne yoma bwa, nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: And since the Lord had promised that he would not let Israel be completely destroyed, he helped Jeroboam rescue them.
translation_verse: Korowii aa wola ŋɔe ŋɔ, wɛɛ ɡeloo Israel nɛra tonɛ kwaara le harɛ la ta la, o cheɡɛ Kooro Jehoas bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ la nɛ, dɛ lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he recaptured the towns of Damascus and Hamath, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ bwara waa aa kaa, ne anɔ la waa ɛa, laa waa yoa, ne ɡɛ waa lɛ bwɛjena Damaskɔs ne Hamat aa lɔ Juda harɛ ta tɛ Israel tena la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Everything else Pekahiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Pekah of Israel
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa ɡe Kooro Pɛkahea aa ɛa o kora dii ta ne anɔ la waa ɛa bwa, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. Israel Kooro Pɛka

english_verse: Pekahiah became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Juda Kooro Ussia di kora bene fifraanue. A taa Kooro Mɛnahem bibaa Pɛkahea di kora Israel harɛ ta. O soɡe Samaria di kora bene anɛ.

english_verse: Azariah obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: Kooro Ussia ɛ waa a too Korowii tea ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Amasea fa aa ɛa la.

english_verse: But Azariah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: O ta bɔra voɡtoroma aa dɛ ɛ sarahare la chɔɡɛ. Dɛ nɛra la teŋɔ kpo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma bela.

english_verse: The Lord punished Azariah with leprosy for the rest of his life. He wasn't allowed to live in the royal palace, so his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ wee ta Kooro Ussia nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa sewɛ. O ta koodem soɡee kpa, asɛ o bibaa Jotam so koodem bela, dɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Everything else Azariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Waane aa chiɡ Kooro Ussia kora dii ta, ne anɔ la bwa waa ɛa la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Azariah died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Jotham then became king. King Zechariah of Israel
translation_verse: Kooro Ussia baa sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo Jerusalam, bela baa huɡe o naawa, Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. O bibaa Jotam chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora. Israel Kooro Sekaria

english_verse: Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, but he ruled only six months from Samaria.
translation_verse: Juda Kooro Ussia di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro. A taa Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ bibaa Sekaria di kora Israel harɛ ta. O soɡe Samaria di kora korobie anumɛl.

english_verse: Shallum son of Jabesh plotted against Zechariah and killed him in public. Shallum then became king.
translation_verse: Asɛ Jabes bibaa Salum vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa, dɛ kpoo nɛra o siwi ta Ibleam, dɛ kpɔ kora la di.

english_verse: So the Lord had kept his promise to Jehu that the next four kings of Israel would come from his family. Everything else Zechariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Shallum of Israel
translation_verse: Anee Korowii baɡɛ Kooro Jehu nyoa dɛ teŋɛ a ta la. Korowii ŋɔ, “He naanar ɛɛ ɛ koranaree ka tel naanar bele banaarɛ baa ka ba nɛ, dɛɛ di kora Israel harɛ ta.” Israel Kooro Salum

english_verse: Shallum became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah's rule in Judah. But only one month after Shallum became king,
translation_verse: Kooro Ussia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanaarɛ taa Jabes bibaa Salum di kora Israel harɛ ta. O soɡe Samaria di kora korobie.

english_verse: Menahem became king of Israel in Azariah's thirty-ninth year as king of Judah, and he ruled Israel ten years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Kooro Ussia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanaarɛ taa Gadi bibaa Kooro Mɛnahem di kora Israel harɛ ta. O soɡe Samaria di kora bene fi.

english_verse: He constantly disobeyed the Lord by following the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Kooro Mɛnahem ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ o kora dii ta bwa, ka tel o serewe wee. Wechɔɡa Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la, Kooro Mɛnahem ɡe ta an ɡelɛ.

english_verse: During Menahem's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria invaded Israel. He agreed to help Menahem keep control of his kingdom, if Menahem would pay him over
translation_verse: Asiiria harɛ ta Koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa la Israel harɛ ta ka yoo ba, asɛ Kooro Mɛnahem tɛo suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kaɡboŋa lafraatoro fifraanaarɛ ŋɔ ó chao, ásɛ o kora la do kpeɡri.

english_verse: Jotham followed the example of his father by obeying the Lord and doing right.
translation_verse: Kooro Jotam ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, dɛ teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Ussia aa ɛa la ta.

english_verse: Everything else Menahem did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Waa ane ɡe Kooro Mɛnahem aa ɛa ɡɛ saŋ waa dɛ di kora la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and caused the Israelites to sin, just as Jeroboam son of Nebat had done.
translation_verse: O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ. O ta wechɔɡa Kooro Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la ta leɛ.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and followed the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Kooro Pɛka ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ. Wechɔɡa Kooro Nɛbat bibaa Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la, o ta an ɡelɛ.

english_verse: During Pekah's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria marched into Israel. He captured the territories of Gilead and Galilee, including the towns of Ijon, Abel-Bethmaacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor, as well as the entire territory of Naphtali. Then he took Israelites from those regions to Assyria as prisoners.
translation_verse: Kooro Pɛka aa di kora Israel harɛ ta la taa Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa kpɔ o laa tena ba yo, dɛ lɛ bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Ijon ne Ebel Bɛt Maaka, ne Janoa ne Kedes dɛ Hasɔ. O berɔ ka lɛ Gelead ne Galilia harɛre, dɛ kpɔ Naftale dea harɛ bwa ja, dɛ larawe Israel tena baa lɔ bela kaa Asiiria harɛ ta.

english_verse: In the twentieth year of Jotham's rule in Judah, Hoshea son of Elah plotted against Pekah and murdered him. Hoshea then became king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ussia bibaa Kooro Jotam aa di kora Juda harɛ bene fifraanɛ taa Ɛla bibaa Hosia vɔrɔwe Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo. O chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di Israel harɛ ta kora.

english_verse: Everything else Pekah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Jotham of Judah (
translation_verse: Waa Kooro Pɛka aa ɛa o kora dii ta la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. Juda Kooro Jotam

english_verse: Jotham son of Azariah became king of Judah in the second year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka aa di kora Israel harɛ ta la, bennɛɛte taa Kooro Ussia bibaa Jotam di kora Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: It was Jotham who rebuilt the Upper Gate that led into the court around the Lord's temple. But the local shrines were not destroyed, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: O ta voɡa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ fuh daawiile a ta la chɔɡɛ. Nɛra teŋɔ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare dɛɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma a ta. Kooro Jotam berɔ kwaa ma Korowii Dea doonyoa baa dɛ yerɔ Weekaŋle Nyundua Doonyoa la.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Kooro Jotam kora dii ta ne waa waa ɛa, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: During his rule, the Lord let King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel start attacking Judah.
translation_verse: Kooro Jotam kora dii saŋ taa Korowii ɡel Siiria Kooro Resin, ne Remalia bibaa Israel Kooro Pɛka pa mun ka yo Juda tena.

english_verse: Jotham died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Jotam aa baa sewɛ la, ba huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen bela baa huɡe o naawa. Asɛ o bibaa Ahas chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

english_verse: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anuanɛ la, a taa Juda Kooro Jotam bibaa Kooro Ahas di kora Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Hezekiah became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahas sewɔ, asɛ ba ka huɡo Jerusalam o naawa huɡribɔr, Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Asɛ o bibaa Hɛsɛkea chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.

english_verse: and was even more sinful than the kings of Israel. He sacrificed his own son, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: dɛ teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta. Hale o kpo o bibaa dɛ fuuh ɛ saraha. Dɛ ɡɛ waa la ɛ voɡtoroma harɛre nɛra Korowii aa doŋ ba tɛ Israel tena, ba tɔ sie ba so o ta la nawee wa. Dɛ Korowii kia.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahas kpoo kwaa dɛ ɛ saraha, dɛ fuh daawiile tɛ voɡare bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ, ne deŋɡarere dor, dɛ dajen bɛlbwa mun.

english_verse: While Ahaz was ruling Judah, the king of Edom recaptured the town of Elath from Judah and forced out the people of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath, and they still live there. About the same time, King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel marched to Jerusalem and attacked, but they could not capture it.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ dɛ Siiria Kooro Resin berɔ ba lɛ bwɛjen Elat, dɛ doŋi Juda tena le o ta. Asɛ Edom tena ba so bela, ba soɡe bela ba le fini.

english_verse: Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria that said, “Your Majesty, King Rezin and King Pekah are attacking me, your loyal servant. Please come and rescue me.”
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Ahas tomɛ nɛra Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa be kɛŋɔ, “N ɛ he bonɔɔ tenten, ba lɛɛ mɛ, Siiria kooro ne Israel kooro dɛ yoo mɛ.”

english_verse: Along with the message, Ahaz sent silver and gold from the Lord's temple and from the palace treasury as a gift for the Assyrian king.
translation_verse: Anee Juda Kooro Ahas kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini koodem la, dɛ tomɛ ba kpɔ ka kɛ Asiiria koojen la.

english_verse: As soon as Tiglath Pileser received the message, he and his troops marched to Syria. He captured the capital city of Damascus, then he took the people living there to the town of Kir as prisoners and killed King Rezin.
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa aa sɛh waa la ta la, o kpɔ o laa tena ba Siiria dɛ ba yo bwɛjen Damaskɔs tena. Dɛ larawe bela tena ka so bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kir, dɛ kpo Kooro Resin.

english_verse: Later, Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser. And while Ahaz was there, he saw an altar and sent a model of it back to Uriah the priest, along with the plans for building one.
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Ahas la Damaskɔs, dɛ ka pu Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa. Waa la bela la, o na kon baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta bela, dɛ nyiŋi o mar, dɛ ma o dɔŋ dɛ tomɛ torome o kpɔ ka baɡle sɔfo Uria.

english_verse: Uriah followed the plans and built an altar exactly like the one in Damascus, finishing it just before Ahaz came back.
translation_verse: Asɛ sɔfo Uria ɡel ba ma kon baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta la dɔŋ. O mao tonɛ mɔɔ Kooro Ahas le Damaskɔs dɛ la.

english_verse: When Ahaz returned, he went to see the altar and to offer sacrifices on it. He walked up to the altar
translation_verse: Kooro Ahas aa le Damaskɔs kaa la, o kaa na kon la, asɛ dɛ ka ɛ saraha o ta.

english_verse: and poured wine over it. Then he offered sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessings.
translation_verse: O ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah ne mea saraha, dɛ fuɡe sen saraha ta o ta, dɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha waa ɛa la chal merɛ saraha kon la ta.

english_verse: After that, he had the bronze altar moved aside, so his new altar would be right in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɛ ayaawa kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta, o che saraha konfale la ne Korowii Dea la baah ta. Anomanta, Kooro Ahas kaa kpɔ ombene la ka cheɡ onfale la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.

english_verse: He told Uriah the priest: From now on, the morning and evening sacrifices as well as all gifts of grain and wine are to be offered on this altar. The sacrifices for the people and for the king must also be offered here. Sprinkle the blood from all the sacrifices on it, but leave the bronze altar for me to use for prayer and finding out what God wants me to do.
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Ahas ŋɔ sɔfo Uria be ŋɔ, “Chɔɔbɔr sarahare baa fuah ne mea sarahare baa ɛa jɔmɔra, ne kooro sarahare waa fuah ne mea sarahare ne harɛ la nɛra bwa sarahare baa fuah, ne mea sarahare dɛ sen sarahare bwa la, ɛa saraha konjen onfale la ta. Kpɔ kwaa baa kpoora fuh ɛ saraha la chal merɛ saraha kon la ta. Kɛ saraha kon baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo, dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta la te, ó ɛ n ɡbo kon ń kpɔ dɛɛ voɡɛ.”

english_verse: Ahaz also had the side panels and the small bowls taken off the movable stands in the Lord's temple. He had the large bronze bowl, called the Sea, removed from the bronze bulls on which it rested and had it placed on a stand made of stone.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Ahas laa kwaa aa maɡre ayaawa saraha kon la keŋkeŋni la, ne loɡa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo nakpale la laa kpɔ a chebɔra. Dɛ berɛ laa ayaawa loɡbajen baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo o chɔŋɛ nabali fi dɛ anɛ baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa la ta, dɛ kpɔ chɔŋɛ bwe ta.

english_verse: He took down the special tent that was used for worship on the Sabbath and closed up the private entrance that the kings of Judah used for going into the temple. He did all these things to please Tiglath Pileser.
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen nomanta, Kooro Ahas laa Korowii Dea baa dɛ tomɔ o bini Ona Tɔpere la kpɔ. Dɛ tɔ doonyoa Juda harɛ koranar aa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ jo Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa Kooro Ahas aa ɛa la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in the twelfth year of Ahaz's rule in Judah, and he ruled nine years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Juda Kooro Ahas aa di kora bene fi dɛ anɛ ta la, a taa Ɛla bibaa Kooro Hosia di kora Israel harɛ ta. O soɡe Samaria dɛ di kora bene anuanaarɛ.

english_verse: Hoshea disobeyed the Lord and sinned, but not as much as the earlier Israelite kings had done.
translation_verse: Kooro Hosia ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, kɛ o wechɔɡa la ta Israel koranar baa tɔ sie la kwaa baa ɛa la tele.

english_verse: During Hoshea's rule, King Shalmaneser of Assyria invaded Israel; he took control of the country and made Hoshea pay taxes.
translation_verse: Kooro Hosia kora dii saŋee Asiiria harɛ Koojen Salmaneesa yo Israel tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, asɛ Kooro Hosia kpɔ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛo benanyoa bɛlbwa.

english_verse: But later, Hoshea refused to pay the taxes and asked King So of Egypt to help him rebel. When Shalmaneser found out, he arrested Hoshea and put him in prison. Samaria Is Destroyed and the Israelites Are Taken to Assyria
translation_verse: Koojen Salmaneesa baa na kɛŋɔ Kooro Hosia aa toɔ bɔe dɛɛ tɛo ɡɛ o fa aa dɛ bɔa benanyoa bɛlbwa la kpa. Dɛ Kooro Hosia ɛo dɔm, dɛ ɡel torome ka ŋɔ Ijipt Kooro baa dɛ yerɔ So be kɛŋɔ ó chao, ásɛ o le Asiiria koojen lɔɡa. Asɛ Koojen Salmaneesa no, dɛ ɡel ba ka lawɛ Kooro Hosia ka do dea. Dɔma yo bwɛjen Samaria dɛ chɔɡo

english_verse: Shalmaneser invaded Israel and attacked the city of Samaria for three years,
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen kaa yo Israel tena, dɛ lɛ harɛ la bwa dɔɔh, dɛ tɔ Samaria tena do bene atoro.

english_verse: before capturing it in the ninth year of Hoshea's rule. The Assyrian king took the Israelites away to Assyria as prisoners. He forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Kooro Hosia aa di kora bene anuanaarɛ taa Asiiria koojen yo lɛ Samaria. O lawɛ Israel tena kaa Asiiria harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ ba ka so bwɛjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Hala, bane ɡe so Habɔ Moo nyoa Gosan harɛ ta, bane ɡe so Midia tena bwɛjena ane ta.

english_verse: All of this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had rescued them from Egypt, where they had been slaves. They worshiped foreign gods,
translation_verse: Samaria chɔɡɔ dɛkalkɛ, dɛ Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ nɛ. Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ Korowiirii lɛɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ, Ijipt kooro nɔn ta. Dɛ ba dɛ tomɛ voɡa ɡe,

english_verse: followed the customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel, and were just as sinful as the Israelite kings.
translation_verse: dɛɛ teŋɛ harɛre Korowii aa doŋi a nɛra tɛɛ ba la we-ɛɛla, ne wechɔɡa ba Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta.

english_verse: Even worse, the Israelites tried to hide their sins from the Lord their God. They built their own local shrines everywhere in Israel—from small towns to large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Waa aa ɡwaala kwaraa kɛŋɔ, Israel tena sɔɔh ɛ waa aa wola Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ tea toorɛ. Ba cheɡ voɡare ba bwɛjeɡre ne bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛɛre bara bwa ta.

english_verse: They also built stone images of foreign gods and set up sacred poles for the worship of Asherah on every hill and under every shady tree.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ bwea ne dajaŋa paaɡe deŋɡarere dor, ne dajen bɛlbwa mun tɛ ba voɡ Asera dɛɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices at the shrines, just as the foreign nations had done before the Lord forced them out of Israel. They did sinful things that made the Lord very angry.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ fuh daawiile kon baa dɛ ɛ sarahare a ta ne deŋɡare bɛlbwa ta, kɛŋɔ ɡɛ nɛra Korowii aa doŋ ba le ba harɛre ta tɛɛ ba fa aa dɛ ɛ la. Israel tena ɛ wedoŋa tenten a di Korowii baah taeh.

english_verse: Even though the Lord had commanded the Israelites not to worship idols, they did it anyway.
translation_verse: Korowii do Israel tena la ŋɔ ba bɛ voɡa tomɛ, kɛ ba ɡe ɡarɔ toma.

english_verse: So the Lord made sure that every prophet warned Israel and Judah with these words: “I, the Lord, command you to stop doing sinful things and start obeying my laws and teachings! I gave them to your ancestors, and I told my servants the prophets to repeat them to you.”
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o keamere ne nɛra baa dɛ na chaahna ta, dɛ kah Israel ne Juda tena ŋɔ, “Hé le he wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre ta, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa do heyaa a ta la ta. N kpɔɔ tɛ he naawa ŋɔ báa teŋɛ a ta, dɛ che n keamere ɡe nɛɛ ŋɔ bá dalwe a ta baɡle heya.”

english_verse: But the Israelites would not listen; they were as stubborn as their ancestors who had refused to worship the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Kɛ Israel tena ta noɛ, dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ ba naawa aa wola Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ yaradae la.

english_verse: They ignored the Lord's warnings and commands, and they rejected the solemn agreement he had made with their ancestors. They worshiped worthless idols and became worthless themselves. The Lord had told the Israelites not to do the things that the foreign nations around them were doing, but Israel became just like them.
translation_verse: Ba vɛh waa Korowii aa do ba a ta la, dɛ vɛh fɔo o ne ba naawa aa fɔwa, ne kaeh waa kah ba la. Ba teŋɛ voɡa aa ɛ konsale nɛ, dɛ ɡbabir ɡe ɛ nɛnsale. Ba chaa harɛre aa bar ba la nɛra nawee we-ɛɛla, dɛ kpɔ ba da. Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ la ɛ.” Kɛ ba ɡarɔ ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ ɛ la.

english_verse: The people of Israel disobeyed all the commands of the Lord their God. They made two gold statues of calves and set up a sacred pole for Asherah; they also worshiped the stars and the god Baal.
translation_verse: Ba ɡel Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la mmarare bwa ta teŋa, dɛ loɡɛ nabali anɛ, dɛ ɛa voɡa dɛɛ toma. Dɛ paaɡe ba voɡ Asera dajaŋa dɛɛ tomɛ weweela ne voɡ Baal.

english_verse: They used magic and witchcraft and even sacrificed their own children. The Israelites were determined to do whatever the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Ba lawɛ ba ɡbaɡba bibaala ne bihaahna kpoo, dɛ fuuh ba ɛ sarahare tɛ ba voɡare. Ba la voɡra ne dobodobo tena be, dɛ kpɔ ba te do waa aa ɛ wechɔɡa ta, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ dɛ ir o bwaawee.

english_verse: The Lord became so furious with the people of Israel that he allowed them to be carried away as prisoners. Only the people living in Judah were left,
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii baah di Israel tena nɛɛ taeh, dɛ doŋ ba le o sie. Juda dea tena ɡboo baa ka.

english_verse: So the Lord turned his back on everyone in Israel and let them be punished and defeated until no one was left.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii berɛ habɔɔ kpo Israel tena bwa. O tɛr ba deŋne, dɛ kpɔ ba do ba dɔma nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa doŋ ba le o sie.

english_verse: Earlier, when the Lord took the northern tribes away from David's family, the people living in northern Israel chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king. Jeroboam caused the Israelites to sin and to stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Korowii aa pere Israel harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr le Juda harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr nɛɛ la, Israel tena kpɔ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam ɛ ba kooro. Kooro Jɛroboam ɡelɔ ba ɡel Korowii toma, a ɡel ba ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.

english_verse: The people kept on sinning like Jeroboam,
translation_verse: Ba teŋɛ Kooro Jɛroboam wechɔɡa ta, dɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛa,

english_verse: until the Lord got rid of them, just as he had warned his servants the prophets. That's why the people of Israel were taken away as prisoners to Assyria, and that's where they remained. Foreigners Are Resettled in Israel
translation_verse: dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii aa doŋ ba le o sie, ɡɛ waa cheɡɛ o keamere nɛɛ dɛ bol la. Anomanta, ba lawɛ Israel tena laa ta kaa bojaŋ Asiiria harɛ, ba ta ka bela ba le fini. Asiiria tena Israel harɛ ta ka soɡa

english_verse: The king of Assyria took people who were living in the cities of Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and forced them to move to Israel. They took over the towns where the Israelites had lived, including the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen kpɔ nɛra le Babelɔn harɛ bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Kuta ne Ava ne Hamat dɛ Sefavaim, dɛ kpɔ ba ka so Samaria bwɛjena ta, Israel tena baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa la buɡ ta. Ba kpɔ bela berɛ ba bwɛjena dɛ so bela.

english_verse: At first these people did not worship the Lord, so he sent lions to attack them, and the lions killed some of them.
translation_verse: Baa baa so bela loɡla la, dɛ baa Korowii tomɛ, anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ nyujentena ba kpoo ba bini bane.

english_verse: A messenger told the king of Assyria, “The people you moved to Israel don't know how to worship the god of that country. So he sent lions that have attacked and killed some of them.”
translation_verse: Ate, ba ka ŋɔ Asiiria koojen be ŋɔ, “Nɛra haa kpɔ ba kaa Samaria ka so la aa harɛ la voɡ we-ɛɛla jemɛ dɛɛ tomɔ. O ɡelɔ nyujentena ba kpoo ba.”

english_verse: The king replied, “Get one of the Israelite priests we brought here and send him back to Israel. He can live there and teach them about the god of that country.”
translation_verse: Asɛ koojen la ŋɔ, “Hé nyin Israel sɔfore la yaa laɡ ba le bela la bɛl, dɛ́ kpɔɔ kaa bela ó ka so, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra ɡɛ bela voɡ baa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ nyin.”

english_verse: One of the Israelite priests was chosen to go back to Israel. He lived in Bethel and taught the people how to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Israel tena baa laɡ ba laa ta le Samaria la bini bɛl waa ɛ sɔfo baa so Bɛtel, dɛɛ baɡ ba ɡɛ baa tomɛ Korowii.

english_verse: But in towns all over Israel, the different groups of people made statues of their own gods, then they placed these idols in local Israelite shrines.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, nɛŋhɔɔhra baa kaa so Samaria la ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ ba voɡare dɛɛ toma. Ba kpɔ voɡa la do voɡa deene Israel tena la aa maa bini.

english_verse: The people from Babylonia made the god Succoth-Benoth; those from Cuthah made the god Nergal; those from Hamath made Ashima;
translation_verse: Nɛra baa le Babelɔn la ɛ ba voɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Sukot Bɛnɔt, banɔ la baa le Kuta ɛ ba voɡ Nɛrɡal. Asɛ banɔ la ba ɡe aa le Hamat ɛ ba ɡe voɡ Asima.

english_verse: those from Avva made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the people from Sepharvaim sacrificed their children to their own gods Adrammelech and Anammelech.
translation_verse: Avi tena ɛ ba voɡa baa dɛ yera Nibhas ne Tatak, asɛ Sefavaim tena fuh ba bii ɛ sarahare tɛ Sefavaim tena voɡa baa dɛ yera Adramɛlɛk ne Anamɛlɛk.

english_verse: They worshiped their own gods, just as they had before they were taken away to Israel. They also worshiped the Lord, but they chose their own people to be priests at the shrines.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba tomɛ Korowii dɛ berɛ tomɛ ba voɡare ɡɛ bɛlbwa harɛ ta nawee waa aa doa.
