english_verse: Everyone followed their old customs. None of them worshiped only the Lord, and they refused to obey the laws and commands that the Lord had given to the descendants of Jacob, the man he named Israel.
translation_verse: Ba ta dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa la ba le fini. Baa Korowii tomɛ kasinteŋ ne, kɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne waa waa do ba a ta, dɛ kpɔa tɛ Jekɔb baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Israel la naanar.

english_verse: At the time when the Lord had made his solemn agreement with the people of Israel, he told them: Do not worship any other gods! Do not bow down to them or offer them a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Korowii ne Israel tena aa fɔwɛ fɔo la, o do ba ŋɔ, “He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ, he bɛ an ɡuŋi kɛɛ dɛ́ kpo kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛa.

english_verse: Worship only me! I am the one who rescued you from Egypt with my mighty power. Bow down to me and offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Hé tomɛ men Korowii maa cheɡɛ n kpeɡri ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta, dɛ kpɔ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la ɡbosoo. N ɡbosoo chɛ kɛ hé tomɛ, dɛ́ kpo kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: and remember the solemn agreement between us. I will say it again: Do not worship any god
translation_verse: He bɛ fɔo n ne haa fɔwa la soh, he bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ.

english_verse: except me. I am the Lord your God, and I will rescue you from all your enemies.
translation_verse: Kɛ hɛ́ɛ tomɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la ɡbo, ásɛ n lɛ heyaa le he dɔma bwa nɔn ta.”

english_verse: But the people living in Israel ignored that command and kept on following their old customs.
translation_verse: Ba ta noɛ, dɛ ta teŋɛ ba webena ta.

english_verse: They did worship the Lord, but they also worshiped their own idols. Their descendants did the same thing.
translation_verse: Hale baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la, dɛ ba ta dɛ tomɛ ba voɡare. Dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini, ba naanar ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ waa ba naawa fa aa dɛ ɛ la.

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah! Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: He bɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea waa no. Asiiria koojen dɛ bol ŋɔ, hé le bwɛjen la bini ba o be, dɛ́ kpɔ he te ba do o lɔɡa. Wɛɛ ɡeloo he bini bɛlbwa dɔ o fiɡ ne o ɡrepo daa kooni nɔna di, dɛ́ nyɔ o kɔlɔŋ bini ne.

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii habɔɔ n le dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo he harɛ nɛra nɔ kɛɛ? Korowii ɡbabirii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ń ba dɛ́ ba chɔɡ harɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord, just as his ancestor David had done.
translation_verse: O ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid ken.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines, then tore down the images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. He also smashed the bronze snake Moses had made. The people had named it Nehushtan and had been offering sacrifices to it.
translation_verse: O chɔɡ bɔra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡare, dɛ paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ teŋni voɡ Asera dajaŋa ta. O kuuɡi ayaawa Mosis fa aa kpɔa ɛ harɛkon baa yerɔ Nehustan la. Dɛ ba tel ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ Israel tena dɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ harɛkon la.

english_verse: He was completely faithful to the Lord and obeyed the laws the Lord had given to Moses for the people.
translation_verse: O kpɔ o te pɛl Korowii, o ta o nɛɛ teŋa ɡelɛ, dɛ do sie dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Mosis la bwa ta.

english_verse: The Lord helped Hezekiah, so he was successful in everything he did. He even rebelled against the king of Assyria, refusing to be his servant.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ja o nɛ, asɛ wobɛlbwa waa ɛa la do wer. O ɛ Asiiria koojen dɔm, dɛ laa o te kpɔ o lɔɡa, dɛ ŋɔ waa on tomɛ kpa.

english_verse: Hezekiah defeated the Philistine towns as far away as Gaza—from the smallest towns to the large, walled cities.
translation_verse: O yo Filisti tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, bwɛjena ne anɔ la baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ bara bwa, dɛ kpoŋe ka le bwɛjen Gasa bwa.

english_verse: During the fourth year of Hezekiah's rule, which was the seventh year of Hoshea's rule in Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria led his troops to Samaria, the capital city of Israel. They attacked
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora bene anaarɛ ta la, dɛ Kooro Ɛla bibaa Kooro Hosia di kora Israel harɛ ta bene anuanɛ. A taa Asiiria koojen Salmaneesa ne o laa tena ba yo bwɛjen Samaria tena dɛ tɔ ba do la.

english_verse: and captured it three years later, in the sixth year of Hezekiah's rule and the ninth year of Hoshea's rule.
translation_verse: Asiiria tena aa tɔ ba do bene atoro la, ba wono pɔ ba nɛ. Gɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea di kora bene anumɛl, asɛ Kooro Hosia ɡe dɔ bene anuanaarɛ o kora ta.

english_verse: The king of Assyria took the Israelites away as prisoners; he forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen lawɛ Israel tena kaa o harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ bane so Hala, bane so Habɔ Moo nyoa Gosan harɛ ta, bane ɡe ka so Midia tena bwɛjena ane ta.

english_verse: All of that happened because the people of Israel had not obeyed the Lord their God. They rejected the solemn agreement he had made with them, and they ignored everything that the Lord's servant Moses had told them. King Sennacherib of Assyria Invades Judah (
translation_verse: Samaria chɔɡɔ dɛkalkɛ, dɛ Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ nɛ. Ba koni fɔo ba ne waa fɔwa la, ba ta waa Korowii fa aa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba la noɛ, dɛ kpɔ ɛ wa. Asiiria koojen Senakerib aah Jerusalam tena

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards, raise your own grain, and have plenty of olive oil and honey. Believe me, you won't starve there. Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him.
translation_verse: Ásɛ mɔɔ koojen la ba kpɔ heyaa kaa bojaŋ harɛ waa do kɛŋɔ he kon nɔ ta. Harɛ daa kooni aa lole he dɔ sen le a ta, ne mea baa kpɔ ɛ paanoo. O ɛ harɛ ɔleve no ne tooh aa lɔ o ta kohona. Hé teŋɛ waa koojen la aa do heyaa a ta la tenaa, hɛɛ dɔ he nyuunee. He bɛ ɡel Kooro Hɛsɛkea neɡre heyaa ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heyaa.

english_verse: One of the Assyrian commanders told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Asiiria laa sitɔɔla la bini bɛl ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, Asiiria koojen dɛ nyin ó jemɛ waa Kooro Hɛsɛkea a dena dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Asiiria nomoa la berɛ ŋɔ, “Kɛ, hɛɛ ŋɔɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la nɛɛ hɛɛ hwɛɡɛ aa? Saraha kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la laa on Kooro Hɛsɛkea chɔɡ, dɛ ŋɔ Juda ne Jerusalam tena bwa be ŋɔ, báa tomɛ Jerusalam bonɔ ɡbo la aa?

english_verse: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah's rule in Judah, King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded the country and captured every walled city, except Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora bene fi dɛ anaarɛ ta la, Asiiria koojen Senakerib kpɔ o laa tena, dɛ ba yo Juda harɛ ta bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah sent this message to Sennacherib, who was in the town of Lachish: “I know I am guilty of rebellion. But I will pay you whatever you want, if you stop your attack.” Sennacherib told Hezekiah to pay ten tons of silver and one ton of gold.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea tomɛ ŋɔ bá la Asiiria koojen be bwɛjen Lakes ta, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa, n poori, n ɛ wechɔɡa, suuɡa bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la mɛɛ bɔɔ tɛɛ, ásɛ he le n nɛɛ kaa.” Asɛ Asiiria koojen ŋɔ o kpɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fi lafraanɛ, ne suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋ fifraanɛ ba tɛo.

english_verse: He even stripped the gold that he had used to cover the doors and doorposts in the temple. He gave it all to Sennacherib.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea berɔ laa suuɡaswɛm o ɡbabir aa kpɔa bɔle Korowii Dea ɡbeni, ne anɔ la waa kpɔa bɔle doonyoa daa la ta swe, dɛ kpɔa ja ka tɛ Asiiria koojen la.

english_verse: The king of Assyria ordered his three highest military officers to leave Lachish and take a large army to Jerusalem. When they arrived, the officers stood on the road near the cloth makers' shops along the canal from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen tomɛ o nomonjena batoro, laa sitɔɔla nomoa ne o ɡbaɡba nachiɡe ne o laa nomoa ŋɔ, bá le Lakes, dɛ́ kpɔ laa tena baa wara ja, dɛ́ la Kooro Hɛsɛkea be Jerusalam. Baa laŋa la, ba kaa che ŋwɛnɛ waa bɛne bobɛl nee aa pala dɛɛ kpɔ, dɛ le nyundua tam bɛl ta dɛɛ jo bwɛjen la ta, bela nɛra bane baa dɛ ɛ yale aa lole.

english_verse: They called out to Hezekiah, and three of his highest officials came out to meet them. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Ba kaa yerɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea, asɛ o tomɛ Hilkia bibaa Eliakim, onee dɛɛ nyiŋi koodem bela waa ta, ne Sɛbna waa ɛ koodem bela karake, dɛ Asaf bibaa Joa waa chwerɛ harɛ la waa dɛɛ do tɔne bini, asɛ ba bwa le, dɛ ka chem ba.

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ nyoa wobol do kɛ wejema, ne kpeɡri ba kpɔ dɛɛ yo laa kɛɛ? Ume nɛɛ he kpɔ he te dawɛ, dɛ ɛɛ mɛ dɔm nɔɔ?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Na, dɛ Ijipt Kooro nɛɛ he kpɔ he te dawɛ aa, aa doo kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ pul ɛ daŋɡbala, ásɛ o ku dɛ́ tɔɡɛ he nɔn. Gɛɛ Ijipt kooro do tɛ nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛɛ bwa.”

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people. He will give you
translation_verse: N ne hɛɛ ŋwɛɛroo n naa Asiiria koojen sɔn ta. Mɛɛ tɛɛ jaɡre kaɡboŋa anɛɛ, dɛ hɛɛ won dɔ laa tena ba so a bwa ta naa.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Haa won kpɔ he te maɡɛ Asiiria koojen nomonome la bini bechala kwara, kɛ he dɛ hwɛɡɛ Ijipt kooro nɛɛ kɛ ó ba tɛɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne laa tena baa dɛ so jaɡre ta.

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Anee Eliakim baa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ Hilkia ne Sɛbna, dɛ Joa ŋɔ Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔ la be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya dɛ soŋe, bol Aram tena wobol baɡle he bonɔɔna. He bolaa, ya dɛ no. Bɛ Hibru tena wobol kpɔ bol ya be. Nɛra baa cheɡɛ bwɛjen nɔ danjwɛɛ nɔ ta dɛ no he be.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you.”
translation_verse: Anee laa sitɔɔ la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ne he kooro ɡbo bee n nomoa tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol waa nɔ kɛɛ? He ɡbo laa, nɛra baa sosoɡe bwɛjen nɔ danjwɛɛ nɔ ta ɡe jao, baa di ba ɡbaɡba benaa, dɛ́ nyɔ ba feene kɛ heya.”

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Ate, laa sitɔɔ la ir che, dɛ kpɔ Hibru tena wobol bol waa takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “Hé no waa Asiiria koojen la aa dɛ bol he be!

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: He bɛ o nɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ́ ɡel hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ ŋɔ, wɛɛ lɛ heyaa, waa bwɛjen nɔɔ kpɔ do Asiiria koojen nɔn ta.

english_verse: Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Harɛ bɛl voɡ wono lɛ harɛ la nɛra le Asiiria koojen nɔn ta ka aa?

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath and Arpad? What about the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Leperaa bwɛjena Hamat ne Aapad tena voɡa dɔɔ? Sefavaim ne Hena dɛ Iva tena ɡe voɡare sɛ? A wono lɛ Samaria tena aa?

english_verse: None of these gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord your God can do any better?
translation_verse: Harɛre nɔ voɡ besoo wona lɛ o harɛ le n be nɔ? Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba wona lɛ Jerusalam ɔ?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Ate, Eliakim ne Sɛbna, dɛ Joa kɛɛ ba laala, a baɡle kɛ ba loo kuu, dɛ la Kooro Hɛsɛkea be, dɛ ka bol waa Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔ la aa bola la o be.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, o ka dɛ tu voɡa o voɡ Nesrɔk dea, asɛ o bibaala banɛ, Adramɛlɛk ne Saresa ka kpoo kere ne, dɛ chwa le kaa Ararat harɛ ta. Asɛ o bibaa Esaahadon chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa no waa la, o ɡe laa o yal waa tɔɔ la kɛɛ, dɛ ka kpɔ lweyal tɔ dɛ ka jo Korowii Dea.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (Isaiah
translation_verse: Leperaa bwɛjena Hamat ne Aapad ne Sefavaim dɛ Hena kɛɛ Iva koranar dɔɔ?” Kooro Hɛsɛkea wesoŋa

english_verse: He told Prime Minister Eliakim, Assistant Prime Minister Shebna, and the senior priests to dress in sackcloth and tell the prophet Isaiah:
translation_verse: O tomɛ Eliakim waa dɛ nyiŋi koodem waa ta, ne Sɛbna waa ɛ karake, dɛ bela sɔfore nomonome ba ɡe aa tɔ lweyale ŋɔ, bá la Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya be.

english_verse: These are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
