translation_verse: Ba lawɔ kaa bwɛjen Ribla ka tɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa o ka bol o waa dɛ pao bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: About a month later, in Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king, Nebuzaradan, who was his official in charge of the guards, arrived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuanaarɛ, korobie anue tɔpera anuanɛ ta la, o laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan la Jerusalam.

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: asɛ Babelɔn laa tena Nebusaradan aa chɔ ba nyoa la kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la.

english_verse: He led away as prisoners the people left in the city, including those who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan lawɛ nɛra baa ka bwɛjen la ta, ne tom-ɛɛra, dɛ banɔ la baa le Kooro Sedekia habɔɔ, dɛ ka teŋɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa nɛɛ la bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.

english_verse: Only some of the poorest people were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
translation_verse: Kɛ o ɡel nyaara baa lɔ Juda harɛ la bane ŋɔ baa ɛ toma daa kooni ne kooni aa lɔ bela la ta.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers took the two bronze columns that stood in front of the temple, the ten movable bronze stands, and the large bronze bowl called the Sea. They broke them into pieces so they could take the bronze to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Babelɔn laa tena la kuuɡi ayaawa pilare ne kwaa aa dɔ nakpale baa taɡa a do Korowii Dea, dɛ ayaawa loɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo la, dɛ kpɔ a bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.

english_verse: as well as the fire pans and the sprinkling bowls. Nebuzaradan ordered his soldiers to take everything made of gold or silver.
translation_verse: Laa sitɔɔ la kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii, ne loɡa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ la, komɛlbwa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ne suuɡapoŋ ɛa te, ba kaa a bwa ne.

english_verse: The pile of bronze from the columns, the stands, and the large bowl that Solomon had made for the temple was too large to be weighed.
translation_verse: Ayaawa aa lɔ pilare anɛ la ta, ne kwaa aa dɔ nakpale baa taɡa, ne loɡbajen baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo Kooro Solomɔn ɛa cheɡ Korowii Dea la, a kan kohona kɛŋɔ ba won maɡɛ a tɔɡre.

english_verse: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.
translation_verse: Laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan lawɛ Sɔfonomoa Seraya ne o dɔŋ Sefania o ɡe aa dɛ chao, dɛ nomonome batoro bane baa dɛ daah doonyoa la laa ta kaa.

english_verse: Then he arrested one of the army commanders, the king's five personal advisors, and the officer in charge of gathering the troops for battle. He also found
translation_verse: Ba bini banɔ la baa ka bwɛjen la bini la, o lawɛ nomoa waa chɔ laa tena nyoa, ne nɛra banue baa dɛ ja kooro la. Dɛ lawɛ laa nomoa la nɛn waa dɛ chao dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ laa tena fifraanumɛl baa jaa dɛ do bwɛɛ la bini.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam to rule the few people still living in Judah.
translation_verse: Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa le Ahikam bibaa Gedalia ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa ka Juda harɛ la nɛ. Ahikam ɡe mɛɛ Safan.

english_verse: When the army officers and troops heard that Gedaliah was their ruler, the officers met with him at Mizpah. These men were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth from Netophah, and Jaazaniah from Maacah.
translation_verse: Juda laa nomonome la bwa ne ba laa tena baa wola ban lawɛ kaa la aa noa kɛŋɔ Babelɔn kooro le Gedalia o ɛ ba harɛ nomoa la, ba la o be Mispa. Banee Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael, ne Karea bibaa Johanan, ne Tanhumet bibaa Seraya, o ɛ Nɛtɔfa te. Dɛ Jaasania, waa ɛ Maaka te bɛl bie, dɛ ba bala.

english_verse: Gedaliah said to them, “Everything will be fine, I promise. We don't need to be afraid of the Babylonian rulers, if we live here peacefully and do what Nebuchadnezzar says.”
translation_verse: Belaa Gedalia ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡ ba ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ berɛ Babelɔn nomonome nɔ ɔma, hé so bonɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Babelɔn kooro, aa chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛɛ.”

english_verse: Ishmael was from the royal family. And about two months after Gedaliah began his rule, Ishmael and ten other men went to Mizpah. They killed Gedaliah and his officials, including those from Judah and those from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Korobie anuanɛ ta la, Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael, waa ɛ koobie, iro dɛ lawɛ baala fi ja o nɛɛ ba la Gedalia be Mispa, dɛ ka kpoo o ne Juda ne Babelɔn tena baa lɔ bela. Ismael nabaa sɔne Elisama.

english_verse: After that, the army officers and all the people in Mizpah, whether important or not, were afraid of what the Babylonians might do. So they left Judah and went to Egypt. Jehoiachin Is Set Free (Jeremiah
translation_verse: Aa ba ɡɛ la, Juda tena nyaara ne kpeɡnɛra bwa, dɛ ba laa nomonome la chwao kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ Babelɔn tena. Ba le Kooro Jehoiachin dea

english_verse: Evil-Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak bol wobodɛɛɡa tɛ Kooro Jehoiachin, dɛ tɛo jirima ɡwaa koranar baa ja o nɛɛ ba laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta Babelɔn bela la bwa.

english_verse: Jehoiachin was even allowed to wear regular clothes, and he ate at the king's table every day.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Kooro Jehoiachin dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ laa laala waa doa ba doo dea la foo bil, dɛ kpɔ anfala do, asɛ o ne Babelɔn kooro pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwa o soɡa bini bwa.

english_verse: Japheth was the father of Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Jafɛt bii waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ, Goma ne Maɡɔɡ ne Madai ne Javan ne Tubal ne Mɛsɛk dɛ Tiras. Ba sɔna nɔɔ ba kpɔ pa ba naanar.

english_verse: Abraham and his slave woman Keturah had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan.
translation_verse: Abraham berɔ kpɔ sɛno baa yerɔ Ketura. O ne on lolɛ Simran ne Joksan ne Medan ne Midian ne Esbak dɛ Suwa. Joksan ɡe bibaalaa, Seeba ne Dedan.

english_verse: Ethiopia was also the father of Nimrod, the world's first mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Kus bibaa bɛl ɡee Nimrod. Onee waa baa kpeɡ la, o ɛ banyoo dɛ do kpeɡri kohona harɛ nɔ ta la.

english_verse: Egypt was the ancestor of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
translation_verse: Lud ne Anam ne Lɛhab dɛ Naftu tena nabaalee Misraim,

english_verse: Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
translation_verse: Goma naanaree, Askenas ne Rifat dɛ Toɡama.

english_verse: Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
translation_verse: Javan naanaree, Elaisa ne Speen ne Saepros dɛ Roods tena.

english_verse: Ham was the father of Ethiopia, Egypt, Put, and Canaan, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Ham bibaala waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ, Kus ne Misraim ne Put dɛ Keenan. Ba sɔna nɔɔ ba kpɔ pa ba naanar.

english_verse: Ethiopia was the ancestor of Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamah was the ancestor of Sheba and Dedan.
translation_verse: Kus naanaree, Seba ne Havila ne Sabta ne Raama dɛ Sabtɛka tena. Raama ɡe naanaree, Seeba ne Dedan tena.

english_verse: Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Sɛm bibaala waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ, Elam ne Assur ne Aafaksad ne Lud dɛ Aram. Aram ɡe aa ira la, o bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Us ne Hul ne Geta dɛ Mɛsɛk.

english_verse: Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather.
translation_verse: Aafaksadee lolɛ Seela, asɛ Seela ɡe lolɛ Iba.

english_verse: Eber named his first son Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided into tribal regions. Eber's second son was Joktan,
translation_verse: Iba ɡe aa baa kpeɡ la, o lolɛ bibaala banɛ. Bɛl sɔne Pɛlɛɡ, dɛkalkɛ o saŋ taa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bini peɡri la. Dɛ o nime ɡe sɔne Joktan.

english_verse: Shem's descendants included Arpachshad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, later renamed Abraham. Abraham's Family (Genesis
translation_verse: dɛ Abram, baa bera baa yerɔ Abraham la. Abraham naanar

english_verse: Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
translation_verse: Abraham bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Aesek ne Ismael.

english_verse: Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. Esau's Family (Genesis
translation_verse: Midian bibaalaa, Efa ne Efar ne Hanɔk ne Abida dɛ Ɛldaa. Ketura naanaree banɔ bwa.

english_verse: Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.
translation_verse: Abraham lolɛ Aesek. Aesek ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Esɔ ne Jekɔb. Esɔ naanar

english_verse: Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
translation_verse: Esɔ ɡe aa ira la, bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Elifas ne Ruwɛl ne Jeyus ne Jalam dɛ Kora.

english_verse: Reuel was the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. The First Edomites and Their Kings (Genesis
translation_verse: Ruwɛl naanaree, Nahat ne Sɛra ne Samaa dɛ Misa tena. Nɛra baa tɔ sie ka so Edom harɛ ta

english_verse: Before kings ruled in Israel, Bela son of Beor ruled the country of Edom from its capital of Dinhabah.
translation_verse: Koranar baa tɔ sie di Edom kora, mɔɔ Israel te bɛlbwa ɡe ba di la sɔnaa teŋa nɔ, Beɔ bibaa Bɛla di kora Edom. Dɛ o bwɛjen sɔne Dinhaba.

english_verse: Seir was the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
translation_verse: Sɛɛ ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Lotan ne Sobal ne Sibeon dɛ Ana, ne Dison ne Esa dɛ Disan.

english_verse: Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna.
translation_verse: Lotan ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Hɔr ne Homam. Dɛ Lotan nimambie sɔne Timna.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
translation_verse: Sobal ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Alvan ne Manahat ne Ebal ne Sɛfo dɛ Onam. Sibeon ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Aeya ne Ana.

english_verse: Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation_verse: Ana bibaa waa lolɔ sɔne Dison. Dison ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ bibaala nɔ, Hɛmdan ne Ɛsban ne Itran dɛ Keran.

english_verse: Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
translation_verse: Asɛ Esa ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Bilhan ne Saavan dɛ Akan. Disan ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ bibaala nɔ, Us ne Aran. Edom koronar

english_verse: After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Bɛla aa baa sewɛ la, Sɛra bibaa Jobab waa le bwɛjen Bosra baa so o buɡ ta.

english_verse: After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Jobab ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Husam waa le Teman harɛ taa baa di kora.

english_verse: After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab.
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Husam ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Bɛdad bibaa Hadad ɡee baa chiɡ o naa ta di kora. Onee fa yo Midian tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ Moab harɛ ta la. O bwɛjen sɔne Avit.

english_verse: After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king;
translation_verse: Kooro Hadad ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ Samla waa le bwɛjen Masrɛka ba di kora.

english_verse: after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king;
translation_verse: Kooro Samla ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Swaul waa le Rɛhɔbɔt waa chɔa bɛne nee laanee baa di kora.

english_verse: and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Swaul ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ Akbɔ bibaa Baal Hanan ɡe ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.

english_verse: After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
translation_verse: Kooro Baal Hanan ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Hadad ɡe ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora. Dɛ o bwɛjen sɔne Pau. O haah ɡe sɔne Mɛhetabɛl, o ɛ Matrɛd bihaah. Matrɛd ɡe nya sɔne Mɛsahab.

english_verse: The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
translation_verse: Kooro Hadad ɡe baa sewɛ. Edom tena koranaree nɔ, Timna ne Alva dɛ Jetɛt,

english_verse: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
translation_verse: ne Oholibama ne Ɛla dɛ Penɔn,

english_verse: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
translation_verse: ne Kenas ne Teman dɛ Mibsar,

english_verse: Magdiel, and Iram.
translation_verse: ne Maɡdiel dɛ Iram.

english_verse: Jacob was the father of twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
translation_verse: ne Dan ne Josef ne Bɛnjamen ne Naftale ne Gad dɛ Aasa.

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Juda ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee nɔ. Ɛr ne Onan dɛ Seela. A ɡɛ bibaala batoro nɔ, o ne o haah Sua waa ɛ Keenan te laanee lol ba. Dɛ Ɛr waa ɛ Juda biloɡle la ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, anomanta, Korowii kpoo.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Juda bibaa haah waa ɛ o helahaah sɔne Taama, o ne o lolɛ Pɛrɛs ne Sɛra. Juda bibaala waa lol ba bwa lɔ banue.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Pɛrɛs lolɛ bibaala banɛ. Banee, Hɛsrɔn ne Hamul.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: Sɛra ɡe lolɛ bibaala banue. Banee, Simri ne Etan ne Heman ne Kalkol dɛ Daada.

english_verse: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kaami ɡe lolɛ bibaa, o sɔne Akan. Onee kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii berɛ o kwa, dɛ ba waa ne ba tɛ Israel tena la.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Etan ɡe lolɛ bibaa beŋkpoŋ, o sɔne Asaria. Kooro Devid luɡe nɛra

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Bibaala batoroo Hɛsrɔn lolɛ. Banee, Jeramiil ne Ram dɛ Kaleb.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Ram iro dɛ lolɛ Aminadab, Aminadab ɡe lolɛ Naasɔn, o ɛ Juda tena sitɔɔla bini bɛl.

english_verse: Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz,
translation_verse: Naasɔn iro dɛ lolɛ Salmon, Salmon lolɛ Boas,

english_verse: Obed, and Jesse.
translation_verse: Boas lolɛ Ɔbɛd, Ɔbɛd lolɛ Jese.

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: Ba nimambihaahnaa, Seruya ne Abiɡel. Seruya bibaala batoro waa lol ba sɔne Abisae ne Joab dɛ Asahɛl.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Abiɡel lolɛ Amasa, o mɛɛ baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jɛta, o ɛ Ismael naa. Hɛsrɔn naanar

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Hɛsrɔn bibaa Kaleb mo haahna banɛ, bɛl sɔne Asuba, bɛl ɡe Jɛreɔt. Asuba lolɛ bibaala batoro, banee, Jɛsa ne Sobab dɛ Aadɔn.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, Asuba baa sewɛ, asɛ Kaleb ka mo Efrat dɛ lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Hur.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Hur ɡe iro dɛ lolɛ Uri, Uri ɡe lolɛ Besalɛl.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Hɛsrɔn aa sewɛ Kaleb Efrata habɔɔ la, Hɛsrɔn haah Abija lolɛ Asur waa vɔrɔwe bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Tekoa. Jeramiil naanar

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Hɛsrɔn binomoa Jeramiil bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Ram, o ɛ biloɡle, ne Buna ne Oren ne Osem dɛ Ahija.

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Dɛ Jeramiil dɔ haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Atara, o bibaa sɔne Onam.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Jeramiil binomoa Ram bibaala waa lol ba laanee nɔ, Maas ne Jamin dɛ Eka.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ. Banee, Samai ne Jada. Asɛ Samai ɡe bibaala banɛ waa lol ba laanee, Nadab ne Abisur.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Dɛ Abisur haah sɔne Abihel, o ne o lolɛ Aban ne Molid.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Nadab ɡe bibaalaa, Sɛlɛd ne Apaem. Kɛ Sɛlɛd te ta bii dɔe, dɛ sewɛ.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Apaem ɡe bibaa sɔne Isi, o ɡe aa ira la, o lolɛ Sɛsan. Asɛ Sɛsan ɡe lolɛ Alae.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Jada waa ɛ Samai nime ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ. Banee, Jɛta ne Jonatan. Jɛta te ta bii lolɛ dɛ sewɛ.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Jonatan lolɛ bibaala, banee, Pɛlet ne Sasa. Jeramiil naanaree a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: O lawɛ o bihaah la bɛl tɛ o bonɔɔ Jarha o mo, dɛ lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Atai.

english_verse: the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad.
translation_verse: Atai lolɛ Netan, Netan lolɛ Sabad,

english_verse: Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama. The Descendants of Caleb
translation_verse: Salum lolɛ Jekamia, Jekamia ɡe lolɛ Elisama. Kaleb naanar bane ɡe

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Hɛbrɔn ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee. Kora ne Tapua ne Rekem dɛ Sema.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Sema ɡee lolɛ Raham, Raham ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Jɔɔkeam, Rekem ɡe lolɛ Samai.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Samai bibaa waa lolɔ sɔne Mayɔn, asɛ Mayɔn ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Bɛt Sor.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Kaleb sɛno baa dɛ yerɔ Efa la bibaalaa, Haaran ne Mosa dɛ Gasɛs. Haaran ɡe lolɛ Gasɛs.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Jadai ɡe lolɛ bibaala banumɛl, banee, Rɛɡɛm ne Jotam ne Gɛsan ne Pɛlɛt ne Efa dɛ Saaf.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kaleb dɔ sɛno bɛl baa yerɔ Maaka. O lolɛ bibaala banɛ, Sebar dɛ Tirihana.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Maaka berɔ lolɛ Saaf waa vɔrɔwe Madmana, ne o bibaa Sɛva o ɡe aa vɔrɔwe Makbɛna ne Gibia. Dɛ Kaleb bihaah sɔne Aksa.

english_verse: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.
translation_verse: o binɛɛte sɔne Salma, onee vɔrɔwe Bɛtlɛham. Bitoorote ɡe sɔne Harɛf, o ɡee vɔrɔwe Bɛt Gada.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Sobal waa vɔrɔwe Kiriat Jearim la naanaree, Harowɛ tena ne Manahat tena pera,

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: ne Kiriat Jearim deene ane kɛŋɔ, Itri ne Put ne Sumat dɛ Misra tena. Ba binii Sora tena ne Ɛstaol tena le.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salma naanaree, Bɛtlɛham ne Nɛtɔfa ne Atrɔt Bɛt Joab, ne Manahat tena pera baa ɛ Sor tena,

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: ne deene nɛra baa dɔ waa chwera dɛ bil wejema soɡe Jabɛs. Banee Tira ne Simeat dɛ Suka tena. Banɔɔ Ken tena baa le Haamat dɛ ɛ Rekab mɛɛ dea luɡe nɛra.

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: A ɡɛ bibaala nɔ bwa habɔɔ, dɛ Kooro Devid ne haahna baa ɛ o sɛnanar lolɛ bibaala bane ɡe. Bihaah waa ja ba nɛɛ la sɔne Taama. Kooro Solomɔn naanar

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Jehoiakim ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ, banee Jehoiachin ne Sedekia. Kooro Jehoiachin naanar

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoiachin baa lawɔ laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta naanar waa nɔ. Dɛ o dɔ bibaala banuanɛ, banee teŋa nɔ. Sealteɛl,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: ne Malkiram ne Pɛdaya ne Sɛnasa ne Jekamia ne Hosama dɛ Nedabia.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pɛdaya ɡe iro, dɛ lolɛ bibaala banɛ. Banee, Sɛrobabɛl ne Simee. Sɛrobabɛl ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ. Banee, Mɛsolam ne Hanania. Ba nimambie sɔne Sɛlomet.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Dɛ o dɔ bibaala banue bane ɡe. Banee, Hasuba ne Ohel ne Bɛrekea ne Hasadia dɛ Jusab Hɛsɛd.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Sɛkania lolɛ bibaa beŋkpoŋ baa dɛ yerɔ Sɛmaya, asɛ o ɡe lolɛ bibaala banue. Banee, Hatus ne Iɡal ne Baria ne Nearia dɛ Safat.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Nearia ɡe lolɛ bibaala batoro. Banee, Elionai ne Hiskia dɛ Asrikam.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Elionai ɡe lolɛ bibaala banuanɛ. Banee, Hodavia ne Eliasib ne Pɛlaya ne Akub ne Johanan ne Delaya dɛ Anani.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Juda ɡe naanaree, Pɛrɛs ne Hɛsrɔn ne Kaami ne Hur dɛ Sobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Sobal bibaalee Reaya, o ɡe lolɛ Jahat, Jahat lolɛ Ahumai dɛ Lahad. Banɔɔ Sora tena naawa, dɛ che tɛ ba deene.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Asur waa vɔrɔwe Tekoa la mo haahna banɛ. Banee, Hela ne Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Naara bibaala waa lol ba laanee Ahusam ne Hɛfa ne Temeni dɛ Haahastari. Banee Naara naanar.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Hela ɡe bibaalaa, Sɛrɛt ne Soha dɛ Ɛtnan.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Kos ɡe bibaalaa Anub ne Hasobeba, dɛ deene ba naa aa le Harum bibaa Ahahɛl luɡe ta.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Dɛ Jabɛs lolanar bini la, dɛ onee dɔ duure kohona. O nya pa o sɔn Jabɛs dɛ ŋɔ, “N bwara nyɛɡ mɛ o lola bini.”

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Jabɛs wio no Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, swee mɛ andɛɛɡa, dɛ́ ɡel n harɛ do kan! Kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, dɛ́ lee mɛ waa aa kpɔ bonyɛɡa ba ta n nɛɛ ta.” Asɛ Korowii no o wesoŋa. Lolanar bane baa jaa

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Suha dɔɔ Kelub, onee lolɛ Mehir, Mehir ɡe lolɛ Ɛstɔn.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Ɛstɔn ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Bɛt Rafa ne Pasea dɛ Tehina, asɛ Tehina ɡe lolɛ Ir Nahas. A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ naanar fa soɡe Reka.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kenas ɡe bibaalaa, Otniel ne Seraya. Otniel ɡe bibaalaa, Hatat ne Meɔnɔtae.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Meɔnɔtae ɡee lolɛ Ofra. Seraya ɡe lolɛ Joab, asɛ Joab ɡe ir, dɛ ka vɔrɔwe bwɛɛ fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, Ge Harasim. Gɛɛ ba pa bela sɔn, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa soɡe bela dɛ sɛh kwa.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Jefune bibaa Kaleb bibaalaa, Iru ne Ɛla dɛ Naam. Ɛla ɡe bibaalee, Kenas.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Naham nahaah waa ɛ Hodia haah bibaalaa, Keila waa ɛ Gam te la mɛɛ, ne Maaka te Ɛstemoa.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Simon ɡe bibaalaa, Amnɔn ne Rina ne Bɛn Hanan dɛ Telɔn. Asɛ Isi ɡe naanaree, Sohɛt ne Bɛn Sohɛt. Seela naanar

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛ mamaala dɛ faa so Nɛtaem ne Gɛdɛra. Dɛ ba soɡe bela dɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ kooro la. Simeon naanar

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simeon naanaree, Nemoɛl ne Jamin ne Jarib ne Sɛra dɛ Swaul,

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: asɛ Swaul lolɛ Salum, Salum lolɛ Mibsam, Mibsam ɡe lolɛ Misma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Misma ɡe luɡee la. O lolɛ Hamoɛl, Hamoɛl lolɛ Sakur, Sakur lolɛ Simee.

english_verse: Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.
translation_verse: ne Bɛt Makabɔt ne Hasar Susim ne Bɛt Biri dɛ Saaraim. Dɛ a ɡɛ bwɛɛre nɔ taa ba so mɔɔ Kooro Devid ba di kora.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Bwɛɛre aa bar ba cheme laanee, Etam ne Ain ne Remɔn ne Token dɛ Asan. A bwa lɔ bwɛɛre anue,

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: dɛ bwɛɛre aa bar bela dɛ kpoŋe kaa Baalat. Dɛ belaa ba soŋni, asɛ ba chwerɛ ɡɛ ba naanar aa soɡa denaa ta.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛ nomonome, dɛ chɔ ba deene nyoo. Ba mun yao kohona,

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ yon le kaa Gedɔr dahare fɛlembɔjen la wee leebɔr, dɛ ka nyin dibɔra tɛ ba peera.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Ba dɔ harɛdɛɛɡe waa wera tɛ ba peera, dɛ harɛ la paɡri, deŋnesɔɔhna ɡe do o ta, dɛ sɔɔh. Dɛ Ham tena bini bane fa soɡe bela.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Ba kpoo Amalɛk tena baa kaa la bwa, dɛ kpɔ bela so, dɛ ba le fini.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Jekɔb binomoa sɔne Rubin, dɛ onee biloɡle, kɛ waa lawɛ o mɛɛ haah chɔ la nomanta, ba laa o nomonome lɛ o be tɛ o nime Josef. A ɡɛ nomanta, o sɔn toole ɡɛ baa lol ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Rubin waa ɛ Jekɔb binomoa la bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Hanɔk ne Palu ne Hɛsrɔn dɛ Kaami.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: Baal lolɛ Beera. A ɡɛ Beera nɔɔ Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa lawɛ laa ta kaa harɛfale ta la. Dɛ onee Rubin dea tena sitɔɔ.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: ne Asas bibaa Bɛla, Sema bibaa Asas, dɛ Sema bibaa Joel. Dɛ ba soɡo le harɛ waa le Arowa, dɛ kpoŋe ba le Nɛbo ne Baal Meɔn.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Harɛ la wee leebɔr, ba soɡo ka le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ kaa Yufretis Moo ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba kondɛɛra yao Gelead harɛ ta.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Kooro Sɔɔl bere saŋ la, ba kaa yo Haɡri tena laa dɛ kpoo ba, dɛ kpɔ ba harɛ waa lɔ Gelead wee leebɔr pera la so. Gad dea tena

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Gad dea tena ɡe soɡo teŋɛ ba nɛ Basan harɛ ta, dɛ kpoŋe ka le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Saleka.

english_verse: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Joel ɛ ba sitɔɔ, asɛ Safam teŋɛ, asɛ Janai ne Safat ɡe ja ba bwa so Basan harɛ ta.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba ɛ Huri bibaa Abihel bibaala, Jaroa bibaa Huri ne Jaroa bibaa Gelead, ne Gelead bibaa Maekel ne Maekel bibaa Jesisai, ne Jesisai bibaa Jado, dɛ Jado bibaa ne Bus,

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: ne Abdeɛl bibaa Ahi, o naa ɛ Guni la, onee ɛ nomonnyu dɛ chɔ ba nyoa.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Dɛ Gad tena soɡe Gelead ne Basan harɛre ta ne bwɛɛre aa bara bwa, dɛ kondɛɛra dibɔra aa chɔa dɛ kaa dɛ do Sarɔn bwa.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ ɡɛ naanar nɔ bwa sɔna, ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Jotam aa di kora, ne Israel Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ aa di kora.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Ba kaa yo Haɡri ne Jetur ne Nafis dɛ Nɔdab tena bwa.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Korowii cha ba dɛ ɡel ba pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ Haɡri tena ne nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ bwa do ba nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ laa la ta la, ba wio no Korowii.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra baa wara keri ne, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowiirii yoa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba. Ate, ba so harɛ la ta ka tel kɛŋɔ baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfale ta. Manasɛ dea pera nɛra

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Manasɛ dea pera tena la warɔ, dɛ so le Basan harɛ ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Baal Hɛmɔn ne Senir, dɛ Hɛmɔn Bwejen ta.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Nomonnyuune baa chɔ ba nyoo laanee, Efar ne Isi ne Eliel, ne Asriel ne Jeremia ne Hodavia dɛ Jadiel. Dɛ ba ɛ nomonnyuune, dɛ ɛ banyoola dɛ berɛ dɔ sɔna kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la be, dɛ ɡelo kaa tomɛ nɛra Korowii aa doŋa ba siwi ta voɡare.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ ɡelɔ Asiiria koojen Pul baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Tiɡlat Pilesa ka yoo ba, dɛ lawɛ Rubin ne Gad dea, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena bwa laa ta kaa harɛfale ta. O kaa bane Hala ne Habɔ ne Hara dɛ Gosan Moo ta. Ba lɔ bela dɛ ba le fini.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohat ɡe bibaalaa, Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Amram ɡe dɔ bibaala banɛ, Arɔn ne Mosis, asɛ o bihaah beŋkpoŋ sɔne Miriam. Arɔn ɡe bibaalaa, Nadab ne Abihu ne Eliasa dɛ Itama.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Jehosadak, ne Juda tena bane, ne Jerusalam tena bane laa ta kaa harɛfale ta. Lewi naanar bane ɡe

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Lewi bibaalaa, Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔn ɡe bibaalaa, Libni ne Simee.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohat ɡe bibaalaa, Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: Merari ɡe bibaalaa, Maali ne Musi. Banɔɔ Lewi dea nomonome, ne ɡɛ ba mɛɛnanar aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ,

english_verse: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Asir ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Tahat, Tahat ɡe lolɛ Uriel. O ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Ussia, Ussia ɡe lolɛ Swaul.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Bibaala banɛɛ Ɛlkana lolɛ. Banee, Amasae ne Ahemɔt.

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: Nahat lolɛ Eliab, Eliab lolɛ Jɛroham, o ɡe lolɛ Ɛlkana, Ɛlkana lolɛ Samoɛl.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Samoɛl ɡe bibaalaa, o binomoa sɔne Joel, nɛɛte ɡe Abija.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: Ussa lolɛ Simia, Simia lolɛ Haɡia asɛ Haɡia ɡe lolɛ Asaya. Korowii Dea hɛhɛla ne yelɡoola

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka ba Jerusalam bela baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la, baala Kooro Devid aa lee ba ba chɔ yela nyoa laanee nɔ.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Ba bala Lewi dea tena la nɔn taa ba kpɔ Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela baa dɛ tomɛ la toma aa kaa la do. Arɔn naanar

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Arɔn ne o naanar ɡboo dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ba kon baa dɛ fuh saraha o ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɡe ba kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile o ta la ta. Banee dɛɛ ɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela toma, dɛ́ soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa Korowii be ó kpɔ kɛ ba, ɡɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa do ba la.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz. The Towns for the Levites (Joshua
translation_verse: Ahitub lolɛ Sadɔk, Sadɔk ɡe lolɛ Ahimas. Bela Lewi dea tena aa soɡa

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Harɛ baa kpɔa tɛ Arɔn naanar baa le Kohat dea laanee nɔ. Banee dɔ bɔr waa tɔ sie baa kpɔa tɛ Lewi dea tena o ɛ ba kon.

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Hɛbrɔn waa lɔ Juda harɛ ne o kondɛɛra dibɔra aa baro laanee ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: Kɛ harɛpare ne bwɛɛre aa bar bwejen la, ba kpɔɔ tɛ Jefune bibaa Kaleb.

english_verse: So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh.
translation_verse: ne Asan ne Juta, dɛ Bɛt Sɛmɛs ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa tɛ Arɔn naanar.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡe, ba kpɔ Gebeɔn ne Geba ne Alemɛt ne Anatɔt dɛ a kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa jaa ba. Bwɛɛre baa bɔna tɛ Kohat dea tena nɔ bwa lɔ fi dɛ atoro.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Kohat dea naanar baa kaa la, bwɛɛre fii ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba dɛ le Manasɛ dea pera tena be.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔn naanar ɡe bini deenaa ta la, bwɛɛre fi dɛ atoroo ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba, dɛ le Isaaka ne Aasa ne Naftale dɛ Manasɛ dea pera waa lɔ Basan harɛ la be.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Merari naanar deenaa ta ɡe, ba dɔ bwɛɛre fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ le Rubin ne Gad dɛ Sebulon deene tena be.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Israel tena tɛ Lewi dea tena bwɛɛre nɔ ne ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa ba so.

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: Juda ne Simeon dɛ Bɛnjamen deene bwɛɛre baa tɔ sie kpɔ tɛɛ ba la, daa ba bil, dɛ bɔɔ le Korowii be mɔɔ.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ba tɛ Kohat dea bii la bane bwɛɛre ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra dɛ le Efrem dea tena harɛ ta.

english_verse: These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon.
translation_verse: ne Aejalɔn ne Gat Remɔn, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwaa ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔn tena ɡe bɔr baa dɔa laanee nɔ. Dɛ le Manasɛ dea pera tena be harɛ ta la, bwɛɛre baa dɔa laanee, Golan waa lɔ Basan harɛ ta ne Astarɔt, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Naftale dea tena ɡe be ba dɔ Kedes waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta ne Hamɔn ne Kiriataim, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Merari tena baa ɛ Lewi dea tena kabora ɡe bwɛɛre baa dɔa, dɛ le Sebulon dea tena be laanee nɔ. Jokneam ne Kaata ne Rimono ne Tabɔ, dɛ ba kondɛɛre dibɔra bwa.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Isaaka bibaalaa, Tola ne Pua ne Jasub ne Simron. Ba lɔ bibaala banaarɛ.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Tola ɡe bibaalaa, Usi ne Refaya ne Jeriel ne Jamai ne Ibsam dɛ Samoɛl. Dɛ ba bwa ɛ nomonnyuune. Kooro Devid bere saŋ la, dɛ Tola naanar baa tela ne laa laŋa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ lafraanumɛl.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Ba mɛɛ Efrem ɛ ba lwe biɡri, asɛ o lolanar ba larawe o bwara.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Usi ɡe bibaalee, Israhia. Israhia ɡe bibaalaa, Maekel ne Obadia ne Joel dɛ Isihia. Bii banue nɔ bwa ɛ koranar.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Sofa ɡe bibaalaa, Suua ne Haanefa ne Sual ne Bɛre dɛ Imra

english_verse: In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of
translation_verse: Isaaka dea bibaala baa tela ne laa laŋa, ba kur ba dɛ́ le o dea bwa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanuatoro dɛ banuanɛ. Bɛnjamen ne Dan naanar

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen dɔ bibaala batoro, banee, Bɛla ne Bɛka dɛ Jedial.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bɛla ɡe bibaalaa, Ɛsbɔn ne Usi ne Usiel ne Jerimot dɛ Iri. Ba lɔ nɛra banue, dɛ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune. Ba baala baa tela ne laa laŋa ba kur ba lɔ, nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ dɛ fifraatoro nɛra banaarɛ.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Bɛka ɡe bibaalaa, Sɛmira ne Joas ne Eliesa ne Elionai ne Omri ne Jɛremɔt ne Abija ne Anatɔt dɛ Alemɛt. Ba bwa lɔ bibaala banuanaarɛ.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Efrem ɡe bibaala ne o naanar wa. Onee lolɛ Sutela, Sutela lolɛ Bɛrɛd, Bɛrɛd lolɛ Tahat, Tahat lolɛ Eleada, Eleada ir, dɛ lolɛ Tahat,

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Jedial ɡe bibaalee, Bilhan. Bilhan ɡe bibaalaa, Jeyus ne Bɛnjamen ne Ehud ne Kenaana ne Sɛtan ne Taases dɛ Ahisaha.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Ulam ɡe bibaalee, Bɛdan. A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Gelead o mɛɛ aa ɛ Makir, o nabaa ɛ Manasɛ la naanar.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Ir naanaree Supi tena ne Hupi tena. Asɛ Hus tena ɡe ɛ Aha naanar. Naftale naanar

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Naftale bibaalaa, Jaseel ne Guni ne Jesa dɛ Silem. Bilha naanaree ba bwa. Manasɛ naanar

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manasɛ naanar ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ nɔ. O ne Aram te waa ɛ o sɛno la lolɛ Asriel ne Makir, Makir ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Gelead.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Makir mo haah tɛ Hupim, dɛ mo bɛl tɛ Supim ɡe. Dɛ Makir dɔ nimambie bɛl baa yerɔ Maaka. O dɔ bibaa bɛl baa yerɔ Selofehad. Bihaahna ɡboo o te lolɛ.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Makir haah Maaka lolɛ bibaala banɛ, bɛl sɔne Pɛres asɛ nɛɛte ɡe Sɛrɛs. Pɛres ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Ulam ne Rakem.

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Dɛ Gelead dɔ nimambie bɛl baa yerɔ Hamɔlɛkɛt. Onee lolɛ Esɔd ne Abeɛsa dɛ Maala.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Sɛmeda bibaalaa, Ahian ne Sɛkem ne Liki dɛ Aniam. Efrem naanar

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: Tahat lolɛ Sabad, Sabad ɡe lolɛ Sutela. Efrem berɔ lolɛ bibaala bane ɡe baa yer ba Esa ne Elead. Esa ne Elead iro ŋɔ ba ka ŋwɛ Gat tena kondɛɛra, asɛ ba kpoo ba.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, o haah kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Bɛrea, dɛkalkɛ o ne o bibaala dɛ na wahala ba soɡa bini.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Efrem dɔ bihaah baa yerɔ Seera. Seera vɔrɔwe Bɛt Hɔrɔn waa chɔ nyunduabɔr, ne Bɛt Hɔrɔn waa chɔ harɛbɔr dɛ Usen Seera.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Efrem dɔ bie bɛl ɡe baa yerɔ Refa, asɛ o lolɛ Resɛf, Resɛf lolɛ Tela, Tela ɡe lolɛ Tahan,

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Ba harɛ baa dɔa dɛ so o ta le Bɛtel ne bwɛjeɡre aa baro, dɛ kpoŋe ka le Naaran wee leebɔr, ne Gɛsa ne bwɛɛre aa baro wee cholibɔr, ne Sɛkem ne bwɛɛre aa lɔ Aeja ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ a bwɛɛre aa baro bwa.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Dɛ kpoŋe ka le Manasɛ dea jwɛh ta kaa Bɛt San ne Taanak ne Meɡido ne Dɔr, dɛ bwɛɛre aa bar bela bwa. Dɛ Jekɔb bibaa Josef naanaree sosoɡe a ɡɛ bwɛɛre nɔ ta. Aasa naanar

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Aasa ɡe bibaalaa, Imna ne Isva ne Isvi dɛ Bɛrea. Bihaah beŋkpoŋ waa ja ba nɛɛ sɔne Sera.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Bɛrea ɡe bibaalaa, Heba ne Malkeɛl, asɛ Malkeɛl ir dɛ lolɛ Birsait. A ɡɛ Malkeɛl nɔɔ vɔrɔwe bwɛjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Birsait.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Heba ɡe bibaalaa, Jaflɛt ne Soma dɛ Hotam. Ba nimambie sɔne Sua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Jaflɛt ɡe bibaalaa, Pasak ne Bimhal dɛ Asvat.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Soma ɡe bibaalaa, Ahi ne Roɡa ne Huba, dɛ Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: O nime Hɛlɛm ɡe bibaalaa, Sofa ne Imna ne Sɛlɛs dɛ Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: ne Bɛsa ne Hod ne Sama ne Silsa ne Itran dɛ Beera.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Jɛta ɡe bibaalaa, Jefune ne Pispa dɛ Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Ula ɡe bibaalaa, Ara ne Haneɛl dɛ Risia.

english_verse: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Aasa naanaree a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa. Ba ɛ nomonnyuune ne banyoola, dɛ dɔ sɔna kohona. Ba baala baa kpeɡa ba kur ba bá won la laa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banumɛl.

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen biloɡle la sɔne Bɛla, Asbɛl teŋɛ nɛɛ, asɛ Ahara teŋɛ tooro,

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Bɛla ɡe bibaalaa, Adaar ne Gɛra dɛ Abihud

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: ne Abisua ne Naaman dɛ Ahoa

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: ne Gɛra ne Sɛfofan dɛ Hiram.

english_verse: Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
translation_verse: Naaman ne Ahija dɛ Gɛra bwa ɛ Ehud bibaala, asɛ Gɛra waa ɛ Usa ne Ahihud mɛɛ la tɔ ba sie.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Ɛl Paal ɡe bibaalaa, Iba ne Misam ne Sɛmɛd, onee vɔrɔwe Ono ne Lod bwɛɛre, dɛ bwɛjeɡre aa bara cheme bwa.

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: Bɛrea ne Sema ba ɡe aa ɛ nomonnyuune, dɛ chɔ nɛra bane baa soɡe bwɛjen Aejalɔn nyoa, dɛ berɛ doŋi Gat tena baa soɡe bela la.

english_verse: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
translation_verse: ne Maekel ne Ispa dɛ Joha bwa ɛ Bɛrea naanar.

english_verse: Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: ne Ismerai ne Islia dɛ Jobab.

english_verse: Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.
translation_verse: ne Adaya ne Bɛraya dɛ Simrat bwa ɛ Simee naanar.

english_verse: Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel.
translation_verse: ne Ifdeya dɛ Pɛnoɛl bwa ɛ Sasak ɡe naanar.

english_verse: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
translation_verse: ne Jaaresia ne Elaeja dɛ Sikri bwa ɛ Jɛroham naanar.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Banɔ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune ne koranar ba deremi, ba kur ba ba bwa so Jerusalam.

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Jeyɛl vɔrɔwe bwɛjen Gebeɔn dɛ so bela. O haah sɔne Maaka.

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: O binomoa sɔne Abdɔn. O bibaala baa jaa laanee, Sor ne Kes ne Baal ne Nɛr dɛ Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: ne Gedɔr ne Ahio dɛ Sɛka,

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: dɛ Meklɔt o ɡe aa lolɛ Simea. Dɛ ba ɡe soɡo bɛne ba lolanar Jerusalam.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Nɛr lolɛ Kes, Kes ɡe lolɛ Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl lolɛ Jonatan ne Malki Sua ne Abinadab dɛ Ɛsbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Jonatan ɡe bibaalee, Mɛreb Baal, o ɡe aa lolɛ Maeka.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Maeka ɡe bibaalaa, Petɔn ne Mɛlɛk ne Tarea dɛ Ahas.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Ahas ɡee lolɛ Jehoada, Jehoada ɡe lolɛ Alemɛt ne Asmavɛt dɛ Simri, asɛ Simri ɡe lolɛ Mosa.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Bibaala banumɛlee Asɛl ɡe lolɛ. Banee, Asrikam ne Bokeru ne Ismael ne Searia ne Obadia dɛ Hanan.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: O nime Esɛk ɡe bibaalaa, Ulam, onee binomoa, Jeyus teŋɛ nɛɛ, Ɛlefɛlɛt ɡe teŋɛ tooro.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Ulam bibaala waa lol ba ɛ banyoola dɛ jemɛ to ne yoi kɛrɛdɛ. Ba dɔ bibaala ne naanar taeh, ba lɔ nɛra lafa fifraanue. Bɛnjamen naanaree ba nɔ bwa.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa le Juda ne Bɛnjamen ne Efrem dɛ Manasɛ deene ta dɛ ba so Jerusalam laanee nɔ.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: Jɛroham bibaa Adaya, ne Pasur bibaa Jɛroham, ne Malkija bibaa Pasur, ne Adeɛl bibaa Maasai, ne Jasera bibaa Adeɛl ne Mɛsolam bibaa Jasera, ne Mɛselɛmet bibaa Mɛsolam, dɛ Ima bibaa Mɛselɛmet.

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Nɛra ba ɡe aa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa laanee, Salum ne Akub, ne Talmɔn ne Ahiman dɛ ba dɔɔranar ne nimanar. Asɛ Salum ɛ ba bwa nyu te

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: dɛ so doonyoa bɛl nyoa baa yerɔ Kooro Doonyoa wee leebɔr. Dɛ banɔɔ dɛɛ daah bela Lewi dea tena aa soɡa la doonyoo a ɡɛ saŋ.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kore bibaa Salum waa ɛ Ɛbeasaf naa ne o bala baa le Kora dea, dɛ banee dɛɛ daah Korowii Dea la doonyoa ba naawa fa aa toma la.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Wubwa la, dɛ Eliasa bibaa Fenehas nɛɛ Korowii ja wɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la nɛ.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Mɛselemea bibaa Sekaria ɡe fa dɛ daah Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.

english_verse: and now they guarded the temple gates.
translation_verse: Ba ne ba naanar nɔn taa ba kpɔ Korowii Dea doonyoo la daahna do.

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la lɔ baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta. O wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr, ne weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr. Asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ ba nomoa.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
translation_verse: Bane ba lolanar le ba bwɛɛre ta, dɛ baa cha ba. Bane balɔ ba ɛ toma yawanyoa beŋkpoŋ aa, dɛ ba kaalɔ, asɛ bane ɡe ba.

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: Kɛ nomonome banaarɛ baa ɛ Lewi dea tena dɛ chɔ doonyoo la nyoo la, ba nɔn taa ba kpɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini bela la do.

english_verse: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Baa dɛ daah bela la nomanta, jwaana bwaa ba yon so dɛ bar, doonyoo la safoone do ba be ba kpɔ dɛɛ pila chɔɔ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.
translation_verse: Ba bini bane chɔ laala baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma bela nyoa. Mɔɔ bá paa le kɛɛ dɛ́ paa baa jo dea la bini la, ba dɛ kura.

english_verse: But only the priests could mix the spices.
translation_verse: Kɛ konsɔɔhsoma la koora te, sɔfore la bini bane nɔn taa a do baa ɛ.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Lewi dea te bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Matitia, Kora te bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Salum binomoaa, onee ba kpɔ paanoo baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ saraha wɔɔra do o nɔn ta.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Kohat dea bibaala la bane ɡee dɛɛ ɛ paanoo baa dɛ dawa teebur ta Ona Tɔpera ta.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa ɛ yelɡoola ne Lewi nomonnyuune la soɡe deene la bini, ba ta ɡelɛ baa ɛ toma bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ ba nɔn taa ba kpɔ bela toma ɛɛ do chɔɔ ne jwaana.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Lewi dea tena nomonnyuune ne koranar ba kur ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, dɛ ba bwa soɡe Jerusalam. Kooro Sɔɔl nabaala ne o naanar

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: Meklɔt ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Simiam. Ba ɡe soɡo bɛne ba lolanar Jerusalam.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Dɛ Jeyɛl waa vɔrɔwe Gebeɔn la soɡe bwɛjen Gebeɔn. O haah sɔne Maaka,

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: O binomoa sɔne Abdɔn, banɔ la baa jaa laanee, Sor ne Kes ne Baal ne Nɛr dɛ Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: ne Gedɔr ne Ahio ne Sekaria dɛ Meklɔt.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Nɛr ɡe bie sɔne Kes, Kes lolɛ Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl lolɛ Jonatan ne Malki Sua ne Abinadab dɛ Ɛsbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Maeka ɡe bibaalaa, Petɔn ne Mɛlɛk ne Tarea dɛ Ahas.

english_verse: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Asɛl ɡe lolɛ bibaala banumɛl. Ba sɔnaa, Asrikam ne Bokeru ne Ismael ne Searia ne Obadia dɛ Hanan.

english_verse: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: A kaa ba kɛ Filisti tena ne Israel tena cheme Gelboa Bwejen ta dɛ́ yo laa. Ba kpoo Israel tena ɡalɡa Gelboa Bwejen ta.

english_verse: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead,
translation_verse: Kooro Sɔɔl kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe dɛ tɛ Korowii waa o sewɛ. O ta Korowii waa ta teŋɛ, hale dɛ ka bɔɔ dɛɛ le nɛn waa dɛ yerɛ lala be, ó baɡlo waa waa ɛ,

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: Filisti tena la chwao ti Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro, Jonatan ne Abinadab dɛ Malki Sua sibeɡra ne dɛ kpoo o bibaala la.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Laa la baa do kpeɡri tɛ Kooro Sɔɔl, asɛ o dɔma la bɛl ta hɛm yaɡɔ dɛ doo bol kohona.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade.
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o bonɔɔ waa dɛ che o dɔmkwaa la be ŋɔ, “Pamɛ he kere la dɛ́ ba tɔɡ mɛ kpo, ásɛ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ nɔ, bɛ men ba kpo dɛ́ chɛɡ mɛ ja.” Kɛ dɛ bonɔɔ la dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ó ɛ ɡɛ, anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl pamɛ o ɡbaɡba kere dɛ chole o ta.

english_verse: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Bonɔɔ la aa naa kɛ Kooro Sɔɔl sewɔ la, o ɡe chole o kon ta dɛ sewɛ ja o nɛ.

english_verse: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
translation_verse: Israel tena baa soɡe Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen bini aa noa kɛŋɔ laa tena la bwa chwao, asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala bwa ɡe serewe la, ba chwao ɡel ba bwɛɛre, asɛ Filisti tena la ba so a ta.

english_verse: The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa,
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, Filisti tena la laŋɔ dɛ ka pa laa tena baa kpoo ba la laala, asɛ dɛ na Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro la kɛ baa serewa chɔ Gelboa Bwejen ta.

english_verse: they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods.
translation_verse: Ba teŋe Kooro Sɔɔl nyu, dɛ pa o dɔmkwaa ja, dɛ tomɛ toroma Filisti harɛ la ta bwa ŋɔ bá ka bol amanesoma nɔ ba voɡa deene ne nɛra bwa be.

english_verse: They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dɔmkwaa la ka bil ba voɡare deene bini, dɛ kpɔ o nyu saɡɛ ba voɡ Daɡɔn dea.

english_verse: When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Jabes waa lɔ Gelead harɛ tena la aa noa ɡɛ Filisti tena la aa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl la,

english_verse: some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: ba bini banyoola laŋɔ ka kpɔ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala baa kpoo ba, dɛ ba ba ne Jabes. Ba huɡ ba dajen bɛl mun bela, dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa tɔpera anuanɛ.

english_verse: instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: dɛ vɛh Korowii nɛɛ teŋa. A waa Korowii kpoo, dɛ berɛ kora la tɛ Jese bibaa Devid.

english_verse: The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
translation_verse: Jebus tena la ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “Haa won ba ya be bonɔ.” Kɛ ane a bwa, o yoo dɛ lɛ Jerusalam, asɛ baa yerɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ne o danjwɛkpeɡ.

english_verse: Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives,
translation_verse: Israel tena bwa ba Devid be Hɛbrɔn dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ya bwa ɛ he lolanar dɛ ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: So we have come to crown you king of Israel.” David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said. David Captures Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Anomanta, Israel nomonome la bwa ba Devid be Hɛbrɔn, o ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo Korowii sie bela, asɛ ba fuɡe noo do Devid nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Samoɛl nɛɛ dɛ bol la. Kooro Devid yo Jerusalam tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ

english_verse: David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Devid fa bolɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa tɔ laa sie dɛ́ ka yo Jebus tena la, onee dɛ́ ɛ nomoa dɛɛ tɔ laa tena sie.” Joab o nya aa ɛ Seruya laanee wona ir dɛ tɔ ba sie la ba be, asɛ ba kpɔ laa sitɔɔ la tɛo.

english_verse: The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid banyoola ne Israel tena bwa baa chao o won di kora, ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡ ba nyoa, o kora che kiŋkiŋ laanee teŋa nɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid ne Israel tena bwa kpɔ ba te kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ba fa dɛ yerɔ Jebus, dɛ ka yo Jebus tena baa soɡe bela,

english_verse: Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David.
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Devid ka so Jerusalam baa ma danjwɛɛ baro la ta. Gɛɛ a do baa yerɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen.

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: Kooro Devid teŋɔ di kpeɡri kohona, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Nemenɛ Korowii ja o nɛ. Kooro Devid banyoola baa dɔ sɔna

english_verse: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: O berɔ kpo Ijipt te bɛl ɡe, dɛ o kpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ, o jaŋne ɛɛ ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tamaa. A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ Ijipt te la kpoŋe lampeajen, kɛ Bɛnaya kpɔ o ɡuli la o be sibeɡra ne, dɛ ka to o lampea le o nɔn ta, dɛ kpɔ kpoo.

english_verse: and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Nyɔɡre dɛ kpo Kooro Devid, asɛ o ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin nomɛl fe aa kaa dɔ nee kɔlɔŋ waa chɔa bɛne Bɛtlɛham doonyojen la ta ba tɛ mɛ ń nyɔ!”

english_verse: The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed
translation_verse: Banyoo waa ɛ banyoola batoro la bwa nomoa laanee Hakmɔn te Jasobeam. Onee kpɔ o lampea yo baala lafraatoro, dɛ kpoo ba laa bɛl ta la.

english_verse: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.
translation_verse: Nɛɛte waa ja banyoola batoro la nɛɛ ɡee Dodai bibaa Eliasa, o le Aho dea.

english_verse: During a battle against the Philistines at Pas-Dammim, all the Israelite soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Dɛ o ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ o ka yo Filisti tena, Pas Damim. Dɛ mea koo bɛl chɔ bela, asɛ ba chwa le Filisti tena la be.

english_verse: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: Kɛ o ne o laa tena lɔ bambile che koo la baah ta, dɛ yo Filisti tena la. Korowii ɡelɔ o kpoo ba kɛrɛdɛ awola.

english_verse: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, laa nomonome la bini fifraatoro la bini batoro ba Kooro Devid be, Adulam bwebɔɔ la ta. Dɛ Filisti laa tena ɡe boa ba nyoa, dɛ cheme Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini.

english_verse: and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ ń nyɔ nee nɔ. Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ maa dɛ nyɔ baala baa ta ba nyu, dɛ won la ka dɔ nee nɔ ba tɛ mɛ nɔ chal.” Anomanta, o vɛh nee la nyɔe. Waa banyoola batoro la aa ɛa laanee la.

english_verse: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: A lole kɛ dɛ baa on kure dɛɛ ja banyoola batoro la nɛ, kɛ onee bera ba chɔ ba bwa nyoa dɛ lɛ sɔn kohona.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Dɛ Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ɛ nɛn waa won yoi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le bwɛjen Kabseel ta, o ɡe ɛ wejena kɛrɛdɛ. Onee wona kpo Moab baala banɛ baa won yoi kɛrɛdɛ la. O berɔ jo bɔɔ bini, awola bɛl, dɛ dombwea leero dɛ ka kpo nyujente.

english_verse: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors,
translation_verse: Waa Bɛnaya aa ɛa laanee la. O ɡe lɛ sɔn kɛŋɔ banyoola batoro la ken.

english_verse: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
translation_verse: Ba tɛo duure kohona ɡwaa banyoola fifraatoro la bini bɛlbwa, kɛ ba ta on kpɔe ja banyoola batoro la nɛ. Asɛ Kooro Devid ɡel o chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daahno la nyoa.

english_verse: Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand.
translation_verse: Ba kpoŋe tori, dɛ jemɛ ane yoi kɛrɛdɛ, kɛɛ dɛ won vamtor bwea tae diɡ ne ɡal bwa. Ba le Kooro Sɔɔl luɡe ta, dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea.

english_verse: Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears.
translation_verse: Baala bane le Gad dea dɛ ba ja Kooro Devid laa tena la nɛɛ dekpeɡ la ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bobɛl. Ba ɛ banyoola baa kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa tɔ ɡbemɡbe dɛɛ yo laa ne lampeare. Ba siebɔra do ɔma kɛŋɔ nyujentena ken, dɛ do ɡbaŋre kɛŋɔ kweɡli aa lɔ bwejena dor.

english_verse: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra baa le Gad dea nɔ bwa ɛ laa sitɔɔla, bane chɔ laa tena lafa nyoa, bane ɡe chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋ nyoa.

english_verse: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river. Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
translation_verse: Banee ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo, korobiloɡle ta ɡɛ saŋ waa sua kohona, dɛ doŋi nɛra baa soɡe fɛlembɔjena bini, wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr ba bwa peɡre la.

english_verse: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, laa tena bane le Bɛnjamen ne Juda deene ta ɡe, dɛ la Kooro Devid be bela waa soɡa o dekpeɡ la bini.

english_verse: David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Devid ir ka chem ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna nee hɛɛ ba n be dɛ́ ba cha mɛ naa, n sɛoh kɛŋɔ ya nyoa pɛ. Kɛ dɛ he balɔ, dɛ́ ba lee mɛ tɛ n dɔma maa wola wechɔɡe bɛlbwa lii nɔ tenaa, Korowii ya naawa aa tomɔ laanee dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne.”

english_verse: Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag.
translation_verse: Manasɛ dea laa tena bane pere ba te, dɛ ba ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ ɡɛ saŋ o ne Filisti tena aa dɛ la ka yo Kooro Sɔɔl la. Kɛ o ne o laa tena ta Filisti tena la chae. Dɛ Filisti koranar la dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ le ba habɔɔ dɛ́ berɛ kaa o nomoa Sɔɔl be. Anomanta, ba ɡelɔ o berɛ ba Siklaɡ.

english_verse: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
translation_verse: Banee cha Kooro Devid wɛɛ yo nɛra laa, dɛ yon lɔ ka tɔ nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ pa ba laala, dɛkalkɛ ba bwa ɛ banyoola, dɛ ɛ o laa sitɔɔla.

english_verse: Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil. Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_verse: Deene ane kɛŋɔ Isaaka ne Sebulon, dɛ Naftale deene tena ɡe le bojaŋa, dɛ kpɔ nyoɡmare ne keeɡore ne nabala aa cheɡɛ kondikwa ne men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ, ne fiɡ daa nɔna aa hola nɔn del, ne daa nɔna ane ɡe aa hola nɔn del, ne sen dɛ ɔleve no. Ba kpɔ nae ne peera aa wara ba ba kpo di, dɛkalkɛ silɛɛ tentenee ba Israel harɛ ta bwa.

english_verse: All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing.
translation_verse: Gɛ laa tena nɔ bwa kpɔ ba te, dɛ ba Hɛbrɔn sibeɡra ne kɛŋɔ, bá ba cheɡ Devid kora Israel harɛ ta. Dɛ Israel tena la kar bwa dɔ liire beŋkpoŋ kɛŋɔ, Devid ɛ kooro Israel harɛ.

english_verse: The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them.
translation_verse: Laa tena la di Devid be bela tɔpera atoro, dɛ di kwaa dɛɛ nyɔ sen ba bala Israel tena aa ɛa ba tɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
translation_verse: O ne Israel tena la iro le bwɛjen Baala baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Kiriat Jearim waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le bela dɛ kaa Jerusalam. Nemenɛ Korowii sɔn dawɛ Daka la ta, asɛ o so o kookara ta, kena kwaa baa dɛ yera Kerobim la baah ta.

english_verse: Some time later, David talked with his army commanders,

english_verse: David chose Asaph and the Levites in his clan to be in charge of the daily worship at the place where the sacred chest was kept.
