english_verse: David also chose Zadok the priest and his relatives who were priests to serve at the Lord's sacred tent at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid kpɔ sɔfo Sadɔk ne o bala sɔfore so Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela baa chema dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii o do Gebeɔn.

english_verse: They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel.
translation_verse: Dɛ a chɛ kɛ ŋɔ bá kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah baa tɛ Korowii bela, kon baa dɛ fuh saraha o ta chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra, ɡɛ aa lɔ Korowii Mmarare bini o kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ laanee, Heman ne Jedutun, dɛ banɔ la bwa baa lee ba cheɡ ŋɔ bá ɡo yela dɛɛ jam Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Heman ne Jedutun chɔ bɛle hoeh ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛ anɔ la aa jaa ba kpɔ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii la nyoa. Jedutun bibaala la te, doonyoa belaa ba ɡel ba so dɛɛ daah bela.

english_verse: After that, everyone went home, and David went home to his family.
translation_verse: Belaa nɛra la bwa le bela kaa ba deremi, asɛ Kooro Devid ɡe kaa o dem, dɛ ka soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ o dem tena.

english_verse: Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.”
translation_verse: Kooro Devid baa so o koodem, asɛ Korowii ɡel o dɔ bosɔɔhna dɛ le o dɔma bwa baa baro cheme be. Belaa o ŋɔ Korowii keame Netan be ŋɔ, “N soɡe koodem baa kpɔ peleme daa kwaaro bini, asɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la te ta che tɛnte dea bini.”

english_verse: and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ta ɡelɛ a jaɡɛ bela dɛ ta teŋɛ ɛ ane dɛɛ ja, he berɔ bol he bonɔɔ naanar baa ka ba kerekere ɡe wa. He berɔ ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ nɛnjen kohona.

english_verse: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.
translation_verse: Le awola tɔpere maa kpɔ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta ba le fini, n ta dea bini soɡe bwa. Tɛnte dea binii mɛɛ so ba kpɔ mɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.

english_verse: I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
translation_verse: Bobɛlbwa n ne n nɛra Israel tena aa kaala bwa, n ta ba sitɔɔla bɛlbwa maa do ba ŋɔ baa nyiŋi n nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peera be ŋɔe ŋɔ, ba ta peleme daa waa kpeɡa kpɔe kwaa dea tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
translation_verse: N ja he nɛ bobɛlbwa haa laŋa, dɛ yo he dɔma baa lɔ he sie, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ tɛɛ. Mɛɛ ɡeloo he sɔn le kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛnjena ken.

english_verse: I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace. They will no longer have to tremble with fear—evil nations won't bother them, as they did
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ harɛ waa ɛ n nɛra Israel tena ɡbaɡba konee tɛɛ ba, bá ka so o ta ba bwara sɔɔh ba. Nɛnchɔɡa aa ban fiiɡi kpa, ɡɛ a fa aa doa wubwa,

english_verse: when I let judges rule my people, and I will keep your enemies from attacking you. Now I promise that like you, your descendants will be kings.
translation_verse: ne ɡɛ maa ɛa dɛ le saŋ maa le sitɔɔla tɛ n nɛra Israel tena la. Mɛɛ berɔ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna le he dɔma bwa nɔn ta. Men Korowii, n bol he be ŋɔ he ne he naanaree dɛɛ ba koranar ɛɛ.

english_verse: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried beside your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler,
translation_verse: Haa ba sewɛ ka pu he naawa la, mɛɛ ɡeloo he ɡbabir bibaala la bini bɛl bá chiɡ he naa ta dɛ́ di kora, ásɛ o kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: Onee dɛ́ do n Dea tɛ mɛ n sɔn ta, ásɛ n ɡel o kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I will be like a father to him, and he will be like a son to me. I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔɔ ɛ n bie, ásɛ n ɡe ɛ o mɛɛ. Mɛɛ che o mun taa, maa n nyinaa laa kpɔ o nɛ, kɛŋɔ maa le Kooro Sɔɔl ne, dɛ ɡel he ba chiɡ o naa ta di kora la.

english_verse: I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ n nɛra ne n harɛɛ do o nɔn ta, ásɛ n ɡel o kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said. David Gives Thanks to the Lord (
translation_verse: Ate, Netan bol waa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡlo la bwa baɡle Kooro Devid. Kooro Devid Korowii wesoŋa

english_verse: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me?
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa men Devid dɔ dɛ́ bol he be jaɔ? He ɡbabir jemɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ wa.

english_verse: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. He sat there and prayed: Lord God, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us,
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Devid ka jo Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr waa baŋro la bini, dɛ ka so Korowii sie dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, umee n ɡe ne n lolanar asɛ he ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɔŋa bwa tɛ mɛ ken nɔɔ?

english_verse: It was your choice to do these wonderful things for me and to make these promises.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he cheɡɛ waa haa bola ne waa haa dɛ nyin ɛɛ ta dɛ ɛ wejena nɔ bwa, asɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ jemɛ a wa.

english_verse: No other god is like you, Lord—you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he kan kohona. Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛ hen, ya te jemɔ saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ he ɡboo Korowii.

english_verse: And there is no other nation on earth like Israel, the nation you rescued from slavery in Egypt to be your own. You became famous by using great and wonderful miracles to force other nations and their gods out of your land, so that your people could live here.
translation_verse: Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra toole dɛ do kɛŋɔ he nɛra Israel tena. Harɛ beŋkpoŋ nɛra hen Korowii aa lɛɛ ba le wenaale ta Ijipt harɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ he nɛra la. Wejena ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla haa ɛa tɛɛ ba la bwa ɡelɔ he dɔ sɔn harɛ nɔ ta bwa. He berɔ doŋi harɛre ane nɛra le ba sie.

english_verse: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.
translation_verse: He lɛ he nɛra Israel tena cheɡ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, asɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, “The Lord All-Powerful rules Israel and is their God.” My kingdom will be strong,
translation_verse: á che a ta he dɔ sɔn kohona saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Ásɛ nɛra na dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi Israel tena nɛ!’ Ásɛ men, he bonɔɔ Kooro Devid naanar che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ do he sie saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: because you are my God, and you have promised that my descendants will be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he pili waa nɔ bini baɡle men he bonɔɔ dɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ ɡeloo n naanar ɛ koranar.

english_verse: Now please bless my descendants forever, and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already blessed my family, and I know you will bless us forever.
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe kɛ he swee n naanar andɛɛɡa, ásɛ baa di he laworomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa. Hen N Naa Korowiirii sweera tɛ n naanar a do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: While King Hadadezer of Zobah was trying to gain control of the territory near the Euphrates River, David met him in battle at Hamath and defeated him.
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Devid berɛ ka yo Soba Kooro Hadadesa, hale dɛ ka le Hamat, ɡɛ saŋ waa la Yufretis Moo nyoa dɛ ka lɛ bela harɛ ba do o lɔɡa ja la.

english_verse: Hadadezer's officers had carried gold shields, but David took these shields and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa Kooro Hadadesa nomonome aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta la, dɛ ba a ne Jerusalam.

english_verse: When troops from the Syrian kingdom of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David killed
translation_verse: Siiria tena baa le Damaskɔs balɔ dɛ ba cha Soba Kooro Hadadesa, asɛ Kooro Devid kpoo ba bini nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.

english_verse: Then David stationed some of his troops in Damascus, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him. Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid bɔne laa tena la bini ba so kuore ta Damaskɔs harɛ ta, asɛ Siiria tena la do o lɔɡa, dɛ kpɔ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛo. Korowii ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ dɛ ɡel bobɛlbwa waa la ka yo la, o pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: King Tou of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Tou heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Hadoram to congratulate David on his victory. Hadoram also brought him gifts made of gold, silver, and bronze.
translation_verse: o tomɛ o bibaa Hadoram Kooro Devid be o ka jaamo yoi waa kaa yo Kooro Hadadesa, dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ la wa. Dɛ o ne Kooro Tou nɔ yo laa ka. Hadoram kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ ayaawa kwaa bwa soo siwi ba tɛ Kooro Devid.

english_verse: David gave these gifts to the Lord, just as he had done with the silver and gold he had captured from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid kpɔ a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ dɛ lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii toma, ɡɛ o fa aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm waa paa le harɛre waa kaa yo, dɛ pɔ a nɛra nɛɛ la. A ɡɛ harɛre laanee, Edom ne Moab, ne Amɔn ne Filisti, dɛ Amalɛk.

english_verse: Abishai the son of Zeruiah defeated the Edomite army in Salt Valley and killed
translation_verse: Abisae nya Seruya kpoo Edom tena nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banuatoro, Yar Fɛlembɔjen bini.

english_verse: Then he stationed troops in Edom, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler. Everywhere David went, the Lord gave him victory in war. A List of David's Officials (
translation_verse: O bɔne laa tena la bini kuore ta ba so bwɛɛre ta Edom harɛ bwa, asɛ harɛ la tena bwa do o lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ. Korowii ja o nɛ, dɛ ɡel o pɔ bobɛlbwa nɛra waa laŋa ka yo bwa nɛ. Kooro Devid nomonome

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.
translation_verse: Dɛ Seruya bibaa Joab, onee chɔ laa tena la nyoa, asɛ Ahilud bibaa Jehosafat ɡe chwerɛ waa aa chiɡa bwa dɛɛ bil,

english_verse: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests. Shavsha was the secretary.
translation_verse: asɛ Ahitub bibaa Sadɔk, ne Abiata bibaa Ahemɛlɛk ɡe ɛ sɔfore, asɛ Seraya ɡe ɛ ba karake waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ do tɔne bini,

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard. David's sons were his highest-ranking officials.
translation_verse: Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ɡe ɛ Kɛrɛt ne Pɛlet tena baa dɛ daah kooro la nomoa, asɛ Kooro Devid bibaala ɛɛ ja kooro o waa ta.

english_verse: David said, “Nahash was kind to me, so I will be kind to his son.” He sent some officials to Ammon to tell Hanun how sorry he was that his father had died. But when David's officials arrived at Ammon,
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Devid lii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ Kooro Nahas bibaa Hanun daramee, ɡɛ n ne o mɛɛ fa aa kpɔ darame la.” Anomanta, kooro tomɛ toroma o be ba ka bwɛɛlo o mɛɛ seo wa. Toroma la aa tel Kooro Hanun be Amɔn tena harɛ ta la,

english_verse: Joab saw that the enemy troops were lined up on both sides of him. So he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Syrians.
translation_verse: Joab nao kɛŋɔ laa tena lɔ o sie ne habɔɔ, anomanta, o le Israel laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ka che Siiria tena la sie ba ne ba yo.

english_verse: Some time later, King Nahash of Ammon died, and his son Hanun became king.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Amɔn Kooro Nahas baa sewɛ, asɛ o bibaa Hanun ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

english_verse: When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had defeated them, they made peace with David and accepted him as their new ruler. The Syrians never helped the Ammonites again.
translation_verse: Koranar baa lɔ Kooro Hadadesa lɔɡa aa naa kɛŋɔ Israel tena pɔ ba nɛɛ la, ba ne Kooro Devid kaa fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔo, dɛ kpɔ ba te do o lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ. Gɛɛ a do Siiria tena ɔmɛ, ba ta Amɔn tena chae kpa.

english_verse: the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, “Do you really believe King David is honoring your father by sending these men to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our country, so he can come and destroy it.”
translation_verse: anee Amɔn nomonjena ŋɔ Kooro Hanun be ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ duuree Kooro Devid kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ he mɛɛ, dɛ tomɛ toroma ŋɔ bá ba bwɛɛle nɔ naa? Toma laa o tom ba ŋɔ bá ba sɔh nyiŋi ya harɛ nɔ, dɛ́ won ba yo yaa, dɛ́ pɔ ya nɛ aa?”

english_verse: Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off and their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Kooro Hanun lawɛ Kooro Devid toroma la dɛ fonɛ bɛlbwa tampona pera ta, dɛ teŋni ba laala baa doa la muŋkela ta, dɛ ɡel ba bá kaa.

english_verse: They were terribly ashamed. When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message that told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.”
translation_verse: Kooro Devid aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o tomɛ toroma ba kpɔ kala ka tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ ba ɡelɔ sihiih kpo ba kohona. O ŋɔ toroma la be kɛŋɔ bá ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá so Jeriko ka tel kɛŋɔ ba tampona la aa moɡa mɔɔ ba berɛ ba.

english_verse: David heard what was happening, and he sent out Joab with his army.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid aa no waa nɔ la, o tomɛ Joab ne laa tena la bwa, ŋɔ bá ka yoo ba.

english_verse: The Ammonite troops marched to the entrance of the city and prepared for battle, while the Syrian troops took their positions in the open fields.
translation_verse: Amɔn tena la kpɔ ba te, dɛ ba che Raba waa ɛ ba bwɛjen la doonyoa, asɛ koranar baa bala dɛ ba cha la ɡe che bwɛɛ la dahare.

english_verse: Then he put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and told them to fight against the Ammonites.
translation_verse: O kpɔ laa tena la kabora do o nime Abisae nɔn ta, asɛ Abisae kpɔ ba ka che Amɔn tena la sie ba ne bá yo.

english_verse: Joab told his brother, “If the Syrians are too much for me to handle, come and help me. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you.
translation_verse: Belaa Joab ŋɔ Abisae be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa na kɛŋɔ Siiria tena la dɛ pɔ n nɛ aa, he ba dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ, dɛ Amɔn tena ɡe kpeɡri ba dɛ ɡwaa he nɛ aa, ń ɡe ba lɛɛ.

english_verse: Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the towns of our Lord God. I pray he will do whatever pleases him.”
translation_verse: Dɔ bambile dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ ɡel ya won yo bansua ne lɛ ya nɛra ne Korowii bwɛjena cheɡ. Waa aa too Korowii tea laanee wɛɛ ba ɛɛ.”

english_verse: Joab and his soldiers attacked the Syrians, and the Syrians ran from them.
translation_verse: Ate, Joab ne o laa tena kpɔ ba te dɛ ka yo Siiria tena la, asɛ ba chwa le ba sie kaa kwaraa.

english_verse: When the Ammonite troops saw that the Syrians had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab then returned to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amɔn tena aa na Siiria tena ba chwa dɛɛ kaa la, ba chwao le Abisae be dɛ kaa bwɛjen la bini. Anomanta, Joab berɔ ba Jerusalam.

english_verse: As soon as the Syrians realized they had been defeated, they sent for their troops that were stationed on the other side of the Euphrates River. Shophach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led these troops to Ammon.
translation_verse: Siiria tena aa naa kɛŋɔ Israel tena pɔ ba nɛɛ la, asɛ ba tomɛ toroma ba ka kpɔ laa tena le Yufretis Moo wee leebɔr baŋ le, asɛ Kooro Hadadesa laa sitɔɔ Sobak tɔ ba sie.

english_verse: David found out what the Syrians were doing, and he brought Israel's entire army together. They crossed the Jordan River, and he commanded them to take their positions facing the Syrian troops. Soon after the fighting began,
translation_verse: Kooro Devid aa no waa nɔ la, o boa Israel laa tena bwa nyoa, asɛ ba ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le. Ba bɔne o laa tena la bini ba ka che ba chebɔra dɔma la baŋ bɛl. Ba pa yoi la mun,

english_verse: The next spring, the time when kings go to war, Joab marched out in command of the Israelite army and destroyed towns all over the country of Ammon. He attacked the capital city of Rabbah and left it in ruins. But David stayed in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Lɔmɔɡa saŋ koranar yon dɛɛ la laa la, Kooro Devid tomɛ Joab ŋɔ ó tɔ o laa tena sie, dɛ́ ka yo laa. Ba kaa yo Amɔn tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ ka bar bwɛjen Raba ɡe cheme, dɛ chɔɡ o bwa o berɛ dimɡbia, kɛ Kooro Devid te soɡe Jerusalam.

english_verse: He forced the people of Rabbah to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. He also did the same thing with the people in all the other Ammonite towns. David then led Israel's army back to Jerusalem. The Descendants of the Rephaim (
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ lawɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta, dɛ ɡel baa peɡri daa dɛɛ loɡɛ para ne kpanfɛre. Gɛɛ o ɛ Amɔn bwɛɛre la bwa ta, asɛ o ne o laa tena la bwa berɛ kaa Jerusalam. Filisti tena yoi wa

english_verse: Some time later, Israel fought a battle against the Philistines at Gezer. During this battle, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were defeated.
translation_verse: Anɔ habɔɔ, ba ne Filisti tena berɔ yo laa Gɛsa. Laa la ta la, Sibekai waa le Husa kpo Refa te waa kpeɡa, o bwara do kpeɡri kohona naanar la bini bɛl baa yerɔ Sipai, asɛ Filisti tena ba do ba lɔɡa.

english_verse: In another battle against the Philistines, Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam.
translation_verse: Ba ne Filisti tena berɔ yo laa, asɛ Jɛɛ bibaa Ɛlhanan kpo Laami waa ɛ Goliat nime, waa le Gat. O lampea nyoa buni tɔɡre kɛŋɔ yasɔɔh kokorowa daa ken.

english_verse: Another one of the Philistine soldiers who was a descendant of the Rephaim was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. During a battle at Gath,
translation_verse: Laa bɛl ɡe chole Gat ja. Dɛ baa bɛl kpeɡo o bwara do kpeɡri kohona. O nɔn bɛlbwa ta, o dɔ nonie anumɛl, o nanie ɡe ɛ anumɛl o nakpale ta. A bwa lɔ fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ. O ɛ Rafa naa.

english_verse: he made fun of Israel, so David's nephew Jonathan killed him.
translation_verse: O muɡli Israel tena baah, asɛ Simea waa ɛ Kooro Devid dɔɔranar la bini bɛl bibaa Jonatan kpoo.

english_verse: David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
translation_verse: Eliasa naa Sadɔk ne Itama ɡe naa Ahemɛlɛk cha Kooro Devid, asɛ o bɔne Arɔn naanar la bini kuore ta, dɛ kpɔ bɛlbwa toma do o nɔn ta.

english_verse: groups, and Ithamar's were divided into eight groups, because Eleazar's family included more family leaders.
translation_verse: fi dɛ anuanaarɛ ɛ Pɛtahea, fifraanɛ ɛ Jehɛskɛl.

english_verse: However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.
translation_verse: Ba ta bɛl nyine dɛ ɡwaa o dɔŋ dɛ bil daa, dɛ nomonome baa nyiŋi Korowii Dea bela lole, asɛ sɔfore ɡe do le, bane ɛ Eliasa naanar bane ɡe ɛ Itama naanar.

english_verse: As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
translation_verse: Nɛtanɛl bibaa Sɛmaya waa ɛ Lewi dea te, onee chwerɛ ba sɔna Kooro Devid ne o nomonome bwa sie. Sadɔk waa ɛ sɔfo ne Abiata bibaa Ahemɛlɛk, ne sɔfore dea ne Lewi dea nomonnyuune ɡe jao, ba chwerɛ sɔna la. Ba le dea beŋkpoŋ le Eliasa naanar bini, dɛ le bɛl le Itama naanar ɡe bini.

english_verse: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron. The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Gɛɛ ba lee ba dɛ kpɔ do ba nɔn ta, ba teŋɛ kaa jo Korowii Dea bela kaa ɛ toma, ɡɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa cheɡɛ ba nabaa Arɔn nɛɛ do ba la. Lewi dea nɛra kabora

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
translation_verse: Lewi naanar kar. Le Amram bibaala, Subael. Le Subael ɡe bibaala, Jedeya.

english_verse: Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
translation_verse: Rehabia ɡe bibaala bini, Isihia, onee biloɡle.

english_verse: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
translation_verse: Isiha tena ɡe la, Sɛlomɔt. Sɛlomɔt bibaala ɡe bini, Jahat.

english_verse: Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Hɛbrɔn bibaala waa lol ba laanee Jɛrea, onee biloɡle asɛ Amaria teŋɛ nɛɛ, Jahaseɛl teŋɛ tooro asɛ Jekameam teŋɛ naarɛ.

english_verse: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
translation_verse: Usiel bibaa, Maeka. Maeka ɡe bibaala, Samir.

english_verse: Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
translation_verse: Maeka nime, Isihia. Isihia bibaala, Sekaria.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.
translation_verse: Merari bibaala, Maali ne Musi. Jaasia bibaa, Beno.

english_verse: Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
translation_verse: Merari bibaala, Jaasia luɡe ta, Soham ne Sakur dɛ Ibri.

english_verse: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.
translation_verse: Musi ɡe bibaala, Maali ne Ida dɛ Jerimot. Banee Lewi naanar ne ba lolanar.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Ba ɡe bil daa kɛŋɔ ba dɔɔranar Arɔn naanar aa ɛa la, Kooro Devid ne Sadɔk ne Ahemɛlɛk dɛ sɔfore nomonnyuune ne Lewi dea nomonnyuune la bwa sie. Ba nyiŋi dea bɛlbwa binomoa, dɛ nyiŋi bechale bwa kɛrɛdɛ, bɛl ta bɛl ɡwaalɛ.

english_verse: David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
translation_verse: Kooro Devid ne o laa nomonome le Asaf bibaala Heman ne Jedutun baa bol Korowii wa, dɛɛ lɔ janjela ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ dɛɛ ɡo yela. Nɛra baa jaa dɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ toma nɔ laanee teŋa nɔ.

english_verse: Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.
translation_verse: Asaf bibaala, Sakur ne Josef ne Nɛtanea dɛ Asarɛla. Dɛ Asaf bibaala lɔ Asaf lɔɡa wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ. Onee dɛ Kooro dɛ nyin waane bini dɛ jemaa, o yon ɡel o bol Korowii waa.

english_verse: His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba bwa lɔ ba mɛɛ sie dɛɛ lɔ kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, ne janjela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii o Dea. Asɛ Asaf ne Jedutun ne Heman ɡe do kooro lɔɡa wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.

english_verse: David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
translation_verse: Ba ne ba nomonome ne bechale bwa, chichare ne nɛra ba ta aa dɛ hweli, ba bil daa mɔɔ bɛlbwa jemɛ o toma waa ɛ.

english_verse: Obed-Edom had been blessed with eight sons: Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sachar, Nethanel, Ammiel, Issachar, and Peullethai.
translation_verse: Ameɛl teŋɛ numɛl, Isaaka teŋɛ nuanɛ, asɛ Peuletai teŋɛ nuatoro. Dɛ Korowii swee Ɔbɛd Edom andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan.
translation_verse: Sɛmaya bibaalaa, Otni ne Refaɛl ne Ɔbɛd dɛ Ɛlsabad. Dɛ o lolanaree, Elihu ne Sɛmakia, dɛ ba ɡe dɔ ba te.

english_verse: Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
translation_verse: Mɛselemea dɔ bibaala ne lolanar baa dɔ ba te kɛrɛdɛ. Ba lɔ nɛra fi dɛ banuatoro.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: asɛ Hilkia teŋɛ nɛɛ, Tabalia teŋɛ tooro, asɛ Sekaria teŋɛ naarɛ. Hosa bibaala ne o lolanar bwa lɔ nɛra fi dɛ batoro.

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: Ba bɔne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa la kuore ta. Ba dɔ ba nomonome baa nyiŋi ba nɛɛ toma baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba ta bela, ɡɛ ba lolanar baa tɔ sie faa ɛa la.

english_verse: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
translation_verse: Doonyoa bɛlbwa ta la, ba bil daa lolanar bɛlbwa bini, le bechale nɛɛ ba nomonome nɛ, dɛ jemɛ onɔ la waa nyiŋi o ta.

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Wee leebɔr doonyoa la lawɛ Sɛlɛmia, asɛ o bibaa Sekaria waa dɛ ja nɛra la, weekaŋle nyundua doonyoa lawɛ o ɡe.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: Weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa kon lawɛ Ɔbɛd Edom, asɛ dea baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa o bini kon lawɛ o bibaala ɡe.

english_verse: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:
translation_verse: Wee cholibɔr doonyoa kon, ne Saleket Doonyoa waa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ dea la nyunduabɔr la ɡe lawɛ Supim ne Hosa. Ba bɔne tɔpera tɛ bɛlbwa ba la kaa daahna.

english_verse: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms,
translation_verse: Tɔpebeŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa, Lewi dea nɛra banumɛl lɔ wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, banaarɛ do o weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, banaarɛ do o weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ ba nɛra banɛnɛ ɡe pɛ dɛɛ so dea baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa o bini la doonyoa.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Wee cholibɔr dembaah la ta te, nɛra banaarɛ dɛ daah ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ bela, asɛ banɛ do dembaah bela tenten.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Gɛɛ ba bɔne Kora ne Merari naanar bini, dɛ kpɔ do ba nɔn ta ŋɔ baa daah doonyoa bela. Korowii Dea la tomare ane ɡe

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Ba bala Lewi dea tenaa chɔ laala aa lɔ Korowii Dea bela ne deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini, ne anɔ la baa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii la bwa nyoa.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: Ladan ɛ Gɛsɔn tena la bini bɛl, o naanar warɔ taeh. O bibaa Jehieli bibaala ne naanar ɡe jao.

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Ladan bibaala banɛ Sɛtam ne Joel, dɛ ba ɡee chɔ laala aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini la nyoa.

english_verse: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Amram naanar, ne Isiha naanar, ne Hɛbrɔn naanar dɛ Usiel naanar dɔ toma baa kpɔa do ba nɔn ta.

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: Subael waa ɛ Mosis bibaa Gɛɛsɔm naa laanee chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah laala la nyoa.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Dɛ Sɛlomet ne o lolanaree chɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, Kooro Devid aa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii nyoa, ne nomonnyuune baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo, dɛ laa tena nomonome bane baa kaa la nyoa.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ laala baa paa laa ta la ane ba tɛ, ba kpɔ ɛ Korowii Dea la toma.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa Samoɛl waa dɛ na chaahna ne Kes bibaa Sɔɔl, ne Nɛr bibaa Abna, dɛ Seruya bibaa Joab aa kpɔa tɛ Korowii ne laala aa jaa bwa, dɛ Sɛlomet ne o lolanaree dɛɛ nyiŋi a ta.

english_verse: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
translation_verse: Isiha naanar bini, Kenania ne o bibaalaa ba kpɔ toma aa wola Korowii Dea bela ta jae tɛ, dɛ ɛɛ ba nomonome baa bol nɛra ne ba bala baah ta wa Israel harɛ ta.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Dɛ Seruya bibaa Joab fe pa mun ŋɔ o kur ba kɛ o ta wone tonɛ. Anomanta, Korowii tɛr Israel tena deŋne nɛra kura nɔ wa, ba ta nɛra baa kur ba la nyoa baɡlɛ do Kooro Devid Waa Tɔne bini. Nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Kooro laala ta

english_verse: In the first month, Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel,
translation_verse: Korobiloɡle ta la, Sabdiel bibaa Jasobeam. Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.

english_verse: in the third month, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada the priest,
translation_verse: Korobitooro te ta, sɔfo Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya, dɛ o ɛ laa sitɔɔ, asɛ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ do o lɔɡa.

english_verse: who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and whose son Ammizabad was also an army commander;
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Bɛnaya nɔ ɛ banyoo tenten, dɛ fa chɔ banyoola fifraatoro bane nyoa. O bibaa sɔne Amisabad, dɛ onee chɔ o laa tena nɔ nyoa.

english_verse: in the fourth month, Asahel the brother of Joab, whose son Zebadiah took over command after him;
translation_verse: Korobinaarɛ ta, Joab nime Asahɛl, dɛ o bibaa sɔne Sebadia dɛ ba chiɡ o naa ta. Ba ɡe lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.

english_verse: in the fifth month, Shamhuth from the Izrah clan;
translation_verse: Korobinue ta, Samhut waa le Isra. Dɛ onee ba sitɔɔ, ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.

english_verse: in the sixth month, Ira the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa;
translation_verse: Korobinumɛl ta, Ikes waa le Tekoa bibaa Ira. O laa tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.

english_verse: in the seventh month, Helez from Pelon in the territory of Ephraim;
translation_verse: Korobinuanɛ ta, ba sitɔɔ Hɛlɛs, Pɛlɔn te, waa le Efrem dea la, dɛ o dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.

english_verse: in the eighth month, Sibbecai from Hushah of the Zerah clan;
translation_verse: Korobinuatoro ta, ba sitɔɔ Sibekai, waa le Husa, dɛ le Sɛra dea la, dɛ o dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.

english_verse: in the ninth month, Abiezer from Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin;
translation_verse: Korobinuanaarɛ ta, sitɔɔ la sɔne Abeɛsa waa le Anatɔt, dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea. Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.

english_verse: in the tenth month, Maharai from Netophah of the Zerah clan;
translation_verse: Korobie fi ta, sitɔɔ la sɔne Maharai waa le Nɛtɔfa, dɛ le Sɛra dea. Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.

english_verse: in the eleventh month, Benaiah from Pirathon in the territory of Ephraim;
translation_verse: Korobie fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta, sitɔɔ la sɔne Bɛnaya waa le Peratɔn, dɛ le Efrem dea. Ba laa tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.

english_verse: in the twelfth month, Heldai from Netophah, who was a descendant of Othniel. David Assigns Tribal Leaders
translation_verse: Korobie fi dɛ anɛ ta, sitɔɔ la sɔne Hɛldai waa le Nɛtɔfa, o ɛ Otniel naa. Ba ɡe lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ. Nomonome baa chɔ deene nyoo

english_verse: When David decided to count the people of Israel, he gave orders not to count anyone under
translation_verse: Kooro Devid ta baala baa wola bene fifraanɛ tele la kure, dɛkalkɛ Korowii baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela ken.

english_verse: Azmaveth the son of Adiel was in charge of the king's personal storage rooms. Jonathan the son of Uzziah was in charge of the king's other storerooms that were in the towns, the villages, and the defense towers in Israel.
translation_verse: Adeɛl bibaa Asmavɛt, dɛ onee dɛɛ nyiŋi koodem deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini bwa ta. Ussia bibaa Jonatan ɡe ɛɛ nyiŋi deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini, bwɛjeɡre ne bwɛjena dɛ jɛŋle ta.

english_verse: Ezri the son of Chelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the king's land.
translation_verse: Kelub bibaa Esri chɔ nɛra baa dɛ parɛ kooni nyoa.

english_verse: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards, and Zabdi from Shepham was in charge of storing the wine.
translation_verse: Simee waa le Rama laanee dɛɛ nyiŋi daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ kooni ta. Sabdi waa le Sɛfam ɡe ɛɛ nyiŋi daa nɔna baa chaara, dɛ́ kpɔ kaa bela baa harama ta.

english_verse: Baal Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the western foothills, and Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.
translation_verse: Baal Hanan waa le Gɛda, ɡe chɔ ɔleve daa ne fiɡ daa aa lɔ wee cholibɔr deŋɡarere harɛ ta nyoa. Asɛ Joas ɡe chɔ ɔleve noo nyoa.

english_verse: Shitrai from Sharon was responsible for the cattle that were kept in Sharon Plain, and Shaphat son of Adlai was responsible for those kept in the valleys.
translation_verse: Sitrai waa le Sarɔn, ɡee chɔ kooro nae nɛra aa kpɔa dɛɛ la a ne dibɔra Sarɔn nyoa. Asɛ Adlai bibaa Safat ɡe chɔ kooro nae baa kpɔa dɛɛ la dibɔra fɛlembɔjena bini nyoa.

english_verse: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys, and Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Obil waa le Ismael dea, ɡe chɔ nyoɡmare nyoa. Jedeya waa le Mɛrɔnɔt ɡe chɔ keeɡore nyoa.

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Jonatan waa ɛ Kooro Devid mɛɛ nime la ɛ nɛn waa dɛ ja nɛra. O dɔ wejema dɛ jemɛ tɔn ɡe. O ne Hakmoni bibaa Jehiel ɡee dɛɛ nyiŋi kooro bibaala nɛ.

english_verse: Ahithophel and Hushai the Archite were two of David's advisors.
translation_verse: Dɛ Ahetofɛl ɡee dɛɛ ja kooro dɛɛ tɛo liire. Husai waa ɛ Aaki te ɛ kooro dam.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Ahetofɛl aa baa sewɛ la, Bɛnaya bibaa Jehoiada ne Abiata baa chiɡ o naa ta, asɛ Joab ɛ kooro laa tena sitɔɔ.

english_verse: David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid yerɛ Israel nomonome la bwa cheme Jerusalam. Nomonome baa chɔ Israel deene nyoo ne nomonome baa chɔ kooro tomare nyoo, ne sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo, ne nomonome baa chɔ kooro bibaala ne o laala ne kondɛɛre nyoo, ne koodem nomonome dɛ banyoola bwa.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Devid ir che dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé no n be, bwɛɛla. N liiro ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ń do dea dɛ́ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ o bini, ó ɛ Korowii natiɡribɔr. Asɛ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ baa mao.

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ n laa dɛ́ do Dea tɛo, n yo laa dɛ kpoo nɛra kohona.

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ le n ne n naanar kɛ, yá ɛ Israel harɛ koranar saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. O le nomoa le Juda dea tena bini, dɛ le nomoa le n mɛɛ wa luɡe waa le Juda. N mɛɛ bibaala bwa bini ɡe menee o bambile lawɛ, dɛ cheɡ mɛ kora Israel harɛ bwa.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii tɛ mɛ bibaala warɛ taeh, o le Solomɔn ba bini ŋɔ ó so Israel kora waa ɛ Korowii kon ta.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: O berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘He bie Solomɔn, onee dɛ́ do n Dea ne a dembaahna bwa tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ n leo dɛ kpɔɔ ɛ n bie, o ɡe kpɔ mɛ ɛ o mɛɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dɛ ŋɔ he be Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ne o nɛra Israel tena bwa siwi ta kɛŋɔ, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ nɔ mmarare ne waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa bwa ta, ásɛ dɛ won dɔ harɛdɛɛɡe nɔ, hale he naanar bwa ɡe bá dɔ ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid berɔ ŋɔ, “N bie Solomɔn, kpɔ he te do Korowii he naawa aa dɛ tomɔ la lɔɡa, dɛ́ tomɔ he bambile ne liire bwa ne. Korowii dɛ nyiŋi bambile bini dɛ jemɛ liire bɛlbwa. He kpɔ he te tɛo waa, hɛɛ nao, kɛ dɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpoo tenaa, o ɡe ɛɛ vɛɛh saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee Korowii le ŋɔ he do o Dea tɛo. Gel he siwi beɡre dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ waa doe la bwa.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Devid kpɔ ɡɛ baa ma dea la pato ne o bini deene, ne deene baa cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bini, ne nyundua deene ne o bini deene, dɛ bela baa kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa la Korowii be kaa soŋe, ó kpɔ kɛ ba tɛo.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: O kpɔ ɡɛ dea la mar aa dɛ ba doe tɛo ɡɛ Korowii Doma la aa kpɔa do o liire bini. O dembaahna ne deene aa baro baa kpɔ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, ne koŋkɛɛla baa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii dɛɛ cheɡ a bini bwa.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: O baɡ ba ɡɛ baa le sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa ba ɛ toma Dea la bini bwa, dɛɛ nyiŋi loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma o bini bwa ɡe ta.

english_verse: He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects,
translation_verse: O baɡle ɡɛ baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔ kwaa loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ tomare Dea la bini.

english_verse: David then said to Solomon: The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “Anɔ bwa, Korowiirii tɛ mɛ ɡɛ o Dea la mar aa doa wejema, n won no a mun, dɛ chwera bil.”

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid berɔ ŋɔ o bie Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Dɔ bambile dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ ɛ toma la. Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ la ja he nɛ. Waa he habɔɔ le bwa ka tel kɛŋɔ Dea la toma bɛlbwa aa tona.

english_verse: The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_verse: Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la baa kpɔ tomare do ba nɔɔra ta dɛ kpa, dɛ́ ɛ toma Korowii Dea bela. Nomɛlbwa ɡe aa le o bambile ta o dɔ wejema bwa soo siwi toma ɛɛ ta la ɛɛ bao, dɛ́ ba chae toma la ta. Nomonome la ne nɛra la bwa ɛɛ no wobɛlbwa haa bol ba be laanee.”

english_verse: That's why I have done my best to get everything Solomon will need to build it—gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, onyx, turquoise, colored gems, all kinds of precious stones, and marble.
translation_verse: N takapɔ nyin laala baa kpɔ do Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ Dea la. N dɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne ayaawa ne bune ne daa, ne bwedɛɛɡa ane a yoɡ aa kpeɡa baa yera onis ne tɛɛkoes, dɛ bwea bwa soo siwi, a warɔ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: ne anɔ la aa jaa bwa nɛra baa dɔ a wejema aa kpɔ ɛ toma bwa. Umee dɛɛ nyin ó le o bambile bini, dɛ́ tɛ kwaa bá kpɔ ɛ Korowii toma fini nɔ?”

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa la kpɔa ba tɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea laala ta baa yerɔ Jehiel waa le Gɛsɔn dea.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Nɛra la bwa sie lɛ ɡɛ ba nomonome la aa le ba bambile ta dɛ tɛ kwaa la, Kooro Devid ɡe sie lɛo kɛrɛdɛ. Kooro Devid Korowii kpɛɛra

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid kpɛɛ Korowii nɛra la bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii ya naa Jekɔb aa tomɛ, henee chɛ kɛ ya kpɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: Henee kana dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ dɔ jirima dɛ dɔ sɔn kohona, dɛkalkɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa ɛ he kwa. Henee dɛɛ di kora, dɛ ɡwaa nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: and you rule with strength and power. You make people rich and powerful and famous.
translation_verse: Kondɔɔh ne jirima bwa le he be, dɛɛ di kpeɡri komɛlbwa nɛ. He bee kpeɡri ne bokpeɡa le, he ɡɔɔ nɛra dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri.

english_verse: We thank you, our God, and praise you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, ya dɛ jaame, dɛɛ kpɛɛ he sɔnjen la.

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: Menee ume, n ne n nɛra nɔ bwa, kɛŋɔ ya ɡe won dɔ kwaa nɔ bwa dɔŋa ŋɔ ya kpɔɔ dɛɛ kɛɛ nɔ? Anɔ bwa yaa dɔa le he be laanee ya berɛ kpɔ baa tɛɛ la.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: Ya ɛ hɔɔhra he sie kɛŋɔ ya naawa bwa fa aa ɛa la. Ya tɔpera yaa di harɛ nɔ ta do kɛŋɔ lileo, tamaa ken dɛ o kaalɔ la ken. Ya ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la waa ya kpɔ kondamanta nɔ bwa tɛ ŋɔ bá kpɔ do he Dea, he bee a bwa le, henee dɔ a bwa.

english_verse: But we are happy, because everyone has voluntarily given you these things. You know what is in everyone's heart, and you are pleased when people are honest.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ bambile binii hɛɛ nyiŋi, he sie ɛɛ lɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ta. Anɔ bwa, n ta n bambile dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ. N berɔ na silɛɛ he nɛra baa lɔ bonɔ ɡe aa dɔa, dɛ le ba bambile ta, dɛ kpɔ kwaa ba tɛɛ.

english_verse: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ya naa Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɛ, ɡel ɡɛ nyina nɔ do he nɛra bambile ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, asɛ ba waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ he ɡbo.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
translation_verse: Gel n bie Solomɔn kpɔ o bambile bwa dɛɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa haa doo ta, ó won ma Korowii Dea maa kpɔ o laala tɛo nɔ.”

english_verse: David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king. Solomon Is Crowned King
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ nɛra la bwa be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ.” Anomanta, ba kpɛɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ, dɛ chole kpɔ sie pi harɛ Korowii ne kooro sie.

english_verse: The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar. That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. The people celebrated and poured olive oil on Solomon's head to show that he would be their next king. They also poured oil on Zadok's head to show that he was their priest.
translation_verse: Ba di saraha kwaa la, dɛ nyɔ sen lɛ ba sie kohona Korowii sie awola. Belaa ba lɛ Solomɔn waa ɛ Kooro Devid bibaa do nɛɛtena kɛŋɔ kooro, dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta Korowii sie, dɛ cheɡo kora ta, dɛ fuɡe noo do Sadɔk nyu ta o ɡe ɛ sɔfo.

english_verse: So Solomon became king after David his father. Solomon was successful, and everyone in Israel obeyed him.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn ba so kora Korowii aa cheɡo ta, o chiɡ o mɛɛ Kooro Devid naa ta. O wobɛlbwa wer tɛo, Israel tena bwa kpɔ duure tɛo.

english_verse: Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him.
translation_verse: Nomonome la bwa ne banyoola, dɛ Kooro Devid bibaala bwa sɛoh, dɛ kpɔ ba te do Kooro Solomɔn lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon. David Dies
translation_verse: Korowii ɡɔɔ Kooro Solomɔn Israel tena bwa sie, dɛ tɛo jirima kohona Israel harɛ ta kooro bɛlbwa aa wola a dɔŋ dɔe. Kooro Devid seo wa

english_verse: David the son of Jesse was king of Israel
translation_verse: Jese bibaa Devid di kora Israel harɛ ta bwa.

english_verse: David was rich and respected and lived to be an old man. Then he died, and his son Solomon became king.
translation_verse: O biɡro kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ ba sewɛ, dɛ o dɔ kondɔɔh ne jirima kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ o bibaa Solomɔn chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

english_verse: Everything David did while he was king is included in the history written by the prophets Samuel, Nathan, and Gad.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Kooro Devid kora dii le mumpar dɛ ba a jaɡa, do Korowii keamere Samoɛl ne Netan dɛ Gad waa tɔne bini,

english_verse: They wrote about his powerful rule and about the things that happened not only to him, but also to Israel and the other nations.
translation_verse: ne ɡɛ waa di kora dɛ di kpeɡri, dɛ waa bwa aa chiɡa o bere saŋ, dɛ Israel harɛ ta waa ne harɛre ane ɡe ta waa bwa.

english_verse: While Solomon was king of Israel, there was silver and gold everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.
translation_verse: O bere saŋ dɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ta nyae Jerusalam kɛŋɔ bwea aa wola nyae nɔ. Peleme daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ do deene ɡe bu kɛŋɔ, pure daa aa cheɡɛ Juda harɛ deŋɡarere lɔɡre ken.

english_verse: and there at the bronze altar, Solomon offered a thousand animals as sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn laŋɔ ka kpo nae ne peera baa wola won kura saraha kon la ta Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la sie, dɛ fuah tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: God appeared to Solomon that night in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Waa lɔ Gebeɔn bela la, Korowii ba o be jwaana deera ta, dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baɡle komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin ásɛ n kpɔ tɛɛ.”

english_verse: Solomon answered: Lord God, you were always loyal to my father David, and now you have made me king of Israel.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “He nyin n mɛɛ Kooro Devid waa kohona, dɛ ɡel n ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛɛ di kora fini nɔ.

english_verse: I am supposed to rule these people, but there are as many of them as there are specks of dust on the ground. So keep the promise you made to my father
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, ɡel nyoa haa baɡɛ n mɛɛ la che. He ɡelɔ mɛɛ di kora nɛra baa wara baa wola won kur ba nɛ.

english_verse: God replied: Solomon, you could have asked me to make you rich or famous or to let you live a long time. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge to rule my people.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Haa lii wedɛɛɡa aa do ken, he ta kondɛɛɡa kɛɛ kondɔɔh kɛɛ waa aa ɡel he dɔ sɔn, kɛɛ he dɔma fe serewe, hale he ta he mkpa dɔe waa soŋɛ, dɛ soŋe wejema ne waa mun noe dɛ́ won nyiŋi n nɛra maa ɡela hɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ nɔ nomanta,

english_verse: Solomon then left Gibeon and returned to Jerusalem, the capital city of Israel. Solomon's Wealth (
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Solomɔn le Gebeɔn, Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela baa dɛ tomɛ la, dɛ ba Jerusalam. Belaa o ba so dɛ di Israel harɛ ta kora.

english_verse: Solomon decided to build a temple where the Lord would be worshiped, and also to build a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn ɛ o liire kɛŋɔ wɛɛ do Dea tɛ Korowii baa tomɔ o bini Jerusalam, dɛ́ berɛ do o ɡbaɡba koodem.

english_verse: This will be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods.
translation_verse: Korowii Dea maa dɛ ba doe nɔ kan, dɛkalkɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la kan ɡwaa voɡare bwa.

english_verse: Praise the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth! He has given David a son who isn't only wise and smart, but who has the knowledge to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Yá kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, o ta nyundua ne harɛ. O tɛ Kooro Devid bibaa waa dɔ wejema, dɛ dɔ waa mun noe kohona, dɛɛ ba Dea doe tɛ Korowii dɛ́ berɛ do o koodem.

english_verse: I am building a temple where the Lord my God will be worshiped. Sweet-smelling incense will be burned there, and sacred bread will be offered to him. Worshipers will offer sacrifices to the Lord every morning and evening, every Sabbath, and on the first day of each month, as well as during all our religious festivals. These things will be done for all time, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba Dea doe tɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ, ásɛ baa tomɔ o bini. Wɛɛ do ɡoroŋee, ásɛ n ne n nɛra fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tomɔ bela, dɛ́ kpɔ paanoo baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii o do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ ba o sie tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra, ne Ona Tɔpera ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, dɛ tɔpejena ane Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa lea cheɡ. Gɛ waa nɔ chɔ le tɛ Israel tena saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: No one can ever build a temple large enough for God—even the heavens are too small a place for him to live in! All I can do is build a place where we can offer sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won do Dea tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ nyundua ɡba aa kanɛ tɛo ó so bela. N ɡee ume, n ŋɔ ń do Dea tɛo ó ba so o bini nɔ? Atane bɔr baa fuh saraha kwaa dɛɛ tɛo o sie ɡbo.

english_verse: Send me a worker who can not only carve, but who can work with gold, silver, bronze, and iron, as well as make brightly colored cloth. The person you send will work here in Judah and Jerusalem with the skilled workers that my father has already hired.
translation_verse: Anomanta, tɛ mɛ nɛn waa dɔ wejema, dɛ́ won di ɡwine dawɛ suuɡaswɛm kɛɛ suuɡapoŋ kɛɛ ayaawa dɛ bune ta, dɛ́ berɛ won kpɔ jiseburum ne jisekɔl, dɛ onswɛm sɔh yal. Wɛɛ ba ja Juda ne Jerusalam nɛra baa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema n mɛɛ Kooro Devid lee ba la nɛɛ baa ɛ toma.

english_verse: I know that you have workers who are experts at cutting lumber in Lebanon. So would you please send me some cedar, pine, and juniper logs? My workers will be there to help them,
translation_verse: N ɡbabir jemɛ ɡɛ he tom-ɛɛra aa dɔ daa teŋna wejema, anomanta, tɛ mɛ peleme daa ne dadɛɛɡa ane soo siwi aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ. N nɛra ɛɛ ba ja ba nɛɛ,

english_verse: because I'll need a lot of lumber to build such a large and glorious temple.
translation_verse: bá nyin daa a warɛ ba tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Dea maa dɛ ba doe la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do kan dɛ́ do wer kohona.

english_verse: Hiram sent his answer back to Solomon: I know that the Lord must love his people, because he has chosen you to be their king.
translation_verse: Asɛ bwɛjen Taaya Kooro Hiram chwerɛ tɔn ba tɛ Kooro Solomɔn ŋɔ, “Korowii aa dɛ nyin o nɛra la waa o cheɡe ŋɔ he ɛ ba kooro.”

english_verse: I am sending Huram Abi to you. He is wise and very skillful.
translation_verse: N berɔ dɛɛ tomɛ nɛn waa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema kɛrɛdɛ, baa yerɔ Hiram Abi he be.

english_verse: His mother was from the Israelite tribe of Dan, and his father was from Tyre. Not only is Huram an expert at working with gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, but he can also make colored cloth and fine linen. And he can carve anything if you give him a pattern to follow. He can help your workers and those hired by your father King David.
translation_verse: O nya le Dan dea, asɛ o mɛɛ le Taaya. O dɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋ ne ayaawa dɛ bune ne bwea, dɛ daa kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema. Dɛ jemɛ jisekɔl ne jiseburum, ne onswɛm ne ompoŋ bwa kpɔe sɔh yapondɛɛɡe. Wɛɛ di ɡwine bɛlbwa baa baɡlo dawɛ kon ta. Gel o ba ja he nɛra baa dɔ kwaa ɛɛ wejema, ne he mɛɛ Kooro Devid nɛra baa dɔ kwaa ɛɛ wejema la nɛ.

english_verse: Go ahead and send the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine you promised to pay my workers.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡel mea ne ane soo siwi ne ɔleve noo dɛ sen haa baɡɛ nyoa la tel he bonɔɔ be.

english_verse: I will tell them to start cutting down trees in Lebanon. They will cut as many as you need, then tie them together into rafts, and float them down along the coast to Joppa. Your workers can take them to Jerusalem from there. Solomon's Work Force
translation_verse: Ásɛ ya teŋe daa haa dɛ nyin la bwa le Lɛbanɔn dɛ́ vɔrɔwa, ásɛ dɛ taɡa kpɔ mpo sie ba tɛɛ Jopa waa lɔ mpo nyoa, he ba kpɔ kaa Jerusalam.” Korowii Dea mae mumpar

english_verse: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were living in Israel, just as his father David had done when he was king, and the total was
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Solomɔn ɡel ba kure hɔɔhra baa soɡe Israel harɛ ta bwa, ɡɛ tenten o mɛɛ Kooro Devid fa aa kure nɛra la. Ba lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanue dɛ batoro lafraanumɛl.

english_verse: He used precious stones to decorate the temple, and he used gold imported from Parvaim
translation_verse: Dɛ kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ɛ Korowii Dea la bwa o do wer. Suuɡaswɛm waa yawa la le Paavaem harɛ ta.
