english_verse: And since Jeroboam and the kings of Israel that followed him would not allow any Levites to serve as priests, most Levites left their towns and pasturelands in Israel and moved to Jerusalem and other towns in Judah.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena la ɡel harɛre aa ɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra dɛ ir ka so Juda ne Jerusalam, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ne o bibaala ta sɛɛh kɛŋɔ bá ɛ Korowii sɔfore.

english_verse: Jeroboam chose his own priests to serve at the local shrines in Israel and at the places of worship where he had set up statues of goat-demons and of calves.
translation_verse: Kooro Jɛroboam le o ɡbaɡba kerekpoŋra ba so voɡa ta, dɛɛ tomɛ daabii ne nabali, dɛ voɡa waa sɛah la.

english_verse: But some of the people from Israel wanted to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done. So they followed the priests and Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa le Israel deene bwa bini dɛ le ba bambile bini ŋɔ, baa tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la teŋɛ Lewi dea tena nɛɛ ba Jerusalam, dɛ ba kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii ba naawa aa toma.

english_verse: For the next three years, they lived in Judah and were loyal to Rehoboam and his kingdom, just as they had been loyal to David and Solomon. Rehoboam's Family
translation_verse: Ba cheɡɛ o habɔɔ dɛ ɡel Juda kora la che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ cha Kooro Solomɔn bibaa Kooro Rɛhoboam bene atoro, ɡɛ baa ɛa Kooro Devid ne Kooro Solomɔn saŋ la. Kooro Rɛhoboam haahna ne bii

english_verse: Rehoboam and Mahalath had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
translation_verse: Bibaala batoroo ba lolɛ. Banee Jeyus ne Sɛmaria dɛ Saham.

english_verse: Then Rehoboam married Maacah the daughter of Absalom. Their sons were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam berɔ mo Absalɔm bihaah Maaka. Asɛ o lolɛ bibaala, Abija ne Atai ne Sesa dɛ Sɛlomet.

english_verse: so he chose their oldest son Abijah to be the next king.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔ o ne o haah Maaka bibaa Abija ɛ o bibaala la bwa nomoa, dɛɛ nyin ó cheɡo kora ta.

english_verse: Rehoboam was wise enough to put one of his sons in charge of each fortified city in his kingdom. He gave them all the supplies they needed and found wives for every one of them.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam ɛ wejemwa, dɛ kpɔ o bibaala la bɛlbwa ka so Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛre bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara la ta. O ta tea, dɛ tɛɛ ba ba konnyina kohona, dɛ mo haahna ɡe tɛɛ ba warɛ.

english_verse: but he still did wrong and refused to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta o bambile bwa kpɔe tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: So in the fifth year of Rehoboam's rule, the Lord punished them for their unfaithfulness and allowed King Shishak of Egypt to invade Judah.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam aa di kora bene anue ta la, Ijipt harɛ Kooro Sisak baa yo Jerusalam tena, ba deŋnekpeɡ baa ɛa dɛ vɛh Korowii la wa.

english_verse: He captured every one of the fortified cities in Judah and then marched to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba yoo lɛ Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, hale dɛ ba tel Jerusalam.

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah had gone to Jerusalem to escape Shishak's invasion. And while they were there, Shemaiah the prophet told them, “The Lord says that because you have disobeyed him, he has now abandoned you. The Lord will not help you against Shishak!”
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii keame Sɛmaya ba Kooro Rɛhoboam ne Juda nomonome baa kaa cheme Jerusalam la be, Kooro Sisak ɔma wa. Asɛ Korowii keame Sɛmaya ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘He vɛɛh mɛ, anomanta, taraken n ɡe vɛh heyaa tɛ Kooro Sisak.’ ”

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, “The Lord is right. We have deserted him.”
translation_verse: Ate, kooro ne Israel nomonome sɛh kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii waa waa ɛa wer.”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry,
translation_verse: Korowii aa na ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la, o ŋɔ o keame Sɛmaya be ja ŋɔ, “Ba sɛh ba chɔɡre nomanta, maa ban chɔɡ kpa. Kɛ dɛ Kooro Sisak baa yoo ba aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo ba le a nyoa. Maa ɡel a che Kooro Sisak nɛɛ Jerusalam tena nyɔ n danana ne.

english_verse: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.
translation_verse: Kooro Sisak ɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ bá do o lɔɡa, ásɛ ba na ɡɛ n toma aa korɛ harɛre koranar toma ta.”

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔ ayaawa ɛ ane chiɡ suuɡaswɛm kwaa la naa ta, dɛ kpɔ do nɛra baa dɛ so koodem la doonyoa dɛɛ daah bela la nomonome nɔn ta, ŋɔ báa nyiŋi a ta.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa kooro aa la Korowii Dea la, nɛra baa dɛ daah bela yon kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta la kpoŋe, ásɛ a habɔɔ ba yon kpɔ ka cheɡ dea baa dɛ cheɡa o bini la ta.

english_verse: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord, and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again. Rehoboam's Rule in Judah (
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam aa pwɛr o te tɛ Korowii nomanta, Korowii bandia le o nɛ, o ta on chɔɡɛ kwaraa kpa. Kasinteŋ, dɛ wobɛlbwa pa mun dɛɛ do wer Juda harɛ ta tama tama.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam kora dii le mumpar ba a jaɡa, ne o haahna ne bii wa, ba chwera do Korowii keamere Sɛmaya ne Ido waa dɛ na chaahna waa tɔne bini. Dɛ yoi chɔ Kooro Rɛhoboam ne Kooro Jɛroboam baah ta saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: When Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Abijah became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Rɛhoboam sewɔ, asɛ ba huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Asɛ o bibaa Abija chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora.

english_verse: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Kooro Jɛroboam aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa Abija di kora Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.
translation_verse: asɛ Juda laa tena la do laa lɔŋɔ, asɛ Kooro Abija tɔ ba sie ba ka yoo ba. Korowii ɡelɔ ba pɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ne Israel tena nɛ.

english_verse: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.
translation_verse: Taraken he dɛ nyin kɛ he yo Korowii Kora waa kpɔa do Kooro Devid naanar nɔn ta la. He laa tena warɔ dɛ berɛ dɔ nabali Kooro Jɛroboam aa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, a ɛ voɡa haa dɛ toma.

english_verse: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.
translation_verse: Kooro Abija di kora Jerusalam bene atoro. Uriel waa le bwɛjen Gebea bihaah Maaka biee Kooro Abija. Aa ba dɛ la sie la, laa chole Kooro Jɛroboam ne Kooro Abija baah.

english_verse: Abijah went to the top of Mount Zemaraim in the hills of Ephraim and shouted: Listen, Jeroboam and all you Israelites!
translation_verse: Kooro Abija ne o laa tena la kaa che Semaraem Bwejen waa lɔ Efrem deŋɡare harɛ ta dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Kooro Jɛroboam ne Israel tena, hé no n be!

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la cheɡɛ fɔo waa chɔ le waa wola chɔɡ ta dɛ kpɔ Israel kora tɛ Kooro Devid ne o naanar saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛɛ?

english_verse: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, nɛnsale bane boa ba nyoa, dɛ ba ja o nɛ, dɛ vuuɡi Kooro Rɛhoboam, ɡɛ saŋ dɛ o nɔn ta kao waa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ, dɛ puu ba yo.

english_verse: You don't even have descendants of Aaron on your side, because you forced out the Lord's priests and Levites. In their place, you appoint ordinary people to be priests, just as the foreign nations do. In fact, anyone who brings a bull and seven rams to the altar can become a priest of your so-called gods.
translation_verse: He laa doŋi Korowii sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ berɛ le nɛra bane so ba buɡ ta, ɡɛ harɛre ane nɛra aa ɛa la aa? Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ won kpɔ nabale kɛɛ peera anuanɛ ba ŋɔ bá sɔ o doŋa ta, dɛ́ ɛo kerekpoŋri kwaa haa dɛ yera he voɡa la ta.

english_verse: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.
translation_verse: Ya te, Korowiirii yaa tomɛ, ya ta on vɛɛh. Arɔn naanar ɛ sɔfore dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma, asɛ Lewi dea tena ɡe ɛɛ cha ba.

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: Chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra bwaa ba kpɔ saraha kwaa ba baa fuh, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛ Korowii. Ba kpɔ paanoo dɛɛ dawɛ teebur waa do ɡoroŋ doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta, dɛ choŋi kandere aa lɔ kandea daa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛo jɔmɔra bɛlbwa. Ya dɛ ɛ waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la aa do yaa, kɛ he te vɛoh.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Korowii ja ya nɛ, onee ya sitɔɔ. O sɔfore ɛɛ hoh laa bɛlee yerɛ yaa yá ba yo heya. Israel tena, he bɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ yo, haa won pɔ o nɛ.”

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Jɛroboam ɡelɔ o laa tena la bane bar Juda laa tena la dɛ do habɔɔ, asɛ ba bini bane ɡe do ba sie.

english_verse: Judah's army won because they had trusted the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Juda tena pɔ Israel tena nɛ, dɛ sɔɔh ba nyoa, dɛkalkɛ ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Kooro Abija ti Kooro Jɛroboam laa tena, dɛ ka lɛ ba bwɛjena Bɛtel ne Jesana dɛ Efron, ne a bwɛjeɡre aa bara cheme bwa.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Kooro Jɛroboam ta berɛ dɔ kpeɡri Kooro Abija bere saŋ kpa. Korowii tɛr o deŋne asɛ o sewɛ.

english_verse: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.
translation_verse: Waane ɡe Kooro Abija aa ɛa dɛ bol o kora dii ta la, ba chwera do Korowii keame Ido bwara waa tɔn bini.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.
translation_verse: Kooro Asa ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre, Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la be.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: O le harɛre ane kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta, ne bela baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa deŋɡarere ta bwa ne. O paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ teŋe voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa ta.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: O do Juda tena bwa ŋɔ, baa ɛ waa Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la aa dɛ nyin, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne o webaɡla ta.

english_verse: The Lord blessed Judah with peace while Asa was king, and so during that time, Asa fortified many of the towns.
translation_verse: O bere saŋ, o ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar Juda harɛ bwɛjena, dɛ laa toole harɛ la ta kpa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii tɛo deŋnesɔɔhna.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: Kooro Asa ŋɔ Juda tena be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar bwɛjena nɔ, dɛ́ ma dejaŋa dɛ́ do bune a nyoo, dɛɛ kaɡra bune ne. Harɛ la ɛ ya kon. Yaa ɛ waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ nyin la waa o ɡel ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna la.” Anomanta, ba ɛ ɡɛ asɛ a do wer tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Asa met him there, and the two armies prepared for battle in Zephathah Valley.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Asa le, dɛ ka puu yo, bɛlbwa ne o laa tena cheɡɛ ba chebɔra Sɛfata Fɛlembɔjen bini, o bɛne Maresa.

english_verse: Asa prayed: Lord God, only you can help a powerless army defeat a stronger one. So we depend on you to help us. We will fight against this powerful army to honor your name, and we know that you won't be defeated. You are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Asa yerɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won cha nɛra baa wola kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe, bá won ka yo nɛra baa kpeɡa kɛ hen. N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, cha yaa, he nɛɛ ya kpɔ ya te dawɛ. He sɔn taa ya ba, dɛɛ ba ba yo laa tena baa wara nɔ la. Bɛ ɡel nɛwɛnyini pɔ he nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Korowii cha Kooro Asa ne Juda laa tena, asɛ ba pɔ Itiopia tena la nɛ. Ba chwao,

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: asɛ Kooro Asa ne o laa tena ti ba ka tel Gerar. Korowii ɡelɔ ba kpoo Itiopia laa tena la warɛ, ba kar ta wone yo kpa, asɛ ba pa ba laala.

english_verse: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord. So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.
translation_verse: Ate, ba chɔɡ bwɛjeɡre aa bar Gerar la bwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɡelɔ ɔmee kohona chole ba nɛ. Ba jo bwɛjeɡre la ta dɛ pa ba laala, dɛkalkɛ dɛ laala lɔ bela kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba kaa yo nɛra bane ɡe baa dɛ nyiŋi boohna ne peera nɛ, bela baa soɡa, dɛ larawe boohna ne peera, dɛ nyoɡmare kohona dɛ laa berɛ ba Jerusalam.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Korowii Doma baa so Ɔdɛd bibaa Asaria nɛ,

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: asɛ o le ka cheme Kooro Asa, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa Kooro Asa ne Juda dɛ Bɛnjamen deene nɛra bwa, hé no n be. Dɛ Korowii waa lɔ he bambile ta naa, wɛɛ ja he nɛɛ. He dɛ nyin o bɔr aa, wɛɛ ɡeloo he nao, kɛ dɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpoo waa, o ɡe ɛɛ vɛh heyaa.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Israel tena soɡo la sie baa wola kasinteŋ Korowii tomɛ. Ba ta sɔfore dɔe bá baɡ ba wa, baa Korowii Mmara ɡe jemɛ.

english_verse: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Kɛ wenaale aa ba ba nɛɛ la, ba ɡaaɡe Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la bɔr, asɛ o ɡel ba nao.

english_verse: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ a kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nɛn won dɛɛ ɡaaɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, dɛkalkɛ wenaale ne wesaɡasaɡare lɔ Israel harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra yon dɛɛ yo dɔŋa, bwɛjena ɡe ɛɛ yo dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowiirii kpɔ wenaale baa ta ba nɛ harɛre la ta.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Kooro Asa aa no Korowii waa Ɔdɛd bibaa Korowii keame Asaria aa bola la, a tɛo kpeɡri bɛl. O le voɡa aa ɛ kii kwaa la bwa ne, Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛre ta, ne anɔ la aa lɔ bwɛjena bwa waa yoa dɛ pɔ a nɛra nɛɛ Efrem deŋɡarere ta la. O berɔ kwaa kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta o do Korowii Dea pato sie la.

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Nɛra warɔ le Efrem ne Manasɛ ne Simeon deene ta dɛ ba ja Kooro Asa nɛ, dɛ so o harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ ba nao kɛŋɔ Korowii ja o nɛ. Kooro Asa yerɛ ba bwa, ne Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene nɛra cheme.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba cheme Jerusalam ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Asa aa di kora bene fi dɛ anue, korobie atoro ta.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: Juda tena la baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, baa tomɛ Korowii ba naawa fa aa tomɔ la ba bambile ne ba liire bwa nee.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.
translation_verse: Ba do lɔŋɔ kohona dɛ hoh bɛle, ne pee nyeɡle bɛle, dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡle Korowii ŋɔ, baa teŋɛ fɔo la taa.

english_verse: Everyone was happy because they had made this solemn promise, and in return, the Lord blessed them with peace from all their enemies.
translation_verse: Juda tena la bwa sie lɛo dɛɛ hɛɡre, dɛkalkɛ ba ŋwɛɛ ntam bambile bwa ne. Ba nyin Korowii sibeɡra ne, asɛ dɛ nao. Anomanta, Korowii tɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna le ba dɔma nɔn ta.

english_verse: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Kooro Asa ir o naa Maaka haŋkora ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɛ voɡ Asera daa aa ɛ kii kwaa la. Kooro Asa teŋni daa la, dɛ fuah Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ Kooro Asa ta bela voɡtoroma aa soɡa dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa bwa chɔɡɛ le Israel harɛ ta te, kɛ dɛ o bambile cheɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ o soɡa bini bwa.

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to God.
translation_verse: O kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne kwaa bwa o ne o mɛɛ aa dɔa, dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta la ba Korowii Dea.

english_verse: There was peace in Judah until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's rule.
translation_verse: Dɛ laa toole kpa, dɛ ka tel Kooro Asa kora dii bene fifraatoro dɛ anue ta.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Kooro Asa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm cheɡ deene baa kpɔ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛɛ cheɡ a bini Korowii Dea la, ne anɔ la aa lɔ o koodem bela, dɛ tomɛ ba kpɔ ka tɛ Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad, dɛ o soɡe Damaskɔs waa ɛ harɛ la bwɛjen tenten ta dɛɛ di kora.

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: Kooro Asa ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, ɡɛ ya naawa fa aa ɛa la. N kpɔ koŋkɛɛla aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, á ɛ fɔo dɛ́ chɔɡ he ne Israel Kooro Baasa fɔo la taraken, ásɛ o ne o laa tena le n harɛ nɔ ta kaa.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Kooro Bɛn Hadad no Kooro Asa be dɛ tomɛ o laa sitɔɔla ne ba laa tena ŋɔ, bá ka yo Israel harɛ bwɛɛre. Ba pɔ Ijon ne Dan dɛ Ebel Bɛt Maaka bwɛɛre, dɛ Naftale dea harɛ bwɛjena baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini bwa.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.
translation_verse: Kooro Baasa aa no ɡɛ la, o ɡel danjwɛɛ mae dɛ bar Rama toma la a ka.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Asa do Juda tena bwa ŋɔ bá la, dɛ́ ka che bwea ne daa Kooro Baasa aa kpɔa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ Rama la. Anee Kooro Asa kpɔ ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛjena Geba ne Mispa.

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii keame Hanani ba Kooro Asa be dɛ ŋɔ, “Haa kpɔ he te dawɛ Siiria kooro nɛɛ dɛ vɛh he te kpɔe dɛ dawɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɛɛ nomanta, Siiria kooro laa tena la le he habɔɔ.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Itiopia tena ne Lebya laa tena fa ta warɛ taeh dɛ dɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne nɛra baa dɛ so jaɡre ta naa? Kɛ haa kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ la, o ɡelɔ he pɔ ba nɛ aa?”

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.
translation_verse: Korowii sie lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa, wɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛo, dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri. He ɛ ɡɛnewa, le fini dɛɛ kaa, laa ɡboo hɛɛ ba dɛɛ yoi.

english_verse: When Asa heard this, he was so angry that he put Hanani in prison. Asa was also cruel to some of his people. Asa Dies (
translation_verse: Kooro Asa baah di Korowii keame Hanani nɛɛ kohona, asɛ dɛ lawɔ do dea. Dɛ berɛ le ɡɛ saŋ dɛɛ kaa la, Kooro Asa pa mun dɛɛ ɛ nɛra la bane hɔhɔrɔwa kohona. Kooro Asa kora dii jaɡa

english_verse: Everything Asa did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Kooro Asa aa di kora le mumpar kaa a jaɡa la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔn bini.

english_verse: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, he got a very bad foot disease, but he relied on doctors and refused to ask the Lord for help.
translation_verse: Kooro Asa aa di kora dɛ dɔ bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanaarɛ la, o we nakpaweela ane soo siwi. A lole kɛŋɔ weela la baa do kpeɡri, kɛ o ta Korowii soŋɛ ŋɔ ó chao, dɛ tɛɡre tena ɡbo bee wɛɛ la.

english_verse: Earlier, Asa had his own tomb cut out of a rock hill in Jerusalem. So he was buried there, and the tomb was filled with spices and sweet-smelling oils. Then the people built a bonfire in his honor.
translation_verse: asɛ ba huɡo Kooro Devid Bwɛjen Jerusalam, bwe bɛl waa komɔ kɛŋɔ dea o ɛ o ɡbaɡba huɡribɔr bini. Ba kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma ne nosɔɔhsoma fɔɡlo dɛ huɡo. Nɛra warɔ cheme dɛ mar nijena a fuh, a baɡle jirima baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛo o seo la wa.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king and strengthened his defenses against Israel.
translation_verse: Kooro Asa bibaa Jehosafat chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora. O nyiŋo dɛ ɡel o laa tena do kpeɡri Israel tena nɛ.

english_verse: He assigned troops to the fortified cities in Judah, as well as to other towns in Judah and to those towns in Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
translation_verse: O kpɔ laa tena ka so Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara bwa, ne bwɛɛre bwa ta, dɛ bwɛjena a fa aa lɔ Kooro Asa lɔɡa Efrem harɛ ta bwa.

english_verse: When Jehoshaphat's father had first become king of Judah, he was faithful to the Lord and refused to worship the god Baal as the kings of Israel did. Jehoshaphat followed his father's example and obeyed and worshiped the Lord. And so the Lord blessed Jehoshaphat
translation_verse: O tomɛ Korowii o mɛɛ aa toma la, dɛ teŋɛ waa waa doo ta. O ta waa Israel koranar aa ɛa ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: and helped him keep firm control of his kingdom. The people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, but even after he became very rich and respected,
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ o kora che kiŋkiŋ Juda harɛ, asɛ nɛra la bwa kpɔ koŋkɛɛla baa tɛo, a che a ta o dɔ kondɔɔh ne duure kohona.

english_verse: he remained completely faithful to the Lord. He destroyed all the local shrines in Judah, including the places where the goddess Asherah was worshiped.
translation_verse: O bambile lawɛ Korowii toma kohona, asɛ dɛ chɔɡ bɔra voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa ne voɡ Asera dajaŋa aa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: Their assistants were the following nine Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-Adonijah. Two priests, Elishama and Jehoram, also went along.
translation_verse: Dɛ Lewi dea tena banuanaarɛ ne sɔfore banɛ ja ba nɛ. Lewi dea tena laanee, Sɛmaya ne Nɛtanea ne Sebadia, ne Asahɛl ne Sɛmeramɔt ne Jehonatan, ne Adonija ne Tobija dɛ Tob Adonija. Asɛ sɔfore la ɡee, Elisama ne Jehoram.

english_verse: They carried with them a copy of the Lord's Law wherever they went and taught the people from it.
translation_verse: Ba iro kpɔ Korowii Mmara Tɔn la, dɛ ɡaaɡe Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta, dɛɛ baɡle o bini waa nɛra be.

english_verse: The nations around Judah were afraid of the Lord's power, so none of them attacked Jehoshaphat.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ ɔmee ta harɛre aa bar Juda la nɛ kɛŋɔ, bá la ka yo Kooro Jehosafat laa.

english_verse: Philistines brought him silver and other gifts to keep peace. Some of the Arab people brought him
translation_verse: Filisti tena bane kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa ne suuɡapoŋa ba kɛo, Arab tena ɡe ba tɛo peera kaɡboŋa anuanɛ lafraanuanɛ, dɛ boohna kaɡboŋa anuanɛ lafraanuanɛ.

english_verse: where he stored supplies. He also kept in Jerusalem some experienced soldiers
translation_verse: dɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta. O berɔ kpɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ ba so Jerusalam.

english_verse: from the Judah and Benjamin tribes. These soldiers were grouped according to their clans. Adnah was the commander of the troops from Judah, and he had
translation_verse: Gɛ baa chwerɛ ba sɔna lolanar bini laanee teŋa nɔ, Dɛ le Juda dea, laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa nyoo laanee nɔ. Adna waa ɛ laa sitɔɔ, on chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraatoro nyoa.

english_verse: Amasiah son of Zichri, who had volunteered to serve the Lord, was third in command, with
translation_verse: Toorotee Sikri bie Amasia, o ɡbabir le o te tɛ Korowii toma, o chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ nyoa.

english_verse: These were the troops who protected the king in Jerusalem, not counting those he had assigned to the fortified cities throughout the country.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Kooro Jehosafat Jerusalam. Ba ta banɔ la waa kpɔ ba so Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara la nɛɛ jae.

english_verse: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ate, Israel Kooro Ahab ne Juda Kooro Jehosafat la bwɛjen Ramɔt Gelead, dɛ ka yoo ba.

english_verse: One day, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in his capital city of Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle and prepared a big feast to honor Jehoshaphat and the officials with him. Ahab talked about attacking the city of Ramoth in Gilead,
translation_verse: Bene ane aa baa kaa habɔɔ la, Kooro Jehosafat la bwɛjen Samaria, dɛ ka na Kooro Ahab. Kooro Ahab kpoo peera ne nae kohona tɛ Kooro Jehosafat, ne nɛra baa ja o nɛ, dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba jirima, dɛ soŋe Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, ó ja o nɛ, bá ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena.

english_verse: But first let's ask the Lord what to do.”
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Gel ya soŋe le Korowii be mɔɔ.”

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Jehosafat bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Amɔ Korowii keame bɛlbwa toole yá che o nɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe le Korowii be naa?”

english_verse: “We could ask Micaiah son of Imlah,” Ahab said. “But I hate Micaiah. He always has bad news for me.” “Don't say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Ahab chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii keame beŋkpoŋ bɛl lole. Onee Imla bibaa Mikaya. Kɛ n ne waa somɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta wobɛlbwa nae le Korowii be dɛ tɛ mɛ a ɛ wedɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ bwa, atane wechɔɡa ɡbo.” Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, bɛ ɡɛ ŋɔ.”

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Ahab yerɛ o nomonome la bini bɛl dɛ ŋɔ, “La ka kpɔ Imla bibaa Mikaya ba taraken.”

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria, listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Dɛ Israel Kooro Ahab ne Juda Kooro Jehosafat do ba koolaala, dɛ so ba kookane ta, pɛla bɛl waa bɛne bwɛjen Samaria doonyoa, asɛ Korowii keamere la bwa che ba sie, dɛɛ bol waa baa naa ba be.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Keamere la bini bɛlee, Kenaana bibaa Sedekia. O kpɔ bune ɛ kwaane a do kɛ nyeɡlare. O ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. ‘Kwaa nɔɔ hɛɛ ba kpɔe yo Siiria tena dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth and promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛ tentenee keamere la bwa bol Korowii waa dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena, hɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ. Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he pɔ ba nɛ.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Torome waa laŋa ka ɡaaɡe Mikaya bɔr la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii keamere la bwa nyoa pɛo ba bol ŋɔ kooro wobɛlbwa chiɡo kɛrɛdɛ. Sɛh dɛ́ ɡel he ne ba waa la ɛ beŋkpoŋ.”

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord my God tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii keame Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole kɛŋɔ, mɛɛ bol waa Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ŋɔa ń bol o bee.”

english_verse: Then Micaiah went up to Ahab, who asked, “Micaiah, should we attack Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you capture the city.”
translation_verse: Mikaya aa ba Kooro Ahab be la, kooro pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N ne n dɔŋ Kooro Jehosafat ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena kɛɛ yá ɡel ɔ?” Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé la ka yoo ba, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo hé pɔ ba nɛ.”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth! What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Ahab ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Keraŋwɛnɛɛ ń ɡel he ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ hé bol kasinteŋ Korowii sɔn ta nɔ?”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers wandering around, lost in the hills like sheep without a shepherd. The Lord said, ‘These troops have no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Mikaya ŋɔ, “N na Israel laa tena baa perɛ deŋɡarere ta kɛŋɔ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe ken. Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Ba ta sitɔɔ dɔe, ɡel bá berɛ kaa dem deŋnesɔɔhna ne.’ ”

english_verse: Ahab turned to Jehoshaphat and said, “I told you he would bring me bad news!”
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “N ta he be ŋɔe ŋɔ o ta wedɛɛɡa bolɛ n be bwa atane wechɔɡa ɡbo aa?”

english_verse: Micaiah replied: I then saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.
translation_verse: Korowii keame Mikaya berɛ teŋɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “No waa Korowii aa bola. N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii aa soɡe o kookara ta nyundua, o dɔm baa ja o nɛ dɛɛ tomɔ che baro.

english_verse: The Lord asked, “Who can trick Ahab and make him go to Ramoth where he will be killed?” They talked about it for a while,
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii pɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ neɡre Kooro Ahab, ásɛ o la Ramɔt Gelead dɛ́ ka yoo ba, ásɛ ba kpoo bela ɔ?’ Korowii dɔm baa cheɡa baro nyundua la bwa waa koɡrɔ. Bane ŋɔ ken, bane ɡe ŋɔ ken.

english_verse: then finally a spirit came forward and said to the Lord, “I can trick Ahab.” “How?” the Lord asked.
translation_verse: Ate, doma bɛl ba che Korowii sie dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ neɡroo.’ Asɛ Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa hɛɛ ba kpɔe neɡro wɔ?’

english_verse: “I'll make Ahab's prophets lie to him.” “Good!” the Lord replied. “Now go and do it. You will be successful.”
translation_verse: Asɛ doma la ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo Korowii keamere baa dɛ tomɛ Kooro Ahab neɡro.’ Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Kaa dɛ́ ka ɛ ɡɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Zedekiah walked over and slapped Micaiah on the face. Then he asked, “Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me?”
translation_verse: Ate, Kenaana bibaa Korowii keame Sedekia la, dɛ ka kpaa Korowii keame Mikaya lwɛɛma dɛ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo Korowii Doma ɡel mɛ dɛ ba bol wa he be bwa nɔ?”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “You'll find out on the day you have to hide in the back room of some house.”
translation_verse: Korowii keame Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ naa, awola haa ŋɔ he ka jo dea bini ka sɔh la.”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Arrest Micaiah! Take him to Prince Joash and Governor Amon of Samaria.
translation_verse: Belaa Israel Kooro Ahab ŋɔ o nomonome la bɛl be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ Korowii keame Mikaya kaa Amɔn waa dɛ nyiŋi bwɛjen nɔ ta, ne n bibaa Joas be,

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”
translation_verse: dɛ́ ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, n ŋɔ ba lawɔ do dea, dɛɛ tɛo paanoo ne nee ɡbo ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba jo sɔnɔnɔɔ.”

english_verse: Micaiah said, “If you do come back, I was wrong about what the Lord wanted me to say.” Then he told the crowd, “Don't forget what I said!” Ahab Dies at Ramoth (
translation_verse: Korowii keame Mikaya ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa jo sɔnɔnɔɔ naa, amɔ dɛ Korowii laa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ bol wa.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa kpɔ waa nɔ do o nyu bini.” Kooro Ahab kpoe Ramɔt Gelead

english_verse: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, “Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe.” Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.
translation_verse: Israel Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ beɡre n tenee dɛ́ ka ja laa tena nɔ nɛ, kɛ he te, do he koolaala.” Anomanta, Kooro Ahab beɡre o te, dɛ kaa laa la ta.

english_verse: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But Jehoshaphat prayed, and the Lord made the Syrian soldiers stop.
translation_verse: Laa sitɔɔla la aa na Kooro Jehosafat la, ba liiro ŋɔ Israel kooroo, asɛ ba laa berɛ ŋɔ bá ka yoo. Kɛ waa dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre la, Korowii chao dɛ ɡel ba laa berɛ kaa.

english_verse: And when they realized he wasn't Ahab, they left him alone.
translation_verse: Laa sitɔɔla la nao kɛŋɔ Israel kooro laa, anomanta, ba ɡel o nɛɛ teŋa.

english_verse: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab between two pieces of his armor. He shouted to his chariot driver, “I've been hit! Get me out of here!”
translation_verse: Siiria laa tena la bɛl ta hɛm o ka yaɡɛ Israel Kooro Ahab kon waa kpɔa tɔ ɡbemɡbe la keŋkeŋ, asɛ dɛ ka yaɡɛ o bambinyoa, dɛ o laa saahna. Asɛ kooro la ŋɔ nɛn waa soɡe o torɔɡo baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔ la be ŋɔ, “Ba do mɛ bol, le n ne laa nɔ ta.”

english_verse: The fighting lasted all day, with Ahab propped up in his chariot so he could see the Syrian troops. He stayed there until evening, and by sundown he was dead.
translation_verse: Dɛ yoi la kpeɡri tɔpebir la bwa, asɛ ba lawɛ kooro la kpoŋe o so torɔɡo la bini, o sie chaɡɛ Siiria laa tena la. Jɔmɔra ne tela dɛ o sewɔ.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: A balɔ kɛŋɔ Juda Kooro Jehosafat berɔ ba o koodem Jerusalam deŋnesɔɔhna ta,

english_verse: But the prophet Jehu son of Hanani met him and said: By helping that wicked Ahab, you have made friends with someone who hates the Lord. Now the Lord God is angry with you!
translation_verse: asɛ Hanani bibaa Jehu waa ɛ Korowii keame la ka cheme Kooro Jehosafat dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé cha nyubinikpeɡ tena, ásɛ dɛɛ nyin nɛra baa hah Korowii aa? Gɛ nomanta, Korowii bandia ba he nɛ.

english_verse: But not everything about you is bad. You destroyed the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah—that shows you have tried to obey the Lord. Jehoshaphat Appoints Judges To Settle Cases
translation_verse: Kɛ he ɛ wedɛɛɡa tama ane, dɛkalkɛ he teŋni voɡ Asera daa nɛra aa dɛ tomɛ le he harɛ ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin ta.” Kooro Jehosafat le o nomonome

english_verse: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he often traveled through his kingdom, from Beersheba in the south to the edge of the hill country of Ephraim in the north. He talked with the people and convinced them to turn back to the Lord God and worship him, just as their ancestors had done.
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Jehosafat soɡe Jerusalam, kɛ o yon ir la harɛ la nɛra be, le Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ne Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ charɛ ba liire le Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la be.

english_verse: He assigned judges to each of the fortified cities in Judah
translation_verse: O le nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole bwɛjen bɛlbwa baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro Juda harɛ ta,

english_verse: and told them: Be careful when you make your decisions in court, because you are judging by the Lord's standards and not by human standards, and he will know what you decide.
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi dɛ́ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, nɛn kpeɡri ne laa, Korowii kpeɡri taa, wɛɛ ja he nɛɛ he waa bola dɛɛ pa bole ta.

english_verse: So do your work in honor of him and know that he won't allow you to be unfair to anyone or to take bribes.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ bol waa aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ be te, waa waa sie berɛ bole pae ta, waa nɛn siebɔr kɛɛ sen yawa nyiŋi.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat also chose some Levites, some priests, and some of the family leaders, and he appointed them to serve as judges in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Jerusalam ɡe la, Kooro Jehosafat le Lewi dea tena ne sɔfore, dɛ Israel nomonnyuune baa chɔ ba lolanar nyoo ŋɔ, baa nyiŋi nomɛlbwa waa koni Korowii Mmara la, dɛ́ bol nɛn ne o dɔŋ baah wa, dɛɛ pa bole Jerusalam.

english_verse: The people of Judah will bring you legal cases that involve every type of crime, including murder. You must settle these cases and warn the people to stop sinning against the Lord, so that he won't get angry and punish Judah. Remember, if you follow these instructions, you won't be held responsible for anything that happens.
translation_verse: He bini bɛlbwa le bwɛjena nɔ ta, dɛ ba waa aa ɛ nɛŋkpoa kɛɛ Korowii Mmara la bini bɛlbwa ne naa, hé kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ wechɔɡa ɛ dɛ́ jo Korowii nɛ, ásɛ o bandia bɛ he nɛɛ ba. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa bolchɔɡee di.

english_verse: Amariah the high priest will have the final say in any religious case. And Zebadiah, the leader of the Judah tribe, will have the final say in all other cases. The rest of the Levites will serve as your assistants. Be brave, and I pray that the Lord will help you do right.
translation_verse: Sɔfonomoa Amariaa dɛɛ ba he sie tɔe Korowii waa bwa ta, ásɛ Ismael bibaa Sebadia waa ɛ Juda dea nomoa la chɔ waa aa ɛ kooro waa nyoa, ásɛ Lewi dea tena la ɡe ɛɛ cha heya. Hé ɛa bambile bwa ne, Korowiirii dɛ ja banɔ la baa ɛa kɛrɛdɛ la nɛ.”

english_verse: Messengers told Jehoshaphat, “A large army from Edom east of the Dead Sea has invaded our country. They have already reached En-Gedi.”
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra bane ba ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “Laa tena damanta le Edom harɛ Yar Mpo baŋ le dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yoi. Ba tel Hasasɔn Taama.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat was afraid, so he asked the Lord what to do. He then told the people of Judah to go without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehosafat ɔmɔ, dɛ bɔɔ le Korowii be ŋɔ ó baɡlo ɡɛ waa ɛ, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Juda te bɛlbwa vɔwɛ nyoa, á baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna.

english_verse: They immediately left for Jerusalem to ask for the Lord's help.
translation_verse: Juda tena baa cheme Jerusalam, dɛ ba bɔɔ le Korowii be. Juda harɛ bwɛɛ bɛlbwa taa nɛra le, dɛ ba soŋe Korowii.

english_verse: After everyone from Judah and Jerusalem had come together at the Lord's temple, Jehoshaphat stood in front of the new courtyard
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Jehosafat ir che nɛra baa le Juda ne Jerusalam bwa sie, Korowii Dea dembaah onfale la sie,

english_verse: and prayed: You, Lord, are the God our ancestors worshiped, and from heaven you rule every nation in the world. You are so powerful that no one can defeat you.
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii ya naawa aa tomɛ, henee dɛɛ di kora nyundua ne harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ. Henee dɔ bokpeɡa ne kpeɡri kohona, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che he sie.

english_verse: Our God, you forced out the nations who lived in this land before your people Israel came here, and you gave it to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.
translation_verse: Henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ. He doŋi nɛra ba fa aa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta le he nɛra Israel tena sie, dɛ kpɔ tɛ he dam Abraham naanar, o ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Our ancestors lived in this land and built a temple to honor you.
translation_verse: Ba soɡe harɛ nɔ ta dɛ do Dea he sɔn ta dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: They believed that whenever this land is struck by war or disease or famine, your people can pray to you at the temple, and you will hear their prayer and save them.
translation_verse: ‘Dɛ wechɔɡa ane bɛlbwa ba ya nɛ, dɛ laa kɛɛ weechɔɡa kɛɛ lɔr aa, yaa ka che Dea nɔ sie he siee, dɛ́ wi noe a wa, ásɛ he no dɛ́ lɛ yaa.’

english_verse: You can see that the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Edom are attacking us! Those are the nations you would not let our ancestors invade on their way from Egypt, so these nations were not destroyed.
translation_verse: Taraken, Amɔn ne Moab ne Edom tena balɔ dɛ́ ba yo yaa. Ya naawa fa aa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, he ta ɡelɛ ba jo ɡɛ harɛre la ta. Ba valɔ dɛ bar ba, dɛ ɡel ba kpoora.

english_verse: Aren't you going to punish them? We won't stand a chance when this army attacks. We don't know what to do—we are begging for your help.
translation_verse: Henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ. Tɛr ba deŋne, dɛkalkɛ ya ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ won che laa tena baa wara dɛɛ ba ya nɛɛ nɔ sie. Yaa jemɛ ɡɛ yaa ɛ, he siwi taa yaa nyiŋi.”

english_verse: While every man, woman, and child of Judah was standing there at the temple,
translation_verse: Dɛ Juda harɛ ta baala ne ba haahna ne bii bwa cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la sie.

english_verse: Then Jahaziel said: Your Majesty and everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you don't need to be afraid or let this powerful army discourage you. God will fight on your side!
translation_verse: Anee Jahaseɛl ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ne nɛra haa lɔ Juda ne Jerusalam bwa, hé no. Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be laanee nɔ, ‘He bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr laa tena baa wara nɔ wa. Korowiirii dɛ́ yo tɛ heya.

english_verse: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.
translation_verse: Hé ir ka yoo ba kere, ɡɛ saŋ baa teeh kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa chɔa kaa Sis dɛɛ ba la. Hɛɛ ka chem ba fɛlembɔjen la nyoa Jeruel waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la bɔr.

english_verse: You won't even have to fight. Just take your positions and watch the Lord rescue you from your enemy. Don't be afraid. Just do as you're told. And as you march out tomorrow, the Lord will be there with you.
translation_verse: He laa dɛɛ ba laa nɔ yoi. Hé te ka che he chebɔra dɛɛ kpa. Hé che kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ dɛ na ɡɛ Korowii aa yo tɛ heya, dɛ́ ɡel he pɔ ba nɛ. Juda ne Jerusalam tena, he bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr, hé te le ka puu ba kere, dɛ́ na ɡɛ Korowii aa ja he nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat bowed low to the ground and everyone worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Jehosafat ɡuŋi dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ. Asɛ nɛra la ɡe bwa ɡuŋi dɛ jam Korowii.

english_verse: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ate, Lewi dea tena bane baa le Kohat ne Kora deene ta la ir che, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ takpeɡ ne.

english_verse: Early the next morning, as everyone got ready to leave for the desert near Tekoa, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Listen my friends, if we trust the Lord God and believe what these prophets have told us, the Lord will help us, and we will be successful.”
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, ba leɔ kaa Tekoa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela. Baa dɛ ba kaala la, Kooro Jehosafat iro che dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé no, Juda ne Jerusalam tena. Hé yarada Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la, dɛ́ yarada waa o keamere ɡe aa bola la, aa chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛɛ.”

english_verse: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: “Praise the Lord! His love never ends.”
translation_verse: Kooro ne nɛra la bane bol wa, asɛ o le yelɡoola bane ŋɔ bá ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, o ɡoroŋ waa doa dɛ do kan kohona la wa, asɛ ba tɔ laa tena la sie dɛɛ ɡo yela ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!
translation_verse: Amɔn ne Moab laa tena pɛo, dɛ yo Edom laa tena dɛ kpoo ba bwa kwaraa. Baa kpoo ba tonɛ la, ba berɛ sie dɔŋa be dɛɛ kpoo dɔŋa, ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bwa aa tona.

english_verse: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.
translation_verse: Juda laa tena la baa tel bobɛl o sie aa chaɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, asɛ dɛ ha sie nyiŋi, dɛ na kɛŋɔ laa tena damanta la bwa serewɔ chɔ. Beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord. That's why that place was called Praise Valley.
translation_verse: Tɔpenaarɛ wee la, ba kaa cheme Bɛraka Fɛlembɔjen ta ɡo yela, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii a wa. A waa baa yerɔ Bɛraka Felembɔjen ba le fini la.

english_verse: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid
translation_verse: Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra no ɡɛ Korowii aa yo Israel tena dɔma tɛɛ ba la aa, dɛ ɔmee kohona laɡ ba.

english_verse: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, Juda Kooro Jehosafat ne Israel Kooro Ahasia o nyu bini aa kpeɡa kohona la fɔwɛ nyopɛo fɔo.

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Deŋɡarere voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la te, o ta an chɔɡɛ. Ba ta ba bambile bwa kpɔe tomɛ Korowii ba naawa fa aa tomɔ la.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Waane ɡe Kooro Jehosafat aa ɛa, le mumpar ba a jaɡa, ba chwera ja Hanani bibaa Jehu bwara waa aa lɔ Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: But the prophet Eliezer warned Jehoshaphat, “The Lord will destroy these ships because you have supported Ahaziah.” The ships were wrecked and never sailed.
translation_verse: Dodavahu waa le Maresa bibaa Korowii keame Eliesa cheɡɛ Korowii waa ta, dɛ kah Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “He ne Kooro Ahasia aa fɔwɛ nyopɛo fɔo nomanta, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa haa ɛa nɔɔ.” Anomanta, stiimaere la paɡrɔ ba ta wone kpɔa la bonadibɔr.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Kooro Jehosafat sewɔ ka chɔ o naawa hoɡa ta Jerusalam, o naa Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Asɛ o bibaa Jehoram chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoram aa di kora saŋee Edom harɛ tena pere ba te le Juda tena nɛ, dɛ ka chiɡ ba kooro.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: Dɛ Filisti tena bane ne Arab tena fa soɡo bɛne bela Itiopia tena bane fa aa soɡa mpo nyoa. Korowii ɡelɔ ba ne Kooro Jehoram yo laa.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: Ba mɛɛ tɛɛ ba suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kohona, dɛ berɛ tɛ bɛlbwa Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara ba ka so a ta. Kɛ Jehoram aa ɛ binomoa la, onee Kooro Jehosafat le o chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora. Juda Kooro Jehoram

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoram kora aa baa che kiŋkiŋ la, o kpoo o nimanar la ne Israel nomonome bane.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: O teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta. Dɛ o mo Kooro Ahab bihaah, anomanta, o ɛ wechɔɡa Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena aa ɛa la, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii aa nyin kɛŋɔ o chɔɡ Kooro Devid dem kora, dɛkalkɛ o ne Devid fɔwɛ fɔo o baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ o naanar ɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Ba le fini, Edom harɛ tena pere ba te le Juda tena lɔɡa. Gɛɛ bwɛjen Lebna tena ɡe pere ba te ɡɛ saŋ, dɛkalkɛ Kooro Jehoram vɛh Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ la.

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: Hale o kwaa bɔra Juda harɛ deŋɡarere ta baa tomɛ voɡa, a che a ta Juda ne Jerusalam tena ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Korowii keame Elaeja chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Kooro Jehoram ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii he naa Devid aa tomɔ aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘He ta waa he mɛɛ Kooro Jehosafat, kɛɛ he nabaa Kooro Asa aa ɛa ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: He teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta, a che a ta Juda ne Jerusalam tena kaa tomɛ voɡa, ɡɛ Kooro Ahab ne banɔ la baa di kora o habɔɔ aa ɛa la. Hale he berɔ kpoo he nimanar ba waa aa wera ɡwaale la.

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ tɛr he nɛra deŋnee taeh, he bii ne he haahna, dɛ chɔɡ kwaa haa dɔa ɡe bwa.

english_verse: You will be struck with a painful stomach disease and suffer until you die.
translation_verse: He ɡbabir ɡe ɛɛ we teweelaa taeh, ka tel kɛŋɔ haa sewɛ.’ ”

english_verse: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.
translation_verse: Ba kaa lɔ tɔ Juda tena nɛ, dɛ pa laala aa lɔ koodem ne o haahna ne bibaala kaa. O bibaa bechala Ahasia ɡboo baa ka.

english_verse: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Korowii ɡelɔ teweela baa wola won chaah ba Kooro Jehoram nɛ.

english_verse: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.
translation_verse: Weela la kpoŋo ka tel dɛ ɛ bene anɛ, asɛ o looni le o sewɛ weweele ne. O nɛra ta on koo huɡa huɡe, dɛ mar nijena, dɛ baɡle jirima baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛo o seo la wa. Dɛ ɡɛɛ ba ɛ o naawa baa tɔ sie la.

english_verse: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot,
translation_verse: Kooro Jehu aa dɛ kpoo ba la, o kaa tel Juda nomonome ne Kooro Ahasia naanar baa ja o nɛɛ la, asɛ dɛ kpoo ba bwa.

english_verse: then gave orders to find Ahaziah. Jehu's officers found him hiding in Samaria. They brought Ahaziah to Jehu, who immediately put him to death. They buried Ahaziah only because they respected Jehoshaphat his grandfather, who had done his best to obey the Lord. There was no one from Ahaziah's family left to become king of Judah. Queen Athaliah of Judah (
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ baa ɡaaɡe Kooro Ahasia bɔr, asɛ o nɛra ka nao bwɛjen Samaria dɛ lawɔ. Ba kpɔɔ ba tɛ Kooro Jehu, asɛ o kpoo. Asɛ ba koh ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Jehosafat aa nyin Korowii o bambile bwa ne waa dɛ huɡo. Anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa toole Kooro Ahasia dem, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won nyiŋi Juda harɛ la ta kpa. Juda Haŋkooro Atalia

english_verse: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.
translation_verse: O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ kɛ Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena, dɛkalkɛ o mɛɛ seo habɔɔ la, dɛ banee dɛɛ jao, a che a ta o chole.

english_verse: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Kooro Ahasia teŋɛ jae baa jao la ta, o ne Israel Kooro Joram ka yo Siiria harɛ Kooro Hasael bwɛɛ Ramɔt Gelead. Yoi la ta la, Siiria laa tena la do Kooro Joram bol.

english_verse: and he went to the town of Jezreel to recover. And Ahaziah later went there to visit him.
translation_verse: Anomanta, o berɔ ba Jesreel dɛ baa chah, asɛ Juda Kooro Ahasia la ka nao.

english_verse: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family,
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowiirii ɛa kɛŋɔ Kooro Ahasia ka na Kooro Joram dɛ kpoo. Waa laŋa la, o ne Kooro Joram laŋɔ ka cheme Nimsi bibaa Jehu, Korowii aa leo ŋɔ ó ba kpo Kooro Ahab dem nɛra la.

english_verse: but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as the others were about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, was married to Jehoiada the priest. So she was able to hide her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah.
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Ahasia mɛɛ bihaah bɛl sɔne Jehoseba, dɛ yalɛ sɔfo Jehoiada. O sɔɔh dɛ lɛ Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas le koobii baa dɛ ba ba kpoora la bini, dɛ kpɔɔ ka sɔh o be dea, dɛ ɡel haah bɛl ɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛɛ Korowii Dea. O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ lɛo le haŋkooro Atalia kpoe o fe aa dɛ nyin o kpoe la nɔn ta.

english_verse: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that,
translation_verse: Kooro Ahasia nya Atalia aa naa kɛ o bibaa Kooro Ahasia sewɔ la, o ŋɔ ba kpoo koobii baa ba di kora Juda harɛ ta bwa.

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
translation_verse: Jehoseba kpɔ Joas sɔh Korowii Dea bela bene anumɛl, ɡɛ saŋ haŋkooro Atalia aa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta la.

english_verse: These five men went to the towns in Judah and called together the Levites and the clan leaders. They all came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ba la Juda harɛ bwɛjena ta, dɛ ka kpɔ Lewi dea tena ne nomonnyuune baa chɔ Israel deene nyoo bwa ba Jerusalam.

english_verse: Jehoiada and his sons brought Joash outside, where they placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of the instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, and the crowd cheered and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Name sɔfo Jehoiada ka lawɛ Joas le buse dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo kora ta. Ba kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ piu, dɛ kpɔ fɔo baa fɔwa dɛ che o ta dɛɛ di kora harɛ la ta do o nɔn ta. Asɛ ba lɔ kpaŋa dɛ moo ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ!”

english_verse: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple,
translation_verse: Gɛ maa dɛ nyin kɛ he sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, he balɔ dɛɛ ba ba daah Korowii Dea Ona Tɔpere aa, he bini bele batoro ba daah doonyoone la,

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: asɛ harɛ la ta nɛra bwa sie lɛ, bwɛjen la sɔɔh, kpoe baa kpo haŋkooro Atalia la wa.

english_verse: After Ahaziah's son Joash had hidden in the temple for six years, Jehoiada the priest knew that something had to be done. So he made sure he had the support of several army officers. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translation_verse: Bene anuanɛ ta la, sɔfo Jehoiada baɡle o kpeɡri. O ne laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena lafare nyoo, ne Jɛroham bibaa Asaria, ne Jehohanan bibaa Ismael, ne Ɔbɛd bibaa Asaria, ne Adaya bibaa Maaseya, dɛ Sikri bibaa Elisafat fɔwɛ fɔo.

english_verse: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra la bwa ne kooro bibaa Joas ba cheme Korowii Dea dɛ fɔwɛ fɔo. Anee sɔfo Jehoiada ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas ɛɛ di koraa, ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ Kooro Devid naanar nyoa la.

english_verse: one will guard the palace, and the other will guard Foundation Gate. The rest of you will stand guard in the temple courtyards.
translation_verse: bele batoro ɡe ka daah koodem, bele batoro ɡe do Mumpar Doonyoa, ásɛ nɛra la kabora ka boa nyoa Korowii Dea dembaahna bela.

english_verse: Only the priests and Levites who are on duty will be able to enter the temple, because they will be the only ones who have gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable. The others must stay outside in the courtyards, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa bɛ Korowii Dea la bini jo, atane sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa lɔ bela dɛɛ ɛ toma. Ba te ɛɛ won jo bela, dɛkalkɛ ba sɔ ba doŋa ta ba do ɡoroŋ. Kɛ banɔ la baa kaa la te chɛ kɛ bá teŋɛ waa Korowii aa bola la ta, dɛ́ so dahara.

english_verse: You Levites must protect King Joash. Don't let him out of your sight! And keep your swords ready to kill anyone who comes into the temple.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ ba dɔmkwaa kpoŋe, dɛ́ che bar Joas, dɛ́ so o jwɛh, bobɛlbwa waa kaa. Ásɛ nomɛlbwa ba dɛ jo Korowii Dea aa, bá kpoo.”

english_verse: The Levites and the people of Judah followed Jehoiada's orders. The guards going off duty were not allowed to go home, and so each commander had all his guards available—those going off duty as well as those coming on duty.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena ne Juda baala la ɛ ɡɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa do ba la bwa. Ba bini bɛlbwa ta nɛra baa dɛ ba toma ta Ona Tɔpere ta, ne banɔ la baa wola toma ta ba Ona Tɔpere ta la ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba kaa ba deremi.

english_verse: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ lampeare ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta, a ɛ Kooro Devid kwaa ba kpɔ cheɡ Korowii Dea la tɛ laa sitɔɔla la.

english_verse: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.
translation_verse: Ate, o ɡel nɛra baa dɛ daah la bɛlbwa kpoŋe o dɔmkon ba che Korowii Dea ne saraha kon la sie, dɛ bar Kooro Joas.

english_verse: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.
translation_verse: Haŋkooro Atalia aa no moola nɛra baa dɛ daah ne nɛra baa lɔ bela aa dɛ moo la, o ɛ warane la ba be Korowii Dea bela.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns near the entrance, which was the usual place for the king. The commanders and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the musicians were playing instruments and leading the people as they celebrated and blew trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: O baa na kɛŋɔ kooro la cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la sie pila bɛl jwɛh ɡɛ ba nawee wa aa doa. Asɛ laa sitɔɔla ne bɛlhoohla che kooro jwɛh. Asɛ harɛ la ta nomɛlbwa sie lɛ, baa hoh bɛle, dɛɛ lɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, asɛ yelɡoola ɡo yela tɔ ba sie. Belaa haŋkooro Atalia laa o batakaare kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o baah diu kohona, dɛ ŋɔ, “He bwa lee mɛ tɛ! He ɛɛ mɛ dɔm!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Don't kill her near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers!”
translation_verse: Dɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa nyin kɛ bá kpo Atalia Korowii Dea bɔr bela, anomanta, o do laa sitɔɔla la ŋɔ, “Hé lawɔ le laa tena nɔ baah ta, dɛ́ kpo nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛ ó ba lɛo.”

english_verse: She tried to escape, but the commanders caught and killed her near the gate where horses are led into the palace.
translation_verse: Ate, ba tɛɡro le, dɛ kpoo Jaɡre Doonyoa bela jaɡre aa cheɡa dɛɛ jo koodem la ta.

english_verse: Jehoiada asked King Joash and the people to join with him in being faithful to the Lord. They agreed,
translation_verse: Sɔfo Jehoiada ne Kooro Joas fɔwɛ fɔo o chɔ Korowii ne harɛ la nɛra baah ta kɛŋɔ nɛra la ɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.

english_verse: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translation_verse: Ate, harɛ la ta nɛra bwa la voɡ Baal dea, dɛ ka paɡre kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo, ne voɡare aa lɔ dea la bini bwa, dɛ paɡre o dea la bwa ɡe kwaraa. Dɛ lawɛ o kerekpoŋri baa dɛ yerɔ Matan, dɛ kpoo kwaa ba fa aa dɛ ɛ sarahare o ta la sie.

english_verse: Jehoiada assigned the priests and Levites their duties at the temple, just as David had done. They were in charge of offering sacrifices to the Lord according to the Law of Moses, and they were responsible for leading the celebrations with singing.
translation_verse: Ate, Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ Korowii Dea bela toma do sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena nɔn ta. Banee Kooro Devid kpɔ do ba nɔn ta ŋɔ, báa fuh saraha kwaa baa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii la, ɡɛ aa lɔ Mosis Mmara Tɔn bini. Dɛ banee chɔ yela ɡoe ne wobɛlbwa aa dɛ ba silɛɛ ne nyoa.

english_verse: Jehoiada ordered the guards at the temple gates to keep out anyone who was unclean.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ nɛra ba che, baa daah Korowii Dea doonyoo la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa kah doŋa la bɛ Dea la bini jo.

english_verse: Finally, Jehoiada called together the army commanders, the most important citizens of Judah, and the government officials. The crowd of people followed them as they led Joash from the temple, through the Upper Gate, and into the palace, where he took his place as king of Judah.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Jehoiada yerɛ laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena lafare nyoo ne nomonome dɛ nomonjena, asɛ ba kpɔ Kooro Joas le Korowii Dea bela ba. Ba kpɔ koodem Nyundua Doonyoa la ta jo, asɛ kooro ba so o kookara ta,

english_verse: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.
translation_verse: Kooro Joas ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, ɡɛ saŋ sɔfo Jehoiada aa dɛ di sɔfore bwa.

english_verse: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.
translation_verse: Kooro Joas ne sɔfo Jehoiada yon kpɔ suuɡa la do nɛra Korowii Dea kwaara aa lɔ ba nɔn ta. Ásɛ ba kpɔ mamaala ne kapenta tena, dɛ nɛra baa jemɛ bune ne ayaawa toma ŋɔ ba kwaa Dea la.

english_verse: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple. Joash Turns Away from the Lord
translation_verse: Ba huɡo koranar huɡribɔr Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, o wedɛɛɡa waa ɛa Israel harɛ tɛ Korowii ne Korowii Dea toma la wa. Kooro Joas nyubinikpeɡ wa

english_verse: And now we need it to repair the temple because the sons of that evil woman Athaliah came in and wrecked it. They even used some of the sacred objects to worship the god Baal.”
translation_verse: Dɛ Haŋkooro Atalia nyubinikpeɡ te la habɔteŋra ku Korowii Dea la, dɛ pa kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la bini ane kaa tomɛ voɡ Baalre.

english_verse: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Jehoiada mo haahna banɛ tɛ Kooro Joas, asɛ o dɔ bibaala ne bihaahna.

english_verse: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Kooro Joas liiro kɛŋɔ wɛɛ berɔɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: He called together the priests and Levites and said, “Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple.” But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.
translation_verse: Asɛ o yerɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena cheme, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡaaɡe Juda harɛ bwɛjena ta, dɛ́ lɛ toɔ aa chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa bɔ benanyoa la ba, ásɛ n kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la. Hé ɛa warane.” Kɛ Lewi dea tena la ta mun pae warane.

english_verse: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, “Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Anomanta, o yerɛ Sɔfonomoa Jehoiada dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta nyiŋe Lewi dea tena la Juda ne Jerusalam, dɛ ka lɛ benanyoa bɛlbwa toɔ, Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis ne Israel tena bwa aa ŋɔa bá ka lɛ ba kwaa Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr laɔ?”

english_verse: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Joas do Lewi dea tena la ŋɔ, bá kwaa daka cheɡ Korowii Dea la doonyoa dɛɛ lɛ suuɡare.

english_verse: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.
translation_verse: Ate, ba kpɔ kala ka tɛ Juda ne Jerusalam tena ŋɔ, nómɛlbwa kpɔ toɔ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis fa aa lɛa Israel tena be pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la ba.

english_verse: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.
translation_verse: Nɛra la ne ba nomonome kpɔ ba toɔre ba silɛɛ ne, asɛ daka la su.

english_verse: Each day, after the Levites took the box into the temple, the king's secretary and the high priest's assistant would dump out the money and count it. Then the empty box would be taken back outside. This happened day after day, and soon a large amount of money was collected.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛlbwa, Lewi dea tena la yon kpɔ daka la ba koodem karakere baa dɛ nyiŋi o ta la be. Dɛ o suu waa, karakere la ne Sɔfonomoa nachiɡe yon fuɡa, dɛ berɛ kpɔ daka la ka cheɡ o buɡ ta. Gɛɛ baa ɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ dɔ suuɡa a warɛ.

english_verse: These workers went right to work repairing the temple, and when they were finished, it looked as good as new.
translation_verse: Tom-ɛɛra la do sie ɛ toma kohona, dɛ ɡel Korowii Dea la berɛ do ɡɛ o fa aa doa wubwa la, dɛ do kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: They did not use all the tax money for the repairs, so the rest of it was handed over to Joash and Jehoiada, who then used it to make dishes and other gold and silver objects for the temple. Sacrifices to please the Lord were offered regularly in the temple for as long as Jehoiada lived.
translation_verse: Tom-ɛɛra la aa tona la, ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa la kar tɛ kooro ne sɔfo Jehoiada, asɛ ba kpɔ kwaa loɡbaala ne konjeɡre bwa soo siwi baa hiah cheɡ Korowii Dea la bini. Sɔfo Jehoiada bere saŋ, nɛra kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ ba Korowii Dea bela saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: He died at the ripe old age of
translation_verse: Sɔfo Jehoiada hwɛɛhrɔ taeh mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ, dɛ o di bene lafa fifraatoro.

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.
translation_verse: Kɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa sewa habɔɔ la, Juda nomonome ba Kooro Joas be, dɛɛ soŋo ŋɔ wɛɛ no ba deŋna wa.

english_verse: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Juda harɛ nɛra vɛh Korowii ba naawa fa aa dɛ tomɔ la ka toma o Dea bela, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa ne voɡa. A ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ nomanta, Korowii baah di Juda tena ne Jerusalam tena nɛ.

english_verse: but he still sent prophets who warned them to turn back to him. The people refused to listen.
translation_verse: Korowii tomɛ o keamere ba be, dɛ kah ba ŋɔ bá charɛ dɛ berɛ ba o be, kɛ ba vɛoh.

english_verse: God's Spirit spoke to Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and Zechariah told everyone that God was saying: “Why are you disobeying me and my laws? This will only bring punishment! You have deserted me, so now I will desert you.”
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii Doma ba so sɔfo Jehoiada bibaa Sekaria nɛ, asɛ o ka che nɛra la sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be laanee nɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ he vɛh n waa maa do heyaa a ta nɔɔ? He wobɛlbwa aa werii do tɛ heyaa bwa. Haa vɛh mɛ nomanta, n ɡe vɛh heya.’ ”

english_verse: King Joash forgot that Zechariah's father had always been a loyal friend. So when the people of Judah plotted to kill Zechariah, Joash joined them and gave orders for them to stone him to death in the courtyard of the temple. As Zechariah was dying, he said, “I pray that the Lord will see this and punish all of you.” Joash Is Killed
translation_verse: Kooro Joas soh ɡɛ Sekaria mɛɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa chao la, dɛ ɡarɛ kpo Sekaria. Waa chɔa dɛɛ sewɛ la o ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe kɛ Korowii na waa haa ɛa nɔ, dɛ́ bɔe a kem!” Kooro Joas kora dii jaɡa

english_verse: In the spring of the following year, the Syrian army invaded Judah and Jerusalem, killing all of the nation's leaders. They collected everything of value that belonged to the people and took it back to their king in Damascus.
translation_verse: Lɔmɔɡa saŋ aa tela la, Siiria laa tena warɔ, dɛ ba Juda ne Jerusalam ba yoo ba, dɛ kpoo ba nomonome bwa. Dɛ pa ba laala bwa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa ka tɛ ba kooro Damaskɔs.

english_verse: The Syrian army was very small, but the Lord let them defeat Judah's large army, because he was punishing Joash and the people of Judah for turning away from him.
translation_verse: Dɛ Siiria laa tena aa kanɛ, kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ ba yo, dɛ pɔ Juda laa tena baa wara kohona nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh Korowii ba naawa aa dɛ tomɔ la. Gɛɛ a do Kooro Joas dɔ o deŋnetɛra.

english_verse: Joash was severely wounded during the battle, and as soon as the Syrians left Judah, two of his officials, Zabad and Jehozabad, decided to revenge the death of Zechariah. They plotted and killed Joash while he was in bed, recovering from his wounds. Joash was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa vɔrɔwe o kpoe vɔrɔwa la bɛl sɔne Sabad. O nya sɔne Simiat dɛ ɛ Amɔn te, ne Jehosabad, o ɡe nya sɔne Simrit dɛ ɛ Moab te.

english_verse: The History of the Kings also tells more about the sons of Joash, what the prophets said about him, and how he repaired the temple. Amaziah son of Joash became king after his father's death.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Kooro Joas bii waa ne ɡɛ Korowii keamere aa bol o wa, ne ɡɛ waa bera kwaa Korowii Dea la waa do Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. O bibaa Amasea baa chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

english_verse: One of God's prophets said, “Your Majesty, don't let these Israelite soldiers march into battle with you. The Lord has refused to help anyone from the northern kingdom of Israel,
translation_verse: Anee Korowii keame bɛl la kooro be ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, bɛ ɡel Israel laa tena teŋɛ he nɛ. Korowii ta Israel tena baa le weekaŋle nyundua harɛ la nɛɛ teŋɛ.

english_verse: Amaziah replied, “What am I supposed to do about all the silver I paid those troops?” “The Lord will give you back even more than you paid,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Amasea bɔɔ Korowii keame la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ maa bɔa tɛ Israel laa tena la waɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ won berɛ tɛɛ ane a ɡwaa ɡɛ.”

english_verse: After Amaziah got his courage back, he led his troops to Salt Valley, where he killed
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Amasea do ɡbemba dɛ tɔ laa tena la sie dɛ kaa Yar Fɛlembɔjen ta. Ba kpoo Edom laa tena kaɡboŋa fi bela.

english_verse: But before the prophet finished speaking, Amaziah interrupted and said, “You're not one of my advisors! Don't say another word, or I'll have you killed.” The prophet stopped. But then he added, “First you sinned and now you've ignored my warning. It's clear that God has decided to punish you!” Israel Defeats Judah (
translation_verse: Korowii keame la nyoa taa lɔ waa la ta wɛɛ bol la, Kooro Amasea ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya lee ŋɔ hɛɛ ja kooro aa? Tɔ nyoa!
