english_verse: King Amaziah of Judah talked with his officials, then sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Juda Kooro Amasea ne nɛra baa dɛ jao vɔrɔwe Israel tena vɔrɔwa. Belaa o kpɔ kala tɛ Israel Kooro Jehoas waa ɛ Kooro Jehoahas bibaa, dɛ ɛ Kooro Jehu o fa aa di kora Israel la naa ŋɔ bá cheme dɔŋa dɛ yo laa.

english_verse: Jehoash sent back a reply that said: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon arranged the marriage between his son and the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Anee Israel Kooro Jehoas ɡe tomɛ toroma Juda Kooro Amasea be, dɛ sɛɡlo ŋɔ, “Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta jabalnadaŋɛ bɛlee fa ira, dɛ ka ŋɔ bela dajen bɛl be ŋɔ, ‘Kpɔ he bihaah tɛ mɛ ń tɛ n bie ó mo.’ Asɛ kpɔɡ bini ol bɛl ɡe ir, dɛ ba tiɡri jabalnadaŋɛ la ta dɛ laa kuuɡi.”

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. But stay at home and do your celebrating. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: O berɔ ŋɔ Kooro Amasea be ŋɔ, “He yo Edom tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ he nyu bini do he som, ɡel a maɡre he ne dɛ́ so he dem. Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin waa ba dawɛ ya nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ he kora ne Juda tena nɔɔ?”

english_verse: so Jehoash led his army to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Israel Kooro Jehoas ne Juda Kooro Amasea kaa cheme dɔŋa Bɛt Sɛmɛs waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ yo laa.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Israel laa tena pɔ Juda laa tena nɛ, asɛ ba chwa peɡre kaa ba bwɛɛre.

english_verse: and Jehoash captured Amaziah. Jehoash took Amaziah with him when he went to attack Jerusalem. Jehoash broke down the city wall from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate, a section nearly
translation_verse: Israel Kooro Jehoas lawɛ Juda Kooro Amasea, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ka kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa baro la. Ba kuuɡu le Efrem Doonyoa ka tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Loŋkora Doonyoa. O jaŋne ɛɛ ɛ naɡale lafraanumɛlee.

english_verse: He carried away the gold, the silver, and all the valuable furnishings from God's temple where the descendants of Obed-Edom stood guard. He robbed the king's treasury, took hostages, then returned to Samaria. Amaziah Is Killed (
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoas pa suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne kwaa aa lɔ Korowii Dea, Lewi dea te Ɔbɛd Edom naanar aa dɛ nyiŋi a ta, ne koodem bela laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kaa Samaria. O lawɛ nɛra ɡe ja kaa.

english_verse: Everything else Amaziah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Waa aa bera chiɡ Juda Kooro Amasea kora dii ta, le mumpar ba a jaɡa la, ba chwera do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah started disobeying the Lord, some people in Jerusalem plotted against Amaziah. He was able to escape to the town of Lachish, but another group of people caught him and killed him there.
translation_verse: Le ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Amasea aa vɛh Korowii toma la, dɛ ba dɛ vɔrɔwe o kpoe vɔrɔwa Jerusalam. Anomanta, o chwao kaa bwɛjen Lakes ta, asɛ ba tomɛ nɛra ba teŋɛ la, dɛ ka kpoo bela.

english_verse: His body was taken to Jerusalem on horseback and buried beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ o chɔɔ dawɛ jaaɡɔ ta ba Jerusalam, asɛ ba huɡo bela baa huɡe o naawa Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta.

english_verse: Uzziah supplied his army with shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and stones used for slinging.
translation_verse: Kooro Ussia tɛ o laa tena la kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta, ne lampeare ne bune ɡbɛrɛre, ne laa batakaani ne tori, dɛ vamtor bwea.

english_verse: Uzziah had leprosy the rest of his life. He was no longer allowed in the temple or in his own palace. That's why his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ wee ta Kooro Ussia nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa sewɛ. O ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe jo Korowii Dea dɛ so o ɡbaɡba dem. Wobɛlbwa toole wɛɛ ɛ kpa, asɛ o bibaa Jotam ba so koodem bela dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la tena nɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Uzziah did while he was king is in the records written by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
translation_verse: Waane ɡe aa chiɡ Kooro Ussia kora dii ta, le mumpar kaa a jaɡa la, Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya chwera do tɔn bini.

english_verse: Some of his skilled workers invented machines that could shoot arrows and sling large stones. Uzziah set these up in Jerusalem at his defense towers and at the corners of the city wall. God helped Uzziah become more and more powerful, and he was famous all over the world. Uzziah Becomes Too Proud
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ nɛra baa dɔ wejema kpɔ bune kwaa kwaane nɛra aa dɛ ba wona che a ta dejaŋa dor, ne danjwɛkpeɡa aa bar bwɛjen Jerusalam loŋkoni ta, dɛɛ ta hɛma ne bwejena. O sɔn leɔ kaa bobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii chao kohona mɔɔ o dɔ kpeɡri.

english_verse: God helped him defeat the Philistines, the Arabs living in Gur-Baal, and the Meunites.
translation_verse: Korowii chao o pɔ Filisti tena ne Arab tena baa soɡe Gur Baal, dɛ Meuni tena nɛ.

english_verse: After the death of King Amaziah, the people of Judah crowned his son Uzziah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Waa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fi dɛ anumɛl. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanue dɛ anɛ. O nya sɔne Jekolia dɛ le Jerusalam.

english_verse: Uzziah became proud of his power, and this led to his downfall. One day, Uzziah disobeyed the Lord his God by going into the temple and burning incense as an offering to him.
translation_verse: Kɛ Kooro Ussia aa ba dɛ di kpeɡri la, mbarafo nomanta o cholo. O waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ ka jo Korowii Dea ŋɔ o ka fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma kon baa dɛ fuah a ta la ta.

english_verse: He obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: Kooro Ussia ɛ waa a too Korowii tea, ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Amasea fa aa ɛa la.

english_verse: Zechariah was Uzziah's advisor and taught him to obey God. And so, as long as Zechariah was alive, Uzziah was faithful to God, and God made him successful.
translation_verse: O tomɛ Korowii o bambile bwa ne ɡɛ saŋ Korowii keame Sekaria, waa dɛ jao Korowii waa ta taa soɡe le, asɛ Korowii sweero andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: While Uzziah was king, he started a war against the Philistines. He smashed the walls of the cities of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod, then rebuilt towns around Ashdod and in other parts of Philistia.
translation_verse: Kooro Ussia ne Filisti tena yo laa, asɛ dɛ ka paɡre danjwɛkpeɡa aa bar bwɛjena Gat ne Jamnia dɛ Asdɔd. O berɔ kwaa vɔrɔwe bwɛjena aa bɛne Asdɔd dɛ Filisti harɛ la ta bobɛla bwa.

english_verse: Even the Ammonites paid taxes to Uzziah. He became very powerful, and people who lived as far away as Egypt heard about him.
translation_verse: Amɔn tena kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa baa tɛ Kooro Ussia, asɛ o sɔn le dɛ ba Ijipt harɛ ta bwa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɔ kpeɡri kohona.

english_verse: In Jerusalem, Uzziah built fortified towers at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and the place where the city wall turned inward.
translation_verse: Kooro Ussia ɡelɔ ba ma dejaŋa aa do kpeɡri Jerusalam Loŋkora Doonyoa, ne bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa, dɛ bela danjwɛɛ baa maa bar bwɛɛ la loŋkora ta.

english_verse: He also built defense towers out in the desert. He owned such a large herd of livestock in the western foothills and in the flatlands, that he had cisterns dug there to catch the rainwater. He loved farming, so he had crops and vineyards planted in the hill country wherever there was fertile soil, and he hired farmers to take care of them.
translation_verse: O berɔ ɡel ba ma dejaŋa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ kwi bɔɔne aa won nee lɛɛ bwea lɔɡre, ne deŋɡarere harɛ aa chɔa kaa la ta, dɛkalkɛ o dɔ kondɛɛra kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ o dɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma o kooni ne daa kooni aa lɔ deŋɡarere ne harɛpare andɛɛɡa ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o sie dɛ lɛ para ta.

english_verse: Uzziah's army was always ready for battle. Jeiel and Maaseiah were the officers who kept track of the number of soldiers, and these two men were under the command of Hananiah, one of Uzziah's officials.
translation_verse: Dɛ o dɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ́ ka yo laa. O karakere banɛ Jeyɛl ne Maaseyaa chwerɛ waa aa dɛ chiɡ dɛɛ bil, asɛ kooro nomoa Hanania chɔ ba nyoa.

english_verse: and said, “Your Majesty, this isn't right! You are not allowed to burn incense to the Lord. That must be done only by priests who are descendants of Aaron. You will have to leave! You have sinned against the Lord, and so he will no longer bless you.”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba la o be ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ he fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ Korowii. Sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar baa sɔ ba doŋa ta, ba do ɡoroŋ Korowii be pera la, banee dɔ a ŋwɛnɛ kɛ bá ɛ ɡɛ toma nɔ. Le Korowii Dea bonɔ kaa, dɛkalkɛ he waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe o sie, waa andɛɛɡaa swee tɛɛ kpa.”

english_verse: Uzziah, who was standing next to the incense altar at the time, was holding the incense burner, ready to offer incense to the Lord. He became very angry when he heard Azariah's warning, and leprosy suddenly appeared on his forehead!
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Ussia cheɡɛ Korowii Dea bela, kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma o ta la jwɛh, dɛ kpoŋe kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma. O baah di sɔfore la nɛ, asɛ buɡ la ta, bwadabii weechɔɡa ane ba le o tile ta.

english_verse: Azariah and the other priests saw it and immediately told him to leave the temple. Uzziah realized that the Lord had punished him, so he hurried to get outside.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Asaria ne sɔfore la nyoa kpoo baa nyiŋu, dɛ na kɛ wee lɔ o tile ta, asɛ ba doŋu le buse warane. Dɛ o ɡbabir kwaraa fe dɛ nyin buse lee wubwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛr o deŋne.

english_verse: Since Uzziah had leprosy, he could not be buried in the royal tombs. Instead, he was buried in a nearby cemetery that the kings owned. His son Jotham then became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Ussia baa sewɛ asɛ ba huɡo bɛne o naawa koo bɛl koranar harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ ba ŋɔ o we wee. O bibaa Jotam chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.

english_verse: Jotham obeyed the Lord and did right. He followed the example of his father Uzziah, except he never burned incense in the temple as his father had done. But the people of Judah kept sinning against the Lord.
translation_verse: Kooro Jotam ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, dɛ teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Ussia aa ɛa la ta. Kɛ o te ta Korowii Dea joɛ, dɛ ka fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛ. Dɛ harɛ la ta nɛra ta teŋɔ, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Jotham remained faithful to the Lord his God and became a very powerful king.
translation_verse: Kooro Jotam baa do kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛ o teŋɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king, including the wars he fought, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Kooro Jotam kora dii ta, ne laa waa yoa, ba chwera do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees. Syria and Israel Attack Judah (
translation_verse: Kooro Ahas kpoo kwaa dɛ ɛ saraha, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ voɡare bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ, ne deŋɡarere dor, dɛ dajen bɛlbwa mun.

english_verse: So Tiglath Pileser came to Judah, but instead of helping, he made things worse.
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa ba o be, kɛ wenaale nee o ba ɡwaa kɛ o fe aa ba chao.

english_verse: and he offered sacrifices in Hinnom Valley. Worst of all, Ahaz sacrificed his own sons, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: O kpoo kwaa dɛ fuah ɛ saraha Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen bini. O kpo o bibaala, dɛ fuuh ba ɛ saraha, dɛ teŋɛ harɛre ane nawee waa Korowii aa kia, dɛ koh a wa doŋ ba le ba Israel tena sie la ta.

english_verse: Ahaz and the people of Judah sinned and turned away from the Lord, the God their ancestors had worshiped. So the Lord punished them by letting their enemies defeat them. The king of Syria attacked Judah and took many of its people to Damascus as prisoners. King Pekah of Israel later defeated Judah and killed
translation_verse: Tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo ta, Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka ne o laa tena iro ka kpoo Juda laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la.

english_verse: If you make slaves of the people of Judah and Jerusalem, you will be as guilty as they are of sinning against the Lord.
translation_verse: Taraken he dɛ́ nyin he ɛ baala ne haahna baa lɔ Juda ne Jerusalam bwa he yoma. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he di bolchɔɡe dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la nɛ aa?

english_verse: Send these prisoners back home—they are your own relatives. If you don't, the Lord will punish you in his anger.
translation_verse: Hé no n be! Hé ɡel he lolanar haa laɡ ba yoma nɔ berɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii baah di he nɛɛ kohona.”

english_verse: About the same time, four of Israel's leaders arrived. They were Azariah son of Johanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai. They agreed with Oded that the Israelite troops were wrong,
translation_verse: Belaa Israel nomonome la bane baa ɛ Jehohanan bibaa Asaria, ne Mɛselɛmɔt bibaa Bɛrekea, ne Salum bibaa Jehiskia, dɛ Hadlai bibaa Amasa ir ka cheme nɛra baa le laa ta dɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: and they said: If you bring these prisoners into Samaria, that will be one more thing we've done to sin against the Lord. And he is already angry enough with us.
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ nɛra haa laɡ ba la kpɔ ba bonɔ, ɡɛ laa aa, yaa di bolchɔɡe Korowii siee. He bɛ ɡel ya kpɔ wechɔɡa ja bolchɔɡe dii ta, a kan ya nɛɛ wubwa, ásɛ Korowii baah di ya nɛɛ kohona.”

english_verse: So in front of the leaders and the crowd, the troops handed over their prisoners and the property they had taken from Judah.
translation_verse: Anomanta, laa tena la kpɔ nɛra la ne laala baa paa laa la ta bwa tɛ nomonome baa lɔ bela la bwa, ba siwi ta.

english_verse: The four leaders took some of the stolen clothes and gave them to the prisoners who needed something to wear. They later gave them all a new change of clothes and shoes, then fixed them something to eat and drink, and cleaned their wounds with olive oil. They gave donkeys to those who were too weak to walk, and led all of them back to Jericho, the city known for its palm trees. The leaders then returned to Samaria. Ahaz Asks the King of Assyria for Help (
translation_verse: Asɛ nomonome banaarɛ la lawɛ nɛra la, dɛ ka kpɔ yale aa ja laala laa tena la aa paa la bini ane tɛ banɔ la baa cheɡɛ mumɡbal la, dɛ tɛɛ ba yale ne naŋɡaware ne kondikwa, dɛ noo baa kpɔ do ba ŋwɛra ta. Ba bini banɔ la baa ɡwɛɡra ɡe la, ba kpɔ ba so keeɡore ta. Gɛɛ a ɛ ba kpɔ ba bwa berɛ kaa ba bala be Jeriko baa dɛ yerɔ Bambie Bwɛjen la, dɛ berɛ ba Samaria.

english_verse: Some time later, the Edomites attacked the eastern part of Judah again and carried away prisoners. And at the same time, the Philistines raided towns in the western foothills and in the Southern Desert. They conquered the towns of Beth-Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco, Timnah, and Gimzo, including the villages around them. Then some of the Philistines went to live in these places. Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria and begged for help.
translation_verse: asɛ Filisti tena ɡe ba lɔ tɔ Juda harɛ ta bwɛɛre aa lɔ deŋɡarere ta, ne Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ tena nɛ. Ba yoo dɛ lɛ bwɛjena Bɛt Sɛmɛs ne Aejalɔn, ne Gɛdɛrɔt ne Soko ne Temna dɛ Gimso, ne a bwɛjeɡre aa bara bwa dɛ so a ta.

english_verse: But God was punishing Judah with these disasters, because Ahaz had disobeyed him and refused to stop Judah from sinning.
translation_verse: Juda Kooro Ahas wechɔɡa waa ba a ne Juda harɛ ta, ne kasinteŋ waa wola dii tɛ Korowii la nomanta, Korowii kpɔ wahala ba ta Juda tena nɛ.

english_verse: Ahaz gave him gifts from the Lord's temple and the king's palace, as well as from the homes of Israel's other leaders. The Assyrian king still refused to help Ahaz. The Final Sin of Ahaz and His Death
translation_verse: Anee Juda Kooro Ahas kpɔ suuɡaswɛm aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne anɔ la aa lɔ koodem, ne anɔ la aa le nomonnyuune be, dɛ tomɛ ba kpɔ ka kɛ Asiiria koojen la, kɛ a ta wone chao.

english_verse: Even after all these terrible things happened to Ahaz, he sinned against the Lord even worse than before.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahas wenaale aa baa ɡwaa o nɛɛ bwa habɔɔ la, dɛ o ta teŋɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ kohona.

english_verse: He said to himself, “The Syrian gods must have helped their kings defeat me. Maybe if I offer sacrifices to those gods, they will help me.” That was the sin that finally led to the downfall of Ahaz, as well as to the destruction of Judah.
translation_verse: O kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare Damaskɔs tena baa yoo dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ voɡare ta, dɛkalkɛ o liiro ŋɔ, “Siiria koranar voɡa aa cha ba nomanta, mɛɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahaa tɛa, ásɛ a cha mɛ.” Kɛ anee ɡela o ne Israel tena lɔ harɛ.

english_verse: Ahaz collected all the furnishings of the temple and smashed them to pieces. Then he locked the doors to the temple and set up altars to foreign gods on every street corner in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahas berɔ pa kwaa aa lɔ Korowii Dea la, dɛ ka paɡra burbur ken. O laa Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la ɡbeni tɔɔɡe, dɛ kwaa bɔra baa ɛ sarahare a ta dɛɛ tɛ voɡa Jerusalam bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: In every city and town in Judah he built local shrines to worship foreign gods. All of this made the Lord God of his ancestors very angry.
translation_verse: O berɔ ɛ bɔr tɛ voɡtoroma Juda harɛ ta bwɛjena ne bwɛɛre ta, dɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ harɛre ane voɡa. Anɔ ɡelɔ Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ la baah di o nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa Kooro Ahas aa ɛa la, ba chwera do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs. His son Hezekiah then became king.
translation_verse: Kooro Ahas sewɔ, asɛ ba ka huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Kɛ ba ta on koranar huɡribɔr huɡe, asɛ o bibaa Hɛsɛkea ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord by doing right, just as his ancestor David had done. The Temple Is Purified
translation_verse: O ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid ken.

english_verse: they went back to Hezekiah and said: Your Majesty, we have finished our work. The entire temple is now pure again, and so is the altar and its utensils, as well as the table for the sacred loaves of bread and its utensils.
translation_verse: Ate, Lewi dea tena la la Kooro Hɛsɛkea be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ya laa doŋa kpɔ Korowii Dea la bwa ta o do ɡoroŋ, ne kon baa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta ne o loɡa, ne teebur baa kpɔ paanoo aa do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ dawɛ o ta, dɛ o laala aa jaa bwa ta.

english_verse: Next, Hezekiah assigned the Levites to their places in the temple. He gave them cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments, according to the instructions that the Lord had given King David and the two prophets, Gad and Nathan.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɡelɔ Lewi dea tena la do Korowii Dea bela, dɛ kpoŋe kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, ɡɛ Kooro Devid ne Gad waa dɛ na chaahna, dɛ Korowii keame Netan aa baɡla la. Korowiirii cheɡɛ o keamere nɛɛ dɛ do ba.

english_verse: After that, Hezekiah and the crowd of worshipers bowed down and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Baa tonɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah tonɛ la, kooro ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la ɡuŋo, dɛ tomɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Then he called the priests and Levites to the east courtyard of the temple
translation_verse: Asɛ o ɡel sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ba cheme Korowii Dea dembaah wee leebɔr pera,

english_verse: and said: It's time to purify the temple of the Lord God of our ancestors. You Levites must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean, then go into the temple and bring out everything that is unclean and unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé Lewi dea tena hé no! Hé tɔ sie le he te cheɡ tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ he nɛɛ dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ Korowii ya naawa aa tomɔ Dea nɔ ta. Hé laa komɛlbwa aa ɡela o kah doŋa kpɔ o bini.

english_verse: Some of our ancestors were unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord our God. Not only did they turn their backs on the Lord, but they also completely ignored his temple.
translation_verse: Ya naawa waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ. Ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo o nɛɛ dɛ vɛoh, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo bela waa lole.

english_verse: They locked the doors, then let the lamps go out and stopped burning incense and offering sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Ba berɔ laa Korowii Dea la ɡbeni tɔɔɡe, dɛ ɡel kandere la dirimi, dɛ vɛh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, kɛɛ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah fueh Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la Dea bini.

english_verse: The Lord became terribly angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and everyone was shocked and horrified at what he did to punish them. Not only were
translation_verse: Korowii koh a wa, asɛ o baah di Juda ne Jerusalam tena nɛ, asɛ o tɛr ba deŋne nomɛlbwa bwara yɔr dɛɛ ɔmɛ. Hé ɡbabir jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: our ancestors killed in battle, but our own children and wives were taken captive.
translation_verse: Ba kpoo ya naawa laa ta, dɛ lawɛ ya haahna ne bii ɡe laa ta kaa.

english_verse: So I have decided to renew our agreement with the Lord God of Israel. Maybe then he will stop being so angry with us.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Kooro Hɛsɛkea kpɔ liire kɛŋɔ n ne Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ o baah bɛ ya nɛɛ di kohona.

english_verse: Let's not waste any time, my friends. You are the ones who were chosen to be the Lord's priests and to offer him sacrifices.
translation_verse: N bii, he bɛ bɔhwaah dɛɛ ɛ, dɛkalkɛ heyaa Korowii le ŋɔ he che o sie fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛo, dɛ́ tɔ nɛra sie baa tomɔ.”

english_verse: These leaders gathered together the rest of the Levites, and they all went through the ceremony to make themselves clean. Then they began to purify the temple according to the Law of the Lord, just as Hezekiah had commanded.
translation_verse: Baa yerɛ ba bala Lewi dea tena cheme, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ kpɔ dɛ do ɡoroŋ la, ba kaa jo Korowii Dea la ɡe bini, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ o ta o do ɡoroŋ, ɡɛ kooro la aa do ba ɡɛ Korowii wa aa dɛ baɡle la.

english_verse: The priests went into the temple and carried out everything that was unclean. They put these things in the courtyard, and from there, the Levites carried them outside the city to Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Sɔfore la ɡe jo Korowii Dea la bini, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta kpɔ, o do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ tenten. Ba pa komɛlbwa aa lɔ o bini dɛ kah doŋa le ba Korowii Dea dembaah bela. Asɛ Lewi dea tena la chea le bela ka ta Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen bini.

english_verse: The priests and Levites began their work on the first day of the first month. It took them one week to purify the courtyards of the temple and another week to purify the temple. So on the sixteenth day of that same month
translation_verse: Ba pa ɡɛ waa nɔ mun korobie waa tɔ sie la tɔpeloɡle ta, asɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, ba tel Korowii Dea pato la ta. Tɔpera anuatoro ja, dɛ ba tonɛ Korowii Dea la bini tenten toma. Ba tonɛ toma la bwa, korobie waa tɔ sie, o tɔpera fi dɛ anumɛl la ta. Korowii Dea kpɔe dɛ́ do Korowii nɔn ta nɛɛtena

english_verse: And we have brought back all the things that King Ahaz took from the temple during the time he was unfaithful to God. We purified them and put them back in front of the altar. Worship in the Temple
translation_verse: Ya berɔ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ kwaa ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Ahas aa di kora, o waa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii, o le a ne kaa la ba. A cheɡɛ saraha kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la sie bela taraken.”

english_verse: At once, Hezekiah called together the officials of Jerusalem, and they went to the temple.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Kooro Hɛsɛkea yerɛ Jerusalam nomonome bwa cheme, asɛ ba la Korowii Dea bela.

english_verse: They brought with them seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven goats as sacrifices to take away the sins of Hezekiah's family and of the people of Judah, as well as to purify the temple. Hezekiah told the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to sacrifice these animals on the altar.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ, ne pebiiri anuanɛ dɛ bombala anuanɛ, dɛ ka ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha tɛ harɛ la nɛra bwa, ne Korowii Dea la, dɛ Juda harɛ nɛra ɡe bwa. Kooro do Arɔn naanar baa ɛ sɔfore la ŋɔ, bá kpoo kwaa la kon baa kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta.

english_verse: The priests killed the bulls, the rams, and the lambs, then splattered the blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Asɛ sɔfore la tɔ sie kpoo nabala, dɛ kpoo pebala ne pebiiri la, dɛ kpɔ a chal merɛ kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta.

english_verse: They took the goats to Hezekiah and the worshipers, and they laid their hands on the animals.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ boohna baa kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha la ba kooro ne nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa sie, asɛ ba kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ a nɛ.

english_verse: The priests then killed the goats and splattered the blood on the altar as a sacrifice to take away the sins of everyone in Israel, because Hezekiah had commanded that these sacrifices be made for all the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Asɛ sɔfore la kpoo boohna la, dɛ ɛ a chal ba merɛ kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la ta, dɛ kpɔ soŋe Israel tena bwa wechɔɡa Korowii be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ kooro laanee do ba ŋɔ bá fuh kwaa ɛ saraha ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare la tɛ Israel tena bwa.

english_verse: The Levites were ready to play the instruments that had belonged to David; the priests were ready to blow the trumpets.
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ Lewi dea tena iro che, dɛ kpoŋe Kooro Devid kwaa waa dɛ hɛlɛ ane la, asɛ sɔfore la ɡe kpoŋe ba bɛle.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah gave the signal for the sacrifices to be burned on the altar, the musicians began singing praises to the Lord and playing their instruments,
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ ba kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah la ba kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la ta. Saraha ɛɛ la aa pa mun la, ba pa mun ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, asɛ bɛle ne kwaa Israel Kooro Devid aa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela ɡe ja.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing the songs of praise that David and Asaph the prophet had written. And so they bowed down and joyfully sang praises to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nomonome ŋɔ Lewi dea tena be ŋɔ, bá kpɔ yela Kooro Devid ne o keame Asaf waa dɛ na chaahna aa chwera la kpɛɛ Korowii. Anomanta, ba ɡo kpɛɛra yela silɛɛ ne, dɛ ɡuŋi tomɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Hezekiah said to the crowd, “Now that you are once again acceptable to the Lord, bring sacrifices and offerings to give him thanks.” The people did this, and some of them voluntarily brought animals to be offered as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Taraken te, he bwa kpɔ he te do Korowii nɔn ta, doŋa bɛlbwa toole he nɛɛ kpa. Hé kpo kwaa ɛ sarahare, dɛ́ kpɔ jam kwaa ba Korowii Dea.” Anomanta, ba ba sarahare ne jam sarahare ne, asɛ bane le ba bambile bini, dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah ba.

english_verse: There were not enough priests to skin all these animals, because many of the priests had not taken the time to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean. However, since all the Levites had made themselves clean, they helped the priests until the last animal was skinned.
translation_verse: Dɛ sɔfore la ta warɛ, dɛ́ won swe ola baa kpoora dɛ́ fuah ɛ saraha la, anomanta, ba bala Lewi dea tena la cha ba dɛ swea tonɛ. Gɛ saŋ dɛ sɔfore baa dɔ bɔr dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ warɔ. Dɛ Lewi dea tena la waa dɔ kasinteŋ doŋa laa dɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɡwaa sɔfore la kwara.

english_verse: Besides all the sacrifices that were burned on the altar, the fat from the other animal sacrifices was burned, and the offerings of wine were poured over the altar. So the temple was once again used for worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah la warɔ, dɛ ja ola noorare baa fuah ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, ne sen sarahare la ta. Gɛɛ a do ba berɛ kwaa pa mun, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii Dea la bini.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people of Judah celebrated, because God had helped them make this happen so quickly.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne nɛra la bwa sie lɛo, Korowii chae waa cha ba ba ɛ a ɡɛ waa la bwa warane la.

english_verse: Everyone from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north was invited. This was the largest crowd of people that had ever celebrated Passover, according to the official records.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba yerɛ Israel harɛ nɛra le Dan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ka le Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr ŋɔ, bá ba cheme Jerusalam dɛ́ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la sɔn ta. Dɛ nɛra ta warɛ dɛ ba di tɔpejen la, ɡɛ baa chwerɛ o waa do tɔn bini la bwa.

english_verse: Hezekiah's messengers went everywhere in Israel and Judah with the following letter: People of Israel, now that you have survived the invasion of the Assyrian kings, it's time for you to turn back to the Lord God our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob worshiped. If you do this, he will stop being angry.
translation_verse: Kooro la ɡelɔ toroma kpɔ tɔne la kaa Israel ne Juda harɛre bwa ta kɛŋɔ, “Israel tena, he le Asiiria tena laa baa yo heyaa la nyoa. Hé berɛ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɔ la, ásɛ o ɡe lawɛ heyaa ba o be.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. Decide now to obey the Lord our God! Come to Jerusalem and worship him in the temple that will belong to him forever. Then he will stop being angry,
translation_verse: He bɛ lwɛmkpeɡ ɛ kɛ ban, dɛ́ kpɔ he te do Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la lɔɡa. Hé ba o Dea waa ɡela o do ɡoroŋ saŋ bɛlbwa la bini Jerusalam, dɛɛ tomɔ ásɛ o bandia le he nɛ.

english_verse: and the enemies that have captured your families will show pity and send them back home. The Lord God is kind and merciful, and if you turn back to him, he will no longer turn his back on you.
translation_verse: Dɛ he berɔ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii aa, aa ɡeloo nɛra baa lawɛ he lolanar laa ta kaa la dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ ba berɛ ba ya harɛ nɔ ta. Dɛkalkɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔ tedoma dɛɛ na nɛn sum. Hé ba o be naa, waa habɔɔ berɛ kpo heya.”

english_verse: Only a few people from the tribes of Asher, West Manasseh, and Zebulun were humble and went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ba bini bane le Aasa ne Manasɛ, dɛ Sebulon deene ta, dɛ sɛh kɛŋɔ baa ba Jerusalamee.

english_verse: God also made everyone in Judah eager to do what Hezekiah and his officials had commanded. Passover Is Celebrated
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Korowii ɛ, dɛ ja Juda tena nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba dɔ nyopɛo, dɛ teŋɛ waa kooro ne o nomonome aa do ba la ta, ɡɛ waa bola la. Galekaa Tɔpejen dii

english_verse: In the second month, a large crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Korobinɛɛte ta la, nɛra warɔ dɛ ba cheme Jerusalam, dɛ di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen.

english_verse: Most of the people that came from Ephraim, West Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun had not made themselves clean, but they ignored God's Law and ate the Passover lambs anyway. Hezekiah found out what they had done and prayed, “Lord God, these people are unclean according to the laws of holiness. But they are worshiping you, just as their ancestors did. So, please be kind and forgive them.”
translation_verse: “N Naa Korowii ya naawa aa tomɛ, che he wer haa doa ta dɛ́ kpɔ kɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ bambile bwa ne nɔ, a lole kɛŋɔ ba ta doŋa laa kpɔ ba nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered Hezekiah's prayer and did not punish them.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii no Kooro Hɛsɛkea wesoŋa la, o kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, o ta ban wobɛlbwa ɛɛ.

english_verse: The worshipers in Jerusalem were very happy and celebrated the Festival for seven days. The Levites and priests sang praises to the Lord every day and played their instruments.
translation_verse: Israel tena aa baa cheme Jerusalam la, ba di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen la silɛɛ kohona ne, tɔpera anuanɛ. Asɛ Lewi dea tena ne sɔfore ɡe kpɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ lɔ yela, dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii kohona tɔpere bɛlbwa, bokpeɡa bwa ne.

english_verse: Hezekiah thanked the Levites for doing such a good job, leading the celebration. The worshipers celebrated for seven days by offering sacrifices, by eating the sacred meals, and by praising the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea jam Lewi dea tena wejema ne kpɛɛra baa dɔa, dɛ kpɔ cha tɔpejen la dii la. Tɔpera anuanɛ bwa la, ba tɛɛ ba saraha kwaa aa ɛ ba dibɔra la ba di, dɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la.

english_verse: Everyone was so excited that they agreed to celebrate seven more days.
translation_verse: Nɛra la bwa sɛoh kɛŋɔ ba berɛ di tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ ja. Anomanta, ba berɔ di tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ silɛɛ ne ja.

english_verse: Everyone was very happy, including those from Judah and Israel, the priests and Levites, and the foreigners living in Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Juda tena baa cheme bela sie lɛo kohona, ba ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ Israel tena baa ba bela bwa, ne hɔɔhra baa le Israel ne Juda harɛre ta bwa.

english_verse: It was the biggest celebration in Jerusalem since the days of King Solomon, the son of David.
translation_verse: Silɛɛ kohona ba Jerusalam, dɛkalkɛ, le Kooro Devid bibaa Kooro Solomɔn aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bwa, a ɡɛ waa nɔ dɔŋa ta chiɡe bwa.

english_verse: The priests and Levites asked God to bless the people, and from his home in heaven, he did.
translation_verse: Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la iro, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ nɛra la, asɛ Korowii no ba wesoŋa le nyundua dɛ ɛ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Hezekiah divided the priests and Levites into groups, according to their duties. Then he assigned them the responsibilities of offering sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He also appointed people to serve at the temple and to sing praises at the temple gates.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea bɔne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la bini, ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa ɛɛ ɛ o toma. Asɛ ba fuh kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛro o Dea doonyoo la ta.

english_verse: The official records also included their wives and children, because they had also been faithful in keeping themselves clean and acceptable to serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Bane ba haahna ne ba bechale, dɛ nɛra ba ne baa soɡa sɔnaa ba chwerɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ ɛ toma baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: He told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings that were to be given to the priests and Levites, so that they would have time to serve the Lord with their work.
translation_verse: Kooro berɔ ŋɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, bá kpɔ saraha kwaa aa chɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ aa ɛ, ásɛ ba won kpɔ ba te tɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ Korowii Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle.

english_verse: After the Festival, the people went to every town in Judah and smashed the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. They destroyed all the local shrines and foreign altars in Judah, as well as those in the territories of Benjamin, Ephraim, and West Manasseh. Then everyone went home. Offerings for the Priests and Levites
translation_verse: Baa di tɔpejen la tonɛ la, Israel tena baa lɔ bela la jo Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta, dɛ paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ teŋni voɡ Asera dajaŋa ta. Ba chɔɡ bɔra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡare deŋɡarere ta, ne kwaa baa dɛ ɛ sarahare a ta, Juda harɛ ne Bɛnjamen ne Efrem, dɛ Manasɛ harɛre deene ta bwa. Baa chɔɡ a bwa tonɛ la, asɛ ba bwa berɛ kaa ba bwɛɛre.

english_verse: Hezekiah provided animals from his own herds and flocks to use for the morning and evening sacrifices, as well as for the sacrifices during the Sabbath celebrations, the New Moon Festivals, and the other religious feasts required by the Law of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea lawɛ o ɡbaɡba nae ne boohna ne peera tɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ɛ sarahare baa dɛ fuah chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra, ne Ona Tɔpera ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, dɛ tɔpejena ane baa lea cheɡ ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Mmara tɔn bini la.

english_verse: The people from the other towns of Judah brought a tenth of their herds and flocks, as well as a tenth of anything they had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel ne Juda baala baa soɡe Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta ɡe bɔne ba nae ne boohna dɛ peera bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋa ba. Gɛɛ ba kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii ba, dɛ bila a daŋɛ chɔ.

english_verse: The people started bringing their offerings to Jerusalem in the third month, and the last ones arrived four months later.
translation_verse: Ba pa mun le korobitooro te ta ba koŋkɛɛla la ne, dɛ ba tel korobinuanɛ te ta.

english_verse: When Hezekiah and his officials saw these offerings, they thanked the Lord and the people.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nomonome aa baa na ɡɛ koŋkɛɛla la aa daŋa chɔ la, ba kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ o nɛra Israel tena.

english_verse: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the large amount of offerings.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea pɛɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la koŋkɛɛla nɔ wa,

english_verse: The high priest at the time was Azariah, a descendant of Zadok, and he replied, “Ever since the people have been bringing us their offerings, we have had more than enough food and supplies. The Lord has certainly blessed his people. Look at how much is left over!”
translation_verse: asɛ Sɔfonomoa Asaria waa ɛ Sadɔk lole la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ le saŋ nɛra la aa pa mun kpɔ koŋkɛɛla dɛɛ ba Korowii Dea bonɔ la, ya dɔɔ dɛɛ di, ásɛ ane ka chɔ warɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii swee o nɛra andɛɛɡa, asɛ andamanta nɔ ta ka dɛ daŋɛ chɔ la.”

english_verse: So the king gave orders for storerooms to be built in the temple, and when they were completed,
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɡel ba kwaa deene baa dɛɛ cheɡ laala a bini Korowii Dea bɔr bela.

english_verse: all the extra offerings were taken there. Hezekiah and Azariah then appointed Conaniah the Levite to be in charge of these storerooms. His brother Shimei was his assistant, and the following Levites worked with them: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah.
translation_verse: Ba le Lewi dea tena nɛra fi ŋɔ bá do Konania ne o nime Simee lɔɡa dɛɛ ɛ toma bela. Banee, Jehiel ne Asasia ne Nahat, ne Asahɛl ne Jerimot ne Josabad ne Eliel, ne Ismakia ne Mahat dɛ Bɛnaya. Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Sɔfonomoa Asaria kpeɡri taa a che, ba lee ba.

english_verse: Kore son of Imnah was assigned to guard the East Gate, and he was put in charge of receiving the offerings voluntarily given to God and of dividing them among the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Lewi dea te Imna bibaa Koree ba le wɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ chɔ sarahare koŋkɛɛla aa le nɛra bambile ta ba kpɔ baa tɛ Korowii ne a bɔna nyoa.

english_verse: He had six assistants who were responsible for seeing that all the priests in the other towns of Judah also got their share of these offerings. They were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah. Every priest and every Levite over
translation_verse: Ba berɔ dɛɛ tɛ bibaala baa di bene atoro, kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa ba chwerɛ ba sɔna teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la. Gɛ ba bini bɛlbwa waa jo Korowii Dea bela, ka ɛ toma baa kpɔa do o nɔn ta tɔpere bɛlbwa la aa doa.

english_verse: Hezekiah also appointed other men to take food and supplies to the priests and Levites whose homes were in the pastureland around the towns of Judah. But the priests had to be descendants of Aaron, and the Levites had to be listed in the official records.
translation_verse: Kɛ sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar dɛ so harɛre baa dɛ parɛ a ta, dɛ so ba bwɛɛre ta kɛɛ bobɛlbwa la te, ba le baala ba bɔne kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ baala baa le sɔfore dea, ne nomɛlbwa baa chwerɛ o sɔn o le Lewi dea la bwa.

english_verse: Everything Hezekiah did while he was king of Judah, including what he did for the temple in Jerusalem, was right and good. He was a successful king, because he obeyed the Lord God with all his heart.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɛa Korowii Dea Jerusalam, ne ɡɛ waa teŋɛ Korowii Mmarare, ne waa waa doo a ta bambile bwa ne la ɡelɔ o wobɛlbwa chiɡu kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The officials said all these things in Hebrew, so that everyone listening from the city wall would understand and be terrified and surrender.
translation_verse: Ate, nomonome la kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ bol waa waa bola la Hibru tena wobol ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ nɛra baa cheɡɛ Jerusalam danjwɛɛ ta ɔmɛ, ásɛ o dɔ bɔr ba lawɛ bwɛjen la tena.

english_verse: You've heard what my ancestors and I have done to other nations. Were the gods of those nations able to defend their land against us?
translation_verse: Hé ta ɡɛ n ne n naawa aa kpɔa ɛ harɛre nɛra noɛ kɛɛ? Gɛ harɛre la voɡare wono lɛ a nɛra le n nɔn ta naa?

english_verse: The Lord rescued Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from Sennacherib and also protected them from other enemies.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do Korowii lɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Jerusalam tena le Asiiria koojen Senakerib, ne ba dɔma baa kaa bwa nɔn ta. O ɡelɔ ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna le harɛre aa bar ba nɛra nɛ.

english_verse: he and his officials worked out a plan to cut off the supply of water outside the city, so that the Assyrians would have no water when they came to attack. The officials got together a large work force that stopped up the springs and streams near Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Belaa nɛra warɛ dɛ cheme, dɛ tɔɔɡe neerare nyuune bwa, ne nee waa pala dɛ kpɔ harɛ la ta bwa dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ Asiiria koranar ba ya be dɛ́ ba na nee nyɔ aa?”

english_verse: Hezekiah's workers also repaired the broken sections of the city wall. Then they built defense towers and an outer wall to help protect the one already there. The landfill on the east side of David's City was also strengthened. He gave orders to make a large supply of weapons and shields,
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɛ toma taeh, dɛ ɡel ba kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la bobɛla aa kuuɡa la, dɛ ma dejaŋa chɔŋɛ danjwɛɛ la ta. translation_verse: Kooro nomonome ɡe le ba bambile ta kpɔ kwaa tɛ nɛra la ne sɔfore dɛ Lewi dea tena. english_verse: When everything was ready to celebrate Passover, the priests and the Levites stood where Josiah had told them.
translation_verse: Baa ɛ wobɛlbwa tonɛ, dɛ pa Galekaa Tɔpejen la dii mun la, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la kaa che ba chebɔra ɡɛ Kooro Josia aa ŋɔa la.

english_verse: During the celebration some of the Levites prepared Passover animals for the musicians and the guards, so that the Levite musicians would not have to leave their places, which had been assigned to them according to the instructions of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king's prophet. translation_verse: Asaf naanar bane baa ɛ yelɡoola, yon ka che ba chebɔra, ɡɛ Kooro Devid ne Asaf ne Heman, dɛ kooro keame Jedutun aa do ba la. Nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la ta chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa le kɛrɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba bala Lewi dea tena la daa Galekaa Tɔpejen kondikwaa la ane baa tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: The message said: I am King Cyrus of Persia. The Lord God of heaven has made me the ruler of every nation on earth. He has also chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. The Lord God will watch over any of his people who want to go back to Judah.
