english_verse: The people followed the rules for celebrating the Festival of Shelters and offered the proper sacrifices each day.
translation_verse: Ba di Kukure Tɔpejen ɡɛ baa chwerɛ o waa bil la, dɛ fuh kwaa ɛ sarahare ɡɛ aa chɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices to please the Lord, sacrifices at each New Moon Festival, and sacrifices at the rest of the Lord's festivals. Every offering the people had brought voluntarily was also presented to the Lord.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, ba kpɔ kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ ɛ sarahare tɔpere bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ Korobifale ne saraha kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɔpejena aa do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii la ne, dɛ anɔ la aa le nɛra bambile ta, ba kpɔ ba ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii la.

english_verse: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year. The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
translation_verse: Korobie anuanɛ tɔpeloɡle ta la, ba pa mun fuh kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ ba ta Korowii Dea la mun pae mɔɔ. Korowii Dea kwaara dɛ́ ma mumpar

english_verse: King Cyrus of Persia had said the Israelites could have cedar trees brought from Lebanon to Joppa by sea. So they sent grain, wine, and olive oil to the cities of Tyre and Sidon as payment for these trees, and they gave money to the stoneworkers and carpenters.
translation_verse: Ate, nɛra la tɛ suuɡa baa kpɔ bɔ tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ peɡri bwea ne kapenta tena, dɛ berɛ kpɔ kondikwaa ne sen dɛ ɔleve noo ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ka tɛ bwɛjena Sidon ne Taaya tena, ásɛ ba kpɔ ka charɛ peleme daa le Lɛbanɔn, ásɛ dɛ taɡa kpɔ mpo sie ba Jopa, ɡɛ Pɛɛsea Koojen Saeros aa bola la.

english_verse: During the second month of the second year after the people had returned from Babylonia, they started rebuilding the Lord's temple. Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned started working. Every Levite over
translation_verse: Anomanta, bennɛɛte korobinɛɛte ta nɛra la aa le bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba la, dɛ daa la tel bela baa dɛ ba Korowii Dea la doe Jerusalam, asɛ ba pa o mun. Ate, Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne Josadak bibaa Jesua, dɛ bwɛɛla la kar ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la bwa kaa ja dɛɛ ɛ toma la. Ba le Lewi dea tena baa di bene fifraanɛ, kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa la ba ɛ nomonome dɛɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ ma Korowii Dea la nɛ.

english_verse: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
translation_verse: Jesua ne o bibaala dɛ o nimanar, ne Kadmiel ne o bibaala baa ɛ Hodavia naanar, ne Henadad bibaala, ne ba ɡe bibaala ne ba dɔɔranar ne nimanar, ba bwa aa ɛ Lewi dea tena la bwa pɛo dɛ ba ja, dɛɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea toma la nɛ.

english_verse: When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David.
translation_verse: Mamaala la aa pa Korowii Dea la mun la, sɔfore do ba laala dɛ ka che ba chebɔra dɛ kpoŋe bɛle, asɛ Lewi dea tena baa ɛ Asaf bibaala kpoŋe kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛ ka che ba chebɔra, dɛ lɔ dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, ɡɛ Israel Kooro Devid fa aa do Israel tena la.

english_verse: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: “The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever.” Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.
translation_verse: Ba ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii dɛ jaamo ŋɔ, “Korowii wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin Israel tena lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Asɛ nɛra la bwa moo kohona dɛ jam Korowii, dɛkalkɛ ba pa Korowii Dea la mun.

english_verse: Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Kɛ sɔfore baa ɛ nomonome ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ nomonnyuune baa tɔ sie na loɡle Dea la aa cheɡa dɛɛ nyiŋi baa pa Dea la mun la, ba wio dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ bane ɡe ɛɛ do silɛɛ lɔŋɔre.

english_verse: Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ banɔ la baa dɛ wi, ne banɔ la baa sie aa lɛa kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ɡbɔɡa aa lɔ bela kan kohona dɛɛ la bojaŋ.

english_verse: The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Juda ne Bɛnjamen tena dɔma noɔ kɛŋɔ Israel tena baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta la berɔ ba, dɛ berɛ baa do Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la Korowii Dea.

english_verse: So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba ba Sɛrobabɛl ne deene nomonnyuune la be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya ba cha heya Korowii Dea nɔ toma ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii beŋkpoŋ nɔɔ ya bwa ɛɛ tomɛ, dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo dɛ le saŋ Asiiria koojen Esaahadon aa ba ya ne bonɔ ba so bwa.”

english_verse: But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
translation_verse: Kɛ Sɛrobabɛl ne Jesua, dɛ Israel deene nomonnyuune la chaŋɔ ŋɔ, “Ya ta he chae hiaeh Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea toma nɔ ta. Ya ɡbo ɛɛ doo, ɡɛ Pɛɛsea Koojen Saeros aa do yaa la.”

english_verse: Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building.
translation_verse: Belaa nɛra baa soɡa bar ba la pa mun dɛɛ chɔɡ Juu tena la liire, a ɡel baa ɔmɛ Korowii Dea la toma ɛɛ.

english_verse: During the time that Cyrus was king and even until Darius became king, they kept bribing government officials to slow down the work. Trouble Rebuilding Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ba yawɛ Pɛɛsea harɛ nomonome sen ŋɔ bá chɔɡ vɔrɔwa bɛlbwa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe Dea la toma wa, dɛ le Pɛɛsea Koojena Saeros ne Dareɔs kora dii saŋ bwa. Jerusalam kwaara dɛ́ ma webeɡra waa ja

english_verse: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Koojen Sɛksɛs kora dii mumpar la, ba dɔma la chwerɛ waa yaɡɛ Juda ne Jerusalam tena.

english_verse: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta la, baala bane baa dɛ yer ba Bislam ne Mitredat, ne Tabeel dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛ chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Koojen Atasɛksɛs. Aram tena wobol taa ba chwera, asɛ nɛn waa kure la, ó baɡle a mun.

english_verse: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
translation_verse: Waa aa teŋa nɔɔ ba chwera do tɔn bini. “Tɔn nɔ dɛ ba Koojen Atasɛksɛs be, dɛ le he bonɔɔna baa soɡe Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr la be. Ya dɛ nae kohona.

english_verse: You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations.
translation_verse: N naa kooro, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Juu tena baa le he harɛre ta dɛ ba la kaa Jerusalam, dɛ berɛ ka kwaa dɛɛ ma deŋnekpeɡ ne nyubinikpeɡ tena bwɛjen la ja. Ba kwaarɔ dɛɛ ma o danjwɛɛre, dɛɛ kwaa a mune la ɡe.

english_verse: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
translation_verse: N naa kooro, berɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ ba wono kwaa do bwɛjen nɔ tonaa, baa toɔ bɛlbwaa bɔ tɛɛ kpa, ásɛ komɛlbwa aa he kara munii do kpa.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: Yaa lɔ he lɔɡa nɔ, yaa nyin kɛŋɔ sihiih ba kpoe haa wola duuree dɔ, anomanta, ya kpɔ kala nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ,

english_verse: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.
translation_verse: ásɛ he nyiŋi koranar baa tɔ he sie di kara la tɔne bini, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ Jerusalam ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena bwɛ, dɛɛ ha ba koranar ne harɛ nomonome. Deŋnekpeɡ tena lɔ o ta le saŋ la bwa. A waa o fa chɔɡ la.

english_verse: If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
translation_verse: Ya ɡelɔ hɛɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ, dɛ ba wono ma bwɛjen nɔ ne o danjwɛɛre tonaa, haa won di kpeɡri bɛlbwa harɛre aa chɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛre nɛra nɛɛ kpa.”

english_verse: After your letter was translated and read to me,
translation_verse: Ba kure tɔn haa chwera la n sie, dɛ baɡle o bini waa n no.

english_verse: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.
translation_verse: N le nɛra ŋɔ bá nyiŋi tɔne bini, asɛ ba na kɛŋɔ, le saŋ la bwaa Jerusalam tena le dɛ le ba koranar habɔɔ, a che a ta deŋnekpeɡ ne wesaɡasaɡare su o ta.

english_verse: And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
translation_verse: Koranar baa kpeɡa Jerusalam di kora dɛ nyiŋi harɛ waa chɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr baŋ le bwa ta, dɛ ɡel ba bɔ toɔre dɛ lɛ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡel ba ŋɔ baala baa dɛ ɛ toma la be ŋɔ bá ɡel ka tel kɛŋɔ, n ɡbabir aa tɛ ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ waa nɔ vɛh, ásɛ a ba chɔɡ n liire maa dɔa Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la ta.”

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: Baa kure Kooro Atasɛksɛs tɔn la waa baɡle Rehum ne Simsai dɛ nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la, ba ɛ warane la Jerusalam dɛ ka ŋɔ Juu tena la be ŋɔ bá ɡel Dea la toma ɛɛ.

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba ɡelɔ Korowii Dea la toma ka che, ka tel kɛŋɔ Koojen Dareɔs aa baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ bene anɛ ta.

english_verse: Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii keamere Haɡae ne Sekaria waa ɛ Ido naa, pa mun dɛɛ bol Korowii waa Juu tena ne banɔ la baa lɔ Jerusalam be, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta.

english_verse: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
translation_verse: Ate, Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne Josadak bibaa Jesua aa no ba waa la, ba berɛ pa mun dɛɛ do Korowii Dea la Jerusalam ja, asɛ Korowii keamere banɛ la cha ba.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ la, Tatenai waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Yufretis Moo harɛ baŋ ne Sɛta Bosenai, dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ la ba ba be, dɛ ka bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Umee tɛ heyaa kpeɡri ŋɔ he berɛ kwaa do Korowii Dea nɔ cheɡ o buɡ bene ta nɔ?”

english_verse: Give us the names of the workers!”
translation_verse: Ba berɔ bɔɔ ŋɔ “Nɛra baa dɛ ma Dea nɔ sɔne ɛrɔɔ?”

english_verse: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la sie lɔ Juu tena nomonome la nɛ, a ɡel Pɛɛsea nomonome la ta wone ɛ wobɛlbwa, ka tel kɛŋɔ baa chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Koojen Dareɔs, asɛ o chaŋ ba mɔɔ.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors sent a report to Darius,
translation_verse: Tatenai ne Sɛta Bosenai dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ bwa chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Kooro Dareɔs.

english_verse: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
translation_verse: N naa kooro, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya la Juu tena harɛ ta, bela Korowii waa kana la Dea aa lole ba berɛ kwaa dɛɛ mao la. Bwejena nee baa mao, dɛ kpɔ dadɛɛɡa dawɛ o danjwɛɛre ta. Ba toma ɛɛ wer, dɛɛ kaa wɔrɔbe nɛ, ɡɛ baa chaɡ ba la.

english_verse: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.
translation_verse: Ya bɔɔ ba nomonome ŋɔ, ‘Umee tɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ he berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea nɔɔ?’

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: Ya berɔ bɔɔ ba ba nomonome sɔna, ɡɛ aa ɛ ya won ɡel he jemɛ nɛra baa chɔ ba nyoa.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: Waa baa chaŋe yaa teŋa nɔ. ‘Ya ɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ne harɛ bonɔɔna, asɛ ya berɛ kwaa dɛɛ ma Korowii Dea ba fa aa mao saŋ la bwa la. Israel kooro bɛl o fa aa dɛ di kpeɡri kohona laanee pa o mun dɛ tonɔ.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Kɛ ya naanar aa ir Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua bandia nomanta, o kpɔ ba do Kooro Nebukadnesa waa ɛ Babelɔn kooro nɔn ta. Kooro Nebukadnesa chɔɡ o Dea la, dɛ lawɛ nɛra la kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn.

english_verse: Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Sɛsbasa balɔ dɛ ba pa Korowii Dea la mun Jerusalam. Nɛra ta lɔ o ta dɛɛ ɛ toma baa wola tonɛ mɔɔ.’

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: N naa kooro, dɛ he sie lɛo waa, ɡel ba nyiŋi koranar tɔne bini bwɛjen Babelɔn, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ Koojen Saeros tɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ bá kwaa ma Korowii Dea nɔ Jerusalam kɛɛ o ta ŋɔe, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ya jemɛ he liire aa lɔ waa nɔ ta.”

english_verse: King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Koojen Dareɔs do mmara ŋɔ, bá nyiŋi koranar tɔne baa kpɔa cheɡ Babelɔn la bini.

english_verse: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show
translation_verse: Baa ka dɛ nyiŋi la, ba na tɔn bɛl bwɛjen baa dɛ yerɔ Ɛkbatana waa lɔ Midia harɛ ta, asɛ ba chwerɛ waa aa teŋa nɔ o bini ŋɔ,

english_verse: with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ bwea atoro ma chɔŋɛ ɛ o danjwɛɛre ta bar aa, dɛ ba kpɔ dola dawɛ a ta. Koodem bela suuɡaa bá kpɔ bɔ a kem.

english_verse: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places. King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa jaa ɡee kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa aa lɔ Korowii Dea, Koojen Nebukadnesa aa paa le Jerusalam ba Babelɔn la, a chɛ kɛ bá berɛ kaa ane a buɡ ta bela tenten a fa aa cheɡa, Korowii Dea Jerusalam.” Koojen Dareɔs do nɛra bá berɛ ɛ toma

english_verse: King Darius sent this message: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple.
translation_verse: Ate, Koojen Dareɔs chaŋe dɛ ŋɔ, “Name Tatenai waa ɛ nomonjen dɛɛ nyiŋi Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ ta, ne Sɛta Bosenai ne he bala nomonome haa lɔ harɛ la ta la, hé le bela kaa.

english_verse: Starting at once, I am ordering you to help the leaders by paying their expenses from the tax money collected in Western Province.
translation_verse: N dɛ do heyaa kɛŋɔ hé cha ba, ásɛ ba won mao. Hé kpɔ suuɡa aa le Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ baa bɔa dɛɛ do kara mun la, dɛɛ bɔ Dea la toma bɛlbwa kem, ɡɛ aa ɛ toma la bɛ ba ka che.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛlbwa a chɛ kɛ hé nyiŋi dɛɛ tɛ sɔfore baa lɔ Jerusalam kwaa baa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛɛ ba. Nabali ne peera, dɛ pebiiri baa fuh ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua, ne jaaɡe ne yar ne sen dɛ ɔleve no. He bɛ ban dɛɛ vɔmɛ,

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba won dɛɛ ɛ sarahare aa dɛɛ su Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua siwi, dɛ́ soŋe tɛ kooro ne o bibaala ɡe.

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: N berɔ dɛɛ do heyaa kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ waa nɔ ta la, bá tɛr dola le o dea ta dɛ́ seɡre o nyoa dɛ́ kpɔ tooh ó saɡɛ. O wechɔɡa waa ɛa nomanta, o dem paɡre dɛ́ berɛ puldoa.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: Korowii waa le Jerusalam cheɡ ŋɔ nɛra ba bela dɛ́ baa tomɔ la, ó ir kooro kɛɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra baa vɛh waa nɔ ta teŋa, kɛɛ dɛ́ ka chɔɡ Korowii Dea nɔ la. Men Koojen Dareɔs, menee do ɡɛ mmara nɔ. Bɛlbwa nyiŋi dɛɛ teŋɛ o ta kɛrɛdɛ.” Korowii Dea kpɔe dɛ́ do o nɔn ta

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Korowii keamere Haɡae ne Sekaria ɡbemba baa do Juu tena nomonome la nomanta, Korowii Dea toma la kaa sie ɡɛ aa chɛa. Ba tonɛ Dea la toma ɡɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, ne Pɛɛsea harɛ Koojena Saeros, ne Dareɔs dɛ Atasɛksɛs aa do ba la.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora bene anumɛl, Adar korobie tɔpetooro wee taa ba ma Korowii Dea la tonɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Belaa Israel tena bwa, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ nɛra baa kaa dɛ le bojaŋ harɛ, dɛ berɛ ba la bwa kpɔ silɛɛ kohona, dɛ kpɔ Dea la do Korowii nɔn ta.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Dea la kpɔe dɛ do Korowii nɔn ta la, ba kpɔ nabala lafa ne pebala lafraanɛ, dɛ pebali lafraanaarɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛ berɛ kpɔ bombala fi dɛ anɛ, bɛlbwa che tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la, dɛ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ Israel tena bwa.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: Ba bɔne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la bini ɡɛ bɛlbwa toma aa doa Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bini, ɡɛ baa chwera do Mosis Tɔn bini la. Galekaa Tɔpejen dii

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Korobie waa tɔ sie la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta la, nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛ ba la, di Galekaa Tɔpejen la.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la tɔ sie laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛ, dɛ do ɡoroŋ. Asɛ Lewi dea tena la kpo Galekaa pebie la tɛ nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛ ba la bwa, ne ba bala sɔfore dɛ ba ɡbabir.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Israel tena baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛ ba la, ne nɛra baa pere ba te le waa nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ aa dɛ ɛa nɛɛ, dɛ so harɛ la ta bwa pɛo, dɛ ba tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen kondikwaa la.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: Ba di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole A Ta Tɔpejen tɔpera anuanɛ silɛɛ ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii charɛ Asiiria koojen liire, o won cha ba ba ma Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Dea la.

english_verse: Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest. Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Ɛsra nɔ ɛ sɔfo dɛ le Babelɔn ba. Dɛ o ɛ chicha ɡe, dɛ jemɛ mmarare Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛ Mosis la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ baɡla. Komɛlbwa waa bɔɔ le koojen be la, o dɛ tɛo, dɛkalkɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la nɔn dawɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
translation_verse: Israel tena la bane ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne yelɡoola, ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo, dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ɡe ba Jerusalam, ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Atasɛksɛs aa di kora bene anuanɛ ta.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: Korobiloɡle tɔpere waa tɔ sie taa ba pa mun le Babelɔn harɛ ta, asɛ korobie anue tɔpeloɡle ne tela dɛ Korowii chao o ba tel Jerusalam.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Koojen Atasɛksɛs chwerɛ waa aa teŋa nɔ tɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa bera ɛ chicha dɛ jemɛ Korowii Mmarare ne waa waa do Israel tena a ta la bini kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: “Tɔn nɔ le men Atasɛksɛs maa ɛ koranar bwa koojen be. N chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ sɔfo Ɛsra haa ɛ chicha, dɛɛ baɡle Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua la Mmarare. N dɛ nae.

english_verse: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
translation_verse: Men Koojen, ne n nomonome banuanɛ baa dɛ ja mɛ, dɛ tomɛ ŋɔ he ka bɔɔ dɛ na kɛ nɛra dɛ teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la mmarare waa kpɔa do he nɔn ta la ta kɛɛ.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm koojen ne nɛra baa dɛ jao aa le ba bambile bini, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, o Dea do Jerusalam la.

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Berɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm haa dɔa le Babelɔn harɛ ta, ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare Israel tena ne ba sɔfore aa kpɔa tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bwa.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ kpɔ a ɡɛ suuɡa nɔ yawɛ nabala ne pebala ne pebiiri, dɛ mea sarahare ne sen sarahare, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ saraha Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la Dea, kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta Jerusalam la ta.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm bɛlbwa aa ka la, he ne he bala Juu tena ɛɛ won kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa aa wera tɛ heya, ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.
translation_verse: Kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm loɡa baa kpɔa do he nɔn ta, ba kpɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ Dea la bwa ka tɛo Jerusalam.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin dɛ ja Korowii Dea bini la, hé lɛa le suuɡa aa le kooro kara mun ka yawɛ.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: Taraken, men Koojen Atasɛksɛs dɛ do Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ nɛra baa dɛ cheɡ n harɛ suuɡare la ŋɔ, bá do sie tɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua chicha dɛɛ baɡle o Mmarare bini la komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin,

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua aa baɡla la, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɡel á ɛ ɡɛ aa chɛa tɛo o Dea bela. Ásɛ o baah bɛ n nɛɛ kɛɛ kooro bɛlbwa waa ba di kora n habɔɔ nɛɛ di.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: Hen sɔfo Ɛsra, che wejema Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa tɛɛ ta, dɛ le nomonome ne banɔ la baa jemɛ waa bola dɛɛ pa bole, ásɛ baa nyiŋi nɛra baa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ ta nɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ Mmarare ta. Takapɔ chaɡle banɔ la ɡe baa wola mmarare la jemɛ la.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ mmarare kɛɛ koojen mmarare ta la, a chɛ kɛ bá kpoo buɡ la ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ doŋu le o harɛ ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o komɛlbwa waa dɔa ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ lawɔ ka do dea, ásɛ a ɛ deŋnetɛra tɛo.” Sɔfo Ɛsra Korowii kpɛɛra

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ate, sɔfo Ɛsra ŋɔ, “Korowii ya naawa aa tomɔ laanee dɔ jam. Onee ɡela Koojen Atasɛksɛs dɔ liire, dɛ ɡel ba berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea waa do ken, dɛ dɔ jirima cheɡ Jerusalam.

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: O berɔ sune n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ n dɔ jirima koojen ne o nɛra baa dɛ jao, dɛ o nomonjena baa kpeɡa bwa sie. Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ja n nɛɛ nomanta, n dɔ ɡbemba dɛ won boa Israel deene nomonnyuune nyoa, asɛ n ne ba berɛ ba Jerusalam.”

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ Israel deene nomonnyuune baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn la, nɛra baa teŋɛ sɔfo Ɛsra nɛɛ ba Jerusalam ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora laanee nɔ.

english_verse: polished bronze articles as valuable as gold.
translation_verse: Fenehas naanar bini, Gɛɛsɔm. Itama naanar bini, Daneɛl, Devid naanar bini, Hatus

english_verse: Gershom of the Phinehas family; Daniel of the Ithamar family; Hattush son of Shecaniah of the David family; Zechariah and
translation_verse: Biɡvai naanar bini, Utai ne Sakur, asɛ baala fifraanuanɛ ja ba nɛ. Sɔfo Ɛsra berɔ ba Jerusalam

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He fa le he ne laala nɔ bwa cheɡ tɛ Korowii dɛ do ɡoroŋ wubwa. Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm la ɛ saraha kwaa aa le nɛra bambile bini ba kpɔ ba tɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ la.

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Ate, men sɔfo Ɛsra boa nɛra baa le harɛfale ta ba la nyoa, bɔɔ bɛl baa kwiu asɛ nee palɛ kpɔ o bini dɛɛ kaa Ahava ta, asɛ ya so bela tɔpera atoro. Maa nyiŋi nɛra la ne sɔfore la bini la, n ta Lewi dea te bɛlbwa nae.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n yerɛ Eliesa ne Areɛl ne Sɛmaya, ne Ɛl Netan ne Jarib ne Ɛl Netan, ne Netan ne Sekaria dɛ Mɛsolam ba fa aa ɛ nomonome, dɛ yerɛ Joiarib ne Ɛl Netan baa dɔ wejema kohona,

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: dɛ tom ba bwɛɛ nomoa bɛl waa lɔ Kasifia baa yerɔ Ido be. N bol waa baa ka bol Ido ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea be ŋɔ, bá tɛ yaa nɛra bá baa tomɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ o Dea.

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa sune ya nɛ, dɛ ja ya nɛɛ nomanta, ba tɛ yaa Sɛrebea waa dɔ kwaa ɛɛ wejema kohona. O ɛ Lewi dea te, dɛ le Maali dea, asɛ o bibaala ne o nimanar baala fi dɛ banuatoro ja o nɛɛ dɛ ba.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: Ba ɡelɔ Hasabia dɛ Jesaya baa le Merari dea ɡe ba, ba lolanar fifraanɛ ja ba nɛ.

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Ahava bela baa kwi bɔɔ nee ɛɛ palɛ o bini belaa n do ba ŋɔ ya vɔwɛ nyoa, ɡɛ aa ɛ yá won pwɛr ya te do Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ lɔɡa. Ya soŋo o ja ya nɛɛ ya kpɔ ya bii dɛ kwaa yaa dɔa bwa kaa Jerusalam sɔnɔnɔɔ.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ o lɛ yaa le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta. Asɛ o no ya wesoŋa, dɛ lɛ yaa. Koŋkɛɛla baa kpɔa ba Korowii Dea

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Ate, n le sɔfo nomonome fi dɛ banɛ, ne Sɛrebea ne Hasabia dɛ ba bala fi ja.

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Hé daahna kɛrɛdɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ haa jo Korowii Dea bini Jerusalam, ásɛ dɛ kari a tɔɡre sɔfo nomonome ne Lewi dea tena dɛ Israel nomonnyuune la sie.”

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ate, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena lɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, dɛ koŋkwaa aa do ɡoroŋ ba kari a tɔɡre la dɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ kaa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea Jerusalam.

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Korobiloɡle, tɔpera fi dɛ anɛ taa ya le bela baa kwi bɔɔ nee ɛɛ palɛ o bini dɛ do Ahava dɛ kaa Jerusalam. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ja ya nɛ, dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe le ya dɔma ne ŋwɛɛra baa sɔh ŋwɛnɛ ta nɔn ta.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Yaa jo Jerusalam la, ya soɡo dɛ onɛ tɔpera atoro.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Asɛ tɔpenaarɛ wee la, ya la Korowii Dea, dɛ ka maɡɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ koŋkwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la do sɔfo Uria bibaa Mɛremɔt waa ɛ sɔfo la nɔn ta, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea la bini. Dɛ Fenehas bibaa Eliasa ja o nɛ, ne Lewi dea tena baa ɛ Jesua bibaa Josabad dɛ Binui bibaa Noadia.

english_verse: goats were sacrificed for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Asɡad naanar bini, Hakatan bibaa Johanan, asɛ baala lafa dɛ fi ja o nɛ.

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Ba berɔ kpɔ tɔn koojen la fa aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la tɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi harɛre aa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ, ne o nomonome bwa, asɛ ba cha nɛra la ne Korowii Dea toma la.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Baa ɛ anɔ bwa tonɛ la, nomonome la ba men sɔfo Ɛsra be ŋɔ, “Israel tena ne sɔfore, dɛ Lewi dea tena la ta ba te pere le Keenan ne Hiti ne Pɛrɛs, ne Jebus ne Amɔn ne Moab ne Ijipt, dɛ Amɔre tena we-ɛɛla Korowii aa kia aa wola were la ta.

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: Israel baala la kpɔ harɛre aa bar ba cheme la haahna mo, a che a ta ba ne Korowii nɛra ba wa aa do ɡoroŋ la, ne ba we-ɛɛla aa wola were la koo dɔŋa. Nomonome ne sitɔɔla laanee tɔ ba sie ba ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ.”

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Maa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, n kɛɛ n batakaare, dɛ tɛr n nyumpona ne n tampona, asɛ dɛ so harɛ n bwara yɔr, n tea bini aa chɔɡa wa.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa no waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa bola la baa bar mɛ cheme dɛɛ chel, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛfale ta dɛ ba la waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe. Asɛ n so bela dɛɛ di suna ka tel kɛŋɔ jɔmɔr saraha ɛɛ aa tela.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Jɔmɔr saraha ɛɛ aa tela la, n iro le bela maa soɡa dɛɛ di suna la, n batakaare maa kɛɛra ta do mɛ, asɛ n ɡuŋi harɛ dɛ ɡɔɔ n nɔɔra Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la be nyundua,

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, sihiih dɛ kpo mɛ n di ncho ɡe kohona, kɛ maa ɡɔɔ nyu dɛɛ nyiŋi he siwi ta nɔ, dɛkalkɛ ya wechɔɡa ɡwaa ya nɛ, hale dɛɛ tel he be nyundua.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: Le ya naawa bere saŋ ba le fini, ya wechɔɡa kan kohona. Anomanta, ya ne ya koranar ne sɔfore bwaa harɛre ane koranar lawɛ laa ta dɛ kpoo yaa, dɛ pa ya laala kaa. A ɡel sihiih kpo yaa, asɛ ya do ba lɔɡa ba le fini nɔ.

english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken nɔ, n Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he sune ya nɛɛ tama bɛl, dɛ ɡel ya bini bane won chwa le yoma yawa ta, dɛ ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta he Dea ta. He ɡelɔ ya dɔ ya te, dɛ tɛ yaa mkpafale.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya ɛ yoma, kɛ hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ ta yaa ɡelɛ ya wenaale ta. He baɡle he nyina ya nɛɛ Pɛɛsea harɛ koojena sie. He tɛ yaa mkpafale ya berɛ won kwaa ma hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ Dea waa kuuɡa la, asɛ dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, dɛ ɡel ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam bwɛdaa ta.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, anɔ bwa habɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona bol ɔ? Dɛkalkɛ ya ta waa haa do yaa a ta teŋɛ,

english_verse: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.
translation_verse: he cheɡɛ he bonɔɔna baa ɛ he keamere la nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Harɛ haa dɛ kaa o ta ka so la, wechɔɡa ɡelɔ nɛra baa soɡe o ta chɔɡo. Ba kpɔ we-ɛɛla men Korowii aa kia ne wedoŋa su harɛ la bwa.

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he bɛ he bihaahna kpɔ tɛ ba bibaala bá mo, ɡɛɛ aa wola chɛɛ kɛ he ɡe bibaala mo ba bihaahna. Hé ne ba bɛ nyopɛo fɔo bɛlbwa fɔwɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ he won so dɛ́ biɡri, dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa dɛ́ di harɛ la ta kondɛɛɡa, ásɛ a chɔ le tɛ he bii saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Waa aa pu yaa nɔ bwa le ya wechɔɡa aa ɡela ya di bolchɔɡe la. Kɛ ane a bwa, N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, tamaa kenii he tɛr ya deŋne. He ta ɡelɛ a ɡwaa ya nɛ, dɛ ɡel ya bini bane dɔ ya nyuune dɛ ta so le.

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Yaa wono teŋɛ dɛɛ koni waa haa dɛ do yaa a ta, ya ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ waa baa kia nɔ kaa mo dɔŋa bihaahna, kɛɛ bihaahna kaa yalɛ ba bibaala aa? He baah aa ya nɛɛ di kohona he chɔɡ yaa, ya bini bɛlbwa aa wola ka dɛ́ so le kpa aa?

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, he waa toɡrɔ kohona! He ɡelɔ ya bini bane ta so le. Ya di bolchɔɡe dɛ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ bil he sie, anomanta, ya bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ba che he sie.”

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Ɛsra taa ɡuŋa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii o Dea la sie, dɛ wi dɛɛ soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa la, Israel tena baa wara, baala ne haahna, dɛ bechale baa baro cheme la ɡe wio kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Belaa Jehiel bibaa Sɛkania waa ɛ Elam naa la bini bɛl ŋɔ Ɛsra be ŋɔ, “Ya waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, kɛŋɔ yaa dɛ mo harɛre nɛra baa soɡa bar yaa nɔ haahna nɔ. Kɛ ane a bwa, ya Israel tena ta dɔ hwɛɡa.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya ne Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ ya doŋi haahna nɔ ne ba bii bwa kaa. Yaa teŋɛ waa he ne nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta aa bola ŋɔ yá ɛ laanee. Yaa ɛa ɡɛ Korowii Mmara aa dɛ baɡle la.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Anomanta, sɔfo Ɛsra, ir nyu ne, dɛkalkɛ he nɔn taa ɡɛ waa nɔ do. Yaa che he habɔɔ, dɔ bambile dɛ́ ɛa.”

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Ate, Ɛsra ir che dɛ ɡel sɔfo nomonome ne Lewi dea tena dɛ Israel tena bwa ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa ɛ ɡɛ Sɛkania aa bola laanee.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Asɛ Ɛsra le Korowii Dea la sie bela dɛ kaa Eliasib bibaa Jehohanan dea. Waa lɔ bela la, o ta kondikwaa dii dɛ vɛh nee ɡe nyɔe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o tea bini chɔɡɔ, nɛra baa kaa bane bojaŋ harɛfale ta, ba berɛ ba ba kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe la wa.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh a ɡɛ chema nɔ mun bala ka tel tɔpera atoro la, wɛɛ paŋɛ kwaa waa dɔa bwaa, ɡɛ nomonome aa bola la, ásɛ ba berɛ doŋu le o harɛ waa soɡe o ta la ta.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Tɔpera atoro la ne tela la, dɛ baala baa soɡe Juda harɛ ne Bɛnjamen dea harɛ bwa cheme Jerusalam. Asɛ korobie anuanaarɛ tɔpera fifraanɛ ta la, ba ka so Korowii Dea dembaah bela. Dɛ bwaala dɛ nɛ kohona, asɛ ba so o bini dɛɛ chel, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba chema la waa hiaoh kohona.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Belaa sɔfo Ɛsra ir che, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe. Harɛfale ta haahnaa he mo, dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ba ja bolchɔɡe Israel tena aa dia ta.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Taraken, hé bol he wechɔɡa baɡle Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ, dɛ́ɛ ɛ o bambile bini wa. Hé laa he te kpɔ harɛfala aa bar heyaa cheme nɔ nɛra, ne haahna baa wola he harɛ ta tena ɛɛ he mo ba la nɛ.”

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Ate, nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa sɛh takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “He waa la wer dɛ toɡre, yaa ɛ ɡɛ haa bola nɔɔ.”

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba berɔ bol ja ŋɔ, “Ya warɛ bonɔ asɛ bwaala ɡe ɛɛ nɛ, anomanta, yaa won che o bini wɛɛ kpo yaa ɡɛ. A ɡɛ waa nɔ ta tɔpebeŋkpoŋ kɛɛ tɔpera anɛ ɡbo waa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ ya nɛra yaa di bolchɔɡe ɡɛ waa nɔ ta warɔ.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya nomonome so dɛ́ nyiŋi a ta tɛ ya bwɛɛla bwa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa mo a ɡɛ haahna nɔ bɛl la, bá yerɔ ó ba tɔpere baa doo ta, dɛ́ kpɔ nomonome ne nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole harɛ waa soɡe o ta ja ba. Kenii dɛ́ ɡel waa nɔ Korowii baah aa di ya nɛɛ a waa nɔ le ya nɛ.”

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Nɛra la bwa no waa la mun, atane Asahɛl bibaa Jonatan ne Tikva bibaa Jaseya ɡbo. Mɛsolam ne Sabetai baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la ɡe ja ba nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Anomanta, nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba berɛ ba la sɛh ɡɛ baa bola la ta. Asɛ sɔfo Ɛsra le baala baa ɛ deene nomonnyuune, asɛ ba chwerɛ bɛlbwa sɔn denaa ta. Korobie fi tɔpeloɡle ta la, ba soɡe harɛ dɛ nyiŋi waa la ta,

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: korobie atoro ne tela, dɛ ba bol baala baa mo haahna baa wola ba harɛ ta tena ɛɛ la waa tonɛ. Baala baa mo harɛfala ta haahna

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers;
translation_verse: Ba bwa baɡɛ Korowii nyoa ŋɔ baa vɛh ba haahna laanee, asɛ bɛlbwa lawɛ pebal ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha, bolchɔɡe baa dia la wa.

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Le Ima naanar ɡe bini, Hanani ne Sebadia.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Le Harim naanar bini, Maaseya ne Elaeja ne Sɛmaya ne Jehiel dɛ Usia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Le Pasur naanar bini, Elionai ne Maaseya ne Ismael ne Nɛtanɛl ne Josabad dɛ Elasa.

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Le Lewi dea tena ɡe bini, Josabad ne Simee ne Kelaya, ba berɔ dɛɛ yerɔ Kelita, ne Pɛtahea ne Juda dɛ Eliesa.

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Le yelɡoola ɡe bini, Eliasib. Le nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo bini, Salum ne Telem dɛ Uri.

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Le Israel tena bane ɡe baa kaa bini, Parɔs naanaree nɔ, Ramia ne Isia ne Malkija ne Mijamin ne Eliasa ne Malkija dɛ Bɛnaya.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Le Elam naanar bini, Matania ne Sekaria ne Jehiel ne Abdi ne Jɛremɔt dɛ Elaeja.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Le Satu ɡe naanar bini, Elionai ne Eliasib ne Matania ne Jɛremɔt ne Sabad dɛ Asisa.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Bebai naanar bini, Jehohanan ne Hanania ne Sabai dɛ Atlai.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Le Bani ɡe naanar bini, Mɛsolam ne Maluk ne Adaya ne Jasub ne Seal dɛ Jɛremɔt.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Le Pahat Moab naanar bini, Adna ne Kelal ne Bɛnaya ne Maaseya ne Matania ne Besalɛl ne Binui dɛ Manasɛ.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Dɛ le Hasum ɡe naanar bini, Matinai ne Mataata ne Sabad ne Ɛlefɛlɛt ne Jɛremai ne Manasɛ dɛ Simee.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Nɛbo ɡe naanar bini, Jeyɛl ne Matitia ne Sabad ne Sebina ne Jadai ne Joel dɛ Bɛnaya.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: Waa Hakalia bibaa Nehemia aa ɛa laanee teŋa nɔ. Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ, Keslɛv ta, dɛ men Nehemia lɔ bwɛjen Susa.

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Belaa n dɔŋ Hanani ne nɛra bane le Juda harɛ ta dɛ ba. Asɛ n bɔɔ ba Juu tena baa wona chwa le bojaŋ harɛ baa laɡ ba kaa laa ta, ne bwɛjen Jerusalam wa.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Anee ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Banɔ la baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta la balɔ. Ba lɔ wahala ne sihiih ta. Danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la kuuɡo, asɛ bwɛɛ la doonyojen ɡbeni la ɡe, ba fuah a ɛ tɔɔ.”

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Maa no waa nɔ la, n soɡo dɛ wi. N wio la sie tɔpere bɛl tama dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ soŋe Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ŋɔ,

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: “N Naa Korowii haa dɛ di kora nyundua, he kan dɛ do ɔma kohona. He dɛ teŋɛ fɔo he ne nɛra baa dɛ nyini aa fɔwa, dɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta kasinteŋ ne.

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: Cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ wesoŋa maa kpɔa dɛɛ bil he sie chɔɔ ne jwaana, he bonɔɔna baa ɛ Israel tena nɔ wa. N dɛ bol n wechɔɡa ne ya Israel tena bwa kwa, dɛ anɔ la n naawa aa ɛa dɛ jo he nɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
translation_verse: Ya ɛ nyubinikpeɡ, dɛ jo he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Ya ta waa he fa aa kpɔa tɛ he bonɔɔ Mosis dɛɛ do yaa a ta, ne mmarare la ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: Lii waa he fa aa do he bonɔɔ Mosis dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ he Israel tena waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe yaa, mɛɛ lɔ heyaa peɡre harɛre ta,

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: kɛ dɛ he berɔ ba n be dɛ ba teŋɛ waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta tenaa, hale dɛ ba lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ jaɡa kwaraa naa, mɛɛ boa he nyoaa, dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa ba bela maa lea cheɡ ŋɔ baa tom mɛ la.’

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ba ɛ he bonɔɔna ne he ɡbaɡba nɛra. He kpeɡri ne he bokpeɡa nee he lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: Cheɡ deŋne no n wesoŋa ne he bonɔɔna baa dɛ nyin ba kpɔ duure tɛɛ la wesoŋa. Gel a chiɡ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ fini, dɛ́ ɡel koojen na n sum.” Gɛ saŋ dɛ menee dɛɛ do Koojen Atasɛksɛs sen.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora bene fifraanɛ, korobie Nisan ta la, ba ba sen ne ba tɛo. Asɛ n lɛ dɛ kpɔ ka tɛo. Dɛ o ta men nae n waa do sum o be bwa.

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: Anomanta, koojen la bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “He bwara aa hen we, aah bɔkwa waa ɡela he waa do sum he tea bini chɔɡ ken?” Ate, dɛ n dɛ ɔmɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ! Bɔkwaa dɛ́ ɡel n waa aa wola sumii doɔ? Bwɛjen baa huɡe n naawa o bini paɡrɔ dɛ berɛ dimɡbia, o doonyojen ɡbeni ɡe bwa fuh.”

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Ate, Koojen Atasɛksɛs ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ n ɛ́ tɛɛ nɔ?” Asɛ n soŋe Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua,

english_verse: Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
translation_verse: dɛ chaŋo ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ he tea too men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛɛ he no n wesoŋa nɔ naa, ɡel ń kaa Juda harɛ ta, bwɛjen Jerusalam baa huɡe n naawa la ta, dɛ́ ka kwaa vɔrɔwo.”

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Anee koojen la ne o haah waa soɡe o jwɛɛh bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Tɔpera aŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ ba kpɔe dɛ́ tel bela, dɛ́ berɛ ba nɔ?” Dɛ koojen la tea toorɔ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel n kaa, anomanta, n doo tɔpere.

english_verse: Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?
translation_verse: Asɛ n berɛ ŋɔ Koojen Atasɛksɛs be ŋɔ, “Dɛ a too he tea aa, cha mɛ dɛ́ chwerɛ tɔne tɛ mɛ ń kpɔ ka tɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr baŋ harɛre ta la, ásɛ ba nyiŋi n nɛ, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń won kaa Juda harɛ ta sɔnɔnɔɔ.”

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: N berɔ soŋo ŋɔ ó chwerɛ tɔn tɛ mɛ ń kpɔ ka tɛ Asaf waa dɛ nyiŋi koojen kɔne ta la, ásɛ o tɛ mɛ doli maa kpɔ ɛ dekpeɡ la doonyoo aa bɛne Korowii Dea, ne danjwɛkpeɡ waa bar bwɛjen la, dɛ dem maa ka so o ta. Korowii ja n nɛɛ nomanta, koojen la tɛ mɛ komɛlbwa maa soŋo.

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Koojen Atasɛksɛs kpɔ laa nomonome ne banɔ la baa soɡe jaɡre ta ba ja n nɛ, asɛ n la Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ ta, dɛ ka kpɔ tɔne waa chwera tɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi bela harɛre ta la ka tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Asɛ Sanbalat waa le Bɛt Hɔrɔn, ne Tobia waa ɛ Amɔn nomonome la bini bɛl noɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛl koh Israel tena kɛrɛdɛ doe wa dɛ ba, asɛ a we ba nɛ. Nehemia kaa nyiŋi Jerusalam danjwɛɛre

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Belaa men Nehemia la Jerusalam, maa di bela tɔpera atoro habɔɔ la,

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: baala tama banee ja n nɛ, n ne ba ir jwaana. N ta waa Korowii aa kpɔa do n liire bini ŋɔ ń ɛ Jerusalam la bolɛ baɡle nomɛlbwa, keeɡo maa soɡe o ta ɡboo, ane ta jae kpa.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Asɛ n kpɔ Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa ta awola jwaana, dɛ kpɔ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kalampoŋa Kɔlɔŋ ne Puldoa Doonyoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Jerusalam danjwɛjena baa kuuɡa, ne ɡɛ baa fuh o doonyoone bwa la.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: Ate, n berɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Nee Nyu Doonyoa ne Kooro Tam ta, kɛ dɛ bɔr toole keeɡo maa soɡe o ta la dɔ bɔr kpɔ,

english_verse: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
translation_verse: anomanta, n kpɔ Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen la bini jwaana la ne, dɛ ha sie dɛɛ nyiŋi danjwɛɛ la. Asɛ n berɛ habɔɔ dɛ berɛ ka kpɔ Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa la ta dɛ jo bwɛjen la ta.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Nomonome baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta, ta bela maa laŋa kɛɛ waa maa dɛ ɛ jemɛ. Dɛ n ta wobɛlbwa n bala Juu tena, ne sɔfore ne nomonjena ne nomonome, dɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ba jae dɛ́ ɛ toma la be bolɛ.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Ate, n ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé na waa yaa lɔ a ta! Jerusalam berɛ dimɡbia, ba fuh o doonyojen ɡbeni. Hé ɡel ya kwaa ma danjwɛɛ o fa aa baro la, ásɛ sihiih bɛ yaa kpo kpa.”

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: N berɔ ŋɔ ba be ɡɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa sune n nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, ne koojen la waa waa bol n be la. Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya pa mun kwaa dɛɛ ma.” Anomanta, ba kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ tondɛɛɡa nɔ.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Asɛ Sanbalat waa ɛ Hɔrɔn te, ne Tobia waa ɛ Amɔn tena nomonome la bini bɛl, dɛ Gɛsem o ɡe aa ɛ Arab te noɔ, asɛ ba mamɛ dɛɛ muɡli ya baah ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa hɛɛ ɛ nɔɔ? Koojenii hɛɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ la.”

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: Asɛ n chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ɛɛ ɡeloo wobɛlbwa kaa kɛrɛdɛ tɛ yaa. Yan yaa ɛ o bonɔɔnaa ɛɛ pa munii dɛɛ ma. Kɛ he te nɔn toole Jerusalam komɛlbwa ta. He toole o saŋ la waa ɡe ta.”

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kwaara ma danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam laanee Sɔfonomoa Eliasib ne o bala. Ba kwaarɔ ma Peera Doonyoa dɛ do o ɡbeni, dɛ ma danjwɛɛ kaa Lafa Dejaŋ ne Hananɛl Dejaŋ ta, dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Asɛ Jeriko baala ɡe kwaa ma choŋi, Imri bibaa Sakur ɡe ne o nɛra ma onɔ la waa teŋa choŋi.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Hasena bibaala ɡe berɛ kwaa ma Pɛŋa Doonyoa, dɛ kpɔ doli dawɛ o ta, dɛ do ɡbeni ne bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ kara.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Uria bibaa Mɛremɔt o nabaa aa ɛ Hakɔs ne o nɛra ɡe ma choŋi. Bɛrekea bibaa Mɛsolam o nabaa aa ɛ Mɛsesabɛl ne o baala ma choŋi. Asɛ Baana bibaa Sadɔk ne o baala ɡe ma choŋi.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Tekoa baala kwaarɔ ma bampera, kɛ bwɛɛ la sitɔɔla ta ba te kpɔe ja nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi toma la ta nɛ.

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Pasea bibaa Joiada ne Besodiya bibaa Mɛsolam ɡe berɛ kwaa ma Jesana Doonyoa. Ba kpɔ doli ne ɡbeni do o ta, dɛ kpɔ bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ karɛ ɡbera la do o ta.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Asɛ Melatia waa le Gebeɔn ne Jadɔn waa le Mɛrɔnɔt, ne Gebeɔn dɛ Mispa baala ɡe ma choŋi ka tel harɛ nomoa waa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr dem.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Haahaya bibaa Usiel waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema ɡe ma choŋi. Asɛ Hanania, waa jemɛ nosɔɔhsoma ɛɛ ma choŋi ka tel danjwɛɛ la bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Danjwɛpaɡ la ta.

english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Hur bibaa Refaya o fa aa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Jerusalam bampera ɡe kwaarɔ ma choŋi.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Asɛ Harumaf bibaa Jedaya kwaa ma choŋi, dɛ bela bɛne o dem. Asɛ Hasabeneeya bibaa Hatus ɡe kwaa ma choŋi.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Asɛ Harim bibaa Malkija dɛ Pahat Moab bibaa Hasub ɡe kwaa ma bampera bobɛl ne dejaŋ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Fononoo Dejaŋ la.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Halɔhɛs bibaa Salum, o ɡe fa aa ɛ Jerusalam bampera nomoa kwaa ma choŋi. O bihaahna chao.

english_verse: Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for
translation_verse: Hanun ne nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjen Sanoa ɡe berɛ kwaa vɔrɔwe Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa. Ba do ɡbera ne bune o ta, dɛ bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ karɔ. Ba berɔ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la dɛ ka tel Puldoa Doonyoa la ta. O jaŋne lɔ naɡale kaɡboŋ lafraanue.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Puldoa Doonyoa la, Rekab bibaa Malkija o fa aa ɛ Bɛt Hakerem harɛ nomoa la ɡee kwaara mao. O do ɡbera o nyoa, dɛ do bune o ta ba kpɔ dɛɛ karɔ.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Kol Hose bibaa Salum o fa aa ɛ Mispa harɛ nomoa laanee kwaara ma Nee Nyu Doonyoa. O tɔɔ dɛ do ɡbeni o nyoa, dɛ do bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ kara. Onee bera kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa bar Siloam tam, waa bɛne Kooro bodɛɛɡe waa du daa jwɛh. O mao ka tel kwaa baa kpɔ a ta tu dɛɛ le Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Asɛ Asbuk bibaa Nehemia, o fa aa ɛ Bɛt Sor harɛ nomoa ɡe kwaa ma choŋi ka tel bobɛl o ne bela baa huɡe Kooro Devid sie aa chaɡɛ dɔŋa, ne tam bɛl baa kwiu, dɛ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Banyoola Dea.

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena baa teŋa nɔ ɡee kwaara ma danjwɛɛ la baŋ bɛla ane choŋi. Banee, Bani bibaa Rehum waa ɛ ba sitɔɔ, ne Hasabia o fa aa ɛ Keila harɛ nomoa, o ɡee aa maa choŋi tɛ o harɛ tena.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;
translation_verse: Ba ɡe nɛɛ Henadad bibaa Bavae o ɡe fa aa ɛ Keila harɛ nomoa ne o nɛra teŋɛ dɛ berɛ kwaa ma choŋi.

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: Asɛ Jesua bibaa Esa o fa aa ɛ nomoa Mispa ɡe berɛ kwaa ma choŋi dea baa dɛ cheɡ dɔmkwa o ta la sie, ka jaɡɛ dea la loŋkora waa ɡoŋa ta.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Sabai bibaa Baruk ɡe kpɔ sibeɡra kwaa ma choŋi o ta, ka tel sɔfo Eliasib dem doonyoa.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Uria bibaa Mɛremɔt, o nabaa sɔne Hakɔs, on ɡe kwaara ma choŋi sɔfo Eliasib dem doonyoa bampera kaa o jaɡa.

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Sɔfore baa teŋa nɔɔ bera kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la bamperi ɡalɡa. Banɔ la baa soɡa bar Jerusalam laanee bera kwaa maa.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen ne Hasub kwaarɔ ma choŋi. Bela lɔ ba dem sideŋ. Asɛ Maaseya bibaa Asaria, baa yerɛ o nabaa Anania ɡe berɛ kwaa ma choŋi. Bela lɔ o dem jwɛh.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Henadad bibaa Binui ɡe berɔ kwaa ma choŋi le Asaria dem ka jaɡɛ danjwɛɛ la loŋkora bobɛl.

english_verse: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Asɛ Usai bibaa Palal kwaa ma choŋi le danjwɛɛ la loŋkora bela dɛ kaa dejaŋ waa lɔ koodem la nyundua. O bɛne dembaah bela nɛra aa dɛ daah la. Asɛ Parɔs bibaa Pɛdaya ɡe kwaa ma choŋi.

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea dɛ so Ofel deŋɡare ta ɡe kwaa ma choŋi ka tel bobɛl o ne Nee Doonyoa sie aa chaɡɛ dɔŋa, dɛɛ kaa wee leebɔr ne dejaŋ waa tɔ Korowii Dea la ta.

english_verse: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
translation_verse: Asɛ Tekoa baala ɡe kwaa ma choŋi le dejaŋ waa tɔ Korowii Dea la bɔr, dɛ ka tel Ofel danjwɛɛ ta.

english_verse: Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.
translation_verse: Sɔfore bane pɛo, dɛ kwaa ma choŋi Jaɡre Doonyoa, weekaŋle nyunduabɔr. Bɛlbwa mao chɔŋɛ o dem sie.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Asɛ Ima bibaa Sadɔk berɛ kwaa ma choŋi o dem sie. Sɛkania bibaa Sɛmaya ɡe berɛ kwaa ma choŋi, dɛ onee dɛɛ daah Wee Leebɔr Doonyoa.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛmia bibaa Hanania, ne Salaf binumɛlte Hanun ɡe berɔ kwaa ma choŋi, asɛ Bɛrekea bibaa Mɛsolam kwaa ma choŋi o dem sideŋ.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Asɛ Malkija waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema, kwaa ma choŋi ka tel bobɛl waa ɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ne bonadiire dem. O ne Kwaa Nyoa Boara Doonyoa sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa, dɛ teŋɛ kaa danjwɛɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua, o wee leebɔr loŋkora bɔr.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema ne bonadiire la kwaarɔ ma danjwɛɛ waa kaa la choŋi, dɛ le dea waa lɔ loŋkora dɛ kaa Peera Doonyoa la ta.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Sanbalat aa noa kɛŋɔ ya Juu tena berɔ kwaa dɛɛ ma Jerusalam danjwɛjen la, bwaawee lawɔ o baah di taeh, wɛɛ mamɛ yaa.

english_verse: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, “What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones?”
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ o bala ne Samaria laa tena sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa Juu tena baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ nɔ ɛɛ ɛ nɔɔ? Baa won berɛ kwaa ma ba danjwɛɛ nɔ cheɡ aa? Baa won ɛ sarahare aa? Baa won ɛ sarahare ásɛ dɛ won tonɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo aa? Baa won berɛ dɔ bwea le anɔ la baa fuah a daŋɛ chɔ nɔ ta naa?”

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Dɛ Tobia waa ɛ Amɔn te cheɡɛ nomoa la jwɛh. O ŋɔ, “Danjwɛɛ baa dɛ ma nɔ, hale dɛ kɔkɔbo kwaraa teehno waa, wɛɛ taɡɔ ɡo.”

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Ate, men Nehemia soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ baa dɛ chɛɡre yaa, ɡel chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡre yaa nɔ ɡure ba nyu ta. Gel ba paŋɛ komɛlbwa baa dɔa, ásɛ ba laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.

english_verse: Don't forgive the mean and evil way they have insulted the builders.”
translation_verse: Bɛ ba bolchɔɡe dii ta tɔ, bɛ ba wechɔɡa soh, dɛkalkɛ ba chɛɡre ya nɛra yaa bera kwaa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ la.”

english_verse: The people worked hard, and we built the walls of Jerusalem halfway up again.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya teŋɔ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la ka tel bela waa kpeɡ ka tel la baah ta tonɛ, dɛkalkɛ nɛra la ɛ toma la sibeɡra ne.

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: Ate, Sanbalat ne Tobia ne Arab ne Amɔn, dɛ Asdɔd tena aa noa kɛŋɔ Jerusalam danjwɛɛ baa bera kwaa dɛɛ ma la chemo dɛɛ nyin tona la, ba baah diu kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Asɛ ba bwa pɛ, dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ, bá ba yo Jerusalam, dɛ́ kpɔ sibeɡra ba ta nɛra baa lɔ bela nɛ.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Anee ya soŋe Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ daah toma la webaŋa ne jwaana, dɛ́ tɔ ba ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: “So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall?”
translation_verse: A bwa habɔɔ, dɛ Juda tena dɛ ɡo yel bɛl wáa do ba ɡbemba toma la ta ŋɔ, “Tom-ɛɛra la dɛ ɡwɛɡre, berekese aa kuuɡa warɔ, yaa wola won kpɔ dɛ́ berɛ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la.”

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: Ya dɔma la berɔ ŋɔ, “Ba ne ŋɔ ba jemɛ kɛɛ dɛ na yaa la, dɛ ya jo ba bini dɛ́ kpoo ba, ásɛ toma la den ka dɛ́ ba a jaɡa.”

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Ate, Juu tena baa soɡa bɛne ya dɔma la ba ŋɔ ya be kera fi ne a habɔɔ bwa ŋɔ, “Bobɛlbwa haa kpɔ bwa, baa yo yaa.”

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nehemia, n kpɔ nɛra la bane so danjwɛɛ la habɔɔ bela waa wola nyundua kaalɛ. N kpɔ ba so denaa ta, ba kpoŋe ba keri ne lampeare ne tori dɛ hɛma.

english_verse: Then I looked things over and told the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Don't be afraid of your enemies! The Lord is great and fearsome. So think of him and fight for your relatives and children, your wives and homes!”
translation_verse: N iro dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ a ɛ waa tɛ nɛra la, anomanta, n ŋɔ ba ne ba sitɔɔla ne ba nomonome, ne banɔ la baa jaa la bwa be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ban ɔmɛ, hé lii ɡɛ Korowii aa do kan dɛ do ɔma kohona, ásɛ dɛ yo tɛ he bwɛɛ tena, ne he bibaala ne bihaahna, ne he haahna dɛ he deremi.”

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.

translation_verse: Saŋ bɛl, Juu tena la ɡalɡa baala ne haahna bwa pa mun dɛɛ naɡre ba bala Juu tena la wa.

translation_verse: Asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Yá kemɛ suuɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ toɔ kooro aa dɛ lɛ yaa ya kooni ne daa kooni ta.

translation_verse: Ya ne ya bala Juu tena bwa beŋkpoŋ. Gɛɛ ya bii ne ba ɡe bii ɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ ya kpɔ ya bibaala ne bihaahna do ba lɔɡa kɛŋɔ yoma ken, ya bihaahna bane tɔ sie ɛ yoma. Taraken ya ta kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe kpa, dɛkalkɛ ya kooni ne daa kooni berɛ nɛra bane kwa.”
