english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Ate, nomonome la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Yaa berɛ ba kwaa tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ haa bola la, yaa komɛlbwaa lɛ le ba be kpa.” Asɛ n yerɛ sɔfore la cheme, dɛ ɡel sitɔɔla ne nomonome la ŋwɛɛ ntam ba sie kɛŋɔ, baa teŋɛ nyoa baa baɡa la taa.

english_verse: Then I emptied my pockets and said, “If you don't keep your promise, that's what God will do to you. He will empty out everything you own, even taking away your houses.” The people answered, “We will keep our promise.” Then they praised the Lord and did as they had promised. Nehemiah Is Generous
translation_verse: N ɡe laa yal waa vɔwɛ n chara la kpɔ dɛ jwiiru, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii Korowii ɛɛ ba nomɛlbwa waa wola o nyobaɡa ta teŋɛ jwiira ta le o dem, ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa ta, ásɛ o nya so.” Asɛ nomɛlbwa waa lɔ bela ŋɔ, “Aamen!” dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii. Asɛ nomonome la ɛ ɡɛ baa baɡɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: I was governor of Judah from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king until the thirty-second year. And during these entire twelve years, my relatives and I refused to accept the food that I was allowed.
translation_verse: Koojen Atasɛksɛs di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ. Waa di kora bene fifraanɛ ta la, o le men Nehemia mɛɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anɛ. Gɛ saŋ la bwa la, ba ta men kɛɛ n lolanar kondikwaa aa chɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta tɛɛ n di.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Nomonome baa tɔ n sie nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta mɔɔ la ɛɡre Juda harɛ ta nɛra dɛ lɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanaarɛ, dɛ kondikwaa ne sen. Hale ba bonɔɔna ɡba fiiɡi nɛra la. Kɛ n te, ɔma maa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii nomanta, n ta ɡɛ ɛɛ.

english_verse: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.
translation_verse: N kpɔ n liire bwa do Jerusalam danjwɛɛ la kwaara dɛ ma toma ta. Nɛra baa ja n nɛɛ la bwa chemo, toma la ɛɛ ta, ya ta harɛ bɛlbwa nyine tɛ ya te.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛlbwaa n ɡel baa kpo nabal ne pedɛɛɡa anumɛl dɛ jala, asɛ tɔpera fi bɛlbwa ɡe, n ɡel baa tɛ sene bwa soo siwi kohona. Anɔ bɛlbwa la, n ta kondikwaa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ tɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ ta waa pɛɛrɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a ɡwaa nɛra la nɛ.

english_verse: After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.

english_verse: Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
translation_verse: Nehemia ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa dem, dɛ́ ka di he silɛɛ kondikwa, dɛ́ nyɔ sensoma, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ane ka tɛ banɔ la baa wola ane dɔe. Fini tɔpere nɔ do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ. He bɛ suna di, dɛkalkɛ silɛɛ Korowii aa tɛ heyaa la ɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ bokpeɡa.”

english_verse: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!”
translation_verse: Asɛ Lewi dea tena larawe nɛra la bwara dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé hel jeiih ken, fini tɔpere nɔ do ɡoroŋ, he bɛ suna dɛɛ di.”

english_verse: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them. Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Ate, nɛra la bwa la ka di kwaa la dɛ nyɔ sen silɛɛ kohona ne, dɛ kpɔ ane kɛ banɔ la baa wola dɔe, dɛkalkɛ ba no waa baa bola baɡ ba la mun kɛrɛdɛ. Kukure Tɔpejen dii

english_verse: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law
translation_verse: Korobie anuanɛ tɔpenɛɛte ta la, nomonnyuune ne sɔfore, dɛ Lewi dea tena la kaa cheme Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme be, o baɡ ba Mmara waa la ja.

english_verse: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.
translation_verse: Ba nao kɛŋɔ Mmara Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ kukure lɔɡree chɛ kɛ Israel tena so, dɛ́ di Kukure Tɔpejen la korobinuanɛ ta,

english_verse: They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ Korowii waa la perɛ ba bwɛɛre ne Jerusalam bwa, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé la deŋɡarere harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka teŋni dadɛɛɡa, ne ɔleve daa kpala, dɛ bambie ne daa bwa soo siwi kpala, ne a papooni, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ kukure ɡɛ baa chwera do Mmara Tɔn bini la.”

english_verse: So the people gathered branches and made shelters on the flat roofs of their houses, in their yards, in the courtyard of the temple, and in the open areas around the Water Gate and Ephraim Gate.
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra la ir ka nyin daa kpala la, dɛ ba ɛ kukure ba saldor, ne ba dembaahna ne Korowii Dea dembaahna, ne Nee Doonyoa sie bela nɛra aa dɛ cheme, dɛ Efrem Dea Doonyoa la sie.

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from Babylonia built shelters. They lived in them and joyfully celebrated the Festival of Shelters for the first time since the days of Joshua son of Nun.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta la bwa berɔ ba, dɛ ba do kukure, dɛ so a bini, dɛ di Kukure Tɔpejen la. Dɛ le Nun bibaa Josua bere saŋ ba ɡɛ tɔpere la ta la, Israel tena ta Tɔpejen nɔ ken dii bwa. Ba sie lɛo kohona.

english_verse: On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.
translation_verse: Sɔfo Ɛsra kure Korowii Mmara Tɔn la bini waa baɡle nɛra tɔpere bɛlbwa, le Tɔpejen la tɔpeloɡle ta ba kaa tɔpere waa ka mun ta. Ba di Kukure Tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ, asɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, ba cheme ɡɛ Mmara la aa baɡla la.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Korobinuanɛ la tenten, tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ ta, Israel tena chemo dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ kpɔ lweyale tɔ, dɛ ɛ teera do ba nyuune ta, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba tea bini chɔɡɔ ba wechɔɡa wa.

english_verse: They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ba bini banɔ la baa ɛ Israel tena naanar la, pere ba te le banɔ la baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra naanar la bini, dɛ ka che dɛ bol ba wechɔɡa, ne ba naawa nyubinikpeɡ waa baɡle Korowii.

english_verse: For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba cheɡɛ bela baa cheɡa, dɛ he bɔne tɔpebir bini bɔre anaarɛ naa, ba kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ kure Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ Mmara Tɔn la bini waa baɡ ba. Asɛ dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ɡe bol ba wechɔɡa, asɛ dɛ tomɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la.

english_verse: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Asɛ Jesua ne Bani ne Kadmiel, ne Sebania ne Buni ne Sɛrebea, ne Bani dɛ Kanani baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la, ir ka che komɛl waa kaa nyundua ta, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ kohona yerɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: Then the Levites Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said: “Stand and shout praises to your Lord, the eternal God! Praise his wonderful name, though he is greater than words can express.” The People Pray
translation_verse: Ate, Jesua ne Kadmiel ne Bani, ne Hasabeneeya ne Sɛrebea ne Hodia, ne Sebania dɛ Pɛtahea ba ɡe aa ɛ Lewi dea tena la ŋɔ, “Hé ir che dɛ́ kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, onee lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Bɛ́lbwa kpɛɛ o sɔn waa dɔ jirima la, o kan ɡwaa ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa kpɔ nyoa bol.

english_verse: You alone are the Lord, Creator of the heavens and all the stars, Creator of the earth and those who live on it, Creator of the ocean and all its creatures. You are the source of life, praised by the stars that fill the heavens.
translation_verse: He ɡboo Korowii, henee ta nyundua ne weweela bwa. Henee ta harɛ ne mpo, dɛ kwaa aa lɔ a ta bwa, dɛ ɡel a bwa do le. Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa dɛ ɡuŋi.

english_verse: You are the Lord our God, the one who chose Abram— you brought him from Ur in Babylonia and named him Abraham.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee le ya naa Abram, dɛ kpɔɔ le Ur waa lɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta, asɛ dɛ beɡre o sɔn Abraham.

english_verse: Because he was faithful, you made an agreement to give his descendants the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, and of the Jebusites and Girgashites. Now you have kept your promise, just as you always do.
translation_verse: He nao kɛŋɔ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛɛ, asɛ he ne o fɔwɛ fɔo. He baɡɔ nyoa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔ Keenan ne Hiti ne Amɔre, ne Pɛrɛs ne Jebus, dɛ Girɡasi tena harɛree tɛ o naanar ba so a ta. He teŋɛ he nyobaɡa ta, dɛkalkɛ he waa dɔ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: When our ancestors were in Egypt, you saw their suffering; when they were at the Red Sea, you heard their cry for help.
translation_verse: He na wahala ya naawa aa naa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ no ba wii Mposwɛm la ta, dɛ cha ba.

english_verse: You knew that the King of Egypt and his officials and his nation had mistreated your people. So you worked fearsome miracles against the Egyptians and earned a reputation that still remains.
translation_verse: He ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla baɡle Ijipt kooro, ne o nomonome dɛ harɛ la tena bwa. Dɛkalkɛ he na ɡɛ baa fiiɡi he nɛra, dɛ lɛ sɔn o ta chɔ le ba le fini.

english_verse: You divided the deep sea, and your people walked through on dry land. But you tossed their enemies in, and they sank down like a heavy stone.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ ŋwɛnɛ chɔ mpo bini tɛ he nɛra, dɛ tɔ ba sie ba valɛ harɛ waa hola ta. He ɡelɔ ba dɔma baa dɛ ti ba ka nee la ta, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ bwe ta mpo vil ta ken.

english_verse: Each day you led your people with a thick cloud, and at night you showed the way with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: He cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua tɔ ba sie webaŋa, jwaana ɡe, he kpɔ nii waa tɛra kaa nyundua tɔ ba sie wɛɛ chaah ba won vala.

english_verse: At Sinai you came down from heaven, and you gave your people good laws and teachings that are fair and honest.
translation_verse: He le nyundua ba Sinai Bwejen ta, dɛ ba bol waa baɡle he nɛra, dɛ kpɔ waa aa wera ne webaɡla aa toɡra baɡ ba.

english_verse: You commanded them to respect your holy Sabbath, and you instructed your servant Moses to teach them your laws.
translation_verse: He ŋɔ báa di he Ona Tɔpera a do ɡoroŋ, dɛ che he bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ kpɔ he Mmarare tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: When they were hungry, you sent bread from heaven, and when they were thirsty, you let water flow from a rock. Then you commanded them to capture the land that you had solemnly promised. *
translation_verse: Lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba la, he tɛɛ ba kondikwaa le nyundua, nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo ba la, he ɡelɔ nee le bwe ta tɛɛ ba ba nyɔ. He ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ harɛ haa baɡ ba nyoa ŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: Our stubborn ancestors refused to obey— they forgot about the miracles you had worked for them, and they were determined to return to Egypt and become slaves again.
translation_verse: Kɛ ya naawa ɛ mbarafo ne deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ vɛh waa haa do ba a ta la ta teŋa.

english_verse: not even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and insulted you by claiming, “This is the god who rescued us from Egypt.”
translation_verse: Ba ɛ voɡ waa do kɛ nabale, dɛ ŋɔ onee tɔ ba sie le bane Ijipt harɛ ta. N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ baa bole nɛnhɛlwobol.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, you never abandoned them in the desert. And you always guided them with a cloud by day and a fire at night.
translation_verse: Kɛ he ta ban ɡelɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela, dɛkalkɛ tedoma haa dɔa tɛ nɛra kan kohona. He ta bam kɛɛ nii waa tɔ ba sie dɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ webaŋa ne jwaana laa kpɔ.

english_verse: Your gentle Spirit instructed them, and you gave them manna to eat and water to drink.
translation_verse: He kpɔ he Doma waa wera tɛɛ ba wɛɛ baɡ ba wa, dɛ tɛɛ ba maana ba di, dɛ tɛɛ ba nee ɡe ba nyɔ.

english_verse: You took good care of them, and for forty years they never lacked a thing. Their clothes didn't wear out, and their feet were never swollen.
translation_verse: He nyiŋi ba nɛɛ bene fifraanaarɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ tɛɛ ba komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin. Ba bwara laala ta kɛɛrɛ, ba napaala ta ɔɡrɛ.

english_verse: You let them conquer kings and take their land, including King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ ba yo dɛ pɔ koranar ne harɛre nɛra nɛ, harɛre aa lɔ ba jwɛh ta. Ba yo Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon, ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ lɛ ba harɛre.

english_verse: You brought them into the land that you had promised their ancestors, and you blessed their nation with people that outnumbered the stars in the sky.
translation_verse: He tɛɛ ba bii ba warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela ken, dɛ ɡel ba yo nɛra dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ so harɛ haa baɡɛ ba naawa ŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la ta.

english_verse: They captured strong cities and rich farmland; they took furnished houses, as well as cisterns, vineyards, olive orchards, and numerous fruit trees. They ate till they were satisfied, and they celebrated your abundant blessings.
translation_verse: He nɛra yoo dɛ pɔ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara nɛ, ne harɛpare ondɛɛɡe, ne deremi kondɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi aa lɔ a ta, ne bɔɔne baa kwia a won nee lɛɛ, ne ɡrepo daa kooni ne ɔleve daa kooni, dɛ daa baa dɛ di a nɔna bwa soo siwi aa wara. Ba diu vaɡre dɛ je, ba sie lɛ kondɛɛɡa kohona haa tɛɛ ba la wa.

english_verse: In spite of this, they rebelled and disobeyed your laws. They killed your prophets, who warned them to turn back to you, and they cursed your name.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba ɛɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ le he habɔɔ. Ba laa ba liire kpɔ he Mmara ta teŋa ta. Ba kpoo he keamere baa kah ba ŋɔ, bá charɛ ba liire ba he be la. Ba bol wedoŋa dɛ taah he sɔn la.

english_verse: So you handed them over to their enemies, who treated them terribly. But in their sufferings, they begged you to help. From heaven you listened to their prayers and because of your great mercy, you sent leaders to rescue them.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he ɡelɔ ba dɔma yoo ba, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ fiɡ ba. Kɛ ba wenaale ta la, ba wio noe asɛ he no le nyundua dɛ cha ba. He cheɡɛ tedoma haa dɔa kohona ta dɛ le nomonome tɛɛ ba, ba ba lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta.

english_verse: But when they were at peace, they would turn against you, and you would hand them over to their enemies. Then they would beg for help, and because you are merciful, you rescued them over and over again.
translation_verse: Deŋnesɔɔhna aa bala la, ba berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa ja, asɛ he ɡel ba dɔma ba yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ ja. Kɛ baa charɛ ba liire dɛ wi noe ŋɔ hé lɛɛ ba la, he dɔ tedoma dɛ no le nyundua, dɛ teŋɛ no ba be, dɛ lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: You warned them to turn back and discover true life by obeying your laws. But they stubbornly refused and continued to sin.
translation_verse: He kah ba ŋɔ baa teŋɛ he webaɡla ta, kɛ ba ɛ mbarafo ba ta he Mmarare ta teŋɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ he waa ta teŋa taa dɛɛ tɛ mkpa. Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoe, dɛ vɛh he waa ta teŋa.

english_verse: For years, you were patient, and your Spirit warned them with messages spoken by your prophets. Still they refused to listen, and you handed them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: He dɔ bambile tɛɛ ba bena bɛlbwa, dɛ che he Doma ta ɡel he keamere bol waa baɡ ba, kɛ ba ta noɛ, asɛ he kpɔ ba do harɛre nɛra nɔn ta, ba yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: But you are merciful and kind, and so you never forgot them or let them be destroyed.
translation_verse: Kɛ he nɛn nɛɛ suna aa kana nomanta, he ta ban vɛɛh kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ ba. He ɛ Korowii haa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ na ba sum.

english_verse: Our God, you are powerful, fearsome, and faithful, always true to your word. So please keep in mind the terrible sufferings of our people, kings, leaders, priests, and prophets, from the time Assyria ruled until this very day.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he kan dɛ do kpeɡri, he waa ɔma kohona. He waa dɔ kasinteŋ hɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo he ne ya naawa aa fɔwa ta. Dɛ le saŋ Asiiria koranar aa fiiɡi yaa dɛ ba le saŋ nɔ, na ɡɛ ya bwara aa nyɛɡa. Ya koranar ne nomonome, ne sɔfore ne Korowii keamere ne ya naawa, dɛ nɛra bwa na bonyɛɡa, na ɡɛ ya bwara aa nyɛɡa.

english_verse: You have always been fair when you punished us for our sins.
translation_verse: He waa toɡrɔ dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ he tɛr ya deŋne, a lole kɛŋɔ ya ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Our kings and leaders, our priests and ancestors have never obeyed your commands or heeded your warnings.
translation_verse: Ya koranar ne nomonome ne sɔfore, dɛ ya naawa ta he Mmarare ta teŋɛ. Ba ta waa haa do ba a ta ne waa haa kah ba ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: You blessed them with a kingdom and with an abundance of rich, fertile land, but they refused to worship you or turn from their evil.
translation_verse: He swee koranar andɛɛɡa ba nyiŋi he nɛra nɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa soɡe harɛpare ondɛɛɡe waa kana he kpɔ tɛɛ ba la ta, kɛ ba vɛh ba liire chara, dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta dɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: Now we are slaves in this fruitful land you gave to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Taraken, ya berɛ yoma harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ yaa ta, harɛ o fe aa wera kohona ya dɔ kondikwaa dɛɛ di o ta la ta.

english_verse: Its plentiful harvest is taken by kings you placed over us because of our sins. Our suffering is unbearable, because they do as they wish to us and our livestock. The People Make an Agreement
translation_verse: Ya wechɔɡa nomanta, harɛ la ta kondikwaa bwa dɛ kaa koranar yaa lɔ ba lɔɡa be. Gɛ baa dɛ nyin laanee baa ɛ ya ne ya kondɛɛra, anomanta, ya lɔ wahala kohona ta. Nɛra la fɔo fɔwa

english_verse: And so, a firm agreement was made that had the official approval of the leaders, the Levites, and priests.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa aa chiɡa nomanta, ya Israel tena dɛ baɡɛ nyoa dɛ́ chwera, ásɛ ya nomonome ne Lewi dea tena dɛ sɔfore kpɔ ba nonibala ɛɡre fɔo nɔ lɔɡa.”

english_verse: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah, Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah, Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch, Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah, Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch, Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin, Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah.
translation_verse: ne Maasia ne Bilɡai dɛ Sɛmaya. Gɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ sɔfore.

english_verse: The Levites who signed were: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the clan of Henadad, Kadmiel,
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena baa jaa laanee nɔ, Asania bibaa Jesua ne Binui waa le Henadad dea dɛ Kadmiel,

english_verse: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
translation_verse: ne Mika ne Rehob dɛ Hasabia,

english_verse: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
translation_verse: ne Sakur ne Sɛrebea dɛ Sebania,

english_verse: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
translation_verse: ne Hodia ne Bani dɛ Bɛneno.

english_verse: The leaders who signed were: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
translation_verse: Harɛ la ta nomonome laanee nɔ, Parɔs ne Pahat Moab ne Elam ne Satu dɛ Bani,

english_verse: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
translation_verse: ne Buni ne Asɡad dɛ Bebai,

english_verse: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
translation_verse: ne Adonija ne Biɡvai dɛ Adin,

english_verse: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
translation_verse: ne Ata ne Hɛsɛkea dɛ Asuur,

english_verse: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
translation_verse: ne Hodia ne Hasum dɛ Bɛsae,

english_verse: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
translation_verse: ne Harif ne Anatɔt dɛ Nebai,

english_verse: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
translation_verse: ne Maɡpias ne Mɛsolam dɛ Hesir,

english_verse: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
translation_verse: ne Mɛsesabɛl ne Sadɔk dɛ Jadua,

english_verse: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
translation_verse: ne Pɛlatea ne Hanan dɛ Anaya,

english_verse: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
translation_verse: ne Hosia ne Hanania dɛ Hasub,

english_verse: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
translation_verse: ne Halɔhɛs ne Pelha dɛ Sobek,

english_verse: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
translation_verse: ne Rehum ne Hasabena dɛ Maaseya,

english_verse: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
translation_verse: ne Ahia ne Hanan dɛ Anan,

english_verse: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah. The Agreement
translation_verse: ne Maluk ne Harim dɛ Baana.

english_verse: All of us, including priests, Levites, temple guards, singers, temple workers and leaders, together with our wives and children, have separated ourselves from the foreigners in this land and now enter into an agreement with a complete understanding of what we are doing. And so, we now place ourselves under the curse of the Lord our God, if we fail to obey his laws and teachings that were given to us by his servant Moses.
translation_verse: Ba bwa kpɔ ba te ja ba sitɔɔla nɛɛ dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam kɛŋɔ, baa teŋɛ Korowii Mmara waa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ la taa, dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa waa do ba a ta ne o webaɡla bwa ta. Ba ŋɔ, dɛ ba ta a ta teŋaa, Kórowii taah ba.

english_verse: We won't buy goods or grain on the Sabbath or on any other sacred day, not even from foreigners. Every seven years we will let our fields rest, and we will cancel all debts.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡa bar yaa yoɡ mea kɛɛ komɛlbwa tɛ yaa Ona Tɔpere kɛɛ tɔpere waa do ɡoroŋ bɛlbwa ta naa, yaa yawɛ. Bene anuanɛ bɛlbwa ta la, yaa ɡel ya harɛre ta paraa, dɛ́ kpɔ kema nɛra aa di yaa ɡe kɛ.

english_verse: Once a year we will each donate a small amount of silver to the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Ya sɛoh kɛŋɔ bena bɛlbwa yaa bɔ suuɡabwe jeɡaa, dɛ́ kpɔ cha Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea kema.

english_verse: This is to pay for the sacred bread, as well as for the daily sacrifices and special sacrifices such as those offered on the Sabbath and during the New Moon Festival and the other festivals. It will also pay for the sacrifices to forgive our sins and for all expenses connected with the worship of God in the temple.
translation_verse: Kema kɛŋɔ, paanoo waa do ɡoroŋ bá kpɔ dawɛ teebur ta, ne mea sarahare baa dɛ ɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa, ne sarahare baa dɛ fuah, ne Ona Tɔpera sarahare, ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, ne tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ, ne sarahare kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare baa kpɔ soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa, dɛ tomare bwa aa lɔ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea.

english_verse: We have decided that the families of priests, Levites, and ordinary people will supply firewood for the temple each year, so that sacrifices can be offered on the altar, just as the Lord our God has commanded.
translation_verse: Ya sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne nɛra la bwa ta bie, dɛ́ jemɛ dem bɛlbwa tena baa kpɔ damara ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea benanyoa bɛlbwa, bá kpɔ fuh sarahare kwaa la Korowii saraha kon la ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Mmara Tɔn bini la.

english_verse: Each year we will bring to the temple the first part of our harvest of grain and fruit.
translation_verse: Ya bwa berɔ sɛh kɛŋɔ benanyoa bɛlbwa, yá kpɔ ya koo kondikonloɡla, ne daa bɛlbwa nɔna aa tɔ sie dɛɛ ba Korowii Dea.

english_verse: We will bring our first-born sons and the first-born males of our herds and flocks and offer them to the priests who serve in the temple, because this is what is written in God's Law.
translation_verse: Yaa kpɔ ya bibanloɡla ne nae biloɡla, ne ya boohna ne peera biloɡlaa ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea ba tɛ sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma bela la, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Mmara Tɔn bini la.

english_verse: To the priests in the temple of our God, we will bring the bread dough from the first harvest, together with our best fruit, and an offering of new wine and olive oil. We will bring ten percent of our grain harvest to those Levites who are responsible for collecting it in our towns.
translation_verse: Yaa kpɔ ya kondikonloɡlaa la Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea, bela baa dɛ cheɡ kwaa la, dɛ́ kpɔ ka tɛ sɔfore la, ya mendɛɛɡa ne mea sarahare, ne ya daa nɔna, ne senfala dɛ ɔleve no. Yaa bɔne komɛlbwa aa le ya kooni ta bɔre fii, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ka tɛ Lewi dea tena la, dɛkalkɛ banee dɛɛ lɛa ya bwɛɛre bwa ta.

english_verse: which is also the place for the sacred objects used by the priests, the temple guards, and the singers. Levites and everyone else must bring their gifts of grain, wine, and olive oil to this room. We will not neglect the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Israel tena ne Lewi dea tena la kpɔ ba mea ne senfala, dɛ ɔleve noo la kaa dejeɡre baa dɛ cheɡ laala baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la bini, bela sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma ne nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo dɛ yelɡoola aa dɛ so la. Yaa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea vɛh.

english_verse: The nation's leaders and their families settled in Jerusalem. But there was room for only one out of every ten of the remaining families, and so they asked God to show them who would live there.
translation_verse: Aa ba dɛ la sie tama la, harɛ la ta nomonome baa so Jerusalam, asɛ nɛra la kabora bil daa, dɛ le dembeŋkpoŋ nɛra le deremi fi bɛlbwa bini, ba ba so Jerusalam bwɛjen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, asɛ banuanaarɛ kar la ɡe ka so ba bwɛɛre ta.

english_verse: Then everyone else asked God to bless those who were willing to live in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Asɛ harɛ la ta tena jam nɛra baa le ba te cheɡ ŋɔ baa so Jerusalam la bwa.

english_verse: Some of the people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple workers, and the descendants of Solomon's servants lived on their own property in the towns of Judah. But the leaders of the province lived in Jerusalem with their families. The Judah Tribe
translation_verse: Nɛra la bini bane baa soɡe bwɛɛre ne bwɛjena ta laanee, Israel tena la bini bane, ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, ne bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea. Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar soɡe Juda bwɛɛre ane ta. Bɛlbwa kaa so o ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ waa le o ta,

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe, three leaders settled in Jerusalem. The first was Sallu son of Meshullam, and the others were Gabbai and Sallai. Sallu's ancestors were Joed, Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, Ithiel, and Jeshaiah. Altogether, there were
translation_verse: ne Gabai ne Salai baa ɛ Sallu lolanar tenten. Bɛnjamen dea nɛra baa kaa so Jerusalam la bwa lɔ lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.

english_verse: Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in command. Priests
translation_verse: Dɛ Sikri bibaa Joel ɛ ba sitɔɔ, asɛ Hasenua bibaa Juda ɛ nomoa waa teŋa nɛɛ dɛ ja o nɛ bwɛjen la ta.

english_verse: The second priest to settle there was Seraiah son of Hilkiah. His ancestors were Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, who had been a high priest.
translation_verse: dɛ Hilkia bibaa Seraya o nabaa aa ɛ Mɛsolam. O nabaalaa Sadɔk ne Merayɔt dɛ Ahitub o fa aa ɛ Sɔfonomoa.

english_verse: Several Levites settled in Jerusalem. First, there was Shemaiah son of Hasshub. His ancestors were Azrikam, Hashabiah, and Bunni.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena ɡee nɔ, Hasub bibaa Sɛmaya, o nabaa sɔne Asrikam. O nabaala bane ɡee Hasabia ne Buni,

english_verse: Next, there were Shabbethai and Jozabad, the Levite leaders in charge of the work outside the temple.
translation_verse: ne Sabetai ne Josabad baa ɛ Lewi dea nomonnyuune. Dɛ ba ɡee Korowii Dea habɔɔ toma do ba nɔn ta.

english_verse: Then there was Mattaniah son of Mica. His ancestors were Zabdi and Asaph. Mattaniah led the temple choir in the prayer of praise. Bakbukiah, who also settled in Jerusalem, was his assistant. Finally, there was Abda son of Shammua; his grandfather was Galal, and his great-grandfather was Jeduthun.
translation_verse: Mika bibaa Matania, o nabaa sɔne Sabdi, o ɛ Asaf naa. Dɛ Asaf nɔɔ dɛɛ tɔ yelɡoola sie Korowii Dea baa ɡo jam yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, ne Bakbukia, onee ja Matania nɛɛ dɛɛ chao, ne Samoa bibaa Abda, o nabaa aa ɛ Galal o ɛ Jedutun naa.

english_verse: One hundred seventy-two temple guards settled in Jerusalem; their leaders were Akkub and Talmon.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa laanee, Akub ne Talmɔn dɛ ba lolanar, ba bwa lɔ lafa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites, including priests and Levites, lived on their own property in the other towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Israel tena baa kaa la ne sɔfore dɛ Lewi dea tena, soɡe ba ɡbaɡba bwɛɛre aa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: But the temple workers lived in the section of Jerusalem known as Ophel, and the two men in charge of them were Ziha and Gishpa.
translation_verse: Dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea soɡe Jerusalam bampera, Ofel deŋɡare ta, asɛ Siha ne Gispa ɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.

english_verse: Uzzi son of Bani was the leader of the Levites in Jerusalem. His grandfather was Hashabiah, his great-grandfather was Mattaniah, and his great-great-grandfather was Mica. He belonged to the Asaph clan that was in charge of the music for the temple services,
translation_verse: Nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi Lewi dea tena baa soɡe Jerusalam nɛɛ sɔne Usi. O mɛɛ sɔne Bani, o nabaalee Hasabia. O nabaala bane ɡee Matania ne Mika. Dɛ Usi ɛ Asaf naanar baa chɔ yela ɡoe nyoa Korowii Dea la bini bɛl.

english_verse: though the daily choice of music and musicians was decided by royal decree of the Persian king.
translation_verse: Dɛ Pɛɛsea koojen do mmara tɛ yelɡoola la, ɡɛ dea bɛlbwa nɛra aa tɔ nɛra sie tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛɛ ɡo yela Korowii Dea.

english_verse: The people of Israel were represented at the Persian court by Pethahiah son of Meshezabel from the Zerah clan of the Judah tribe. The People in the Other Towns and Villages
translation_verse: Mɛsesabel bibaa Pɛtahea waa ɛ Sɛra naanar la bini bɛl dɛ le Juda dea, chiɡ Israel tena naa ta Pɛɛsea koodem.

english_verse: Some of the people of Judah lived in the following towns near their farms: Kiriath-Arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel,
translation_verse: Juu tena la ɡalɡa soɡe bwɛɛre aa bɛne ba kooni ta. Banɔ la baa le Juda dea la soɡe bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ, Kiriat Aaba ne Debɔn dɛ Jekabsiil ne bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta,

english_verse: Zanoah, Adullam, Lachish, and Azekah. In fact, they settled the towns from Beersheba in the south to Hinnom Valley in the north.
translation_verse: ne Sanoa ne Adulam dɛ a bwɛjeɡre ta, ne Lakes ne kooni aa baro ta, ne Aseka ne o bwɛjeɡre ta. Gɛɛ ba so le Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ teŋe ba kaa Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen weekaŋle nyundua.

english_verse: The people of Benjamin lived in the towns of Geba, Michmash, Aija, Bethel with its nearby villages,
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen dea tena soɡe Geba ne Mikmas ne Aeja dɛ Bɛtel ne bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta,

english_verse: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
translation_verse: ne Anatɔt ne Nɔb dɛ Anania,

english_verse: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
translation_verse: ne Hasɔ ne Rama dɛ Getaim,

english_verse: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
translation_verse: ne Hadid ne Seboim dɛ Nebalat,

english_verse: Lod, and Ono, as well as in Craft Valley.
translation_verse: ne Lod ne Ono, dɛ Baala Baa Dɛ Sɛh Kwaa Fɛlembɔjen bini.

english_verse: Several groups of Levites from the territory of Judah were sent to live among the people of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena la bini bane baa le Juda dea la koo Bɛnjamen dea tena la bini, ba ne ba so.

english_verse: Many priests and Levites had returned from Babylonia with Zerubbabel and Joshua as their leaders. Those priests were Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
translation_verse: Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa teŋɛ Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne Sɔfonomoa Jesua nɛɛ ba le bojaŋ harɛ baa laɡ ba kaa ta ba laanee nɔ. Seraya ne Jeremia dɛ Ɛsra,

english_verse: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
translation_verse: ne Amaria ne Maluk dɛ Hatus,

english_verse: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
translation_verse: ne Sɛkania ne Rehum dɛ Mɛremɔt,

english_verse: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
translation_verse: ne Ido ne Gineton dɛ Abija,

english_verse: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
translation_verse: ne Mijamin ne Moadia dɛ Bilɡa,

english_verse: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
translation_verse: ne Sɛmaya ne Joiarib dɛ Jedaya,

english_verse: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and another Jedaiah. These were the leading priests and their assistants during the time of Joshua.
translation_verse: dɛ Sallu ne Amɔk ne Hilkia dɛ Jedaya. Banɔɔ sɔfore sitɔɔla ne banɔ la baa dɛ cha ba, Jesua bere saŋ.

english_verse: The Levites who returned were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah. They and their assistants were responsible for the songs of praise,
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena ɡe sɔnaa, Jesua ne Binui ne Kadmiel, ne Sɛrebea ne Juda dɛ Matania, ne o bala baa ja o nɛ. Banee chɔ yela baa ɡoa dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii Dea la nyoa.

english_verse: while Bakbukiah and Unno, together with their assistants, were responsible for the choral responses. Descendants of Joshua the High Priest
translation_verse: Asɛ Bakbukia ne Uni dɛ ba bala baa ja ba nɛɛ ɡe che Korowii Dea bampera, ba ne ba sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa baa ɡo yela la ane. Sɔfonomoa Jesua naanar

english_verse: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, the grandfather of Eliashib, and the great-grandfather of Joiada.
translation_verse: Jesua lolɛ Joiakim, Joiakim lolɛ Eliasib asɛ Eliasab lolɛ Joiada,

english_verse: When Joiakim was high priest, the following priests were leaders of their clans: Meraiah of the Seraiah clan, Hananiah of Jeremiah,
translation_verse: A saŋ Joiakim aa ɛ Sɔfonomoa la, dɛ banɔɔ nomonnyuune ba lolanar bini, Seraya lolanar bini, Meraya, Jeremia lolanar bini, Hanania,

english_verse: Meshullam of Ezra, Jehohanan of Amariah,
translation_verse: Ɛsra lolanar bini, Mɛsolam, Amaria lolanar bini, Jehohanan,

english_verse: Jonathan of Malluchi, Joseph of Shebaniah,
translation_verse: Maluk lolanar bini, Jonatan, Sɛkania lolanar bini, Josef,

english_verse: Adna of Harim, Helkai of Meraioth,
translation_verse: Harim lolanar bini, Adna, Mɛremɔt lolanar bini, Helkai,

english_verse: Zechariah of Iddo, Meshullam of Ginnethon,
translation_verse: Ido lolanar bini, Sekaria, Gineton lolanar bini, Mɛsolam,

english_verse: Zichri of Abijah, Piltai of Moadiah,
translation_verse: Abija lolanar bini, Sikri, Miniamin ne Moadia lolanar bini, Peltae,

english_verse: Shammua of Bilgah, Jehonathan of Shemaiah,
translation_verse: Bilɡa lolanar bini, Samoa, Sɛmaya lolanar bini, Jehonatan,

english_verse: Mattenai of Joiarib, Uzzi of Jedaiah,
translation_verse: Joiarib lolanar bini, Matinai, Jedaya lolanar bini, Usi,

english_verse: Kallai of Sallai, Eber of Amok,
translation_verse: Sallu lolanar bini, Kalai, Amɔk lolanar bini, Iba,

english_verse: Hashabiah of Hilkiah, and Nethanel of Jedaiah. The Priestly and Levite Families
translation_verse: Hilkia lolanar bini, Hasabia, Jedaya ɡe lolanar bini, Nɛtanɛl.

english_verse: During the time of the high priests Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, and including the time that Darius was king of Persia, a record was kept of the heads of the Levite and priestly families.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Lewi dea nomonnyuune ne sɔfore sɔna bil ɡɛ saŋ Sɔfonomonome ba sɔna aa teŋa nɔ aa lole. Banee, Eliasib ne Joiada ne Johanan, dɛ Jadua. Ba chwerɛ ɡɛ sɔna nɔ tonɛ ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta.

english_verse: However, no official record was kept of the heads of the Levite clans after the death of Johanan, the grandson of Eliashib.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Lewi dea tena nomonnyuune sɔna do tɔne bini, ɡɛ saŋ Eliasib bibaa Johanan aa lole.

english_verse: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their assistants organized two choirs of Levites to offer praises to God, just as King David, the man of God, had commanded.
translation_verse: Dɛ Lewi dea tena nomonome laanee, Hasabia ne Sɛrebea dɛ Kadmiel bibaa Jesua, dɛ ba bala baa ja ba nɛ. Ba bɔne ba bini kuore anɛ, beŋkpoŋ dɛ ɡo yela asɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡe ɛɛ sɛh ba nyoa. Ba bwa pɛo dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ dɛɛ jam Korowii, ɡɛ Korowii nɛn Kooro Devid aa baɡla la.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were responsible for guarding the storerooms near the temple gates.
translation_verse: Dɛ Matania ne Bakbukia ne Obadia, ne Mɛsolam ne Talmɔn dɛ Akub, dɛ daah dejeɡre baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini a bɛne Korowii Dea doonyoo la.

english_verse: All of these men lived during the time of Joiakim and during the time that I was governor and Ezra, a teacher of the Law of Moses, was priest. Nehemiah Dedicates the City Wall
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ dɛ Jesua bibaa Joiakim, o nabaa aa ɛ Josadak, ne Nehemia waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta, dɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme la lole. Jerusalam danjwɛɛ kpɔe dɛ́ do Korowii nɔn ta

english_verse: When the city wall was dedicated, Levites from everywhere in Judah were invited to join in the celebration with songs of praise and with the music of cymbals, small harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Baa dɛ ba bwɛjen Jerusalam danjwɛɛ baa maa baro kpɔe dɛ́ do Korowii nɔn ta la, ba yerɛ Lewi dea tena le bobɛlbwa baa soɡa ba. Asɛ ba ba ja, dɛ ɡo jam yela, dɛ kpɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ lɔ yela lɛ ba sie.

english_verse: The Levite singers lived in villages around Jerusalem, and so they came from there, as well as from the villages around Netophah, Beth-Gilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth.
translation_verse: ne Bɛt Gelɡal ne Geba dɛ Asmavɛt, dɛkalkɛ dɛ yelɡoola la ma ba deene dɛ so bar Jerusalam.

english_verse: The priests and Levites held special ceremonies to make themselves holy, and then they did the same for the rest of the people and for the gates and walls of the city.
translation_verse: Sɔfore la ne Lewi dea tena la ɛ we-ɛɛla, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ Korowii be pera, ne nɛra la ne doonyoo, dɛ danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen la bwa ta.

english_verse: I brought the leaders of Judah to the top of the city wall and put them in charge of the two groups that were to march around on top of the wall, singing praises to God. One group marched to the right in the direction of Garbage Gate.
translation_verse: Ate, men Nehemia yerɛ Juda nomonome la cheme danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen la doa, dɛ ɡel ba chɔ yelɡoola kuore anɛ aa kana nyoa ŋɔ, bá valɛ bar bwɛjen la, dɛ́ ɡo yela jam Korowii. Kuo beŋkpoŋ tɔ sie kpɔ sie chaɡɛ danjwɛɛ la diɡ pera, dɛ kaa Puldoa Doonyoa la ta.

english_verse: Hoshaiah and half of the leaders followed them.
translation_verse: Asɛ Hosaya ne Juda nomonome pera ɡe teŋɛ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Then came the priests Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
translation_verse: Ba ne Asaria ne Ɛsra dɛ Mɛsolam,

english_verse: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
translation_verse: ne Juda ne Bɛnjamen ne Sɛmaya dɛ Jeremia,

english_verse: and his relatives, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani. They played musical instruments like those that had been played by David, the man of God. And they marched behind Ezra, the teacher of the Law.
translation_verse: O bala ba ɡe aa ɛ Asaf naanar la bane teŋɛ o nɛ. Banee, Sɛmaya ne Aasarɛl ne Milalai, ne Gilalai ne Maai ne Nɛtanɛl, ne Juda dɛ Hanani. Dɛ ba bwa kpoŋe Korowii nɛn Kooro Devid kwaa waa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela la dɔŋa. Asɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme tɔ ba sie.

english_verse: When they reached Fountain Gate, they climbed the steps to David's City and went past his palace, before stopping at the Water Gate near the eastern wall of the city.
translation_verse: Baa tel Nebule Doonyoa ta la, ba cheɡɛ kwaa ane a do kɛ sanjol ta teeh kaa Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, dɛ ɡarɛ Kooro Devid koodem, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ ba Nee Doonyoa waa lɔ bwɛjen la wee leebɔr pera ta.

english_verse: The second group of singers marched along the wall in the opposite direction, and I followed them, together with the other half of the leaders of Judah. We went past Oven Tower, Broad Wall,
translation_verse: Kuo nɛɛte baa ɡo yela jam Korowii la kpɔ ɡal pera, dɛ kpɔ danjwɛɛ la doa, asɛ n ne nomonome la bini bane teŋɛ ba nɛ. Ya valɔ dɛ ka ɡarɛ Fononoore Dejaŋ dɛ kaa Danjwɛpaɡ la ta,

english_verse: Ephraim Gate, Old Gate, Fish Gate, Hananel Tower, Hundred Tower, and on to Sheep Gate. Finally, we stopped at Gate of the Guard,
translation_verse: dɛ le bela ka ɡarɛ Efrem ne Jesana ne Pɛŋa Doonyoo, ne Hananɛl ne Lafa Dejaŋa, dɛ kaa Peera Doonyoa la ta. Yaa vala ka tel doonyoa waa bɛne Korowii Dea la, asɛ ya che.

english_verse: where we stood in front of the temple with the other group, praising God. In the group with me were half of the leaders,
translation_verse: Kuore anɛ baa ɡo yela jam Korowii la bwa kaa che ba chebɔra Korowii Dea bela, asɛ n ɡe ka che, n ne nomonome baa ja n nɛɛ la bwa,

english_verse: as well as the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, who were blowing trumpets.
translation_verse: dɛ sɔfore bane kɛŋɔ, Eliakim ne Maaseya ne Miniamin, ne Mikaya ne Elionai ne Sekaria, dɛ Hanania kpoŋe ba bɛle.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer also stood there, as Jezrahiah led the singers.
translation_verse: Asɛ Maaseya ne Sɛmaya ne Eliasa, ne Usi ne Jehohanan ne Malkija, ne Elam dɛ Esa teŋɛ ba nɛ. Asɛ Jesrahia tɔ yelɡoola la sie, ba kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ɡo yela.

english_verse: God had made the people very happy, and so on that day they celebrated and offered many sacrifices. The women and children joined in the festivities, and joyful shouts could be heard far from the city of Jerusalem. Preparation for Worship
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, ba kpoo kwaa warɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛɛ hɛɡre, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ɡelɔ ba dɔ silɛɛ kohona. Haahna ne bechale ɡe sie lɛo, nɛra la silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa ɛɛ la bojaŋa bwa.

english_verse: On that same day, some leaders were appointed to be responsible for the safekeeping of gifts for the temple and to be in charge of receiving the first part of the harvest and the ten percent of the crops and livestock that was offered to God. These same leaders also collected the part of crops that the Law of Moses taught was to be given to the Levites. Everyone was pleased with the work of the priests and Levites,
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ la, ba le baala bane baa nyiŋi deene baa lɛ kwaa dɛ kpɔ baa cheɡ a bini Korowii Dea la ta. Kondikonloɡla ne kwaa baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ a bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋa dɛɛ ba ne. Ba lɛa le kooni aa bar bwɛɛre ta ba cheɡ deene la bini, ɡɛ Mmara aa chaɡla kɛŋɔ, anee chɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la. Dɛkalkɛ, dɛ Juda tena bwa sie lɛ ba ne Lewi dea tena la nɛ.

english_verse: when they performed the ceremonies to make people acceptable to worship God. And the singers and the temple guards did their jobs according to the instructions given by David and his son Solomon.
translation_verse: Ba ɛ we-ɛɛla dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ be pera, ɡɛ Korowii aa do ba la. Gɛɛ yelɡoola ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo ɡe ɛ, ɡɛ Kooro Devid ne o bibaa Solomɔn aa do ba la.

english_verse: In fact, ever since the days of David and Asaph, there had been song leaders and songs of praise and worship.
translation_verse: Le Kooro Devid ne Asaf bere saŋ, dɛ nɛra tɔ yelɡoola sie baa kpɛɛ dɛɛ jam Korowii yela ne.

english_verse: During the time that Zerubbabel and I were in charge, everyone in Israel gave what they were supposed to give for the daily needs of the singers and temple guards from the Levi tribe. Then the Levites would give the priests their share from what they had received.
translation_verse: Anomanta, le Sɛrobabɛl ne Nehemia bere saŋ bwaa Israel tena le, dɛɛ tɛ yelɡoola ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea kwa tɔpere bɛlbwa. Ba kpɔ saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ tɛ Lewi dea tena, ásɛ ba ɡe kpɔ anɔ la aa chɛ sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar kwaa tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: On that day when the Law of Moses was read aloud to everyone, it was discovered that Ammonites and Moabites were forbidden to belong to the people of God.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, ba kure Mosis Mmara Tɔn la a le baŋ nomɛlbwa no. Ba kure o bobɛl waa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, Amɔn te kɛɛ Moab te bɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii nɛɛ ja,

english_verse: This was because they had refused to give food and water to Israel and had hired Balaam to call down a curse on them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ ba ta Israel tena kondikwaa ne nee tɛɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la. Ba kaa kpɔ Balam ŋɔ, ó ba taah Israel tena, kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ taahna la berɛ hɛɛra.

english_verse: Following the reading of the Law of Moses, the people of Israel started sending away anyone who had any foreign ancestors. Nehemiah Makes Other Changes
translation_verse: Israel tena la aa no ɡɛ Mmara nɔ la, ba le nɛŋhɔɔhra baa koo ba bini la bwa ne harɛ la ta.

english_verse: The priest Eliashib was a relative of Tobiah and had earlier been put in charge of the temple storerooms.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔ aa wola balɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ sɔfo Eliasib dɛ nyiŋi deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini Korowii Dea. Dɛ o ne Tobia som.

english_verse: So he let Tobiah live in one of these rooms, where all kinds of things had been stored—the grain offerings, incense, utensils for the temple, as well as the tenth of the grain, wine, and olive oil that had been given for the use of the Levites, singers, and temple guards, and the gifts for the priests.
translation_verse: Asɛ Eliasib kpɔ dejen ba fa aa dɛ cheɡ mea baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha ne daawiile, ne laala bwa soo siwi aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne mea baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋa, ne senfala dɛ ɔleve noo aa chɛ kɛ ba kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena, ne Korowii Dea yelɡoola dɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi doonyoo ta, dɛ anɔ la baa kpɔ tɛ sɔfore bwa, do Tobia nɔn ta.

english_verse: This happened in the thirty-second year that Artaxerxes ruled Babylonia. I was away from Jerusalem at the time, because I was visiting him. Later I received permission from the king
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔ bwa aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ men Nehemia toole Jerusalam, dɛkalkɛ Babelɔn Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ taa n berɛ kaa o be. A habɔɔ n soŋo ŋwɛnɛ,

english_verse: to return to Jerusalem. Only then did I find out that Eliashib had done this terrible thing of letting Tobiah have a room in the temple.
translation_verse: dɛ berɛ ba Jerusalam. Maa bala la, n nao kɛŋɔ Eliasib ɛ wechɔɡa kɛ waa kpɔ dea tɛ Tobia, o do o bini Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: It upset me so much that I threw out every bit of Tobiah's furniture.
translation_verse: A ɛɛ mɛ bwaawee kohona taeh, asɛ n pa Tobia laala bwa aa lɔ Dea la bini ta buse.

english_verse: Then I ordered the room to be cleaned and the temple utensils, the grain offerings, and the incense to be brought back into the room.
translation_verse: Ate, n ɡel ba ɛ we-ɛɛla a ɡel deene la do ɡoroŋ, asɛ n berɛ kpɔ Korowii Dea laala la bwa ne mea sarahare, dɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma la ka cheɡ o bini.

english_verse: I also found out that the temple singers and several other Levites had returned to work on their farms, because they had not been given their share of the harvest.
translation_verse: N berɔ na kɛŋɔ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ ɡo yela Korowii Dea la, ne Lewi dea tena la bane ɡe le Jerusalam, dɛ berɛ kaa ba kooni ta, dɛkalkɛ nɛra la aa ban kwaa aa chɛ kɛ ba tɛɛ ba la tɛ.

english_verse: I called the leaders together and angrily asked them, “Why is the temple neglected?” Then I told them to start doing their jobs.
translation_verse: N baah diu, n kah nomonome la ɡɛ baa ɡela Korowii Dea chɔ pɛɛ la. Asɛ n berɛ ba Lewi dea tena la ne yelɡoola la ne Korowii Dea, ba baa ɛ ba tomare ja.

english_verse: Finally, I appointed three men with good reputations to be in charge of what was brought there and to distribute it to the others. They were Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the teacher of the Law, and Pedaiah the Levite. Their assistant was Hanan, the son of Zaccur and the grandson of Mattaniah.
translation_verse: N kpɔ nɛra ŋɔ baa nyiŋi deene baa kpɔ kwaa dɛɛ cheɡ a bini la ta. Banee, sɔfo Sɛlɛmia ne tɔnjereme Sadɔk dɛ Lewi dea te Pɛdaya. Asɛ Hanan ɛɛ cha ba, o mɛɛ sɔne Sakur, o nabaa sɔne Matania. Banee n ŋɔ ba bɔne kwaa la dɛɛ tɛ ba bala tom-ɛɛra la. Dɛ n dɛ yarada ba.

english_verse: I pray that my God will remember these good things that I have done for his temple and for those who worship there. The Sabbath
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, nyiŋi waa maa ɛa kasinteŋ ne he Dea nɔ ta nɔ, ne ɡɛ baa dɛɛ tomɛ bela.

english_verse: I also noticed what the people of Judah were doing on the Sabbath. Not only were they trampling grapes to make wine, but they were harvesting their grain, grapes, figs, and other crops, and then loading these on donkeys to sell in Jerusalem. So I warned them not to sell food on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, n na Juda tena bane baa dɛ tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna ta, dɛ kpɔ a nee dɛɛ ɛ sen Ona Tɔpere ta. Bane ɡe che mea ne sen ne ɡrepore, ne fiɡ daa nɔna, dɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi ba keeɡore ta, dɛɛ ba Jerusalam. Anomanta, n kah ba ŋɔ, bá nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ komɛlbwa yoɡ Ona Tɔpere ta.

english_verse: People who had moved to Jerusalem from the city of Tyre were bringing in fish and other things to sell there on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Dɛ bwɛjen Taaya tena bane soɡe Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔ pɛŋa ne laala bwa soo siwi ba yoɡ dɛɛ tɛ Juda tena Ona Tɔpere ta.

english_verse: I got angry and said to the leaders of Judah, “This evil you are doing is an insult to the Sabbath!
translation_verse: N baah di Juu tena nomonome nɛ, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa aa ɛ wechɔɡaa he ɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ chɔɡ Ona Tɔpere la.

english_verse: Didn't God punish us and this city because our ancestors did these very same things? And here you are, about to make God furious again by disgracing the Sabbath!”
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee he naawa ɛ, asɛ Korowii tɛr ba deŋne, dɛ chɔɡ bwɛjen nɔ la. Asɛ he ta teŋɛ dɛɛ chɔɡ Ona Tɔpere, dɛ kpɔ Korowii bandia kohona ba ta Israel harɛ ta la.”

english_verse: I ordered the gates of Jerusalem to be closed on the eve of the Sabbath and not to be opened until after the Sabbath had ended. Then I put some of my own men in charge of the gates to make certain that nothing was brought in on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ŋɔ bɔr aa dɛ ba joe ásɛ Ona Tɔpere tel la, bá laa bwɛjen la doonyoo ɡbeni tɔɔɡe ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa kaa. N kpɔ n tom-ɛɛra la bane so doonyoo la ta, ásɛ ba nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ komɛlbwa kpɔ ba jo bwɛjen la ta Ona Tɔpere ta.

english_verse: Once or twice some merchants spent the night outside Jerusalem with their goods.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwaa bonadiire ne nɛra baa dɛ yoɡ kwaa bwa soo siwi yon dɛɛ so bwɛjen Jerusalam baŋ Fiara jɔmɔra dɛ́ yoɡ ba kwa.

english_verse: I ordered the Levites to make themselves holy and to guard the gates on the Sabbath, so that it would be kept holy. God is truly merciful, and I pray that he will treat me with kindness and bless me for doing this. Mixed Marriages
translation_verse: Asɛ n ŋɔ Lewi dea tena la be ŋɔ, bá sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta Korowii be pera, dɛ́ kaa daah doonyoa la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba di Ona Tɔpere la, o do ɡoroŋ. N Naa Korowii, lii n waa anɔ ɡe ta ja, dɛ́ sune n nɛɛ ɡɛ he nyina kohona aa doa la.

english_verse: I discovered that some Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ n berɔ na kɛŋɔ Juda baala la ɡalɡa mo Asdɔd ne Amɔn dɛ Moab haahna.

english_verse: About half of their children could not speak Hebrew—they spoke only the language of Ashdod or some other foreign language.
translation_verse: Ba bii la bini bane dɛ bol Asdɔd wobol, kɛɛ nɛra bane ɡe baa jaa wobol ane. Baa won Juda wobol te bol.

english_verse: So in my anger, I called down curses on those men. I had them beaten and even pulled out the hair of some of them. Then I made them promise: In the name of God we solemnly promise not to let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.
translation_verse: Asɛ n baah di ba nɛ, dɛ taah ba. N lɔɔ ba, dɛ chuɡri ba bini bane ɡe nyumpona, dɛ ɡel ba ŋwɛɛ ntam Korowii sɔn ta kɛŋɔ, ba ne ba bibaala ne bihaahna bɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola Korowii tomɛ mo, kɛɛ dɛ yalɛ kpa bwa.

english_verse: So we will obey you and not rebel against our God by marrying foreign women.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ yá teŋɛ wechɔɡ damanta ne kasinteŋ haa wola dɔe dɛ tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nɛ, dɛ́ ɡe ka mo haahna baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra kɛɛ?

english_verse: Jehoiada, the son of the high priest Eliashib, had a son who had married a daughter of Sanballat from Horon, and I forced his son to leave.
translation_verse: Dɛ Sɔfonomoa Eliasib bibaa Joiada ɡe bibaa bɛl mo Sanbalat waa le Bɛt Hɔrɔn bihaah. Anomanta, n doŋi o bibaa la le Jerusalam.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish them for breaking their priestly vows and disgracing the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, tɛr ba deŋne kɛŋɔ, baa kpɔ doŋa kah sɔfore toma, ne fɔo waa chɔ he ne Lewi dea tena ne ba baah ta la wa.

english_verse: Then I made sure that the people were free from every foreign influence, and I assigned duties for the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n sɔ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la doŋa bɛlbwa ta Korowii be pera le wobɛlbwa aa ɛ wehɔɔhra ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ bɛlbwa toma do o nɔn ta, asɛ bɛlbwa jemɛ waa waa dɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: I also arranged for the people to bring firewood to the altar each day and for them to bring the first part of their harvest to the temple. I pray that God will bless me for the good I have done.
translation_verse: N baɡle saŋ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ daa baa kpɔ dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa ne ba koo kondikonloɡla dɛɛ ba. N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, lii n wa, dɛ́ sune n nɛ.

english_verse: King Xerxes of Persia lived in his capital city of Susa and ruled
translation_verse: Dɛ o soɡe Susa waa ɛ Pɛɛsea koobwɛɛ ta.

english_verse: During the third year of his rule, Xerxes gave a big dinner for all his officials and officers. The governors and leaders of the provinces were also invited, and even the commanders of the Persian and Median armies came.
translation_verse: Waa di kora bentooro te ta la, o yerɛ o nomonjena ne o nomonome bwa ba cheme, asɛ ba di kondikonjena dɛ lɛ ba sie. Pɛɛsea harɛ ne Midia harɛ laa nomonome, ne nomonome baa chɔ o harɛre bwa nyoo ne nomonjena balɔ.

english_verse: At the end of this time, King Xerxes gave another dinner and invited everyone in the city of Susa, no matter who they were. The eating and drinking lasted seven days in the beautiful palace gardens.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Kooro Sɛksɛs berɔ ɛ kondikonjena la ane ja, dɛ yerɛ o koobwɛɛ Susa tena bwa, hale dɛ́ le nomonjena nɛɛ dɛ́ kaa dansaara bwa nɛ. Ba di kwaa la koodem bela, bodɛɛɡe bɛl baa du dadɛɛɡa ane lɔɡre tɔpera anuanɛ.

english_verse: The area was decorated with blue and white cotton curtains tied back with purple linen cords that ran through silver rings fastened to marble columns. Couches of gold and silver rested on pavement that had all kinds of designs made from costly bright-colored stones and marble and mother-of-pearl.
translation_verse: Bela baa di kwaa la, ba paaɡe pilare baa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane soo siwi maa bar, asɛ dɛ kpɔ pateesanpoŋa ne pateesanburumre saɡre a ta bar. Ba berɔ pɛrɛ jisepoŋ ne jisekɔl pɛ, dɛ kpɔ do pateesanre la ta, dɛ lawɛ vɔwɛ suuɡapoŋa noniseɡa baa kpɔa paaɡe pilare la ta kaa. Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa, dɛ ɛ bobɛl o ir nyundua. Ba kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ampoŋa ne answɛɛma, ne anɔ la aa dɛ nyɛɡle, dɛ anɔ la aa ɛ burum bwa, dɛ kwaa bela harɛ o do wer.

english_verse: The guests drank from gold cups, and each cup had a different design. The king was generous
translation_verse: Kooro la ɡelɔ ba do sen tɛ nɛra suuɡaswɛm numoli bini ba nyɔ. Numoli la koɡrɔ, asɛ sen la warɛ kohona a baɡle kooro bonya waa dɔa tɛ nɛra la.

english_verse: and said to them, “Drink all you want!” Then he told his servants, “Keep their cups full.”
translation_verse: O ŋɔ nɛra baa cheme bela la bɛlbwa nyɔ sen la ɡɛ del waa won nyɔ. O ŋɔ o bonɔɔna la be ŋɔ bá do nomɛlbwa ɡɛ del waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: While the men were enjoying themselves, Queen Vashti gave the women a big dinner inside the royal palace.
translation_verse: Dɛ Kooro Sɛksɛs haah sɔne Vasti. O ɡe ɛ kondikonjena la ane, dɛ yerɛ haahna baa lɔ koodem bela la ba ba di.

english_verse: By the seventh day, King Xerxes was feeling happy because of so much wine. And he asked his seven personal servants, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas,
translation_verse: Tɔpenuanɛ wee kooro aa nyɔ sen dɛ dɛɛ la, o yerɛ o bonɔɔna baa fɔɡɛ ba lure baa tomɔ la cheme. Banee, Mehuman ne Bista ne Haabona, ne Biɡta ne Abaɡta ne Sɛta, dɛ Kaakas.

english_verse: The king's servants told Queen Vashti what he had said, but she refused to go to him, and this made him terribly angry.
translation_verse: Kooro bonɔɔna aa la o haah Vasti be la, o vɛh bala. Kooro aa noa la, o baah diu kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The king called in the seven highest officials of Persia and Media. They were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan. These men were very wise and understood all the laws and customs of the country, and the king always asked them what they thought about such matters.
translation_verse: dɛ dɔ dibɔra kooloŋ ta bela. Banee, Kaasena ne Sɛta ne Admata, ne Taases ne Meres ne Maasena, dɛ Mɛmokan. Gɛ nomonjena banuanɛ nɔ le Pɛɛsea ne Midia harɛre ta, dɛ ɛ nomonjena ɡwaa nomonome baa lɔ o kora bini bwa.

english_verse: The king said to them, “Queen Vashti refused to come to me when I sent my servants for her. What does the law say I should do about that?”
translation_verse: Ate, kooro ŋɔ o nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Vasti vɛh yera men Kooro Sɛksɛs aa tomɛ n bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá yerɔ ó ba la. Ɛrɛɛ mmara ɛɛ baɡle kɛ ń ɛo wɔ?”

english_verse: Then Memucan told the king and the officials: Your Majesty, Queen Vashti has not only embarrassed you, but she has insulted your officials and everyone else in all the provinces.
translation_verse: Asɛ Mɛmokan che kooro ne o nomonjena la bwa sie dɛ chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ he haah Vasti ɛ ɡɛ tenaa, o ɛ wechɔɡa. He ɡbo sie laa o lawɛ teɡɛ harɛ. Nomonjena ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛre nɔ bwa ta ɡe jao.

english_verse: The women in the kingdom will hear about this, and they will refuse to respect their husbands. They will say, “If Queen Vashti doesn't obey her husband, why should we?”
translation_verse: He haah waa waa ɛa nɔ, haahna noɔ waa, baa che a taa ba siwi sa ba jaranar, dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Kooro Sɛksɛs kwaraa aa do o bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ o haah la, o vɛoh.’

english_verse: Before this day is over, the wives of the officials of Persia and Media will find out what Queen Vashti has done, and they will refuse to obey their husbands. They won't respect their husbands, and their husbands will be angry with them.
translation_verse: Fini tɔpere nɔ, dɛ Pɛɛsea ne Midia harɛre nomonjena haahna no he haah waa waa ɛa nɔ naa, ba ɡee dɛɛ ɛ yaa ɡɛɛ. Haahna bwa aa yaa bu kpa, ásɛ ya baala ɡe baah ɛɛ di ba nɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.”

english_verse: Your Majesty, if you agree, you should write for the Medes and Persians a law that can never be changed. This law would keep Queen Vashti from ever seeing you again. Then you could let someone who respects you be queen in her place.
translation_verse: Mɛmokan ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, do mmarafale bá chwerɛ ja Pɛɛsea ne Midia harɛre mmarare ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola won beɡra bwa, kɛŋɔ Vasti bɛ hen Kooro Sɛksɛs sie tire kpa. O bɛ he haah ɡe ɛ kpa, bá nyin haah waa dɔ da dɛ ɡwaalo tɛɛ he moo.

english_verse: When the women in your great kingdom hear about this new law, they will respect their husbands, no matter if they are rich or poor.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba ɡelɔ mmarafale nɔ kaa he kora harɛre aa do kan kohona nɔ bwa ta naa, anee dɛ́ ɡel haah te bɛlbwa ɛɛ duu o jaa, hale dɛ́ le nomonjena nɛ dɛ́ kaa dansaara nɛ.”

english_verse: King Xerxes and his officials liked what Memucan had said,
translation_verse: Kooro ne o nomonjena la sie lɛ Mɛmokan waa waa bola la ta, anomanta, o do mmara la.

english_verse: and he sent letters to all of his provinces. Each letter was written in the language of the province to which it was sent, and it said that husbands should be in charge of their wives and children.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ ba kpɔ mmara la kaa harɛre waa dɛ di kora a ta la bwa ta. Ba chwerɔ tɛ harɛ bɛlbwa tena, ɡɛ ba chwera ne ba wobol aa doa, kɛŋɔ baa bɛlbwa ɛɛ di nomonome o dem.

english_verse: After a while, King Xerxes got over being angry. But he kept thinking about what Vashti had done and the law that he had written because of her.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, Kooro Sɛksɛs baah sɔɔhnɔ tama, asɛ o lii Vasti wa, ne waa waa ɛa la, ne ɡɛ waa koh o waa do mmara la.

english_verse: Then the king's personal servants said: Your Majesty, a search must be made to find you some beautiful young women.
translation_verse: Anomanta, kooro ɡbaɡba bonɔɔna baa lɔ o jwɛɛh la ba liire ne ŋɔ, “N Naa kooro, ɡel bá nyiŋi harɛre la bwa ta, dɛ́ nyin toli baa wera, baa wola baa jemɛ bwa tɛɛ.

english_verse: You can select officers in every province to bring them to the place where you keep your wives in the capital city of Susa. Put your servant Hegai in charge of them since that is his job. He can see to it that they are given the proper beauty treatments.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won ɡel nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi harɛre haa dɛ di kora a ta la bwa, kpɔ toli baa wera ba koodem haahna dobɔr koobwɛɛ Susa nɔ ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ba do Heɡai baa fɔɡɔ o lur, o do koodem haahna dobɔr dɛɛ nyiŋi kooro haahna nɛɛ la nɔn ta, wɛ́ɛ di ba toli.

english_verse: Then let the young woman who pleases you most take Vashti's place as queen. King Xerxes liked these suggestions, and he followed them.
translation_verse: Ba bini bɛlbwa he sie aa lɛ o nɛɛ la, kpɔɔ ɛ he haah chiɡ Vasti naa ta.” Kooro aa no ɡɛ baa jao la, o sie lɛ a ta, dɛ ɡel ba ɛa ɡɛ.

english_verse: At this time a Jew named Mordecai was living in Susa. His father was Jair, and his grandfather Shimei was the son of Kish from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ate, Susa bwɛjen ta bela, dɛ Juu te bɛl lole baa yerɔ Mɔdekae. Bɛnjamen dea o le. O mɛɛ sɔne Jɛɛ, asɛ Jɛɛ ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Simee, asɛ Simee mɛɛ sɔne Kes.

english_verse: Kish was one of the people that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from Jerusalem, when he took King Jeconiah of Judah to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiachin ne nɛra bane le Jerusalam kaa o harɛ ta, dɛ Mɔdekae ja ba nɛ.

english_verse: Mordecai had a very beautiful cousin named Esther, whose Hebrew name was Hadassah. He had raised her as his own daughter, after her father and mother died.
translation_verse: Dɛ Mɔdekae mɛnjen bie bɛl sɔne Ɛsta. O sɔn bɛl ɡee Hadasa, Hibru tena wobol ta. O siebɔr ne o mar wer kɛrɛdɛ. Ɛsta nya ne o mɛɛ aa sewa la, Mɔdekae kpɔɔ berɛ o ɡbaɡba bie dɛɛ nyiŋu.

english_verse: When the king ordered the search for beautiful women, many were taken to the king's palace in Susa, and Esther was one of them. Hegai was put in charge of all the women,
translation_verse: Kooro Sɛksɛs aa ŋɔa bá ɡaaɡe toldɛɛɡa bɔr la, ba dɔ bane dɛ kpɔ ba kaa koobwɛɛ Susa koodem haahna dobɔr ka tɛ Heɡai ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ. Dɛ Ɛsta ɡe ja bɛl.

english_verse: and from the first day, Esther was his favorite. He began her beauty treatments at once. He also gave her plenty of food and seven special maids from the king's palace, and they had the best rooms.
translation_verse: Heɡai sie lɛ Ɛsta nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ o waa su o siwi, anomanta, o do sie nyiŋu ɡɛ aa chɛa. Buɡ la ta, o tɛo kwaa waa kpɔ dɛɛ di toli, ne kondikondɛɛɡa wɛ́ɛ di, dɛ berɛ tɛo haahna banuanɛ dɛ le koodem bela báa tomɔ, dɛ kpɔ ba ka do haahna dobɔr bela waa wera kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Mordecai had warned Esther not to tell anyone that she was a Jew, and she obeyed him.
translation_verse: Dɛ Mɔdekae fa kah Ɛsta ŋɔ ó bɛ ɡel ba jemɛ o nɛnsoo, anomanta, o ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ o ɛ Juu te.

english_verse: He was anxious to see how Esther was getting along and to learn what had happened to her. So each day he would walk back and forth in front of the court where the women lived.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛlbwaa Mɔdekae yon le o dem dɛ́ la haahna dobɔr la sie bela, dɛ́ ka valɛ la sie dɛɛ ba habɔɔ kɛŋɔ o ken ɛɛ na Ɛsta dembaah belaa ɡɛ waa doa.

english_verse: The young women were given beauty treatments for one whole year. The first six months their skin was rubbed with olive oil and myrrh, and the last six months it was treated with perfumes and cosmetics. Then each of them spent the night alone with King Xerxes.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ toli la bɛlbwa dɔ bɔr la kooro be o ne ó chɔ la, korobie fi dɛ anɛɛ o kpɔ dɛɛ kwaa o te. Korobie anumɛlee o kpɔ dɛɛ fɔɡle nosɔɔhsoma baa dɛ yera korobo la, dɛ́ berɛ fɔɡle konsɔɔhsoma aa dɛ kwaa bwara ɡe korobie anumɛl.

english_verse: When a young woman went to the king, she could wear whatever clothes or jewelry she chose from the women's living quarters.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere toli la bɛlbwa aa le haahna dobɔr bela dɛɛ la kooro be la, komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin la, ba kpɔɔ dɛɛ tɛo.

english_verse: In the evening she would go to the king, and the following morning she would go to the place where his wives stayed after being with him. There a man named Shaashgaz was in charge of the king's wives. Only the ones the king wanted and asked for by name could go back to the king.
translation_verse: Jɔmɔraa wɛɛ la o be dɛ́ ka chɔ. Tɔɔ perɔ aa, baa kpɔɔ la sɛnanar denɛɛte ta, dɛ́ ka do kooro bonɔɔ Saasɡas baa fɔɡɛ o lur, wɛɛ nyiŋi kooro haahna nɛɛ la nɔn ta. Waa kooro bee la kpa, nemenɛ kooro sie lɛ o nɛɛ ó baɡle o sɔn ŋɔ bá yerɔ tɛo ja.

english_verse: Xerxes liked Esther more than he did any of the other young women. None of them pleased him as much as she did, and he immediately fell in love with her and crowned her queen in place of Vashti.
translation_verse: Ɛsta aa la o be la, kooro sie lɛ o nɛɛ kohona, o waa su o siwi dɛ ɡwaa o haahna ne toli la bwa. Asɛ o kpɔ ɡbɛrɛ waa baɡla kɛŋɔ ó ɛ o haah la piu. O kpɔɔ ɛ o haah chiɡ Vasti naa ta.

english_verse: In honor of Esther he gave a big dinner for his leaders and officials. Then he declared a holiday everywhere in his kingdom and gave expensive gifts. Mordecai Saves the King's Life
translation_verse: Kooro ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikonjena a warɛ kohona tɛ Ɛsta waa ɛo o haah la. O yerɛ o nomonjena ne nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ la bwa, ba ba di kwaa dɛ lɛ ba sie. Dɛ ɛ awola tɔpere la ona tɔpere, dɛ kɛ nɛra kwaa kohona aa baɡle kan waa doa. Mɔdekae lɛ Kooro mkpa

english_verse: When the young women were brought together again, Esther's cousin Mordecai had become a palace official.
translation_verse: Ba berɔ ba toli la ne koodem bela nɛɛtena, dɛ Mɔdekae dɔ nomonome dɛ so koodem doonyoa bela.

english_verse: He had told Esther never to tell anyone that she was a Jew, and she obeyed him, just as she had always done.
translation_verse: Mɔdekae aa ŋɔ Ɛsta be ŋɔ o bɛ ɡel ba jemɛ o nɛnsoo kɛŋɔ o ɛ Juu te la, o noɔ tɛo ɡɛ waa dɛ no o waa le o bechale saŋ bwa la.

english_verse: Bigthana and Teresh were the two men who guarded King Xerxes' rooms, but they got angry with the king and decided to kill him.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ Mɔdekae aa lɔ toma ta koodem doonyoa la, dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ daah kooro dea doonyoa la bini banɛ baa dɛ yer ba Biɡtana ne Tɛrɛs la baah diu baa vɔrɔwe kɛ baa kpo kooroo.

english_verse: Mordecai found out about their plans and asked Queen Esther to tell the king what he had found out.
translation_verse: Mɔdekae no waa la, dɛ ka taa baɡle kooro haah Ɛsta. Asɛ o ɡe kpɔ ka taa kooro be kɛŋɔ, ɡɛɛ Mɔdekae no dɛ ba bol o be.

english_verse: King Xerxes learned that Mordecai's report was true, and he had the two men hanged. Then the king had all of this written down in his record book as he watched.
translation_verse: Kooro ɡelɔ ba nyiŋi waa la bini, asɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ a ɛ kasinteŋ, dɛ ɡel ba saɡɛ ɡɛ nɛra banɛ la. O ɡelɔ ba chwerɛ ɡɛ waa la do Koojen Sɛksɛs harɛ waa dɛ di kora o ta la waa tɔn bini.

english_verse: Later, King Xerxes promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha to the highest position in his kingdom. Haman was a descendant of Agag,
translation_verse: Aa baa tel saŋ bɛl la, Koojen Sɛksɛs kpɔ nomonome tɛ Hamedata bibaa Heeman o nabaa aa ɛ Aɡaɡ, o ɛ nomonjen ɡwaa harɛ la nomonome bwa.

english_verse: and the king had given orders for his officials at the royal gate to honor Haman by kneeling down to him. All of them obeyed except Mordecai.
translation_verse: Koojen do nɛra baa lɔ koodem bela dɛɛ ɛ toma la bwa ŋɔ, báa ɡuŋi Heeman harɛ, dɛ́ɛ duuru saŋ bɛlbwa. Ba bwa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ, kɛ dɛ Mɔdekae te aa on ɡɛ ɛ.

english_verse: he said, “Because I am a Jew.” They spoke to him for several days about kneeling down, but he still refused to obey. Finally, they reported this to Haman, to find out if he would let Mordecai get away with it.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛlbwaa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ bol waa la o be, kɛ o ta ba be noɛ. O ŋɔ, “Juu tee men. Maa won ɡuŋi Heeman.” Anomanta, ba bol Heeman be, dɛ na kɛ o sie ɛɛ lɛ Mɔdekae waa la taa.

english_verse: Haman was furious to learn that Mordecai refused to kneel down and honor him.
translation_verse: Heeman ɡbabir aa naa kɛŋɔ Mɔdekae aa on harɛ ɡuŋi dɛɛ duuru la, o baah diu kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: And when he found out that Mordecai was a Jew, he knew that killing only Mordecai was not enough. Every Jew in the whole kingdom had to be killed.
translation_verse: Waa naa kɛ Mɔdekae ɛ Juu te la, o ɛ o liire kɛ waa o ɡboo kpo, dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ wɛɛ kpoo o ne Juu tena baa lɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛ ta la bwaa.

english_verse: It was now the twelfth year of the rule of King Xerxes. During Nisan, the first month of the year, Haman said, “Find out the best time for me to do this.” The time chosen was Adar, the twelfth month.
translation_verse: Kooro Sɛksɛs kora dii bene fi dɛ anɛ Nisan korobie ta la, Heeman ɡelɔ ba bil daa o sie, dɛ́ lawɛ korobie ne tɔpere waa wera tɛo, ó kpɔ ɛ waa waa vɔrɔwa la. Korobie baa lawɔ laanee Nisan korobie.

english_verse: Then Haman went to the king and said: Your Majesty, there are some people who live all over your kingdom and won't have a thing to do with anyone else. They have customs that are different from everyone else's, and they refuse to obey your laws. We would be better off to get rid of them!
translation_verse: Belaa Heeman la ka ŋɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, nɛra bane perɛ he kora harɛre la ta bobɛlbwa. Ba we-ɛɛla korɛ nɛra bwa we-ɛɛla ta. Baa he kora mmarare ɡe ta teŋɛ, anomanta, dɛ he le ba ne naa, a fe wer.

english_verse: Why not give orders for all of them to be killed? I can promise that you will get tons of silver for your treasury.
translation_verse: Dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, do mmara, ásɛ ya kpoo ba. A ba ɡɛ naa, mɛɛ bɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa lafraatoro fifraanaarɛɛ do he kara mun tɛ nɛra baa kpoo a ɡɛ nɛra la.”

english_verse: The king handed his official ring to Haman, who hated the Jews, and the king told him,
translation_verse: Belaa kooro sɛh, dɛ foo o noniseɡ waa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛɡɛ tɔn ta la, dɛ ɛ mmara la, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Hamedata bibaa Heeman waa hah Juu tena kohona la.

english_verse: “Do what you want with those people! You can keep their money.”
translation_verse: Kooro ŋɔ Heeman be ŋɔ, “Gel suuɡa la do he be, ásɛ dɛ ka ɛ nɛra la ɡɛ bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.”

english_verse: On the thirteenth day of Nisan, Haman called in the king's secretaries and ordered them to write letters in every language used in the kingdom. The letters were written in the name of the king and sealed by using the king's own ring. At once they were sent to the king's highest officials, the governors of each province, and the leaders of the different nations in the kingdom of Xerxes.
translation_verse: Korobiloɡle tɔpera fi dɛ atoro ta la, Heeman yerɛ kooro nomonome bwa cheme. O ɡelɔ ba chwerɛ ɡɛ waa bol Juu tena waa la wobol bwa soo siwi aa lɔ harɛre la bɛlbwa ta, ne ɡɛ ba chwera aa doa, dɛ kpɔ ka tɛ koranar ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛ bɛlbwa nyoa, ne ba nomonjena bwa. Kooro sɔn taa ba chwera, dɛ kpɔ o noniseɡ ɛɡɛ a ta, asɛ a ɛ mmara, dɛ chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: The letters were taken by messengers to every part of the kingdom, and this is what was said in the letters: On the thirteenth day of Adar, the twelfth month, all Jewish men, women, and children are to be killed. And their property is to be taken.
translation_verse: Ba le toroma bá kpɔ tɔne la kaa harɛre kooro aa di kora a ta la bwa ta. A bini waa dɛ chaɡle kɛ bá kpoo Juu tena bwa. Toli ne bonɔɔna ne nomonome, dɛ haahna ne bechale, bɛlbwa bɛ ka, bá ɛa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ. Adar korobie o tɔpera fi dɛ atoro weeree aa ba chiɡa, ásɛ ba pa ba laala ɡe bwa.

english_verse: King Xerxes gave orders for these letters to be posted where they could be seen by everyone all over the kingdom. The king's command was obeyed, and one of the letters was read aloud to the people in the walled city of Susa. Then the king and Haman sat down to drink together, but no one in the city could figure out what was going on.
translation_verse: Kooro aa do mmara la nomanta, toroma la ɛ warane dɛ kaa, asɛ bane kpɔ waa la perɛ koobwɛɛ Susa ta. Dɛ kooro ne Heeman soɡo dɛɛ nyɔ sen, asɛ bwɛɛ la bwa ɛɛ vuuɡi.

english_verse: When Mordecai heard about the letter, he tore his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he covered his head with ashes and went through the city, crying and weeping.
translation_verse: Mɔdekae aa na waa baa ɛa la, o kɛɛ o laala dɛ kpɔ lweyal tɔ, dɛ ɛ tɔɔ do o nyu ta, a baɡle kɛŋɔ o tea bini chɔɡɔ. O valɛ bwɛjen Susa fɔɡbaahna dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wi kohona.

english_verse: But he could go only as far as the palace gate, because no one wearing sackcloth was allowed inside the palace.
translation_verse: Koodem doonyoa ɡboo o jaɡɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa tɔ lweyal la ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ó jo bela.

english_verse: In every province where the king's orders were read, the Jews cried and mourned, and they went without eating. Many of them even put on sackcloth and sat in ashes.
translation_verse: Harɛre la bɛlbwa ta kooro mmara la aa tela la, Juu tena baa lɔ bela la tea bini chɔɡɔ baa dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wi kohona. Ba vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ kpɔ lweyale tɔ, dɛ ɛ tɔɔ merɛ harɛ dɛ chɔ a ta. A baɡle kɛ ba lɔ sibeɡra ta.

english_verse: When Esther's servant girls and her other servants told her what Mordecai was doing, she became very upset and sent Mordecai some clothes to wear in place of the sackcloth. But he refused to take them.
translation_verse: Kooro haah Ɛsta toli ne baala baa fɔɡɛ ba lure baa nyiŋi o nɛɛ la aa kaa bol Mɔdekae waa o be la, a we o nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ. O kpɔ laala tɛɛ ba ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ka tɛo ó do, dɛ́ foo lweyal la bil, asɛ o vɛh, o ta laala la lɛɛ.

english_verse: Esther had a servant named Hathach, who had been given to her by the king. So she called him in and said, “Find out what's wrong with Mordecai and why he's acting this way.”
translation_verse: Kooro haah berɔ yerɛ baa bɛl baa fɔɡɛ o lur baa yerɔ Hatak, kooro aa leo wɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛɛ la, dɛ doo ŋɔ ó ka bɔɔ Mɔdekae waa aa bala wɛɛ wi.

english_verse: Hathach went to Mordecai in the city square in front of the palace gate,
translation_verse: Anomanta, Hatak leɔ dɛ ka na Mɔdekae kɛ waa soɡe bwɛɛ la cheremibɔr, waa lɔ koodem doonyoa la sie.

english_verse: and Mordecai told him everything that had happened. He also told him how much money Haman had promised to add to the king's treasury, if all the Jews were killed.
translation_verse: Mɔdekae baɡle waa aa chiɡa la bwa, dɛ berɛ baɡle suuɡa Heeman aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, wɛɛ bɔɔ do kooro kara mun, ásɛ ba kpoo Juu tena bwa la.

english_verse: Mordecai gave Hathach a copy of the orders for the murder of the Jews and told him that these had been read in Susa. He said, “Show this to Esther and explain what it means. Ask her to go to the king and beg him to have pity on her people, the Jews!”
translation_verse: O kpɔ tɔn baa chwera, asɛ ba bol o bini waa Susa la bɛl tɛ Hatak ŋɔ, ó kpɔ ka tɛ Ɛsta dɛ́ baɡle o bini waa o be, ásɛ o la kooro be, dɛ́ ka soŋo ŋɔ ó na o ne o nɛra bwa sum.

english_verse: Hathach went back to Esther and told her what Mordecai had said.
translation_verse: Hatak kaa bol waa Mɔdekae aa bola la bwa kooro haah Ɛsta be.

english_verse: She answered, “Tell Mordecai
translation_verse: O berɔ tomɛ Hatak Mɔdekae be ŋɔ,

english_verse: there is a law about going in to see the king, and all his officials and his people know about this law. Anyone who goes in to see the king without being invited by him will be put to death. The only way that anyone can be saved is for the king to hold out the gold scepter to that person. And it's been thirty days since he has asked for me.”
translation_verse: “Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma koodem bela, ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛre la ta bwa jemɛ mmara la kɛŋɔ, baa kɛɛ haah aa won la kooro be kooloŋ ta, nemenɛ kooro yerɔ mɔɔ. Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, kpoe chɛ kɛ bá kpoo, nemenɛ kooro tɛr o suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala la tɛo dɛ́ lɛ o nyu.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro aa yer mɛ n la o be, tɔpera fifraatoroo nɔ.”

english_verse: When Mordecai was told what Esther had said,
translation_verse: Hatak aa kaa bol waa Ɛsta aa bola nɔ Mɔdekae be la,

english_verse: he sent back this reply, “Don't think that you will escape being killed with the rest of the Jews, just because you live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Mɔdekae berɔ chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kooro haah, bɛ lii kɛŋɔ haa lɔ koodem bela nomanta, dɛ ba kpoo Juu tena bwa naa, hɛɛ dɔ he nyuu.

english_verse: If you don't speak up now, we will somehow get help, but you and your family will be killed. It could be that you were made queen for a time like this!”
translation_verse: He tɔ nyoa he ta waane bolɛ taraken nɔ naa, Juu tena ɛɛ dɔ nomɛlee ó cha ba, kɛ he te ne he mɛɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ serewoo. Dɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ waa he ɛ kooro haah taraken nɔ naa, he jemaa?”

english_verse: Esther sent a message to Mordecai, saying,
translation_verse: Ɛsta berɔ ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ Mɔdekae be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Bring together all the Jews in Susa and tell them to go without eating for my sake! Don't eat or drink for three days and nights. My servant girls and I will do the same. Then I will go in to see the king, even if it means I must die.”
translation_verse: “Kaa dɛ́ ka yerɛ Juu tena baa soɡe bwɛjen Susa nɔ ta bwa cheme, ásɛ he vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ. He bɛ kwaa di, dɛ bɛ nee ɡe nyɔ tɔpera atoro chɔɔ ne jwaana. N ne n toli ɡe ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ kooro ta nɛn yerɛ aa waa o sie la, kɛ mɛɛ lao. Hale seo kwaraa yaa, ń sewɛ.”

english_verse: Three days later, Esther dressed in her royal robes and went to the inner court of the palace in front of the throne. The king was sitting there, facing the open doorway.
translation_verse: Baa vɔwɛ ba nyoa tɔpetooro wee tonɛ la, Ɛsta kpɔ laala aa baɡla kɛ o ɛ kooro haah la do, dɛ ka che koodem baah bela kooro dea doonyoa aa chaɡa, dɛ kooro soɡe o kookara ta o sie chaɡɛ doonyoa.

english_verse: He was happy to see Esther, and he held out the gold scepter to her. When Esther came up and touched the tip of the scepter,
translation_verse: Waa na o haah Ɛsta bela la, o sie lɛ o nɛ, dɛ tɛr o suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala waa kpoŋa la pa Ɛsta nɛ, asɛ o suuh tel o be dɛ kpɔ o nɔn leɡe suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala la nyoa.

english_verse: the king said, “Esther, what brings you here? Just ask, and I will give you as much as half of my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N haah Ɛsta, a som tenaa? Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ɔ? Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la, mɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ. Hale harɛ maa dɛ di kora o ta nɔ peraa hɛɛ nyin kwaaraa naa, mɛɛ tɛɛ.”

english_verse: Esther answered, “Your Majesty, please come with Haman to a dinner I will prepare for you later today.”
