translation_verse: N tɔ lweyal dɛɛ wi, Korowii pɔ n nɛɛ n so bomboɡ ta.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: N wio n sibie swɛɛ dɛ bwa ɔɡre.

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: N ta naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla ane bɛlbwa ɛɛ, n Korowii soŋa ta ɡe n kpɔ duure tɛo.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: Dɛ n sewaa, bɛ nɛra baa ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ kɛ ba! Bɛ ɡel wii maa dɛ wi n kasinteŋ waa la ta tɔ.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Taraken, n dɔ nomɛl nyundua waa dɛ ba n naa ta cheɡa, dɛ́ bol n waa tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: N daamanar dɛ mam mɛ, n dɛ wi siniire ŋɔ Korowii cha mɛ.

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin nomɛl ó che n naa ta soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ, ɡɛ dam yon soŋe dɛɛ tɛ o dɔŋ la.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: A ka n bene tamaa ken, n kaa bela baa wola laŋɛ dɛɛ ba kpa.”

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Job berɔ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Maa won hwee kɛrɛdɛ kpa, n seo tɔpere telo tonɛ, lalbɔɔ ɡbosoo kaa dɛ chɔ kpaa mɛ.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Nɛra bwa dɛ mam mɛ, n dɛ na ɡɛ ba sie aa beɡra baa muɡli n baah.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ɡbabir ba che tɛ mɛ nɔ. Umee lole dɛ́ ba che n habɔɔ?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: He kpɔ waa mun noe sɔɔh ba, haa ɡel ba di bole n nɛ.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Gɛ baa dɛ sɛɡle ŋɔ, Dɛ nomɛl le o daamanar tɛ dɛ lɛ komɛl aa, naate la biirii dɛ́ na a waa la.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ nɛra kpɔ sɛɡla nɔ dɛɛ bol n wa, nɛra lawɛ n sie dɛɛ teɡɛ harɛ.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Suna dii ɡelɔ maa na kɛrɛdɛ n nɔɔra ne nakpale ɡwaŋre, dɛ do kɛŋɔ dawii ken.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwara yɔrɔ a wa, dɛɛ pwaah mɛ ŋɔ maa Korowii tomɛ.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la ɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛ́ do ɡɛ dɛɛ la, dɛ́ teŋɛ dɔ bokpeɡa saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: N soɡa bini tɔpera tonɔ, n waa maa maɡla bil ɡe chɔɡ, n hwɛɡa ɡe tonɛ.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: N daamanar kpɔ jwaana berɛ webaŋa bɔr joɔ ɡe aa ba ŋɔ, ‘A ka tama bɔr chaah.’

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: N hwɛɡa bwa lɔ lalabwɛ, belaa mɛɛ ba n kalaŋ pae dɛ́ chɔ biro ta.

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: Ásɛ n ŋɔ lalbɔɔ be ŋɔ, ‘N mɛɛ hen,’ dɛ́ ŋɔ dudule ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Heyaa n nya ne n nimambii.’

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Waa maa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta la, n ne aa lalabwɛɛ kaa.”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Anee Bildad, Su te la chaŋe Job ŋɔ,

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Saŋ besoo he wobobala nɔ ɛɛ ba tona ɔ? Tɔ nyoa ya ɡe bol ane.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii yaa kɛ ola nɔɔ? He dɛ lii kɛ ya ɡɛnɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: He kpɔ bandia dɛɛ chɔɡ he wa. He bandia nomanta, Korowii chɔɡ harɛ kɛɛ dɛ huɡri bwejena le a chebɔra aa?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra kandea ɛɛ dimoo, wɛɛ ɡel hɔe.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Ba vala bini fa kpeɡri, kɛ a sɔɔhnɔ, jae baa dɛ ja nɛra bane la ɡelɔ ba ɡbabir chole.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Bel la dɛ lawɛ ba nalurumi, dɛ kpoŋe ba bini kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Weechɔɡa ɡboo ba bwadabi, a ɡelɔ ba nɔɔra ne nakpale bwa pɔh.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Seo kpɔ ba le bela baa soɡa ba bwara sɔɔh ba, dɛ kaa ba ne lalabwɛ.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛ daa waa sewa le o lune ta ka ta o kpala ta.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔma doŋ baa le harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ́ le bochaah ta kaa biro ta.

english_verse: without any children to carry on their name.
translation_verse: Baa bii kɛɛ naanaree dɔ, ba dwee bɛlbwa aa ka.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Gɛ aa dɛ ba wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛɛ chiɡa laanee la, nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba ɡela n bambile sɔɔh mɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwaa hɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ, sihiih aa heyaa kpo ɡɛ haa dɛ sopa mɛ nɔ naa?

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Dɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa kwaraa naa, he waane laa, n nɛɛ a dawɛ.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: He dɛ lii kɛ he ɡwaa mɛ, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ n wechɔɡaa ɡela mɛɛ na wa.

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ɡela wenaale nɔ ba n nɛ, o harɛ bel dɛ laɡ mɛ.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: N wio dɛɛ nyin nomɛl ó ba lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale nɔ ta, n do lɔŋɔ, kɛ kasinteŋ te bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: O baah dɛ di n nɛɛ kohona, wɛɛ yoo mɛ kɛ o dɔm ken.

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: Nɛra baa soɡe n dem ne n toli dɛ lii mɛ hɔɔh, n berɛ nɛŋhɔɔh ba siwi ta.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: N yerɛ n bonɔɔ o ta men chaŋɛ, hale n soŋo ŋɔ ó cha mɛ.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: N haah naa n hweera sɔɔh nyin dɛ́ no, n dɔɔranar ne n nimanar aa n jwɛɛh bala nyin.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Bechale ɡba dɛ nyiŋi n nyubaah, ba na mɛ naa, ba dɛ mam mɛ.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: N daamanar tenten kii mɛ, nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: N bwadabii tonɔ a ka n hoɡa ɡbo, a ka tama n fee sewɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: N daamanar, hé dɔ tedoma tɛ mɛ, Korowiirii lɔ mɛ bil.

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ he che n nɛɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa ɡela aa noo mɛ nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ha mɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ nomɛl fee lii n waa nɔ, dɛ́ chwera do tɔn bini,

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ n Lɛɛ lole, waa bwa jaɡa saŋ la, wɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ taa, dɛ́ ba bol n waa tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Weela nɔ aa chɔɡ n bwadabii nɔ habɔɔ n ta do le nɔ, mɛɛ na Korowiirii.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: N ɡbabir ɛɛ nao siwi nee, nomɛl laa dɛɛ ba o nae, n sie cheɡɛ chiŋ o wa.

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa yaa ba wona ɡel o bwara nyɛɡo wɔ?’ Hé dɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta dɛ́ ha mɛ.

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Ate, Sofar Naama te la chaŋe Job ŋɔ,

english_verse: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
translation_verse: “Waa la ha mɛ asɛ n piɡri chaŋe, n liire ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ ń chaŋe.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: N no waa haa bola la a ɛ chɛɡa, kɛ n jemɛ ɡɛ maa chaŋe.

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: nyubinikpeɡ tena silɛɛ aa biɡri, nɛra baa wola Korowii jemɛ dɔ silɛɛ, kɛ aa ɡɛɛ ka.

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Ba dɛ ɛ mbarafo dɛɛ ɡɔɔ ba te, ba nyu kaa leɡe baama ta,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: baa nyoɡro kwaraa kɛŋɔ peu aa kpɔ tutuɡ kaa la, ásɛ nɛra baa na ba ka la ɛɛ pɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa ba dɔɔ?’

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba fa aa na ba la aa ban na kpa, bela ba fa aa soɡa la.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Ba ɡbabir biirii chɛ kɛ bá bɔ kwaa baa lɛa le nyaara be la, ba ɡbabirii dɛ́ berɛ kwaa baa lɛa la tɛ a tena.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Ba bonɔɔne saŋ bokpeɡa la, ba ne anee dɛ́ ka chɔ teera bini.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: A do kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa aa ɛ kontora ba nyoa bini ken, asɛ ba kpɔ do ba kaŋa bini dɛɛ moɡra,

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: Kondikwa aa jo ba tea bini la, ɛɛ do kpelii kɛŋɔ tɛɡchɔɡa ken.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Nɛra kondɔɔh nyubinikpeɡ tena aa lɛa la, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba uɡe a bwa.

english_verse: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ ba fiiɡi nyaara dɛ vɛɛh ba, dɛ lɛ deene ba laa maa.

english_verse: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Ba siwi aa komɛlbwa su, kwaa baa lɛa cheɡ la, bɛlbwa aa won lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Ba lɛ nɛra kondɔɔh ba be a tonaa, anɔ la baa lea cheɡ ba be la ɡe ɛɛ le ba nɔn taa.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Ba chwao le dɔmkon baa kpɔ buni ɛo nyoa aa, hɛm o nyoa aa ɛ ayaawaa dɛɛ ba ba yaɡa dɛ́ kpoo ba.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Hɛma la ɛɛ yaɡ baa dɛ vah le, a nyoo aa dɛ nyɛɡle la yaɡɛ dɛ che ba pwɛ ta le. Ɔmee kohona ɛɛ chole ba nɛɛ,

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: komɛlbwa baa dɔa nyoɡre biro ta, nii nɛn aa wola an marɛ, ba fuh ba ne ba haahna ne bii bwa.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Nyundua ne harɛ, ɛɛ lee baa tɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Ba kondɔɔh bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, awola Korowii baah aa di kohona, kɛŋɔ nee aa sua dɛ yon kpɔ komɛlbwa kaa la.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa lea cheɡ nyubinikpeɡ tena laanee la, ɡɛɛ baa ba nae.”

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Hé tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, ásɛ n bol n wa, ásɛ n tonɔ mɔɔ naa, hé mam mɛ.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: Nɛn siee n kpɔ waa dɛɛ bil aa? Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ ń lawɛ bambile ɔ?

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋ mɛ asɛ he bwara yɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔɔra sawɛ nyoo.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: N lii waa aa puu mɛ nɔ naa, dɛ ɔmee laɡ mɛ taeh, n bwara bwa ɛɛ sa.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɡel nyubinikpeɡ tena so biɡri, dɛ hwɛɛh dɛɛ dɔ ba te nɔɔ?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Ba dɛ dɔ bii ne naanar, dɛ́ so ba kpeɡ ba siwi ta.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta ba deremi, baa wola ɔmɛ, Korowii aa ba deŋne tɛr.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Ba nabala dɛ jwee, ba naneene loɡle, aa harɛ dɛɛ ta.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Ba yiiɡi kwaa dɛɛ lɔ janjela ba bii ɛɛ sa, ba bii no kalipe sii ba sie lɛ kohona.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra la dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh ba soɡa bini bwa, dɛ yon sewɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ta, bá huɡ ba.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Ane a bwa, ba dɛ bol Korowii be ŋɔ, ‘Gel ya so ya soɡa jeiih ken! Yaa he waa la nyin dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Ba wer doe toole ba ɡbaɡba be, anomanta, n ne ba toole wobɛlbwa bini.

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena piɡri dɛɛ sewaa? Wekpeɡa toolo dɛɛ ba ba nɛ aa? Korowii baah diu o tɛr nɛnchɔɡe deŋne bwa naa?

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡhole peu kpɔa ba kaa la aa? Kɛɛ haahra dompeu kpɔ ba kaa. Akai!

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: He bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii kwaa mɛɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ cheɡ o bie.’ Korowii tɛr mɛɛ la ɡbaɡba deŋne o wechɔɡa la waa o na.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Gel wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la ɡbabir na o deŋnetɛra waa dɛ ba dɔe, dɛ́ nyɔ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la danana ne.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: O waane laa bii waa ta ba habɔɔ wa, ɡɛ saŋ o tɔpera aa ba su dɛ ba a jaɡa la.

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Nomɛl ɛɛ won baɡle Korowii wa aa? Onee dɛɛ bol hale nomonjena wa.

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Nomɛl ɡe dɛ́ sewɛ sum ne, o ta som bɛlbwa nae bwa.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Ba bwa dɛ́ sewɛ baa huɡ ba, ásɛ kwaa di ba ola.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: N jemɛ waa bwa aa lɔ hé liire bini, ne liichɔɡa haa liira dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bwa wa.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: He dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa nɛnjena la nɛra, ba fa aa ɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena deremi, ba fa aa soɡe a bini la dɔɔ?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Korowii laa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra daa le, awola waa ba tɛr nɛra deŋne, wɛɛ ɡel ba tenee awola waa ba kembɔr ne la.

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Ba te la, ba dɛ la ka huɡ ba, nɛra dɛ daah ba ŋwama,

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: He te, waa aa wola mun dɔe he bol dɛɛ larawe n bwara, he wobol bwa ɛ nyosone.”

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Dɛ he waa toɡrɔ aa, Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ dɛ dɔ komɛl, kɛɛ he waa wer aa, a dɔ tɔnɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ɔ?

english_verse: Is he correcting you for worshiping him?
translation_verse: Haa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii waa wɛɛ ba he pwaeh, dɛ́ bol he waa kɛɛ?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: He wechɔɡa laa kana aa? He wechɔɡa ta nyoa dɔe.

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: He lɛ he dɔŋ kon cheɡ awɔba pɛɛpɛɛ, he laa o yal wur, o che dakpaŋ.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: He vɔmɛ nɛra nyoɡre aa dɛ kpo ba ne, dɛ vɔmɛ nɛra lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba kondikwa,

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: He doŋi luhaahna ba kaa nɔŋɡbala ne, dɛ fiiɡi bilalbii ɡe.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: A waa nafuɡere bare cheme, asɛ ɔmee den su he bwa la.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: A waa a do kɛŋɔ bɔr biro ta he nɛɛ haa wola na, a do kɛ nee suu tɔ he nɛɛ la.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Nyundujaɡla laa Korowii do aa? Dɛ ba sie ne harɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi weweela a ɡe aa lɔ nyundua aa?

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Kɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwaa Korowii jemɔɔ? Wɛɛ do biro nɔ taa dɛ́ bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole aa?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Baama aa kana tɔ o nɛ, dɛ ɡel waa yaa na. O lɔ nyundujaɡla ne harɛ baah ta dɛɛ valɛ.’

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Hɛɛ soo kɛŋɔ saŋ la tena aa? Gɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra fa aa soɡa la aa?

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Kɛ Onee tɛɛ ba kondɛɛɡa a su ba deene, anomanta, n laa n te kpɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra liire la ta.

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘Kpelaa, Korowii chɔɡ ya dɔma, asɛ nii fuh ba kondɔɔh bwa.’

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: Job, kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii, ásɛ he bwara sɔɔhne, he ɛ ɡɛ naa, wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: No waa waa dɛ doe a ta, dɛ́ kpɔa do he nyu bini.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Dɛ he berɔ ba Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la be naa, wɛɛ lɛɛ. Dɛ he laa wechɔɡa kpɔ bela haa soɡa,

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: dɛ pa he suuɡaswɛm ta bomboɡ ta, ne he suuɡaswɛm tenten ta bwea aa lɔ nenabɔɔne aa hweehra baah ta,

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold,
translation_verse: ásɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la do kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm, ne suuɡapoŋ kohona tɛɛ.

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: Anee dɛ́ ɡel he sie lɛ o nɛɛ kohona, ásɛ he won dɛɛ tomɔ bambidɛɛɡe ne.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ wiu noo ásɛ o no he be, hɛɛ baɡɔɔ nyoa dɛ́ won teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Waa haa dɛ lii ŋɔ hɛɛ ɛo ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ, he ŋwɛnɛre bwa chaah.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn lɔ harɛ naa, hé soŋe Korowii tɛo ŋɔ ó lawɔ ir, o dɛ lɛ banɔ la baa dɛ pwɛr ba te.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Nɛn wobɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛɛ kwaraa la, Korowii ɛɛ lɛo, wɛɛ che he tepoŋ haa dɔa la taa dɛ lɛo.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Hale fini n waa ta kpeɡri dɛ ɡwaa n nɛɛ ja, n pɛma habɔɔ, Korowii ta dɛ tɛr n deŋne.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa na Korowii, dɛ́ na ɡɛ maa ɛ dɛ́ la bela waa soɡa!

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: N fe ɛɛ nao ɡɛ waa chaŋ mɛ, dɛ́ no waa waa bol baɡ mɛ.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: N waa toɡra nomanta, awola mɛɛ kpɔ n waa bil o sie, ó pa mɛ bole dɛ́ lee mɛ ta kwaraa.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: Kɛ n la wee leebɔr aa, o toole bela, n berɔ la wee cholibɔr ɡe aa, maa on na.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: O dɛ ɛ toma weekaŋle nyunduabɔr aa, maa on na. O berɔ do weekaŋle harɛbɔr ɡe aa, n sie aa o nɛɛ dawɛ.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Kɛ o jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa dɛ kpɔ o ta, o daah mɛɛ na naa, mɛɛ do werii, kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm baa doo nii ta.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: N dɛ teŋɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa dɛ kpɔ o ta kasinteŋ ta, n dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta, maa bɛlbwa ɡel.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Korowii te, ɡɛ waa doa o den do, nomɛlbwa aa won beɡre waa do o nyoa, anɔ la waa dɛ nyinii wɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, biro la ta ɡelɛ n ɡel wii, a lole kɛŋɔ biro kohona la ta ɡelɛ mɛɛ na.”

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ ŋwɛ bilalbie keeɡo, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡa kemɛ luhaah, dɛ́ lɛ o nabal cheɡ awɔba.

english_verse: The poor are trampled and forced to hide
translation_verse: Ba dɛ tɔ nyaara ŋwɛnɛ ba wenyina ta, dɛ́ doŋ ba bwa bá chwa ka sɔh.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Gɛ keeɡore yon do pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe kondikwaa la, ɡɛɛ nyaara la ɡe do, ɡɛ tentenee ba ɡaaɡe nyin kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ ba bii.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Kooni aa wola ba kwaa ɛɛ taa baa kuuh kondikwa, dɛ́ ka kuuh daa nɔna nyubinikpeɡ tena kooni ta.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Ba ta yale dɔe, dɛɛ chɔ dakpaŋ, waa dɛ kpo ba jwaana, komɛlbwa toole ba kpɔ tɔ.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Bwaalajena nɛo dɛɛ kpo ba bwejena dor, baa wola bobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ jo la, ba yon ka pɛɡle bwea ba bwara wɔrɔbe.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Ba lɛ bilalbie o taa dɛ ɔr le o nya be, dɛ lɛ nyaa bie ka cheɡ awɔba.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Baa wola yale dɔe nomanta, pɛɛpɛɛ ɡɛɛ baa valɛ, dɛ́ che mea le kooni ta dɛ́ chɔ lɔr.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Nyaara la harame nyubinikpeɡ tena noo dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ harame ba ɡrepo nɔna nee baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen, kɛ baa ɡel ba nyɔ ane.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ba serewa dɛ pɛmɛ bwɛjen la ta, banɔ la baa do ba bola ɡe ɛɛ wi, dɛɛ nyin Korowii ó cha ba, kɛ Korowii laa sie kpɔ ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la nɛ.

english_verse: Some rebel and refuse to follow the light.
translation_verse: Nɛra bane lole dɛ hah bochaah, baa jemɛ webaŋa valɛ.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Bɔr joɔ waa, dɛ nɛn waa dɛ kpoo nɛra iro, dɛ́ kaa kpoo nɛŋɡwɛɡra ne nyaara, jwaana dɛɛ bɛɛ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa lawɛ nɛra bane haahna dɛɛ chɔ la, dɛ́ kpa kɛŋɔ bɔr bir. O dɛ lii kɛŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa aa men na,’ dɛ́ kpɔ sie sɔh.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛɛra ku deene ɡbeni dɛɛ jo a bini jwaana, kɛ webaŋa dɛ ba tɔ ba te do dea, baa bɔr chaahna nyin dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Bɔr biraa, o ber ba webaŋa, ɔmewaa aa lɔ biro ta la man ba.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena la do kɛŋɔ, doŋa aa jaah nee sie, Korowii taah harɛ baa dɔɔ, nomɛlbwa aa ba daa kooni taa la kaa ɛ toma.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Gɛ dombwea yon nyoɡre bɔwɔb kɛɛ hwel saŋ la, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡe nyoɡre dɛɛ kaa lalabwɛ.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Ba fiiɡi hambara ne haahna baa wola bii dɔe, ba ta luhaahna nɛɛ sune.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ chɔɡ kpeɡnɛra, a lole kɛŋɔ ba soɡe le, kɛ ba jemɔ kɛ baa mkpaa dɔ.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Korowii ken ɛɛ ɡeloo ba bwara sɔɔh ba ba soɡa bini, kɛ dɛ o sie lɔ ba we-ɛɛla ta.

english_verse: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, umee dɛ won ŋɔ n teŋe nyosone, dɛ́ baɡle kɛ ɡɛ laa waa la doɔ?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Belaa Bildad, Su te la chaŋe ŋɔ,

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Korowiirii dɔ kpeɡri komɛlbwa ta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa ɔmɔ, o ɡelɔ deŋnesɔɔhna do o be nyundua bela.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ o laa tena nyoa ɔ? Bobɛlbwa toole o bochaah la aa wola toole.

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Hale dɛ korobie aa chaah Korowii be, weweela aa were o be naa,

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini waa do kɛŋɔ dudul kɛɛ sɔɡlɔ do o be nɔ?”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Na ɡɛ haa cha nɛn waa wola bokpeɡa dɔe! Berɛ na ɡɛ haa lɛ men maa ɡwɛɡraa nɔ!

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Na jae haa ja nɛn waa wola wejema dɔe! Na ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ waa mun noe kohona!

english_verse: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
translation_verse: Umee chae he bol ɡɛ waa nɔɔ? Umee tɛɛ liire he bol ɡɛ waa nɔɔ?

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Lala bwara dɛ sa kɛrɛdɛ, banla baa lɔ neerare bini, ne kwaa aa soɡe a bini bwa.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Lalabwɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ Korowii siwi ta, komɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔ o ta waa wola on na.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Korowii paɡri weekaŋle nyunduabɔr bɔle, bela komɛlbwa aa wola toole, o ta ɡelɛ harɛ saɡɛ komɛlbwa ta o lawɔ kpoŋe.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: O kpɔ kon tɔ korobie bwa, dɛ paɡri o baama tɔ o ta.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: O pere bochaah le biro ta, o do kɛŋɔ jwɛh dɛ teŋɛ mpo ne nyundua baah.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ pilare aa lawɛ nyundua kpoŋe laanee yaa, aa yiiɡuu ɔmee lawa.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ ɡel mpo ɛɛ vuuɡi, dɛ che o wejema ta chɔɡ mpo bini oljen Rahab.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: O nyoa peuwee ɡela nyundua chaah, o nɔn nee o kpo kontuuɡi damanta waa ɛ harɛkon, dɛ tuuɡa dɛɛ kaa la.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Waa waa ɛa la bini tamaa la, a bini wetama anee ya no. Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ kpela, ɡɛ Korowii kan ne o kpeɡri aa doa ɔ?”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii, waa lole saŋ bɛl bwa, Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ waa wola men kɛrɛdɛ ɛɛ, dɛ ɡel mɛɛ na wahala,

english_verse: and while he gives me breath,
translation_verse: n ta aa lɔ mkpa bini, Korowii ta ɡel mɛɛ hwee nɔ,

english_verse: I will tell only the truth.
translation_verse: maa nyoa pili bol wechɔɡe bɛlbwa, maa nyosonee teŋe.

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Maa won ŋɔ he waa wer, maa sɛh ŋɔ n di bolchɔɡe ka tel kɛŋɔ maa sewa.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: Korowii, ɡel n dɔma na ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ na, bá na ɡɛ nɛra ba wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe aa dɛ na.

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ no ba wii ɡɛ saŋ wenaale aa ba ba nɛɛ yaa?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Ba sie ɛɛ dɛɛ lɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ nɛɛ yaa? Baa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwaa yaa?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii kpeɡri aa doa, maa On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la ŋwɛnɛree kpɔ sɔh heya.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: He bwa siwi na ɡɛ waa nɔ. Ɛrɛɛ he ta ɛɛ bol waa aa wola mun dɔe nɔɔ?

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ, aa dɛ ba ɡela a pu nyubinikpeɡ ne sikpeɡ tena laanee nɔ.

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Ba bii ɛɛ warɔɔ, kɛ baa kpoo ba laa taa, ba naanar aa kondikwaa dɔ di vaɡɛ.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Weechɔɡaa dɛ́ kpoo ba bii ne ba naanar baa ba ka la, ba luhaahna aa ban wi.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: A lole kɛ ba dɔ suuɡapoŋ kɛ nee ken, dɛ dɔ yale kohona,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: nɛra ba wa aa toɡra laanee dɛ́ tɔ yale la, ásɛ banɔ la wobɛlbwa aa wola toole ba nɛɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la bɔne dɔŋa.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena deene baa maa do kɛŋɔ kon dudul yon sɔh tɔ o nɛɛ la, kɛɛ pata nɛn waa dɛ kpa koo aa doa.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ chɔ kɛ kondɔɔhna, kɛ baa ɡɛɛ ka, ba ne jara dɛ a bwa le ba nɔn ta.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ɔmee dɛ́ piɡ ba kɛŋɔ nee aa sua, peukpeɡ ta dɛ́ ba kpɔ ba kaa jwaana.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ba taɡ baa ta, waa wola ba nɛɛ sune, ba chwa dɛɛ le o be.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Harɛ binii ba kwi buni dɛɛ le, dɛ dɔ ayaawa dɛɛ le bwea ane ɡe ta.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ taa kondikwa le dɛɛ ba, kɛ o bini ɡe, ba kpɔ nii dɛɛ peɡri bwea la ɡɛ saŋ.

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Jumbii aa dɛ di ola bɛlbwa aa bela ŋwɛnɛ jemɛ, kɔla siwi ta bela nae bwa.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Kpɔɡ bini ola ta bela kpɔe bwa, nyujente ta bela laŋɛ bwa.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Nɛra kwiu dɛ paɡre bwekpeɡa, dɛ kwi bwejena a lɔɡre chɔ.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Ba forɛ bɔɔ bwea la bini, ba siwi ɛɛ na kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa la bwa.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Ba nyiŋi neerare nyuune ta, dɛ kpɔ kwaa aa sɔah la ɛɛ le baŋ.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Haa won na wejema neerare vile ta. Mpo ta ɡe, haa won dɔɔ bela.

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Baa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten yawɔ, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ ɡɛ suuɡapoŋ tɔɡre aa doa maɡɛ o yoɡ.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kɛɛ diɡi maɡɔ, haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare charɔ.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Ane ɡe a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, ne suuɡaswɛm baa yawa dɛɛ le bojaŋ harɛ ɡba, ta on tele.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: O sɔh nɛra ne ola bwa Korowii aa taa, hale jumbii aa dɛ ɡah ɡba.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa lɔ lalabwɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Tamaa kenii ya no o wa.’

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Korowii dɔ o ŋwɛnɛ wejema, o ɡboo jemɛ bela waa lole,

english_verse: he alone sees everything beneath the heavens.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ o dɛ na harɛ jaɡa bwa, dɛɛ na komɛlbwa waa lɔ o ta.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Korowiirii ɡela peu nyoa do kpeɡri, dɛ maɡɛ mpo bini ne,

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: dɛ baɡle ɡɛ saŋ bwaala aa dɛɛ nɛ, dɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ bwaala aa kɔr dɛɛ kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: he also determined the truth and defined wisdom.
translation_verse: O na wejema kɛŋɔ o waa hiaoh, dɛ na kɛŋɔ o wer, dɛ daahno na.

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ nɛwɛnyini be ŋɔ, ‘N ɔmaa dɛɛ ba ɡela hé dɔ wejema, he ki wechɔɡa ɡe aa, anee waa mun noe.’ ”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: “Gɛ n fe aa dɛ nyin kɛ n berɛ do kɛ ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa nyiŋi n nɛɛ,

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: ɡɛ saŋ waa ɡela n ŋwɛnɛre chaah dɛ ɡel n won valɛ biro ta!

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ n fa aa cheɡɛ n naa ta, dɛ kpɔ Korowii ɛ n dam tenten, o kpɔ nɔn tɔ n ne n dem tena nɛ.

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: ɡɛ saŋ n fa aa ɛ kondɔɔh dɛ n dɔ ɔleve noo taeh!

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɛ la bwɛjen la doonyojen la ta, dɛ́ ka so bela nomonome bwa aa dɛ so la,

english_verse: while the older ones stood
translation_verse: nomonome ɡel wobol, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔɔra tɔ nyoo.

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: Hale nomonjena dɛ hel, baa wola waa bol.

english_verse: Everyone was pleased with what I said and did.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa no n wobol dɛ́ bol n bwara wedɛɛɡe, banɔ la baa na mɛ kpɛɛ mɛ,

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: lɛɛ maa dɛ lɛ nyaara baa wia dɛɛ nyin nɛra bá cha ba la wa, ne bilalbii baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa cheɡɛ seo nyoa soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ, n ɡel luhaahna baah sɔɔh ba.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Menee fa dɛ tɔ nyoŋa sie, dɛɛ cha boobie.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: N do kɛŋɔ mɛɛ dɛ tɛ nyaara, dɛɛ cha hɔɔhra ba wa aa lɔ kɔɔto.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: N dɛ sɔɔh nyubinikpeɡ tena nyoa, dɛ́ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ di kpeɡri ba nɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: N liiro kɛŋɔ ń dɔ mkpajaŋ, dɛ́ chɔ n dem sewɛ sɔnɔnɔɔ.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: N do kɛŋɔ daa o lune aa kaa nee ta, asɛ mɛn ɛɛ ta o kpala ta jwaana.

english_verse: or like an archer's new bow.
translation_verse: N nyanyini aa tonɛ bwa, n bwara ɛɛ do kpeɡri saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ kpa dɛ́ no n wa, ba dɛ hel jeiih ken, dɛ́ no n wejaala.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: N bol waa tonaa, baa waa bol kpa, n waa dɛ jo ba nyuune bini.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Ba dɛ kpaa mɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra yon dɛɛ kpa bwaala la, kɛŋɔ paara aa dɛ kpa yoo saŋ bwaala ken.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: N ɛ ba nyu te dɛɛ tɔ ba sie, n soɡe ba bini kɛŋɔ kooro ne o laa tena, dɛ do kɛ nɛn waa dɛ larawe nɛra ba loo aa kua bwara.”

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: Job teŋɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra maa ɡwaa ba nomonome kwaraa dɛ mam mɛ taraken! Ba mɛɛnanar kwaraa n fe aa wola ban kpɔ, ba ne n nyootena daah n peera.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Nyaa ne lɔr nomanta, ba lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin kondikwa jwaana.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Ba doŋi a ɡɛ nɛra la le ba bala bini, dɛɛ moo ba kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛra ken.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Nenabɔɔne aa hweehra binii ba ka so, bwea baah ne bɔɔne bini bwa.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Ba ɛ nɛra ba wa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe, ba ta sɔna dɔe, ba doŋ ba le harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Name, menee ba bibaala kpɔ ɡo yela dɛɛ mamɛ, menee ba kpɔ maɡɛ waa dɛ bol dɛɛ mamɛ.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Ba hah mɛ, baa men bɛne, baa waa haŋre, dɛ ta nentane dɛɛ ta n siebɔr.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Korowii aa ɡela n ɡwɛɡre, maa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa nomanta, ba na mɛ naa, ba dɛ ɛɛ mɛ wobɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Ba yon pɛ nyoa lɔ ba tɔ n nɛɛ dɛɛ yoo mɛ, dɛ doŋ mɛ n chwa dɛɛ kaa, dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Ba tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ́ dɔ bɔr chɔɡ mɛ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ kah ba.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Ɔmee kohona chole n nɛ, n nyanyini kaa kɛŋɔ peu ken, n kondɔɔh ɡe bwa le n nɔn ta kaa kɛŋɔ bam ken.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba sewa, tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ na wahala.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: N hoɡa bini dɛ chwee mɛ jwaana, n bwara bini wee aa men ɡel bwa.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Korowii hamɛ n baŋa, n batakaare jwereme marɛ n nɛ.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: O taɡ mɛ ta kpechɛɡre ta, n do kɛŋɔ teera ne tɔɔ aa wola toole wobɛlbwa bini la.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ yerɛ kɛ haa men chaŋe, n iro che, kɛ he sie pa n nɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ seo binii hɛɛ kaa n ne, bela haa lea cheɡ nomɛlbwa la.

english_verse: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.
translation_verse: Kpelaa, nɛn waa lɔ wahala ta, dɛ wi dɛɛ nyin nɛn ó chao la, baa on lɔ.

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Kɛ maa dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ wedɛɛɡa ta la, wechɔɡaa mɛɛ dɔ, maa dɛɛ nyin bochaah la, biroo mɛɛ na.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: N bambile bini dɛ wure, waa ɡel bwa, tɔpere bɛlbwaa wenaale ɛɛ puu mɛ.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: N lɔ tebinichɔɡ ta saŋ bɛlbwa, maa wɛre bwa, n iro dɛɛ che nɛra baah ta, dɛɛ soŋe kɛ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: N dɛ wi suna wii kɛŋɔ kalampoŋa kɛɛ taataa aa dɛ si la ken.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: N bwadabii sie biro dɛɛ sɔle, n bwara bwa wɔrɔbɔ kɛŋɔ kabul aa laɡ mɛ ken.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: Job berɔ ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ maa bitoloo nyiŋi n pɛla dɔɔ.

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Waa n we-ɛɛla jemaa? Waa n naɡale bɛlbwa na naa?

english_verse: I am not dishonest or deceitful,
translation_verse: Dɛ n teŋɛ wepuu ta, kɛɛ dɛ teŋɛ nyosone waa ta naa,

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
translation_verse: amɔ Korowii nyiŋi n waa bini, wɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛ,

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: amɔ Korowii ɡel nɛra bane di kwaa maa para, dɛ́ ɡel ba fuɡri n koo kondikwa.

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: Dɛ n pɛla dɔ haah, kɛɛ dɛ n kaa pɛl n dɔŋ bɛl doonyoa aa,

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: A fe ɛ sihihwa, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá bol a waa dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: Aa doo kɛŋɔ nii dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa, dɛ́ kaa n ne seo ta, dɛ́ chɔɡ komɛlbwa maa dɔa.

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: Dɛ n ta kasinteŋ bolɛ n bonɔɔna ne toli be, ɡɛ saŋ waa aa lɔ n ne ba baah ta naa,

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona ka che Korowii sie nɔ? Bɔkwa waa mɛɛ ba dɔe dɛ́ bol o be n we-ɛɛla waɔ?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Korowii waa ta mɛ do n nya tea bini laa ta ba ɡe aa? O tenten laa ta ya bwa do teene bini naa?

english_verse: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
translation_verse: Dɛ n vɛh nyaara pɛla kwaa kpɔe dɛ tɛɛ ba, kɛɛ dɛ ɡel luhaana hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ,

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: n ɡbosoo kpɔ n kondikwa, n ta bilalbii ane tɛɛ,

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: kɛ n bonɔɔne saŋ n nyiŋi nyaara nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba mɛɛ, dɛ nyiŋi luhaahna nɛɛ le n bechale saŋ,

english_verse: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
translation_verse: o ta andɛɛɡa sweerɛ tɛ mɛ, kɛ maa wola n peera pona kpɔe sɔh yal tɛo,

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: kɛɛ dɛ n aah bilalbie dɛ fiiɡu, jema maa jema kɛŋɔ mɛɛ di bole kɔɔto la waa yaa,

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: Kórowii ɡel n nɔɔra kuuɡi, dɛ́ tor le n vam ta.

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: N ɔmɛ waa Korowii aa ɡel a ba n nɛ, n ɔmɛ o kan waa doa, n ta wone ɛ ɡɛ waa la.

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: dɛ n fe dɛ hɛɡre n kondɔɔh kohona wa, kɛɛ kwaa maa dɔa,

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: Dɛ n sie fe lɛ n dɔm wahala waa dɛ na, kɛɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ o waa waa dɛ na ta,

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: n ta waa bolɛ dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ taahno o sewɛ,

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: dɛ n tɔ n wechɔɡa ta ɡɛ bane aa dɛ ɛ, a do n bambile bini,

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: kɛŋɔ maa bol waa nɛra aa bol la wa, asɛ n ɔmɛ mama n lolanar aa mam mɛ waa kohona, n tɔ nyoa n ta buse leɛ.

english_verse: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
translation_verse: Dɛ n fe dɔ nɛn waa no n wa, n kpɔ n waa bil o sie, Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔree dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ, nɛn n ne waa dɔa la, ó chwerɛ waa la.

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔa dawɛ n vam ta, dɛ́ kpɔ pi kɛ kooɡbɛrɛ.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ baɡle Korowii wobɛlbwa maa ɛa n baŋa pa ásɛ n ba o sie maa wola ɔmɛ.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: Dɛ n harɛ la dɛ wi n tɛl kɛŋɔ nɛn, o pweeri ɛɛ wi siniire,

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: dɛ n di harɛ la ta kondikwa n ta a kem bɔe, dɛ ɡel harɛ la tena bambile chɔɡ aa,

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: ate Korowii ɡel mea a fe aa le la, jabalnadaŋɛre le chiɡ a naa ta, ane ɡe soo siwi aa le la, kpɔɡa le chiɡ a naa ta.” Job nyoa wobol la chiɡo.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do Job daamanar batoro la ɡel o chaŋa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɛ lii kɛ o waa toɡrɔ o ɡbaɡba be.

english_verse: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
translation_verse: Belaa Barakɛl bibaa Elihu, o nabaa sɔne Ram, ba bwa le Bus dea. Elihu baah di Job nɛɛ kɛ waa ŋɔa ŋɔ o waa toɡrɔ ɡwaa Korowii la.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: O baah di Job daamanar batoro la ɡe nɛ, kɛ baa wola wone ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ o waa ta maɡrɛ la.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Elihu lawɛ bambile tama mɔɔ dɛ bol waa Job be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ɡwaalo nomonome.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Waa naa kɛŋɔ nɛra batoro la ta waane dɔe dɛ́ bol Job be la, o baah diu.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: Ate, Barakɛl bibaa Elihu ŋɔ, “Bechalaa men, heyaa nomonome, a waa mɛɛ ɔmɛ kɛ n pili nyoa dɛ́ baɡle waa maa jema he be.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: N liiro kɛŋɔ, ‘Nomonomee chɛ kɛ ba bol wa, ásɛ nɛra baa biɡra ɡe ɛɛ baɡle nɛra wejema.’

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ŋɔ, he cheɡ deŋne no n be! N ɡe ɛɛ baɡle heyaa anɔ la maa jema.

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: He bɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ya na wejema, Korowiirii dɛ ŋɔ o wa aa were, nɛn te laa.’

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: N laa Job bol waa yaɡɛ, maa he nyoa wobol taa che dɛ́ chaŋo.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Job daamanar batoro la bwara yɔrɔ, ba ta waane dɔe dɛ́ bol, baa jemɛ waa baa bol.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Baa hela nɔ, n kpa tama aa? Baa cheɡa baa wola wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ bol nɔ.

english_verse: No! I will give my opinion,
translation_verse: N ɡee bol waa, mɛɛ bol anɔ la maa jemaa.

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Wobol su n nyoa, maa won ɡel a ka n tea bini.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Maa bɛlbwa siebɔree nyiŋi ɡwaa bɛl, maa waa bol dɛɛ fɛrɛ,

english_verse: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
translation_verse: dɛ n bol waa dɛɛ fɛrɛ aa, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ mɛɛ.”

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Korowii Doma taa o che ta mɛ, On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔree hweera do n bini n dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ wonoo waa, chaŋ mɛ, kpɔ he te dɛ́ ba n sie.

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: N deno do kɛ hen Korowii sie, teeraa ba kpɔ ma n ɡe.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛ he ɔm mɛ, kɛɛ mɛɛ fiiɡii.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii na wechɔɡa n nɛ, o kpɔ mɛ ɛ o dɔm.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: O do kpɛɛ n nakpale, dɛɛ nyiŋi n vala bini bwa.’

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: Job, he waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe anɔ ta, Korowii ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini.

english_verse: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ he bol he waa dɛɛ baɡle Korowii waa wola hen chaŋe nɔɔ?

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ bol waa fini, kere dɛ bol anfala, kɛ nɛn aa liire a ta do.

english_verse: Sometimes in the night, he uses terrifying dreams
translation_verse: Deera ne wepila ta jwaana, ɡɛ saŋ nɛn aa chɔ dom kwaraa o kalaŋ ta la,

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: dɛ́ berɛ ba liire le wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, dɛ́ le ba ne mbarafo ta,

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba ba bɛ ban kpoo.

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ́ tɛr nɛra deŋne weela ne, ba hoɡa bini bwa ɛɛ wee ba kohona,

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: ásɛ kondikwa aa ba som do, ba pɛla yon le kondikondɛɛɡa ta.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Ba ɡwaŋɛ, haa won jem ba kpa, dɛ́ ka hoɡa ɡbo.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: A ka tama ba sewɛ ba huɡ ba, dɛ́ sewɛ kaa lalabwɛ.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ nyundua torome balɔ dɛ́ ba cha ba aa, bɛl le kaɡboŋa bini ba dɛ́ ba che tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ baɡle waa aa wera tɛ nɛwɛnyini,

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: dɛ ba na ba sum, dɛ́ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, ‘Lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa n dɔ kon dɛ́ kpɔ charɛ ba nyu,’

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra la soŋe Korowii aa, o dɛ na ba sum, ba dɛ tomɛ Korowii silɛɛ ne, Korowii dɛ lɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ ba waa toɡrɔ o be.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: Asɛ bɛlbwa ba che nɛra baah ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ le waa aa toɡra ta, Korowii ta ɡelɛ n dɔ deŋnetɛra aa chɛ mɛ.

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: O lɛɛ mɛ le seo nyoa, n ta so le dɛɛ na som nɔ.’

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Korowii ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn kera anɛ, hale kera atoro,

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: dɛ́ lawɔ le seo ta, ó bɛ sewɛ, dɛ́ so mkpa ta silɛɛ ne.

english_verse: So, Job, pay attention and don't interrupt,
translation_verse: Job, cheɡ deŋne, ásɛ dɛ no n be, hel, ásɛ n bol wa.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔ waane dɛ́ bol aa, he chaŋ mɛ, bol wa n jemɛ kɛŋɔ he waa toɡrɔ.

english_verse: Otherwise, listen in silence to my wisdom.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, no n be, hel, mɛɛ chaɡle wejemaa.”

english_verse: Elihu said:
translation_verse: Elihu berɔ ŋɔ,

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: “Nɛra haa ɛ wejerema, hé no n waa nɔ, hé no, nɛra haa jemɛ wa.

english_verse: Think about my words, as you would taste food.
translation_verse: Deŋnee dɛɛ no wa, asɛ nyondoŋe ɛɛ daɡɛ kondikwa.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya kpɔ waa aa toɡra dawɛ ya nɛ, hé ɡel ya pɛ hweli waa aa wera.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Job te ŋɔ, ‘N ta bolchɔɡe dii, kɛ Korowiirii vɔm mɛ bole pae.

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: A lole kɛ n waa toɡrɔ, kɛ ba dɛ lii mɛ nyosonteŋni, a lole kɛ n ta bolchɔɡe dii, Korowii do mɛ bol, asɛ mɛɛ ba sewa.’

english_verse: But to tell the truth, Job is shameless!
translation_verse: Nɛn besoo Job, waa wola duure kpɔe tɛ Korowii nɔɔ?

english_verse: He spends his time with sinners,
translation_verse: O ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa pɛa, o ne nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ valɛ.

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Kɛ Job te bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Tɔnɔ bɛlbwa toole dɛ tɛ nɛn kɛŋɔ o ne Korowii pɛ.’

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé no men Elihu be, he nɛra haa dɛ no waa mun. Nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛ Korowii aa wechɔɡa ɛ, On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la aa won ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Umee kpɔ harɛ nɔ do o nɔn ta nɔ? Umee ŋɔa wɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ nɔ bwa ta nɔ?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii fe saahnɔ ŋɔ, wɛɛ laa o hweeraa kpɔ nɛn bini naa,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: nɛwɛnyina bwa fe ɛɛ pɛo serewe, dɛ́ bwa berɛ kaa teera bini.

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa hah kasinteŋ la ɛɛ won nyiŋi nɛra nɛ aa? Hɛɛ won pwah Korowii waa kana o waa toɡre la aa?

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: Waa koranar siebɔr nyiŋi, waa suuɡa tena kpɔe dɛɛ ɡwaa nyaara, dɛkalkɛ, onee ta ba bwa.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛmbele banɛ la bwa piɡro dɛɛ sewɛ harambaŋa, Korowii lɔ ba dɛɛ bil baa serewe, o dɛ le nomonjena la ne sɛmɛlɛŋ ken.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Bɔr bira toole, biro toole bobɛlbwa, dɛ́ tɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛ ba kpɔ ba te sɔh Korowii.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: Waa nomonjena waa bini nyiŋi mɔɔ dɛɛ ir ba, dɛ kpɔ bane dɛɛ chiɡ ba naa ta.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Waa dɛ nyiŋi ba we-ɛɛla bini nomanta, o dɛ le ba ne jwaana dɛɛ lɛ ba nomonome ba be.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: O dɛ tɛr ba deŋne ba wechɔɡa wa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa na ba,

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Ba ɡelɔ nyaara wi dɛɛ no Korowii, asɛ wɛɛ no yera baa dɛ yerɔ ŋɔ ó cha ba.

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: Korowii ta ɡelɛ nɛn waa wola on tomɛ ɛɛ di kora, dɛ́ haɡre nɛra la bela.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, ‘N ɛ wechɔɡa, maa ɡɛɛ ɛ kpa.

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: Chaɡ mɛ waa maa wola an nae, dɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa aa, maa an ɛ kpa.’

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Job, a chɛ kɛ Korowii tɛɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin kembɔr, haa vɛh he liire chara nɔ naa? Henee chɛ kɛŋɔ he lii, n laa, bol anɔ la haa jema baɡ mɛ.

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: ‘Job dɛ bol waa aa, wejema toole a ta, o wobol ta mun dɔe.’

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Dɛ he nyiŋi Job waa bini ka tonaa, hɛɛ nao kɛ o dɛ bol waa kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ.

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: O kpɔ deŋnekpeɡ dɛɛ ja wechɔɡa ta, ya bini kwaraa la, o mamɔ dɛɛ lɔ kpaŋa, dɛ teŋɛ bol waa kohona dɛɛ yaɡɛ Korowii.”

english_verse: Elihu said:
translation_verse: Elihu berɔ ŋɔ,

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ n chaŋe, he ne he daamanar baa ja he nɛ.

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Dɛ he waa toɡrɔ aa, bɔkwaa aa tɛo wɔ? Korowii aa komɛlbwa lɛ he be.

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: He wechɔɡa ɡelɔ nɛra bane ɛɛ na wa, he waa toɡraa, nɛra banee a dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛlbwa aa bol ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa Korowii waa ta mɛ la dɔɔ? Onee dɛɛ larawe nɛn bwara o wenaale ta jwaana.

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ wi aa, Korowii aa ban chaŋe, mbarafo wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ ɛ nomanta.

english_verse: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa jaa, he ŋɔ waa nɛra deŋne tɛr o bandia ne, waa sie do kohona wechɔɡ-ɛɛra be.

english_verse: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.
translation_verse: Job, he dɛ bol waa pɛɛpɛɛ, haa wola wejema dɔe nomanta, he wobol warɔ.”

english_verse: Elihu said:
translation_verse: Elihu berɔ ŋɔ,

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Job, lawɛ bambile tɛ mɛ tama, n ta dɔ waa dɛ́ che Korowii naa ta dɛ́ bol.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ baɡle kɛ n dɔ wejema kohona, dɛ́ baɡle kɛ Korowii waa ta mɛ la waa wer.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɔ wejema kohonaa cheɡɛ he sie la, jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ maa nyosone teŋe.

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana kohona, waa nomɛlbwa vɛh, o kan dɛ jemɛ wobɛlbwa bini.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: O ta ɡelɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena so dɛɛ biɡri, o bol nyaara waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Waa sie laa dɛɛ kpɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ, o ɡelɔ baa do kɛ koranar, dɛɛ dɔ duure saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Dɛ ba lawɛ nɛra do dea, dɛ do ba jɔɡrɔre baa na waa baa ɛa aa,

english_verse: God points out their sin and their pride,
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ́ baɡle ba bá wechɔɡa ne ba mbarafo we-ɛɛla.

english_verse: then he warns them to turn back to him.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ kah ba bá sɛh ba chɔɡre, dɛ́ do ba bá charɛ liire le ba wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba no Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ wa aa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛ tɔpera aa ka ba sie taa, ásɛ dɛ so bosɔɔhna ta.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ baa no aa, baa kpoo ba keri nee, dɛ ba ta wejema dɔe.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la dɔ bandia ba bini, dɛ Korowii tɛr ba deŋne kwaraa naa, baa on soŋe ŋɔ ó cha ba.

english_verse: So they die young in shameful disgrace.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ serewe ba bonɔɔne saŋ, ba we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ baa dɔ sihihseo seo.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Korowii siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ó lawɛ dɛɛ le he wenaale ta, dɛ́ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna, dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ kondikondɛɛɡa kohona dɛɛ di.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken he dɔ deŋnetɛra ɡɛ aa chɛa kɛ ba kpɔ tɛɛ.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ kondɔɔh kpɔ neɡre, bɛ ɡel sen yawa ɡole he wa.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: He kondɔɔh kɛɛ he kpeɡri haa dɔa bwa, aa won chae.

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Bɛ too ŋɔ seo ba kpɔe warane, ɡɛ saŋ harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa aa serewe.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ he te kpɔ jo wechɔɡa ta, a waa Korowii kpɔ wahala ba ta he nɛ.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Korowii kpeɡri kan dɛ ɡwaa wobɛlbwa. Umee dɛ won baɡle waa kɛ Korowii ɔ?

english_verse: to guide or correct him. Others Have Praised God
translation_verse: Umee dɛ won baɡle Korowii wa, kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ o ɛ wechɔɡa ɔ?

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Lii dɛ kpɛɛro kohona o we-ɛɛla wa, ɡɛ nɛra aa ɡo yela kpɛɛro a waa la.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyina bwa na waa waa ɛa, nɛra che bojaŋ dɛ nyiŋa jeiih ken.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana! O kan waa doa ɡwaa nɛn liire ta, nomɛlbwa aa saŋ waa lea do le, ba le fini jemɛ.

english_verse: and supplies us with rain.
translation_verse: Bwaala le baama ta, dɛɛ nɛ kohona nɛwɛnyina bwa nɛ.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa kpɔ baama bɔle nyundua, o wobol le bwaala kɔra bini bela waa lole nɔ?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ waa ɡela bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle nyundua bwa, asɛ dɛ ɡel mpo vile bwa te bir.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Ken taa o che dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwaa kohona.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Bwaala kɔra kpeɡri lɔ o nɔn ta, dɛ́ won ɡel o ka chiɡ bela bwa waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Bwaala kɔra dɛ tɔ sie ásɛ dompeu teŋɛ, ásɛ nae bwa jemɛ o bala wa.”

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Hé bwa no Korowii taa waa do kɛ bwaala aa dɛ kɔr, kɔɡra aa dɛ le o nyoa.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle nyundua bobɛlbwa, o nyɛɡla dɛ tel harɛ jaɡa bwa.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Kpɔɡ bini ola kaalɔ, ka chɔ a bɔɔne bini.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Korowii hweero asɛ neerare sɔɔh, a sɔɔhnɔ kohona dɛ hel.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ nee do baama bini, dɛ ɡel bwaala nyɛɡle do a bini bwa.

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: O won baama kpɔe ba tɛr nɛra deŋne, kɛɛ dɛ́ ba sɔɔh harɛ, dɛ́ baɡle o nyina.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: Job, dɛɛ no waa nɔ, tɔ nyoa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii nyokpowaa waa ɛ.

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: He jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa Korowii ɡel bwaala nyɛɡle dɛɛ le baama bini naa?

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: He jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa baama saɡɛ nyundua, ne ɡɛ Korowii nyokpowe-ɛɛla aa doa aa?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Bɔwɔb dɛ kpoe he yal bini, ɡɛ saŋ peuchɔɡe waa le weekaŋle harɛbɔr, aa ba ta harɛ la ta dɛ́ chɔɡo la.

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won ja Korowii nɛɛ dɛ́ paɡri nyundua, waa do kpeɡri kɛ ayaawa aa dɛ nyɛɡle kɛ diɡi aa?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Baɡle yaa waa yaa bol Korowii be dɛ́ chaŋo, ya liire damɔ nomanta, ya ta wobɛlbwa dɔe.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Nomɛl ɛɛ won ka bol o be ŋɔ n dɛ nyin ń bol wa aa? A chɛ kɛ n tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó chɔɡ mɛ naa?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Peu tao dɛ laa baama kpɔ nyundua aa, wee dɛ chaah kohona, nomɛlbwa aa won nyiŋi nyundua.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Korowii jirima le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba kɛ suuɡaswɛm, ya na o jirima waa kana la dɛɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Korowii Waa ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ kan, yaa won bɛno, o waa toɡrɔ dɛ do wer, waa nɛn fiiɡi.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ duuru a wa, nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛ ba jemɛ wa, kɛ dɛ ɡɛn la, waa ban nyin.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Korowii chaŋe Job le peujen la bini ŋɔ,

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: “Umee hen hɛɛ tɔŋle n waa wobol aa wola mun dɔe ne nɔɔ?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Ir dɛ́ ba che n sie, ń bɔɔre wa, ásɛ he chaŋ mɛ.

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: Maa ta harɛ dɛ ɡel o ba che o chebɔr, dɛ leperaa he doɔ? He jemaa, he baɡ mɛ.

english_verse: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
translation_verse: Umee maɡɛ o paɡri ne o jaŋne ɔ? Umee tɛr ŋwɛn dɛ maɡɔ wɔ? He jemaa?

english_verse: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
translation_verse: Bɔkwa kwaa taa harɛ chɔŋɛ a lawɔ kpoŋe, kɛɛ umee pa o mun ɔ?

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: dɛ kpɔ baama tɔ o ta, dɛ kpɔ biro tenten fɔrɔwo,

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: dɛ pe bela waa baa jaɡɛ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa tɔ o nyoa kɛŋɔ ɡbera,

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Bonɔɔ hɛɛ ba wona ba jaɡɛ, haa ɡarɛ! He nehɛma aa kpeɡa la nyoa ɡe jaɡɛ bonɔ.’

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Job, le saŋ baa lolɛ, he wono ɡel jwaana berɛ webaŋa aa?

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: He wono ɡel bɔr chaah harɛ bwa ta, asɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra na dɛ chwa le ba sɔɔhbɔra kaa la aa?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Bɔr chaahnaa, a ɡelɔ baa na deŋɡarere ne nenabɔjena, a do kɛŋɔ baa kpɛrɛwe yal, kɛɛ baa di ɡwine vii ta ken.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa bɔchaah ta nyin, aa ɡelɛ ba dɔ bɔr dɛɛ di ba dichɔɡa.

english_verse: Job, have you ever walked on the ocean floor?
translation_verse: Job, he wono valɛ mpo vile bini ka aa? He wono valɛ mpo bɔluŋ tenten bini naa?

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Nomɛl baɡle bela baa kpɔa dɛɛ jo lalabwɛɛ waa ɛ biro la ta kaa?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: He jemɛ ɡɛ harɛ nɔ aa kana aa? He jemɛ anɔ bwa naa, he chaŋ mɛ.

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: He jemɛ bela bɔr chaahna aa lea ba naa? Leperaa biro doɔ?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: He jemɔ, dɛkalkɛ baa lolɛ biɡro! Gɛ saŋ maa ta harɛ nɔ la dɛ he lole.

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: He jemɛ bela maa ɡela mɛn ne dombwea do aa?

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: N lea cheɡ tɛ wenaale ne laa yoi tɔpera.

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Umee baɡle bwaala luɡri o che a ta dɛɛ ba, ne bwaala kɔra ŋwɛnɛre ɔ?

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel o do wer, kpɔɡa won le o ta nɔ?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Bwaala do kɛ nɛn dɛ dɔ mɛɛ aa? Nomɛlee lolɛ mɛn aa dɛ le ɡe aa?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Umee lolɛ dombwea ɔ? Umee lolɛ mɛn aa le nyundua ɡeɔ?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Gɛ kwaa nɔ yon sɔɔh dɛ hel, dɛ tɔ neerare ne mpo sie.

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won ta weweela aa wera bwa soo siwi pɛ, kɛɛ dɛ pere ane bini, bɛlbwa ka che a che bɔr aa?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won baɡle saŋ weweela bɛlbwa aa le, kɛɛ dɛ ɡel Baŋɡaahna le dɛ tɔ o bii nɛ aa?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: He jemɛ Mmarare aa dɛ baɡle weweela aa lɔ nyundua dɛɛ chaah wa aa? Hɛɛ won jemɛ ɡɛ tenten tɛ kwaa aa lɔ harɛ ta ɡe aa?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won do baama ŋɔ á kpɔ nee ba bɔle he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nee yon su la aa?

english_verse: or will lightning flash at your command?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won do bwaala ó nyɛɡle dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔɔree hen naa?’

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Umee kpɔ wejema do nɛn liire bini, kɛɛ nɛn ɛɛ no waa mun ɔ?

english_verse: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water
translation_verse: Umee dɔ wejema kohona dɛ́ won kure baama ɔ? Umee ɡela aa nɛ bwaala ɔ?

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won tɛ nyujentena kondikwa, ásɛ a bii lɔr aa dɛ kpoa won vaɡɛ,

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Umee tɛ ɡaahɡaah bii kondikwa aa di dɛ a wio dɛɛ no Korowii, dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin kondikwa dɛ diɔ?”

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “He jemɛ saŋ bwea dor boohna aa dɛ lolɛ a bii aa? He siwi nao kweɡla lolɛ o bie ka aa?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Kpɔɡ binii a bii yon do dɛ́ kpeɡ, a bwara do kpeɡri dɛ kaa, aa berɛ ba a be kpa.

english_verse: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
translation_verse: Pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa n kpɔ tɛo o so, bela kpɔɡa aa wola won kpeɡ.

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Waa ɡbɔɡa aa dɛ le bwɛjena ta nyin, nomɛlbwa aa won dɛɛro dɛ́ kpɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma.

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Bwea doree o do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, dɛɛ nyin kpɔɡlwɛɛ bɛlbwa waa lea dɛ́ chwe.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Kpɔɡ bini nao ɛɛ sɛoh ɛ toma tɛɛ naa? Wɛɛ sɛoh chɔ he kondɛɛra kondikondibɔr jwaana aa?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won lawɛ o par ŋwɛn kpoŋe ó ɛ toma aa? Wɛɛ won parɛ he harɛ tɛɛ naa?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: O bokpeɡa kohona nomanta, hɛɛ kpɔ he tenee dawɛ o nɛ aa? Hɛɛ ɡel he tomkpeɡaa ta o nɛ aa?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: He dɛ yarada kɛ o kpɔ he mea ba, dɛ ba boa a nyoa a lɔ bɔr aa?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Taataa dɛ lɔ a kena silɛɛ ne, kɛ a ta do kɛŋɔ chaŋɡal kwa,

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: harɛɛ taataa yon hwe hala bil, dɛ́ ɡela a chɔ bomboɡ ta wɔrɔbe.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: Waa jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ken ɛɛ won paɡre, kɛɛ kpɔɡ bini ol bɛl ɛɛ won ba tiɡri a ta.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: O nyu bini kpeɡri o bii nɛ, á do kɛ o bii laa ken, o waane laa kɛŋɔ o koeh waa koah la ɛ pɛɛ.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Men Korowii ta ɡelɛ o jemɛ wa, kɛɛ dɛ tɛo waa mun noe bɛlbwa.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o paɡri kena dɛɛ ba chwae yaa, o dɛ mamɛ jaaɡɔ waa won chwae kohona ne nɛn waa soɡe o ta.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: Job, henee ɡela jaaɡɔ bwara do kpeɡri dɛ tɛo pona a bɔle o baŋa ta naa?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ o won jaeh kɛŋɔ hɔɔhre dɛɛ aah nɛra hweera kohona ne naa?
