english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: O nafikoko kwii harɛ dɛɛ ta, bokpeɡa nee wɛɛ chwa silɛɛ ne kaa jo laa ta.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Waa ɔmee kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa, waa tokobii na dɛ́ le habɔɔ.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Dɔmkwaa nɛn waa soɡe o ta aa kpoŋa la dɛ si, dɛɛ nyɛɡle pelɔpelɔ ken.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Jaaɡɔ la kpɔ sibeɡra chwa dɛɛ kaa, o no bɛla sii yaa, waa won bobeŋkpoŋ che.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Ba hoh bɛla aa, dɛ o sio. O won laa ɡbɔɡa noe dɛ le bojaŋ, laa nomonome nyɛɡa baa dɛ nyɛɡ ne lɔŋɔre baa dɛ do laa ta.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Henee baɡle kɔla wɛɛ ir, dɛ́ paɡri kena kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr aa?

english_verse: Did you train eagles to build
translation_verse: He bee kee ɛɛ hweli o kɔr sɔeh nyundua aa?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Nyundua belaa o do, dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ lawɛ, o siwi dɛ naa dɛ le bojaŋ.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: Ol lwɛɛ chalee ɛ o bii kondikwa, bela nɛra aa serewa chɔ laanee baa nao.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ,

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: “Umee hen hɛɛ tɔŋle Men Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ rɔ? Dɛ ɡɛɛ yaa, amɔ te chaŋ mɛ.”

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Anee Job chaŋe Korowii ŋɔ,

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: N bol waa kpee he ta men chaŋɛ, dɛ bol nɛɛ, kɛ taraken maa waa bol kpa.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii bol waa Job be dɛ le peujen la bini ŋɔ,

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: “Ir dɛ́ ba che n sie, ásɛ n bɔɔree wa, he chaŋ mɛ.

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ ŋɔɔ he waa wer, dɛ́ chɔɡ mɛ ŋɔ n te waa aa were kɛɛ?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: He kpeɡri tel men Korowii aa? He nyɛɡa ɡe ɛɛ won do kan kɛŋɔ n nyɛɡa, kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra aa?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Job, dɛ ɡɛɛ yaa, baɡle he nyanyini ne he kan haa doa, baɡle kɛŋɔ he kan nɛra ɛɛ duuri.

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo, ɡel he baah di ba nɛ, ásɛ ba nyoa sɔɔh,

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Huɡe ba bwa pɛ, kwaa ba sie sɔh lalbɔɔ bini.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Ate, n fe ɛɛ tɔ sie kpɔ jaamee tɛɛ, dɛ́ sɛh kɛ he kpeɡri ɛɛ won lɛɛ.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: Nyiŋi kaka maa ta he ne on la na, wɛɛ chwe kpɔɡaa kɛŋɔ nao aa dɛ chwe la aa?

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: O bwara kpeɡri taeh, o dɛɛhne ɡel o dɔ bokpeɡa!

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: O din pao kɛŋɔ peleme daa ken, o nakpadɛɛhne do kpeɡri.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: O hoɡa kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ayaawa, o nakpale do kɛŋɔ bune ken.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Korowii kontaala bwa bini, onee tɔ sie. Korowii waa tao la ɡboo dɛ́ won bɛno.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Kpɔɡa le deŋɡarere ta o dɔa dɛɛ chwe, asɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa bwa ɛɛ hɛlɛ o jwɛh.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: O chɔ sɔɔhne bini, o sɔh kataŋa bini kpɔɡa tɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Sɔɔhne la tɔ o nɛ, asɛ daa aa cheɡɛ nee nyoa baro cheme.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Hale Jɔɔdan Moo suu ba tɔ o nɛɛ kwaraa naa, waa ɔmɛ.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won bɛɛlo dɛ́ dɔɔ lawɔ ɔ? Umee dɛ won lawɔ bel ne dɛ́ do ŋwɛn o mee ta nɔ?”

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bɔɔ Job ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ won ta ɡoŋa lawɛ lɛŋɔ, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ŋwɛn vɔwɛ o nyoa aa?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won kpɔ ŋwɛn do o mebɔɔ bini, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ɡoŋa lawɛ o nyoa aa?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Wɛɛ sɛoh he ne o fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ dɛɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa naa?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won dɛɛro kɛŋɔ jumbie, kɛɛ dɛ́ do ŋwɛn o nakpala, he toli ɛɛ hɛlɛ o ne naa?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Bonadiire ɛɛ ba chemoo, dɛɛ nyin ba yawɔ, kɛɛ dɛ́ bɔne o bini naa?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won yaɡɛ o bɔtɔn, kɛɛ o nyu tim ne naa?

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won sɔɔh o nyoa, he siwi ne o nɛɛ dawa, dɛ he bwara yɔrɔ.

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: O ɡɔɔ o te naa, dɛ́ o ɔma. Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ba che o sie.

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa won ŋɔ men Korowii di o kem, komɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɛ n kwa.

english_verse: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
translation_verse: Gel n baɡle ɡɛ lɛŋɔ nakpale, ne o kan ne o bokpeɡa aa doa.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won wur o bɔtɔn, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ kabaɡrare ba che o sie nɔ?

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won hah o nyoa, nyena aa do ɔma dɛ bar cheme nɔɔ?

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: O nyaŋ pɛɡa kpeɡri dɛ tɔ o nɛ, dɛ marɛ dɔŋa kiŋkiŋ ken.

english_verse: firmly bound and closer together
translation_verse: Bɛlbwa marɛ dɔŋa, peu ɡba aa won jo a baah.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: A deno marɛ dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ ken, komɛlbwa aa wola won pere a baah.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: O sio waa, a do kɛ nii aa dɛ le o mee ne o nyoa, o sibie swɛɛ kɛŋɔ chɔɔlen wee aa dɛ le ken.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Ninlao dɛ le o nyoa, nihɛma ɡe ɛɛ chuɡri kohona.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Chuu dɛ le o mebɔɔne bini, kɛŋɔ vii aa chɔŋɛ kpɔɡa nii ta ken.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: O hweeraa, hɔla dɛ lawɛ nii, ninlao chuɡri dɛɛ le o nyoa.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: O kpeɡri lɔ o baŋa ta, a ɡelɔ nomɛlbwa waa chemo la, dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: O bwara bobɛlbwa kpeɡri kɛŋɔ buni, dɛ che kiŋkiŋ nomɛlbwa aa wola won taɡɔ.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: O ɡɔɔ o te naa, ɔmee dɛ́ chole kpeɡnɛra nɛ, bá chwa le o sie dɛɛ kaa.

english_verse: No sword or spear can harm it,
translation_verse: Tokobii aa won ɛo waane, hale lampea kɛɛ hɛm wa bini bɛlbwa.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Buni do kɛŋɔ haahra o siwi ta, ayaawa ɡe do kɛŋɔ daa waa pɔah ken.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Waa hɛma nae dɛɛ chwa, vamtor bwea do kɛŋɔ haahra o be, aa on wobɛlbwa ɛ.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Guli kpɔe dɛ lɔɔ do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ o be, lampeare tae dɛ yaɡɔ ɛ wesoma tɛo.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: O tea pɛɡa do kɛŋɔ kaŋle, o dɛ tuuɡi kpechɛɡre ta kɛŋɔ baa tuuɡi daa ken.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: O jo mpo vile ta naa, a dɛ wure kɛŋɔ newɔb, dɛ ɡel mpo ɛɛ wure kɛŋɔ, baa kpɔ sooma noo chɔŋɛ nii ta la.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: O pere nee dɛɛ kaa laa, nehɛma dɛ to teŋɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyumpompoŋa ken.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Haa won kpɔ komɛlbwa maɡɔ harɛ nɔ ta, o ɛ hweera kon waa wola ɔmɛ.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: O na oljen bɛlbwa naa, o jeɡa tɛo o siwi ta, o dɛ di kora kpɔɡ bini oljena bwa nɛ.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “N Naa Korowii, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ henee dɔ kpeɡri kohona. Nomɛlbwa aa won tɔe ŋwɛnɛ wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: He bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee hen hɛɛ tɔŋle n waa wobol aa wola mun dɔe ne nɔɔ?’ Kasinteŋ, n bol waa maa wola a mun no, waa aa ɛ nyokpoa kohona, maa wola a mun jemɛ.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: He ŋɔ, ‘Cheɡ deŋne ń bol waa he be, mɛɛ bɔɔre waa ásɛ he chaŋ mɛ.’

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Noe n no nɛra ɛɛ bol he wa, kɛ taraken, n ɡbabir kpɔ siwi nae.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Korowii aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡle Job tonɛ la, o ŋɔ Elifas, Teman te la be ŋɔ, “N baah di he ne he daamanar banɛ la nɛ, dɛkalkɛ he ta n bwara wedɛɛɡe bolɛ kɛ n bonɔɔ Job.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Anomanta, lawɛ nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ ka tɛ n bonɔɔ Job ó kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah tɛ heya. Wɛɛ soŋoo tɛ heya, ásɛ n no dɛ bɛ he deŋne tɛr he ɡɛna waa kpa. He ta n waa kasinteŋ bolɛ kɛ n bonɔɔ Job.”

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Asɛ Elifas ne Bildad, dɛ Sofar ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ ba be la, asɛ Korowii no Job wesoŋa la.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Ate, Job aa soŋa tɛ o daamanar batoro la tonɛ la, Korowii ɡelɔ o ɛ kondɔɔh ja. O dɔ anɔ la o fa aa dɔa la bele anɛ ja.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: O dɔɔranar ne nimanar ne nimambii, dɛ nɛra ba fa aa jemɔ bwa ba o dem, ba ne o di kwaa dɛ lɛ ba sie. Ba bwɛɛlo dɛ larawe o bwara wenaale Korowii aa ɡela o na la wa, asɛ bɛlbwa tɛo suuɡa ne suuɡaswɛm noniseɡ.

english_verse: whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch.
translation_verse: Bihaah waa tɔ sie sɔne Jemima, nɛɛte sɔne Kesia, asɛ toorote ɡe Keren Hapuk.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: O bibaala lɔ banuanɛ dɛ bihaahna batoro.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah bɛlbwa toole dɛ do wer harɛ la ta kɛŋɔ Job bihaahna la, asɛ ba mɛɛ tɛ bane ba nimanar ne dɔɔranar o kondɔɔh la pera.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Anomanta, waa sewa dɛ o biɡro kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa wola nɛnchɔɡa we-ɛɛla ta teŋɛ, baa wola waa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ ɛ ɛ, kɛɛ baa wola banɔ la baa dɛ mamɛ Korowii nɛɛ jae la, ba na som.

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Ba sie dɛ lɛ Korowii waa ta, dɛɛ hweli o Mmara la chɔɔ ne jwaana.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ daa baa duu bela waa sɔna, saŋ bɛlbwa o dɛ nɔnɛ o saŋ ta, o papooni ɡe aa chure bwa. A ɡɛ nɛra la wobɛlbwa baa ɛ dɛ́ do wer.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Gɛ laa nɛnchɔɡa la te do, ba waa do kɛŋɔ haahra, peu yon ta dɛ́ kaa ane la ken.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere Korowii aa bol nɛra waa la, nɛnchɔɡa aa won che o sie, baa nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛɛ ja.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyiŋi nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre te, a dɛ kaa ba ne seo ta.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ harɛre nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ, lɛ ɡaeh, dɛɛ le jina dɛɛ koh ba te pɛɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Ba koranar kpɔ ba te, dɛ ir che dɛɛ vɔrɔwe Korowii ne o kooro waa leo la vɔrɔwa.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya lɛ ya te le ba lɔɡa, ásɛ ba bɛ won di kpeɡri ya nɛ.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Korowii soɡe o kookara ta nyundua dɛɛ mam ba, ba waa ɛ wesale o be.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: O bol waa baɡ ba bandia kohona ne, dɛ aah ba ŋɔ,

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: “N cheɡ n kooro n deŋɡare waa do ɡoroŋ Saayɔn ta.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Kooro la ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ bol waa Korowii aa bola la waa. O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘N Biee hen, fini n berɛ he Mɛɛ.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Soŋ mɛ, mɛɛ kpɔ harɛre bwaa tɛɛ.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Hɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ kpeɡri ne, hɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ, ba yon paɡre vii burbur la ken.’ ”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Anomanta, koranar, hé hweli wa, harɛre nomonome, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ, hé charɛ he liire, dɛ́ ba he te ne harɛ.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii bie la, ásɛ o baah bɛ di dɛ́ chɔɡ heya. O baah won dii saŋ bɛlbwa. Nɛra baa chwaa kaa marɔ la bwa, ba na som.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɔma warɔ, ba warɔ dɛ che n nɛ.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Dɔma la ɡalɡa dɛ bol n waa ŋɔ, “Korowii aa on lɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe. N Naa Korowii, henee tɛ mɛ jirima, dɛ ɡel n dɔ hwɛɡa.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: N wio no Korowii takpeɡ ne, asɛ o no n be o deŋɡare waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: N dɛ chɔ dɛ́ chɔ dom kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ir ja, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛ.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: N dɔma warɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, maa ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, ir nyu ne dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ! N Naa Korowii, sɔɔh n dɔma nyoa.

english_verse: because you protect and bless your people.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ lɛ nɛra, swee andɛɛɡa tɛ he nɛra.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he waa toɡrɔ, no n wesoŋa saŋ bɛlbwa. Lɛɛ mɛ le n wahala ta, na n sum, dɛ́ no n wesoŋa.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Saŋ besoo he nɛra haa dɛ chɔɡ mɛ la ɛɛ ba ɡela ɔ? Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba waa aa ɛ wepuu, ne nyosone waa ta teŋa ɡela ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii le nɛn, o wa aa toɡra tɛ o te biɡri. Saŋ bɛlbwa maa wi noo la, o dɛ no.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel he baah di bandichɔɡa he ɛ wechɔɡa, he ka chɔ dɛ lii a wa, saŋ haa chɔ he kalaŋre ta la.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: He ɛ sarahare Korowii aa ŋɔa la ásɛ dɛɛ yaradao.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Nɛra warɔ dɛɛ soŋe ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ won ɡel yá dɔ wedɛɛɡa ɔ?” N Naa Korowii, na ya sum.

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ n dɔ silɛɛ kohona, ɡwaa silɛɛ nɛra yon dɔ, ɡɛ saŋ mea ne sen yon bu ba nɛɛ la.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔ domii deŋnesɔɔhna ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ hen Korowiirii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ n nɛ.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n wesoŋa, dɛ́ no n hima maa dɛ hime nɔ.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: No n wii maa wia dɛɛ noe nɔ dɛ́ cha mɛ, henee n kooro ne Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee mɛɛ soŋe.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, chɔɔ bɛlbwa he dɛ no n taa. Chɔɔbɔr n kpɔ n wesoŋa dɛɛ bil he sie, dɛɛ kpa ɡɛ haa chaŋ mɛ.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he sie aa wechɔɡa ta lɛ, nyubinikpeɡ tena aa won ba he be.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Mbarafo tena aa won che he sie, he hah nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Kɛ n te, he nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ kohona nomanta, mɛɛ won ba he Dea dɛ́ ba ɡuŋi, dɛɛ tomɛ he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ ta ɔmee ne.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɔma warɔ kɛrɛdɛ! Tɔ n sie ń ɛ anɔ la aa too he tea, ɡel n na he wa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Wobol aa le ba nyoo dɛɛ ba bwa ɛ nyosone, ba pɛla waa bwaa nɛra chɔɡa. Nɛra neɡra dɛ́ kpoo ba ɡboo lɔ ba nyu bini, nɛra ɡboo baa neɡre.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, pa ba bole dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne, ɡel ba ɡbaɡba waa baa vɔrɔwa ɡure ba nyu ta. Doŋ ba le he sie, ba wechɔɡa kohona ne ba deŋnekpeɡ baa dɛ ɛɛ la wa.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Gel nɛra baa chwaa baa marɛ sie lɛ, baa wonoo ɡo yela saŋ bɛlbwa ba sie lɛ. Kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ nɛra he wa aa lɔ ba bambile ta la sie lɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Kpela, Korowii he ɡelɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra na som. He nyina haa dɛ nyin ba la tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe, dɛ bar ba cheme.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel he baah di hé pwaah mɛ, bɛ ɡel he baah di kohona hé tɛr n deŋne.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n ɡwɛɡrɔ, n poori, na n sum. N hoɡa bini bwa dɛ wee mɛ, chaah mɛ.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: N bwadabii bwa dɛ wee mɛ taeh. N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo he ba cha mɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ba lɛɛ mɛ. Che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le seo ta.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Nɛn sewaa, waa he waa lii kpa. Umee dɛɛ kpɛɛre lalabwɛ ɔ?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: N pɛmɔ dɛ ba koh, jwaana bɛlbwaa n sinii ɛɛ yɔɔ mɛ kalaŋ ta, dɛɛ pweh n kapuri bwa!

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Maa na kɛrɛdɛ kpa, wii dɔma aa ɡela mɛɛ wi nomanta.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, hé le n sie! N Naa Korowii, no n wii.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: O no n suna wii, wɛɛ sɛh n bee.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Sihiih ɛɛ kpo n dɔma bwaa ba bwara yɔr, ásɛ Korowii ɡel ba berɛ, dɛ́ den kpɔ baŋaɡola kaa.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n chwao baa marɛ. Lɛɛ mɛ dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, dɛ́ le nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ nɔn ta,

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: ásɛ ba bɛ n bini peeɡe kɛŋɔ nyujente, dɛ́ toɡri n bini nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: dɛ n ɛ nɛn n ne waa soma wechɔɡa, kɛɛ dɛ ɛ nɛn waa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ wechɔɡa pɛɛpɛɛ aa,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: ate, tɛ n dɔm ŋwɛnɛ ó dɔɔ mɛ lawɛ, dɛ́ kpo mɛ bil, ásɛ n sewɛ chɔ.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel he baah di. Kpɔ ba che n dɔma ba baah aa di n nɛɛ kohona la nɛ. Ir nyu ne tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Gel harɛre nɛra bare cheme he do nyundua dɛ́ di kora ba nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Henee bol nɛwɛnyina bwa waa dɛɛ pa bole. Nemenɛ Korowii, cha mɛ, dɛ́ bol n waa tɛ mɛ. He jemɔ kɛŋɔ n tea too.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he waa toɡrɔ, he jemɛ nɛwɛnyini bambile bini, ne o liire bwa wa. Gel nyubinikpeɡ tena naɡrenyin waa bwa ba a jaɡa, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra ba wa aa toɡra do le.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, on dɛɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ bol waa aŋwɛnɛ ta kasinteŋ ne, dɛɛ pa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bolchɔɡe saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la ta ba liire charaa, Korowii ɛɛ sar o tokobii, dɛ́ harɛ o to kpa.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa! Ba dɛ le jina dɛɛ neɡre nɛra.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Ba nafuɡere baa kwia la, ba ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ le a ta, á laɡ ba.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Naɡrenyin waa baa liira la ɡure ba nɛ, waa baa ba a ne la, ba ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ na a wa.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: N dɛ jam N Naa Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o waa toɡrɔ. Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he sɔn kan harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa! Nɛra dɛ kpɛɛre kohona, aa tel nyundua bwa.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Bechale ne bifola bwa ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre he dɔma wa, dɛ ɡel dɔma ne nɛra baa kpɔ waa dɛɛ bɔ waa kem la nyoa sɔɔh.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Dɛ n ta sie dɛ nyiŋi nyundua, dɛ lii kwaa haa taa, ne ɡɛ haa kpɔ korobie ne weweela cheɡ a chebɔra aa,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: nɛwɛnyini ɡee bɔkwa, asɛ hɛɛ lii o waɔ? Nɛwɛnyini ɡee bɔkwa, hɛɛ dawɛ o waɔ?

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Tamaa kenii he ɡel nyundua toroma ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini, he ɡelɔ nɛn dɔ jirima asɛ komɛlbwa ɛɛ tɛo duure.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ o dɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri a do o lɔɡa,

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: peera ne nae, dɛ kpɔɡ bini ola bwa,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: ne jumbii aa lɔ nyundua, dɛ pɛŋa aa lɔ mpo bini, ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o bini bwa.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he sɔn kan harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ kpɛɛre n bambile bwa nee, mɛɛ bol nyokpowaa haa ɛa bwaa.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: He nomanta, mɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yelaa, dɛ́ hɛɡre. Nemenɛ Korowii, mɛɛ kpɛɛ he sɔnee yela ne.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: N dɔma nae naa, dɛ ba laa berɛ, dɛ́ choɡli dɛɛ serewe.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: He waa dɔ kasinteŋ, dɛ bol n waa tɛ mɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta, he soɡe he kookara ta, dɛ bol n waa tɛ mɛ n di bole.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: He pa voɡtoroma bolchɔɡe, dɛ chɔɡ nyubinikpeɡ tena, dɛ ɡel ba sɔna he harɛ nɔ ta kwaraa.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ya dɔma heo, yaa ba waa lii kpa. He chɔɡ ba bwɛjena, ya soh ba waa kwaraa.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Korowii, he dɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa. He kpɔ he kookara cheɡ, dɛɛ ba ba waa bola.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa a toɡre, dɛ di kora aŋwɛnɛ ta.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Hen Korowiirii nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la chwa baa marɛ. He do kɛ dekpeɡ waa balaa, nɛra chwa baa jo he be.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nɛra baa jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ bwa ɛɛ yaradae, haa banɔ la baa dɛ nyin he bɔr la vɛh.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii waa dɛ di kora Saayɔn. Hé bol waa waa ɛa harɛre nɛra bwa be.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Hen Korowii dɛ lii nɛra ba bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ ba wa, haa wii baa dɛ wi waa soh. He dɛ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ nɛra wechɔɡa la deŋne.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ n dɔma aa cheɡɛ n nɛ, dɛ ɡel n bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ! Sune n nɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le seo ta,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: ásɛ n che Jerusalam tena bwa sie, dɛ́ bol ba be waa bwa haa ɛa. Mɛɛ hɛɡroo, lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Voɡtoroma kwi nafuɡe, dɛ ɡbaɡba le o ta, ba ɡbaɡba bel laɡ ba.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Hen Korowii cheɡɛ bole haa dɛ pa a toɡre la ta, dɛ ɡel nɛra jemɛ, nyubinikpeɡ tena ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla laɡ ba.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Seo chɔ le dɛɛ kpa nyubinikpeɡ tena, banee harɛre nɛra baa vɛh hen Korowii toma la.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Hen Korowii aa nɛra baa wola komɛlbwa dɔe waa soh. He ta ɡelɛ nyaara hwɛɡa ɛɛ ta pɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne. Bɛ ɡel nɛwɛnyini nyiŋi he nyubaah. Ba voɡtoroma ne he sie, dɛ́ pa ba bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, aah ba, ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyinaa ban.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ n ne he baah do jaŋne ken nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ waa puu mɛ, he sɔɔh mɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena mbarafo, ba cheɡɛ nyaara nɛ, ɡel ba liichɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena dɛ maŋkura ba te ba pɛlchɔɡa ta, nɛra baa dɛ nyin kafo dɛ bol Korowii bwara wechɔɡa dɛɛ vɛoh.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena waane laa Korowii wa, ba mbarafo, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ, Korowii waa ta hiaih.

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Ba we-ɛɛla bwa dɛ do wer dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, baa ŋwɛnɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o ta, dɛɛ pa bole mun no, dɛɛ mamɛ ba dɔma.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Ba dɛ lii ba nyu bini ŋɔ, ba wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, wobɛlbwa aa ban pu bwa ɡe.

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Nɛra taahna ne nɛra neɡra, dɛ nɛra aahra ɡboo ba bwa, wobochɔɡa ne musuwaa ɡboo baa bol.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ba yon sɔh bwɛjeɡre dahare, dɛ́ pɛɡle dɛɛ kpaah nɛra baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó lɛɛ ba, dɛ́ kpoo.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ sɔh dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ nyujente ken, dɛ́ pɛɡle lawɛ nɛra baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó lɛɛ ba, dɛ́ laɡ ba, dɛ́ tɛɡ ba kaa.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena la yon lii ba nyu bini ŋɔ, “Korowii waane laa. O laa sie kpɔ, waa yaa na bwa!”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, tɛr nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔ deŋne, dɛ bɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra waa soh.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ ba wona ɛ hen Korowii sisawa ɔ? Ɛrɛɛ baa lii ba nyu bini kɛŋɔ, hen Korowii aa ba deŋnee tɛr ɔ?

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he dɛ na nɛra siswɛm ne lokua wa, dɛ yon dɛɛ cha ba. He nɔn taa nɛŋɡwɛɡra kpɔ ba nyu dɛɛ do, hɛɛ cha ba saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Sɔɔh kpeɡri nyubinikpeɡ tena ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɔa la nyoa, ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa, tɛr ba deŋne ka tel kɛŋɔ, baa ɡela kwaraa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee kooro saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa ɛɛ heo le he harɛ ta.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he dɛ no nɛŋɡwɛɡra wesoŋa, dɛɛ do ba ɡbemba,

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: dɛɛ lɛ bilalbii ne nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba, dɛ́ bol ba waa tɛɛ ba ɡɛ aa ɛ nɛwɛnyini waa won sewa nɔ bɛ on aah kpa.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Korowiirii n chwa kaa marɛ, bɔkwa waa hɛɛ ba wona ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ir kɛŋɔ jumbie, dɛ́ kaa bwejen la ta,

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena harɛ ba tori kpa, hɛm la jaɡɛ to la ŋwɛn ta, ba sɔh biro ta, dɛ́ ta nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Dɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena chɔɡ wedɛɛɡa ŋwɛnaa, ɛrɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta ɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii lɔ o Dea waa lea cheɡ tɛ o te bini nyundua, dɛɛ di kora, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyini bobɛlbwa, dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: O dɛ pese nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena, ne naɡrenyin tena te, o hah ba o bambile bwa.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ fuɡe ninhɔla, ne jebɔrɔwe niinii ta ɡɛ nɛra la nɛ, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne peuwɔb ne.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Korowii waa toɡrɔ, o dɛ nyin kasinteŋ. Nɛra ba wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ ba o nae.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lɛ yaa! Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra toole kpa, kasinteŋ diile tonɛ nɛra bini.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Nyosonee bɛlbwa teŋe dɛɛ tɛ o dɔŋ, nyokpɛlee ba kpɔ dɛɛ neɡre dɔŋa.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel nyokpɛl ne nyoo baa kpɔa dɛɛ bol wejena ba a jaɡa.

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛra la dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya nyoa ɛɛ yoo tɛ yaa. Yaa bol anɔ la yaa dɛ nyinii. Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ.”

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ bao, fiiɡa baa dɛ fiiɡi nɛŋɡwɛɡra, ne pɛma nyaara aa dɛ pɛmɛ la wa. Mɛɛ lɛɛ ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Korowii waa do chasee, dɛ do yaradae, kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ baa laa doŋa kpɔ o ta kera anuanɛ, o do wer kohona la.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, kpɔ nɔn tɔ ya nɛ, dɛ́ lɛ yaa le ɡɛ nɛra nɔ nɔn ta kwaraa.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena perɔ, dɛ valɛ dɛɛ ɡu, ba na waa aa wola were nɛra ɛɛ ɛaa, dɛ ba dɛ kpɛɛra.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba n waa soeh ka tel ɔ? Hɛɛ soh n waa kwaraa kɛɛ? Hɛɛ laa sie kpɔ n nɛɛ biɡri kɛɛ?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Saŋ besoo waa aa dawɛ n nɛɛ nɔ ɛɛ ba a jaɡa bala ɔ? Bɛweeree tebinichɔɡ aa lɔ n nɛɛ chɔɔ ne jwaana nɔ, ɛɛ ba tona ɔ? Saŋ besoo n dɔma pɔ n nɛɛ ka tel ɔ?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, no n be dɛ́ cha mɛ, ɡel n do kpeɡri ja, bɛ ɡel ń sewɛ,

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: a ba ɡɛ naa, n dɔma ɛɛ ŋɔɔ ba pɔ n nɛ, n horaa, baa hɛɡroo.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: N kpɔ n te dawɛ he nyina waa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta, n sie dɛ lɛ, lɛɛ haa dɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre, kɛ haa ɛɛ mɛ wedɛɛɡa ɡa la.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Gɛnaa yon dɛɛ lii ba nyu bini kɛŋɔ Korowii toole, ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, ba ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Korowii lɔ nyundua, dɛ ba sie ne harɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyina kɛŋɔ bɛl dɔ wejema dɛɛ nyin o Korowii bɔr dɛ́ tomɔ.

english_verse: But all of them are corrupt; no one does right.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa berɛ habɔɔ kpoo, nɛndɛɛɡe bɛlbwa toole ba bini, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Amɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ hweli waa yaa? Banee lawɛ n nɛra baa teŋɛ n nɛɛ dɛɛ liɡli kɛŋɔ kondikwa, baa wola men Korowii soŋe ŋɔ ń cha ba la.”

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Baa ɔmɔɔ ba bwara ɛɛ sa, jae Korowii aa ja nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la nɛɛ wa.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: He wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, he dɛ tɔ nyaara we-ɛɛla ŋwɛnɛ, kɛ Korowiirii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe Korowii waa lɔ Saayɔn kohona, kɛ o ba lɛ Israel tena! Dɛ Korowii ɡelɔ Israel tena dɔ ba te ja aa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo kohona ba hɛɡre!

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nɛn besooree dɛ́ won jo he Dea ɔ? Bamewaa dɛ́ won so Saayɔn waa ɛ he deŋɡare waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, dɛ́ tomɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Naate waa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra, dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ o bambile bwa ne la,

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: nɛn waa wola o dɔŋ wechɔɡe bol, nɛn waa wola o dɔŋ wechɔɡa ɛ, dɛ nɛn waa wola o dɔŋ waa kpɔe dɛɛ perɛ,

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: nɛn waa hah wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, kɛ dɛɛ duu nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta, hale dɛ a kpeɡri tɛo kwaaraa noo,

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: ne nɛn waa dɛ kemɛ suuɡa, waa wola a nee lɛ, ne nɛn waa wola sɛɛh baa yawɔ sen, dɛ di dansewea dawɛ nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ nɛ. Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa la, o wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛo.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, he nɛɛ n sie dawɛ kɛ mɛɛ dɔ n nyuu.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: N ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ. He habɔɔ, n ta kondɛɛɡe bɛlbwa dɔe.”

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la nyin waa dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛ. Maa ba nɛɛ ja kpoo kwaa tɛ ba voɡare bwa, maa ba voɡaree tomɛ bwa!

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee n komɛlbwa, hen tɛ mɛ anɔ la maa dɛ nyin bwa, n kerekere waa bwa lɔ he nɔn ta.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: He koŋkɛɛla haa tɛ mɛ wer kɛrɛdɛ! A wer ɡa.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, on dɛɛ ja mɛ. Jwaana kwara, n liire dɛ baɡ mɛ wa.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: N dɛ na kɛŋɔ, n ne Korowii lole saŋ bɛlbwa. Maa ɔmɛ bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o cheɡɛ n habɔɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n sie lɛo mɛɛ jam hen Korowii, maa wobɛlbwa ɔmɛ kpa,

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: tɔe haa dɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, dɛɛ le seo ta la wa. Haa he Bidɛɛɡe waa soeh ba lalabwɛ, haa ɡel ó chɔ bɔɔ bini pɔh.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ baɡ mɛ mkpa ŋwɛnɛɛ. N lɔ he sie naa, n sie dɛ lɛ, n bwara ɡe ɛɛ sɔɔh mɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no nɛn n wa aa toɡra nɔ wesoŋa, no n wii maa dɛ wi nɔ. Ken deŋne dɛ́ no n wesoŋa, nyosone laa mɛɛ teŋe.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ bol n waa tɛ mɛ, henee jemɛ waa aa wera.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: He jemɛ n bambile bini wa, he ba n be jwaana, dɛ nyiŋi n waa bini, dɛ pese mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, he ta wechɔɡa nae n nɛ, n ɛ n liire kɛ, wechɔɡa aa n nyoa le.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: He ŋwɛnɛ taa mɛɛ valɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, n ta kee le o ta bwa.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ noe, n jemɔ kɛ hɛɛ chaŋ mɛɛ, cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no n wesoŋa.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Baɡle he nyokpoa nyina waa do kan la, ásɛ n chwa le n dɔma be ba marɛ.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe kɛŋɔ, haa dɛ tɔ n siwinyiŋi ta la, kpɔ mɛ sɔh he kena lɔɡre kɛŋɔ, jal yon lawɛ o bii do lɔɡa la ken.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena baa dɛ nyin ba yoo mɛ nɔn ta, n dɔma baa bar mɛ, dɛɛ nyin n kpoe la be.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Baa nɛn sum na, mbarafo wobolee baa bol.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ba bar mɛ cheme, bobɛlbwa maa kpɔ la, dɛ ba lole, dɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ, dɛ́ taɡ mɛ ɡo.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ nyujente lɔr aa dɛ kpoo, wɛɛ nyin ol dɛ́ lawɛ, dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ toɡri n ola.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, puu ba, dɛ́ ba ba ne harɛ, kpɔ he tokobi, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, che he kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire, dɛɛ nyin ba soɡa bini kwaa la nɔn ta. Banɔ la haa dɛ nyin ba waa la dɔ kondikwaa kohona, ba bii dɔ ane di dɛ́ vaɡɛ, ásɛ ane ka ba naanar ɡe ba dɔ.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: N waa aa toɡra nomanta, mɛɛ nae, n chɔɔ ir aa, n sie ɛɛ lɛo kohona, ń na ɡɛ haa doa.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ta tea tɛɛ dɛ́ nyin he wa, henee n Kpeɡnɛn.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, maa chwaa kaa marɛ, ne danjwɛkpeɡ hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ. Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, maa chwaa kaa marɛ. Henee dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, dɛ ɛ n kpeɡnɛn.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: N wio no hen Korowii waa chɛ kpɛɛra la, asɛ he lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Seo vɔɡ mɛ bil, asɛ nehɛma aa kpeɡa lɔ dɛɛ kpɔ n nɛ.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Seo bela bar mɛ cheme, lalbɔɔ hah nyoa dɛɛ kpaa mɛ.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: N wahala bini n wio no hen Korowii ŋɔ hé lɛɛ mɛ, n wio no hen Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ ŋɔ, hé cha mɛ, he no n taa he Dea la bini, n wii la tel he be, asɛ he no.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Harɛ jiɡro dɛ yiiɡi, asɛ bwejena mune jiɡri. Korowii bandia waa a bwa ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Ninchuu le o mebɔɔne bini, ninlao aa dɛ chɔɡ kwaa le o nyoa, ninhɔla aa dɛ fuh kwaa ɡe ɛɛ le o nyoa.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: O forɔ le nyundua ba harɛ, baama aa bira kpirkpir do o nakpale lɔɡa.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Kerobim taa o so dɛɛ ɡah, peu kena taa o kpɔ ba.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: O kpɔ biro bɔle o bwa, baama aa bira kpirkpir, tenɛ bwaala, dɛ baro cheme.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Bɔr nyɛɡlɔ le baama la bini tɔ o sie, asɛ dombwea ne ninlao, ɛɛ le bela aa dɛ nyɛɡle la ta.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii bol waa nyundua, a do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra ken, asɛ ba no o taa bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
translation_verse: O ta o hɛma, o dɔma peɡre, o ɡelɔ bwaala nyɛɡle kohona, ba chwa kaa.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nyɛɡa haa nyɛɡ he dɔma nɛ, ne he bandia kohona nomanta, a ɡelɔ mpo vile bwa hweeh dɛ chɔ pɛɛ, harɛ mumpar ɡe chɔ pɛɛ.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: He ha nɔn le nyundua dɛ laɡ mɛ, dɛ tɛr mɛ le vile bini.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: He laɡ mɛ le n dɔma baa kpeɡa nɔn ta, nɛra baa hah mɛ, dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa mɛ.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Ba cheɡɛ n nɛɛ kɛ bá chɔɡ mɛ, ɡɛ saŋ maa lɔ wahala ta, kɛ hen Korowii, he cheɡɛ n habɔɔ.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: He cha mɛ dɛ le n ne wekpeɡa ta, he lɛɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ he sie lɛ n nɛ.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Korowii bɔ mɛ kem ɡɛ n wa aa toɡra, o swee andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛ.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: N teŋɛ Korowii waa ta, n ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ vɛoh.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: N teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ta, n ta waa waa do mɛ a ta la ta leɛ.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Korowii bɔ mɛ kem ɡɛ n wa aa toɡra, dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛɛ o be.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ nɛn o tea aa toa, he waa wer kɛrɛdɛ dɛ tɛ nɛn, wechɔɡa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Nɛn o tea aa toa la, onee he dɔ tepoŋ tɛ, kɛ he dɔ wejema ɡwaa nɛn waa dɔ baradeɛre.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: He dɛ lɛ nɛra baa pwɛra, kɛ mbarafo tena te, he dɛ ba ba ne harɛ.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee ɡela bɔr chaah n sie mɛɛ na, he ɡelɔ n le biro ta ba bochaah ta.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Korowii te, o ŋwɛnɛre bwa wer, o waa bwa toɡrɔ. O do kɛŋɔ ɡbemɡbe, dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa chwaa baa marɔ.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Ya Naa Korowii habɔɔ, bɛlbwa toole. O ɡboo ɛ Bwetal dɛ́ won tɔ ya nɛ.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Korowii tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa, dɛ ɡel n ŋwɛnɛ do wer mɛɛ kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ n nakpala do kɛŋɔ welo kwaa ken, dɛ ɡel n won bwejena dor cheɡa.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: O baɡ mɛ n won laa yoi, asɛ n won to waa do kpeɡri tae.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe dɛ lɛɛ mɛ, nyiŋa haa dɛ nyiŋi n nɛɛ la ɡelɔ n do kpeɡri, asɛ he kpeɡri ɡel n dɔ n te.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: He kwaa ŋwɛnɛ o do paɡri tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n bɛ naa lɔ.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: N ti n dɔma dɛ ka puu ba, n kpoo ba mɔɔ dɛ laa berɛ.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: N lɔ ba bil, baa wola won ir kpa ba serewe chɔ n sie.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: He tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa n won laa yoi, dɛ sɔɔh n dɔma nyoa n pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ba wio dɛɛ nyin lɛɛ, kɛ nomɛlbwa toole, ba wio no hen Korowii, he ta ban chaŋɛ.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: N nam ba, ba ɛ kɛŋɔ tutuɡ peu aa taa dɛɛ kaa ane ken, dɛ sa ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, fɔɡbaah kpechɛɡre.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: He lɛɛ mɛ le nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ bini, dɛ ɡel mɛɛ di kora harɛre nɛra nɛ, nɛra maa wola ban jemɛ laanee dɛɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Ba hwɛɡa bwa tonɔ, ba kpɔ bochela le ba dekpeɡa bini dɛɛ ba.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Korowii lole kɛrɛdɛ! Korowii waa do kɛ Bwetal la, hé kpɛɛro! Onee n chwa kaa marɛ. Hé ɡel Korowii waa dɛ lɛɛ mɛ la sɔn le.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Korowiirii tɔ n wel tɛ mɛ, o kpɔ harɛre nɛra do n nɔn ta.

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma bini. He laɡ mɛ le nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ bini, he lɛɛ mɛ le nɛnchɔɡa nɔn ta.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɛɛre harɛre nɛra bwa bee, mɛɛ yerɛ he sɔnee, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛre.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Kɛŋɔ haa tɛ he kooro kpeɡri kohona, o pɔ o dɔma nɛ, dɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin nɛn haa leo, ó ɛ Devid ne o naanar kon, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la la.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Nyundua dɛ baɡle kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɔ jirima, kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ɡe bwa ɛɛ chaɡle ɡɛ tenten, toma Korowii aa ɛa.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛlbwaa aa na Korowii jirima, jwaana bɛlbwa ɡee aa na o wejema.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Aa waa bol, nɛraa a waa no.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Kɛ a webaɡla do kɛŋɔ wobol, dɛɛ tel harɛre bwa ta, asɛ a waa ɛɛ tel harɛ jaɡa bwa. Korowii kwaa bɔr nyundua bela tɛ wee,

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: o le bela dɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ, hanfale jaa sie aa lɛa, kɛɛ nɛn o sie aa beɡra wɛɛ ba chwae dɛ́ lɛ komɛl la ken.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Wee dɛ le nyundua baŋ bɛl, dɛ ɡale ba kaa baŋ bɛl. Komɛlbwa aa won laa on kpɔ le o nyɛɡre la ta.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Korowii Mmara wer, dɛɛ tɛ bokpeɡfale, Korowii waa waa dɛ do yaa a ta chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ ya te dɛɛ dawɛ a ta, a ɡelɔ banɔ la baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ la ɛɛ jemɛ wa.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Korowii Mmarare toɡrɔ, dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɛ teŋɛ a ta silɛɛ. O waa waa dɛ do yaa a ta wer, dɛɛ pili nɛn sie.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Korowii ɔma wer ɡa, aa do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Korowii waa bola dɛ́ pa bole ɛ kasinteŋ dɛ toɡre.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: O waa bola dɛ́ pa bole dɔ tɔnɔ, dɛ ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm tenten, a torodi dɛ ɡwaa tohno baa wola komɛlbwa a ta koore.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: A cheɡɛ a ta men maa ɛ he torome ɛɛ dɔ wejema, dɛɛ dɔ kembɔr a ta teŋa ta.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ o ɡbaɡba wechɔɡa waa ɛaɔ? N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡa maa wola jemɛ dɛ ɛ la ta.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡa maa saahna ɛ ta, bɛ ɡel a lɛ n liire. Anee dɛ́ ɡel n waa do wer, ásɛ n dɔ n te le wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel n nyoa wobol, ne n liire ɛɛ lɛ he sie, henee n Lɛɛ, dɛ do kɛ Bwetal maa chwaa kaa marɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no he wii he wahala ta, Kórowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ la, kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ!

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ó che o Dea bela dɛ́ chae, ó tɛɛ kpeɡri le Saayɔn Bwejen ta.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Ó lii sarahare haa tɛo bwa, ásɛ dɛ lɛ sarahare haa fuah tɛo la.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Ó tɛɛ komɛlbwa he bambile aa lawa, dɛ́ ɡel waa haa dɛ maɡle bwa do wer tɛɛ.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Ásɛ ya kpɔ silɛɛ moo, pɔe haa pɔ ya dɔma nɛɛ la wa, dɛ́ ir ya fraŋkaare, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ sɔn ta. Kórowii no he wesoŋa bwa.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Name, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ tɛ nɛn waa leo kɛ kooro kpeɡri, wɛɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛ. O dɛ sɛh o be nyundua bela waa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛ che o kpeɡri ta, dɛ ɡel o yo dɛɛ le.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Nɛra bane dɛ hwɛɡɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ta, bane ɡee hwɛɡɛ ba jaɡre nɛ, kɛ ya te, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la nɛɛ yaa hwɛɡɛ.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛɛ lɔ naa, dɛ́ choɡli, kɛ ya te ɛɛ iruu, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, cha kooro ó pɔ o dɔma nɛ! Dɛ ya wio noe naa, no ya be!

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, kooro dɛ hɛɡre bokpeɡa haa tɛo wa. O sie lɛo kohona pɔe haa ɡela o pɔ o dɔma nɛɛ la wa.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: He tɛo kwaa o bambile aa lawa, he sɛh waa waa soŋa ta tɛo.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: He swee andɛɛɡa tɛo kohona, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kooɡbɛrɛ tenten piu.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: O soŋe mkpa, asɛ he tɛo mkpajaŋ waa wola jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: He chao o pɔ o dɔma nɛ, dɛ ɡel o ɛ nɛnjen, dɛ tɛo sɔn o dɔ jirima kohona.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, he swee andɛɛɡa aa wola jaɡa dɔe tɛo, dɛ ɡel o do he sie o sie ɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Kooro la dɛ hwɛɡɛ hen Nemenɛ Korowii nɛ, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ɡelɔ o dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Kooro ɛɛ kpɔ o nɔnee dawɛ o dɔma bwa nɛ, wɛɛ lawɛ nomɛlbwa waa haoh laanee.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Korowii baa forɛ le aa, wɛɛ chɔɡ baa kɛŋɔ, nii yon fuh kwaa a chɔɡ la. Korowii baah ɛɛ diu kohona, ó chɔɡ ba bwa, dɛ́ ɡel nii fuuh ba kwaraa.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Ba naanar bɛlbwa aa kae ba, kooro la ɛɛ kpo ba bwaa.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: A lole kɛ ba chemo dɛ yon dɛɛ vɔrɔwe kooro vɔrɔwa, baa won ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ́ pɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ harɛ o too ba nɛ, ásɛ ba berɛ habɔɔ dɛ́ chwa kaa.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ya dɛ kpɛɛre he kpeɡri kohona wa, yaa ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre a wa.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii! N Naa Korowii! Ɛrɛɛ he chwa mɛ nɔɔ? N do lɔŋɔ sum ne ŋɔ hé cha mɛ, kɛ maa wobɛlbwa na.

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ noe chɔɔ haa men chaŋe, dɛ wi dɛɛ noe jwaana, kɛ n bwara aa men sɔɔh.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛ he ɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ dɛɛ di kora, henee Israel tena ɛɛ kpɛɛ.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: He nɛɛ ya naawa hwɛɡɛ, ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ he nɛ, asɛ he lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Ba wio noe, asɛ he lɛɛ ba le siswɛm ta, ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ he nɛ, he ta ɡelɛ a ɛ pɛɛ.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: N ta nɛn ɛɛ kpa, n do kɛ sɔɡlɔ, nɛra baa hah mɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi n nyubaah.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Nɛra na mɛ naa, ba dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, dɛ di n loro dɛɛ viiɡi ba nyuune.

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ, “He kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛ, ɛrɛɛ waa wola hen lɛɛ yɔ? Dɛ Korowii dɛ nyini naa, ɛrɛɛ waa wola hen chae yɔ?”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Hen Korowiirii ɡela ba lol mɛ, n taa ɛ bechasɔɔhna dɛɛ ɔr la, he nyiŋi n nɛ, dɛ tɛ mɛ bosɔɔhna.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Awola baa lol mɛ bwaa n le kpɔ n te dawɛ he nɛ, he ɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel n ne he baah do jaŋne! Waa puu mɛ tonɛ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ cha mɛ.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Dɔma warɔ dɛ bar mɛ cheme, kɛŋɔ Basan harɛ nabala a bwara aa kpeɡa ken.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Ba hah nyoo kɛŋɔ nyujentena, dɛɛ kɔɡre, dɛ́ toɡri n ola.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: N bokpeɡa tonɔ kɛŋɔ, baa fuɡe nee ta harɛ ken, asɛ n hoɡa bwa soɡre, n bambile chɔɡ, n ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: N ta bokpeɡa dɔe kɛŋɔ kaŋli ken, n nyondoŋe marɛ n nyoa, hé ɡel mɛ ń sewɛ ka chɔ lalabwɛ.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: N dɔma bar mɛ cheme, kɛŋɔ nyootena aa wara dɛ tɔ mɛ do baah ta, dɛɛ toɡri n nɔɔra ne nakpale.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: N ka hoɡa ɡbo, n dɔma nyiŋ mɛ dɛɛ mamɛ.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Ba ta chacha n laala wa, dɛ bɔna kpɔ.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel n ne he baah do jaŋne! Henee n kpeɡri, ba warane dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le tokobi seo nyoa. Lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma baa do kɛŋɔ nyootena nɔ nɔn ta.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ n dɔma baa do kɛ nyujentena nɔ nɔn ta, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma baa do kɛ, nabala nyeɡlare nɔ nyoa.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bol he waa haa ɛa n nɛra bee, mɛɛ kpɛɛree ba chema binii.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: “He banɔ haa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la, hé kpɛɛro! Jekɔb naanar, hé kpɔ duure tɛo! Israel tena, hé tomɔ!

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Korowii aa nyaara vɛh ba wenaale ta, waa habɔɔ berɛ dɛɛ kpo ba, ba wio noo waa, o dɛ cha ba.”

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɛɛre nɛnlaa tenten baahnee, nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ siee mɛɛ ba kwaa kpoora ɛ saraha tɛɛ, ɡɛ maa baɡɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Nyaara ɛɛ di kwaa vaɡɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin, nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɛɛ kpɛɛroo. Kórowii ɡel bá dɔ silɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la!

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ lii Korowii waa dɛ́ kpɛɛro, baa le harɛ jaɡa bwaa, dɛ́ ba o be, harɛre nɛra bwa ba ɡuŋi o sie.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii ɛ kooro, dɛɛ di kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Naanar baa ka ba bwa ɛɛ tomɛ Korowii, dɛ́ bol o waa baɡle ba biirere ne ba naanar.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Bii baa wola ban lolɛ mɔɔ kwaraa ɛɛ ba noo kɛŋɔ, “Korowii lɛ o nɛra.”

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Korowii do kɛ peteɡre dɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛ, komɛlbwa aa men nya.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ mɛɛ chɔ bela kpɔɡlwɛɛ aa lole, dɛ tɔ n sie dɛɛ kaa nee aa wera ta.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: O dɛ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡfala, dɛ tɔ n sie dɛɛ baɡ mɛ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡa, o sɔnjen la wa.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Hale n dɛ valɛ biro tenten bini kwaraa naa, maa ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛ he ja n nɛ, he daŋɡbala haa kpɔa dɛɛ teɡɛ peera laanee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bosɔɔhna.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: He ɛ kondikonjena cheɡ n sie, n dɔma bwa siwi ta. He fuɡe noo do n nyu ta, dɛ ɡel n numol su dɛɛ ta.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛ he waa wer hɛɛ nyin mɛ nomanta, hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ n soɡa bini tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ n so hen Korowii Dea, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɔ harɛ nɔ ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta, hale nɛwɛnyina bwa sekwara.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Onee pa harɛ mun o chɔŋɛ nee sie, dɛ ɡel kwaa aa lawɔ kpoŋe che viljena ta.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Umee dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ teeh kaa Korowii Dea, bela waa do ɡoroŋ ba le cheɡ dɛɛ tomɔ la ta nɔ?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Nɛn o we-ɛɛla aa wera, o tea to waa wola voɡa tomɛ, kɛɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ saɡasaɡa.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Gɛ te laanee Korowii ɛɛ ba andɛɛɡa sweera tɛ dɛ́ lɛo, dɛ́ pao bole.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛraa dɛɛ nyin Korowii be bala, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ la be.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Hé ya doonyojena la kohona, hé ya saŋ la doonyoo la, ásɛ Koojen waa dɔ jirima la ba jo.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Umee Koojen waa dɔ jirima kohona nɔɔ? Onee Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ do kan, dɛ ɛ banyoo laa yoi ta la.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Hé ya doonyojena la kohona, hé ya saŋ la doonyoo la, ásɛ Koojen waa dɔ jirima la ba jo.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Umee Koojen waa dɔ jirima kohona nɔɔ? Nemenɛ Korowiirii, onee Kooro waa dɔ jirima kohona la!

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he nɔn taa n kpɔ n nyu dɛɛ do,

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ. Bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ, kɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel n dɔma pɔ n nɛ.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, baɡ mɛ he ŋwɛnɛre, ásɛ n jemɛ dɛɛ kpɔ a ta.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Baɡ mɛ he kasinteŋ waa la mɛɛ teŋɛ a ta, dɛkalkɛ henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he ɛ n Lɛɛ, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bɛ n bonɔɔne saŋ wechɔɡa, ne deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla lii. Che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ta, dɛɛ lii n wa, dɛkalkɛ he waa wer.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Korowii wer, o waa toɡre, o dɛ baɡle wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe baa kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: O cha nɛŋɡwɛɡra baa ɛ wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ baɡ ba o ŋwɛnɛre.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Korowii dɔ nyina, o waa dɔ kasinteŋ, wɛɛ tɔ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la ta siee.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, a lole kɛŋɔ n wechɔɡa kan te, koh he sɔnjen la wa dɛ́ kpɔ kɛ mɛ.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ duu Korowii la, wɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛɛ baa kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba saŋ bɛlbwa, ba naanar kpɔ harɛ la ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ duu Korowii la, o kpɔ ba ɛ o daamanar, o ɡelɔ o ne ba fɔo baa fɔwa la che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: N sie dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa kɛ ó cha mɛ, onee dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le wekpeɡa ta.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, berɛ sie n be, dɛ́ sune n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ɡwɛɡrɔ, n ta nomɛlbwa dɔe ó cha mɛ.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Laa waa aa dawɛ n nɛɛ kpɔ n nɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale bwa ta.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi n suna dii ne n bonyɛɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ n wechɔɡa bwa kɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Na n dɔma wara baa wara, dɛ hah mɛ kohona.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ, bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ, henee n chwa baa marɛ.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe, ɡel kasinteŋ ne wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ tɔ n nɛ, he nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lɛ he nɛra Israel tena le ba wenaale bwa ta.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi n waa bini dɛ́ pa mɛ bole, dɛkalkɛ n waa toɡrɔ, he nɛɛ n den kpɔ n te dawɛ.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi n bini, dɛ́ daah mɛ na dɛ́ pese n we-ɛɛla ne n liire.
