english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa laanee dɛɛ baɡle mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, he kasinteŋ ɡe ɛɛ tɔ n sie.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: N ne nyosonteŋna aa darame kpɔ, n ne nɛnchɔɡa toole wobɛlbwa bini.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n sarame nɔɔra, a baɡle kɛ n ta bolchɔɡe bɛlbwa dii, dɛ ka valɛ bar he saraha kon la dɛɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: while gratefully singing about your wonders.
translation_verse: N ɡo yela kohona dɛɛ kpɛɛre, dɛɛ bol he nyokpowe-ɛɛla bwa wa.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bela haa soɡa dɛ do n wer, bela he jirima aa lole la.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Bɛ pɛ chɔɡ n ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, bɛ men kpo ja nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra nɛ,

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: ba bee wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa bwa le, dɛ ɡel baa yaɡ ba sen tɔpere bɛlbwa.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Kɛ n te, n waa toɡrɔ, sune n nɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ!

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: N cheɡɛ bodɛɛɡe, nɛra ɡalɡa binii mɛɛ ba hen Korowii kpɛɛra.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Korowii do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah mɛ, dɛ ɛ n Lɛɛ, maa nomɛlbwa ɔmɛ. Korowiirii ɛ n Kpeɡnɛn n chwa kaa marɔ, maa ɔmɛ bwa.

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛnchɔɡa balɔ ba lɔ tɔ n nɛ dɛɛ nyin bá kpo mɛ naa, baa lɔ naa dɛ́ choɡli.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Dɛ laa tena bar mɛ cheme aa, n bambile aa teŋe. Hale n dɔma ba dɛ yoo mɛ kwaraa naa, hen Korowii nɛɛ n hwɛɡa ta do.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, kombeŋkpoŋii n soŋe dɛɛ le he be, ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin laanee kɛŋɔ, ń so he Dea n soɡa bini bwa, dɛ́ nyiŋi ɡɛ he wa aa wera dɛ́ kooɡa, dɛ́ soŋe, he nyiŋi n nɛ.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ n wenaale tɔpere, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ he Dea dɛ́ laɡ mɛ sɔh bela, dɛ́ kpɔ n naa cheɡ bodɛɛɡe.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Anee dɛ́ ɡel n baŋa pa, n dɔma baa bar mɛ cheme la nɛ. Mɛɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛɛ he Dea bela silɛɛ lɔŋɔre ne, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛre.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ yerɛ naa, no n wii, na n sum, dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ!

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: He fa ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ba dɛ ba tom mɛ,” asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ bao,

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: bɛ he te kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.” Bɛ ɡel he baah di men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛ. Henee dɛɛ cha mɛ, bɛ men vɛh, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ. N Naa Korowii, henee n Lɛɛ.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Hale dɛ n mɛɛ ne n nya ɛɛ vɛɛh mɛ kwaraa naa, hen Korowii te ɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛɛ.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, baɡ mɛ he ŋwɛnɛre, tɔ n sie, dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta, dɛkalkɛ n dɔma warɔ.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Bɛ men ɡel tɛ n dɔma, ba teŋe nyosone dawɛ n nɛ, dɛ nyin mɛ naɡra, dɛɛ aah mɛ.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: N dɔ hwɛɡa hen Korowii nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, mɛɛ soo, dɛ́ jemɛ he wedɛɛɡa haa dɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ ya te dawɛ hen Korowii nɛ, dɛ́ lawɛ bambile, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he siwi ta.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii haa do kɛ Bwetal dɛ che n habɔɔ, henee n wi dɛɛ yerɛ. No n wii maa dɛ wi nɔ! He laa deŋna kpɔ n be naa, mɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa ka chɔ lalabwɛɛ ken.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: No n wii maa wia dɛɛ noe nɔ, dɛ́ cha mɛ, sune n nɛ, dɛ́ no n wii, maa ɡɔɔ nɔɔra nyundua chaɡɛ he Dea dɛ́ soŋe, bela waa do ɡoroŋ la.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Bɛ pɛ pa n ne nyubinikpeɡ tena bolchɔɡe, nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, ba nyoa wobol som ba bala be, kɛ dɛ dɔ liichɔɡa ba nyu bini la.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Ba siwi aa waa Korowii aa ɛa tɔɡɛ, kɛɛ kwaa waa taa bwa. Anomanta, wɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba kwaraa!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o sune n nɛɛ dɛ no n wii.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe dɛ ɛ n Kpeɡnɛn, o nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ, wɛɛ cha mɛ. N dɛ hɛɡre n bambile bini, mɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yelaa kpɛɛro.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra nɛ, dɛɛ tɛɛ ba bokpeɡa, o do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ, dɛɛ lɛ kooro waa leo cheɡ.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ba lɛ he nɛra, dɛ́ swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba. Nyiŋi ba nɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre kaa saŋ waa wola jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Nyundua toroma, hé kpɛɛ Korowii, hé kpɛɛ o jirima ne kpeɡri waa dɔa wa.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Hé baɡle kɛŋɔ o sɔn la dɔ jirima kohona, hé tomɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ, dɛ dɔ jirima kohona la.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Korowii taa bɔle mpo ta, Korowii waa dɔ jirima kɔrɔ kɛŋɔ bwaala ken, a ka le mpo ta bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Korowii taa kpeɡri, dɛ do kan, dɛ dɔ jirima kohona.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Korowii taa kpeɡri dɛ won peleme daa kuuɡa, hale dakpeɡa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: O taa ɡelɔ Lɛbanɔn bwejena ɛɛ yiiɡi kɛ nabiiri aa dɛ jah, Hɛmɔn Bwejen ɡe do kɛ nabale waa dɛ jah.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Korowii bol wa, a do kɛ bwaala aa nyɛɡla.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: O taa ɡbo ɡelɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ jiɡri, o ɡelɔ Kades pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ jiɡri.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Korowii taa yiiɡi dakpeɡa, dɛ chure kɔr bini daa papooni ta. Asɛ nɛra baa lɔ o Dea ɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ jirima tɛ Korowii!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ di kora mpo vile ta, o dɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ o nɛra bokpeɡa, dɛɛ swee ba andɛɛɡa, dɛɛ tɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ kpɛɛree, dɛkalkɛ he lɛɛ mɛ, he ta ɡelɛ n dɔma mam mɛ.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, n wio noe kɛ he cha mɛ, asɛ he chaah mɛ,

english_verse: saving me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le seo ta, he ta ɡelɛ n kaa lalabwɛ.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro, hé kpɛɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: O baah diu waa, aa biɡri dɛ o sɔɔhnɔ, kɛ o nyina waa dɛ nyin nɛn lole saŋ bɛlbwa. Yaa won dɛɛ wi jwaana, kɛ tɔɔ ne pera dɛ silɛɛ ɡboo.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: N fa aa dɔ bosɔɔhna la, n ŋɔ, “Wobɛlbwa aa won ɛɛ mɛ.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, haa sune n nɛɛ la, he ɡelɔ n che kiŋkiŋ kɛŋɔ bwejen ken. Kɛ haa laa sie kpɔ n nɛɛ la, n ɔmɔ kohona.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee n wi dɛɛ yerɛ, n soŋe kɛ he na n sum ŋɔ,

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “Dɛ n sewɔ ba huɡ mɛ naa, tɔnɔ besoo aa ba lee dɛ́ tɛɛ nɔ? Nɛn sewaa, wɛɛ won kpɛɛre ja aa? Wɛɛ won bol he wedɛɛɡa, aa wola jaɡa dɔe la waa ja aa?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ n suna dii berɛ silɛɛ, mɛɛ sa, dɛ ɡel n soh n wii, dɛ kpɔ silɛɛ tɔ mɛ kɛŋɔ yal.

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: Anomanta, maa nyoa tɔ, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa dɛ́ kpɛɛre. Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, mɛɛ kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee n chwa baa marɛ, bɛ ɡel n di sihiih, che toɡra he wa aa toɡra ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no n be, dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ warane. Do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, ń chwa ba marɛ, ɛ danjwɛkpeɡ dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Haa do kɛŋɔ n Bwetal n chwa baa marɛ ne danjwɛkpeɡ nɔ, ba tɔ n sie, dɛ́ baɡ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, he sɔn la wa.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: N dɔma har mɛ bela, lɛɛ mɛ le a ta, dɛkalkɛ henee n chwa baa marɛ.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: He nɔn taa n kpɔ n lileo do, N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ, lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: N hah nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe nɛ, kɛ hen Korowiirii mɛɛ yarada.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: N sie ɛɛ lɛo dɛ́ hɛɡre, nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ la wa, dɛkalkɛ he na n wahala, dɛ jemɛ n weweele.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: He ta ɡelɛ n dɔma dɔɔ mɛ, he kpɔ n naa cheɡ bodɛɛɡe.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na n sum, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ na wahala kohona, wii kohona ɡelɔ maa na kɛrɛdɛ, n bwadabii bwa ɡwɛɡre.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Suna dii ɡelɔ n ɡwɛɡre, wii kohona ɡelɔ maa won biɡri kohona. Wahala nae ɡelɔ n ɡwɛɡre, hale n hoɡa bini sɔɔhnɔ.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: N dɔma we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ n bala aa men komɛl yerɛ. N daamanar bwa dɛ ɔm mɛ, ba na mɛ fɔɡbaahna aa, dɛ ba dɛ chwa.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Ba soh n waa kɛŋɔ, maa sewa ken, n do kɛŋɔ vii waa paɡra.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: N noɔ nɛra ɡalɡa ɛɛ ŋwalɛ ŋɔ, ɔmee kohona chole n nɛ. Ba dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa, dɛ́ kpo mɛ.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Kɛ n Naa Korowii, henee mɛɛ yarada, henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa, n lɔ he nɔn ta, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma, ne nɛra baa dɛ nyin bá chɔɡ mɛ nɔn ta.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Sune men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛ, che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ, henee n wi dɛɛ no. Gel sihiih kpo nyubinikpeɡ tena, ba serewe ka chɔ lalabwɛ jeiih ken.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Gel nyosonteŋna la nyoa sɔɔh, mbarafo tena baa wola waa bu, dɛ bol wobochɔɡa dɛɛ yaɡɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ la, he kwaa kondɛɛɡa aa wera cheɡ ba. Nɛra baa chwaa baa marɛ la, he kpɔ waa aa wera dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee dɔ jam, dɛkalkɛ he baɡle he nyina kohona n nɛ, ɡɛ saŋ n dɔma aa bar mɛ cheme la.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: N ɔmɔ dɛ lii kɛŋɔ, he doŋ mɛ le he sie. Kɛ maa wia noe ŋɔ he cha mɛ la, he sune n nɛ, dɛ cha mɛ.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra he wa aa toɡra, hé baɡle he nyina o nɛ. O kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ nɛ, kɛ mbarafo tena te, o dɛ tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ aa chɛa.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ bwa, hé lawɛ bambile, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Nɛra Korowii aa kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, waa wola a waa lii kpa la, ba na som.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Nɛn Korowii aa wola o wechɔɡa waa lii kpa, nyosone bɛlbwa aa wola toole o bini la, o na som.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: N fa aa wola n wechɔɡa maa ɛa bolɛ la, n wio tɔpebir bwa, dɛ ba koh.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa he tɛr n deŋne, asɛ n bokpeɡa bwa tonɛ, kɛŋɔ wee yon lɔ bobɛlbwa hol hwel saŋ la.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Asɛ n bol n wechɔɡa baɡle, n ta kpɔe sɔeh. N liiro kɛ mɛɛ boloo baɡle, ásɛ he kpɔ a bwa kɛ mɛ.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡel nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ ɛɛ soŋe ba wahala nae saŋ, ásɛ dɛ wenaale do kɛŋɔ nee waa sua dɛɛ ba naa, o bɛ won tel ba be.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: He bee n chwa baa sɔh, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ le sibeɡra ta. Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre, lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ aa chɛ kɛ he kpɔ o ta, mɛɛ bol waa baɡle, dɛ́ kpɔ n nɔn tɔ he nɛ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡɛn kɛŋɔ jaaɡɔ kɛɛ keeɡo, ba yon kpɔ kabaɡrare do o nyoa, mɔɔ o jemɛ waa o dɔɔ aa dɛ nyin kɛ o ɛ la.”

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena wenaale warɔ taeh, kɛ Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la, dɛ tɔ nɛn waa dɛ yaradao la nɛ.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Nɛra he wa aa toɡra bwa, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii waa waa ɛa wa, nɛra haa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta bwa, hé kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Hé lɔ janjela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ koŋkwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ bwa soo siwi, lɔ yela kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yelfale tɛo, hé lɔ janjela kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ moo silɛɛ ne.

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ lɔ Korowii waa ta, o waa waa dɛ ɛ bwa wer.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyin wa aa toɡra dɛ do wer, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe lɔ harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Nyoa wobol nee Korowii ta nyundua, ne kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra, hé tomɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ duure tɛo.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Nyoa wobol nee Korowii ta harɛ, asɛ komɛlbwa do le, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa ŋɔa.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Korowii chɔɡ harɛre nɛra vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa, o lɔ waa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe bwa ta.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: O wobɛlbwa waa vɔrɔwa dɛ che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, o liire aa charɛ bwa, a lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra baa kpɔ Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ, o lee ba tɛ o te la, ba na som.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Korowii soɡe nyundua, dɛɛ na nɛwɛnyina bwa harɛ ta.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: O soɡe bela waa dɛ di kora, dɛɛ na nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Onee tɛ nɛwɛnyina liire, dɛ jemɛ waa baa dɛ ɛ bwa.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Kooro laa tena wara laa ɡela o yo laa dɛɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛ, banyoo kpeɡri laa ɡela o yo dɛɛ le.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Jaɡre baa soɡe a ta dɛɛ yo, aa won ɡel nɛn pɔ o dɔm nɛɛ laa ta, a bokpeɡa kohona laa dɛ́ won lɛ naate.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Korowii sie lɔ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta, nɛra baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ta la.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Ya hwɛɡa bwa lɔ Korowii nɛ, onee dɛɛ cha yaa, dɛɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ hwɛɡɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, anomanta, ya dɛ hɛɡre.

english_verse: I will always praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii saŋ bɛlbwaa. Maa o jaamaa ɡel bwa.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɛɛro n bambile bwa nee, ɡel nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba no, ba sie lɛ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel n ne he bwa kpɔ jirima tɛ Korowii, yá ɡɔɔ o sɔn.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: N soŋe Korowii, asɛ o chaŋ mɛ, dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le ɔmewa bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛɛ sie dɛ lɛ, sihiih aa ban kpo bwa.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Nɛŋɡwɛɡra wio no Korowii, o no ba be, dɛ lɛɛ ba le ba wenaale bwa ta.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome dɛ daah nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, dɛɛ lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Hé daɡɛ Korowii waa la, dɛ́ na kɛ o wer, nɛra baa chwaa kaa marɔ la, ba na som.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra he wa aa toɡra, hɛ́ɛ duuru, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta la, ba dɛ dɔ komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Lɔr ɛɛ won kpo nyujentena a ɡwɛɡre, kɛ banɔ la baa dɛ no Korowii be la, kondɛɛɡa aa ban paŋɛ.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: N bii, hé ba dɛ́ ba cheɡ deŋne no n be, mɛɛ baɡle heyaa ɡɛ haa kpɔ duure tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin mkpajaŋ, dɛɛ nyin kɛ o bwara sɔɔhno la,

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi o nyoa kɛrɛdɛ. O bɛ wobochɔɡa dɛɛ bol, o bɛ nyosone dɛɛ teŋe.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Wɛ́ɛ ke o te wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa. Ó swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ ba nyopɛo ne.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛɛ su Korowii siwi la, Korowii dɛ nyiŋ ba, dɛɛ no ba wesoŋa.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra te, o kii ba, ba sewaa, baa ba waa lii kpa.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra wio no Korowii aa, o dɛ no, dɛ lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le ba wahala bwa ta.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ bɛne banɔ la ba bambile aa chɔɡa, dɛɛ lɛ banɔ la baa wola hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ won na wahala kohona, kɛ Korowii lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le a bwa ta,

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, ba hoɡ beŋkpoŋ kwara aa ku.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ laanee dɛɛ kpoo ba, nɛra baa hah nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɡe ɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ lɛ o nɛraa, wɛɛ lɛ banɔ la baa chwaa kaa marɔ laanee.

english_verse: Shield me and help me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he dɔmkwa tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, ásɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he lampea ne kpanfɛ, dɛ́ yo nɛra baa dɛ ti mɛ la. Baɡɛ nyoa kɛŋɔ, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ.

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo. Nɛra baa dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa la, ɡel ba wili, dɛ́ berɛ kaa.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Gel ba do kɛŋɔ haahra peu aa taa dɛɛ kaa a ne la ken, Korowii nyundua torome teŋɛ ba nɛ dɛ́ɛ kaa.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Gel biro ba tɔ ba ŋwɛnɛ ta o do vɔle, Korowii nyundua torome la teŋɛ ba nɛ.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: N ta ban wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba har mɛ bel, dɛ forɛ bɔluŋ, dɛ́ laɡ mɛ.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Gel ba ne jara, dɛ wenaale ba ba nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba ɡbaɡba bel la laɡ ba, ba lee bɔluŋ la bini dɛ́ serewe.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Ásɛ Korowii nomanta, n sie lɛ, dɛɛ hɛɡre, o lɛɛ waa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ le n bambile bini bwaa dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, umee do kɛ hen ɔ? He lɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra dɛɛ le nɛŋkpeɡa nɔn ta, dɛ lɛ nyaara dɛɛ le nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba nɔn ta.”

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡa teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛ, waa maa wola a waa jemɛ laanee baa bɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡaa ba kpɔ dɛɛ bɔ mɛ wedɛɛɡa kem, a ɡel n sie aa lɛ, n bambile chɔɡ.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Ba bwara fa aa dɛ wee ba la, lweyalee n kpɔ tɔ, n vɔwɛ nyoa, n ta kwaa dii. N ba harɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: ɡɛ n fe aa soŋe tɛ n dam kɛɛ n nime. N bambile chɔɡɔ mɛɛ wi, kɛŋɔ maa dɛ wi n nya seo waa ken.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ nyiŋa ka tel ɔ? Lɛɛ mɛ le yoi baa dɛ yoo mɛ nɔ ta, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma baa do kɛ nyujentena nɔ nɔn ta.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Ásɛ n kpɔ jam tɛɛ he nɛndamanta baa chema bini, nɛnlaa baahnee mɛɛ ba he kpɛɛra.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel nɛra baa hah mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ la di n loro, bɛ ɡel ba sie lɛ, n suna maa dɛ di nɔ ta.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Baa waa aa ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne bol, nyosonee ba teŋe dɛɛ dawɛ, nɛra baa wola ba bwara ne waa nyin nɛ.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ba dɛ pwaah mɛ ŋɔ, “Ya na waa bwa haa ɛa.”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he na ɡɛ waa nɔ, bɛ nyoa tɔ. Bɛ bojaŋ kaa ɡel mɛ.

english_verse: Fight to defend me, Lord God,
translation_verse: Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ yo tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, che toɡra he wa aa toɡra ta, dɛ́ pa mɛ boldɛɛɡe, bɛ ɡel n dɔma mam mɛ.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel ba lii ŋɔ, “Ya dɔɔ ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyin name!” Kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya dɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ mam mɛ kohona, ásɛ dɛ wili, n wahala maa dɛ na wa. Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛ ba ɡwaa mɛ kohona.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel banɔ la baa dɛ nyin n di boldɛɛɡe, ɛɛ do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ ne. Ásɛ baa bol ŋɔ, “Korowii kan ɡa, o sie lɛ o bonɔɔ wer waa doa ta.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Belaa mɛɛ ba toɡra he wa aa toɡra la waa bola, dɛ́ kpɛɛre tɔpebir bwa.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ lii ba nyu bini kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nɛnjena nomanta, Korowii aa ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la nae ba, dɛ́ pa ba bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ ne nyosone waa baa bol, ba ta wedɛɛɡa liire dɔe kpa.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ba chɔ ba chɔɔbɔra kwaraa naa, baa wobɛlbwa aa wera ɛ, baa wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɡe vɛh.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ɡwaa komɛlbwa, he kasinteŋ waa ɡe ta jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: He wa aa toɡra la jaŋne kaa nyundua kɛ bwejena tenten ken, he bole pae bini do luŋri kɛŋɔ mpo vil, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyina ne ola bwa nɛ.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe aa wera! He kena lɔɡree ya chwa baa sɔh, kɛŋɔ jal yon lawɛ o bii, do o kena lɔɡre la.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: He tɛ yaa kondikwa a warɛ yaa di he dem, dɛ tɛ yaa he wedɛɛɡa, a do kɛ nee waa dɛ palɛ yaa nyɔ.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: He nɛɛ ya che dɛɛ dɔ mkpa, he nii laanee ɡela bɔr chaah yaa na.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ he waa ta, dɛ́ɛ ɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel mbarafo tena ba yoo mɛ, kɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena la doŋ mɛ.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa chola, ba taɡ ba ta, baa wola won ir kpa.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel nyubinikpeɡ tena we-ɛɛla we he nɛ, he bɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwara we.

english_verse: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
translation_verse: Baa biɡri hol kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken, dɛ́ piɡri serewe kɛŋɔ, kpɔɡlwɛɛ yon hol la.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛ, dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ dɛ so harɛ la ta deŋnesɔɔhna ne.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he sie ɛɛ lɛ Korowii nɛ, ásɛ o tɛ heya he bambile konnyina.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he waa bwa do Korowii nɔn ta, hé kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛ, ásɛ o cha heya.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ che toɡra he wa aa toɡra taa, ásɛ he kasinteŋ dii do kɛ nii, dɛɛ chaah kɛŋɔ webaŋa ken.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Hé lawɛ bambile, dɛɛ kpa Korowii, dɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena waa wer dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aa, he bɛ ɡel a we he nɛ kɛŋɔ aa chiɡ ba kɛrɛdɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Hé laa he te kpɔ tebinichɔɡ ne bandia ta, wechɔɡa ɡbo taa aa kaa nɛn ne.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɔ hwɛɡa Korowii nɛɛ la ɛɛ dɔ harɛɛ dɛ́ so o ta, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena te, baa doŋ ba le o ta.

english_verse: Sinners will soon disappear, never to be found,
translation_verse: Aa biɡri dɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena toole kpa, hɛ́ɛ baa nyin ba bɔree, kɛ háa ban na.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa pwɛr ba te la, ɛɛ so harɛ la taa, dɛ́ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna kohona.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena dɛ vɔrɔwe nɛra ba wa aa toɡra vɔrɔwa, dɛɛ nyiŋ ba sichɔɡa ne.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ mamɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena, o jemɔ kɛŋɔ ba chɔɡa tɔpere telo tonɛ.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena kpɔ ba tokobie, dɛ harɛ ba tori kpa. Ba dɛ nyin bá kpoo nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra ba wa aa toɡra,

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: kɛ ba ɡbabir tokobie dɛ́ kpoo ba, ba tori kuuɡi.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta cheɡa dɛ́ dɔ konjeɡa wer dɛ ɡwaa, kɛ haa cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta dɔa kohona,

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ, Korowii ɛɛ sɔɔh nyubinikpeɡ tena nyoa, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Korowii jemɛ nɛra wechɔɡa aa wola toole ba nɛɛ wa, baa dɔ harɛ laanee ó ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Baa wahalaa na sibeɡra saŋ, lɔr saŋ kwaraa yaa, dɛ ba te dɔ kondikwa.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ serewoo, nɛra baa ɛ Korowii dɔm la do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa wola biɡri la ken, baa nyoɡroo kɛŋɔ ninchuu ken.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena kemɛ kon aa, ba dɛ vɛh bɔe, kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te aa nɛra kwaa tɛɛ ɡel bwa.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nɛra Korowii aa swee ba andɛɛɡa la, ɛɛ dɔ harɛ laanee, kɛ banɔ la waa taah ba la te, wɛɛ doŋ baa le o ta.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Korowii sie lɛ nɛra we-ɛɛla ta naa, o dɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ o ta, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Ba lɔ naa kwaraa naa, baa chole, dɛkalkɛ o laɡ ba kpoŋe.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: N fa ɛ bechala, dɛ ba ɛ banjena, kɛ n ta nae kɛŋɔ Korowii laa nɔn kpɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ, kɛɛ ba bii valɛ dɛɛ soŋe kondikwa.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Ba won kwaa kɛɛ, dɛɛ kemɛ ba bala ja, ba bii ɛɛ dɔ andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ́ɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ he so harɛ la ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ́ɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Waa aa wera dɛ toɡre laanee Korowii ɛɛ nyin, waa nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ laanee ɡel. Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ ba nɛ, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena naanar te, wɛɛ doŋ baa le harɛ la ta.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la, banee dɛ́ dɔ harɛ la ta so, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nyoa wejemwaa do, ba nyoa waa aa wera ne kasinteŋ do.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ Mmara lɔ ba bambile bini, baa an kpɔe dɛɛ ta bwa.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena dɛ kpaah nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ nyin ba dɛ́ kpoo,

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: kɛ Korowii aa ɡel ba di kpeɡri ba nɛ, kɛɛ ba di bolchɔɡe, ɡɛ saŋ wa aa puu ba la.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛ, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta. Wɛɛ ɡeloo hé dɔ harɛ la ta so, dɛ́ doŋi nyubinikpeɡ tena la he siwi ta.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: N na nyubinikpeɡ te waa wola nɛn nɛɛ sune, o soɡa bini do wer kɛŋɔ, daa waa kpeɡa harɛdɛɛɡe ta ken,

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: kɛ a ta biɡre bɛlbwa, o den sewɛ, n ɡaaɡe o bɔr, n ta on nae.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi nɛra ba wa aa toɡra na, ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ba kerekere soɡa bini.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa ɛɛ serewoo, ba naanar aa kae ba harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ lɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ lɛɛ ba ba wenaale ta.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: O kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ, dɛɛ lɛɛ ba, o lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ, onee ba chwa kaa marɛ.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel he baah di he pwaah mɛ, bɛ ɡel he baah di kohona, he tɛr n deŋne.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: He ta he hɛma yaɡ mɛ, dɛ lɔ mɛ bil.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: He bandia ɡelɔ n bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ mɛ, n wechɔɡa nomanta, n bwadabii bwa ne weelaa.

english_verse: are so heavy that I am crushed.
translation_verse: N wechɔɡa ɡwaa n nɛɛ kohona, a do kɛ bontɔɡa maa wola won che.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: N wechɔɡa aa ɡela n ɡɛn nomanta, n ŋwɛra pɔɔh, dɛ do sɔɔh.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: N weweele ɡwaa n nɛ, a ɡel maa won che, dɛɛ wi tɔpebir bwa kɛŋɔ, nɛn waa dɛ ɛ lwe ken.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: N nyaŋ dɛ nyaa mɛ, dɛɛ wee mɛ, n bokpeɡa tonɛ.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: N ɡwɛɡrɔ, n bwara bini bwa sɔɔh, suna dii ɡel mɛɛ pɛmɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ɡbabir jemɛ n waa bwa aa chɔ he sie, he dɛ no n pɛma maa dɛ pɛmɛ bwa.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: N bambile dɛ lɔ, n bokpeɡa tonɛ, n sibie ɡe aa na kɛrɛdɛ kpa.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: N daamanar ne n soma bwa chwa mɛ n ŋwɛra wa, hale n lolanar bwa ɡe chwa mɛ.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, haɡre mɛ bela, nɛra baa dɛ nyin n chɔɡa dɛ́ aah mɛ, tɔpere bɛlbwaa baa vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa, dɛ́ chɔɡ mɛ.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: N do kɛ nɛn o deŋne aa wola waa no, kɛŋɔ amumu maa wola won bol wa.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: N do kɛ nɛn waa wola waa no, ba bol wa waa wola won chaŋe la ken.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: Kɛ N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, henee dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel n dɔma mam mɛ n wenaale wa, bɛ ɡel n chola ɛɛ ba silɛɛ.

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba chola, wee n bwara aa dɛ wee mɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa wa.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: N dɛ bol n wechɔɡa, a ɡelɔ mɛɛ ɔmɛ kwara.

english_verse: Many deadly and powerful enemies hate me,
translation_verse: N dɔma warɔ, dɛ do kpeɡri, ba warɔ, dɛ hah mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ bɔ wedɛɛɡa kem cheɡɛ n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bɛ habɔɔ berɛ kpo mɛ, Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, bɛ bojaŋ kaa ɡel mɛ.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee ɛ n Lɛɛ, ba warane, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: N lii n nyu bini ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ nyiŋi n ŋwɛnɛre ta kɛrɛdɛɛ, maa ɡel a che n nyoa wobol ta, n ɛ wechɔɡa. Nɛnchɔɡa bɛn mɛ naa, maa wobɛlbwaa bol.”

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Kɛ n fa aa tɔ nyoa maa wola wobɛlbwa bolɛ, n ta wedɛɛɡe bɛlbwa ɡe bolɛ la, a taa n bonyɛɡa ɡwaa n nɛɛ kohona.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: N bambile chɔɡɔ kohona, maa ŋɔ ń kpɔ liire la, name tenee a yon ɡwaa, asɛ n ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: “N Naa Korowii, chaɡ mɛ saŋ maa so ka tel, ne n tɔpera aa ka n sie. Aa biɡri dɛ n sewɔ.

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ me mkpa do bori, a ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ he siwi ta, nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa mkpa do kɛŋɔ peu he be.

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini mkpa do kɛŋɔ lileo, ba wobɛlbwa ɛ wepuu. Wɛɛ nyin kondɔɔh cheɡ kohona, kɛ waa jemɛ naate aa ba ɛ o kwa.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bɔkwaa mɛɛ nyin taraken jaɔ? N hwɛɡa bwa lɔ he nɛ.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le n wechɔɡa bwa ta, bɛ ɡel nɛra baa ɡɛna dɔɔ mɛ, dɛ́ mam mɛ.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: N tɔ nyoa name, maa wobɛlbwaa bol kpa, henee ɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Bɛ n deŋne tɛr kpa! He deŋnetɛra la ɡwaa n nɛ.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: He bol wa bandia ne, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tɛr ya deŋne, ya wechɔɡa wa, ɡɛ dudul yon di kon dɛ chɔɡo la, ɡɛɛ he chɔɡ ya kondɔɔh, nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa do kɛŋɔ peu ken.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, no n wii dɛ́ cha mɛ, bɛ he deŋna laa kpɔ n be. N do kɛŋɔ hɔɔh harɛ nɔ ta he sie, kɛŋɔ ya naawa bwa fa aa ɛa la.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Laa sie kpɔ n nɛ, ásɛ n sie berɛ lɛ ja, mɔɔ n sewɛ le harɛ nɔ ta.”

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: N wio no Korowii, dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛɛ kpao, asɛ o na n sum, dɛ no n wii.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: O laɡ mɛ le lalabwɛ waa do kɛŋɔ bɔluŋ ta, n le seo nyoa. O kpɔ mɛ ba chɔŋɛ bwetal ta, n bwara sɔɔh mɛ, asɛ n che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: O kpɔ yelfale do n nyoa, kpɛɛra yel waa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la kan. Nɛra ɡalɡa ɛɛ na waa waa ɛa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ la, ba na som. Nɛra baa wola mbarafo tena we-ɛɛla nyiŋi, kɛɛ baa wola voɡa tomɛ la.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, nyokpowe-ɛɛla haa ɛa la warɔ ɡa. Yaa won baɡle wejena haa vɔrɔwa bil tɛ yaa la, a warɔ kohona, yaa wola won kura.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Konaatena ne koŋkwaa baa kpɔa ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛɛ la, he sie aa a ta lɛ, he tɛ mɛ deŋne ŋɔ, n kpɔ no he wa. He siwi aa konaatena baa dɛ fuah ambire dɛɛ tɛɛ, ne sarahare baa ɛa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ soŋe nɛra wechɔɡa la su.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Belaa n ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, menee la. N balɔ. Ba chwerɛ n waa do he Mmara tɔn la bini.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin he waa ɛɛ, n kpɔ he webaɡla la do n bambile bini.”

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Maa amanesoma aa dɛ lɛ nɛra la kpɔe dɛɛ sɔh n bambile bini, n dɛ bol he kasinteŋ ne he chae waa la. He nɛra chemo warɛ aa, maa nyoa tɔ, he waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ, ne he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n jemɔ kɛ haa n sum nae ɡel bwa, he nyina ne kasinteŋ ɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbee saŋ bɛlbwa. Chae wesoŋa

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: N dɔma baa wola nyoa dɔe bar mɛ cheme, n wechɔɡa ɡwaa n nɛ, maa jemɛ bela maa kpɔ. A warɔ ɡwaa n nyumpona kwara, a ɡel n hwɛɡa bwa ta.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, lɛɛ mɛ, ba warane, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Gel nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo la, sihiih kpo ba, bá wili. Nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ n wenaale ta la, ber ba kaa, dɛ́ ɡel sihiih kpo ba.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel banɔ la baa dɛ mam mɛ la bambile chɔɡ, pɔe haa pɔ ba nɛɛ la wa.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa laŋa kaa tomɛ la, ɡel bá dɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ hɛɡre. Gel nɛra haa lɛɛ ba ba dɔ mkpa la ɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: N nyao, dɛ ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre, kɛ he ta n waa soɛh. Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee ɛ n Lɛɛ, n poori, ba warane, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ dawɛ nyaara waa la, ba na som, wenaale puu ba aa, Korowii lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le a nyoa.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ́ tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe, ásɛ ba soɡa bini do wer, o swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba harɛ la ta, ba dɔma lii wechɔɡa tɛɛ ba aa, o kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ cha baa ba weela bini, dɛ́ ɡel ba berɛ dɔ bokpeɡa.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: N ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, na n sum, chaah mɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo he nɛ.”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: N dɔma dɛ bol n bwara wechɔɡe ŋɔ, “Bɛweeree ó sewɛ ásɛ o sɔn he te nɔ?”

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa na mɛ naa, nyosonee wɛɛ teŋe, liichɔɡa yon su o bambile, dɛ́ le kaa bola bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: My enemies whisper about me. They think the worst,
translation_verse: N dɔma pɛo dɛɛ ŋwal mɛ, ba lii wechɔɡa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: “Weechɔɡa lɔɔ bil, waa won ir le o chɔɔbɔr.”

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Hale n dansom maa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛ, nɛn n ne waa pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwaa la, ɛ n dɔm.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na n sum, laɡ mɛ ir, ásɛ n bɔ n dɔma kem, waa baa ɛɛ mɛ la wa.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he sie lɛ n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɔma ta wone pɔ n nɛ.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: N waa toɡrɔ nomanta, hɛɛ laɡ mɛɛ do he sie, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɔ jam, le saŋ waa wola jaɡa dɔe dɛɛ la. Aamen!

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡɛ nyɔɡre kpo welo, o siwi yon swɛɛ, wɛɛ nyin nepale waa sɔna la, ɡɛɛ n siwi swɛɛ he wa.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Korowii haa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, n dɛ nyini kɛ nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo nɛn ken. Bɛweeree ń won ba he sie, dɛ́ ba tomɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Sinii ber mɛ kondikwa, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa. Saŋ bɛlbwaa n dɔma ɛɛ pɛɛ mɛ ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ?”

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: N lii n saŋ la aa, dɛ n bambile chɔɡɔ, n ne nɛnlaa bwa fa yon la hen Korowii Dea, ásɛ n tɔ ba sie ba teŋɛ, ba sie lɛ ba ɡo yela, dɛɛ hɛɡre dɛɛ kpɛɛre.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ n tea bini chɔɡ ken? Ɛrɛɛ n liire bwa chɔɡ ken nɔɔ? N kpɔ n hwɛɡa bwa do hen Korowii nɛ, dɛ berɛ kwaa dɛɛ kpɛɛre ja. Henee ɛ n Lɛɛ,

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: ne Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ. N bambile chɔɡɔ kohona, anomanta, mɛɛ lii he waa, dɛ́ le Jɔɔdan Moo nyuune ta, ne Misar ne Hɛmɔn Bwejena dor.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ bɔchuubu nee lɔ dɛɛ kpɔ n nɛ mɛɛ di suna, kɛŋɔ nɛn nee aa sua dɛ kpɔɔ kaa ken.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ baɡle o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe n nɛɛ webaŋa, a ɡel n ɡo yel tɛo jwaana, dɛ soŋe Korowii waa ɡela n so le.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: N ŋɔ Korowii waa do kɛ Bwetal n chwa kaa marɔ be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he soh n waa nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ wi n dɔma, ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa nɔn ta nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: N hoɡa bwa dɛ wee mɛ, n dɔma aa dɛ muɡli n baah la wa, dɛɛ bɔɔ mɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ?”

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ tebinichɔɡ su n bwa ken? Ɛrɛɛ n bambile chɔɡ ken nɔɔ? N kpɔ n hwɛɡa bwa dawɛ hen Korowii nɛ, dɛ berɛ kwaa dɛɛ kpɛɛre ja, henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee n Lɛɛ.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, pa mɛ boldɛɛɡe, che n habɔɔ, dɛ́ bol n waa tɛ mɛ, nɛra baa wola hen Korowii tomɛ nɔ be, lɛɛ mɛ le nyosonteŋna, ne nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Henee dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe. Ɛrɛɛ he vɛɛh mɛ nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ n dɔma ɡel n bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ, dɛɛ muɡli n baah nɔɔ?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he nii waa do kɛ kandea, ne he kasinteŋ ba tɔ n sie, ba n ne he bwe waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, he Dea bela haa lole la.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Ásɛ n la hen Korowii saraha kon la ta, henee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ. Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa, dɛ́ lɔ janjela kpɛɛre, henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ n tea bini chɔɡ ken? Ɛrɛɛ n liire bwa chɔɡ ken nɔɔ? N kpɔ n hwɛɡa bwa do hen Korowii nɛ, dɛ berɛ kwaa dɛɛ kpɛɛre ja, henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee ɛ n Lɛɛ.

english_verse: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ya noa deŋne ne, ya naawa bol wejena haa ɛa, ba bere saŋ la ya be.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: He kpeɡri nee he doŋi harɛre nɛra, dɛ kpɔ ya naawa ka so ba harɛ la ta. He chɔɡ ba, dɛ ɡel ya naawa wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Ba tokobie ne laa ba yo lɛ harɛ la, kɛɛ ba ɡbaɡba bokpeɡa ne laa, he ɡbabir kpeɡri nee, dɛkalkɛ he baɡ ba nyoa ŋɔ, he ja ba nɛ, dɛɛ nyin ba.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Henee kooro ne Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, dɛ ɡel he nɛra Israel tena yo, dɛɛ pɔ ya dɔma nɛ.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: He kpeɡri taa a che, ya won pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, he sɔn taa ya che, dɛ tiɡri ba nɛ.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: N to kɛɛ n tokobi, laa ɡela n won pɔ n dɔma nɛ.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Henee tɛ yaa kpeɡri, ya pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, dɛ ɡel sihiih kpo nɛra baa hah yaa.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ yaa tamane tɔpere bɛlbwa, yaa kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken, he vɛh yaa dɛ ɡel ba pɔ ya nɛ, haa ya laa tena nɛɛ ja, dɛɛ la laa kpa.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ ya chwa le ya dɔma sie, asɛ ba ba kam ya laala, kɛ laa ta kwa.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ ba kpoo yaa kɛŋɔ peera ken, dɛ lɔ yaa peɡre harɛre ta.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: He yoɡ yaa tɛ ya dɔma pɛɛpɛɛ, he ta komɛlbwa dɔe le a ta.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ ya bala nyiŋi yaa dɛɛ vah, nɛra baa soɡa bar yaa dɛ mamɛ yaa.

english_verse: Foreigners joke about us and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Yanee harɛre tena bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ, ba nyiŋi yaa dɛɛ viiɡi nyuune.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ di sihiih, sihiih ɡboo n bwa,

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: nɛra dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, dɛɛ muɡli n baah, dɛkalkɛ, n dɔma cheɡɛ ɡɛ ta, dɛɛ tɔ ba wel.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ anɔ bwa pu yaa, kɛ dɛ ya ta he waa soɛh, kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ ya ne he fɔo yaa fɔwa la.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: He waa ta lɔ ya bambile ta, ya ta waa haa do yaa a ta la vɛɛh,

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: kɛ he ɡel yaa tɛ kpɔɡ bini ola, biro tenten tɔ ya nɛ.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya fe vɛh hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, dɛ kaa tomɛ harɛfala ta voɡa aa,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: he fe nao, dɛkalkɛ, he jemɛ ya nyu bini liire aa sɔah bwa.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: He nomanta, ya cheɡɛ seo nyoa saŋ bɛlbwa, baa ɛ yaa kɛ peera baa dɛ la ka kpoora ken.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, ɛrɛɛ a do kɛŋɔ he chɔ dom nɔɔ? Gɔɔ he te, dɛ bɛ yaa vɛh kwaraa.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ he kpɔ sie sɔh yaa nɔɔ? Bɛ ya dɔma wenaale baa do yaa a ta la soh.

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Ya cholo chɔ bomboɡ ta, yaa wola won ir kpa.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Ir nyu ne, dɛ́ ba cha yaa! Lɛ yaa he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la wa.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Wobol aa wera su n nyoa, mɛɛ ba kpɔe ɡo yel tɛ kooro. N nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ, kon nɛn waa jemɛ chwera kɛrɛdɛ, aa kpoŋa dɛɛ chwerɛ.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Henee wera kohona, baala bwa bini, he nyoa jemɛ wobol ɡe, dɛkalkɛ Korowii sweere andɛɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Che kan haa doa ta ka yo, dɛ́ pɔ he dɔma nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ kasinteŋ ne toɡra he wa aa toɡra, bol waa dɛɛ pa bole. He kpeɡri kohona ɛɛ ɡeloo hé pɔ he dɔma nɛ.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: He hɛma nyɛɡre, dɛɛ jo he dɔma bambile bini, harɛre nɛra choɡli he sie.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: He kora Korowii aa lea cheɡe, ɛɛ cheo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, kasinteŋii hɛɛ ba kpɔe, dɛ́ nyiŋi he nɛra nɛ.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: He dɛ nyin waa aa toɡra, dɛ ki wechɔɡa. A waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ lee cheɡ he bala koranar bwa bini, dɛ fuɡe noo do he nyu ta dɛ tɛɛ silɛɛ.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: He laala sɔɔh tɔ konsɔɔhsoma bwa soo siwi, ba kpɔ bala nyena kwaa he kooderemi, yelɡoola kpɔ janjela lɔ yela, dɛɛ lɛ he sie.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Koranar bihaahna ja haahna baa dɔ jirima, dɛ do he dem nɛ, asɛ hanfale do kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛa, dɛ che he diɡ pera.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Kooro hanfale, dɛɛ no waa maa dɛ ba bola nɔ, soh he nɛra ne he lolanar wa.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: He wer ɡelɔ kooro bambile do he nɛ, dɛɛ duuru, dɛkalkɛ he dɔɔree on.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Taaya tena ɛɛ ba koŋkɛɛla nee ba tɛɛ, suuɡa tena ɛɛ nyin bá kpɔ ba kwaa ba di he liire.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Kooro hanfale lɔ koodem, o wer dɔŋ toole, ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ŋwɛɛra sɔh ja ŋwɛɛra baa kpɔa sɔh o batakaarejaŋ la ta.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: O do batakaarejaŋ ba sɔh kwaa dawɛ o ta, baa ba o ne hen kooro be, o toli teŋɛ o nɛ, baa ba ba ɡe ne he be.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ ba, dɛ hɛɡre ba jo he koodem bela.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: N naa kooro, hɛɛ lolɛ bibaalaa taeh, bá ba chiɡ he naawa naa ta ɛ koranar, ásɛ he ɡel baa nyiŋi harɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: N yel la ɛɛ ɡeloo hé dɔ sɔn kohona dɛɛ la, ásɛ harɛre nɛra kpɛɛre, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ya chwa kaa marɛ wɛɛ tɛ yaa bokpeɡa ya wenaale bwa ta, o ja ya nɛ.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Dɛ harɛ jiɡro kwaraa, bwejena chuɡri ka le mpo vile ta,

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: hale mpo nehɛma nyoa kpeɡri, dɛɛ si ɡɛ bɛlbwa, dɛ ɡel bwejena ɛɛ yiiɡi aa, yaa ɔmɛ.

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Nee bɛl ɡelɔ nɛra ɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ, Korowii bwɛjen la ta, Nemenɛ Korowii Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Korowii lɔ bwɛjen la ta, waa won chɔɡ, Korowii ɛɛ bao bɔr chaahna saŋ, dɛ́ ba cha ba.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ ɔmee ba ta harɛre nɛra nɛ, o kɔrɔ kɛŋɔ bwaala, asɛ harɛ mwɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Korowii waa ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro ja ya nɛ, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ laanee do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ, ya chwa kaa marɔ.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Hé ba dɛ́ ba na toma Korowii aa ɛa, nyokpowaa waa ɛa a do ɔma ya harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: O won laa nyoa sɔɔhna harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, dɛɛ kuuɡi tori ne lampeare, dɛɛ fuh kwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe, dɛɛ yo laa.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel yoi, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ menee Korowii, menee kana harɛre nɛra bwa bini, n dɔŋ toole harɛ nɔ bwa ta.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ja ya nɛ, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ laanee do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ, ya chwa kaa marɔ.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Harɛre bwa nɛra, hé lɔ kpaŋa, á baɡle kɛ he sie lɛo, hé do lɔŋɔre kpɛɛ Korowii silɛɛ yela ne.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowiirii ɔma kohona, onee koojen waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ nɔ bwa ta.

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Onee ɡela ya yo harɛre nɛra, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, ba ba do ya lɔɡa.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Korowii iro dɛɛ la ka so o kookara ta, nɛra hoh bɛle silɛɛ ne dɛɛ moo.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro.

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Korowii soɡe o kookara waa do ɡoroŋ ta, dɛɛ di kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta koranar chemo, ba ne Korowii Abraham aa tomɔ nɛra. Harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa lɔ o lɔɡa, o dɔŋ toole.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ kan, a chɛ kɛ yá kpɛɛro o bwɛjen waa chɔŋɛ bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Korowii Saayɔn Bwejen wer, dɛ do jaŋne kohona, koojen la bwɛjen kpɔ silɛɛ baa tɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Korowii lɔ o bwɛjen la ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa lɔ o ta nɛ.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: kɛ baa ba bwɛjen la ta la, ba bwara yɔrɔ, ɔmee kohona ɡel ba chwa kaa.

english_verse: They trembled all over like women giving birth
translation_verse: Bochela laɡ ba bela, kɛŋɔ loltea aa lɔ haah ken,

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: kɛŋɔ peuchɔɡe aa taa le wee leebɔr dɛ lɔ stiimaere dɛɛ kaa la.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Ya no waa Korowii aa ɛa, dɛ ɡbaɡba naa siwi ne, Nemenɛ Korowii waa ɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ bwɛjen la ta. Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ o bwɛjen la taa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ɡbo waa lɔ ya nyu bini, yaa lii he Dea bela.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡɛ he sɔn aa kana la, ɡɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ kpɛɛre le harɛ jaɡa bwa, he kpeɡri kohona nomanta, he bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa lɔ Saayɔn Bwejen doa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ. Juda harɛ bwɛjeɡre tena ɡe sie lɛ, kɛ haa dɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Hé valɛ bar Saayɔn, dɛ́ kure o dejaŋa,

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: hé nyiŋi o danjwɛɛre ne o danjwɛkpeɡa, dɛ́ dɔ waa bol baɡle he naanar baa ka ba,

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Nómɛlbwa no waa nɔ, nɛra haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa,

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: dansaara ne nɛnjena, dɔɔhna ne nyaara bwa.

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bol wejemwaa, á ɡel he liire bini chaah, hɛɛ no waa mun.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ cheɡ deŋnee dɛɛ no wobosɛɡla, dɛ́ kpɔ janjela lɔ dɛɛ baɡle a mun.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Dɛ wenaale balɔ, n dɔma bar mɛ cheme, kwaraa naa, maa ɔmɛ.

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ ba kondɔɔh ta koh a waa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo aa, maa ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa won lɛ o dɔŋ mkpa, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ komɛl charɛ o nyu Korowii be.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini mkpa yoɡ kpeɡri, komɛlbwa toole bá won kpɔ yawɔ,

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: ásɛ o won so le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, waa wola sewɛ.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa nao kɛŋɔ wejerema dɛ sewɛ, ɡɛna ne banɔ la baa wola liire dɔe ɡe ɛɛ sewɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba kondɔɔh tɛ bane.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Ba lalbɔɔne ɛɛ ber ba deenee bá chɔ a bini, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ ba fa dɔ harɛre, baa do belaa saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Waa aa chɔ le dɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ ba ɡbaɡba nɛɛ, ne nɛra baa teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛɛ no waa baa dɛ bol ta laanee.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Baa na waa, dɛ́ serewe kɛ peera, seo tɔ ba sie dɛ́ kaa ba ne lalbɔɔne bini. Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ tiɡri ba nɛɛ, ba pɔh ba lalbɔɔne bini, ba ne ba deremi baah do jaŋne.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ, wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ le kpeɡri seo aa dɔa la nyoa.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn dɔ kondɔɔh kohona naa, bɛ ɡel a we he nɛ, hale dɛ a nao dɛɛ dawɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa naa,

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: o baa sewaa, waa komɛlbwa ne kaala ba, waa won kpɔ a bɛlbwa kaa o be lalbɔɔ bini.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ waa soɡe le la, dɛ o dɛ lii o te nɛn waa na som, nɛra ɛɛ kpɛɛro a wa aa,

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: wɛɛ sewɔɔ ka pu o naawa, waa wola bɔr chaahnaa na kpa.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri kohona yerɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa ba cheme, le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Korowii do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah dɛ le bwɛjen Saayɔn waa wera kohona ta.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ dɛ ba naa, waa sɔeh dɛɛ ba, nijena dɛ́ tɔ o sie, ásɛ peukpeɡ ta baro dɛɛ cheme.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: O ŋɔ nyundua ne harɛ di danseɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra, ásɛ o bol o nɛra wa, dɛ́ pa ba bole.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii waa toɡrɔ, dɛkalkɛ onee bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé no, n nɛra Israel tena, maa he waa bola ba dɛ́ tɛ heya, menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Maa nabala nyin dɛ́ le he naleɡa ta, kɛɛ boohna dɛ́ le he boohna leɡa bini,

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ kpɔɡ bini ola bwa ɛ n kwa, a ne nae aa lɔ deŋɡarere kaɡboŋa ta bwa.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: N jemɛ jumbii aa lɔ bwejena dor wa, asɛ koŋkwaa maa taa bwa ɛ n kwa.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Dɛ lɔr dɛ kpo mɛ naa, maa he bee bol, dɛkalkɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa ɛ n kwa.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: N dɛ chwe nabala ol kɛɛ boohna chalee mɛɛ diɔ?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jam ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii, dɛ́ ka chuɡri he nyobaɡa bwa Nemenɛ Korowii be.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Hé yer mɛ he wenaale tɔpere aa, mɛɛ ba lɛ heyaa, ásɛ he kpɔ duure tɛ mɛ.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ me Mmarare dawɛ he nyoo hɛɛ kura, kɛɛ hɛɛ bol n ne he fɔo la waa nɔɔ?

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: He hah waa maa do heyaa a ta la, dɛ kpɔa ta habɔɔ.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: He na ŋwɛɛ bɛlbwa naa, he kpɔɔ dɛɛ berɛ he dam, he ne nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamanee dɛɛ valɛ.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Wobochɔɡa ɡboo su he nyoo, he do ɡbaŋre nyosone teŋa ta.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: He won soɡa dɛɛ bol he dɔŋa bwara wechɔɡa, dɛɛ chɔɡ he ɡbaɡba nyabii.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwaa hɛɛ ɛ, asɛ n tɔ nyoa, he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ n do kɛ heya. Kɛ n dɛ kah heya, dɛ́ kpɔ waa haa ɛa bwa bil he sie.”
