english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: Hé no, he banɔ la haa soh men Korowii waa la, ɡɛ laa aa, mɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa, nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛ heya.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa kpɔ jam tɛ mɛ naa, dɛ sarahaa o ɛ tɛ mɛ la, onee dɛɛ duu mɛ. O kpɔɔ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ cheɡ, dɛ́ na ɡɛ men Korowii aa won nɛra lɛɛ.

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, koh he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la wa, dɛ́ na n sum. Koh he tedoma kohona la wa, dɛ́ fee n wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Sɔ n wechɔɡa ta, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ nee dɛɛ yaɡle doŋa la, ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa le n nɛ,

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ n jemɔ kɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɔ n sie saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: He ɡbosoroo n ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wola were he sie. Anomanta, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ, he won bol n waa dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ tɛr n deŋne.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: N lola saŋ bwaa n le ɛ wechɔɡa, hale saŋ n nya aa kpoŋe n tea.

english_verse: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ ne waa aa weraa hɛɛ nyin, anomanta, tɛ mɛ he wejema.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Fee n wechɔɡa, ásɛ doŋa bɛlbwa le n nɛ, laa doŋa kpɔ n bini, ásɛ n bambile to kɛ yabi.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Gel n no silɛɛ ne hɛɡra ɡbɔɡa, a lole kɛŋɔ he lɔ mɛ bil, n hoɡa bini ɛɛ wee mɛ, mɛɛ berɔ dɔ silɛɛ ja.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Laa sie kpɔ n wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ fee n wechɔɡa bwa.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel n bambile bini to, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ dadɛɛɡe.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Bɛ men doŋi le he sie, kɛɛ dɛ́ laa he Doma kpɔ n nɛ.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Berɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ he lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ bambidɛɛɡe ń won dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Ásɛ n baɡle wechɔɡ-ɛɛra he Mmarare la, bá charɛ ba liire, dɛ́ berɛ ba he be.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, dɛ n kpo nɛn dɛ di a bolchɔɡe aa, lɛɛ mɛ. Ásɛ n ɡo yela silɛɛ ne, dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ he wa aa toɡra.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, cha mɛ ń won waa bola, ásɛ n won kpɛɛre.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: N kpɔ n bambile waa chɔɡa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛɛ. Bambile waa chɔɡa dɛ won chara laanee hen Korowii ɛɛ nyin.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, sune Saayɔn tena nɛ, dɛ́ cha ba, kwaa ma Jerusalam danjwɛɛ waa kuuɡa la.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Ásɛ mɔɔ he sie lɛ saraha aa wera dɛ toɡre, ne saraha kwaa baa fuah la ta, mɔɔ yá kpoo nabala tɛɛ he saraha kon la ta.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Nomonjen, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ baɡle he te wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta nɔɔ? Korowii nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa, lole saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: He vɔrɔwe nɛra vɔrɔwa dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, he nyondoŋe do kɛŋɔ naŋɡɔse ken, saŋ bɛlbwaa hɛɛ teŋe nyosone.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: He dɛ nyin wechɔɡa dɛ ɡwaa wedɛɛɡa, dɛɛ nyin nyosone dɛ ɡwaa kasinteŋ dii.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Nyosontenŋi bɛl le! He dɛ chɔɡ nɛra he nyoa wobol ne!

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛ́ ba jo he dem tɛre le, dɛ́ lawɛ le harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la ɛɛ nao dɛ́ ɔmɛ, baa dɛɛ mamɛɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Hé na, baa waa wola Korowii kpɔe ɛ o Kpeɡnɛn laanee la. O kpɔ o hwɛɡa bwa do o kondɔɔh ta, o nyu bini do kpeɡri kohona o bala chɔɡa ta.”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Kɛ n te, n do kɛŋɔ ɔleve da, dɛ che Korowii Dea dɛɛ kpeɡ. N dɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɛɛree saŋ bɛlbwa, he waa haa ɛa wa, he sɔn la taa mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ he waa wer, dɛ́ kpɛɛre he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra sie.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Gɛna ɡboo yon ŋɔ, “Korowii toole.” Nɛndɛɛɡe bɛlbwa toole ba bini, wechɔɡa ɡboo ba bwa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Korowii lɔ nyundua, dɛ ba sie ne harɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyina kɛŋɔ bɛl dɔ wejema dɛɛ nyin o Korowii bɔr dɛ́ tomɔ.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa berɛ habɔɔ kpoo, nɛndɛɛɡe bɛlbwa toole ba bini, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Amɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ hweli waa bwaa yaa? Ba dɛ liɡli n nɛra kɛŋɔ baa dɛ di kwaa ken, baa wola wi dɛɛ no men Korowii.”

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Belaa ba do ɔmee su ba bwa, kɛ dɛ a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá fe ɔmɛ. Korowii lɔ nɛra baa yo heyaa la hoɡa peɡre, he ɡelɔ sihiih kpo ba, dɛkalkɛ Korowii vɛɛh ba.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe kɛŋɔ mkpa lɛɛ le Saayɔn, dɛ́ ba o nɛra Israel tena be. Dɛ Korowii berɔ ba lɛ o nɛra Israel tena ja aa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo.

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, che he sɔnjen la ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ, che he kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ pa mɛ bole!

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, no n waa maa dɛ bol!

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Nɛŋhɔɔhra balɔ dɛɛ ba ba yoo mɛ, nyubinikpeɡ tena ba siwi aa kpeɡa, dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo. Banee nɛra baa wola hen Korowii komɛl yerɛ la.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ cha mɛ, henee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Gel n dɔma vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa ɡure ba nyu ta, che he kasinteŋ ta dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ɛ saraha aa le n bambile taa tɛɛ, mɛɛ kpɛɛ he sɔn laanee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he waa wer.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Henee lɛɛ mɛ n wahala bwa ta, dɛ ɡel n na n dɔma chola.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, bɛ sie laa kpɔ waa maa dɛ soŋe nɔ ta,

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: no n be dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ, n liire chɔɡ waa aa dɛ ha mɛ ta,

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: n dɔma aahra baa dɛ aah mɛ, ne fiiɡa baa dɛ fiɡ mɛ nomanta, ba kpɔ wenaale ba ta n nɛ, ba muɡli n baah dɛ hah mɛ.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: N bambile dɛ lɔ, seo ɡelɔ n bwara yɔr n ɔmɛ dɛɛ chel kohona.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Ɔmee ne bochela chole n nɛ, asɛ n bambile teŋe kohona.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɔ kena kɛŋɔ kweah aa, n fe ɛɛ iruu kaa bojaŋ dɛ́ ka onɛ.

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: N fe ɛɛ iruu kaa bojaŋ, dɛ́ ka so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: Dɛ́ ɛ warane ka nyin sobɔr, dɛ́ le peukpeɡ waa dɛ ta dɛɛ nɛ bwaala bini.

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel n dɔma wili, ba bɛ won bol wa! N na wesaɡasaɡare ne yoi bwɛjen la ta,

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: ba bɛɛlɔ dɛɛ bar o danjwɛɛre chɔɔ ne jwaana, dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ne waa aa wola were su o bwa.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɔmee dɛɛ chɛɡre mɛ naa, n fe ɛɛ lɛo do. Dɛ nɛn waa hah mɛ ɡee dɛɛ mam mɛ naa, n fe ɛɛ laa n tenee kpɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen haa ɛ n chamenate la, henee dɛɛ ɛɛ mɛ. N dam n ne haa dɛ valɛ,

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: ya bwa fa pɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa kɛrɛdɛ ken, dɛ kaa tomɛ Korowii o Dea.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel n dɔma piɡri serewe, ɡel ba huɡ ba dɛ ba siwi ta lole, dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡa lɔ ba bambile ne ba deremi.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Kɛ n wio no hen Korowii, asɛ he no dɛ cha mɛ.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Jwaana, chɔɔ ne webaŋa, n suna wii ne n pɛma dɛ tel he be, asɛ hɛɛ no n taa.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ berɔ lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma baa wara, laa maa kaa yoo ba ta, dɛ́ ba n ne sɔnɔnɔɔ ken.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Hen Korowii, henee dɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa, hɛɛ no n wesoŋaa dɛ́ yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ. Dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh ba liire chara, baa hen ɔmɛ.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: O nyoa wobol pwɛre kɛŋɔ noo ken, kɛ dɛ liichɔɡa lɔ o bambile ta, dɛ won mɔna kɛŋɔ kerenyɛɡ ken.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he waa bwa dawɛ Korowii nɛ, wɛɛ che he habɔɔ, waa ɡel nɛra ba wa aa toɡra chole bwa.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Korowii, hɛɛ taɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra, ne nyosonteŋna laanee do ba lalbɔɔne bini, bá serewe mɔɔ ba saŋ tel. Kɛ n te, n kpɔ n te dawɛ hen Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na n sum, n dɔma dɛ ti mɛ sibeɡra ne tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛ́ yoo mɛ.

english_verse: Many of them are pursuing and attacking me,
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛlbwaa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe n bɔr, ba warɔ kohona dɛɛ yoo mɛ.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii, ɔmee laɡ mɛ naa, mɛɛ kpɔ n tenee dawɛ he nɛ.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Hen Korowii nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ, maa ɔmɛ, henee mɛɛ ba kpɛɛra, he nyoa haa baɡ mɛ la wa. Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini waa won sewa ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ mɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: N dɔma nyin waa dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, saŋ bɛlbwaa baa vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa dɛ́ kpo mɛ.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Ba pɛ nyoa ka sɔh, dɛɛ nyiŋi wobɛlbwa maa dɛ ɛ, ba siwi beɡre n kpoe wa.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, tɛr ba deŋne ba wechɔɡa wa, yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ he bandia ne.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: He na ɡɛ n bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ, he ɡbabir jemɛ n suna maa dɛ di. A toole he tɔn bini ɡɛ naa?

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Awola maa wi yerɛ la, n dɔma ɛɛ berɛ habɔɔ, waa maa jema laanee kɛŋɔ hen Korowii ja n nɛ.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: He nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ, maa wola ɔmɛ, bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini waa won sewa ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ mɛ nɔ?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee n baɡɛ nyoa, mɛɛ kpɔ n jam kwaa ba tɛɛ.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: He lɛɛ mɛ le seo ta, he ta ɡelɛ n dɔma pɔ n nɛ. Anomanta, mɛɛ wono dɛɛ valɛ he sie, he nii waa dɛ chaah dɛɛ tɛ nɛra mkpa la bini.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na n sum, dɛkalkɛ henee n chwa baa marɛ dɛ dɔ bosɔɔhna. He lɔɡaa n chwa baa sɔh, kɛŋɔ jal yon lawɛ o bii do o kena lɔɡre, ka tel saŋ harɛ chɔɡa aa baa kaa.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ no n wesoŋaa le nyundua dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ, dɛ́ pɔ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ mɛ nɛ. Hen Korowii ɛɛ baɡle he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne he kasinteŋ haa dɔa laanee n nɛ.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: N dɔma bar mɛ cheme, ba do kɛŋɔ nyujentena lɔr aa dɛ kpoa, aa nyin nɛra ola dɛ́ di ken. Ba nyena do kɛŋɔ lampeare ne hɛma, ba nyondoŋa nyɛɡre kɛ keri ken.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel ya na he kan haa doa nyundua, ásɛ he jirima tɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: N dɔma haɡre bela, dɛ́ laɡ mɛ, suna ɡboo mɛɛ di. Ba kwi nafuɡe n ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ fee laɡ mɛ, kɛ ba ɡbaɡba berɔ le o bini.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kohona, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ iruu che, dɛ́ kpɔ janjela ne kwaa bwa soo siwi lɔ yela! Mɛɛ feluu ir mɔɔ bɔr chaah.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ jaame harɛre nɛra bwa binii, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre nɛnlaa baahnee.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe kan dɛɛ tel nyundua, he wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ ɡe ɛɛ tel bela.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel ya na he kan haa doa nyundua, ásɛ he jirima tɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Hé koranar, hé bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta naa? Hé bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole ɡɛ aa chɛ aa?

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa ba soɡa bini bwa, dɛ le awola baa lol ba, dɛɛ teŋe nyosone.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Ba nyoa wobol do kɛ tɛɡchɔɡa, kɛŋɔ harɛkonchɔɡe aa choɡe nɛn dɛ tɔɔɡe o deŋna ken.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, fome n dɔma nyena aa do kɛŋɔ nyujentena nyenkpaahna.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Gel ba hol kɛŋɔ ketere dɛ́ serewe, kɛɛ bie baa haro ta, waa wola wee nae mɔɔ la.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ba jemɛ la, dɛ ba teŋ ba ta kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken, hen Korowii ɛɛ perewi baa ta he bandia kohona la ne, ɡɛ saŋ ba taa soɡe le la.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɔ deŋnetɛra, baa valɛ ba chal taa.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Belaa nɛra ɛɛ ba ŋɔe ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɔ ba kembɔr, Korowii lole kpela, dɛ bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole, harɛ nɔ ta.”

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔn ta, banɔ la baa dɛ kpoo nɛra la.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ baa kaa sɔh dɛɛ kpaah mɛ! Nɛnchɔɡa dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa, kɛ dɛ n ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ.

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: N ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, kɛ ba ɡe ɡarɛ dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ yoo mɛ. N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ cha mɛ n waa nɔ ta.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Korowii waa ɛ Koronar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ ba tɛr nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ la deŋne, bɛ dɔma baa ɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena la nɛɛ sune.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Ba yon berɛ ba jɔmɔra, dɛ nyee nyena kɛŋɔ nyootena ken, dɛɛ bɛɛ bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahna.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: No chɛɡa ne waa aa dɛ le ba nyoo, ba nyondoŋa do kɛ keri ken, kɛ dɛ ɡee lii kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa ba be no.

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen n Naa Korowii te, he dɛ mam ba, he dɛ di nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ la loro.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii haa ɛ n Kpeɡnɛn, he do kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ n chwa baa marɛ.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he dɛ nyin n wa, hɛɛ ba n bee dɛ́ ɡel n na n dɔma chola.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, bɛ ban kpoo, ɡɛ laa aa, n nɛra ɛɛ ba sooh. Che he kpeɡri ta dɛ́ lɔ ba peɡre, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ sɔɔh ba nyoa.

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: dɛ́ chɔɡ ba he bandia ne, ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bwa aa tona. Ásɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ hen Korowii, he dɛ di kora Israel tena nɛ.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Ba yon berɛ ba jɔmɔra, dɛ nyee nyena kɛŋɔ nyootena ken, dɛɛ bɛɛ bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahna.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin kondikwa, ba ta vaɡrɛ aa, ba yon dɛɛ ŋoo kɛŋɔ nyootena ken.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre he kpeɡri la wa, ásɛ chɔɔ bɛlbwa ɡe n ɡo yela kpɛɛre he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la wa, dɛkalkɛ he do kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ, waa puu mɛ naa, ń chwa baa marɛ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii haa ɛ n Kpeɡnɛn, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre, he do kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ n chwa baa marɛ, N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ nyin n wa.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he baah fa di ya nɛɛ dɛ vɛh yaa, he baah di ya nɛɛ te, kɛ berɛ lawɛ yaa ba he be taraken.

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ harɛ jiɡri, o bini pere. Berɛ kwaa tɔɔɡe bɔɔne la, dɛkalkɛ a dɛ paɡri.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ he nɛra na wahala kohona, ya valɛ dɛɛ yɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ yaa nyɔ sen dɛ dɛɛ ken.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: He ir he fraŋkaa dɛ́ kpɔ kah nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba dɔma bɛ ban kpoo.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Lɛ yaa he kpeɡri ne, dɛ́ no ya wesoŋa, ɡɛ aa ɛ he lɛ nɛra haa dɛ nyin ba la.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa o Dea bela waa do ɡoroŋ la dɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ yo bwɛjen Sɛkem tenaa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ bɔne o ne Sukot Fɛlembɔjen bini tɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Gelead harɛ ne Manasɛ dea harɛ bwa ɛ n kwa. Efrem harɛ do kɛŋɔ n laa ɡbɛrɛ, asɛ Juda harɛ ɡe do kɛŋɔ n koodaŋɡbala.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab harɛ nɛra ɛ n bonɔɔna, ba do kɛ loɡ maa dɛ loo kwaa o bini ken, mɛɛ kpɔ n naŋɡawaa ta Edom harɛ ta. N dɛ moo, dɛkalkɛ n pɔ Filisti tena nɛ.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, umee dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ jo bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro nɔ ta nɔ? Umee dɛ́ tɔ n sie kaa Edom ɔ?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Cha yaa yá won pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, nɛwɛnyini chae ɡɛ bɛlbwa naa, a bwa dɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Korowii ja ya nɛ aa, yaa yoo, dɛ́ pɔ ya dɔma nɛ. Wɛɛ tiɡri ya dɔmaa do harɛ.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no n wii, no n wesoŋa!

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: N lɔ bojaŋ harɛ jaɡa, dɛ di suna wi dɛɛ noe! Laɡ mɛ kaa bela maa ka dɔ n nyu,

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ henee kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ n nɛ, dɛ do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ n dɔma sie.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Gel n so he Dea bela saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, laɡ mɛ sɔh he lɔɡa, kɛŋɔ jal yon lawɛ o bii do o kena lɔɡre la.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he no nyoa maa baɡɛ la, dɛ tɛ mɛ kwaa haa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel ó so he sie di kora dɛɛ la, dɛ́ kpɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne he kasinteŋ haa dɔa tɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Anee dɛ́ ɡel n ɡo yela kpɛɛ he sɔn saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛɛ chuɡri n nyobaɡa tɔpere bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: N soɡo jeih ken, dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii siwi ta kɛ ó ba lɛɛ mɛ, o ɡbo nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: O ɡboo do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, n chwa kaa marɔ wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ, onee cheɡɛ n habɔɔ, maa chole bwa.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Saŋ besoo hé bwa ɛɛ ba nɛn waa wola kpeɡe kɛ danjwɛɛ waa kɔɔhna dɛ́ chole nɔ yoi ɡela ɔ?

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: He dɛ nyin kɛ he lɔɔ harɛ le bodɛɛɡe waa soɡa, he sie dɛ lɛ nyosone teŋa ta. Wobosoma dɛ le he nyoo, kɛ he bambile ta te, taahna ɡbosoo.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡbosoo nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ, o nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: O ɡboo do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, n chwa kaa marɔ wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ, onee cheɡɛ n habɔɔ, maa chole bwa.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ dɛɛ tɛ mɛ jirima, onee do kɛ Bwetal maa chwaa kaa marɔ.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé kpɔ he hwɛɡa do Korowii nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ kpɔ he wehiah bwa bil o sie, dɛkalkɛ onee ya chwa kaa marɛ wɛɛ lɛ yaa.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyina bwa do kɛŋɔ nyoa peu ken, nyaara ne kondɔɔhna bwa kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ ba kpɔ ba dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa ta naa, ba fɛɡre dɛ ɡwaa nyoa peu ɡba.

english_verse: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
translation_verse: N noɔ Korowii aa bola keraŋwɛnɛ bwa kɛŋɔ onee dɔ kpeɡri,

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ɡe do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Kasinteŋ, o dɛ bɔ nɛra kem ɡɛ ba we-ɛɛla aa doa.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, n pɛla dɔe sibeɡra ne, n bambile lawɛ kɛ nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo nɛn, wɛɛ nyin nee dɛ nyɔ, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, bela nee aa wola toole.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: N na ɡɛ he kpeɡri ne he jirima aa doa, he Dea bela.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la toole naa, nɛn toole wobɛlbwa bini, anomanta, mɛɛ kpɛɛree.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɛɛree n soɡa bini bwa, mɛɛ ɡɔɔ n nɔɔraa nyundua, dɛ́ kpɔ n wesoŋa bil he sie.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: N sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛ maa di silɛɛ kondikonjena dɛ vaɡɛ ken, dɛ́ ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ he sɔn.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: N chɔ kalaŋ ta naa, n dɛ lii he wa, he waa dɛ do n bambile bini jwaana bwa,

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee dɛɛ cha mɛ, he lɔɡaa n chwa baa sɔh, kɛŋɔ jal yon lawɛ o bii do lɔɡa la, mɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yela.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lawɛɛ kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ he tɔ n nɛɛ he kpeɡri ne.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ nyin n kpoe, ɛɛ serewoo kaa lalabwɛ.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Baa kpo ba laa taa, ásɛ kalampoŋare di ba ola.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Korowii aa ɡela kooro pɔ o dɔma nɛɛ nomanta, o sie ɛɛ lɛo. Nɛra baa dɛ yerɛ Korowii sɔn bwa ɛɛ kpɛɛroo, kɛ nyosonteŋna te, wɛɛ tɔ ba nyoo.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena vɔrɔwa nyoa, lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa wara nɔn ta.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Ba nyoa wobol nyɛɡre kɛŋɔ, kere, dɛɛ yaɡɛ kɛŋɔ kpaah yon ta hɛmchɔɡe la ken.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Ba dɛ do dɔŋa ɡbemba ba wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa ta, dɛɛ baɡle bela baa kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔ haɡre bela la sɔh. Ba yon ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa aa yaa na.”

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Ba dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Waa yaa vɔrɔwa nɔ maɡrɔ kɛrɛdɛ!” Kasinteŋ, nɛwɛnyini tea bini aa jemɛ.

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, ba ne jara dɛ ba choɡlo chɔ, kɛŋɔ baa ta hɛma yaɡ ba ken.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo ba vɔrɔwa la bwa ɡure ba nyu ta, ásɛ nɛra na ba dɛɛ viiɡi ba nyuune, dɛɛ mam ba.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ, dɛ́ na waa Korowii aa ɛa, dɛ́ kpɔ do ba liire bini.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa ɛɛ hɛɡroo, dɛ́ chwa ka marɔ, ásɛ nɛra ba bambile bini aa toa kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ duure tɛɛ bwɛjen Saayɔn, dɛ́ chuɡri ya nyobaɡa yaa baɡɛ la,

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ henee dɛɛ no ya wesoŋa. Nɛra ɛɛ le bobɛlbwaa ba he be dɛ́ ba tomɛ,

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: ba wechɔɡa aa ɡwaa ba nɛɛ la wa, ásɛ he kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa lee ba ŋɔ bá ba so he Dea bela la, ba na som. Ya sie ɛɛ lɛ kondɛɛɡa haa swee yaa a do he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la taa.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii haa dɛ lɛ yaa, he cheɡɛ he nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta, dɛ no ya wesoŋa. He nɛɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa, ne banɔ la baa lɔ mpo jaɡa bwa ɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: He kpeɡri taa he che dɛ ta bwejena dɛ chaɡle kpeɡri kohona haa dɔa.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ mpo nehɛma sii nyoa hel, asɛ harɛre nɛra nyoa sɔɔh, moola baa dɛ moo ta.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Bambiteŋa kohona chole harɛre nɛra nɛ, he wejena haa ɛa la wa. He we-ɛɛla ba silɛɛ ne ba tɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ bwa ta, baa moo.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: He dɛ dawɛ ya wa, dɛ ɡel bwaala ɛɛ nɛ harɛ nɔ ta, o do wer dɛɛ ɛ konduula kohona. He ɡelɔ nenabɔɔne bwa suuɡi, nɛra dɔ kondikwaa dɛɛ di. Gɛ haa ɛa laanee teŋa nɔ,

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: he nɛ bwaala tɔɡa kooni baa para ta, asɛ harɛ bwa sɔɔh kohona. He ɡelɔ o nɛ kompar ta, harɛ pwɛr a won le dɛ kpeɡ.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: He wer haa doa nomanta, he ɡelɔ kondikwaa ba kohona, dɛ bu harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Peera lɔ kpɔɡ bini bobɛlbwa, dɛɛ di, fɛlembɔjena bwa su mea, aa ɡo yela dɛɛ moo silɛɛ ne kɛ nɛra ken.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ o sɔn waa dɔ jirima la, hé duuru dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛo.

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Hé ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “He we-ɛɛla dɔ nyokpoa, he kpeɡri haa dɔa ɡe do kan kohona a ɡel he dɔma kpɔ ɔmee baa ɡuŋi he sie.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra bwa dɛ tomɛ, dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre, ba ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ he sɔn.”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Hé ba, dɛ́ ba na waa Korowii aa ɛa, nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa koh nɛwɛnyina waa dɛ ɛ.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Onee ɡela mpo hweeh, harɛpɛɛ hol chɔ, ya naawa valɛ kpɔ o ta le. Belaa ya sie lɛ, waa Korowii aa ɛa wa.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa. O sie lɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛ, deŋnekpeɡ tena bɛ habɔɔ berɛ kpoo.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, hé ɡel baa no kpɛɛra haa dɛ kpɛɛro la bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: O nyiŋi ya nɛɛ ya ta so le, o ta ɡelɛ ya lɔ naa dɛ chole.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ ya le bel haa harɛ yaa ta, dɛ kpɔ bontɔɡa dawɛ ya nɛ.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ ya dɔma pɔ ya nɛ, ya na wahala kɛŋɔ nii ne nee aa chɔɡ nɛra kwaa ken, kɛ taraken, he berɔ kpɔ yaa ba harɛ o taa soma ta.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ba tɛɛ he Dea, dɛ́ chuɡri n nyobaɡa maa baɡɛ la.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Hé ba, dɛ́ ba no, he nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, ásɛ n baɡle waa waa ɛa tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: N wio noo ŋɔ ó cha mɛ, asɛ dɛ ɡo kpɛɛra yela tɛo.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Dɛ n vɛh n wechɔɡa bola aa, Korowii fe ta n be noɛ.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, Korowii no n wesoŋa, o no n wii maa wia noo la.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɔ jam, dɛkalkɛ o ta n wesoŋa vɛɛh, kɛɛ dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ne.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na ya sum dɛ swee yaa andɛɛɡa, nyiŋi ya nɛɛ dɛ́ na ya sum,

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa jemɛ waa haa dɛ nyin, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba bwa na ɡɛ haa won nɛra lɛɛ.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa kpɛɛre, kasinteŋ, a chɛ kɛ bá bwa kpɛɛre.

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Gel harɛre nɛra bwa ɡo silɛɛ yela, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa kpɛɛre, kasinteŋ, a chɛ kɛ bá bwa kpɛɛre.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Kondikwa ɛɛ wonoo ɛ ya harɛ nɔ ta kohona, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ swee yaa andɛɛɡaa.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ swee yaa andɛɛɡaa, ásɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa ɛɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne ásɛ dɛ lɔ he dɔma peɡre, he dɔma ɛɛ chwao le he sie.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Gɛ peu yon ta dɛ́ kpɔ ninchuu kaa la, ɡɛɛ he kpɔ ba kaa ta. Gɛ ba yon kpɔ nii dɛɛ mwɛɛ tohkel la, ɡel nɛnchɔɡa sewɛ he sie ɡɛ.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra sie lɛo, baa hɛɡre hen Korowii sie, ba sie lɛo baa moo.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn, hé kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛo, o le baama bini dɛɛ ba. O sɔne Korowii, hɛɛ hɛɡre o sie.

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: O ɛ bilalbii mɛɛ, dɛɛ che luhaahna habɔɔ. Onee Korowii waa soɡe o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ bini.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Korowiirii tɛ nɛra baa nya nɛra bɔr, ba yon so, dɛ le nɛra baa do ba dea, dɛ ɡel ba sie lɛ baa di ba nyu. Bambikpeɡ tena te, harɛ waa chɔɡa taa baa ba soɡa.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, haa tɔ he nɛra sie, dɛ valɛ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la,

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: harɛ jiɡro asɛ bwaala nɛ he sie. Henee Sinai Bwejen Dɔɔ, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ bwaala nɛ kohona, dɛ sɔɔh harɛ haa kpɔa baɡɛ yaa nyoa la ta.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ he nɛra so o ta, asɛ he tesom kohona nomanta, he kpɔ tɛ nyaara.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Korowii bol wa, ásɛ haahna warɛ kohona dɛ́ kaa bola ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: “Koranar ne ba laa tena chwao le dɛɛ kaa!” Haahna baa ka dem la kpɔ laala baa kpɔa laa ta la bɔne dɔŋa.

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kaa dɛ do bela dɛɛ daah peera la, dɔ suuɡapoŋa baa kpɔa dawɛ kwehre kena ta. Suuɡaswɛm dawɛ a kena nyoo dɛɛ nyɛɡle.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ aa lɔ koranar peɡre harɛ la ta la, a do kɛŋɔ dombwea aa lee Salmɔn Bwejen ta ken.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Bwejena aa lɔ Basan harɛ jaŋne kaa nyundua kɛrɛdɛ, bwea paaɡe a dor kɛŋɔ deŋɡarere ken.

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Korowii dɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, baa wola won kura, dɛ le Sinai Bwejen ta, dɛɛ ba o Dea la ta.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: O teehnɔ kaa nyundua, dɛ lawɛ nɛra waa laɡ ba laa ta kaa, asɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena kpɔ koŋkɛɛla baa tɛo dɛ ŋɔ, Korowii ɛɛ ba so belaa.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Ya kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, onee ya Lɛɛ la. Tɔpere bwaa wɛɛ nyiŋi ya nɛ, ya waa bwa dawɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛɛ paɡre o dɔma nyuunee, banɔ la ba taa lɔ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta la.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ le he dɔma ne Basan harɛɛ ba, mɛɛ le ba ne mpo vile binii,

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: ásɛ he valɛ kpɔ ba chal ta, he nyootena ɡe kpɛla ɡɛ aa dɛ nyin.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nɛra bwa nae he valɛ baa kaa, Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ o ɛ n kooro la baa jo o Dea bini.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Yelɡoola tɔ sie, nɛra baa dɛ lɔ yela teŋɛ, asɛ bitoli baa dɛ yiiɡi loŋa do ba baah ta.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii bela o nɛra aa wara dɛ cheme. Israel tena bwa, hé cheme dɛ́ kpɛɛro.

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen dea nɛra baa wola kanɛ la tɔ sie, Juda dea nomonome teŋɛ, ásɛ Sebulon ne Naftale deene nomonome ɡe teŋɛ.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: Ya Naa Korowii, chaɡle he kpeɡri, kpeɡri he fa aa chaɡle ya nɛɛ la.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: He Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam nomanta, koranar ɛɛ kpɔ koŋkɛɛlaa ba tɛɛ.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Tɛr Ijipt nɛra baa do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ola, aa chɔ nee nyoa la deŋne. Tɛr harɛre nɛra baa do kɛŋɔ nabala, dɛ koo nabii bini la deŋne, ka tel saŋ baa ba ɡuŋi harɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ ba suuɡapoŋa ba tɛɛ. Lɔ harɛre nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ laa yoi ta la bwa peɡre.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Nomonome ɛɛ che Ijipt tena naa taa ba, ásɛ Itiopia tena ɡe kpɔ ba te ba do Korowii lɔɡa.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro,

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: onee soɡe nyundujaɡla, dɛ do le saŋ la bwa. Hé cheɡ deŋne no kɔɡra waa dɛ kɔɡre kohona.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Hé bol o kpeɡri waa dɔa wa, o nyanyini bɔle Israel tena nɛ, o kpeɡri do nyundua ɡe.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Korowii le o Dea dɛɛ ba naa, ɔmee kohona dɛ chole nɛra nɛ. Onee Israel tena ɛɛ tomɛ, wɛɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri. Hé kpɛɛro!

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: A do kɛŋɔ maa dɛ morɛ vil kpechɛɡre aa lɔ o bini, n ta bodɛɛɡe dɔe ń kpɔ n naa cheɡ. A do kɛŋɔ maa le vil bini nehɛma ɛɛ ba lɔe ba tɔ n nɛ.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: N wio noe ŋɔ hé ba cha mɛ, dɛ ba koh, n lobi bwa holɔ. N nyiŋi he siwi ta, he ba cha mɛ kahonɛ.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Nɛra baa hah mɛ pɛɛ warɔ ɡwaa n nyumpona. N dɔma teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛ, ba bwara kpeɡri baa nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, ba ɡelɔ n berɛ bɔ kwaa maa wola ŋwɛɛ kem tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n wechɔɡa bwa chɔ he sie, he jemɛ n ɡɛnewaa bwa.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: He waa ba koh dɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ, asɛ sihiih kpo mɛ.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: N berɛ hɔɔh n lolanar be, dɛ do kɛ nomɛl waa le harɛfale bɛl ta, n ɡbaɡba nɛra bini.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: He Dea la waa swɛɛ n siwi taeh, chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡre bwa ɡe dawɛ n nɛ.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: N vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ di suna, asɛ nɛra ɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: N tɔ lweyal asɛ baa mam mɛ.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ bol n waa fɔɡbaahna, sennyɔdɛɛra kpɔ mɛ dɛɛ ɡo yela.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Kɛ N Naa Korowii, henee n wi dɛɛ no, le saŋ haa dɛ nyin cheɡ dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ. Chaŋ mɛ he nyina waa kana la wa, he nyoa haa baɡ mɛ nomanta, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale aa do kɛ maa dɛ morɛ vil kpechɛɡre aa lɔ o bini ta. Lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ne vile ta.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel nee la su ba kpɔ mɛ, bɛ ɡel ń ka chɔ vile bini, kɛɛ seo ba kpo mɛ.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ta, dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ. Berɛ sie n be, dɛ́ sune n nɛɛ kohona.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Bɛ he sie laa kpɔ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛ, n lɔ wenaale kohona bini, ba dɛ́ ba cha mɛ warane!

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Ba n be dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: He ɡbabir na ɡɛ baa dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, ɡɛ sihiih aa dɛ kpo mɛ, baa wola men komɛlbwa yerɛ, he dɛ na n dɔma bwa.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Chɛɡa ɡelɔ n bambile chɔɡ, dɛ ɡel n liire bwa damɛ. N dɛ nyin nomɛl ó fee ba larawe n bwara, n ta nɛn nae, kɛɛ nomɛl ba do mɛ ɡbemba, kɛ nɛn toole.

english_verse: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.
translation_verse: Gel ba nyoŋe, ásɛ dɛɛ na wahala saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Gel he bandia kohona la ba ba nɛ, kpɔ he bandia waa do ɔma kohona ta ba nɛ.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Gel ba sobɔr chɔ pɛɛ, nomɛlbwa bɛ ba tɛnte deene bini do,

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ ba dɛ ɛ nɛra haa tɛr ba deŋne la hɔhɔrɔwa, dɛɛ bol nɛra haa do ba bola, ba bonyɛɡa baa dɛ na la wa.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Gel ba fee ba sɔna le Mkpa Tɔn la bini, bɛ ba sɔna kpɔ ja he nɛra nɛ.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n bwara dɛ nyɛɡ, n hwɛɡa tonɛ, laɡ mɛ ir dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn, dɛ́ kpɔ jam tɛo o kan waa doa wa.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Anee dɛ su o siwi dɛ́ ɡwaa, kɛ baa kpɔ nabal baa sao ɛ saraha tɛo, a ɡwaa kɛ baa kpo nabal waa kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ tɛo.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la na ɡɛ naa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo, ásɛ banɔ la baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii dɔ ɡbemba.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ no nɛŋɡwɛɡra wii, waa nɛra baa laɡ ba do dea waa soh.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Korowii kontaala aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ kwaa bwa kpɛɛ Korowii, mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ o bini bwa ɡe kpɛɛro.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ lɛ Jerusalam tenaa, dɛ́ berɛ kwaa ma Juda harɛ bwɛjena, ásɛ o nɛra berɛ ka kpɔ harɛ la, dɛ́ so o ta.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: O bonɔɔna naanaree dɛ́ ka so o ta, nɛra baa dɛ nyin o waa laanee dɛ́ ka so bela.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, lɛɛ mɛ. Ba warane, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo la, bá wili. Nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ n wenaale ta la, ber ba kaa, dɛ́ ɡel sihiih kpo ba.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Gel banɔ la baa dɛ mam mɛ la bambile chɔɡ, he pɔe haa pɔ ba nɛɛ la wa.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa laŋa kaa tomɛ la, ɡel ba dɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ hɛɡre. Gel nɛra haa lɛɛ ba ba dɔ mkpa la ɛɛ ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n nyao dɛ ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre, ba n be warane. Henee n Lɛɛ, n poori, ba warane dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, lɛɛ mɛ. Ba warane, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo la, bá wili. Nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ n wenaale ta la, ber ba kaa, dɛ́ ɡel sihiih kpo ba.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Gel banɔ la baa dɛ mam mɛ la bambile chɔɡ, he pɔe haa pɔ ba nɛɛ la wa.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa laŋa kaa tomɛ la, ɡel ba dɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ hɛɡre. Gel nɛra haa lɛɛ ba ba dɔ mkpa la ɛɛ ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n nyao dɛ ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre, ba n be warane. Henee n Lɛɛ, n poori, ba warane dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee n chwa baa marɛ, bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Che toɡra he wa aa toɡra ta, dɛ́ cheɡ deŋne no n be, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: He do kɛŋɔ Bwetal maa chwaa baa marɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, che he waa haa bola la ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ. Henee n Bwetal, ne n danjwɛkpeɡ.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, lɛɛ mɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena, ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔn ta.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ Nemenɛ Korowii, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, n kpɔ n te dawɛ he nɛ, dɛ le n bechale saŋ bwa.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: N soɡa bini bwaa n le, dɛ kpɔ n te dawɛ he nɛ, baa lol mɛ bwaa he le, dɛ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ. Mɛɛ kpɛɛree saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Nɛra ɡalɡa hweli n we-ɛɛla, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa, dɛkalkɛ henee cheɡɛ n habɔɔ.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Tɔpebir bwaa mɛɛ kpɛɛre, dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ he jirima aa doa.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Bɛ men ta n hwɛɛhra bini, bɛ men vɛh n ɡwɛɡra saŋ.

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: N dɔma dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, ba dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Korowii vɛoh, hé ɡel ya tiu dɛ́ lawɔ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ lɛo.”

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛ, nɛra baa dɛ nyin n ne wechɔɡa la, ɡel ba di ncho kohona.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Kɛ n te, mɛɛ kpɔ n hwɛɡaa do he nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, maa he kpɛɛraa ɡel bwa.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bol he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa, dɛ́ bol lɛɛ haa dɛ lɛ nɛra tɔpebir bwa wa, a lole kɛ a ɡwaa n liire ta kɛ ń won jemɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii, mɛɛ bol he wejena haa ɛa waa, mɛɛ bol toɡra he wa aa toɡra waa, he ɡbosoo waa toɡra.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: N bechale saŋ bwaa he le baɡ mɛ he nyokpowe-ɛɛla wa, n ta ɛɛ bola dɛ ba le fini.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Hale n hwɛɛhrɔ n nyumpona to kwaraa naa, N Naa Korowii, bɛ men ta. Ja n nɛ, ásɛ n bol he kpeɡri ne he kan haa doa waa baɡle n naanar baa ka ba bwa.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, toɡra he wa aa toɡra kan kohona, he we-ɛɛla ɡe kan kohona. He habɔɔ, nomɛlbwa toole.

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ he ɡelɔ n na wahala kohona te, kɛ hɛɛ berɔ ɡel n dɔ bokpeɡa ja, hɛɛ laɡ mɛɛ le seo nyoa, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ mkpa.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ ɡeloo ń ɛ nɛnjen kohona, dɛ́ berɛ kwaa larawe n bwara ja.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɔ janjelaa kpɛɛre, N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, mɛɛ kpɛɛree he kasinteŋ haa dɔa la wa. Mɛɛ kpɔ n janjelaa lɔ yela kpɛɛ hen Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ nee, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre, he lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bol he toɡra haa toɡra waa tɔpebir bwaa, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ba fe aa dɛ nyin n ne wechɔɡa la, sihiih kpo ba, ba wili.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, baɡle kooro ɡɛ waa bol wa, dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, ɡɛ he wa aa toɡra. Baɡlo o do ɡɛ haa doa la,

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ bol he nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ nyiŋi he nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Gel kondikwaa ba ya harɛ ta kohona, toɡra he nɛra wa aa toɡra la wa.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Gel kooro bol nyaara waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ cha ba bii, dɛ́ pɔ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la nɛ.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Gel kooro do kɛŋɔ bwaala waa ɡela koo kwa ɛɛ do wer, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ bwaala nee aa ɡela harɛ sɔɔh, dɛɛ do wer la ken.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel waa aa wera dɛ toɡre la do harɛ nɔ ta, o kora dii ta saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ka tel kɛŋɔ, korobie aa ɡel chaahna.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ di koraa le mpo bɛl ta ba kaa bɛl ta, dɛ le Yufretis Moo ta ba kaa harɛ jaɡa.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi o siee, ásɛ o dɔma chole chɔ bomboɡ ta.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Taases harɛ koranar, ne nɛra baa soɡe mpo nyoa bojaŋa ɛɛ kpɔ ba harɛre kwaa ba tɛo. Seeba ne Seba koranar ɡee kpɔ koŋkɛɛlaa ba tɛo.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Koranar bwa ɛɛ ba ɡuŋuu, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa tomɔ.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Kooro la ɛɛ lɛ nyaara baa wia dɛɛ noo, ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra baa wola nɛra dɔe bá cha ba laanee.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ na nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra sumii, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ lɛɛ ba le fiiɡa ne nɛnchɔɡa nɔn taa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba mkpa dɔe waa hiaoh.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ! Gel nɛra le Seeba harɛ ta dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ba tɛo. Gel nɛra sweero andɛɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ soŋe dɛɛ tɛo tɔpere bɛlbwa ɡe.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Gel boyu perɛ harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ mea ɡe bu deŋɡarere bwa dor. Gel a ɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ anɔ la aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ bwejena dor, ásɛ nɛra ɡe su bwɛjena la ta, kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa lɔ koo ta ken.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Gel kooro sɔn do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ, wee aa lole dɛɛ lɔ saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ. Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ che o nɛɛ dɔ andɛɛɡa ásɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ Korowii sweero andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ! O ɡboo dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ o sɔn waa dɔ jirima saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Hé ɡel o jirima su harɛ nɔ ta bwa. Aamen.

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Jese bibaa Kooro Devid wesoŋa la jaɡaa nɔ.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: ) Korowii kasinteŋ waa dɔa Asaf yel

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, Korowii waa wer tɛ o nɛra Israel tena, banɔ la ba tea bini aa toa dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa ta la.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ n na ɡɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena, ne mbarafo tena wa aa wera dɛɛ tɛɛ ba la aa, dɛ n dɛ wee ba bwara.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Baa bonyɛɡa bɛlbwa na, ba bwara kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba kpɔ mbarafo do baŋa kɛŋɔ baŋa kwa, asɛ naɡrenyin ber ba yal ba kpɔ tɔ.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡa su ba bambili, nyubinikpeɡ vɔrɔwa ɡbo waa swɛɛ ba siwi baa lii.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ mamɛ ba bala, dɛɛ bol ba bwara wechɔɡa, ba dɔ mbarafo, dɛɛ vɔrɔwe ɡɛ baa fiiɡi ba bala.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii nɛra berɔ baa teŋɛ ba nɛ, dɛɛ yarada waa baa dɛ ɛ la bambile bwa ne kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba wona jemɛ ɔ? Nemenɛ Korowii ta a wejema dɔe.”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena waa do, wobɛlbwa aa ban ha, ba dɔ kondɔɔh saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ ja.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Amɔ pɛɛpɛɛ n ɡel n bambile bini to, n ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ nɔ naa?

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ n bwara nyɛɡ mɛ tɔpebir bwa, chɔɔ bɛlbwaa hɛɛ tɛr n deŋne.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Dɛ n bol ɡɛ waa la bɛlbwa naa, n fe le he nɛra la tɛ.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: N fe takapɔ kɛŋɔ n no ɡɛ waa nɔ mun, kɛ a kpeɡri tɛ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: nemenɛ maa jo hen Korowii Dea mɔɔ, dɛ jemɛ waa aa pu nyubinikpeɡ tena la.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, hɛɛ ɡeloo ba lɔ na, dɛ́ choɡli baa wola won ir kpa.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Ba chɔɡɔ buɡ la ta, dɛ sewɛ seo wɔb.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: N bambile aa chɔɡa, n loo ku la,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: dɛ n ɡɛnɔ kɛŋɔ ol ken, n ta he waa mun noɛ.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ saŋ bɛlbwa n ja he nɛ, he lawɛ n nɔn kpoŋe.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: He dɛ baɡ mɛ asɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa la ta. A habɔɔ la, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ ń dɔ jirima.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ɡboo lɔ nyundua dɛ́ won cha mɛ. He habɔɔ, maa komɛlbwa nyin harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: N bwadabii ɡwɛɡrɔ n liire chɔɡ aa, hen Korowiirii dɛ́ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa, henee n komɛlbwa.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa berɛ habɔɔ kpoe la bwa ɛɛ serewoo, ɡɛɛ nɛra baa wola he waa ta teŋɛ la, hɛɛ ba ɡela ba ɡe serewe.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Kɛ n te, a wer kɛŋɔ ń bɛne hen Korowii. Hen Nemenɛ Korowiirii n chwa baa marɛ, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ, mɛɛ bol he nyokpowaa haa ɛa bwaa baɡle nɛra.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he den vɛh yaa kwaraa ɡɛ nɔɔ? Saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin he baah di he ɡbabir nɛra nɛɛ ka tel ɔ?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Lii he nɛra saŋ la haa lee ba cheɡ tɛ he te la wa, nɛra haa lɛɛ ba le fiiɡa baa dɛ fiɡ ba ta. Lii Saayɔn Bwejen he fa aa soɡe o ta la wa.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ́ ba na he Dea ya dɔma aa kuuɡu, o chɔɡ dɛ berɛ dimɡbia la.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: He dɔma moolo dɛɛ hɛɡre he Dea la bini, ba kpɔ ba fraŋkaare pa, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba pɔ ya nɛ.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa kpɔ kpanfɛre dɛɛ teŋni daa ken.

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ ba kpanfɛre ne ba saahne chɔɡ kwaa baa kpɔ daa sɛah la bwa.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Ba fuh he Dea la, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah bela baa dɛ tomɛ la.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Ba bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Yaa chɔɡ baa kwaraa!” Ba fuh dea bɛlbwa baa dɛ tomɛ hen Korowii o ta harɛ la ta.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Korowii keamere toole kpa, ásɛ ya na he nyokpowe-ɛɛla. Nomɛlbwa ɡe aa jemɛ saŋ ya wenaale aa ba a jaɡa.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo ya dɔma mamɛ ka tel ɔ? Bá na dɛ́ bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ he sɔn saŋ bɛlbwa ɡɛ kɛɛ?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee Kooro le saŋ la bwa, henee bala dɛ́ ba lɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: He cheɡɛ he kpeɡri kohona ta, dɛ ɡel mpo pere, dɛ paɡre mpo bini oljena nyuune.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Henee paɡre mpo bini oljen baa dɛ yerɔ Lɛvayatan la nyuune, dɛ kpɔ tɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta olchɔɡa a di.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ buli ne nenabɔɔne ɛɛ palɛ, dɛ ɡel mojena hweeh.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Henee ta bɔchaah ne biro, dɛ kpɔ wee ne korobie cheɡ a chebɔra,

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: henee bil harɛ jwɛhre, dɛ ta bwaala ne lɔmɔɡa saŋ.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ he dɔma aa dɛ mamɛ, na ɡɛ nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ aa dɛ ɛɛ nɛnhɛla.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Bɛ he nɛra baa ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra, ɡel tɛ ba dɔma ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa kohona nɔ. Bɛ he nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la waa soh.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Lii fɔo ya ne haa fɔwa la wa. Nɛra sɔɔh dɛɛ ɛ naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla biro bini, harɛ nɔ ta bwa.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la, ɡel nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra kpɛɛ he sɔn.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ nyiŋi he waa ta, dɛ́ dɔ waane bol, bɛ soh kɛŋɔ ɡɛna dɛ mamɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ya kpɔ jam dɛɛ tɛɛ, ya dɛ bol kan haa doa, ne nyokpowaa haa ɛa wa.

english_verse: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “N le saŋ bɛl cheɡ dɛ́ bol nɛra wa, dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Dɛ harɛ jiɡro Korowii kontaala bwa ɛɛ chel aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo kwaa aa lawɔ kpoŋe la che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: N dɛ ŋɔ mbarafo tena be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel mbarafo ɛɛ’, dɛ ŋɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel mbarafo wobol bola.

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: He bɛ waa bol yaɡɛ men Korowii.’ ”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole toole wee leebɔr kɛɛ wee cholibɔr, weekaŋle harɛbɔr kɛɛ weekaŋle nyundua.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Korowiirii bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole. Onee dɛɛ pa boldɛɛɡe, dɛɛ pa bolchɔɡe ɡe.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Korowii kpoŋe numol, o bandia aa do kɛŋɔ danana nee suu. O fuɡa kɛŋɔ seŋkpeɡa tɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena bwa ba nyɔ, ba nyɔ a bwa a tonɛ kwaraa.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Kɛ n te, maa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ waa bolaa ɡel saŋ bɛlbwa bwa, mɛɛ ɡo kpɛɛra yelaa tɛo.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ sɔɔh kpeɡri nɛnchɔɡa aa dɛ di la nyoaa, kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te, wɛɛ berɔ tɛɛ ba bokpeɡa.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ Juda harɛ ta jemɛ Korowii, hale Israel harɛ ta tena dɛ́ bol ŋɔ Korowii sɔn kan.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Jerusalamee o bwɛ, o so Saayɔn Bwejen doa.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Belaa o kuuɡi o dɔma hɛma, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe ne keri, dɛ dɔmkwaa bwa soo siwi.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Ba lɛ dɔmkwaa bwa aa lɔ ba banyoola be, asɛ ba serewe chɔ. Ba kpeɡri ne ba wejema bwa ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Korowii Jekɔb aa dɛ tomɛ, haa aah ba la, ba jaɡre ne nɛra baa soɡe a ta bwa serewɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ɡbosoo nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔmɛ, he baah diu waa, nomɛlbwa aa won che he sie.

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Nyundua he che bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole, asɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ɔmɛ dɛ hel jeih ken,

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: ɡɛ saŋ haa ira che dɛ́ pa nɛra bole dɛ́ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba harɛ nɔ ta la.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ kwaa haa baɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nyoa la ba tɛo. Harɛre nɛra haa bɛna bwa, hé kpɔ koŋkɛɛla ba tɛo, onee chɛ kɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: O dɛ sɔɔh koranar bambikpeɡ nyoa, koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa dɛ ɔmɔ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: N wio no Korowii ŋɔ, ó cha mɛ, n wio noo asɛ o no n be.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ wa aa puu mɛ la, n wio no Korowii, n ɡɔɔ nɔɔra jwaana bwa dɛ soŋo, kɛ n ta bolarawa bɛlbwa dɔe.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ maa won dom chɔ, n bwara dɛ nyɛɡ n bol waa kahonɛ.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: N lii tɔpera, ne bene aa baa kaa saŋ la wa.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Korowii ɛɛ den vɛh yaa kwaraa ɡɛ naa? Waa ya nɛɛ sune kpa aa?

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: O nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la toole ya nɛɛ kpa aa? Nyoa waa baɡɛ yaa la toole kpa aa?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Korowii soɔh kɛŋɔ ó sune ya nɛ aa? Bandia baa chiɡ tedoma waa dɔa tɛ nɛra la naa ta kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Asɛ n ŋɔ, “Waa aa dɛ ha mɛ kohona laanee kɛ, Nemenɛ Korowii ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ won lɛ yaa kpa kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ lii he wejena haa ɛa la waa, he nyokpowaa haa ɛa saŋ la.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lii waa haa ɛa laanee, ásɛ dɛ lii he wejena haa ɛa la bwa.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he wobɛlbwa do ɡoroŋ, voɡa nɛra aa dɛ tomɛ la ta kpeɡri dɔe kɛŋɔ, hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ nɔ.

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Henee Korowii haa dɛ ɛ nyokpowa, he baɡle he kpeɡri harɛre nɛra bwa bini.
