english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: He cheɡɛ he kpeɡri ta dɛ lɛ he nɛra, Jekɔb ne Josef naanar bwa.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, neerare do kɛŋɔ nɛra, dɛ nae dɛɛ ɔmɛ, asɛ mpo vile ɡe ɛɛ chel he sie.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Baama nɛ bwaala, dɛ nyɛɡle le nyundua, asɛ dɛ kɔɡre dɛɛ nyɛɡle bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, haa ta he hɛma la ken.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ bwaala nyɛɡle dɛɛ kɔɡre kohona, dɛɛ nyɛɡle harɛ nɔ ta bwa, asɛ harɛ jiɡri.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: He valɛ mpo nehɛma ta dɛ ɡale o vile, kɛ ba ta he nabuɡe nae.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: He tɔ he nɛra sie kɛŋɔ peteɡre ken, asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn chɔ ba nyoa.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: N nɛra, hé no waa maa dɛ baɡle heya, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ bol.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ sɛɡlaa bol waa chaɡle heya, waa nomɛlbwa aa wola jemɛ bwa, le harɛ nɔ mumpar,

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: waa yaa noa dɛ jema, anɔ la ya naawa aa bola baɡle yaa.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yaa kpɔ sɔh ya bii, yaa boloo baɡle ya naanar baa ka ba, dɛ́ kpɛɛ Korowii kpeɡri ne o wejena, dɛ o nyokpo we-ɛɛla waa ɛa.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: O kpɔ o Mmarare tɛ Israel tena baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar, a do le tɛɛ ba. O baɡle ya naawa ŋɔ, bá kpɔ baɡle ba ɡe bii,

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: ásɛ ya naanar baa ka ba la hweli le ba be, ba baa kpeɡ aa, bá ɡe bol baɡle ba bii.

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: Anee dɛ́ ɡel ba kpɔ ba hwɛɡa dawɛ Korowii nɛ, dɛ bɛ waa waa ɛa la soh, dɛ́ na dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare la ta.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Efrem laa tena kpɔ ba tori, kɛ aa tel laa ta la, ba berɔ chwa kaa dem.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Ba ta Korowii fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la ta teŋɛ, dɛ vɛh o Mmarare la.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Ba soh waa waa ɛa, nyokpowaa waa ɛa baɡ ba la.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: O ɛ nyokpowaa ba naawa siwi ta, Soan harɛ waa chɔa kaa dɛ do Ijipt harɛ ta.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ mpo pere anɛ, dɛ tɔ ba sie, asɛ ba valɛ o bini le kɛŋɔ harɛpɛɛ ken. O ɡelɔ nee la teŋe che kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ diɡ ne ɡal.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua ta, dɛ tɔ ba sie webaŋa, asɛ jwaana bwa ɡe, o kpɔ nii waa tɛra kaa nyundua tɔ ba sie wɛɛ chaah ba ba won vala.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: O pere bwea aa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta nee kohona le a bini, kɛŋɔ mpo nee ken tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ nee le bwe ta, dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ nenapale ken.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba teŋɔ ɛ Korowii wechɔɡa, dɛɛ ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii deŋnekpeɡ, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Ba saahnɔ daah Korowii na, dɛɛ nyin kondikwaa ba pɛla aa lawa.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Ba bol waa yaɡɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ won tɛ yaa kondikwaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bonɔ naa?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ o kpɔ kon lɔ bwe, asɛ nee fuɡe le kohona. Aah wɛɛ won tɛ yaa kondikwaa dɛ tɛ yan yaa ɛ o nɛra nɔ ola ja aa?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii aa no ba waa la, o baah diu, bandia kohona la ɡelɔ nii ba le o nɛra Israel tena nɛ, asɛ a ɡwaa ba nɛɛ kohona,

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta o waa yaradae, ba ta lɛɛ do kɛŋɔ wɛɛ won lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, Korowii nyoa wobol ɡelɔ nyundua pili.

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: O tɛɛ ba kondikwa ane soo siwi aa le nyundua baa dɛ yera maana ba di.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba di kondikwa nyundua toroma aa dɛ di, o tɛɛ ba ba di dɛ vaɡre.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ wee leebɔr peu ta, dɛ che o kpeɡri ta ɡel weekaŋle harɛbɔr kon ɡe ta,

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ ɡel jumbii ba lee o nɛra la bini. A warɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ a ba lee bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dembaah, dɛ bar ba tɛnte deene la bwa.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Ba diu dɛ vaɡre, dɛkalkɛ kondikwaa ba pɛla aa lawa laanee Korowii kpɔ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Ba taa dɛ di ba pɛla kondikwa a ta su ba nyoo la,

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii baah di ba nɛ, o kpoo ba bini nɛŋkpeɡa, bonɔɔna ba bwara aa kpeɡa kohona Israel harɛ ta la.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ ba ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, o nyokpo we-ɛɛla la bwa habɔɔ, ba ta on yaradae.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: O baa kpoo ba bini bane aa, banɔ la baa kaa la yon berɛ ba o be, dɛ́ charɛ ba liire, dɛɛ soŋo sibeɡra ne.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Ba liiro kɛŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowiirii fa do kɛŋɔ Bwetal dɛɛ tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe, dɛ ɛ ba Lɛɛ.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ neɡra ɡboo baa neɡro, ba wobɛlbwa ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ.

english_verse: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
translation_verse: Baa o waa ta teŋɛ, baa fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii sune o nɛra nɛ, o kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, o ta ban chɔɡɛ. Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa o lawɛ bambile, dɛ ɡel o bandia nyoa sɔɔh.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: O liiro kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nɛwɛnyina baa dɛ ba wona sewɛ, dɛ do kɛŋɔ peu aa taa baa kaa ken.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ o nɛ, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ teŋɛ ɡel o bambile chɔɡ.

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwaa ba na dɛ daah Korowii dɛɛ na, dɛɛ ir Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la bwaawee.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ba soh o kpeɡri kohona ne tɔpere waa lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: dɛ ɛ wejena ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla, Soan harɛ waa chɔa kaa, dɛ do Ijipt harɛ ta la wa.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ Ijipt harɛ neerare bwa berɛ chal, ba nyin nee dɛ́ nyɔ kahonɛ.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ chwɛɛhne fuɡe le ba nɛ, dɛ baa ha ba, asɛ sapone ɡe ba chɔɡ ba harɛ.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ tontombɛ ba chɔɡ ba kondikwa, dɛ chɔɡ ba kooni.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ dombwea ba chɔɡ ba ɡrepo, ne pur daa kooni bwa.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: O kpoo ba nae dombwea ne, dɛ ɡel bwaala kɔr kpoo ba peera.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: O kpɔ o bandia kohona ba ta ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba waa do sum kohona, a do kɛŋɔ baa tomɛ toroma ŋɔ, bá ba kpoo ba ken.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: O ta ɡelɛ o bandia nyoa sɔɔh, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ba bwara kɛ ba, o kpoo ba weechɔɡa ne.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: O kpoo Ijipt harɛ bibanloɡla, dem bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ tɔ o nɛra sie kɛŋɔ peteɡre ken, dɛ kpɔ ba valɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: O tɔ ba sie dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ ba ta ɔmɛ, kɛ ba dɔma la te, mpo bɔle ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba kaa.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: O kpɔ ba ba o harɛ waa do ɡoroŋ ta, deŋɡarere harɛ nɛra aa soɡe a ta, o yo dɛ lɛa la.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: O tɔ sie doŋi nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta, dɛ bɔne harɛ la denaa ta tɛ Israel tena, dɛ kpɔ ba ka so ba deene la ta.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ daahno na, ba vɛh o Mmarare ta teŋa.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Ba deŋne kpeɡri, baa waa bu kɛ ba naawa ken, ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ bela baa dɛ tomɛ ba voɡa dɛɛ muɡli o baah, dɛ kpɔ ba voɡa dɛɛ ir o bwaawee.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii aa no ba waa la, o baah diu kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, o vɛh Israel tena kwaraa.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: O ɡel o Tɛnte Dea waa lɔ Silo, waa ɡela ba baŋro o ɛ o dobɔr harɛ nɔ ta la.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ ya dɔma ba kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la. Onee cheɡa tɛ o kpeɡri ne o jirima.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: O baah di o ɡbaɡba nɛra nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba dɔma kpoo ba.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ ba kpoo ba bonɔɔna laa ta, ba toli ta baala dɔe dɛ yalɛ.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Ba kpoo ba sɔfore laa ta, ba ta ɡelɛ ba luhaahna wi.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ o dɔma peɡre, ba di sihiih saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: O vɛh Josef naanar, o ta Efrem dea nɛra leɛ.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: Kɛ Juda dea nɛraa o le, ne Saayɔn Bwejen waa dɛ nyin bela kohona la.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Belaa o ma o Dea, o do jaŋne kɛ bwejena ken. O mao o che kɛ harɛ waa tao nɔ, dɛ che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: O le o bonɔɔ Devid ɡɛ saŋ waa dɛ nyiŋi peera nɛɛ kpɔɡ bini,

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: dɛ ba o ne ŋɔ, ó ba tɔ o nɛra Israel tena baa ɛ o kapɛrɛ nɛra la sie, kɛŋɔ peteɡre.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Devid nyiŋi ba nɛɛ bambile bwa ne, dɛ tɔ ba sie wejema ne.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola hen tomɛ, baa lɛ he harɛ la dɔɔh. Ba kpɔ doŋa kah he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛ ɡel Jerusalam berɛ dimɡbia.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ serewa la tɛ kɔkɔsakire aa di. Ba berɛ kpɔɡ bini ola kondikwa.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Ba kpoo nɛra ba chal fuɡe dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ nee ken, dɛɛ palɛ Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna bwa, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ huɡ ba.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: Harɛre aa bar yaa cheme nɛra dɛ chɛɡre yaa, ba kpɔ yaa berɛ akwekwe nɛra.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo he baah di ya nɛɛ ka tel ɔ? He bandia ɛɛ teŋɔ ɡwaa ya nɛɛ ɡɛ dɛɛ la naa?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Gel he baah di harɛre nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ la nɛ, nɛra baa wola hen jemɛ dɛ́ soŋe la,

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ ba kpoo he nɛra Israel tena, dɛ chɔɡ he harɛ.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Bɛ ya naawa wechɔɡa baa ɛa kpɔ tɛr ya deŋne. Na ya sum warane, ya hwɛɡa bwa tonɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ba cha yaa dɛ́ lɛ yaa. Ba lɛ yaa dɛ́ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa, he sɔn la wa.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ harɛre nɛra ɛɛ bɔɔ yaa ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ dɔɔ nɔɔ?” Tɛr nɛra baa kpoo he bonɔɔna deŋne, ya siwi ta bonɔ.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: No nɛra baa laɡ ba do dea la hima baa dɛ hime. Che he kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ba ba kpoora.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bɔ harɛre baa kaa la kem bele anuanɛ, chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡre la wa.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Ásɛ he nɛra yaa do kɛŋɔ peera he sie nɔ, ɛɛ kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛ́ le fini kaa ya naanar baa ka ba bwa nɛ.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Israel Peteɡre, no ya wii. Henee tɔ Josef naanar sie kɛŋɔ peteɡre, dɛ so he kookara ta, Kerobim la baah ta.

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he te chaɡle Efrem ne Bɛnjamen dɛ Manasɛ deene tena, che he kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ ba lɛ yaa.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, berɛ lɛ yaa, sune ya nɛ, ásɛ dɛ lɛ yaa.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, saŋ besoo he bandia nyoa ɛɛ ba sɔɔhna, he nɛra wesoŋa ta nɔ?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ suna do kɛŋɔ kondikwaa yaa di, siniire ɡe do kɛ nee yaa nyɔ.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ harɛre nɛra baa bar yaa cheme yo dɔŋa ya harɛ wa, asɛ ya dɔma chɛɡre yaa.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, berɛ ba lɛ yaa, sune ya nɛ, ásɛ dɛ lɛ yaa.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: He lawɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, kɛŋɔ haa teŋe ɡrepo da, dɛ ba doŋi harɛ la nɛra le o ta, dɛ kpɔ yaa chɔɔ bela.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Daa la kpeɡo o kpala tɔ bwejena ta, hale pelema bwa ta.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Daa la ta kpala ka le Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta, dɛ teŋe ba kaa Yufretis Moo ta.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ he ɡel nɛŋhɔɔhra dɔ bɔr kuuɡi kon baa kpɔa ke daa la nɔɔ? Nomɛlbwa teŋo baa kaa laa, wɛɛ won ba tɔɔ o nɔna di.

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Nɛŋhɔɔhra do kɛŋɔ chweri dɛɛ tiɡri harɛ la ta, kpɔɡ bini ola ɡee chɔɡo.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Korowii Haa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ, berɛ sie ya be. Che nyundua nyiŋi, dɛ́ ba lɛ yan yaa ɛ he nɛra,

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: haa kpɔ yaa ba so bonɔ, dɛ ɡel ya mun ya kohona nɔ.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ya dɔma chɔɡ yaa kɛŋɔ baa teŋe da, dɛ kpɔ do nii ta o fuh la ken. Gel he baah di ba nɛ, he chɔɡ ba.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nɔn tɔ nɛra haa lee ba tɛ he te la nɛ, lɛ nɛra haa lee ba dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri kohona la.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Yaa habɔɔ berɛ kpoe kpa, tɛ yaa bokpeɡfala, ásɛ ya won kpɛɛre.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, berɛ ba lɛ yaa, sune ya nɛ, ásɛ dɛ lɛ yaa.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii waa dɛ tɛ yaa bokpeɡa. Hé ɡo yela kohona kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Hé pa mun ɡo yela, dɛ́ yiiɡi loŋa, hé kpɔ janjela lɔ yelsoma.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Hé hoh pebal nyeɡle bɛla Korobifale Tɔpejen ta, korobie baa kpeɡ ɡe aa, hé berɛ hoh.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Mmara waa chɔ le dɛ tɛ Israel tena laanee, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ laanee kpɔa tɛ yaa.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Mmara nɔɔ Korowii kpɔ tɛ Israel tena, ɡɛ saŋ waa kaa yo Ijipt tena la. N no taa bɛl o ŋɔ,

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: “N lɛ he bone haa cheɡa dɛɛ koh, dɛ choɡ he bontɔɡa cheɡ harɛ.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ haa lɔ wenaale ta la, he yerɛ men Korowii, asɛ n ba lɛ heya. N cheɡɛ peukpeɡ bini dɛ chaŋe heya, dɛ daah heyaa na Mɛreba, bela ne aa bula la.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé cheɡ deŋne no n wejaala nɔ. N nɛra, n dɛ nyin kɛ he fe aa no n be!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ ka ja n nɛ, he bɛ an dɛɛ ɡuŋi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Menee Korowii haa dɛ tomɛ, n le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta la. Hé waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ mɛ naa, mɛɛ tɛ heya kondikwaa kɛŋɔ, jumbie aa dɛ tɛ o bii la.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: Kɛ ane abwa, Israel tena aa n be no, baa n waa ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ɡel ba deŋnekpeɡ waa tɛɛ ba, ba kaa ɛ anɔ la aa too ba tea.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ n nɛra fe aa no n deŋna wa, ásɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta.

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: N fe ɛɛ yo ba dɔmaa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ warane.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa hah men Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ ɔmee ba ɡuŋi n sie. Ba deŋnetɛra ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, mɛɛ tɛ heyaa mendɛɛɡa, ne tohdɛɛɡa he di dɛ vaɡɛ.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Korowii soɡe o kookara ta nyundua, koŋkwaare aa dɛ tomɔ bwa cheme o sie, asɛ o bol a waa dɛɛ pa bole dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Saŋ besoo he ɡel nɛra sie nyiŋa dɛ́ɛ pa bole ɔ? Hé ɡel nyubinikpeɡ tena nɛɛ suna bole pae ta.

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Hé bol nyaara ne bilalbii waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ bɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra ne nɛra, baa wola nɛra dɔe bá cha ba pere dɛɛ ta.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Hé lɛɛ ba le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: Haa wobɛlbwa jemɛ, hé ɡɛnɔ! Neɡraa hɛɛ neɡre nɛra, kasinteŋ tonɛ harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Men Korowii maa lɔ nyundua ŋɔ, ‘He bɛlbwa do kɛ Korowii, kɛɛ men Nemenɛ Korowii bii.’

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Kɛ he bwa ɛɛ serewoo kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini waa won sewa la ken, he ne koranar bwa.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ bol harɛ nɔ nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole. Henee dɔ harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, bɛ nyoa tɔ! Ir nyu ne.

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ he dɔma aa ir he nɛ, nɛra baa haeh ba deŋne do kpeɡri la.

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Ba sɔɔh dɛɛ vɔrɔwe he nɛra vɔrɔwa, ba dɛ vɔrɔwe nɛra haa kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛɛ la vɔrɔwa.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya chɔɡ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta, ásɛ Israel harɛ sɔn den nyoɡre kwaraa.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Ba nyoa pɛo baa vɔrɔwe he vɔrɔwa. Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dɛɛ ba ba yoi laanee nɔ,

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Edom ne Ismael tena, ne Moab dɛ Haɡri tena,

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: ne Gebal ne Amɔn ne Amalɛk, ne Filisti dɛ Taaya tena.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Ɛɛ ba ɡɛ haa ɛ Midian tena la, chɔɡ ba ɡɛ haa chɔɡ Sisera ne Jabin, baa ɛ laa nomonome Kesɔn nenabɔɔ ta la.

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: He kpoo ba bil Ɛndɔr, ba chɔ bela dɛ pɔh.

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ, “Yaa kpɔ Korowii harɛ laanee berɛ ya kon.”

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lɔ ba peɡre kɛŋɔ tutuɡ, kɛŋɔ peu aa taa dɛ kpɔ haahra kaa ken.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Gɛ nii yon fuh kɔr dɛ́ kpɛle bwejena dor bwa la,

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: kpɔ bwaala peu doŋ ba, dɛ́ ɡel peukpeɡ kpɔ ɔmee kohona ba ta ba nɛ.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel sihiih kpo ba, dɛ́ ɡel ba na he kpeɡri.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Gel ba bwara yɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ ɔmee ta ba nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, ɡel ba sewɛ sihihseo.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Gel ba jemɛ kɛ he ɡbosoo Nemenɛ Korowii, he habɔɔ, kooro bɛlbwa toole harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii, n bambile lawɛ he Dea kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Bela waa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ taeh! N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa lɔ he Dea. Mɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yela n bambile bwa nee tɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Joŋa kwara sɔh kɔne, bilore ɡe dɔ a kɔne, a bii yon do a bini, he saraha kon la jwɛh, bela baa fuh kwaa dɛɛ tɛɛ la. Nemenɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee n kooro.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ he Dea la, ba na som. Ba ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ he nɛɛ la, ba na som. Banɔ la ba bambile aa lawa kɛ ba valɛ kaa Saayɔn Bwejen doa la.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Ba valɔ kpɔ Baka Fɛlembɔjen bini Korowii ɡel wɛɛ bule o su, kɛŋɔ yoo saŋ bwaala aa nɛa dɛ ɡel o su.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Ba dɔ bokpeɡa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, ka tel kɛ baa na Korowii o kpeɡri aa ɡwaa voɡa bwa, Saayɔn Bwejen doa la.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, no n wesoŋa, Korowii Jekɔb aa dɛ tomɛ, no n be!

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, swee ya kooro waa dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe andɛɛɡa, kooro haa leo cheɡ tɛ he te la.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Nɛn soɡe he Dea tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo aa, a bɔ kɛ waa kaa di tɔpera kaɡboŋ bobɛl. N fe ɛɛ che Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ Dea doonyoa dɛɛ daah bela, dɛ́ ɡwaa kɛ maa kaa so nyubinikpeɡ tena deremi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, dɛ ɛ ya kooro waa dɔ jirima. O swee yaa andɛɛɡa, dɛ sune ya nɛ, dɛ tɛ yaa jirima. Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la, waa ban kondɛɛɡe bɛlbwa vɔmɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii, nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dawɛ he nɛɛ la, o na som.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he sune he harɛ nɛra nɛ, he berɔ ɡel Israel tena wobɛlbwa maɡre tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: He kpɔ he nɛra wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ kɛ ba, he tɔ ba wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: He ta ɡelɛ he baah di ba nɛ, he laa he bandia kohona kpɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: Ya naa Korowii haa ɛ ya Lɛɛ, berɛ ɡel ya wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ yaa, bɛ ɡel he baah di ya nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: He baah ɛɛ di ya nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la ɡɛ naa? He bandia nyoa aa sɔɔh bwa naa?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Berɛ tɛ yaa bokpeɡfala ja, ásɛ yan yaa ɛ he nɛra nɔ kpɛɛre.

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: N dɛ no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol la, o baɡɛ yaa nyoa ŋɔ, dɛ ya ta berɛ kaa ya ɡɛne we-ɛɛla ta naa, wɛɛ tɛ yaa deŋnesɔɔhnaa.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tomɔ la, wɛɛ lɛo, ásɛ o jirima do ya harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Korowii nyina ne o kasinteŋ do kɛŋɔ nɛra banɛ aa chema ken, asɛ waa aa toɡra ne deŋnesɔɔhna ɡe ɛ beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ harɛ ta ɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii, ásɛ Korowii che toɡra waa toɡra ta le nyundua dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ya wobɛlbwa do wer, ásɛ kondikwa kohona ba ya harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Toɡra Korowii aa toɡra la ɛɛ tɔ o siee kɛŋɔ nɛn, dɛɛ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ ó kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ, n ɛ nyaa dɛ ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: N kpɔ n te tɛɛ nomanta, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ. Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, anomanta, lɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ he nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na n sum dɛkalkɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa n wi dɛɛ noe.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ silɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ he siee n kpɔ n wesoŋa dɛɛ bil.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he waa wer tɛ yaa, kpɔ ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ yaa, he kpɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, dɛɛ nyin nɛra baa wia dɛɛ yerɛ bwa.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, no n suna wii, dɛ́ cha mɛ.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: N wio dɛɛ noe n wenaale tɔpere, dɛkalkɛ henee dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, voɡa nɛra aa dɛ tomɛ ta kpeɡri dɔe kɛ hen, nomɛlbwa ta he we-ɛɛla dɔŋa ɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra haa ta ba bwa ɛɛ ba he siee, dɛ́ ba ɡuŋi, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛ he sɔn haa dɔa.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: He kpeɡri dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowa, he ɡboo ɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, chaɡ mɛ he ŋwɛnɛ, ásɛ n tomɛ kasinteŋ ne. Gel n kpɔ bambibeŋkpoŋ tomɛ, dɛɛ ɔmɛ he sɔn.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, mɛɛ kpɛɛre n bambile bwa nee, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛ he sɔn saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la kan tɛ mɛ! He lɛɛ mɛ le seo nyoa.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nyubinikpeɡ tena ne mbarafo tena dɛ yoo mɛ. Ba pɛ nyoa dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, baa hen komɛl yerɛ.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Korowii te, he dɔ tedoma tɛ nɛra, dɛɛ nyin ba. He baah aa di warawara, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ, hɛɛ nyin nɛn.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Berɛ sie n be, dɛ́ na n sum. Tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ bokpeɡa. Lɛɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ n tomɛ n bambile bwa ne.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Gel n na waane, á baɡle kɛŋɔ he waa wer tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n dɔma na sihiih kpo ba, dɛkalkɛ henee cha mɛ dɛ larawe n bwara.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Korowii ma o bwɛjen Jerusalam o do bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ doa.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: O dɛ nyin bwɛjen la, dɛ ɡwaa Israel harɛ bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Jerusalam, no ɡɛ waa bol he jirima haa dɔa wa.

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “Dɛ mɛɛ chwerɛ bwɛɛre ba nɛra aa dɛ no n deŋna waa yaa, Ijipt ne Babelɔn harɛre nɛra waa mɛɛ ba chwera. Mɛɛ kure Filisti ne Taaya tena, dɛ Itiopia tena bwaa, ásɛ ba ŋɔ Jerusalamee ba lolɛ yaa.”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Baa bol bwɛjen Jerusalam waa ŋɔ, o binii harɛre nɛra bwa le dɛ ba, Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ó do kpeɡri.

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ chwerɛ nɛra la sɔnaa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ja Jerusalam tena nɛ.

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Baa ɡo yelaa dɛɛ sa ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Jerusalam taa ya wedɛɛɡa bwa ɛɛ le.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee ɛ n Lɛɛ, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa n kpɔ n wii dɛɛ bil he sie.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: No n wesoŋa, cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no n wii maa dɛ wi, dɛ́ cha mɛ.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: N dɛ na wahala kohona, a ɡelɔ a ka tama n sewɛ.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: N do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ ba sewa, n bokpeɡa bwa tonɔ.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: He kur mɛ ja nɛra baa serewa nɛ, n do kɛ nɛra baa serewa chɔ lalbɔɔne bini. Nɛra hen Korowii aa soh ba waa kwaraa, haa wola won cha ba la ken.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: He taɡ mɛ ta lalbɔɔ waa luŋa ne biro kohona bini.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: He bandia ɡwaa n nɛɛ kohona, dɛ ba tɔ n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma ken.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ n chamene tena chwa mɛ, baa n siwi ɡba nyin dɛ́ na. N do kɛ maa le bel ta, maa wola won chwa.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Suna dii ɡelɔ mɛɛ ba nyoŋa. N Naa Korowii, tɔpere bɛlbwaa n wi dɛɛ yerɛ, n ɡɔɔ nɔɔra dɛɛ soŋe.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: He dɛ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla nɛra baa serewa bini naa? Baa won ir che dɛ́ kpɛɛre.

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ba dɛ bol he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la waa lalbɔɔ bini, kɛɛ he kasinteŋ waa la lalabwɛ aa?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Ba dɛ na he nyokpowaa biro ta bela, kɛɛ he wedɛɛɡa lalabwɛɛ bela baa dɛ soh wobɛlbwa nɔ naa?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ laa sie kpɔ n nɛɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Le n bechale saŋ bwaa n bwara wee mɛ, a ka tama n sewɛ. N ɡwɛɡrɔ dɛ le deŋnetɛra haa kpɔa ba ta n nɛɛ mɛɛ di suna la wa.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: He bandia kohona la ɡwaa n nɛ, he yoi haa dɛ yoo mɛ chɔɡ mɛ.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ n daamanar tenten ne nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ ɡba chwa mɛ, biro ɡboo berɛ n dam name.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.

translation_verse: Nyundua ne harɛ bwa ɛ he kwa, henee ta harɛ ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta.

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.

translation_verse: wɛɛ dɔ naanaree saŋ bɛlbwa, mɛɛ nyiŋi o harɛ taa ó che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ wee aa dɛ chaah saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.

translation_verse: He chɔɡ he ne he bonɔɔ fɔo haa fɔwa la, dɛ kpɔ o kooɡbɛrɛ ta harɛ.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.

translation_verse: He won ɡela nɛwɛnyina teŋe sewɛ kɛŋɔ dom yon piɡri lawɛ nɛn la ken. Ba do kɛ kpɔɡlwɛɛ haa naa chɔɔ,

translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he waa haa dɛ ɛ kan, he wejema ta jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ di kora, o do laala kɛŋɔ kooro, dɛ dɔ jirima kohona dɛɛ di kpeɡri. O ta harɛ dɛ ɡel o che kiŋkiŋ, nomɛlbwa aa wola won kpɔ le o buɡ ta.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Saŋ la bwaa he kora le. Mɔɔ wobɛlbwa pa mun la, dɛ he lole.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mpo vile dɛ si, a taɡɛ nehɛma aa kana dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ si kohona.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Korowii te, he dɛ di kora nyundua, dɛ do kan ɡwaa mpo sii waa dɛ si. He kpeɡri ɡwaa mpo nehɛma kwara.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: He mmarare cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. He Dea do ɡoroŋ kohona, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ tɛr nɛra deŋne, ɡel ba na he bandia.

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Henee bol nɛra bwa waa dɛɛ pa bole, ir dɛ́ bɔ mbarafo tena kem ɡɛ aa chɛa.

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Ba dɛ bol mbarafo wobol, mbarafo ɡboo su wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Ba yon dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, “Korowii aa yaa na, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la sie toole ya be.”

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: N nɛra, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɡɛn ɡɛ nɔɔ? Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba waa hwela ɔ?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Korowii laa tɛ yaa deŋna ne sibie aa? Waa waa no aa? Waa na naa?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Korowii waa dɛ kah nɛra la aa won tɛr ba deŋne aa? Nɛn waa dɛ baɡle nɛra waa la, o nya liire kɛɛ?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Korowii jemɛ nɛwɛnyini liire kɛŋɔ a ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nɛra haa dɛ baɡ ba wa, ne banɔ la haa dɛ baɡ ba he Mmarare la, ba na som.

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: Wenaale ane dɛ ba ba nɛ aa, he ɡelɔ baa dɔ bosɔɔhna, ka tel kɛŋɔ baa forɛ bɔɔ, dɛ́ harɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena bel.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Korowii aa o nɛraa vɛh, waa nɛra waa lee ba cheɡ tɛ o te laanee ɡel bwa.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Waa bola dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ berɔ do le, ásɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii laa cha mɛ naa, n fe sewɔ warane kaa lalabwɛ.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Asɛ n ŋɔ, “N keero dɛɛ ba chola,” kɛ Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la laɡ mɛ kpoŋe.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: N liire baa chɔɡ kohona aa, he dɛ larawe n bwara dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ, dɛ che n habɔɔ, onee do kɛ Bwetal n chwa kaa marɔ.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ bɔ ba kem ba wechɔɡa waa, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba ba nyubinikpeɡ wa. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ chɔɡ baa.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Hé ba ya kpɛɛ Korowii! Hé ɡel ya ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛro, onee do kɛ Bwetal ya chwa kaa marɔ.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya ba o sie ba jaamo, dɛ́ ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛro.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ Korowii dɔ kpeɡri kohona, onee dɛɛ di kora voɡare bwa nɛ.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: O dɛ di kora harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛ, hale bwebɔɔne aa luŋa ta ne bwejena dor.

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: Hé ba ya ɡuŋu dɛ́ tomɔ, yá ɡuŋi Korowii waa ta yaa la sie!

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Onee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, o nɛraa yan wɛɛ nyiŋi ya nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre yon dɛɛ nyiŋi peera nɛɛ la ken. Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be fini laanee nɔ,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: “He bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kɛŋɔ he naawa fa aa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Mɛreba, dɛ vɛh o waa noe, dɛ jo o nɛɛ la, ɡɛ baa ɛa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta Maasa la.

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: He naawa na waa maa ɛa tɛɛ ba bela, kɛ ba daah mɛ na.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Bene fifraanaarɛ bwaa n baah di ba nɛ, asɛ n ŋɔ, ‘Ba deŋne kpeɡri! Ba vɛh waa maa do ba a ta.’

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: N baah aa dia la, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, ‘Baa ona maa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ onɛ la dɔe ba bwa.’ ”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yelfale kpɛɛ Korowii! Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro!

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn! Hé bol o lɛɛ waa dɛ lɛ nɛra tɔpere bɛlbwa wa.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Hé bol o jirima waa baɡle harɛre nɛra, dɛ́ bol o nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa baɡle nɛra bwa.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Korowii kan, a chɛ kɛ ya kpɛɛro kohona. Onee chɛ kɛ ya kpɔ duure tɛ dɛ́ ɡwaa voɡa.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Harɛre bwa voɡare ɛ konsale baa kpɔ nɔɔra ɛa, kɛ Korowiirii ta nyundua.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: O kan dɛ dɔ jirima kohona, kpeɡri ne jirima su o Dea.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii. Hé kpɛɛro, o jirima ne kpeɡri waa dɔa wa.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima aa chɛ o sɔn la tɛo. Hé kpɔ saraha kwaa ba tɛo o Dea.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jirima tɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ la. Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa, hé ɔmɔ!

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Hé ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa no kɛŋɔ, “Korowii dɛ di kora! O ta harɛ o che kiŋkiŋ waa wola yiiɡi, dɛ bol nɛra bwa waa dɛɛ pa ba bole ɡɛ aa chɛa.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ lɛ ba sie. Mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ o bini bwa ɡe, hé do lɔŋɔre.

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Kooni ne kwaa aa lɔ a bini bwa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ lɛ ba sie! Ásɛ kɔr bini daa ɡe ɛɛ hɛɡre,

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: saŋ Korowii aa ba di kora harɛ nɔ ta la. Wɛɛ ba bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta ne kasinteŋ ne.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra, hé ɡel he sie lɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ di kora. Gel nɛra baa soɡe ekwie harɛre ta la ɡe hɛɡre.

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Baama ne biro baro cheme, waa aa toɡra ne kasinteŋ nee wɛɛ di kora.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Nii tɔ o sie dɛɛ lawɛ, dɛɛ fuh o dɔma baa baro cheme.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Nii la dɛ lawɛ kohona kɛŋɔ bwaala nyɛɡla ken, asɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra na dɛɛ chel.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Bwejena dɛ mwɛɛ kɛŋɔ tohkel, Korowii waa dɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛɛ la sie.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua dɛ baɡle kɛ o waa toɡrɔ, asɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ na o jirima.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa bwa, nɛra baa kpɔ voɡare dɛɛ maŋkura ba te, ne voɡa bwa dɛ ɡuŋi Korowii sie.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Saayɔn tena noɔ ba sie lɛ, Juda bwɛjena tena ɡee hɛɡre, hen Korowii waa bola dɛ́ pa bole wa.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii, henee dɛɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ, henee kana ɡwaa voɡare bwa.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Nii dɛ chaah nɛra ba wa aa toɡra sie, nɛra ba wa aa wera ɡe ɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yelfale tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ waa aa dɛ kpo nyoa! O cheɡɛ kpeɡri ne ɡoroŋ waa doa ta, dɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Korowii bol pɔe waa pɔ o dɔma nɛɛ wa, dɛ ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa jemɛ lɛɛ waa lɛ o nɛra wa.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O teŋɛ nyoa waa baɡɛ Israel tena kasinteŋ ne nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ne. Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa na ɡɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa lɛ o nɛra.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro dɛ́ moo silɛɛ ne.

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ janjela lɔ yela kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Hé hoh bɛle ne pebala nyeɡlare kohona, dɛ́ moo silɛɛ ne kpɛɛ Korowii waa ɛ ya kooro la.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa ɡe moo, harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ne koŋkwaa bwa ɡo yela kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Neerare ne deŋɡarere pɛ lɔ kpaŋa, dɛ́ ɡo yela silɛɛ ne kɛŋɔ nɛra ken kpɛɛ Korowii,

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ o dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta ba di kora. Wɛɛ ba bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, ne kasinteŋ ne.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ di kora, asɛ harɛre nɛra bwara ɛɛ chel. O soɡe kookara ta nyundua Kerobim baah ta, asɛ harɛ ɛɛ jiɡri.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Korowii kan dɛ do bwɛjen Saayɔn dɛɛ di kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ kpɛɛ o sɔn waa kana dɛ dɔ jirima laanee, onee do ɡoroŋ kohona.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛ kooro, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri kohona, dɛɛ nyin waa aa toɡra, o ɡelɔ kasinteŋ do Israel harɛ ta. O ba wa aa toɡra dɛ do wer ne.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la, hé ɡuŋi o kookara sie dɛ́ tomɔ, onee do ɡoroŋ kohona!

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Dɛ Mosis ne Arɔn fa ɛ o sɔfore, asɛ Samoɛl che o sɔn ta dɛɛ soŋo. Ba soŋe Korowii, asɛ o no ba be.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua ta, dɛ bol waa ba be, asɛ ba teŋɛ mmarare ne waa waa do ba a ta.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he no he nɛra wesoŋa. A lole kɛ he tɛr ba deŋne te, kɛ he ɡelɔ ba jemɛ kɛ he kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ tomɔ o bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ ta. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ silɛɛ tomɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ silɛɛ yela ba o sie!

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ onee Korowii. Onee ta yaa, dɛ dɔ yaa, O nɛraa yan, ya do kɛŋɔ peera ken o sie.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ silɛɛ ɡo yela jaamo, dɛ́ jo o Dea bini kpɛɛro. Hé jaamo dɛ́ kpɛɛ o sɔn la.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Korowii waa wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa ne o kasinteŋ lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ he nyina ne he kasinteŋ haa dɔa wa, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi n we-ɛɛla bini kɛrɛdɛɛ. Saŋ besoo he ba cha mɛ nɔ? Mɛɛ kpɔ bambidɛɛɡee so n dem,

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: dɛ́ laa n te kpɔ wechɔɡa ta. N hah nɛra baa berɛ habɔɔ kpo hen Korowii la we-ɛɛla, n ne ba toole wobɛlbwa bini.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: N ne nɛnchɔɡa baah ɛɛ do jaŋnee. Mɛɛ laa n tenee kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa sɔah dɛɛ chɔɡ o dɔŋ la, mɛɛ doŋu le n be. N ne nomɛlbwa waa dɛ na o nyu aa won pɛ.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo n sie do n nɛra Israel tena ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la nɛ, ásɛ n ne ba pɛ so n koodem. Nɛra ba wa aa wera kɛrɛdɛ laanee mɛɛ ba ɡela baa tom mɛ.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ neɡre o dɔŋ, aa n demii so. Nyosonteŋna ɡe aa won che n sie.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ dɛɛ kpoo nɛra ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa harɛ nɔ ta tɔpere bɛlbwaa. Mɛɛ doŋi wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwaa le Korowii bwɛjen nɔ taa.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Dɛ waa puu mɛ naa, bɛ sie laa kpɔ n nɛ. Cheɡ deŋne no n be, dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ warane.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: N tɔpera dɛ kaa warane kɛ chuu, n hoɡa bini ɛɛ wee mɛ kɛŋɔ hɔla aa dɛ fuh ken.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: N do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa hola dɛ kuuɡi chɔ la ken, n pɛla aa kondikwa bɛlbwa lawɛ.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: N hima kohona nomanta, n ɡwaŋɔ ka hoɡa ɡbo.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: N chɔɔ n sie kpaŋe, n do kɛ jumbibeŋkpoŋ waa joŋi dea doa.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwaa n dɔma ɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ, n sɔnee ba yerɛ dɛɛ taah nɛra.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Tɔɔ ber mɛ kondikwa, siniire koo nee ta mɛɛ nyɔ,

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: he bandia kohona nomanta, he laɡ mɛ dɛ ɡɔɔ mɛ viɡri.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: N tɔpera dɛ ba warane kɛŋɔ wee yon le harɛ, bɔr ɛɛ bir la, n holɔ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Korowii te, he di kora saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Naanar baa ka ba bwa ɛɛ lii he waa.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ sune bwɛjen Saayɔn tena nɛɛ, saŋ haa lea cheɡ la telo kɛ he dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Yan yaa ɛ he toroma sie dɛ lɛ bwɛjen Saayɔn wa, a lole kɛŋɔ o bwa paɡrɔ kwaraa.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowiirii, ásɛ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɡe kpɛɛ o jirima waa dɔa.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Wɛɛ berɔ ba kwaa ma bwɛjen Saayɔn ja, ásɛ dɛ forɛ le o jirima ne.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ no he nɛra baa vɛɛh ba la bee, dɛ́ no ba wesoŋa.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: Korowii lɔ o sobɔr waa do ɡoroŋ nyundua, dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ,

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: dɛɛ no nɛra baa laɡ ba do dea hima, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le kpoora baa dɛ ba ba kpoora ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔ ba te.

english_verse: All Jerusalem should praise you, our Lord,
translation_verse: Anomanta, baa kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn bwɛjen Saayɔnee, dɛ́ kpɔ duure tɛo Jerusalam,

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: awola harɛre nɛra ne ba koranar aa cheme, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: N taa dɔ bokpeɡa maa wola hwɛɛhrɛ mɔɔ la Korowii ɡelɔ n ɡwɛɡre, dɛ teŋe me mkpa tɔpera ta.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel ń teŋe sewɛ. He lole saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le naanar baa ka ba bwa.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa mumpar la, henee ta harɛ, kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ɡe, he nɔn tomaa a bwa.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: A bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, aa wola lee do kpa, kɛ he te ɛɛ do lee dɛɛ la. A bwa ɛɛ ba ɛ kombenaa ba kpɔ ta kɛŋɔ yal yon hɛh la.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Kɛ he te, hɛɛ do ɡɛ haa doa saŋ bɛlbwaa, ásɛ he bene ɡe aa jaɡaa dɔ bwa.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Ya bii ɛɛ so he siee ásɛ he kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ dɛ nyiŋi ba naanar nɛ ba bwara sɔɔh ba.”

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne! N kpɔ n bwadabii bwa dɛɛ kpɛɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne, maa o wedɛɛɡa la waa soh.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: O kpɔ n wechɔɡa bwa dɛɛ kɛ mɛ, dɛɛ chah n weela ɡe bwa.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: O lɛɛ mɛ dɛɛ le seo nyoa, dɛɛ swee mɛ andɛɛɡa o nyina ne tedoma waa dɔa tɛ mɛ ne.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: O dɛ tɛ mɛ n konnyina n soɡa bini bwa, a ɡel n berɛ bonɔɔ dɛ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ kee ken.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: O kpɔ o waa baɡle Mosis, dɛ ɡel Israel tena na o wejena waa dɛ ɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Nɛra waa dɛ domɛ Korowii tea wɛɛ sune ba nɛ, o baah aa di warawara, o nyina ɡe ta jaɡa dɔe bwa.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Waa teŋɛ dɛɛ pwah yaa, o baah diu waa, o dɛ sɔɔh warane.

english_verse: he doesn't punish us as our sins deserve.
translation_verse: Waa ya deŋne tɛr ɡɛ aa chɛa, kɛɛ dɛɛ bɔ yaa ya wechɔɡa kem.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Gɛ harɛ ne nyundua baah aa do jaŋa la, ɡɛɛ o nyina do kan nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ la nɛ.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Gɛ wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr baah aa jaŋa la, ɡɛɛ ya ne wechɔɡa waa laa kpɔ ya nɛɛ la baah do jaŋne.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Gɛ mɛɛ yon dɔ tedoma o bii nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ Korowii tea ɛɛ domɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ nɛ,

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ o jemɛ ɡɛ yaa doa, o dɛ lii kɛŋɔ teera nee o ma yaa.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Kɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa do kɛ kpɔɡa, ba mkpa ɡe do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa fee, kpɔɡa dɛ sewɛ a fee ɡe ɛɛ lee,

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: kɛ dɛ peu tao waa, a bwa dɛ hol o kaa a ne, bɛlbwa aa an na kpa.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la te, o nyina lɔ ba nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, asɛ dɛɛ ɛ ba bii ne ba naanar andɛɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ o kookara cheɡ nyundua, dɛɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Nyundua toroma haa kana dɛ do kpeɡri, heyaa dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta, hé kpɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Korowii dɔm haa wara dɛ do o be nyundua, hé kpɛɛro.

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Korowii kontaala bwa, hé kpɛɛro bela bwa waa dɛ di kora. N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne, Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he kan kohona! He kpɔ he kan ne he jirima tɔ kɛŋɔ yal ken,

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: asɛ nii bare cheme, dɛ paɡri nyundua kɛŋɔ tɛnte,

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: dɛ ma he sobɔr baama baŋ nyundua. He kpɔ baama berɛ kon waa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo, dɛ so o bini dɛɛ kaa, a do kɛŋɔ peu aa dɔ kena dɛɛ kaa he ne la ken.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ he nyundua toroma do kɛŋɔ peu ne ninlao.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: He kpɔ harɛ chɔŋɛ kwaa ta a lawɔ kpoŋe, o che kiŋkiŋ waa wola yiiɡi bwa.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: He kpɔ mpo bɔle o ta kɛŋɔ yal ken, asɛ nee la bɔle bwejena ta.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: A palɔ kpɔ bwejena ta dɛ kaa fɛlembɔjena ta, dɛ kaa bela haa kwaara cheɡa la.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: He maɡɛ bela aa jaɡɛ tɛa, ásɛ a bɛ won su bɔle harɛ bwa ta kpa.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ buli bule jo fɛlembɔjena bini, neerare palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ bwejena baah.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: A ɡel kpɔɡ bini ola dɔ nee dɛɛ nyɔ, kpɔɡ bini keeɡore nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpoa ɡe dɔ ane nyɔ.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Jumbii sɔh a kɔne, daa aa cheɡɛ neerare la nyoo ta dɛɛ si.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ bwaala le nyundua, dɛ nɛ bwea dor, asɛ harɛ bwa vaɡɛ ne.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ kpɔɡa moɡɛ nae dɔ dɛɛ di, dɛ ɡel nɛwɛnyina dɔ koo kwaa ɡɛ aa ɛ bá dɔ kondikwaa dɛɛ di,

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: dɛ́ dɔ sen nyɔ ba sie lɛ, ne noo baa kpɔ fɔɡle ba siebɔra á do wer, dɛ kondikwa aa tɛɛ ba bokpeɡa ɡe.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Peleme daa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn, Korowii aa dua la, dɔ bwaala nee kohona.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Jumbii sɔh kɔne a ta, hale chaŋɡale bwa so dakpeɡa la ta.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Kpɔɡ bini boohna soɡe bwejena dor, asɛ kukubane ɡe dɔ sɔɔhbɔra bwea baah.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Henee ta korobie wɛɛ baɡle saŋ, dɛ ɡel wee ɡe ɛɛ jo o saŋ ta.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ bɔr bir dɛ ɛ jwaana, asɛ kpɔɡ bini ola bwa le dɛɛ valɛ.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Nyujentena bii kpaahnɔ dɛɛ kɔɡre, dɛɛ nyin kondikwa hen Korowii aa tɛa.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Wee baa le aa, dɛ a bwa berɔ ka jo a bɔɔne bini chɔ,

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: mɔɔ nɛra le kaa ɛ ba tomare ka tel jɔmɔra.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he cheɡɛ he wejema ta, dɛ ɛ wejena taeh, harɛ nɔ bwa su he kontaala haa taa.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Mpo ɡe kan dɛ do paɡri chɔ, he kontaala anjeɡre ne anjena, aa wola nyoa dɔe bwa su o bini.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Stiimaere kpɔ o sie dɛ la dɛɛ ba, asɛ mpo bini oljen Lɛvayatan, haa tao la ɛɛ hɛlɛ o bini.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Hen Korowii nɛɛ a bwa sie dawɛ kɛŋɔ, he tɛa kondikwaa á di a saŋ ta.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: He dɔɔ dɛ tɛa aa, anee á ɡe dɔ di, he nɔn ta kondikwaa a dɔ di dɛɛ vaɡɛ.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: He laa sie kpɔ a be naa, dɛ ɔmee chole a nɛ, he lɛ hweera haa kpɔa tɛa la aa, a dɛ serewe, dɛ́ berɛ kaa teera haa kpɔa maa la ta.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Hweeraa he hwee do a bini dɛ taa, dɛ ɡel kwaa haa taa bwa dɔ mkpa harɛ ta.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe kɛŋɔ, N Naa Korowii jirima do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la! N dɛ soŋe kɛŋɔ, o sie lɛ kwaa waa taa la ta.

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: O nyiŋi harɛ aa, o dɛ jiɡri, o leɡe bwejena chuu ɛɛ le a ta.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ Korowii n soɡa bini bwa, n ta soɡe le tenaa, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa dɛ́ kpɛɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe kɛ Korowii sie lɛ yel maa dɛ ɡo nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛ onee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe kɛ he chɔɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra le harɛ nɔ ta, nyubinikpeɡ tena bɛ le do kpa. N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne! Hé kpɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Hé jam Korowii dɛ́ yerɛ o sɔn, hé ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa jemɛ waa waa ɛa.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro, dɛ́ bol o nyokpowe-ɛɛla wa.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii dɛ́ na o kpeɡri, dɛ́ɛ tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Hé lii o nyokpowaa waa ɛa, o wejena ne o waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la wa,

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: he Abraham naanar, haa ɛ Jekɔb bibaala waa le heyaa tɛ o te la.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Onee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, o bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Wɛɛ lii o fɔo la waa saŋ bɛlbwaa, o nyoa waa baɡɛ naanar kaɡboŋa baa ka ba la bwa.

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “He ne he naanaree mɛɛ ba Keenan harɛ kpɔe tɛ, ó ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ dɛ Korowii nɛra aa kanɛ, dɛ ɛ hɔɔhra do Keenan harɛ ta.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Dɛ harɛre taa ba do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe. Ba le harɛ bɛl ta naa, dɛ ba kaa bɛl ta.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ta ɡelɛ nomɛlbwa fiɡ ba, ba lɛɛ nomanta, o kah koranar ŋɔ,

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: “Nomɛlbwa bɛ nɔn kpɔ leɡe n bonɔɔna maa lee ba cheɡ tɛ n te nɔ, he bɛ n keamere nɔ bini bɛlbwa ha.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ lɔr chole harɛ la ta, kondikwaa bwa chɔɡ.

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o tɔ sie ɡel ba yoɡ Josef, Ijipt harɛ ta kɛ yom.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ bune jɔɡrɔre do o nakpale ne o baŋa,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: ka tel kɛŋɔ waa waa bola aa ɛa. Korowii waa laanee baɡla kɛŋɔ o waa la ɛ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: O kpɔɔ chɔ harɛ la nyoa, wɛɛ nyiŋi o kwaa bwa ta,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: dɛɛ di kpeɡri o nomonjena bwa nɛ, dɛɛ baɡle o nomonome baa dɛ jao la wa.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Ate, Jekɔb ne o bii ir dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta ka so kɛŋɔ hɔɔhra ken.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ ba ɛ o nɛra, dɛ ɡel ba mun ya ɡwaa ba dɔma.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: O berɛ Ijipt harɛ tena liire, dɛ ɡel ba hah o nɛra, dɛ dɔ liichɔɡa tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Belaa o tomɛ o bonɔɔna Mosis ne Arɔn waa lee ba tɛ o te la.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Ba kaa ɛ nyokpowaa ne wekpeɡa ba bini Ijipt harɛ ta.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ biro tenten ba tɔ harɛ la bwa ta, kɛ Ijipt tena ta o waa ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ ba neerare berɛ chal a pɛŋa bwa serewe.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Sapone baa su harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa, hale koodem ne ba chɔɔbɔra bwa.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Korowii bol wa, asɛ chwɛɛhne ne konjeɡre ba su harɛ la ta bwa,

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel dombwea ber ba bwaala, asɛ bwaala kɔɡre dɛɛ nyɛɡle.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: O chɔɡ ba daa kooni, dɛ kuuɡi harɛ la daa bwa.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: O bol waa asɛ tontombɛ ba su harɛ la ta bwa, baa wola won kura.

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: A di harɛ la ta konlwɛɛ te bɛlbwa, hale koo kondikwaa bwa.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: O kpoo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla bwa, dem bɛlbwa bibanloɡle ta kae.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii tɔ Israel tena sie le Ijipt harɛ ta, ba cheɡɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ba bwara do kpeɡri.
