english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Ijipt tena la sie lɛo kɛŋɔ Israel tena la aa dɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba dɛ ɔm ba.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Ba bɔɔro kondikwaa baa di wa, asɛ o tɛɛ ba chayambwibwi ba chwe, dɛ le kondikwaa ne nyundua ba tɛɛ ba ba di vaɡre.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ bwe bini pere, asɛ nee le dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ, nenapale ken, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Korowii lii nyoa waa baɡɛ o bonɔɔ Abraham, o do ɡoroŋ la wa.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: O kpɔ nɛra bane harɛre ne ba kooni tɛɛ ba a berɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwa,

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ baa teŋɛ o Mmarare, ne waa waa do ba a ta la ta. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii! Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii dɛkalkɛ o wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa ta jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won baɡle wejena waa ɛa kɛɛ dɛ kpɛɛro kɛrɛdɛ nɔ?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta, ba waa toɡre saŋ bɛlbwa la, ba na som.

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: ásɛ n dɔ wedɛɛɡa he nɛra aa dɛ ba dɔe la ane, n ne ba bwa dɔ silɛɛ, ásɛ n ne he nɛra haa lee ba cheɡ la hɛɡre kohona.

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Ya ɛ wechɔɡa kɛ ya naawa ken, ya ɛ nyubinikpeɡ dɛ koni.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Ya naawa fa ta hen Korowii nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa mun noɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta la. Ba soh nyina haa nyin ba la keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, dɛ ɛɛ deŋnekpeɡ Mposwɛm la ta.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Kɛ he lɛɛ ba ɡɛ haa baɡ ba nyoa la, dɛ baɡle ɡɛ haa dɔ kpeɡri kohona.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: He kɔr Mposwɛm asɛ o hweeh, asɛ he tɔ he nɛra sie ba valɛ harɛpɛɛ ta kɛŋɔ, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken dɛ ɛɡɛ le o baŋ.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel nee bɔle ba dɔma bwa nɛ, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Belaa he nɛra yarada waa haa baɡ ba nyoa la, dɛ ɡo yela kpɛɛre.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba soh waa haa ɛa tɛɛ ba buɡ la ta, ba ta bwara sɔɔhnɛ, dɛ no waa haa bol ba be.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Ba pɛla lawɛ kondikwa, asɛ dɛ daah hen Korowii na, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he tɛɛ ba kwaa baa soŋe la, dɛ berɛ kpɔ weechɔɡa ta ba nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Ba sie beɡre Mosis ne he bonɔɔ Arɔn haa lee ba cheɡ, ba do ɡoroŋ tɛɛ la nɛɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Belaa harɛ pere asɛ Datan le o bini, dɛ tɔ Abiram ne o haah ne bii nɛ.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ nabale Sinai Bwejen ta, dɛɛ tomɔ kɛ voɡ ken.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Ba soh hen Korowii, haa cheɡɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta, dɛ lɛɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la wa.

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Nyokpowaa haa ɛa Mposwɛm ta, ne ɔmewaa haa ɛa bela kan kohona.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: He baah diu dɛ fee ŋɔ hɛɛ chɔɡ baa, kɛ Mosis waa ɛ he bonɔɔ, he leo tɛ he te la soŋe, dɛ sɔɔh he bandia nyoa, he ta ban chɔɡɛ kpa.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, ba vɛoh kɛ baa jo harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la taa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta he waa haa baɡ ba nyoa la yaradae.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Ba soɡe ba tɛnte deene bini dɛɛ naɡre wa, ba ta he waa la ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Anomanta, he ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡ ba ŋɔ, hɛɛ ɡeloo bá serewe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta,

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Baa tel Peɔ la, ba kpɔ ba te ka do voɡ Baal lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ di saraha kwaa baa ɛa tɛ voɡa aa wola mkpa dɔe.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: Ba we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ hen Korowii baah di, asɛ he ɡel weechɔɡa ba le ba nɛ.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Ba ɡelɔ hen Korowii baah di ba nɛɛ bule waa lɔ Mɛreba la ta, a kpɔ sibeɡra ta Mosis nɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: Ba ɛ hen Korowii Doma deŋnekpeɡ, anomanta, Mosis piɡro bol waa o fe aa wola liire tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Ba ta nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ kpoorɛ ɡɛ haa do ba la,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: kɛ ba sɛoh ba bii ɛɛ kpɔ dɔŋa, a che a ta, ba kpɔ ba voɡa toma da la.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: He nɛra tomɛ ba voɡa la, asɛ a ɛ bela dɛ laɡ ba.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Ba kpoo ba bibaala ne bihaahna ɛ sarahare tɛ Keenan voɡa.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Ba kpoo bii baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, dɛ ɛ sarahare tɛ voɡa aa lɔ Keenan, asɛ ba chal kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ la.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he baah di he nɛra nɛɛ kohona, asɛ he ki ba we-ɛɛla.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: He vɛɛh ba tɛ nɛra baa wola hen Korowii tomɛ la, asɛ ba do ba lɔɡa dɛɛ tom ba.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Ba dɔma fiɡ ba dɛ ɡel ba do ba lɔɡa.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa he lɛ he nɛra, kɛ dɛ ba sie ta lɔ lwɛmkpeɡ we-ɛɛla ta, a kaa ba ne wechɔɡa kohona ta.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Kɛ baa lɔ wenaale ta la, he chaŋ ba dɛ no ba suna baa dɛ di.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la bwa berɛ na ba sum.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, lɛ yaa dɛ́ berɛ lawɛ yaa le harɛre ta ba, ásɛ ya kpɔ jam tɛɛ dɛ́ kpɛɛ he sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, hé kpɛɛro saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Gel nɛra bwa ŋɔ, “Aamen.” Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
translation_verse: ) Korowii wer waa doa kpɛɛra

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o waa wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: dɛ lawɛ heyaa le harɛfala ta ba le wee leebɔr, dɛ́ ba kaa wee cholibɔr ne weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ́ ba kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr.

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Bane nyoɡre pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela, ba ta bwɛɛ bɛlbwa nae dɛ́ ka so o ta.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Lɔr ne nyɔɡre kpo ba, asɛ ba hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Asɛ ba wahala nae bini la, ba wi no Korowii, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le suna baa dɛ di ta.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: O tɔ ba sie dɛ kpɔ ba pa sie kaa bwɛjen baa ka so o ta.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne nyokpowaa waa ɛa tɛɛ ba la wa,

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ o tɛ nɛra nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo ba nee ba nyɔ, dɛ tɛ banɔ la lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba ɡe kondikondɛɛɡa ba di.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Dɛ ba bini bane soɡe biro tenten ta, ba do ba jɔɡrɔre dɛ laɡ ba do dea, ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ,

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ vɛh waa waa baɡ ba ta teŋa.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Anomanta, o do ba dɛ ɡel ba ɛ tomkpeɡa dɛ ba koh, ba ta nomɛlbwa dɔe o lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Asɛ ba wahala nae bini la, ba wi no Korowii, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le suna baa dɛ di ta.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: O laɡ ba le biro tenten ta dɛ chaa jɔɡrɔre baa kpɔa do ba.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne o nyokpowaa waa ɛa tɛɛ ba la wa,

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ o kuuɡi ayaawa ɡbeni, dɛ teŋni bune baa kpɔa kaɡra.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ ba bini bane ɡɛn, ba wechɔɡa ɡel ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ,

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: dɛ baa kondikwa kwaraa nyin dɛ na, dɛ so dɛɛ kpa seo.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Asɛ ba wahala nae bini la, ba wi no Korowii, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le suna baa dɛ di ta.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: O nyoa wobol chaah ba, dɛ lɛɛ ba le seo ta.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne o nyokpowaa waa ɛa tɛɛ ba la wa.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá kpo kwaa ba ɛ sarahare dɛ́ jam Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ silɛɛ ɡo yela baɡle waa waa ɛa.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Bane kpɔ stiimaere dɛɛ kpɔ mpo sie, dɛ kaa nyin ba nyoa kondikwa.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Ba na waa Korowii aa ɛa, nyokpowaa waa ɛa mpore ta.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: O nyoa wobol ɡelɔ peukpeɡ ta, asɛ dɛ ir mpo nehɛma kohona.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Nehɛma la ɡɔɔ stiimaere la kaa nyundua a ba le vil bini, dɛ ɡel nɛra baa lɔ a bini bambile teŋe.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Ba valɔ dɛɛ yɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛra ken, ba ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Asɛ ba wahala nae bini la, ba wi no Korowii, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le suna baa dɛ di ta.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ peukpeɡ la nyoa sɔɔh, asɛ nehɛma la ɡel lɔe.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Nehɛma la nyoa aa sɔɔhna la, ba sie lɛo, asɛ o tɔ ba sie ba bela baa dɛ nyin ba chuɡe.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne o nyokpowaa waa ɛa tɛɛ ba la wa.

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá bol ɡɛ o sɔn aa kana nɛnlaa baah, dɛ́ kpɛɛro bela ba nomonjena aa chema o Dea.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ nenabɔɔne hweeh pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, buli ɡe ɡel pala,

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel harɛ waa wera berɛ harɛ komɛlbwa aa wola won do wer o ta, nyubinikpeɡ tena ba fa aa soɡe bela la wa.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ berɛ taama, asɛ nee ɛɛ palɛ harɛ waa hola ta.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: O tɛ nɛra lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba ŋwɛnɛ ba ba so bela, asɛ ba ma bwɛjen dɛ so o ta.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Ba parɛ daa kooni, asɛ a nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ ba chaa.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: O swee ba andɛɛɡa ba dɔ bii kohona, ba nae ɡe ya kohona.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra dɔma aa fiɡ ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ nomanta, a ɡelɔ ba nyoa sɔɔh baa di suna.

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: Korowii siwi ta ba nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la sui, a ɡel ba do pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, bela ŋwɛnɛre aa wola toole dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Kɛ o lawɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra le ba wenaale ta, dɛ ɡel ba bii warɛ kɛŋɔ peera ken.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nao ba sie lɛ, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena te, ba helɔ.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa jemɛ waa la, bá kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ do ba liire bini, dɛ́ lii Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la wa.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kohona, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre n bambile bwa ne.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ iruu che, dɛ́ kpɔ janjela ne kwaa bwa soo siwi lɔ yela! Mɛɛ feluu ir mɔɔ bɔr chaah.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ jaamee harɛre nɛra bwa binii, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre nɛnlaa baahnee.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe kan dɛɛ tel nyundua, he wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ ɡe ɛɛ tel bela.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel ya na he kan haa doa nyundua, ásɛ he jirima tɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Lɛ yaa he kpeɡri ne dɛ́ no ya wesoŋa, ɡɛ aa ɛ he lɛ nɛra haa dɛ nyin ba la.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa o Dea bela waa do ɡoroŋ la dɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ yo bwɛjen Sɛkem tenaa dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ bɔne o ne Sukot Fɛlembɔjen bini tɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Gelead harɛ ne Manasɛ dea harɛ bwa ɛ n kwa, Efrem harɛ do kɛŋɔ n laa ɡbɛrɛ, asɛ Juda harɛ ɡe do kɛŋɔ n koodaŋɡbala.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab harɛ nɛra ɛ n bonɔɔna, ba do kɛ loɡ maa dɛ loo kwaa o bini ken, mɛɛ kpɔ n naŋɡawaa ta Edom harɛ ta. N dɛ moo, dɛkalkɛ n pɔ Filisti tena nɛ.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, umee dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ jo bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro nɔ ta nɔ? Umee dɛ́ tɔ n sie kaa Edom ɔ?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Cha yaa ya won pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, nɛwɛnyini chae ɡɛ bɛlbwa naa, a bwa dɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Korowii ja ya nɛ aa, yaa yoo, dɛ́ pɔ ya dɔma nɛ. Wɛɛ tiɡri ya dɔmaa do harɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ kpɛɛre, ir nyu ne, bɛ nyoa tɔ,

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena ne nyosonteŋna dɛ yoo mɛ, ba teŋe nyosone bol waa dɛɛ yaɡ mɛ.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Haeh wobol ɡboo ba bol dɛɛ yaɡ mɛ, dɛɛ yoo mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ haeh chiɡ darame naa ta, kɛ n te, hen Korowiirii n soŋe dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ bɔ mɛ wedɛɛɡa kem, dɛ kpɔ haeh bɔ mɛ nyina kem.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, le nɛnchɔɡe waa bol n dɔm waa dɛ́ pao bole, ɡel o dɔm ɡbaɡba che o nɛ.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Gel ba bol o waa ó di bolchɔɡe, ɡel o wesoŋa kwaraa berɛ wechɔɡa tɛo.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Gel o tɔpera waa di do boraa ken, ásɛ nɛnfale di nomonome waa dɛ di la.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Gel o bii berɛ bilalbii, ásɛ o haah ɛ luhaah.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Gel o bii ɡaaɡe dɛɛ soŋe kwa, ɡel ba doŋ ba le dimɡbeeni baa lɔ a ta la ta.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Gel nɛra waa di ba kema pa o kondɔɔh bwa kaa, dɛ́ ɡel hɔɔhra pa komɛlbwa waa koah dɛ dɔ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa ɛɛ sune o nɛ, dɛ́ ɛo wedɛɛɡa kɛɛ dɛ́ na o bilalbii la sum.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Gel o naanar bwa serewe, dɛ́ ɡel o sɔn nyoɡre naanar baa ka ba bwa bini.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lii o naawa wechɔɡa o sie. Bɛ o nya wechɔɡa kpɔ kɛo bwa.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowiirii dɛ́ lii ba wechɔɡa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ɡel nomɛlbwa bɛ ba waa lii harɛ nɔ ta kpa.

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ dɛ waa wedɛɛɡa lii, dɛ o dɛ kpoo dɛɛ do nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra, dɛ banɔ la ba bambile aa chɔɡa hɔhɔrɔwa.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: N dɔm la dɛ nyin nɛra taahna, ɡel o taahna ɡure o nyu ta. O hah sweera dɛ tɛ o dɔŋ, bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa swee tɛ o ɡe.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: O kpɔ nɛra taahna berɛ batakaare dɛɛ do. Gel o nɛra taahna sɔɔ kɛŋɔ ne, dɛ́ jooɡe o hoɡa bini kɛŋɔ no.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Gel a do kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ batakaare fɔrɔwo, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ kiriso vɔwɔ saŋ bɛlbwa ken!

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, tɛr n dɔm deŋne n wa, tɛr nɛra baa dɛ bol n bwara wechɔɡa la deŋne.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen, Nemenɛ Korowii, che he sɔn ta dɛ́ cha mɛ. Lɛɛ mɛ he wer ne he nyina haa dɔa la wa,

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ n ɛ nyaa dɛ ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre, asɛ n bambile bwa ɛɛ wee mɛ.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba nyoɡra kɛŋɔ bɔr aa joa dɛɛ bir ken. N do kɛŋɔ hɔɔhre peu aa kpɔ mɛ ka ta.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Nyoa vɔwa ɡelɔ n natuune ɛɛ sa, n ɡwaŋɛ ka hoɡa.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Ba na mɛ naa, ba dɛ muɡli n baah, dɛɛ viiɡi ba nyuune.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, cha mɛ, koh he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la waa dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel n dɔma jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Baa taah mɛɛ, kɛ hɛɛ swee mɛ andɛɛɡaa. Ba dɛ yoo mɛ naa, hɛɛ ɡeloo sihiih kpo ba, ásɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ sie lɛ.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Gel sihiih kpo n dɔma kohona, dɛ́ bɔle ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ batakaarejaŋ ken.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ jam Korowii kohonaa, dɛ́ kpɛɛro nɛnlaa bini,

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ o dɛ che nyaara habɔɔ, dɛ lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le nɛra baa kpoo ba nɔn ta.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii ŋɔ n Dɔɔ be ŋɔ, so nomombɔr n diɡ ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba he dɔma ne harɛ he tiɡri ba nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ tɛɛ kpeɡrii Saayɔn, ásɛ he di kora he dɔma baa bare cheme nɛ.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Awola haa yo he dɔma la, he nɛra ɛɛ sɛoh dɛ́ ba teŋɛ he nɛ. He bonɔɔna ɛɛ leo ba he be kɛŋɔ chɔɔlen mɛn ken, he bwe waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Korowii baɡɛ nyoa waa wola o liiree charɛ ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ ɛ sɔfoo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ che he mun taa, o baah diu waa, wɛɛ yo koranaree dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ bol harɛre nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole, ba serewe warɛ chɔ laa ta, dɛ́ kpoo harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Kooro la ɛɛ nyɔ nee ŋwɛnɛ nyoa nepale taa, dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa, dɛ́ yo o dɔma dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii! Mɛɛ jam Korowii n bambile bwa nee, o nɛnlaa baa chema bini.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa dɛ ɛ dɔ nyokpoa, nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta kpɔa do ba liire ta dɛɛ lii saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Jirima ne nyanyini lɔ waa waa dɛ ɛ ta. O waa toɡrɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ yaa lii nyokpowaa waa ɛa, Korowii dɔ tedoma tɛ yaa dɛɛ na ya sum.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: O dɛ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ tomɔ kondikwa, waa o fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la waa soh saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ o nɛra na o kpeɡri waa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma, dɛ lɛ harɛre nɛra bane harɛre tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: O waa waa dɛ ɛ bwa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛ toɡre. Waa waa dɛ do nɛra a ta bwa wer, baa hwɛɡɛ a ta.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: O berɔ kwaa lɛ o nɛra, dɛ ɡel ba di ba nyu. O ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo waa do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. O sɔn do ɡoroŋ dɛ do ɔma kohona.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Korowii ɔmaa dɛɛ ba ɡela he dɔ wejema. Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta la, o ɡelɔ baa no waa mun kohona. Onee chɛ kpɛɛra saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii! Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, o sie ɛɛ lɛ o Mmarare ta kohona la, o na som.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Naate bii ɛɛ di kpeɡri harɛ taa, ásɛ Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ o naanar.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Kondɔɔh ne suuɡa ɛɛ do naate demii, ásɛ o wobɛlbwa do wer, ó ɛ kondɔɔh saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Hale biro ta, nii dɛ chaah nɛn o wa aa toɡra sie, nɛn waa dɔ tedoma ne nɛn nɛɛ suna o waa dɔ kasinteŋ la.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa ta tea dɛɛ kemɛ o bala suuɡa dɛɛ di kasinteŋ o toma ta la, o na som.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Nɛndɛɛɡe wobɛlbwa dɛ do wer dɛɛ tɛo. Nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ lii o waa saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Waa wechɔɡa noɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ, o yarada kan, o kpɔ o te dawɛ Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: O bambile cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ, waa ɔmɛ. O jemɔ kɛ Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ó pɔ o dɔma nɛ.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Waa nɔn nyore, o dɛ tɛ nyaara tɛɛ tenten, o wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta jaɡa dɔe, wɛɛ di kpeɡrii dɛ dɔ jirima.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ nao ba baah di kohona, ásɛ ba liire chɔɡ ba che dɛɛ nyiŋi ba hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii! Nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, hé kpɛɛro dɛ́ yerɛ o sɔn.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛro dɛ́ tɛo sɔn, le saŋ nɔ ne saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ di kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ. Nɛra dɛ kpɛɛ o jirima waa dɔa nyundua.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Umee do kɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, o so o kookara ta nyundujaɡla,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: dɛ ba sie ne harɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi nyundua ne harɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: O lawɛ nɛra dɛɛ le ba nyaa ta, dɛ lɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra dɛɛ le ba sum ta.

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: O dɛ do ba koobii bini ba ne baa di kora, hale Korowii nɛra baa ɛ nomonjena bini.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: O swee hambara andɛɛɡa o dem, o berɛ won dɔ bii o sie lɛ. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Awola Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta, Jekɔb naanar aa le harɛ baa kaa ɛ hɔɔhra o ta la,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ Juda tena ɛ o nɛra baa do ɡoroŋ, Israel tena ɡe ɛ o kapɛrɛ nɛra.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Mposwɛm pere anɛ ba siwi ta, asɛ Jɔɔdan Moo ɡe ɡel pala.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Bwejena dɛ jah kɛŋɔ pebala, asɛ deŋɡarere ɡe ɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ pebiiri ken.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Bɔkwa waa bala Mposwɛm pere anɛ, asɛ Jɔɔdan Moo ɡe ɡel pala ɔ?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Bwejena, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ pebala nɔɔ? Deŋɡarere, ɛrɛɛ he ɡe ɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ pebiiri nɔɔ?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Hárɛ, jiɡri Korowii sie, Korowii Jekɔb aa dɛ tomɔ sie.

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: Onee ɡela nee bule le bwe ta dɛ berɛ tam, dɛ ɡel nee le bwekpeɡ ta, dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ nenapale.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne he kasinteŋ nomanta, he ɡbosoroo chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ jirima tɛ, ya te laa.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ harɛre nɛra ɛɛ bɔɔ yaa ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la lɔ nyundua, waa aa too o tea laanee wɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm nee ba ɛ ba voɡare, nɛwɛnyinii kpɔ nɔɔra ɛa.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: A dɔ nyoo, aa won bol wa, dɛ dɔ sibie, aa na.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: A dɔ deŋna, aa waa no, dɛ dɔ mee, aa sɔɔh no.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: A dɔ nɔɔra, aa won kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa, dɛ dɔ nakpale, aa won valɛ, aa won do ɡbɔɡa bɛlbwa ɡe.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kwaara ne nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ a nɛɛ bwa ɛɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋii.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛ, onee dɛɛ cha heya, dɛɛ tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Korowii sɔfore, hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛ, onee dɛɛ cha heya, dɛɛ tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛ, onee dɛɛ cha heya, dɛɛ tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ lii ya waa, dɛ swee yaa andɛɛɡa. Wɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ Israel tena ne o sɔfore bwa.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ, nɛnjena ne nɛmpɛɛne bwa.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡel hé ya, he ne he bii bwa.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ la, swee heya andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ nyundua ɛ o dobɔr, dɛ kpɔ harɛ nɔ tɛ ya nɛwɛnyina.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Nɛn sewaa, waa won kpɛɛ Korowii, nomɛlbwa aa won kpɛɛro lalabwɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Kɛ yan ya taa soɡe le nɔ te, yaa kpɛɛroo le fini ne saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: N wio noo waa, o cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no n be saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Seo vɔɡ mɛ bil, lalbɔɔ weweele bɔle n nɛ n liire chɔɡ, ɔmee su n bwa.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Belaa n yerɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Korowii waa toɡrɔ wɛɛ sune nɛn nɛ. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ dɔ tedoma.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n liiro ŋɔ, N wee, ɡel he baah sɔɔh name, nyiŋa Korowii aa nyiŋi n nɛɛ la wa.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he lee mɛ seo nyoa, dɛ fee n siniire, he ta ɡelɛ n lɔ na,

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel n won dɛɛ valɛ he sie weera harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: N yaradae, hale n ŋɔ, “Weweele ta ɡelɛ n bwara ɛɛ sɔɔh mɛ.”

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: N liire aa chɔɡa la, n ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe!”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba wona kpɔ chiɡ hen Korowii wedɛɛɡa haa ɛa tɛ mɛ nɔ naa ta nɔ?

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɛ sen sarahaa tɛɛ, dɛ jaame, lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: He nɛra warɔ dɛ cheme aa, belaa mɛɛ ba n nyobaɡa maa baɡɛ la chuɡra.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra o be la waa hiaoh, ba seo ɡelɔ o loo ɛɛ ku.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n ɛ he bonɔɔ kpela, n tomɛ ɡɛ n nya aa tomɛ. He lɛɛ mɛ le seo nyoa.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpo kwaa ɛ jam sarahaa tɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ n wesoŋa bil he sie.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: He nɛra warɔ dɛ cheme aa, belaa mɛɛ ba n nyobaɡa maa baɡɛ la chuɡra,

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: he Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bini. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra bwa, hé jam N Naa Korowii, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛro!

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa kan kohona. O waa dɔ kasinteŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o waa wer. O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Arɔn naanar, hé ŋɔ, “O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: He banɔ la bwa haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, hé ŋɔ, “O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Maa lɔ weweele ta la, n wio no Korowii, asɛ o chaŋ mɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Korowii ja n nɛ, maa ɔmɛ. Ɛrɛɛ nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ mɛ nɔ?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Korowii ja n nɛɛ dɛɛ cha mɛ, anomanta, mɛɛ won pɔ n dɔma nɛ.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: A wer kohona kɛ nɛn kpɔ o te do Korowii lɔɡa, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ o te dawɛ nɛwɛnyini nɛ.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ bwa bar mɛ cheme, kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ n habɔɔ dɛ ɡel n pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba bar mɛ cheme, kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ n habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel n pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Ba warɔ bar mɛ cheme, kɛŋɔ toohna ken, kɛ ba serewɔ wɔrɔbe nɛ, kɛŋɔ nii aa le sɔɔhne baah ken, asɛ Korowii che n habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel n pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Ba baa yoo mɛ, a ka tama ba fee pɔ n nɛ, kɛ Korowii cha mɛ.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: N bokpeɡa maa dɔa ne n kpeɡri bwa le Korowii be, onee nɛn waa dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: O kpeɡri ɡelɔ ya pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, o won wekpeɡa kohona ɛɛ.”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Maa sewa ba, mɛɛ so lee dɛ́ baɡle waa Korowii aa ɛa.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Korowii tɛr n deŋne kohona, kɛ o ta ɡelɛ n sewɛ.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Hé pili Korowii Dea doonyoo tɛ mɛ, bela nɛra ba wa aa toɡra aa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, ásɛ n jo kpɔ jam ka tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Korowii Dea doonyoa laanee la, o taa nɛra ba wa aa toɡra che dɛɛ jo.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ kpɔ jamee tɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ he no n be dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Bwe la mamaala aa vɛoh dɛ liiru konsala laanee bera ba lawɛ dea la kpoŋe la.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ɡela a ɛ ɡɛ, asɛ a ɛ yaa nyokpowa.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Finii ɛ tɔpere yaa kpɔa dɛɛ lii awola Korowii aa pɔ o dɔma nɛ. Hé ɡel ya sie lɛ, yaa hɛɡre a wa.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ba lɛ yaa, ɡel ya wobɛlbwa chiɡ yaa kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Korowii swee naate waa valɛ o sɔn ta dɛɛ ba nɔ andɛɛɡa. Ya cheɡɛ Korowii Dea dɛɛ sweere andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Korowii beŋkpoŋ ɡboo lole, on sune ya nɛɛ dɛ lɛ yaa. Hé pa he tɔpejen dii la mun, dɛ́ kpoŋe bambie daa, dɛ́ ka valɛ bar kwaa aa do kɛ nyeɡlare, dɛ do Korowii saraha on la bɔr la.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, n kpɔ jam dɛɛ tɛɛ, mɛɛ bol he kan haa doa waa.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o waa wer. O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba we-ɛɛla aa toɡra, baa teŋɛ Korowii Mmarare ta la, ba na som.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ nyin o waa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta bambile bwa ne la, ba na som.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: Baa wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛ, ba dɛ valɛ o ŋwɛnɛre waa baɡla la ta.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he kpɔ he Mmarare tɛ yaa, dɛ ŋɔ yá kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ n waa fe dɔ kasinteŋ, mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta!

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Dɛ n do sie dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta naa, sihiih aa men kpo bwa.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɛ hweli he wa aa toɡra dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta naa, mɛɛ dɔ bambidɛɛɡee dɛɛ kpɛɛre.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare taa, bɛ men vɛh kwara. Korowii Mmarare ta teŋa

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ bonɔɔ we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ba wona do wer he be nɔ? Nemenɛ wɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: N dɛ tomɛ n bambile bwa ne. Bɛ ɡel n vɛh waa haa do mɛ a ta la ta teŋa.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: N kpɔ he waa do n bambile bini, dɛ bɛ hen wechɔɡa ɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ kpɛɛre, baɡ mɛ he Mmarare la.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ dɛɛ bol he waa haa kpɔa baɡ mɛ laanee nɛra be.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: N sie dɛ lɛ he waa ta teŋa, ɡwaa kɛ maa dɔ kondɔɔh kohona.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: N kpɔ he waa la do n nyu bini, dɛɛ kari a bwa.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin he Mmarare la kohona, maa he waa laanee vɛh. Korowii waa ta teŋa dɔ silɛɛ

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ n won so dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa haa baɡ mɛ la ta.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Pili n sie, ń won jemɛ he waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ he Mmarare ta la.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: N ɛ hɔɔh harɛ nɔ ta, bɛ he waa haa do mɛ a ta la kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: N bambile lawɔ kɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare la ta, saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: He dɛ kah mbarafo tena, dɛɛ taah nɛra baa vɛh he waa ta teŋa.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le chɛɡa ne sihiih ta, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: A lole kɛ nɛra baa dɛ di kpeɡri dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa, kɛ mɛɛ kpɔ he waa laanee do n nyu bini.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: He Mmarare laanee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ, anee dɛɛ ja mɛ. Korowii Mmara ta teŋa siswɛm ne

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: N cheɡɛ seo nyoa, ɡel he waa la tɛ mɛ bokpeɡfala, ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: N bol n wenaale baɡle, asɛ he chaŋ mɛ, baɡ mɛ he ŋwɛnɛre.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Cha mɛ ń won no he waa la mun, ásɛ mɛɛ lii he nyokpowe-ɛɛla la.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: N dɛ di suna kohona, tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa, ɡɛ haa baɡɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Lee mɛ waa aa ɛ nyosone ta, he wa aa toɡra nomanta, chaɡ mɛ he Mmarare la.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ n waa dɔ kasinteŋ, dɛ kpɔ n te dawɛ he waa ta.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n lawɛ he Mmarare la kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ, bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ swɛɛ siwii dɛɛ teŋɛ he webaɡla ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he cha mɛ, dɛ ɡel mɛɛ no waa mun kɛrɛdɛ. Waa mun noe wesoŋa

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, baɡ mɛ he Mmarare la, ásɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ a ta saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Cha mɛ n won dɛɛ no waa mun, ásɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta, n bambile bwa ne.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Chaɡ mɛ he waa ŋwɛnɛre mɛɛ kpɔ a ta, dɛkalkɛ a taa mɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Gel mɛɛ nyin he waa ta teŋa ta, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ maa dɔ kwa.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel n pɛla do kwaa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe ta. Tɛ mɛ mkpa ɡɛ he waa la aa baɡla la.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ kon haa baɡ mɛ nyoa, ɡɛ haa baɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ la.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le chɛɡa maa dɛ ɔmɛ kohona ta, dɛkalkɛ he waa dɔ nyokpoa.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin he waa la ta teŋa kohona. Che toɡra he wa aa toɡra ta dɛ tɛ mɛ mkpa. Korowii waa la yaradae

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel n na he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la. Lɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ haa baɡɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: Ásɛ n won chaŋe nɛra baa dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, dawa maa kpɔ n te dawɛ he waa ta nomanta.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Gel n won kasinteŋ bola saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n hwɛɡa bwa lɔ he waa la ta.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare la taa, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ valɔɔ maa wola ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bol he waa koranar sie, sihiih aa wola men kpo.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ nyin he Mmarare la nomanta, n sie dɛ lɛ a ta teŋa ta.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin he waa la dɛɛ duura, mɛɛ kpɔa do n nyu bini. Yarada dɔe Korowii Mmara ta wa

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Lii men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ waa haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la. A ɡelɔ n dɔ hwɛɡa.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Bolarawa maa dɔa dɛ le n wenaale bini laanee kɛŋɔ, he nyoa haa baɡ mɛ la ɡelɔ n dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n lii he Mmarare aa lole dɛ le saŋ la bwa wa aa, dɛ n dɔ bolarawa.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: N nao kɛ nɛnchɔɡa vɛh he Mmarare la ta teŋa aa, dɛ n baah diu.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: N soɡa tama harɛ nɔ ta nɔ, he waa laanee ber mɛ yela mɛɛ ɡo.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, hale jwaana n dɛ lii he wa, dɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Anee ɛ waa maa dɛ ɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa la ta tɔpere bɛlbwa. Korowii Mmarare ta teŋa kasinteŋ ne

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee n komɛlbwa. N sɛoh kɛŋɔ mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare la taa.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: N bambile bwa nee mɛɛ nyin he bɔr. Sune n nɛ, ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: N nyiŋi ɡɛ n we-ɛɛla aa doa dɛ charɛ n liire, dɛ baa teŋɛ he waa la ta.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɛ waranee maa wola hɛlɛ, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ waa haa do mɛ a ta la.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Hale nɛnchɔɡa har mɛ bela kwaraa naa, maa he Mmarare laanee soh bwa.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Harambaŋa n yon ir dɛ́ɛ kpɛɛre, ɡɛ he waa la aa toɡra wa.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: N kpɔ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tomɛ la ɛ n dam, nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta bwa.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe su harɛ nɔ ta bwa. Baɡ mɛ he Mmarare la. Korowii Mmarare wer aa doa

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he teŋɛ he nyobaɡa ta, dɛ ɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ wedɛɛɡa.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Tɛ mɛ wejema ne liire, dawa maa kpɔ n te dawɛ he Mmarare ta la nomanta.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ he tɛr n deŋne la, dɛ wechɔɡaa n ɛ, kɛ taraken te n dɛ teŋɛ waa haa do mɛ la ta.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: He waa wer, he wobɛlbwa ɡe wer, chaɡ mɛ he waa la.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Mbarafo tena teŋe nyosone dawɛ n nɛ, kɛ n bambile bwa nee mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Ba nyu bini kpeɡri, ba tea aa nɛn nɛɛ domɛ, kɛ he Mmarare la taa mɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: A wer kɛ maa dɔ deŋnetɛra, dɛkalkɛ a ɡelɔ n won hweli he waa la.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Mmarare haa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la ɡwaa mɛ harɛ nɔ ta suuɡa bwa, hale suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ta an tele. Korowii Mmara kasinteŋ aa dɔa

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Henee ta mɛ, dɛ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ. Tɛ mɛ waa mun noe, ń kpɔ hweli he Mmarare la.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ la na mɛ naa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo, dɛkalkɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ he waa la ta.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ he bole pae toɡrɔ, he che kasinteŋ ta dɛ tɛr n deŋne.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la larawe n bwara ɡɛ haa baɡɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nyoa la.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Sune n nɛ, ásɛ n won so le, dɛkalkɛ n sie dɛ lɛ he Mmarare la ta teŋa ta.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Gel sihiih kpo mbarafo tena, nyosone baa teŋa dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛ pɛɛpɛɛ wa, kɛ n te, mɛɛ dɛɛ lii he waa laanee.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Gel nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ la berɛ ba n be, nɛra baa jemɛ he Mmarare la bwa.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Gel n bambile lawɛ he waa la, mɛɛ teŋɛ a ta kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ sihiih bɛ men kpo. Korowii nɛn lɛɛ wesoŋa

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n nyiŋi he siwi ta kɛ hɛɛ ba lɛɛ mɛɛ kahonɛ, n hwɛɡa bwa lɔ he waa la ta.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: N nyiŋi waa haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la ŋwɛnɛ dɛ ba koh, dɛɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba n bwara larawa ɔ?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: N do kɛ yakwajɛɡla, baa wola men kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa ken, kɛ n ta he Mmarare la soɛh.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: N kpae ka tel saŋ besoo? Bɛweeree hɛɛ ba n dɔma deŋne tɛra ɔ?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Mbarafo tena baa wola he Mmarare ta teŋɛ kwi bɔɔne, dɛ́ kpɔ har mɛ bela.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: A ka tama ba kpo mɛ, kɛ n ta he Mmarare ta teŋa ɡelɛ bwa.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, ásɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he webaɡla bwa ta. Yarada dɔe Korowii Mmara ta

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, a cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ nyundua.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: He kasinteŋ lole ka tel ya naanar baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ bwa. Henee kpɔ harɛ cheɡ o chebɔr asɛ o do le.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: He nyoa wobol nee he ta kwaa bwa, asɛ a do le ba le fini, dɛkalkɛ a bwa lɔ he lɔɡa.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Dɛ he waa ta laa n silɛɛ che naa, n fe sewɛ n wenaale ta.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Maa he waa laanee vɛh bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ maa dɛ teŋɛ a ta waa he ɡel n so le.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ henee dɔɔ mɛ, n takapɔ dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa la ta.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡa dɛ́ kpa kɛŋɔ bá kpo mɛ, kɛ ane a bwa, maa he Mmarare la ta teŋaa ɡel, mɛɛ dɛɛ liiraa.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ nyin he Mmarare la kɛrɛdɛ, tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ lii a wa.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: He Mmarare la lɔ n liire bini tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛ ɡel n dɔ wejema, dɛ ɡwaa n dɔma.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: N dɔ wejema dɛ ɡwaa nomonome baa hwɛɛhra, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ nyin mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta nomanta, n laa n te kpɔ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: N ta he Mmarare la vɛɛh, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee baɡ mɛ wa.

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: He waa la do kɛ kandea dɛ tɛ mɛ, dɛ ɛ nii dɛɛ chaah mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, bela bwa maa kpɔ.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare aa toɡra la taa.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n na wahala kohona, tɛ mɛ bokpeɡfala ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no n jaama maa dɛ jaame nɔ, dɛ́ chaɡ mɛ he Mmarare la.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa n cheɡɛ seo nyoa, n ta he waa soɛh bwa.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡa har mɛ bel, kɛ n ta habɔɔ berɛ kpo he Mmarare la bwa.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: He Mmarare la do kɛ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa tɛ mɛ saŋ bɛlbwa ken, anee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: N bambile lawɔ kɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa la taa, ka tel tɔpere maa sewɛ. Bosɔɔhna aa lɔ Korowii Mmara ta

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: N hah nɛra baa wola bambile bwa kpɔe dɛɛ tomɛ, kɛ n te dɛ nyin he Mmara la.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Henee n chwa baa marɛ hɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, n kpɔ n hwɛɡa bwa do he waa la ta.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Hé le n nɛɛ kaa, wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, ásɛ n won dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa do mɛ ta!

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa ásɛ n won so le, ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la. Bɛ ɡel n hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Laɡ mɛ kpoŋe, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ, ásɛ n cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no waa he Mmarare la aa dɛ baɡle.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Haa nɛra baa vɛh he Mmarare ta teŋa nyin, dɛkalkɛ ba nyosone vɔrɔwa bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡa do kɛŋɔ haahra he siwi ta, anomanta, n sie dɛ lɛ he webaɡla ta.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: He ɔma ɡelɔ n bwara ɛɛ chel, n dɛ ɔmɛ he Mmarare la. Korowii Mmarare ne a ta teŋa

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: N ɛ wa aa toɡra dɛ do wer, bɛ men ɡel tɛ n dɔma.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, bɛ men ɡel tɛ mbarafo tena bá fiɡ mɛ.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: N nyiŋi he siwi ta dɛ ba koh kɛ hɛɛ ba lɛɛ mɛɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi nyoa haa baɡ mɛ ŋɔ, hɛɛ ba lɛɛ mɛɛ la.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la nyin mɛ, dɛ́ chaɡ mɛ he Mmarare la.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ waa mun noe, ásɛ n won no he waa la mun.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin he Mmarare haa dɛ do mɛ a ta la ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm, hale suuɡaswɛm tenten bɛlbwa,

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: anomanta, n dɛ teŋɛ he webaɡla ta, dɛ hah waa aa wola were te bɛlbwa. Korowii Mmara ta teŋa nyina

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: He webaɡla waa dɔ nyokpoa, anomanta, n dɛ teŋɛ a ta n bambile bwa ne.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: He waa la baɡla ɡelɔ nɛra liire bini ɛɛ chaah, dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ wejema.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: N pɛla lawɛ he Mmarare kohona, n sie beɡrɔ kɛ ń jemɛ waa aa dɛ baɡle.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Berɛ sie n be, dɛ́ na n sum, ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyini bwa la.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel n lɔ na, ɡɛ haa baɡɛ nyoa la, dɛ bɛ ɡel wechɔɡa ɡwaa n nɛ.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ mɛ nɔn ta, ásɛ n won dɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare la ta.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛ, dɛ́ chaɡ mɛ he waa la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he waa toɡrɔ, he Mmarare ɡe do wer.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: N baah dɛ fuh kohona kɛŋɔ nii ken, dɛkalkɛ n dɔma laa sie kpɔ he webaɡla ta.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: He nyoa haa baɡa ɛ kasinteŋ. Men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ sie dɛ lɛ a ta.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ n toole wobɛlbwa bini te, kɛ maa he webaɡla la soh.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: He toɡra haa toɡra ta jaɡa dɔe, asɛ he Mmara ɡe dɔ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Wenaale ne suna su n bwa, kɛ he waa laanee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: He webaɡla toɡrɔ saŋ bɛlbwa. Tɛ mɛ waa mun noe, ásɛ n won so le. Korowii nɛn lɛɛ wesoŋa

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ yerɛ n bambile bwa ne. Sɛh n be, mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare taa.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: N wio dɛɛ yerɛ. Lɛɛ mɛ, ásɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ wee aa le chɔmbibii la, dɛ n wio noe kɛ he cha mɛ. N kpɔ n hwɛɡa do he waa la ta.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: He Mmarare la waa lɔ n nyubini. Jwaana bwaa mɛɛ lii a wa, maa dom chɔ.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ta, dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ. Sune n nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena baa teŋɛ n nɛɛ puu mɛ tonɛ, baa he Mmarare ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Korowii, he ja n nɛ, he Mmarare bwa ɡe ɛ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Saŋ la bwaa he waa la do le n hwela, a lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Chae wesoŋa

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi wahala maa dɛ na, ásɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ta he Mmara la vɛɛh.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Bol n waa tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ. Kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Haa nɛnchɔɡa lɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa he Mmarare la kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ waane.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Korowii, he tedoma haa dɔa kan, sune n nɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: N dɔma warɔ, ba ɛ nɛnchɔɡa dɛɛ fiɡ mɛ, kɛ n ta sie laa kpɔ he Mmarare ta.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Maa nɛra baa wola hen yarada la nyin, dɛkalkɛ baa he Mmarare ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin he webaɡla, che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: He waa bwa ɛ kasinteŋ, he Mmarare la toɡre, dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa. Korowii nyina ne o Mmarare ta teŋa kasinteŋ ne

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: N dɔma baa kpeɡa dɛ yoo mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, kɛ he waa laanee mɛɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: N ki waa aa ɛ nyosone kwaraa, kɛ he Mmarare la te, n dɛ nyina.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: N dɛ kpɛɛre kera anuanɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ he waa la toɡrɔ.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ nyin he Mmarare la, dɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna kohona, komɛlbwa aa won ɡel ba lɔ na.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ kpae kɛ he ba lɛɛ mɛ. N dɛ teŋɛ he waa haa do mɛ la ta.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin he Mmarare la n bambile bwa ne, dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: N dɛ teŋɛ he webaɡla, ne he Mmarare bwa ta. He te jemɛ n waa bwa maa dɛ ɛ. Chae wesoŋa

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no n wii maa wia dɛɛ noe nɔ, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ waa mun noe liire, ɡɛ he waa la aa dɛ baɡle la.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: No n wesoŋa, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwaa, dɛkalkɛ he dɛ baɡ mɛ he Mmarare.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡo he waa la yelaa, dɛkalkɛ he waa haa do mɛ a ta la toɡrɔ.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ teŋɛ he webaɡla ta nomanta, kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ n nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n sie dawɛ he nɛɛ kɛ he lɛɛ mɛ, he Mmarare laanee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Gel n dɔ mkpa, ásɛ dɛ won kpɛɛre, ɡel he Mmarare la cha mɛ.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ do kɛŋɔ pee waa nyoɡra ken. Ba ɡaaɡe n bɔr, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n ta he Mmarare la vɛɛh.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ le nyosonteŋna baa dɛ neɡre nɛra nɔn ta.

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Banyoo hɛma aa nyɛɡa, ne hɔla aa dɛ hɔ kohona nee wɛɛ ba he deŋne tɛra.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: N na waa kɛŋɔ maa soɡe Mɛsɛk ne Keda tena baa ɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena baah.

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: N ne nɛra baa hah deŋnesɔɔhna soɡo biɡri to.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna, kɛ n bol wa aa, dɛ a berɛ naɡra ba be.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: N ha sie nyiŋi bwejena dor. Umee n dɔ ó ba cha mɛ nɔ?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii bee n chae ɛɛ ba lee. Onee ta nyundua ne harɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Waa ɡel he lɔ naa dɛ́ chole. Korowii waa kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛɛ la aa dom chɔ.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Korowii waa kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ Israel tena nɛɛ la siwi lole saŋ bɛlbwa, waa dom chɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛ, o lɔ he jwɛɛh dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa kpoŋe, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ webaŋa ne jwaanaa, wobɛlbwa aa heyaa ha.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heyaa le siswɛm bɛlbwa taa, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ ken.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛɛ he buse bala ne he buse lee bini, le fini ne saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: N sie lɛo kɛ baa ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ir ya la Korowii Dea.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Taraken Jerusalam, he doonyoonee ya che nɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Jerusalam ɛ bwɛjen baa ma o deene a farɛ, dɛ do wer kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Belaa Israel deene bwa ɛɛ cheme dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, ɡɛ waa do ba la.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Devid luɡe koranar fa so, dɛ bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Soŋe deŋnesɔɔhna tɛ Jerusalam tena ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa dɛ nyin hen Jerusalam la, ba wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Kórowii ɡel deŋnesɔɔhna do Jerusalam baa ma danjwɛjen baro, ne o kooderemi bwa ta.”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: N lolanar ne n daamanar nomanta, n soŋe deŋnesɔɔhna dɛɛ tɛ Jerusalam tena!

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea nomanta, n dɛ soŋe ŋɔ hé wobɛlbwa chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he siwi taa mɛɛ nyiŋi nyundua, bela haa dɛ di kora la.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, sune ya nɛ, nɛra aa yaa komɛl yerɛ.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Dɔɔhna mamɛ yaa biɡri, mbarafo tena nyiŋi yaa vah.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii fe ta ya nɛɛ jae yaa, ɛrɛɛ ya fe ɛɛ ba doe yɔ? Israel tena, hé bwa chaŋe!

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii fe ta ya nɛɛ jae, ɡɛ saŋ ya dɔma aa baa yo yaa la aa,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: ba bandia kohona nomanta, ba fe kpoo ya bwa.

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: A fe ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nee aa sua ba bɔle ya nɛɛ ken, dɛ́ fee kpɔ yaa kaa.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ Korowii, waa wola ɡelɛ ya dɔma chɔɡ yaa la wa.

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Ya ɛo kɛŋɔ jumbie waa foora le kpaah bel ta ken. Bel la kuuɡo asɛ ya dɔ ya nyu.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ bee ya chae bwa le.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ la do kɛŋɔ Saayɔn Bwejen. Baa yiiɡi bwa, dɛ che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Gɛ bwejena aa bar Jerusalam dɛɛ tɔɔ ɡbemɡbe la, ɡɛɛ Korowii bar o nɛra cheme fini ne tɔpere bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɛ nɛra ba wa aa wera wedɛɛɡa, nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta la.
