english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he tɛr nɛnchɔɡa deŋne aa, tɛr nɛra baa vɛh he waa ta teŋa la ɡe deŋne. Israel tena, Korowii tɛ heyaa deŋnesɔɔhna!

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Korowii aa bera lawɛ yaa ba Jerusalam la, dɛ a do kɛŋɔ deera ken ya be.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Ya sie lɛo kohona, ya mamɛ dɛɛ ɡo yela, asɛ harɛre nɛra bwa bol ya waa ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛ wejena tɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, ya sie lɛo kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ɛ wejena tɛ yaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡel ya wobɛlbwa berɛ do wer tɛ yaa kɛŋɔ, bwaala yon nɛ do nenabɔɔne aa hola ta á suuɡi la ken.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ siniire du kwaa la, baa koma silɛɛ nee dɛɛ ɡo yela.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ siniire dɛ che ba kondwee le ka du la, baa komaa dɛ chea ba silɛɛ yela ne.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii ta chae ba ma dea aa, mamaala koeh bwa ɛ pɛɛ. O ɡbabir ta bwɛɛ daahnɛ aa, nɛra baa dɛ daah la dɛ koh pɛɛ.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: A ɛ wepuu kɛ nɛwɛnyini le chɔɔ ɛ toma ka tel jɔmɔra, kondikwaa waa di ɡbo wa, dɛkalkɛ nɛra Korowii aa dɛ nyin ba la, ba chɔ dom kwara naa, o dɛ tɛɛ ba ba konnyina.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Bii ɛ kwaa Korowii aa swee nɛra andɛɛɡa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Bibaala baa aa lola o bonɔɔne saŋ la, do kɛŋɔ laa te waa kpoŋe hɛma ken.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa waa dɔ ɡɛ bibaala la, o na som. O ne o dɔma chemo aa, baa won pɔ o nɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta la, ba na som.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Naate ɛɛ di o koeh tɔnɔɔ, dɛ́ na som o wobɛlbwa do wer tɛo.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: O haah ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ daa waa won nɔna kohona ken. O bii ɛɛ do kɛ daa o nɔna aa wara, dɛ́ baro cheme.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba andɛɛɡa sweera tɛ o ɡe.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Kórowii che o Dea waa lɔ Saayɔn sweere andɛɛɡa he soɡa bini bwa, dɛ́ ɡel he na Jerusalam wer doe.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ó ɡel he so biɡri, dɛ́ na he naanar. Israel tena, Korowii tɛ heya deŋnesɔɔhna!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: N bonɔɔne saŋ bwaa ba le fiɡ mɛ kohona. Israel tena, hé chaŋe ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Le ya bonɔɔne saŋ bwaa ya dɔma yo yaa taeh, kɛ ba ta wone pɔ ya nɛ.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Ba chɛwɛ ya nyaŋre yaa na wahala, kɛŋɔ paa yon kpɔ par chɛwɛ harɛ la ken.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii o wa aa toɡra la lɛ yaa le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Kórowii ɡel sihiih kpo nɛra baa hah bwɛjen Saayɔn la, bá berɛ habɔɔ kaa.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Kórowii ɡel bá do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa le saldoa, aa wola won kpeɡ dɛ a holɔ la ken.

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: Aa kpeɡ ba won dɛɛ boa a nyoa kɛɛ a won su nɔn.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa teŋe ba kaa dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Kórowii sweere andɛɛɡa!” dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Ya cheɡɛ Korowii sɔn ta soŋe andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ bwa.”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n bambichɔɡ do kɛŋɔ maa le vil bini, dɛ wi dɛɛ yerɛ!

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: No n wii maa wia dɛɛ yerɛ. Cheɡ deŋne no n be, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Dɛ he fe chwerɛ nɛn wechɔɡa waa dɛ ɛ dɛɛ bil aa, umee dɛ́ fe leɔ?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Kɛ he kpɔ ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ yaa, asɛ a che a ta yaa ɔmɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: N dɛ kpa sibeɡra ne kɛŋɔ Korowii ba cha mɛ. O waa la taa mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: N dɛ kpa Korowii sibeɡra ne, ɡwaa ɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah bɔr jwaana, yon dɛɛ nyiŋi bɔr chaahna ŋwɛnɛ kohona la.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa do Korowii nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o nyina ta jaɡa dɔe, dɛ́ sɛh kɛ saŋ bɛlbwa wɛɛ lɛ heyaa.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ lɛ o nɛra Israel tenaa le ba wechɔɡa bwa ta.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n ɡel mbarafo ɛɛ, maa n te ɡɔɔ kpa. N liire toole wejena kɛɛ nyokpowa aa ɡwaa n nɛɛ ta.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: N liire ba harɛ n deŋne sɔɔh mɛ. Gɛ bechala yon dawɛ o nya nakpale ta jeiih o bwara sɔɔhno la, ɡɛɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé kpɔ hwɛɡa do Korowii nɛ, le saŋ nɔ dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lii Kooro Devid ne wahala waa naa wa.

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: O ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡle hen Korowii, Nemenɛ Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɛ la ŋɔ,

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “Maa n demii la, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ chɔ n kalaŋ taa.

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: ka tel kɛŋɔ maa nyin sobɔr tɛ N Naa Korowii, Nemenɛ Korowii, Jekɔb Kpeɡnɛn waa tomɔ la.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Yaa lɔ Bɛtlɛham la, ya no Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la wa, dɛ ka nao Kiriat Jearim tena kooni ta.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Belaa ya ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel yá kaa Korowii be o Dea, dɛ́ ka tomɔ o kookara la sie.”

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ir kpɔ He Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka waa cheɡa tɛ he kpeɡri la ba he Dea, dɛ́ ba so bonɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Gel he sɔfore teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra, ásɛ he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa ɡe do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ ne.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: He baɡɛ Kooro Devid nyoa, haa wola nyoa charɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar bini bɛl ba di he kara.

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Korowii le Saayɔn cheɡ, dɛ kpɔ bela ɛ o soŋnibɔr.

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔ mɛɛ ba soɡa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, bonɔɔ mɛɛ nyin ń so dɛ́ di kora.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛ Saayɔn tena ba konnyinaa, dɛ́ tɛ ba nyaara kondikwaa bá di dɛ́ vaɡre.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ swee Saayɔn sɔfore andɛɛɡaa wobɛlbwa baa dɛ ɛ ta, ásɛ o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yela saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lawɛ Kooro Devid naanar la bini bɛlee, dɛ́ cheɡo kora ta Saayɔn wɛɛ di kpeɡri, dɛ́ ɡel kooro maa leo cheɡ la jirima ɛɛ chaah, kɛŋɔ nii waa dɛ chaah saŋ bɛlbwa ken.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Sihiih ɛɛ kpo o dɔmaa kohona, kɛ o te kora ɛɛ dɔ jirimaa kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Na wer ne silɛɛ aa dɔa kohona, kɛ nɛn ne o dɔŋa aa soɡe sodɛɛɡa nyopɛo ne!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: A wer dɛ do kɛŋɔ, baa dɛ cheɡ Arɔn sɔfore ta, dɛ fuɡe noo a yoɡ aa kpeɡa do o nyu ta, a palɛ jo o tampona ta, dɛ ba le o batakaare baŋa ta ken.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: A wer kɛŋɔ mɛn aa le Hɛmɔn Bwejen ta, dɛɛ lee Saayɔn Bwejen doa ken. Belaa Korowii baɡɛ o nɛra nyoa ŋɔ, wɛɛ swee o nɛra andɛɛɡaa, bá dɔ mkpa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii, hé nɛra haa ɛ o bonɔɔna bwa, hé banɔ la haa dɛ tomɔ o Dea jwaana.

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Hé ɡɔɔ nɔɔra Korowii Dea bela dɛ́ kpɛɛro.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ la, ó le Saayɔn dɛ́ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii, he nɛra haa ɛ o bonɔɔna la, hé kpɛɛro,

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: he nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ o Dea la.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛro, o wer waa doa wa, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ o sɔn, dɛkalkɛ o wer.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: O le Jekɔb luɡe tena, Israel tena baa ɛ o ɡbaɡba nɛra la tɛ o te.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kan. O kan ɡwaa voɡare bwa.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa dɛ nyin laanee wɛɛ ɛ nyundua ne harɛ, mpo ne o vile bwa ta.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ baama aa dɛ nɛ bwaala ir dɛɛ le harɛ jaɡa, dɛ ɡel bwaala ɛɛ nɛ dɛɛ nyɛɡle, asɛ dɛ ɡel peu ta le bela waa lole.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: O kpoo Ijipt harɛ nɛra biloɡla, ne kondɛɛra ɡe biloɡla.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: O ɛ nyokpowaa Ijipt tena bini, dɛ tɛr Ijipt kooro ne o nomonome bwa deŋne.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: O kpoo harɛre nɛra ɡalɡa, hale koranar baa dɔ kpeɡri.

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Banee, Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ, dɛ Keenan harɛ koranar bwa,

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ kpɔ ba harɛre la tɛ o nɛra Israel tena a ɛ ba kwa.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he sɔn haa dɔa la ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Naanar baa ka ba bwa ɛɛ dɛɛ lii he waa.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ bol o nɛra waa tɛɛ ba ásɛ dɛ dɔ tedoma tɛ o bonɔɔna.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm nee ba ɛ harɛre la voɡare. Nɔɔra nee ba kwaara.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: A dɔ nyoo, kɛ aa waa bol, dɛ dɔ sibie, kɛ aa na.

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: A dɔ deŋna, aa waa no, aa won hwee ɡe.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kwaara ne nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ a nɛɛ bwa beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé kpɛɛ Korowii, hé nɛra haa ɛ o sɔfore ɡe kpɛɛro.

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Lewi dea tena, hé kpɛɛ Korowii, hé nɛra haa dɛ tomɔ bwa ɡe kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii waa lɔ o Dea bwɛjen Saayɔn, dɛ do Jerusalam waa ɛ o dem la. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii o wer. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii waa ɡwaa voɡa bwa. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ jam tɛ kpeɡnɛra bwa dɔɔ. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O ɡboo dɛɛ ɛ wejena aa ɛ nyokpoa. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ o wejema ta dɛ ta nyundua. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onee ta harɛ o chɔŋɛ neerare sie. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onee ta wee ne korobie. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ wee ɛɛ chaah webaŋa. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Korobie ne weweela ɡe ɛɛ chaah jwaana. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onee kpoo Ijipt harɛ bibanloɡla. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O tɔ Israel tena sie le Ijipt harɛ. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O kpeɡri nee o lɛɛ ba. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onee ɡela Mposwɛm pere anɛ. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Asɛ o tɔ Israel tena sie ba valɛ o bini le. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Kɛ o ɡelɔ Ijipt kooro ne o dɔm ka nee ta. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onee tɔ o nɛra sie ba kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onee kpoo koranar baa kpeɡa kohona. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ kpoo koranar baa lɛ sɔn. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O kpo Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O kpo Basan tena Kooro Ɔɡ. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O kpɔ ba harɛre tɛ o nɛra. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O kpɔɔ tɛ Israel tena baa ɛ o bonɔɔna. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onee lii ya waa dɛ na ya sum, ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ wahala ta. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O lɛ yaa le ya dɔma nɔn ta. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Onee dɛɛ tɛ hweera kwaa bwa kondikwa aa di. O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Ya soɡe Babelɔn harɛ neerare nyoo, belaa ya lii Saayɔn waa dɛ wi.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Belaa ya kpɔ ya janjelare saɡɛ daa ta, dɛ ɡel a lɔe.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lawɛ yaa la ŋɔ yá ɡo yela, ba ŋɔ yá ɡo yela lɛ ba sie ŋɔ, “Hé ɡo yela aa dɛ baɡle Saayɔn waa ya no.”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Yaa lɔ harɛfale ta nɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona ɡo yela tɛ Korowii ɔ?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Jerusalam, dɛ n soh he wa aa, Korowii ɡel n bɛ won kpɔ nɔn lɔ janjela kpa.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Dɛ n ta he waa liire kɛŋɔ henee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ kohona naa, Korowii ɡel n bɛ won ɡo yela kpa.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lii waa Edom tena aa ɛa awola Babelɔn tena aa pɔ Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la. Ba do lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Hé kuuɡu, ó bwa chɔ harɛ.”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Babelɔn tena, ɡɛ haa kpɔa ɛ yaa nɔ, Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ nɛra baa bá bɔ heya a kem.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Nɛra baa bá lawɛ he bechasɔɔhne, dɛ́ kpɔ ba cha bwea la, Korowii swee ba andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ kpɛɛre n bambile bwa nee, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre voɡa sie.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ sie pa he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la taa, dɛ́ ba harɛ dɛɛ kpɛɛre, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne kasinteŋ dɔe la wa. Dɛkalkɛ he sɔn ne waa haa ŋɔa hɛɛ ɛo kan ɡwaa komɛlbwa.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Maa wia noe la, he noɔ dɛ chaŋ mɛ, he cheɡɛ he kpeɡri ta dɛ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɛɛ kpɛɛree, dɛkalkɛ ba no waa haa bola.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Baa kpɔ waa haa ɛa laanee ɡo yela, dɛkalkɛ he jirima kan kohona.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ he lɔ nyundujaɡla dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛŋɡwɛɡra nɛ, kɛ mbarafo tena te, he dɛ na ba.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: N ba dɛ na wahala kohona naa, henee kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ n nɛ. He dɛ yo n dɔma ba baah aa di n nɛ, dɛ che he kpeɡri ta dɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, hɛɛ ɛ waa haa baɡ mɛ nyoa laanee. He nyina haa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, anomanta, bɛ he ɡbaɡba nɛra haa ta yaa la vɛh.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he pese mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ jemɛ n wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: He jemɛ n harɛ soɡa ne n ira dɛ che bwa bini, n ne he baah jaŋne kwaraa naa, he jemɛ n nyu bini liire bwa.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ n pili nyoa dɛ́ bol waa la, dɛ he jemɛ waa maa bol bwa.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: He lɔ n sie dɛ do n habɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ n nɛɛ he kpeɡri ne.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Gɛ haa jemɛ n waa la kpo n nyoa kohona, maa wone dɛɛ no a mun.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Leperaa n kpɔ haa wola men na nɔ? Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona chwa le he sie nɔ?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: N la nyundua aa, he lɔ bela, n kaa chɔ lalabwɛɛ kwaraa naa, he lɔ bela.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: N iro kaa bojaŋ wee leebɔr, kɛɛ dɛ ka so bojaŋ wee cholibɔr kwaraa naa,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: he lɔ bela dɛ tɔ n sie he kpeɡri ne dɛɛ cha mɛ.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: N ŋɔ ń ka sɔh biro ta ó tɔ n nɛ, kɛɛ bɔr waa chaahna bar mɛ la bir tɔ n nɛ, kɛŋɔ jwaana aa,

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: biro ta komɛl waa won tɔ waa ta he be, jwaana do kɛŋɔ webaŋa he be, dɛkalkɛ biro ne bochaah bwa beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Henee ta n bwa, dɛ ta mɛ pɛ n nya tea bini.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: N dɛ kpɛɛre, he we-ɛɛla haa cheɡɛ a ta dɛ ta mɛ la bwa ɔma, dɛ dɔ nyokpoa kohona. N jemɛ a bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Haa ta n hoɡa dɛɛ pɛ kɛrɛdɛ ken n nya tea bini n sɔh bela dɛɛ kpeɡ la, dɛ he jemɛ n wa.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: He na ɡɛ maa doa mɔɔ ba lol mɛ. He chwerɛ tɔpera maa di harɛ ta do he tɔn bini mɔɔ a bɛlbwa pa mun.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he liire kan maa wola won jemɛ! A kan, a ɡwaa n liire!

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: N ŋɔ n kura aa, a ɡwaa mpo nyoa hɛŋle. N chɔɔ dɛ har kwaraa naa, n ne henee ta.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ nyin kɛ he fe aa kpoo nyubinikpeɡ tena! N dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra fee ɡel mɛ, ásɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ.

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ bol he bwara wechɔɡe, dɛ bol waa dɛɛ chɔɡ he sɔn.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n hah nɛra baa haeh! N kii nɛra ba deŋne aa kpeɡa baa jo he nɛ!

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: N hah ba kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ n dɔma.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, pese mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ n liire, daah mɛ na, dɛ́ jemɛ n nyu bini.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi dɛ na kɛ wechɔɡa ane lɔ n bini, dɛɛ tɔ n sie ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta, saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ le nɛnchɔɡa nɔn ta, lɛɛ mɛ le naɡrenyine be.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Ba nyoa wobol dɛ kpo kɛ tɛɡchɔɡa ken, dɛ do kɛŋɔ domkpuli aa choɡe nɛn.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta. Lɛɛ mɛ le naɡrenyine baa dɛ vɔrɔwe n chɔɡa vɔrɔwa be.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Mbarafo tena sɔɔh dɛ haɡre mɛ bela, ba kpɔa bil ŋwɛnɛ maa dɛ kpɔ o ta la ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔɔ mɛ lawɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: N ŋɔ n Naa Korowii be ŋɔ, “Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ.” No n wii dɛ́ cha mɛ!

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii, he kpeɡri dɛɛ che n habɔɔ, henee tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe laa ta,

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: bɛ ɡel nɛnchɔɡa dɔ ba tetoowa, bɛ ɡel ba vɔrɔwa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe maɡre, asɛ baa ɛ mbarafo a wa.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel n dɔma won pɔ n nɛ, ɡel ba aahra baa dɛ aah mɛ ɡure ba nyu ta.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Chure ninhɔla ta ba nɛ, ɡel ba taɡ ba do bɔluŋ bini baa wola won le kpa.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii bol nyaara waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛɛ lɛ ba nyoa.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la ɛɛ kpɛɛree, baa do he siee.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n dɛ yerɛ, ba dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ warane. No n wii maa dɛ wi, dɛ́ no n be.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: No n wesoŋa kɛŋɔ daawiile baa dɛ fuah a sɔɔh do som. Lɛ n nɔɔra maa ɡɔɔra dɛɛ soŋe nɔ, ɡɛ haa dɛ lɛ jɔmɔr saraha la.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, cha mɛ, mɛɛ nyiŋi wobol aa dɛ le n nyoaa.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Laa n bambile kpɔ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, bɛ ɡel n ja wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, kɛɛ n ne ba pɛ nɔn di ba silɛɛ kondikwa.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Gel nɛn o wa aa toɡra kah mɛ dɛ́ toɡ mɛ, nyina waa dɛ nyin mɛ wa. Maa duure bɛlbwa nyin wechɔɡ-ɛɛra be, dɛkalkɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa mɛɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ ó chɔɡ ba wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Baa ba che bwejena dor dɛ́ taɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra sitɔɔla ta harɛ la, anee dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ n waa la ɛ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Baa boloo ŋɔ, “Gɛ ba yon buɡli harɛ la, ɡɛɛ ya hoɡa lɔ peɡre lalbɔɔ nyoa.”

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Nemenɛ Korowii nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, henee n chwa baa marɛ, bɛ ɡel n sewɛ.

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le bela baa har mɛ ta, wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bela nɔɔ n ŋɔ nɔ.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Gel ba ɡbaɡba lee bela baa hara ta, ásɛ n te valɛ ba kaa sɔnɔnɔɔ ken.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: N do lɔŋɔ yerɛ Korowii, n soŋo ŋɔ ó na n sum.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: N kpɔ n waa bwa bil o sie, dɛ bol n wahala nae baɡlo.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Dɛ n bambile chɔɡɔ aa, onee dɛɛ baɡ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ. N dɔma sɔɔh kpɔ bel harɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa dɛ kpɔ o ta la ta.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: N keo nyiŋi na naa, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ cha mɛ. N ta nɛn maa chwa ka sɔh o be dɔe, nomɛlbwa waane laa n nyu dɔe wa.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ noe ŋɔ he cha mɛ, henee dɛ waa puu mɛ naa, n chwa baa marɛ harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Lee mɛ suna maa dɛ di nɔ ta, ásɛ n kpɛɛre he nɛra baa chema warɛ bini, he wer haa doa tɛ mɛ la wa.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, che toɡra haa toɡra ta, dɛ́ na n sum. Chaŋ mɛ he kasinteŋ haa dɔa la ne.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Bɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ daah na, nomɛlbwa toole o waa toɡre he sie.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: N dɔma ti mɛ, dɛ lɔ mɛ bil harɛ, dɛ ɡel n do biro ta, kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa kaa biɡri ken.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n hwɛɡa bwa tonɔ tonɛ, n bambile bwa chɔɡɔ.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: N lii tɔpera aa baa kaa la, dɛ lii toma haa ɛa bwa naa, n dɛ na we-ɛɛla haa ɛa bwa.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: N ɡɔɔ nɔɔra dɛ wi dɛɛ noe, n bambile lawɛ kɛŋɔ harɛ hole aa hiah nee ken.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, chaŋ mɛ warane, dɛkalkɛ n hwɛɡa bwa tonɔ. Bɛ sie laa kpɔ n nɛ, ɡɛ laa aa, mɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa kaa lalabwɛɛ ken.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ lii mɛ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la chɔɔ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ he nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ. Henee n wi dɛɛ no, baɡ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ he bee n chwa baa sɔh.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ. Baɡ mɛ mɛɛ ɛ waa haa dɛ nyin. Nyiŋi n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel mɛɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la, che he toɡra haa toɡra ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale ta.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Koh nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ la wa, dɛ́ kpoo n dɔma, dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ mɛ bwa, dɛkalkɛ n ɛ he bonɔɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, onee do kɛ Bwetal, n chwa baa marɔ. Onee chaɡ mɛ n jemɛ laa yoi.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Onee Korowii waa do kɛ danjwɛjen, dɛɛ nyin n waa n chwa baa marɔ. Onee dɛɛ tɔ n nɛ, dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, n chwa baa sɔh o lɔɡa. O ba harɛre nɛra ne harɛ, asɛ ba do n lɔɡa.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nɛwɛnyina ɡee bɔkwa, hɛɛ lii ba waɔ? Ba ɡee bɔkwa, hɛɛ dawɛ ba waɔ?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛ nyoa peu, ba tɔpera do kɛ lileo ken, tama dɛ ba nyoɡrɔ.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, forɛ le nyundua, dɛ́ tu ba harɛ. Kpɔ nɔn leɡe bwejena, dɛ́ ɡel chuu le a ta.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Gel bwaala nyɛɡle, dɛ́ lɔ he dɔma peɡre. Ta he hɛma do ba bini, bá chwa kaa.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Le nyundua tɛr nɔn, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le suna maa dɛ di nɔ ta. Lɛɛ mɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa dɛ yoo mɛ nɔn ta.

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: Nyosone ɡboo su ba nyoo, hale ba ŋwɛɛ dɛɛ ja ba nyosone ta.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ɡo yelfalee tɛɛ, mɛɛ kpɔ janjelaa lɔ yela kpɛɛre.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: Henee ɡela Israel koranar yo dɛɛ pɔ ba dɔma nɛ, dɛ lɛ he bonɔɔ Kooro Devid le seo nyoa.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le nɛŋhɔɔhra baa dɛ yoo mɛ nɔn ta, nyosone ɡboo su ba nyoo, hale ba ŋwɛɛ dɛɛ ja ba nyosone ta.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Gel ya bibaala bonɔɔne saŋ do kɛŋɔ daa baa nyiŋi a ta kɛrɛdɛ, á kpeɡ dɛ́ do kpeɡri. Gel ya bihaahna ɡe do kɛŋɔ pilare baa paaɡa koodem, a ɡel o do o wer la.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Gel koo kondikwaare bwa soo siwi su ya dɔndɔŋre bini. Gel ya peera ya kaɡboŋa, hale kaɡboŋa fifi.

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Gel ya nae loɡle, dɛ́ ya kohona dɛ bɛ a bii har dɛɛ ta. Bɛ ɡel wii ne suna dii do ya fɔɡbaahna.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɔ a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba na som. Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la, ba na som!

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, ne n kooro, mɛɛ jaame saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ ba he kpɛɛra. Mɛɛ kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he kan dɛ chɛ kpɛɛra. He kan haa doa ɡwaa nɛwɛnyina liire ta.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Fini bii ɛɛ baɡle waa haa ɛa baɡle kerekere biirii, baa bol he wejena haa ɛa waa.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Baa bol he jirima, ne nyɛl ne kpeɡri haa doa waa. Mɛɛ lii nyokpowaa haa ɛa la waa.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Baa bol he kpeɡri ne he we-ɛɛla aa do ɔma kohona waa, ásɛ n bol he kan haa doa wa.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Baa bol he wer haa doa waa bwaa, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛ he suna haa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ kohona wa.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he dɛ nyin yaa dɛ dɔ tedoma, he baah aa di warawara, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ɡe do kan.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: He wer tɛ nomɛlbwa, dɛ dɔ tedoma tɛ kwaa haa taa bwa.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, kwaa haa taa bwa ɛɛ kpɛɛree, ásɛ he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa ɡe kpɛɛre.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Baa bol jirima he kora aa dɔa waa, dɛ́ bol kan haa doa wa,

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: ásɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ he wejena haa dɛ ɛ, ne jirima he kora aa dɔa wa.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: He kora dii ta jaɡa dɔe, hɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la. N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ hɛɛ teŋɛ he nyobaɡa ta, dɛ dɔ nyina tɛ kwaa haa taa bwa.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: He lawɛ nɛra baa chola dɛɛ ir, dɛɛ cha banɔ la wenaale aa lɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Kwaa haa taa bwa sie dawɛ he nɛ, hɛɛ tɛa kondikwaa saŋ aa chɛa ta.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: He ta tea dɛɛ tɛa kohona, bɛlbwa dɔ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, waa haa dɛ ɛ bwa toɡrɔ, he dɛ nyin he kontaala bwa.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: He bɛne banɔ la baa dɛ yerɛ bwa, nɛra baa dɛ yerɛ kasinteŋ ne la.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ la, he dɛ tɛɛ ba ba konnyina, dɛ no ba wii dɛɛ lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ nyin he waa la, he kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa te, hɛɛ chɔɡ baa.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii saŋ bɛlbwaa. Korowii kontaala bwa, hé kpɛɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɛɛro n soɡa bini bwaa, dɛ́ ɡo yela ɡe kpɛɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Bɛ he te kpɔ dawɛ koranar kɛɛ sitɔɔ bɛlbwa nɛ, nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa aa won lɛɛ.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Ba sewɔ aa, ba dɛ huɡ ba. Le awola tɔpere la, ba liire ne vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa bwa dɛ ba a jaɡa.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ hwɛɡa do Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ nɛɛ wɛɛ chao la, o na som.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ta nyundua ne harɛ, mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ a ta bwa. O dɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel nyoŋa berɛ dɛɛ na. O lawɛ nɛra baa chola dɛɛ ir, o dɛ nyin nɛra ba wa aa toɡra wa.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: O kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ hɔɔhra baa soɡe ya harɛ ta nɛ, dɛɛ cha luhaahna ne bilalbii. Kɛ nɛnchɔɡa te, o dɛ chɔɡ vɔrɔwa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Korowii waa dɛ di kora Saayɔn, ɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii! A wer kɛ yá ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, a dɔ silɛɛ dɛ chɛ kɛ yá kpɛɛro.

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ kwaa ma Jerusalam, dɛ lawɛ Israel tena baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfala ta la ba.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ nɛra ba bambile aa chɔɡa dɔ bolarawa, dɛ vɔrɔwe ba ŋwɛra.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Onee ta weweela dɛ jemɛ a nyoa, dɛ pa bɛlbwa sɔn.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ kan, dɛɛ di kpeɡri kohona, o wejema ɡe ta jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: O dɛ cha nɛŋɡwɛɡra, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa te, o dɛ lɔ ba harɛ.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ janjela lɔ yela tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Onee kpɔ baama tɔ nyundua bwa, dɛ ɡel bwaala ɛɛ nɛ harɛ ta, kpɔɡa ɡe ɛɛ moɡɛ deŋɡarere ta.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Onee dɛɛ tɛ ola kondikwa, dɛɛ tɛ ɡaahɡaah bii lɔr aa dɛ kpoa kondikwa aa di.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: O sie aa jaɡre a bwara aa kpeɡa, kɛɛ banyoola nɛɛ lɛ,

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: o sie dɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ, ne nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛ, ne o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Nɛra haa lɔ Jerusalam, hé kpɛɛ Korowii. Saayɔn tena, hé kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ!

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Onee tɛ heyaa deŋnesɔɔhna he harɛ jwɛhre ta, asɛ dɛ tɛ heyaa mea aa do wer.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: O bol waa harɛ nɔ ta tena be naa, ba dɛ ɛa wɔrɔbe nɛ.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: O nɛ dombwea perɛ kɛŋɔ baa paɡri bombo, dɛ ɡel mɛn ta kɛŋɔ tɔɔ ken.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ dombwea lee kɛŋɔ bwea ken. Umee dɛ́ won che dombwea la sɔne nyoa ɔ?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: O bol waa asɛ dombwea la mwɛɛ, dɛ ta peu a nee la palɛ.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: O pili o Mmarare ne o waa bini chaɡle Jekɔb naanar baa ɛ o nɛra Israel tena la.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: O ta anɔ ɛɛ tɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra, baa o Mmarare jemɛ. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii! He kpɛɛ Korowii le nyundua, kwaa haa lɔ o be nyundua la.

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nyundua toroma, hé kpɛɛro, Korowii dɔm haa wara dɛ do o be nyundua bwa, hé kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Wee ne korobie bwa, hé kpɛɛro, weweela aa dɛ chaah bwa, hé kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nyundujaɡla ne neerare aa lɔ bela bwa, hé kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Á bwa kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o nyoa wobol taa o che taa.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: O nyoa wobol nee o cheɡa a chebɔra, a do le saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ ɡel a do le ɡɛ dɛɛ la, aa wola won charɛ.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ne mpo bini oljena ne mpo vile bwa, hé kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Bwaala nyɛɡla ne dombwea, ne baama dɛ peukpeɡa aa dɛ no o be,

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: bwejena ne deŋɡarere, ne daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ, dɛ peleme daa bwa,

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: ne kpɔɡ bini ola ne nae, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne kwaa aa dɛ huuh, dɛ jumbii bwa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: Koranar ne harɛre nɛra bwa, nomonome ne sitɔɔla bwa,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: ne bonɔɔna ne toli, ne banjeni ne hanjeni, dɛ bechale ɡe bwa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Hé bwa kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o sɔn laanee kana ɡwaa sɔn bɛlbwa, o jirima ɡwaa nyundua ne harɛ.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ o nɛra Israel tena ba waa aa toɡra, waa do o bambile ta kohona, ásɛ ba bwa kpɛɛro. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii! Hé ɡo yelfale tɛ Korowii! Hé kpɛɛro bela o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra aa wara dɛ cheme!

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé ɡel he sie lɛ he hɛɡre, Korowii waa ta heyaa la wa. Saayɔn tena, hé hɛɡre he kooro wa!

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro dɛɛ sa, hé lɔ ɡboŋri ne janjela kpɛɛro.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Korowii sie dɛ lɛ o nɛra nɛ, dɛɛ cha nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te, dɛ ɡel baa pɔ ba dɔma nɛ.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la hɛɡre, dɛ́ ɡo silɛɛ yela jwaana bwa, pɔe baa pɔ ba dɔma nɛɛ wa.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Bá do lɔŋɔre dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpoŋe tokobijen sie anɛ te waa nyɛɡa,

english_verse: Take revenge and punish the nations.
translation_verse: dɛ́ pɔ harɛre nɛra nɛɛ, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne.

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Bá vɔrɔwe ba koranar jɔɡrɔre ne, dɛ́ do kwaa ba nomonjena nakpale.

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Bá tɛr harɛre nɛra la deŋne, ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la. Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa jirimaa la. Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛ Korowii! Hé kpɛɛ Korowii o Dea bela! Hé kpɛɛro, o kpeɡri waa dɔa nyundua wa!

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Hé kpɛɛro o wejena waa ɛa wa. Hé kpɛɛro o kan waa doa kohona ɡwaa komɛlbwa wa.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Hé hoh bɛle kpɛɛro, dɛ́ lɔ janjela ne kwaa bwa soo siwi kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Hé yiiɡi loŋa kpɛɛro dɛɛ sa. Hé lɔ janjela, dɛ́ hoh kalipere kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Korowii kontaala aa dɛ hwee bwa, hé kpɛɛro! Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Kooro Devid bibaa Kooro Solomɔn o fa aa di kora Israel harɛ ta la sɛɡla.

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Aa ɡeloo nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ sie pili, ásɛ toli ne bonɔɔna dɔ wejema.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Wejerema, hé cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no sɛɡla nɔ, dɛ́ dɔ wejema kɛrɛdɛ. Nɛra baa dɛ no waa mun la won ba te lawa, anɔ la aa wera ne anɔ la aa wola were ta,

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: dɛ́ won dɛɛ no sɛɡla a mun noe aa kpeɡa, ne wejerema wobol ne wobobeela mun.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Wejema mumparee Korowii ɔma. Gɛna ɡboo dɛɛ vɛh wejema, ne waa baa dɛ do ba a ta. Bonɔɔna ne toli jae wa

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: N bie, dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra dɛ doe hé ɛ wechɔɡa aa, bɛ sɛh.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Dɛ ba ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, “Ba ya ka nyin nɛn kpo, kɛɛ ya ka teŋe ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ́ kpo nɛn ne o tepoŋ pɛɛ,

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: ya ka kwaa ba ne ba bokpeɡa sɔh, kɛɛ ya ka do ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa lalabwɛ.

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: Yaa dɔ kondɔɔh bwa soo siwii, ba su ya deremi kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba ja ya nɛɛ ásɛ ya bwa ka bɔne kwaa yaa ŋwɛ la.”

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: N bie, he ne nɛra baa do ɡɛ la bɛ valɛ, laa he te kpɔ ba nɛ,

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: ba ɡbaŋre wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, baa won ba te lawɛ nɛŋkpoa ta.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: He dɛ nyin jumbie dɛ́ lawaa, baa on bel harɛ o siwi ta, baa mea lwee nyubaah ta du.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa do ɡɛ la dɛ harɛ o te bel, o dɛ nyin o ɡbaɡba seo!

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Gɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin kafo waa do, o dɛ sewɛ ɡɛ yoi we-ɛɛla la ta. Wejema dɛ yerɛ

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Wejema do kɛ haah dɛ do fɔɡbaahna dɛɛ yerɛ, o taa cheɡɛ chiŋ yawa baahna.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ bwɛɛ doonyoo ne bela nɛra aa wara, dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa o taa che chiŋ ŋɔ,

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “Nɛra he sie aa wola pile, saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin kɛ he ɡɛn ka tel ɔ? Haa waa hweli aa?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Dɛ he no kaeh maa dɛ kah heya aa, n fe ɛɛ kpɔ n bambile bwaa tɛ heya, dɛ́ baɡle heyaa wa.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Haa waa maa dɛ ja heyaa a waa la nyin, he vɛh waa maa bola dɛɛ baɡle heyaa la ɡe.

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: Awola siswɛm aa pu heyaa kɛŋɔ dompeu, dɛɛ ba he nɛɛ kohona kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ, ásɛ hɛɛ na weweele ne wahala la,

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: belaa hɛɛ ba men maa dɔ wejema nɔ yera, ásɛ n mwaa he bwa ne. Hɛ́ɛ ɡaaɡoo dɛɛ nyin n bɔr bobɛlbwa yalayala ken, kɛ haa men na.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Hé kii wejema, haa nyin kɛ he ɔmɛ Korowii.

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Hé ta waa maa dɛ ja heyaa la ta teŋɛ, he vɛh kaeh maa kah heyaa la nɛra bwa siwi ta.

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hɛɛ dɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyinii, ásɛ he ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla ɡure he nyu ta.

english_verse: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
translation_verse: Gɛna dɛ sewɛ wejema baa vɛah wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba kpɔ wejema dɛɛ ta habɔɔ, baa sie waa ta do.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no n waa la te ɛɛ so lee jeiih ken, o bwara sɔɔhno, ɔmee liire bɛlbwa aa wola on pu.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: N bie, dɛ he no waa maa bola dɛɛ baɡle, dɛɛ do liire n waa ta,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: dɛ cheɡ deŋne wejemwaa ta, dɛ sɔɔh bwara dɛɛ no n waa mun,

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: dɛ he soŋe Korowii wejema, dɛɛ no waa a mun noe aa kpeɡa mun,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: dɛ he siwi beɡrɔ, hɛɛ nyina kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ, kɛɛ kondɔɔh ane aa sɔh bobɛl aa,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: a taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ Korowii ɔma mun, dɛ́ berɛ jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Korowii bee wejema le, onee dɛɛ tɛ wejema ne waa mun noe.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Onee dɛɛ cha nɛn o wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ tɔ nɛn o ŋwɛnɛre aa wera ɡbemɡbe.

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ba bala kɛrɛdɛ nɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi banɔ la baa ta ba te tɛo nɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: He sie ɛɛ piluu, ásɛ he wejema ɡel he sie lɛ.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: He waa mun noe ne he wejema ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ,

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛɛ lee waa aa wola were ta. Aa kee le nɛra baa wola kasinteŋ bol dɛɛ ba waa ne nɛ,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: nɛra baa vɛh wedɛɛɡa ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ kaa kpɔ wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ aa ɛ biro ta wa,

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: Ba ɛ nɛra ba wa aa wola sie chɔ, dɛ ɛ nɛra baa wola ba nɛɛ hwɛɡɛ. Ba waa bwaa kɛ baa neɡre nɛra.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Wejemaa dɛ won lɛɛ le hanjwamane nɔn ta, haah waa kpɔ wobosoma kaa he ne wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: Haah waa le o sɛnojaa habɔɔ, dɛ chɔɡ fɔo o ne o jaa fa aa fɔwa Korowii sie la,

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: ɡɛ haah la dem ŋwɛnɛ kaa seo ta, o chɔɔ kaa lalabwɛ.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ la o be aa berɛ dɛɛ ba kpa. Naate aa mkpa ŋwɛnɛ ta chiɡ kpa.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Anomanta, teŋɛ nɛndɛɛɡe luɡe ta, ásɛ dɛ so kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ teŋe nɛnchɔɡaa le harɛ nɔ ta, wɛɛ chuɡri wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa le o ta kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa kɛɛ daa ken.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: N bie, bɛ waa maa baɡle nɔ soh, ɡel he liire do waa maa ŋɔa hɛɛ ɛ ta,

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: aa ɡeloo he dɔ mkpajaŋ, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he soɡa bini do wer.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel Korowii nyina ne nɛnnyin dɛ kasinteŋ paŋɛ. Kpɔa ɛ kɛŋɔ baŋa kon, ɡel a ɛ he bambile wa.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: He ɛ ɡɛ naa, hɛɛ dɔ sɔndɛɛɡee Korowii ne nɛra bwa be.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Bɛ he te kpɔ dawɛ anɔ la haa jema ta, kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa do Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ la, lii Korowii wa, ásɛ o baɡle ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe hé kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Bɛ he te wejereme kohona dɛɛ lii, ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛ ke he te wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Dɛ he teŋɛ a ta naa, aa ɛo kɛŋɔ tɛɛɡa, dɛ́ do he bwara bini dɛɛ chaeh.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he kondɔɔh, ne he koo kondikonloɡla tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ duuru.

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he dɔ mea kohona he dɔndɔŋ su, ásɛ dɛ berɛ dɔ senfala kohona, haa wola won dɔ kwaa dɛ́ do a bwa.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: N bie, dɛ Korowii dɛ tɛr he deŋne aa, bɛ an wesale lii. Dɛ o dɛ toɡre naa, bɛ ɡel a hwah he bwara.

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Nɛn Korowii aa dɛ nyin la, onee wɛɛ kah, kɛŋɔ mɛɛ yon dɛɛ toɡre o binyini la.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ wejema la, o na som. Nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la,

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: a dɔ tɔnɔ dɛ ɡwaa suuɡapoŋ, a ɛ kondɔɔh ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Wejema yoɡ kpeɡri, dɛ ɡwaa kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, he konnyini bɛlbwa toole he won kpɔ maɡɔ.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: O dɛ tɛ mkpajaŋ, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ tɛ kondɔɔh ne jirima.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ he soɡa bini ɛɛ do wer, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel hɛɛ dɔ bosɔɔhna.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɔ wejema la, ba na som, o dɛ tɛ mkpa kohona.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Wejema nee Korowii ta harɛ, waa mun noe taa o che, dɛ ta nyundua ɡe.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: O wejema taa o che, dɛ ta neerare aa palɛ, dɛ berɛ ta baama aa ɛ bwaala dɛɛ nɛ.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: N bie, lawɛ he wejema ne waa mun noe bini, bɛ ɡel a paŋɛ.

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: Aa tɛɛ mkpaa, dɛ́ ɡel he soɡa bini do wer.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he valɛ wobɛlbwa ta sɔnɔnɔɔ, haa wola nachɔɡee lɔ.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: He chɔɔ waa haa ɔmɛ, dɛ́ chɔ domsoma.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Haa wekpeɡa aa dɛ piɡri nɛn waa lii, kɛɛ wenaale aa dɛ ba wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛɛ laanee ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛ, waa ɡel he jo waa ta.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Gɛ haa dɛ ba wona ɛ tɛ nɛra aa hiah ba la ɛ, dɛ he dɔ a kpeɡri aa.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔ komɛl dɛ́ tɛ he dɔŋ aa tɛo, bɛ ŋɔ ó kaa kere dɛ́ ba.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Bɛ wechɔɡa lii tɛ he dɔŋ waa dɔ hwɛɡa he nɛɛ dɛ so bɛne.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Bɛ waa kpɔ dawɛ he dɔŋ nɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, dɛ o ta hen waane ɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre nɛn waa dɛ nyin yoi kwaa ta, bɛ waa waa dɛ ɛ la ane ɛ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Korowii kii nɛn o ŋwɛnɛre aa ɡola, o dɔ hwɛɡa tɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ bol o waa o be.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Korowii nyotaahna lɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ dem, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra dem te, o swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ mamɛ mbarafo tena baa dɛ mamɛ ba bala, dɛɛ sune nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te la nɛ.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Wejeremaa dɛɛ dɔ jirima, ɡɛna ɡee dɛɛ so sihiih ta.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: N bii, hɛɛ no waa he mɛɛ aa dɛ baɡle, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no, ásɛ dɛɛ no waa mun.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Wedɛɛɡaa mɛɛ baɡle heyaa la, hé ɡel a do he liire bini.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: N fa aa lɔ n nya ne n mɛɛ sie, dɛ ɡbo ɛ bibaa dɛ ta ɛ bechala la,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: n mɛɛ fa yon bol waa dɛɛ baɡ mɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Gel waa nɔ ɛɛ liire dɛ bɛ soh. Dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta ásɛ dɛ biɡri.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Kpɔ wejema dɛɛ no waa mun, do liire a ta, dɛ bɛ waa maa bola la ta le.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Bɛ wejema vɛh, ásɛ o nyiŋi he nɛ. Nyinu he bambile bwa, ásɛ o kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Wejema kan taeh, anomanta, hwelu. Waa mun noe ɡwaa komɛlbwa haa dɔa.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Duu wejema, ásɛ o ɛɛ nɛnjen, kpɔ he te pɛlo, ásɛ o tɛɛ jirima.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kpɔ jirimaa sime kɛŋɔ botidɛɛɡe, dɛ́ kpɔ pii kɛŋɔ kooɡbɛrɛ he dɔ jirima.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: N bie, no n be, dɛ́ do sie a ta kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpajaŋ.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: N baɡle wejema, n kpɔe cheɡ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe haa kpɔ o ta dɛ́ so.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ valɛ wejema ne naa, wobɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔe ŋwɛnɛ, he dɛ chwa kwaraa naa, haa nakpalaa lɔ.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Lawɛ waa haa hwela la bini saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ bɛ ɡel a le he nɔn ta, nyiŋi a ta kɛrɛdɛ, anee he mkpa.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Bɛ bela nɛnchɔɡa aa dɛ la la, bɛ ba waa dɔŋa ɛ.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ ke he te, bɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta kpɔ, ke o ta, dɛ́ kpɔ he ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra la aa won chɔ, dɛ ba ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ, baa won haŋre, dɛ ba ta wechɔɡa dii.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ ne yoi we-ɛɛlaa ɛ ba kondikwaa ne sen.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra waa do kɛŋɔ, bɔr aa chaahna chɔmbibii ka tel kɛŋɔ wee aa baŋa.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Kɛ nɛnchɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ te do kɛŋɔ, bɔr aa bira kpirkpir ken, baa kon baa lɔ naa o ta na.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: N bie, cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no waa maa bol baɡle, dɛɛ no n be kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel a le he liire ta, ɡel a do he nyu bini.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: A ɛ mkpa dɛ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ no a mun, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba bokpeɡa.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: He dɛ lii wa aa, dɛɛ nyiŋa kɛrɛdɛ, waa haa dɛ lii la, anee hɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Bɛ waa aa wola kpela ɛɛ bol bwa, laa he te kpɔ neɡra wobol ta.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi he vala bini kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ che kiŋkiŋ bela haa dɛ kaa.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Laa he te kpɔ wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ ɡel he ŋwɛnɛ toɡre. Bɛ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ta le.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: N bie, cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no n wejema nɔ, no waa aa dɛ tɛ waa mun noe.

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ che a ta dɔ dadɛɛɡe, ásɛ he wobol baɡle kɛŋɔ he dɔ wejema.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Hanjwamane nyoa wobol som kɛŋɔ tooh ken, o taa pwɛre ɡwaa no,

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: kɛ a habɔɔ la, waa waa doe a ta la kpeli kɛŋɔ ol kpela. O nyoa wobol dɛ do nɛn bol kɛŋɔ naŋɡɔse ken.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kaa he ne seo taa, lalabwɛɛ ŋwɛnɛɛ wɛɛ kpɔ.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Waa ŋwɛnɛ waa dɛ tɛ mkpa la ta kpɔ, valaa o valɛ dɛɛ valɛ, waa jemɛ anɔ la waa dɛ ɛ.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: N bii, hé berɛ no, hɛɛ berɛ waa maa dɛ bol he be nɔ soeh.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Haah waa do ɡɛ la, hé laa he te kpɔ o nɛ, he bɛ o doonyoa kwaraa fɛrɛ.

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Gɛ laa aa, hɛɛ paŋɛ he bonɔɔne saŋ jirima he fa aa dɔa la nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn taa.

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: Ásɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ba kpɔ he kondɔɔh di, ásɛ kwaa haa ɛ toma dɛ dɔ la, bɛ nomɛl kwaa ba berɛ.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Haa ba hwɛɛh la, he ba chɔ dɛɛ hime, ɡɛ saŋ he bwadabii bwa aa ɡwɛɡra la,

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Asɛ buɡ nɔ ta mɛɛ ba ncho dii, nɛra bwa siwi ta nɔ.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: He ne he haah ɡbo ɛɛ chɔ, kɛŋɔ haa dɛ nyɔ he dem nee ɡbo la.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Bɛ fɔɡbaahna haahna ka nyin. Ba do kɛŋɔ nee aa wola were ne nyɔe.

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Kpoŋe he haah ɡbo, he ne nomɛlbwa kon laa.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Gel he sie ɛɛ lɛ he bonɔɔne saŋ haah nɛ. Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ he ne o chɔe bini.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: O wer kɛŋɔ diɡi ken, o we-ɛɛla ɡe do wer, ɡel he sie ɛɛ lɛ o nɛ, hɛɛ nyinu kohona saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: N bie, bɔkwaa ɡela he berɛ kpɔ he te tɛ hanfale bɛl jaɔ? Bɔkwaa ɡela hɛɛ sewɛ he dɔŋ bɛl haah nɛɛ jaɔ?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ na wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ, o jemɛ he vala bini bwa.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe wechɔɡa do kɛŋɔ bel dɛ tɛo, o dichɔɡaa dɛɛ lawɔ.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Lawa waa wola won o te lawɛ laanee dɛ́ kpoo, o ɡɛnaa ɡela wɛɛ sewɛ.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: N bie, a balɔ kɛŋɔ he di ajinamuu tɛ he dɔŋ, dɛ he baɡɛ nyoa waane ta tɛ nomɛl aa,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: amɔ dɛ he nyobaɡa la ɛ bel dɛ tɛɛ, waa haa bola la harɛ bel.

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: N bie, a ba ɡɛ naa, dɛ he nɔn lɔ he dɔŋ la nyoa, ɛ warane la o be dɛ́ ka soŋo, dɛ́ dɔ he te.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Bɛ kpoŋe so, bɛ kpɔ chɔ.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Ɛ warane kɛŋɔ welo aa na kpaah, dɛ laa o te kpɔ, kɛɛ jumbie aa na nɛn waa dɛ harɔ bel la.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Bɔhwaah bɛlbwa nyiŋi vaɡla we-ɛɛla, dɛ́ che a ta hweli wa.

english_verse: but they store up food during harvest season.
translation_verse: kɛ a nyin a kondikwaa dɛɛ cheɡ hwel saŋ, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ kpa bwaala nee saŋ.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Bɔhwaah, saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin he chɔ ka tel, dɛ́ ir saŋ besoo?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: He yon ŋɔ, “Chɔe tama, dom chuɡla tama, nɔɔra fɔɔla dɛ́ so onɛ tama.”

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: He ne ŋɔe he ba jemɛ la, dɛ nyaa piɡri kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ aa kpoŋe dɔmkon dɛ́ ba che he nɛ.

english_verse: winking and giving signals to deceive others.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ sie ne nakpale dɛɛ bol wa, dɛ kpɔ nonie dɛɛ baɡle wa,

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: ba dɔ liichɔɡa ba nyu bini, dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa ba bambile ta. Wobochɔɡa lɔ ba nyoo baa ir nɛra bandia.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Anomanta, kerabeŋkpoŋii wekpeɡa ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala, buɡ taa aa ba ba nɛɛ chiɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, ba chah kahonɛ.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Webele anumɛl kɛɛ anuanɛ ane lole Korowii haah kɔkɔkɔkɔ, anee,

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: nɛn waa nyiŋi nɛn dɛɛ vah, ne nyosonteŋni, ne nɛŋkpoa,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: ne nɛn waa dɔ wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa o nyu bini, ne nɛn waa ɡbaŋa wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: ne dansewea dɛ nɛn wobochɔɡa aa lɔ o nyoa, dɛɛ ba peɡra ne o dem tena baah ta. Jwamane jae wa

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Kpɔa ɛ kɛŋɔ baŋa kon, ɡel a ɛ he bambile wa.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Aa tɔ he siee bobɛlbwa haa dɛɛ la, he chɔe bini, aa nyiŋi he nɛ, ásɛ he iro ɡe aa, a tɛɛ liire.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Webaɡla nɔ do kɛŋɔ kandea dɛɛ chaahne, wejaala nɔ ɛɛ won baɡle ɡɛ haa dɛ ba wona so.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Bɛ o wer waa koh dɛ́ ɡel he sie do o nɛ, bɛ ɡel o kpɔ o tolsie neɡre.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
