translation_verse: Hɛɛ won kpɔ kondikwaa tamaa ken dɔ hanjwamane. Kɛ dɛ he dɛ nyin nomɛl haah tenaa, komɛlbwa dɛ le he nɔn ta.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won pa ninhɔla kore, he laala aa wola fuah?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won valɛ ninhɔla ta, he napaala aa wola bwɛ aa?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do, nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ o dɔŋ haah chɔ la, baa tɛr o deŋne.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn dɛ chɔ lɔr, dɛ ka ŋwɛ kwaa di aa, he bɛ on hah, dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ba lawɔ tenaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ kwaa waa ŋwɛa la bele anuanɛ. Kwaa waa dɔa bwa ɛɛ le o nɔn taa.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Baa waa le o haah habɔɔ, dɛ kaa nyin hanfala la ta liire dɔe, o dɛ chɔɡ o ɡbaɡba.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Waa duure dɔ, lɔɔraa chɔ le tɛo, sihiih aa o nɛɛ le bwa.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Baa baah aa di kohona, nemenɛ o meera tɔpere o yon bɔ a kem ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: O sie aa larawa bɛlbwa ta lɛ, komɛlbwa toole he kpɔ tɛo o baah sɔɔh.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: N bie, dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta, dɛ́ɛ do liire waa maa dɛ doe a ta la ta.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ no n waa dɛ́ dɔ mkpa, dɛ́ɛ nyiŋi waa maa dɛ baɡle la ta kɛrɛdɛ, kɛŋɔ he siwinyiŋi ken.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Kpɔa do kɛŋɔ noniseɡ, dɛ́ ɡel a do he bambile bini.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Kpɔ wejema kɛŋɔ he nimambie, dɛ́ kpɔ waa mun noe kɛŋɔ he dansom.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Aa lawɛɛ le hanjwamane, ne nomɛl haah o nyoa wobol aa soma nɛ.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, n lɔ dea dɛ ha sie nyiŋi tokoro ta,

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Ate, haah la kpɔ o te dɛ ba cheme bonɔɔ la, dɛ haah la do jwamanlaala dɛɛ taaɡe sie.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: O ɛ haah o deŋne aa kpeɡa, waa sihiih jemɛ, dɛ do ɡaaɡa ɡbo ta,

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ o cheɡɛ loŋkoni ta, kɛɛ fɔɡbaahna ane ta yawa ta, dɛ́ dɔ baa lawɛ.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Belaa haah la ba ɡbaa bonɔɔ la pɛl o te, dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o vaama ta, dɛ nyiŋi o siebɔr, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Fini n kpo kon dɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, asɛ a ka ola la ane.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Asɛ n le dɛ baa ɡaaɡe he bɔr, n nyin he bɔr asɛ dɛ nae la!

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: N kpɔ yadɛɛɡe Ijipt harɛ tena aa ɛo, o do wer kɛrɛdɛ pa n chɔɔbɔr.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Dɛ kpɔ korobo ne konsɔɔhsoma bwa soo siwi merɛ o ta.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Ba ya ka lɛ ya sie jwaana nɔ ne bwa, ya ka di ya bwara!

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: N jaa toole, o kaa bobɛl, bela jaŋne.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: O kpoŋe suuɡa kohona dɛ kaa, wɛɛ dɔ yawanyoa anɛɛ.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Haah la kpɔ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ ne wobosoma dɛ dɔɔ kaa.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Buɡ la ta, bonɔɔ la den teŋɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nao baa tɛɡro dɛɛ la ka kpo la, kɛɛ kweɡla aa jo bel ta

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: bela hɛm aa yaɡɔ dɛ́ kpoo la. O berɔ do kɛŋɔ jumbie aa toola dɛɛ kaa bel ta, waa wola jemɛ kɛŋɔ o dɛ ba sewa la.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: N bii, name hé no n be, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n wa.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Hé bɛ ɡel he pɛla do haah waa do ɡɛ nɔ nɛɛ ó ba neɡre heya, he bɛ bɛl nɛɛ teŋɛ bwa.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Gɛ haah nɔ chɔɡ baala taeh, dɛ berɛ ɡel bane ɡe serewe baa wola won kur ba.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: He nakpala tire o dem aa, amɔ dɛ lalabwɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ taa he che la. Bela ne seo bori.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ nyoa deŋɡarere ta, o lɔ ŋwɛnɛ chɛchɛre ta.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ bwɛjen doonyoo, bela baa kpɔa dɛɛ jo o bini, o lɔ bela dɛɛ yerɛ.

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “N dɛ yerɛ nomɛlbwa, nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwaa mɛɛ yerɛ.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: He sie ta pilaa, hé hweli sipila wa. He ɡɛnaa, hé hweli wejemwa.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no, n waa nɔ wer taeh, anɔ la bwa maa dɛ bol he be la toɡrɔ.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Kpelaa mɛɛ bol, maa nyosone teŋe bwa.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa maa bol la bwa ɛ kasinteŋ, a bɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ nyosone kɛɛ neɡra.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la, a bwa bini chɔɔ tɛo, dɛ berɛ toɡre tɛ banɔ la baa dɔ wejema.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ ja heya dɛ́ ɡel suuɡapoŋ, hé kpɔ wejema ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm tenten.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Menee Wejema, n ɡwaa kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, haa won kpɔ he bambile ta komɛlbwa maɡ mɛ.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Menee Wejema, n sie pilo, n jemɛ waa dɛɛ no waa mun.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii kii wechɔɡa, anomanta, n kii mbarafo ne maŋkurae we-ɛɛla, ne wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre, dɛ nyosone.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: N dɛ baɡle nɛra waa bá kpɔ ɛ toma aa cha ba, n ɡelɔ baa no waa mun, dɛ́ dɔ kpeɡri.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: N cha koranar baa di kora, ásɛ nomonome won mmarare aa wera doe.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin n bɔr dɛ́ na mɛ.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Menee dɔ kondɔɔh ne jirima dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ, dɛ soɡa bini wer doe dɛ ka tonɛ.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Kon haa dɔ le n be la ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm baa laa doŋa kpɔ o ta, dɛ ɡwaa suuɡapoŋ tenten.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Waa aa toɡraa mɛɛ ɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ ta,

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: dɛɛ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ nyin mɛ kondɔɔh, ba deremi ɛɛ su kohona.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Men Wejema, menee Korowii tɔ sie ta, mɔɔ dɛ pa mun ta komɛlbwa.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Menee Korowii tɔ sie ta mumpar la, mɔɔ dɛ ta harɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: O ta mɛ mɔɔ dɛ ta mpore, ne nee nyuune.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Waa wola bwejena tae mɔɔ la, dɛ n lole, mɔɔ o kpɔ deŋɡarere ba cheɡ la, dɛ ba lol mɛ.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Waa wola harɛ ne kpɔɡ bini kɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta teera kwaraa tae mɔɔ la, dɛ n lole.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: N siwi taa Korowii ta nyundua, dɛ pe mpo ne nyundua chenchema,

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: ɡɛ saŋ waa kpɔ baama do nyundua, dɛ ta neerare a palɛ kaa jo mpo ta la.

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: N lole o maɡɛ bela mpo aa dɛɛ jaɡɛ, dɛ ŋɔ o bɛ bela ba ɡarɛ, ne ɡɛ saŋ waa pe harɛ mun.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: Dɛ n lɔ Korowii jwɛɛh ya bwa pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma, dɛ n dɛ ɛ waa o bambile aa dɛ nyin tɔpere bɛlbwa, n sie ɛɛ lɛ o be saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: Asɛ n sie lɛ toma yaa pɛa ɛ la ta, n tea too nɛwɛnyina bwa nɛ.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: N bii, name hé no n be, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ n waa ta la, o na som.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Hé no anɔ la maa dɛ do heyaa a ta, he bɛ an vɛh, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ wa.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ no n waa la, o na som, nɛn waa dɛ so n dem doonyoa kɛɛ dɛɛ kpa bela la, o na som.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa na mɛ la dɔ mkpa, Korowii tea ɛɛ too o nɛɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa wola men nae la, o ɛ o te, nomɛlbwa waa hah mɛ la pɛla lawɛ seo.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Wejema do kɛ haah waa ma o dem, asɛ dɛ ɛ pilare anuanɛ do o ta.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: O kpo ol dɛ kpɔ ɛ kondikonjena, dɛ kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma ane koo sen ta, dɛ pa chɔŋre teebur ta.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: O tomɛ o toli ŋɔ bá la bwɛɛ la bela aa dawɛ deŋɡare ta ka yerɛ nɛra.

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Hé ba di kwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen maa koo kwaa a ta nɔ ane.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Hé le he sie bɛ pila la ta, dɛ́ dɔ he nyu. Hé teŋɛ wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta.

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: He dɛ ja nɛn waa dɛ ɛ sisawa aa, chɛɡaa hɛɛ dɔ. He dɛ di wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɡe kasinteŋ aa, waa hɛɛ dɔ.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Bɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ nɛra sisawaa kasinteŋ di o ba haeh, di wejereme kasinteŋ, ásɛ o nyini.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Hé dɛ ja wejereme aa, a ɡelɔ wɛɛ jemɛ waa kohona. Anɔ la bɛlbwa haa bol nɛn o wa aa toɡra be la, a dɛ ja o wejema ta.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Wejema mumparee Korowii ɔma, waa mun noe ɡe cheɡɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ jema ta.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Menee Wejema, he teŋɛ n nɛ aa, hɛɛ dɔ mkpajaŋee.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: He jemɛ wa aa, aa do werii tɛɛ, he vɛah ɡe aa, hɛɛ na waa.”

english_verse: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.
translation_verse: Gɛna do kɛŋɔ haah waa ɛ wobobala te, waa wola sihiih jemɛ.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: O dem doonyoa kɛɛ bwɛɛ la deŋɡare taa o kara che wɛɛ so o ta,

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ ɡɛna be ŋɔ, “Nɛra he sie aa wola pile, hé ba n be bonɔ.”

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Nee haa ŋwɛ nyɔ la som taeh, kondikwaa haa sɔh di la som.”

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Kooro Solomɔn sɛɡlaa teŋa nɔ. Bechawejereme ɡelɔ o mɛɛ baŋa ɛɛ pa, kɛ bechaɡɛne te ɡelɔ o nya loo ɛɛ ku.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ kpɔe dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe, kɛ dɛ he waa toɡraa, a dɛ lee seo ta.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Korowii aa ɡel lɔr kpo nɛn o wa aa toɡra. O lɔ nɛnchɔɡe konnyini dɛɛ ta.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɛ bɔhwaah aa, nyae hɛɛ nya, kɛ dɛ he dɛ ɛ toma tenaa, kwaa hɛɛ dɔ.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Wejereme dɛ́ komɛ o koo kwaa a koma saŋ, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ́ chɔ kwaa koma saŋ te dɛ́ di sihiih.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te mur, waa yoi waa bol á le baŋ.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra na som, baa o waa soh, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te waa won soeh warane.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Wejereme dɛ́ no jae, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ bol ɡɛnewaa te waa dɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la, o wobɛlbwa dɛ́ do wer, nɛn o wa aa wola sie chɔ te, ba dɛ nao.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol dɛ́ ba mkpa ne, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te mur, waa yoi waa bol á le baŋ.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Che kaɡraree dɛɛ ba tim kaɡrare tae ne, kɛ nɛnnyin te dɛ́ tɔ wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Wejereme dɛ hweli wa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ do o nyu bini, kɛ nɛn waa ɡɛna wobol te, dɛ ba waa ne.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Dɔɔh suuɡaa dɛɛ tɔɔ ɡbemɡbe, kɛ nyaa te, o nyae dɛ́ kaa o ne chɔɡa ta.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra kembɔree mkpa, asɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa ɡbo ne.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no jae la dɛ́ biɡri, kɛ onɔ la waa wola o wechɔɡa sɛh la dɛ́ dɔ wa.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa hah o dɔŋ dɛɛ tɔh la ɛ nyosonteŋni, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ taa nyokpɛl la ɡɛnɔ.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Wobobala te bɛlbwa dɛ koni, asɛ nɛn waa won o nyoa lawa la jemɛ wa.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol do kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ tenten, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te liire ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol dɔ tɔnɔ dɛɛ tɛ nɛndamanta, kɛ ɡɛne te, liire waa wola dɔe la, dɛ́ kaa o ne seo ta.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ naa, a dɛ ba kondɔɔh ne, wenaale bɛlbwa aa a ta ja.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Gɛne siee dɛɛ lɛ wechɔɡa ta, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun te, o sie dɛ lɛ wejemwaa ta.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Waa nɛnchɔɡe aa dɛ ɔmɛ la, a dɛ ba o nɛ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, dɛ́ dɔ kon waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Wekpeɡa pu wechɔɡ-ɛɛ aa, o dɛ sewɛ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, o dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Gɛ konnyɛɡa aa dɛ nyɛɡ nyena, asɛ ninchuu ɡe ɛɛ we sie la, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ bonyɛɡa do tɛ nɛn waa tomɔ. Waa on bansɔɔhna tɛ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii aa, he dɛ biɡri, kɛ he dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa he saŋ tel.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Kon nɛn o wa aa toɡra aa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o ta la, ɛ silɛɛ kon, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te hwɛɡa dɛ́ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ, dɛɛ chɔɡ banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ́ so deŋnesɔɔhna ta, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te, baa doŋu le o harɛ ta.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ bol nɛmbiwa, kɛ nɛn o nyondoŋe aa bar o nyu te waa dɔ jaɡa.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol dɛ́ sɔɔh baah, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te, o wobol dɛ muɡli baah.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ faah nɛra kwaa yoɡa ta. O sie dɛ lɛ nɛn waa kpɔ kon waa maɡra ne kwaa maɡa nɛ.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Mbarafo dɛ ba sihiih ne, asɛ pwɛre doe ɡe ɛɛ ba wejema ne.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: He waa toɡrɔ aa, a ɡelɔ hɛɛ jemɛ anɔ la haa ɛ, kɛ nɛra baa wola kasinteŋ dɔe la we-ɛɛlaa dɛɛ chɔɡ ba.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Kondɔɔh ta tɔnɔ dɔe seo tɔpere, kɛ he waa toɡrɔ aa, a dɛ lee seo ta.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: He waa toɡrɔ aa, dɛ he waa wer, kɛ he ɛ nɛnchɔɡe aa, he ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla dɛ chɔɡe.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra daa dɛɛ lɛo, asɛ nɛn waa wola kasinteŋ dɔe la ɡbaɡba pɛla waa dɛɛ lawɔ.

english_verse: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe sewaa, o hwɛɡa bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, anɔ la o sie aa dawɛ a ta bwa tonɔ.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ lɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛɛ le wahala ta, a yon berɛ ba nɛnchɔɡe nɛ.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Nyoa nee nɛn waa nyiŋi nɛn sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ waa ɛɛ chɔɡ o dɔŋ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, o wejemaa dɛɛ lɛo.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, bwɛɛ la tena bwa sie dɛ lɛ, kɛ dɛ nɛnchɔɡe baa sewaa, bɛlbwa dɛ mamɛ.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra we-ɛɛla taa a che bwɛɛ ɛɛ pili, dɛ berɛ che nɛnchɔɡe wobol ta bwɛɛ ɛɛ paɡre.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: A ɛ ɡɛnewaa kɛŋɔ he muɡli he dɔŋ baah, kɛ he jemɛ waa tenaa, he dɛ lawɛ he nyoa.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ ŋwalɛ nɛra aa won waa ta tɔ, kɛ nɛn nɛra aa dɔ hwɛɡa o nɛɛ te dɛ tɔ wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Dɛ wejerema toole dɛ nyiŋi harɛ bɛl ta naa, o dɛ paɡre. Bela nomondɛɛɡa aa lole la, deŋnesɔɔhna lɔ bela.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Haa nɛn jemɛ aa, haa o habɔɔ che kem ta. Haa on ajinamuu di. He vɛoh bɔ kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ he te do a ta.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Haah waa dɔ dadɛɛɡe la dɛ dɔ nyanyini, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ lɛ ɡaeh dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh ɡbo.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa wera dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ, nyubinikpeɡ te dɛ ha o ɡbaɡba.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ koeh aa tɔnɔ bɛlbwaa dɔ tɛo, nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Nɛn o siwi aa swɛɛra kɛŋɔ o waa toɡre kɛrɛdɛ la, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu, kɛ nɛn waa teŋa dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la te dɛ́ sewɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Korowii kii nɛn o liire aa wola were, o sie dɛ lɛ nɛn o we-ɛɛla aa wera nɛ.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: A ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛraa, kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa te ɛɛ dɔ ba nyuu.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Handɛɛɡe waa wola da dɔe la, do kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm noniseɡ do parakoo mee ta!

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra konnyini ɛ wedɛɛɡa, kɛ kon wechɔɡ-ɛɛ aa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o waa la, o dɛ ba bandia ne.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Nomɛl nɔn dɛ pili kɛ dɛ ta ɛɛ dɔ, asɛ bɛl ɡe nɔn aa pili kɛ dɛ ɡe nya.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ pili nɔn ásɛ wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ, dɛɛ cha banfala ásɛ ba cha he ɡe.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa tɔ mea cheɡ, dɛɛ kpa suuɡajena la, nɛra dɛ taahno, kɛ onɔ la waa le o kwaa ne dɛɛ yoɡa la, ba swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: He dɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa aa, nɛra dɛ nyin he wa, kɛ he dɛ nyin wechɔɡa aa, he dɛ dɔ.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o kondɔɔh ta la, wɛɛ cholo kɛŋɔ hwel saŋ papoo yon le la, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te ɛɛ do werii, kɛŋɔ bwaala nee saŋ papoo ken.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ waa dɛɛ dawɛ o dem tena nɛɛ la dɛ chɔ pɛɛ. Gɛɛ a do ɡɛne ɛɛ berɛ wejereme bonɔɔ.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ nɛra ɛɛ dɔ mkpa, kɛ naɡrenyin te dɛ chɔɡ o bala.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Nɛndɛɛɡa dɛ dɔ ba wedɛɛɡa kembɔr harɛ nɔ ta naa, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ la, ɛɛ ba ba wechɔɡa kembɔr dɔe.

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o jemɛ waa la dɛ sɛh chɔɡre. Gɛnee wola sɛh kɛ ba baɡlo wa.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Korowii tea dɛ to nɛndɛɛɡa nɛ, dɛɛ pa nɛra baa dɛ lii wechɔɡa bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ aa won che o we-ɛɛla ta dɛ́ lɛ o te, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te dɛ́ so le kiŋkiŋ ken.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Handɛɛɡe ɡelɔ o jaa ɛɛ dɔ jirima, kɛ haah waa kpɔ sihiih dɛɛ kpo o jaa la, do kɛŋɔ weela aa lɔ nɛn nɛ.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, kɛ nɛn o nyondoŋe aa bar o nyu te liire ɛ nyosone ɡbosoo.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe wobol do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa sɔah dɛɛ nyin o dɔŋ dɛ́ kpo, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol dɛ́ lɛ nɛra.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra mun ɛɛ heo kwaraa, ásɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te dwee do le.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Wejeremee baa kpɛɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi ɡɛna nyubaahna.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Dansaa waa dɔ bonɔɔ la, bɔ nɛn waa dɛ lii o te nɛnjen dɛ berɛ dɛɛ chɔ lɔr.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ nyiŋi o kondɛɛra nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Nɛnchɔɡaa dɛɛ ɛ nyubinikpeɡ ba kwaa nɛ.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Paa waa swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ toma laanee, dɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona. Gɛnee dɛɛ chɔɡ o te toma aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe ta.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡa pɛla waa bwaa kɛŋɔ bichɔɡwa, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ ken.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe nyoa wobolee dɛɛ lawɔ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te dɛ́ le wahala ta.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Nɛn kembɔr lɔ anɔ la waa bol ne o we-ɛɛle ta. Anee ɡela wɛɛ dɔ kwaa aa chɛo.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Gɛnee yon dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ o wobɛlbwa wer, kɛ nɛn waa lɛ o dɔŋ waa dɛɛ ja o kwaa ta laanee wejereme.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Gɛne bandiaa baa na warane, kɛ nɛn waa dɔ nfɛrɛ laa liire dɛɛ kpɔ chɛɡa ta.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ di kasinteŋ laanee dɛɛ di danseɛ aa toɡra, nyosonteŋnii dɛɛ di dansewea.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ lole saŋ bɛlbwa, nyosonee dɔ jaɡa.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Nyosone ɡboo nɛn waa dɛ lii wechɔɡa nyu bini. Nɛra baa dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne la dɔ silɛɛ.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡa aa nɛn o wa aa toɡra pu, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te ne wejoree.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Korowii kii nyosonteŋni, o sie dɛ lɛ nɛn waa dɛ di kasinteŋ nɛ.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Wejereme dɛ tɔ o wejemwaa ta, ɡɛnee dɛɛ pili o ɡɛnewaa ta dɛɛ tɛ nɛra.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ toma kohonaa dɛɛ dɔ nomonome, bɔhwaahree dɛɛ do nɛn lɔɡa, baa doo tomkpeɡa ta.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Waa liira kohona do kɛŋɔ bone ken, asɛ wobodɛɛɡa ɡe ɛɛ sɔɔh baah.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ tɛ o dɔŋ liidɛɛɡa, nɛnchɔɡee dɛɛ neɡre o dɔŋ.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa ɛ bɔhwaah la, waa o tetoo kwaa dɔ, kɛ nɛn o sie aa wola on hwah la o dɛ dɔ kwa.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Waa aa toɡra ŋwɛnɛ chɔɔ kaa mkpa ta, wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ te, seo taa o kaa.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Bechawejeremee dɛɛ no waa o mɛɛ aa dɛ doo a ta, kɛ deŋnekpeɡ te te, waa o wechɔɡa sɛh.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: He dɔ wobodɛɛɡa aa, he na som, kɛ nɛn waa wola kasinteŋ bol te, dɛ na wa.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: He jemɛ he wobol nyiŋaa, he laa he te dɛɛ kpɔ waa ta, kɛ nɛra baa bol waa baa wola liire a ta do la, dɛ chɔɡ ba te.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Bɔhwaah bɛlbwa aa o konnyini dɔ, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin toma te, o dɛ dɔ kon waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra aa nyosone nyin, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe wobol te, sihihwaa ne ncho ɡboo a bwa.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Nɛn wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛ chao o soɡa bini, asɛ nyubinikpeɡ ɡe ɛɛ chɔɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Nɛra bane dɛ ɛ ba te kɛ dɔɔhna, kɛ dɛ komɛlbwa toole ba be, bane ɡe ɛ ba te nyaara, kɛ dɛ dɔɔhnaa ban.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Dɔɔhnee ba lawɛ dɛɛ lɛ suuɡa, kɛ nyaa te, ba waane laa o wa.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra soɡa bini chaahnɔ kɛŋɔ bochaah ken, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te do kɛŋɔ kandea waa dɛ dime.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Waa nee jenu ɛɛ ba, wejeremee dɛɛ bɔɔ waa bini.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ dɔ kwaa la, ɡelɔ aa kaa kɛŋɔ peu ken. Bɔwɔb kweena dɛ́ dɔ kwaa ɡe ɡelɔ a che dɛɛ warɛ.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: He hwɛɡɛ kon ta, dɛ he ta dɔe yaa, he bambilee dɛɛ chɔɡ, kɛ he hwɛɡɛ komɛl ta dɛ dɔ aa, he sie dɛ lɛ.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ wedɛɛɡa kpɔ he deŋna habɔɔ kaa laa, waa he nyin dɛɛ dawɛ he nɛ, kɛ he teŋɛ a ta naa, he bwara dɛ sɔɔhne.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Wejereme webaɡla do kɛ bule dɛɛ tɛ mkpa, a dɛ le nɛn seo ta.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɔ wejema la, dɛ́ dɔ duure, kɛ nɛn o wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe te, a dɛ kaa o ne wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Wejereme bɛlbwa dɛ lii waa mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛa, kɛ ɡɛne te ɡelɔ baa na o ɡɛna.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa wola jae no la dɛ nya dɛɛ di sihiih, kɛ naate waa dɛ no jae la, o dɛ dɔ nyanyini.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ aa dɛ do som kɛ haa dɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin! Nɛn waa ɡɛnaa ki o wechɔɡa ta lee.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he te pɛl wejereme ásɛ dɛ jemɛ wa, kɛ nɛn o ne ɡɛne aa pɛa la, o dɛ na wahala.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne waa bobɛlbwa, kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te, wedɛɛɡaa ɛ ba kembɔr.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra naanaree dɛɛ di ba kapɛrɛre, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa te kapɛrɛre dɛ kaa nɛra ba wa aa toɡra be.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Dɛ nyaa koo kondikwaa ɛo kohona naa, nɛnchɔɡa ɡelɔ aa le o nɔn ta.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: He dɛ fah he bie nyu aa, dɛ haa on nyin, kɛ dɛ he dɛ nyinu waa, he do sie dɛɛ kaoh buɡ ta.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra di kwaa o baah ɛɛ sɔɔhno, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te dɛ chɔ lɔr saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Hanwejeremee dɛɛ vɔwɛ dea, kɛ hanɡɛnee yon dɛɛ paɡre dea.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra laanee dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ neɡre nɛraa wola Korowii kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Gɛne mbarafo wobol taa a che wɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra, asɛ wejereme wobol ɡe ɛɛ leo waa ta.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Bela baa kpɔ nae dɛɛ parɛ la, dɛ nae toole naa, kondikwa aa le do. Kɛ nae lɔ bela tenaa, kondikwaa dɛ bu.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɔ kasinteŋ la aa nyosone teŋe, nɛn waa dɛ di dansewea la, nyosone ɡboo o bwa.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ mamɛ wejemwaa la aa waa jemɛ, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun te, dɛ́ jemɛ waa warane.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Laa he te kpɔ ɡɛne nɛ, waa won baɡle wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Wejereme jemɛ waa aa wera kɛ o ɛ. Gɛnee yon dɛɛ neɡre o nyu kɛ o jemɔ.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Gɛna waane laa wechɔɡa baa ɛ wa, nɛra ba wa aa toɡraa yon dɛɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ jemɛ waa aa dɛ ha o dɔŋ, kɛɛ ɡɛ o silɛɛ aa doa.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe dem dɛ chole, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra dem te dɛ che le.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o soɡa waa soɡa la ken wer, kɛ dɛ aa were, o ka tona la ɛ seo.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Mama bɛl ɡelɔ tebinichɔɡ ɛɛ le nɛn nɛ, asɛ silɛɛ bɛl habɔɔ ɡe ɛɛ berɛ wii.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa ɡel wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra, nɛndɛɛɡa ɡe ɛɛ dɔ ba we-ɛɛla kembɔr.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Gɛnee yon dɛɛ yarada wobɛlbwa waa dɛ no, kɛ wejereme te dɛ́ nyiŋi o vala bini.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Wejereme dɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ o soɡa bini kɛ o bɛ waa dɔ. Gɛnee dɛɛ ɛ waa saɡasaɡa, o baah ɛɛ di warawara.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Nɛn o baah aa wola biɡri dii dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛnewa, wejeremee dɛɛ lawɛ bambile.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi nɛndɛɛɡa baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii siee.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Nyaa dɔŋ kwaraa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛ, suuɡatee dɔ chamene tena warɛ.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ na nyaara sum la, o na som, kɛ a ɛ wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ he hah he dɔŋ, dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: He dɛ lii liichɔɡa aa, dɛ he kono, kɛ he dɔ liidɛɛɡa aa, nɛra dɛ yaradae, dɛɛ tɛɛ duure ɡe.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Koeh habɔɔ tɔnɔ do, kɛ nyoa wobol te, pɛɛpɛɛ dea aa la.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Wejereme kondɔɔh o wejema, asɛ ɡɛne ɡe we-ɛɛla ɡel baa jemɔ.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ danseɛ dii dɛ́ lɛ nɛn nyu, dansewea tee dɛɛ le nɛn habɔɔ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Baa waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii bwara dɛ sɔɔhno. Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ o haah ne bii nɛ.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Korowii ɔma do kɛ bule waa dɛ tɛ mkpa, anee dɛɛ le nɛn seo ŋwɛnɛre ta.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Nɛn nee baa di kora, nɛra toole naa, kora ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Deŋnesɔɔhna dɛ tɛ bokpeɡa, kɛ bɔweela te, ɛ weela.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: He dɛ do nyaara weweele aa, he dɛ chɛɡɛ Korowii waa ta ba, kɛ he dɛ ɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ naa, he dɛ tɛ Korowii jirima.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ we-ɛɛlaa dɛɛ ba o chɔɡa ne, nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɔ hwɛɡa, hale seo ta.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɔ liiree dɔ wejema, ɡɛnee wola wejema liire dɔe.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Harɛ bɛl ɛɛ dɔ sɔnee yaa, dɛ a cheɡɛ toɡra o nɛra aa toɡra ta, wechɔɡaa ɛ sihiih tɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Kooro bɛlbwa siwi dɛ su o bonɔɔ waa jemɛ wa. O dɛ tɛr onɔ la waa dɛ ɛ sihihwaa deŋne.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Tahaah dɛ sɔɔh bandia, takpeɡ ɡe ɛɛ ir bwaawee.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Wejereme wobol ɡelɔ wejema ɛɛ dɔ pɛla, ɡɛne ɡee dɛɛ bol waa warawara, wejema aa wola toole a ta.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ na bobɛlbwa, o dɛ nyiŋi wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne wedɛɡ-ɛɛra bwa.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Wobodɛɛɡa do kɛŋɔ tɛɛɡa ken, neɡra wobolee dɛɛ ku loo.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Gɛnee dɛɛ vɛh o mɛɛ wa, kɛ nɛn baa dɛ jao wɛɛ no la, dɛ jemɛ wa.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ dɔ kondɔɔh o dem, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa kwaa dɔe dɛ tɛɛ ba wa.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Wejerema wobol dɛ tɛ wejema, Gɛne wobolee wola won wobɛlbwa tɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Korowii kii nɛnchɔɡa saraha, o dɛ no nɛra ba wa aa toɡra wesoŋa.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Korowii hah nɛnchɔɡa we-ɛɛla, O dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ waa aa toɡra ta.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: He laa sie kpɔ wedɛɛɡa ta naa, he dɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra kohona, he kii kɛ ba bol waa baɡle naa, sewee hɛɛ dɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ na lalbɔɔ ne lalabwɛɛ waa bwa, a ta do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bambile bini.

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ muɡli nɛra baah la, aa nɛn waa jao la waa nyin, waa nɛn waa jemɛ waa la be la.

english_verse: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.
translation_verse: Nɛn sie lɛo waa, o dɛ mamɛ, o loo kuu tenaa, o bambile dɛ chɔɡ.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɔ liire la pɛlaa dɛɛ lawɛ kɛŋɔ ba hweli waa dɛɛ ja, ɡɛnee dɛɛ do sie ɡɛnewaa ta.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ wahala ta la soɡa bini aa were, kɛ nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ la, do kɛŋɔ baa dɛ di kondikonjena saŋ bɛlbwa ken.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ dɔ kwaa tama, bɔ kɛŋɔ haa dɔ kwaa kohona dɛɛ dɔ wa.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: He di dɔkpɔɡa dɔr komɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta bela baa dɛ nyini, bɔ kɛŋɔ haa di nao waa do noo dɔr bela baa haeh.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di warane la dɛ ba naɡra ne, kɛ nɛn waa dɔ bambile te dɛ sɔɔh waa nyoa.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Bɔhwaah soɡa bini do kɛŋɔ, waa dɛ valɛ sɔɔhne ta, kɛ he waa toɡraa, he ŋwɛnɛ wer.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Bechawejereme ɡelɔ o mɛɛ baŋa ɛɛ pa, kɛ biɡɛne te hah o nya, dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa wola liire dɔe la, ɡɛnewaa dɛ lɛ o sie, kɛ nɛn waa dɔ liire la waa toɡrɔ.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: He maɡle waa dɛ he ta jajaa dɔe yaa, a dɛ chɔɡ, kɛ dɛ he dɔ jajaala waraa, a dɛ do wer.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: He chaŋe waa aŋwɛnɛ ta naa, a dɛ ba silɛɛ ne dɛɛ tɛɛ. Waa bola a saŋ ta wer ɡa.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Wejereme bɛlbwa dɛ kpɔ mkpa ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ laa o te dɛɛ kpɔ waa aa ba seo ne.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ mbarafo la, Korowii dɛ chɔɡ o dem, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ luhaahna kwaa ta.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Korowii kii nɛnchɔɡa liire, nɛndɛɛɡa liiree dɛɛ lɛ o sie.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ nyin kafo la kpɔ waa dɛɛ ba o ne dem tena nɛ, kɛ nɛn waa kia kɛ ba yawɔ sen la ɛɛ so lee.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa yon dɔ haŋra waa ta mɔɔ dɛɛ chaŋe, kɛ nɛnchɔɡee yon too wobochɔɡa ɛɛ le o nyoa.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Korowii ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛ baah jaŋne, o dɛ no nɛn o wa aa toɡra wesoŋa.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Dɔŋa be mama dɛ́ ba silɛɛ ne, asɛ amanesoma ɡe ɛɛ ba bokpeɡa ne.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no jae aa dɛ ba mkpa ne la, o ne wejeremaa dɛɛ pɛ.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa wola jae no la ta o nyu, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ no jae la, o dɛ no waa mun.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la dɛ jemɛ wa, he ta he te pwɛraa, haa jirima dɔ.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyinii dɛɛ maɡle wa, asɛ Korowii ɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ haa bola a do wer.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o we-ɛɛla wer o be, kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi a bini.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he wobɛlbwa haa ɛ la do Korowii nɔn ta, ásɛ wobɛlbwa haa maɡla la do wer tɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa Korowii aa ɛ la, dɛ waane waa dɛ nyin waa o ɛa. O ɡelɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ so le, ka tel saŋ baa dɔ deŋnetɛra.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Korowii hah nɛn waa dɛ ɛ mbarafo, kpelaa, naate ɛɛ di bolchɔɡee dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Nyina ne kasinteŋ taa wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ do. Korowii ɔma ɡe taa nɛn che dɛɛ ke wechɔɡa.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn waa dɛ su Korowii siwi aa, o ɡelɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ɛɛ ba o ne o dɔma kwaraa baah ta.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta cheɡa dɔ kontama wer, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta, dɛ dɔa kohona.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Nɛn nyubini liire nee wɛɛ maɡle wa, kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ baɡle waa waa ɛ.

english_verse: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
translation_verse: Kooro nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ Korowii waa ken, waa bole pae ta koni.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyin kasinteŋ bona dii waa ta, a waa o ɡel kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa do le.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Kooro bɛlbwa kii wechɔɡa, waa aa toɡraa ɡela kora ɛɛ che.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Kooro baah diu waa, wɛɛ won ɡel ba kpoe, wejeremee jemɛ o larawa.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Kooro sie lɛo waa, a dɛ ba mkpa ne, a do kɛŋɔ sitɔ bwaala baama ken, a nɛo waa, kwaa dɛ do wer.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: A wer kɛŋɔ haa dɔ wejema ne waa mun noe, dɛ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa dɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa!

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra la dɛ ke wechɔɡa o vala bini, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyiŋi o vala bini la, dɛ dɔ o nyu.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: He pwɛre he te dɛ nya bɔ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ he ne mbarafo tena aa bɔne laa ta kwa.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no waa la, dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ la, o na som.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Nɛn o liire aa wera dɛ dɔ wejema laanee ba ŋɔ o dɛ no waa mun. O wobosoma taa a che nɛra sɛh dɛɛ ba o be.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Wejema do kɛ bule dɛɛ tɛ wejereme mkpa, asɛ ɡɛne ɡe deŋnetɛra ɛɛ leo o ɡɛnewaa ta.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Wejeremee lii waa mɔɔ dɛɛ bol, o wobol ɡelɔ nɛra sɛh dɛɛ ba o be.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Wobodɛɛɡa do kɛŋɔ tohnoo ken, a som nyoa ta dɛɛ tɛ bokpeɡa ɡe.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Teabɔɔ ɡela nɛn ɛɛ ɛ toma, onee dɛɛ doo a ta.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡee dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa, o wobol do kɛŋɔ ninlao ken.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡee kpɔ waa dɛɛ perɛ, onee dɛɛ ba waa ne, dɛɛ peɡri daamanar baah.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ nyin yoi la dɛ faah o dɔŋ, o kpɔ o dɔŋ la dɛɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ waa ta la dɛ lii wechɔɡa, o dɛ tɔ nyoa nyiŋi wechɔɡa chiɡ.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Nyumpompoŋa ɛ jirima botire, nɛn o wa aa toɡra laanee dɛɛ dɔa.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Bambile dɔe wer ɡwaa banyoo tenten, he jemɛ he te lawa aa, a ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa yoa lɛ bwɛbir.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ ta bie dɛɛ nyin liire a ta, kɛ Korowiirii jemɛ ɡɛ aa chiɡ.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Kondikonchwee bosɔɔhna aa lɔ a ta, ɡwaa kondikondɛɛɡa naɡra aa lɔ a ta.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Yom waa jemɛ waa la, dɛ nyiŋi o dɔɔ bie o wa aa wola kɛrɛdɛ doe nɛ, o dɛ dɔ kapɛrɛ kwaa aa ɛ bii la kwaa la ane.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Niinii ba kpɔ dɛɛ jemɛ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ a wer, ɡɛɛ Korowii ɡe ɛɛ nyiŋi bambile bini.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡee dɛɛ do deŋna wobochɔɡa ta, ɡɛɛ nyosonteŋni ɡe cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no musuwa.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: He dɛ mamɛ nyaaraa, Korowii waa ta baa hɛɛ chɛɡɛ, ɡɛɛ a do dɛ he sie dɛ lɛ he dɔŋ wahala ta naa, hɛɛ ba deŋnetɛra kohona dɔe.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Banjeni ne hanjeni jirimaa ba naanar, ɡɛɛ nya ne mɛɛ ɡe jirima ɛ ba bii.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Mbarafo wobol aa were tɛ ɡɛne, ɡɛɛ a ta chɛ kɛ kooro teŋe nyosone.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ waa o dɔŋ aa ɛo ta la dɔ nyina. A kpoŋa dɛɛ bol te dɛ peɡri darame.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa jemɛ wa dɛ́ hweli waa dɛɛ le webeŋkpoŋ haa bol baɡlo ta la, ɡwaa ɡɛne baa chao chweema kera lafa.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe waa dɛ nyin deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla ɡbo la nɛn waa wola nɛn sum naa baa tomɛ o be.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: He cheme sisire baa pa o bii kaa bɔ ɡɛne waa lɔ o ɡɛne we-ɛɛla ta.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: He kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ bɔ wedɛɛɡa kem aa, wechɔɡa aa he demii paŋɛ bwa.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Naɡra mumpar do kɛŋɔ haa teɡɛ nee bio, waa la aa wola dɔe do kan la, teŋe a ta mɔɔ a kaa sie.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Korowii hah nɛn waa dɛ pa nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ bolchɔɡe, dɛ hah nɛn waa pa nɛn waa ɛ wechɔɡa boldɛɛɡe ɡe.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Tɔnɔ besoo a dɔ kɛŋɔ ɡɛne kpoŋe suuɡa dɛɛ nyin wejema dɛ o ta a liire dɔe yɔ?

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Darame dɛ baɡle nyina saŋ bɛlbwa, asɛ lolanar ɡe do le tɛ dɔŋa chae waa ta.

english_verse: It's stupid to guarantee someone else's loan.
translation_verse: Gɛnee di ajinamuu dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin naɡra sie dɛ lɛ wechɔɡa ta, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ta nyoa ɛɛ kaa chɔɡa ta.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe waa kpɔ waa dɛɛ perɛ, aa andɛɛɡa dɔ, ɡɛɛ nɛn o nyondoŋe aa bar o nyu la ɛɛ na wa.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Biɡɛne lola dɛ we, silɛɛ toole tɛ o mɛɛ.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Silɛɛ dɛɛ tɛ bokpeɡa, asɛ lokua ɡee sɔɔh nɛn.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡee ba sɔh dɛɛ yawɛ sen, asɛ wɛɛ berɛ waa sie.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Wejereme sie lɔ wejema ta saŋ bɛlbwa, ɡɛnee wola wobɛlbwa dɔe dawɛ o sie ta.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Biɡɛnee wola ɡelɛ o mɛɛ sie ɛɛ lɛ, onee ɡela o nya tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡ.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: A ta maɡrɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn ɛ kɛrɛdɛ ba tɛr o deŋne, kɛɛ dɛ lɔɔ nomonome baa dɛ di kasinteŋ.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Wejereme wobol lɔ tamaa ken, nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la jemɛ o te lawa.

english_verse: Even fools seem smart when they are quiet.
translation_verse: Hale ɡɛne tɔ o nyoa so naa, ba dɛ liiru wejereme.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa wola nɛra baah jo la waane laa nomɛlbwa wa, o dɛ lɛ ɡaeh, waa nɛn waa lɛɛ dɛɛ do.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Gɛne waane laa waa mun noe, o waa bwaa kɛŋɔ o ɡe baɡle o wejema.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Nɛn nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ nee waa luŋa ken, wejema leebɔr do kɛŋɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Aa were kɛŋɔ bá nyiŋi nɛnchɔɡe siebɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ bolchɔɡe tɛ nɛn waa wola bolchɔɡe dii.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Gɛne wobol dɛ ba naɡra ne, o nyoa wobolee ɡela baa lɔɔro.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Gɛne wobolee dɛɛ chɔɡo, o nyoa dɛɛ doo waa ta.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Nɛn ŋwala som, a do kɛŋɔ kondikonsoma aa dɛ jo tea.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Bɔhwaah aa toma ɛɛ nyin, o dɔŋee nɛn waa dɛ chɔɡ kwa.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Korowii do kɛŋɔ dejaŋ waa kpeɡa, belaa nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa chwa dɛɛ kaa wɛɛ lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: A ɛ ɡɛnewaa dɛ dɔ sihiih kɛŋɔ haa wola waa mun noɛ dɛɛ chaŋe.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Liire haa dɔ he weela ta kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɡbaŋroo la, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ, dɛ he ta ɡɛ liire dɔe yaa, dɛ hwɛɡa toole.

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Wejerema dɔ liire kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ hweli waa, baa cheɡ deŋnee dɛɛ no wa.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Koŋkɛɛla pili ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ tɛ nɛn, a ɡelɔ wɛɛ jo nomonome bini.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: He bol wedɛɛɡaa, he dɛ vaɡɛ kɛŋɔ haa di kondikondɛɛɡa ken, wobol aa wera ɡelɔ he baah ɛɛ sɔɔhne.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Nyoa wobol dɛ ba seo ne mkpa ne. Anomanta, nyiŋi he nyoa wobol bini kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ bɛ waa dɔ.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: He dɔ haah naa, dɛ he dɔ kondɛɛɡe, a dɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii chae.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Nyaa dɛ bol wa aa, o kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ soŋe, kondɔɔhnee dɛɛ chaŋe waa kpeɡri nɛ.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Chamene tena kpɔe kohona dɛ chɔɡe, kɛ damsom bɛl ɡwaa lole.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Nyaa o bwara aa wola wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔe la, ɡwaa nyosonteŋni waa ɡɛna.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Aa were kɛŋɔ nɛn nya wejema, ɡɛɛ dɛ haa waa bini nyiŋi dɛɛ ɛa warawara ɡe aa, hɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛŋɡɛnee dɛɛ chɔɡ o te, kɛ o yon berɛ kpɔ nya Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Dɔɔh daamanaree dɛɛ warɛ, nyaa daamanaree yon chwao.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɡalɡa takapɔ kɛŋɔ ba waa ɛɛ lɛ nɛnjen sie, ɡɛɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe ɛ nɛn waa dɛ kɛ kwaa dam.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: He nyao waa, he lolanar dɛ́ vɛɛh, n baa bol he daamanar wa. He dɔ waa dɛɛ nyin ba bɔr aa, haa ban na.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ wejema la, dɔ nyina tɛ o ɡbaɡba, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la, o wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do wer.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Dansewea te dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra, ɡɛɛ nyosonteŋni ɡe ɛɛ sewɛ.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Yɛɛra ta ɡɛne chɛɛ, ɡɛɛ yom ɡe aa wola chɛɛ kɛ nomonjena do o lɔɡa.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Wejeremee won bambile lawa, o dɛ dɔ jirima waa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ ta.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Kooro bandia do kɛŋɔ nyujente aa sia ken, asɛ o silɛɛ ɡe do kɛŋɔ mɛn aa ta kpɔɡa ta ken.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Bibaa waa ɡɛna dɛ́ tɛ o mɛɛ wa, asɛ hannaɡrenyini we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ nee aa dɛ kor la ken.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Dem ne suuɡaa baa ne o haah sewɛ dɛɛ ɡel o bii, kɛ handɛɛɡe te, Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Bɔhwaahree dɛɛ chɔ dom kohona, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa wola waane ɛɛ nyin la ɡe ɛɛ chɔ lɔr.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii Mmara ta la, o dɛ dɔ o nyu, nɛn waa wola a ta teŋɛ la, ó dɛ sewɛ.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ nyaa kɛrɛdɛ la, Korowiirii o kpɔ dɛɛ kemɛ, waa waa ɛa la, o dɛ tɛo a nachiɡe.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Kah he bii, ba nɛɛ he dɔ hwɛɡa kerekere, dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, hɛɛ ɡeloo ba chɔɡ.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di kohona dɔ wa aa, bɛ on lɛ, ɡel a noo, ɡɛ laa aa hɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ lɛo.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ jae naa dɛɛ no, dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta, ásɛ tɔpebɛl he ba dɔ wejema.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Nɛn won waa maɡla kohona, kɛ anɔ la Korowii aa dɛ nyin laanee dɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Kɛrɛdɛ nɛn aa dɛ ɛ waa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin o wa, nɛn nyao bɔ kɛŋɔ waa dɛ teŋe nyosone.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Korowii ɔmaa dɛɛ ba mkpa ne, anee ɡela nɛn liire ɛɛ chɔ bobeŋkpoŋ o bwara ɛɛ sɔɔhno.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Nɛra bane bɔhwaah ɡwaa ba nɛɛ kɛ, bá won kpɔ kondikwaa kwaraa la nyoa.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Bammuɡli nɛn dɔ deŋnetɛra aa, nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ hweli waa dɛɛ le a ta, ɡɛɛ ba baɡle wejereme waa, wɛɛ jemɛ wa.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Bechala waa dɛ fiiɡi o mɛɛ, dɛ doŋi o nya dɛɛ le dem la, o ɛ sihihbie.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: N bie, he dɛ vɛh waa baa dɛ doe a ta hwela aa, hɛɛ le wejema ŋwɛnɛ taa.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Dansewea tee kpɔ o dɔŋ kasinteŋ waa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ do wechɔɡ-ɛɛ som kɛ kondikwa.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Deŋnetɛra chɔ le kpa bammuɡli nɛn, ɡɛɛ lɔɔra ɡe do le tɛ ɡɛne.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Sen nyɔe kohona ɡelɔ nɛn ɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa dɛɛ ɡɛn. Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ a nyɔe berɛ o toma la ta liire dɔe.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Kooro bandia do kɛŋɔ nyujente aa dɛ si ken. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ doo bwaawee la dɛ ta o nyu.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa jirimaa kɛŋɔ o laa o te kpɔ naɡra we-ɛɛla ta, ɡɛnee dɛɛ nyin yoi.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Paa waa dɛ ɛ bɔhwaah kwaa para saŋ la, ɡɛɛ waa wola kondikwaa dɔ a koma saŋ ɡe.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Waa aa lɔ nɛn liire bini do kɛŋɔ bule waa luŋa bini nee ken, naate waa dɔ wejema laanee won nee la dɔe.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Nɛra ɡalɡa dɛ bol ŋɔ ba dɔ nyina saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛ umee dɛ́ won jemɛ nɛn o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ ɔ?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra o bwara aa wola wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔe la, o seo habɔɔ, o bii dɛ na som.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won ŋɔ, “N te tea bini too, wechɔɡa toole n nɛ kwaraa nɔ?”

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ faah nɛra kwaa yoɡa ta, ne kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa o faah la.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Bechala we-ɛɛla taa ba che dɛɛ jemɛ kɛ o ɛ bechadɛɛɡe.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Dom dɛ do he som kohona naa, nyae hɛɛ nya, he iro dɛɛ ɛ toma aa, kondikwaa dɛɛ bu he nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone likes to brag about getting a bargain.
translation_verse: He yon ŋɔ kon yoɡ aa were, dɛ berɛ kaa maŋkura he te o yawa ta.

english_verse: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
translation_verse: Dɛ he jemɛ waa haa dɛ bol aa, he dɔ kon ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋ.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Nomɛl di hɔɔh ajinamuu he be naa, lɛ o yal cheɡ, dɛ naate ta he bini bɛl ɛɛ yaa, lɛ o komɛl cheɡ awɔba.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: He kpɔ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ lɛ kwaa di aa, a som, kɛ a habɔɔ la, a dɛ do kpeli he nyoa bini.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa haa maɡla la, ɡel ba jae mɔɔ he ɛ. Nyin ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe mɔɔ dɛ vɔrɔwe laa.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: He taah he nya kɛɛ he mɛɛ aa, he piɡro dɛɛ sewɛ kɛŋɔ kandea aa dima biro ta la.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ta koɛh dɛ dɔ he te mumpar aa, a habɔɔ la, aa hen kɛrɛdɛ chiɡ.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ bɔ wechɔɡa kem, dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ o ɛ wobɛlbwa tɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ faah nɛra kwaa yoɡa ta, ne onɔ la baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa dɛɛ faah nɛn.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Korowiirii kpɔ ya nakpale ɛɛ cheɡ bela waa wera, ɛrɛɛ nɛn ɛɛ ba wona jemɛ o vala bini nɔ?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: He toolo baɡɛ Korowii nyoa aa, a ɛ bel dɛ chɔ kpae, a habɔɔ a ba ɛ waa dawɛ he nɛ.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Korowii hweera waa hweera do nɛn bini la, do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah waa aa lɔ ya liire bini.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Nyina ne kasinteŋ ɡelɔ Kooro ɛɛ biɡri, nyina taa a che o kora ɛɛ che.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Bonɔɔ bokpeɡaa ɡela o dɔ jirima, ɡɛɛ nyumpompoŋa ɡel banjeni ɛɛ dɔ duure.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Deŋnetɛra kohona won wechɔɡa laa dɛ́ kpɔ nɛn bambile ta.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Kooro bɛlbwa liire lɔ Korowii nɔn ta, kɛŋɔ nɛn yon pere bɔr tɛ nee wɛɛ kpɔ o ta la.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o wobɛlbwa toɡrɔ o be, kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi a bini.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: We-ɛɛla aa wera dɛ toɡre, dɛ su Korowii siwi ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa ɛ saraha tɛo.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Sisa we-ɛɛla ne mbarafo, ne wedoŋa bwa ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ maɡle waa kɛrɛdɛ la dɛ́ dɔ kwaa taeh, kɛ he too waa ta naa, nyae hɛɛ nya.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: He kpɔ nyosone ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ dɔ kwa aa, a dɛ le he nɔn ta kɛŋɔ peu ken, dɛ́ berɛ ba seo ne.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ te naɡrenyinii dɛɛ chɔɡo, o dɛ vɛh waa aa wera ɛɛ.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa di waa ane bolchɔɡe la, o wobɛlbwa aa toɡre, kɛ nɛn waa di bole la soɡa bini toɡrɔ.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: He ɡbo soɡe saldoa bɔ kɛ he ne hannaɡrenyini aa pɛ dem.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ te bɛlbwa dɛ nyin wechɔɡa taeh, waa o dɔŋ nɛɛ sune.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Bammuɡli nɛn dɔ deŋnetɛra aa, ɡɛne hweli waa dɛɛ le a ta, ɡɛɛ ba baɡle wejereme wa aa, wɛɛ jemɛ wa.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Korowii O Wa Aa Toɡra jemɛ waa aa lɔ nɛnchɔɡe dem. Wɛɛ tɛr o deŋnee.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: He laa deŋna kpɔ nyaa wii waa dɛ wi ta naa, he ɡe ɛɛ baa wiu, haa nɛnee dɔ ó lɛɛ.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl baah di he nɛ, he sɔh kpɔ kon kɛo waa, a ɡelɔ o baah ɛɛ sɔɔh.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra la, ba bol kasinteŋ aa, o sie dɛ lɛ, dɛ ɛ ɔmee kohona tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa kona le wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta la, sewaa wɛɛ sewɛ.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: He dɛ nyin silɛɛbɔra kohona naa, nyae hɛɛ nya. Gɛɛ dɛ he dɛ nyin sen ne kondikondɛɛɡa aa, a do dɛɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ te dɛ nyin nɛn o wa aa toɡra ne wechɔɡa aa, a dɛ ɡure o nɛ.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Baa ɡbo soɡo bɔ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ waa mo hannaɡrenyini o baah aa dɛ di kohona.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa jemɛ waa la dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh ne kondɛɛɡa, kɛ ɡɛnee dɛɛ chɔɡ o kwa.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa teŋɛ waa aa toɡra ta, dɛ dɔ nyina ɡe la, o dɛ biɡri, o wobɛlbwa ɡe ɛɛ do wer wɛɛ dɔ jirima.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa jemɛ waa la won bwɛjen bokpeɡa tena aa lɔ o ta yoi, dɛ́ paɡre ba dekpeɡa baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: He jemɛ he nyoa lawa aa, haa waa dɔ.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ maŋkura o te la dɛ́ ɛ mbarafo. O ɛ bammuɡli nɛn o we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ɡwaa kohona.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Bɔhwaah pɛla konee dɛɛ kpoo, dɛkalkɛ waa toma ɛɛ nyin.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Korowii kii nɛnchɔɡe saraha, n baa bol kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ liichɔɡa ɛa.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Dansewea te dɛ sewɛ, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no o be la ɡe sewɛ.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe dɛ ɛ o siebɔr kɛŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe, nɛn o wa aa toɡra te dɛ́ nyiŋi o waa bini kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini wejema ne waa mun noe, dɛ wejaala ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, dɛ Korowii ta o nɛɛ jae yaa.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: He dɔ jaɡre ɡɛ bɛlbwa dɛ won kpɔa yo aa, Korowiirii dɛ won ɡel he yo le.
