english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Do he bie kɛrɛdɛ waa aa wera ta, ásɛ dɛ o baa kpeɡ aa, o bɛ an ɡel.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Gɛ suuɡate aa dɛ di kpeɡri nyaa nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa di kem la ɛ nɛn waa kemɔ suuɡa la bonɔɔ.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la dɛ na a wa, nɛra waa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la dɛ ba a jaɡa.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɔ tesom dɛɛ tɛ nyaara kondikwa la, Korowii ɡelɔ wɛɛ na som.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Doŋi bammuɡli nɛn le he jwɛh, ásɛ wobobala ne naɡra ne chɛɡa bwa tonɛ.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔ bambidɛɛɡe dɛ jemɛ wobol aa, kooro dɛ kpɔe dam.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyiŋi nomɛlbwa waa dɔ wejema, dɛ taɡɛ nyosonteŋni waa dɛɛ ta.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Bɔhwaahree yon ŋɔ, “Nyujente lɔ dahare!” Kɛɛ, “O ken ɛɛ kpo mɛ fɔɡbaahnaa!” dɛɛ so dem.

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Hanjwamane wobol do kɛŋɔ bɔluŋ ken. Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ Korowii bandiwaa la dɛ le o bini.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Gɛnewa lɔ bechala bɛlbwa bambile ta, kɛ dɛ he kpɔ chweema toɡro waa, o dɛ jemɛ wa.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Nɛn waa ɛɡre nyaara dɛ dɔ kwaa dɛɛ ja la, ne onɔ la waa kpɔ kwaa dɛɛ kɛ dɔɔhna la, ba bwa dɛ nya. Wejerema waa baa bola

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Cheɡ deŋne dɛ no nɛn waa jemɛ waa wobol, dɛ́ hweli waa maa dɛ baɡle nɔ.

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: A wer kɛ he kpɔ do he nyu bini, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ bol wa.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ hɛɛ jemɛ fini, ɡɛ aa ɛ he kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa do Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: N chwerɛ webele fifraatoro dɛ tɛɛ, wejaala ne wejema lɔ a ta.

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: A taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ kasinteŋ, dɛ́ kpɔ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa tomɛ.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Bɛ he dɔŋ nyae waa koh dɛ́ ɛɡro lɛ komɛl. Bɛ o nɛɛ nya, ásɛ dɛ bol waa bɔɔ kɔɔto.

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ bol a ɡɛ nɛra la waa tɛɛ ba, ásɛ ɡɛ haa lɛɛ ba kwaa la, ó lɛ le he be.

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: ásɛ he ba hwelu dɛ́ le a ta kahonɛ.

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Bɛ nɔn kpɔ ɛɡɛ tɔn ta tɛ nomɛl, kɛɛ dɛ di ajinamuu tɛo.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: Dɛ he ta komɛl bwa dɔe dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ aa, baa won lɛ he kalaŋ haa dɛ chɔ o ta ɡba.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Bɛ harɛ jwɛh he naawa aa bilu la laa kpɔ.

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa jemɛ nɔn toma kɛrɛdɛ la, koranar tomaa wɛɛ ɛ, waa nɛnsale toma ɛ.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Bɛ nɛn o tea bini aa kpela kondikwaa ba di bwa, bɛ ɡel he pɛla do o kondikondɛɛɡa ta.

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ne nomonjen dɛ ba kwaa dii yaa, nyiŋi he waa bini kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: dɛ he ɛ kafonyini aa, jemɛ he te lawa.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel he pɛla do o kondikondɛɛɡa la ta, a ken ɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa kpɔ neɡre.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Gɛ naate la liire aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o ɡbaɡba do. Wɛɛ ŋɔ he bee ŋɔ, “Di he tea bwa.” Kɛ dɛ o bambile bwa ne laa.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Kondɔɔh won hee kelo kɛŋɔ komɛl yon ɡale he sie ta la, a won ɛɛ kɛŋɔ kee kena yon moɡɛ ó ir kaa la.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Vaɡa haa vaɡa la, hɛɛ chwɛɛroo, ásɛ he wobosoma haa bola la yon ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Bɛ waa bol ɡɛne be koh, o dɛ lii waa aa lɔ a ta la wesale.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Bɛ saŋ la jwɛh waa chɔ le la laa kpɔ, bɛ bilalbii harɛ lɛ.

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: N bie, no dɛ́ che a ta jemɛ wa, ásɛ he sie chɔ harɛ he soɡa bini.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Bɛ sennyɔɔra nɛɛ ja, he ne banɔ la baa dɛ di kondikombala la bɛ pɛ.

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: Sen nyɔe ne kondibala te, nyae nee aa ba, ɡɛɛ dom chɔe kohona ɡe ɛɛ ba yakwane tɔe ne.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ no he mɛɛ deŋna wa, onee lolɛ, he nya ɡe baa hwɛɛhraa, bɛ on nyiŋi vah.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Lawɛ kasinteŋ bini kpoŋe dɛ bɛ kpɔ ta, nyin wejema ne waa hwela dɛ waa mun noe.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra mɛɛ sie dɛ lɛ, nomɛlbwa waa lolɛ biwejereme la, sie dɛ lɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: Make your parents proud, especially your mother. –
translation_verse: Gel he nya ne he mɛɛ sie ɛɛ lɛ, he nya te fanfa.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: N bie, cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ n da.

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Hanjwamane do kɛŋɔ bel, haah waa le o jaa habɔɔ do kɛŋɔ bɔluŋ.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: O kpɔ o te dɛɛ sɔh kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ ken, dɛ ɡel baala le ba haahna habɔɔ dɛɛ ba o be. O lawɛ ba nyuune dɛɛ lɔ dɔŋa.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Umee dɛɛ na waa kɛɛ dɛɛ wi suna ɔ? Umee lɔ wobobala ne naɡra ta nɔ? Umee ba do bol pɛɛpɛɛ ɔ? Ume sibie swɛɛra ɔ?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa soɡe sen mun dɛɛ biɡri, kɛɛ dɛɛ daɡɛ sen baa koora a do kpeɡri la.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel sen a nyɔe aa soma, a sie swɛɛ dɛɛ wure numol bini neɡre.

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, a do kɛŋɔ domkpule aa choɡe ken.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ na musuwaa, ásɛ he liire ɛ sakaa.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: He sie ɛɛ birii kɛŋɔ haa soɡe ɡbera ta vil sie ken, kɛɛ haa chɔ ɡbera bini nehɛma ɛɛ lɔ la ken.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Hɛɛ boloo ŋɔ, “Ba lɔ mɛ, kɛ ba ta men bol doe.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Ba lɔɔ mɛ, kɛ maa jemɛ. Saŋ besoo mɛɛ ba ira dɛ́ ka nyin sen nyɔ jaɔ?”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel he baah di wechɔɡ-ɛɛra we-ɛɛla wa, bɛ ban bɔweela ɛ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Bɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bɔweela ɛ, bɛ ɡel he pɛla lawɛ kɛ he ne baa pɛo.

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Waa ba liire yon do a ta laanee naɡre wa, ba wobol ɡe ɛ bichɔɡwa.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe kerekere, wobɛlbwa toole o sie dawɛ a ta.

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Wejema nee baa do dem, asɛ waa mun noe ɡel wɛɛ che.

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: Wejema taa a che deene aa lɔ dem bela la su kondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: N bie, dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii ne he kooro, he ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ bɛ pɛ dɛ́ ɛ beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé maɡle he waa kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ yo laa. Gɛɛ a do dɛ he dɔ jajaala kɛrɛdɛ waraa, hɛɛ ba wona yo le.

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: Wekpeɡa ane ɛɛ won piɡri le Korowii kɛɛ kooro la be dɛ ba. Umee dɛ won jemɛ wahala aa le ba bɛlbwa be dɛ́ ba nɔ? Wejerema waa ane ɡe ja

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Wejemwobol mun noe kpeɡri tɛ ɡɛne kɛŋɔ ó won no a mun. Bwɛɛla chemo dɛɛ bol wa aa, waa won ane bol.

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Wejemwobol ane ɡee nɔ. Nɛn siebɔr nyiŋa dɛ́ bol waa dɛ́ pa bole ta aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa la, nɛnchɔɡee baa yerɔ.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Gɛne wemaɡla bɛlbwa ɛ wechɔɡa, asɛ nɛn bɛlbwa ɡe hah bammuɡli nɛn.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: He pa boldɛɛɡe te bolchɔɡe aa, harɛre nɛra bwa dɛ́ taahnee dɛ́ haeh.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Waa ba he nɛɛ dɛ he ta wone che kiŋkiŋ naa, dɛ he bokpeɡa aa kanɛ kpa.

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: He tɛr bolchɔɡe te deŋne aa, wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ, he dɔ sɔndɛɛɡe.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛra baa dɛ́ ba bá kpoora ba tepoŋ ne, bɛ che nyiŋ ba ba serewe.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Bɛ sie laa kpɔ waane ta, dɛ́ ŋɔ he waane laa. Korowiirii jemɛ bambile bɛlbwa wa. Wɛɛ bɔ bɛlbwa kemee ɡɛ waa ɛa.

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: He chaŋe nɛn waa aŋwɛnɛ ta naa, a dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he ne o darame pɛo.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: N bie, tohnoo dɔ pɛla dɛ do som, anomanta, bɛ an vɛh.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Jemɛ kɛŋɔ wejema wer tɛ he wee, he dɔ wejema aa, he dɔ hwɛɡa he soɡa bini kerekere.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Nyin koo haa dɛ di o ta mɔɔ dɛɛ nyin bela haa kpɔ he nyu bil.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Bɛ he te ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛnchɔɡa yon vɔrɔwe vɔrɔwa, dɛ́ ka bar nɛndɛɛɡa deremi cheme, dɛ́ ŋwɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Waa pu nɛn o wa aa toɡra, o chole kera anuanɛ naa, o berɔ dɛɛ ir. Kɛ dɛ wechɔɡa pu nɛnchɔɡe te naa, o dɛ lɔ harɛ.

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Bɛ waa haa wola he dɔŋ nɛɛ nae la danseɛ di, bɛ nyosone teŋe.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Waa pu he dɔm aa, bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ, o lɔ harɛ naa, bɛ ɡel a do he som.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: A ba ɡɛ naa, Korowii ɛɛ nae, ásɛ dɛ laa o bandia kpɔ ɡɛ nɛn la nɛ.

english_verse: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
translation_verse: Bɛ ba lii ŋɔ, “Gɛ waa ɛɛ mɛ la, n ɡee ɛo anee, kɛɛ mɛɛ tɔɔ a welee.”

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: N fɛrɛ bɔhwaah bɛl koo nyoa, n kpɔ ɡɛne bɛl daa koo ta.

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: Jabalnadaŋɛ ne kpɔɡa lɛ koo la bwa, bwea waa kpɔa ma danjwɛɛ baro la ɡe kuuɡi.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: N nyiŋi koo la jeiih ken, dɛ lii waa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ kpɔ hweli wa.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Chɔe tama, dom chuɡla tama, nɔɔra fɔɔla dɛ́ so onɛ tama,

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Solomɔn sɛɡla ane Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea karakere aa nyiŋi a ta dɛ chwerɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Gɛ haa wola won jemɛ nyundua jaŋne, ne harɛ bini luŋri la, ɡɛɛ haa wola won jemɛ kooro liire.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Laa doŋa kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ta, ásɛ nɛn waa jemɛ a toma kpɔ kwaa kondɛɛɡe.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡa le kooro jwɛh aa, o kora ɛɛ cheo, toɡra o wa aa toɡra la wa.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Bɛ he te ɡɔɔ kooro sie, bɛ sobɔr nyin nɛnjena baah.

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: A wer kɛŋɔ kooro la ŋɔ, “Ba so n jwɛh,” ɡwaa kɛŋɔ waa iri, dɛ kpɔ he sobɔr tɛ nɛn waa ɡwaale. Waa he ɡbaɡba aa naa la,

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: bɛ too dɛ́ kpɔ kaa kɔɔto, ɡɛ laa dɛ he dɔŋ kaa di danseɛ bɔe naa, hɛɛ di sihiih.

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ne he dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, he ne o ɡbo bola, dɛ bɛ ɡel a le baŋ.

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: A ba ɡɛ naa, baa bol he bwara wechɔɡaa, ásɛ nyanyini haa dɔa la tonɛ.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Wobol aa wera dɛ maɡre la, do kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔa di suuɡapoŋ ɡwini ken.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ no nɛn waa jemɛ waa wejaala la, a ɡwaa kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛa.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Bambile dɔe ne tahaah won nomonjen liire bera, ɡɛɛ a won wekpeɡa ɡe sɔɔhna.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Dɔŋ dem laŋa kohona dɛ peo, a che a ta o berɛ haeh kwara.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa di dansewea dɛɛ dawɛ o dɔŋ nɛɛ la, o do kɛŋɔ ɡuli kɛɛ kere kɛɛ hɛm waa nyɛɡa ken.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔ waa dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ he dam haa wola hwɛɡa o nɛɛ dɔe yaa, a do kɛŋɔ he nyen haa wola won kpɔ chaŋe kwa, kɛɛ he nakpala haa wola won valɛ o ta.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: He dɔm chɔ lɔr aa, tɛo kondikwaa ó di. O ta nee dɔe dɛ́ nyɔ aa tɛo ane.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: He ɛ ken aa, sihiih dɛ ba o kpoe o baŋa ɡole, Korowii tɛɛ a kembɔr.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Gɛ dɔŋ bwara waa bola aa dɛ ba bandia ne la, ɡɛɛ peu waa taa le bobɛl dɛɛ ba bwaala nee ne la do.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: He ɡbo soɡe saldoa bɔ kɛ he ne hannaɡrenyini aa pɛ dem.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Gɛ he yon no amanesoma le bojaŋ a do he som la, ɡɛɛ nesɔn aa dɛ kpo nyɔɡre la ɡe do.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra kpɔ o te tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa, a do kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ doŋa do nee waa pala baa kaa ta ken.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Tooh kohona dii aa were, ɡɛɛ aa wola were kɛ he nyin sɔn kohona.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa wola won bambile lawɛ la, o do kɛŋɔ bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛɛ baro o kuuɡi la ken.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Gɛ ɡɛne aa wola kpɛɛra chɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ dombwea kɛɛ bwaala aa wola kwaa koma saŋ hiaeh.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Nyotaahna aa wola hen chɛɛ la, do kɛŋɔ jumbii aa dɛ ɡah aa wola daa ta joŋi la ken.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Chweema chɛ jaaɡɔ ne keeɡo, ɡɛɛ ɡɛne chɛ lɔɔra.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Bɛ he nyoa kpɔ do ɡɛne waa ta, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ba do kɛ on.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Chaŋe ɡɛne o ɡɛnewaa ta, ásɛ o jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ta wejereme ɛɛ.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: He tomɛ ɡɛne aa, he nakpalee dɛɛ sɔɔhne, he bambile te aa hen sɔɔh.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Gɛ boobi aa wola won valɛ la, ɡɛɛ ɡɛne aa wola jemɛ sɛɡle.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: He kpɛɛ ɡɛne aa, waa jemɛ. A do kɛŋɔ haa vɔwɛ bwe ne taya tɔn pɛ, he ta bwe laa, waa kaa.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Gɛ sennyɔɔ aa wola won laa sɔɔh kpɔ o nɔn ta la, ɡɛɛ a do kpeɡri tɛ ɡɛne kɛ ó won sɛɡle.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Dɛ he bɔ ɡɛne waa ba dɛ kaa o bobɛl paa aa, dɛ a do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa ta hɛma ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ do nɛra bola ken.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Gɛ nyoate yon uɡe dɛ berɛ kaa dia la, ɡɛɛ ɡɛne teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛnewa.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Nɛn waa ɡɛna kohona la, hwɛɡa lɔ o nɛɛ ɡwaa nɛn waa dɛ lii kɛ o jemɛ wa, kɛ o ɡe aa jemɛ.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Bɔhwaahree yon ŋɔ, “Nyujente lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta, o lɔ fɔɡbaahna.” Anomanta, waa le.

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Gɛ ɡbera aa cheɡɛ njinasoɔre ta dɛ ya dɛɛ tɔ la, ɡɛɛ bɔhwaah chɔ kalaŋ ta dɛɛ beɡre o te.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Nɛra bane bɔhwaah ɡwaa ba nɛɛ kɛ bá won kpɔ kondikwaa kwaraa la nyoa.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Bɔhwaah dɛ lii o te wejereme, kɛŋɔ o ɡwaa nɛra banuanɛ baa dɛ ba wona tɛ liidɛɛɡa.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa kpɔ o nyoa ɛɛ do nɛra waa aa wola o waa ɛɛ ta la, o do kɛŋɔ waa la fɔɡbaah, dɛ ka lawɛ nyoate deŋne.

english_verse: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows
translation_verse: Choɡla te waa dɛ ta hɛma nii naa lɔ a nyoa dɛɛ kpoo nɛra la,

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ neɡre o dɔŋ dɛ́ yon berɛ ŋɔ, hɛlaa wɛɛ hɛlɛ.

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Gɛ nindaa hɔɔ tonaa, nii yon dime la, ɡɛɛ nɛn ŋwala ɡe toole naa, naɡra toole.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Gɛ hɔla aa dɔ nii, damara ɡe ɡel nii ɛɛ hɔ la, ɡɛɛ naɡrenyini ɡe ɛɛ ba naɡra ne.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Nɛn ŋwala som, a do kɛŋɔ kondikonsoma aa dɛ jo tea.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Nɛn dɛ bol o dɔŋ bwara wedɛɛɡe kɛ dɛ dɔ o liichɔɡaa, a do kɛŋɔ baa ɛ suuɡapoŋ bɔle vii habɔɔ la.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Nɛn o nyoa wobol aa soma, kɛ dɛ dɔ liichɔɡa la dɛ́ neɡre nɛra.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: O wobol la dɛ do som, kɛ bɛ on yarada, liichɔɡa bwa soo siwii lɔ o nyu bini.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: He kwi nafuɡe aa, he ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ le o bini. He ɡbili bwe ŋɔ he ta he dɔŋ nɛ aa, wɛɛ berɔ ba he nɛ.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Nyosonteŋni hah nɛra waa teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛ, ɡɛɛ neɡra wobol ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa ɡbo ne.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Bɛ waa haa ɛ kere kpɔ dɛɛ bol wa, haa jemɛ ɡɛ tɔɔ aa dɛ ba he pera.

english_verse: Don't brag about yourself— let others praise you.
translation_verse: Bɛ he te kpɛɛ, ɡel nɛra kpɛɛre.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Bwe ne hɛŋle bwa tɔɡre te, kɛ waa ɡɛne aa dɛ ba a ne la ɡwaa a bwa.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di wɛɛ tɔ waa wel la, o nyu bini kpeɡri dɛɛ chɔɡ wa, kɛ bɔweela te ɡwaalo.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: He damdɛɛɡe dii kasinteŋ bɔ, kɛŋɔ he dɔm aa kpɔ nɔn dawɛ he vam ta.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Nɛn di kwaa vaɡɛ o tea aa, o waane laa tooh wa, ɡɛɛ nɛn lɔr aa dɛ kpoo la, koŋkpela ɛɛ do o som.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Gɛ jumbie yon ir le o kɔr ta dɛ kaa la, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa jo pua kaa dɛ ɡel o dem la do.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Konsɔɔhsoma sɔɔh ɡelɔ nɛn sie ɛɛ lɛ, ɡɛɛ dansom tenten ɡe liire waa tɛɛ la do.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Bɛ he chamenate kɛɛ he mɛɛ chamenate chwa. He dam waa bɛne la ɡwaa lole waa lɔ bojaŋ, anomanta, dɛ waane pui naa, haa won la he lole be ŋɔ ó chae.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: N bie, hweli waa dɛ jemɛ wa, ásɛ n baŋa pa, ń dɔ waa dɛ bol nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ nɛnsala la be.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɔ nfɛrɛ la, dɛ na waa aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba, dɛ yon ke o te. Nɛn waa wola liire dɔe yon so nyiŋi a ba diu.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Lɛ nɛn waa cheɡɛ hɔɔh kem nyoa la yal bil, dɛ o di haah waa wola he bini bɛl ɛɛ ajinamuu aa, lɛ o yal bil.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Dɛ he felo chɔmbibi dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ chɔɔ he dɔŋ aa, a dɛ berɛ chɛɡa tɛ nɛn haa chɔɔro la.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Hannaɡrenyini do kɛŋɔ, bwaala aa dɛ wiri waa wola ɡel bwa.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Gɛ haa wola won kpoŋe peu, kɛɛ noo a mwɛɛ nɔn ta la, ɡɛɛ haa wola won larawe a ɡɛ haah la ó ɡel naɡra.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Gɛ buni aa dɛ sar buni la, ɡɛɛ chamene tena hweli waa dɛɛ le dɔŋa be.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Dɛ he nyiŋi fiɡ daa ta kɛrɛdɛ naa, he dɔ o nɔna dɛɛ di, ɡɛɛ dɛ bonɔɔ tomɛ o dɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, wɛɛ dɔ sɔn.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛn nyiŋi nee ta o yon na ɡɛ o siebɔr aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o liire ɡe ɛɛ baɡle o nɛnsoo.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛwɛnyini pɛla kwa aa wola tonɛ bwa la, ɡɛɛ lalabwɛɛ ɡe aa wola su bwa.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Nii taa ba kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm do dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ a wer, ɡɛɛ a che nɛn kpɛɛra ta, baa jemɛ o nɛnsoo.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa ɡɛna te, he lɔɔro ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwara noo, o ɡɛna ta lɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Nyiŋi he kondɛɛra ta kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ do sie a nɛ,

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Dɛ he kɛ kondɛɛra kondikwaa cheɡ, dɛ berɛ kɛ kpɔɡa aa lɔ deŋɡarere ta, mɔɔ anfala ɛɛ moɡaa,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: anee dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ yal tɔ le he peera ta, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ suuɡa le he boohna ta yawɛ harɛ.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɔ na-elnee kohona dɛɛ he haah ne bii, dɛ he toli, ba bwara do wer.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe dɛ chwa dɛ nomɛl aa on doŋi, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra baah suu kɛŋɔ nyujente ken.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Harɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa lɔ o ta la, o koranaree dɛɛ warɛ. Kɛ harɛ waa dɔ nomonome baa dɔ wejema la, dɛ do kpeɡri dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Kooro waa dɛ ɛ nyaara hɔhɔrɔwa la, do kɛŋɔ bwaala waa wola komɛlbwa kwaa ken.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡaa wola waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ mun no, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii te dɛ́ no a mun kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Nyaa o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la, o bɔ suuɡa te o wa aa doŋa.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Biwejeremee dɛɛ teŋɛ Mmara ta, kɛ onɔ la o ne nɛnsale aa dɛ valɛ la te, kpɔ sihiih dɛɛ kpo o mɛɛ.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ kemɛ nɛra suuɡa, dɛ lɛ a nee kohona dɛ dɔ kondɔɔh la, o lɛa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɛ na nyaara sum.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Dɛ he vɛh Mmara ta teŋa aa, Korowii kii he wesoŋa.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: He neɡre nɛndɛɛɡe dɛɛ kaa wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ ta naa, a dɛ di he ɡbaɡba. Nɛn wobɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛɛ la, na som kerekere.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Suuɡa te dɛ lii o te wejereme, kɛ nyaa waa jemɛ waa la jemɛ ɡɛ naate aa doa.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Nɛndɛɛɡa baa di nomonome aa, nomɛlbwa sie dɛ lɛ, kɛ nomonchɔɡa balaa, ɡɛɛ nomɛlbwa hɔrɔme.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ tɔ o wechɔɡa ta la aa wer do, kɛ nɛn waa wona bol o kwaa dɛ ɡel a ɛɛ la, Korowii dɛ́ na o sum.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la, o na som, kɛ deŋnekpeɡ te ɛɛ ba na waa taeh.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Nomonchɔɡe waa dɛ nyiŋi nɛŋɡwɛɡra la, o do kɛŋɔ nyujente kɛɛ sisire yon dɛɛ kɔɡre, dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ́ lawɛ la.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Kooro waa wola liire dɔe, o nyu bini do kpeɡri laanee dɛɛ fiiɡi o nɛra, kɛ onɔ la waa wola kafo nyin la dɛ́ dɔ mkpajaŋ.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ kpoo nɛra la, o ɡbaɡba bɔɔ wɛɛ kwi, bɛ on kah.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: He waa bini wer aa, he dɛ dɔ he nyu, kɛ dɛ he waa bini ta toɡraa, he dɛ chole warane.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Paa waa swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ toma laanee, dɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona, kɛ onɔ la waa teŋɛ wesale ta la te dɛ nya.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ bol kasinteŋ la, o dɛ na som taeh, kɛ nɛn o siwi aa swɛɛra kɛ o dɔ kwaa warane la ne wahalaa.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Siebɔr nyiŋa dɛ́ pa bole aa were, kɛ bane dɛ che komɛl tama waa dɔ di la ta, dɛ yon ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Nɛn o siwi aa dɛ beɡre kwaa dɔe ta la, waa saŋ nyae aa ba o nɛɛ la te lii.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Haa ŋwɛ he nya kɛɛ he mɛɛ komɛl, dɛ ŋɔ he ta ŋwɛɛ ɛɛ la, dɛ henee ŋwɛɛ tenten.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ nyin kɛ o ɡbo ɛɛ dɔ la, dɛ́ ba wahala ne, kɛ nɛn waa kpɔ o te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ la soɡa bini dɛ do wer.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te ɛɛ dawɛ o ɡbaɡba liire ta la ɡɛnɔ, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ teŋɛ wejerema waa ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ cha nyaara la, komɛlbwa aa on nya, kɛ nɛn waa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ la, dɛ́ dɔ nyotaahna taeh!

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Nomonchɔɡa baa di kora aa, ɡɛɛ nɛra hɔrɔme, ba le bela tenaa, dɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɔ bɔr dɛ di kora.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ saŋ bɛlbwa ba kaeh kahonaa, he ne ba jara la, dɛ he dɔ wa, haa a nyoa tɛɛɡaa dɔ.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Nɛndɛɛɡa baa di kora aa, nomɛlbwa sie dɛ lɛ, dɛ nɛnchɔɡa ɡe baa di aa, nomɛlbwa dɛ hime.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin wejema la, o mɛɛ sie dɛ lɛ, kɛ nɛn o ne haahna baa dɛ bɔ jwamane nyoa aa pɛa la, dɛ he o kondɔɔh.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Kooro waa dɛ di kasinteŋ la, o ɡelɔ harɛ la wobɛlbwa ɛɛ maɡre, kɛ onɔ la o sie aa dɛ lɛ kɛ baa yawɔ sen te dɛ paɡre harɛ.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ pa o dɔŋ la, dɛ́ harɔ bel.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe bɛlbwa wechɔɡaa dɛɛ lawɔ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, silɛɛ ne hɛɡraa o bwa.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra la jemɛ waa aa wera tɛ nyaa, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te waane laa o wa.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Wejeremee won waa larawa, kɛ bammuɡli nɛn te won waa ne bwɛjen ta bala.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Dɛ wejereme kpɔ ɡɛne la kɔɔto aa, ɡɛne la dɛ mamɛ dɛ́ do ɡbɔɡa, dɛ́ ba chɛɡa ne.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Gɛnee dɛɛ baɡle o bandia nɛra baah ta, wejeremee dɔ bambile dɛ won o te lawa.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Kooro waa dɛ do deŋna nyosone waa ta la, o nomonome bwa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa nyaa ne nɛn waa dɛ fiiɡi nyaa la te bwa beŋkpoŋ, Korowiirii tɛ bɛlbwa sie o kpɔ dɛɛ na wa.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Kooro waa bol nyaara waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta la, o kora dɛ́ che dɛɛ biɡri.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Bechala deŋnetɛra wer dɛɛ tɛo wejema, kɛ he ta o nyu tɛo waa, o kpɔ sihiih dɛɛ kpo o nya.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡa baa di kora aa, wechɔɡaa dɛɛ warɛ, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ so lee, dɛ́ na ba harɛ lɔe.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: He do he bii kɛrɛdɛ naa, ba ɡelɔ hɛɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ne bambisɔɔhna.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Harɛ o nɛra aa wola Korowii waa kpɔe dawɛ ba nɛɛ la, bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o Mmara ta la, ba na som.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Baa wobol ɡbo kpɔe dɛɛ do bonɔɔ, wɛɛ no a munii, kɛ o ken aa sie do.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Hwɛɡa lɔ ɡɛne nɛ, dɛ ɡwaa nɛn waa dɛ bol waa waa wola lii mɔɔ.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: He ɡbɛɡbɛ he bonɔɔ le o bechale saŋ aa, a habɔɔ o dɛ ba bambichɔɡ ne.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di warawara la, dɛ ba naɡra ne. Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di kohona dɛ ba wechɔɡa ne taeh.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: He ne ŋwɛɛ dɛ bɔ aa, he ta he nyu, he bol kasinteŋ kɔɔto aa, ba dɛ tɛr he deŋne, he ta kasinteŋ bolɛ aa, Korowii dɛ taahne.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini ɔma do kɛŋɔ bel ken, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada Korowii la, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ nɛra ɡalɡa aa dɛ nyin kɛ koranar nyin ba waa la.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Waa aa le Jake bibaa Aɡur be laanee nɔ. “Korowii kpɔ mɛ ta, n ta lɛɛ dɔe.

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: Dɛ n fa do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ol, n ta nɛn liire dɔe.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Dɛ n ta wejema hwele, kɛɛ dɛ jemɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ la wa.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Nomɛl la Korowii doa dɛ berɛ ba kaa? Umee lawɛ peu kpoŋe o nɔmpaa bini kaɔ? Umee ɡbaa nee aa lɔ harɛ ta bwa do yal ta, kɛɛ umee kpɔ jwɛhre bil harɛ nɔ ta nyoa ɔ? Umee jemɛ naate ɔ? O sɔne ɛrɔɔ? O bie sɔne ɛrɔɔ? He jemɔ waa, baɡ mɛ!

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta. O dɛ tɔ nomɛlbwa waa ba o be ɡbemɡbe.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Bɛ waa Korowii aa wola bolɛ la kpɔ ja o waa ta, ásɛ o ba kaeh dɛ́ yerɛ nyosonteŋni.”

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Aɡur ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, webele anɛɛ mɛɛ nyin he be mɔɔ dɛ́ sewɛ, bɛ men vɔmɛ.

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Lɛɛ mɛ le wesale ne nyosone ta kwaraa, bɛ ɡel ń nya kɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh kohona. Tɛ mɛ anɔ la maa dɛɛ di tɔpere bɛlbwa.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɔ kohona naa, mɛɛ soh he waa, dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Korowiirii ume o?’ N berɔ nya kwaraa ɡe aa, ŋwɛɛ mɛɛ ba ŋwɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he sɔn chɔɡ.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Bɛ bonɔɔ sɔn ba chɔɡ tɛ o dɔɔ, ásɛ o ba taahne á dɔe.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Nɛra bane dɛ taah ba mɛɛnanar, baa andɛɛɡa sweerɛ dɛɛ tɛ ba nyare.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa toole ba nɛ, kɛ dɛ ba senɛ wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: Nɛra bane dɛ ɛ mbarafo, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra nyubaahna.

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: A do kɛŋɔ kpanjeɡ aa dɔ bihaahna banɛ, a sɔne ‘Tɛ mɛ!’ Kombele atoro ane lole aa vaɡɛ bwa, naarɛte lole waa wola ŋɔ, ‘A maɡrɔ!’

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Anee nɔ, lalabwɛ ne hambara, ne harɛ waa wola vaɡɛ dɛɛ nyin ne, dɛ nii aa dɛ lawɛ baa wola won dima.

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Nɛn o siwi aa wola o mɛɛ tɔɡɛ wɛɛ mamɔ, dɛ berɛ nyiŋi o nya dɛɛ vah la, ɛɡreree dɛ́ foromi o sibie, ásɛ kokosakire di o ola.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Kombele atoro ane waa dɔ nyokpoa kɛrɛdɛ n be, naarɛte ɡe maa o mun no.

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Anee kɛŋɔ, ɡɛ kee aa dɛ ɡah nyundua, harɛkon won bwetal ta kpɔe, ɡbera won nee sie kpɔe, asɛ baa ne haah yon dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa la.

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Webele atoro ane lole yaa wola won kpoŋe, naarɛte ɡe ɡɛ.

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Anee kɛŋɔ, yom waa bera di kora, ne ɡɛne waa dɔ kondikwa kohona dɛ di.

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: Ne haah nomɛlbwa aa wola on nyin o berɛ ba dɔ jaa, ne yomhaah waa lɛ haah waa lɔ o sie tolo jaa.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Kombele anaarɛ ane lɔ harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ do jeɡrejeɡre ken, kɛ dɛ ɡe jemɛ waa taeh.

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Anee vaɡla, aa kpeɡe kɛ a dɛ nyin a kondikwaa hwel saŋ cheɡ, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ kpa bwaala nee saŋ.

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Kukubanere aa wola kpeɡe nomanta, a jemɛ waa dɛɛ chɔ bwebɔɔne bini.

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: Tontombɛ ta sitɔɔ dɔe, kɛ a bwa pɛo dɛ ir dɛɛ kaa.

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ won lawɛ ɡer he nɔn ta, kɛ koodemii hɛɛ nao.

english_verse: Three or four creatures really strut around:
translation_verse: Kombele atoro ane lole a vala do wer, ɡɛɛ naarɛte ɡe do.

english_verse: Those fearless lions who rule the jungle,
translation_verse: Bɛlee puadɔɔ, o bwara kpeɡri ɡwaa ola bwa, waa komɛlbwa ɔmɛ kpɔɡ baah,

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: ne bombala, ne jabala aa laa nyuune pa, ne koranar ba nɛra aa bar ba cheme.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛne haa dɛɛ maŋkura he te, dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa aa, ɡel dɛɛ lii wa.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: He lɔ sooma aa, noo dɛ le a ta, he lɔ he dɔŋ mee ta naa, chal dɛ le, ɡɛɛ he muɡli he dɔŋ baah aa, hɛɛ ba naɡra ne.”

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Waa aa hiah Kooro Lɛmoɛl, o nya bol baɡloo nɔ,

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: “N bidɛɛɡe, n tea bini bie hen. N baɡɛ Korowii nyoa, dɛ lolɛ.

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Bɛ he bokpeɡa chɔɡ haahna nɛ, ba ɡelɔ koranar ɛɛ chɔɡ.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: Lɛmoɛl, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ koranar nyɔ seŋkpeɡa, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ba pɛla do a ta.

english_verse: Drinking makes you forget your responsibilities, and you mistreat the poor.
translation_verse: A ɡelɔ baa soh mmarare aa lɔ ba harɛre ta, baa nyaara waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta.

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa soɡe seo nyoa, kɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ di suna laanee chɛ kɛ o nyɔ seŋkpeɡa.

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Banee chɛ kɛŋɔ ba nyɔa, dɛ́ soh ba nyae ne suna baa dɛ di.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Bol waa dɛɛ tɛ a ɡɛ nɛra ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta, ásɛ dɛ ɛ nɛn waa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.” Handɛɛɡe kpɛɛra

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Umee dɛ dɔ handɛɛɡe ɔ? O dɔe kpeɡri ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa ne baŋa kwa.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: O jaa yarada bwa lɔ o nɛ, waa ɡelɛ wobɛlbwa ɛɛ hiah o jaa.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: O dɛ ɛ o jaa kɛrɛdɛ, waa on wechɔɡa ɛ o soɡa bini bwa.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: O swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ta yabii ba kpɔ sɔh yal o do wer kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: O dɛ la bojaŋ dɛ ka kpɔ kondikwa dɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ, stiimae yon la bojaŋ ka kpɔ bonadiire dɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: O felo dɛɛ ir chɔmbibii, dɛɛ tɛ o dem tena kondikwa, dɛ́ berɛ baɡle o toli dem toma bá ɛ.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: O dɛ nyin harɛ waa wera dɛ́ yawɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ o suuɡa yawɛ daa dɛɛ du.

english_verse: and she always works hard.
translation_verse: O bwara kpeɡri o swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: O dɛ na kɛŋɔ o bonadii dɔ tɔnɔ, dɛ ɛ toma wee kaa jo, o yon choŋi kandea, waa chɔ warane.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: Waa o ɡbo kon nyin, o dɛ ta tea dɛɛ tɛ nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra kwa.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Waa ɡelɛ waa ɛɛ kpo o dem tena waa saŋ. O dɛ tɔ ba yale.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: O ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ nyarɛ bombore dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ pa o chɔɔbɔr. O dɛ li yadɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: O jaa ɡe soɡe bwɛɛ nomonome bini naa, nomɛlbwa dɛ duuru.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: O dɛ sɔh yapondɛɛɡa ne kirisore dɛ yoɡ dɛɛ tɛ bonadiire.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: O bwara kpeɡri o waa dɔ nyɛl, o bwara aa on hwah, o dɔ hwɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: O dɛ bol wejemwa, dɛɛ baɡle waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: O dɛ do sie o dem tena nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, o siwi ɛɛ swɛɛ wɛɛ nyin kwaa aa hiah ba.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: O bii swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo, o jaa ɡe ɛɛ kpɛɛro.

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: O jaa yon ŋɔ, “Handɛɛɡa lole te, kɛ he dɔŋ toole.”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Tolwaa te dɛ neɡre nɛn, wer ɡe ɛɛ tu, kɛ haah waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la chɛ kpɛɛra.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: O chɛ kpɛɛra wobɛlbwa waa ɛ ta, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó dɔ duure nomɛlbwa be.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Waa Wejereme bɛl, waa ɛ Kooro Devid bie dɛ di kora Jerusalam, aa bola laanee nɔ.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: “Komɛlbwa ɛ wepuu. Wobɛlbwa ta mun dɔe.” Wejereme laanee dɛɛ bol! “Wobɛlbwa sese ta mun dɔe.”

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ nɛn ɛɛ ba dɔe dɛ́ le koeh bwa waa dɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta nɔ?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ sewɛ, baa lolɛ banfala, kɛ harɛ nɔ ta do ɡɛ waa doa.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Wee dɛ le dɛɛ chole, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ warane ba kaa bela waa dɛ le.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Peu dɛ ta baa kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ́ berɛ ta baa kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr, o dɛ ta bar ɡɛ naa dɛ ba cheme, dɛ́ berɛ ba kaa o buɡ ta.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Neerare bwa palɔ kaa jo mpo ta, kɛ waa su bwa. A bwa berɔ dɛɛ kaa bela aa lea, dɛ́ palɛ ba kaa ja.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa ɛ koeh tenten, nɛn aa wola won bola ka tonɛ. Siwi aa won ɡel nyiŋa, deŋne ɡe aa a noe ɡel.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before; nothing is new, nothing under the sun.
translation_verse: Waane a fa aa chiɡa ka la ɛɛ berɔ chiɡ ja, waa Korowii aa ɛa ɡe, ɛɛ berɔ ɛ, wobɛlbwa ta wefala ɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Waane lole ásɛ nomɛl na dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Anɔ te ɛ wefala aa?” Akai, a bwa fa lole, a lole saŋ la bwa mɔɔ ba lolɛ yaa.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa saŋ la baala waa lii kpa, hale banɔ la ba taa dɛ ba ba lola, nɛra baa lol ba, ba ɡe habɔɔ la, aa ba waa lii. Wejema ɛ wepuu

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Men maa ɛ wejereme la, dɛ n fa ɛ Israel kooro dɛ so Jerusalam.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: N siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ń jemɛ, dɛ le n te cheɡ dɛ hweli waa bwa nɛra aa dɛ ɛa harɛ nɔ ta. Na wekpeɡa Korowii aa kpɔa ba dawɛ ya nɛ!

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: N na komɛlbwa nɛra aa dɛ ɛa harɛ nɔ ta, a bwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Kon waa ɡola la, baa won toɡro. Kwaa toole naa, nɛn aa an na dɛ́ kura.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: N lii n nyu bini ŋɔ, “N kpeɡo dɛ dɔ wejema ɡwaa kooro bɛlbwa waa tɔ n sie dɛ ba di kora Jerusalam. N hweli ɡɛ wejema ne liire dɔe aa doa, dɛ jema kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: N siwi beɡrɔ n berɛ dɛɛ nyin ń jemɛ ɡɛ wejema ne ɡɛnewaa aa doa, dɛ na kɛ a bwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ, wejema kohona dɔe, ne suna dii kohonaa dɛɛ valɛ, waa mun noe kohona ɡe ne bambichɔɡaa.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: N ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ mɛɛ teŋɛ pɛlchɔɡa waa taa, dɛ́ kpɔ daah n te na, dɛ́ na ɡɛ silɛɛ aa doa. Kɛ a bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: N nao kɛŋɔ mama ɛ ɡɛnewa, pɛlchɔɡa ɡe aa wedɛɛɡa ne ba.

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: N cheɡɛ n wejema ta dɛ ŋɔ mɛɛ nyɔ senee dɛ́ di n nyu. N liiro kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba wona di ba nyuune, tɔpera tama baa dɛ ba dii harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: N ɛ wejena taeh. N do deene dɛ parɛ daa kooni tɛ n te.

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɛ bodɛɛɡee dɛ́ du daa bwa soo siwi aa dɛ nɔnɛ.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: N kwi taama nee le bela palɛ kaa jo daa la mune, ásɛ a won kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: N yawɛ yoma baala ne haahna bwa, asɛ ba lolɛ ba bini bane ɡe n dem. N berɔ dɔ nae ne peera, dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa tɔ n sie dɛ so Jerusalam bwa.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: N lɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm kohona, ne kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ le harɛre koranar baa lɔ n lɔɡa be. N dɔ haahna ne baala ɡe, ba ɡo yela dɛɛ lɛ n sie, asɛ n nyin haahna ɡe kohona.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: N baa ɛ nɛnjen kohona, dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa tɔ n sie Jerusalam. Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, dɛ n ta dɔ wejema kohona.

english_verse: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.
translation_verse: N ta n te laa kpɔ kwaa n sie a dɛ lɛ a ta nɛ, n vɛh wobɛlbwa n bambile aa dɛ nyin. N bambile lawɛ tomare bwa maa ɛa, anee ɛ kembɔr tɛ mɛ a bwa ta.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Kɛ maa kari waa bwa maa ɛa, ne kwaa maa koah dɛ dɔ la, dɛ komɛlbwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken, komɛlbwa ta tɔnɔ dɔe harɛ nɔ ta. Wejema ne ɡɛna bwa ɛ wepuu

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Belaa n berɛ kpɔ liire, dɛ nyiŋi ɡɛ wejema aa doa, ne ɡɛ choɡla ne ɡɛnewaa ɡe aa doa. Bɔkwaa kooro waa baa chiɡ o dɔŋ naa ta, ɛɛ ba wona ɛ á ɡwaa anɔ la sitɔte la aa ɛa ta nɔ?

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: N nao kɛŋɔ wejema wer ɡwaa ɡɛna, ɡɛ bɔr chaahna aa do wer ɡwaa biro la.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Wejereme bɛlbwa dɛ na bela waa dɛ kaa, kɛ ɡɛne te, biro binii o do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, waa jemɛ bela waa dɛ kaa. Kɛ ane a bwa, n nao kɛŋɔ, sewee chɔ le tɛ ba bwa.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Belaa n lii kɛŋɔ, “Waa aa pu ɡɛne la ɛɛ won ba n ɡe nɛ. Amɔ dɛ ɛrɛɛ n wejema maa dɔa la dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ mɛ nɔ?” Asɛ n ŋɔ, “Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu, a ta mun dɔe.”

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: N sie ta kwaa maa ɛ toma dɛ nyina harɛ nɔ ta lɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ba a ɡela tɛ nomɛl waa ba di n kwa.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ kɛ naate ɛ wejereme kɛɛ ɡɛne ɔ? Kɛ onee dɛ́ di kpeɡri kondɔɔh maa koah, dɛ nyina cheɡ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ta. Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n bambile pa mun chɔɡ, koeh bwa maa koah harɛ nɔ ta la wa.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Nɛn ɛɛ che o wejema ne o liire waa dɔa taa ɛ toma dɛ́ nyin kwa, dɛ́ ɡel a bwa habɔɔ tɛ nomɛl waa wola a toma ɛɛ. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba dɔe, dɛ́ le o koeh bwa waa swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta nɔ?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Toma waa dɛ ɛ o soɡa bini bwa ɛ weweele ne suna dii ɡbo. Hale jwaana bwa, dɛ o ta dɛ lii wa, waa wola won chɔ. A nɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Waa aa wera tɛ nɛwɛnyini bwaa kɛŋɔ, o di kondikwa dɛ́ nyɔ sen lɛ o sie, ásɛ o bwara sɔɔhno o toma waa ɛa ta. Anɔ ɡe kwaraa la, Korowii bee aa le,

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ dɛ o laa aa, umee dɛ́ won dɔ kondikwa di, dɛ́ lɛ o sie ɔ?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ nɛn o wa aa dɛ lɛ o sie wejema ne liire dɛ silɛɛ, kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ te, o ɡelɔ wɛɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ boa o kondɔɔh nyoa cheɡ tɛ nɛn o wa aa dɛ lɛ Korowii sie. Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa dɔ o saŋ Korowii aa lea cheɡ, asɛ wobɛlbwa ɡe dɔ o tɔpere harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: Bie lola dɔ o tɔpere, seo ɡe dɔ o tɔpere, kwaa dui saŋ lole, a fuɡra ɡe dɔ a saŋ,

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: Dɔŋa nyina dɔ a tɔpere, dɔŋa haeh tɔpere ɡe do le, laa yoi tɔpere lole, deŋnesɔɔhna dɔe tɔpere ɡe do le.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa nɛn waa dɛ ɛ toma, ɛɛ ba dɔe le o koeh waa dɛ koh ta nɔ?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: N na wekpeɡa Korowii aa kpɔa ba dawɛ nɛwɛnyina nɛ.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ komɛlbwa do wer o saŋ ta. O ɡelɔ ya jemɛ ya liire bini waa aa lole saŋ la, ne anɔ la aa chiɡ kerekere saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, kɛ yaa won no waa bwa Korowii aa ɛa le mumpar kaa a jaɡa mun.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: Anomanta, n nao kɛŋɔ waa nɛwɛnyina aa won ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, yá ɡel ya sie lɛ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa ya soɡa bini harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa di kondikwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen, ásɛ o sie lɛ kwaa waa koah dɛ dɔ la ta, a ɛ Korowii koŋkɛɛla waa kpɔa kɛ yaa.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ komɛlbwa Korowii aa ɛ la, ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Nɛn aa won kpɔ ane ja kɛɛ dɛ́ laa ane kpɔ a ta. Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ, ásɛ nɛwɛnyina kpɔ duure tɛo.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa aa chiɡa ka la, ne anɔ la aa chiɡ ɡe fa chiɡo ka. Korowiirii ɡela ɡɛ waa la bwa berɛ dɛɛ chiɡ.

english_verse: Everywhere on earth I saw violence and injustice instead of fairness and justice.
translation_verse: N berɔ na waane harɛ nɔ ta ja, nyubinikpeɡ chiɡ kasinteŋ bole pae naa ta, wechɔɡa ɡe chiɡ waa aa toɡra naa ta.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: N lii n nyu bini ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ ba bol nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ne nyubinikpeɡ tena bwa waa dɛ́ pa ba bole, dɛkalkɛ wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɔ o saŋee, we-ɛɛla bɛlbwa ɡe dɔ o tɔpere.”

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: N berɔ lii ŋɔ, “Kɛ nɛwɛnyina te, Korowii daah ba dɛɛ na, dɛ́ ɡel bá jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba do kɛŋɔ ola ken.

english_verse: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Webeŋkpoŋii chɔ le dɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyina ne ola bwa, ɡɛ bɛl aa sewɛ la, ɡɛɛ o dɔŋ ɡe ɛɛ ba sewa. Hweera beŋkpoŋii lɔ a bwa bini. Nɛwɛnyina ta ola ɡwaalɛ. Wobɛlbwa ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Bobeŋkpoŋii Korowii kontaala bwa ɛɛ kaa. Teeraa Korowii kpɔ taa, anomanta, teera binii a bwa berɛ ɛɛ ba kaala.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyina doma dɛ kaa nyundua, asɛ ola doma ɡe dɛɛ ka harɛ bini nɔ?”

english_verse: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n nao kɛŋɔ waa nɛwɛnyini aa ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, ó ɡel o sie lɛ toma waa ɛa dɛ dɔ kwaa la ta, dɛkalkɛ anee ɛ kembɔr aa chɛ kɛ ó dɔ. Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ o seo habɔɔ wa ɔ?

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: N berɔ nyiŋi dɛ na fiiɡa nɛra aa dɛ fiiɡi ba dɔŋa harɛ nɔ ta. N na nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba siniire, kɛ nɛn toole dɛ́ larawe ba bwara, dɛkalkɛ, nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la nɔn taa kpeɡri ka di.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: Asɛ n bol ŋɔ, nɛra baa serewa la, ba na som dɛ ɡwaa banɔ la ba taa soɡe le.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Kɛ nɛra baa wola ban lolɛ, baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta nae mɔɔ la, ba na som.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ate, n na kɛŋɔ toma nɛra aa dɛ ɛ dɛ́ dɔ kwaa bwa, le o dɔŋ bɛl komɛl waa dɔa, o na o siwi beɡre la ta. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, a do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Gɛnee yon fɔɔ o nɔɔra so ŋɔ, waa tomaa ɛ, lɔr ɛɛ kpoo ó sewɛ.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: He dɔ kondikwaa nɔndel di deŋnesɔɔhna ta, ɡwaa haa koah kohona, dɛ dɔa nɔndela anɛ di. A bwa ɛ wepuu, kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: N berɔ na waane ɡe aa wola mun dɔe harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Dɛ baa bɛl ɡboo soɡa, o ta bibaa kɛɛ nime dɔe. Dɛ tɔpere bɛlbwaa wɛɛ koh, kɛ o siwi aa o kondɔɔh su. Ate, o bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Ume waa mɛɛ koh maa wola won lɛ n sie nɔɔ?” Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, bosɔɔhna aa wola toole a ta.

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Banɛ wer ɡwaa beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛ ba nyoa ɛɛ won pɛ, ásɛ ba ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ dɔ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Beŋkpoŋ baa chole aa, o dɔŋ ɛɛ won chao ó ir. Kɛ nɛn waa chole o ta nɛn dɔe o lawɔ ir la na wa!

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Nɛra banɛ pɛo chɔ aa, ba dɛ wɔrɔbe dɔŋa bwara. Kɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ɡbo aa won chɔ o bwara wɔrɔbe.

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ bɛl ɛɛ won yo, dɛ́ pɔ o dɔŋ nɛ, kɛ ba pɛ nɛra banɛ naa, baa won lɛ ba te. Ŋwɛn baa pɛra atoro chae kpeɡri.

english_verse: You may be poor and young, but if you are wise, you are better off than a foolish old king who won't listen to advice.
translation_verse: Bonɔɔ waa nyaa dɛ jemɛ waa la, ɡwaa kooro waa hwɛɛhra, dɛ ɡɛn waa wola jae no.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ bonɔɔ la, ba ken lawɔ do dea mɔɔ o ba di kora, kɛɛ ba lolɔ nyaa bini o do o harɛ ta.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: N nao kɛŋɔ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta bwa, teŋɛ bonɔɔ baa lawɔ o ba chiɡ kooro naa ta la nɛ.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nɛra kooro aa dɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ ta nyoa dɔe, kɛ dɛ o baa sewaa, nomɛlbwa sie aa o waa waa ɛa taa lɛ. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, a do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: He dɛ la Korowii Dea aa, nyiŋi he vala bini kɛrɛdɛ. Do sie no o waa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡwaa ɡɛna saraha ba yon dɛɛ ɛ, baa wola jemɛ kɛ ba dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ lawɛ he nyoa, he dɔ waane dɛ́ bol aa, nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ too, dɛ́ bol baɡle Korowii. Korowii te, nyundua o do, asɛ he do harɛ, anomanta, bɛ ɡel he wobol do kan.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Liire waraa ɡela nɛn ɛɛ dee deera, ɡɛɛ dɛ nɛn dɛ́ bol waa kohona, dɛ o ta nyiŋe kɛrɛdɛ naa, wɛɛ bol ɡɛnewa.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: A wer kɛ nɛn ɡel nyoa baɡa, ɡwaa kɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa, dɛ vɛh a ta teŋa.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel he nyoa wobol kaa he ne wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ sɔfo be ŋɔ, sibeɡra ta laa he baɡɛ nyoa. Bɛ ɡel Korowii baah di he nɛ he nyoa wobol wa, dɛ́ chɔɡ kwaa haa koah dɛ dɔ.

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Deera kohona ne wobol kohona ta mun dɔe. Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii. Kondɔɔh ɛ wepuu

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: He na nomɛl waa nyaa, baa wola o waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛo aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ fiiɡu harɛ la ta naa, bɛ ɡel á kpo he nyoa. Nomoa bɛlbwa lɔ o dɔŋ waa ɡwaalo lɔɡa, asɛ ba bwa habɔɔ, nomonome bane ɡe ɡwaa ba.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa aa le harɛ la ta la, nɛra baa lɔ o ta la bwaa dɛɛ dia, waa aa chɛ kooro laanee kɛŋɔ, wɛɛ nyiŋi harɛpare la ta, dɛkalkɛ o ɡe ɛɛ dɔ anee di kohona.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa o sie aa beɡre suuɡa laa an dɔ kohona, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kondɔɔh kohona la sie aa a ta lɛ. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, a do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Nɛn dɔ kondɔɔh kohona naa, nɛra baa dɛ dia ɡe dɛ warɛ. Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ naate la ɛɛ ba dɔe? O sie ɡbo laa dɛɛ ba a ta lɛɛ yaa?

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Tom-ɛɛ chɔe dɛ do o som, hale o di kondikwaa tama kɛɛ kohona noo. Kɛ kondɔɔh kwaa waa dɔa kohona nomanta, waa won dom chɔ.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: N na wedoŋa ane ɡe harɛ nɔ ta, nɛra yon pa ba kondɔɔh sɔh kɛ aa ban cha,

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: kɛ a yon che waane ta bá paŋɛ ba kondɔɔh la, ásɛ dɛ ba dɔ bibaala bane kwaraa naa, baa komɛlbwaa dɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ ja ba.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Ba lolɛ bie ba harɛ nɔ ta naa, waa komɛlbwa ne ba, ɡɛ tentenee o sewaa wɛɛ ba kaala. Waa won kpɔ komɛlbwa waa koah dɔ harɛ nɔ ta kaa.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Waa aa teŋa nɔ ɡe ɛ wedoŋa kohona. Gɛ baa lolɛ nɛn o ba harɛ nɔ ta la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ kaalo. Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ wɛɛ ba dɔe, o koeh waa dɛ koh pɛɛpɛɛ ta nɔ?

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: O soɡa bini bwa do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa soɡe biro ta ken, o liire chɔɡ, dɛɛ na wenaale kohona o baah di.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Ate, n na kɛŋɔ a wer kɛ nɛn di kondikwa, dɛ́ nyɔ sen, ásɛ o sie lɛ koeh waa dɛ koh tɔpera tama, Korowii aa kpɔa tɛo harɛ nɔ ta. Waa aa chɔ le tɛo laanee la.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ Korowii tɛ nomɛl kondɔɔh dɛ ɡel o sie ɛɛ lɛ a ta, asɛ o jemɛ kɛŋɔ anee chɔ le tɛo waa, anee Korowii kpɔ kɛo.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Korowii aa ɡela o dɔ silɛɛ nomanta, waa o tɔpera tama waa di harɛ nɔ ta waa liira ba.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: N berɔ na wechɔɡa ane harɛ nɔ ta, aa do tɔɡre kohona kɛŋɔ bone, dɛ dawɛ nɛra nɛ.

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ nɛn kondɔɔh ne jirima, ɡɛ aa ɛ o bɛ komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin nya o soɡa bini. Kɛ Korowii aa ɡel ó dɔa di, nɛmpɛɛ bɛlee yon berɛ ba kpɔ. Anɔ ta mun dɔe, a ɛ wedoŋa.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl soɡo biɡri dɛ dɔ bii lafa, kɛ o soɡa dɛ biɡri bwa habɔɔ, dɛ o ta wone dɔ silɛɛ o kondɔɔh waa dɔa ta, dɛ sewɛ ba huɡo kɛrɛdɛ naa, amɔ dɛ bie baa haro ta kwaraa ɡwaalo.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ bie la ta wee nae kɛɛ dɛ jemɛ komɛlbwa te, kɛ o bwara sɔɔhno dɛ ɡwaa a ɡɛ nɛn la,

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: hale ɡɛ nɛn waa dɔ kondɔɔh la soɡo bene kaɡboŋa anɛ kwaraa naa, silɛɛ bɛlbwa aa a taa do. Ane a bwa, bobeŋkpoŋii bie la ne nɛn la bwa ɛɛ kaa.

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Kondikwaa nɛn aa di waa wɛɛ koh, kɛ waa vaɡɛ bwa.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Gwaala besoo wejereme ɡwaa ɡɛne ɔ? Dɛ nɛn nyao waa, o jo nɛra bini naa, o jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ lawɛ o te.

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: A wer kɛ he sie lɛ anɔ la haa dɔa ta, ɡwaa anɔ la haa kpɔ sie dawɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɔɔ ta. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa aa chiɡa saŋ la dɔ sɔn, asɛ ya jemɛ ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini ɡe aa doa. Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ne nɛn, waa do kpeɡri ɡwaalo aa won cheme.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Nɛn wobol warɔ kohona naa, aa mun kohona dɔ. Ɛrɛɛ aa ba wona dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ bɛlbwa nɔ?

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ umee dɛ́ won jemɛ waa aa wera tɛ nɛn, ya tɔpera tama aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe dɛ teŋe baa kaa kɛ lileo nɔ ta nɔ? Umee dɛ́ won baɡle waa aa chiɡ harɛ nɔ ta o seo habɔɔ?

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Sɔndɛɛɡe wer ɡwaa nosɔɔhsoma, ɡɛɛ seo tɔpere ɡe do wer ɡwaa lola tɔpere.

english_verse: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.
translation_verse: A wer kɛŋɔ nɛn la lwe mun, dɛ ɡwaa kɛ waa la bela baa dɛ di kondikonjena, dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ sewɔɔ. A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ do waa nɔ dɛɛɡɔ.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Suna dii ɡwaa mama, dɛkalkɛ suna dii ɡelɔ yaa hweli waa aa wera.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Wejereme dɛ́ kaeh naa, no o be, ɡwaa kɛ ɡɛne aa dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: Gɛne mama do kɛŋɔ, baa kpɔ sɔɔhne do nii ta aa parame. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: Corruption makes fools of sensible people, and bribes can ruin you.
translation_verse: He ɛ wejereme dɛɛ faah nɛra aa, he do kɛŋɔ ɡɛne. He sɛoh baa yawɛ sen ɡe aa, nɛnchɔɡee hɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
