translation_verse: Komɛlbwa tona wer ɡwaa o mumpar, asɛ bambile lawa ɡe ɡwaa kɛ haa dɛ ɛ mbarafo.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel he baah ɛɛ di warawara, ɡɛnee lɛ o dɔŋ waa dɛɛ do o bini.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Bɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ saŋ la wobɛlbwa do wer ɡwaa fini nɔɔ?” A ɛ ɡɛnewaa kɛ he bɔɔ ɡɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.
translation_verse: Wejema dɛ tɔ nɛn nɛ, kɛŋɔ suuɡa aa won nɛn lɛɛ la ken. Wejema dɔe kohona ɛɛ won ɡel naate la so sodɛɛɡa, dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Nyiŋi waa Korowii aa ɛa. Umee dɛ́ won toɡre kon waa ɡela o ɡoloo?

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Waane kaalɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ naa, ɡel he sie lɛ, kɛ dɛ wenaale bɛlee tenaa, lii kɛŋɔ, Korowiirii ba silɛɛ ne, dɛ berɛ ba wenaale ɡe ne. Anomanta, nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ ɡɛ aa chiɡu kerekere.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: N soɡa maa soɡa aa wola mun dɔe nɔ, webele anɛ aa teŋa nɔɔ n na, nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ́ sewɛ o wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ wa, ásɛ nyubinikpeɡ te so dɛ́ biɡri o wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: So don't destroy yourself by being too good or acting too smart!
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ he waa toɡrɔ kohona, kɛɛ he jemɛ waa kohona, dɛ́ chɔɡ he te.

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ berɛ nyubinikpeɡ ɛɛ kohona, dɛɛ berɛ ɡɛna ɡe kohona. Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ he sewɛ, dɛ he saŋ ta tele mɔɔ nɔ?

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: Lawɛ a bwa bini kpoŋe, dɛ bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa le he nɔn ta. Naate waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii ɛɛ won le ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa nyoa.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Wejema ɛɛ won ɡel nɛmbeŋkpoŋ di kpeɡri, dɛ́ ɡwaa koranar fi baa lɔ bwɛjen ta.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Bɛ deŋne cheɡ dɛɛ no waa bwa nɛra aa dɛ bol, ɡɛ laa aa, hɛɛ ba noo kɛŋɔ he bonɔɔ kwaraa taahne,

english_verse: Haven't you cursed many others?
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ he ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ he taah nɛra bane.

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: N cheɡɛ n wejema ta dɛ nyiŋi, dɛ daah a bwa na dɛ ŋɔ, “N siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ń dɔ wejema,” kɛ dɛ a berɔ ɡwaa n liire ta.

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n kpɔ n liire bwa do a ta, dɛ́ won jemɛ a mun, dɛ́ nyiŋi wejema ne ŋwɛnɛ aa cheɡɛ a ta waanee yon dɛɛ ɛ, dɛ́ na ɡɛnewaa aa lɔ nyubinikpeɡ ne ɡɛna ta.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: N na waane aa dɛ we dɛ ɡwaa seo, haah bɛl do kɛŋɔ bel baa dɛ harɔ. O bambile do kɛ nafuɡe, asɛ o nɔɔra do kɛŋɔ jɔɡrɔre, o kpɔ dɛɛ harɛ nɛra. Wejereme bɛlbwa o wa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi la, ɛɛ won chwa le o nafuɡere la ta, kɛ ɡɛne te, wɛɛ lawɔɔ.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I have tried to find out how everything fits together,
translation_verse: Wejereme la ŋɔ, “Hé na, waa maa naa laanee nɔ, n nyiŋi waane bini beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ aa cheɡɛ a ta waane yon dɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.
translation_verse: N taa dɛ nyiŋi a bini n ta wobɛlbwa nae mɔɔ la, babeŋkpoŋ o wa aa toɡra ɡboo n na nɛra kaɡboŋ bini, kɛ haah o wa aa toɡra beŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole ba bini.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Waa aa teŋa nɔɔ n hweli le a ta, Korowii fe ta nɛwɛnyina bwa ba waa toɡre, kɛ ba berɔ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛfale ta dɛ chɔɡ ba te.”

english_verse: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile. Obey the King
translation_verse: Umee ɛ wejereme ɔ? Umee dɛ won baɡle waa mun ɔ? Wejema dɛ kwaa nɛn siebɔr, dɛ ɡel wɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ. Kooro duura wa

english_verse: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.
translation_verse: Dɛ kooro bol wa aa, nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ waa ŋɔa, dɛkalkɛ he ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡle Korowii a wa.

english_verse: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.
translation_verse: Bɛ too ŋɔ hɛɛ le kooro sie kaa. Bɛ on deŋnekpeɡ ɛ, dɛkalkɛ wɛɛ won ɛɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Kooro aa dɛ di kpeɡri nomanta, dɛ o bol waa, umee dɛ́ won tɔŋlo wɔ?

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa no o waa waa dɛ bol la, aa wahalaa na, kɛ wejereme te ɛɛ won jemɛ saŋ waa wera ne ɡɛ waa ɛ.

english_verse: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything,
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini wenaale ɡwaa o nɛɛ te, kɛ wobɛlbwa dɔ saŋ waa wera ne ŋwɛnɛ baa ɛa.

english_verse: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ta kpeɡri dɔe o doma nɛ, nomɛlbwa aa jemɛ tɔpere waa dɛ ba sewa. Gɛ baa wola won lawɛ nɛn le laa ta la, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡa aa wola nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa bini le.

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: N na a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, asɛ n lii waa baa dɛ ɛa harɛ nɔ ta bwa. Nɛra bane dɛ di kpeɡri, asɛ bane ɡe do ba lɔɡa ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ.

english_verse: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.
translation_verse: N berɔ na nyubinikpeɡ tena baa huɡ ba, kɛ nɛra le huɡribɔr bela ba naa, ba yon berɛ dɛɛ kpɛɛ ba bwɛjen la bini baa soɡa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la. Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.
translation_verse: Nɛn ɛ wechɔɡa ba ta o deŋnetɛra kpɔe tɛo warane naa, nɛra dɛ dɔ liifala dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɛɛ won ɛ wechɔɡa kera lafa dɛ́ ta so biɡri. Kɛ n jemɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ duuru la, wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: but no one who sins and rejects God will prosper or live very long.
translation_verse: Kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa wola Korowii ɔmɛ nomanta, aa wer doe ba dɛ́ tɛɛ ba. Ba tɔpera aa jaŋnee do kɛŋɔ, lileo yon teŋe ba kaa la ken.

english_verse: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.
translation_verse: Waane ɡe lole aa wola mun dɔe harɛ nɔ ta ja. Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ dɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋnetɛra, asɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡe ɛɛ dɔ kembɔr aa chɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu ja.

english_verse: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n liiree kɛŋɔ a wer kɛ nɛwɛnyini di kondikwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen lɛ o sie harɛ nɔ ta. Gɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel o dɔ silɛɛ o toma ne o tɔpera Korowii aa kpɔa tɛo o so harɛ nɔ ta bwa.

english_verse: Day and night I went without sleep, trying to understand what goes on in this world.
translation_verse: N siwi beɡrɔ n nyiŋi ɡɛ wejema aa doa, dɛ na nɛwɛnyini koeh waa dɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta. N nao kɛŋɔ nɛn aa wone dɛɛ chɔ dom chɔɔ ne jwaana,

english_verse: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.
translation_verse: asɛ n na waa Korowii aa ɛa bwa. Nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ waa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ka tonɛ bwa. Hale anɔ bwa habɔɔ, nɛwɛnyini ta wone jemɛ a mun. Wejereme waa ŋɔa o jemɔ kwaraa la, waa won jemɛ bwa.

english_verse: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.
translation_verse: N lii anɔ bwa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ne wejerema waa baa dɛ ɛ bwa, lɔ Korowii nɔn ta. Kɛ bɛlbwa aa jemɛ kɛ wedɛɛɡa, kɛɛ wechɔɡa chɔ le dɛɛ kpaa ba.

english_verse: But exactly the same thing will finally happen to all of us, whether we live right and respect God or sin and don't respect God. Yes, the same thing will happen if we offer sacrifices to God or if we don't, if we keep our promises or are afraid to make them.
translation_verse: Nyokala beŋkpoŋii chɔ le dɛ tɛ ba bwa, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, nɛndɛɛɡa ne nɛnchɔɡa, banɔ la baa kah doŋa, ne banɔ la baa wola doŋa kaeh, dɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛ banɔ la baa wola sarahare ɛ bwa. Waa aa chɔ le tɛ nɛndɛɛɡe la, ɡɛɛ a chɔ tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɡe, ɡɛ aa doa dɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam la, ɡɛɛ a do tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɔmɛ ŋwɛɛra.

english_verse: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.
translation_verse: Waa aa ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ do wobɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta laanee nɔ. Webeŋkpoŋ laanee chɔ le tɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa. Wechɔɡa su nɛra bambili ɡɛ saŋ ba taa soɡe le dɛɛ ɡɛn, ásɛ mɔɔ bá piɡri sewɛ.

english_verse: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.
translation_verse: Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola sewɛ mɔɔ, dɛ ta so harɛ nɔ ta dɔ hwɛɡa. Nyoate waa wola sewɛ ɡwaa nyujente waa sewa.

english_verse: We know we will die, but the dead don't know a thing. Nothing good will happen to them—they are gone and forgotten.
translation_verse: Weera jemɔ kɛ baa sewɔɔ, kɛ nɛra baa serewa aa wobɛlbwa jemɛ, ba ta kembɔr bɛlbwa dɔe, nɛra aa ba waa kwaraa lii kpa.

english_verse: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.
translation_verse: Ba dɔŋa nyina ne dɔŋa haeh, dɛ ba meera waa bwa nyoɡrɔ, baa komɛlbwaa dɔ le wobɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta kpa.

english_verse: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.
translation_verse: Kaa ka di kondikwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen silɛɛ ne, kɛ taraken Korowii sie dɛ lɛ waa haa dɛ ɛ ta.

english_verse: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.
translation_verse: Gel he sie ɛɛ lɛ hɛɛ hɛɡre saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.
translation_verse: He ne he haah haa dɛ nyinu so sodɛɛɡa dɛɛ lɛ he sie, tɔpera aa teŋa baa kaa Korowii kpɔ tɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɔ. Dɛkalkɛ anee chɔ le tɛɛ, he le koeh haa dɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta nyoa.

english_verse: Work hard at whatever you do. You will soon go to the world of the dead, where no one works or thinks or reasons or even knows anything.
translation_verse: Do sie dɛɛ ɛ toma bokpeɡa bwa ne, dɛkalkɛ lalabwɛɛ haa dɛ ba kaala la, toma ɛɛ kɛɛ waane vɔrɔwa, kɛɛ waa mun noe, dɛ wejema toole bela.

english_verse: Here is something else I have learned: The fastest runners and the greatest heroes don't always win races and battles. Wisdom, intelligence, and skill don't always make you healthy, rich, or popular. We each have our own share of misfortune.
translation_verse: N berɔ na waane ɡe harɛ nɔ ta. Nɛra baa won chwae kohona laa chwaa dɛɛ tɔ sie, banyoola bwa laa wona yo laa dɛɛ pɔ nɛra nɛ. Wejema laa dɛɛ tɛ kondikwa, kɛɛ nɛn o liire bini aa chaahna laa dɛɛ dɔ kondɔɔh. Nɛn waa hweli tɔn kaa sie bwa laa dɛ́ won ɛ nomonjen. Kɛ wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa dɛ ba ba bwa nɛ.

english_verse: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap. Better To Be Wise than Foolish
translation_verse: Ane a bwa, nomɛlbwa aa o tɔpere jemɛ, ɡɛ ba yon kpɔ asau lawɛ pɛŋe, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ bel lawɛ jumbie la, ɡɛɛ ba yon harɛ nɛra bela dɛ́ piɡri laɡ ba tɔpechɔɡe wee. Wejema dɔe ɡwaa ɡɛna

english_verse: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.
translation_verse: N berɔ na waane aa ɛ wejemwaa aa lɛ n sie harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.
translation_verse: Dɛ bwɛjen bɛl waa wola kanɛ kohonaa fa lole, nɛra baa lɔ o ta ɡe aa kanɛ. Kɛ kooro bɛl waa kpeɡa kohona kpɔ o laa tena ba chɔ baro, dɛ ma kwaa baa che a ta jo bwɛjen la ta.

english_verse: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ŋɔ, “Wejema ɡwaa kpeɡri.” Kɛ baa la waa nyaa dɛ dɔ wejema la, nɛra ta on bui, nomɛlbwa ta o waa kwaraa liire kpa.

english_verse: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.
translation_verse: A wer kɛ ya no wobopwɛra wejereme aa dɛ bol, ɡwaa kooro waa kpɔ nyɛɡa bol waa dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛna.

english_verse: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.
translation_verse: Wejema wer ɡwaa dɔmkwaa baa dɛ yo ane, kɛ ɡɛne beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ won chɔɡ waa aa wera kohona.

english_verse: A few dead flies in perfume make all of it stink, and a little foolishness outweighs a lot of wisdom.
translation_verse: Koŋɡaahle sewɔ aa, o sɔɔh won nosɔɔhsoma sɔɔh chɔɡa, ɡɛɛ ɡɛnewa tamaa bini do tɔɡre ɡwaa wejema ne jirima.

english_verse: Sensible thoughts lead you to do right; foolish thoughts lead you to do wrong.
translation_verse: Wejereme bɛlbwa bambile cheɡɛ waa aa toɡra ta, kɛ ɡɛne te, wedoŋa ɡboo lɔ o bambile ta.

english_verse: Fools show their stupidity by the way they live; it's easy to see they have no sense.
translation_verse: Hale o kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa kwaraa naa, o ta liire bɛlbwa dɔe, a ɡel nɛra bwa na o ɡɛna waa ɡɛna.

english_verse: Don't give up your job when your boss gets angry. If you stay calm, you'll be forgiven.
translation_verse: Dɛ kooro baah di he nɛɛ aa, bɛ ŋɔ he dɛ vɛh toma waa kpɔa do he nɔn ta. Bambile lawa ɛɛ won sɔɔh he wechɔɡa haa ɛa nyoa.

english_verse: Rulers do some things that are terribly unfair:
translation_verse: N na wedoŋa ane ɡe harɛ nɔ ta, waane kooro bɛl aa koni a ta.

english_verse: They honor fools, but dishonor the rich;
translation_verse: Gɛnaa ba yon kpɔ chɔ wejena nyoo, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡa tena chɔ anjeɡre nyoo.

english_verse: they let slaves ride on horses, but force slave owners to walk.
translation_verse: N na yoma ba so jaɡre ta, asɛ nomonjena ɛɛ valɛ naa ta kɛŋɔ yoma ken.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you might fall in; if you break down a wall, a snake might bite you.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kwi bɔɔ la, wɛɛ won le o bini, nomɛlbwa waa ku danjwɛɛ dɛ jo la, harɛkon ɛɛ won choɡo.

english_verse: You could even get hurt by chiseling a stone or chopping a log.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ paɡre bwea la, bweaa dɛ́ doo bol, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ peɡri daa ɡe la, anee dɛ́ doo bol.

english_verse: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.
translation_verse: Dɛ kpanfɛ nyoa taŋɔ, ba ta on sarɛ aa, bokpeɡa nee hɛɛ ba o ne toma ɛɛ, kɛ he wejema taa aa ba cheɡa he won tonɛ.

english_verse: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.
translation_verse: Dɛ harɛkon choɡe tɛɛɡa te mɔɔ wɛɛ vɔwɔ kabere aa, dɛ a ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe tɛo.

english_verse: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Jirima lɔ wejereme nyoa, kɛ ɡɛne te, o ɡbabir nyoa wobolee dɛɛ chɔɡo.

english_verse: Fools begin with nonsense, and their stupid chatter ends with disaster.
translation_verse: Gɛne bol wa aa, a ɛ ɡɛne wobol, a tona bini do kɛ choɡla te wobol.

english_verse: They never tire of talking, but none of us really know what the future will bring.
translation_verse: Gɛne wobol warɔ, aa tonɛ bwa. Nomɛlbwa aa jemɛ waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere. Umee dɛ́ won baɡle waa aa chiɡ ya seo habɔɔ?

english_verse: Fools wear themselves out— they don't know enough to find their way home.
translation_verse: Gɛne dɛ koh o toma ta, waa jemɛ ɡɛ waa ɛ dɛ́ kaa bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.
translation_verse: Harɛ o nɛra kooro aa ɛ bonɔmbi, ba nomonome ɛɛ di kondikonjena, dɛɛ lɛ ba sie jwaana la, ba bwɛɛlɛ!

english_verse: But a nation will prosper when its ruler is mature, and its leaders don't party too much.
translation_verse: Kɛ harɛ o nɛra kooro aa ɛ koobie, ba nomonome ɛɛ di kwaa saŋ waa wera ta, dɛ dɔ bokpeɡa ɡwaa kɛ baa nyɔ sen dɛɛ la, ba na som.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl ɛ bɔhwaah dɛ vɛh o dea kwaara aa, wɛɛ luloo, ásɛ o nyundua la ku le o bini.

english_verse: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.
translation_verse: Kondikonjena dii dɛ ba silɛɛ ne, asɛ sen nyɔe ɡee ba hɛɡra ne, kɛ he ta suuɡa dɔe yaa, haa won ɛ a bini bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.
translation_verse: Bɛ he liire ɛ kɛŋɔ, hɛɛ bol kooro bwara wechɔɡe bɛlee, kɛɛ dɛ́ taah suuɡate he dea haa chɔ o bini, dɛkalkɛ jumbie bɛl ken ɛɛ kpɔ waa haa bola laanee ka taa baɡ ba.

english_verse: Be generous, and someday you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Kpɔ he paanoo ta nee sie, tɔpera ane habɔɔ la, wɛɛ berɔ ba he be.

english_verse: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.
translation_verse: Bɔne he kwaa haa dɔa bini ane tɛ nɛra banuanɛ kɛɛ banuatoro, dɛkalkɛ haa jemɛ saŋ chɔɡa aa ba harɛ la ta.

english_verse: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.
translation_verse: Haa wola luɡe peu aa dɛ kpɔ o ta jemɛ, kɛɛ ɡɛ nɛn aa dɛ kpeɡ o nya tea bini nɔ, ɡɛɛ haa wola won no Korowii we-ɛɛla waa mun.

english_verse: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce. Youth and Old Age
translation_verse: Hɛɛ du kwaa yaa, he dua chɔɔ dɛ bɛ so pɛɛpɛɛ jɔmɔra ɡe. Haa won jemɛ anɔ la aa do wer, chɔɔ kɛɛ jɔmɔra kwaa laanee yoo. A laa ɡe aa, a bwa ken ɛɛ won do wer. Lii Korowii waa tae he bonɔɔne saŋ

english_verse: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.
translation_verse: Bɔr chaahnɔ nɛn na naa, dɛ silɛɛ balɔ.

english_verse: Even if you have a very long life, you should try to enjoy each day, because darkness will come and will last a long time. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl wono so dɛ biɡri aa, a chɛ kɛ o sie lɛ o tɔpera la bwa ta. Kɛ ó lii kɛŋɔ tɔpechɔɡa ane lole, dɛ warɛ ɡwaa anɔ la waa kpɔa so. Wedɛɛɡa ane bɛlbwa toole dɛ do a habɔɔ kpa.

english_verse: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.
translation_verse: He ta ɛ bonɔɔ naa, ɡel he sie lɛ, dɛɛ di he bwara he bonɔɔne saŋ. Dɛɛ teŋɛ waa he bambile aa dɛ nyin, ne komɛlbwa haa na ta. Kɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ ba bol a bwa waa, dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.
translation_verse: Anomanta, bɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa hae, kɛɛ he na weweele bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ bonɔɔne saŋ waa teŋo baa kaa, dɛ bwa ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: Keep your Creator in mind while you are young! In years to come, you will be burdened down with troubles and say, “I don't enjoy life anymore.”
translation_verse: He taa lɔ he bonɔɔne saŋ ta la, dɛɛ lii Korowii waa tae wa, mɔɔ tɔpechɔɡa haa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa la ba. Ásɛ tɔpere bɛl habɔɔ mɔɔ he lii ŋɔ, “N sie aa n soɡa ta lɛ kpa,”

english_verse: Someday the light of the sun and the moon and the stars will all seem dim to you. Rain clouds will remain over your head.
translation_verse: mɔɔ wee ne bɔrchaahna, ne korobie dɛ weweela kaa biro ta, ásɛ baama aa dɛ nɛ bwaala la ba tɔ nyundua,

english_verse: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.
translation_verse: Berɛ lii mɔɔ saŋ tel ba tɔɔɡe doonyoo aa lɔ fɔɡbaahna ɡbeni, ásɛ manikare aa dɛ namɛ kwaa ɡel sii, ásɛ mɔɔ jumbii sii ɡel nɛra ir dom ta, kɛɛ yela ɡoe ɡbɔɡa bwa ba a jaɡa,

english_verse: You will be afraid to climb up a hill or walk down a road. Your hair will turn as white as almond blossoms. You will feel lifeless and drag along like an old grasshopper. We each go to our eternal home, and the streets here are filled with those who mourn.
translation_verse: ɡɛ saŋ nɛra aa dɛɛ ɔmɛ bwejaŋa dor laŋa, ne ɔmee aa lɔ fɔɡbaahna, ne ɡɛ saŋ daa bɛl waa dɛ fe fepoŋa. Ásɛ hɔɔhre jah dɛɛ kaa tama tama, pɛlchɔɡa bwa ba a jaɡa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra boa ba nyoa, dɛɛ ba ba kaa lalabwɛ.

english_verse: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.
translation_verse: Lii Korowii waa tae waa mɔɔ suuɡapoŋ jɔɡrɔre cha, kɛɛ loɡ baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛo, ne vii baa dɔ nee dɛɛ do o bini paɡre, kɛɛ buni kɔlɔŋ ŋwɛn aa dawɛ o ta, ba tɛr nee dɛɛ kpɔ o ta la ku.

english_verse: So our bodies return to the earth, and the life-giving breath returns to God.
translation_verse: Ya bwadabii ɛɛ berɔɔ kaa teera ta, ásɛ ya doma kaa Korowii waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la be.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
translation_verse: Wejereme la ŋɔ, “A bwa ɛ wepuu, Wobɛlbwa ta mun dɔe.” Waa la tona

english_verse: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
translation_verse: Wejereme la aa dɔ wejema nomanta, o baɡle bane ɡe ba dɔ wejema. O hweli wobosɛɡla, dɛ na a bini kasinteŋ kɛrɛdɛ ken.

english_verse: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.
translation_verse: O takapɔ ŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ bolarawa wobolee, kɛ o waa waa chwera la a ɛ kasinteŋ dɛ do wer.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.
translation_verse: Wejereme wobol do kɛŋɔ, daa peteɡre aa kpɔa dɛɛ teɡɛ peera ken. O wobosɛɡla ɡe do kɛŋɔ, baa lɔ dadowɛre do kon ta, a lawɔ kpoŋe. Korowiirii ɛ Peteɡre beŋkpoŋ waa lole dɛ tɛ ya bwa.

english_verse: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
translation_verse: N bie, nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ wobɛlbwa kpɔ ja a ta. Tɔne chwera ta jaɡa dɔe, kwaa hwela kohona ɡelɔ nɛn ɛɛ ɡwɛɡre.

english_verse: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
translation_verse: No waa la bwa name, a jaɡa bwaa kɛŋɔ, ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta, waa aa chɛ kɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛ laanee.

english_verse: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa yaa dɛ ɛ la, Korowii ɛɛ bol a waa, dɛ́ pa bole, andɛɛɡa ne anchɔɡa bwa, hale anɔ la aa sɔah bwa.

english_verse: Kiss me tenderly! Your love is better than wine,
translation_verse: Baɡle nyina kohona haa dɔa tɛ mɛ, he nyina dɔ pɛla kohona dɛ ɡwaa sen.

english_verse: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
translation_verse: He nosɔɔhsoma sɔɔh som, he sɔn do kɛŋɔ baa fuɡe nosɔɔhsoma ta. A waa ɡela bitoli bwa ɛɛ nyin he wa.

english_verse: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. The Young Women Speak: We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. She Speaks: Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.
translation_verse: Laɡ mɛ kaa warane, n dɛ nyin kɛ n kooro laɡ mɛ kaa o dem warane! Daamanar la Yá hɛɡre, dɛ́ ɡel ya sie lɛ kohona, yaa kpɛɛ he nyina haa dɔa laanee ɡwaa kɛ ya nyɔ sen. Hanfale la A waa ɡela bitoli bwa ɛɛ nyin he waa kɛrɛdɛ la!

english_verse: My skin is dark and beautiful, like a tent in the desert or like Solomon's curtains.
translation_verse: Jerusalam bitoli, n biro dɛ do wer, n biro kɛŋɔ tɛnte deene aa lɔ Keda pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, kɛ dɛ berɛ do wer kɛŋɔ, Kooro Solomɔn koodem pateesanre.

english_verse: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.
translation_verse: Bɛ men ɡɛɛh, n bira maa bira wa, weeree ɡela n bir. N nimanar baah di n nɛ dɛ ɡel n kaa ɛ daa koo bini toma, n ta bɔr dɔe dɛ nyiŋi n daa koo ta.

english_verse: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds. He Speaks:
translation_verse: N sɛno maa dɛ nyini kohona, baɡ mɛ bela he peera aa dɛ di, ne bela aa ba dɛ onɛ webaŋa. Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ ń kpɔ sie sɔh yal bini, kɛŋɔ haah waa dɛ teŋɛ peteɡra bane ne ba peera nɛɔ? Daamanar la

english_verse: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
translation_verse: Haah haa wera haahna bwa bini, haa jemɛ kɛ he teŋɛ peera luɡri ta, dɛ kpɔ he bombiire a kaa di peteɡra la kukujeɡre jwɛh. Sɛno baa la

english_verse: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
translation_verse: N sɛnodɛɛɡe, n kpɔe dɛɛ maɡɛ Ijipt kooro jaaɡɔnee baa vɔwɔ pɛl torɔɡo ta ken.

english_verse: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ he siebɔr ne deŋna kwa aa wera, he baŋa ne suuɡaswɛm baŋa kwaa ɡe do wer.

english_verse: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Yaa ɛ suuɡaswɛm deŋna kwaa tɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡapoŋ kwaa o bwara. Hanfale la

english_verse: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
translation_verse: N kooro taa chɔ o kara ta la, n nosɔɔhsoma sɔɔh lɛ bɔr bwa.

english_verse: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;
translation_verse: N sɛno maa dɛ nyinu sɔɔh som kɛŋɔ korobo, dɛ do n ela baah.

english_verse: you are flower blossoms from the gardens of En-Gedi. He Speaks:
translation_verse: N sɛno do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa fea, dɛ do daa kooni aa lɔ Ɛn Gedi harɛ ta ken. Sɛno baa la

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
translation_verse: N sɛnodɛɛɡe, na ɡɛ haa do wer, he wer tolo ɡa! He sibie wer kɛŋɔ borɔnoma sibie. Hanfale la

english_verse: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ haa do pwɛre, n sɛnodɛɛɡe, he waa dɛ lɛ n sie kohona. Kpɔɡlwɛɛ ɛ ya chɔɔbɔr. Sɛno baa la

english_verse: in the shade of cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Peleme dolii ba kpɔ chiɡri ya dea, asɛ dadɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi ɡee ba kpɔ ɡoo.

english_verse: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
translation_verse: N do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa fee aa lɔ Sarɔn harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta, dɛ do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa fee aa lɔ nenabɔɔ bini. Sɛno baa la

english_verse: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Gɛ kpɔɡ fee aa wera dɛ do sɔɔhne baah la, ɡɛɛ haah maa dɛ nyinu do toli bini. Hanfale la

english_verse: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.
translation_verse: Gɛ apol daa aa lɔ kɔr bini, dɛɛ nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡa la, ɡɛɛ baa maa dɛ nyinu do wer bonɔɔna bini. N sie lɛo kɛ ń so o chunchule lɔɡa, o nɔna som n nyoa bini.

english_verse: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.
translation_verse: O laɡ mɛ ba bela waa di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ o sie, dɛ baɡle o nyina waa dɔa tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Refresh and strengthen me with raisins and apples. I am hungry for love!
translation_verse: Tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa ne bosɔɔhna, he daa nɔna aa hola ne apolre dɛ do som, dɛkalkɛ he nyina waa ɡboo lɔ n liire bini.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: N kpɔ nyu dawɛ o nɔŋɡal ta, o nɔndiɡ ɡbaa mɛ pɛl o te.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready. Winter Is Past She Speaks:
translation_verse: Jerusalam haahna, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, hé ŋwɛɛ komɛlbwa sɔn ta baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ, haa n ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe baahnee chɔɡ. He bɛ ya nyina chɔɡ, ka tel kɛŋɔ ya nyina aa tona. Yel nɛɛte Hanfale la

english_verse: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills
translation_verse: N dɛ no n sɛno taa. O tuo le bwejena dor warane, dɛ chwa kpɔ deŋɡarere dor dɛɛ ba n be.

english_verse: like a deer or a gazelle. Now he stands outside our wall, looking through the window
translation_verse: N sɛnodɛɛɡe ɡbaŋre kɛŋɔ chwae kɛɛ kweɡlibale, onee ka cheɡa pɛl danjwɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi tokorore ta la.

english_verse: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Baa maa dɛ nyinu ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ir che, n sɛno, n sɛnodɛɛɡe, ásɛ n ne he kaa.

english_verse: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
translation_verse: Nyiŋi na, waa saŋ baa kaa, bwaala ɡe toole.

english_verse: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
translation_verse: Kpɔɡa dɛ fe harɛ ta bobɛlbwa, yela ɡoe saŋ telo name, asɛ bilore ɛɛ si harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Fiɡ daa nɔna pa mun dɛɛ ɛ bie, daa fee sɔɔh tɔ bobɛlbwa. Ir che n sɛno, ir ba n sɛnodɛɛɡe, ásɛ n ne he kaa.” Sɛno baa la

english_verse: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.
translation_verse: He do kɛ bilo waa kaa sɔh bwebɔɔ bini. N dɛ nyin he wer haa doa la dɛ na, ɡel ń no he taa waa soma la.

english_verse: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Lawɛ kalampoŋare aa do jeɡre la mɔɔ á chɔɡ ya daa kooni aa dɛ ba fee la. Hanfale la

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.
translation_verse: Menee dɔ n sɛnodɛɛɡe, asɛ o ɡee dɔɔ mɛ. O ɡbo peeraa dɛɛ di kpɔɡa aa dɛ fe la bini.

english_verse: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.
translation_verse: Laa berɛ ba, n sɛnodɛɛɡe, ka tel kɛ bɔr aa chaahna biro bɛlbwa aa wola toole kpa, dɛɛ chwa kɛŋɔ chwae kɛɛ kweɡlibale, waa lɔ Bɛtɛr Bwejena dor.

english_verse: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Maa chɔ n kalaŋ ta jwaana bwa la, n lii n sɛnodɛɛɡe wa. N nyin o bɔr, kɛ n ta on nae.

english_verse: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ iruu dɛ́ ɡaaɡe bwɛjen la bini, o fɔɡbaahna ne bela nɛra aa dɛ so. Mɛɛ ka ɡaaɡoo nyin nɛn n bambile aa lawa. N ɡaaɡɔ n ta on nae.

english_verse: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛɛ la ɡaaɡɔ dɛ ba puu mɛ, asɛ n bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He na nɛn n bambile aa lawɔ mɛɛ nyinu kohona la aa?”

english_verse: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.
translation_verse: Maa dena ɡar ba n den na n sɛnodɛɛɡe la. N bamu ŋɔ maa ɡel ó kaa, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba o ne n nya dem, bela baa lol mɛ.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready. The Groom and the Wedding Party Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Jerusalam haahna, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, hé ŋwɛɛ komɛlbwa sɔn ta baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ, haa n ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe baahnee chɔɡ. Yel toorote Hanfale la

english_verse: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ le chuu dɛɛ kaa nyundua a sɔɔh do som, kɛŋɔ daawiile ne korobo bonadiire aa dɛ yoɡa nɔɔ?

english_verse: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.
translation_verse: Hé na, Kooro Solomɔn kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheo laanee. Banyoola fifraanumɛl teŋɛ o nɛ, ba ɛ Israel harɛ nomonjena ɡbaɡba.

english_verse: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.
translation_verse: Ba bwa kpoŋe tokobie, dɛ bwa dɔ yoi wejema kɛrɛdɛ. Bɛlbwa tokobii sɛɡle o baŋ bɛl, dɛɛ kpa wobɛlbwa aa ba jwaana.

english_verse: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.
translation_verse: O daa aa paaɡa la, suuɡapoŋee ba kpɔ ɛ a bwara, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ o mun la ɡe. Ba kpɔ yakɔl bɔle o kara ta, Jerusalam haahna kpɔ kondɛɛɡa ɛ o bini ne o habɔɔ bwa.

english_verse: Now come and see the crown given to Solomon by his mother on his happy wedding day.
translation_verse: Jerusalam haahna, hé le ba, dɛ́ ba na Kooro Solomɔn kooɡbɛrɛ o nya aa kpɔa piu, awola o sie aa lɛa kohona wɛɛ ɛ o hanfalwaa la.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: N sɛnodɛɛɡe, na ɡɛ haa wera! He wer kohona to! He kpɔ yal bɔle he nyu, asɛ he siwinyiŋi do kɛŋɔ borɔnoma sibie. He nyumpona biro kɛŋɔ bombiŋere aa tua le Gelead Bwejen doa dɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
translation_verse: He nyena too kɛŋɔ peera baa fonɛ a pona a le dɛɛ ba. Bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ pɛo valɛ dɛɛ ba, beŋkpoŋ ɡba ta o te pere.

english_verse: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
translation_verse: He nyotɔne swɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛnswɛm, a ne wobol do wer kohona. He faɡra dɛ nyɛɡle yal bini.

english_verse: Your neck is more graceful than the tower of David, decorated with thousands of warriors' shields.
translation_verse: He baŋa jaŋne dɛ siɡri, dɛ do wer, kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid dejaŋ ken. He baŋa kwaa saɡre teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta anjeɡre kaɡboŋ.

english_verse: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
translation_verse: He ela wer kohona, a do kɛ kweɡli bii anɛ, aa dɛ di kpɔɡa fee bini ken.

english_verse: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ka so deŋɡare daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, ne korobo aa lɔ o taa, ka tel chɔɔbɔr ɡɛ saŋ biro aa wola toole kpa.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
translation_verse: N sɛnodɛɛɡe, he wer kohona to, kirihiah bɛlbwa toole he nɛ.

english_verse: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
translation_verse: N hanfale, le Lɛbanɔn bwea dor dɛ́ ba n be, le Lɛbanɔn bela ba n be. Le Amana Bwejen doa tu ba, Senir ne Hɛmɔn Bwejena dor, bela nyujentena ne nonietena aa lole.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
translation_verse: N hanfale ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe, he ɡelɔ n bambile lawɛ kohona, he nyiŋ mɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ he waa lɛ n liire, he baŋa kon beŋkpoŋ haa doa la wa.

english_verse: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: N sɛnodɛɛɡe, he nyoa nee som kɛ tohnoo ken, wobosoma lɔ he nyoa, he yale sɔɔh som kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn yale.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
translation_verse: N hanfale ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe, he do kɛ bodɛɛɡe baa du daa, ne nee nomɛlbwa aa wola won nyɔ ba tɔ a nyoo.

english_verse: Your arms are vines, covered with delicious fruits and all sorts of spices— henna, nard,
translation_verse: Kwaa aa lɔ bela kpeɡo dɛ do wer. A do kɛŋɔ daa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ pɔmeɡranet dɛɛ nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡa. Kwaa aa sɔɔh aa soma ne alele ta bela nyae,

english_verse: saffron, calamus, cinnamon, frankincense, myrrh, and aloes —all the finest spices.
translation_verse: ne safrɔn, ne kalamus ne sinamɔn, ne korobo, dɛ konsɔɔhsoma aa wera bwa soo siwi.

english_verse: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon. She Speaks:
translation_verse: He do kɛŋɔ nenapale nyu bodɛɛɡe baa du daa, kɛŋɔ bule waa dɛ palɛ wɔrɔbe nɛ, dɛ le Lɛbanɔn bwejena dor dɛɛ ba. Hanfale la

english_verse: Let the north wind blow, the south wind too! Let them spread the aroma of my garden, so the one I love may enter and taste its delicious fruits.
translation_verse: Weekaŋle nyundua peu ir, ásɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr peu ɡe ta. Ta kpɔ bodɛɛɡe maa du daa la, ásɛ daa la sɔɔh yɛɛ kaa bojaŋ. Gel n sɛnodɛɛɡe ba jo daa la baah, dɛ́ di a nɔna aa soma la.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:
translation_verse: N sɛnodɛɛɡe ne n hanfale, n ba bodɛɛɡe maa du daa. N boa n konsɔɔhsoma ne korobo bwa nyoa. N di n tohvaahna ne n tohno, dɛ nyɔ n sen ne na-elne. Daamanar la N daamanar, hé di kondikwa dɛ nyɔ sen. Hé nyɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa ɡɛ haa won. Yel naarɛte Hanfale la

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: Maa chɔa kwaraa la, dɛ n ta dɛ kpɔ liire. N noɔ kɛŋɔ n sɛno aa lɔ ɡbera dɛ ŋɔ, “N hanfale ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe, he wer kɛŋɔ borɔnoma, he ta kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, yaa mɛ ɡbera. Mɛn pwe n nyu bwa, kɔɔla ta jwaana, n nyumpona pwe.”

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: N laa n batakaare foo, a chɛ kɛ ń berɛ kpɔ do ja aa? N sarame n nakpale, ń berɛ kpɔ valɛ harɛpɛɛ aa?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: N sɛno ha nɔn lawɛ ɡbera, asɛ n bambile ɛɛ lɔ o wa.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: N iro ŋɔ n yao ɡbera, n nonie ne n nɔɔra bwa maa korobo, ɡɛ saŋ maa lawɛ ɡbera la koŋkare kon la.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: N ya ɡbera ŋɔ n sɛno fee ba jo kɛ o kaalɔ, n ta on nae. N bambile chɔɡ kaala waa kaala wa, asɛ n nyin o bɔr n ta on nae, n yerɔ ɡe o ta chaŋɛ.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛjen la ɡaaɡɔ dɛ ba chem mɛ o bini. Ba lɔɔ mɛ, dɛ do mɛ bol, dɛ lɛ n yal kaa.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:

translation_verse: Haah waa wera haahna bwa bini, he sɛnodɛɛɡe la korɛ sɛnanar bwa bini kɛɛ? Bɔkwaa ɡela o te ɡbosoroo waa korɛ, asɛ he ŋɔ ya baɡɛ nyoa ɔ? Hanfale la

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: N sɛnodɛɛɡe la wer bonɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ, o bwara ɡe do kpeɡri, o dɔŋ toole baala kaɡboŋa fi bini.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: O siebɔr wer dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten, o nyumpona ɡuɡro dɛ do wer, dɛ bir kɛŋɔ ɡaahɡaah ken.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: O sibie wer kɛŋɔ borɔnomare aa toa kohona kɛŋɔ na-elne, dɛ do nenabɔɔne nyoo.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: O faɡra wer kɛŋɔ bodɛɛɡe baa du daa konsɔɔhsoma su o bwa. O nyotɔn do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa fee aa wera, korobo noo pweoh.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.
translation_verse: O nakpale wer dɛ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ pilare baa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa aa toa ɛa, asɛ a chɔŋɛ suuɡaswɛm loɡa ta. O mar wer dɛ dɔ jirima kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn peleme dajaŋa.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: O nyoa som ne moe, o wobɛlbwa wer tɛ mɛ. Jerusalam haahna, ɡɛ n sɛnodɛɛɡe aa doa mɛɛ nyinu kohona laanee la.

translation_verse: Umee le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ ba dɛ kpɔ o te dawɛ o sɛno nɛɛ nɔɔ? Hanfale la N iro che daa waa dɛ nɔnɛ lɔɡa, dɛ lawɛ ir bela baa lolɛ la.

translation_verse: Gel n ɡbo waa do he bambile ta saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ baŋe do he nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ seo aa wola jaɡa dɔe la, ɡɛɛ n ne he dɔŋa nyina do. Baa ne haah meera kpeɡri kɛŋɔ seo, a won nii lawa kɛŋɔ nijena ken.

english_verse: Love cannot be drowned by oceans or floods. It cannot be bought— any offer would be scorned no matter how great. Their Friends Speak:

translation_verse: Ya dɔ nimambie waa ɛ bitolo, waa wola ela leɛ mɔɔ. Dɛ baa balɔ ŋɔ o dɛ nyinu waa, bɔkwa waa yaa ba wona ɛ tɛo wɔ?

english_verse: She isn't a wall that we can defend behind a silver shield. Neither is she a room that we can protect behind a wooden door. She Speaks:

translation_verse: Dɛ n fa do kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ ken, kɛ n ela kpeɡo kɛŋɔ dejaŋa. Anomanta, n sɛnodɛɛɡe jemɔ kɛŋɔ n dɔ bansɔɔhna ne deŋnesɔɔhna dɛɛ le o be.

translation_verse: Baa bɛlee fa lole baa yerɔ Emɔɔs, o bibaa sɔne Aesaya. Korowii pili waane bini kɛŋɔ deera ken baɡle Aesaya, aa ba Juda harɛ ta ne Jerusalam chiɡa. translation_verse: Aesaya ŋɔ, Nɛra haa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ, hɛ́ɛ no waa Korowii aa bola! “N dɛɛ n bii dɛ nyiŋ ba ba kpeɡ, kɛ ba kpaŋe n nɛ.

translation_verse: Le he nyu ta ba ta harɛ, he bobɛlbwa toole dɛ do kpeɡri. Ŋwɛra ne bela aa darawa ne chale ɡboo he bwa. Ba ta an jaɡrɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa do tɛɛɡa a taa dɛ́ vɔwa.

translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa kwaa haa dɛ kpoo kohona dɛ kpɔ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la ɛɛ baɡleɔ? Kwaa haa kpoora dɛ fuah dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ jam mɛ, pebala, ne ola noorare pe mɛ, nae ne pebiiri ne boohna chale aa men pɛla dɔ.

translation_verse: N bambile aa he Korobifala Tɔpejena dii ne tɔpejena haa lea cheɡ dɛɛ di kwa dɛɛ lɛ sie a ta la lawɛ. Name te n koɔh, a le n mee.

translation_verse: dɛ́ do sie wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta! Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ cha nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa. Hɛ́ɛ bol bilalbii ne luhaahna waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.

translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he vɛoh dɛ ta do he kpaŋa la ta te naa, laa nyoa hɛɛ ba kae. Men Korowiirii bola.”

translation_verse: He nomonome kpaŋe n nɛ, dɛ berɛ ka kpɔ ŋwɛɛra ɛ ba chamene tena. Ba dɛ nyin kɛ nɛra ɛɛ yaɡ ba sen, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ koŋkɛɛla ɡbo ta. Baa bilalbii waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ, ɡɛɛ baa wola sie do luhaahna waa ta.

translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel Kpeɡnɛn la ŋɔ, “Namete he berɛ n dɔma n bwaawee ir he nɛ. Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee bɔ kem ásɛ n baah sɔɔh mɛ.

translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee kohona, dɛ ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ suuɡaswɛm do nii ta dɛ laa o doŋa kpɔ o ta la ken.

translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔ ɡel he dɔ nɛra baa bol he waa dɛɛ pa bole, ne nɛra baa dɛɛ ja heyaa kɛŋɔ he fa aa dɔɔ ba wubwa la. Ásɛ mɔɔ bá berɛ yerɛ heyaa Kasinteŋ Diile bwɛ, Nɛndɛɛɡa bwɛ.”

english_verse: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord, will all disappear.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpaŋe o nɛ, ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la, wɛɛ pɛo chɔɡ ba bwa. Asɛ nɛra ba ɡe aa vɛoh la, ó kpoo ba ɡe.

translation_verse: “Sihiih ɛɛ kpo heyaa daa haa dua dɛɛ toma la waa. Hɛɛ di nchoo bela haa du kwaa dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa a baah ta la waa.

translation_verse: Bokpeɡa tena ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ daa aa hola ken, asɛ ba toma baa toma ɡe do kɛŋɔ nii ken. Kombele anɛ nɔ bwa ɛɛ pɛo dɛɛ fuh nomɛlbwa aa wola won dima.”

english_verse: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ ka ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya kaa Korowii Saayɔn Bwejen la doa Jerusalam, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ la Dea. Wɛɛ baɡle yaa o ŋwɛnɛree, ásɛ yaa valɛ o webaɡla ta.” Saayɔn Bwejen taa o Mmarare ɛɛ ba lee, bá bol baɡle o nɛra Jerusalam bela.

english_verse: He will settle arguments between nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ bol harɛre nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ kwaa ba baah. Baa beɡre ba kerii a ɛ para, dɛ́ beɡre ba lampeare ɡe ɡoori. Harɛre nɛra aa dɔŋaa yo, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa hweli laa waa kpa.

english_verse: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
translation_verse: Jekɔb naanar, hé ɡel yaa valɛ Korowii waa aa chaahna o kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ yaa la ta. Korowii Tɔpere waa lea cheɡ

english_verse: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he vɛh he nɛra Jekɔb naanar. Ba lɔ wee leebɔr tena wepuu ta, dɛ berɛ voɡra kɛŋɔ Filisti tena, dɛ jo nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ we-ɛɛla ta.

english_verse: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
translation_verse: Anomanta, hen Korowii ɛɛ ba ba bɛlbwa ne harɛɛ, ásɛ ba di sihiih. N Naa Korowii, bɛ ba wechɔɡa kpɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: Hé bwa chwa ka jo bwebɔɔne bini, hé takapɔ dɛ́ kwi bɔɔne dɛ́ jo a bini, dɛ́ le Korowii bandia ne o kpeɡri dɛ o jirima kohona la ta.

english_verse: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
translation_verse: Nɛn nyanyini ɛɛ tonɔɔ ɡɛ saŋ, ásɛ maŋkurae nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ maŋkura o te la ba harɛ, Korowii ɡbo sɔnee dɛɛ ba lee ɡɛ saŋ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.

english_verse: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
translation_verse: Wɛɛ chɔɡ Lɛbanɔn peleme dajaŋa ne Basan dajena ɡe bwaa,

english_verse: all high mountains and hills,
translation_verse: ne bwejaŋa ne deŋɡarejena bwa,

translation_verse: Hale stiimaere bonadiire aa dɛ so a bini, ne stiimajena andɛɛɡa bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
translation_verse: Nɛn nyanyini ɛɛ ba harɛɛ ɡɛ saŋ, ásɛ maŋkurae nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ maŋkura o te la tonɛ. Korowii ɡbo sɔnee dɛɛ ba lee awola tɔpere,

english_verse: Idols will be gone for good.
translation_verse: ásɛ voɡa ɡe bwa nyoɡre kwaraa.

english_verse: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ kohona, dɛ́ chwa ka jo bwebɔɔne, dɛ́ kwi bɔɔne dɛ́ jo a bini, dɛ́ le Korowii bandia ne o kpeɡri, ne o jirima kohona la nyoa, ɡɛ saŋ waa ba jiɡri harɛ la.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ pa ba voɡa baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ɛa, dɛɛ toma laanee ta a wola tɔpere, ásɛ a berɛ daŋɡboŋre ne jereme kwa.

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: Baa kpɔ ɔmee chwa ka jo bwebɔɔne, ne bwejena aa peɡra la baah, dɛ́ le Korowii bandia ne o kpeɡri, ne o jirima kohona la nyoa, ɡɛ saŋ waa ba jiɡri harɛ la.

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: He bɛ hwɛɡa kpɔ do nɛwɛnyini nɛɛ kpa. Waa sewaa? Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini ɡeɔ?

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *
translation_verse: Hé no, Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛ ba nɛra ne kwaa Jerusalam ne Juda tena aa kpɔ ba te dawɛ a nɛɛ la laa dɛ kpɔ. Wɛɛ tɔ ba kondikwaa ne nee ŋwɛnɛɛ,

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ fiiɡi dɔŋaa, nɛn pu o dɔŋ dɛɛ yo, chamenate ne o chamenate ɛɛ yo. Bechale aa ba nomonomee duu, nɛnsale ɡe aa nɛra baa dɔ nyanyinii kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Nɛn ɛɛ lawɛ o lole bɛlee dɛ́ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Henee dɔ bwara laala. Ba di ya nomonome, saŋ waa chɔɡa dɛ do kpeɡri nɔ ta!”

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: Wɛɛ iruu che ɡɛ saŋ dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Akai! Maa won ɛ he nomoa dɛ́ cha heya. N ta kondikwaa ne bwara laala bɛlbwa dɔe n dem. He bɛ men kpɔ ɛ he nomoa.”

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Jerusalam paɡrɔ, Juda harɛ ɡe chɔɡ. Nɛra baa lɔ bela nyoa wobol ne ba we-ɛɛla dɛ jo Korowii nɛ. Ba pili nyoa dɛɛ chɛɡɛ Korowii waa ɛ jirima te la.

english_verse: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
translation_verse: Ba siebɔra ɡba dɛ baɡle ba nɛnsoo. Ba dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa kpelelee kɛŋɔ Sodom tena, baa an sɔh. Bá bwɛɛlɛ! Ba ɡbaɡbaa nyin ba wahala dɛ dɔ.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Gel nɛra ba wa aa toɡra no kɛŋɔ aa do werii tɛɛ ba. Baa di ba we-ɛɛla tɔnɔɔ.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwɛɛlɛ! Aa do kpeɡrii tɛɛ ba taeh. Waa ba ɡbaɡba aa ɛa la kembɔree baa ba dɔe.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Toli ne bonɔɔna dɛ fiiɡi n nɛra. Haahnaa dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ dɛɛ do ba. N nɛra, he sitɔɔla ɡelɔ he nyoɡre. Ba ɡelɔ he nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
translation_verse: Korowii soɡo dɛ́ bol nɛra wa. O kpɔ o te dɛɛ ba o nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ ba o nɛra nomonome ne ba sitɔɔla waa bola dɛ́ pa bole. O ŋɔ, “Heyaa he n daa koo. Heyaa pa nyaara kwaa le ba be kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa, dɛ kpɔ su he be deene.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ? Haa kɛrɛdɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ fɔɡɛ n nɛra, dɛ pa nyaara kwa, dɛ lawɛ ba sie dɛɛ teɡɛ harɛ nɔ. Men Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooroo ŋɔa.”

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Saayɔn haahna dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te, dɛ valɛ dɛ laa ba baŋa pa, dɛ kpɔ sie dɛɛ nyin baala. Ba dɛ valɛ tolvala naɡale bori ne, asɛ naloɡa baa kpɔa do ba nakpale la ɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa.”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo Saayɔn haahna nyubaahna chuɡri ŋwɛra, ásɛ ba nyuune ɡba.

english_verse: When that day comes, I will take away from those women all the fine jewelry they wear on their ankles, heads, necks, ears, arms, noses, fingers, and on their clothes. I will remove their veils, their belts, their perfume, their magic charms, their royal robes, and all their fancy dresses, hats, and purses.
translation_verse: ne diɡe, ne ba laalapoŋa andɛɛɡa, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba nyuune, dɛ anɔ la baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba sie, a bwaa wɛɛ ba laa kpɔ.

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Konsɔɔhsoma a fe aa ɡel ba bwaraa sɔɔh do som la, sɔɔhraa ba bwara ɛɛ ba sɔɔhra, ásɛ ɡboɡbie ber ba kirisore, ásɛ ba nyumpona ba yon ɛa a do wer la bwa chure, ba nyuune ɡba, ba laaladɛɛɡa bwa berɛ yakwane, ásɛ ba wer tu, ba berɛ di sihiih.

english_verse: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Saayɔn doonyoo ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ bwɛjen la do kɛŋɔ haah tea bini aa chɔɡa, o so harɛ dɛɛ wi la.

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Gɛ tɔpere la, haahna banuanɛɛ ka lɔɔ tɔ babeŋkpoŋ nɛɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ, “He te kpɔ he sɔn dawɛ ya nɛɛ dɛ mo yaa, dɛ laa sihihsɔn haŋkwii la kpɔ ya nɛ. Yaa hen kondikwaa waa pɛɛ, yaa hen yal waa pɛɛ.” Baa berɔɔ kwaa vɔrɔwe Jerusalam

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo nomɛl ba a ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ́ dɔ jirima dɛ́ do wer kɛŋɔ baa teŋe daa ta o berɛ forɛ le o buɡ ta dɛ do wer la. Ásɛ nɛra baa ba ka Israel harɛ ta, dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu la bwa sie lɛ o nɛ, dɛ́ dɔ jirima le o nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who is left alive in Jerusalem will be called special,
translation_verse: Nɛra báa ba ka Jerusalam Korowii aa ɡela ba dɔ ba nyu la, báa yer baa nɛra baa do ɡoroŋee.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ninchuu ɛ kɛŋɔ baama, dɛ́ ba tɔ Saayɔn Bwejen ne nɛra baa lɔ o ta nɛ webaŋa, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel nii ɡe tɔ ba nɛɛ dɛɛ chaah ba jwaana á ɛ kɛŋɔ chunchule, dɛ́ tɔ bwɛɛ la jirima bwa ta,

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: bɔwɔb aa ban kpo webaŋa, hale bá dɔ bɔr dɛ́ chwa sɔh bwaala ne o peu ta.

english_verse: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡo nɛn maa dɛ nyinu yelee. Gɛ yel nɔ ɛ n chamenate, ne o daa koo yel. O para deŋɡare harɛdɛɛɡe bɛl ta.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: O buɡli harɛ la, dɛ laa bwea aa lɔ o ta bwa pa mɔɔ dɛ nyin dadɛɛɡa chɔɔ o ta, dɛ chiɡri jɛŋla baa so o ta dɛɛ kpa koo la. O komɛ bwe bɔɔ, bela baa ba tiɡri a nɔna ta a nee le. Name o soɡo dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ aa nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡaa, kɛ a berɛ nɔnɛ nɔnchɔɡa.

english_verse: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa lɔ Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ ta, hé nyiŋi n ne n daa nɔ wa bini dɛ́ na.

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: A fe ta ka waane n fee ɛ daa la ta, asɛ n ta wone ɛ kɛɛ? N fe dɛ nyin kɛ a nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡa, aah bɔkwaa bera ɡel a nɔnɛ nɔnchɔɡa nɔɔ?

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ ba daa la ɛɛ. Mɛɛ laa kwaa baa kpɔa keo laanee pa, ásɛ kwaa dia dɛ́ chɔɡa. Mɛɛ kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa baro la ɡee, ásɛ kwaa tiɡra do harɛ.

english_verse: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ maa wola belaa parɛ kpa, maa daa la kpalaa kɛ, ásɛ sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛ le bela. Maa ɡel bwaala nɛ harɛ la ta kpa.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooroo dɔ daa koo la, asɛ koo la che tɛ Israel tena. Daa la cheɡɔɔ tɛ Juda tena, banee daa waa chɔɔra o sie lɛ a ta la. O fe dɛ nyin kɛ baa ɛ waa aa wera, asɛ ba berɛ dɛɛ kpoo nɛra. Dɛ o dɛ nyin kɛ baa ɛ wedɛɛɡa ɡe, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba wii wɛɛ no. Wechɔɡa nɛra aa dɛ ɛ

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa yawɛ deremi dɛɛ ja deremi ta, dɛ berɛ yawɛ kooni dɛɛ ja kooni ta, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ bɔr aa wola lee do tɛ he bala, asɛ he ɡbo lɛ harɛ dɔɔh dɛ so.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii bol waa a chole n deŋna ta. O ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, demjena ɛɛ che dimɡbeenii, deremi aa kana dɛ do wer ɛɛ cheo nɛn aa lee do dɛ́ so a bini.

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Ba bini bɛlbwa aa koh, kɛɛ baa lɔ nakpalaa. Dom aa bɛlbwa chuɡli, baa dom ɡe chɔ. Kirisore baa vɔrɔwa áa foo, ásɛ naŋɡaware baa doa ɡe áa kɛɛ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa cheɡɛ nyosone ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ tɛɡre wechɔɡa dɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛ, he banɔ la haa kpɔ he bokpeɡa dɛɛ ɛ nyubinikpeɡ kɛŋɔ baa do nao ɡboɡbii dɛɛ tɛr la.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa ira chɔmbibi dɛɛ ti sen, he banɔ la haa dɛ were sen mun ka tel kɛŋɔ haa dɛɛra.

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Hé dɛ di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ he sie aa, he dɛ lɔ janjela dɛɛ yiiɡi kwaa dɛɛ hoh kalipere. Kɛ Korowii we-ɛɛla te, haa sie a ta do, anɔ la waa dɛ ɛ, haa on duu.

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: He waa mun bɛ noe nomanta, baa lawɛ heyaa kaa harɛfale bɛl taa, dɛ kaa do heya. Lɔr ɛɛ kpo he bini banɔ la baa chɔ he nyoa bá serewe, ásɛ dansaara haa ka la, nyɔɡre kpo heyaa he serewe.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Lalabwɛɛ chɔɔ dɛɛ kpaa ba, o doonyoa pilo che. Jerusalam nomonjena ne dansaara ba sie aa lɛa baa do ɡbɔɡa la bwa ɛɛ jo belaa.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Anomanta, sihiih ɛɛ kpo mbarafo tenaa, dɛ́ ba nomɛlbwa ne harɛ.

english_verse: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ bol waa dɛ́ pa bole kasinteŋ ne, dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ baɡle o kan waa doa. Wɛɛ che waa aa toɡra taa, dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ waa do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Peera ɛɛ chwe kpɔɡa bwɛɛ la dimɡbia taa. Bela ɛɛ berɛ pebiiri dibɔree.

english_verse: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Hé bwɛɛlɛ he banɔ la haa dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Korowii, ɛ warane dɛ́ ɛ he toma ya na. Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ, baɡle he ŋwɛnɛre ya jemɛ.”

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa dɛ yerɛ he te baala sen nyɔe ta, he baah su haa wola sen baa kpɔa koo dɔŋa nyɔe ɔmɛ la.

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ yawɛ heyaa sen hɛɛ ta ba, dɛ́ yon pa bolsom te bolchɔɡe la.

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡɛ ninlao yon piɡri lawɛ jaaɡesɛɛh dɛ́ fuah, kɛɛ dɛ yon fuh kpɔɡhola la, ɡɛɛ he ɡe ɛɛ ba tona kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa lune yon pɔh a fee ɡe hol, peu kpɔa kaa kɛŋɔ tutuɡ ken, dɛkalkɛ he vɛh Nemenɛ Korowii Mmara la, dɛ lii Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ waa waa kpɔa baɡle heyaa la wepuu.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa ɡelɔ Korowii baah di o nɛra nɛ, o ir nɔn dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne. Bwejena ɛɛ jiɡruu, ásɛ nɛra baa serewe la lala chɔ fɔɡbaahna kɛŋɔ haahra ken. Anɔ bwa habɔɔ o baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ.

translation_verse: Korowii ɡɔɔ o fraŋkaa dɛ yerɛ nɛra le bojaŋ harɛre ta. O foolɔ yerɛ o nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa. Hé na! Ba chwao dɛɛ ba wɔrɔbe nɛ.

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Ba hɛma nyɛɡre, ba harɛ ba tori dɛɛ ba tae. Jaɡre baa soɡe a ta la nafikokore kpeɡri kɛŋɔ kwɛrboɔ ken. Kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore nakpale dɛ kile kohona kɛŋɔ kawulewule ken.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Ba ɡbɔɡa do kɛŋɔ nyujentena aa dɛ si. Gɛ nyujente lawɛ ol dɛ́ yon tuuɡu dɛɛ kaa dɛɛ kɔɡre la, ɡɛɛ ba lawɛ n nɛra dɛɛ kaa, dɛɛ ɛ, nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.

english_verse: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
translation_verse: Asɛ men Aesaya berɛ no kɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa ŋɔ, “Umee ń tomɔɔ? Umee dɛ́ la tɛ yaɔ?” Anee n sɛh ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ lao, tom mɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “La dɛ́ ka ŋɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, ‘Hɛ́ɛ no n waa kohonaa, kɛ haa a mun noe ba, hɛɛ nyiŋi a bini kohonaa, kɛ haa waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa jema ba.’ ”

translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ka ɡel nɛra nɔ bambile do kpeɡri, tɔɔɡe ba deŋna, dɛ tɔɔɡe ba sibie ɡe. A waa laa aa, ba sie fe ɛɛ nao, ásɛ ba deŋna no, ba bambile lawa, bá berɛ ba n be ń lɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
translation_verse: Anee n ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, dɛ ka tel saŋ besoo?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ bwɛjena la aa berɛ dimɡbia, nomɛlbwa aa wola a taa so, ásɛ deremi aa lɔ a ta la chɔ pɛɛ, kooni bwa berɛ pua.

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ doŋi nɛra laanee kaa bojaŋ, dɛ́ ɡel harɛ la bwa chɔ pɛɛ.

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ka harɛ la ta kwaraa naa, mɛɛ chɔɡ o ɡbaa. Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ ba yon teŋe daa a ka o muŋkpul che dɛɛ moɡɛ la.” Daa la muŋkpul la cheɡɔ tɛ n nɛra baa ba ka harɛ la ta la.

english_verse: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ tel Juda Kooro Ahas ne o nɛra be kɛŋɔ Siiria tena ne Israel tena pɛo ba harɛ la ta dɛ́ ba yoo ba, asɛ ba bwara yɔr dɛɛ sa kɛŋɔ peu aa taa jo daa bini la.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Aesaya be ŋɔ, “Yerɛ he bie Sea Jasub, ásɛ he ne o ka cheme Kooro Ahas bɔɔ baa kwiu feelɔɔ ken le nyundua tam la ta nee palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ o bini la harɛbɔr, ŋwɛnɛ baah ta bela baa dɛ ɛ yale toma la.

english_verse: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
translation_verse: Ŋɔ Kooro Ahas be ŋɔ ó sɔɔh bwara, wɛ́ɛ berɛ ɔma. Wɛ́ɛ berɛ ɡela o bambile chɔɡ. Ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, nindaa anɛ chuu ɔma ɡwaa Kooro Resin, ne o harɛ Siiria tena dɛ Kooro Pɛka ne o nɛra bandia.

english_verse: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
translation_verse: bá ka jo Juda tena harɛ ta dɛ́ yoo ba, dɛ́ bɔne o bini, ásɛ bɛ́lbwa dɔ o pera, dɛ́ kpɔ Tabeel bibaa so kora ta wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi o bwa ta.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.

english_verse: Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than
translation_verse: Israel harɛ ta bwɛjen laa Samaria aa? Kooro Pɛka ɡee bwɛɛ la nyu te. Onee umeo? Dɛ he ta yarada dɔe dɛ che kiŋkiŋ naa, haa won che kɛrɛdɛ kpa.”

english_verse: Once again the Lord God spoke to King Ahaz. This time he said,
translation_verse: Korowii tomɔ ba ka ŋɔ Kooro Ahas be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: “Soŋe Korowii háa dɛ tomɔ dɛ́ na waane, hale dɛ le lalabwɛɛ kɛɛ nyundujaɡla, á baɡle waa nɔ kasinteŋ.”

english_verse: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Ahas ŋɔ, “Maa soŋe dɛ́ na wobɛlbwa, maa Korowii daah dɛ́ na.”

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Ate, Aesaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Kooro Devid naanar, hɛ́ɛ no. Hae haa dɛ ha nɛra ba mee le ta maɡrɛ, asɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin he ha Korowii ɡe naa?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: A ne ɡɛ saŋ tela la, koranar banɛ nɔ baa dɛ aah heyaa nɔ, ba dɔma ɛɛ ba yoo baa dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ba harɛre chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: Aesaya ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ Korowii ɡel wekpeɡa ba he ne he nɛra, ne he koodem nɛra nɛ, dɛ́ ɡwaa ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena ne Juda tena aa peɡri dɔŋa baah la. Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ Asiiria koojen ne o laa tenaa bá yo heya.

english_verse: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ Korowii ɛɛ fooloo yerɛ Ijipt harɛ ta nɛra baa lɔ nee nyoa bojaŋ bá wur ba kɛ chwɛɛhne ken, ne Asiiria tena ba ɡe warɛ ba kɛŋɔ toohna ken.

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.

translation_verse: Belaa Korowii kpɔ o kpeɡri kah mɛ ŋɔ n bɛ ŋwɛnɛ Juda tena aa dɛ kpɔ ta teŋɛ. O ŋɔ,

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Nɛra ŋɔ he be ŋɔ hé la voɡra baa dɛ bol waa woroworo ne ajɔsaara be dɛ́ ka jemɛ waane bini naa, dɛ a dɔ mun aa? Bɔkwa waa chɛ kɛŋɔ yá ka bɔɔ lala dɛ́ jemɛ weera waa bini nɔ? Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laa chɛ kɛŋɔ yá kpɔ ya waa dɛɛ bil o sie naa?

translation_verse: Ba bwara ɛɛ hwaoh baa valɛ harɛ la ta, lɔr ɡe kpo ba, ba kpɔ bandia ha sie nyundua dɛ́ taah ba kooro ne Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ.

translation_verse: Kɛ ane abwa, wenaale bɛlbwa toole dɛ ba nɛra ba bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ nɛ. Saŋ la, Korowii ɡelɔ Sebulon ne Naftale deene tena harɛre sɔn ba harɛ. english_verse: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
translation_verse: He pɔ ba dɔma ba fa aa dɛ ha ba, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ daa dawɛ nae anɛ nɛ aa parɛ, dɛ kpɔ daŋɡbale dɛɛ lɔɔra la nɛ. Gɛ tentenee he kuuɡi daa aa dawɛ Midian tena nɛ dɛ lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Laala baa doa dɛɛ yo laa, ne kon te bɛlbwa chal aa ɛo la, baa kpɔa do nii ta a fuh, baa kpɔa mar nii.

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: Ba lolɛ bie tɛ yaa, bibaalee. Onee dɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ bwa kooro ɛɛ, baa yerɔ Nyokponɛn, ne Nomondɛɛɡe Waa Won Nɛra Jae, ne Nemenɛ Korowii, ne Saŋ Te Bɛlbwa Mɛɛ, dɛ Deŋnesɔɔhna Kooro.

english_verse: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
translation_verse: O kora ɛɛ do kanee dɛɛ ja saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ deŋnesɔɔhna aa wola jaɡa dɔe do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Wɛɛ chiɡ Kooro Devid naa taa, dɛ́ di kora. O kora ɛɛ che kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡra taa dɛ́ do kpeɡri, dɛ́ le saŋ nɔ ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ. Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ do siee dɛ́ ɛ anɔ bwa. Korowii ɛɛ tɛr Israel tena deŋnee

english_verse: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Korowii bol waane Jekɔb naanar baa ɛ Israel tena be, aa ba ba pui,

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: ásɛ nɛra la bwa jemɛ a wa. Israel ne Samaria tena la dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te dɛɛ maŋkura ba te dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
translation_verse: “Berekese dea la cholo, kɛ yaa sɛh bweaa dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ ma. Ba teŋni fiɡ daa aa pwɛra la ta, kɛ yaa kpɔ peleme daa aa kpeɡaa chiɡ a buɡe ta.”

english_verse: The Lord made their enemies attack them.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena dɔma baah di bá ba yoo ba.

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Siiria tena le wee leebɔr, ásɛ Filisti tena ɡe le wee cholibɔr, dɛ́ ba haah Israel tena pɛ dɛ́ laɡ ba lile. Anɔ nɔ bwa habɔɔ Korowii baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Israel tena la ta ba liire charɛ ba deŋnetɛra la habɔɔ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa nyin Nemenɛ Korowii bɔree.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ tɛr Israel tena nomonome ne ba nɛra deŋnee. Wɛɛ teŋ baa ta kɛŋɔ baa teŋe daa nyundua ne o harɛbɔr bwa ta ken.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Nomonome ne nɛra baa dɔ jirima laanee daa la nyu, asɛ Korowii keamere baa dɛ teŋe nyosone o waa la ta la, ɡee daa la harɛbɔr.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa tɔ nɛra la sie la, ɡelɔ baa koni, dɛ ɡel banɔ la baa teŋɛ ba nɛɛ la ɡe nyoɡre kwaraa.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii sie aa ba bini bonɔɔna nɛɛ lɛɛ ba, hale waa bilalbii ne luhaahna kwaraa sum nae ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba bini bɛlbwa aa o waa ta teŋɛ, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, ba wobol aa were. Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, o baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro bandia nomanta, o deŋnetɛra do kɛŋɔ nii aa dɛ fuh harɛ la ta bwa, dɛɛ fuh nɛra. Ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa o dɔŋ sumii na kpa.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Baa kah kondikwaa nɔndiɡ ne ɡal bwa nee dɛɛ di, kɛ baa vaɡɛ, hale dɛ́ larawe ba biirere chwe.

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manasɛ dea nɛra ɛɛ yo Efrem dea nɛraa, ásɛ Efrem dea nɛra ɡe yoo ba, a ɡɛ deene anɛ nɔ ɛɛ pɛo dɛ́ yo Juda dea nɛra. Anɔ nɔ bwa habɔɔ, Korowii baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ do mmarare aa wola aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ, ne mmarakpeɡa dɛ́ fiiɡi nɛra la, ba bwɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ awola Korowii aa dɛ ba he deŋne tɛra, ne wenaale aa le bojaŋ ba he nɛɛ laɔ? Umee hɛɛ ba chwae ka marɔɔ? Leperaa hɛɛ ba he kondɔɔh la ɡela ɔ?

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa toole hé ɛ kpa, nemenɛ hé ja nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta, kɛɛ banɔ la baa ka kpoo la nɛ. Anɔ nɔ bwa habɔɔ, o baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ. Asiiria tena bole pae

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Asiiria tena bwɛɛlɛ! Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ɛ kɛŋɔ n ɡuli maa kpɔ dɛɛ tɛr nɛra n baah aa di ba nɛɛ deŋne.

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa wola men tomɛ la bee mɛɛ ba Asiiria tena toma, nɛra baa dɛ ɛ n bandiwaa la bee mɛɛ ba ba doe bá ka yoo ba, dɛ́ pa ba laala dɛ́ kah ba kondɔɔh, ásɛ dɛ tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kpechɛɡre aa lɔ fɔɡbaahna ken.

english_verse: He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.
translation_verse: Kɛ Asiiria koojen te fe aa an ɡɛ nyin, dɛ o liire laa. O waa bwaa kɛŋɔ o fee den chɔɡ harɛre ɡalɡa bwa kwara.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: O dɛ maŋkura o te ŋɔ, ‘N laa sitɔɔla bwa ɛ koranar!

english_verse: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.
translation_verse: Gɛ maa chɔɡ bwɛjena Kaakɛmes ne Kalno ne Aapad ne Hamat dɛ Damaskɔs la, ɡɛɛ n chɔɡ Samaria ɡe.
