english_verse: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
translation_verse: maa won ɛ Jerusalam harɛ ne o voɡare ɡe ɡɛ maa ɛ Samaria harɛ ne o voɡare la kɛɛ?’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii baa tonɛ ɡɛ waa ɛ nɛra baa lɔ Saayɔn Bwejen doa ne Jerusalam bwa naa, wɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Mɛɛ ba tɛr Asiiria koojen deŋnee o mbarafo ne nyiŋa waa nyiŋi nɛn dɛɛ vah la wa.

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ o dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘N ɡbabir bokpeɡa ne n wejemaa n kpɔ ɛ waa nɔ bwa. N chɔɡ harɛre jwɛhre dɛ yoo ba dɛ pa ba kondɔɔh. Banyoo tentenee men. N ir koranar ba kora ta.

english_verse: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
translation_verse: N pa ba kondɔɔh kɛŋɔ jumbie kɔr ne hala ken. Gɛ nɛn yon ka pu kwaa hala kɛŋɔ a chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ o yon pa la, ɡɛɛ n kpɔ harɛre la bwa. Bɛlbwa ta parawe kɛɛ dɛ si.’ ”

english_verse: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?
translation_verse: Kpanfɛ ɛɛ won ŋɔ o ɡwaa nɛn waa kpɔɔ dɛɛ teŋe daa aa, kɛɛ saradaa ɛɛ won ŋɔ o ɡwaa naate waa dɛ ɛ o ne toma aa? Guli ɛɛ won ɡɔɔ o te dɛ nɛn laa kpɔɔ waa? Kɛɛ da ɛɛ won ɡɔɔ nɛn aa?

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ kpɔ ɡwaŋa weelaa ta Asiiria koojen laa tena baa kpeɡa kohona nɛ, ásɛ dɛ chɔɡ o jirima kɛŋɔ nii yon fuh kon tonɛ la.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Korowii waa do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah Israel tena, wɛɛ berɛ niinii dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa. Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ Israel tena ɛɛ tomɔ la, ɛɛ berɛ ninlawee, dɛ́ fuh komɛlbwa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ, hale sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛ bwa.

english_verse: The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ fuh kɔne aa wera, ne harɛdɛɛɡa bwaa kwara, komɛlbwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo. Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ serewe weela aa lɔ nɛn nɛɛ la.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Daa aa ka o kɔr la bini la, tamaa kenii dɛɛ ba kae, ásɛ bechajeɡa kwaraa won kura. Israel tena baa kaa wa

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ la, Israel tena baa kaa la aa hwɛɡaa dɔ Asiiria koojen waa lɔ ba harɛ la nɛɛ kpa. Korowii Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la nɛɛ baa ba ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ kasinteŋ ne.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Israel tena, dɛ he warɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle kwaraa naa, he tamaa dɛɛ ba kae dɛ́ berɛ ba. Chɔɡa chɔ le dɛɛ kpa heya. Gɛ Korowii aa cheɡ heyaa la, he chɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
translation_verse: Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛɛ ba chɔɡa waa vɔrɔwa cheɡ la ne bala ba ta harɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nomanta, Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛ bol ŋɔ, “N nɛra haa lɔ Saayɔn, hale dɛ Asiiria tena kpɔ daa dɛɛ lɔɔ heyaa ɡɛ Ijipt tena fa aa ɛ heyaa la aa, hé bɛ ban ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: A ka tamaa ken dɛ n baah sɔɔhnɔ, maa hé deŋnee tɛr kpa, ásɛ dɛ berɛ n bandia ta Asiiria tena ɡe nɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.”

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ lɔɔ baa chweema nee, ɡɛ waa ɛ Midian tena dɛ kpoo ba Oreb bwe ta la. Wɛɛ ir o daŋɡbalaa pa nee ta, ɡɛ waa ɛ Ijipt tena ba ka nee ta la.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ laa wahala baa dɛ ɛ heyaa a berɛ heyaa bone laanee kpɔ he nɛ, ásɛ wobɛlbwa le he baŋa a ɡɛ saŋ.

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Hé na! Laa tena jo bwɛjen Aiyat, dɛ kpɔ Meɡrɔn dɛɛ ba, dɛ ka kpɔ bone ka cheɡ Mikmas.

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: Ba le ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa Geba baŋ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Yaa ka chɔ Gebaa jwaana la bwaa.” Ɔmee lawɛ Rama tena ba bwara ɛɛ sa, Kooro Sɔɔl bwɛɛ Gebea tena ir chwa.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Galim tena, hé do lɔŋɔre! Nɛra haa lɔ Laisa ɡe, hé no. Anatɔt tena, hé waa sum.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Fini tɔpere nɔ, baa bao dɛ́ ba che Nɔb. Baa nyiŋi Jerusalam Saayɔn Bwejen la taa, dɛ́ ume nɔɔra pa ba nɛɛ dɛɛ aah ba.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
translation_verse: Hé no! Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ba ba ne harɛɛ, kɛŋɔ baa choo daa dɛɛ ta la ken. Dajaŋa la, wɛɛ teŋaa ɡo, dajena ɡe bwa choɡli.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ teŋ baa ta, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ kpanfɛ teŋni kɔr baah daa dɛɛ ta la ken. Ba kpeɡri kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn daa kwara naa, wɛɛ teŋ baa ta.

english_verse: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.
translation_verse: Kooro bɛl ɛɛ le Jese bie Devid luɡe taa dɛ́ ba, kɛŋɔ daa yon pamɛ le o muŋkpul ta, dɛ dɔ kpala dɛ nɔnɛ la.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Korowii Doma ɛɛ so o nɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel o dɔ wejema ne waa mun noe, dɛ́ jemɛ nɛra jae dɛ́ dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel ó jemɛ Korowii waa bini dɛɛ duuru.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Korowii duuraa dɛ́ lɛ o sie. Waa nɛra siebɔree nyiŋi dɛ́ pa bole, waa nɛra wobol taa teŋɛ dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛ waa toɡra taa wɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛɛ bol nɛra aa hiah ba wa, dɛ́ pa bole, kasinteŋii wɛɛ ba kpɔe dɛ́ bol harɛ nɔ ta nyaara waa tɛɛ ba. O nyoa wobolee wɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛr nɛn deŋne, waa waa bol la ɛɛ kpoo wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa.

english_verse: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
translation_verse: Waa aa toɡra ne kasinteŋii wɛɛ ba kpɔe ɛ kiriso, dɛ́ kpɔ vɔwɛ o chara.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ, ɡbolo ne pebie ɛɛ pɛ bobeŋkpoŋii, noniete ne booh pɛ chɔ. Nao bie ne puadɔɔ ɡe pɛ bobeŋkpoŋ dɛɛ di, bechala ɛɛ teɡa.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Nao ne sisire ɛɛ pɛo dɛɛ di bobeŋkpoŋ, a bii ɡe pɛ dɛɛ chɔ, puadɔɔ chwe kpɔɡa kɛŋɔ nao ken.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Bechala ɛɛ huuhnuu ka hɛlɛ bɔɔ biro aa lɔ o bini nyoa, bechala ka kpɔ nɔn do domkpule bɔɔ bini waa on wobɛlbwaa ɛ.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Nɛra aa ba dɔŋaa kpo kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ komɛlbwa kpa, Korowii Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta. Nɛra ɛɛ jemɛ Korowii harɛ la bwa taa, kɛŋɔ mpo aa yɛɛra la ken.

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Jese naa waa dɛ ba bala la ɛɛ cheo tɛ harɛre nɛra bwa kɛŋɔ fraŋkaa, ba bwa ɛɛ ba cheme o siee bela waa lole la, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛo.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ berɔ che o kpeɡri ta lɛ o nɛra baa kaa dɛ le Asiiria ne Ijipt ne Patrus, ne Itiopia ne Elam ne Babelɔn, dɛ Hamat harɛre bwa, dɛ banɔ la bwa baa lɔ bojaŋa harɛre ta.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ir fraŋkaa harɛre nɛra nɔ bwa na, dɛ́ boa Israel tena baa laɡ ba ka so harɛre ta la nyoa, dɛ́ ɡel Juda tena baa peɡra kaa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa la bwa ba cheme.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Israel tena sie aa Juda tenaa beɡre kpa, Gɛɛ Juda tena ɡe aa wola Israel tenaa dɔm kpa.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Baa pɛo dɛ́ lɔ ka tɔ Filisti tena baa lɔ wee cholibɔr nɛɛ dɛ́ yoo ba, dɛ́ ka kah banɔ la baa lɔ wee leebɔr la ɡe laala kɛ laa ta kwa, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ Edom ne Moab tena nɛ, Amɔn tena berɛ ba bechale dɛɛ tom ba.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo Ijipt mpo kpale la hweeh kwaraa, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ir nɔn pa Yufretis Moo la ta, peuwɔb bɛl ta kpɔ o ta, ásɛ o peɡri nenabɔɔne anuanɛ, nɛra won do naŋɡawa dɛ́ jo dɛɛ le o baŋ.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛjen ɛɛ chɔɔ tɛ o nɛra baa kaa, dɛ́ le Asiiria harɛ la ta, ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ fa aa chɔa tɛ Israel tena ɡɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, hɛɛ ɡo yelaa ŋɔ, “Korowii jam kɛ o baah fa aa di n nɛɛ dɛ berɛ sɔɔh dɛɛ larawe n bwara taraken nɔ.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, Korowiirii n Lɛɛ. Mɛɛ dɛɛ yaradao dɛ bɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ. Korowii bee n bokpeɡa do, n yel maa ɡo bwa ɡee kɛŋɔ Korowii. Onee n Lɛɛ.”

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: Gɛ nyɔɡre dɛ kpo nɛn o dɔ kɔlɔŋ nee nyɔ, o sie lɛ la, ɡɛɛ dɛ Korowii lɛ nɛra aa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, hɛɛ ɡo yelee ŋɔ, “Hé yerɛ Korowii sɔn, hé jaamo. Hé ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa jemɛ ɡɛ waa ɛa, ásɛ dɛ berɛ baɡ ba ɡɛ o sɔn aa kana.

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, o ɛ wejena ɡa, Hé bol a waa harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa no.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Saayɔn tena, hé hɛɡre dɛ́ ɡo yela kohona. Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la kan kohona! O ne o nɛra so.”

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Babelɔn waa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡle Emɔɔs bie Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ.

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ laa fraŋkaa ka pa deŋɡare daa aa wola toole o ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ laa tena ba, dɛ́ ir nɔɔra baɡ ba bá ka jo nɛnjena bwɛɛ la ta dɛ́ yoo ba.

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: Hé no! Gbɔɡa dɛ le bwejena dor dɛɛ ba birbir kɛ nɛnlaa aa dɛ valɛ ken, kɛ harɛre nɛra ne ba koranar aa baa pɛ ken. Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ yer ba bá kaa laa la.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: Ba le harɛre jaɡa bojaŋ dɛɛ ba. Bandia nee Korowii ɛɛ ba ba ne, bá ba chɔɡ harɛ la bwa.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ nyu dɛ́ wi. Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la telo. Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la tɔpere waa dɛ ba nɛra chɔɡa la telo.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ telaa, nomɛlbwa bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, ásɛ ba hwɛɡa ɡe tonɛ.

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: Ɔmee ɛɛ chole ba nɛɛ, ba bwara wee ba chweeh, baa beɡre ba te kɛŋɔ loltea aa lɔ haah. Ba nyoa ɛɛ kpoo kohonaa, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba, baa nyiŋi dɔŋa.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Hé na! Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la dɛ ba. Awola tɔpere la aa werii do kwara, o baah ɛɛ diu taeh. Wɛɛ ɛ harɛ nɔɔ kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra le o ta.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Weweela aa chaah ɡɛ saŋ, wee aa bɔr chaahna ba kpa, korobie ɡe aa won chaah.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ba chɔɡ harɛ nɔɔ. Mɛɛ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋnee ba wedoŋa wa, dɛ́ ɡel ɡɔɔra nɛra aa dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te la teŋe. Dɛ́ ba banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo la ɡe ne harɛ.

english_verse: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa le a nyoa ɛɛ ka tama kenii, ba waa do tɔɡre ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm tenten.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nyundua yiiɡi, ásɛ harɛ jiɡri dɛ́ le o chebɔr, ɡɛ tɔpere men Koranar Bwa Kooro aa baɡle n bandia harɛ nɔ ta la.

english_verse: Everyone will run to their homelands, just as hunted deer run, and sheep scatter when they have no shepherd.
translation_verse: Hɔɔhra baa soɡe Babelɔn ɛɛ lɔɔ peɡre, dɛ́ kaa ba harɛre ta kɛŋɔ kpaahna aa jo kweɡli baah a lɔ peɡre la. Baa chwao peɡre kɛŋɔ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe ken.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa baa lawɔ la, baa yaɡɔɔ kere nee kpo.

english_verse: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
translation_verse: Baa cheo dɛɛ nyiŋi ba lɔɔ ba bii kpoo, dɛ́ jo ba deremi dɛ́ bal ba laala dɛ paɡɛ ba haahna ɡe.”

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé no! Mɛɛ ɡeloo Midia tena ba yo Babelɔn tena. Ba waane laa suuɡapoŋa wa, haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm yaɡ ba sen.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: Baa kpɔ ba tori ne hɛmaa le bonɔɔna nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba. Ba te waane laa bechasɔɔhne wa, ba ta tedoma dɔe tɛ bechajeɡre ɡe.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Babelɔn kora wer ɡwaa bwɛɛre bwa kora, bela tena kpɔɔ dɛɛ ta nyoa. Kɛ men Korowii, mɛɛ chɔɡ kora laanee kɛŋɔ maa ɛ Sodom ne Gomoora la.

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: Pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ola dɛ ba bela doe dɛɛ si deremi la bini, kwiure sɔh a kɔne bela, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini ola aa do kɛŋɔ boohna do bela dɛɛ jah.

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: Kalampoŋare ɛɛ dɛɛ si dekpeɡa binii, ásɛ ɡboli si koranar dedɛɛɡa bini. Babelɔn chɔɡa saŋ telo, waa jaŋɛ kpa.”

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ Israel tena, wɛɛ berɔ lee ba tɛ o te ja, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ba so ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta. Hɔɔhra ɛɛ ba ja ba nɛɛ ba ne ba pɛ so.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ cha baa dɛ kpɔ ba ba, ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta. Ásɛ Israel tena berɛ kpɔ harɛre la nɛra berɛ ba yoma Korowii harɛ waa kpɔa tɛ Israel tena la ta. Nɛra Israel tena fa aa lɔ ba lɔɡa la berɛ ba do ba lɔɡa, ásɛ dɛ baa tom ba.

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere Korowii aa tɛ heyaa ona le weweele ne hɔhɔrɔwa dɛ dochɔɡa he fa aa lɔ a ta la,

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: hɛɛ kpɔ yelee sɛɡle Babelɔn kooro dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ nyubinikpeɡ te la aa bera sɔɔh! Hé na ɡɛ o bandia aa ba a jaɡa!

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: Korowii kuuɡi wechɔɡ-ɛɛra daŋɡbale, o ɡelɔ koranar kpeɡri sɔɔh.

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Harɛ bwa dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna, nomɛlbwa ɛɛ ɡo yela silɛɛ ne.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Lɛbanɔn harɛ peleme daa, ne anɔ la aa jaa kwaraa sie lɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la kora la ɡui wa, dɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Taraken baa ba he ne harɛ nɔ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ teŋe yaa kpa.’

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Ba bwa ɛɛ ŋɔ o bee ŋɔ, ‘He ɡe sɔɔhnɔ ɡɛ yaa doa nɔ, ya bwa kɛrɛdɛ!

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: He jenu bwa tonɛ lalabwɛ, janjela baa lɔa dɛɛ duuri bwa chiɡo. Dudulee he kalaŋ, dɛ tɔe yal.’

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: Babelɔn kooro, na ɡɛ haa le nyundua ba le harɛ. Chɔmbibi wewee, chɔmbibi bonɔɔ! Ba taɡɛ ta harɛ, nɛn he fa aa pɔ harɛre nɛ!

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: He fa liiro ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ teehnoo kaa nyundua. Korowii weweela baŋ lee mɛɛ ba n kookara kpɔe ka cheɡ, dɛ́ so kɛŋɔ kooro weekaŋle nyunduabɔr bwejen la ta, bela kwaa aa bea baa wola an na aa dɛ cheme la.

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ teehnoo ka so baama baŋ, dɛ́ ɛ n te kɛŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowii ken.’

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, Korowii ba he ne harɛ, dɛ kpɔe kaa lala huɡribɔr bɔɔ bini.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa nae la ɛɛ nyiŋii jeiih ken, dɛɛ lii ŋɔ, ‘Baa la waa ɡela harɛ jiɡri dɛ ɡel koranar chel laanee nɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Onee chɔɡ bwɛjena dɛ ɡel bela bwa berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, waa wola nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kpɔe ta la aa?’

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Koranar baa serewa la bɛlbwa chɔ o ɡbaɡba lalbɔɔ bini, ba ɛ ba ŋwama la a do wer.

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: Kɛ he te, ba kpɔe viɡri kɛŋɔ baa teŋe daa ta ken, ba ta hen huɡe. Nɛra baa ka laa ta la lalaa tɔ he nɛ, ba kpɔ he ne ba bwa ta bwebɔɔ bini dɛ tiɡri he nɛ.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Ba ta hen huɡe kɛŋɔ baa huɡe he bala koranar la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, he chɔɡ he harɛ, he kpoo he nɛra. Baa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra naanar sɔnee yerɛ kpa bwa.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Kwaa bɔr dɛ́ kpoo o naanar ba naawa chɔɡre baa ɛa la wa, ásɛ ba bɛ ir dɛ́ ba lɛ harɛ nɔ dɔɔh, dɛ́ ma bwɛjena o ta bwa.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ka che bwɛjen Babelɔn ne o nɛra nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba maa komɛlbwaa ɡel, bechale ɡba aa ka, o sɔn he. Men Korowiirii ŋɔa.

english_verse: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo bela berɛ kataŋa ne kwiure dobɔr, dɛ́ ɡbaa bela bwa ó chɔɡ. Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.” Korowii bol Asiiria tena chɔɡa wa

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, “Waa maa vɔrɔwa la, anee dɛɛ ba ɛɛ, anɔ la aa dawɛ n sie la ɡee mɛɛ ba ɛɛ.

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ Asiiria tenaa le n harɛ ta, mɛɛ tiɡri ba nɛɛ Israel harɛ bwejena ta, dɛ́ lawɛ n nɛra le Asiiria tena kpeɡri baa dɛ di ba nɛ, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ daa dawɛ nae anɛ baŋa ta a pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma la.

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Waa nɔɔ n vɔrɔwe bil dɛɛ ba ɛɛ harɛ ta bobɛlbwa. N ir nɔn dɛ́ tɛr harɛre nɛra deŋne.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now! The Philistines Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa vɔrɔwa nɔ, umee dɛ́ won bera ɔ? O ir nɔn dɛ́ tɛr nɛra deŋne, umee dɛ won ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o bɛ ɛɔ? Korowii bol Filisti tena chɔɡa wa

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: A bena Kooro Ahas aa chɔ o banɔn ta, waa aa le Korowii be ba laanee.

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Filisti tena, daŋɡbala baa kpɔa lɔɔ heyaa ka la kuu, kɛ he bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ he hɛɡre. Harɛkon sewaa, onchɔɡe kɛ domkpule dɛ́ chiɡ o naa ta, ásɛ o bii ɡe do kɛŋɔ doh dɛ́ ir.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa nyaa kohona ɛɛ dɔ kwaa dɛɛ di, ásɛ banɔ la ba soɡa bini aa kpeɡa tɛɛ ba ɡe dɔ bɔr chɔ bosɔɔhna ta, komɛlbwa aa ban ɛ. Kɛ he Filisti tena te, lɔree mɛɛ ba kpɔe kpoo heyaa he mun he harɛ la ta. He bini bɛlbwa aa kae ba.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: Hé do lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wii, he banɔ la haa lɔ bwɛjena bini la! Filisti tena, hé ɡel he bambile teŋe! Yoyoora tenten le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, kɛŋɔ ninchuu ken, dɛ bwa pɛ dɛɛ ba ba yo heya.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Webesoo yaa ba toroma baa le harɛ la ta ba la chaŋa ɔ? “Korowii kpɔ Saayɔn cheɡ, ásɛ o nɛra baa dɛ na wahala dɔ bɔr so dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu.”

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Moab harɛ ta Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ, Moab harɛ ta bwɛjena Ar ne Kir chɔɡɔ. Jwaana beŋkpoŋii ba chɔɡa.

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Debɔn tena teehnɔ kaa deŋɡare ta, bela ba voɡ aa lole dɛ́ ka wi. Moab harɛ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ wi bwɛjena Nɛbo ne Medeba waa, dɛ́ fonɛ ba nyuune ne tampona bwa ta, aa baɡle suna dii.

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: Ba tɔ lweyale fɔɡbaahna bwa, saldor ne bela baa dɛ cheme bwa, ba ne siniiree, ba wio dɛ ba tal.

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Hɛsbɔn tena ne Eleale tena dɛ wi, ba lɔŋɔre tel Jahas. A ɡelɔ ɔmee lawɛ Moab laa tena bwa ba lɔŋɔre bɔle, ba bwara yɔr.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: N bambile dɛ wee mɛ Moab tena wa. Nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta chwao kaa Soar, hale dɛ ka tel Eɡlat Sɛleseya. Bane teehnɔ kaa Luhit, baa dɛ kaa la bwa, dɛ ba ne wii. Bane chwao kpɔ Horonaim ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ wi ba chɔɡa wa.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Nimrim nenabɔɔ nee bwa hweehrɔ kwaraa, kpɔɡa aa lɔ o nyoa bwa holɔ, papo-lwɛɛ bɛlbwa toole dɛ ta che bela kpa.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Ba cheɡɛ ba kondɔɔh baa dɔa bwa ɡale Dajaŋa Nenabɔɔ, dɛɛ ba kpɔe ka sɔh.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Moab harɛ jwɛhre bobɛlbwaa baa wi, ba wii tel bela bwɛɛre Eɡlaim ne Beɛ Elim.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Chal ɡboo Demɔn neerare bwa, kɛ Korowii ta dɔ waane aa ɡwaa ken, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ nɛra baa soɡe bela. Seo chɔ le dɛɛ kpa Moab tena baa dɛ chwa, ne banɔ la baa ka harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Sela tena, hé lawɛ pebiiri dɛ́ kpɔ ka tomɛ Israel tena kooro. Hé tomɛ nɛra bá kpɔ le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ dɛ́ kaa Saayɔn Bwejen ta.

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Moab haahna lɔ Aanɔn Moo nyoa milimili, dɛ la dɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ jumbii baa doŋa le a kɔne ta ken.

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ Juda harɛ nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé ja yaa, hé baɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa ɛ. Hé ɡel ya so he lɔɡa, hé chunchuli tɔ ya nɛ. Hé kpɔ yaa sɔh, he bɛ yaa le tɛ nɛra baa dɛ yo yaa nɔ.

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya Moab tena baa doŋi yaa ya ba marɛ nɔ dɔ sobɔr he harɛ ta. Hé tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, he bɛ ɡel ya dɔma dɔ yaa.” Wahala ɛɛ tonɔɔ, nɛŋkpoa ba a jaɡa, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ vuuɡi harɛ la bwa ɡe le o ta.

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: Baa cheɡ kora bɛlee, Kooro Devid naa dɛɛ ba o ta soɡa. Kasinteŋ ne nɛnnyin nee wɛɛ ba o kara dii, dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta. Waa waa aa toɡra habɔɔ ta.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Moab tena ɛɛ wi ba harɛ waa, ba bwa ɛɛ wiu. Ba bwa ɛɛ lii konsoma ba fa aa dɛ di bwɛjen Kir Haresɛt la waa, dɛ́ pɛ dɛɛ wi.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Kooni aa bɛne Hɛsbɔn bwa chɔɡɔ, ɡɛɛ daa kooni aa lɔ Sibma la ɡe chɔɡ. A ɡɛ daa kooni la nɔna senee harɛre nomonjena fa nyɔ dɛɛ dɛɛ. Daa kooni la fa yɛɛrɔ tel bwɛjen Jasa, ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Yar Mpo ta.

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: N dɛ wi dɛɛ tɛ daa kooni aa lɔ Sibma, ɡɛ baa dɛ wi a waa Jasa la. Hɛsbɔn tena ne Eleale tena, sinii dɛ yɔɔ mɛ he wa. Moola fe dɛ le daa nɔna chaara saŋ nɔ, kɛ nɔna toole a ta, bɔr helɔ.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Silɛɛ ne hɛɡra toole daa kooni ta kpa. Nomɛlbwa aa yela kɛɛ lɔŋɔree do daa kooni ta kpa. Nomɛlbwa ɡe aa a nɔna ta tiɡri a nee le a ta kpa. Silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa teŋo.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: N dɛ hime Moab wa, n tea bini chɔɡ kohona Kir Haresɛt wa.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Moab tena teehno kaa bwe doa ba voɡa la ta naa, ba dɛ koh pɛɛpɛɛ. Ba la ba voɡa deene bini dɛ ka soŋa oo, aa ban komɛlbwa lee ba.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Moab harɛ waa Korowii aa bola wubwa laanee la.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Taraken Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Gɛ paa te yon dɛɛ do o tɔpere la, ɡɛɛ Moab tena ɡe tɔpere do. Bonɔ bene atoro Moab kondɔɔh bwa dɛ́ ba chɔɡa ó di ncho. Nɛn damanta baa lɔ o ta bwa, tamaa kenii dɛɛ ba kae, baa ɡwɛɡroo.”

english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ bwɛjen Damaskɔs Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ. “Damaskɔs aa bwɛjen ɛɛ ba kpa, wɛɛ ba chɔɡoo dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia chɔ.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Bwɛjena aa lɔ Siiria harɛ dɛ́ ba dimɡbia bera dɛ chɔ. Aa berɛ peera ne nae dibɔraa, nomɛlbwa aa lee do dɛ́ doŋa.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro toole Israel harɛ ta kpa. Bwɛjen Damaskɔs ɡe aa koobwɛɛ ɛ kpa. Siiria tena ɛɛ ba ka tamaa ba jirima tonɛ, ɡɛ Israel tena jirima aa tona la.” Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, Israel jirima waa dɔa la ɛɛ tonɔɔ, ásɛ nyaa chiɡ o kondɔɔh naa ta.

english_verse: Israel will be like wheat fields in Rephaim Valley picked clean of grain.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ koo baa komɛ o mea dɛ paa kaa la ken. Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ koo baa kuuh mea Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini, o chɔ pɛɛ.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Kɛ mea tamaa dɛɛ ba kae, kɛŋɔ ba yon chaa ɔleve daa nɔna, ásɛ a yon ba ka nɔna anɛ kɛɛ atoro daa la nyundujaɡla kɛɛ tama aa ka o kpala ta la.” Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee bola.

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛɛ kpɔ sie dawɛ Korowii nɛ. Onee Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ waa ta ba baa tomɔ.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: Baa kwaa ba ɡbaɡba aa maa dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa dɛɛ tɛ voɡa a ta laanee nyiŋi kpa. Baa voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa ba ɡbaɡba aa paaɡa, ne bela baa maa dɛɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma la ta hwɛɡɛ kpa.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, ba bwɛjena aa do kpeɡri ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbeenii, dɛ le kpɔɡa ne daa, ɡɛ Israel tena fa aa pɔ a ɡɛ bwɛɛre la nɛɛ a nɛra chwa a berɛ dimɡbeeni dɛ che la.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Israel tena, he liire le he Lɛɛ Korowii nɛ. Onee Bwetal haa kpɔ he te marɔ wɛɛ tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe la, kɛ he soh o wa. He du dadɛɛɡa bodɛɛɡa, dɛ kwaa bela dɛɛ tomɛ harɛre voɡare.

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: He fe wono ɡel a le awola tenten haa dua la, dɛ moɡɛ dɛ fe aa, haa komɛlbwa a ta chaa. Wahala ne weweele aa wola tonɛ ɡboo hɛɛ ba dɔe.

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Hale nɛra warɔ dɛɛ moo kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma sii aa, Korowii ɛɛ kah baa ásɛ ba chwa kaa bojaŋ. Baa chwao dɛ́ peɡre kɛŋɔ peu aa kpɔ haahra, kɛɛ kawulewule aa kpɔ doŋa kaa la ken.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: A tel jɔmɔra aa, ba dɛ ɛ ɔmewa, kɛ tɔɔ ne pera chɔɔ dɛ ba kaalɔ. A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛ́ chiɡ nɛra baa bal ya laala kɛ laa ta kwa kaa la nɛ.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ Itiopia harɛ neerare baŋ le tontombɛ aa su o ta la, bá bwɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ tomɛ toroma bá so dafɛɡa ɡbeni bini, dɛ́ kpɔ Nael Moo sie. Toroma haa ɡbaŋa, hé la harɛ o nɛra aa kpeɡa kohona ba bwara loɡa la be, nɛra baa do ɔma harɛ nɔ bwa ta, dɛɛ tiɡri ba dɔma nɛ neerare peɡri ba harɛ bini.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ba pa fraŋkaa bwe doa aa, hé nao, dɛ́ cheɡ deŋne, dɛ ba hoh bɛla aa, ásɛ he no.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ so nyundua dɛ́ nyiŋi jeiih ken, kɛŋɔ wee aa lea bɔr wɔrɔbe, kɛɛ mɛne aa dɛ ta wee lɔ a ta aa nyɛɡle kwaa koma saŋ la.”

english_verse: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
translation_verse: Gɛ kpala la aa chɔa la, ɡɛɛ Itiopia lala ɛɛ ba chɔe, ásɛ jumbii aa dɛ di ola dia bɔwɔb saŋ, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ɡe ba dia waa saŋ.

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, nɛra baa kpeɡa kohona ba bwara do wer, ba do ɔma harɛ nɔ bwa ta, dɛɛ tiɡri ba dɔma nɛ, neerare peɡri ba harɛ bini la, baa kpɔ koŋkɛɛlaa ba tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro Saayɔn Bwejen ta, bela baa dɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Ijipt harɛ ta, Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ. Hé na! Korowii cheɡɛ bam ta, dɛɛ ba Ijipt harɛ ta wɔrɔbe nɛ. Voɡare aa lɔ bela bwa jum jah o sie, asɛ bela tena bwa bwara yɔr.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Ijipt tena hwɛɡa bwa ɛɛ tonɔɔ, ásɛ ba maɡla baa maɡla bil bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, bá kaa bɔɔ voɡa ne lala ne ba voɡra ne ba bebeela.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ Ijipt tenaa do kooro nyubinikpeɡ te bɛl nɔn ta, o wa do ɔma, wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ. Men Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.”

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Nael Moo waa chɔ bela ɛɛ hweehroo, ásɛ o nenabɔɔ bini hol chɔ.

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: Bɔra baa kwia nee palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ a ta bwa ɛɛ sɔɔhnoo, ásɛ nenabɔɔne hweeh. Kpɔɡa aa cheɡɛ nee ta bwa sewɛ.

english_verse: Fields along the Nile will be completely barren; every plant will disappear.
translation_verse: Kwaa aa lɔ Nael Moo nyoa, ne kwaa baa dua o nyoa la bwa ɛɛ holoo, peu kpɔa kaa kwara.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ jisere dɛɛ ɛ yapondɛɛɡa bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ sɔah bwara hwah.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ yale toma bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ di a paane waa do sum.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Nomonome baa chɔ Ijipt bwɛjen Soan nyoa la ɛ ɡɛna, nomonome baa jemɛ waa dɛɛ ja Ijipt kooro la aa on liidɛɛɡa tɛ. Aah, hɛɛ won ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be ŋɔ, “N ɛ wejereme kɛŋɔ saŋ la tena wejerema ne koranar la bini bɛl aa?”

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Ijipt kooro, namete leperaa he wejerema la dɔɔ? Gel ba baɡle he jemɛ ɡɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro aa kpaŋre Ijipt tena waa bil dɛɛ ba kpɔe ɛɛ ba.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Nomonome baa chɔ Soan nyoa berɛ ɡɛna, Mɛmfes nomonome ɡe wili. Banee fe chɛ kɛŋɔ ba tɔ Ijipt tena sie, dɛ berɛ ɡel ba nyoɡre.

english_verse: The Lord has confused Egypt; its leaders have made it stagger and vomit like a drunkard.
translation_verse: Korowii perewi sibir ta ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel Ijipt tena ɛ sakaa ba we-ɛɛla ta, kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛ yon chwɛɛ dɛɛ ɡbaɡre a ta la.

english_verse: No one in Egypt can do a thing, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa toole Ijipt tena won ɛ kpa, nomonome kɛɛ dansaara aa won cha ba, nɛnjena kɛɛ nɛmpɛɛne aa won cha ba.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere, Ijipt tena ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ haahna ken. Baa ɔmɔɔ ba bwara chel Koranar Bwa Kooro nɔn waa ɡɔɔra dɛ́ kpɔ tɛr ba deŋne la wa.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Juda harɛ sɔn ɛɛ ɡeloo ɔmee kohona lawɛ Ijipt tena. Nomɛlbwa yerɛ Juda harɛ sɔn aa, Ijipt tena bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, kpaŋra Koranar Bwa Kooro aa kpaŋre ba waa bil nomanta.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Ijipt harɛ bwɛjena anue tena ɛɛ bol Juda tena wobolee, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te tɛ kɛŋɔ baa tomɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro. Baa pa bwɛjena la bɛl sɔnee ‘Bwɛjen waa dɛ ba Chɔɡa’.

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Baa ɛ saraha kon Ijipt harɛ baah taa tɛ Korowii, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bwe ka pa o jwɛh ta tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ lii, awola tɔpere.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Aa cheo dɛɛ baɡle waa dɛ tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro Ijipt harɛ ta. Dɛ nɛra dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa asɛ ba do lɔŋɔ tɛ Korowii aa, wɛɛ tɛɛ baa lɛɛree ó lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ o tenee baɡle Ijipt tena bá jemɔ awola, dɛ́ tomɔ dɛ́ kpoo kwaa tɛo, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mea sarahare ɡe tɛo. Baa baɡɔ nyoa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ tɛr Ijipt tena deŋnee mɔɔ dɛ lɛɛ ba. Baa ba o bee ásɛ o no ba wesoŋa dɛ́ chaah ba.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, ŋwɛnɛ ɛɛ chɔɔ le Ijipt harɛ ka ta Asiiria harɛ ta, ásɛ Asiiria tena won Ijipt laŋa, Ijipt tena ɡe won Asiiria bala. Gɛ nɛmbele banɛ nɔ ɛɛ pɛo dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Israel tena dɛ ba Ijipt ne Asiiria tena nɛɛ jae, dɛ́ ɡel harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa na som.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛɛ ba dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Ijipt tena baa ɛ n nɛra, ne Asiiria tena maa ta ba, dɛ Israel tena maa lee ba tɛ n te la, ba na som.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: A bena Asiiria koojen Saaɡɔn aa tomɛ o laa nomoa o la bwɛjen Asdɔd dɛ ka yoo ba dɛ lɛ bwɛjen la la,

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: a ɡɛ saŋee Korowii che Emɔɔs bie Aesaya nɛɛ dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Ka laa lweyal wur bil, dɛ́ laa naŋɡawa parame he nakpale.” Asɛ Aesaya ka ɛ ɡɛ, dɛ valɛ dakpaŋ ne o nakpapɛɛ ne.

english_verse: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ n bonɔɔ Aesaya aa dɛ valɛ dakpaŋ ne nakpapɛɛ bene atoro nɔ, a ɛ we-ɛɛla dɛ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba Ijipt harɛ ne Itiopia harɛ chiɡa.

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee Asiiria koojen ɛɛ ba Ijipt ne Itiopia tena waa kaa yoo ba, dɛ laɡ ba la ɛɛ ba bá valɛ dakpaŋ ne nakpapɛɛ ne. Nomonome ne bechale bwa ɛɛ valɛ mumɡbal sihiih nee.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɔ Itiopia hwɛɡa, dɛɛ tamane Ijipt nɛɛ la ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ sihiih kpo ba.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa soɡe mpo nyoa bela la ɛɛ na waa aa puu baa dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Na ɡɛ aa chiɡ nɛra yaa kpɔ ya te dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛɛ la, nɛra yaa chwaa kaa mar ba bá lɛ yaa le Asiiria koojen nɔn ta la! Na waa aa puu ba! Leperaa yaa ba sie doe jaɔ?’ ”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Babelɔn harɛ ta Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ. Gɛ kawulewule aa taa dɛɛ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, ɡɛɛ wekpeɡa ɛɛ ba a le harɛ waa do ɔma ta ba.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: N na waane kɛŋɔ chaahna ken a ɛ lokua kohona. Bane le dɔŋa dɛɛ tɛ, bane ɡee chɔɡ kwaa kohona. Elam tena, hé ka lɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ yoo ba! Midia tena, hé bar ba bwɛjena cheme, dɛ́ tɔ ba do! Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo wahala Babelɔn aa ba a ne la teŋe.

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa maa naa la ɡelɔ n bwadabii wee mɛ chweeh ken, kɛŋɔ loltea aa lɔ haah ken. Waa maa noa la ɡelɔ maa won ɛ wobɛlbwa, n ɛo chinchaŋ waa maa naa la wa.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ nɛn ó kaa daah, ásɛ wobɛlbwa waa na la ó ba bol.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: Dɛ o baa na kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ne jaɡre ne keeɡore dɛ nyoɡmare laa tena so a ta naa, ó nyiŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: Then a guard said, “I have stood day and night on this watchtower, Lord.
translation_verse: Belaa nɛn waa dɛ daah la kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa n che dejaŋ doa dɛɛ daah.”

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Na, baa bɛl waa cheɡɛ kon waa do kɛ torɔɡo bini ne jaɡre dɛ ba. Asɛ nɛn waa dɛ daah la ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Babelɔn paɡrɔ! O paɡrɔ! Voɡare aa lɔ o ta bwa, ba paɡre a bwa burbur ken bil harɛ.”

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: Aesaya ŋɔ, “N nɛra, ba ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ baa lɔ mea ken, waa maa noa le Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ be laanee n bol la.” Korowii bol Edom harɛ chɔɡa wa

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Edom harɛ ta Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ. Nomɛl lɔ Edom dɛ pɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛn haa dɛ daah, aa biɡruu mɔɔ bɔr chaah naa?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Tɔɔ dɛ ba pera, kɛ bɔr ɛɛ berɔɔ jo ja. Dɛ he dɛ nyin dɛ́ jemaa, ba dɛ́ berɛ ba bɔɔ ja.” Korowii bol Arab harɛ chɔɡa wa

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Arab harɛ ta, Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ. Dedan tena haa lɔ Arab harɛ ta dɛ valɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa hɛɛ ba he tɛnte deene baŋra dɛɛ chɔ jwaana.

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: Tema tena, hé kpɔ kondikwaa ne nee ba cheme banɔ la baa chwaa le laa ta la.

english_verse: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
translation_verse: Ba chwao dɛɛ le keri, ne hɛma baa hara dɛɛ ba ba tae, dɛ wekpeɡa aa lɔ laa ta la nyoa.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Gɛ paadii yon jemɛ kɛŋɔ benanyoa wɛɛ ba o toma tona la, ɡɛɛ Keda tena jirima bwa ɛɛ ba tona benanyoa.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: Keda laa tena baa jemɛ hɛma tae kɛrɛdɛ la aa kanee do kpa. Men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ laanee bola.”

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Chaahna Fɛlembɔjen ta, Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ. Bɔkwaa waa bala ɔ? Ɛrɛɛ bwɛjen nɔ nɛra bwa ɛɛ lɛ ba sie saldor nɔɔ?

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Akwe! Lɔŋɔre ɡbo bwɛ, bwɛjen ɡbɔɡa ne silɛɛ aa sui. Kere laa ba kpɔ kpoo heya, laa ta ɡe laa he ka.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: He bwɛjen la nomonome bwa pɛo chwa, kɛ ba laɡ ba, dɛ ba ta ban hɛma tae. Hale ba dɔma aa lɔ bojaŋ ba chwa kaa kwaraa la, ba lawɛ ba bwa.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: A waa n ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel mɛ n wi n nɛra. He bɛ n bwara larawe n nɛra baa serewa nɔ wa.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ɡeloo o ɛ ɡbɔɡa ne ɡaeh ne ɔmee tɔpere Chaahna Fɛlembɔjen la ta. Ba kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen la ta awola, ba wii kaa le bwejena dor.

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, su he fɛlembɔjena harɛdɛɛɡa la bwa, asɛ nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta ɡe che Jerusalam doonyoone.

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Kwaa aa tɔ Juda tena nɛɛ la, ba laa kpɔ. A ɡɛ saŋ la, he kpɔ sie dawɛ dɔmkwaa aa lɔ Kɔr Bini Koodem la ta.

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: He nao kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ waa bar Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la pera aa choɡla, asɛ he ɡel nee do harɛbɔr tam la ta warɛ.

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: He kure Jerusalam deene, asɛ dɛ kuuɡi ane dɛ kpɔ a bwea ma danjwɛɛ la o do kpeɡri.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: He ma konjen asɛ nee le tambene la ta dɛ ba jo o bini, bwɛɛ la ne danjwɛɛ waa baro la baah ta. He ɛ anɔ nɔ bwa, kɛ he ta sie kpɔe dawɛ Korowii waa waa maɡla bil wubwa, dɛ ɛa la ta.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, hé dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛ́ wi, dɛ́ fonɛ he nyuune dɛ́ kpɔ lweyale tɔ awola tɔpere, á baɡle kɛŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: Kɛ he kpoo nae ne peera dɛɛ di kwa, dɛ nyɔ sene dɛɛ hɛlɛ dɛɛ lɛ he sie. Hé ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya di kwaa dɛ nyɔ sen. Kere ɡbo dɛ ya serewɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ɡbaɡba bol n be ŋɔ, “Maa ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔɔ kpɔ kɛ ba bwa ka tel ba seo tɔpere. Men Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro tomɛ men Aesaya ŋɔ, “La Sɛbna waa chɔ koodem bela tomare nyoa be ka ŋɔ,

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: ‘Henee umeo? Umee tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ hé pɛɡre bwe, dɛ́ kpɔ bela ɛ he lalbɔɔ, asɛ hɛɛ ɛo bodɛɛɡe dɛ́ kpɔ bela ɛ he chɔɔbɔr nɔɔ?

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: Na, he ne he nɛnjen ɛɛ bwa, men Korowii dɛ́ ba he ɡɔɔra viɡri bonɔ.

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ keerii kɛŋɔ bɔɔl ken, dɛ́ kpɔe ta harɛ waa paɡa ta. Belaa hɛɛ ba sewa, belaa he laa torɔɡore haa dɛ che a bini, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ nyin sɔn la ɛɛ ba kae. Sihiih ɛɛ kpo he nomoa he waa.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ doo he nomombatakaarejaŋ laanee, dɛ́ vɔwɔ he kiriso la dɛ́ kpɔ he nomonome la do o nɔn ta. Wɛɛ ɛ nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam ne Juda dea tena bwa mɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: O nɔn taa mɛɛ ba Kooro Devid dem safoa kpɔe do ó di kpeɡri, dɛ o pili komɛl aa, nomɛlbwa aa won tɔɔ, dɛ o tɔ komɛl ɡe aa, nomɛlbwa aa won pilu.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo o che kiŋkiŋ, kɛŋɔ baa kpaa tɛnte baŋra daa do harɛ o che kiŋkiŋ la, ásɛ o nomonome dii dɔ jirima o dem.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: O dem nɛra wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dawɛ o nɛɛ, o naanar ne ba ɡe bii bwa saɡre o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ numoli ne loŋa aa saɡre daa ta la.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, tɛnte baŋra daa maa kpaara do harɛ o pa kiŋkiŋ la ɛɛ pamɔɔ le dɛ́ chole, ásɛ laala aa saɡɛ o ta la bwa chɔɡ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre: Cry, you seagoing ships! Tyre and its houses lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ Taaya Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ. Nɛra haa dɛ ɛ toma stiimaere aa le Taases la, hé wi! Taaya paɡrɔ. Deene kɛɛ stiimae chebɔr toole kpa. Saepros harɛ taa ɡɛ waa nɔ le ba he be.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa soɡe mpo nyoa la, hé wi! He ne bonadiire baa le Sidon dɛɛ ɛ toma stiimae bini dɛ dɛɡ la, hé wi.

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: He tomɛ baala ba la mpo baŋ, dɛ ka yawɛ mea le Ijipt harɛ, dɛ ba yoɡ dɛɛ tɛ harɛre nɛra. Bela baa ɛ bona dibɔr harɛre ɡalɡa ta.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Sidon tena, a chɛ kɛ sihiih kpo heya. Mpo haa kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛɛ la taɡɛ heyaa ta dɛ ŋɔ, “N do kɛ hambara, n ta bibaala dɛɛrɛ bwa, n baa bol bihaahna wa.”

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Dɛ Ijipt tena noɔ kɛŋɔ bwɛjen Taaya paɡraa, ba bwara ɛɛ yɔroo ba wi tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: He nɛra haa soɡe mpo nyoa la, hé wi dɛ́ ir kaa Taases.

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: He bwɛsom Taaya laanee nɔ naa? Bwɛbenebene o nɛra aa joa ka so bojaŋ harɛre ta laanee nɔ naa?

english_verse: its merchants were kings honored all over the world. Who planned to destroy Tyre?
translation_verse: Umee ɡela ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡ Taaya ɔ? Kondɛɛɡa bwɛɛ o bonadiire aa beɡre koobii dɛ dɔ nyanyini harɛ nɔ ta bwa laanee nɔ naa?

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooroo ɡela a chiɡ. O ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ ba jirima baa dɔa dɛɛ ɡɔɔ ba te la tonɛ, dɛ́ ba banɔ la baa dɔ nyanyini harɛ nɔ ta la ne harɛ.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Taases tena, he ta stiimae chuɡribɔr dɔe kpa. Anomanta, hé ka parɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ parɛ Nael Moo nyoa harɛ ta la.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Korowii tɛr o nɔn pa mpo ta, o ir mpo nyoa koranar ɡalɡa. O bol Keenan harɛ nɛra baa soɡe mpo nyoa la wa, dɛ chɔɡ ba dekpeɡa.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Sidon haa wera kɛŋɔ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ, taraken he chɔɡɔ! Silɛɛ aa lɔ he ta la bwa toole kpa. Ir dɛ́ kaa Saepros harɛ ta, hale bela ɡba haa ona dɔe ba.”

english_verse: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Nyiŋi Babelɔn tena harɛ na, ɡɛ nɛra nɔ fa toole wobɛlbwa bini. Asiiria tena ɡelɔ o berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ola sobɔr. Ba ma konjaŋa dɛ pɛl danjwɛɛre aa bar bwɛɛre la ta, dɛ che a ta jo, dɛ kuuɡi dekpeɡa bela bwa berɛ dimɡbia.

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa dɛ ɛ toma Taases stiimaere bini la, hé wi! Bwɛjen haa kpɔ sie dawɛ o ta la paɡrɔ!

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: “Hanjwamane te, ba soh he wa. Kpɔ he janjela dɛ́ lɔ kohona valɛ bwɛɛ bini. Go yela kohona ásɛ baala lii he wa.”

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba tɔnɔ baa dɔ ne ba suuɡa baa dɔa la, baa a taa tɔ. Baa kwaaraa cheɡ á ɛ Korowii kwa, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ la kpɔ yawɛ kondikwaa kohona dɛ́ di dɛ́ yawɛ ba bwara laaladɛɛɡa baa dɛ nyin bwa.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Hé no! Korowii dɛ ba harɛ nɔ chɔɡa o chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ. Wɛɛ lɔ nɛra baa lɔ o taa peɡre, dɛ́ chɔɡ komɛlbwa o ta.

english_verse: including ordinary people and priests, slaves and slave owners, buyers and sellers, lenders and borrowers, the rich and the poor.
translation_verse: Gɛ webeŋkpoŋ nɔ ɛɛ pu nɛra ne ba sɔfore, bonɔɔna ne ba dɔɔranar, bonadiire ne yarawa ne banɔ la baa dɔa dɛɛ kemɛ nɛra, ne banɔ la baa laŋa kaa kemɛ, dɛ dɔɔhna ne nyaara.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ɛɛ chɔɡoo dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, o komɛlbwa tonɛ kwaraa. Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The earth wilts away; its mighty leaders melt to nothing.
translation_verse: Hwel cheɡɛ harɛ ta, o ta kwaa bwa jwalɛ, nyundua tɔɔ, harɛ som tonɔ, harɛ ta nɛnjena ɡwɛɡre.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Harɛ ta nɛra siwi ta Korowii waa la sui, ba vɛh o Mmarare dɛ chɔɡ fɔo o ne baa fɔwa ó chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen serewɔ, dɛ ɡel sen waa do tɔɡre. Nomɛlbwa o sie fa aa dɛ lɛ sen ta la berɔ dɛɛ di suna.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Baa senee nyɔ dɛ́ ɡo yela kpa, seŋkpeɡa aa somɛ a nyɔɔra nyoo kpa.

english_verse: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen la chɔɡɔ dɛ chɔ pɛɛ, ba karɛ dem bɛlbwa doonyoa ɡbera tɔ ba ɡbaɡba nɛ.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Ba dɛ wi sen waa fɔɡbaahna, silɛɛ bwa tonɔ, sum ɡboo kaa. Hɛɡra toole harɛ ta kpa.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen la chɔɡɔ, o doonyoo ɡbeni bwa kuuɡo kwaraa.

english_verse: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
translation_verse: Gɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ. Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ baa chaa ɔleve ne ɡrepore nɔna, a ka beŋkpoŋa saɡre baa kuuhna la.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɔ ba nyu la ɛɛ ɡo yela silɛɛ nee. Banɔ la baa lɔ wee cholibɔr ɛɛ baɡle jirima Korowii aa dɔa.

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa lɔ wee leebɔr pera ɡe, hé tɛ Korowii sɔn. Ekwie harɛre aa lɔ mpo ta bwa nɛra, hé kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Yaa no yelaa le harɛ jaɡa bwa bá ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel Korowii O Wa Aa Toɡra la dɔ sɔn!” Anee n ŋɔ, “A tonɔ, a tonɔ! N dɛ ɡwaŋɛ! Banɔ la baa dɛ neɡre nɛra ta nao dɛɛ neɡre.”

english_verse: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa no n be! Ɔmewaa ne bɔɔ ne bela chɔɔ kpa heya.

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa no ɔmewaa ɡbɔɡa dɛ́ chwa la, wɛɛ ka le bɔɔ binii. Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa le bɔɔ bini dɛ́ takapɔ ir la, wɛɛ le bel taa. Nyundua ɛɛ piluu nee fuɡe, kwaa harɛ aa cheɡɛ a ta ɡe yiiɡi kohona.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Harɛ ɛɛ peroo, wɛɛ jiɡruu dɛ́ peɡri.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Harɛ ɛɛ yɛɛɡoo kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛ ken, kɛɛ pata peu aa dɛ kpɔɔ ken. Harɛ nɛra wechɔɡa sii ba nɛ, dɛ́ ba ba ne harɛ, baa choloo baa wola ir kpa.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ tɛr kwaa aa dɔ kpeɡri dɛ do nyundua, ne koranar baa dɔ kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta deŋnee.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ lawɛ koranaree pɛ do dea, kɛŋɔ ba yon lawɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra dɛɛ do dea la, ásɛ a ba dɛ la sie ó tɛr ba deŋne.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Dɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro baa di o kora Saayɔn Bwejen ta Jerusalam aa, o kora dii jirima ɛɛ ɡwaa korobie chaahna ne wee lɔe, ásɛ bwɛjen la nomonome na dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ waa kana.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee mɛɛ tomɛ, mɛɛ tɛɛ sɔnee dɛ́ kpɛɛre. He ɛ nyokpowa, waa haa maɡla bil saŋ la, he ɛa kasinteŋ ne.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ bwɛjena berɛ dimɡbia, he kuuɡi danjwɛkpeɡa aa bara la. Dekpeɡa hɔɔhra aa maa la, he kuuɡa ta, baa an ma kpa.

english_verse: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa ɛɛ kpɛɛree, ásɛ bwɛjena a nɛra nyu bini aa kpeɡa duuri.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: He lɛ nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra ba suna dii tɔpere ta. He dɛ tɔ ba nɛɛ dɛɛ le peukpeɡ ta, wee nyɛɡre aa, he laɡ ba dɛɛ tɛɛ ba chunchule. Nyubinikpeɡ tena do kɛŋɔ, peukpeɡ aa taa dɛ kpɔ nee dɛɛ lɔ danjwɛɛ dɛɛ kuu la,

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: dɛ berɛ do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta wee waa do nyɛɡre ken. He sɔɔh ɡbɔɡa ya dɔma nyubinikpeɡ tena baa le harɛre ta aa dɛ do la nyoa, ɡɛ bam yon tɔ wee ta dɛ sɔɔh o nyoa la.

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ yerɛ harɛre nɛra bwaa ŋɔ, bá ba di kondikonjena, dɛ́ nyɔ sendɛɛɡa dɛ́ lɛ ba sie, Saayɔn Bwejen ta Jerusalam.

english_verse: Here the Lord will strip away the burial clothes that cover the nations.
translation_verse: Gɛ bwejen nɔ taa Korowii ɛɛ ba tebinichɔɡ aa lɔ harɛre nɛra bwa nɛɛ la chɔɡa, dɛ́ laa a bwa kpɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Wɛɛ le seo nee waa wola lee do kpa bwa. Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ fee nomɛlbwa siniiree, dɛ́ laa sihiih o nɛra aa dia kpɔ harɛ nɔ bwa ta. Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
translation_verse: A ba ɡɛ naa, baa boloo ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laanee la. Korowii yaa hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ laanee la, o lɛ yaa. Hé ɡel ya hɛɡre ya sie lɛ, lɛɛ waa lɛ yaa la wa.”

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ Saayɔn Bwejen la taa, kɛ Moab tena te, baa tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa tiɡri kpɔɡa dɛɛ koo nabena ta la.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ chɔɡ Moab harɛ bwɛɛre danjwɛkpeɡa ne anjaŋa bwaa, dɛ́ kuuɡa a bwa a chɔ harɛ.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ Juda harɛ nɛra ɡo yel nɔ harɛ la ta. Ya dɔ bwɛjen danjwɛkpeɡ aa baro name, Korowii ɡbabirii cheɡɛ ya habɔɔ, dɛɛ nyiŋi danjwɛɛ waa baro ta.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Hé ya bwɛjen la doonyoone, ásɛ harɛ o nɛra wa aa toɡra, ba waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ Korowii bá jo.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa. Onee Bwetal waa dɛ tɔ ya nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: O dɛ ba banɔ la baa dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te ne harɛ. O dɛ kuuɡi bwɛjen waa kpeɡa baa soɡe o ta, ásɛ o kuuɡi chɔ harɛ.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba, ne nyaara ɛɛ valɛ o taa, dɛ́ tiɡru do harɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ŋwɛnɛ ɛɛ do wer, he kwaaro baa valɛ o ta.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Ya sie dawɛ he nɛɛ yaa teŋɛ he Mmarare ta, he ɡbosoo ya bambile lawɛ.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: N sie dɛ che chiŋ jwaana he wa, chɔɔbɔr ɡe, n pɛla dɛ lawɛ. He baa bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛ pa bole aa, aa ɡeloo ba hweli waa aa toɡra.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ he ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, kɛ baa waa aa toɡra hweli. Hale harɛ o nɛra wa aa toɡra ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, ba sie aa he kan haa doa tɔɡɛ.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he dɔma aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ ba ba deŋne tɛra. Gel ba na ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin he nɛra, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba. Kpɔ deŋnetɛra haa maɡla bil ba la chɔɡ ba.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he dɛ tɛ yaa deŋnesɔɔhna, komɛlbwa yaa dɔa la, henee ɛa tɛ yaa.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, nɛra banee fa dɛ nyiŋi ya nɛ, kɛ he ɡboo ya kpɔ jirima dɛɛ tɛ.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Taraken, ɡɛ nɛra la serewɔ, ba toole kpa, ba lala aa ir kpa. He tɛr ba deŋne dɛ chɔɡ ba, nomɛlbwa aa ba waa lii kpa bwa.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ ya harɛ do kan. He tuuh o jwɛhre kaa sie o do kan. He ɛ ɡɛ dɛ dɔ jirima nɛra be.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he tɛr he nɛra deŋne baa na wahala, asɛ ba ba he be ba soŋe.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ ya bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ yaa wi, kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ ken.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Weweele yaa nao la ta wobɛlbwa ne balɛ, ya ta wone pɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra nɛ, ya ta wone yo lɛ harɛ la.

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: Kɛ he nɛra baa serewa la ɛɛ iruu, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ bwadabii ja. He banɔ la haa lɔ lalbɔɔne bini, hé ir, dɛ́ ɡo silɛɛ yela! Gɛ mɛn yon ta kwaa ta aa do wer chɔɔbɔr la, ɡɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba banɔ la baa serewa la mkpa tɛɛ.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Anomanta, n nɛra, hé ka jo he deene, dɛ́ laa ɡbeni tɔ he nɛ. Hé kpɔ he te sɔh tama ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii baah aa sɔɔhna.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Hé no! Korowii le o dobɔr nyundua dɛɛ ba, dɛ́ ba tɛr nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta deŋne ba wechɔɡa wa. Harɛ ɛɛ le nɛra baa sɔah kpoo nɛra laanee tɛ, waa ban kpɔ sɔh kpa.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ o kerejen waa nyɛɡa laanee tɛr oljen waa dɛ tuuɡi harɛ, dɛ ɛ harɛkon, dɛ ɡoɡli dɛɛ kaa sɔrr la deŋne. Onee mpo bini oljen Lɛvayatan la.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ bol o daa koo bɛl waa wera waa ŋɔ,

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: “Men Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi o ta, menee dɛɛ do nee o ta tɔpere bɛlbwa, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa mɛɛ daahno, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ on ba chɔɡ.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: N baah ta daa koo nɔ waa cheɡa tɛ n nɛra la nɛɛ dii, kɛ dɛ jabalnadaŋɛre ne sɔɔhne aa cheɡa tɛ ba dɔma, leɔ dɛ tɔ ba nɛɛ tenaa, mɛɛ jo ba binii dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ n nɛra dɔma dɛ nyin kɛ n kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛ aa, n ne ba baah ɛɛ do werii.”

english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao Jekɔb naanar baa ɛ Israel tena la dɔ lune dɛ́ le kɛŋɔ daa ken, dɛ́ moɡɛ dɛ́ fe, ásɛ dɛ nɔnɛ perɛ harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Korowii ta Israel tena deŋne tɛrɛ kohona, dɛ kpoo ba kɛŋɔ waa kpoo ba dɔma la.

english_verse: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
translation_verse: Laalee o kpɔ tɛr Israel tena deŋne, dɛ doŋ ba le ba harɛ ta kpeɡri ne kaa harɛfale ta, kɛŋɔ peuchɔɡe aa taa le wee leebɔr, dɛ kpɔ kwaa dɛɛ kaa la.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ Israel tena wechɔɡaa kɛ ba aa, atane baa kuuɡi kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare la buruburu kɛŋɔ fula ken, dɛ́ teŋni ba voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa, ne bwea baa paaɡa dɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛo a ta la bwa ta.

english_verse: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro la paɡrɔ, Nomɛlbwa toole o ta, o chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛ berɛ nae dibɔr. Belaa a chɔ dɛɛ onɛ, dɛ́ pɛɡre daa kpala bwa ta.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Dɛ a holaa, a kuuɡo dɛɛ lee, ásɛ haahna yon ba paa kaa mar. Israel tena aa waa mun no. Anomanta, Korowii tea aa ba nɛɛ domɛ. Onee ta ba, kɛ waa ba sum na.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
