translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ boa o nɛra nyoa le Yufretis Moo, dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta, dɛ lɔɔ ba kɛŋɔ mea ken, dɛ́ tɔɔ Israel tena beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa pɛ.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Awola bɛla ɛɛ siu kohona, dɛ́ yerɛ Israel tena baa laɡ ba laa ta, ba kaa Asiiria ne Ijipt harɛ ta ka so biɡri la, ásɛ ba bwa berɛ ba tomɛ Korowii Jerusalam, Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Israel harɛ bwɛɛlɛ! O jirima dɛ dime kɛŋɔ kwaa fee aa lɔ sitɔɔla baa ɛ sennyɔɔra kooɡbɛrɛre ta dɛɛ lee la. Ba nyuune baa ɡɔɔra dɛɛ valɛ sɔɔh konsɔɔhsoma, kɛ ba dɛɛrɔ chɔ.

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Hé na, Korowii dɔ nomɛl waa dɔ jirima o bwara ɡe do kpeɡri. O bala bini do kɛŋɔ dombwea aa dɛ lee la, kɛɛ dompeu chɔɡe waa taa dɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa la. Wɛɛ taɡɛ bwɛɛ laanee ɡo harɛ, kɛŋɔ bwaala yon nɛ kohona, dɛ́ chɔɡ kwaa dɛ́ pala kaa la.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Israel sitɔɔla, baa ɛ sennyɔɔra kooɡbɛrɛre baa kpɔa dɛɛ maŋkura ba te la, baa tiɡraa do harɛ.

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: Ba sitɔɔla la jirima dɛ ba dima, kɛŋɔ fiɡ daa nɔnloɡle bɛl aa tɔ sie swɛɛ, asɛ nɛn kpɔ di warane la.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛ́ ɛ kooɡbɛrɛ waa wera dɛ dɔ jirima kohona tɛ o nɛra baa kaa la.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Dɛ́ berɛ tɛ nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la liire, baa bola kasinteŋ ne, a berɛ che o nɛɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la doonyoo, dɛ lɛɛ ba dɛɛ ta laa ta la dɔ bokpeɡa.

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Chwɛɛra ɡboo ba teeburre bwa, a bobɛlbwa sese ta kae dɛ do wer.

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: O webaɡla ta mun dɔe. O bol waa la sie, dɛ o bolɔ ba habɔɔ.”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: A wer ɡa, haa a mun no tenaa, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he no o waa wobofala ta. Nɛŋhɔɔhraa wɛɛ ba ɡela ba bol baɡle heya.

english_verse: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ona bɔree la, nomɛlbwa waa koah la, ó ba onɛ,” dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Deŋnesɔɔhna bɔree” kɛ baa no.

english_verse: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped. False Security Is Fatal
translation_verse: Baa wobɛlbwa Korowii aa dɛ bol ba be mun no. Ba bol waa la sie, dɛ ba bolɔ ba habɔɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa, asɛ ba le habɔɔ dɛ ka choɡli, dɛ foɡri, dɛ jo bel ta ba laɡ ba.

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he sitɔɔla haa dɛ nyiŋi Jerusalam tena nɛɛ he siwi aa wola nɛn tɔɡɛ, hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol.

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: He dɛ ta nyoa ŋɔ, “Ya ne seo fɔwɛ fɔo, ya ne lalabwɛɛ nyoa pɛ. Dɛ harɛchɔɡ peu dɛ ba naa, waa yaa dɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya kpɔ ya te do nyosone ne neɡra ta, kɛŋɔ aa tɔ ya nɛ dɛ́ lɛ yaa.”

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Waa Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bolee nɔ. “Na, n pɛne Bwedɛɛɡe o wa aa hiah, dɛ kpɔ pa n Dea mun Saayɔn, o lawɔ kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build.” Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋii mɛɛ ba kpɔe berɛ ŋwɛn ba kpɔ dɛɛ maɡɛ kon, dɛ́ kpɔ waa aa toɡra berɛ kon demamaala aa kpɔa dɛɛ toɡre dea. Dompeu ne nee dɛɛ ba a palɛ nyosone haa kpɔa tɔ he te la kaa.

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: Fɔo he ne seo aa fɔwa la ɛɛ chɔɡoo, nyopɛo he ne lalabwɛ aa dɔa la ɡe aa lee do kpa. Dɛ harɛchɔɡ peu baa ta aa, wɛɛ dɔ heyaa, dɛ́ lɔ heyaa bil harɛ.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa wɛɛ ba tae, saŋ te bɛlbwa waa ta la, wɛɛ kaa he nee.” Dɛ he no waa nɔ mun aa, ɔmee ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa kohonaa taeh.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ iruu, dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ o fa aa ɛa Pɛrasem Bwejen ta la, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ tenten Gebeɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta, ásɛ dɛ ɛ o toma aa ɛ wefala yaa wola a dɔŋa nae bwa, dɛ́ ɛ nyokpowa.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: He bɛ jae maa dɛ ja heyaa nɔ mamɛ, ásɛ he wahala haa dɛ́ ba nae la bɛ he nɛɛ ba ɡwaa kohona. Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro bol n be, maɡla waa maɡla bil kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ harɛ bwaa la.

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n be! Hé no waa maa dɛ bol nɔ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Farmers don't just plow and break up the ground.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa laa paa teŋɛ dɛɛ parɛ, kɛɛ dɛɛ buɡli koo.

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: Waa kwaa harɛ la tonɛ la, wɛɛ merɛ anɔ la waa merɛɛ, dɛ́ du anɔ la ɡe waa du a bwa ne a bɔra.

english_verse: They learn this from their God.
translation_verse: O jemɛ o toma. Korowiirii baɡlo anɔ la aa wera.

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: Waa kontɔɡ kpɔe dɛɛ lɔ konjeɡre kɛŋɔ jule. Daa waa maɡraa o kpɔ dɛɛ lɔa, ásɛ a bɛ peɡri.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Namaa wɛɛ namɛ mea, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ paanoo. Lɔe laa wɛɛ lɔa. Saŋ bɛlbwa laa o teŋɛ dɛɛ lɔ mea. Lɔe wɛɛ lɔa, ásɛ a bie le. Nama laa wɛɛ nama.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Gɛ liire nɔ bwa, Koranar Bwa Kooro bee a le. Baɡla waa baɡle nɛra waa dɔ nyokpoa, o wejema ta jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena hé bwɛɛlɛ! He bwɛjen Kooro Devid aa soɡe o ta la ɛɛ chɔɡoo. Bena bɛlbwaa he teŋɛ dɛɛ di he tɔpejena,

english_verse: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
translation_verse: kɛ Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo he Jerusalam tena bwara nyɛɡ heya, ásɛ hɛɛ wi dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre. He bwɛjen la bwa ɛɛ ɛ chalee, kɛŋɔ kon baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta.

english_verse: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ lɔ heyaa bil harɛ, he chɔ dɛɛ bol wa, he taa ɛɛ le tama tama ken. He wobol ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ lale wobol dɛɛ le harɛ bini, aa baŋee le kohona.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ba lɛ heyaa bwaala kɔɡra nee, harɛ jiɡri, ɡbɔɡa tɔ kohona, peukpeɡ ta, bwaalachɔɡe nɛ, nii chɔɡ kwa.

english_verse: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra baa wara, dɛ pu Jerusalam dɛɛ yo, dɛ ka kuuɡi o dekpeɡa, dɛ baro dɛ tɔ o nɛra do la, ba bwa waa ɛɛ kaaloo kɛŋɔ, haa na waane dɛ deera jwaana ken.

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena nyoa ta kpoe yaa? He bwara ta yɔraa? He mwaalo ne, a ɡel he nyoŋe, he ta sen nyɔe kɛ dɛ ɡe dɛɛ, he dɛ yɛɛɡe, kɛ he ta seŋkpeɡa nyɔe.

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ dom ta he nɛ, hɛɛ ba dom chɔe ka ɡarɛ, dɛ tɔɔɡe keamere la sibie, dɛ wili nɛra baa dɛ na waa bini la.

english_verse: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
translation_verse: Kɛɛ dɛ he kpɔ tɔn la la nɛn waa wola jemɛ kure be ŋɔ, “N poori, kure tɛ mɛ” naa, o ŋɔ, “Maa jemɛ kure.”

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ te, nyoa ɡbo nee baa baɡle kɛŋɔ n ne ba pɛo, nyoa ɡbo nee baa duu mɛ, kɛ ba tea bini te ta toe. Toma baa dɛ tom mɛ la, nɛwɛnyini mmarare taa baa baɡle ŋɔ nɛ́ra teŋɛ.

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ ba nyokpowaa nee ba ta ba nɛɛ ja, ba bwara yɔr. Aa ɡeloo wejerema ɡɛn, ásɛ nɛra baa jemɛ waa bini waa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.”

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa swɛɛ siwi kpɔ ba waa dɛɛ sɔh Korowii la, ba bwɛɛlɛ! Ba dɛ ɛ ba waa biro ta dɛɛ lii ŋɔ, “Umee na mɛ nɔ? Umee dɛɛ ba jema ɔ?”

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: He berɛ waa sie pi, kɛŋɔ mamaa aa berɛ choh. Kon baa mao la ɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ nɛn waa mao la be ŋɔ, “He laa ma mɛ,” kɛɛ vii ɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ mamaa be ŋɔ, “Haa wobɛlbwa jemɛ” aa?

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: A ka tamaa Lɛbanɔn kɔr berɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe, ásɛ o ta kwaa do kɛŋɔ kɔr bini kwaa ken.

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ la, amumure ɛɛ noo kɛŋɔ baa dɛ kure tɔn, ásɛ nyoŋa baa soɡe biro ta la won dɛɛ na.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɛŋɡwɛɡra sie ɛɛ berɔɔ lɛ Korowii waa ta ja, nyaara hɛɡre Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la wa.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Nyubinikpeɡ tena aa lee do kpa, bammuɡli tena aa lee do kpa, nɛra ba sie aa swɛɛ wechɔɡa ta bwa, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ baa.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii waa lɛ Abraham bol waa nɔ dɛɛ baɡle Israel tena ŋɔ, “Sihiih aa heyaa kpo kpa bwa, haa he dɔma ɔma waa koh ɡwaŋɛ kpa.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba baa na ba bii ba bini, ɡɛ maa ɡela ba warɛ la aa, baa duu mɛɛ, dɛ́ sɛh kɛŋɔ menee Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la, dɛ́ ɔmɛ men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la kohona.

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ɡɛna ɛɛ hweli waa dɛ́ no a mun, banɔ la baa dɛ naɡre waa la ɡe sɛh baa baɡ ba wa.”

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Deŋnekpeɡ tena baa dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta la, ba bwɛɛlɛ! Ba dɛ teŋɛ ba ɡbaɡba liire aa wola n be leɛ ta, dɛɛ fɔwɛ nyopɛo fɔo n Doma aa wola ba nɛɛ jae, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ ja wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Ba ta men bɔɔrɛ no dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ la Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ka marɛ Ijipt kooro ó tɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ lee ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ Juda tena toroma lɔ Ijipt bwɛjena Soan ne Hanes,

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa bera kpɔ baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta, a ɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa waa Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa nɔ. “Juda tena toroma la vɔrɔwe ba laala dawɛ keeɡore ta, dɛ vɔrɔwe ba kondɔɔh dawɛ nyoɡmare ta, dɛ kpɔ wekpeɡa ne siswɛm harɛ, nyujentena ne domkpule ne harɛkwaare aa dɛ jah aa lole, dɛɛ kaa harɛ la tɔnɔ bɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta la ta.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Chae bɛlbwa toole Ijipt harɛ ta, a ɛ wepuu. A waa mɛɛ yerɔ Harɛkpeɡ Waa Wola Kpeɡri Dɔe.”

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Ba ɛ nɛra baa dɛ lɛ ɡaeh ne nyosonteŋna. Ba ɛ nɛra baa vɛh Korowii waa noe.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ Korowii keamere baa dɛ na waa chaahna ta be ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ chaahna waa bol ya be kpa. He bɛ kasinteŋ waa aa chɛ kɛ ya ɛ dɛɛ bol kpa. Hɛ́ɛ bol waa aa dɛ lɛ sie, dɛ ɛ wesoma ya be.

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛ la. He bɛ Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la waa bol ya be kpa.’ ”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la ŋɔ, “Haa vɛh waa nɔ, dɛ kpɔ he ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ di kpeɡri nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ neɡ ba nomanta,

english_verse: This sin is like a crack that makes a high wall quickly crumble
translation_verse: he wechɔɡa ɛɛ ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ waa pera dɛɛ ba chola, asɛ dɛ piɡri chole buɡ ta la.

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Wɛɛ paɡroo kɛŋɔ vimamaa vii yon paɡre, dɛ́ peɡri burbur la ken, o kaŋli aa wola kanee do kɛ ba kpɔ buh nii, kɛɛ ba kpɔ ɛ nee la.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Waa Nemenɛ Korowii, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ aa bol nɛra la bee nɔ. “Hé berɛ ba n be, dɛ́ kpɔ he hwɛɡa dawɛ n nɛ, ásɛ n lɛ heya, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ. Kɛ he vɛoh, he ta balɛ.

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: He nɛra kaɡboŋ ɛɛ na he dɔm beŋkpoŋii dɛ ɔmɔ dɛ́ chwa, he dɔma banue ɛɛ ɡeloo he bwa chwa, a ka he laa fraŋkaa ɡbo pa deŋɡare ta.”

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: Ane a bwa, Korowii tea dɛ domɔ he waa wɛɛ kpa kɛ he ba o be. O na he sum, dɛkalkɛ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ. Banɔ la bwa baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛɛ la, ba na som.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: Saayɔn tena, nɛra haa soɡe Jerusalam, haa wi kpa. Korowii dɛ na he sum. He wio noo waa, buɡ la ta, wɛɛ no he bee.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo wekpeɡa ne hɔhɔrɔwa ba he nɛ, kɛ waa o webaɡlaa kpɔ sɔh heya. Wɛɛ kpɔ o tenee baɡle heyaa hé nao.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: He kono kpɔ diɡ oo, ɡal oo, hɛɛ no taa bɛl he habɔɔ, o ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛ laanee la, hé kpɔ o ta.”

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Haa he voɡa haa kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara, laanee kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa kpa, dɛ́ kpɔa ka ta kɛŋɔ yakwara aa wola were ken, dɛ́ ŋɔ a be ŋɔ, “Hé le ya sie.”

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ nɛ bwaalaa do kwaa haa dua ta, ásɛ a do wer dɛ́ ɛ kɛrɛdɛ. He kondɛɛra ɛɛ dɔ bɔr waa kanaa dɛɛ di.

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: Nae ne keeɡore haa kpɔa dɛɛ parɛ he kooni la, ɛɛ di mea baa pala kɛrɛdɛ pɛɡaa.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Awola Korowii aa ba kpoo he dɔma kohona dɛ́ kuuɡi ba dejaŋa ta la, nee ɛɛ palɔɔ le bwejaŋa ne deŋɡarere aa kaa nyundua bwa ta.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Korobie ɛɛ lɔɔ dɛ chaah bɔr kɛŋɔ wee ken, ásɛ wee chaah bɔr kohona kɛŋɔ baa lɔ tɔpera anuanɛ wee bɔr chaahna pɛ ken. A ɡɛ saŋ Korowii ɛɛ vɔrɔwe bola waa do o nɛra laanee, dɛ́ chaah ba.

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Hé no! Korowii sɔn ɔma, o le bojaŋ dɛɛ ba. O baah diu kɛŋɔ nii aa dɛ hɔ ken, chuu ɛɛ le kohona. Bandia ɡboo o wobol bwa, aa fuh o dɔmaa kɛŋɔ nii aa dɛ fuh kwaa ken.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: O hweera do kɛŋɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ dɛ su tel baŋa ta la. O dɛ ɡboo harɛre nɛra kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɡboo kwaa la ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba. Gɛ baa kpɔ kabaɡrare do jaaɡɔ nyoa dɛɛ beɡro la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba harɛre nɛra beɡra le waa baa maɡla bil la ta.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra sie ɛɛ lɛo baa ɡo yela kɛŋɔ, baa dɛ di tɔpejena dɛɛ ɡo yela jwaana la. He baah ɛɛ sɔɔh heyaa kɛŋɔ nɛra aa hoh kalipere dɛɛ kaa Korowii Dea. Korowiirii do kɛ Israel tena Bwetal waa dɛ lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra no o taa, dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ waa do kan, dɛ́ ɡel ba na o bandia waa dɛ́ ba o ne, dɛ́ ba tɛr ba deŋne. Bandichɔɡe ne nii aa dɛ chɔɡ kwa, ne bwaalachɔɡe ne peu, ne bwaala kɔɡra dɛ dombwea nee wɛɛ ba bala.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Korowii taa la ɛɛ ɡeloo Asiiria tena bwara hɛlɛ, wɛɛ kpɔ o koodaŋɡbalaa lɔ ba bil.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Korowii aa ir o daŋɡbala dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ tɛr ba deŋne la, lɔe bɛlbwa waa lɔ ba la, dɛ Israel tena ɡe dɛ yiiɡi kwaa kɛŋɔ loŋa ken, dɛɛ lɔ janjela dɛɛ ɡo yela. Korowii ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ ba ba yoi.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Korowii kwaa bobɛl cheɡ tɛ Asiiria koojen saŋ bɛl biɡri, dɛ́ fuuh. O ɛ nimar bɔr o do luŋri dɛ do paɡri, ba pa damara bil a daŋɛ chɔ. Korowii hweera ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ nii ne jebɔrɔwe ken, dɛ́ ba jo daa la ta a fuh.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa la Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ́ kaa nyin kɛŋɔ ba cha ba la, bá bwɛɛlɛ! Ba kpɔ hwɛɡa do torɔɡore aa wara, baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre dɛɛ che a bini, ne bokpeɡa tena baa so jaɡre ta nɛ, dɛ laa sie kpɔ Korowii Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la nɛ. Baa o bɔr nyin ó cha ba.

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Kɛ onee wejereme, onee dɛ́ won ba bɔr chɔɡa ne. Waa nentane tae dɛɛ ta harɛ, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ kpɛla. Wɛɛ iruu che wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, ne banɔ la baa dɛ cha wechɔɡa la nɛ.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Nɛraa Ijipt tena, Korowii laa ban, asɛ ba jaɡre ɡe ɛ ola, a ta kwaa aa bea yaa wola an na ɛɛ. Dɛ Korowii baa ir o nɔn dɛ́ tɛr nɛra deŋne aa, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ cha nɛra ɛɛ keeruu, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ cha ba la ɡe choɡli, ásɛ ba nɛmbele banɛ la bwa pɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa bol men Aesaya be laanee nɔ. “Gɛ nyujente onjen yon lawɛ ol dɛ́ kpoo dɛɛ ŋoo, ásɛ ba yerɛ peteɡra warɛ ŋɔ, bá doŋu, waa wola aahra baa dɛ aahro la ɔmɛ, waa wola ba ɡbɔɡa chaŋe la, ɡɛ tentenee men Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ba bala bá ɛ Saayɔn Bwejen ta, dɛ́ ba yo Jerusalam dɔma nomɛlbwa aa wola won kah mɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Gɛ jumbii yon ɡah dɛɛ bar a bii nɛɛ a kɔne ta dɛɛ tɔa ɡbemɡbe la, ɡɛɛ men Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ba Jerusalam tena daahna. Mɛɛ daah baa, mɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ dɛ́ yo lɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Israel tena, he berɛ ba men he siwi aa sa mɛ, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ la be.

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, he bɛlbwa ɛɛ vɛh voɡa haa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ɛa, dɛ che a ta ɛ wechɔɡa laanee.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: Asiiria tena ɛɛ serewoo dɛ ba ne nɛra laa yoa, kere waa wola nɛn kon ɛɛ dɛɛ ba ba kpoora. Baa chwa laa taa, ásɛ ba lawɛ ba bini bonɔɔna yoma.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ba koojen ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ dɛ́ chwa, ásɛ ba nomonome baa chɔ laa nyoa la kpɔ ɔmee dɛ́ chwa ɡel ba laa fraŋkaa.” Korowiirii bola. O nii waa kpɔa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa la lɔ Jerusalam Saayɔn Bwejen ta.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Banla baa dɛ na aa ba sie laa kpɔ kpa, baa cheɡ deŋne ɡee dɛɛ no.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Banla ba liire aa wola bobeŋkpoŋ cheɡɛ la ɛɛ no waa munii, ásɛ banɔ la baa dɛ mɛnɛme won waa bola kɛrɛdɛ a bini chɔ.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ nɛn waa ɛ ɡɛne la baa on jirima tee yerɛ, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ neɡre nɛra la, bá yerɔ kasinteŋ te.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛne te dɛ bol ɡɛnewa, dɛɛ lii wechɔɡa dɛ́ ɛ. Waa waa dɛ ɛ ne anɔ la waa dɛ bol bwa ɛ Korowii bwara wechɔɡe. O dɛ vɔmɛ nɛn lɔr aa dɛ kpoo kondikwa, dɛɛ vɔmɛ nɛn nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpoo ne.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ neɡre nɛra ɛ nɛnchɔɡe, wechɔɡa liiree wɛɛ lii, dɛ che neɡra ta dɛɛ chɔɡ nyaara ba wa aa suma, dɛɛ tɔ ba kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɔ jirima te, o dɛ maɡle waa aa dɔ jirima dɛ́ ɛ, ásɛ a che a ta wɛɛ do kɛrɛdɛ. Jerusalam haahna wa

english_verse: Listen to what I say, you women who are carefree and careless!
translation_verse: Haahna haa lɔ bosɔɔhna ta, hé no n be! Bitoli haa soɡa kɛrɛdɛ, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n wa!

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Benanyoa ne tɔpere tamaa bɛl habɔɔ la, he banɔ la haa soɡe bosɔɔhna ta la bwara ɛɛ sao, dɛkalkɛ daa nɔna toole hé chaa kpa.

english_verse: Shake and shudder, you women without a care! Strip off your clothes— put on sackcloth.
translation_verse: Haahna haa lɔ bosɔɔhna ta la bwara ɛɛ sao he ɔmɛ. Hé wur he laala ta, dɛ́ kpɔ lweyale mile chara.

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ nɔɔra lɔ bambili á baɡle kɛ he tea bini chɔɡɔ, he harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la wa, ne daa nɔna aa chɔɡa la wa.

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: Sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛre ɡboo n nɛra harɛre. He wi deremi silɛɛ fa aa lɔ a ta la, ne bwɛjen o fa aa soma la wa.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Koodem ne bwɛjen nɛra fa aa su a ta la ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ. Deremi ne dekpeɡa aa tɔ ba nɛɛ la bwa ɛɛ choɡluu, dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini keeɡore ne peera, kpɔ bela ɛ a dibɔr.

english_verse: Honesty and justice will prosper there,
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡraa dɛɛ ba harɛ la ta bwa doe.

english_verse: You, the Lord's people, will live in peace, calm and secure,
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra ɛɛ so deŋnesɔɔhna taa, wobɛlbwa aa wola ba nɛɛ ba ba deremi, ásɛ ba so kɛrɛdɛ ken.

english_verse: even if hailstones flatten forests and cities.
translation_verse: Hale dombwea lee kɔr la ta, bwɛjen la chɔɡ kwaraa naa,

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: hɛɛ na somee, hɛɛ parɛ neerare nyoo, he kondɛɛra dɔ kpɔɡdɛɛɡa dɛɛ di.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Hé bwɛɛlɛ, nɛra haa dɛ chɔɡ nɛra, nɛra aa wola he te chɔɡ. Hé le nɛra dɛɛ tɛ, nɛra aa wola he te leɛ dɛɛ tɛ. Hé ɡel nɛra chɔɡaa, nɛra ɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa, he ɡel nɛra lee dɛ tɛ aa, nɛra ɛɛ le heyaa tɛ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na ya sum, he bee ya hwɛɡa bwa do. Nyiŋi ya nɛɛ he kpeɡri ne tɔpere bɛlbwa. Lɛ yaa dɛɛ le wenaale ta.

english_verse: Nations scatter when you roar and show your greatness.
translation_verse: He kɔr harɛre nɛra laa ta naa, ba dɛ chwa, he iro che ɡe aa, nɛra dɛ peɡre.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Gɛ tontombɛ aa dɛ di koo kwaa bwa la, ɡɛɛ baa ba ba laala pae laa ta a tonɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Korowii kan taeh, o soɡe nyundua tenten. Wɛɛ ɡeloo kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡra su Jerusalam.

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ dea mumpar waa kpeɡa dɛ tɛ heyaa he saŋ, dɛ́ lɛ heya dɛ́ tɛ heya wejema ne waa mun noe kohona saŋ bɛlbwa. O ɔma taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ dɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Na, ba kpeɡnɛra dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre kohona fɔɡbaahna dɛɛ nyin lɛɛra. Nɛra baa tom ba ŋɔ bá ba larawe la ɡe dɛ wi kohona.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Ba ŋwɛnɛjena bwa chɔ pɛɛ, nɛra aa a ta kpɔ kpa. Ba chɔɡ fɔo la, dɛ to ntama. Nomɛlbwa toole baa duuru.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Harɛ la chɔɡɔ, o chɔɔ pɛɛ. Sihiih kpo Lɛbanɔn kɔne, a daa serewe. Sarɔn fɛlembɔdɛɛɡe berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, Basan harɛ ne Kaamɛl Bwejen ta, daa papooni dɛ chure.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ harɛre nɛra be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ iruu name. Mɛɛ baɡle n kpeɡri aa ɡwaa komɛlbwaa.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Hé kpoŋe n nɛra tea, kɛ aa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, he ɡbaɡba hweera ɛɛ berɛ niinii dɛ́ kpoo heya.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ fuuh kɛŋɔ baa fuh kwaa dɛɛ ɛ tɛɡ, kɛɛ baa pa sɔɔhne do nii ta a fuh la.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa lɔ bojaŋa, hé no waa maa ɛa! He banɔ haa bɛna ɡe, hé sɛh kɛŋɔ n dɔ kpeɡri.”

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam dɛ ɔmɛ, nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la bwara dɛ sa. Ba ŋɔ, “Ya bini umee dɛ won so nii aa dɛ hɔ aa wola dime, dɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa nɔ jwɛh ɔ?”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ, baa wola ba kpeɡri ta cheɡɛ hamɛ nɛra dɛɛ dɔ kwa. Nɛra ba sie aa wola lɛ kɛ ba yaɡ ba sen, dɛ laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ nɛŋkpoa waa ta, dɛɛ lawɛ ba te kɛŋɔ baa wechɔɡaa ɛ la.

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: Banee dɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne soɡa, kɛŋɔ baa soɡe dekpeɡ bini. Baa dɔ kondikwaa dɛɛ di, nee ɡe aa ban paŋɛ bwa.

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ na kooro ne o wer ne kan waa doa, ne o harɛpaɡ waa chɔa dɛ kaa bojaŋ.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: He liire aa webena haa dɛ ɔma kohona la taa do kpa. Hɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Leperaa nɛn waa dɛ kure nɛra la dɔɔ? Naate waa dɛ lɛ toɔ la ɡe sɛ? Leperaa naate waa dɛ nyiŋi dejaŋa ta la ɡe dɔɔ?”

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Haa jenu tena laanee na kpa bwa, nɛra ba wobol aa kora haa wola a mun no la.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi Saayɔn, bwɛjen yaa dɛ di tɔpejena o ta la. Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ Jerusalam dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ne soɡa, kɛŋɔ tɛnte dea waa cheɡɛ o buɡ ta, saŋ bɛlbwa, o daa baa kpaara do harɛ dɛ kpɔ baŋro la aa fome kpa bwa, ɡɛɛ o ɡboɡbie ɡe aa wola chaa.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ do belaa dɛ́ ɛ ya Kpeɡnɛn. Wɛɛ ɡeloo yá so harɛdɛɛɡe nejena ne nenabɔɔne aa lɔ o ta. Ya dɔma aa ɡbeni a taa tawɛ, ba stiimaere aa a taa kpɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛ́ bol ya wa, onee do Mmarare dɛɛ tɛ yaa, dɛ́ ɛ ya kooro. Onee dɛ́ lɛ yaa.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Gboɡbie dɔma aa kpɔa baŋre ba ɡbeni yal la yɔɡɔ. A ta wone lawɛ dajaŋ yal la aa lɔ o ta la kɛrɛdɛ, Nɛra ɛɛ bɔne dɔma laaladamanta baa paa laa ta laanee, hale boobie kwaraa pa ane.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam wechɔɡaa kɛ ba. Hale bɛlbwa aa berɛ ŋɔ, “N bwara dɛ wee mɛ.”

english_verse: Everyone of every nation, the entire earth, and all its creatures, come here and listen!
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra, hé suuh tel dɛ́ no! Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no! Hé ɡel harɛ ne kwaa bwa aa lɔ o ta no n wa!

english_verse: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Korowii baah di harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ. O bwaawee iro kohona ba laa tena nɛ. O lee ba cheɡ dɛ́ kpoo ba kwaraa.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Baa ban huɡe, baa paa baa ta, ásɛ ba sɔɔh tɔ bɔr bwa koŋkoŋkoŋ ken, ba chale ɛɛ palɛ bwejena dor bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Wee ne korobie dɛ weweela bwa ɛɛ nyoɡroo, ásɛ Korowii doa ɡuɡri kɛŋɔ baa ɡuɡri kalaŋ la. Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa ɛɛ lee harɛɛ kɛŋɔ papohola aa le daa ta dɛɛ lee la.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Korowii kere baa tonɛ o toma nyundua aa, wɛɛ berɔɔ ba Edom tena nɛ. O pa ba bolchɔɡe cheɡ, dɛ́ kpoo ba.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: Chal ne noo ɡboo tɔ Korowii kere la bwa, kɛŋɔ baa kpo pebiiri ne boohna dɛ ler a kporombie ɛ saraha ken. Korowii dɔ saraha ɛɛ bwɛjen Bosra. Nɛra ɛɛ serewoo kɛrɛdɛ kere la nyoa, Edom harɛ ta.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kpoo nɛra baa dɔ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini nae, ne banɔ la baa do kɛŋɔ nabali bwaa, ásɛ harɛ la bwa sɔ chal ne no.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Korowii le tɔpere bɛl cheɡ, dɛ́ ba lɛ Jerusalam tena, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba dɔma bɔ kem.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Edom harɛ neerare ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ kootal ken, bela teera ɛ kɛŋɔ jebɔrɔwe, ásɛ harɛ la bwa fuh.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ dɛɛ fuuh webaŋa ne jwaana waa wola dime bwa, ásɛ o ninchuu ɡe teŋɛ tɛr dɛɛ kaa nyundua saŋ bɛlbwa. Harɛ la ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, nomɛlbwa aa wola belaa kpɔ kpa bwa.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Kwiu bwa soo siwi, ne ɡaahɡaahre lɛ bela dɔɔh. Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la berɛ dimɡbia waa wola maree dɔ.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Kooro aa lee do dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta, sitɔɔla ɡe aa lee do,

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: ásɛ sɔɔhne le kooderemi, apeah ɡe le bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, ne ba dekpeɡa ta. Wɛɛ berɛ kalampoŋare ne kwiure sobɔree.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Belaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ola ne ɡboli ɛɛ ba doe dɛɛ ɡɔle, dɛ́ do ɡbɔɡa dɛɛ yerɛ dɔŋa. Kpɔɡ bini ola aa dɛ valɛ jwaana ɡe ɛɛ ba belaa, dɛ́ baa onɛ.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Kwiure ɛɛ sɔh a kɔne belaa dɛɛ hwe, dɛ tee a bii do a kena lɔɡre dɛɛ nyiŋa. Kokosakire ɡe ɛɛ ba cheme belaa, bɛlbwa ne o chee.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi Korowii tɔn bini dɛ́ kure na. Kwaa nɔ bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ nyoɡre, bɛlbwa aa belaa do waa wola o cheerii dɔ. Korowiirii bola ŋɔ á ɛ ɡɛ, o Doma la ɛɛ ba a ne Edom harɛ taa.

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: Onee dɛ bɔne harɛ la tɛa, bɛlbwa dɔ o kon, dɛ́ do bela saŋ te bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Silɛɛ ɛɛ ba pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa, hɛɡra ba harɛ komɛlbwa aa wola o ta ɛ ta, ásɛ kwaa le o ta dɛ́ fe.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Aa feo kohona, silɛɛ ne moola ba bela kɛrɛdɛ. Aa do werii kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn bwejena, ásɛ harɛ la do wer ne para, kɛŋɔ Kaamɛl ne Sarɔn harɛre ken. Anɔɔ dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ we-ɛɛla aa wera, dɛ dɔ jirima kohona, o kpeɡri ɡe do kan.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Hé do banɔ la ba bwara aa yɔra la ɡbemba, bá won che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Hé ŋɔ banɔ la ba bambile aa chɔɡa la be ŋɔ, “Hé che kiŋkiŋ, he bɛ ɔmɛ. Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɛ ba, dɛ́ ba cha heya. Wɛɛ ba lɛ heyaa le he dɔma nɔn taa, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne kohona bɔ kem.”

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: O balaa, nyoŋa sie ɛɛ piluu bá na bɔr, ásɛ amumure ɡe no wa.

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: Ásɛ boobie ir che, dɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ kweɡli ken, amumure ɡe ɡo yela silɛɛ ne. Nee ɛɛ pili pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa, ásɛ nenabɔɔne chɔ harɛ waa hola ta dɛɛ palɛ.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Bela wee aa lɔa o hol la ɛɛ berɛ tamee, ásɛ bela nee fa aa wola toole pili ne. Bela kalampoŋare fa aa lole la ɛɛ berɛ kataŋaa, o berɛ moɡɛ kpɔɡa ne pul.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛjen ɛɛ chɔ belaa baa yerɔ “Ŋwɛnɛɡoroŋ Waa Dɛ Kaa Korowii be.” Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa o taa kpɔ, ó chɔ tɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ Korowii waa la ta, hale ɡɛna kwara aa o taa kpɔ.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Nyujentena aa belaa do, kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡe bɛlbwa aa ŋwɛnɛ la taa kpɔ. Nɛra Korowii aa lɛɛ ba la ɡbosoo dɛɛ ba o ta kpɔe.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Baa valɔɔ ɡo silɛɛ yela ka jo Jerusalam, hɛɡra aa wola nyoa dɔe ne. Ba sie ɛɛ lɛo ba bwara sɔɔh ba, suna dii ne tebinichɔɡ le ba bini kwaraa.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel Kooro Hɛsɛkea neɡre heyaa ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heyaa. Harɛ bɛl voɡ wono lɛ harɛ la nɛra le Asiiria koojen nɔn ta ka aa?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Ate, laa sitɔɔ la ir che dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ bol waa Hibru tena wobol ne ŋɔ, “Hé no Asiiria koojen waa maa ba a ne!

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Leperaa bwɛjena Hamat ne Aapad voɡa dɔɔ? Sefavaim tena voɡare sɛ? A wono lɛ Samaria tena aa?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Dɛ́ he bɛ ɡel Kooro Hɛsɛkea neɡre heya. Waa won lɛ heya!

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Baala batoro le Kooro Hɛsɛkea be Jerusalam, dɛ la Asiiria koojen torome la be. Banee, Hilkia bibaa Eliakim waa chɔ koodem nyoa, ne Sɛbna waa ɛ kooro karake, dɛ Asaf bibaa Joa waa dɛ nyiŋi kooro tɔne ta.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Laa sitɔɔ la ŋɔ ba be, bá la ka ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be kɛŋɔ Asiiria koojen la dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa taa he kpɔ he te dawɛ dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ ɔɔ?

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ nyoa wobol do kɛ wejema, ne kpeɡri ba kpɔ dɛɛ yo laa kɛɛ? Ume nɛɛ he kpɔ he te dawɛ, dɛ ɛɛ mɛ dɔm nɔɔ?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Na, dɛ Ijipt kooro nɛɛ he kpɔ he te dawɛ aa, a do kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ pul ɛ daŋɡbala, asɛ o ku dɛ tɔɡɛ he nɔn. Gɛɛ Ijipt kooro do tɛ nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea ta ɡelɛ he chɔɡ kwaa haa dɛ toma bwea dor dɛ ŋɔ Juda harɛ ta ne Jerusalam tena bwa be ŋɔ báa tomɛ kombeŋkpoŋ ta Jerusalam aa?

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you
translation_verse: N ne hɛɛ ŋwɛɛroo n naa Asiiria koojen sɔn ta. Mɛɛ tɛɛ jaɡre kaɡboŋa anɛɛ, dɛ hɛɛ won dɔ laa tena bá so a bwa ta naa.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Haa won kpɔ he te maɡɛ Asiiria koojen nomonome la bini bechala kwara, kɛ he dɛ hwɛɡɛ Ijipt kooro nɛɛ kɛ o ba tɛɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne laa tena baa dɛ so jaɡre ta.

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii habɔɔ n le dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo he harɛ nɛra nɔ kɛɛ? Korowii ɡbabirii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń ba dɛ́ ba chɔɡ harɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Eliakim ne Sɛbna dɛ Joa ŋɔ Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔ la be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya dɛ soŋe, bol Aram tena wobol baɡle he bonɔɔna. He bolaa, ya dɛ no. Bɛ Hibru tena wobol kpɔ bol ya be. Nɛra baa cheɡɛ bwɛjen nɔ danjwɛɛ nɔ ta dɛ no he be.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Anee laa sitɔɔ la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ne he kooro ɡbo bee n nomoa tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol waa nɔ kɛɛ? He ɡbo laa, nɛra baa sosoɡe bwɛjen nɔ danjwɛɛ nɔ ta ɡe jao, baa di ba ɡbaɡba benaa, dɛ́ nyɔ ba feene kɛ heya.”

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: He bɛ o nɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ́ ɡel hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ ŋɔ, wɛɛ lɛ heyaa, waa bwɛjen nɔɔ kpɔ do Asiiria koojen nɔn ta.

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: He bɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea waa no. Asiiria koojen dɛ bol ŋɔ, hé le bwɛjen la bini ba o be, dɛ́ kpɔ he te ba do o lɔɡa. Wɛɛ ɡeloo he bini bɛlbwa dɔ o fiɡ ne o ɡrepo daa kooni nɔna di, dɛ́ nyɔ o kɔlɔŋ bini ne,

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ maa kpɔ heyaa kaa bojaŋ harɛ waa do kɛŋɔ he kon nɔ ta. Harɛ daa kooni aa lole he dɔ sen le a ta, ne mea baa kpɔ ɛ paanoo, ne ɡrepo daa kooni.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Harɛre nɔ voɡ besoo wona lɛ o harɛ le n be nɔ? Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba wona lɛ Jerusalam ɔ?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Ate, Eliakim ne Sɛbna dɛ Joa kɛɛ ba laala, a baɡle kɛ ba loo kuu, dɛ la Kooro Hɛsɛkea be, dɛ ka bol waa Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔ la aa bola la o be.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa no waa la, o ɡe laa o yal waa tɔɔ la kɛɛ, dɛ ka kpɔ lweyal tɔ dɛ ka jo Korowii Dea.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Leperaa bwɛjena Hamat ne Aapad ne Sefavaim dɛ Hena kɛɛ Iva koranar dɔɔ?” Kooro Hɛsɛkea wesoŋa

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Waa waa kpɔa tɛ ŋɔ ba ka ŋɔ Aesaya be laanee kɛŋɔ, “Wahala ne deŋnetɛra ne sihiih tɔperee fini. Ya do kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ o ɡwɛɡre waa wola won lolɛ la ken.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen tomɛ o laa sitɔɔla nomoa, ó ba chɛɡre Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la. N dɛ soŋe Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ kɛ, ó tɛr a ɡɛ nɛra la deŋne a wa. Anomanta, soŋe Korowii tɛ ya nɛra ya taa kaa nɔ.”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea toroma la aa ba Aesaya be la,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ka ɡel he dɔɔ no kɛŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ Asiiria koojen waa la ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ maa won lɛ heya.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: No, mɛɛ ɡeloo koojen la no waane aa ɛ ɔmewa, ásɛ a ɡel o berɛ kaa o harɛ ta, ásɛ Korowii ɡel bá ka kpoo kere ne.’ ”

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Asiiria laa nomoa la noɔ kɛŋɔ, Asiiria koojen ne o laa tena le Lakes, dɛ kaa yo bwɛjen Lebna tena baa bɛn ba, asɛ o ir la koojen la be bela.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Belaa Asiiria koojen no kɛŋɔ, Ijipt Kooro Tirhaka waa le Itiopia ne o laa tena dɛ ba ba yoo. Anomanta, o chwerɛ tɔn, dɛ kpɔ tomɛ toroma Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: “Bɛ he Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛɛ la neɡre kɛŋɔ, Asiiria koojen la aa won yo lɛ Jerusalam.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ he no ɡɛ Asiiria koojen bɛlbwa aa ɛ harɛre nɔ bwa, dɛ chɔɡa kwaraa. He te ɛɛ won le a nyoa aa?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: N naawa yo harɛre nɛra bane baa le Gosan ne Haran ne Rɛsɛf, dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛre, dɛ kpoo Bɛt Eden tena baa soɡe Tɛl Asa, ba voɡare wono lɛɛ ba aa?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea lɛ tɔn la dɛ kure, dɛ kpɔ la Korowii Dea, dɛ ka laa paɡri bil Korowii sie.

english_verse: Then he prayed:
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ,

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “N Naa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, he so kena kwaa Kerobim doa. Korowii bɛlbwa toole ka ja he nɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛre bwa ta. Henee ta nyundua ne harɛ.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: A ɛ kpela, Korowii, kɛŋɔ Asiiria koojena yo harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra, dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛre a chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta ba la, wɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ o ta kaa waa wola won jo bwɛjen nɔ ta. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Sennacherib, you cursed, shouted and sneered at me, the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Koojen Senakerib, umee hɛɛ lii he nyu bini kɛ onee hɛɛ chɛɡre dɛɛ ɛo nɛnhɛla nɔɔ? Men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ laanee hɛɛ ɛ sisawaa la.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: He tomɛ he toroma ba ɛ mbarafo baɡ mɛ ŋɔ, he wono kpɔ torɔɡore teeh kaa bwejena aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn dor. He ŋɔ belaa he teŋni peleme daa aa jaŋa kohona, ne dadɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi, dɛ jo kaa kɔr la baah tenten.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: He ɛ mbarafo ŋɔ, he kwi buli harɛfala ta, dɛ nyɔ a bini nee bela. Dɛ ŋɔ he laa tena nakpale ɡbo ɡelɔ Ijipt Nael Moo hweeh.

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: He ta noɛ kɛ saŋ la bwaa n le vɔrɔwa bil kɛɛ? N tɛɛ kpeɡri he ɡel bwɛɛre danjwɛkpeɡa aa bara kuuɡi, dɛ berɛ dimɡbeeni.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ a nɛra bwa ɡwɛɡre, ba bwara yɔr ba di sihiih. Ba ɛo kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa lɔ koo ta, kɛɛ kpɔɡa aa lɔ lɔɡ doa, asɛ wee leebɔr peu chɔɡe yon ta a sewɛ la ken.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: N jemɛ he wobɛlbwa bini, he laŋa ne he bala bwa, ne he deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla haa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: N no he deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla, ne he mbarafo haa dɛ ɛ, a chole n deŋna ta. Mɛɛ kpɔ ɡoŋaa do he mee ta, dɛ́ kpɔ kabaɡrare do he nyoa, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔe kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta ba la ta kaa.’ ”

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Ate, Aesaya ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, “Waa aa che a ta, n naa Kooro Hɛsɛkea, he jemɛ laanee nɔ. Koo kwaa baa koma bena nɔ la, ane ɛɛ le a buɡ taa, ásɛ he dia, ásɛ benanyoa chemaa, hé di a tenten. A bentooro te la, hé du mea dɛ́ koma, dɛ́ parɛ daa kooni, dɛ́ di a nɔna.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ka, dɛ́ le Juda dea la ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ, daa waa ta lune kaa bini, dɛ won nɔna la ken.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Bane ɛɛ kao dɛ́ do Jerusalam Saayɔn Bwejen ta. Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ do siee, dɛ́ ɛ anɔ bwa.”

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen waa Korowii aa bola laanee nɔ. “Waa bwɛjen nɔ taa dɔ jo, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ta hɛm bonɔɔ. Waa konee kpɔ tɔ o te ɡbemɡbe dɛ́ ba o doonyoa, kɛɛ dɛ́ ma kon waa che o ta teeh jo o bini dɛ́ yo.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Aa ba ɡɛ la, Asiiria koojen Senakerib ɡel laa la yoi, dɛ ir ka so Asiiria bwɛjen Niniwe. Dɛ belaa ɛ koojen soŋnibɔr.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, o ka dɛ tu voɡa o voɡ Nesrɔk dea, asɛ o bibaala banɛ, Adramɛlɛk ne Saresa ka kpoo kere ne, dɛ chwa kaa Ararat harɛ ta. Asɛ o bibaa Esaahadon chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea berɛ o sie chaɡɛ danjwɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ,

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ, ásɛ ya lɔ janjela dɛɛ ɡo yela o Dea, ya soɡa bini bwa.”

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Aa ba dɛ la sie la, weela lɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea wɛɛ ba sewa. Asɛ Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya la o be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ɛ he dem ne he wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haa he weela nɔ taa ir, hɛɛ chɔ he banɔn taa!”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: N ŋɔ, “Maa Korowii na harɛ nɔ ta kpa, kɛɛ dɛ́ na nɛra ba soɡe harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: “N Naa Korowii, n poori, lii ɡɛ maa ta tea bwa tɛɛ, dɛ tomɛ kasinteŋ ne, dɛ ɛ waa haa dɛ nyin.” Dɛ wi lokua ne kohona.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Anee Korowii berɛ ŋɔ Aesaya be ŋɔ,

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: ó berɛ, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be kɛŋɔ, “Men Korowii he nabaa Devid fa aa tomɔ la, n no he wesoŋa, dɛ na siniire aa dɛ yɔɔre. Mɛɛ kpɔ bene fi dɛ anuee ja he mkpa ta.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Ń bol ameo? Korowiirii bol a waa n be, dɛ ɡbaɡba berɛ ɛa. Suna aa lɔ n bambile bini nomanta, maa won dom chɔ.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛ he ne bwɛjen Jerusalam tenaa, ásɛ Asiiria koojen bɛ won pɔ he nɛ. Mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ bwɛɛ nɔ ta.”

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: Aesaya ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ ɛ waanee á baɡle kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɛ waa waa baɡɛ nyoa laanee.

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo wee chunchule kaa mun ta, ásɛ chunchule ka dawɛ kon Kooro Ahas aa mao dɛ che o ta teeh dɛɛ jo dea la naɡale fi kon la ta.” Waa bol ɡɛ la, wee berɔ kaa mun ta, chunchule la ka dawɛ naɡale fi kon la ta.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Juda harɛ ta Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɡbaŋra habɔɔ la, o chwerɛ jam yel.

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: “N liiro kɛŋɔ n ta n saŋ tele, dɛɛ ba sewa. N cheɡɛ lalabwɛɛ doonyoa, dɛ n fe aa lii kɛŋɔ mɛɛ dɔ mkpaa.”

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Ba lɛ me mkpa le harɛ nɔ ta, kɛŋɔ baa boŋi tɛnte dea baa baŋro. Gɛ yasɔɔh yon sɔh yal tonɛ dɛ́ laa teŋe la, ɡɛɛ n ɡe ɛɛ ba teŋa sewɛ. N liiro ŋɔ Korowii fe lɛ me mkpa tonɛ.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Jwaana bwaa n kpɔ weweele bini dɛ wi, a do kɛ nyujente aa dɛ paɡre n hoɡa ken. N liiro ŋɔ Korowii fe lɛ me mkpa tonɛ.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: N wio n taa do jeɡaa kɛŋɔ kweah aa dɛ si ken. N ha sie nyiŋi nyundua dɛ ba koh. N Naa Korowii, ba lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale bwa maa dɛ na nɔ ta.

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, anɔ bwa taa nɛwɛnyina mkpa do, a taa n ɡe mkpa do. Gel n ɡbaŋre, ásɛ dɛ dɔ n nyu.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: N weweele ɛɛ ber mɛ deŋnesɔɔhnaa. He cheɡɛ he nyina ta, dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le wekpeɡa a fe aa dɛ ba n nɛɛ bala ta, dɛ kpɔ n wechɔɡa bwa kɛ mɛ.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ lalabwɛɛ aa won kpɛɛre, serewe aa won ɡo yel kpɛɛre. Nɛra baa lɔ lalabwɛɛ aa won hwɛɡɛ he waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la ta.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Weeraa dɛɛ kpɛɛre ɡɛ maa dɛ kpɛɛre fini nɔ. Eehnanar dɛ bol he kasinteŋ waa ba bii be.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Aesaya bol Kooro Hɛsɛkea be wubwa ŋɔ, bá ka toɡri fiɡ nɔna dɛ́ nama dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ marɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɔr la ta, ásɛ o ɡbaŋre.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa dɛ́ baɡle kɛ mɛɛ la Korowii Dea nyundua belaa yɔ?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea lɛ toroma la silɛɛ ne, asɛ dɛ kpɔ o kara mun kwaa aa lɔ dem, suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne konsɔɔhsoma ne nodɛɛɡa, dɛ o dɔmkwaa ne bela waa dɛ cheɡa bwa baɡ ba. Komɛlbwa toole dɛ do o dem kɛɛ harɛ la ta waa wola ban baɡlɛ.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Babelɔn harɛ ta kooro bɛl sɔne Mɛrɔdak Baladan, o mɛɛ sɔne Kooro Baladan. Kooro Mɛrɔdak Baladan aa no Kooro Hɛsɛkea weela waa la, o chwerɛ tɔne dɛ kpɔ koŋkɛɛla ja tomɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ka tɛo.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii keame Aesaya la ka bɔɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Leperaa ɡɛ nɛra nɔ leɔ? Dɛ́ ba amaneɛ ɔ?” Anee Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Ba le bojaŋ harɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Babelɔn ta.”

english_verse: “What did you show them?” I asked. Hezekiah answered, “I showed them everything in my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Aesaya pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa ba na he koodem ɔ?” Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Ba na komɛlbwa aa lɔ n koodem. Komɛlbwa toole n kara mun maa wola kpɔe baɡ ba.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Aesaya ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, “Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ,

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ komɛlbwa waa lɔ he koodem bonɔ ne anɔ la bwa he naanar aa nyina cheɡ ba le fini la bwa Babelɔn tena ba kpɔa kaa ba harɛ ta, komɛlbwa aa ka. Korowiirii ŋɔa.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Baa larawe he ɡbaɡba naanar la banee kaa, dɛ́ ka fɔɡɛ ba lure, bá do Babelɔn koodem dɛɛ tomɛ.”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛsɛkea chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waa haa ɡela n no le Korowii be nɔ wer.” Dɛkalkɛŋɔ, o liiro kɛ wɛɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhnaa o kora che kɛrɛdɛ o saŋ.

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Hé larawe n nɛra bwara.

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Hé bol bansɔɔh waa baɡle Jerusalam tena dɛ́ ŋɔ, ba weweele baa naa kohona teŋo, ba bɔ ba wechɔɡa kem tonɛ. Ba dɔ ba wechɔɡa bwa deŋnetɛra kohona, dɛ le men Korowii be.”

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Nomɛl dɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ŋɔ, “Nɛ́ra ɡel ba we-ɛɛla toɡre, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ kpa ba Dɔɔ bala.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Ásɛ Korowii ba baɡle o jirima nɛwɛnyina bwa na. Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: N no taa bɛl o ŋɔ, “Bol waa takpeɡ ne!” Asɛ n ŋɔ, “Ń ŋɔ ɛrɔɔ?” “Ŋɔ nɛwɛnyina bwa do kɛ kpɔɡa fee, ba jirima ɡe do kɛ kpɔɡa fee aa wola biɡri la ken.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ Korowii ta peu dɛɛ ta a ta, kpɔɡa dɛ sewɛ, a fee ɡe ɛɛ lee. Nɛwɛnyini do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa, kpela.

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Kpɔɡa dɛ sewɛ, a fee ɡe ɛɛ chure, kɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la te waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, he teeh kaa bwejena dor, dɛ́ ka bol amanesoma la! Hé bola takpeɡ ne, he bɛ ɔmɛ, hé ŋɔ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre nɛra be ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɛ ba.”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii dɛ ba kpeɡri ne, dɛ́ ba di kora. Hé na, o dɛ ba o kembɔr ne dɛ́ ba tɛ nɛra.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Wɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre yon dɛɛ nyiŋi o peera nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ a bii pɛl o bambile, ásɛ dɛ teɡɛ a nyare aa loɡla la kaa bɔeeh ken.

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won kpɔ o nɔŋkola maɡɛ moo, kɛɛ dɛ won kpɔ nɔn maɡɛ ɡɛ nyundua aa do kan nɔɔ? Umee wona kari harɛ nɔ ta teera, kɛɛ bwejena ne deŋɡarere tɔɡre kɛrɛdɛ nɔ?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Nɛn besoo jemɛ Korowii liire ɔ? Umee dɛ́ won baɡlo waa dɛ́ jao wɔ?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Ume bee Korowii la, naate baɡlo waa ó jemɔɔ? Umee baɡlo kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ ɔ? Ume tenee baɡlo wejema, kɛɛ waa mun noe yɔ?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra do tamaa kɛŋɔ bokiti bini nee aa kora le kerabeŋkpoŋ ken Korowii be. Ba do kɛŋɔ tutuɡ aa dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa tɔɡre ta ken. O dɛ kari ekwie harɛre a do fɛɡre o siwi ta kɛŋɔ tutuɡ ken.

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Daa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn kɔr bini aa kanɛ dɛ won fuh jam kwaa Korowii saraha kon ta, n baa bol ola aa lɔ o ta ba kpoora dɛ fuh dɛɛ tɛo wa.

english_verse: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ Korowii be. Ba do kɛ kwaane aa wola siwi su o be ken.

english_verse: Who compares with God? Is anything like him?
translation_verse: Umee yaa ba wona kpɔ Korowii maɡɔɔ? Bɔkwaa yaa ba kpɔe baɡle o waɔ?

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Voɡ te, loɡree dɛɛ loɡɔ, asɛ nɛn waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema ɡe yon kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ o bwara, dɛ ɛ suuɡapoŋa jɔɡrɔre doo.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Nyaa waa wola won dɔ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ la, o dɛ nyin daa waa wola pɔh, dɛ́ nyin nɛn waa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema, ó sɛh dɛ ɛ voɡ ó won che kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ bɛ chole.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Haa jemaa? He ta noɛ yaa? Haa a mun jemaa? Ba ta he be bolɛ saŋ Korowii aa ta harɛ mumpar la kɛɛ?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Onee di harɛ bwa kora dɛ so kookara ta nyundua, asɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta do jeɡre kɛŋɔ vaɡla ken. Onee paɡri nyundua bɔle kɛŋɔ yal ken, dɛ baŋro kɛŋɔ baa baŋre tɛnte dea dɛ so o bini la.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: Onee won koranar ɛɛ kɛŋɔ dansaara ken, ba waa ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ kwaa baa dua, kɛɛ kwaa baa mera, a pa mun dɛɛ dɔ lune, asɛ Korowii ɡel peu ta a ta a hol, asɛ kawulewule kpɔa kaa kɛŋɔ haahra ken.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ la ŋɔ, “Umee hɛɛ ba men kpɔe maɡɔɔ? Umee n ne o ɛ kɛrɛdɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Hé ha sie dɛ nyiŋi nyundua ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta. Korowiirii ta weweela dɛ ɡel a le beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa dɛ warɛ, asɛ o pa bɛlbwa sɔn. O kpeɡri waa dɔa kohona nomanta, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta nyoɡrɛ.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Israel tena, bɔkwa waa hɛɛ naɡre waa saŋ bɛlbwa ŋɔ, Korowii aa he wehiah jemɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, o laa sie kpɔ he wahala ta nɔɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Haa jemaa? He ta noɛ yaa? Korowii lole saŋ bɛlbwa. Onee ta harɛ nɔ bwa. Waa koh bwa, waa ɡwɛɡre ɡe. Nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ o wejema waa dɔa mun bwa.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Bonɔɔna ne toli kwaraa won koeh dɛ ɡwɛɡre, dɛ́ lɔ naa chole.

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: Kɛ nɛra baa dɔ hwɛɡa Korowii nɛɛ la te ɛɛ dɔ bokpeɡfalaa. Wɛɛ ɡeloo bá dɔ kena, dɛ́ ir kɛŋɔ kee ken. Baa chwao, kɛ baa koh bwa, dɛ́ valɛ baa ɡwɛɡre bwa ɡe.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra, hé hel dɛ́ no n be! Harɛre nɛra, hé nyin bokpeɡfala, dɛ́ ba bol he wa! Ya bwa cheme kɔɔto ásɛ bɛlbwa bol o wa.

english_verse: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Umee le nɛn le wee leebɔr ɔ? Umee tɛo kpeɡri o won yo lɛ harɛre dɛ pɔ a koranar nɛɔ? O kpɔ o tokobi dɛ kpoo ba, dɛ kpɔ o to ne hɛma ba peɡre, kɛŋɔ peu aa taa dɛ kpɔ tutuɡ ne haahra kaa la.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: O dɛ ti ba, dɛ́ doŋ ba dɛɛ kaa, wobɛlbwa aa wola on ha. O ɡbaŋre, a do kɛŋɔ o nakpale aa harɛ leɡe ken.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Umee ɛ waa nɔ dɛ ɡel a maɡre, kɛŋɔ waa yerɛ nɛra ne ba naanar ne ba ɡe naanar le mumpar bá ɛ o toma ɔ? Men Korowii maa lole le mumpar la, menee ɛa, menee dɛɛ ba nɛra baa ka mun ɡe nɛɛ jae.

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ ekwie harɛre ta naa dɛ ɔmɛ, hale banɔ la baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwara ɛɛ sa ba suuh tel dɛ ba,

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: bɛlbwa ɛɛ cha o dɔŋ, ásɛ dɛ yon ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Che kiŋkiŋ!’

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ sɛh kwa dɛ́ do nɛn waa jemɛ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ o bwara ɡbemba. Nɛn waa lɔ suuɡaswɛm dɛɛ pɛ dɛ ɛo voɡ la, dɛ́ do onɔ la waa dɛ loɡa o bwara ɡe ɡbemba. O ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o ɛ wa, dɛ kpaa dadowɛre do voɡ la ta, o bɛ chole.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: Kɛ he te, Israel tena haa ɛ n bonɔɔna, Jekɔb naanar maa le heya, n dam Abraham dwee,

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: harɛ jaɡa lee n kpɔ heyaa le, o jaɡaa n yerɛ heyaa le, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N bonɔɔnaa heya.’ N le heyaa tɛ n te, n ta heyaa tae.

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.

translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, haa kanɛ, haa kpeɡe. He bɛ ɔmɛ, mɛɛ cha heyaa. Men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ maa ɛ he Lɛɛ laanee ŋɔa.

translation_verse: Hé na, mɛɛ ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ erɛ boyu onfale o do nyɛɡre, ásɛ he kuuɡi bwejaŋa dɛ́ paɡra, dɛ́ bur deŋɡarere kɛŋɔ tutuɡ ken.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor

translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɔ nyoŋa siee, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kpɔ ŋwɛnɛre baa wola a ta jemɛ ta. Mɛɛ ɡeloo biro baa lɔ o ta la berɛ bochaah dɛ́ tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛre aa wola were a chɔ harɛ. Waa nɔɔ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ tɛɛ ba, maa ban ta.

translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ nɛra baa dɔ sibie kɛ baa wola na, ne nɛra baa dɔ deŋna kɛ baa wola waa no la ba.

translation_verse: Kpelaa, n ɡboo Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa. Nomɛlbwa aa won lɛ o te n nɔn ta. Anɔ la maa ɛ la, nomɛlbwa aa won bera.” Israel tena Babelɔn harɛ ta lee wa
