translation_verse: He ta daawiile kalamus a sɔɔh aa soma yawɛ bá fuh tɛ mɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ he tɛ mɛ he saraha kwaa bodɛɛɡa á su n siwi. Kɛ he wechɔɡa kan dɛ ɛɛ mɛ bone, he wedoŋa ɡe ɛɛ le n mee.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: Menee fee he wechɔɡa dɛɛ ta. N ɡbaɡba waa mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ, maa an lii kpa bwa.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Hé lii mɛ waa a fa aa chiɡa, ásɛ ya cheme dɛ́ bola, ásɛ he baɡle anɔ la haa di bole a ta.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: He nabaa waa tɔ sie la ɛ wechɔɡa, asɛ he nomonome bwa kpaŋe n nɛ.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ le he sɔforee le ba toma ta Korowii Dea sihiih kpo ba. Mɛɛ kpɔ Israel tenaa do ba dɔma nɔn ta bá chɔɡ ba, ba tama baa ka ɡe, bá ɛɛ ba nɛnhɛla.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena haa ɛ Jekɔb naanar, hé no! He ɛ n bonɔɔna n le heyaa tɛ n te.

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Menee Korowii maa ta heya, dɛ jemɛ heyaa mɔɔ ba lolɛ heya, dɛ cha heyaa la. He bɛ ɔmɛ, he ɛ n bonɔɔna maa le heyaa tɛ n te, n bambile lawɛ heya.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nee chɔ harɛ waa hola ta, ásɛ nenabɔɔne chɔ dɛɛ palɛ. Mɛɛ ɡeloo n Doma ba so he bii nɛ, dɛ́ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ he naanar.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Baa kpeɡuu kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa lɔ harɛsɔn ta, ne dajaŋa aa cheɡɛ nee nyoa ken.

english_verse: They will worship me and become my people. They will write my name on the back of their hands.
translation_verse: Bɛl ɛɛ bao dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Korowiirii mɛɛ tomɛ,’ ásɛ bɛl ɡe kpɔ Jekɔb sɔn dawɛ o nɛ, bɛl ɡe chwerɛ o nɔn ta kɛŋɔ ‘Korowii nɛnee men,’ ásɛ dɛ kpɔ Israel sɔn pa o te.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii waa ɛ Israel tena Kooro ne ba Lɛɛ la ŋɔ, “Menee komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ, ne a Muŋkaa bwa, n habɔɔ Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Umee do kɛŋɔ men ɔ? Ó bol. Naate ɡel n jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa n ne o ɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Ó baɡle waa aa chiɡa le ɡɛ saŋ maa ta saŋ la tena, ne waa a taa dɛ ba bala kerekere.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel he bwara ɛɛ sa! He bɛ ɔmɛ! Saŋ la bwa laa n le baɡle waa nɔ, dɛ bola aa? N danseɛree heya. Dɔɔ bɛl ɡe lole dɛ ja n nɛ aa? Akai, Bwetal bɛlbwa toole he chwa ka marɔ ó won lɛ heya, beŋkpoŋ ɡba toole.”

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ma voɡa kɛɛ dɛɛ sɛah la dɛ ɛ wepuu, kwaa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta la ɛ konsale. Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa nɔ, ba do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa nyoŋa ken, baa wobɛlbwa jemɛ, baa di sihiih.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ma voɡ kɛɛ dɛɛ loɡɔ la, o ta tɔnɔ dɔe tɛo.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: O ne nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡ la bwa ɛɛ di sihiih. Nɛra laa dɛɛ sɛh kwa aa? Ame binii ba doɔ? Ba bwa ɛɛ ba chemoo ba bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole, ásɛ ba bwara yɔr kohona, ba di sihiih.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Nii taa loɡre do buni dɛ́ yon kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma. Hamba nee wɛɛ lɔɔro bokpeɡa ne, dɛ́ ɛo ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin kɛ kon la mar do. Lɔr ne nyɔɡre nee wɛɛ ɛo dɛ́ ba koh.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa jemɛ kwaa sɛɛh dɛ maɡɛ daa waa kpɔ sɛh kon, dɛ́ kpɔ kon peo, mɔɔ dɛ́ sɛoh, ó do wer, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ nɛn, dɛ́ kpɔ ka cheɡ voɡ dea.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: O dɛ mar daa nɔ ane, dɛɛ ŋwee, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ daa kondikwa, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɡe sɛh voɡ dɛɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: He enjoys the warm fire and the meat that was roasted over the burning coals.
translation_verse: O kpɔ daa la ane dɛɛ mar nii, dɛɛ wɔɔ ola kɛɛ dɛ daala dɛɛ chwe. O yon ŋwee nii la dɛ ŋɔ, “N bwara wɔrɔbɔ.”

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Daa la pera ɡe, o kpɔɔ dɛɛ sɛh voɡ, dɛɛ yerɔ o dɔɔ, dɛ ɡuŋi dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “N dɔɔree hen, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ.”

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ lii wa, bɛlbwa ta wejema dɔe dɛ́ no a mun dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Daa nɔ tentenee n mar, dɛ kpɔ o hɔla dɛɛ daa kondikwa, dɛ wɔɔ ol a ta dɛ chwe. O pera chɛ kɛŋɔ ń kpɔ ɛ kii kon aa? A chɛ kɛŋɔ ń ɡuŋi dakpul aa?”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: A ɛ wesale kɛŋɔ waa dɛ di tɔɔ ken. O neɡre o nyu dɛ nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ. Waa won lɛ o te, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ won jemɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Kon maa kpoŋa ɛ nyosone kon.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, Israel tena, hé lii ɡɛ waa nɔ. N bonɔɔnaa heya. Menee ta heya. Maa he waa soh bwa.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: N laa he wechɔɡa fee a tonɛ, kɛŋɔ bam ne chɔɔlen kɔɔla ken. Hé laa berɛ ba n be, dɛkalkɛ menee lɛ heya.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela. Komɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ ta ɡe, hé ɡo hɛɡra yela, hale bwejena ne kɔr bini daa bwa. Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii lɛ Israel tena, dɛ baɡle o jirima waa dɔa. Nɛra ɛɛ berɔ ba so Jerusalam

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: Israel tena, Korowii waa ɛ he Lɛɛ, dɛ ta heyaa la ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii maa ta komɛlbwa. N ɡboo paɡri nyundua kɛŋɔ yal, nomɛlbwa ta n nɛɛ jae n ta harɛ.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Menee ɡela keame nyosonteŋna waa ɛ nyosone, dɛ ɡel voɡra waa ɛ ɡɛnewa, dɛ won beɡre harɛ nɔ ta wejerema wejema, a ɛ wesale.

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: Menee ɡela waa n toroma aa bol la ɛɛ ɛ kpela. Menee ŋɔa nɛra ɛɛ berɔɔ bá so Jerusalam, Juda bwɛɛre a fa aa paɡra la, bá berɛ kwaa vɔrɔwa.

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: N dɛ ŋɔ mpo hweeh, ó hweeh, ásɛ nenabɔɔne ɡe hweeh.

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: Men Korowii berɔ bol Saeros ɡe waa ŋɔ, ‘Henee dɛɛ ba n nɛra nɛɛ nyiŋa, dɛ́ ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin la bwa ka tonɛ,’ dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé kwaa pa Jerusalam ne men Korowii Dea la mun.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Korowii le Saeros ŋɔ ó ɛ kooro, dɛ leo ŋɔ ó pɔ harɛre nɛra nɛ. O leo ŋɔ ó yo harɛre, dɛ́ pɔ ba koranar nɛɛ dɛ lɛ́ ba kpeɡri ba be. Korowiirii dɛ́ ya bwɛjena doonyoone ɡbeni tɛo. O ŋɔ Saeros be ŋɔ,

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: “Mɛɛ tɔ he siee, dɛ́ bur bwejena ne deŋɡarere. Mɛɛ paɡre ayaawa ɡberjenaa, dɛ́ kuuɡi bune baa kpɔa kaɡra la ɡe.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛɛ kondɔɔh aa sɔah nɛra aa wola an na, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ, n yerɛ he sɔn.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: N bonɔɔnaa Israel tena n lee ba tɛ n te nomanta, n le he Saeros cheɡ dɛ tɛɛ jirima kohona, a lole kɛ dɛ haa men jemɛ.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Menee Korowii, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa, nemenɛ n ɡbo. Haa men jemɛ, kɛ mɛɛ tɛɛ kpeɡrii.

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: N ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ le wee leebɔr kaa o cholibɔr, nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii. N habɔɔ, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa, nemenɛ n ɡbo.

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Menee ta bochaah ne biro bwa, menee dɛɛ tɛ bosɔɔhna, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ba sibeɡra ɡe ne. Men Korowii, menee ɛ anɔ bwa.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo wa aa toɡra le nyundua ba harɛ ta kɛ bwaala ken, ásɛ waa aa wera ne kasinteŋ do le, Men Korowiirii ta a bwa.”

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Nɛn o ne Korowii waa tao la aa dɛ yo la, ó bwɛɛlɛ! Naate do kɛŋɔ vii ken. Choh ɛɛ won ŋɔ mamaa be ŋɔ waa o toma jemaa? Vii ɛɛ won bɔɔ mamaa waa aa bala o mao wa aa?

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do, nɛn waa ŋɔ o nya ne o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he lol mɛ dɛ ɡel n do ken?”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Korowii, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ waa ta ba, dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa chiɡ kerekere la ŋɔ, “He ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ, hé bɔɔ mɛ n bii wa, kɛɛ dɛ́ baɡ mɛ ɡɛ maa ɛ.

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Menee ta harɛ, dɛ ta nɛwɛnyina do o ta. N kpeɡrii n kpɔ baŋre nyundua kɛŋɔ yal, dɛ kpɔ wee ne korobie dɛ weweela cheɡ a chebɔra.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Mɛɛ che toɡra n wa aa toɡra taa, dɛ́ ɡel Saeros ir dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra ne anɔ la maa dɛ nyin. Mɛɛ kwaa o ŋwɛnɛree a do wer. Onee dɛ́ ba kwaa ma n bwɛjen Jerusalam, dɛ́ lɛ n nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa harɛfala ta la. Waa ɛ dɛ́ lɛ komɛl le nɛn be. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii ŋɔa.”

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Ijipt ne Itiopia harɛre kondɔɔh kwaa ɛɛ ɛ he kwaa, ásɛ Seba baala baa kpeɡa kohona berɛ he yoma. Baa do ba jɔɡrɔree, ba teŋɛ he nɛ. Baa ɡuŋi heyaa harɛɛ, dɛ́ sɛh ŋɔ, ‘Korowii teŋɛ he nɛɛ kpela. Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole.’ ”

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ wɛɛ lɛɛ ba la, o ɛ Korowii waa kpɔ o te dɛɛ sɔh.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Sihiih ɛɛ kpo nɛra baa cheɡ voɡaa. Ba bwa ɛɛ pɛo di ncho.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Kɛ Israel tena te, Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ baa saŋ bɛlbwa. Baa sihiih di, saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ta nyundua onee Korowii, dɛ berɛ ta harɛ ɡe o che kiŋkiŋ. O ta harɛ tae o chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ, kɛ o tao ŋɔ nɛra so o ta. O ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: N ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ sɔh, kɛɛ dɛ che biro ta bol waa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa. N ta Israel tena be ŋɔe ŋɔ, ‘Hé nyin n bɔr pɛɛpɛɛ.’ Menee Korowii, Kasinteŋ ɡboo n bwa, waa aa wera dɛ toɡre ɡboo mɛɛ bol.”

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra haa chwaa le laa ta kaa la, hé berɛ ba. Nɛra baa kpɔ daa berɛ voɡa dɛ kpoŋa dɛɛ valɛ la aa waane jemɛ. Ba kpɔ wesoŋa dɛɛ bil voɡa aa wola won lɛɛ ba sie.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Hé cheme, dɛ́ bol he waa kɔɔto, ásɛ nɛra baa kpɔ waa daɡ ba la le jina dɛ́ kpɔ liire. Umee bol waa aa chiɡa taraken nɔ bil wubwa nɔ? Umee le saŋ la bwa dɛ bola ɔ? Men Korowii maa ɛ he Lɛɛ la laa aa? Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra bwa, hé ba n be, dɛ́ ba dɔ he nyu. N ɡboo Korowii, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: N ŋwɛɛ n ɡbaɡba, maa nentanee ta dɛ́ berɛ kpɛla. N nyoa wobol bɛlbwa toɡrɔ. Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ ɡuŋ mɛ harɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ che n sɔn ta ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba Dɔɔree men.

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: Baa bol n waa ŋɔ, ‘O ɡbo bee waa aa toɡra ne kpeɡri do.’ Banɔ la ba baah aa di n nɛɛ la bwa, ɛɛ berɔɔ ba n be sihiih ne.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Men Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo Jekɔb naanar bwa waa toɡre, ásɛ ba kpɛɛ mɛ.”

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Babelɔn tena voɡa Bel ne Nɛbo baa dɛ toma la di sihiih, ba paa dawɛ keeɡore ta a ɛ bontɔɡa a chea dɛɛ koh.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Voɡa la ta wone lɛ a te, ba dɔma cheɡɛ a bwa kaa.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: Israel tena haa kaa la bwa, hé no n be. Menee nyiŋi he nɛɛ le ɡɛ saŋ baa lolɛ bwa.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Menee dɛɛ ba he nɛɛ nyiŋa, dɛ́ ka tel he hwɛɛhra saŋ he nyumpona aa to. Menee ta heya, mɛɛ chwaa heyaa, dɛ́ kpoŋe heya, dɛ́ lɛ heya.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?
translation_verse: Umee hɛɛ ba men kpɔe maɡɔɔ? Umee do kɛ men ɔ?

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Bane fuɡe suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa le pure bini, dɛ kpɔa dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa ta. Ba kpɔa tɛ nɛn waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema o kpɔ kwaa voɡ, asɛ ba ɡuŋi dɛɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Ba ɡɔɔro dɛ chwaa, dɛ choɡo cheɡ o chebɔr aa, dɛ o cheɡɔ, waa won tu nakpala. Ba yerɔ waa won sɛh. Waa won lɛɛ ba le ba wahala ɡe ta.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, hé lii waa nɔ, dɛ́ ɡel a ka he nyu bini. Hé ɡel he siwi swɛɛ a ta.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Hé lii waa aa chiɡa saŋ la. N ɡboo Korowii, n dɔŋ toole.

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ yerɛ nomɛlee le bojaŋ harɛ wee leebɔr, ásɛ o ba tawɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra baah ta kɛŋɔ kela ken, dɛ́ ba tonɛ anɔ la maa maɡla bil bwa. Waa maa bola la, anee dɛɛ ba ɛɛ.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Hé no n be, deŋnekpeɡ tena, he ne waa aa toɡra baah jaŋne.

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba n waa aa toɡra ne. A toole bojaŋ, aa biɡri kwaraa. Mɛɛ lɛ Jerusalam tenaa, dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔ n jirima.”

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Babelɔn, bwɛjen baa wola yoi dɛ pɔ he nɛ, he do kɛŋɔ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ. Tu he kookara ta, dɛ́ ba so harɛ. Taraken baa hen ɡbɛɡbɛ kpa, he berɛ yom.

english_verse: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
translation_verse: Ka namɛ men nam ta, laa kon haa kpɔa bɔle sie la kpɔ, dɛ́ laa yal ɡbaa he hwie ta, dɛ́ jo neerare le a baŋ.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ nae kɛŋɔ he cheɡɛ mumɡbal, baa na sihiih haa dia. Mɛɛ bɔe he wechɔɡa kemee, maa nomɛlbwa nɛɛ sune.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Ya Lɛɛ, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ, Koranar Bwa Kooro yaa dɛ tomɔ la.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Babelɔn haa do kɛŋɔ bitolo, so harɛ biro ta jeiih ken. Baa hen harɛ nɔ ta bwa bwɛɛre haŋkooroo yerɛ kpa!

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: N baah fa di n nɛra Israel tena nɛ, n tɛr ba deŋne kɛŋɔ n nɛra laa ban ken, dɛ kpɔ ba do hen Babelɔn nɔn ta. He ta ba nɛɛ sune, hale banɔ la baa hwɛɛhra kwaraa la, he do ba hɔhɔrɔwa.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: He fa ŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛ ɛ haŋkooro saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, anomanta, he ta ɡɛ we-ɛɛla nɔ kpɔe do he liire bini, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ lii ɡɛ aa dɛ ba he chiɡa.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: No, he dɛ di he bwara, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ɛɛ. He ŋɔ he ne Korowii kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa toole he habɔɔ. He ta liire kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɛ luhaahnee bwa, haa biseo ɡee di.

english_verse: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
translation_verse: Gɛ webele anɛ nɔ ɛɛ piɡri tɔpebeŋkpoŋii. Ane he kaberere bwa, hɛɛ di bisewee, he jaa sewɛ.

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: He kpɔ he te dawɛ he wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa aa men na.’ He wejema ne he liire wili dɛ ɡel he ŋɔ, ‘Menee men. Nomɛlbwa toole n habɔɔ kpa.’

english_verse: But without warning, disaster will strike— and your magic charms won't help at all.
translation_verse: Wekpeɡa ɛɛ pui, he bebee waa bwa aa won sɔɔh a nyoa. Siswɛm waa ɛɛ pui, waa haa wola a waa deere bwa piɡri.

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: Anomanta, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ do sie he kaberere ne he dobodobo we-ɛɛla aa wara he le a ne bechale saŋ, dɛɛ ɛa la. A ken ɛɛ won ɛ waane, he ken ɛɛ won kpɔ aah he dɔma.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Jae bwa haa dɔa habɔɔ, he ta kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe. Gel wejerema baa jemɛ weweela wa, dɛɛ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa korobie bɛlbwa ta, ir ba lɛɛ le waa aa dɛ ba he pui la ta.

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Na, ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡhole, nii ɛɛ fuuh baa. Hale baa won lɛ ba te le ninlao la ta kwara. Gɛ nii la ta doe kɛŋɔ nii haa won la a jwɛɛh ka ŋwee.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Waa nɛra haa le he bechale saŋ dɛɛ la ba be baa jae la aa dɛ ba ɡela he na laanee. Bɛlbwa ɛɛ nyin bɔree dɛ́ chwa kaa, bɛlbwa aa lee do, dɛ́ lɛɛ.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé no, Jekɔb naanar baa bera dɛɛ yerɛ heyaa Israel tena he le Juda dea, he dɛ ŋwɛɛ men Korowii sɔn, dɛɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la, kɛ haa waa haa dɛ bol la ɛ.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: He dɛ́ maŋkura he te ŋɔ he le bwɛjen Jerusalam, dɛ ŋɔ he kpɔ he te dawɛ men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la nɛ.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: Fini laa n le dɛ bol waa aa ɛa. N bola biɡri asɛ he jemɛ, buɡ la taa n den ɡel a ɛ.

english_verse: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
translation_verse: A waa ɡela n bol waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la, dɛ bol waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa mɔɔ á chiɡ, ásɛ he bɛ ba ŋɔ he voɡaa ɡela a chiɡ.

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: He no waa n fa aa bola baɡle heyaa asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ. A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé sɛh kɛŋɔ a ɛ kpela. Le fini dɛɛ kaa mɛɛ bol wefala aa sɔah maa wola he be bolɛ la he bee.

english_verse: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.
translation_verse: Tarakenii mɛɛ ba ɡela a chiɡ. Waa aa do ɡɛ ta chiɡe bwa. Ane chiɡo ka aa, he fe ŋɔ he jemɛ a wa.

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, he ɛ nɛra bane baa jema kɛ ɡaeh tenaa heya. A waa haa wola waa nɔ bwa no la.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: N sɔn ne kpɛɛra waa mɛɛ lawɛ bambile he nɛ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ heyaa ba chɔɡ.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: N do heyaa weweele ta, dɛ daah heyaa na, kɛŋɔ ba yon do suuɡapoŋ nii ta dɛ mwɛɛlo la. Kɛ n nao kɛŋɔ haa siwi su.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: N ɡbaɡba waa n ɛa ɡɛ. Maa ɡel n sɔn chɔɡ, maa ɡel he kpɔ jirima aa chɛ mɛ la tɛ nomɛl.” Israel tena dɔ ba te le Babelɔn lɔɡa

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé no n be, Israel tena maa yerɛ heya. Menee Korowii, menee komɛlbwa sitɔɔ, ne muŋkaa.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: N ɡbaɡbaa kpɔ nɔn pa harɛ mun, dɛ kpɔ n nɔndiɡ baŋre nyundua. N yera aa, a dɛ ba n be.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: Hé bwa ba cheme dɛ́ no. Voɡa la bini umee wona baɡle anɔ nɔɔ? Nɛn maa leo la ɛɛ yo Babelɔn tenaa. Wɛɛ ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin kɛ o ɛ bwaa.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Menee pili nyoa dɛ yerɔ, menee leo dɛ ɡel o won ɛ o toma bwa ka tonɛ.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Hé suuh tel n be, dɛ́ ba no waa nɔ. Le waa nɔ mumpar bwa n ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ a sɔh heya, n wobɛlbwa maa bol la, a dɛ ɛ kpela.” Nemenɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o Doma ta, dɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii, waa ɛ he Lɛɛ, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la aa dɛ bolee nɔ, “Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, menee dɛɛ chaɡle heyaa anɔ la aa wera tɛ heya, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ chaɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: Dɛ he fe cheɡ deŋne n waa ta naa, he fe dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna kɛrɛdɛ, kɛŋɔ nenabɔɔ waa wola hweeh bwa, dɛ́ dɔ kpeɡri kohona kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma ken, dɛ́ won wobɛlbwa ɛɛ á toɡre.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: He naanar fe ɛɛ warɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken. N fe nyiŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ ba dɔma bɛ won chɔɡ ba, ásɛ ba sɔn bɛ he.”

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Hé le Babelɔn harɛ ta, hé chwa le o nɛra bini! Hé kpɔ silɛɛ taa bol bobɛlbwa ŋɔ, “Korowii lɛ o bonɔɔna Israel tena.”

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: Waa kpɔ ba kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, nyɔɡre ta ban kpoe. O ɡelɔ nee bule le bwe ta tɛɛ ba. O pere bwe nee palɛ le o ta.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Bosɔɔhna toole dɛ tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.”

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Bojaŋa harɛre nɛra, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n be. Korowii lee mɛ n ɛ o bonɔɔ, o yerɛ n sɔn mɔɔ ba lol mɛ.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ n nyoa wobol do nyɛɡre kɛŋɔ naŋɡɔse ken, dɛ kpɔ o nɔn tɔ n nɛ, dɛ ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ hɛm waa nyɛɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ ɛ toma ken.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: O berɔ ŋɔ, “Israel harɛ, he do kɛŋɔ n bonɔɔ, he nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa nɛra kpɛɛ mɛ.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Anee n ŋɔ, “N koɔh ta pɛɛ, n chɔɡ n bokpeɡa wepuu ta pɛɛpɛɛ. Kɛ n kpɔ n waa bwa do Korowii nɔn ta, n kembɔr ɡe lɔ o be.”

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Korowii lee mɛ dɛ ɛɛ mɛ o bonɔɔ mɔɔ ba lol mɛ, dɛ ŋɔ ń berɛ ba o nɛra Israel tena baa peɡra dɛ do bobɛlbwa la ne o be. Korowii ɡelɔ n dɔ duure, o bee n kpeɡri do.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “N bonɔɔ, n dɔ wejena ane tɛɛ he ɛ. Israel tena baa kaa la ɡbo sie laa hɛɛ ba tɔe. Mɛɛ ɛɛ kɛŋɔ kandea hɛ́ɛ chaah harɛre nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ la bwa nɛ, ásɛ n won lɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Israel tena Lɛɛ, ba Nɛŋɡoroŋ la ŋɔ nɛn harɛre nɛra aa haoh baa wola on kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa, ba nomonome ɛo yom la be ŋɔ, “Koranar ɛɛ nae dɛ́ ir che, koobii nae dɛ́ ɡuŋi harɛ. A nɔ bwa ɛɛ ɛo dɛkalkɛŋɔ, men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ n wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la, menee lee.” Korowii ɛɛ berɔɔ lɛ Israel tena

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ saŋ telo kɛŋɔ ń lɛ heya aa, mɛɛ na he sumii dɛ́ cha heya. Mɛɛ nyiŋi heyaa, dɛ́ ɡel he ne nɛra bwa fɔwɛ fɔo. Mɛɛ ɡeloo he ka so he harɛ waa chɔɡa dɛ chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ la ta ja.

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa do ba deene bee ŋɔ, ‘Hé le kaa!’ dɛ́ ŋɔ banɔ la baa lɔ biro ta ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Hé le ba bɔchaah ta.’ Baa ɛo kɛŋɔ peera aa dɛ di deŋɡarere ta ken,

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: lɔr ne nyɔɡre aa ba kpoe ba. Wee nyɛɡre ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta peuwɔb aa ban ha, dɛkalkɛ naate waa dɛ nyin ba waa la ɛɛ tɔ ba siee, dɛ́ la ba ne bela nesɔn aa bula dɛɛ le.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: Mɛ́ɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛɛ bil bwejena dor, dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ n nɛra bá kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Baa le bojaŋaa ba, bane ɛɛ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔree, bane ɡe le wee cholibɔr dɛ́ ba, ásɛ bane ɡe le Aswan dɛ́ ba.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua, hé do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ ne, kwaa aa lɔ harɛ ta ɡe, hé hɛɡre! Bwejena ɡe ɡo silɛɛ yela. Korowii ɛɛ larawe o nɛra bwaraa, wɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ wahala tena ɡe.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Kɛ Jerusalam tena te ŋɔ, “Korowii ɡel yaa, o soh ya wa.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Haah ɛɛ won soh o bilole waa ɔro wa aa? Dɛ nya ɛɛ soh o bie waa yaa, n te aa he waa soeh ba bwa.

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Jerusalam, n chwerɛ he sɔn do n nɔmpaala bini, he waa dawɛ n bambile ta saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ba kwaa vɔrɔwe ɛɛ bao taraken, ásɛ banɔ la baa chɔɡe la le kaa.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Ha sie nyiŋi bar dɛ́ na waa aa dɛ chiɡ! He nɛra dɛ́ cheme dɛ́ berɛ ba he be dem! N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛ, maa ɛ Korowii maa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ, he sie ɛɛ lɛ he nɛra nɛɛ, kɛŋɔ hanfale sie yon lɛ o baŋa kwaa ne nɔnloɡa aa wera ta la.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ harɛ la fa paɡrɔ, dɛ berɛ dimɡbia, kɛ taraken harɛ la ɛɛ do jeɡaa tɛ nɛra baa dɛ ba ba so o ta. Ásɛ nɛra ba fa aa chwa he yaa la, bá kpɔ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: He bii baa kaa lol ba harɛfale ta la ɛɛ ba ŋɔ he be tɔpebɛlee ŋɔ, ‘Ya farɛ harɛ nɔ ta to, waa kanɛ tɛ yaa. Tɛ yaa bɔr yá so!’

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Ásɛ he ba lii he nyu bini ŋɔ, ‘Ume tenee lolɛ ɡɛ bii nɔ tɛ mɛ nɔ? Dɛ n paŋɛ bii maa wola lii kɛ mɛɛ dɔ banee kpa. Ba doŋ mɛ n kaa harɛfale ta, aah umee dɛɛ bechale nɔɔ? Dɛ n ɡboo kaa, leperaa ba le ba te nɔ?’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kenii Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ o nɛra be, “Mɛɛ kwɛr harɛre nɛraa, ásɛ ba kpɔ he bii berɛ ba dem.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Koranar ɛɛ kpɔ heyaa berɛ ba bii, ásɛ ba haŋkoranar ɡe berɛ he nyare. Baa dɛɛ ɡuŋi heyaa harɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ duure tɛ he ya. Belaa hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii. Nɛra baa kpɔ hwɛɡa dawɛ n nɛɛ la, sihiih aa ban kpo bwa.”

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra baa dɛ yoo heyaa la kpoo ba ɡbaɡba, dɛ́ nyɔ ba ɡbaɡba chale, dɛ́ dɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa nyɔ sen ken, ásɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ, Men Korowii, menee he Lɛɛ, menee yawɛ he nyu, dɛ berɛ ɛ Jekɔb Kpeɡnɛn waa tomɔ la.”

english_verse: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
translation_verse: N ba he be, n ta heyaa nae, n yerɛ heyaa he ta sɛɛh. Kpeɡri maa kpɔ lɛ heyaa laanee n ta dɔe kɛɛ? Mɛɛ won ŋɔ mpo hweeh, ó hweeh, dɛ́ berɛ won ɡel neerare hweeh, bela do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ásɛ a pɛŋa bwa serewe dɛ́ pɔh.

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Mɛɛ won ɡel biro tɔ nyundua bwa, ásɛ dɛ bir kɛŋɔ lweyal ken.”

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii baɡ mɛ n jemɛ wobol, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ do nɛra baa koah ɡbemba. O laɡ mɛ dɛɛ ir chɔɔ bɛlbwa dɛ ɡel mɛɛ no waa waa dɛ ba n baɡla.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ɡelɔ mɛɛ no waa mun. N ta deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: N berɛ n nyaŋ tɛ nɛra ba lɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ n taŋɡbaɡre ɡe tɛ nɛra ba chuɡri n tampona. N ta n sie laa fɛr sihihwaa ne nentane baa taa ta n sie ta.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Sihiih aa men kpo, dɛkalkɛ Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ cha mɛ. Anomanta, n lawɛ n te, dɛ n jemɔ kɛŋɔ maa nchoo di bwa.

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ cha mɛ, umee dɛ́ won pa mɛ bolchɔɡe ɔ? Ba bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ yal sɛɛle aa diu la ken.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: He banɔ la bwa haa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛɛ no o bonɔɔ waa la, a balɔ kɛ he dɛ valɛ biro ta kwaraa naa, hé yarada Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: He banɔ la ɡe haa dɛ nyin hé chɔɡ he bala la, aa di he ɡbaɡbaa. Korowii ɡbabirii dɛɛ ba ɡela á chiɡ ɡɛ. Hɛɛ na waa kohonaa taeh.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Hé lii he nabaa Abraham, ne Saara haa le ba bini la wa. Maa yerɛ Abraham dɛ o ta bie dɔe, asɛ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛo dɛ́ ɡel o naanar warɛ.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Jerusalam berɛ dimɡbia, mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ o nɛra baa soɡe o ta. Mɛɛ ɡeloo o pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ le daa warɛ dɛ́ do wer, kɛŋɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe la. Silɛɛ ne hɛɡra ɛɛ do belaa, ásɛ ba ɡo kpɛɛra ne jam yela dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: N nɛra, hé no n be! N harɛ ta nɛra, hé cheɡ deŋne no waa maa dɛ bol nɔ. Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ me Mmarare, ásɛ n kasinteŋ ɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah harɛre nɛra.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bao warane, dɛ́ ba lɛɛ ba, ba lɛɛ tɔpere aa jaŋɛ kwara. N ɡbabirii dɛ nyiŋi harɛre nɛra nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ n kasinteŋ la. Bojaŋa harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ dɔ hwɛɡaa, dɛɛ nyiŋi lɛɛ maa dɛ ba ba lɛɛ la ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Hé ha sie nyiŋi nyundua, dɛ́ berɛ ba sie ne harɛ dɛ́ nyiŋi. Nyundua ɛɛ nyoɡroo kɛŋɔ ninchuu ken, ásɛ harɛ ɡe chɔɡ kɛŋɔ yakwara aa kɔɔhna ken, nɛra baa lɔ o ta serewe kɛŋɔ chwɛɛhne. Kɛ lɛɛ maa dɛ ba nɛra lɛɛ la ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. N waa aa toɡra ɡe aa tonɛ bwa.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa jemɛ waa aa toɡra, dɛɛ teŋɛ me mmarare ta la, hé no n be. He bɛ bammuɡla nɛra aa dɛ ɛ heyaa la ɔmɛ, kɛɛ he bwara hwah chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡɛ heyaa la wa.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Ba bwa ɛɛ heo kɛŋɔ, sɛɛle aa di laala kɛɛ dudule aa dɛ chɔɡ yabii ken. Kɛ toɡra n wa aa toɡra ɛɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwaa, ásɛ lɛɛ maa lɛ nɛra la chɔ ka le naanar baa ka ba bwa.”

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne dɛ́ cha yaa! Kpɔ he kpeɡri la ba lɛ yaa ɡɛ haa ɛa saŋ la! He laa chɛwɛ mpo bini oljen Rahab la aa?

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: He laa ɡela mpo hweeh, ŋwɛnɛ chɔ bela waa luŋa, asɛ nɛra haa lɛɛ ba won le o baŋ la aa?

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Nɛra haa lɛɛ ba la ɛɛ berɔɔ ba jo Jerusalam, dɛ́ ɡo yela dɛɛ hɛɡre silɛɛ ne. Ba sie ɛɛ lɛo saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ sum ne hima le kwaraa.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee dɛɛ larawe he bwara. Nɛwɛnyina ɡee bɔkwa, hɛɛ ɔm baɔ? Ba dɛ serewe, ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa.

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: Kɛ he soh men Korowii maa ta heyaa dɛ paɡri nyundua kɛŋɔ yal, dɛ pa harɛ mun la wa. Ɛrɛwaa tɔpere bɛlbwa hɛɛ ɔmɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi heya, dɛɛ nyin bá chɔɡ heyaa kohona nɔɔ? Leperaa ba bandia ɛɛ tel ɔ?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa do ba dea la, aa biɡri bá lee ba. Baa dea baa kwiu bɔɔ biro tenten do bela la binii serewe, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ kondikwaa waa ɛɛ noo baa.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la. Menee wona ɡel mpo ɛɛ ir dɛɛ lɔ nehɛma. N sɔnee Nemenɛ Korowii.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Menee kpɔ n waa tɛ heya, dɛ kpɔ n nɔn tɔ he nɛ. Menee paɡri nyundua kɛŋɔ yal, dɛ pa harɛ mun. Menee ŋɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, ‘N nɛraa heya.’ ” Jerusalam tena wenaale jaɡa

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, hé ir nyu ne, hé ir! He nyɔ Korowii danana nee a nyoa aa kpeɡa kɛŋɔ sen la, he nyɔ a bwa kwaraa dɛ dɛɛ, dɛɛ yɛɛɡe.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: He bii haa lol ba bwa, bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔ he sie. Bɛlbwa toole he dɛɛ ó lawɛ he nɔɔra.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: He bii ɡwɛɡrɔ chɔ fɔɡbaahna, ba do kɛŋɔ kweɡla aa lɔ bel ta ken. Korowii baah di ba nɛ, aa noo ba kohona.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Hé no, Jerusalam tena, he waa sum. Hé dɛɛrɔ, kɛ he ta sen nyɔe.

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ wɛɛ che he habɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Hé na, n lɛ n danana nee numol haa nyɔ o bini sen dɛɛ la le he nɔn ta. Haa anee nyɔ kpa bwa.

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔɔ do nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi heyaa la nɔn ta. Banee yon ŋɔ, ‘Hé chɔ harɛ, ásɛ ya valɛ he nyaŋ ta.’ He chɔ harɛ ba kpɔ he nyaŋ berɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ tiɡri he nɛ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Jerusalam, ir! Ir nyu ne! Kpɔ bokpeɡa tɔ he te kɛŋɔ yal ken. Jerusalam, Korowii bwɛɛ waa do ɡoroŋ, kpɔ he yadɛɛɡe tɔ dɛ dɔ jirima. Nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ, dɛ kah doŋa te bɛlbwa, aa won jo he bwɛɛ nɔ ta kpa.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: Jerusalam haa do kɛ bitolo, ir dɛ́ pee he bwara ta, dɛ́ so he kookara ta. Ásɛ dɛ laa jɔɡrɔre baa lawɛ dɛ doe laa ta la foo.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Kenii Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ he nɛra be. “Ba ta heyaa yoɡe lɛ komɛlbwa, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ba lɛɛ dɔe haa wola komɛlbwaa bɔ.”

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “N nɛra fa kaa so Ijipt harɛ ta ka. Ban dɛɛ nyin dɛ kaa. Asɛ aa la sie Asiiria tena laɡ ba kaa kpeɡri ne.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Bɔkwa waa nɔ jaɔ? Babelɔn tena lawɛ n nɛra bwa kaa pɛɛpɛɛ, ba ka do ba lɔɡa, ba siwi sa ba. Ba dɛ bol mɛ nɛnhɛlwobol saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: Anomanta, saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao n nɛra jemɛ ɡɛ maa doa, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii. Menee bola.”

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Hé na ɡɛ toroma baa kpoŋe Amanesoma dɛ valɛ bwea dor dɛɛ ba wa aa dɔ nyokpoa ne, dɛɛ bol deŋnesɔɔhna ne Korowii lɛɛ wa! Hé no ba bala wa aa, he bambile ɛɛ sɔɔh heyaa taeh. O bol Saayɔn tena be ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ di kora!”

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛjen la pɛo dɛɛ do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ ne! Ba na Korowii ba siwi ne kɛ waa bera dɛɛ ba Saayɔn!

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, he bwɛjen berɛ dimɡbia, hé pɛ ɡo silɛɛ yela. Korowii larawe o nɛra bwara, dɛ lɛ Jerusalam ɡe.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre nɛra bwa na ɡɛ o kpeɡri aa do ɡoroŋ. Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa ɛɛ na ɡɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa wona lɛ yaa.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Hé le Babelɔn harɛ! Hé pere he te le ba nɛɛ kwara! He bɛ komɛlbwa waa kah doŋa leɡe! He nɛra haa cheɡɛ Korowii Dea laala la, hé le ba bini, dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Toola ne laa hɛɛ ba lee, kɛɛ chwae laa hɛɛ ba chwae le, dɛ́ dɔ he nyu. Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ tɔ he siee, wɛɛ berɔ teŋɛ he nɛɛ dɛ́ daah heya. Korowii Bonɔɔ bonyɛɡa ne o jirima dɔe wa

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “N bonɔɔ ɛɛ won ɛ toma maa kpɔa do o nɔn ta la tonɛ, baa duuruu taeh, dɛ́ ɡel o sɔn le.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Nɛra warɔ dɛ nao ba bwara yɔr, ɡɛ baa ɛo, o siebɔr ne o bwadabii beɡre dɛ doŋ kohona la, o ta nɛn leɛ kwaraa kpa.

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken, harɛre nɛra nyoa ɛɛ kpo o waa, koranar hel, ba bwara yɔr. Baa na waa baa wola ba be bolɛ bwaa, ásɛ anɔ la baa wola noɛ bwa la, bá no a mun.”

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Anee nɛra la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ fe yarada waa yaa dɛ bol nɔɔ? Umee dɛ́ fe jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ɛaɔ?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ɡela o bonɔɔ kpeɡ o sie, dɛ do kɛŋɔ daa waa le harɛ hole ta. O ta nyanyini ne wer dɔe yá pɛla lawɔ, o wobɛlbwa ta silɛɛ dɔe yá nyinu.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Nɛra haoh dɛ vɛoh, o na wahala ne weweele. Nɛra nao, dɛ laa sie kpɔ o nɛ. Ya ta on kpɔe ɛ wobɛlbwa, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo.

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: Kpela, onee laa ya ɡwɛɡra, ne weweele kpɔ ya nɛ. Kɛ ya te liiro kɛŋɔ Korowiirii lɔɔro dɛ doo weweele dɛ kpɔ tɛr o deŋne.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Ya wechɔɡa waa ba doo bol, ya wechɔɡa waa ba lɔɔro. Gɛ aa ɛ yá dɔ bosɔɔhna waa o dɔ deŋnetɛra, á che a ta ya dɔ bokpeɡa.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Ya bwa do kɛ peera aa kpaŋa ken, bɛlbwa ɛɛ kaa bela waa dɛ nyin, asɛ Korowii ɡel deŋnetɛra a fe aa chɛ yaa la bwa ba o nɛ.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Ba ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa, kɛ o helɔ, o ta nyoa pile. O tɔ nyoa kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ pebie dɛɛ kaa kpobɔr la. O ɛo jeiih kɛŋɔ penee baa dɛ fonɛ o pona ken. O ta nyoa pile dɛ bol wobɛlbwa sese.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Ba lawɔ dɛ vɛh o waa dii dɛ tɛo aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ kpoo. Waa dɔa sewɛ la, umee dɛ́ won baɡle o naanar waa kpaɔ? N nɛra wechɔɡa waa ba kpoo.

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: O ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa ba pɛ huɡe, dɔɔhna lalbɔɔ binii o chɔ. A lole kɛ o ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ, kɛɛ dɛ teŋe nyosone bwa.”

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Men Korowii tetooraa ba doo bol, o na wahala. O seo la ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha, dɛ kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛɛ kɛ ba. Waa wona ɛ ɡɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpajaŋee dɛ́ na o naanar, ásɛ a che o nɛɛ waa men Korowii aa maɡla bil la ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: O soɡa bini wahala waa baa na habɔɔ la, wɛɛ berɔɔ dɔ mkpa, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ta wahala nae pɛɛpɛɛ. N bonɔɔ o waa aa toɡra, o lɛ nɛndamanta wechɔɡa che nomanta, mɛɛ che o seo la taa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Anɔ waa mɛɛ ba on nomombɔr tɛɛ, dɛ́ tɛo kpeɡri, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kpɔ o te tɛ ba kpoo, ba kuro ja wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛ. O kpɔ o te ɛ saraha, dɛ lɛ nɛndamanta bwa wechɔɡa che, dɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa men Korowii be tɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam haa do kɛŋɔ hambara, ɡel he sie lɛ hɛɛ moo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haah o jaa aa chwao la ɛɛ ba dɔ biirii ɡwaa onɔ la o jaa aa wola on chwae.

english_verse: Make your tents larger! Spread out the tent pegs; fasten them firmly.
translation_verse: Paɡri he tɛnte dea kɛrɛdɛ ó do kan. Gel o ŋwɛɛra do jaŋne, dɛ́ kpaa daa haa kpɔa baŋro la, á kaa bini.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɔmɛ, sihiih aa he kpoe ba kpa, nɛra aa ɡel he fɛɡre. Hɛɛ soh he toli saŋ sihiih waa bwaa, haa ɡɛ saŋ haa do kɛŋɔ luhaah laanee lii kpa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Naate waa tae laanee dɛ́ do kɛ he jaa, o sɔne Nemenɛ Korowii. Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ laanee he Lɛɛ, onee harɛ nɔ bwa Dɔɔ.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: He do kɛŋɔ bitolo o jaa aa vɛoh aa we o nɛɛ kohona.” Kɛ Korowii yerɛ ŋɔ he ba o be, dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: “Tamaa kenii n ɡele, kɛ n tea ɛɛ domɛ he nɛɛ kohona, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: Bandia kohonaa ɡela n laa sie kpɔ he nɛɛ tama, kɛ n nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe nomanta, mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛɛ. Men Korowii maa ɛ he Lɛɛ bola.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: A do kɛŋɔ Nowa ber saŋ ken n be, ɡɛ maa ŋwɛɛra kɛ maa ɡel nee su bɔle harɛ bwa kpa la. Gɛɛ taraken mɛɛ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ n baah aa he nɛɛ di ń tɛr he deŋne kpa.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Hale bwejena jiɡro le a buɡ ta, asɛ deŋɡarere chuɡri aa, n nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la te ɛɛ do lee, n ne he deŋnesɔɔhna fɔo la ɡe aa jaɡa dɔe ba bwa. Men Korowii maa dɔ tedoma tɛɛ laanee bola.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: Jerusalam, wahala bwɛjen peuchɔɡa aa taa dɛ chɔɡe, nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ larawe he bwara, mɛɛ kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ́ berɛ kwaa mae.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: Men Korowiirii dɛ́ baɡle he bii wa, dɛ́ ɡel a chiɡ ba kɛrɛdɛ, bá dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Waa aa toɡra taa aa ba cheɡa he won che kɛrɛdɛ, he ne nyubinikpeɡ tena baah ɛɛ do jaŋnee, komɛlbwa toole he ɔmɛ.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa nyini naɡra aa, n be laa a le. Bɛlbwa waa kpɔ yoi ba pui la aa hen wo.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: Menee ta loɡre, o yon kpɔ nii do hɔla ta dɛ́ lɔa a hɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ buni do dɛ́ loɡɛ dɔmkwa. Menee ta laa tena ɡe, ba kpɔ dɔmkwaa yo dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Dɔmkon bɛlbwa toole bá won kpɔ che he nɛɛ á maɡre. Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ waa dawɛ he nɛɛ la, wɛɛ di bolchɔɡee. Mɛɛ che n bonɔɔna habɔɔ, bá di bole ba dɔma nɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé banɔ la nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo heyaa la, nee lole, hé ba nyɔ! He ta suuɡa dɔe yaa, hé ba, hɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa di pɛɛpɛɛ! Sen ne na-elnee lole, suuɡa ne laa baa yawa, yoɡ ɡe toole a ta!

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Bɔkwa waa hɛɛ chɔɡ suuɡa kwaa aa wola kondikwaa ɛɛ ta, dɛɛ koh kwaa aa wola vaɡɛ ta nɔɔ? Hé cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ no waa maa dɛ baɡle heya, ásɛ dɛ dɔ kondikondɛɛɡa di.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: Hé cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ ba n be, hé no n be, ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpa. N ne hɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee o do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, ɡɛ maa baɡɛ Devid nyoa ŋɔ, mɛɛ dɛɛ nyin o waa kasinteŋ nee la.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Menee ɛo harɛre nɛra sitɔɔ ne nomoa, ásɛ a che o nɛɛ ń baɡle n kpeɡri.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Kpelaa, hɛɛ yerɛ harɛre nɛra baa wola hen jemɛɛ, bá ba he be, harɛre nɛra haa wola ban jemɛ ɡe ɛɛ chwao ba he be. Men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ haa dɛ tom mɛ nomanta, baa ba he bee, jirima maa ɡela he dɔ la wa.”

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Hé nyin Korowii bɔr saŋ haa nao nɔ ta, hé yerɔ, taraken waa bɛne heyaa nɔ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡe ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ, dɛ́ charɛ o liire, dɛ́ berɛ ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ be. O dɛ sune nɛn nɛ, dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ o bambile bwa ne.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Waa haa dɛ lii laa mɛɛ lii, he we-ɛɛla dɔŋa laa mɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Gɛ harɛ ne nyundua baah aa jaŋa la, ɡɛɛ n we-ɛɛla ne n liire ɡwaa he kwa.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: N waa la do kɛ bwaala ne mɛn yon le nyundua dɛ pweh harɛ la ken. A ɡelɔ kwaa baa dua won ɛɛ, nɛra dɔ kondikwaa di, dɛ́ dɔ a dwee ɡe du.

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: Gɛɛ waa aa le n nyoa ɛɛ ba ɛɛ. Maa bol á berɛ ba n be pɛɛpɛɛ, nemenɛ waa maa dɛ nyin la bwa aa ɛa ka tonɛ.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: Silɛɛ nee hɛɛ ba Babelɔn lee, bosɔɔhna nee baa ba he sie tɔe le he ne bwɛjen la ta. Bwejena ne deŋɡarere bwa ɛɛ nao dɛɛ ɡo yela, daa bwa ɡe lɔ kpaŋa.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bela sɔɔhne aa lole la, dajaŋa ɛɛ le a buɡ taa, ásɛ jabalnadaŋɛre le dadɛɛɡa buɡ ta. Gɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ɡeloo Korowii dɔ sɔn kohona, dɛ́ chɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ lii waa men Korowii aa ɛa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ bol waa aŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra. Lɛɛ maa dɛ ba ba lɛ heyaa la telo. Nɛra ɛɛ nao ɡɛ n waa aa toɡra.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛŋhɔɔh kpɔ o te ja Korowii nɛra nɛɛ aa, o bɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii aa men lɛ ja o nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ nɛ.” Nomɛlbwa baa fɔɡɛ o lur ɡe bɛ ŋɔ, “N te heo.”

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: baa dɔ komɛl waa ɡwaa bibaala ne bihaahnaa. Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba sɔn ka n Dea, dɛ́ do le saŋ bɛlbwa, bá kpɔ dɛɛ liiru.”

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa kpɔ ba te ba pɛlo, asɛ dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ nyinu dɛɛ yerɛ o sɔn, dɛɛ di Ona Tɔpere baa wola on chɔɡ, dɛ lawɛ o fɔo la bini kiŋkiŋ la be ŋɔ,

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: “Mɛɛ la he ne Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ taa, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa silɛɛ n soŋebɔr bela. N siwi ɛɛ su kwaa baa fuah ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ n saraha kon ta laanee dɛ́ lɛa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa yerɛ n Dea Korowii soŋebɔree tɛ harɛre nɛra bwa.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii waa tɔ Israel tena sie dɛ le ba ne bojaŋ harɛfale ta la ŋɔ, “N ta ɛɛ ba bane ɡe nee, ba ba ja ba nɛ.” Korowii pwah Israel nomonome

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra haa ɛ he te kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ola, hé ba dɛ́ ba chɔɡ n nɛra Israel tena.

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Nomonome baa ɛ sitɔɔla dɛɛ daah n nɛra Israel tena la, ba do kɛŋɔ nyoŋa ken, baa waa mun no. Ba do kɛŋɔ nyootena aa wola won wor dɛ chɔ dɛɛ dee ɡbo, dɛɛ nyin chɔe.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ nyootena aa dɛ di kwaa kohona aa wola vaɡɛ bwa. Ba do kɛ peteɡra baa wola waa mun no. Bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ anɔ la aa dɛ su o siwi, ne waa aa le tɔnɔ tɛo.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ba yon ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel ya nyin sen nyɔ! Hé ɡel ya nyɔ seŋkpeɡa dɛ́ dɛɛ. Ásɛ kere ɡe yá ɛ ɡɛ ja, á ɡwaa fini kwara.’ ”

english_verse: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away,
translation_verse: Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ́ serewe, dɛ nomɛlbwa waane laa, hale nomɛlbwa aa a mun jemɛ. Ba serewaa, wenaale bɛlbwa aa ba nɛɛ ba kpa.

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa la, ba serewaa, ba dɛ chɔ sɔnɔnɔɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ta.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Kɛ heya, sɔmmɔra bii, nɛra baa dɛ chɔɡ yal ne jwamane tena bii, hé ba bonɔ!

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Ume loroo hɛɛ di nɔɔ? Ume baahnee hɛɛ muɡli dɛɛ mile he nyoo o nɛɛ nɔɔ? Deŋnekpeɡ tena naanar ne nyosonteŋna dwee laa heyaa?

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Hé liire bwaa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ di sɛm he voɡa dajena mune. Hé dɛ kpoo he bii dɛɛ ɛ sarahare voɡa aa lɔ bwebɔɔne aa bɛne nenabɔɔne ta.

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Bwea aa bwara aa loɡaa, he kpɔ le nenabɔɔne ta ɛ voɡa dɛɛ toma. Anee he wee sen saraha dɛɛ tɛa, dɛɛ tɛa mea saraha ɡe. Anɔ nɔ bwa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ, n sie lɛ a ta naa?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Bwejena doree he la dɛ ka kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha, dɛɛ di sɛm.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Hale he kpɔ he voɡa cheɡ he deremi dɛ tɔ ɡbeni a ta. He chwa mɛ, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa, a do kɛŋɔ he ne aa dɛ chɔ mpa ta dɛɛ di sɛm ken. He bambile lawa taeh, he yoɡ he te tɛa he ne a pɛ dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: He dɛ fɔɡle ɔleve noo ne nosɔɔhsoma kohona dɛ kaa tomɛ he voɡ Molɛk. He tomɛ nɛra bojaŋ, hale lalabwɛ dɛɛ nyin voɡfala.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: He chwao ti voɡa dɛ koh, kɛ dɛ vɛh ɡela. He berɔ kwaa dɔ bokpeɡfala dɛɛ nyin voɡfala, haa ɡwɛɡre.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa tenee voɡa hɛɛ ɔma kohona dɛ le n habɔɔ, dɛ soh n waa kwaraa ɡɛ nɔɔ? Maa mwaa he bwa ne saŋ la bwa, waa ɡela haa wola men ɔmɛ nɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Dɛ waane pu heya aa, hé do lɔŋɔ tɛ he voɡdamanta la, á ba lɛ heya. Peu bɛlbwa ɛɛ won che a bwa kaa. Nyoa peu kwaraa ɛɛ won kpɔa kaa. Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dawɛ n nɛɛ la te ɛɛ so harɛ la taa, dɛ́ tom mɛ N Dea Jerusalam.” Nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te bolarawa

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Kwaa ŋwɛnɛ, kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ n nɛra bá ba! Laa komɛlbwa waa tɔ bɔr la kpɔ ta.

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Menee dɔ sɔn dɛ ɡwaa komɛlbwa dɛ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa. N soɡe n kookara waa daŋa ta boɡoroŋ nyundua, dɛ berɛ so nɛra ba tea bini aa chɔɡa ba wechɔɡa wa. Ba pwɛr ba te baah ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba sie sɔɔh, bá dɔ hwɛɡa ja.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Maa teŋɛ dɛ kpɔ waa dawɛ n nɛra nɛ, kɛɛ n baah di ba nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa. Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, ba bwara ɛɛ hwaoh n sie. Menee ta ba, dɛ tɛɛ ba mkpa.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Ba wechɔɡa ne ba sibeɡra waa nomanta, n baah fa di ba nɛɛ taeh, asɛ n tɛr ba deŋne dɛ laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ. Kɛ ane a bwa ba deŋne kpeɡri, dɛɛ ɛ waa ba bambile aa lawa.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: N jemɛ ɡɛ ba wechɔɡa ɛɛ aa chɔɡ ba kɛŋɔ weela, kɛ mɛɛ chaah baa, dɛ́ tɔ ba sie, dɛ́ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ́ larawe banɔ la baa dɛ wi bwara,

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: ásɛ Israel tena wii berɛ kpɛɛra. Banɔ la baa lɔ bojaŋa ne sie bonɔ la, mɛɛ tɛɛ baa deŋnesɔɔhna tentenee, mɛɛ chaah baa. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Kpɔ takpeɡ bol wa, bɛ hel! Gel he taa le kohona kɛŋɔ bɛla! Ŋɔ n nɛra Israel tena be ba deŋnekpeɡ ne ba wechɔɡa baa ɛɛ mɛ la wa.

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ tom mɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ nyin n ŋwɛnɛre dɛ jemɛ, dɛɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ ba waa toɡrɔ, á do kɛŋɔ ba ta Korowii Mmarare vɛɛh. Ba dɛ soŋe waa aa toɡra n be, dɛɛ nyin kɛ n bɛn ba.”

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
