translation_verse: Nɛŋhɔɔhra ɛɛ tomɛ heyaa, dɛɛ teɡɛ he peera, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ parɛ he kooni dɛɛ nyiŋi he daa kooni ta.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Baa yerɛ heyaa Korowii sɔforee, ne Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la bonɔɔna. Harɛre nɛra kondɔɔh ɛɛ ɛ he kwaa, ásɛ he koh a waa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo.

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: He sihiih ne ncho haa dia bwa tonɔ. Hɛɛ so he ɡbaɡba harɛ taa ásɛ he kondɔɔh warɛ kohona, he silɛɛ aa jaɡaa dɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin waa bola dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, n kii ŋwɛɛ ne wechɔɡa ɛɛ. Mɛɛ tɛ n nɛra kembɔree kasinteŋ ta, n ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo, o do le saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Ba sɔn ɛɛ leo harɛre nɛra bwa bini, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa na ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ banee n swee andɛɛɡa tɛ.”

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: N dɛ hɛɡre kohona waa Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ɛa nɔ wa. O kpɔ laala ne waa aa toɡra ɛ batakaare do mɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ. N wer kɛŋɔ hanfale ne o jaa aa kpɔ ba te kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ kaa ba cheremibɔr ken.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Gɛ konduuli yon pere harɛ dɛ le, dɛ kpeɡ la, ɡɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba o nɛra lɛɛ, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa kpɛɛro.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bol waa dɛ do Saayɔn tena ɡbemba. Jerusalam nomanta, maa nyoa tɔ, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa pɔ he nɛra dɔma nɛ. Toɡra baa toɡra la ɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔ silɛɛ kɛŋɔ, kapɛla aa dɛ hɔ jwaana ken.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ na Jerusalam ne o nɛra toɡra baa toɡra, ba koranar bwa ɡe na he jirima. Korowii ɡbabir ɛɛ tɛɛ sɔnfalee.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ kooɡbɛrɛ waa wera kɛrɛdɛ tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Your name will no longer be “Deserted and Childless,” but “Happily Married.” You will please the Lord; your country will be his bride.
translation_verse: Baa hen ‘Bwɛɛ baa ɡelo’, kɛɛ he harɛ ‘Dimɡbia’ yerɛ kpa. Sɔnfale baa dɛ ba he yera laanee ‘Hɛpseba’ dɛɛ yerɛ he harɛ ɡe ‘Biula’ dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii sie lɛ he nɛ, ásɛ o do kɛŋɔ jaa tɛ he harɛ.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Gɛ bonɔmbii yon nyin bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ dɛ lawɔ hanfale la, ɡɛɛ Korowii waa tae ɛɛ ba he jaa ɛɛ. Gɛɛ Korowii sie ɛɛ ba he nɛɛ lɛɛ, kɛŋɔ baa sie yon lɛ o hanfale nɛɛ la.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Jerusalam, n kpɔ nɛra ba so he danjwɛɛre ta baa daahne. Baa nyoa tɔ webaŋa ne jwaana bwa. Baa lii Korowii o nyobaɡa la waa, ásɛ o bɛ he waa soh.

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: Baa ɡel Korowii onɛ bwa ka tel kɛŋɔ, waa bera kwaa vɔrɔwe hen Jerusalam. Wɛɛ ɛɛ bwɛjen nɛra bwa kpɛɛre harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Korowii baɡɛ nyoa, dɛɛ ba ɡela a che o kpeɡri ta ɛ ɡɛ. O ŋɔ, “Maa ɡel he dɔma dɔ he mea di kpa, nɛŋhɔɔhra ɡe aa he senee dɔ nyɔ kpa.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa du mea dɛ koma laanee dɛɛ ba a dii, dɛ́ kpɛɛ men Korowii. He banɔ la haa pa ɡrepo nɔna laanee dɛɛ ba a sen nyɔe n Dea dembaahna.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, hé le kaa, dɛ́ ka kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ he nɛra baa bera dɛɛ ba la! Hé laa bwea aa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ la ta la pa, ó do wer! Hé kpɔ fraŋkaa pa ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra jemɛ.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa be ŋɔ, “Saayɔn tena, he na ɡɛ he Lɛɛ aa dɛ ba! O kpoŋe o kembɔr, o ne nɛra waa lɛɛ ba dɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Baa yer baa ‘Korowii Nɛra Baa Do Goroŋ’, ne ‘Nɛra Korowii Aa Lɛɛ Ba’. Baa yerɛ Jerusalam ɡee, ‘Bwɛjen Korowii Aa Dɛ Nyin’, ne ‘Bwɛjen Korowii Aa Wola On Vɛɛh’.

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: “Umee le bwɛjen Bosra waa lɔ Edom harɛ ta dɛɛ ba nɔɔ? Umee ka dɛ ba dɛ tɔ yaswɛɛma dɛɛ ba kpeɡri ne bokpeɡa ta ken?” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee, n dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won lɛ heya n dɛ ba dɛ́ ba bol yoi maa yoa dɛ pɔ wechɔɡa nɛɛ wa.”

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: “Bɔkwaa ɡela he yal nɔ swɛɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna ta nɔɔ?”

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “N tiɡri harɛre nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, baa tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna ta ken, nomɛlbwa ta men ba chae. Bandia nee n tiɡri ba nɛ, asɛ ba chal ɛ n yal bwa la.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: N liiro kɛŋɔ saŋ maa lɛ n nɛra la telo, kɛŋɔ n tɛr ba dɔma deŋne bɔ kem.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: A ɛɛ mɛ nyokpoa kɛŋɔ, maa nyiŋa n ta nomɛlbwa nae ó ba cha mɛ. N bandia ɡelɔ n dɔ bokpeɡa dɛ won yo dɛ pɔ n dɔma nɛ.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: Bandia nee n tiɡri harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛ fuɡe ba chal ta harɛ.” Kpɛɛra ne wesoŋa

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bol Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la waa. Mɛɛ kpɛɛro waa bwa waa ɛa tɛ yaa la wa. O nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ne tedoma waa dɔa nomanta, o swee andɛɛɡa tɛ ya Israel tena.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “N nɛraa ban, baa men neɡre.” A waa o lɛɛ ba le ba wenaale ta la.

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome laa lɛɛ ba le ba wahala ta, Korowii ɡbabirii lɛɛ ba. Nyina ne tedoma waa dɔa tɛɛ ba waa o lɛɛ ba. O nyiŋi ba nɛɛ le saŋ la bwa.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ o nɛɛ dɛ ɡel Korowii Domadɛɛɡe tea bini chɔɡ. Anomanta, Korowii berɛ ba dɔm dɛ yoo ba.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Anee ba berɛ lii waa aa chiɡa, Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis saŋ la, asɛ dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii waa lɛ o nɛra ne ba sitɔɔla le mpo ta la dɔɔ taraken nɔ? Korowii waa kpɔ o Doma tɛ Mosis la sɛ?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Korowii aa cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ ɡel Mosis ɛ wejena mpo teŋe la, o lɛ sɔn waa wola jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Gɛ ba yon teɡɛ nae kaa deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta a yon ka onɛ la, ɡɛɛ Korowii tɛ o nɛra ona. O tɔ o nɛra sie o sɔn dɔ jirima.

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ba sie ne harɛ le nyundua boɡoroŋ bela haa soɡa ne jirima haa dɔa dɛ́ nyiŋi yaa. Leperaa nyina he fa aa dɛ nyin ya waa la dɔɔ? Leperaa he kpeɡri la dɔɔ? He nyina ne he tedoma la sɛ? Bɛ yaa ta.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya nabaa Abraham ne Jekɔb ŋɔ baa yaa jemɛ kwaraa naa, he te aa yaa ta, henee ya mɛɛ.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he ɡel ya kpaŋe ya laa sie kpɔ he ŋwɛnɛre ta nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ he ɡel ya ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoe nɔɔ? Koh banɔ la baa dɛ tomɛ ne banɔ la baa ɛ he nɛra la waa dɛ́ ba ya be.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: He Dea waa do ɡoroŋ fa ɛ he nɛra kon saŋ bɛl, kɛ taraken ya dɔma kuuɡu, dɛ tiɡru do harɛ.

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Ya do kɛŋɔ nɛra he fa aa wola ya nɛɛ nyiŋe ka, kɛɛ ya ta he nɛra ɛɛ ken.

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ haa wola nyundua pere dɛ́ ba harɛ nɔ? Bwejena fe ɛɛ nae dɛ́ ɔmɛ, dɛ́ yiiɡi.

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ nee yon chɔŋɛ nii ta dɛɛ wure chachacha la. Ba dɛ́ ba baɡle he dɔma he kpeɡri, dɛ́ ɡel harɛre nɛra bwara chel he siwi ta!

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: He fa ɛ ɔmewaa kohona ya fa aa wola a waa liire, bwejena jiɡri he siwi ta.

english_verse: You are the only God ever seen or heard of who works miracles for his followers.
translation_verse: Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole ba nao o do kɛ hen Korowii, kɛɛ dɛ no wejena haa ɛa tɛ nɛra baa dɔ hwɛɡa he nɛ.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: He dɛ lɛ banɔ la baa kpɔ silɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra, ne ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ baa ɛ. He bandia kohona habɔɔ, ya ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa le saŋ la bwa.

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Ya bwa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ kah doŋa, ya wedɛɛɡa kwaraa do kɛŋɔ yakwara waa chɔ puldoa ken. A ɡelɔ ya do kɛŋɔ papooni aa hola, peu ta dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ kaa la ken.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa toole dɛɛ soŋe, nomɛlbwa aa nyin kɛŋɔ he chao. He kpɔ he te sɔh yaa, dɛ koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ ta yaa.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ya mɛɛ hen, ya do kɛŋɔ choh, asɛ henee mamaa. Henee ta ya bwa.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel he baah di ya nɛɛ kohona, bɛ ya wechɔɡa waa kpɔ do he nyu bini saŋ bɛlbwa. He nɛraa yaa, na ya sum.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: He bwɛjena la berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, Jerusalam berɛ dimɡbia.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: He Dea waa do ɡoroŋ dɛ do wer tɛ yaa ya naawa fa aa kpɛɛre o bini la, nii fuuh. Bɔra ya sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta bwa kuuɡo dɛ berɛ dimɡbeeni.

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, dɛ he na anɔ bwa ken aa, hɛɛ soo nyiŋi dɛ́ ɡel ya na waa a ɡwaa yaa nɛɛ kohona naa?

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “N kpɔ n te baɡle nɛra baa wola n waa bɔɔrɛ, kɛ nɛra baa wola n bɔr ɡaaɡɛ laanee na mɛ. N yerɛ harɛ o nɛra aa wola men tomɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Menee nɔ. Menee nɔ.’

english_verse: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwaa n paɡri n nɔɔra kɛŋɔ ń lɛ n nɛra ba deŋne aa kpeɡa, dɛɛ ɛ waa baa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: Ba teŋɔ dɛɛ muɡli n baah, dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha voɡare ta, bodɛɛɡe baa du daa bini, dɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛa.

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ la bwebɔɔne bini ne lala huɡribɔr, dɛ ka yerɛ lala jwaana, dɛ́ ka so ŋwama ta dɛɛ were. Ba dɛ chwe parakoo ola, dɛɛ di dɛɛ nyɔ ola baa kpoora tɛ voɡa dɔr, ne kwaa maa kia.

english_verse: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
translation_verse: Ba yon ŋɔ ba bala be ŋɔ, ‘He laa he te kpɔ ya nɛ, ya do ɡoroŋ, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé leɡe yaa!’ N mee le ba nɛ, n bandia ɡe do ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, nii aa wola dime bwa ken.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: N lii ɡɛ maa tɛr ba deŋne cheɡ, ba chwera bil n sie. Maa sie laa kpɔ waa baa ɛa nɔ ta. Mɛɛ bɔ ba a kemee,

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: ba ne ba naawa bwa wechɔɡa baa ɛa wa. Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba fuh daawiile voɡa ta deŋɡarere dor, dɛ chɛɡre mɛ bela. Anomanta, mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee ɡɛ aa chɛa, ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛ le saŋ la bwa wa.”

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Gɛ nee aa lɔ ɡrepo nɔna sao ta ba yon ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ an chɔɡ, ba ta ɛɛ daa a ne senee’ la, ɡɛɛ maa wola n nɛra bwaa chɔɡ, mɛɛ lɛ banɔ la baa dɛ tom mɛɛ.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ swee Israel tena baa ɛ Juda dea tena andɛɛɡaa, ásɛ ba naanar so bwejena dor. Nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te, baa tom mɛ laanee dɛɛ ba bela soɡa.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Sarɔn ɛɛ ɛ peera dibɔree, ásɛ Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen ɛ bela nae aa dɛ onɛ, dɛ́ tɛ n nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ bambile bwa ne.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ dɛ vɛh Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡ Gad ne voɡ Meni.

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: Aa ɛ nyokalaa tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ sewɛ laa taa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, n yerɛ heyaa he ta sɛɛh, dɛ bol waa he be he ta men chaŋɛ. He kpɔ he ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ ɛ waa aa wola n siwi sui dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N bonɔɔna ɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa di dɛɛ nyɔ sen kohona, kɛ he te, lɔr ne nyɔɡre ɛɛ kpo heyaa taeh. N bonɔɔna sie ɛɛ lɛo, kɛ he te ɛɛ di sihiih.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: N bonɔɔna ɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yelaa, kɛ he te ɛɛ wi lokua wii.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: He sɔn ɛɛ berɛ tooh tɛ nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te laanee. Men Nemenɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ kpoo heyaa, dɛ́ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ duu mɛ kɛrɛdɛ la sɔnfale.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa dɛ nyin kɛ o swee andɛɛɡa harɛ la ta naa, ó soŋe le men Kasinteŋ Korowii be. Wahala aa lɔ he nɛɛ wubwa ɛɛ tonɔɔ, he soh a wa.” Nyundufale ne harɛfale wa

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ta nyundufale ne harɛfalee. Haa webena a fa aa lole la waa lii kpa bwa.

english_verse: Celebrate and be glad forever! I am creating a Jerusalem, full of happy people.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he sie lɛ hɛɛ hɛɡre saŋ bɛlbwa. N dɛ ba Jerusalamfale ɛɛ o do som, ásɛ o nɛra sie ɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: N ɡbabir sie ɛɛ lɛ Jerusalam ne o nɛra nɛɛ kohona. Wii ne lɔŋɔre aa o taa do kpa.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Bechasɔɔhne aa serewe kpa, nɛra bwa ɛɛ soo biɡri. Baa yerɛ nɛra baa di bene lafa bonɔɔnaa, nomɛlbwa sewɔ dɛ o ta ɡɛ dɔe yaa, amɔ te dɛ n taahno.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Baa do deenee dɛ́ so a bini, dɛ́ parɛ daa kooni, dɛ́ di a nɔna.

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: Baa deenee ma nɛra bane ba so a ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ du kwaa nɛmpɛɛne dia kpa. Nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te la ɛɛ biɡruu kɛŋɔ daa aa dɛ biɡri la, dɛ́ ɡbaɡba di ba toma baa ɛa ta.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Baa koh ta pɛɛ bwa, ba tomare bwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ ba. Wekpeɡa ɡe aa ba bii nɛɛ ba bwa. Mɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ ba ne ba naanaree saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Gboli ne pebiiri ɛɛ pɛ bobeŋkpoŋii dɛɛ di, nyujentena chwe kpɔɡa kɛŋɔ nae ken, harɛkon ɡe, teeraa wɛɛ ba dii. A bɛlbwa aa kwaa chɔɡ, aa nɛra ɡee kpo n bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ Saayɔn ta kpa.” Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Nyunduaa n kara, asɛ harɛ ɡee n natiɡribɔr. Debesoo siwii hɛɛ ba wona ma ń jo o ta nɔ? Debesoo taa ń won jo dɛ́ chɔ onɔɔ?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: N ɡbaɡba laa ta ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwa kɛɛ?” Korowiirii bola. Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa pwɛr ba te, dɛ sɛh ba liire chara laanee mɛɛ nyin kohona. Banee dɛɛ ɔm mɛ dɛɛ no n wa.

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra la dɛ ɛ waa aa too ba tea. Ba kpo nao ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a do kɛŋɔ baa kpo nɛn ken, a do kɛŋɔ baa kpo nyoate. Gɛɛ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ mea saraha la, a do kɛŋɔ parakoo chal, bɛlbwa fuh daawiile ɡe aa, a do kɛŋɔ waa dɛ tu voɡa. Kwaa maa kia la taa ba sie ɛɛ lɛ.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡaa ba ta ba nɛ, waa baa dɛ ɔma kohona la. Dɛkalkɛŋɔ n yer ba, bɛlbwa ta chaŋɛ, dɛ bol wa, bɛlbwa ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no. Ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa maa wola nyin.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol, he nɛra haa dɛ ɔmɔ dɛɛ no o deŋna waa la. O ŋɔ, “He wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ mɛ nomanta, he bala bane hah heya, dɛ vɛh heya. Ba dɛ muɡli he baah ŋɔ, ‘He ɡel Korowii baɡle o kpeɡri dɛ́ lɛ heya ásɛ ya na he silɛɛ.’ Kɛ ba ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ ba sihiih dii kohona.

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ no moola kohona aa dɛ le bwɛjen la bini, dɛ́ no ɡbɔɡa aa le Korowii Dea bela. Korowii deŋnetɛra waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ o dɔma moolaa.

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: N bwɛjen waa do ɡoroŋ la do kɛŋɔ haah waa lolɛ bie waa wola weweele bɛlbwa nae.

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Nomɛl noɔ kɛɛ dɛ na waa nɔ dɔŋa ka aa? Baa won vɔrɔwe harɛbir tɔpebeŋkpoŋ aa? Gɛɛ loltea aa wola Saayɔnee lɔ biɡri ó na weweele mɔɔ dɛ́ lolɛ o bii.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ pili haah lolee dɛ́ berɛ vɔmɔ bie aa? He bɛ lii kɛŋɔ saŋ telo kɛŋɔ ba lolɛ n bii aa, mɛɛ tɔ a ŋwɛnɛɛ.” Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa dɛ nyin Jerusalam waa la, he ne ó pɛ lɛ sie. Nɛra haa wia tɛo bwa ɡe hɛɡre.

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Jerusalam ɛɛ dɛɛ heyaa hé dɔ o kondɔɔh la ane hé sie lɛ, kɛŋɔ haah elne yon bu o bie nɛɛ ó ɔr vaɡɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Jerusalam, mɛɛ ɡeloo deŋnesɔɔhna ne harɛre kondɔɔh bu he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, nee waa wola hweeh bwa ken. Hɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ haah yon kpoŋe o bie nɔn ta, dɛɛ nyinu, dɛɛ dɛɛro la.

english_verse: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ larawe Jerusalam tena bwaraa, ɡɛ haah yon dɛɛ ɛ o bie la.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Dɛ he na ɡɛ waa nɔ a chiɡ aa, he sie ɛɛ lɛo, a tɛɛ kpeɡri, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ n dɛ cha nɛra baa dɛ no n deŋna wa, dɛɛ baɡle n bandia nɛra baa ɛɛ mɛ dɔm nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: He na, Korowii kpɔ o torɔɡore dɛɛ ba nii ne kɛŋɔ kawulewule. O baah dɛ fuh kohona, wɛɛ ba ó ba tɛr nɛra deŋne.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Nii ne laalee wɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛr harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa deŋne. Nɛra waa kpoo ba ɛɛ warɔɔ taeh.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Saŋ telo kɛŋɔ n kpoo banɔ la baa laa doŋa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛɛ la voɡa ta daa mune, ne banɔ la baa dɛ chwe parakoo ne mari, dɛ kondikwaa bwa soo siwi maa kia la.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: Maa jemɛ ba liire ne ba we-ɛɛla nomanta, n dɛ ba ń yerɛ harɛre nɛra, ne wobol bɛlbwa tena bwa cheme, ásɛ ba na n jirima.

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɛ waane ba binii, dɛ́ tomɛ banɔ la baa le a nyoa la, ásɛ ba la bojaŋa harɛre nɛra baa wola n waa noɛ dɛ na n jirima ne n kpeɡri la be. Harɛre nɛra kɛŋɔ, Taases ne Lebya dɛ Lidia tena. Lidia tena nɔ jemɛ to tae taeh, ne Tubal ne Grik tena harɛ. Gɛ harɛre nɔ nɛra bee baa ba laŋa dɛ́ ka bol n kpeɡri maa dɔa la waa baɡ ba.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Baa kpɔ he bala baa lɔ bela harɛre la ta laanee ba tɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ koŋkɛɛla ken. Jaɡre ne keeɡore ne nyoɡmare ne kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne anɔ la aa dɔ tɔre baa taɡa nee baa ba koŋkɛɛla ne bala ba tɛ mɛ, n bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ ta Jerusalam. Baa ba a nee kɛŋɔ Israel tena yon kpɔ mea sarahare do kondɛɛɡa bini baa tɛ mɛ n Dea la ken.

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ le ba bini banee ɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena.”

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ harɛfale la ne nyundufale maa dɛ́ ba tae a che n kpeɡri ta dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ la, ɡɛɛ he ne he naanar sɔna ɛɛ ba cheɡa.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Korobifale Tɔpejena dii ne Ona Tɔpere bɛlbwa ta la, nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛɛ ba tom mɛɛ Jerusalam bonɔ.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ leo dɛ́ kaa nyiŋi banɔ la baa ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ la lala kɛ baa serewa chɔ. Dudule aa dɛ di ba ola la aa sewɛ bwa, nii aa dɛ fuuh ba ɡe aa dime bwa, ásɛ ba waa pe nɛwɛnyina bwa.”

english_verse: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
translation_verse: Baa bɛl sɔne Hilkia, dɛ o ɛ sɔfore baa lɔ Anatɔt la bɛl, dɛ do Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta. O bibaa sɔne Jeremia, Jeremia waa waa bola laanee teŋa nɔ.

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa Jeremia be ɡɛ saŋ Amɔn bibaa Kooro Josia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fi dɛ atoro ta,

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: ne ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora Juda harɛ. A habɔɔ, Korowii berɔ bol waa Jeremia be ka tel Kooro Josia bibaa Sedekia aa di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta. A ɡɛ bena la korobie anue ta la, ba lawɛ Jerusalam tena laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta. Korowii yera waa yerɛ Jeremia

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: “N tɔ sie lee cheɡ dɛ tɛɛ mkpa, mɔɔ ba lolɛ la, dɛ n lee cheɡ, menee lee ŋɔ hé ɛ n keame harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.”

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, n ta ɛ bechala, maa wobol jemɛ.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ŋɔ he ɛ bechala, a chɛ kɛ he la nomɛlbwa maa tomɛ o be la be, dɛ́ ka bol wobɛlbwa maa doe ŋɔ hé bol.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Dɛɛ berɛ ba ɔma. Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii tɛr nɔn leɡe n nyoa dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Taraken n kpɔ n waa dɛɛ do he nyoa, hé ka bol.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Na, n lee fini dɛ tɛɛ kpeɡri harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, hé fuɡri dɛ́ kuuɡi dɛ́ chɔɡ, dɛ́ berɛ laɡ ba ir dɛ́ du, bá kpeɡ kɛŋɔ konduula ken.”

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bɔɔ mɛ ja ŋɔ, “Jeremia, bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” N chaŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n na almɔn daa kpale.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “He bol kasinteŋ, kɛ n dɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ n waa maa bola la bwa ɛ ɡɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bɔɔ mɛ ja ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” Asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N na vii bɛl nee do o bini, dɛɛ wure kɛŋɔ waa chɔŋɛ nii ta ken, dɛ wɛle le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Wenaale ɛɛ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔree dɛ́ ba nɛra baa lɔ Juda harɛ ta nɛ.

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba nɛra baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛre ta bwa yera cheme. Ba koranar ɛɛ bao ba cheɡ ba kookane Jerusalam doonyojena ta, dɛ́ ba yoo ba, dɛ́ kuuɡi o danjwɛjena aa baro, dɛ Juda bwɛɛre bwa ɡe.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Ir, dɛ́ kpɔ he te, Jeremia, dɛ́ ka bol wobɛlbwa maa doe ŋɔ hé bol ba be. Dɛɛ berɛ ba ɔma taraken, he ɛ ɡɛ naa, henee mɛɛ ba ɡela he berɛ ɔm ba kohona ba sie.

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Fini, n ɡelɔ he do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro, ne buni pila ne ayaawa danjwɛɛ harɛ la ta, ásɛ he won yo Juda koranar ne ba nomonome, sɔfore ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Baa yoi, kɛ baa won pɔ he nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ja he nɛɛ ásɛ dɛ lɛɛ, men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord told me
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: “Ir la ka bol n waa nɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, ‘N dɛ lii ɡɛ he waa fa aa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ mɛ he toli saŋ, ɡɛ maa mo heyaa loɡla hɛɛ nyin mɛ, dɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, harɛ baa wola komɛlbwa o ta due.

english_verse: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.
translation_verse: Israel tena, he fa do ɡoroŋ tɛ men Korowii ɡbo, dɛ do kɛŋɔ koo kondikonloɡla baa koma ken, asɛ nɛra baa fiiɡi heyaa la, n kpɔ wenaale kohona ba ta ba nɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.’ ”

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Bɔkwa waa n ne he naawa dɔ, asɛ ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ nɔɔ? Ba teŋɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe nɛɛ dɛ berɛ nɛnsale.

english_verse: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
translation_verse: Ba ta n waa bɔɔrɛ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa Korowii dɔɔ? Onee lawɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ, dɛ kpɔ yaa valɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, harɛ komɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta, o dɔ bɔluŋe, biro ne hwel do bela, nomɛlbwa aa o ta kpɔ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra ɛɛ so belaa.’

english_verse: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
translation_verse: Harɛpare ondɛɛɡe taa n kpɔ ba ba so, bá ba dɔ daa nɔna ne kondikwaa aa wera di. Kɛ ba kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la dɛ chɔɡo.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Sɔfore ɡba ta bɔɔrɛ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa Korowii dɔɔ?’ Nɛra baa dɛ baɡle me Mmarare ɡba ta men jemɛ. Nomonome la bwa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛɛh mɛ. N keamere bol waa voɡ Baal sɔn ta, dɛ kaa teŋɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe nɛ.

english_verse: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Korowii, n ne he dɔɔ ja. Mɛɛ tɛr he bii ne he naanar deŋnee.

english_verse: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
