translation_verse: Saŋ besoo laa fraŋkaare, ne bɛle hoeh nɔ ɛɛ ba ɡela ɔ?”

english_verse: I heard the Lord say, “My people ignore me. They are foolish children who do not understand that they will be punished. All they know is how to sin.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “N nɛra ɡɛnɔ, baa men jemɛ. Ba ɛ bechale baa wola liire dɔe, baa waa mun no. Ba dɔ wejema bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ baa wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ te jemɛ.”

english_verse: After this, I looked around. The earth was barren, with no form of life. The sun, moon, and stars had disappeared.
translation_verse: N nyiŋi harɛ nɔ dɛ o ta mar dɔe, komɛlbwa toole o ta, asɛ nyundua ɡe, kwaa aa dɛ chaah bɔr toole.

english_verse: no people could be seen, and all the birds had flown away.
translation_verse: N berɔ nyiŋi n ta nomɛlbwa nae, jumbii bwa ɡe ir kaa.

english_verse: Farmland had become a desert, and towns were in ruins. The Lord's fierce anger had done all of this. The Death of Jerusalem
translation_verse: N nyiŋo, dɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, o bwɛjena bwa berɛ dimɡbia, Korowii bandia kohona la wa.

english_verse: The Lord said: I have made my decision, and I won't change my mind. This land will be destroyed, although not completely. The sky will turn dark, and the earth will mourn.
translation_verse: Gɛ nomanta, harɛ la ta nɛra ɛɛ wiu ásɛ nyundua bwa bir, dɛkalkɛ menee bola maa nsana le. N dɔɔ kpɔ a liire, maa habɔɔ le.”

english_verse: Enemy cavalry and archers shout their battle cry. People run for their lives and try to find safety among trees and rocks. Every town is empty.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta, ne banɔ la baa kpoŋe tori ɡbɔɡa ɡelɔ nɛra bwa chwa kaa. Bane chwao ka sɔh kɔne bini, bane chwa ka teeh bwea. Bwɛɛre la bwa chɔ pɛɛ, nɛra toole a bini.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your land has been wiped out. But you act like a prostitute and try to win back your lovers, who now hate you. You can put on a red dress, gold jewelry, and eye shadow, but it's no use— your lovers are out to kill you!
translation_verse: Jerusalam, he harɛ bwa chɔɡɔ, he do kɛ hanjwamane dɛ do tol-laala, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm baŋa kwaa ne deŋna kwaa do. Bɔkwaa dɔ kwaa kpɔe ɛ he siebɔr dɛ́ di toli ɔ? He kpɔ kondɛɛɡa dɛɛ kwaa he te pɛɛpɛɛ, he sɛnanar bwa vɛɛh hale dɛɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo.

english_verse: I heard groaning and crying. Was it a woman giving birth to her first child? No, it was Jerusalem, gasping for breath and begging for help. “I'm dying!” she said. “They have murdered me.”
translation_verse: N dɛ no lɔŋɔ kɛ haah loltea aa lɔɔ, wɛɛ eeh dɛɛ lolɛ o biloɡle. A kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ Jerusalamee do kɛŋɔ haah waa dɛ wi o hweera pi, dɛɛ tɛɡre nɔɔra ŋɔ, “Akwe, n na wa, ba dɛ ba dɛ́ ba kpo mɛ.”

english_verse: I answered, “I know that you look for truth. You punished your people for their lies, but in spite of the pain, they became more stubborn and refused to turn back to you.”
translation_verse: Belaa n lii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, kasinteŋ ɡbo laa hɛɛ nyin aa? He tɛr ba deŋne, kɛ ba ta weweele bɛlbwa nae, he do ba sibeɡra, kɛ ba ta wobɛlbwa hwele le a ta. Ba ɡelɔ ba bambile do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwe ken, dɛ vɛh kɛ baa charɛ ba liiree.”

english_verse: Then I thought to myself, “These common people act like fools, and they have never learned what the Lord their God demands of them.
translation_verse: Ate, n berɛ lii ŋɔ, “Ba ɛ nyaara ɡbo baa wola jemɛ, ba ɛ ɡɛna, dɛkalkɛ baa waa Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ nyin jemɛ.

english_verse: So I'll go and talk to the leaders. They know what God demands.” But even they had decided not to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ la nomonjena bee n ne bá ka bol. Ba te jemɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la waa bwa kɛrɛdɛ.” Kɛ ba bwa pɛ nyoa dɛ vɛh Korowii waa la ta teŋa.

english_verse: The people have rebelled and rejected the Lord too many times. So enemies will attack like lions from the forest or wolves from the desert. Those enemies will watch the towns of Judah, and like leopards they will tear to pieces whoever goes outside. Enemies Will Punish Judah The Lord said:
translation_verse: Anomanta, nyujente ɛɛ le kpɔɡ binii dɛ́ ba kpoo ba, ɡboli le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ́ ba toɡri ba ola. Ásɛ noniete ba chɔ ba bwɛɛ dahare, dɛ́ toɡri nomɛlbwa waa le ola, dɛkalkɛ ba wechɔɡa kan, ba habɔɔ bera dɛ́ kpo Korowii ɡe ɡwaa.

english_verse: People of Judah, how can I forgive you? I gave you everything, but you abandoned me and worshiped idols. You men go to prostitutes and are unfaithful to your wives.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Juda tena, ɛrɛ waa a chɛ kɛ ń kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heya ɔ? He vɛɛh mɛ dɛɛ tomɛ voɡare a wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe. N tɛ heyaa komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin, kɛ he ɡarɛ kaa bɔ jwamane, he ne hanjwamanere ɛɛ valɛ.

english_verse: You are no better than animals, and you always want sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ jaɡ-bala aa dɔ kwaa di vaɡɛ kohona, dɛɛ nyin jweera ken. Bɛlbwa pɛla lawɛ o dɔŋ haah.

english_verse: I will tell their enemies, “Go through my vineyard. Don't destroy the vines, but cut off the branches, because they are the people who don't belong to me.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo dɔma ba teŋni n nɛra daa kooni nɔna ta, kɛ baa den chɔɡ a bwa kwaraa. Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba teŋni a kpala bwa ta, dɛkalkɛ ba cheɡɔ tɛ nɛra baa wola men jemɛ la.

english_verse: In every way, Judah and Israel have been unfaithful to me. *
translation_verse: Israel ne Juda tena bwa waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ mɛ kwaraa. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Their prophets lie and say, “The Lord won't punish us. We will have peace and plenty of food.”
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra teŋe nyosone ŋɔ, “Waa yaa wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba. Yaa wekpeɡa bɛlbwa nae ba. Laa bɛlbwa aa ya nɛɛ ba, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ lɔr kpo yaa yá serewe.

english_verse: They tell these lies in my name, so now they will be killed in war or starve to death.
translation_verse: Korowii keamere la waa do kɛŋɔ peu aa taa baa kaa ken, Korowii waa la toole ba bini, anomanta, waa baa dɛ bol la ɛɛ ɡure ba nyu taa.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful. Jeremiah, I will tell you exactly what to say. Your words will be a fire; Israel and Judah will be the fuel.
translation_verse: Anomanta, waa Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Nɛra nɔ aa bol ɡɛ nomanta, n wobol maa kpɔ do he nyoa la ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nii ken. Ba ɡe ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ daa nii aa dɛ fuah.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, n kpɔ nɛra le bojaŋ harɛ ta ásɛ ba ba yo heya. Harɛ o nɛra aa lole le saŋ la bwa dɛ do kpeɡri haa wola ba wobol no, haa a mun ɡe no.

english_verse: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.
translation_verse: Ba laa tena jemɛ hɛma tae kohona, baa wola nomɛlbwa nɛɛ sune.

english_verse: This nation will eat your crops and livestock; they will leave no fruit on your vines or fig trees. And although you feel safe behind thick walls, your towns will be destroyed and your children killed. Israel Refused To Worship the Lord
translation_verse: Baa di he kondikwaa bwaa, dɛ́ kpoo he bibaala ne bihaahna. Baa kpoo he peera ne naee, dɛ́ chɔɡ he ɡrepo ne fiɡ daa bwa. Baa chɔɡ he bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, hɛɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta bwaa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, the enemy army won't kill everyone in Judah.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Ane a bwa, tɔpere la telaa, maa he bwaa chɔɡ kwaraa.

english_verse: And the people who survive will ask, “Why did the Lord our God do such terrible things to us?” Then tell them: I am the Lord, but you abandoned me and worshiped other gods in your own land. Now you will be slaves in a foreign country.
translation_verse: Ba bɔɔ ɡɛ aa bala n ɛ anɔ bwa naa, Jeremia, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Gɛ haa dena berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ harɛfala voɡare la, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ba nɛŋhɔɔhra toma ba harɛ ta.’ ”

english_verse: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ waa nɔ Jekɔb naanar be dɛ́ bola baɡle Juda tena ŋɔ,

english_verse: You fools! Why don't you listen when I speak? Why can't you understand
translation_verse: ‘Hé cheɡ deŋne, ɡɛna haa wola liire bɛlbwa dɔe. He dɔ sibie kɛ haa na, he dɔ deŋna kɛ haa waa no.

english_verse: that you should worship me with fear and trembling? I'm the one who made the shore to hold back the ocean. Waves may crash on the beach, but they can come no farther.
translation_verse: Menee Korowii, amɔ haa men ɔmaa? A ta chɛ kɛ hɛɛ chel n sie naa? Menee ɡela hɛŋle ɛ mpo jwɛh, o do le saŋ bɛlbwa mpo aa wola won su ɡale. Nehɛma ɛɛ won ta ɡɛ bɛlbwa, kɛɛ dɛɛ si kohona, kɛ aa won ɡale kaa hɛŋle baŋ.

english_verse: You stubborn people have rebelled and turned your backs on me.
translation_verse: Kɛ he nɛra nɔ te, he ɡɛnɔ dɛ ɛ bambikpeɡ nɛra. He berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ dɛ ɡel n toma ɛɛ.

english_verse: You refuse to say, “Let's worship the Lord! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.”
translation_verse: He ta liire dɔe ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta kɛŋɔ he kpɔ duure tɛ mɛ. Menee ɡela bwaala loɡla ne yoo bwaala ɛɛ nɛ, he kondikwaare ɛɛ do wer, hɛɛ koma bena bɛlbwa.

english_verse: That's why I cannot bless you! *
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡɛ waa aa wera nɔ paŋɛ heya, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa la wa.

english_verse: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra soɡe n nɛra bini, dɛ chɔ dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ nɛra yon harɛ bela dɛɛ lawɛ jumbii, ne bela baa hara dɛɛ lawɛ nɛra ken.

english_verse: You are evil, and you lie and cheat to make yourselves rich. You are powerful
translation_verse: Gɛ kpaah yon pa jumbii su ɡbɛr bini la, ɡɛɛ ba pa laala baa cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡa ta su ba deene. Anee ɡela ba dɔ suuɡa dɛɛ di kpeɡri.

english_verse: and prosperous, but you refuse to help the poor get the justice they deserve.
translation_verse: Baa di kondɛɛɡa vaɡɛ dɛ je nomanta, ba wechɔɡa ta jaɡa dɔe. Baa bilalbii waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, baa kasinteŋ bol dɛɛ cha nyaara ɡe.

english_verse: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!
translation_verse: Waa aa dɔ nyokpoa aa wola were chiɡ harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?
translation_verse: N keamere dɛ bol wa aa ɛ nyosone ɡbosoroo, sɔfore cheɡɛ ba kpeɡri ta dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta, kɛ n nɛra sie dɛ lɛ a ta. Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ baa ba ɛɛ yɔ?’ ”

english_verse: Run for your lives, people of Benjamin. Get out of Jerusalem. Sound a trumpet in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Beth-Haccherem. Soon you will be struck by disaster from the north.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamen dea tena, hé chwa le Jerusalam dɛ́ dɔ he nyu. Hé hoh bɛla la Tekoa, ásɛ dɛ choŋi nii Bɛt Hakerem ɡe, á baɡle kɛ siswɛm balɔ. Wekpeɡa ne harɛchɔɡ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a lovely pasture,
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Saayɔn wer kohona, kɛ mɛɛ chɔɡoo,

english_verse: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.
translation_verse: peteɡra ɛɛ kpɔ ba peera la dibɔr bela, dɛ́ baŋre ba tɛnte deene bar o bwa, ásɛ bɛlbwa ka so bela waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
translation_verse: Baa bol dɔŋa bee ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya kpɔ ya te dɛ́ ka yo Jerusalam! Hé ir, webaŋaa yaa ba laŋa ka yo. Akwe, wee joɔ tonɛ, saŋ kaalɔ bɔr kwaraa dɛ ba bira.

english_verse: we'll attack after dark and destroy its fortresses.”
translation_verse: Jwaanaa yaa ba laŋa ka yo, dɛ́ chɔɡ danjwɛkpeɡa baa maa bar bwɛjen la.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Hé teŋni daa dɛ́ kpɔ ma kwaa haa che a ta jo ka chɔɡ bwɛjen Jerusalam. Jerusalam chɛ deŋnetɛra, dɛkalkɛ nɛra fiiɡa su o ta.

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: Gɛ nee yon bule dɛɛ le bule ta la, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡa le Jerusalam dɛɛ ba. Kwaa chɔɡa ne yoi ɡbɔɡa su o ta. Weela ne dɔŋa bola doe ɡboo mɛɛ na bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, hɛ́ɛ no jae maa dɛ ja heya, ɡɛ laa aa, mɛɛ vɛh heyaa, dɛ́ ɡel he harɛ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa wola won so o ta.”

english_verse: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro bol n be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo Israel dɔma ba pa ba harɛ komɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, baa chaa ɡrepo koo daa nɔna bwa le o ta ken. Gɛɛ a chɛ kɛ saŋ bɛl taa lole nɔ, hé cha nomɛlbwa.”

english_verse: I have told the people that you, Lord, will punish them, but they just laugh and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Anee men Jeremia chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋɔ n bol wa dɛ́ kah ba aa, umee dɛ́ no n be nɔ? Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena dɛ vɛh he waa noe. Ba dɛ mamɛ waa haa ŋɔa n bol la.

english_verse: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
translation_verse: He bandia waa lɔ ba nɛɛ la dɛ we n bambile maa wola won kpoŋa kpa.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ n bandia ba bechale nɛɛ fɔɡbaahna, ne bela bonɔɔnaa aa dɛ cheme, ne baala ne ba haahna bwa nɛ, hale banɔ la baa hwɛɛhra bwa.

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Baa kpɔ ba deremii tɛ nɛra bane, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kooni ne ba haahna ja, ɡɛ saŋ maa tɛr nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta deŋne. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Bechale ne nomonome bwa cheɡɛ sibeɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ nyin kwa, hale n keamere ne sɔfore dɛ teŋe nyosone.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Ba na n nɛra ŋwɛra dɛ ŋɔ kuree. Dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Deŋnesɔɔhna lole,’ kɛ dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna bɛlbwa toole.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Amɔ sihiih kpo ba wedoŋa baa ɛa nɔ ta kenɛ? Akai, sihiih ta ban kpoe kwara, ba siebɔra ɡba dɛ baɡle kɛ sihiih ta ban kpoe. Anomanta, baa chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ bane aa chɔɡa la. Awola maa ba tɛr ba deŋne la, ba wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba a jaɡaa. Men Korowiirii bola.” Israel tena vɛh Korowii ŋwɛnɛ

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé ka che ŋwɛnɛ chɛchɛre ta dɛɛ nyiŋi. Hé bɔɔ ŋwɛnɛbena wa, dɛ́ jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa wera dɛɛ kpɔ o ta, dɛ́ so deŋnesɔɔhna ta. Anee he ŋɔ, ‘Akai, yaa o taa kpɔ.’

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Belaa men Korowii le nɛra baa dɛɛ daah heya dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no bɛla sii!’ Ate he ŋɔ, ‘Yaa ɡɛɛ sɛh.’

english_verse: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
translation_verse: Anomanta, harɛre nɛra, hé no, ásɛ dɛ hweli waa aa dɛ ba n nɛra nɛɛ chiɡa.

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Hé no, harɛre nɛra bwa, n kpɔ wenaale dɛɛ ba n nɛra nɛ, ásɛ a ɛ ba wechɔɡa kembɔr, dɛkalkɛ ba ta n waa noɛ dɛ vɛh men Mmarare ta teŋa.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: N waane laa daawiile baa le ane Seeba harɛ dɛɛ ba, kɛɛ kalamus a sɔɔh aa soma baa le a ne bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la. Maa saraha kwaa haa dɛ fuah la nyin, n sie aa kwaa haa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ mɛ ta lɛ.

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo ɡɛ nɛra nɔ lɔ naa dɛ́ choɡli. Lolanar ne ba bii ɛɛ serewoo, nɛra ne ba daamanar ɡe serewe.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi na! Laa tena le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, harɛ o nɛra aa kana kpɔ ba te le harɛ jaɡa dɛɛ ba ba yo laa.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ ba tori ne lampeare kpoŋe, ba nyu bini kpeɡri, baa nɛn nɛɛ sune. Ba soɡe jaɡre ta a nakpale ɛɛ si kɛŋɔ mpo aa dɛ si la ken. Ba kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ba yo Jerusalam. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena ŋɔ, “Ya no ba wa, asɛ ya bwara yɔr, weweele ne bambiteŋa ɡel ya do kɛŋɔ loltea aa lɔ haah ken.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Yaa won ŋɔ yaa leo kaa dahare, kɛɛ dɛ ka valɛ ŋwɛnɛre ta, dɛkalkɛ ya dɔma kpɔ ba te dɛ kpoŋe ba dɔmkwa, asɛ ɔmee kohona bar yaa cheme.”

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol waa o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ lweyale tɔ dɛɛ ɡbili tɔɔ ta, dɛɛ wi lokua ne kɛŋɔ haa wi he bibambeŋkpoŋ waa sewa ken. Dɛkalkɛ nɛn waa dɛ́ ba ba chɔɡ heyaa la ɛɛ piɡri heyaa.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Ba bwa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ ne bambikpeɡ tena, dɛ valɛ dɛɛ ɛ nyokpɛl ɡbo. Ba kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ayaawa ne buni ken, ba bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla aa were.

english_verse: Silver can be purified in a fiery furnace, but my people are too wicked to be made pure, and so I have rejected them.
translation_verse: Baa dɛɛ yerɛ n nɛra sɔnee ŋɔ suuɡapoŋa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n vɛɛh ba. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kɛ he ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be. Hale he bambile berɔ do kpeɡri dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena kohona ɡwaa he naawa.

english_verse: Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel hɔɔhra ne bilalbii dɛ luhaahna fiiɡa. Hé ɡel nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ so he bini la kpoora, dɛ́ ɡel voɡare ɡe toma, a ɡɛ ɛɛ won chɔɡ heya.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
translation_verse: He bɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋe nyosone nɛɛ teŋɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ bol ŋɔ he dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna la. Ba yon ŋɔ, Korowii Dea laanee la! Korowii Dea laanee la! Korowii Dea laanee la!

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: Hé charɛ he liire dɛ́ ɡel ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛ la. Hé ɡel he waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ dɔŋa.

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Hé charɛ he liire aa, hɛɛ teŋɔɔ so harɛ nɔ maa kpɔa tɛ he naawa o ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la la ta.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: Hé no, waa aa ɛ nyosone taa he yarada do.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: He dɛ ŋwɛ, dɛɛ kpoo nɛra, dɛɛ bɔ jwamane dɛɛ di dansewea, dɛɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare voɡ Baal ta, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡare haa wola an jemɛ wubwa.

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: Waa maa kia laanee he yon ka ɛ, dɛ́ berɛ ba che n sie n Dea bonɔ dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna.’

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: He dɛ lii kɛ n Dea maa ŋɔa baa tom mɛ o bini nɔ ɛ ŋwɛɛra sɔɔhbɔr kɛɛ? N na waa haa dɛ ɛ bwa.

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Hé la Silo bela n fa aa tɔ sie le cheɡ ŋɔ hɛɛ tom mɛ la, dɛ́ ka na waa maa ɛa bela, n nɛra Israel tena wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Hé taa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa nɔ la, men Korowii bol he be keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, kɛ he vɛh n be noe. N yerɛ heya, kɛ he ta men chaŋɛ.

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡɛ maa ɛ Silo laanee mɛɛ ba n Dea maa lea cheɡ ŋɔ hɛɛ tom mɛ o bini, dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ o ta la ɛɛ. Dea nɔ maa kpɔa tɛ he ne he naawa nɔ ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ maa ɛ Silo la.

english_verse: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
translation_verse: Mɛɛ doŋi heyaa le n sie ɡɛ maa doŋi Israel tena baa ɛ he lolanar bini bane la. Men Korowiirii bola.” Israel tena Korowii deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ wa

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Haa ba we-ɛɛla na Juda bwɛjena ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna aa?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Ba bechale cheɡɛ damara ba bil, ba mɛɛnanar ɛɛ mar nii, asɛ haahna kpɔ noo koo men ta, dɛ charama dɛ wɔɔra kɛŋɔ paanoo, dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Nyundua Haŋkooro la. Ba berɔ fuɡe sen dɛ kpɔ ɛ sarahare tɛ voɡare ane ɡe, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ muɡli n baah.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Amɔ men Korowii baahnee baa muɡli ɡɛ nɔ naa? Akai, ba ɡbabirii dɛɛ do ba te sihiih.

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ n bandia waa do kɛ nii ba ta n Dea nɔ ne nɛra dɛ kondɛɛra bwa nɛ. Hale daa ne koo kondikwaa bwa soo siwi. N bandia la aa sɔɔh bwa.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.
translation_verse: N nɛra, he dɛ ba sarahare kwaa fuih yaa, he dɛ fuh ane bwa kon baa dɛ ɛ sarahare o ta, dɛɛ di ane ɡe, kɛ men Korowii dɛ bol he be ŋɔ, hɛɛ won dɛɛ di a bwa.

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Maa lawɛ he naawa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba la, n ta ban saraha kwaa baa fuah kɛɛ saraha bɛlbwa waa ta doe.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: N do ba ŋɔ baa no n wa, ásɛ n ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra. N berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ baa ɛ ɡɛ maa do ba la, ásɛ wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be, dɛ teŋɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ ne wechɔɡa we-ɛɛla aa lɔ ba bini la ta, dɛ chɔɡ ba te kwaraa.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Le awola he naawa aa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba le fini, keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa n teŋɛ dɛɛ tomɛ toroma baa ɛ n keamere la he be.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ba harɛ nɛra aa men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ waa ta teŋɛ kɛɛ dɛ hweli waa ane le ba deŋnetɛra ta. Kasinteŋ toole kpa. Baa a waa bol kpa kwara.

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, hé wi, hé fonɛ he nyuune dɛ́ pa ta. Hé kaa deŋɡarere dor dɛ́ kaa taa wiile, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii, n baah di he nɛɛ n vɛh heya. Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen bini wechɔɡa

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Juda tena ɛ wechɔɡa ane. Ba kpɔ ba voɡare maa kia la cheɡ n Dea maa lea cheɡ ŋɔ baa tom mɛ o bini la, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen binii ba ma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ yerɔ Tɔfɛt. Belaa ba kpoo ba bibaala ne bihaahna dawɛ nii ta ɛ saraha. Gɛ laa n bol ba be, ɡɛ toole n liire ta.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Anomanta, saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao baa wola on yerɛ Tɔfɛt kɛɛ Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen kpa, baa dɛɛ yerɔ Nɛŋkpoa Fɛlembɔjenii. Baa huɡe nɛra belaa ka tel kɛ bɔr aa wola lee do bá huɡ ba.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ ba serewa chɔ dɛ́ ɛ kondikwaa tɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola, nomɛlbwa aa wola lee do dɛ́ doŋa.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Harɛ la ɛɛ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛɛ. Mɛɛ laa silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa te bɛlbwaa kpɔ Juda ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahnaa, hale ba hanfalwaa silɛɛ bwa. Dɛkalkɛ harɛ la ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbiaa.”

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “A ɡɛ saŋ la, baa pa Juda koranar ne nomonome, ne sɔfore ne Korowii keamere, dɛ banɔ la baa jaa dɛ fa so Jerusalam la hoɡaa le ba lalbɔɔne bini.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: A fe aa chɛ kɛ bá boa a nyoa dɛ́ ka huɡa la, aa chɔɔ kɛŋɔ haahra aa ɡela harɛ ɛɛ do wer ken harɛ la bobɛlbwa. Baa pa hoɡa laanee nyenɛ, ásɛ wee ne korobie ne weweela aa do kɛ voɡare a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ aa nyina kohona dɛɛ toma, dɛ kaa bɔɔ ba nyu waa a be la ɛɛ lɔ a ta.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Ásɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena baa ka dɛ́ so harɛ la ta la, banɔ la men Korowii aa lɔ ba peɡre ba so bobɛla ɛɛ dɛɛ nyinu kɛŋɔ, ba fe serewe ɡwaa kɛ ba taa soɡe le. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Wechɔɡa ne deŋnetɛra wa

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ men Jeremia bol o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Nɛn cholaa, waa berɛ dɛɛ ir kpa aa? Nɛn nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ aa, waa habɔɔ berɛ aa?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Bɔkwa waa bala nɛra nɔ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa Jerusalam tena ɛɛ le habɔɔ nɔɔ? Ba sie ta dɛ lɛ waa aa ɛ nyosone ta, baa nyin kɛ bá berɛ ba n be.

english_verse: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
translation_verse: N cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no ba be, kɛ baa kasinteŋ bol. Nomɛlbwa aa lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ charɛ o liiree dɛ́ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa n ɛɔ?’ Bɛlbwa ne o ŋwɛnɛ waa dɛ kpɔ o taa kɛŋɔ jaaɡɔ o sie aa beɡra baa kaa o ne laa ta ken.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Hale chaŋɡale aa dɛ ɡah nyundua ɡba jemɛ komɛlbwa saŋ, ɡɛɛ kwehre ne konkolombiiri bwa ɡe jemɛ saŋ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe sobɔrfala. Kɛ n nɛra te aa jemɛ waa maa dɛ nyin dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona ŋɔ he jemɛ wa dɛ jemɛ me Mmarare la ɡeɔ? Nɛra baa dɛ chwerɛ Mmarare la bera, dɛ́ neɡre heya.

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Sihiih ɛɛ kpo wejerema la bwaa, baa wiluu á do kɛŋɔ bel aa laɡ ba. Baa vɛh n waa la nomanta, ba ta wejema bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.

english_verse: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ ba haahnaa tɛ jafala, dɛ kpɔ ba kooni do nɛnfala nɔɔra ta baa nyiŋi a ta. Nomɛlbwa, le bechale nɛɛ kaa nomonome nɛ, bɛlbwa dɛ nyin kwaa sibeɡra ne. Hale n keamere ne n sɔfore bwa, ba sie dɛ lɛ nɛra faahra ta.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Amɔ sihiih kpo ba ba wedoŋa baa ɛa nɔ ta kenɛ? Akai, sihiih ta ban kpoe, ba siebɔra ɡba dɛ baɡle kɛ sihiih ta ban kpoe. Anomanta, baa chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ bane aa chɔɡa la. Awola maa ba tɛr ba deŋne la, ba wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba a jaɡaa. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɛ nyin n boa nɛra nyoa, kɛŋɔ paa yon komɛ koo kondikwa dɛ boa a nyoa la ken. Kɛ ba do kɛŋɔ daa waa wola nɔna dɔe, kɛŋɔ fiɡ daa nɔna aa wola toole o ta ken, hale a papooni bwa hol. Anomanta, n ɡelɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra ba lɛ ba harɛ dɛ so o ta. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ya bwa ta so nɔɔ? Yá boa ya nyoa. Hé ɡel ya chwa kaa bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara bini, dɛ́ den ka serewe bela. Korowii ŋɔ yá na waa dɛ́ serewe, dɛ do tɛɡchɔɡa nee ta tɛ yaa ŋɔ yá nyɔ, wechɔɡa yaa ɛa dɛ jo o nɛɛ la wa.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Deŋnesɔɔhna dɔe taa yaa hwɛɡɛ, kɛ yaa wedɛɛɡa bɛlbwa na. Ya dɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛ ya dɔ chaeh, ɔmeeree bera ba chole ya nɛ.

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: Ya dɛ no ya dɔma jaɡre hweera aa nyoa aa kpeɡa, dɛ le bwɛjen Dan ta. Jaɡ-bala sii kpɔ ɔmee kohona ba ta harɛ la nɛra bwa nɛ baa chel. Ba balɔ dɛ́ ba chɔɡ ya harɛ ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ o ta, ne bwɛjen la dɛ nɛra baa lɔ o ta bwa.”

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: Korowii bolɔ ja ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no! Mɛɛ tomɛ he dɔmaa kɛŋɔ harɛkonchɔɡa á ba yo heya. Domkpuli aa dorome heya, haa wola won vɔwa kabere.” Jeremia bambile chɔɡɔ o nɛra wa

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: N bambile chɔɡɔ kohona, asɛ n loo ku.

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Hé no n nɛra wii baa dɛ wi bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii toole Saayɔn kpa kɛɛ? Saayɔn Kooro ɡe toole bela kɛɛ?” Asɛ Korowii waa ɛ ba kooro la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he kpɔ kwaa he ɡbabir aa ɛa dɛɛ muɡli n baah, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe, dɛ le harɛfala ta nɔɔ?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Nɛra la do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ, “Lɔmɔɡa saŋ kaalɔ, kwaa koma ba a jaɡa, kɛ ya ta lɛɛ dɔe mɔɔ.”

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Asɛ Jeremia ŋɔ, “Lokua su n bwa, dɛkalkɛ ba chɔɡ n nɛra. N dɛ wi, n bwara yɔr kohona.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Tɛɛɡa toole Gelead harɛ kɛɛ? Nɛra baa dɛ chah weela toole bela aa? Ɛrɛɛ n nɛra ta chaeh dɔe nɔɔ? Ba ŋwɛra aa won tonɛ.”

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: Jeremia berɔ ŋɔ, “N nyu bini fe do kɛŋɔ bule bini ne, asɛ n siniire do kɛŋɔ nenapale aa, n fe ɛɛ wiu chɔɔ ne jwaana, kpoora baa kpoo n nɛra la wa.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa dɔ bobɛl ka so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ le bela n nɛra aa lole. Ba bwa waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, dɛ ɛ nɛnchɔɡa ɡbosoroo.

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ kpa saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ bá teŋe nyosone kɛŋɔ ba yon harɛ hɛm dɛ́ tao la ken. Ba ta sɛɛh dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ.” Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “N nɛra ɛ wechɔɡa aa, ba yon berɛ ka ɛ ane ja, baa jemɛ kɛ menee Korowii aa chɛ kɛ bá tom mɛ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, all your friends and relatives tell lies about you, so don't trust them.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he daamanar kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ berɛ he hwɛɡa kpɔe do he lolanar nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba bɛlbwa ɛ nyosonteŋni, asɛ daamanar ɡe ɛɛ chɔɡ dɔŋa.

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Dam dɛ neɡre o dɔŋ, bɛlbwa aa kasinteŋ bol. Nyosone ɡboo su ba nyoo, baa koh wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Jeremia, nyosonteŋna binii he so, ba nyosone teŋa nomanta, ba vɛɛh mɛ kɛ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ do n nɛra nii taa, dɛ́ daah ba na kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ buni do nii ta la ken. Bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba ɛɛ n nɛra wechɔɡa waa jaɔ?

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Ba nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ hɛm waa dɛ kpo ken, wechɔɡa ɡboo baa bol. Nyoa wobol ɡbo nee baa lea dɔŋa, kɛ ba bambile bini te ta chaahnɛ, ba dɛ haɡre dɔŋa bela.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ń tɛr ba deŋne waa nɔ wa aa? A ta chɛ kɛ ń bɔ harɛ waa do ken nɔ nɛra kem aa? Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: Belaa n ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ wiu dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre bwejena wa, dɛ taa wiile pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, kondɛɛra dibɔra la wa. A bwa berɛ dimɡbia, nomɛlbwa aa a ta kpɔ, bɛlbwa aa nae ɡbɔɡa ɡe no. Jumbii bwa iro kaa, kpɔɡ bini ola ɡe bwa chwa kaa.”

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ paɡre Jerusalamee o berɛ dimɡbia, ásɛ kalampoŋare kpɔ bela berɛ a sobɔr, dɛ́ chɔɡ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre, nomɛlbwa aa wola won so a ta.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, “Baa vɛh n webaɡla maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la waa, ba ta duure kpɔe tɛ mɛ, kɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ta.

english_verse: They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba ɡarɔ teŋɛ ba bambikpeɡ we-ɛɛla ta. Voɡa Baalre nɛɛ ba teŋɛ dɛɛ toma, ɡɛ ba naawa aa baɡ ba la.

english_verse: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Anomanta, kenii men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la ɛɛ bol, ‘Mɛɛ do tɛɡchɔɡa kondikwaa ne nee taa tɛ nɛra nɔ ba di.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɔ baa peɡre harɛre ba ɡbabir kɛɛ ba naawa aa wola an jemɛ ta. Dɛ ɡel laa tena ti ba ka tel kɛŋɔ baa kpoo ba bwa kwaraa.’ ” Jerusalam tena wio dɛɛ nyin chae

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. “Hé nyiŋi waa aa chiɡa nɔ! Hé yerɛ haahna baa dɛ wi, haahna baa jemɛ wiile taara kɛrɛdɛ la, hé yer ba, bá ba.”

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Anee nɛra la ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ba ba warane, dɛ́ ba taa wiile tɛ yaa, ka tel kɛŋɔ siniire aa su ya sibie dɛɛ yɔɔ yaa.

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no wii ɡbɔɡa aa dɛ le Saayɔn. Ba ŋɔ, ‘Akwe, ya chɔɡɔ! Sihiih kpo yaa kɛrɛdɛ. A chɛ kɛŋɔ yá le ya harɛ nɔ ta, ya soŋnibɔra bwa paɡrɔ.’ ”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Belaa Jeremia ŋɔ, “Haahna, hé cheɡ deŋne Korowii be, dɛ́ɛ no waa waa dɛ bol. Hé chaɡle he bihaahna ɡɛ baa dɛ wi, ne he daamanar ɡɛ baa dɛ taa wiile.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Seo do kɛŋɔ nɛnchɔɡe dɛ che ya tokorore ta jo ya deremi. Bechale serewɔ chɔ fɔɡbaahna, asɛ bonɔɔna ɡe serewe chɔ cheremibɔra.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa ŋɔa n bol laanee nɔ. ‘Nɛra serewɔ chɔ bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ haahra aa chɔ kpɔɡ bini ken. A do kɛ nɛra aa kuuɡi boyu a daŋɛ chɔ ba habɔɔ nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ boa a nyoa.’ ”

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o te maŋkurae la, wɛɛ maŋkura o te kɛŋɔ o jemɛ men Korowii dɛɛ no n waa mun, dɛkalkɛ n nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. N waa wer dɛ toɡre ɡe, dɛkalkɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛɛ lɛ n sie. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Banee Ijipt ne Juda ne Edom ne Amɔn ne Moab tena, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ do bojaŋ harɛre ta la. Dɛkalkɛ a ɡɛ harɛre nɔ nɛra ne Israel tena ta n waa kpɔe do ba bambile bini.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: “He bɛ harɛre nɛra bane we-ɛɛla ta dɛɛ teŋɛ. He bɛ waa aa dɛ chiɡ nyundua, dɛɛ baɡle waane aa ha heya, a lole kɛŋɔ harɛre nɛra bane te dɛ ɔma.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Ba nawee waa bwa ɛ wepuu, ba yon teŋe daa le kɔr bini, ásɛ nɛn waa jemɛ kwaa sɛɛh kpɔ o buni sɛoh.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ɛ o bwara, ó do wer, dɛ kpɔ hamba lɔ dadowɛre do o ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ ó che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ bɛ chole.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ba ɛa a do kɛŋɔ yakwane baa saɡa koo, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ doŋi jumbii la ken, ba voɡare la aa won waa bol. Cheɡaa baa chea, dɛkalkɛ aa won valɛ. He bɛ an dɛɛ ɔmɛ, wobɛlbwa toole á won ɛ, kɛɛ dɛ́ won ɛ wedɛɛɡa ane tɛ heya.”

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra bwa Kooro, umee dɛ ŋɔ waa duuree kpɔ tɛɛ nɔ? A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa duuri. Harɛre bwa nɛra ne wejerema dɛ ba koranar, bɛlbwa ta do kɛ hen.

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Ba yon kpɔ suuɡapoŋa le bwɛjen Taases ne suuɡaswɛm le bwɛjen Ufas ta, dɛ baa ɛ ba voɡare bwara. Nɛra baa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh, ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ yale sɔeh wejema ɡe, yon kpɔ yaburum ne yakɔl ɛ a bwara.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ, henee kooro haa lole saŋ bɛlbwa. He baah diu waa, harɛ bwa dɛ chel, harɛre nɛra aa won che he bandia nyoa.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ voɡare aa wola wone ta nyundua ne harɛ nɔ la, a dɛ ba chɔɡa le harɛ nɔ ta kwaraa.” Korowii kpɛɛra yel

english_verse: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Korowii cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ ta harɛ, o wejema nee o ta harɛ nɔ bwa, dɛ che o liire ta dɛ paɡri nyundua ɡe.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: O bol wa aa, bwaala dɛ nɛ dɛɛ kɔɡre nyundujaɡla, o ɡelɔ baama aa dɛ nɛ bwaala ir dɛɛ le harɛ jaɡa. O ɡelɔ bwaala ɛɛ nɛ dɛɛ nyɛɡle, asɛ dɛ ɡel peu ta le bela waa lole.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ta liire dɔe, ba ɡɛnɔ, sihiih kpo nɛn waa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa o voɡare la. Kwaa waa ɛa la bwa ɛ nyosone, a ta hweera dɔe.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: A waa ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe, dɛ ɛ kwaa a wa aa dɔ wesoma. A chɔɡa saŋ telo Korowii ba naa, wɛɛ chɔɡ a bwaa.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ta do kɛ ban, dɛkalkɛ onee ta komɛlbwa, dɛ le Israel tena tɛ o te, dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ o kapɛrɛ nɛra. Koranar Bwa Kooroo o sɔn. Harɛchɔɡ waa dɛ ba

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, hé boa he laala nyoa, dɛ́ le harɛ la ta, he dɔma chɔɔ bar heyaa dɛ́ ba yo heya.

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ doŋi nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ taa, dɛ́ kpɔ wenaale kohona ba ta ba nɛ, ásɛ ba laɡ ba kaa.”

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Ya na wa, bola baa do yaa wa! Yaa won chah ya ŋwɛra! Ya liiro kɛ yaa koh ya weela taa, kɛ yaa le a nyoa.

english_verse: Our homes are destroyed; our children are dead. No one is left to help us find shelter.”
translation_verse: Ya tɛnte deene chɔɡɔ, a ŋwɛɛra bwa chaa. Ya bii bwa kaalɔ ɡel yaa, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole, dɛ́ baŋre ya tɛnte deene, kɛɛ dɛ́ nyin sobɔra tɛ yaa.”

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: N chaŋɔ ŋɔ, “Ya sitɔɔla bwa nya liire, baa waa bɔɔrɛ dɛɛ le Korowii be. Anomanta, aa ban kɛrɛdɛ chiɡ, asɛ ba nɛra bwa lɔ peɡre.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no! Waane dɛ ba, laa tena ɡbɔɡa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, dɛ́ ba chɔɡ Juda bwɛjena á berɛ dimɡbia, ásɛ kalampoŋare kpɔ bela berɛ a soŋnibɔra.” Jeremia wesoŋa wa

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nomɛlbwa ta o nyokala kpeɡri dɔe, bɛlbwa ɡe aa won jemɛ o soɡa waa bini.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Kpɔ kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ ta toɡ mɛ, he bandia ne laa, ɡɛ laa aa, hɛɛ chɔɡ mɛɛ.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Gel harɛre nɛra na he bandia, banɔ la baa wola hen tomɛ, dɛ vɛɛh la. Ba kpoo he nɛra Israel tena dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛ kwaraa.

english_verse: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa wola waa aa lɔ fɔo nɔ ta teŋɛ la, nyotaahna lawɔ.

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: A ɛ waa maa do ba naawa ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ waa do wɔrɔbe ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nii aa won buni mwɛɛla la. N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, baa duu mɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa maa do ba a ta la ta, ásɛ ba ɛ n nɛra, n ɡe ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: Belaa n fe ɛɛ ba harɛ maa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa ŋɔ o ɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la kpɔe tɛɛ ba ó ɛ ba kon. Harɛ baa soɡe o ta fini nɔ.” Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, á ɛ ɡɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ka bol ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa Juda bwɛjena ta, ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna. Bol nɛra la ɡe be ŋɔ bá cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa aa lɔ fɔo nɔ ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Le saŋ maa lawɛ ba naawa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba le fini, keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa n kah ba ŋɔ baa duu mɛ.

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be. Dɛɛ teŋɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla ne wechɔɡa ta. Anomanta, n kpɔ taahna bwa aa lɔ fɔo la maa do ba ŋɔ ba fe ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta la ba ta ba nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba ta n waa la noɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii berɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Juda ne Jerusalam tena dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Ba charɛ ba liire dɛɛ ɛ ba naawa wechɔɡa baa ɛa la, dɛ vɛh n waa ta teŋa. Ba kaa teŋɛ voɡare ane nɛɛ dɛɛ toma. Israel ne Juda tena bwa chɔɡ fɔo n ne ba naawa aa fɔwa la.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Korowii ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡa baa wola won le a nyoa ba ta ba nɛ. Ba wio dɛɛ yer mɛ kwaraa naa, maa ba bee no.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Juda tena voɡare warɔ kɛŋɔ ba bwɛjena ken, asɛ kwaa baa dɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma a ta dɛɛ tɛ ba sihihvoɡ Baal ɡe warɛ, kɛŋɔ Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna aa wara la.

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: Jeremia, bɛ nɛra nɔ naa ta che soŋe le n be tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ ba wio yer mɛ ba sibeɡre wee ta naa, maa ba bee no.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: N nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe dɛ́ so n Dea kpa. Ba ɡalɡa nyu bini kpeɡri, hale dɛ yon kpɔ n saraha kwaa ba fe aa fuh tɛ mɛ la le kaa. Kɛ dɛ n kpɔ wenaale ba ta ba nɛ aa, ba sie aa lɛ kpa.

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: N fa ŋɔ ba do kɛŋɔ ɔleve daa waa kpeɡa kohona dɛ dɔ papooni, asɛ nɔndɛɛɡa su o bwa, dɛ do wer. Mɛɛ ɡeloo peukpeɡ ta kerabeŋkpoŋ, ásɛ nii le o papooni ta, dɛ́ kuuɡi o kpala.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Israel ne Juda tena fa do kɛŋɔ daa men Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dua, kɛ taraken n liiro kɛ ń kpɔ wahala ba ta ba nɛ. Ba wechɔɡa waa a ɡɛ waa nɔ ɡure ba nyu ta. Dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ, dɛ kaa fuh daawiile voɡ Baal ta dɛɛ muɡli n baah.” Jeremia kpoe vɔrɔwa wa

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ men Jeremia jemɛ vɔrɔwa n dɔma aa dɛ vɔrɔwe n wa.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: Dɛ n do kɛŋɔ pebie waa pwɛra ba lawɔ dɛɛ kaa kpobɔr ken. N ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba dɛ vɔrɔwe n bwara wechɔɡa ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya kpo Jeremia ɡɛ ba yon chɔɡ daa ne o nɔna bwa la, dɛ́ kpoo le harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ o sɔn den he kwaraa.”

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Ate, Jeremia soŋe ŋɔ, “Koranar Bwa Kooro haa dɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ nyiŋi ɡɛ nɛn liire ne o bambile aa doa, tɛr ba deŋne, dɛ́ bɔ ba kem, dɛkalkɛ he nɔn taa n kpɔ n waa do.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ Anatɔt baala bane ŋɔ n bɛ Korowii waa bol o sɔn ta, ɡɛ laa aa baa kpo mɛɛ.”

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee. Baa kpoo ba bonɔɔna laa taa, lɔr kpo ba bibaala ne bihaahna ɡe ba serewe.

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: Ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ba kae, dɛkalkɛ chɔɡa tentenee mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta Anatɔt baala nɛ, ba deŋnetɛra bena la ta.”

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: Jeremia ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, saŋ bɛlbwa maa kpɔ n waa bil he sie la, he konee dɛɛ do som. Mɛɛ bol he waa bola dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta waa. Ɛrɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena wobɛlbwa yon dɛɛ chiɡ ba kɛrɛdɛ nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ nɛnchɔɡa ɛɛ dɔ bosɔɔhna nɔɔ?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ daa he kpɔ ba du, he nyiŋi ba nɛɛ ba kpeɡ dɛ dɔ lune dɛɛ nɔnɛ. Ba nyoo ɡbo nee baa kpɛɛre, kɛ he waa toole ba bambile bini.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, kɛ ane a bwa, he jem mɛ, he dɛ na mɛ dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ he waa aa lɔ n bini. Tɛɡre nɛnchɔɡa la kɛŋɔ peera baa dɛ la ka kpoora! Lee ba cheɡ ka tel saŋ baa kpoo ba!

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Saŋ besoo harɛ nɔ ɛɛ ba hola ka tel mɔɔ kpɔɡa bwa hol ɔ? Dɛkalkɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena soɡe o ta, a ɡel kpɔɡ bini ola ne jumbii bwa serewe. A bwa habɔɔ la, nɛra la dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Korowii aa waa aa pu yaa nae ba.’ ” Gɛ Korowii aa chaŋe Jeremia

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Jeremia, he ne nɛra chwao, he ta ban wone dɛ koh aa, ɛrɛɛ he ne jaɡre ɛɛ ba wona chwa ɔ? He lɔ naa bɔchaah ta naa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona chwa Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa kɔr bini nɔ?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: He dɔɔranar ne nimanar, dɛ he ɡbabir lolanar lee tɛ, ba taa cheɡɛ chiŋ baa mooli. A lole kɛŋɔ he ne ba bol waa dɛɛ mamɛ, kɛ dɛɛ berɛ ba yaradae.”

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ vɛh n nɛra Israel tenaa, nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te la. Mɛɛ lawɛ nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba waa do ba dɔma nɔn ta.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: N ɡbabir nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te chwa mɛ, ba do kɛŋɔ nyujente waa lɔ kpɔɡ bini dɛɛ kɔr mɛ, anomanta, n hah ba.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: N nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te do kɛŋɔ jumbie kɔle aa baro cheme dɛ́ yoo. Hé yerɛ kpɔɡ bini ola á bwa ba cheme dɛ́ di o ola.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Peteɡra kpɔ ba peera ba tiɡri n daa koo do harɛ, kɛŋɔ harɛre ane koranar aa chɔɡ n nɛra la. A ɡelɔ koo n sie aa dɛ lɛ o ta chɔɡ, dɛ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Laa tena baa wara lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ deŋɡarere dor, dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba chɔɡ nɛra ne kwa. Men Korowiirii kpɔ ba dɛɛ ba, bá ba yoo ba, dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ la bwa ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ deŋnesɔɔhna dɔ.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: N nɛra ɛɛ du meaa, kɛ sɔɔhnee baa ba koma, dɛ́ koh pɛɛpɛɛ baa wola komɛlbwaa dɔ. N bandia kohona nomanta, ba koo kondikwaa bwa chɔɡɔ sihiih kpo ba.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa, ba so bar harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ n nɛra Israel tena ba ba chɔɡo la, mɛɛ le ba ne ba harɛre taa, kɛŋɔ ba yon fuɡri dua la ken, dɛ́ lɛ Juda tena le ba bini.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, mɛɛ berɔ dɔ tedoma tɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa, dɛ́ berɛ ba ba ne ba buɡ ta. Ásɛ bɛlbwa kaa o nɛra bini, ne harɛ waa le o ta.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ba wono charɛ ba liire dɛ hweli n nɛra we-ɛɛla, dɛ won dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ n sɔn ta ŋɔ, ‘N ta aa lole saŋ bɛlbwa’ nɔ ɡɛ ba fa aa baɡle n nɛra ba yon ŋwɛɛ voɡ Baal la aa, amɔ ba ɡee ja n nɛra nɛɛ, ásɛ ba wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Dɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no aa, mɛɛ le ba nee kɛŋɔ baa fuɡri dua ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ka yawɛ yapondɛɛɡe dɛ́ ɛo kiriso vɔwɛ he chara. Bɛ ɡel nee leɡo.”

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n kaa yawɛ yapondɛɛɡe kiriso la, dɛ kpɔ vɔwɛ n chara, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ n be la.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Belaa o berɛ bol waa n be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Kpɔ kiriso haa yawa dɛɛ vɔwɛ chara la, dɛ́ kpɔ kaa Yufretis Moo ta ka sɔh o bwebɔɔne bini taraken.”

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n laŋɔ dɛ ka kwi bela maa kpɔa huɡe la. Kɛ dɛ o bwa chɔɡɔ kwaraa, o ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ doe.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii bol waa n be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Gɛ kiriso la aa chɔɡa la, ɡɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba Juda ne Jerusalam tena baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo la chɔɡa.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Gɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔ vɛh n waa ta teŋa. Ba deŋne kpeɡri, ba nyu bini do kpeɡri kohona, asɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ harɛre ane voɡare. Anomanta, baa doo kɛŋɔ kiriso waa chɔɡa, waa wola ɛɛ doe kpa la ken.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Gɛ ba yon kpɔ kiriso vɔwɛ chara la, ɡɛɛ n lawɛ Israel ne Juda tena vɔwɛ n te. Ásɛ ba fe ɛ n nɛra, dɛ́ kpɔ kpɛɛra ne duure tɛ mɛ. Kɛ ba vɛh n waa noe. Men Korowiirii bola.” Sen loŋa ane wa

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Jeremia, ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ sen loŋ bɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé do sen o bini ó su. Baa chaŋo ŋɔ ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ sen loŋ bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ ó su sen.

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Ásɛ he berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Korowii dɛ ba ɡela nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta dɛɛ, kɛŋɔ baa nyɔ sen ken. Hale koranar baa ɛ Kooro Devid naanar, ne sɔfore ne n keamere, dɛ banɔ la baa soɡe Jerusalam bwa jao.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Mɛɛ laɡ baa lɔ dɔŋa, kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ loŋa lɔ dɔŋa a paɡre la ken. Hale mɛɛnanar ne ba bii bwa. Maa bɛlbwa sumii na, kɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ tedoma tɛ nomɛlbwa ŋɔ maa ban chɔɡ. Men Korowiirii bola.” Jeremia ja nɛra mbarafo ɛɛ wa

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Israel tena, Korowiirii bol waa la. Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no o be, he bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Hé tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ jirima mɔɔ o ɡel bɔr bir, ásɛ he bɛ naa lɔ deŋɡarere dor. Hé dɛ nyin kɛ bɔr chaah he nɛ, kɛ wɛɛ berɔ ɡel bɔr chaahna la berɛ biro ta he nɛ, dɛ́ bir kpirkpir ken.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he vɛh o waa la noe yaa, sɔeh mɛɛ ba sɔeh dɛ́ wi, he mbarafo wa. Mɛɛ wiu kohona siniire yɔɔ mɛ, lawa baa lawɛ Korowii nɛra laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta la wa.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ ń ŋɔ kooro ne o nya be ŋɔ, “Hé le he kookane ta tu ba, dɛkalkɛ he kooɡbɛrɛre aa wera dɛ́ ba he nyuune ta lee.”

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Baa tɔɔɡe Juda weekaŋle harɛbɔr bwɛjena ɡbenii baa wola won yaa, dɛkalkɛ ba dɔma baa chɔ bar bwɛɛ la. Baa lawɛ Juda tena bwaa kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: Hé ha sie nyiŋi, he dɔma le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba. Leperaa nɛra baa lɔ he nɔn ta, he koh ba waa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la dɔɔ?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra haa dɛ lii ba he daamanar baa yo heya, dɛ pɔ he nɛɛ he do ba lɔɡa aa, bɔkwa waa hɛɛ ba bola ɔ? Hɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ wɛɛ ba lola ken.

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Kɛ he berɔ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ pu yaa nɔɔ?” He wechɔɡa kohona waa he bwara laala kɛɛ, a ɡel he bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ kohona la.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Itiopia te ɛɛ won charɛ bwadabi aa? Kɛɛ noniete ŋɔ waa nyin kɛ o bwara lɛɡre aa? Gɛɛ he nɛra wechɔɡa aa jooɡe heyaa nɔ aa wola won ɡel hɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: “Mɛɛ lɔ heyaa peɡre kɛŋɔ, peu yon ta haahra ɛɛ kaa la ken.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé dɔ laanee la, anee n maɡɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ he vɛɛh mɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡare a wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡbaa he bwara laalaa kaa nyundua, ásɛ nɛra na he ncho dii, sihiih kpo heya.

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: N jemɛ he jwamane ne pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla wa. Dɛ na ɡɛ haa tomɛ voɡa deŋɡarere dor ne kpɔɡ bini ba fe aa kia la. Jerusalam tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ. Saŋ besoo he kah doŋa ka tel ɔ?”

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa bol men Jeremia be, hwel bɛl waa dɛ́ ba cheɡa waa nɔ. O ŋɔ,

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Nomonjena tomɛ ba bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá ka nyin ne. Ba la kwaa aa won nee lɛɛ ta ba ta nee nae. Ba kpɔ ba polviine berɛ ba pɛɛ, ba bambile chɔɡɔ ba hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa bɔle nyuune, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba loo kuu.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Harɛ la holɔ dɛɛ peɡri dɛkalkɛ bwaala aa nɛ, asɛ paara bambile chɔɡ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa bɔle nyuune, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba loo kuu.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Hale kweɡlinee chwao ɡel o bifola, dɛkalkɛ kpɔɡa toole ó chwe.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Kpɔɡ bini keeɡore cheɡɛ deŋɡarere dor, dɛɛ hɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ kalampoŋare ken, aa won na kɛrɛdɛ dɛkalkɛ kpɔɡa toole á chwe.

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: N nɛra wio dɛɛ noo mɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, a lole kɛŋɔ ya wechɔɡa ɡelɔ ya di bolchɔɡe, koh he sɔndɛɛɡe la wa dɛ́ cha yaa. Dɛkalkɛ ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoe kohona.

english_verse: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
translation_verse: He ɡbo nɛɛ ya Israel tena sie dawɛ, he ɡboo lɛ yaa dɛɛ le wenaale ta. Ɛrɛɛ he do kɛŋɔ hɔɔh harɛ nɔ ta kɛɛ nɛŋkaa waa baa so ya bini tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo nɔɔ?

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ he do kɛ nɛn waane aa piɡru, kɛɛ banyoo waa wola kpeɡe dɛ́ won lɛ o nɛra nɔɔ? N Naa Korowii, kasinteŋ he ja ya nɛ, he sɔn dawɛ ya nɛ, anomanta, bɛ yaa vɛh.’ ”

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Korowii bol nɛra nɔ waa ŋɔ, “Ba dɛ nyin bá chwa le n be, dɛ́ kaa valɛ bobɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin. Anomanta, men Korowii sie aa ba nɛɛ lɛ, mɛɛ lii ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa waa dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ wedɛɛɡa soŋa dɛ́ tɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ ba dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, kɛ maa wii baa wia dɛɛ noo mɛ laanee no. Ba fuh sarahare dɛ ɛ mea sarahare dɛɛ tɛ mɛ, kɛ n sie aa a ta lɛ. Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpoo ba laa ta, ásɛ lɔr ne weechɔɡa ɡe kpoo ba.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Anee n ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, keamere la bane teŋɔ dɛɛ bol nɛra la be ŋɔ, baa laa kɛɛ lɔr bɛlbwa nae ba, dɛkalkɛ ba ŋɔ he baɡ ba nyoa ŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ɡboo dɛ́ do ya harɛ nɔ ta.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Keamere la teŋe nyosone dɛɛ bol wa n sɔn ta. N ta ban tomɛ kɛɛ dɛ lee ba, n ta wobɛlbwa ɡe bolɛ ba be. Waa baa dɛ na chaahna ta, ne anɔ la aa chiɡ kerekere, dɛ voɡa toma waa baa dɛ bol la bwa ɛ waa ba ɡbaɡba aa liira.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Laa ne lɔr la nomanta, nɛra baa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡ ba la ɡe ɛɛ serewoo, ásɛ ba paa ba ta Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna. Nomɛlbwa aa lee do dɛ́ huɡe ba ne ba haahna ne bibaala dɛ bihaahna bwa. Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔ ba nyubinikpeɡ baa ɛa la kembɔr kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Korowii do mɛ ŋɔ, ń bol n suna maa dɛ di waa ba be ŋɔ, “Siniire dɛ yɔɔ mɛ chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa aa wola tonɛ, n nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba, kɛŋɔ bitolo waa wola baa bɛlbwa jemɛ, ba doo bol kohona la wa.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: N leɔ kaa kpɔɡ bini naa, n dɛ na nɛra baa kpoo ba laa ta, n berɔ ba bwɛjen la bini ɡe aa, n dɛ na nɛra lɔr aa kpo ba ba serewe. Korowii keamere ne sɔfore bwa lɔ harɛ la ta, baa jemɛ waa Korowii aa ŋɔa bá ɛ.”

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Nɛra la bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he deno vɛh Juda tena kwaraa kɛɛ? He hah Saayɔn tena ɡe aa? Ɛrɛɛ he do yaa bola yaa wola won dɔ chaeh nɔɔ?
