english_verse: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.
translation_verse: Ya na ya wechɔɡa ne ya naawa bolchɔɡe baa dia, ya bwa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛɛ kohona.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Lii nyoa haa baɡɛ yaa la, dɛ bɛ yaa nyiŋi vah, bɛ ɡel Jerusalam tena di sihiih, belaa he kookara che dɛ dɔ jirima la. Bɛ fɔo ya ne haa fɔwa la chɔɡ.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Harɛre voɡare aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe ɛɛ won ɡel bwaala nɛ aa? Nyundua ɡe ɡbo ɛɛ won ɡel bwaala wir aa? Akai, hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ ɡbosoroo dɛ won ɛ. Ya hwɛɡa bwa lɔ he nɛ, dɛkalkɛ he ɡboo wona dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii bol n be ŋɔ, “Hale Mosis ne Samoɛl ba fa aa ɛ n bonɔɔna baa che n sie dɛɛ soŋe kwaraa naa, maa nɛra nɔ nɛɛ sune. Gel ba kaa, bá le n sie bonɔ kaa.

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ ba bɔɔre ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa yaa ba kaala aa,’ hé ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘Weechɔɡaa dɛ́ kpoo bane, baa kpoo bane ɡe laa taa, ásɛ lɔr kpoo bane ɡe, mɔɔ ba lawɛ bane laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛre ta.’

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: Men Korowii ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ wekpeɡa bele anaarɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɡela ba na. Baa kpoo ba laa taa, ásɛ nyootena tuɡ ba ka ta. Jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini olaa dɛ́ di ba ola kabora.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre nɛra bwa bambile teŋe ba wa, waa Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea bibaa Manasɛ aa ɛa Jerusalam la wa.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam tena, umee dɛ́ sune he nɛɛ jaɔ? Nomɛl lole dɛ́ wi tɛ heya aa? Umee dɛ́ bɔɔ heyaa he bokpeɡa dɔe waa jaɔ?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: He berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, he deno na teŋɛ dɛɛ vɛɛh mɛ. Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee dawɛ he nɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ heya, maa won dɔ tedoma tɛ heyaa kpa. Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɔ heyaa peɡre, ɡɛ ba yon palɛ mea la ken, bwɛjen doonyojena la ta. Mɛɛ kpoo he ne he biirii, dɛkalkɛ he ta liire charɛ le he wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre ta.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo luhaahna warɛ harɛ la ta, dɛ́ ɡwaa mpo nyoa hɛŋle. Mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔm ba chɔɡ bonɔɔna ne ba nyare webaŋkpelaa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bambiteŋa ne ɔmee kohona ba ta he nɛ.

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Bii banuanɛ nya bwara ɛɛ yɔroo ó hwaahɡe. Webaŋkpela ɛɛ berɔ jwaanaa, ásɛ sihiih kpoo o bambile ɛɛ weo. Mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma ba kpoo he bini banɔ la baa kaa la. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Asɛ men Jeremia ŋɔ, “Akwe, n nya, n na waa kɛ haa lol mɛ, harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa hah mɛ dɛɛ yoo mɛ. N ta bɛl kon kemɛ kɛɛ dɛ kemɛ le bɛl be, kɛ nɛra bwa ɡarɔ dɛɛ taah mɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, mɛɛ lɛ heyaa, ásɛ wobɛlbwa maɡre tɛ heya, dɛ́ ɡel he dɔma ba ɡuŋi heyaa harɛ, he wenaale ne suna dii tɔpera ta.

english_verse: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won ku buni ɔ? Gɛɛ haa wola won yo he dɔma baa do kɛŋɔ buni ayaawa aa koo o ta o do kpeɡri, ba le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo he do he dɔma lɔɡa dɛɛ tom ba harɛfale haa wola o ta jemɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ n bandia iro dɛɛ fuh kɛŋɔ nii dɛɛ ba he nɛ.”

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Belaa men Jeremia ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he ɡbabir jemɛ waa nɔ mun, lii n wa, dɛ́ nyiŋi n nɛ. Bɔ n dɔma baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo kem. Bɛ so nyiŋi bá dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ba kpo mɛ, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ he waa mɛɛ na anɔ bwa.

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ, haa bol waa n be la, n cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ noa. A ɛɛ mɛ silɛɛ n bambile lawa, dɛkalkɛ henee dɔɔ mɛ.

english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: N laa n te kpɔ nɛra baa soɡa dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa, dɛɛ hɛɡre kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛra bini. N ɡbo soɡo, dɛkalkɛ he ja n nɛ, asɛ bwaawee far mɛ.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ n bonyɛɡa aa wola tonɛ, asɛ ba do mɛ bol kohona, maa wola chaah dɔ nɔɔ? He do kɛŋɔ nenabɔɔ kɛɛ bule hwel saŋ, nee aa wola toole a ta tɛ mɛ kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Anomanta, waa Korowii aa dɛ bol men Jeremia be laanee nɔ, “He berɔ ba n be naa, mɛɛ lɛɛ, ásɛ he berɛ ɛ n keame. He dɛ bol wobodɛɛɡa, dɛ anchɔɡa laa aa, hɛɛ bol n waa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ. Gel nɛra nɔ no, dɛ́ ba he be, he te laa dɛ́ la ba be.

english_verse: because I am making you strong, like a bronze wall. They are evil and violent, but when they attack,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo he do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ tɛ nɛra nɔ, danjwɛkpeɡ tenten baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo. Baa yoi kɛ baa won pɔ he nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛɛ le nɛnchɔɡa nɔn ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba nyubinikpeɡ waa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe bwa ɛ pɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii berɛ bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé mo haah dɛ́ lolɛ bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna Juda harɛ ta bonɔ.”

english_verse: I'll tell you what's going to happen to children and their parents here.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ waa Korowii aa bol bibaala ne bihaahna baa lol ba harɛ nɔ ta, ne ba nyare dɛ ba mɛɛnanar be laanee teŋa nɔ.

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: “Weechɔɡaa dɛɛ ba ba kpoora, nomɛlbwa aa ban wi kɛɛ dɛ huɡ ba, ásɛ a chɔ kɛŋɔ puldoa haahra aa ɡela harɛ ɛɛ do wer. Laa kɛɛ lɔree dɛ́ kpo ba bá serewe, ásɛ ba ola berɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola kondikwa.”

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Lwe ba dem bɛl ta naa, bɛ bela jo. Bɛ lokua dɔ tɛ nomɛlbwa, maa andɛɛɡaa swee tɛ n nɛra ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna, kɛɛ dɛ baɡle n nyina kɛɛ dɛ sune ba nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Suuɡa tena ne nyaara bwaa dɛɛ ba serewa he harɛ nɔ ta. Nomɛlbwa aa ban huɡe kɛɛ dɛ́ wii ba. Bɛlbwa aa konee kpɔ mɔn o te kɛɛ dɛ́ fonɛ o nyu, á baɡle kɛ o dɛ di suna.

translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa kondikwaa kɛɛ senee yawɛ tɛ o dɔŋ bɛl o lole aa sewa wa, dɛ́ kpɔ larawo bwara. Bɛlbwa aa o dɔŋ bwaraa larawe, hale nɛn o nya kɛɛ o mɛɛ aa sewa wa.

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: Bɛ dem nɛra aa cheme bela dɛɛ di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ ba sie jo. He ne ba bɛ pɛ so dɛ́ di kwa kɛɛ dɛ́ nyɔ sen.

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: He bol waa nɔ baɡ ba aa, baa bɔɔre waa aa bala men Korowii ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ ń tɛr ba deŋne kohona. Dɛ berɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ wechɔɡa besoo bolchɔɡee ba di, webesoo ba ɛ dɛ jo men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ nɛɔ?

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Asɛ he ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘He naawa aa berɛ habɔɔ kpo men Korowii dɛ ka teŋɛ voɡare nɛɛ dɛɛ toma la waa. Ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ ɡel me Mmarare ta teŋa,

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: kɛ he wedoŋa berɔ ɡwaa anɔ la he naawa aa ɛa. He bwa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, haa men duu.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ heyaa ka ta harɛfale he naawa aa wola o ta jemɛ bwa ta, ásɛ he kaa tomɛ voɡare bela chɔɔ ne jwaana. Maa he nɛɛ suna ba!’ ”

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ nɛra aa n sɔn taa dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ men Korowii maa lole saŋ bɛlbwa laanee fa lawɛ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta kpa.

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Kɛ baa berɔ ŋwɛɛ n sɔn taa ŋɔ men Korowii maa lole saŋ bɛlbwa laanee lawɛ Israel tena le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛ ta, ne harɛre waa lɔ ba peɡre a ta la ta. Mɛɛ berɔ kpɔ ba ba harɛ ba ɡbaɡba aa le o ta, n kpɔ tɛ ba naawa la.”

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo dɔma baa wara ba lawɛ nɛra nɔ, kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ nee toma yon dɛɛ lawɛ pɛŋa la ken. Dɛ́ ɡel dɔma ɡaaɡe ba bɔr bwea ne deŋɡarere dɛ bwebɔɔne bwa ta, kɛŋɔ kpaahna yon dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ́ kpo la ken.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ na waa bwa baa dɛ ɛ, a bwa chɔ o sie. Gɛɛ baa wola won kpɔ ba wechɔɡa ɡe sɔɔh.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa, dɛ do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ n chwa baa marɛ n sibeɡra wee. Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ le harɛ jaɡaa dɛ́ ba he be ba ŋɔ, “Ya naawa ta komɛlbwa dɔe, ka ja voɡare aa ɛ konsale aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe ta.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ a do tenaa, mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre la nɛra na n kpeɡri ne n kan maa doa kohona, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii aa chɛ kɛ bá tom mɛ.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Juda tena, ba kpɔ buni chwerɛ he wechɔɡa dawɛ he bambili ta, dɛ kpɔ kwɛrboɔ dia ɡwine dawɛ nyeɡlare aa paaɡe saraha kwaa loŋkoni la ta.

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: He nɛra laŋɔ kaa tomɛ kwaa haa dɛ ɛ sarahare a ta, ne voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa baa paaɡa dajena mune ne deŋɡarere,

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Hɛɛ paŋɛ harɛ maa kwaara cheɡ heya o ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon laanee. Mɛɛ kpɔ heyaa do he dɔma lɔɡa hɛɛ tom ba, harɛ haa wola o ta jemɛ bwa ta, dɛkalkɛ he ɡelɔ n baah di, waa wola sɔɔh bwa.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee. “Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dawɛ nɛwɛnyini nɛ, dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ o bokpeɡa ta dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo men Korowii la, o bwɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dawɛ n nɛɛ la, o na som.

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Naate ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ daa baa duu nee nyoa, o dɛ ta lune kaa nee la ta. Hwel cheɡɔ waa, aa on wobɛlbwa ɛ, dɛ o te ta dɔ papooni. Bwaala ta nɛɛ benanyobir kwaraa naa, dɛ o ta won nɔna.

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ nɛwɛnyini bambile bini waɔ? Wobɛlbwa toole o bini ka ja neɡra ɡbo, nomɛlbwa aa wola won kwaaro.

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Men Korowii te, n dɛ nyiŋi nɛn liire bini, dɛ́ jemɛ anɔ la bwa aa lɔ o bambile ta. Dɛ́ che bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla ta tɛo, o kembɔr ɡɛ aa chɛo.”

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ nyin suuɡa sibeɡra ne la, o do kɛŋɔ jal waa tee hala aa wola o kwaa ɛɛ. Naate soɡa bini tama la, wɛɛ paŋɛ o kondɔɔh laanee, ásɛ a habɔɔ ó na kɛ o ɛ ɡɛnewa.

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ Israel tena sie dawɛ, sihiih ɛɛ kpo nɛra baa berɛ habɔɔ kpoe bwaa. Nɛra baa chwaa le he be bwa sɔna ɛɛ nyoɡroo kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa ken. Dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh hen haa do kɛ nee waa dɛ bule saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ tɛ Israel tena.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, chaah mɛ ásɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Lɛɛ mɛ ásɛ n dɔ bosɔɔhna kohona, dɛkalkɛ henee mɛɛ kpɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Juda tena teŋɔ dɛɛ bol n be ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa waa Korowii aa ŋɔa aa chiɡu la dɔɔ? Gel á ba ya na.’

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: N ta vɛɛh kɛŋɔ mɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre, maa nyin kɛ he kpɔ sibeɡra tɔpere bɛlbwa ba ba nɛ. Wobɛlbwa aa le n nyoa la chɔ he sie.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Bɛ men ɔmee kohona dɛɛ do, henee n chwa baa marɛ sibeɡra tɔpere.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛ, kɛ bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ. Gel ɔmee laɡ ba kohona, dɛ laa ɔmee kohona kpɔ n nɛ. Gel ba na he sibeɡra tɔpere la, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, dɛ́ berɛ chɔɡ ba ja.” Ona Tɔpere dii wa

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: dɛ́ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no Korowii wa, hé Juda koranar ne nomɛlbwa waa soɡe Jerusalam dɛ che doonyoa nɔ ta dɛɛ jo bwa.

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he cheɡ deŋne dɛ no n be, he ta bone bɛlbwa kpɔe kpɔ bwɛjen nɔ doonyojena ta Ona Tɔpere ta, dɛ ɡel tɔpere la do ɡoroŋ, he ta toma bɛlbwa o ta ɛɛ yaa,

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: amɔ bwɛjen nɔ doonyojena taa koranar baa soɡe Kooro Devid kookara ta, ne ba nomonome ɛɛ ba kpɔe dɛɛ jo. Ba ne ba nomonome ɛɛ so jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore taa ba, ásɛ Juda baala ne nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam bwa ɡe ja, ásɛ nɛra so bwɛjen nɔ ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ le Juda bwɛɛre ne bwɛjeɡre aa bar Jerusalam, ne Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ne wee cholibɔr bwea lɔɡre bwɛɛre, ne deŋɡarere harɛ, dɛ Nɛɡɛv waa ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ne anɔ la baa kpoora, ne mea sarahare, ne daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ jam saraharee ba Korowii Dea.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he taŋ deŋne he ta Ona Tɔpere la dii o do ɡoroŋ, dɛ che bone dɛɛ jo Jerusalam doonyojena la ta naa, amɔ mɛɛ choŋi nii aa wola dime bwaa Jerusalam doonyojena bwa ta, ásɛ dekpeɡa bwa fuh.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told me,
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: “Ir dɛ́ la vimamaa dem, belaa mɛɛ ba n bol waa he be.”

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n iro dɛ tu la vimamaa la dem, dɛ ka na kɛ o soɡo dɛɛ ma.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o baa na kɛŋɔ vii la bɛlbwa ta kɛrɛdɛ doe o be naa, o yon chɔɡo dɛ́ berɛ kwaa kpɔ ma konfale bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii bol waa n be ŋɔ,

english_verse: People of Israel, I, the Lord, have power over you, just as a potter has power over clay.
translation_verse: “Israel tena, maa won ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ mamaa nɔ aa ɛa nɔ naa? Gɛ choh yon do mamaa nɔn ta la, ɡɛɛ he Israel tena ɡe do n nɔn ta.

english_verse: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation,
translation_verse: Dɛ saŋ bɛlbwa n ŋɔ mɛɛ chɔɡ harɛ bɛl nɛraa, dɛ́ paɡro dɛ́ kuuɡi o bwa,

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: kɛ dɛ harɛ la nɛra berɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa baa men duu aa, mɛɛ ɡel wedɛɛɡa n fe aa ŋɔa mɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ ba laanee.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ŋɔ Juda tena ne nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam be ŋɔ kenii men Korowii ɛɛ bol, ‘Hé na, n dɛ ba ń kpɔ wenaale ane ba ta he nɛ, dɛ́ɛ vɔrɔwe he vɔrɔwa ɡe. Anomanta, bɛlbwa charɛ o liire dɛ́ ɡel o ŋwɛnɛre ne o we-ɛɛla do wer.’

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: Kɛ baa chaŋo ŋɔ, ‘A bɛlbwa ta tɔnɔ dɔe. Ya ɡbabir ɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi ya we-ɛɛla taa, ásɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ teŋɛ o bambikpeɡ ne o wechɔɡa waa ta.’ ”

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: Anomanta, waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. “Bɔɔ harɛre nɛra ŋɔ, ‘Umee no waa nɔ dɔŋa kaɔ? Israel tena fe ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, kɛ ba ɛ wedoŋa ne waa aa wola were kohona.

english_verse: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
translation_verse: Lɛbanɔn dombwea bwa won mwɛɛla le o bwejena dor kwaraa naa? Lɛbanɔn bwejena neerare aa sɔna dɛ palɛ dɛɛ le a ta la ɛɛ won ɡel pala aa?

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Kɛ n nɛra te soh n wa. Ba fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ voɡa a wa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe. Ba lɔ na, dɛ ɡel ŋwɛnɛbena la ta kpɔe, dɛ kaa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛfala baa wola a ta jemɛ ta.

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Ba harɛ ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbiaa, dɛ́ berɛ waa nɛra aa na dɛɛ mamɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa bwa nyoa kpo dɛɛ viiɡi nyuune.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Gɛ peu yon ta le wee leebɔr la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba ba lɔe peɡre ba dɔma sie. Ba wenaale tɔpere ta la, mɛɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo ba, maa n sie berɛ dɛ́ cha ba.’ ”

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra la bane ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya vɔrɔwe Jeremia vɔrɔwa, dɛkalkɛ sɔfore waa baa dɛ bol la ɛɛ do lee, wejerema ɡe webaɡla aa tonɛ, ɡɛɛ Korowii keamere ɡe waa la ɛɛ ba cheɡa. Anomanta, hé ɡel ya nyin waane dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel waa waa dɛ bol la noe.”

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Jeremia soŋɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no waa nɛra baa hah mɛ aa dɛ bol.

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ wechɔɡa bɔ wedɛɛɡa kem aa? Kɛ ba kwi nafuɡe dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ lawɛ. Lii kɛŋɔ n fa cheɡɛ he sie, dɛ bol ba waa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ, hé laa he bandia kpɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡel lɔr kpoo ba bii, kɛɛ ba serewe laa ta. Gel ba haahna ɛ luhaahna dɛ bɛ bii dɔ, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ba kpoo ba jaranar, ásɛ ba bonɔɔna ɡe serewe laa ta.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Gel ba dɔma piɡri lɔ ba tɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ pa ba laala, ásɛ ɔmee laɡ ba baa dooɡe lɔŋɔre, dɛkalkɛ ba kwi nafuɡe dɛ sɔh har mɛ bela, dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ lawɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ir la ka yawɛ leo le o mamaa be. Kpɔ bwɛjen la nomonome ne sɔfore la bane ja he nɛ,

english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: ásɛ he la Jerusalam Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen waa bɛne Kaŋli Doonyoa la ta. He tel bela aa, hé bol waa maa bol he be la.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Juda koranar ne Jerusalam tena, hé bwa cheɡ deŋne no men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ aa dɛ bol. N dɛ ba wenaale kpɔe ba ta harɛ nɔ ta, á ɡel nomɛlbwa waa no la, o bwara yɔr kohona.

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwaa baa ɛ sarahare a ta tɛ voɡ Baal, dɛ fuh ba bibaala ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛo. N ta ban doe ŋɔ ba ɛ ɡɛ, a toole n liire ta kwaraa.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Anomanta, tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba bala, ásɛ nɛra aa bonɔ Tɔfɛt kɛɛ Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjenii yerɛ kpa. Baa dɛɛ yerɔ Nɛŋkpoa Fɛlembɔjenii.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Bonɔɔ mɛɛ ba Juda ne Jerusalam tena vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa bil bwa chɔɡa. Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔma pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba laa ta, ásɛ ba ola berɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola kondikwa.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Chɔɡa kohona waa do kenii mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta bwɛjen nɔ ta, ásɛ o berɛ kon nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa na, dɛ́ ɔmɛ ba nyoa kpo, o nɛra bola baa do ba wa.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Ba dɔma ɛɛ ba bar bwɛjen laanee dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ kpo o bini nɛra. Kwaa baa ma dɛ́ che a ta jo ba be ɛɛ do ɔmaa kohona, a ɡel lɔr chole o nɛra nɛ, ásɛ ba kpoo dɔŋa dɛɛ chwe, hale ba bibaala ne bihaahna bwa.’ ”

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ ń paɡre leo la nɛra n ne baa la bela la siwi ta,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: asɛ n ŋɔ Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ ne o nɛra chɔɡa, ó do kɛŋɔ leo waa paɡra baa wola won kwaa mao kpa. Baa huɡe nɛra Tɔfɛt belaa, ka tel kɛŋɔ bɔr aa wola lee do baa huɡ ba kpa.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Jerusalam deene bini ne Juda koranar deene, ne saldor baa fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ weweela, dɛ bela baa fuɡe sen ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ voɡare bwa ɛɛ kah doŋaa kɛŋɔ Tɔfɛt ken.”

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Belaa men Jeremia le Tɔfɛt bela Korowii aa tom mɛ n ka bol o waa la. Asɛ n ka che Korowii Dea dembaah bela dɛ ŋɔ nɛra la bwa be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Hé no! N dɛ ba wenaale bwa maa ŋɔa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta bwɛjen nɔ ne bwɛjeɡre bwa aa baro bwa nɛra nɛɛ la ne, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ tena dɛ vɛh n waa la noe.’ ”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Ima, o bibaa sɔne Pasur. Dɛ sɔfo Pasur ɛ nomonjen waa chɔ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea nyoa. Waa noa kɛŋɔ men Jeremia dɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ la,

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: o ɡelɔ ba lɔɔ mɛ, dɛ do mɛ jɔɡrɔre. Bela bɛne Bɛnjamen Doonyoa nyunduabɔr, Korowii Dea bela.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, Pasur baa foo n jɔɡrɔre la, asɛ n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii ta ŋɔe ŋɔ he sɔne Pasur, sɔn waa pae laanee Maɡor Misabib.

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. ‘N dɛ ba ɡela a che he nɛɛ ɔmee chole he ne he daamanar bwa nɛ, ásɛ ba dɔma kpoo ba laa ta he siwi ta. N dɛ ba Juda tena bwa kpɔe do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa. Wɛɛ lawɛ banee kaa o harɛ ta dɛ́ kpoo bane ɡe.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Pasur te, baa lawɛ he ne he dem tena bwaa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta. Belaa hɛɛ ba sewa bá huɡe, he ne he bala haa teŋe nyosone kohona tɛɛ ba la bwa.’ ” Jeremia Korowii waa naɡra

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he neɡ mɛ, asɛ n teŋɛ he nɛ. He pɔ n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ he kpeɡri ɡwaa mɛ. Nɛra dɛ muɡli n baah, tɔpebir bwaa baa mam mɛ.

english_verse: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba waa bola aa, lɔŋɔree mɛɛ do, dɛɛ bol yoi ne kwaa chɔɡa wa. Waa Korowii waa la aa kpɔa tɛ mɛ laanee, chɛɡa ne bammuɡla tɔpebir bwa.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ n ŋɔ maa Korowii sɔnee yerɛ, kɛɛ dɛ́ bol waa o sɔn ta kpa aa, o waa la yon do n bambile bini, dɛɛ fuh n hoɡa bini kɛŋɔ nii ken. N yon takapɔ ŋɔ n lawɛ n te, kɛ dɛ n horɔ.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: N dɛ no nɛra bwa aa dɛ ŋwalɛ ŋɔ, “Ɔmee kohona bar yaa cheme! Hé ɡel ya kpɔ o waa ka bil nomonome sie.” N daamanar ɡba dɛ nyin n harɛ lɔe, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛl ken ɛɛ won neɡro, ásɛ ya won lawɔ, dɛ́ bɔ ya kem.”

english_verse: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Korowii, he ja n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ banyoo ken, anomanta, nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ bwa ɛɛ horɔɔ. Sihiih ɛɛ kpo ba saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la, dɛkalkɛ ba wobɛlbwa aa maɡra ba. Nɛra aa sihiih baa di la soeh ba bwa.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro, henee dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛn o wa aa toɡra bini, dɛ jemɛ waa aa lɔ o bambile ne o liire bini. Anomanta, ɡel n na kembɔr haa kpɔ tɛ n dɔma, dɛkalkɛ he nɔn taa n kpɔ n waa do.

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii. Hé jam Korowii. Onee lɛ nyaara dɛɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: N taah nyoa tɔpere baa lol mɛ o ta. Soh tɔpere n nya aa lol mɛ wa.

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Nyotaahna lawɛ naate waa ɡela n mɛɛ no a wa, dɛ ɡel o sie lɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Ba lolɛ bibaa tɛɛ” la.

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Kórowii ɛ naate ó do kɛ bwɛjena waa chɔɡa, o ta ba nɛɛ sune la ken. Ó ɡel naate ɛɛ no wii ɡbɔɡa chɔɔ, dɛɛ no laa lɔŋɔre ɡe webaŋa,

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.

translation_verse: Korowii bol waa Jeremia be ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Sedekia aa tomɛ Malkija bibaa Pasur, ne Maaseya bibaa sɔfo Sefania o be. Ba ŋɔ,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Bɔɔ le Korowii be tɛ yaa, dɛkalkɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa dɛ ba ba yo yaa. Korowii ken ɛɛ ɛ nyokpo waanee tɛ yaa kɛ saŋ la, ásɛ o berɛ habɔɔ kaa.”

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii berɛ ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ ń bol nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé no. Webele anɛ nɔɔ n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, ŋwɛnɛ haa che o ta dɔ mkpa, ne ŋwɛnɛ haa che o ta dɔ seo.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa soɡe bwɛjen nɔ ta naa, baa kpoo laa taa, kɛɛ weechɔɡa ne lɔr ɡel o sewɛ. Kɛ bɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te ka do Babelɔn tena baa chɔa bar heyaa nɔ lɔɡa te ɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: N siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ń chɔɡ bwɛjen nɔ, o kɛrɛdɛ doe te laa. Babelɔn kooro nɔn taa wɛɛ ba doe, ásɛ o fuh o bwa dɛɛboo ken.” Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.
translation_verse: Dɛ he nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ waa maa do heyaa a ta nɔ ta naa, amɔ Kooro Devid naanar ɛɛ teŋɔ di kora. Asɛ ba ne ba nomonome, ne ba nɛra so jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore bini bwa kpɔ koodem doonyojena nɔ ta dɛɛ jo.

english_verse: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ haa waa maa do heyaa a ta teŋaa, amɔ te men Korowii, n dɛ ŋwɛɛ n ɡbaɡba kɛŋɔ koodem nɔ bwa ɛɛ kuuɡuu dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia.”

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. “A lole kɛŋɔ Juda koodem wer kɛŋɔ Gelead harɛ ne Lɛbanɔn bwejena n be, kɛ kasinteŋ, mɛɛ ɛɔ kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, kɛŋɔ bwɛɛre nɛra aa wola toole a ta ken.

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo laa tena ba yoo, bɛlbwa kpoŋe o dɔmkwa. Baa teŋni o peleme daa aa wera laanee ta, dɛ́ paa do nii ta.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, harɛre nɛra ɛɛ teŋo baa kaa dɛ́ na bwɛjen nɔ, dɛɛ bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa Korowii ɛ bwɛjen nɔ ken?’

english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ásɛ nɛra bane ɡe chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Baa vɛh fɔo ba ne Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ aa fɔwa, dɛ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡare ane, dɛɛ duura la waa.’ Kooro Joahas waa Jeremia aa bola

english_verse: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.
translation_verse: Juda tena, he bɛ Kooro Josia wi, he bɛ o lwe kwaraa ɛ. Kɛ hé wi tɛ o bibaa Joahas kohona, dɛkalkɛ baa lawɔɔ kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta waa wola berɛ ba kpa, waa harɛ baa lolɔ o taa na kpa.

english_verse: Jehoahaz became king of Judah after his father King Josiah died. But Jehoahaz was taken as a prisoner to a foreign country. Now I, the Lord, promise that he will die there without ever seeing his own land again. King Jehoiakim The Lord told me to say: *
translation_verse: Bojaŋ harɛfale baa lawɔ laa ta kaa la taa wɛɛ ba sewa, waa won berɛ ba o harɛ ta kpa.’ Kooro Jehoiakim waa Jeremia aa bola

english_verse: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ma n koodemii ó do kan, o nyundua deene bini do paɡri.’ Anomanta, o do tokorojena o ta, dɛ kpɔ peleme daa kwaa o bini, dɛ kpɔ konswɛɛma maala.

english_verse: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.
translation_verse: He do dem dɛ kpɔ peleme daa kwaaro waa, anee dɛ́ ɡel nɛra ŋɔ he ɛ kooro kɛɛ? Kondikwaa ne sen fa ta he mɛɛ nyae, kɛ o ɛ anɔ la aa wera dɛ toɡre, anomanta, o wobɛlbwa wer dɛ tɛo.

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: O bol nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra waa tɛɛ ba, anomanta, o wobɛlbwa wer tɛo. Gɛ laa dɛɛ baɡle kɛ nɛn jemɛ men Korowii aa?

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Kɛ he sie beɡre anɔ la he ɡbo aa dɔ ta, dɛɛ kpoo nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, dɛɛ fiɡ ba, dɛ ɛɡ ba dɛɛ lɛ ba kwa. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡɛ Korowii aa bol Juda Kooro Josia, o bibaa Jehoiakim waa nɔ. “Nomɛlbwa aa Kooro Jehoiakim seo waa wi, kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Aku, n dam, he seo dɛ we, bwɛɛlɛ ne seo.’ Nomɛlbwa aa on wi ŋɔ, ‘Aku, n dɔɔ, kɛɛ n naa kooro, bwɛɛlɛ ne seo!’

english_verse: You will be given a burial fit for a donkey; your body will be dragged outside the city gates and tossed in the dirt. I, the Lord, have spoken. King Jehoiachin and the People of Jerusalem The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Gɛ keeɡo sewɔ, ba yon tuuɡu le ka ta bwɛɛ dahare la, ɡɛɛ baa ba Kooro Jehoiakim tuuɡa le, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka ta Jerusalam doonyojena baŋ.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, hé ir la ka do lɔŋɔre Lɛbanɔn, dɛ́ la Basan harɛ ne Abarim ɡe ka wi, dɛkalkɛ ba kpoo nɛra baa ja he nɛɛ la bwa.

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ he wobɛlbwa aa wera tɛɛ laanee n kaeh, kɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Maa deŋnee cheɡ dɛ́ no.’ Gɛɛ he do dɛ le he bechale saŋ bwa, haa sɛɛh dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Peu ɛɛ tao kpɔ he sitɔɔla baa do kɛ peteɡra la kaa, baa lawɛ nɛra baa ja he nɛɛ laa taa kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta. Ásɛ he di ncho, sihiih kpoe, he nyubinikpeɡ haa ɛa la wa.

english_verse: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
translation_verse: He soɡe Lɛbanɔn deene baa kpɔ peleme daa ɛa bini, he bwara sɔɔhne, kɛ he waa dɛ ba sum doe hɛɛ pɛmɛ, kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ ken!”

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Jehoiakim bibaa Kooro Jehoiachin be ŋɔ, “Men Korowii taa lole nɔ, hale dɛ he do kɛŋɔ noniseɡ waa dɛ baɡle kpeɡri nɛn aa dɔa, dɛ do n nɔndiɡ ta kwaraa naa, mɛɛ foori ta.

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔe do nɛra baa dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo, hɛɛ ɔm ba la nɔn ta. Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne o laa tena nɔn taa mɛɛ ba he kpɔe do.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo bá lawɛ he ne he nya laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta. Harɛ baa wola he bini bɛlbwa o ta lolɛ, ásɛ he bwa so bela serewe.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ate, men Jeremia ŋɔ, “Amɔ Kooro Jehoiachin nɔ do kɛŋɔ loŋ waa paɡra, ba kpɔ ta nomɛlbwa aa wola nyin kpa kɛɛ? A waa ba lawɛ o ne o bii laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale, baa wola o ta jemɛ nɔ naa?

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ danseɛ dɛ́ cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no Korowii waa waa bola.

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. ‘Chwerɛ baa nɔ waa do tɔne bini, dɛ́ kpɔɔ kɛŋɔ o ta bii dɔe, nɛn o wobɛlbwa aa wola werii do tɛo o soɡa bini bwa, waa naanaree dɔ, ba ba so Juda harɛ kara ta, Kooro Devid luɡe ta.’ ”

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Sitɔɔla baa do kɛŋɔ peteɡra, dɛɛ chɔɡ n nɛra, dɛ lɔ ba dɛɛ peɡre la, bá bwɛɛlɛ.”

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Anomanta, waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol sitɔɔla aa chɛ kɛ bá nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ laanee nɔ, “He ta n nɛra la nɛɛ nyiŋe dɛ doŋ ba, dɛ ɡel ba lɔ peɡre. Taraken, n dɛ ba he deŋne tɛra, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa la wa.

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: N ɡbabir ɛɛ boa ba bwa nyoa, dɛ́ le harɛre maa lɔ ba peɡre a ta la ta, dɛ́ berɛ teɡ ba ba harɛ baa dɔ kpɔɡa dɛɛ chwe ta. Baa loɡle biirii warɛ, ásɛ dɛ ya kohona.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔɔ le sitɔɔla baa nyiŋi ba nɛ, ásɛ bɛlbwa aa ɔmɛ kɛɛ dɛ́ nyoɡre kpa. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpera ane dɛ ba ásɛ n ɡel Kooro Devid naa o wa aa toɡra, dɛ do kɛŋɔ Daa Kpale ba, dɛ́ ba di kora. O balaa, wɛɛ che wejema taa nyiŋi ba nɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera harɛ la bwa ta.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: O baa di kora aa, Juda tena ɛɛ dɔ bosɔɔhnaa, ásɛ Israel tena ɡe so deŋnesɔɔhna ta. Sɔn baa dɛɛ yerɔ laanee, ‘Korowii Waa Dɛ Lɛ Yaa.’

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Tɔpera ane dɛ ba ásɛ nɛra aa n sɔn taa ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ lawɛ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta kpa.’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Kɛ baa ŋɔɔ, ‘Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ lawɛ Israel tena le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛ ta, ne harɛre waa lɔ ba peɡre a ta.’ Ásɛ ba dɔ ba ɡbabir harɛ dɛ́ so o ta.” Keame nyosonteŋna wa

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ Korowii keamere wa. N loo kuu a kpɔ bochela ta n nɛ, n hoɡa bini bwa ɛɛ wee mɛ. N do kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛ ken, kɛ nɛn waa nyɔ sen kohona, Korowii waa aa do ɡoroŋ o bol n be la wa.

english_verse: Those unfaithful prophets misuse their power all over the country. So God turned the pasturelands into scorching deserts. The Lord Will Punish Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Jwamane su harɛ la ta, Korowii taahna nomanta, harɛ la chɔɡɔ, a ɡel kondɛɛra dibɔra aa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ hol. Keamere la kpɔ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡa ta dɛɛ di kpeɡri.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Keamere la ne sɔfore bwa aa men duu, hale n Dea bela, ba dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Now I will punish you with disaster, and you will slip and fall in the darkness. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo ŋwɛnɛre baa dɛ kpɔ a ta do vɔle, biro do o ta, ásɛ ba lɔ naa dɛ́ choɡli. Mɛɛ kpɔ wenaalee ba ta ba nɛ, ba deŋnetɛra tɔpere. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: N na waane maa kia keamere baa lɔ Samaria nɛ. Ba dɛ bol waa voɡ Baal sɔn ta, a ɡel n nɛra Israel tena nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: N berɔ na waane aa wola were kwaraa keamere baa lɔ Jerusalam ɡe nɛ. Ba dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛɛ teŋe nyosone. Ba dɛ do wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡbemba wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, a ɡel nomɛlbwa aa charɛ dɛɛ le a ta. Ba wechɔɡa do kɛŋɔ Sodom ne Gomoora tena n be.”

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Anomanta, Koranar Bwa Kooro bol keamere baa lɔ Jerusalam waa ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ do tɛɡchɔɡa kondikwaa taa bá di, dɛ́ do ane ɡe nee ta bá nyɔ, dɛkalkɛ ba ɡelɔ nɛra aa men tomɛ harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa.”

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. “He bɛ waa keamere la aa dɛ bol he be la no, ba dɛ chɔɡ he liire, hwɛɡa bɛlbwa toole a ta. Anɔ la baa liira ɡboo ba na chaahna ta dɛɛ baɡle, waa men Korowii aa bola laa.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Ba teŋɔ dɛɛ bol nɛra baa vɛh n waa ta teŋa be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ŋɔ, hɛɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhnaa.’ Dɛɛ bol deŋnekpeɡ tena ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Wenaale bɛlbwa aa he nɛɛ ba.’

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Kɛ keamere nɔ bɛlbwa aa Korowii liire ne o wesɔɔhla jemɛ. Bɛlbwa toole dɛ no, kɛɛ dɛ jemɛ o waa la mun.

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Hé na, Korowii bandia do kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ waa dɛ ta, kɛŋɔ kawulewule dɛ ta dɛɛ kpɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena nyubaahna.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: Korowii bandia la nyoa aa sɔɔh, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa ɛ o tetoowa tonɛ. Tɔpera ane dɛ ba bala, ásɛ mɔɔ he no waa nɔ mun kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: N laa tomɛ ɡɛ keamere nɔ, kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ ba iro dɛ kaa. N ta ŋɔe ba ka bol wobɛlbwa, kɛ ba cheɡɛ n sɔn ta kaa bol wa.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Dɛ n ne ba fe chemo, ba jemɛ n liire ne n wesɔɔhla la aa, n nɛraa ba fee ka bol n waa la baɡle, ásɛ ba charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ne nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla bwa ta.

english_verse: I am everywhere— both near and far,
translation_verse: N ɛ Korowii maa lɔ bobɛlbwa, bobeŋkpoŋ ɡbo laa n do.

english_verse: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa won ka sɔh bobɛl maa wola on na. N toole nyundua ne harɛ ta bwa naa? Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: N no keamere nyosonteŋna maa wola ban tomɛ, asɛ ba che n sɔn ta dɛɛ bol n waa la wa. Ba yon ŋɔ, ba deero dɛ na men Korowii waa chaahna ta.

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Saŋ besoo a ɡɛ keamere nyosonteŋna baa cheɡɛ ba ɡbabir liire ta dɛɛ baɡle waa nɔ ɛɛ ba ɡela ɔ?

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ lii ŋɔ chaahna baa dɛ na, dɛɛ bola dɔŋa be la ɛɛ won ɡel n nɛra soh n wa, ɡɛ ba naawa fa aa cheɡɛ voɡ Baal toma ta, dɛ soh n waa la.

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Keame bɛlbwa na waane chaahna ta naa, o yon ŋɔ deeraa o dee, kɛ n keame bɛlbwa waa dɛ bol waa aa le n be la te, wɛ́ɛ bola kasinteŋ ta. Haahra ta korɛ, asɛ mea ɡe koraa?

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: N waa la do kɛŋɔ nii, dɛ berɛ do kɛ hamba waa won bwea paɡra burbur ken. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ne nɛra baa cheɡɛ chaahna ta, dɛ teŋe nyosone dɛɛ maŋkura ba te la dɔɔ. Ba bola dɛ ɡel n nɛra ɛɛ nyoɡre, dɛ n ɡe laa tom ba. Ba waa la aa nɛra nɔ cha tama bɛlbwa. Men Korowiirii bola.” Keame nyosonteŋna baa wola Korowii waa bol

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Dɛ n nɛra nɔ bini bɛlbwa kɛɛ n keame, kɛɛ n sɔfo bɔɔre ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa men Korowii ɛɛ bol ɔ?’ Asɛ he chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘He waa do kɛ bone dɛ dawɛ Korowii nɛ, anomanta, wɛɛ vɛh heyaa.’

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ nomɛlbwa kɛɛ n keame, kɛɛ sɔfo bɛlbwa bol waa ŋɔ, ‘Bone aa ɡwaala Korowii kpɔ dawɛ ya nɛ’ aa, mɛɛ tɛr ba ne ba lolanar deŋnee.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá ɡarɛ bɔɔ ba daamanar ne lolanar ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa Korowii chaŋe ɔ? Bɔkwa waa o bol ɔ?’

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba bɛ waa aa ɡwaala Korowii kpɔ dawɛ ba nɛɛ la waa bol kpa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ bɛlbwa ɛ ɡɛ naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo n waa la do kɛŋɔ bontɔɡa ɡbaɡba dawɛ o nɛ. Ba berɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ waa la sie, Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro la.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Jeremia, bɔɔ n keamere la ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ Korowii chaŋe heya ɔ? Bɔkwa waa o bol ɔ?’

english_verse: But if you disobey me and say, “Here is news from the Lord,”
translation_verse: Dɛ ba vɛh waa maa do ba a ta, dɛ ŋɔ waa aa ɡwaalaa n kpɔ ba dawɛ ba nɛ aa, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ,

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: ‘Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛɛ soh he waa, dɛ́ kpɔ he ne bwɛɛ waa kpɔa tɛ he ne he naawa la ka ta bojaŋ, ásɛ he le o sie kwaraa.

english_verse: You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo he di sihiih taeh, sihiih nomɛlbwa aa wola o waa soh bwa.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiakim bibaa Jehoiachin ne o nomonome, ne nɛra baa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema, dɛ nɛra baa dɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi ɛɛ wejema le Jerusalam kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn. A habɔɔ, Korowii ɡel men Jeremia na waane chaahna ta, dɛ fiɡ daa nɔna wɛɡrɛre anɛ cheɡɛ o Dea doonyoa bela.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Nɔndɛɛɡa su wɛɡrɛ beŋkpoŋ, anee tɔ sie swɛɛ, asɛ wɛɡrɛ nɛɛte la te kwaa ɛ nɔnchɔɡa, baa wola won dia.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Jeremia, bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” Asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Fiɡ daa nɔnaa mɛɛ na. Anɔ la aa ɛ nɔndɛɛɡa la wer, kɛ anɔ la aa ɛ nɔnchɔɡa la te bwa chɔɡɔ, baa wola won dia.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii berɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ,

english_verse: People of Judah, the good figs stand for those of you I sent away as exiles to Babylonia,
translation_verse: “Kenii men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la ŋɔ, ‘Fiɡ nɔndɛɛɡa la do kɛŋɔ, Juda tena maa ɡela ba laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn.

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ do sie ba bee ba wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ berɛ ba bane bonɔ, dɛ́ laɡ ba ir bá kpeɡ, maa ɡel ba chole, dɛ́ kwaa ba du, maa ban fuɡri ta kɛŋɔ dua.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔ nyina bambile, á ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ. Mɛɛ ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra, dɛkalkɛ baa kpɔ ba bambile bwaa tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ berɛ ba n be.

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: Kɛ fiɡ nɔnchɔɡa baa wola won dia la te, men Korowii ŋɔ ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba Juda Kooro Sedekia ne o nomonome, ne nɛra baa kaa dɛ do Jerusalam ɛɛ. Hale ba lɔ bonɔ harɛ nɔ ta, kɛɛ dɛ ka so Ijipt harɛ ta kwaraa noo.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ wenaale kohonaa ba ta ba nɛ, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa ɔmɛ kohona. Nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ mam baa dɛɛ muɡli ba baah, dɛɛ taah ba bobɛlbwa maa lɔ ba peɡre bwa.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: Laa ne lɔr, dɛ weechɔɡaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta ba nɛ, ka tel kɛŋɔ beŋkpoŋ kwaraa aa wola ka, harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ ba ne ba naawa la ta.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa Korowii tomɛ o bonɔɔna baa ɛ o keamere he Juda ne Jerusalam tena be, kɛ he ta deŋne cheɡɛ, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ noo.

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ba yon ŋɔ, ‘Hé charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ne he we-ɛɛla aa wola were ta, ásɛ he won so harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ he ne he naawa la ta, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
translation_verse: He bɛ voɡare nɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ toma. He bɛ kwaa he ɡbabir aa kpɔ nɔɔra kwaara kpɔ ir Korowii bwaawee. He ɛ ɡɛ tenaa, waa heyaa chɔɡ.’

english_verse: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ he ta o be noɛ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa he ɡbabir aa kpɔ nɔɔra kwaara ir o bwaawee, a ba wenaale ne ba ta he nɛ.

english_verse: You refused to listen to me,
translation_verse: Anomanta, Koranar Bwa Kooro bolɔ kɛŋɔ, haa wola o be noɛ nomanta,

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: wɛɛ yerɛ nɛra baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne o bonɔɔ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesaa, ásɛ ba ba yo nɛra baa soɡe Juda ne harɛre aa bara cheme bwa. Wɛɛ chɔɡ ba bwaa kwaraa ken, ásɛ ba do kɛ komɛl waa doŋa nɛra na dɛɛ mamɛ, harɛ la bwa chɔ pɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo ba silɛɛ ne ba hanfalwaa ɡbɔɡa bwa ba a jaɡa. Nɛra aa mea baa dɛ nama nambwe ta ɡbɔɡaa no, kɛɛ dɛ na kandere chaahna.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: He harɛ nɔ bwa ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbiaa, nɛra na ba nyoa kpo, ásɛ harɛre aa baro cheme la nɛra do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa, dɛɛ tomɔ bene fifraanuanɛ.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: Kɛ bene fifraanuanɛ la baa kaa laa, wɛɛ tɛr Babelɔn kooro ne o harɛ nɛra deŋnee ba wechɔɡa la wa, ásɛ dɛ chɔɡ harɛ la o berɛ dimɡbia saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kpɔ wenaale bwa baa chwera do tɔn nɔ bini, o che men Jeremia nɛɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta harɛ la ta laanee ba ta ba nɛ.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Wɛɛ bɔ Babelɔn tena kemee waa baa ɛa la wa, ásɛ harɛre nɛra ɡalɡa ne koojena ba laɡ ba yoma.” Korowii bandia danana nee nyɔe wa

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Jeremia, lɛ numol nɔ, sen aa lɔ o bini do kɛŋɔ n bandia danana ne, mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ nɛra bá nyɔ dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne. Kpɔ kaa harɛre nɛra maa tomɛ ba be la be, dɛ́ ɡel bá nyɔ.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Ba nyɔɔ tonaa, baa dɛɛroo dɛɛ yɛɛɡe, asɛ choɡla chole ba nɛ, laa maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ la wa.”

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n lɛ numol la, dɛ ɡel harɛre nɛra waa tom mɛ ba be la nyɔ o bini sen la. Banee,

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: Jerusalam ne Juda bwɛɛre nɛra, ba ne ba koranar ne nomonome bwa, ásɛ a ɡel ba harɛ berɛ dimɡbia, nɛra bambile teŋe baa mamɛ dɛɛ taah ba dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini.

english_verse: and all the foreigners who lived in the country. Next I went to the king of Uz, and then to the four kings of Philistia, who ruled from Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what was left of Ashdod.
translation_verse: ne nɛŋhɔɔhra bwa baa lɔ bela, ne Us harɛ koranar ne Filisti koranar bwa, banɔ la baa le Askɛlɔn ne Gasa ne Ekron dɛ nɛra baa kaa dɛ do Asdɔd,

english_verse: Then I went to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon,
translation_verse: ne Edom ne Moab dɛ Amɔn harɛre ta,

english_verse: and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea.
translation_verse: ne koranar baa lɔ bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon bwa, ne harɛre aa lɔ ba lɔɡa dɛ do mpo la baŋ bwa,

english_verse: After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert,
translation_verse: ne Arab koranar bwa ne harɛfala koranar baa soɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛre ta,

english_verse: and the countries in the north, both near and far. I went to all the countries on earth, one after another, and finally to Babylonia.
translation_verse: dɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr koranar baa lɔ bojaŋa ne ambori bwa ta, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ nyɔ. Ba bwa habɔɔ la, mɔɔ Babelɔn kooro ɡe ba nyɔ danana nee la.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la dɛ do ba ŋɔ, bá nyɔ n bandia danana sen la ka tel kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ dɛ chwɛɛ, ka tel kɛŋɔ baa choɡli baa wola won ir kpa, laa maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ la wa.

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ ba vɛh numol la lɛɛ dɛ nyɔ aa, hé ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooroo ŋɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá nyɔ.

english_verse: Starting with my own city of Jerusalem, everyone on earth will suffer from war. So there is no way I will let you escape unharmed.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ wenaalee ba ta bwɛjen n ɡbabir sɔn aa dawɛ o ta. Ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba tenee wola deŋnetɛraa dɔ aa? Akai, baa won le a nyoa, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ba laa ne ba ta harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ. Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.

english_verse: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death. Disaster Is Coming
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa ɛɛ no o nyɛɡa laanee. Korowii ne harɛre nɛra dɔɔ, wɛɛ bol nɛwɛnyina bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole, ásɛ dɛ kpoo nyubinikpeɡ tena.’ ” Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. “Hé na, wenaale dɛ ba, o le harɛ bɛl nɛra be dɛ kaa bane ɡe be. O do kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ aa taa le harɛ jaɡa ken.”

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ la, nɛra baa kpoo ba laa ta la ɛɛ warɔɔ chɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, le harɛ baŋ bɛl ba kaa o jaɡa. Nomɛlbwa aa ba lwee ɛ, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ ba huɡ ba. Ásɛ ba chɔɡ, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ nabena aa ɡela harɛ ɛɛ do wer ken.

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: He nomonome haa do kɛŋɔ peteɡra dɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛra nɛɛ la, hé do lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wi kohona! Hé chɔ harɛ dɛɛ ɡbili, dɛkalkɛ saŋ telo kɛ bá kpoo heya. Hɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ vii yon le harɛ dɛ paɡre la ken.

english_verse: You have nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. *
translation_verse: Nomonome haa do kɛŋɔ peteɡra la aa bɔree dɔ chwa kaa bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: Haa deŋnesɔɔhnaa dɔ harɛ la ta, Korowii bandia kohona la wa.

english_verse: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.
translation_verse: Korowii vɛh o nɛra kɛŋɔ nyujente yon chwa le o sɔɔhbɔr la ken. Harɛ la berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o bandia kohona ta ɡel ba dɔma ba chɔɡ ba harɛ.

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Sɔfore, ne Korowii keamere dɛ nɛra la bwa no waa men Jeremia aa bola Korowii Dea bela la.

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ he kpo mɛ naa, he ne nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen nɔ ta ɛɛ di bolchɔɡee, kɛŋɔ haa kpo nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ. Kasinteŋ, Korowiirii tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba kah heya.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: “Ir ka che n Dea dembaah, dɛ́ bol waa bwa maa doe ŋɔ he bol baɡle nɛra baa le Juda bwɛɛre ta dɛ baa tom mɛ bela la. Bɛ webeŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta, bol a bwa.

english_verse: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Ba ken ɛɛ noo dɛ́ charɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta. Ba ɛ ɡɛ tenaa, mɛɛ charɛ n liiree chɔɡa n fe aa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta ba nɛɛ laanee.”

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ ń bol nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ teŋɛ n waa maa dɛ baɡle heyaa la ta,

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛɛ no waa n bonɔɔna baa ɛ n keamere maa tom ba he be keraŋwɛnɛ bwa la be. Kɛ ane a bwa, he ta waa maa cheɡɛ ba nɛ dɛ bol he be la ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: Dɛ he ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ aa, ate waa maa ɛ Silo laanee mɛɛ ba n Dea bonɔ ɛɛ, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa kpɔ bwɛjen Jerusalam sɔn ɛ kon baa taahno.”

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ he che Korowii sɔn ta dɛɛ bol ŋɔ Dea nɔ ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ Silo, ásɛ bwɛjen nɔ ɡe chɔɡ, nɛra aa wola o taa so kpa nɔɔ?” Ate, nɛra la bwa den ba bar men Jeremia Korowii Dea bela.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Juda nomonome aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba le koodem bela dɛ la Korowii Dea, dɛ ka che ba chebɔra doonyoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Doonyofale la ta.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Belaa sɔfore, ne Korowii keamere la ŋɔ nomonome la ne nɛra la bwa be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ chɛ kɛ ba kpoo, dɛkalkɛ o bol Korowii waa yaɡɛ bwɛjen nɔ nɛra. He ɡbabir noɔ!”

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé charɛ he soɡa ne we-ɛɛla bwa, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɛ, ásɛ o charɛ o liire dɛ bɛ wenaale waa bol a waa la kpɔ ba ta he nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: N te, n dɔɔ do he nɔn ta, wobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la, hé kpɔ ɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Belaa nomonome ne nɛra la bwa ŋɔ sɔfore ne Korowii keamere la be ŋɔ, “Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ sɔn taa baa nɔ che dɛ bol waa baɡle yaa, a ta chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.”

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, nomonome la bane iro che dɛ bol nɛra baa chema la be ŋɔ,

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: “Gɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora la, Korowii keame Maeka waa le Mɔresɛt bol Koranar Bwa Kooro waa baɡle Juda tena bwa ŋɔ, ‘Saayɔn ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ koo baa parɔ dɛ du kwaa o ta ken, Jerusalam bwa ɛɛ kuuɡuu dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ Korowii Bwejen Dea aa chɔŋɛ o ta la berɛ kɔr.’

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Juda tena ta Maeka kpoe. Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ soŋe ŋɔ o na o sum. Asɛ Korowii charɛ o liire wenaale waa ŋɔa o fe ɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta ba nɛɛ la ta. Kɛ taraken ya berɔ dɛɛ nyin wenaale kohona dɛ́ ba ta ya nɛ.”

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.
translation_verse: ń kpɔ oltɔn ŋwɛɛra vɔwɛ da, dɛ́ kpɔ dawɛ n baŋa ta kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ daa dawɛ nae nɛ aa parɛ la.

english_verse: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Some officials from these countries are in Jerusalem, meeting with Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ń kpɔ kala tɛ nomonome baa cheɡɛ koranar baa lɔ Edom ne Moab harɛre ta, ne bwɛjena Amɔn ne Taaya dɛ Sidon naa ta, dɛ ba Kooro Sedekia be Jerusalam la.

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ń do ba bá ka ŋɔ ba koranar be waa Korowii fa aa bola ŋɔ,

english_verse: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth,
translation_verse: “N kpeɡri waa kana kohona nee n ta harɛ nɔ bwa ne nɛwɛnyini dɛ ola aa lɔ o ta bwa, dɛ kpɔa do nomɛlbwa maa leo nɔn ta.

english_verse: and I have chosen my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to rule all nations, including yours. I will even let him rule the wild animals. All nations will be slaves of Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson. Then many nations will join together, and their kings will make slaves of the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ tomɔɔ, dɛ tomɛ o bibaa ne o naa ka tel kɛŋɔ o harɛ la aa chɔɡ. Ásɛ o harɛ nɛra ɛɛ tomɛ harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa kohona ne koojena.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra ta sɛɛh dɛ kpɔ ba te do o lɔɡa aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpoo ba laa ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ lɔr ne weechɔɡa ba ta ba nɛ, á ɛ ba deŋnetɛra ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ɡela Kooro Nebukadnesa aa chɔɡ ba kwaraa.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he bɛ he keamere kɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ baa won baɡle waa aa dɛ ba wona chiɡ kerekere, dɛ che deera kɛɛ lala yera kɛɛ dobodobo we-ɛɛla ta be dɛɛ no. Ba bwa dɛ bol he be ŋɔ he bɛ he te kpɔ do Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa lɔɡa.

english_verse: If you listen to such lies, I will have you dragged far from your country and killed.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ neɡre heya dɛ́ ɡel ba lawɛ heya kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta. Mɛɛ doŋi heyaa ásɛ he ka serewe.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra kpɔ ba te ka do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ waa, ate mɛɛ ɡeloo ba so ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta, dɛɛ parɛ o ta. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Men Jeremia fa tɔ sie bol ɡɛ waa nɔ tenten baɡle Juda Kooro Sedekia ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he te do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa. He ne he nɛra tomɔ ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu.

english_verse: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ he ne he nɛra sewɛ laa ta, kɛɛ lɔr kɛɛ weechɔɡa kpoo heya ɔ? Gɛ waa nɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ aa pu harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra baa vɛah dɛ kpɔ ba te do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa la.

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: He bɛ keamere baa ŋɔa he bɛ he te kpɔ do o lɔɡa la be no. Neɡraa baa neɡre heya.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡbabir bolɔ ŋɔ o ta bɛlbwa tomɛ, asɛ ba che o sɔn ta dɛɛ teŋe nyosone la. Anomanta, o ŋɔ wɛɛ doŋi he bwaa, ásɛ ba kpoo heya, he ne keamere baa dɛ teŋɛ nyosone la bwa.”

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
