translation_verse: Belaa n ŋɔ sɔfore la ne nɛra la be waa Korowii fa aa bola ŋɔ, “He bɛ keamere baa dɛ bol ŋɔ aa biɡri bá berɛ kpɔ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ faa do Korowii Dea bonɔ la le Babelɔn ba la be no. Neɡraa baa neɡre heyaa la.

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
translation_verse: He bɛ ba be dɛɛ no! Hé kpɔ he te ka do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa, ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu! Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ bwɛjen nɔ paɡre dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia ɔ?

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba ɛ Korowii keamere kpela aa, bá bɔɔ le men Koranar Bwa Kooro be, ásɛ n bɛ ɡel laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ do n Dea, ne anɔ la aa lɔ koodem bela la, ba paa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.”

english_verse: will be taken to Babylonia, where they will remain until I decide to bring them back to Jerusalem. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Baa paa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta, a do bela ka tel kɛŋɔ n liire aa berɛ ba a ta. Ásɛ n berɛ ɡel bá berɛ ba a ne, ásɛ n berɛ lɛa cheɡ bonɔ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa aa teŋa nɔ chiɡo ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene anaarɛ korobinue te la ta. Belaa Korowii keame bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Hanania, o mɛɛ sɔne Asuur o le Gebeɔn, o bol waa men Jeremia be Korowii Dea, nɛra la ne sɔfore bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: he told me that the Lord had said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I will smash the yoke that Nebuchadnezzar put on the necks of the nations to make them his slaves.
translation_verse: “Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kuuɡi Babelɔn kooro kpeɡri, waa do kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ daa dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ laanee.

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Bene anɛ ne tela dɛ n ɡelɔ ba kpɔ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ fa do Korowii Dea, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa paa le bonɔ la, dɛ́ berɛ ba a ne.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ Jehoiakim bibaa Kooro Jehoiachin, ne Juda tena bwa baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn la bwa ba. Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ba n kuuɡi Babelɔn kooro kpeɡri waa do kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ daa dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ la ken. Men Korowiirii bola.’ ”

english_verse: The priests and the others were still standing there, so I said:
translation_verse: Belaa men Jeremia che sɔfore ne nɛra baa lɔ Korowii Dea la sie dɛ bol Hanania be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: “Aamen! Kórowii ɛa ɡɛ! N dɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel o waa haa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ, dɛ́ ɡel laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ do Korowii Dea la ne nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfale ta la bwa, bá berɛ le a bwa ne Babelɔn ba bonɔ.

english_verse: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.
translation_verse: Keamere baa tɔ n ne he sie saŋ la bolɔ ŋɔ, harɛre nɛra ne koojena ɛɛ serewe laa taa, ásɛ lɔr ne weechɔɡa ɡe kpoo bane.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Kɛ keame bɛlbwa waa dɛɛ bol Korowii waa ŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna lole, ásɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ laanee nɛra ɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ keame kasinteŋ Korowii aa tomɔ.”

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Belaa Hanania laa daa waa dawɛ men Jeremia baŋa kɛŋɔ bontɔɡa la ku,

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ che nɛra la bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba o kuuɡi Babelɔn kooro kpeɡri waa do kɛŋɔ daa ba yon kpɔ dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ, Babelɔn kooro kpɔ dawɛ harɛre nɛra baŋa ta la. Bene anɛ ne tela dɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛo.” Ate, Jeremia le bela dɛ kaa.

english_verse: to go back and say to Hananiah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You smashed a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with one made of iron. I will put iron yokes on all the nations, and they will have to do what King Nebuchadnezzar commands. I will even let him rule the wild animals.
translation_verse: Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, dɛ́ wɛɛ kpɔ buni waa do kɛŋɔ daa ba yon kpɔ dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ laanee dawɛ harɛre nɛra baŋa ta, ásɛ baa tomɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa. Hale dɛ́ ɡel kpɔɡ bini ola ɡba ɛɛ tomɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa.’ ”

english_verse: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii dɛ ba he kpoe le harɛ nɔ ta. Benanyoa ne chema dɛ he sewɔ, dɛkalkɛ he ɡelɔ nɛra nɔ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo. Gɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ.”

english_verse: Two months later, Hananiah died.
translation_verse: Asɛ Hanania sewɛ a ɡɛ bena la korobinuanɛ ta.

english_verse: I had been left in Jerusalem when King Nebuchadnezzar took many of the people of Jerusalem and Judah to Babylonia as prisoners, including King Jehoiachin, his mother, his officials, and the metal workers and others in Jerusalem who were skilled in making things. So I wrote a letter to the priests, the prophets, the leaders, and the rest of our people in Babylonia.
translation_verse: N chwerɛ tɔn nɔ ɡɛ saŋ baa lawɛ Kooro Jehoiachin ne o nya ne koodem nomonome, ne Juda ne Jerusalam nomonome, ne nɛra baa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema, dɛ banɔ la baa dɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi ɛɛ wejema laa ta kaa harɛfale ta la.

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: Men Jeremia kpɔ tɔn maa chwera la do Safan bibaa Elasa ne Hilkia bibaa Gemaria, Juda Kooro Sedekia aa laɡ ba tɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa la nɔn ta. O bini waa nɔ,

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: “Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ bol nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta le Jerusalam kaa Babelɔn laanee nɔ.

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: ‘Hé ma deene dɛ́ so a bini, ásɛ dɛ parɛ bodɛɛɡa dɛ́ du daa dɛɛ di a ta.

english_verse: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.
translation_verse: Hé mo haahna dɛ́ loɡle bibaala ne bihaahna, dɛ́ nyin haahna tɛ he bibaala ɡe, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ he bihaahna ɡe tɛ yal, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba ɡe dɔ bibaala ne bihaahna. Hé ɡel he mun ya kohona bela, dɛ bɛ mule.

english_verse: I will bless you with a future filled with hope—a future of success, not of suffering.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ n jemɛ anɔ la maa vɔrɔwa dɛɛ cheɡ heya. Vɔrɔwa aa ɡel he wobɛlbwa do wer, haa wola chɔɡ, ásɛ he dɔ kerekere hwɛɡa.

english_verse: You will turn back to me and ask for help, and I will answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Belaa hɛɛ ba n sɔn yera dɛɛ soŋ mɛ, ásɛ n no he wesoŋa.

english_verse: You will worship me with all your heart, and I will be with you
translation_verse: Hɛɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe n bɔree dɛ́ na mɛ, dɛ he dɛ́ nyin n bɔr he bambile bwa ne naa, hɛɛ na mɛɛ.

english_verse: You feel secure, because you think I have sent prophets to speak for me in Babylonia.
translation_verse: He ken ɛɛ dɛɛ boloo ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛ yaa o keamere Babelɔn harɛ ta,

english_verse: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Anomanta, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ɛ no men Korowii wa, he nɛra maa ɡela ba lawɛ heyaa le Jerusalam kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me what would happen to Shemaiah, who was one of our people in Babylonia. After my letter reached Babylonia, Shemaiah wrote letters to the people of Jerusalem, including the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and the other priests. The letter to Zephaniah said:
translation_verse: waa chwerɛ tɔn o sɔn ta ka tɛ nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam bwa, ne sɔfo Maaseya bibaa Sefania dɛ sɔfore baa kaa bwa be. Tɔn la bini la, o bol Sefania be ŋɔ,

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the Lord chose you to be the priest in charge of the temple security force. You know that anyone who acts crazy and pretends to be a prophet should be arrested and put in chains and iron collars.
translation_verse: “Korowii lee sɔfo he ba chiɡ Jehoiada naa ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi o Dea la ta. Henee chɛ kɛ he nyiŋi dɛ́ lawɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ we choɡla, dɛɛ ɛ o te kɛ Korowii keamee on la, dɛ́ doo bune jɔɡrɔre ne bune kwaa o baŋa ta.

english_verse: Jeremiah from the town of Anathoth is pretending to be a prophet there in Jerusalem, so why haven't you punished him?
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ he ta Jeremia waa le Anatɔt dɛɛ bol waa kɛŋɔ Korowii keame la kaeh yɔ?

english_verse: He even wrote a letter to the people here in Babylonia, saying we would be here a long time. He told us to build homes and to plant gardens and grow our own food.
translation_verse: O kpɔ kala tɛ yaa Babelɔn kɛŋɔ yaa so belaa biɡri. Anomanta, hé ma deene dɛ́ so a bini, ásɛ dɛ parɛ bodɛɛɡa dɛ́ du daa dɛɛ di a ta.”

english_verse: When Zephaniah received Shemaiah's letter, he read it to me.
translation_verse: Anee sɔfo Sefania kure tɔn la bini waa baɡle men Jeremia.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me what to write in a second letter
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii bol waa n be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to the people of Judah who had been taken to Babylonia. In this letter, I wrote that the Lord had said: I, the Lord, have not chosen Shemaiah to be one of my prophets, and he has misled you by telling lies in my name.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ kala nɔ ka tɛ nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa harɛfale ta bojaŋ la. Ŋɔ Sɛmaya waa ɛ Nehelam te dɛ ba bol Korowii waa la baɡle la, n laa tomɔ, asɛ o neɡre dɛ ɡel he yarada waa aa ɛ nyosone.

english_verse: He has even talked you into disobeying me. So I will punish Shemaiah. He and his descendants won't live to see the good things I will do for my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ tɛr Sɛmaya ne o naanar deŋnee. O nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwara aa ka dɛ́ do nɛra nɔ bini. Waa kondɛɛɡa maa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ n nɛra la nae ba, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ deŋnekpeɡ o ta n waa ta teŋɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel said, “Jeremiah, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.
translation_verse: ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ waa maa bol he be la bwa do tɔn bini.

english_verse: Someday I will let my people from both Israel and Judah return to the land I gave their ancestors.”
translation_verse: Tɔpera ane dɛ ba, ásɛ n lawɛ n nɛra Israel ne Juda tena le harɛfala ta, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ ba ba harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa ŋɔ ba konee la ta. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to Israel and Judah: Screams of terror are heard, with no word of peace.
translation_verse: “N no lɔŋɔ waa do ɔma kohona, hundam chole bobɛlbwa, deŋnesɔɔhna aa wola toole bela.

english_verse: Can men give birth? Then why do I see them looking so pale and clutching their stomachs like women in labor?
translation_verse: Hé pɛɛ no! Baa lɛɛ won kpoŋe tea dɛ́ lolɛ bie aa? Aah ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ na baala ba bwara aa kpeɡa, ba nɔɔra dawɛ ba teene ta kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ nɔɔ? Nomɛlbwa siebɔr ɡwaŋɔ kohona.

english_verse: My people, soon you will suffer worse than ever before, but I will save you.
translation_verse: Tɔpechɔɡe bɛl dɛ ba, baa won kpɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa maɡɔ. Wɛɛ ɛ suna dii tɔperee tɛ Jekɔb naanar, kɛ ane a bwa, baa le a nyoaa.”

english_verse: Now you are slaves of other nations, but I will break the chains and smash the yokes that keep you in slavery.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ kuuɡi kon waa do kɛŋɔ da, ba yon kpɔ dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ, ba kpɔ dawɛ Jekɔb naanar baŋa ta laanee, dɛ́ kuuɡi jɔɡrɔre la ɡe bwa. Ásɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra aa won dɛɛ fiɡ ba kpa.

english_verse: Then you will be my servants, and I will choose a king for you from the family of David. *
translation_verse: Baa tomɛ men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ laanee, ne Kooro Devid naa maa leo tɛɛ ba, wɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ la.

english_verse: Israel, you belong to me, so don't be afraid. You deserved to be punished; that's why I scattered you in distant nations. But I am with you, and someday I will destroy those nations.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n nɛra, he bɛ ɔmɛ, Israel tena, he bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ. Mɛɛ lɛ heyaa le bojaŋ harɛre taa ba, he naanar baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta la. Ásɛ he berɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ne bosɔɔhna, nomɛlbwa aa heyaa aah kpa.

english_verse: Then I will bring you and your descendants back to your land, where I will protect you and give you peace. Then your fears will be gone. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Heal Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ lɛ heya. Mɛɛ chɔɡ harɛre nɛra maa lɔ heyaa peɡre ba bini bwaa, kɛ he te, maa den chɔɡ heyaa kwaraa. Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee, kɛ mɛɛ sune he nɛɛ dɛ́ nyiŋi heya kɛrɛdɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, you are wounded and near death.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol waa o nɛra be ŋɔ, “He ŋwɛra aa won tonɛ, he bola haa dɔa bwa ɡe haa chaeh dɔ.

english_verse: You are accused of a crime with no one to defend you, and you are covered with sores that no medicine can cure. *
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ nyiŋi he nɛ, tɛɛɡa toole dɛ́ chah he ŋwɛra, hwɛɡa bɛlbwa toole kɛ baa chah heyaa.

english_verse: Your friends have forgotten you; they don't care anymore. Even I have acted like an enemy. And because your sins are horrible and countless, I will be cruel as I punish you.
translation_verse: He daamanar bwa soh he wa, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ nyiŋi heyaa kɛrɛdɛ kpa. N baa yo heya kɛ he dɔm, dɛ tɛr he deŋne kohona, dɛkalkɛ he wechɔɡa ne he nyubinikpeɡ kan kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: But if your enemies try to rob or destroy you, I will rob and destroy them, and they will be led as captives to foreign lands.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin he chɔɡa la mɛɛ chɔɡoo, ásɛ ba lawɛ he dɔma bwa kaa harɛfala ta. Nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi heya la, baa fiiɡi ba ɡee, ba pa he laala kaa laa, baa pa ba ɡe laalaa.

english_verse: No one wants you as a friend or cares what happens to you. But I will heal your injuries, and you will get well. The Lord Will Rescue Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Kɛ mɛɛ berɔ ɡel he dɔ bokpeɡa ásɛ dɛ chah he ŋwɛra, a lole kɛŋɔ he dɔma dɛ bol kɛŋɔ, ‘Ba vɛh Saayɔn, nomɛlbwa aa o waa dawɛ kpa.’ Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I will be kind to you and let you come home. Jerusalem now lies in ruins, but you will rebuild it, complete with a new palace.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ berɔ lawɛ n nɛra ba ba harɛ ta, dɛ́ dɔ tedoma tɛ bɛlbwa ne o lolanar. Baa berɔ kwaa ma Jerusalam, dɛ́ kwaa o koodem la cheɡ o buɡ ta.

english_verse: Other nations will respect and honor you. Your homes will be filled with children, and you will celebrate, singing praises to me.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa soɡe bela ɛɛ ɡo kpɛɛra yelaa, dɛ́ do lɔŋɔre dɛɛ hɛɡre. Mɛɛ swee ba andɛɛɡaa, dɛ́ ɡel ba mun ya, ásɛ dɛ dɔ duure.

english_verse: It will be just like old times. Your nation will worship me, and I will punish anyone who abuses you.
translation_verse: Ba bii ɛɛ berɔ do kɛ saŋ la ken, ásɛ n lawɛ harɛ la nɛra ba che kiŋkiŋ n sie, dɛ́ tɛr nomɛlbwa waa fiɡ ba la deŋne.

english_verse: One of your own people will become your ruler. And when I invite him to come near me at the place of worship, he will do so. No one would dare to come near without being invited.
translation_verse: Ba ɡbaɡba binii ba sitɔɔ waa ɛ ba kooro ɛɛ ba lee. Mɛɛ lawɛ ɡɛ nɛn laanee ba n be ó bɛn mɛ. Umee dɛ́ won ba n be dɛ n laa ta nɔn yerɔ wɔ? Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: You will be my people, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba n nɛra ɛɛ, ásɛ n ɡe ɛ Korowii haa dɛɛ tom mɛ.”

english_verse: I am furious! And like a violent storm I will strike those who do wrong.
translation_verse: Hé na, Korowii bandia do kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ, dɛ́ ta kpɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena nyuune ta.

english_verse: I won't calm down until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday, you will understand what I mean.
translation_verse: Korowii bandia waa do ɔma la nyoa aa won sɔɔh, atane o tonɛ o bambile bini wa. Tɔpera ane ta dɛ ba mɔɔ, ásɛ n nɛra won no waa nɔ mun.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I promise that someday all your tribes will again be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao ásɛ Israel deene bwa kpɔ mɛ ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ n ɡe kpɔ ba ɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: In the desert I was kind to those who escaped death. I gave them peace, and when the time is right, I'll do the same for you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Rebuild Israel
translation_verse: Israel tena baa ka baa wola sewɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo ta la, mɛɛ sune ba nɛɛ. Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba bwara sɔɔh ba.”

english_verse: Some time ago, the Lord appeared to me and told me to say: Israel, I will always love you; that's why I've been so patient and kind.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ o te baɡle Israel tena saŋ la dɛ ŋɔ, “Nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe n nyin heya. Nyina kohonaa n ta teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin heya.

english_verse: You are precious to me, and so I will rebuild your nation. Once again you will dance for joy and play your tambourines.
translation_verse: Israel tena, mɛɛ berɔ lawɛ heyaa ir, ásɛ he berɛ kwaa che kɛrɛdɛ. Hɛɛ berɔ kpɔ he janjelaree le, he ne nɛra ba sie aa lɛa kaa sa.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria and enjoy the grapes.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ berɔɔ kwaa du daa kooni Samaria deŋɡarere ta. Paa bɛlbwa waa dua la, wɛɛ di a nɔnaa ó sie lɛ.

english_verse: Someday those who guard the hill country of Ephraim will shout, “Let's go to Zion and worship the Lord our God.” Israel Will Return to Its Own Land
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah Efrem harɛ lɔŋɔre ɛɛ le deŋɡarere dor dɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘He ba ya kaa Saayɔn Bwejen waa lɔ Jerusalam la doa, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la be.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord says: Celebrate and sing for Israel, the greatest of nations. Offer praises and shout, “Come and rescue your people, Lord! Save what's left of Israel.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé ɡo silɛɛ yela tɛ Israel tena, ba harɛɛ kana harɛre bwa bini. Hé ɡo kpɛɛra yel ŋɔ, ‘Korowii lɛ o nɛra banɔ la baa kaa la bwa.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, will bring my people back from Babylonia and everywhere else on earth. The blind and the lame will be there. Expectant mothers and women about to give birth will come and be part of that great crowd.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ laɡ baa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ́ boa ba nyoa le harɛ jaɡa. Nyoŋa ne banɔ la ba peri aa serewa, hale tekpoŋra, dɛ banɔ la lol tea aa lɔ ba bwa, nɛnlaa tentenee dɛɛ ba bera ba.

english_verse: They will weep and pray as I bring them home. I will lead them to streams of water. They will walk on a level road and not stumble. I am a father to Israel, my favorite children.
translation_verse: Baa ba wii nee, dɛɛ soŋe men Korowii, ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba dɛɛ ba. Mɛɛ laɡ baa kpɔ nenabɔɔne nyoo, harɛ waa chɔa kaa, baa wola naa lɔ o ta, dɛkalkɛ n ɛ Israel tena mɛɛ, Efrem ɡe ɛ n bibanloɡle.”

english_verse: Listen to me, you nations nearby or across the sea. I scattered the people of Israel, but I will gather them again. I will protect them like a shepherd guarding a flock;
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra, hé no, hɛ́ɛ bol n waa la mpo nyoa bojaŋ harɛre ta. N lɔ n nɛra Israel tena peɡre, kɛ mɛɛ berɔ boa ba nyoa, ásɛ dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre aa dɛ nyiŋi peera la ken.

english_verse: I will rescue them from enemies who could overpower them.
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ Israel tena di ba nyu, dɛ lɛɛ ba le harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa kohona nɔn ta.

english_verse: My people will come to Mount Zion and celebrate; their faces will glow because of my blessings. I'll give them grain, grapes, and olive oil, as well as sheep and cattle. Israel will be prosperous and grow like a garden with plenty of water.
translation_verse: Baa bao dɛ ba ɡo silɛɛ yela Saayɔn Bwejen la ta, ásɛ ba sie lɛ n koŋkɛɛla, aa ɛ mea ne sen ne ɔleve no, dɛ peera ne nae bwa ta. Baa doo kɛŋɔ bodɛɛɡe ba du daa, bwaala nɛ o ta ken, dɛ́ dɔ kondɛɛɡa men Korowii aa kpɔ tɛɛ ba. Ásɛ ba sunaa di kpa.

english_verse: Young women and young men, together with the elderly, will celebrate and dance, because I will comfort them and turn their sorrow into happiness.
translation_verse: Belaa toli ɛɛ ba sae ba sie lɛ, ásɛ bonɔɔna ne banjeni bwa ɛɛ hɛɡre. Mɛɛ larawe ba bwaraa, dɛ́ ɡel ba wii ber ba silɛɛ, ásɛ ba dɔ hɛɡra kohona le ba suna dii ta.

english_verse: I will bless my people with more food than they need, and the priests will enjoy the choice cuts of meat. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Offers Hope
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo sɔfore di kondikondɛɛɡaa, ásɛ n nɛra bwa ɡe dɔ ba kwaa baa dɛ nyin. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: In Ramah a voice is heard, crying and weeping loudly. Rachel mourns for her children and refuses to be comforted, because they are dead. *
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Ba no taa bɛl le Rama. Lokua wii naate ɛɛ wi. Rakɛl dɛ wi o bii wa, ba larawo kahonɛ, dɛkalkɛ o bii bwa serewɔ.”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, say to dry your tears. Someday your children will come home from the enemy's land. Then all you have done for them will be greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Kenii Korowii ɛɛ bol, “Hé ɡel wii haa dɛ wi la, dɛ́ fee he siniire. Anɔ la haa ɛa tɛ he bii aa pɛɛ ɛɛ ba, hɛɛ dɔ a kembɔree, ba bwa ɛɛ berɔɔ le ba dɔma harɛ taa ba.

english_verse: So don't lose hope. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Hwɛɡa lole tɛ heya kerekere, ásɛ he bii bwa berɛ ba ba harɛ la ta. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The people of Israel moan and say to me, “We were like wild bulls, but you, Lord, broke us, and we learned to obey. You are our God— please let us come home.
translation_verse: N no n nɛra Israel tena suna wii baa dɛ wi, ‘N Naa Korowii, ya do kɛŋɔ kondɛɛre waa kpaŋa ken, kɛ he baɡle yaa ŋɔ yaa teŋɛ he waa ta. Berɛ lawɛ yaa ba he be, ya dɛ kpa kɛ he berɛ lawɛ yaa ba he be, dɛkalkɛ henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: When we were young, we strayed and sinned, but then we realized what we had done. We are ashamed and disgraced and want to return to you.”
translation_verse: Ya berɛ habɔɔ kpoe, kɛ a ta biɡre ya dɔ liire, dɛ berɛ ba he be. Kɛ a habɔɔ haa tɛr ya deŋne la, ya baŋa ɡolo sihiih kpo yaa. Sihiih kpo yaa kohona, dɛkalkɛ ya bechale saŋ bwaa ya le ɛ wechɔɡa.’ ”

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my own dear children. Don't I love you best of all? Though I often make threats, I want you to be near me, so I will have mercy on you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, he do kɛŋɔ bibaa maa dɛ nyinu kohona. Saŋ bɛlbwa maa yerɛ he sɔn la, he nyina waa dɛ do n bini kohona. N bambile dɛ lawɛ, n dɔ tedoma tɛ heya.

english_verse: With rock piles and signposts, mark the road well, my dear people. The road by which you left by will now lead you home.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ kwaa paaɡe á ɛ nso ŋwɛnɛ la ta, á baɡle heya ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta kaa. Israel tena, hé berɛ ba, hé berɛ ba bwɛɛre haa le a ta kaa la ta.

english_verse: Will you ever decide to be faithful? I will make sure that someday things will be different, as different as a woman protecting a man. The Lord Will Bring Judah Home
translation_verse: Nɛra he wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba he ɡaaɡe bala nɔ ɡela ɔ? He fa do kɛ bitolo o wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe. Mɛɛ beɡre wobɛlbwa anfalaa harɛ nɔ bwa taa, kɛŋɔ haah aa kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o jaa nɛɛ la ken.” Korowii nɛra wer doe kerekere

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I promise to set the people of Judah free and to lead them back to their hometowns. And when I do, they will once again say, “We pray that the Lord will bless his home, the sacred hill in Jerusalem where his temple stands.”
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “N berɔ lawɛ Juda tena ɡe ba ba harɛ ta naa, baa dɛɛ bol Juda harɛ ne o bwɛɛre taa ŋɔ, ‘Korowii swee Saayɔn Bwejen waa lɔ Jerusalam boɡoroŋ bela o Dea aa lole la andɛɛɡa.’

english_verse: The people will live in Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. Some will be farmers, and others will be shepherds.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ berɔɔ ba so Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta, paara ne peteɡra baa dɛ teɡɛ ba kondɛɛra bwa.

english_verse: Those who feel tired and worn out will find new life and energy,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra ba bambile aa chɔɡa la dɔ bokpeɡfala, ásɛ dɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa lɔr aa kpoo o ɡwɛɡre kondikwaa o di.”

english_verse: and when they sleep, they will wake up refreshed.
translation_verse: Belaa men Jeremia n chɔ dɛ ir, asɛ n na kɛ n dom la som n be.

english_verse: Someday, Israel and Judah will be my field where my people and their livestock will grow.
translation_verse: “Men Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, tɔpera ane dɛ ba ásɛ n ɡel nɛra ne kondɛɛra ba su Israel ne Juda harɛ bwa ta.

english_verse: In the past, I took care to uproot them, to tear them down, and to destroy them. But when that day comes, I will take care to plant them and help them grow.
translation_verse: Gɛ maa nyiŋi ba nɛɛ dɛ fuɡri dɛ kuuɡi dɛ chɔɡ dɛ berɛ laɡ ba ir dɛ du la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ nyiŋa dɛ́ laɡ ba ir, ásɛ ba kpeɡ kɛŋɔ konduula ken.

english_verse: No longer will anyone go around saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: Tɔpera la telaa, nɛra aa berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nya ne mɛɛ di ɡrepo nɔnnyɛɡa, ásɛ ba bii nyena nyɛɡ.’

english_verse: When that day comes, only those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste, and only those who sin will be put to death. The New Agreement with Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa di ɡrepo nɔnnyɛɡa la nyenaa dɛɛ ba nyɛɡa, ásɛ dɛ bwa serewe ba ɡbaɡba wechɔɡa baa ɛa wa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: The time will surely come when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao, ásɛ n ne Israel ne Juda tena bwa fɔwɛ fɔofale bɛl.

english_verse: It will be different from the agreement I made with their ancestors when I led them out of Egypt. Although I was their God, they broke that agreement.
translation_verse: O ne fɔo la n ne ba naawa aa fɔwa a ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la, aa beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba naawa fa ta fɔo la ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: Here is the new agreement that I, the Lord, will make with the people of Israel: “I will write my laws on their hearts and minds. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Fɔo n ne Israel tena aa fɔwɛ tɔpera aa lɔ sie la ta laanee nɔ. Mɛɛ kpɔ me Mmaraa do ba bambili bini, dɛ́ chwerɔ do ba nyuune bini, ásɛ n ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: “No longer will they have to teach one another to obey me. I, the Lord, promise that all of them will obey me, ordinary people and rulers alike. I will forgive their sins and forget the evil things they have done.”
translation_verse: Aa berɛ hiah kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa baɡle o dɔŋ kɛɛ o nime ŋɔ, ‘Jemɛ Korowii kɛ onee he Dɔɔ’ kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba bechale ne nomonome bwa ɛɛ jem mɛ kɛ ba Dɔɔree men. Mɛɛ sune ba nɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ ba waa aa wola toɡrɛ kɛ ba, maa ba wechɔɡa waa lii kpa bwa. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. I command the sun to give light each day, the moon and stars to shine at night, and ocean waves to roar.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee ta wee asɛ wɛɛ chaah webaŋa, dɛ ɡel korobie ne weweela ɡe ɛɛ chaah jwaana. Menee ɡela mpo ir dɛɛ lɔ nehɛma, Koranar Bwa Kooroo n sɔn.

english_verse: I will never forget to give those commands, and I will never let Israel stop being a nation. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua nɔ ɛɛ ɡel toma ɛɛ yaa, amɔ dɛ ɡɛɛ Israel harɛ nɛra ɡe aa wola lee do.

english_verse: Can you measure the heavens? Can you explore the depths of the earth? That's how hard it would be for me to reject Israel forever, even though they have sinned. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
translation_verse: Dɛ tɔpebɛl ba fe ɛɛ won maɡɛ ɡɛ nyundua aa doa, dɛ́ jemɛ kwaa harɛ nɔ aa chɔŋɛ a ta naa, anee n fe vɛh n nɛra Israel tena waa bwa baa ɛa la wa. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The Lord said: Someday, Jerusalem will truly belong to me. It will be rebuilt with a boundary line running from Hananel Tower to Corner Gate.
translation_verse: Tɔpera ane dɛ́ ba ásɛ ba berɛ kwaa ma bwɛjen Jerusalam n sɔn ta, dɛ́ le Hananɛl Dejaŋ wee cholibɔr, dɛ́ kaa Loŋkora Doonyoa la ta.

english_verse: From there, the boundary will go in a straight line to Gareb Hill, then turn toward Goah.
translation_verse: Ásɛ ba jwɛh le bela kaa wee cholibɔr dɛ́ kaa Gareb deŋɡare ta, dɛ́ bar kaa Goa.

english_verse: Even that disgusting Hinnom Valley will be sacred to me, and so will the eastern slopes that go down from Horse Gate into Kidron Valley. Jerusalem will never again be destroyed.
translation_verse: Fɛlembɔjen la bwa, bela baa dɛ huɡe nɛra, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ta chaa o bini, dɛ harɛre aa chɔ Kedrɔn nenabɔɔ ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le Jaɡre Doonyoa wee leebɔr bwa, ɛɛ do ɡoroŋee tɛ mɛ. Nomɛlbwa aa bwɛjen laanee kuuɡi kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡo kpa. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene fi ta, dɛ ɡɛ saŋ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ɡe di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro.

english_verse: At that time, the Babylonian army had surrounded Jerusalem, and I was in the prison at the courtyard of the palace guards.
translation_verse: Dɛ Babelɔn kooro laa tena baa bar Jerusalam cheme ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ laɡ mɛ do dea, n do Juda tena koodem dembaah, bela nɛra baa dɛ daah kooro aa lole.

english_verse: Zedekiah had ordered me to be held there because I told everyone that the Lord had said: I am the Lord, and I am about to let the king of Babylonia conquer Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Juda Kooro Sedekia laɡ mɛ do dea kɛŋɔ maa ŋɔa ŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba ɡela Babelɔn kooro ba yo bwɛjen nɔ tena, dɛ́ laɡ ba.

english_verse: King Zedekiah will be captured and taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will speak with him face to face.
translation_verse: Kooro Sedekia aa won chwa. Baa lawɔɔ ka tɛ Babelɔn kooro, ásɛ o ne o sie ɡba dɔŋa ba bol wa.

english_verse: Then Zedekiah will be led away to Babylonia, where he will stay until I am finished with him. So, if you people of Judah fight against the Babylonians, you will lose. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Baa lawɔɔ kaa Babelɔn, o do bela ka tel kɛŋɔ maa nyiŋi o waa bini tonɛ. Hale o yo Babelɔn tena kwaraa naa, aa on kɛrɛdɛɛ chiɡ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Later, when I was in prison, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will visit you. He must sell his field near the town of Anathoth, and because you are his nearest relative, you have the right and the responsibility to buy it and keep it in the family.
translation_verse: “He mɛɛ nime Hanamɛl waa ɛ Salum bibaa la ɛɛ ba he bee dɛ́ ba soŋe, hé yawɛ o koo waa lɔ Anatɔt Bɛnjamen harɛ ta. Dɛkalkɛ henee ɛ o lole tenten dɛ dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ he yawɛ harɛ la.”

english_verse: Hanamel came, just as the Lord had promised. And he said, “Please buy my field near Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. You have the right to buy it, and if you do, it will stay in our family.” The Lord had told me to buy it
translation_verse: Belaa Hanamɛl ba n be dembaah bela, dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń yawɛ harɛ la ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la. Anee ɡela n jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii bol waa n be kpela.

english_verse: Lord God, you stretched out your mighty arm and made the sky and the earth. You can do anything.
translation_verse: “Nemenɛ Korowii, henee cheɡɛ he kpeɡri kohona ta dɛ ta nyundua ne harɛ. Wobɛlbwa aa kpeɡe tɛɛ.

english_verse: I had two copies of the bill of sale written out: an official copy containing the details of our agreement and another copy, without the details. Some witnesses and I signed the official copy, which was folded and tied, before being sealed shut with hot wax. Then I gave Hanamel the silver.
translation_verse: Belaa n kpɔ tɔne anɛ aa dɛ baɡle kɛ n yawɛ harɛ la, ne a wobɛlbwa aa jaa dɛ do tɔn la bini, onɔ la baa marɛ a nyoa ne onɔ la baa wola o nyoa marɛ,

english_verse: And while he, the witnesses, and all the other Jews sitting in the courtyard were still watching, I gave both copies to Baruch son of Neriah.
translation_verse: dɛ kpɔa tɛ Nɛrea bibaa Baruk, o nabaa sɔne Maseeya. Hanamɛl ne danseɛ tena baa jaa dɛ ɛɡre ba nɔɔra la, dɛ Juda tena baa soɡe dembaah bela la bwa la siwi ta.

english_verse: I told Baruch that the Lord had said: Take both copies of this bill of sale, one sealed shut and the other open, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
translation_verse: “Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee doe ŋɔ he lɛ tɔn baa marɛ o nyoa, ne onɔ la baa wola o nyoa marɛ la bwa, dɛ́ kpɔa do leo bini ásɛ a won biɡri.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I promise you that people will once again buy and sell houses, farms, and vineyards in this country. Jeremiah Questions the Lord
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Baa berɔ yawɛ deene ne kooni dɛ daa kooni he harɛ nɔ ta ja.’ ” Jeremia wesoŋa

english_verse: You show kindness for a thousand generations, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: He baɡle he nyina nɛra kaɡboŋa nɛ, kɛ he berɔ dɛɛ tɛr nɛra deŋne ba mɛɛnanar wechɔɡa baa ɛa wa. He kan dɛ do kpeɡri, henee Koranar Bwa Kooro.

english_verse: With great wisdom you make plans, and with your great power you do all the mighty things you planned. Nothing we do is hidden from your eyes, and you reward or punish us as we deserve.
translation_verse: He dɛ vɔrɔwe vɔrɔwa aa wera dɛɛ ɛ wejena. He sie lɔ wobɛlbwa nɛn aa dɛ ɛ ta, dɛɛ bɔ ba kem ɡɛ bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla aa doa.

english_verse: You are famous because you worked miracles in Egypt, and you are still working them in Israel and in the rest of the world as well.
translation_verse: A saŋ la, he ɛ nyokpowaa Ijipt harɛ ta, he ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛa dɛ ba le fini. Israel ne harɛre nɛra bwa bini, a ɡel nomɛlbwa jemɛ he waa bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: You terrified the Egyptians with your miracles, and you reached out your mighty arm and rescued your people Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: He cheɡɛ wejena ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta, dɛ kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta ya dɔma nɛ, dɛ che he kpeɡri ta lawɛ he nɛra Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta.

english_verse: Then you gave Israel this land rich with milk and honey, just as you had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: He kpɔ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe waa do ken nɔ tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ he fa aa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa la.

english_verse: But when our ancestors took over the land, they did not obey you. And now you have punished Israel with disaster.
translation_verse: Kɛ baa bala dɛ ba so o ta la, ba vɛh he Mmarare la, ba ta waa haa do ba a ta kɛɛ waa haa baɡ ba la ta teŋɛ. A waa he kpɔ wenaale nɔ bwa ba ta ba nɛɛ la.

english_verse: Jerusalem is under attack, and we suffer from hunger and disease. The Babylonians have already built dirt ramps up to the walls of our city, and you can see that Jerusalem will be captured just as you said.
translation_verse: Babelɔn tena ma kwaa baa che a ta dɛ́ jo bwɛjen la bini bar o bwa, dɛ́ yoo ba dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ. Hale ba pa mun kwara. Laa ne lɔr dɛ weela ɛɛ ɡeloo bá pɔ ba nɛɛ warane. He ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ waa haa bola la ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: So why did you tell me to get some witnesses and buy a field with my silver, when Jerusalem is about to be captured by the Babylonians? The Lord Explains about the Field
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ a ka tama Babelɔn tena ba yo dɛ lawɛ yaa kaa. Kɛ ane a bwa, Nemenɛ Korowii, henee do mɛ ŋɔ ń yawɛ harɛ la nɛra baa di danseɛ la siwi ta.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I am the Lord God. I rule the world, and I can do anything!
translation_verse: “Menee Korowii maa dɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ, wobɛlbwa toole dɛ do kpeɡri tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: It is true that I am going to let King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ kpɔe do Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne o laa tena nɔn ta, ásɛ ba yoo dɛ́ pɔ o nɛra nɛ,

english_verse: The Babylonian army is already attacking, and they will capture the city and set it on fire. The people of Jerusalem have made me angry by going up to the flat roofs of their houses and burning incense to Baal and offering wine sacrifices to other gods. Now these houses will be burned to the ground!
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ fuh o bwa. Baa fuh bwɛjen la bwaa, ne nɛra baa fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Baal ba sal deene dor, ne sen sarahare baa fuɡa dɛɛ tɛ voɡare ane dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ muɡli n baah la.

english_verse: They have set up repulsive idols in my temple, and now it isn't a fit place to worship me.
translation_verse: Hale ba kpɔ voɡa maa kia la ba cheɡ n Dea maa ŋɔa baa tom mɛ o bini la ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh.

english_verse: And they led Judah into sin by building places to worship Baal in Hinnom Valley, where they also sacrificed their sons and daughters to the god Molech. I have never even imagined they would commit such disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwaa baa ɛ sarahare a ta tɛ voɡ Baal deŋɡarere dor. Ba kpoo ba bibaala ne bihaahna ɡe dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Molɛk Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta. N ta ban doe ŋɔ ba ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ, a toole n liire ta kwaraa ŋɔ baa ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔɔ, a che a ta Juda tena ɛ wechɔɡa.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, what you said is true. The people of Jerusalem are suffering from hunger and disease, and so the king of Babylonia will be able to capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Jeremia, nɛra nɔ dɛ bol ŋɔ laa ne lɔr dɛ weechɔɡa ɛɛ ɡeloo Babelɔn kooro ba yo yaa, dɛ́ pɔ ya nɛ, ásɛ ya do o lɔɡa. Berɛ no waa maa dɔa dɛ́ bol ja,

english_verse: I am angry with the people of Jerusalem, and I will scatter them in foreign countries. But someday I will bring them back here and let them live in safety.
translation_verse: ‘N dɛ ba nɛra maa cheɡɛ n bandia kohona ta dɛ lɔ ba peɡre harɛre bwa ta la nyoa boara, mɛɛ berɔ ba ba bwa ne bonɔ, dɛ́ ɡel ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.

english_verse: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Baa ɛ n nɛraa, ásɛ n ɡe ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: Even though I have brought disaster on the people, I will someday do all these good things for them.
translation_verse: Gɛ maa kpɔ wenaale ba ta nɛra nɔ nɛɛ nɔ, ɡɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba wedɛɛɡa ɡe ne bala ba tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ maa baɡ ba nyoa la.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when you bought the field, you showed that fields will someday be bought and sold again. You say that this land has been conquered by the Babylonians and has become a desert, emptied of people and animals.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ harɛ nɔ ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, ásɛ nɛra kɛɛ kpɔɡ bini ola aa wola won so o ta, ásɛ ba kpɔ do Babelɔn tena nɔn ta. Kɛ baa berɔ yawɛ kooni bonɔ ja.

english_verse: But someday, people will again spend their silver to buy fields everywhere—in the territory of Benjamin, the region around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and in the hill country, the foothills to the west, and the Southern Desert. Buyers and sellers and witnesses will sign and seal the bills of sale for the fields. It will happen, because I will give this land back to my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ yawaa, ásɛ ba ɛ a tɔne dɛ́ ɛɡre nɔɔra dɛ́ lɛa do, ásɛ nɛra di a danseɛ. A ɡɛ waa nɔ, Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ne bwɛɛre aa bar Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ ta dɛ deŋɡarere harɛ bwɛɛre, ne Juda bwejena lɔɡre bwɛɛre bwa, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Nɛɡɛv waa ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa aa ba chiɡa. Mɛɛ laɡ baa ba ba harɛ ta. Men Korowiirii bola.’ ”

english_verse: I was still being held prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guards when the Lord told me: I am the Lord, and I created the whole world.
translation_verse: “Menee Korowii maa ta harɛ nɔ dɛ kwaaro cheɡ o chɔŋɛ kwaa ta dɛ do le. N sɔnee Korowii,

english_verse: Ask me, and I will tell you things that you don't know and can't find out.
translation_verse: Yer mɛ, ásɛ n chaŋe, ásɛ dɛ baɡle wejena ne waa aa sɔah haa wola an jemɛ.

english_verse: Then someday, I will heal this place and my people as well, and let them enjoy unending peace.
translation_verse: Kɛ bwɛjen nɔ nɛra te, mɛɛ berɔ ɡel bá dɔ bokpeɡa, dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ne bosɔɔhna ɡe kohona.

english_verse: I will give this land to Israel and Judah once again, and I will make them as strong as they were before.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba ɡela Juda ne Israel tena wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel bá do kpeɡri ɡɛ ba fa aa doa wubwa la.

english_verse: They sinned and rebelled against me, but I will forgive them and take away their guilt.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ fee ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛ jo n nɛɛ la bwaa, dɛ́ laa bolchɔɡe baa dia la kpɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: When that happens, all nations on earth will see the good things I have done for Jerusalem, and how I have given it complete peace. The nations will celebrate and praise and honor me, but they will also tremble with fear because of the powerful things I have done.
translation_verse: Ásɛ a che bwɛjen Jerusalam nɛra nɛ n dɔ silɛɛ ne jirima dɛ duure, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa ɔmɛ dɛɛ chel, wedɛɛɡa maa ɛa tɛ Jerusalam tena, ne ɡɛ maa ɡela ba wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba la wa.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, you say that this land is a desert without people or animals, and for now, you are right. The towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem are deserted, and people and animals are nowhere to be seen. But someday you will hear
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛra dɛ bol ŋɔ bonɔ do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, nɛra kɛɛ kondɛɛra toole o ta. Kpelaa ba ŋɔ. Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna bwa chɔ pɛɛ, nɛra kɛɛ kondɛɛra toole bela. Kɛ hɛɛ berɔɔ baa no,

english_verse: happy voices and the sounds of parties and wedding celebrations. And when people come to my temple to offer sacrifices to thank me, you will hear them say: “We praise you, Lord All-Powerful! You are good to us, and your love never fails.” The land will once again be productive.
translation_verse: silɛɛ ne hɛɡra lɔŋɔre dɛ hanfalwaa mune ɡbɔɡa. Hɛɛ noo nɛra ɡo yela dɛ́ kpɔ jam sarahare dɛɛ ba n Dea, dɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro! O waa wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ nɔ berɛ do wer ɡɛ o fa aa doa wubwa la. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Now it is empty, without people or animals. But when that time comes, shepherds will take care of their flocks in pastures near every town in the hill country, in the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert, in the land of the Benjamin tribe, and around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord's Wonderful Promise
translation_verse: Deŋɡarere bwɛɛre ne bwejena lɔɡre bwɛɛre, ne Nɛɡɛv bwɛɛre aa lɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta, ne bwɛɛre aa bar Jerusalam, dɛ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta la, peteɡra ɛɛ won dɔ bɔr dɛɛ kure ba peera. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The Lord said: I made a wonderful promise to Israel and Judah, and the days are coming when I will keep it.
translation_verse: Tɔpera ane dɛ ba ásɛ waa maa baɡɛ Israel ne Juda tena nyoa la ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: I promise that the time will come when I will appoint a king from the family of David, a king who will be honest and rule with justice.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ tɔpera la, mɛɛ ɡeloo Kooro Devid naanar bini nɛn o wa aa toɡra ir, dɛ́ kpɔ waa aa toɡra ne kasinteŋ ba harɛ la ta.

english_verse: In those days, Judah will be safe; Jerusalem will have peace and will be named, “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, mɛɛ lɛ Juda ne Jerusalam nɛra bwaa, ásɛ ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta. Ásɛ baa yerɛ bwɛjen Jerusalam ‘Korowii Waa ɛ Ya Lɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The king of Israel will be one of David's descendants,
translation_verse: Anomanta, kenii Korowii ɛɛ bol, “Kooro Devid naa ɛɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ di kora Israel harɛ,

english_verse: and there will always be priests from the Levi tribe serving at my altar and offering sacrifices to please me and to give thanks.
translation_verse: ásɛ sɔfore le Lewi dea dɛɛ tom mɛ n Dea saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛɛ fuh sarahare ne mea sarahare, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa baa kpoora ɡe baa tɛ mɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me:
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: I, the Lord, have an agreement with day and night, so they always come at the right time. You can't break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: “Gɛ haa wola won chɔɡ fɔo waa chɔ n ne webaŋa ne jwaana baah, ásɛ webaŋa ne jwaana aa won ɛ toma a saŋ ta la,

english_verse: and you can't break the agreements I have made with David's family and with the priests from the Levi tribe who serve at my altar. A descendant of David will always rule as king of Israel,
translation_verse: ɡɛɛ haa wola won chɔɡ fɔo n ne n bonɔɔ Devid aa fɔwa o do le la. O naa ɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la. Gɛ tentenee n ne n sɔfore baa le Lewi dea ɡe fɔwɛ fɔo kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ tom mɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, a ɡɛ fɔo la aa wola won chɔɡ bwa.

english_verse: and there will be more descendants of David and of the priests from the Levi tribe than stars in the sky or grains of sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo n bonɔɔ Devid naanar, ne Lewi dea tena baa ɛ n Dea sɔfore mun ya kohona, ásɛ ba bɛ won kur ba, kɛŋɔ baa wola won kure weweela kɛɛ mpo nyoa hɛŋle la.”

english_verse: The Lord also said:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: You've heard foreigners insult my people by saying, “The Lord chose Israel and Judah, but now he has rejected them, and they are no longer a nation.”
translation_verse: “He ta noɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra nɔ aa dɛ bol ŋɔ, men Korowii vɛh Israel ne Juda tena maa lee ba tɛ n te la aa? Ba hah n nɛra, dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nyubaahna, baa wola ban komɛl yerɛ, dɛɛ lii ba harɛfale bɛl nɛra.

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will never break my agreement with the day and the night or let the sky and the earth stop obeying my commands.
translation_verse: Kɛ men Korowii fɔo chɔ n ne webaŋa ne jwaana baah, dɛ do mmarare tɛ nyundua ne harɛ bwa.

english_verse: In the same way, I will never reject the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob or break my promise that they will always have a descendant of David as their king. I will be kind to my people Israel, and they will be successful again.
translation_verse: Gɛ maa ɛa nɔ nomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo n ne Jekɔb naanar ne n bonɔɔ Devid fɔo yaa fɔwa la do le. Mɛɛ le Devid naanar la bini bɛlee ó ba nyiŋi Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb naanar nɛ. Mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ n nɛra, dɛ́ ɡel ba wobɛlbwa berɛ do wer tɛɛ ba ja.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar had a large army made up of people from every kingdom in his empire. He and his army were attacking Jerusalem and all the nearby towns, when the Lord told me
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be, ɡɛ saŋ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne o laa tena, ne harɛre nɛra, dɛ wobol bwa soo siwi nɛra baa lɔ o lɔɡa, aa pɛa dɛɛ yo Jerusalam ne bwɛɛre aa baro cheme.

english_verse: to say to King Zedekiah: I am the Lord, and I am going to let Nebuchadnezzar capture this city and burn it down.
translation_verse: Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ waa waa bol n be laanee kɛŋɔ, ń ir la ka ŋɔ Juda Kooro Sedekia be ŋɔ, o dɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ kpɔe do Babelɔn kooro nɔn ta, ásɛ o fuh o bwa.

english_verse: You will be taken prisoner and brought to Nebuchadnezzar, and he will speak with you face to face. Then you will be led away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Kooro Sedekia aa bɔree dɔ chwa, baa lawɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka do Kooro Nebukadnesa nɔn ta. O ne o sie ɛɛ ɡba dɔŋaa ba bol wa, ásɛ ba lawɔ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.

english_verse: You will die a peaceful death. People will mourn when you die, and they will light bonfires in your honor, just as they did for your ancestors, the kings who ruled before you.
translation_verse: Deŋnesɔɔhna taa hɛɛ ba sewa. Gɛ nɛra yon dɛɛ fuh daawiile ɡɛ saŋ ba yon dɛɛ huɡe koranar baa ɛ he naawa dɛ tɔ he sie la, ɡɛɛ baa ba daawiile fuih tɛ he ɡe. Baa wiu dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Akwe, ya kooro sewɔ.” ’ ”

english_verse: I went to Zedekiah and told him what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Belaa men Korowii keame Jeremia bol waa nɔ bwa Juda Kooro Sedekia be Jerusalam,

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king of Babylonia was trying to break through the walls of Lachish, Azekah, and Jerusalem, the only three towns of Judah that had not been captured. The People Break a Promise
translation_verse: ɡɛ saŋ Babelɔn kooro laa tena aa dɛ yo bwɛjen Jerusalam la. Dɛ laa tena la dɛ yo bwɛjena Lakes ne Aseka ɡe, dɛ a ɡboo ka bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara Juda harɛ ta. Yoma nyu dii

english_verse: King Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Jerusalem made an agreement to free all Hebrew men and women who were slaves. No Jew would keep another as a slave. And so, all the Jewish slaves were given their freedom.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nɛra la ne ba nomonome bwa baa fɔwɛ fɔo la sɛoh ŋɔ, baa ɡel nɛra baa laɡ ba yoma laanee, ásɛ ba bɛlbwa di o nyu. Asɛ ba bwa sɛh dɛ ɡel bɛlbwa dɔ o te.

english_verse: But those slave owners changed their minds and forced their former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Kɛ a habɔɔ, nɛra baa dɔ yoma dɛ ɡel ba di ba nyu la charɛ ba liire, ba ɛɡ ba dɛ ɛɛ ba yoma ja.

english_verse: That's when the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii bol men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: I am the Lord God of Israel, and I made an agreement with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, where they had been slaves.
translation_verse: “Waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘N ne he naawa fɔwɛ fɔo ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta, bela baa do ba kɛŋɔ yoma la, kɛŋɔ

english_verse: As part of this agreement, you must let a Hebrew slave go free after six years of service. Your ancestors did not obey me,
translation_verse: bene anuanɛ bɛlbwa ta la, Hibru te bɛlbwa waa tomɛ o dɔɔ bene anumɛl la, a chɛ kɛ bá ɡelo ó di o nyu. Kɛ ane a bwa, he naawa ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be.

english_verse: but you decided to obey me and do the right thing by setting your Hebrew slaves completely free. You even went to my temple, and in my name you made an agreement to set them free. But you have abused my name, because you broke that agreement and forced your former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Kɛ he berɔ charɛ he liire dɛɛ chɔɡ n sɔn, bɛlbwa berɔ ka lawɛ baa kɛɛ haah o fa aa ɛ yom he lawɔ la. He berɔ ɛɡ ba dɛ ɛɛ ba yoma ja.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by not giving your slaves their freedom. So I will give you freedom—the freedom to die in battle or from disease or hunger. I will make you disgusting to all other nations on earth.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Korowii ŋɔ, he ta n waa la noɛ, he ta ɡelɛ he bala dɔ ba nyu di. Gɛ aa wera laanee kɛŋɔ, mɛɛ ɡeloo hé di he nyu, ásɛ laa ne weechɔɡa dɛ lɔr ɡe kpoo heya. Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre nɛra bwa bambile teŋe he wa.

english_verse: You asked me to be a witness when you made the agreement to set your slaves free. And as part of the ceremony you cut a calf into two parts, then walked between the parts. But you people of Jerusalem have broken that agreement as well as my agreement with Israel. So I will do to you what you did to that calf.
translation_verse: Baala baa wola n ne ba fɔo yaa fɔwa ta teŋɛ la, mɛɛ ɛɛ baa kɛŋɔ ba yon fɔwɛ fɔo dɛ́ pere nabale bini anɛ, ásɛ dɛ valɛ kpɔ o baah ta kaa la ken.

english_verse: These enemies are King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his army. They have stopped attacking Jerusalem, but they want to kill King Zedekiah and his high officials. So I will command them to return and attack again. This time they will conquer the city and burn it down, and they will capture Zedekiah and his officials. I will also let them destroy the towns of Judah, so that no one can live there any longer.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ do baa ásɛ ba berɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ ta. Baa ba yo nɛra baa lɔ o taa dɛ́ laɡ ba, ásɛ dɛ fuh o bwa. Mɛɛ ɡeloo Juda harɛ bwɛɛre do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken, nomɛlbwa aa won so a ta. Men Korowiirii bola.’ ”

english_verse: When Jehoiakim was king of Judah, the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora Juda harɛ la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Go to the Rechabite clan and invite them to meet you in one of the side rooms of the temple. When they arrive, offer them a drink of wine.”
translation_verse: “Ir la Rekab dea luɡe nɛra be ka bol waa ba be. Ásɛ dɛ laɡ ba ba deene aa lɔ Korowii Dea keŋkeŋ la bɛl bini, ásɛ dɛ tɛɛ ba sen bá nyɔ.”

english_verse: So I went to Jaazaniah, the leader of the clan, and I invited him and all the men of his clan.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n laŋɔ dɛ ka lawɛ Jeremia nɛɛte ɡe bibaa Jaasania. A ɡɛ Jeremia nɔ mɛɛ Habasiinia. Jaasania nimanar ne o dɔɔranar dɛ o bibaala bwa n lawɛ,

english_verse: I brought them into the temple courtyard and took them upstairs to a room belonging to the prophets who were followers of Hanan son of Igdaliah. It was next to a room belonging to some of the officials, and that room was over the one belonging to Maaseiah, a priest who was one of the high officials in the temple.
translation_verse: dɛ ba ba ne Korowii Dea bela. N laɡ ba jo Iɡdalia bibaa Hanan waa ɛ Korowii keame, ne o habɔteŋra dea. Gɛ dea nɔ lɔ Salum bibaa Maaseya dea nyunduabɔr, dɛ Salum dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa, asɛ nomonome la bini bane ɡe baa jaa kwaa teŋɛ.

english_verse: I set out some large bowls full of wine together with some cups, and then I said to the Rechabites, “Have some wine!”
translation_verse: Ate, n kpɔ sen aa su loŋa dɛ numoli cheɡ Rekab tena la sie, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé lɛ sen nyɔ.”

english_verse: But they answered: No! The ancestor of our clan, Jonadab son of Rechab, made a rule that we must obey. He said, “Don't ever drink wine
translation_verse: Belaa ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Yaa sen nyɔ, ya nabaa Jonadab waa ɛ Rekab bibaa do yaa ŋɔ, ya ne ya naanar bɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ ya nyɔ sen bwa.

english_verse: or build houses or plant crops and vineyards. Instead, you must always live in tents and move from place to place. If you obey this command, you will live a long time.”
translation_verse: O berɔ ŋɔ a ta chɛ kɛ yá do deene, kɛɛ dɛ́ parɛ kɛɛ dɛ́ yawɛ daa kooni. O do yaa ŋɔ yáa so tɛnte deene ɡbo bini, ásɛ dɛ won so harɛ yaa soɡe o ta kɛŋɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra nɔ ta.

english_verse: except now we have to live inside Jerusalem because Nebuchadnezzar has taken over the countryside with his army from Babylonia and Syria.
translation_verse: Kɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne o laa tena aa baa lɔ tɔ ya nɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta la, ya liiro kɛŋɔ ya chwa ba Jerusalam dɛ le Babelɔn ne Siiria laa tena nyoa. A waa ya so Jerusalam la.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, want you to learn a lesson
translation_verse: “Ir la ka ŋɔ baala baa lɔ Juda ne Jerusalam be ŋɔ, ‘Amɔ haa waa hweli ásɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ waa ta naa?

english_verse: from the Rechabite clan. Their ancestor Jonadab told his descendants never to drink wine, and to this very day they have obeyed him. But I have spoken to you over and over, and you haven't obeyed me!
translation_verse: Rekab bibaa Jonadab do o bibaala ŋɔ ba bɛ sen nyɔ, asɛ ba teŋɛ a ta. Hale ba le fini baa sen nyɔ, dɛkalkɛ ba no ba nabaa deŋna wa. Kɛ ane a bwa, n teŋɔ bol waa he be keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, kɛ bɛlbwa ta n waa ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: You refused to listen to my prophets, who kept telling you, “Stop doing evil and worshiping other gods! Start obeying the Lord, and he will let you live in this land he gave your ancestors.”
translation_verse: N teŋɔ tomɛ n bonɔɔna baa ɛ n keamere bwa he be. Ba bol he be ŋɔ bɛlbwa charɛ o liire le wechɔɡa ta dɛ́ ɡel he we-ɛɛla do wer. Dɛ he bɛ voɡare ane nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ toma. Ásɛ he won so harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ he ne he naawa la ta. Kɛ ane a bwa, he ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be.

english_verse: The Rechabites have obeyed the command of their ancestor Jonadab, but you have not obeyed me,
translation_verse: Jonadab naanar teŋɛ waa ba nabaa aa bol ba be la ta, kɛ he ta n waa ta teŋɛ.’

english_verse: your God. I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warned you about the terrible things that would happen to you if you did not listen to me. But you have ignored me, so now disaster will strike you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Makes a Promise to the Rechabites
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Korowii Maa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ ɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡa maa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta Juda ne nomɛlbwa waa lɔ Jerusalam nɛɛ laanee ba. Dɛkalkɛ n bol waa he be, he ta noɛ, dɛ yerɛ heya he ta men chaŋɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the Rechabite clan: “I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You have obeyed your ancestor Jonadab,
translation_verse: Ate, men Jeremia ŋɔ Rekab dea luɡe nɛra la be ŋɔ, Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la bolɔ ŋɔ, “He no waa he nabaa Jonadab aa bol he be la, dɛ teŋɛ waa waa baɡle heya, ne anɔ la bwa waa do heyaa ta.

english_verse: so I promise that your clan will be my servants and will never die out.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Rekab bibaa Jonadab luɡe taa nɛra ɛɛ ba lee dɛɛ tom mɛ.’ ”

english_verse: During the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, the Lord said to me, “Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Juda Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora bene anaarɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: since the time Josiah was king, I have been speaking to you about Israel, Judah, and the other nations. Now, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you,
translation_verse: “Ir dɛ kpɔ tɔn chwerɛ Israel ne Juda tena, dɛ harɛre aa jaa waa maa bol he be, dɛ́ le Kooro Josia bere saŋ ba le fini.

english_verse: then read it to the people of Judah. Maybe they will stop sinning when they hear what terrible things I plan for them. And if they turn back to me, I will forgive them.”
translation_verse: Dɛ Juda tena no wekpeɡa maa dɛ nyin n kpɔ ba ta ba nɛɛ nɔ naa, ba ken ɛɛ charɛ ba liiree le ba wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ n kpɔ ba nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla ne ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.”

english_verse: I sent for Baruch son of Neriah and asked him to help me. I repeated everything the Lord had told me, and Baruch wrote it all down on a scroll.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Jeremia yerɛ Nɛrea bibaa Baruk, dɛ kpɔ waa bwa Korowii aa bol n be la tɛo ó chwerɛ. Asɛ Baruk chwerɛ a bwa do tɔn bini.

english_verse: Then I said, Baruch, the officials refuse to let me go into the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Asɛ n ŋɔ Baruk be ŋɔ, “Ba ta men ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ n won jo Korowii Dea,

english_verse: so you must go instead. Wait for the next holy day when the people of Judah come to the temple to pray and to go without eating. Then take this scroll to the temple and read it aloud.
translation_verse: anomanta, ir la bela awola tɔpere baa dɛɛ vɔwɛ nyoa la, ásɛ dɛ kure tɔn la bini waa maa ɡela he chwerɛ do tɔn bini la bwa baɡle ba. Kura baɡle Juda tena baa le ba bwɛɛre ta ba la bwa.

english_verse: The Lord is furious, and if the people hear how he is going to punish them, maybe they will ask to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ba ken ɛɛ soŋe Korowii, ásɛ dɛ charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii kpɔ o bandia waa do ɔma kohona la dɛɛ ba ba ta ba nɛ.”

english_verse: In the ninth month of the fifth year that Jehoiakim was king, the leaders set a day when everyone who lived in Jerusalem or who was visiting there had to pray and go without eating. So Baruch took the scroll to the upper courtyard of the temple. He went over to the side of the courtyard and stood in a covered area near New Gate, where he read the scroll aloud. This covered area belonged to Gemariah, one of the king's highest officials.
translation_verse: Gemaria mɛɛ Safan waa ɛ koodem karake dea belaa Baruk che dɛ kure waa bwa maa bol o be o chwerɛ do tɔn bini la. O dea la lɔ nyunduabɔr dɛ bɛne Korowii Dea doonyoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Doonyofale la bɔr. Baruk kure Korowii tɔn bini waa baɡle nomonome

english_verse: Gemariah's son Micaiah was there and heard Baruch read what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Mikaya waa ɛ Gemaria bibaa dɛ ɛ Safan naa, no Korowii waa bwa aa lɔ tɔn la bini,

english_verse: When Baruch finished reading, Micaiah went down to the palace. His father Gemariah was in the officials' room, meeting with the rest of the king's officials, including Elishama, Delaiah, Elnathan, and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: ate o ir la koodem karake la dea bela, dɛ nomonome la bwa soɡo. Banee koodem karake Elisama, ne Sɛmaya bibaa Delaya, ne Akbɔ bibaa Ɛl Netan, ne Safan bibaa Gemaria, ne Hanania bibaa Sedekia, dɛ nomonome baa kaa bwa.

english_verse: Micaiah told them what he had heard Baruch read to the people.
translation_verse: Mikaya aa bol waa bwa waa noa Baruk kure le tɔn la bini baɡle nɛra la tonɛ la,

english_verse: the officials said, “Please sit down and read it to us,” which he did.
translation_verse: Anee nomonome la ŋɔ Baruk be ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ soŋe, so harɛ ásɛ dɛ kure baɡle ya ɡe.” Ate, Baruk kuro baɡ ba.

english_verse: After they heard what was written on the scroll, they were worried and said to each other, “The king needs to hear this!” Turning to Baruch, they asked,
translation_verse: Baa no tɔn la bini waa la, ba nyiŋi dɔŋa sie bochela ne dɛ ŋɔ Baruk be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ yá bol waa nɔ bwa baɡle kooro.”

english_verse: “Yes, Jeremiah did,” Baruch replied. “I wrote down just what he told me.”
translation_verse: Ate, Baruk chaŋe ŋɔ, “Jeremiaa bol wobɛlbwa n be, asɛ n ɡe chwera do tɔn nɔ bini.”

english_verse: The officials said, “You and Jeremiah must go into hiding, and don't tell anyone where you are going.”
translation_verse: Belaa ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He ne Jeremia bwa ka nyin bɔr sɔh. He bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa jemɛ bela haa lole.” Kooro fuh tɔn la

english_verse: The king told his son Jerahmeel to take Seraiah and Shelemiah and to go arrest Baruch and me. But the Lord kept them from finding us. Jeremiah's Second Scroll
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro la do o bibaa Jeramiil, ne Asriel bibaa Seraya dɛ Abdeel bibaa Sɛlɛmia ŋɔ bá ba lawɛ Baruk ne men Korowii keame Jeremia ba tɛo. Kɛ Korowii lawɛ yaa sɔh.

english_verse: I had told Baruch what to write on that first scroll, but King Jehoiakim had burned it. So the Lord told me
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoiakim aa fuh tɔn maa bol o bini waa baɡle Baruk tonɛ la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to get another scroll and write down everything that had been on the first one.
translation_verse: ń kpɔ tɔnfale dɛ́ chwerɛ waa aa lɔ loɡle tɔn Kooro Jehoiakim aa fuuh la do o ta.

english_verse: Then he told me to say to King Jehoiakim: Not only did you burn Jeremiah's scroll, you had the nerve to ask why he had written that the king of Babylonia would attack and ruin the land, killing all the people and even the animals.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ ń bol Juda Kooro Jehoiakim be ŋɔ, “He fuh tɔn la, dɛɛ bɔɔ Jeremia ɡɛ aa ɛa o chwerɛ ŋɔ Babelɔn kooro ɛɛ bao ba chɔɡ he harɛ nɔ, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa aa lɔ o ta.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, promise that you will be killed and your body thrown out on the ground. The sun will beat down on it during the day, and the frost will settle on it at night. And none of your descendants will ever be king of Judah.
translation_verse: Anomanta, waa men Korowii aa dɛ bol hen Kooro Jehoiakim be laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘He naa bɛlbwa aa kara Kooro Devid aa soɡe o ta la dii ba bwa. He dɛ ba sewa ba kpɔ he chɔɔ ka ta, ásɛ wee lɔ he nɛɛ webaŋa, jwaana ɡe la mɛn lee he nɛ.

english_verse: You, your children, and your servants are evil, and I will punish everyone of you. I warned you and the people of Judah and Jerusalem that I would bring disaster, but none of you have listened. So now you are doomed!
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr he ne he naanar dɛ he nomonome deŋnee, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa dɛ jo n nɛɛ la wa. He ne Jerusalam kɛɛ Juda tena bɛlbwa ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no waa maa dɛ kah heyaa la, anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡa maa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta he nɛɛ laanee ba.’ ”

english_verse: After the Lord finished speaking to me, I got another scroll and gave it to Baruch. Then I told him what to write, so this second scroll would contain even more than was on the scroll Jehoiakim had burned.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Jeremia kpɔ tɔnfale tɛ Nɛrea bibaa Baruk waa ɛ n karake la. Asɛ o chwerɛ wobɛlbwa a fa aa lɔ loɡle tɔn la bini dɛ anɔ la bwa aa jaa n kpɔ tɛo la.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had removed Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim from being the king of Judah and had made Josiah's son Zedekiah king instead.
translation_verse: Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Josia bibaa Sedekia so kora ta Juda harɛ ta chiɡ Jehoiakim bibaa Jehoiachin naa ta.

english_verse: But Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Judah ignored everything the Lord had told me.
translation_verse: Kɛ o ne o nomonome ne harɛ la ta nɛra bini bɛlbwa ta deŋne cheɡɛ, dɛ no waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ men Jeremia nɛɛ dɛ bol ba be la.

english_verse: Then the Babylonians will return and attack Jerusalem, and this time they will capture the city and set it on fire.
translation_verse: Ásɛ Babelɔn laa tena la berɛ ba ja dɛ́ ba yo bwɛjen nɔ nɛra dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ dɛ fuh o bwa ja.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves into thinking that the Babylonians will leave as they did before.
translation_verse: Men Korowii ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ berɛ he te neɡra dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ Babelɔn tena ɛɛ ɡel heyaa. Baa ɡɛɛ ɛ!

english_verse: Even if you could defeat their entire army, their wounded survivors would still be able to leave their tents and set Jerusalem on fire. Jeremiah Is Put in Prison
translation_verse: Hale dɛ he wono pɔ Babelɔn laa tena bwa nɛ, asɛ a ka banɔ la baa do ba bola ɡbo ba chɔ ba tɛnte deene bini kwaraa naa, baa iruu le dɛ́ ba fuh bwɛjen nɔ bwa.”

english_verse: The Babylonian army had left because the Egyptian army was on its way to help us.
translation_verse: Babelɔn laa tena berɔ le Jerusalam kaa, dɛkalkɛ Ijipt kooro laa tena dɛ ba.

english_verse: So I decided to leave Jerusalem and go to the territory of the Benjamin tribe to claim my share of my family's land.
translation_verse: Ate, men Jeremia pa mun le bwɛjen Jerusalam ta dɛ́ kaa Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka lɛ n bɔr maa dɔ le n lolanar harɛ ta.

english_verse: I was leaving Jerusalem through Benjamin Gate, when I was stopped by Irijah, the officer in charge of the soldiers at the gate. He said, “Jeremiah, you're under arrest for trying to join the Babylonians.”
translation_verse: Kɛ maa tel Bɛnjamen Doonyoa ta la, nomoa waa chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah bela nyoa baa yerɔ Irija, o mɛɛ Sɛlɛmia, o nabaa ɡe sɔne Hanania, laɡ mɛ dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “He chwao dɛɛ kaa Babelɔn tena be.”

english_verse: “I'm not trying to join them!” I answered. But Irijah wouldn't listen, and he took me to the king's officials.
translation_verse: Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Gɛ laa a do! Chwae laa n chwa dɛɛ kaa Babelɔn tena be.” Ane a bwa, Irija ta n be noɛ, o laɡ mɛ dɛ kpɔ mɛ kaa nomonome la be.

english_verse: King Zedekiah secretly had me brought to his palace, where he asked, “Is there any message for us from the Lord?” “Yes, there is, Your Majesty,” I replied. “The Lord is going to let the king of Babylonia capture you.”
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Kooro Sedekia tomɔ ba ba yer mɛ ba o be koodem. Asɛ o bɔɔ mɛ bokɛre ŋɔ, “Waane lole dɛ le Korowii be tɛ yaa kɛɛ?” Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waane lole, baa lawɛɛ tɛ Babelɔn kooro.”

english_verse: Then I continued, “Your Majesty, why have you put me in prison? Have I committed a crime against you or your officials or the nation?
translation_verse: Belaa n bɔɔ Kooro Sedekia ŋɔ, “Wechɔɡa besoo n ɛ he ne he nomonome ne nɛra nɔ, asɛ he laɡ mɛ do dea nɔɔ?

english_verse: Have you locked up the prophets who lied to you and said that the king of Babylonia would never attack Jerusalem?
translation_verse: He keamere baa ŋɔa ŋɔ Babelɔn kooro aa he harɛ nɔɔ ba yo la bɔkwa waa puu baɔ?

english_verse: King Zedekiah had me taken to the prison cells in the courtyard of the palace guards. He told the soldiers to give me a loaf of bread from one of the bakeries every day until the city ran out of grain.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Kooro Sedekia ɡelɔ ba do mɛ dea o dembaah bela. N lɔ bela, asɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa nɛra baa dɛ wɔɔ paanoo ɛɛ tɛ mɛ paanoo beŋkpoŋ, ka tel kɛŋɔ paanoo aa baa tonɛ bwɛjen la bwa ta.

english_verse: One day, Shephatiah, Gedaliah, Jehucal, and Pashhur heard me tell the people of Judah
translation_verse: Dɛ Matan bibaa Sɛfatea ne Pasur bibaa Gedalia ne Sɛlɛmia bibaa Jehukal dɛ Malkija bibaa Pasur dɛ no waa men Jeremia yon bol dɛɛ baɡle nɛra dɛɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: that the Lord had said, “If you stay here in Jerusalem, you will die in battle or from disease or hunger, and the Babylonian army will capture the city anyway. But if you surrender to the Babylonians, they will let you live.”
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ nɛra kpɔe do Babelɔn Kooro ne o laa tena nɔn ta, ásɛ ba yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.”

english_verse: So the four of them went to the king and said, “You should put Jeremiah to death, because he is making the soldiers and everyone else lose hope. He isn't trying to help our people; he's trying to harm them.”
translation_verse: Belaa nomonome la ŋɔ Kooro Sedekia be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ chɛ kpoe. O dɛ chɔɡ laa tena baa ka bwɛjen nɔ ta, ne nɛra la bwa liire o wobol ne. Ba kɛrɛdɛ laa wɛɛ nyin, ka ja ba chɔɡa ta.”

english_verse: Zedekiah replied, “Do what you want with him. I can't stop you.”
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Sedekia chaŋe ŋɔ, “N kpɔɔ do he nɔn ta. Maa won tɔe ŋwɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Then they took me back to the courtyard of the palace guards and let me down with ropes into the well that belonged to Malchiah, the king's son. There was no water in the well, but I sank down in the mud.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba lawɛ men Jeremia dɛ kpɔ mɛ ta kooro bibaa Malkija kɔlɔŋ bini. Dɛ o lɔ kooro dembaah bela nɛra la aa dɛ daah la. Ŋwɛɛraa ba kpɔ vɔɡ mɛ dɛ kpɔ mɛ tu kɔlɔŋ la bini. Dɛ nee toole o bini, kpechɛɡre ɡboo, asɛ n ka jo a ta.

english_verse: Ebedmelech said, “Your Majesty, Jeremiah is a prophet, and those men were wrong to throw him into a well. And when Jerusalem runs out of food, Jeremiah will starve to death down there.”
translation_verse: “N naa kooro, nyubinikpeɡ waa baala nɔ ɛ Korowii keame Jeremia la. Ba lawɔ ka ta kɔlɔŋ bini bela lɔr aa dɛ ba o kpoe ó sewɛ, dɛkalkɛ bwɛjen nɔ kwaraa ta la, kondikwaa toole kpa.”

english_verse: Ebedmelech and the soldiers went to the palace and got some rags from the room under the treasury. He used ropes to lower them into the well.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Ɛbɛd Mɛlɛk lawɛ baala la ja o nɛ, asɛ ba la dea bɛl baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa o bini koodem bela la lɔɡa. O pa yakwane ne laala ane aa kɛɛra le bela asɛ dɛ vɔrɔwa, dɛ ta ŋwɛɛra la do n be kɔlɔŋ la bini.

english_verse: Then he said, “Put these rags under your arms so the ropes won't hurt you.” After I did,
translation_verse: Belaa Ɛbɛd Mɛlɛk ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ yakwane la ne laala aa kɛɛra la do he luɡbɔɔne ásɛ ŋwɛɛra haa kpɔ vɔwɛ a ta la bɛ hen bola ba do.” N ɛ ɡɛ,

english_verse: the men pulled me out. And from then on, I was kept in the courtyard of the palace guards. King Zedekiah Questions Jeremiah
translation_verse: asɛ ba tɛr mɛ le kɔlɔŋ la bini ŋwɛɛra la ne. Asɛ n den ka do dembaah bela nɛra la aa dɛ daah la. Kooro Sedekia bɔɔ Jeremia waa ja

english_verse: King Zedekiah had me brought to his private entrance to the temple, and he said, “I'm going to ask you something, and I want to know the truth.”
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Sedekia tomɛ ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ men Jeremia ba doonyotooro te waa lɔ Korowii Dea bela la ta, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba hen waane bɔɔra, kɛ na kɛŋɔ haa wobɛlbwaa kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.”

english_verse: He said, “I swear in the name of the living Lord our Creator that I won't have you killed. No one else can hear what we say, and I won't let anyone kill you.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, Kooro Sedekia sɔɔh dɛ ŋwɛɛ baɡ mɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ tɛ yaa mkpa nɔ, maa hen kpo kɛɛ dɛ́ lawɛ do nɛra baa dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo nɔn ta.”

english_verse: Then I told him that the Lord had said: “Zedekiah, I am the Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Israel. I promise that if you surrender to King Nebuchadnezzar's officers, you and your family won't be killed, and Jerusalem won't be burned down.
translation_verse: Belaa n ŋɔ Kooro Sedekia be ŋɔ, “Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ he kpɔ he te do Babelɔn kooro nomonome lɔɡa aa, baa hen kpo, ásɛ dɛ ɡel bwɛjen nɔ ɡe fuih, he ne he lolanar bwa ɡe dɔ he nyu.

english_verse: But if you don't surrender, I will let the Babylonian army capture Jerusalem and burn it down, and you will be taken prisoner.”
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he ta he te kpɔe ka do Babelɔn kooro nomonome lɔɡa aa, bwɛjen nɔ ɛɛ ka do Babelɔn tena nɔn taa ásɛ ba fuuh, he ɡbabir kwara aa he nyuu dɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Zedekiah answered, “I can't surrender to the Babylonians. I'm too afraid of the people of Judah who have already joined them. The Babylonians might hand me over to them, and they would torture me.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Sedekia ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ɔmɛ Juu tena baa kpɔ ba te ka ja Babelɔn tena bini la, dɛkalkɛ Babelɔn tena la ken ɛɛ lee mɛɛ tɛɛ ba, ásɛ ba fiɡ mɛ.”

english_verse: I said, “If you will just obey the Lord, the Babylonians won't hand you over to those Jews. You will be allowed to live, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Anee men Jeremia chaŋe ŋɔ, “Baa he lee ba dɛ tɛɛ ba. He te ɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa bola la ta, ásɛ wobɛlbwa kaa kɛrɛdɛ tɛɛ, he dɔ he nyu.

english_verse: But the Lord has shown me that if you refuse to obey,
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he ta sɛɛh dɛ kpɔ he te do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa aa, waa Korowii aa pili a bini baɡ mɛ laanee kɛŋɔ,

english_verse: then the women of your palace will be taken prisoner by Nebuchadnezzar's officials. And those women will say to you: Friends you trusted led you astray. Now you're trapped in mud, and those friends you trusted have all turned away.
translation_verse: haahna la bwa baa kaa dɛ do Juda kooro dem bela la, baa laɡ baa le bela ka tɛ Babelɔn kooro nomonome. A ɡɛ haahna la ɛɛ bol he bee ŋɔ, ‘Kooro daamanar tenten neɡro, ba waa tɔɔɡe o waa ta. Taraken o nakpale aa morɛ kpechɛɡre ta nɔ, o daamanar chwao ɡelo.’ ”

english_verse: The Babylonian army will take your wives and children captive, you will be taken as a prisoner to the King of Babylonia, and Jerusalem will be burned down.”
translation_verse: Asɛ men Jeremia berɛ ŋɔ, “Baa lawɛ haahna ne ba bii bwaa ka tɛ Babelɔn tena. He ɡbabir ɡe aa a nyoa lee ba. Babelɔn kooro ɛɛ lawɛ hen kooro laa taa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, ásɛ ba fuh bwɛjen nɔ bwa dɛɛboo ken.”

english_verse: Zedekiah said, “Jeremiah, if you tell anyone what we have talked about, you might lose your life.
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Sedekia chaŋ mɛ ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa no waa yaa bola nɔ, ɡɛ la aa, hɛɛ sewɔɔ.

english_verse: And I'm sure that if my officials hear about our meeting, they will ask you what we said to each other. They might even threaten to kill you if you don't tell them.
translation_verse: Nomonome la noɔ kɛŋɔ n ne he bol waane aa, baa bao dɛ ba bɔɔre waa haa bol kooro be, ne waa waa bol he be. Baa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ dɛ hɛɛ bol kasinteŋii yaa, baa hen kpo.

english_verse: So if they question you, tell them you were begging me not to send you back to the prison at Jonathan's house, because going back there would kill you.”
translation_verse: Den ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ dɛ he dɛ soŋ mɛ ŋɔ n bɛ hen lawɛ ka do dea Jonatan dem ásɛ he sewɛ bela.”

english_verse: The officials did come and question me about my meeting with the king, and I told them exactly what he had ordered me to say. They never spoke to me about the meeting again, since no one had heard us talking.
translation_verse: Ate, nomonome la bwa ba n be dɛ ba bɔɔ mɛ wa, asɛ n bol wobɛlbwa kooro aa do mɛ ŋɔ ń bol ba be la. Anomanta, ba ta wone ɛ wobɛlbwa kpa, dɛkalkɛ ba bini bɛlbwa ta waa n ne kooro aa bola la noɛ.

english_verse: I was held in the courtyard of the palace guards until the day Jerusalem was captured.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba laɡ mɛ do dea n do koodem dembaah bela ka tel tɔpere Babelɔn laa tena aa baa yo Jerusalam tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: When King Zedekiah and his troops saw that Jerusalem had been captured, they tried to escape from the city that same night. They went to the king's garden, where they slipped through the gate between the two city walls and headed toward the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Juda Kooro Sedekia ne o laa tena bwa aa na ɡɛ la, ba chwao le bwɛjen la bini dɛ kpɔ doonyoa bɛl waa lɔ danjwɛɛre anɛ ane baah ta le, dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta jwaana.

english_verse: to Ebedmelech from Ethiopia: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. I warned everyone that I would bring disaster, not prosperity, to this city. Now very soon I will do what I said, and you will see it happen.
translation_verse: “Ir la ka ŋɔ Itiopia te Ɛbɛd Mɛlɛk be ŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘N dɛ ba ɡela wekpeɡa maa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta bwɛjen nɔ nɛra nɛɛ la ba, wedɛɛɡa te laa. A ɡɛ saŋ telo aa, hɛɛ naa siwi nee.

english_verse: “Find Jeremiah and keep him safe. Take good care of him and do whatever he asks.”
translation_verse: “Kpɔɔ kaa dɛ́ kaa nyiŋi o nɛ, dɛɛ berɛ on hɔhɔrɔwa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, kɛ wobɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin la, ɛ tɛo.”

english_verse: But the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah and took him to the town of Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial, then found him guilty,
translation_verse: Babelɔn laa tena la ti ba dɛ ka lawɛ Kooro Sedekia Jeriko harɛ bɛl waa chɔa kaa ta. Ba lawɔ ka tɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa, ɡɛ saŋ dɛ o lɔ bwɛjen Ribla waa lɔ Hamat harɛ ta. Belaa Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ka bol o waa dɛ pao bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: and gave orders for him to be punished. Zedekiah's sons were killed there in front of him, and so were the leaders of Judah's ruling families.
