english_verse: But now, my people will watch, while I repay you for what you did to Zion.
translation_verse: He siwi taa mɛɛ ba bwɛjen Babelɔn ne nɛra baa soɡe Babelɔn harɛ ta kem bɔe, wechɔɡa baa ɛa Jerusalam la wa. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: You destroyed the nations and seem strong as a mountain, but I am your enemy. I might even grab you and roll you off a cliff. When I am finished, you'll only be a pile of scorched bricks.
translation_verse: Babelɔn, he do kɛŋɔ bwejen haa dɛ chɔɡ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra. Kɛ men Korowii ɛɛ dɔm, mɛɛ ɡeloo hé fuh dɛ́ berɛ tɔɔ ásɛ n taɡɛ ta harɛ.

english_verse: Your stone blocks won't be reused for cornerstones or foundations, and I promise that forever you will be a desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Nations Will Attack Babylon The Lord said:
translation_verse: He bwe bɛlbwa aa werii do bá kpɔ ma dea, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ pa dea mun kpa, dɛkalkɛ he dɛ ba doe kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Signal the nations to get ready to attack. Raise a flag and blow a trumpet. Send for the armies of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Choose a commander; let the cavalry attack like a swarm of locusts.
translation_verse: Hé ir fraŋkaa harɛ la ta! Hé hoh bɛla ásɛ harɛre nɛra jemɛ! Hé boa harɛre nɛra nyoa ásɛ ba ka yo Babelɔn tena. Bol Ararat ne Mini dɛ Askenas harɛre nɛra be. Le laa sitɔɔ waa tɔ ba sie, dɛ́ kpɔ jaɡre aa wara kɛŋɔ tontombɛ dɛ́ ka yo.

english_verse: Tell the kings and governors, the leaders and the people of the kingdoms of the Medes to prepare for war!
translation_verse: Boa harɛre nɛra nyoa bá ba yo Babelɔn tena laa. Koranar baa le Midia, harɛ la sitɔɔla dɛ ba nomonome, dɛ harɛre baa dɛ nyiŋi a ta laa tena bwa ba.

english_verse: The earth twists and turns in torment, because I have decided to make Babylonia a desert where no one can live, and I won't change my mind.
translation_verse: Harɛ la jiɡro, dɛkalkɛ waa Korowii aa maɡla bil la telo kɛŋɔ Babelɔn harɛ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won so bela kpa.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers have lost their strength and courage. They stay in their fortresses, unable to fight, while the enemy breaks through the city gates, then sets their homes on fire.
translation_verse: Babelɔn laa tena ɡel yoi dɛ ka so ba dekpeɡa bini. Ba bokpeɡa tonɔ ba do kɛŋɔ haahna ken. Ba kuuɡi bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ kaɡre ba doonyojena bwa, dɛ kpaa nii do ba deene ta.

english_verse: One messenger after another announces to the king, “Babylon has been captured!

translation_verse: Jerusalam tena ŋɔ, “Babelɔn kooro chɔɡ ya Jerusalam tena dɛ kpoo yaa, o ɡelɔ ya do kɛŋɔ loŋ komɛlbwa aa wola toole o bini ken. O do kɛ harɛkon dɛ lawɛ yaa lile ya ola do o som o tea su, dɛ berɛ uɡe yaa ta.

translation_verse: Hɔhɔrɔwa bɛlbwa yaa naa bwa dawɛ Babelɔn harɛ nɛra nɛ. Ya seo kembɔr bwa ɡure nɛra baa lɔ Babelɔn nyu ta.”

translation_verse: Babelɔn tena dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ ŋoo kɛŋɔ nyujentena ken.

english_verse: And since they are hungry, I will give them a banquet. They will celebrate, get drunk, then fall asleep, never to wake up!
translation_verse: Ba dɛ nyin kondikwa kohona kɛɛ? Mɛɛ ɛ kondikondɛɛɡaa cheɡ ba, ásɛ ba di dɛ́ nyɔ sen dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛ́ mamɛ dɛɛ moo. Baa iruu ka chɔ baa wola won ir kpa bwa. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I will lead them away to die, like sheep, lambs, and goats being led to the butcher.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba laɡ ba, kɛŋɔ ba yon lawɛ peloni kɛɛ boohna kɛɛ pebala, dɛ́ ka kpoora la ken.”

english_verse: Babylon's enemies will rise like ocean waves and flood the city.
translation_verse: Mpo suu tɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta, o nehɛma tao ba bɔle o ta.

english_verse: Horrible destruction will strike the nearby towns. The land will become a barren desert, where no one can live or even travel.
translation_verse: O bwɛɛre bwa chɔ pɛɛ dɛ hol, kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ken. Nomɛlbwa aa harɛ la taa so, á ba ɛ kɛ nɛn ɛɛ kpɔ o taa.

english_verse: I will punish Marduk, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit out everything he gobbled up. Then nations will no longer bring him gifts, and Babylon's walls will crumble. The Lord Offers Hope to His People
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr voɡ Baal waa lɔ Babelɔn deŋnee, dɛ́ ɡel o uɡe komɛlbwa waa dia. Harɛre nɛra aa berɛ dɛɛ tomɔ dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa baa tɛo kpa. Babelɔn danjwɛɛ bwa dɛ́ ba kuuɡa.

english_verse: Get out of Babylon, my people, and run for your lives, before I strike the city in my anger!
translation_verse: N nɛra Israel tena, hé chwa le ba. Hé chwa dɛ́ dɔ he nyu. Hé chwa le men Korowii bandia waa do ɔma la ta.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or lose hope, though year after year there are rumors of leaders fighting for control in the city of Babylon.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ kɛɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ, waa haa dɛ no harɛ la ta wa. Bena bɛlbwa hɛɛ dɛɛ no wefalaa, hɛɛ no yoi waa harɛ taa, kooro ne o dɔŋ kooro ɛɛ dɛɛ yoo.

english_verse: The time will come when I will punish Babylon's false gods. Everyone there will die, and the whole nation will be disgraced,

english_verse: when an army attacks from the north and brings destruction. Then the earth and the heavens and everything in them will celebrate.

english_verse: Babylon must be overthrown, because it slaughtered the people of Israel and of many other nations.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bwɛjen Babelɔn paɡre, kpoora baa kpoo Israel tena dɛ kpoo harɛ nɔ ta nɛra la ɡe wa. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: My people, you escaped death when Jerusalem fell. Now you live far from home, but you should trust me and think about Jerusalem. Leave Babylon! Don't stay!
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ bol waa o nɛra baa lɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta be ŋɔ, “He nɛra haa chwaa dɛ dɔ he nyu la, hé le warane, he bɛ hɛlɛ. Hé lɔ bojaŋ harɛ ta te, kɛ he lii n wa, dɛɛ lii Jerusalam ɡe wa.”

english_verse: You feel ashamed and disgraced, because foreigners have entered my sacred temple.
translation_verse: He ŋɔ, “Sihiih kpo yaa ya di ncho, dɛkalkɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra dɔ bɔr jo Korowii Dea bɔra aa do ɡoroŋ bela.”

english_verse: Soon I will send a war to punish Babylon's idols and leave its wounded people moaning everywhere.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpera ane dɛ ba bala ásɛ n chɔɡ Babelɔn harɛ voɡa, ásɛ nɛra baa do ba bola bwa ɛɛ pɛmɛ harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Although Babylon's walls reach to the sky, the army I send will destroy that city. I, the Lord, have spoken. Babylon Will Be Destroyed The Lord said:

english_verse: Listen to the cries for help coming from Babylon. Everywhere in the country the sounds of destruction can be heard.

english_verse: An enemy will attack and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured and their weapons broken, because I am a God who takes revenge against nations for what they do.
translation_verse: Baa bao dɛ́ ba chɔɡ Babelɔn harɛ, dɛ́ lawɛ o laa tena bwa, ásɛ dɛ kuuɡi ba tori. Menee Korowii maa dɛ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne. Mɛɛ bɔ Babelɔn tena kemee ɡɛ aa chɛa.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo o koranar ne nomonome, ne wejerema dɛ laa tena, nyɔ sen dɛɛ. Baa chɔ domii baa wola won ir kpa. Men Koranar Bwa Kooro maa ɛ Kooro laanee bola.”

english_verse: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke. Jeremiah Gives Seraiah a Scroll
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro bolɔ ŋɔ, “Babelɔn danjwɛkpeɡ la dɛ́ ba kuuɡa chɔ harɛ, ásɛ nii le o doonyojena ta. O nɛra koeh baa koah ɛ pɛɛ, ásɛ nii le a bwa ta á fuh.”

translation_verse: Waa men Jeremia aa kpɔa tɛ Nɛrea bibaa Seraya, baa dɛ yerɛ o nabaa Maaseya laanee teŋa nɔ. Dɛ onee dɛɛ cha Juda Kooro Sedekia ɡɛ saŋ waa di kora bene anaarɛ, asɛ o ne o la Babelɔn harɛ ta.

english_verse: Before they left, I wrote on a scroll all the terrible things that would happen to Babylon.
translation_verse: Dɛ men Jeremia chwerɛ wenaale bwa aa dɛ ba Babelɔn harɛ ta bala do tɔn bini.

english_verse: I gave the scroll to Seraiah and said: When you get to Babylon, read this scroll aloud,
translation_verse: N ŋɔ Seraya be ŋɔ, “He tel Babelɔn harɛ ta naa, na kɛŋɔ hɛɛ kure tɔn nɔ bini waa bwaa takpeɡ ne kohonaa ba no.

translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, he fa bolɔ ŋɔ hɛɛ chɔɡ bonɔɔ, ásɛ nɛra kɛɛ kondɛɛra aa wola won so o ta, ó berɛ dimɡbia saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’

english_verse: When you finish praying, tie the scroll to a rock and throw it in the Euphrates River. Then say,

english_verse: “This is how Babylon will sink when the Lord destroys it. Everyone in the city will die, and it won't have the strength to rise again.” The End of Jeremiah's Writing Jeremiah's writing ends here.

english_verse: Zedekiah's sons and the officials of Judah were killed while he watched,

english_verse: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan,
translation_verse: Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuanaarɛ, korobie anue tɔpera fi ta la, o laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan la Jerusalam.

english_verse: and he burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.
translation_verse: O kaa fuh Korowii Dea ne koodem, dɛ Jerusalam deremi bwa. O fuh nomonjena dedɛɛɡe te bɛlbwa.

english_verse: He led away the people left in the city, including everyone who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar, the rest of the skilled workers, and even some of the poor people of Judah.

english_verse: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.

english_verse: Jerusalem, once so crowded, lies deserted and lonely. This city that was known all over the world is now like a widow. This queen of the nations has been made a slave.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ bwɛjen Jerusalam aa chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ nɛra fa su o ta ɡa! Na ɡɛ waa bera do kɛ luhaah, o waa do sum, dɛ o fa lɛ sɔn harɛre nɛra bini taeh! Bwɛjen o fa aa do kɛ haŋkooro la, o berɛ yom taraken.

english_verse: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.
translation_verse: Jwaana bwaa wɛɛ wi kohona, siniire ɛɛ yɔɔro. Harɛre nɛra baa dɛ nyinu bwa chwao, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ larawe o bwara kpa. O daamanar leo tɛ, dɛ bwa berɛ o dɔma taraken.

english_verse: The people of Judah are slaves, suffering in a foreign land, with no rest from sorrow. Their enemies captured them and were terribly cruel.
translation_verse: Ba fiiɡi Juda tena baa lɔ Jerusalam kohona, dɛ laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta. Ba lɔ harɛfala ta, ba ta bosɔɔhna bɛlbwa dɔe. Ba dɔma bar ba cheme, ba ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ le chwa kaa.

english_verse: Enemies now rule the city and live as they please. The Lord has punished Jerusalem because of her awful sins; he has let her people be dragged away.
translation_verse: O dɔma pɔ o nɛ, dɛɛ di kpeɡri. Korowiirii ŋɔa o bwara nyɛɡ o wechɔɡa aa kana kohona la wa. Ba lawɛ o bii bwa laa ta kaa harɛfala ta o dɔma siwi ta.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.
translation_verse: Jerusalam nyanyini bwa tonɔ. O koranar ɡwɛɡrɔ kɛŋɔ lɔr aa kpo ola a ɡaaɡe nyin kondikwaa dɛ́ di kahonɛ la ken, a chwao le nɛra baa dɛ kpaahna dɛɛ nyina dɛ́ kpo la sie.

english_verse: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena lii ɡɛ saŋ baa lɔ wenaale ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, ne kondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ba faa dɔa la. Ba dɔma aa baa yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ la, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ba lɛɛ ba. Ba dɔma nyiŋi ba chɔɡa la dɛɛ mam ba.

english_verse: Jerusalem's horrible sins have made the city a joke. Those who once admired her now hate her instead— she has been disgraced; she groans and turns away.

english_verse: Her sins had made her filthy, but she wasn't worried about what could happen. And when Jerusalem fell, it was so tragic. No one gave her comfort when she cried out, “Help! I'm in trouble, Lord! The enemy has won.”
translation_verse: Bɛlbwa na wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah o te, o ta waa aa dɛ ba o nɛɛ chiɡa kerekere waa liire. O chola waa chola la ɔma kohona, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ larawe o bwara. O ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, sune n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɔma pɔ n nɛ, dɛ kpɔ wenaale ba ta n nɛ.”

english_verse: Zion's treasures were stolen. Jerusalem saw foreigners enter her place of worship, though the Lord had forbidden them to belong to his people.
translation_verse: Dɔma pa o laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa kaa. O ɡbabir na harɛre nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ aa dɛ jo Korowii Dea la bini, bela Korowii fe aa wola ban ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛ ba jo.

english_verse: Everyone in the city groans while searching for food; they trade their valuables for barely enough scraps to stay alive. Jerusalem Speaks: Jerusalem shouts to the Lord, “Please look and see how miserable I am!”
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena bwa himo dɛɛ nyin kondikwaa dɛ́ di. Ba kpɔ ba laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛɛ charɛ kondikwa, dɛ́ won so. Dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi dɛ́ na wenaale yaa lɔ a ta taraken.”

english_verse: No passerby even cares. Why doesn't someone notice my terrible sufferings? You were fiercely angry, Lord, and you punished me worst of all.
translation_verse: Jerusalam wio kɛ nɛn ken, dɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋ mɛ, amɔ nomɛl ɡe lole dɛɛ na n wenaale nɔ dɔŋa aa? Wenaale Korowii baah aa dia kohona o kpɔ ba ta n nɛɛ saŋ nɔ ta nɔ.

english_verse: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ nii le nyundua dɛ ba jo n bini fuh n hoɡa. O har mɛ bel dɛ ɡel n chole harɛ, asɛ dɛ ɡel mɛ bela, n do weweele ta tɔpere bɛlbwa.

english_verse: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.

english_verse: You, Lord, have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.
translation_verse: Korowii vɛh n banyoola bwa, dɛ ɡel laa tena ba yo n bonɔɔna, dɛ chɔɡ ba kɛŋɔ ba yon tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna dɛɛ kpɔ a nee la ken.

english_verse: Because of this, I mourn, and tears flood my eyes. No one is here to comfort or to encourage me; we have lost the war— my people are suffering. The Prophet Speaks:
translation_verse: A waa siniire ɛɛ yɔɔ mɛ kohona la. Nomɛlbwa aa won larawe n bwara, bɛlbwa ɡe aa won do mɛ ɡbemba. N dɔma pɔ n nɛ, n bii ta sidawa bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.

english_verse: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Jerusalam do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa ta nɔn dɛɛ nyin nomɛl ó ba chao, kɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ba larawe o bwara. Korowii do nɛra baa soɡa bar Israel, asɛ ba ba yoo laa, dɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ kondoŋ bɛl ken.

english_verse: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.
translation_verse: Korowii te waa toɡrɔ tɛ mɛ, kɛ menee vɛh waa waa do mɛ a ta. Hé no n be, he nɛra haa lɔ bobɛlbwa, dɛ́ na wenaale maa lɔ o ta. Ba lawɛ n bonɔɔna ne toli bwa laa ta kaa harɛfala ta.

english_verse: I called out to my lovers, but they betrayed me. My priests and my leaders died while searching the city for scraps of food.
translation_verse: N yerɛ harɛre nɛra n ne ba nyoa aa pɛa, kɛ ba vɛh n chae. Nomonome ne sɔfore serewɔ chɔ bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahna, kondikwaa baa ka soŋe di dɛ́ won so la wa.

english_verse: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, na n suna maa dɛ di, n loo kuu, n bambile chɔɡ n wechɔɡa wa. Nɛŋkpoa lɔ fɔɡbaahna, hale nɛra ɛɛ serewe deremi ta.

english_verse: Everyone heard my groaning, but no one offered comfort. My enemies know of the trouble that you have brought on me, and it makes them glad. Hurry and punish them, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ba no n wii maa dɛ wii, kɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ba larawe n bwara. N dɔma bwa no n wenaale wa, asɛ ba sie lɛ kɛ haa kpɔa ba ta n nɛ. Gel tɔpere bɛl haa baɡɛ nyoa o waa la ba, ásɛ ba ɡe bwara nyɛɡ kɛ n kwaa nɔ.

english_verse: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!
translation_verse: Pa ba bolchɔɡe ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa wa, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ haa tɛr n deŋne n wechɔɡa waa nɔ. N hima kan kohona n jum jah.”

english_verse: The Lord was angry! So he disgraced Zion though it was Israel's pride and his own place of rest. In his anger he threw Zion down from heaven to earth.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kpɔ o bandia ba bɔle bwɛjen Saayɔn ta kɛŋɔ bam, dɛ tɛr o nɛra deŋne. O le nyundua taɡɛ Israel wer ta harɛ. O ta o natiɡribɔr waa ɛ o Dea la ɡba waa dawɛ o bandia tɔpere la ta.

english_verse: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.
translation_verse: O chɔɡ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bwa o ta bɛlbwa nɛɛ sune, dɛ chɔɡ dekpeɡa aa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa bandia ne. O ɡelɔ sihiih kpo koranar ne ba harɛre.

english_verse: The Lord was so furiously angry that he wiped out the whole army of Israel by not supporting them when the enemy attacked. He was like a raging fire that swallowed up the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: O cheɡɛ o bandia kohona ta, dɛ sɔɔh Israel nɛŋkpeɡa nyoa. Gɛ saŋ ba dɔma aa ba ba nɛɛ la, o berɛ habɔɔ kpo ba, o ta ban chae. O baah di Israel tena nɛɛ kohona, o chɔɡ ba kɛŋɔ nii yon fuh dɛ chɔɡ komɛlbwa la.

english_verse: He attacked like an enemy with a bow and arrows, killing our loved ones. He has burned to the ground the homes on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: O do kɛŋɔ dɔm waa harɛ o to pa ba nɛ, dɛ kpoo nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ ba nɛ dɛɛ nyin ba kohona. O bandia kohona la ba Jerusalam tena nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was like an enemy! He left Israel in ruins with its palaces and fortresses destroyed, and with everyone in Judah moaning and weeping.
translation_verse: Korowii do kɛŋɔ dɔm dɛ ba chɔɡ Israel harɛ. O ɡelɔ o dekpeɡa ne kooderemi bwa berɛ dimɡbeeni, dɛ kpɔ wii ne suna dii aa wola jaɡa dɔe ba ta Juda tena nɛ.

english_verse: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.
translation_verse: O kuuɡi o Dea baa dɛ tomɔ o bini burbur ken, dɛ ɡel tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ a do ɡoroŋ, ne Ona Tɔpera bwa ba a jaɡa. Kooroo yoo, sɔfoo yoo ba bwa nyɔ o danana ne.

english_verse: The Lord abandoned his altar and his temple; he let Zion's enemies capture her fortresses. Noisy shouts were heard from the temple, as if it were a time of celebration.
translation_verse: Korowii vɛh kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo ta, dɛ ɡel o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la. O ɡelɔ dɔma ba kuuɡi kooderemi danjwɛɛre. Dɔma la do silɛɛ lɔŋɔre bela ba fa aa dɛ tomɛ, kɛŋɔ tɔpejen baa lea cheɡ tɔpere bɛl ta ken.

english_verse: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.
translation_verse: Korowii siwi beɡrɔ kɛŋɔ Saayɔn danjwɛɛ kuuɡi. O maɡɔ cheɡ kɛŋɔ ó chɔɡo kwaraa. Danjwɛɛre la do kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ wi ken, a ta bokpeɡa bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.

english_verse: Zion's gates have fallen facedown on the ground; the bars that locked the gates are smashed to pieces. Her king and royal family are prisoners in foreign lands. Her priests don't teach, and her prophets don't have a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen la doonyojena choɡlo dɛ huɡe harɛ, bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ kaɡra ɡe kuuɡi dɛ chɔɡ. Ba lawɛ o koranar ne nomonjena bwa laa ta kaa harɛfala ta. Sɔfore aa nɛra Korowii waa baɡle, asɛ Korowii keamere ɡe aa won wepila na dɛɛ le Korowii be kpa.

english_verse: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.
translation_verse: Jerusalam banjeni helɔ dɛ so harɛ jeiih ken, ba ɛ teera do ba nyuune ta dɛ kpɔ lweyale tɔ, a baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna. Bitoli ɡe ɡure nyuune su harɛ.

english_verse: My eyes are red from crying, my stomach is in knots, and I feel sick all over. My people are being wiped out, and children lie helpless in the streets of the city.
translation_verse: N wio kohona n sie bwa ɛɛ wee mɛ, n loo ɡe ku. N di suna dɛ ba koh, n nɛra chɔɡa baa chɔɡa wa, dɛkalkɛ bechale ne bechasɔɔhne bwa ɡwɛɡrɔ chɔ bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahna.

english_verse: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Lɔr ne nyɔɡre ɡelɔ ba wi dɛɛ yerɛ ba nyare, dɛɛ choɡli bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaahna kɛŋɔ baa do ba bola ken, dɛ serewe dawɛ ba nyare nɔɔra ta.

english_verse: Zion, how can I comfort you? How great is your pain? Lovely city of Jerusalem, how can I heal your wounds, gaping as wide as the sea?
translation_verse: Akwe! Ee, Jerusalam maa dɛ nyini kohona, ɛrɛɛ ń bol he waɔ? Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona larawe he bwara ɔ? Nomɛlbwa ta he wenaale nɔ dɔŋa nae bwa. He wenaale nɔ bini luŋri kɛŋɔ mpo vil ken, he ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe.

english_verse: Your prophets deceived you with false visions and lying messages— they should have warned you to leave your sins and be saved from disaster.
translation_verse: Wepila he keamere aa naa dɛɛ baɡle la ɛ nyosone, ba webaɡla la neɡre, ba ta ɡelɛ he jemɛ he wechɔɡa, ásɛ he charɛ he we-ɛɛla, ba bɛ hen lawɛ kaa harɛfala ta.

english_verse: Those who pass by shake their heads and sneer as they make fun and shout, “What a lovely city you were, the happiest on earth, but look at you now!”
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Jerusalam, nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa nyiŋi dɛɛ mamɛ. Ba viiɡi nyuune dɛɛ mamɛ, chɔɡa haa chɔɡa waa dɛ ŋɔ, “Akwe, bwɛjen Jerusalam waa wera kohona, asɛ harɛre nɛra bwa sie fa ɛɛ lɛ o nɛɛ laanee nɔ naa?”

english_verse: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, “This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you!”
translation_verse: He dɔma bwa dɛ mamɛ dɛɛ muɡli he baah. Ba mile nyoo dɛɛ pwee ŋɔ, “Ya wono chɔɡo! Tɔpere yaa dɛ kpa laanee fini!”

english_verse: The Lord has done everything that he had planned and threatened long ago. He destroyed you without mercy and let your enemies boast about their powerful forces.
translation_verse: Korowii teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta, dɛ ɛ waa o fa aa vɔrɔwa bil ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo la. O chɔɡe, o ta he nɛɛ sune, dɛ ɡel he dɔma pɔ he nɛ, dɛɛ di he loro, he chɔɡa la wa.

english_verse: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Jerusalam, wi yerɛ Korowii. He danjwɛɛre do kɛŋɔ nɛn o lole bɛl aa sewa wɛɛ wiu ken. Gel siniire ɛɛ yɔɔre chɔɔ ne jwaana kɛŋɔ nenapale, bɛ suna dii ne wii ɡel.

english_verse: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Ir jwaana bɛlbwa dɛ́ɛ wi, dɛ́ɛ yerɛ Korowii ó chae. Pili he bambile dɛ́ɛ soŋo ó sune he bii nɛ, bechale lɔr aa kpo ba ba serewe chɔ fɔɡbaahna la wa.

english_verse: Think about it, Lord! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi na. Umee he ɛ ken bwa nɔ? A chɛ kɛ haahna chwe ba bii baa dɛ nyin ba ola aa? A chɛ kɛ bá kpoo sɔfore ne Korowii keamere he Dea la bini naa?

english_verse: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.
translation_verse: Bechale ne nomonome bwa serewɔ chɔ fɔɡbaahna, ya dɔma kpoo bonɔɔna ne toli laa ta. He ta ba nɛɛ sune dɛ kpoo ba awola he baah aa dia la.

english_verse: When you were angry, Lord, you invited my enemies like guests for a party. No one survived that day; enemies killed my children, my own little ones.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ta nɔn yerɛ nɛra cheme kɛŋɔ kondikonjena dii tɔpere, asɛ ɔmee kohona bar mɛ cheme. Awola he baah aa dia la, nomɛlbwa ta wone chwa kɛɛ dɛ le a nyoa. Dɔma kpoo n bii maa dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ nyin ba kohona.

english_verse: I have suffered much because God was angry.
translation_verse: Menee nɛn maa na wenaale kohona dɛ le Korowii bandia ta.

english_verse: He chased me into a dark place, where no light could enter.
translation_verse: O doŋ mɛ le o sie mɛɛ valɛ biro bini, ɡwaa kɛ n fe aa lɔ bɔchaah ta,

english_verse: I am the only one he punishes over and over again, without ever stopping.
translation_verse: kasinteŋ, o teŋɔ dɛɛ lɔɔ mɛ waa wola ɡel tɔpebir bwa, o ta n nɛɛ sune.

english_verse: God caused my skin and flesh to waste away, and he crushed my bones.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ n ɡwaŋɛ, n ta bwadabii dɔe kpa, dɛ kuuɡi n hoɡa.

english_verse: He attacked and surrounded me with hardships and trouble;
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ suna dii ne wahala nae bar mɛ cheme, kɛŋɔ baa laɡ mɛ do dea ken.

english_verse: he forced me to sit in the dark like someone long dead.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ n do biro ta kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa biɡri la ken.

english_verse: God built a fence around me that I cannot climb over, and he chained me down.
translation_verse: O vɔɡ mɛ jɔɡrɔre ne, n do kɛŋɔ nɛn baa lawɔ do dea, n ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ won lɛ n te.

english_verse: Even when I shouted and prayed for help, he refused to listen.
translation_verse: Hale n kpɔ takpeɡ yerɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ ó cha mɛ kwaraa naa, waa n be no.

english_verse: God put big rocks in my way and made me follow a crooked path.
translation_verse: O kpɔ bwea tɔ mɛ bɔr, a ɡel n ŋwɛnɛre ɡole.

english_verse: God was like a bear or a lion waiting in ambush for me;
translation_verse: O sɔh kpɔɡ bini kɛŋɔ sisire, kɛɛ nyujente dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ lawɛ.

english_verse: he dragged me from the road, then tore me to shreds.
translation_verse: O tuɡ mɛ le ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ peeɡe n ola, dɛ ɡel mɛ n ɡbo chɔ.

english_verse: God took careful aim and shot his arrows
translation_verse: O laa o to kpɔ, dɛ kpɔ o hɛma pa n nɛ, dɛɛ ta.

english_verse: I am a joke to everyone— no one ever stops making fun of me.
translation_verse: A cheɡɛ a ta n nɛra kpɔ mɛ berɛ akwekwe nɛn, tɔpebir bwaa n mama ber ba yela baa ɡo.

english_verse: He made me eat gravel and rubbed me in the dirt.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ n chole bwea kuuɡi n nyena, n chɔ bomboɡ ta.

english_verse: I cannot find peace or remember happiness.
translation_verse: N ta deŋnesɔɔhna bɛlbwa dɔe, dɛ soh ɡɛ silɛɛ kwara aa doa.

english_verse: I tell myself, “I am finished! I can't count on the Lord to do anything for me.”
translation_verse: N hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ Korowii nɛ, n jemɔ kɛ aa biɡri n sewɛ.

english_verse: Just thinking of my troubles and my lonely wandering makes me miserable.
translation_verse: N lii n wenaale ne ɡaaɡa maa dɛ ɡaaɡe aa, a do kɛŋɔ maa di tɛɡkpela ken.

english_verse: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.
translation_verse: N dɛ lii a waa kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ n wee chwa le n bini.

english_verse: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.
translation_verse: Kɛ webeŋkpoŋ bɛlee n yon lii, ásɛ dɛ berɛ dɔ hwɛɡa.

english_verse: The Lord's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.
translation_verse: Korowii nyina kohona aa wola tonɛ bwa, ne o tedoma nomanta, ya ta soɡe le, waa yaa ɡel bwa.

english_verse: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.
translation_verse: Chɔɔ bɛlbwaa aa beɡre anfala. N Naa Korowii, he ɡbo waa dɔ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I say, “The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him!”
translation_verse: Korowiirii n komɛlbwa, n hwɛɡa bwa lɔ o nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is kind to everyone who trusts and obeys him.
translation_verse: Korowii wer tɛ nɛra baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛ, dɛɛ nyinu bambile bwa ne,

english_verse: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.
translation_verse: anomanta, a wer kɛŋɔ nɛn lawɛ bambile dɛɛ kpa lɛɛ waa ba lɛ nɛra la.

english_verse: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ nɛn hweli ɡɛ bambile nɔ lawa le o bonɔɔne kɛɛ toli saŋ.

english_verse: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛn la ɡbo so jeih dɛ́ kpɔ liire, dɛkalkɛ Korowiirii ɡela a ba o nɛ.

english_verse: Being rubbed in the dirt can teach us a lesson;
translation_verse: Naate kpɔ nyoa teɡɛ harɛ, á baɡle kɛ o sɛh chɔɡre, hwɛɡa ane ken ta lole.

english_verse: we can also learn from insults and hard knocks.
translation_verse: Ó sɛh chɛɡa ne sihiih, dɛ lɔɔra bɛlbwa.

english_verse: The Lord won't always reject us!
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ sune nɛra nɛ, waa won den vɛɛh ba ka tonɛ.

english_verse: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ba suna dii nee, kɛ wɛɛ berɔ dɔ tedoma, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe kan kohona.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't enjoy sending grief or pain.
translation_verse: O sie aa lɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ wenaale kɛɛ suna dii ba ta nɛn nɛ.

english_verse: Don't trample prisoners under your feet
translation_verse: Nɛra tiɡri nɛra baa laɡ ba do dea do harɛ,

english_verse: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything,
translation_verse: dɛ tɔ ba waa baa dɔa kɛ ba ɛ ŋwɛnɛ Nemenɛ Korowii sie,

english_verse: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.
translation_verse: dɛ ba berɛ nɛn waa sie kɔɔto aa, amɔ Korowii aa a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwaa na naa?

english_verse: No one can do anything without the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ bol waa aa won chiɡ, dɛ Korowii laa sɛah kɛ a chiɡo?

english_verse: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii nyoa laa wechɔɡa ne wedɛɛɡa bwa do aa?

english_verse: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ nɛn ta soɡe le dɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra o wechɔɡa wa aa, wɛɛ naɡre waɔ?

english_verse: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya nyiŋi ya we-ɛɛla bini na, dɛ́ charɛ ya liire, dɛ́ berɛ ba Korowii be.

english_verse: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say,
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya pili ya bambili dɛ́ ir nɔɔra soŋe Korowii waa dɛ di kora nyundua ŋɔ,

english_verse: “We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!
translation_verse: “N Naa Korowii, ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ ɛɛ deŋnekpeɡ, he ta ya wechɔɡa kpɔe kɛ yaa.

english_verse: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.
translation_verse: He bandia kohona ɡelɔ he ti yaa, dɛ kpoo yaa haa wola ya nɛɛ sune.

english_verse: You are behind a wall of clouds that blocks out our prayers.
translation_verse: He kpɔ bandia bɔle he te kɛŋɔ bam, ásɛ ya wesoŋa bɛ won tel he be.

english_verse: You allowed nations to treat us like garbage;
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ ya do kɛŋɔ puldoa haahra harɛre nɛra be.

english_verse: We are terrified and trapped, caught and crushed.”
translation_verse: Ya na ɔmewaa kohona, ba harɛ yaa nafuɡere, ba lawɛ yaa dɛ kpoo yaa.

english_verse: My people are destroyed! Tears flood my eyes,
translation_verse: Siniire dɛ yɔɔ mɛ kɛŋɔ nenapale, kpoora baa kpoo n nɛra la wa.

english_verse: until the Lord looks down from heaven and helps.
translation_verse: ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡbaɡba aa le nyundua dɛ na.

english_verse: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.
translation_verse: N nyiŋi waa aa pu haahna bwa baa lɔ bwɛjen Jerusalam la aa, dɛ n bambile chɔɡɔ.

english_verse: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.
translation_verse: N dɔma hah mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ dɛɛ kpaah mɛ kɛŋɔ jumbie ken.

english_verse: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.
translation_verse: Ba lawɛ n ne n siwi ta kɔlɔŋ bini, dɛ foɡ mɛ bwea, dɛ́ fee kpo mɛ.

english_verse: Water covered my head— I thought I was gone.
translation_verse: Ate, nee ba bɔle n nɛ, asɛ n lii ŋɔ n sewɔ tonɛ.

english_verse: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n wio noe le kɔlɔŋ la bini ŋɔ hé cha mɛ.

english_verse: I begged you to listen. “Help!” I shouted. “Save me!” You answered my prayer
translation_verse: He no n waa maa kpɔa bil he sie. Bɛ deŋna tɔɔɡe, no n wii, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.

english_verse: and came when I was in need. You told me, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: He no n wesoŋa la, dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ n bɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You rescued me and saved my life.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he baa che n habɔɔ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: You saw them abuse me, Lord, so make things right.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he ɡbabir na wechɔɡa baa kpɔa ɛɛ mɛ. Ba bol n waa tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: You know every plot they have made against me.
translation_verse: He ɡbabir na ɡɛ n dɔma aa hah mɛ, ne ɡɛ baa dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa.

english_verse: All day long they attack with words and whispers.
translation_verse: Tɔpebir bwaa baa bol n wa, dɛɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa.

english_verse: No matter what they are doing, they keep on mocking me.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ n waa berɛ yela dɛɛ ɡo chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa.

english_verse: Pay them back for everything they have done, Lord!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ aa chɛa, ba waa baa ɛa la wa.

english_verse: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel ba dɔ hwɛɡa bɛlbwa, ásɛ he nyotaahna do ba nɛ.

english_verse: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.
translation_verse: Kpɔ bandia ti ba, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba le harɛ nɔ ta kwaraa!”

english_verse: The purest gold is ruined and has lost its shine; jewels from the temple lie scattered in the streets.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ ya suuɡaswɛm sie aa chɔɡa, suuɡaswɛm tenten o fa aa dɛ nyɛɡle kohona la, o ta berɛ do ɡɛ kpa. Korowii Dea bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, peɡrɔ dɛ chɔ fɔɡbaahna.

english_verse: These are Zion's people, worth more than purest gold; yet they are counted worthless like dishes of clay.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ bwɛjen Saayɔn bonɔɔna ba fa aa do kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm a yoɡ aa kpeɡa aa doa, kɛ taraken, ba berɔ do kɛŋɔ vii baa kpɔ choh mao ken.

english_verse: Even jackals nurse their young, but my people are like ostriches that abandon their own.
translation_verse: Kalampoŋa ɡba jemɛ ɡɛ waa ɔr o bie dɛ́ nyiŋi o nɛɛ ó kpeɡ. Kɛ n nɛra Jerusalam tena nyu bini kpeɡri ba bii nɛɛ, kɛŋɔ taataa ken.

english_verse: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.
translation_verse: Ba ɡelɔ nyɔɡre ne lɔr kpo bechasɔɔhne baa serewe. Bechale ɡaaɡɔ dɛɛ soŋe kondikwa, kɛ nomɛlbwa aa ban tɛ.

english_verse: All who ate expensive foods lie starving in the streets; those who grew up in luxury now sit on trash heaps.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba fa aa dɔ kondikondɛɛɡa dɛɛ di la, lɔr kpo ba ba serewe chɔ fɔɡbaahna. Banɔ la baa dɛ di yɛɛ ɡe kam kompuɡreri puldoa dɛɛ di.

english_verse: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.
translation_verse: N nɛra deŋnetɛra ɡwaa Sodom tena Korowii aa ɡela ba chɔɡa piɡ ba, nomɛlbwa aa wola wone lɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: The leaders of Jerusalem were purer than snow and whiter than milk; their bodies were healthy and glowed like jewels.
translation_verse: Jerusalam sitɔɔla waa fa do chasee kɛŋɔ yabi aa toa ken. Ba fa dɔ bwadabii dɛ dɔ bokpeɡa, dɛ je ɡe kohona.

english_verse: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken ba serewɔ chɔ fɔɡbaahna baa wola ban jemɛ. Ba bwadabii holɔ kɛŋɔ da, dɛ marɛ ba hoɡa.

english_verse: Being killed with a sword is better than slowly starving to death.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa sewɛ laa ta la, bɔ banɔ la lɔr aa kpoo ba. Kondikwa bɛ toole waa lɔr kpoo ba.

english_verse: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
translation_verse: Wenaale aa chiɡ n nɛra nɛɛ nɔ, a ba wedoŋa kohona ne taeh, hale haahna baa dɔ tedoma tɛ ba bii daa ba ola chwe.

english_verse: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
translation_verse: Korowii baah diu kohona, asɛ o choŋi nii dɛ fuh Saayɔn bwa dɛɛboo ken.

english_verse: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
translation_verse: Harɛre koranar, kɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛn bɛlbwa, ta liire kɛŋɔ dɔma ɛɛ won kpɔ Jerusalam doonyojena ta jo o bini.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Kɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ wono chiɡ, dɛkalkɛ a cheɡɛ Korowii keamere ne o sɔfore wechɔɡa ta, nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ serewe.

english_verse: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ keamere ne sɔfore la dɛ ɡaaɡe fɔɡbaahna kɛŋɔ nyoŋa ken. Nɛra aa cheɡɛ ba nɛɛ ba serewe, ba chale do ba nɛɛ la ɡelɔ ba kah doŋa, anomanta, nomɛlbwa aa won leɡ ba.

english_verse: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra la nyɛɡ ba nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé le ya be kaa! Hé kah doŋa! He bɛ yaa leɡe!” Gɛɛ baa ba harɛre ta doe dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡbabirii lɔ ba peɡre, o laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ. Nɛra aa sɔfore duu, baa nomonome ɡe kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.
translation_verse: Ya dɔma dɛ nyiŋi ya vala bwa bini, a ɡel yaa won fɔɡbaahna kwaaraa valɛ. Ya tɔpere telo tonɛ, a ka tamaa ken ya serewe.

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: Ba ɡbaŋre ɡwaa kɛŋɔ kee yon le nyundua la ken, dɛ ba tɔ ya nɛ. Ba ti yaa bwejena dor, dɛ ka sɔh dɛɛ kpaah yaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: Ba lawɛ kooro Korowii aa leo tɛ yaa. Ya liiro kɛŋɔ o nɛɛ yá che dɛ́ dɔ mkpa. Onee ya yarada kɛŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ yaa le nomɛlbwa waa ba lɔ tɔ ya nɛɛ la be.

english_verse: You people of Edom can celebrate now! But your time will come to suffer and stagger around naked.
translation_verse: Edom ne Us tena, hé hɛɡre dɛ́ ɡel he sie lɛ. He ɡe chɔɡa dɛ ba, hɛɛ yɛɛɡoo mumɡbal ne, ásɛ sihiih kpo heya.

english_verse: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
translation_verse: Saayɔn tena dɔ deŋnetɛra ba wechɔɡa wa, Korowii aa ɡel ba lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta kpa. Kɛ he Edom tena te, wɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee, dɛ́ le he nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla ne baŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, lii ya wa dɛ́ na waa aa pu yaa. Nyiŋi dɛ́ na ɡɛ sihiih aa kpo yaa.

english_verse: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.
translation_verse: Harɛ waa ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon kaa di nɛŋhɔɔhra nɔn ta, harɛfala nɛra lɛ ya deremi dɛ so a ta.

english_verse: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
translation_verse: Ya mɛɛnanar serewɔ asɛ ya ɛ bilalbii, ya nyare ɛ luhaahna.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ bɔ nee kem mɔɔ dɛ́ dɔ nyɔ, ɡɛ tentenee yaa yawɛ damara ɡe.

english_verse: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.
translation_verse: Ya dɔma ti yaa dɛɛ di ya nafeena, ya koɔh kɛ baa yaa ɡel ya onɛ.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: Ya koh kondikwaa yaa dɔ di wa, dɛ kpɔ ya te ka do Ijipt ne Asiiria tena lɔɡa.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Ya naawa fa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ bwa serewe kaa, kɛ taraken yanee bera dɔ a deŋnetɛra.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Yomaa bera dɛɛ nyiŋi ya nɛ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won lɛ yaa le kpeɡri baa dɛ di ya nɛɛ ta.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Nɛŋkpoa aa lɔ kpɔɡ bini nomanta, ya dɛ sɛh seo kwara dɛ le kaa nyin kondikwa.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: Ba ɡuɡri haahna dɛ laɡ ba chɔ Saayɔn Bwejen ta, ɡɛɛ ba ɛ toli baa wola baala jemɛ ɡe Juda harɛ bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ɡe ta.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: Ba vɔrɔwe ya sitɔɔla nɔɔra ŋwɛɛra ne dɛ ka saɡ ba, baa duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ banjeni.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: Ba ɛɡre bonɔɔna baa namɛ boyu kɛŋɔ yoma ken, bibaala ɡe che datɔɡa dɛɛ kɛŋle.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Nomonome aa bwɛjen la doonyojen ta bela so kpa, bonɔɔna ɡe ɡel yela ɡoe.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa toole ya won dɛɛ tamane o waa kpa. Ya ɛ wechɔɡa nomanta, wenaale kohona ba ya nɛ.

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Gɛ ɡelɔ ya bambili bwa chɔɡ, siniire nomanta, ya sibie swɛɛrɔ, yaa wone dɛɛ na kɛrɛdɛ kpa,

english_verse: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ Saayɔn Bwejen chɔ pɛɛ, asɛ kalampoŋare do o ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he dɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa, hɛɛ teŋɔɔ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: Bring us back to you! Give us a fresh start.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, berɛ lawɛ yaa ba he be. Berɛ ɡel ya dɔ silɛɛ o fa aa lole wubwa la.

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Kɛɛ he deno vɛh yaa kwara kɛɛ? He bandia ta jaɡa dɔe ya nɛ aa?

english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
translation_verse: N nao kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ bɛl aa taa dɛ kpɔ bam waa kana le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, nii baro cheme, o bini ɛɛ nyɛɡle pelɔpelɔ ken. Waa dɛ nyɛɡle la, komɛl do kɛŋɔ ayaawa ken dɛ do o bini.

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: Maa nyiŋi nii la bini la, n na hweera kwaa anaarɛ a mar aa do kɛŋɔ nɛn bela,

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: bɛlbwa dɔ siebɔra anaarɛ ne kena anaarɛ.

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: A nakpale toɡrɔ, a napaala ɡe do kɛŋɔ nabale kwa, dɛɛ nyɛɡle kohona kɛŋɔ ayaawa baa looru ken.

english_verse: Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand.
translation_verse: A siebɔra anaarɛ ne kena anaarɛ la habɔɔ, bɛlbwa dɔ nɛn nɔn beŋkpoŋ keni bɛlbwa lɔɡa, a ɛ nɔɔra anaarɛ.

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: A bɛlbwa kena nyoo dɛ leɡe o dɔŋ kwa, a pɛ dɛɛ ir, aa a te berɛ.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Siebɔra hweera kwaa anaarɛ la aa dɔa la kokoɡrɔ. Gɛ aa doa teŋa nɔ. Nɛn siebɔr lɔ o sie, nyujente siebɔr do diɡ, nabal siebɔr do ɡal, asɛ kee siebɔr do habɔɔ.

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛɛ a siebɔra do. A bɛlbwa dɔ kena anaarɛ, a paɡri anɛ kaa nyundua aa leɡe dɔŋa kwa, anɛ ɡe ɛɛ bɔle a bwara.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Bobɛlbwa Korowii Doma la aa dɛ kaa ane la, kaalaa aa kaa, aa sie berɛ.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Hweera kwaa la dɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ ninhɔla kɛɛ kapɛle ken. Asɛ nii do a baahna ta, dɛ la sie dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ chaah dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwaala.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Hweera kwaa la laŋɔ dɛɛ ba wɔrɔbe nɛɛ kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ nyɛɡle la.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Maa dɛ nyiŋi hweera kwaa la, n na kwaane a do kɛŋɔ saaker nakpale anaarɛ a che harɛ a bɛlbwa jwɛh.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Saaker nakpale anaarɛ la dɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane baa dɛ yera kresolet, a bwa ɛ siwi beŋkpoŋ. A do kɛŋɔ beŋkpoŋ su o dɔŋ ta ken.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning.
translation_verse: Bobɛlbwa hweera kwaa la aa dɛ kaa la, kaalaa aa kaa, saaker nakpale la aa menɛ dɛɛ kaa bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ saaker nakpale la kan, dɛ do ɔma kohona sibie su a bwa bar.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Hweera kwaa la dɛ kaa laa, a ne saaker nakpale laanee dɛɛ kaa, a cheɡɔ aa, dɛ a ɡe cheɡɔ. A iro aa, saaker nakpale la yon marɛ a nɛ, dɛkalkɛ hweera kwaa la doma lɔ saaker nakpale la ta.

english_verse: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.
translation_verse: Kon la aa bɔle a nyundua la lɔɡa la, a paɡri a kena anɛ a leɡe dɔŋa, dɛ kpɔ anɛ ɡe tɔ a bwara.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Hweera kwaa la dɛ kaa laa, n dɛ no a kena sii kɛŋɔ chuubu aa dɛ si la ken, a berɛ do kɛŋɔ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la taa, kɛɛ laa tena aa wara ɡbɔɡa ken. A cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ aa, dɛ a fɔɔ a kena la.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: N berɔ no taa bɛl le kon waa bɔle hweera kwaa la nyundua ɡɛ saŋ aa baa che dɛ fɔɔ a kena la.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Kon waa bɔle hweera kwaa la nyundua la, n na komɛl waa do kɛŋɔ kookara, ba kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane aa ɛ burum baa yera safaaya ɛ o doa, asɛ a do kɛŋɔ nɛn soɡe kookara la ta ken.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: N nao kɛŋɔ nɛn waa soɡe kookara la ta la, le o chara ta dɛ kaa nyundua do kɛŋɔ buni baa doo nii ta wɛɛ nyɛɡle, dɛ́ berɛ le o chara ta dɛ́ ba harɛ la ɡe do kɛŋɔ nii, asɛ nii waa chaahna kohona baro cheme.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Gɛ bwaala deŋɡare yon le baama ta bɔr chaah la, ɡɛɛ bɔr waa chaahna bar kookara la do. A dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii jirima aa doa. Maa nao la, n cholo dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ, asɛ dɛ no taa bɛl.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ir che ásɛ n bol waa he be.”

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Waa dɛ bol waa la, o Doma baa so n nɛ dɛ ɡɔɔ mɛ ir che, asɛ mɛɛ no o wobol la.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, n dɛ tomɛ n nɛra Israel tena be. Nɛra ba deŋne aa kpeɡa, ba ne ba naawa vɛɛh mɛ le saŋ la ba le fini.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Nɛra men Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ tomɛ ba be la lwɛɛma kpeɡri, baa men bu. N dɛ tomɛ he ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ kenii mɛɛ bol.

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: Ba no he be kɛɛ ba ta he be noɛ yoo, ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena wubwa, kɛ baa jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii keame ba ba be.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
translation_verse: Kɛ hen nɛwɛnyini bie, dɛɛ berɛ ba ɔma, dɛɛ berɛ ba waa baa dɛ bol ɡe ɔma, a do kɛŋɔ haa dɛ la ka do jabalnadaŋɛre ne sɔɔhne baah ta. Nɔrɔme baah taa hɛɛ la ka jo, kɛ bɛ ban ɔmɛ. Bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ ba sie, ba deŋne kpeɡri.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen nɛwɛnyini bie, dɛɛ no waa maa dɛ bol he be nɔ. Bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kɛ ban. Hah nyoa dɛ́ lɛ kwaa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛɛ nɔ di.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Belaa n nyiŋi dɛ na nɔn bɛl aa tɛra ba n be asɛ dɛ kpoŋe tɔn,

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: dɛ paɡru n sie. Dɛ ba chwerɛ wiile, wii ne wenaale waa do o sie ne o habɔɔ.
