english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa lɔ bojaŋa la, weechɔɡaa dɛ́ kpoo ba, ásɛ banɔ la baa bɛna la serewe laa ta. Banɔ la baa kaa la, lɔr ɛɛ kpo ba ɡee ba serewe. Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɡela ba na n bandia kohona.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ serewoo chɔ bobɛlbwa, ba voɡare ne kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta bwa, ne deŋɡarere ta ne bwejena dor ne dajena mune, dɛ bela baa fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare bwa.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Kpelaa, mɛɛ tɛr n nɔnee pa ba nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba harɛ. Mɛɛ ɡeloo ó chɔ pɛɛ le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Dibla, ne bobɛlbwa baa soɡa. Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛ menee Korowii.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii bol men Ɛsekeɛl be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Israel tena harɛ la dɛ ba chɔɡa. O bwa ɛɛ chɔɡo kwaraa.

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Maa he nɛɛ sune, maa kpɔ kɛ heya, mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee he wechɔɡa ne waa maa kia he ɛa la wa. Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ”

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Waa bwa jaɡa saŋ la telo, o pu heyaa tonɛ. O joɔ.

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa soɡe harɛ la ta, he chɔɡa telo. Saŋ la telo, tɔpere la joɔ tonɛ. Silɛɛ bɛlbwa toole voɡa aa lɔ bwea dor ta kpa, sibeɡra ɡboo.

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Maa biɡri dɛ́ kpɔ n bandia ba he nɛ, mɛɛ bol he waa haa ɛa la waa dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne waa maa kia he ɛa la wa.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: Maa he nɛɛ sune, maa kpɔ kɛ heya. Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee waa haa ɛa la ne waa maa kia he ɛ la waa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii ba a ne.

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: He naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla la ɛɛ berɛ daŋɡbalaa, dɛ́ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne, ba komɛlbwa aa kae ba, ba kondɔɔh ne kwaa aa dɛ tɛɛ ba jirima la bɛlbwa aa kae ba.

english_verse: The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop,
translation_verse: Tɔpere la telo, o pu heyaa tonɛ. Kon-yoɡra ne yarawa sie aa lɛ, n bandia la dɛ ba nɛnlaa la bwa nɛ.

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa yoɡ harɛ tɛ o dɔŋ la, dɛ ba bwa ta soɡe le naa, waa berɛ dɔɔ kpa. Wepila aa dɛ baɡle nɛnlaa la bwa waa la aa beɡre. Ba wechɔɡa nomanta, beŋkpoŋ kwara aa o nyuu dɔ.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Ba hoh laa bɛla nomɛlbwa kpɔ o te, kɛ nɛn waa la laa toole, dɛkalkɛ n baah di nɛnlaa la bwa nɛ.

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: He leɔ kɛrɛ aa, he lɔ laa ta, he berɔ so dem ɡe aa, he ne weechɔɡa ne lɔree. Laa taa banɔ la baa lɔ kpɔɡ bini ɛɛ ba serewa. Banɔ la ɡe baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta la, weechɔɡa ne lɔree dɛɛ ba ba kpoora.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa dɔ ba nyu dɛ chwa la ɛɛ ka so bwejena doree, dɛɛ wi kɛŋɔ fɛlembɔjena bini kwehre ken, bɛlbwa wechɔɡa waa ɛa wa.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, ásɛ ba bwara ɛɛ sa.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: Baa kpɔ lweyalee tɔ ɔmee laɡ ba kohona. Sihiih ɛɛ kpo baa ba fonɛ ba nyuune bwa ta, á baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Baa kpɔ ba suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛmee ta fɔɡbaahna kɛŋɔ chaa. Ba suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm la aa won lɛɛ ba le men Korowii bandia tɔpere la ta. Baa won kpɔa yawɛ kwaa di, baa won dia ɡe dɛ́ vaɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ a taa ba lɔ naa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Ba maŋkura ba te ba suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa ne baŋa kwaa ne noniseɡa aa wera la, dɛ kpɔ ɛ voɡa maa kia ne kondoŋa. A waa mɛɛ ba ɡela ba kondɔɔh ɛ kondoŋa tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ laa sie kpɔ ba be, ásɛ ŋwɛɛra ba jo n Dea bela laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa aa lole la, dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kaoh.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: Hé nyin jɔɡrɔre cheɡ, nɛŋkpoa ɡboo harɛ la bwa, yoi ɡboo bwɛjen la bwa.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛnchɔɡa tenten le harɛre ta ba, dɛ́ ba lɛ he deene dɛ́ kpɔ. Mɛɛ ɡeloo he kpeɡnɛra haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ ba nɛɛ la nyoa sɔɔh, dɛ́ ɡel bela haa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Chɔɡa la dɛ ba, hɛɛ dɛɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhnaa, kɛ haa dɔ.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Harɛchɔɡ ɛɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ ba, waa aa wola kasinteŋ ɛɛ la ɡe ɛɛ warɔɔ saŋ bɛlbwa. Hɛɛ dɛɛ nyinuu kɛ he no wepila waa le n keamere be. N waa la nyoɡre sɔfore liire ta, baa won bola kpa. Nomonome ɡe aa won jemɛ ja nɛra kpa.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Kooro ɛɛ wiu, sitɔɔ bwara yɔr, ásɛ harɛ la ta nɛra bwara ɛɛ sa. He we-ɛɛla taa mɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa mɛɛ ba kpɔe pa heyaa bolchɔɡe, ɡɛ haa ɛ he bala la. Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ yaa kaa harɛfale ta bene anumɛl korobinumɛl tɔpenue ta la, dɛ men Ɛsekeɛl soɡe n dem, asɛ Juda tena nomonome la cheme n sie, asɛ Nemenɛ Korowii Doma den ba so n nɛ.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: N nyiŋo dɛ na komɛl wepila ta kɛŋɔ nɛn ken. Le o chara ta kaa o nakpale ta do kɛŋɔ ninlao ken, dɛ berɛ le o chara ta kaa o nyundua ɡe do kɛŋɔ ayaawa baa looru wɛɛ nyɛɡle.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: O tɛr komɛl kɛŋɔ nɛn nɔn dɛ lawɛ n nyumpona, asɛ Korowii Doma ɡɔɔ mɛ n do harɛ ne nyundua baah ta. A ɡɛ wepila nɔ ta la, Korowii kpɔ mɛ kaa Jerusalam o Dea la dembaah doonyoa waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua pera, dɛ voɡ Korowii aa kiu kɔkɔkɔkɔ lɔ bela.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Belaa n na Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ jirima, ɡɛ n fa aa nao Keba Moo la bɔr la.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, nyiŋi weekaŋle nyundua pera.” Asɛ n nyiŋi doonyoa waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ voɡ Korowii aa kiu kɔkɔkɔkɔ la cheɡɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta jwɛh.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na waa maa kia Israel tena ɛa bonɔ kenɛ? Waa aa doŋ mɛ le n Dea kaa bojaŋee ba ɛ la. Hɛɛ na anɔ la maa kia kohonaa á ɡwaa anɔ kwara.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Asɛ o laɡ mɛ ba dembaah la doonyoa bela. N nyiŋo dɛ na bɔɔ bɛl danjwɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, paɡri bɔɔ nɔ.” Maa paɡru la, n nao kɛŋɔ doonyoa bɛlee.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Jo dɛ́ ka na wedoŋa ne kwaa maa kia baa ɛa bela.”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Ate, n jo dɛ ka na kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, ne ola maa kia bwa, Israel tena voɡa baa ɛa dɛɛ toma bwa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la bwa ta.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Dɛ Israel nomonome fifraanuanɛ lɔ bela, asɛ Safan bibaa Jaasania ja ba nɛ. Ba bɛlbwa kpoŋe kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile a ta, chuu la sɔɔh do som dɛɛ kaa nyundua.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na waa Israel nomonome aa baa sɔh dɛɛ ɛ kenɛ? Ba lɔ dea ba voɡa aa suu bini dɛɛ toma. Waa baa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Korowii aa yaa na, o vɛh harɛ nɔ.’ ”

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ na anɔ la maa kia kohona á ɡwaa anɔ.”

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ laɡ mɛ ba o Dea la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa la ta, asɛ n na haahna bane baa soɡa dɛɛ wi ba voɡ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Taamus la seo.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: O berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na anɔ ɡe kenɛ? Hɛɛ na anɔ la maa kia kohona á ɡwaa anɔ kwara.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na anɔ kenɛ? Juda tena dɛ ɛ waa maa kia la, a ɡbo ta ba ne maɡrɛ, ba berɔ kpɔ naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla perɛ bwɛɛre la bwa, dɛɛ muɡli n baah, dɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ kohona.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee bandia ne, maa ba nɛɛ sune, maa ba bwaraa kpɔ kɛ ba. Ba wio noo mɛ kohona noo, maa ba bee no.”

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Korowii kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛjen nɔ ba bonɔ, bɛlbwa kpɔ o dɔmkon kpoŋe.”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Belaa n na baala banumɛl ba le Korowii Dea doonyoa o sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, bɛlbwa kpoŋe dɔmkon. Dɛ baa bɛl jao dɛ tɔ yapoŋ, asɛ kwaa waa kpɔa dɛɛ chwerɛ do o be. Ba bwa baa jo Dea la bini dɛ ba che saraha kon baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo jwɛh.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la jirima le Kerobim la ta, bela o fa aa lole la, dɛ kaa Dea la doonyoa. Korowii ŋɔ baa la waa tɔ yapoŋ asɛ kwaa waa kpɔ chwerɛ do o be la be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: “Gaaɡe Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna, dɛ́ do nɛra baa na waa maa kia, asɛ baa wi dɛɛ di suna a waa la nso ba tili ta.”

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Hé kpoo banjeni, bonɔɔna ne toli, haahna ne bechale. Kɛ he bɛ banɔ la baa do ba nso la te kpoo. Hé pa mun le n Dea bonɔ.” Anomanta, ba pa mun le nomonome baa lɔ Korowii Dea la sie nɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé pa nɛra haa kpoo ba la ba su n dembaah bela, dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah n Dea la. Hé kaa.” Anomanta, ba jo bwɛjen la bini, dɛ pa mun dɛɛ kpoo nɛra la.

english_verse: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
translation_verse: Ba lɔ nɛŋkpoa la ta, asɛ a ka n ɡbo che. Belaa n kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ do lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Oo! Nemenɛ Korowii, amɔ he dɛ ba Israel tena baa kaa nɔ bwa kpoora, dii he baah aa dia Jerusalam tena nɛɛ kohona nɔ wa aa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Korowii chaŋ mɛ ŋɔ, “Israel ne Juda tena wechɔɡa ɡwaalɔ kohona, nɛŋkpoa ɡboo harɛ la bwa, kasinteŋ toole Jerusalam kpa. Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Korowii vɛh ya harɛ nɔ, waa yaa na.’

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, maa ba nɛɛ sune, maa ba bwaraa kpɔ kɛ ba, mɛɛ ɛɛ ba ɡɛ baa ɛ bane la.”

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Belaa baa la waa tɔ yapoŋ asɛ kwaa baa dɛ chwerɛ ane do o be la berɛ la ka ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “N kaa ɛ waa haa do mɛ a ta la tonɛ.”

english_verse: I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne.
translation_verse: Men Ɛsekeɛl nyiŋi kon waa bɔle Kerobim la doa, dɛ na komɛl kɛŋɔ kookara baa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane aa ɛ burum baa yera safaaya ɛo.

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ baa la waa tɔ yapoŋ la be ŋɔ, “La saaker nakpale aa lɔ Kerobim la lɔɡa la baah ta. Pa ninhɔla he nɔɔra su, dɛ́ kpɔ merɛ bwɛjen la ta.” N taa cheɡa dɛɛ nyiŋu la, o kaa jo.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Dɛ Kerobim la cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ baa la ka jo bela. Belaa bam ba tɔ Korowii Dea dembaah bela bwa.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Korowii jirima le Kerobim la ta, dɛ ba kaa Korowii Dea la doonyoa bela. Bam baa tɔ dembaah bela, asɛ Korowii jirima chaah bela bwa.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Kerobim la kena dɛ si, dɛ nɛn lɔ dembaah la baŋ kwaraa naa, o dɛ no sii la. A sii la do kɛŋɔ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la taa ken.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Belaa Kerobim la bɛl tɛr nɔn, dɛ kpɔ nii aa lɔ a baah ta la ane do baa la aa tɔ yapoŋ la nɔn ta, asɛ o lɛ dɛ kpɔ le kaa.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: Kerobim la bɛlbwa kena lɔɡre la, kwaane do kɛŋɔ nɛn nɔɔra ken.

english_verse: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.
translation_verse: Men Ɛsekeɛl berɔ nyiŋi dɛ na saaker nakpale anaarɛ. Beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa cheɡɛ Kerobim la jwɛh, dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane baa dɛ yera kresolet ken.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: He nyiŋi saaker nakpale la aa, anaarɛ la bwa le dɔŋa. A do kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa berɔ su o dɔŋ ta ken.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.
translation_verse: Kerobim la dɛ kaa laa, a won baŋne anaarɛ a siebɔra la aa chaɡa la bɛlbwa kaala. Saaker nakpale la aa sie berɛ.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Kerobim la bwara bwa, a habɔɔ ne nɔɔra dɛ a kena ta bwa dɔ sibie, ɡɛɛ a saaker nakpale anaarɛ la ɡe dɔ sibie.

english_verse: And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
translation_verse: N no taa bɛl wɛɛ yerɛ ŋɔ, “Saaker nakpale aa dɛ kile kɛŋɔ kawulewule.”

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Kerobim la bɛlbwa dɔ siebɔra anaarɛ. Onla waa tɔ sie do kɛŋɔ nabal siebɔr, nɛɛte do kɛŋɔ nɛn siebɔr, toorote do kɛŋɔ nyujente siebɔr, naarɛte la ɡe do kɛŋɔ kee siebɔr.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Kerobim la cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ aa, dɛ saaker nakpale la ɡe cheɡɔ, Kerobim la iro dɛɛ kaa nyundua aa, a ne anee dɛɛ ir, dɛkalkɛ hweera kwaa la doma lɔ a nakpale la ta.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii jirima le o Dea doonyoa bela dɛ ba che Kerobim la nyundua.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Maa nyiŋa la, n nao kɛ Kerobim la paɡri kena dɛ ir kaa nyundua, a ne saaker nakpale la. A kaa che Korowii Dea wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, asɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la jirima tɔ a nɛ.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ hweera kwaa nɔɔ n fa na Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ jirima tɔ a nɛɛ Keba Moo la bɔr la. Anee ɡela n jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ɛ Kerobim.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: A siebɔra do kɛŋɔ anɔ la n fa aa naa Keba Moo la bɔr la. Bɛlbwa pa sie dɛɛ kaa, aa a te berɛ.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: asɛ n bol wobɛlbwa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡ mɛ la chaɡle n bala la.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, baala nɔɔ dɔ liichɔɡa dɛɛ do nɛra baa ɛ wechɔɡa bwɛjen nɔ ta la.

english_verse: They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’
translation_verse: Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Saŋ aa chɛ kɛ ya do deene ta telaa? Bwɛjen nɔ do kɛŋɔ vii baa kpɔa dɛɛ daa kwa, asɛ ya ɡee ola aa lɔ o bini.’

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Korowii Doma la baa so n nɛ, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ ń bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “N jemɛ waa haa dɛ bol, ne anɔ la haa dɛ vɔrɔwe bwa ɡe.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: He kpoo nɛra bwɛjen nɔ ta warɛ ɡa, ba lala perɛ fɔɡbaahna bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra haa kpoo ba perɛ bobɛlbwa laanee ola la, asɛ bwɛjen nɔ ɡee vii la. Kɛ mɛɛ doŋi heyaa le o ta.

english_verse: and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɔmɛ laa, kɛ laalee mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta he nɛɛ bá kpoo heya.

english_verse: Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ doŋi heyaa le bwɛjen nɔ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ heyaa do nɛŋhɔɔhra nɔn ta, dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne.

english_verse: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: He ɡbaɡba harɛ taa baa ba heyaa kpoora laa ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen nɔ aa won lɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ ola lɔ vii bini aa, o yon tɔ a nɛɛ la. Israel harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa haa ka do bwa, mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee.

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii, dɛkalkɛ he ta me Mmarare ne n waa ta teŋɛ, dɛ kaa teŋɛ harɛre aa bar heyaa cheme nɔ tena mmarare ta.’ ”

english_verse: Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, “Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: N nyoa taa lɔ waa aa dɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala ta mɛɛ bol la, Bɛnaya bibaa Pɛlatea den chole sewɛ. Belaa n kpɔ sie pi harɛ, dɛ do lɔŋɔ lokua ne kohona ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, amɔ he dɛ ba nɛra baa ka Israel harɛ bwa chɔɡa kwaraa kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam dɛ bol he ne he bala Israel tena baa lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa harɛfale ta la waa ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa Babelɔn la ne men Korowii baah jaŋne kɛŋɔ ba won tom mɛ, dɛ ŋɔ banee Israel harɛ la ɛ ba kon.’ ” Korowii baɡɛ Israel tena nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ba ba nee

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bol he bala baa lawɛ he ne ban kaa harɛfala ta la be ŋɔ, ‘Menee ɡela ba laɡ ba kaa bojaŋa, ba lɔ peɡre harɛre ane ta la. Kɛ taraken nɔ, mɛɛ ja ba nɛɛ harɛre baa lɔ a ta la ta.’

english_verse: And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again.
translation_verse: Berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ boa ba nyoa le harɛre maa lɔ ba peɡre a ta la taa, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ Israel harɛ la tɛɛ ba ja.’

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: Baa berɔ ba, dɛ́ ba laa voɡdoŋa maa kia bwa kpɔ le harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba bambile che bobeŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba liifala. Mɛɛ laa ba bambikpeɡ waa do kɛŋɔ bwe laanee kpɔ, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba bambile waa pwɛra.

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Ásɛ baa teŋɛ me Mmarare ne n waa ta kɛrɛdɛ. Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ɛ n nɛra, ásɛ n ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Kɛ banɔ la ba bambili taa lɔ kondoŋa ne voɡa maa kia ta la te, mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋne a waa. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Kerobim la paɡri a kena dɛ ir, asɛ saaker nakpale la ja a nɛ, asɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la jirima chaah kohona dɛ tɔ a nɛ.

english_verse: left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.
translation_verse: Korowii jirima le bwɛjen la ta, dɛ kaa bwejen bɛl waa lɔ o wee leebɔr doa.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Wepila la ta la, Korowii Doma la kpɔ mɛ ir ba n bala baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfale ta Babelɔn la be. Belaa wepila la ba a jaɡa,

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, deŋnekpeɡ tena binii he so la. Ba dɔ sibie kɛ baa na, dɛ dɔ deŋna ɡe kɛ baa waa no, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini bie, ɛ dɛ́ pa he laala bwa webaŋa nomɛlbwa siwi ta. Le bela kaa kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ dɛɛ kaa harɛfale ta he ka ɛ hɔɔh ken. Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ nɛra te, kɛ ba ken ɛɛ no a munii.

english_verse: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.
translation_verse: Pa he laala webaŋa ba siwi ta, ásɛ jɔmɔra ɡe he le dɛ́ɛ kaa ba bwa siwi ta, kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ dɛɛ kaa harɛfale ta la.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Forɛ bɔɔ he danjwɛɛ ta ba siwi ta, dɛ́ che bela pa he laala le.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɔr aa dɛɛ jo la, dawɛ he laala la vam ta ba siwi ta, ásɛ dɛ le kaa. Kpɔ kon tɔ sie, dɛ bɛ harɛ haa dɛ kaa o ta la na. Gɛ haa ɛ laanee dɛ́ baɡle Israel tena wa.”

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ la. Bɔr aa chaahna la, n do n bone dɛ kpɔ le kɛ nɛn baa lawɔ dɛɛ kaa harɛfale ta la. Bɔr aa dɛ jo la, n kpɔ nɔɔra forɛ bɔɔ danjwɛɛ la ɡe ta, dɛ kpɔ n bone dawɛ n vam ta nɛra la bwa siwi ta dɛ le kaa.

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, taraken Israel tena deŋnekpeɡ nɛra aa dɛ bɔɔre waa haa dɛ ɛ nɔ,

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘N waa nɔ ɛ Jerusalam kooro ne Israel tena bwa baa lɔ bela wa.’

english_verse: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Gɛ maa ɛa nɔ dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba ba ɛɛ.’ Baa laɡ ba laa taa kaa harɛfale ta.

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Kooro waa lɔ bela la ɛɛ kpɔ o bonee dawɛ vam ta jɔmɔra. Baa forɛ bɔɔ danjwɛɛ taa ó kpɔ o ta le kaa. Wɛɛ kpɔ konee tɔ sie dɛ bɛ harɛ na.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɔ o nomonome ne o laa tena bwaa peɡre bobɛlbwa, ásɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: Dɛ n laɡ ba kaa harɛfala ta dɛ lɔ ba peɡre harɛre ta naa, a taa baa ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡel ba bini tama banee ba bɛ laa ne lɔr dɛ weechɔɡa nyoa ka, ásɛ dɛ ka lii waa maa kia ba ɛa la harɛre baa chwaa kaa a ta la ta. Ásɛ dɛ che a ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kpɔ bochela di kondikwa, dɛ́ nyɔ nee ɔmee ne sibeɡra ne.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ harɛ la ta nɛra be ŋɔ, ‘Men Nemenɛ Korowii dɛ bol nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam ne Israel harɛ la ta nɛra be kɛŋɔ, báa di kwaa bochela nee, dɛ́ nyɔ nee ɔmee ne sibeɡra ne. Harɛ la bwa dɛ ba chɔɡa dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, deŋnekpeɡ ne naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla aa lɔ bela la wa.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Bwɛjena nɛra aa su a ta bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, sɛɡla Israel tena aa dɛ sɛɡle ŋɔ, ‘A dɛ biɡri, yaa wepila Korowii keamere aa dɛ baɡle ŋɔ aa bao la ɡe na.’

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: Ŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowii bol a waa ŋɔ o dɛ ba ɡela sɛɡla la ba a jaɡa, baa ɡɛ waa laanee bol Israel harɛ ta kpa. Gel ba no kɛŋɔ waa baa naa wepila ta la bɛlbwa telo tonɛ.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Men Korowii te, n bol wa aa, aa biɡri dɛ́ ba. Saŋ he deŋnekpeɡ tena nɔ aa lole nɔ taa mɛɛ bola dɛ́ ɛa. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Israel tena ta dɛ bol kɛŋɔ wepila haa naa ne waa haa bola ŋɔ aa bao la, fini laa, kerekere waa.

english_verse: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Wobɛlbwa aa le n nyoa la aa biɡri kpa, a bwa ɛɛ bao. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kah Israel keamere baa kpɔ ba ɡbabir liire dɛɛ bol waa aa dɛ ba bala la. Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ bol.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Keame ɡɛna la bwɛɛlɛ. Ba cheɡɛ ba ɡbaɡba wejema ta, dɛ ŋɔ ba dɛ na chaahna, dɛ ba ta wobɛlbwa nae.

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Israel tena, he keamere la do kɛŋɔ dimɡbia kalampoŋare ken.

english_verse: They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me.
translation_verse: Baa sie do danjwɛɛre aa peɡra la ta, dɛ́ kwaara, ásɛ dɛ laa dɛ ba naa, ba won lɛ Israel ta, dɛ́ won che Korowii Tɔpere La nyoa.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Ba wepila ne ba nyosonwaa baa ŋɔa aa bao kerekere la bwa ɛ nyosone, ba ŋɔ men Korowiirii bola, dɛ n laa tom ba, dɛ ta ɛɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ anɔ la baa bola la ɛɛ ɛo.

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “He dɛ neɡre nɛra, he waa ha ŋɔa aa bao ne he wepila la ɛ nyosone, n ne he dɔɔ.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr he keamere haa ŋɔa he dɛ na wepila ne waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere a ɛ nyosone la deŋnee. Haa n nɛra Israel tena nɛɛ ja, kɛɛ bá chwerɛ he sɔna ja ba nɛ. He bɛlbwa nakpala aa Israel harɛ taa tire kpa. Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Nemenɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: Keamere la tɔ n nɛra sie dɛ ɡel baa nyoɡre. Ba ŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna lole, dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ɡe toole bobɛlbwa. N nɛra ma danjwɛɛ waa wola kpeɡe, asɛ keamere la kpɔ fula lɔɔ.

english_verse: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ keamechɔɡa la be ŋɔ, ba danjwɛɛ la dɛ ba chola. Mɛɛ ɡeloo bwaala nɛ kohona, dombwea lee o ta, ásɛ peukpeɡ ta kohona lɔɔ.

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: Danjwɛɛ la baa chole aa, nɛra ɛɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, fula baa kpɔa lɔ danjwɛɛ la munii ɛrɔɔ?”

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ o baah diu wɛɛ ba ɡela peukpeɡ ta, ásɛ bwaala nɛ kohona dombwea lee, dɛ́ chɔɡ danjwɛɛ la.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ taɡɛ danjwɛɛ baa lɔɔ fula laanee ta ó bwa chɔ harɛ, ásɛ bwea baa kpɔa pa o mun la chɔ baŋ. Waa ba chole la, he bwa ɡe dɛ ba serewa. Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead,
translation_verse: Danjwɛɛ la ne nɛra baa kpɔ fula lɔɔ la nɛɛ mɛɛ ba n bandia ne bala, dɛ́ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Danjwɛɛ la kuuɡo, ɡɛɛ nɛra baa lɔɔ fula la ɡe aa wola lee do kpa.

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:

english_verse: Tell them they're doomed! They wear magic charms on their wrists and scarves on their heads, then trick others into believing they can predict the future. They won't get away with telling those lies.
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Haahna haa nyarɛ sɛmbɛ kwaa dɛɛ do nɔɔra, ne sɛmbɛ botini haa nyara dɛɛ bɔle nyuune la, hé bwɛɛlɛ. He dɛ nyin kɛ he dɔ seo ne mkpa kpeɡri n nɛra Israel tena nɛ, dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ dɔ he te.

translation_verse: Men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘N hah he sɛmbɛre haa doa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lawɛ nɛra kɛŋɔ jumbii la. Mɛɛ chaara le he nɔɔra ta, ásɛ dɛ ɡel n nɛra haa laɡ ba kɛ jumbii la dɔ ba te.

translation_verse: Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ Israel tena bwa baa vɛɛh mɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa la, ásɛ ba berɛ ba n be.’

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ‘Men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire le voɡa ne kwaa maa kia baa toma la ta, dɛ́ berɛ ba n be.

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: Dɛ Israel te bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe Israel tena bini berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ dɛ kpɔ voɡa toma che o bambile ta, dɛ ir la n keame be, dɛ́ ka bɔɔ dɛ́ jemɛ waa maa dɛ ba ɛɛ yaa, n ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ chaŋe naate waa tɛo.

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: N siwi ɛɛ beɡre naate nɛɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa che a ta dɛ́ hweli wa. Mɛɛ pere naatee le n nɛra Israel tena bini. Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

translation_verse: N keame bɛlbwa baa neɡro o bol waane la, dɛ men Korowiirii neɡro o bol. N nɔn dawɛ naate nɛ, mɛɛ chɔɡo le Israel tena bini.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Naate waa la ɡɛ keame la be la ne keame la bwa di bolchɔɡe, mɛɛ tɛr ba bwa deŋnee.

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: Anee dɛ́ ɡel Israel tena berɛ ba n be, dɛ́ ɡel wechɔɡa ta teŋa, dɛ bɛ doŋa kpɔ kah ba te. Baa ɛɛ n nɛraa, ásɛ n ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ” Nomɛlbwa aa Korowii bole pae nyoa le

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, dɛ harɛ bɛl tena waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ mɛ dɛɛ ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa aa, mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee dawɛ ba nɛ, dɛ́ tɔ ba kondikwaa ŋwɛnɛ. Lɔr chole ba nɛ, ásɛ nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa serewe.

english_verse: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.
translation_verse: Kɛɛ dɛ n kpɔ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ba harɛ la ta, a ba kpoo nɛra baa lɔ o ta o chɔ pɛɛ, a ɡel nɛra ɛɛ ɔmɛ o ta kpɔe yaa,

english_verse: As surely as I live, I promise that even if these three men lived in that nation, their own children would not be spared. The three men would live, but the land would be an empty desert.
translation_verse: hale dɛ ɡɛ baala batoro nɔ lɔ harɛ la ta naa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, baa won lɛ ba bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna nyu. Ba ɡbosoroo dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu, kɛ harɛ la te bwa ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ.

translation_verse: Kɛɛ dɛ n kpɔ laa tena ba harɛ la ta tena nɛ, ba kpɔ dɔmkwaa ba kpoo nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa le o ta,

translation_verse: hale dɛ baala batoro la lɔ o ta kwaraa naa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, baa won lɛ ba bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna nyu. Ba ɡbosoroo dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu.

translation_verse: hale dɛ Nowa ne Daneɛl dɛ Job lɔ bela kwaraa naa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, baa wona ba dɛ́ lɛ ba bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna. Ba ɡboo dɛ́ won dɔ ba nyu ba wedɛɛɡa wa.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I promise to punish Jerusalem severely. I will send war, starvation, wild animals, and deadly disease to slaughter its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Webele anaarɛ aa wola weree mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba tɛr Jerusalam tena deŋne. Laa ne lɔr ne kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa dɛ weechɔɡaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba kpoo nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa.

english_verse: And those who survive will be taken from their country and led here to Babylonia. Ezekiel, when you see how sinful they are, you will know why I did all these things to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ane a bwa, ba bini bane ɛɛ kao, bibaala ne bihaahna ɛɛ le o taa ba hen Ɛsekeɛl be. Hɛɛ na ba daa, ne ba we-ɛɛla, dɛ́ dɔ bolarawa le wenaale maa kpɔa ba ta Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: You will be convinced that I, the Lord God, was right in doing what I did.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ aŋwɛnɛ taa n ɛɛ ba ɡɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, what happens to the wood of a grapevine after the grapes have been picked? It isn't like other trees in the forest,
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bɔkwaa ɡrepo da kpale kpɔ ɡwaa daa aa lɔ kɔr bini bɛlbwa kpale ɔ?

translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee. Ba le nii ane nyoa te, nii la ɛɛ berɔ fuuh ba. Maa ba tɛr ba deŋne la, anee he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: I will make their country an empty wasteland, because they have not been loyal to me. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ mɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, remind the people of Jerusalem of their disgusting sins
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ɡel Jerusalam tena jemɛ kii waa baa ɛa.

translation_verse: Ŋɔ waa men Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol Jerusalam tena be laanee nɔ, ‘Keenan harɛ taa ba lolɛ he naawa. Amɔre tee he nabaa, asɛ Hiti tee he nya.

english_verse: When you were born, no one cut you loose from your mother or washed your body. No one rubbed your skin with salt and olive oil, and wrapped you in warm blankets.
translation_verse: Awola baa lolɛ la, bɛlbwa ta he ul teŋe, kɛɛ dɛ sɔe nee he bwara doŋa le he nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ yal fɔrɔwe.

english_verse: Not one person loved you enough to do any of these things, and no one even felt sorry for you. You were despised, thrown into a field, and forgotten.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ta tedoma dɔe tɛɛ, dɛ́ ɛɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bini bɛlbwa. Kpɔɡ binii ba kpɔe ka ta, dɛkalkɛ awola baa lolɛ la bwaa ba haeh.

english_verse: I saw you lying there, rolling around in your own blood, and I couldn't let you die.
translation_verse: Belaa n teŋe baa kaa dɛ nae kɛ haa chɔ chal ta dɛɛ ta nakpale. He taa chɔ chal ta bela la, n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, dɔ́ he nyu dɛ́ so.

translation_verse: N nyiŋi he nɛɛ dɛ ɡel he kpeɡ kɛŋɔ kon baa duu koo ta ken. He kpeɡo dɛ do jaŋne dɛ do kpeɡri dɛ su haah. He ela cheɡɛ chiŋ kɛrɛdɛ, he dɔ nyumpona kohona, kɛ dɛ komɛlbwa ta he nɛɛ tɔe hɛɛ valɛ mumɡbal.

translation_verse: A habɔɔ n berɔ fɛrɛ ba kaa, dɛ na kɛŋɔ namete he kpeɡo kohona kɛŋɔ he yalɛ, asɛ n paɡri n yal nyoa tɔ he nɛ, he ta mumɡbal cheɡɛ kpa. N ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡle asɛ n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo he berɛ n haah. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I washed the blood off you and rubbed your skin with olive oil.
translation_verse: N sɔe ne he chal la bwa le, dɛ fɔɡle noorare.

translation_verse: Batakaare baa sɔh kwaa dawɛ o ta ne oltɔn naŋɡawadɛɛɡaa n kpɔ doe, dɛ kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa tɔe.

english_verse: I gave you bracelets, a necklace,

translation_verse: N kpɔ noniseɡ do he mee ta, dɛ doe deŋna kwa, dɛ kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ waa wera pii.

english_verse: Your jewelry was gold and silver, and your clothes were made of only the finest material and embroidered linen. Your bread was baked from fine flour, and you ate honey and olive oil. You were as beautiful as a queen,
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do n kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa kwaa ɛɛ. Yapondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ba sɔh kwaa dawɛ a ta ɛ he yale. Mendɛɛɡa baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ ne tooh, dɛ ɔleve noo ɛ he kondikwa. He kpeɡo dɛ do wer kohona, dɛ ba ɛ haŋkooro.

translation_verse: He wer kohona la nomanta, he lɛ sɔn harɛre bwa ta, dɛkalkɛ menee ɡela he do wer ka tonɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: You learned that you were attractive enough to have any man you wanted, so you offered yourself to every passerby.
translation_verse: Kɛ he teŋɛ he wer kohona ne he nyanyini ta dɛɛ bɔ jwamane. Nomɛlbwa teŋo baa kaa dɛ he ne o kaa chɔ.

translation_verse: He kpɔ he laala la ane ka kwaa bela nɛra aa chema dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa. Belaa he bɔ jwamane la. A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ, kɛɛ a chiɡ kwara.

english_verse: You made idols out of the gold and silver jewelry I gave you, then you sinned by worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: He berɔ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa kwaa maa kpɔa tɛɛ la loɡɛ voɡbaala dɛɛ toma dɛɛ bɔ jwamane.

english_verse: You dressed them in the clothes you got from me, and you offered them the olive oil and incense I gave you.
translation_verse: He kpɔ he yale baa sɔh kwaa dawɛ a ta la bɔla, dɛ kpɔ noo ne daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma n kpɔ tɛɛ la tɛa.

english_verse: I supplied you with fine flour, olive oil, and honey, but you sacrificed it all as offerings to please those idols. I, the Lord God, watched this happen.
translation_verse: He berɔ kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ ne ɔleve no, dɛ tohnoo maa kpɔa tɛɛ ŋɔ hé di la ɛ saraha tɛa a sie lɛ he nɛ. Gɛɛ a ɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: But you did something even worse than that—you sacrificed your own children to those idols!
translation_verse: He lawɛ he bibaala ne bihaahna haa lol ba tɛ mɛ la, dɛ kpoo ba ɛ saraha tɛ voɡa. He jwamane la ɡbo ta maɡraa?

english_verse: You slaughtered my children, so you could offer them as sacrifices.
translation_verse: He kpoo n bii dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ voɡa.

english_verse: You were so busy sinning and being a prostitute that you refused to think about the days when you were young and were rolling around naked in your own blood.
translation_verse: Haa lɔ waa maa kia ne jwamane ta la, he ta ɡɛ haa doa he bechale saŋ liire. Gɛ saŋ haa chɔ mumɡbal chal ta dɛɛ ta nakpale la.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord God, say you are doomed! Not only did you do these evil things,
translation_verse: Bwɛɛlɛ! Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola. Anɔ la haa bera ɛ ja he wechɔɡa ta laanee kɛŋɔ,

english_verse: where you disgraced yourself by having sex with anyone who walked by. And you did that more and more every day!
translation_verse: Fɔɡbaahna bwa taa he ma voɡa chɔŋɛ pwee ta, dɛ kpɔ chɔɡ he wer haa doa. He kpɔ he te dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa waa teŋa baa kaa, dɛ na teŋɛ dɛɛ bɔ jwamane kohona.

english_verse: To make me angry, you even offered yourself to Egyptians, who were always ready to sleep with you.
translation_verse: He ne Ijipt tena haa do jwɛh bwaa dɛɛ bɔ jwamane he ne baa chɔ. Ba ɛ nɛra jwamanwa aa dɛ lɛ ba sie kohona. He kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ muɡli n baah.

english_verse: So I punished you by letting those greedy Philistine enemies take over some of your territory. But even they were offended by your repulsive behavior.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n nɔn dawɛ he nɛ, n lɛ he harɛ maa sweera dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ la pera, asɛ dɛ kpɔe do he dɔma Filisti tena baa hah waa haa dɛ ɛ nɔ nɔn ta.

english_verse: You couldn't get enough sex, so you chased after Assyrians and slept with them. You still weren't satisfied,
translation_verse: He ɡarɔ bɔ jwamane Asiiria tena bini ɡe, a bwa habɔɔ kwaraa la, a ta he ne maɡrɛ.

english_verse: so you went after Babylonians. But those merchants could not satisfy you either.
translation_verse: He teŋɔ kpɔ he jwamanwe-ɛɛla la kaa Babelɔn tena harɛ ta ɡe. Ba bwa ɛ bonadiire, hale anɔ bwa habɔɔ a ta he ne maɡrɛ.’ ”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say that you were so disgusting that you would have done anything to get what you wanted.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ haa wola liidɛɛɡa dɔe. He we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ hanjwamane waa wola sihiih bɛlbwa jemɛ ken.

english_verse: You had sex on every street corner, and when you finished, you refused to accept money. That's worse than being a prostitute!
translation_verse: Haa ta pweeri fɔɡbaahna dɛ kpɔ he voɡa chɔŋɛ a ta nɛra bwa siwi ta dɛɛ bɔ jwamane nomanta, he waane laa suuɡa wa kwara.

english_verse: You are nothing but an unfaithful wife who would rather have sex with strangers than with your own husband.
translation_verse: He do kɛ haah waa le o jaa habɔɔ. He dɛ nyin hɔɔhra ɡwaa he jaa.

english_verse: Prostitutes accept money for having sex, but you bribe men from everywhere to have sex with you.
translation_verse: Hanjwamane bɛlbwa dɛ lɛ suuɡa, kɛ he te kpɔ kwaa dɛɛ kɛ baala baa dɛ nyini dɛɛ yaɡ ba sen, asɛ ba le bobɛlbwa ba he be, he ne baa chɔ.

english_verse: You're not like other prostitutes. Men don't ask you for sex—you offer to pay them! Jerusalem Must Be Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: Anomanta, he cheɡɛ he jwamanwe-ɛɛla ta he waa korɛ he bala bini. Nomɛlbwa aa he nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin komɛl. He ɛ nomɛl haa dena korɛ kwaraa, he dɛ tɛ nɛra suuɡa, kɛ baa he te tɛ.

english_verse: You chased after lovers, then took off your clothes and had sex. You even worshiped disgusting idols and sacrificed your own children as offerings to them.
translation_verse: Kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ bol, ‘Haa pa he kondɔɔh ta, dɛ che mumɡbal kɛŋɔ hanjwamane, dɛ kpɔ he te tɛ baala dɛ tomɛ voɡa maa kia, dɛ kpoo he bii ɛ saraha tɛa la

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will gather every one of your lovers, those you liked and those you hated. They will stand around you, and I will rip off your clothes and let all of those lovers stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: nomanta, n dɛ yerɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyini he kpɔ he te tɛɛ ba la bwa cheme. Nɛra haa dɛ nyin ne banɔ la haa hah ba bwa, ásɛ n foo he yale ba siwi ta he che mumɡbal ba baah ta.

english_verse: I will find you guilty of being an unfaithful wife and a murderer, and in my fierce anger I will sentence you to a violent death!
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee kɛ haahna baa dɛ le ba jaranar habɔɔ, dɛɛ kpoo nɛra la ken. Mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia kohonaa ba ta he nɛ, dɛ́ kpoe bɔ kem.

english_verse: Then I will hand you over to your lovers, who will tear down the places where you had sex. They will take your clothes and jewelry, leaving you naked and empty-handed.
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ lawɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyini la, ásɛ ba chɔɡ pweeri ne he voɡjaŋa la bwa. Baa laa he laala bwaa wur he bwara ta, dɛ laa he suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa ne baŋa kwaa aa wera la kpɔ, he che mumɡbal.

english_verse: Your lovers and an angry mob will stone you to death; they will cut your dead body into pieces
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛra la ɛɛ kpɔ nɛnlaalee ba ta he nɛ, ásɛ ba foɡre bwea, dɛ́ kpɔ keri chɛwɛ.

english_verse: and burn down your houses. Other women will watch these terrible things happen to you. I promise to stop you from being a prostitute and paying your lovers for sex.
translation_verse: Baa fuh he deenee, dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne haahna baa wara siwi ta. Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jwamane la bwa ba a jaɡa, haa won dɛɛ tɛ nɛra haa dɛ nyin ba la suuɡa kpa.

english_verse: You made me furious by doing all these disgusting things and by forgetting how I took care of you when you were young. Then you made things worse by acting like a prostitute. You must be punished! I, the Lord God, have spoken. Jerusalem's Two Sisters The Lord said:
translation_verse: He ta ɡɛ maa ɛɛ he toli saŋ la liire, dɛ ka ɛ waa maa kia nɔ bwa, dɛ ir n bandia, a waa mɛɛ ba he deŋne tɛra la. Ɛrɛɛ he berɛ kpɔ jwamane ja waa maa kia la bwa ta nɔɔ? Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ”

english_verse: People will use this saying about you, Jerusalem: “If the mother is bad, so is her daughter.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛra ɛɛ kpɔ ɡɛ sɛɡlaa dɛɛ bol he waa ŋɔ, ‘Jerusalam, ɡɛ nya aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o bihaah ɡe do.’

english_verse: You are just like your mother, who hated her husband and her own children. You are also like your sisters, who hated their husbands and children. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation_verse: He ɛ he nya bihaah kpela, o vɛh o jaa ne bii. He ɛ he nahaahnanar nime kpela, ba ɡe vɛh ba jaranar ne bii. He ne bwɛjena aa bare la do kɛŋɔ nyabii. He nya ɛ Hiti te, he mɛɛ ɛ Amɔre te.

english_verse: Your older sister was Samaria, that city to your north with her nearby villages. Your younger sister was Sodom, that city to your south with her nearby villages.
translation_verse: He nahaahnee Samaria, o ne o bihaahna so he weekaŋle nyunduabɔr. He nime bihaah ɡee Sodom, o ne o bihaahna so he weekaŋle harɛbɔr.

translation_verse: Ba da ɡbo laa he kpɔ, asɛ dɛ hweli ba waa maa kia la ɡe dɛ ɛa. Kɛ he we-ɛɛla bwa ta la, a ta biɡre he den ɡwaa ba kwaraa.

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, the people of Sodom and its nearby villages were never as sinful as you.
translation_verse: Men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, ‘He nime Sodom ne o bihaahna ta wechɔɡa he ne he bihaahna aa ɛa nɔ dɔŋa ɛɛ.

english_verse: They were arrogant and spoiled; they had everything they needed and still refused to help the poor and needy.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡa he nime Sodom aa dɛ ɛ laanee nɔ. O ne o bihaahna dɔ mbarafo, ba dɔɔ kohona dɛɛ di ba waane laa nomɛlbwa wa. Ba ta nyaara ne nɛra aa hiah ba chae.

english_verse: They thought they were better than everyone else, and they did things I hate. And so I destroyed them.
translation_verse: Ba ɛ mbarafo dɛ ɛ waa maa kia n siwi ta, a waa n chɔɡ ba ɡɛ he na la.

english_verse: You people of Jerusalem have sinned twice as much as the people of Samaria. In fact, your evil ways have made both Sodom and Samaria look innocent.
translation_verse: He wechɔɡa haa ɛa la, Samaria ta a dɔŋa ɛɛ. He ɛ waa maa kia kohona ɡwaa ba, he nime ne he nahaah waa toɡrɔ ɡwaale.

english_verse: So their punishment will seem light compared to yours. You will be disgraced and put to shame because of your disgusting sins. Jerusalem Will Be Ashamed The Lord said to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: He ne he sihiih so, he ɡelɔ he nimanar waa do wer ɡwaale, dɛkalkɛ he wechɔɡa kan ɡwaa ba kwa. A do kɛŋɔ ba waa toɡrɔ kɛrɛdɛ ɡwaale. Sihiih kpoe, he di ncho, he nimanar waa berɔ toɡre ɡwaale.’ ”

english_verse: Someday I will bless Sodom and Samaria and their nearby villages. I will also bless you, Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam tena, mɛɛ ɡeloo he na som, mɛɛ berɔ ɡel Sodom ne Samaria tena ɡe na som, dɛ́ ja he nɛ.

english_verse: Then you will be ashamed of how you've acted, and Sodom and Samaria will be relieved that they weren't as sinful as you.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ di sihiih waa haa ɛa la wa, ásɛ ba che a ta dɔ bolarawa.

english_verse: When that day comes, you and Sodom and Samaria will once again be well-off, and all nearby villages will be restored.
translation_verse: He nime Sodom ne o bihaahna, ne he nahaah Samaria ɡe ne o bihaahna bwa ɛɛ berɔ kaa bela ba fa aa lole, ásɛ he ɡe ne he bihaahna berɛ kaa bela he fa aa lole.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so arrogant that you sneered at Sodom.
translation_verse: He fa aa dɔa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la, dɛ haa he nime Sodom komɛlbwa yerɛ,

english_verse: But now everyone has learned how wicked you really are. The countries of Syria and Philistia, as well as your other neighbors, hate you and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: mɔɔ he wechɔɡa la bwa le baŋ. He berɔ do kɛ on, hale Edom ne Filisti bihaahna bwa, dɛ nɛra baa soɡa bare bwa, dɛ haeh.

english_verse: You must pay for all the vulgar and disgusting things you have done. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Makes a Promise to Jerusalem The Lord said:

english_verse: But I remember the agreement I made with you when you were young, and so I will make you a promise that will last forever.
translation_verse: Kɛ mɛɛ lii fɔo n ne haa fɔwa he toli saŋ laanee, ásɛ n ne he berɛ fɔwɛ fɔo waa do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: When you think about how you acted, you will be ashamed, especially when I return your sisters to you as daughters, even though this was not part of our agreement.
translation_verse: He baa lii waa he fa aa lɔ a ta la aa, sihiih ɛɛ kpoe. Maa kpɔ he nimanar ne he nahaahnanar ba tɛɛ bá do kɛ bihaahna tɛɛ la, ate ta fɔo n ne haa fɔwa la ta jae.

translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ka sɛɡle Israel tena

translation_verse: dɛ ɡel ba jemɛ kɛ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Keejen bɛl o kena aa kpeɡa, o pona do jaŋne dɛ do wer iro ba Lɛbanɔn, dɛ ba lawɛ peleme daa kpale waa pama kaa nyundua

english_verse: The eagle also took a seed from Israel and planted it in a fertile field with plenty of water, like a willow tree beside a stream.
translation_verse: O kpɔ Israel harɛ ta konduuli bii ka du harɛdɛɛɡe bɛl ta. O duu kɛŋɔ nee nyoa da, bela nee aa lole kohona.

english_verse: The seed sprouted and grew into a grapevine that spread over the ground. It had lots of leaves and strong, deep roots, and its branches grew upward toward the eagle.
translation_verse: O leɔ dɛ pi harɛ kɛŋɔ ɡrepo da. O kpala la kaa nyundua dɛ chaɡɛ kee la nɛ, asɛ o lune te kaa harɛ bini. O ta kpala dɛ moɡɛ papooni.

english_verse: There was another eagle with strong wings and thick feathers. The roots and branches of the grapevine soon turned toward this eagle, hoping it would bring water for the soil.
translation_verse: Dɛ keejen bɛl ɡe lole o kena do kpeɡri, o pona jaŋne dɛ do wer. Grepo daa la lune tɛrɔ kpɔ harɛ bini kaa kee la be, dɛ berɛ tɛr o kpala ɡe kaa o be dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ nee le o be.

english_verse: But the vine was already growing in fertile soil, where there was plenty of water to produce healthy leaves and large grapes.
translation_verse: Harɛdɛɛɡe taa ba duu, o che bela nee aa lole kohona, ó won ta kpala dɛ nɔnɛ dɛ́ do wer kɛrɛdɛ.’

english_verse: Now tell me, Ezekiel, do you think this grapevine will live? Or will the first eagle pull it up by its roots and pluck off the grapes and let its new leaves die? The eagle could easily kill it without the help of a large and powerful army.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ ba ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Grepo daa la ɛɛ won kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ aa? Kee waa tɔ sie la aa on fuɡri ta, dɛ chaa o nɔna, dɛ kuuɡi o kpala o bwa hol aa? A ta bokpeɡa kohona kɛɛ nɛra baa wara hiaih mɔɔ dɛ fuɡru ta.

english_verse: The grapevine is strong and healthy, but as soon as the scorching desert wind blows, it will quickly wither. The Lord Explains the Story
translation_verse: Hale ba fuɡru ka chɔɔ bofale aa, wɛɛ won kpeɡ dɛ́ do wer ja aa? Dɛ wee leebɔr peuwɔb tao waa, wɛɛ sewɔɔ dɛ den hol che harɛ la ta bela.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, ask the rebellious people of Israel if they know what this story means. Tell them that the king of Babylonia came to Jerusalem, then he captured the king of Judah and his officials, and took them back to Babylon as prisoners.
translation_verse: “Bɔɔ deŋnekpeɡ tena la ba baɡle sɛɡla la mun.” Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Babelɔn kooro la Jerusalam, dɛ ka lawɛ bela kooro ne o nomonjena, dɛ kaa ba ne Babelɔn.

english_verse: He chose someone from the family of Judah's king and signed a treaty with him, then made him swear to be loyal. He also led away other important citizens,

translation_verse: ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ harɛ la mule, dɛ bɛ won kaa sie kpa, ásɛ a che o ne o fɔo la ɡbo ta mɔɔ ó berɛ won che.

english_verse: But this new king of Judah later rebelled against Babylonia and sent officials to Egypt to get horses and troops. Will this king be successful in breaking the treaty with Babylonia? Or will he be punished for what he's done?
translation_verse: Kɛ Juda kooro la ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ ŋɔ waa won do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa, asɛ o tomɛ toroma Ijipt harɛ ba ka kpɔ jaɡre ne laa tena baa wara ba. Aa won maɡre tɛo waa? Wɛɛ won le a nyoa aa? Wɛɛ won chɔɡ o ne o baah fɔo la waa wola deŋnetɛraa dɔ aa?

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I swear that the king of Judah will die in Babylon, because he broke the treaty with the king of Babylonia, who appointed him king.
translation_verse: Men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ, Babelɔn belaa Jerusalam kooro Babelɔn kooro aa cheɡo kora ta la ɛɛ ba sewa. O ta ŋwɛɛra waa ŋwɛɛra la ne fɔo baa fɔwa la ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: Even the king of Egypt and his powerful army will be useless to Judah when the Babylonians attack and build towers and dirt ramps to destroy the cities of Judah and its people.
translation_verse: Ijipt kooro ne o laa tena baa wara dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ jemɛ yoi kohona la aa won chao laa ta, ɡɛ saŋ o laa tena aa ba ma teera sawɛ bwɛjen la danjwɛɛre, dɛ́ che a ta kpoo nɛra kohona la.

english_verse: The king of Judah broke his own promises and ignored the treaty with Babylonia. And so he will be punished!
translation_verse: Kooro la ŋwɛɛra waa ŋwɛɛra ne fɔo o ne Babelɔn kooro aa fɔwa la, o ta a ta teŋɛ. Anɔ waa ɛa nɔ bwa ɡelɔ waa won le a nyoa.”

english_verse: He made a promise in my name and swore to honor the treaty. And now that he has broken that promise, my name is disgraced. He must pay for what he's done.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛ n taa lole nɔ, mɛɛ tɛr o deŋnee, chɔɡa waa chɔɡ n ne o fɔo ne ŋwɛɛra waa ŋwɛɛra baɡ mɛ la wa.

english_verse: I will spread out a net to trap him. Then I will drag him to Babylon and see that he is punished for his unfaithfulness to me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ harɔɔ belii dɛ́ lawɔ. Mɛɛ lawɔ kaa Babelɔn, dɛ́ tɛr o deŋne bela, dɛkalkɛ o le n habɔɔ.

english_verse: His best troops will be killed in battle, and the survivors will be scattered in every direction. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Baa kpoo o laa tena baa chwaa dɛɛ kaa bwa laa taa, ba bini banɔ la baa ka la peɡre kaa bobɛlbwa. Asɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Someday, I, the Lord, will cut a tender twig from the top of a cedar tree, then plant it on the peak of Israel's tallest mountain,
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “N ɡbabir ɛɛ ku peleme daa la kpale waa kaa nyunduaa ásɛ dɛ ka chɔɔro. O kpale waa pama dɛ do o nyundujaɡlaa mɛɛ ba kui ka chɔɔ bwejen doa.

english_verse: where it will grow strong branches and produce large fruit. All kinds of birds will find shelter under the tree, and they will rest in the shade of its branches.
translation_verse: Israel bwejen doaa mɛɛ ba o chɔɔra. Wɛɛ ta kpalaa, dɛ́ do wer dɛ́ nɔnɛ. Jumbii bwa soo siwi ba sɔh a kɔne bela, dɛ́ so o chunchule ta.
