english_verse: The Lord God said: Someday I will gather the people of Israel from the nations where they are now scattered, and every nation will see that I am holy. The Israelites will once again live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N baa boa Israel tena maa lɔ ba peɡre harɛre ta bwa nyoa tonaa, harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ. Israel tena ɛɛ so ba ɡbaɡba harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ n bonɔɔ Jekɔb la taa.

english_verse: They will be safe and will build houses and plant vineyards. They will no longer be in danger, because I will punish their hateful neighbors. Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Baa so deŋnesɔɔhna taa, dɛ́ do deene, dɛ́ parɛ daa kooni. Mɛɛ tɛr nɛra baa ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la deŋnee, ásɛ Israel tena dɔ ba te. Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.”

english_verse: Ten years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the twelfth day of the tenth month. He said:
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi, korobie fi tɔpera fi dɛ anɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the king of Egypt. Tell him and his people
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, eɡle sie dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba Ijipt kooro ne o harɛ ta bala.

english_verse: that I am saying: King of Egypt, you were like a giant crocodile lying in a river. You acted as though you owned the Nile and made it for yourself. But now I, the Lord God, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Ŋɔ o be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Ijipt kooro, n ne he dɔɔ, he do kɛŋɔ lɛŋɔ damanta dɛ do he nenabɔɔne ta. He ŋɔ Nael Moo ɛ he kon, he ɡbabirii ɛo.

english_verse: I will put a hook in your jaw and pull you out of the water, and all the fish in your river will stick to your scaly body.
translation_verse: Kɛ mɛɛ do ɡoŋa he nyoaa, ásɛ pɛŋa aa lɔ nee la ta bwa marɛ he pɛɡa ta, ń tɛɡre le baŋ.

english_verse: I'll throw you and the fish into the desert, and your body will fall on the hard ground. You will be left unburied, and wild animals and birds will eat your flesh.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡelee ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, he ne pɛŋa la bwa. Hɛɛ chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ harɛ la taa, nomɛlbwa aa wola hen kpɔ. Mɛɛ kpɔe tɛ harɛ la ta olchɔɡa ne jumbii á di he ol.

english_verse: Then everyone in Egypt will know that I am the Lord. You and your nation refused to help the people of Israel and were nothing more than a broken stick.
translation_verse: Ásɛ nɛra baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena kpɔ ba te dawɛ he Ijipt tena nɛɛ dɛɛ nyin kɛ hé cha ba, kɛ he do kɛŋɔ pul daŋɡbala waa wola kpeɡe.

english_verse: When they reached out to you for support, you broke in half, cutting their arms and making them fall.
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ kpoŋe la, he pɛɡrɔ dɛ tɔɡɛ ba vaama. Baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ he nɛɛ la, he kuu dɛ ɡel ba nyaŋ diɡe.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will send troops to attack you, king of Egypt. They will kill your people and livestock,
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo laa tena kpɔ keri ba yoi, dɛ́ kpoo he nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa.

english_verse: until your land is a barren desert. Then you will know that I have done these things. You claimed that you made the Nile River and control it.
translation_verse: Ijipt harɛ bwa dɛ ba chɔɡa, dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii. Haa ŋɔa ŋɔ hen dɔ Nael Moo, henee ɛo la wa.

english_verse: Now I am turning against you and your river. Your nation will be nothing but an empty wasteland all the way from the town of Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south, and as far as the border of Ethiopia.
translation_verse: N ne he dɔɔ, n ne he nenabɔɔne ɡe dɔ. Mɛɛ chɔɡ Ijipt harɛ bwaa o chɔ pɛɛ, le bwɛjen Miɡdol waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ka le bwɛjen Aswan o ɡe aa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le Itiopia harɛ jwɛh ta.

english_verse: No human or animal will even dare travel through Egypt, because no sign of life will be found there for
translation_verse: Nɛn kɛɛ ol bɛlbwa aa o taa kpɔ. Bene fifraanaarɛ habɔɔ laa aa, nomɛlbwa kɛɛ komɛlbwa aa won so bela.

english_verse: It will be the most barren place on earth. Every city in Egypt will lie in ruins during those
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo Ijipt harɛ chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ́ ja harɛre aa chɔɡa bwa ta. O bwɛjena bwa dɛ ba pɛɛ chɔe bene fifraanaarɛ. Ásɛ n lɔ Ijipt tena peɡre harɛre bwa ta.”

english_verse: They will once again live in their homeland in southern Egypt. But they will be a weak kingdom
translation_verse: dɛ́ ɡel ba ba so Ijipt harɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ba naawa harɛ ba fa aa soɡe o ta la ta. Ba harɛ la kora aa kpeɡrii do kpa.

english_verse: and won't ever be strong enough to rule nations, as they did in the past.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɛ kora waa wola kpeɡrii do kpa harɛre koranar bwa bini. Waa ir dɛ́ do kpeɡri dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛfala ane ta kpa.

english_verse: My own people Israel will never again depend on your nation. In fact, when the Israelites remember what happened to you Egyptians, they will realize how wrong they were to turn to you for help. Then the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, did these things. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia Will Conquer Egypt
translation_verse: Israel tena aa ba tenee kpɔ dawɛ Ijipt tena nɛɛ ŋɔ bá cha ba kpa. Baa na waa aa ba Ijipt harɛ laanee, dɛ na kɛ aa were kɛŋɔ ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ Ijipt tena nɛ. Ásɛ Israel tena jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Nemenɛ Korowii.”

english_verse: Twenty-seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the first month. He said:
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, korobiloɡle tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked the city of Tyre. He forced his soldiers to carry so many heavy loads that their heads were rubbed bald, and their shoulders were red and sore. Nebuchadnezzar and his army still could not capture the city.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena ka yo bwɛjen Taaya tena. O ɡelɔ o laa tena la che bontɔɡa ba nyuune ɡba, ba vaama swe. Kɛ kooro la ne o laa tena la bɛlbwa ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe le a ta.

english_verse: So now I will hand over the nation of Egypt to him. He will take Egypt's valuable treasures and give them to his own troops.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, wɛɛ kpɔ Ijipt harɛɛ do Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa nɔn ta, ásɛ o pa Ijipt harɛ ta kondɔɔh bwa laa ta kaa, á ɛ o laa tena kembɔr.

english_verse: Egypt will be his reward, because he and his army have been following my orders. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: N kpɔ Ijipt harɛ bɔ Babelɔn kooro ne o laa tena kem, waa baa kaa ɛ tɛ mɛ la wa. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Ezekiel, when Egypt is defeated, I will make the people of Israel strong, and I will give you the power to speak to them. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡo aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena do kpeɡri, ásɛ dɛ ɡel hen Ɛsekeɛl bol waa nomɛlbwa no, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Egypt that I am saying: Cry out in despair,
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol waa men Nemenɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa a dɛ ba bala dɛ wi ŋɔ, ‘Tɔpere waa do ɔma kohona dɛ ba!

english_verse: because you will soon be punished! That will be a time of darkness and doom for all nations.
translation_verse: Tɔpere la telo tonɛ. Tɔpere Korowii aa bol Ijipt harɛ tena waa la telo tonɛ. Baama ɛɛ tɔɔ awola, ásɛ harɛre bwa chɔɡ.

english_verse: Your own nation of Egypt will be attacked, and Ethiopia will suffer. You will be killed in battle, and your land will be robbed and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Laa tena dɛ ba ba yo Ijipt tena, Itiopia tena loo ɛɛ kuu. Baa ba kpoo Ijipt tena la, baa pa ba kondɔɔh kaa, dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ la ó berɛ dimɡbia.

english_verse: Soldiers hired from Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, Arabia, Kub, as well as from Israel, will die in that battle.
translation_verse: Baa kpoo Itiopia ne Lidia ne Arab, dɛ Lebya harɛre laa tena baa kaa kpɔ ba, ba ba cha ba la bwa laa taa, dɛ́ kpoo n nɛra la bini bane ɡe.’ ”

english_verse: All of your allies will be killed, and your proud strength will crumble. People will die from Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Ijipt chamene tena baa dɛ chao la bwa ɛɛ serewoo. O laa tena baa do kpeɡri wɛɛ ɛ mbarafo ba waa la bwa ɛɛ serewoo. Baa kpoo ba bwa laa taa le Miɡdol dɛ ba Aswan. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Your nation of Egypt will be the most deserted place on earth, and its cities will lie in complete ruin.
translation_verse: Harɛ la ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ harɛre bwa bini, ásɛ o bwɛjena bwa ɡe chɔɡ kwaraa dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia.

english_verse: I will set fire to your land, and anyone who defended your nation will die. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ nii ba chɔɡ Ijipt harɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra baa dɛ chao waa, anee baa ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: On the same day I destroy Egypt, I will send messengers to the Ethiopians to announce their coming destruction. They think they are safe, but they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere, mɛɛ tomɛ toromaa bá kpɔ stiimaere ba, dɛ́ ba aah Itiopia tena, dɛ́ le ba ne ba bosɔɔhna ta. Lokua ɛɛ chole ba nɛɛ awola Ijipt aa chɔɡ la. Tɔpere la ɛɛ bao kpela.”

english_verse: Your Egyptian army is very strong, but I will send King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to completely defeat that army.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpoo Ijipt harɛ nɛndamanta bwa.

english_verse: I will dry up the Nile River, then sell the land to evil buyers. I will send foreigners to turn your entire nation into a barren desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. Egypt's Proud Cities Will Lie in Ruins The Lord said to the people of Egypt:
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nenabɔɔne aa su Nael Moo ta hweeh, ásɛ dɛ yoɡ harɛ la tɛ nɛnchɔɡa. Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛŋhɔɔhra ba chɔɡ harɛ la, ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta o chɔ pɛɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: All the idols and images you Egyptians worship in the city of Memphis will be smashed. No one will be left to rule your nation, and terror will fill the land.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ chɔɡ voɡaa, ne anɔ la baa ɛa a do bwɛjen Mɛmfes bwaa. Kooro aa Ijipt harɛ taa do kpa, ásɛ n kpɔ ɔmee kohona ba ta nɛra nɛɛ harɛ la ta bwa.

english_verse: The city of Pathros will be left in ruins, and Zoan will be burned to the ground. Thebes, your capital city, will also be destroyed!
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ Ijipt harɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔree o chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ́ fuh bwɛjen Soan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɡe, dɛ́ ba tɛr Tebes waa ɛ ba bwɛjen la tena ɡe deŋne.

english_verse: The fortress city of Pelusium will feel my fierce anger, and all the troops stationed at Thebes will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia ba ta bwɛjen Pɛloseɔm waa ɛ Ijipt dekpeɡ la taa. Mɛɛ kpoo nɛndamanta baa lɔ bwɛjen Tebes ɡe bwaa.

english_verse: I will set fire to your nation of Egypt! The city of Pelusium will be in anguish. Thebes will fall, and the people of Memphis will live in constant fear.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ fuh Ijipt harɛɛ, ásɛ lokua chole bwɛjen Pɛloseɔm tena nɛ. Baa kuuɡi bwɛjen Tebes danjwɛɛre aa baroo la, ásɛ bwɛjen Mɛmfes tena ɛɛ na weweele saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: The young soldiers in the cities of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die in battle, and the rest of the people will be taken prisoner.
translation_verse: Baa kpoo bonɔɔna baa lɔ bwɛjena Hɛleopɔles ne Bubastis laa taa, ásɛ dɛ lawɛ bwɛjena la nɛra bane kaa.

english_verse: You were so proud of your nation's power, but when I crush that power and kill that pride, darkness will fall over the city of Tahpanhes. A dark, gloomy cloud will cover the land as you are being led away into captivity.
translation_verse: N baa sɔɔh Ijipt harɛ kpeɡri nyoa aa, bɔr dɛ ba bira bwɛjen Tapanes, ásɛ Ijipt harɛ kpeɡri baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la ba a jaɡa. Baama ɛɛ tɔ o bwaa, ásɛ ba lawɛ nɛra baa lɔ o bwɛjeɡre ta kaa.

english_verse: When I'm through punishing Egypt, you will know that I am the Lord. Egypt's King Is Powerless
translation_verse: Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba Ijipt tena deŋne tɛra, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the seventh day of the first month. He said:
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ, korobiloɡle la tɔpenuanɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I, the Lord, have defeated the king of Egypt! I broke his arm, and no one has wrapped it or put it in a sling, so that it could heal and get strong enough to hold a sword.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, n pɔ Ijipt kooro nɛ. A do kɛŋɔ maa ku o nɔn ba ta on vɔwɛ o choŋi dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ́ won lawɛ kere kpoŋe la ken.

english_verse: So tell him that I am now his worst enemy. I will break both his arms—the good one and the broken one! His sword will drop from his hand forever,
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ne Ijipt kooro dɔɔ. Mɛɛ ku o nɔɔraa, ásɛ kere la le o nɔn ta le harɛ.

english_verse: and I will scatter the Egyptians all over the world.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba Ijipt tena bwa lɔe peɡre harɛre bwa ta.

english_verse: I will strengthen the power of Babylonia's king and give him my sword to use against Egypt. I will also make the wounded king of Egypt powerless, and he will moan in pain and die in front of the Babylonian king. Then everyone on earth will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ, mɛɛ ɡeloo Ijipt kooro sɔɔh, dɛ́ ɡel Babelɔn kooro do kpeɡri. Maa ba kpɔ n kere do Babelɔn kooro nɔn ta, ásɛ o kpɔ pa Ijipt tena nɛɛ la, nomɛlbwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: I will force the Egyptians to live as prisoners in foreign nations, and they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɔ Ijipt tena bwaa peɡre harɛre bwa ta, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the third month. He said:
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ, korobitooro te, tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the king of Egypt and his people that I am saying: You are more powerful than anyone on earth. Now listen to this.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ŋɔ Ijipt kooro ne o nɛnlaa be ŋɔ, ‘Umee n kpɔ he kora kpeɡri maɡɔɔ?

english_verse: There was once a cedar tree in Lebanon with large, strong branches reaching to the sky.
translation_verse: He do kɛŋɔ peleme daa waa lɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta, o kpala ne papooni do wer dɛ tɔ kɔr. O pamɔ kaa nyundua dɛ do jaŋne dɛ kaa baama ta.

english_verse: This tree had plenty of water to help it grow tall, and nearby streams watered the other trees in the forest.
translation_verse: Nee lɔ bela dɛ́ ɡel o kpeɡ, a bulo le harɛ bini dɛ ɡel o kpeɡ dɛ do jaŋne, dɛ sɔɔh o mun bela waa cheɡa la. Dɛ palɛ kaa jo daa aa cheɡɛ kpɔɡ bini bela la baah ta.

english_verse: But this tree towered over those other trees, and its branches grew long and thick.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do o kpeɡ kaa nyundua kohona ɡwaa daa aa cheɡɛ kpɔɡ bini bwa. Nee aa lɔ bela kohona nomanta, o kpala la tɛrɔ dɛ do kan kaa nyundua.

english_verse: Birds built nests in its branches, and animals were born beneath it. People from all nations lived in the shade of this strong tree.
translation_verse: Jumbii bwa baa sɔh a kɔne o ta, asɛ kpɔɡ bini ola bwa ɡe ba chɔ o lɔɡa dɛ loɡle. Harɛre bwa nɛra baa so o chunchule ta.

english_verse: It had beautiful, long branches, and its roots found water deep in the soil.
translation_verse: Daa la kpeɡo, dɛ ɛ dajen, dɛ do wer kohona, dɛ ta kpala a do jaŋne, dɛkalkɛ o lune kaa bini bela nee aa lole kohona.

english_verse: None of the cedar trees in my garden of Eden were as beautiful as this tree; no tree of any kind had such long branches.
translation_verse: Haa won kpɔ peleme daa aa lɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe bela men Korowii aa du daa la maɡɔ. Haa won kpɔ dakpeɡ bɛlbwa soo siwi kpala maɡɛ peleme daa la kpala. Daa aa lɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe bela bɛlbwa toole dɛ do wer kɛ on.

english_verse: I, the Lord, gave this tree its beauty, and I helped the branches grow strong. All other trees in Eden wanted to be just like it.
translation_verse: Menee ɡela o do wer, dɛ ta kpala kohona. Men Korowii daa maa dua Eden bodɛɛɡe bela fe dɛ nyin a do kɛ on.

english_verse: King of Egypt, now listen to what I, the Lord God, am saying about that tree: The tree grew so tall that it reached the sky and became very proud and arrogant.
translation_verse: Name kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ bol waa aa dɛ ba daa waa kpeɡa kaa baama ta la pui. Waa do jaŋne kohona nomanta, o mbarafo.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will reject the tree and hand it over to a foreign ruler, who will punish it for its wickedness.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n kpɔɔ do harɛre nɛra baa ɛ hɔɔhra la kooro nɔn ta, ásɛ o ɛo ɡɛ aa chɛa o nyubinikpeɡ la wa. N vɛoh.

english_verse: Cruel foreigners will chop it down and leave it wherever it falls. Branches and broken limbs will be scattered over the mountains and in the valleys. The people living in the shade of those branches will go somewhere else.
translation_verse: Nɛŋhɔɔhra ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa teŋo ta dɛ ɡelo. O kpala ne a nyoo aa kuuɡa chɔ bwejena ne fɛlembɔjena bwa ta. Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ba bwa fa aa soɡe o chunchule ta la, le o mun.

english_verse: Birds will then nest on the stump of the fallen tree, and wild animals will trample its branches.
translation_verse: Jumbii dɛ so daa waa chola la ta, asɛ kpɔɡ bini ola ɡe do o kpala la baah ta.

english_verse: Never again will any tree dare to grow as tall as this tree, no matter how much water it has. Every tree must die, just as humans die and go down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Anomanta, le fini dɛɛ kaa, daa waa cheɡɛ bela nee aa lole kohona bɛlbwa aa kpeɡ dɛ́ ka tel baama ta kpa. A chɔ le kɛŋɔ a bwa serewe kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyina, dɛ kaa lalabwɛ.’ ”

english_verse: On the day this tree dies and goes to the world below, I, the Lord God, will command rivers and streams to mourn its death. Every underground spring of water and every river will stop flowing. The mountains in Lebanon will be covered with darkness as a sign of their sorrow, and all the trees in the forest will wither.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere daa la aa sewa dɛ kaa lalabwɛɛ la, n ɡelɔ harɛ bini neerare aa dɛ bule bɔle o ta, á baɡle kɛŋɔ a wio. N ɡelɔ neerare ɡel pala. Daa la aa sewa la, n ɡelɔ biro ba tɔ Lɛbanɔn bwejena ta, asɛ daa aa lɔ kɔr bini bwa serewe.

english_verse: This tree will crash to the ground, and I will send it to the world below. Then the nations of the earth will tremble. The trees from Eden and the choice trees from Lebanon are now in the world of the dead, and they will be comforted when this tree falls.
translation_verse: Maa teŋo ta o sewɛ kaa lalabwɛɛ la, n ɡelɔ ɔmee chole harɛre nɛra nɛ, o sii waa sia la wa. Daa aa lɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe, ne dadɛɛɡa aa wera, dɛ do bela nee aa lole kohona Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta, dɛ sewɛ kaa la, o seo la tɛa bolarawa.

english_verse: Those people who found protection in its shade will also be sent to the world below, where they will join the dead.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa soɡe o chunchule ta, dɛ ɛ o chamene tena baa lɔ harɛre ta ne o kaa lalabwɛ, dɛ ka ja nɛra baa kpoo ba keri ne la nɛ.

english_verse: King of Egypt, all these things will happen to you and your people! You were like this tree at one time—taller and stronger than anyone on earth. But now you will be chopped down, just as every tree in the garden of Eden must die. You will be sent down to the world of the dead, where you will join the godless and the other victims of violent death. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ daa laanee Ijipt kooro ne o nɛndamanta la. Daa aa lɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe la bini ume kan ne o wer ne onee ɛ kɛrɛdɛ ɔ? Baa teŋe o ne Eden daa la bwaa ta, o kaa harɛ bini. Taraken, wɛɛ ka ja nɛra baa wola men tomɛ ne banɔ la baa kpoo ba laa ta la nɛɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the twelfth month. He said:
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi dɛ anɛ, korobie fi dɛ anɛ, tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the king of Egypt and tell him I am saying: You act like a lion roaming the earth; but you are nothing more than a crocodile in a river, churning up muddy water with your feet.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kpɔ wiile ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be ŋɔ, ‘He do kɛŋɔ nyujente harɛre ta nɛra baah ta, he do kɛŋɔ lɛŋɔ waa lɔ moo ta. He dɛ jo nenabɔɔne ta dɛ́ pora a chɔɡ.

english_verse: King of Egypt, listen to me. I, the Lord God, will catch you in my net and let a crowd of foreigners drag you to shore.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ ta asawii lawɛ, ásɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra warɛ, dɛ́ tɛɡre ba ta baŋ.

english_verse: I will throw you into an open field, where birds and animals will come to feed on your flesh.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔe ta harɛ la ta, dɛ́ ɡel jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ba kah he ola.

english_verse: I will spread your rotting flesh over the mountains and in the valleys,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo he ola perɛ bwejena dor, dɛ́ berɛ su fɛlembɔjena bini.

english_verse: and your blood will flow throughout the land and fill up the streams.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo he chal palɛ dɛ́ pweh harɛ kaa bwejena la dor, dɛ́ ka su fɛlembɔjena la ta.

english_verse: I will cover the whole sky and every star with thick clouds, so that the sun and moon will stop shining.
translation_verse: Maa ba chɔɡe tonɛ la, mɛɛ tɔ nyundua, ásɛ weweela nyoɡre, dɛ́ kpɔ baama tɔ wee ta, ásɛ korobie ɡel chaahna.

english_verse: The heavens will become black, leaving your country in total darkness. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ dime kwaa aa lɔ nyundua dɛɛ chaah bwaa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bɔr bir ta he nɛ, he harɛ ta. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Foreign nations you have never heard of will be shocked when I tell them how I destroyed you.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo a ha harɛre ta nɛra, maa ba chɔɡe le ba baah ta la, harɛre haa wola an jemɛ la.

english_verse: They will be horrified, and when I flash my sword in victory on the day of your death, their kings will tremble in the fear of what could happen to them.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre ta nɛra bwara yɔr he wa maa ba tɛr n kere le ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ aah ba la, ɔmee ɛɛ chole ba koranar nɛɛ. He chɔɡa tɔpere wee la, bɛlbwa ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ o bwara ɛɛ sa, a do kɛŋɔ o dɛ ba sewa.’ ”

english_verse: The king of Babylonia is coming to attack you, king of Egypt!
translation_verse: Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be ŋɔ, “Babelɔn kooro ɛɛ kpɔ o keree dɛ́ ba yoi.

english_verse: Your soldiers will be killed by the cruelest army in the world, and everything you take pride in will be crushed.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre a laa tena nyu bini aa kpeɡa ɡwaa harɛre bwa kpɔ ba keri ba kpoo he nɛra bwa. Baa chɔɡ he nɛndamanta ne he kondɔɔh haa dɛ ɛ mbarafo a waa la bwaa.

english_verse: I will slaughter your cattle that graze by the river, and no people or livestock will be left to muddy its water.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba kpoo nae aa lɔ nejena nyoo bwaa. Nɛra kɛɛ nae aa lee do dɛ́ jo a ta dɛ́ pora kpa.

english_verse: The water will be clear, and streams will be calm. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔɔ ɡel Ijipt neerare la chole a sie do wer, dɛ́ ɡel aa palɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Egypt will become a barren wasteland, and no living thing will ever survive there. Then you and your people will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Maa ba ɡel Ijipt harɛ chɔ pɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta, dɛ́ kpoo o nɛra bwa la, anee baa ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: This is your warning, and it will be used as a funeral song by foreign women to mourn the death of your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. A Sad Ending for Egypt
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ baa ba kpɔe dɛɛ wiu. Harɛre ta haahna bwaa dɛ́ taa ɡɛ wiile la tɛ Ijipt harɛ ne o nɛra bwa. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mourn for the Egyptians and condemn them to the world of the dead, where they will be buried alongside the people of other powerful nations.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, wi tɛ Ijipt harɛ ta nɛndamanta bwa, kpɔ ba ka ja harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa dɛ serewe kaa lalabwɛɛ la nɛ.

english_verse: Say to them: You may be more beautiful than the people of other nations, but you will also die and join the godless in the world below.
translation_verse: Bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, ‘He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he wer kohona ɡwaa nɛra bwa kɛɛ? Hɛɛ kaa lalabwɛɛ, dɛ́ ka ja nɛra baa wola men Korowii tomɛ dɛ serewe kaa la nɛ.’

english_verse: You cannot escape! The enemy's sword is ready to slaughter every one of you.
translation_verse: Ijipt tena bwa ne banɔ la baa kpoo ba keri ne la dɛ́ ba pɛɛ serewe. N pamɛ n kere dɛɛ ba ba bwa kpoora.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Assyria are there. They once terrified people, but they were killed in battle and now lie deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Asiiria harɛ ta nɛra ŋwama lɔ lalabwɛɛ bela, asɛ o laa tena chɔ baro harɛ bini bela. Banɔ la ba fa aa kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta harɛre ta nɛra nɛɛ la, ba kpoo ba keri ne.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Elam are there. The very sight of those godless soldiers once terrified their enemies and made them panic. But now they are disgraced and ashamed as they lie in the world of the dead, alongside others who were killed in battle.
translation_verse: Elam harɛ ta nɛra ja nɛra baa kpoo ba laa ta la nɛ, o laa tena ŋwama baro cheme. Ba bwa ɛ nɛra baa wola men Korowii tomɛ, ba kpoo ba laa ta. Ba fa aa soɡe le la, ba kpɔ ɔmee ta nɛra nɛ. Ba serewɔ, ba ne banɔ la baa kpoo ba laa ta la di sihiih.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Meshech and Tubal are there. These godless soldiers who terrified people were all killed in battle.
translation_verse: Mɛsɛk ne Tubal bwa lɔ bela, ba laa tena ŋwama bar ba cheme. Ba bwa fa aa men Korowii tomɛ, asɛ ba kpoo ba laa ta. Ba fa aa soɡe le la, ba kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta nɛra nɛ.

english_verse: They were not given a proper burial like the heroes of long ago, who were buried with their swords under their heads and with their shields over their bodies. These were the heroes who made their enemies panic.
translation_verse: Ba ta ba te nomonhuɡa huɡe ɡɛ ba yon dɛɛ huɡe saŋ la banyoola dɛ kpɔ ba nyuune dɛɛ dawɛ ba keri ta lalabwɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba dɔmkwaa dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛɛ la. Banyoola nɔ fa aa soɡe le dɛ do kpeɡri la, ba kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta nɛra nɛ.

english_verse: You Egyptians will be cruelly defeated, and you will be buried alongside these other godless soldiers who died in battle.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɡela ba kpo Ijipt kooro. Mɛɛ chɔɡoo ásɛ o sewɛ chɔ nɛra baa wola men Korowii tomɛ ba kpoo ba laa ta la baah.

english_verse: The graves of kings and leaders from Edom are there. They were powerful at one time. Now they are buried in the world of the dead with other godless soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: Edom tena ne ba koranar ne ba nomonjena bwa chɔ bela. Dɛ ba laa tena fa kpeɡri taeh, kɛ ane a bwa, ba ɡarɔ kpoo ba laa ta. Ba chɔ nɛra ba fa aa wola men Korowii tomɛ la baah ta lalabwɛ.

english_verse: The graves of the rulers of the north are there, as well as those of the Sidonians. Their powerful armies once terrified enemies. Now they lie buried in the world of the dead, where they are disgraced like other soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: Koranar baa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne Sidon tena bwa chɔ bela. Kɛ ba kpoo ba ba di sihiih, ba kpeɡri ba fa aa dɔa dɛ kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta nɛra nɛɛ la habɔɔ. Ba chɔ nɛra ba fa aa wola men tomɛ la baah ta lalabwɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God says: When your king of Egypt sees all of these graves, he and his soldiers will be glad they are not the only ones suffering.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ Ijipt kooro ne o laa tena na nɛndamanta baa kpoo ba laa ta la, dɛ́ kpɔ larawe bwara. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I sent him to terrify people all over the earth. But he and his army will be killed and buried alongside other godless soldiers in the world of the dead. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ Ijipt kooro kpɔ ɔmee ta nɛra nɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta te, kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo ba kpo o ne o laa tena damanta bwa ba ka chɔ nɛra baa wola men tomɛ ba kpoo ba laa ta la baah ta. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: and to sound a warning signal when the enemy is seen coming.
translation_verse: asɛ naate na laa tena bala aa, ó hoh bɛla dɛ́ ir harɛ la nɛra deŋne.

english_verse: Their past sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they have done right.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa la bɛlbwaa kɛo, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu dɛkalkɛ o ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre.

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, a refugee who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me on the fifth day of the tenth month. He told me that the city had fallen.
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi dɛ anɛ, korobie fi, tɔpenue ta la, baa bɛl waa dɔ bɔr chwa le Jerusalam ba men Ɛsekeɛl be, dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Jerusalam paɡrɔ!”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, warn your people by saying: Someday, I, the Lord, may send an enemy to invade a country. And suppose its people choose someone to stand watch
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol he bwɛɛ tena la be ŋɔ dɛ n ba laa ne harɛ la ta, asɛ ba le ba bini bɛl ŋɔ wɛɛ daah harɛ la,

english_verse: If any of these people hear the signal and ignore it, they will be killed in battle. But it will be their own fault, because they could have escaped if they had paid attention.
translation_verse: Naate no bɛla la sii dɛ vɛh o ta kpɔe ɛ wa aa, o seo ɛɛ ɡure o nyu taa. O pu sie ɛ waane aa, o fe dɔ o nyu.

english_verse: But suppose the person watching fails to sound the warning signal. The enemy will attack and kill some of the sinful people in that country, and I, the Lord, will hold that person responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn waa dɛ daah harɛ la na dɔma bala o ta bɛla la hoɛh nɛra la jemɛ, asɛ dɔma la ba kpo ba bini bɛlbwa naa, naate baa kpoo la sewɛ o wechɔɡa wa, kɛ mɛɛ pɛɛ naate waa sewa la chal waa le nɛn waa dɛ daah bɔr la be.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini bie, henee n le ŋɔ hɛɛ daah Israel harɛ ta nɛra. No waa maa bola nɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ ja ba.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways. But if you refuse to warn them, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: N ŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ be ŋɔ wɛɛ sewɔɔ, asɛ he ta on kaeh o le o wechɔɡa ta, dɛ sewɛ a ta naa, mɛɛ pɛɛ o chal waa le he be.

english_verse: If you do warn them, and they keep sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent. The Lord Is Always Fair (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Dɛ he kaoh o ta a ta leɛ yaa, wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa la taa, kɛ he te ɛɛ dɔ he nyuu.”

english_verse: If good people start doing evil, they will be put to death, because they have sinned.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra ɡel wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa la waa.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people with you in Babylonia talk about you when they meet by the city walls or in the doorways of their houses. They say, “Let's ask Ezekiel what the Lord has said today.”
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Nɛwɛnyini bie, he nɛra la lawɛ dɔŋa pɛl bwɛjen la danjwɛɛ ne ba doonyoo dɛɛ bol he waa ŋɔ, ‘Hé ba yá ka no waa aa le Korowii be.’

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, the people of Israel are complaining that the punishment for their sins is more than they can stand. They have lost all hope for survival, and they blame me.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ba dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Ya wechɔɡa ne waa yaa koni a ta ɡwaa ya nɛ, a dɛ kaa ya ne mun ta. Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ ya nyu ɔ?’

english_verse: Tell them that as surely as I am the living Lord God, I don't like to see wicked people die. I enjoy seeing them turn from their sins and live. So if the Israelites want to live, they must stop sinning and turn back to me.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ń sie aa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra seo ta lɛ, n dɛ nyin kɛ ba le a ta, dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu. Israel tena, hé charɛ! He charɛ he liire, dɛ́ le liichɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta. Hé ɡel wechɔɡa haa dɛ ɛ la. Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin seo nɔɔ?’

english_verse: Tell them that when good people start sinning, all the good they did in the past cannot save them from being punished. And remind them that when wicked people stop sinning, their past sins will be completely forgiven, and they won't be punished.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nɛwɛnyini bie, ŋɔ he bwɛɛ tena be ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra ɛ wechɔɡa aa, waa o nyuu dɔ toɡra o waa fa aa toɡra wubwa la wa. Dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ le o wechɔɡa ta naa, waa deŋnetɛraa dɔ.’

english_verse: Suppose I promise good people that they will live, then later they start sinning and believe they will be saved by the good they did in the past. These people will certainly be put to death because of their sins. Their good deeds will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Dɛ n ŋɔ nɛn o wa aa toɡra be ŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu, asɛ o kpɔ o te dawɛ toɡra o waa fa aa toɡra la ta dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, maa o wedɛɛɡa waa ɛa wubwa la bɛlbwa liira ba. Wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa la waa.

english_verse: Suppose I warn wicked people that they will die because of their sins, and they stop sinning and start doing right.
translation_verse: N ŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ be ŋɔ wɛɛ sewɔɔ, asɛ o le o wechɔɡa la ta dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera dɛ toɡre,

english_verse: For example, they need to return anything they have taken as security for a loan and anything they have stolen. Then if they stop doing evil and start obeying my Law, they will live.
translation_verse: kɛŋɔ dɛ nomɛl kpɔ komɛl ka tɛo o kpɔ cheɡ awɔba, dɛ lɛ suuɡa, asɛ o berɛ naate kon tɛo, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ komɛl waa ŋwɛa ka tɛ kon te, dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare aa dɛ tɛ mkpa ta, dɛ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ yaa, waa sewa ba, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, your people accuse me of being unfair. But they are the ones who are unfair.
translation_verse: Kɛ he nɛra la dɛ bol men Korowii waa ŋɔ n waa ta toɡrɛ. Gɛ laa a do, ba waa wola toɡrɛ.

english_verse: And if wicked people stop sinning and start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera dɛ toɡre aa, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.

english_verse: But the Israelites still think I am unfair. So warn them that they will be punished for what they have done. The News of Jerusalem's Fall
translation_verse: Kɛ he Israel tena ŋɔ, ‘Men Korowii waa ta toɡrɛ.’ Mɛɛ nyiŋi he bini bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla taa dɛ́ bol o wa.” Jerusalam paɡra waa baɡla

english_verse: The evening before this man arrived at my house, the Lord had taken control of me. So when the man came to me the next morning, I could once again speak. What Will Happen to Those Left in Israel?
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii tɛ mɛ kpeɡri jɔmɔra bɛl, mɔɔ tɔɔper chɔɔbɔr baa la ba n be, asɛ Korowii pili n nyoa, dɛ ɡel n berɛ won waa bola.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii bol n be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in the ruined cities of Israel are saying, “Abraham was just one man, and the Lord gave him this whole land of Israel. There are many of us, and so this land must be ours.”
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, nɛra baa soɡe Israel harɛ bwɛjena aa paɡra ta dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ Abraham ɡboo, asɛ Korowii kpɔ harɛ la bwa tɛo o ɛ o kon. Kɛ ya berɔ warɛ, anomanta, o berɛ ya bwa kon pi.’

english_verse: So, Ezekiel, tell them I am saying: How can you think the land is still yours? You eat meat with blood in it and worship idols. You commit murder
translation_verse: Anomanta, ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Haa dɛ di ola ne a chale, dɛ tomɛ voɡa dɛɛ kpoo dɔŋa nɔ, a chɛ kɛ he dɔ harɛ nɔ o ɛ he kon aa?

english_verse: and spread violence throughout the land. Everything you do is wicked; you are even unfaithful in marriage. And you claim the land is yours!
translation_verse: Hé ɛ nɛŋkpoa nɛra, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa maa kia, dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa haahna. A chɛ kɛ harɛ nɔ ɛ he kon aa?’

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, you people in the ruined cities will be killed in battle. Those of you living in the countryside will be eaten by wild animals, and those hiding in caves and on rocky cliffs will die from deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Ń ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ n taa lole nɔ, baa kpoo nɛra baa kaa dɛ ta so bwɛjena aa paɡra la ta bwaa. Banɔ la baa chwaa ka so kpɔɡ bini la, kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡaa dɛ́ di ba ola, ásɛ weechɔɡa kpoo banɔ la ɡe baa chwaa ka so dekpeɡa ne bwebɔɔne bini.

english_verse: I will make the whole country an empty wasteland and crush the power in which you take such pride. Even the mountains will be bare, and no one will try to cross them.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ kpeɡri o fa aa dɔa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la ba a jaɡa. Bwejena aa lɔ Israel harɛ ta bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won kpɔ a ta.

english_verse: I will punish you because of your sins, and I will turn your nation into a barren desert. Then you will know that I am the Lord. The People Listen, but Don't Change The Lord said:
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ waa maa kia ba ɛ la wa aa, baa jemɔ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’

english_verse: So they all come and listen to you, but they refuse to do what you tell them. They claim to be faithful, but they are forever trying to cheat others out of their money.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ ba yon dɛɛ ba he be saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ba so dɛɛ no waa haa dɛ bol, kɛ baa an kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ aa dɛ baɡle. Ba nyoo ɡboo ba kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, kɛ anɔ la baa dɔ ɡbo taa ba liire do.

english_verse: They treat you as though you were merely singing love songs or playing music. They listen, but don't do anything you say.
translation_verse: Ba te be la, he waa la do kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ janjela dɛɛ lɔ yelsoma tasom ne. Ba no waa haa bola la bwa, kɛ ba ta a bɛlbwa kpɔe ɛ waane.

english_verse: Soon they will be punished, just as you warned, and they will know that a prophet has been among them.
translation_verse: He waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ ɛo, aa bao kpela ɡe. Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii keame bɛl fa lɔ ba bini.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, Israel's leaders are like shepherds taking care of my sheep, the people of Israel. But I want you to condemn these leaders and tell them: I, the Lord God, say you shepherds of Israel are doomed! You take care of yourselves while ignoring my sheep.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol waa aa dɛ ba Israel nomonome baa do kɛŋɔ peteɡra nɛɛ bala, dɛ́ ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Hé bwɛɛlɛ! He ɛ peteɡra haa wola he peera nɛɛ nyiŋi, he ɡbo waa hiah heya. Hé laa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi a nɛ aa?

english_verse: You drink their milk and use their wool to make your clothes. Then you butcher the best ones for food. But you don't take care of the flock!
translation_verse: He dɛ nyɔ a elne, dɛ kpɔ a pona ɛ yale dɛɛ tɔ, dɛ kpoo anɔ la aa wera dɛɛ di. Kɛ haa a nɛɛ nyiŋi.

english_verse: You have never protected the weak ones or healed the sick ones or bandaged those that get hurt. You let them wander off and never look for those that get lost. You are cruel and mean to my sheep.
translation_verse: He ta anɔ la aa ɡwɛɡra nɛɛ nyiŋe, he ta a weela tena chaeh, kɛɛ dɛ jaɡre anɔ la baa doa bola ŋwɛra. He ta anɔ la aa yeŋa ne anɔ la aa nyoɡra ɡe bɔr nyine, dɛ ba a ne. Nyubinikpeɡ nee he nyiŋa.

english_verse: They strayed in every direction, and because there was no shepherd to watch them, they were attacked and eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Haa wola a nɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ nomanta, a bwa lɔɔ peɡre, asɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ba kpoora, dɛ di a ola.

english_verse: So my sheep were scattered across the earth. They roamed on hills and mountains, without anyone even bothering to look for them.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n peera yeŋo ka do bwejena dor ne deŋɡarere ta. A peɡrɔ kaa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, nomɛlbwa ta a waa liire dɛ ɡaaɡe a bɔr.

english_verse: Now listen to what I, the living Lord God, am saying to you shepherds. My sheep have been attacked and eaten by wild animals, because you refused to watch them. You never went looking for the lost ones, and you fed yourselves without feeding my sheep.
translation_verse: Men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ, n peera nya teɡre, a che a ta kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa lawa dɛɛ di. N peteɡra la ta a bɔr ɡaaɡɛ, ba ɡbaɡba waa hiah ba.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, will punish you! I will rescue my sheep from you and never let you be their shepherd again or butcher them for food. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii, n ne he dɔɔ. Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee dɛ́ lɛa le he be, haa a teɡraa ɛ kpa. Mɛɛ lɛa le he be, maa ɡel he di a ta kpa.

english_verse: The Lord God then said: I will look for my sheep and take care of them myself,
translation_verse: Men Nemenɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ nyin n peera bɔree, ásɛ dɛ nyiŋi a nɛ.

english_verse: just as a shepherd looks for lost sheep. My sheep have been lost since that dark and miserable day when they were scattered throughout the nations. But I will rescue them
translation_verse: Gɛ peteɡre la peera ne dibɔr, dɛ ane peɡrɔ o yon ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin a bɔr la, ɡɛɛ Israel tena fa peɡre kaa harɛre bwa ta awola tɔpechɔɡe bɛl wee. Mɛɛ ɡaaɡe ba bɔree name, dɛ́ berɛ ba ba ne.

english_verse: and bring them back from the foreign nations where they now live. I will be their shepherd and will let them graze on Israel's mountains and in the valleys and fertile fields.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lawaa le harɛre aa kaa a ta la taa, dɛ́ boa a nyoa. Mɛɛ le a ne harɛfala taa dɛ́ kpɔa ba a ɡbaɡba harɛ ta. Israel bwejena dor ne neerare nyoo aa sɔnaa dɛɛ ba a dibɔra ɛɛ.

english_verse: They will be safe as they feed on grassy meadows and green hills.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ teɡaa kaa dibɔra aa wera taa á ka di. Israel harɛ bwejena doree mɛɛ ba a dɛɛra, á dɔ kpɔɡdɛɛɡa di a bwara sɔɔhna.

english_verse: I promise to take care of them and keep them safe,
translation_verse: N ɡbabirii dɛ́ teɡɛ n peera dɛ nyin bodɛɛɡe tɛa a chɔ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: to look for those that are lost and bring back the ones that wander off, to bandage those that are hurt and protect the ones that are weak. I will also slaughter those that are fat and strong, because I always do right. Judgment on the Strong Sheep
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡaaɡo nyin anɔ la aa nyoɡra bɔr, dɛ́ berɛ ba anɔ la aa yeŋa la ɡe ne. Mɛɛ vɔrɔwe anɔ la a bobɛla aa kuuɡaa, dɛ́ chah anɔ la a bwara aa dɛ wea, ásɛ a dɔ bokpeɡa. Kɛ anɔ la aa dɔ bokpeɡa a bwara do wer la te, mɛɛ kpooraa, dɛkalkɛ n ɛ peteɡre n wa aa toɡra.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God said to his sheep, the people of Israel: I will carefully watch each one of you to decide which ones are the strong sheep and which ones are weak.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N peera, mɛɛ nyiŋi he binii dɛ́ pere pedɛɛɡa le anchɔɡa bini, dɛ́ pere pebala le boohna bini.

english_verse: Some of you eat the greenest grass, then trample down what's left when you finish. Others drink clean water, then step in the water to make the rest of it muddy.
translation_verse: Kpɔɡdɛɛɡa haa dɛ chwea la aa heyaa tel aa? A chɛ kɛ he tiɡri a kar do harɛ naa? Nedɛɛɡa haa dɛ nyoa la aa he ne maɡre aa? A chɛ kɛ he porɛ a kar aa?

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will separate you strong sheep from the weak.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ bol n peera aa ɡwaŋra ne anɔ la a bwara aa wera la waa.

english_verse: You strong ones have used your powerful horns to chase off those that are weak,
translation_verse: He taɡɛ n peera aa ɡwɛɡra la vaama ne, dɛ chuɡra nyeɡlare ne ka ta,

english_verse: but I will rescue them and no longer let them be mistreated. I will separate the good from the bad.
translation_verse: anomanta, mɛɛ lɛ n peera nyuu, ásɛ ba bɛ won ɛa hɔhɔrɔwa kpa. Mɛɛ bol n peera la bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ baah waa.

english_verse: After that, I will give you a shepherd from the family of my servant King David. All of you, both strong and weak, will have the same shepherd, and he will take good care of you.
translation_verse: Kooro waa do kɛ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devidii mɛɛ ba lee kɛŋɔ peteɡre beŋkpoŋ wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.

english_verse: He will be your leader, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken. A Bright Future for the Lord's Sheep The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Men Korowiirii dɛ́ ɛ Korowii baa tom mɛ, ásɛ kooro waa do kɛ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devid ɛ ba kooro. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The people of Israel are my sheep, and I solemnly promise that they will live in peace. I will chase away every wild animal from the desert and the forest, so my sheep will not be afraid.
translation_verse: N ne baa fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔwee, dɛ́ le kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ne harɛ la ta, ásɛ n peera la do pua kpɔɡbaah ta, dɛ́ chɔ kɔne bini deŋnesɔɔhna ta.

english_verse: They will live around my holy mountain, and I will bless them by sending more than enough rain
translation_verse: Mɛɛ swee ba ne harɛre aa chɔa bar n bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ dɛ do Jerusalam la andɛɛɡaa. Mɛɛ ɡeloo bwaala nɛ o saŋ ta, á ɛ bwaala dɛɛɡa.

english_verse: to make their trees produce fruit and their crops to grow. I will set them free from slavery and let them live safely in their own land. Then they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Harɛ la ta daa bɛlbwa ɛɛ nɔnɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ koo kondikwaa ɛ kohona, nomɛlbwa so deŋnesɔɔhna ta o harɛ ta. N baa lawɛ n nɛra le nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba kɛ yoma nɔn ta naa, anee baa ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: Foreign nations will never again rob them, and wild animals will no longer kill and eat them. They will have nothing to fear.
translation_verse: Harɛre ane nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ aa won ba yoo ba, dɛ́ pa ba laala kaa kpa. Gɛɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ɡe aa wola won ba laɡ ba chwe. Nomɛlbwa aa won ba aah ba kpa, ásɛ ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.

english_verse: I will make their fields produce large amounts of crops, so they will never again go hungry or be laughed at by foreigners.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛɛ ba harɛpare ondɛɛɡee ba kondikwa won ɛ, dɛ́ ɡel lɔr ba a jaɡa harɛ la ta. Harɛre ane nɛra aa ban mamɛ kpa.

english_verse: Then everyone will know that I protect my people Israel. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ Israel tena nɛɛ ba ɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: They are my sheep; I am their God, and I take care of them.
translation_verse: Hé ɛ n peera, mɛɛ dɛɛ heya. Hé ɛ n nɛra, n ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: and say to them: I, the Lord God, am now your enemy! And I will turn your nation into an empty wasteland,
translation_verse: Men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Edom bwejena, n ne he dɔɔ. Mɛɛ tɛr nɔnee pa he nɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ la, o ta do ɔma dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ.

english_verse: leaving your towns in ruins. Your land will be a desert, and then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ he bwɛjena bwaa a berɛ dimɡbia dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ. Belaa hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: People of Edom, not only have you been Israel's longtime enemy, you simply watched when disaster wiped out its people as punishment for their sins.
translation_verse: Edom tena, he fa ɛ Israel tena dɔm, dɛ ɡel ba dɔma kpoo ba ba wenaale tɔpere, ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa deŋnetɛraa.

english_verse: And so, as surely as I am the living Lord God, you are guilty of murder and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ n taa lole nɔ, haa dɛ kpoo nɛra nɔ, he ɡe ɛɛ sewɔɔ, haa won le a nyoa.

english_verse: I will destroy your nation and kill anyone who travels through it.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo Edom harɛ deŋɡare chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra baa dɛ kpɔ o ta bwa.

english_verse: and your land will lie in ruins forever. No one will live in your towns ever again. You will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ harɛ laanee kwaraa, ásɛ nɛra aa won berɛ ba so o ta kpa. Anee hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: You thought the nations of Judah and Israel belonged to you, and that you could take over their territory. But I am their God,
translation_verse: Menee Juda ne Israel harɛre nɛra ɛɛ tomɛ, kɛ he Edom tena ŋɔ hɛɛ ka kpɔ harɛ laanee ɛ he kon.

english_verse: and as surely as I live, I will punish you for treating my people with anger and hatred. Then they will know that I, the Lord, am punishing you!
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ n taa lole nɔ, mɛɛ bɔ heyaa kemee he bandia ne meera, dɛ haeh haa hah n nɛra la wa. Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee dɛɛ tɛr he deŋne waa haa ɛɛ ba la wa.

english_verse: And you will finally realize that I heard you laugh at their destruction and say their land was yours to take.
translation_verse: Anee hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ men Korowii, n no nɛnhɛlwobol haa bola Israel bwejena waa ŋɔ a bwa chɔ pɛɛ ba kpɔ tɛ heyaa a ɛ he kwa.

english_verse: You even insulted me, but I heard it all.
translation_verse: N no mbarafo waa haa bola yaɡ mɛ aa wola nyoa dɔe.’ ”

english_verse: just as you celebrated when Israel was destroyed. Your nation of Edom will be nothing but a wasteland. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Edom tena, he sie aa lɛa ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena harɛ aa chɔ pɛɛ la, ɡɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba kpɔe ɛ heya, Sɛɛ Bwejen ne Edom harɛ bwa. Asɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, am saying: Your enemies sneered and said that you mountains belonged to them.
translation_verse: ‘He dɔma bol he waa ŋɔ, bwejaŋa aa lole saŋ la bwa la berɛ ba kwaa name.

english_verse: They ruined and crushed you from every side, and foreign nations captured and made fun of you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ harɛre aa bar heyaa cheme aa baa yo heyaa dɛ lɛ Israel harɛre la, ba bwa chɛɡre Israel tena.

english_verse: So all you mountains and hills, streams and valleys, listen to what I will do. Your towns may now lie in ruins, and nations may laugh and insult you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Israel bwejena ne deŋɡarere, ne nenabɔɔne ne fɛlembɔjena, ne bwɛɛre aa chɔɡa dɛ chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ bwɛjena baa pa a laala laa ta kaa, harɛre nɛra baa bar heyaa cheme la mamɛ heya.

english_verse: But in my fierce anger, I will turn against those nations, and especially the Edomites, because they laughed at you the loudest and took over your pasturelands.
translation_verse: Men Nemenɛ Korowii cheɡɛ n bandia kohona ta, dɛ bol waa yaɡɛ harɛre kabora la ne Edom harɛ bwa, dɛkalkɛ ba sie lɛo, dɛ che wedoŋa ta kpɔ n harɛ ɛ ba kon, dɛ kpɔ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.

english_verse: so I will now insult and disgrace them. That is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛɛ a do tenaa, n ir nɔn dɛ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ harɛre aa bar heyaa cheme nɔ nɛra ɡe ɛɛ di sihiih bá mam ba.

english_verse: Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home.
translation_verse: Kɛ daa aa lɔ Israel bwejena dor ɛɛ berɔ moɡɛ, dɛ́ nɔnɛ kohona á ɛ kondikwaa tɛ n nɛra Israel tena, dɛkalkɛ aa biɡri n berɛ ba ba ne dem.

english_verse: I will take care of you by plowing your soil and planting crops on your fertile slopes.
translation_verse: He waa lɔ n bambile ta, mɛɛ sune he nɛɛ he berɛ parɛ he harɛ la, dɛ́ du kwa.

english_verse: The people of Israel will return and rebuild your ruined towns and live in them.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo he Israel tena ya. Nɛra ɛɛ berɔ ba so bwɛjena aa paɡra la ta, dɛ́ kwaa vɔrɔwa.

english_verse: Children will be born, and animals will give birth to their young. You will no longer be deserted as you are now, but you will be covered with people and treated better than ever. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra ne kondɛɛra ya kohona, dɛ́ ɡel he berɛ ba so ɡɛ he fa aa soɡa wubwa la, ásɛ he wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ heyaa ɡwaa saŋ la kwara. Belaa hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: I will bring my people Israel home, and they will live on you mountains, because you belong to them, and your fertile slopes will never again let them starve.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena haa ɛ n nɛra berɛ ba so harɛ la ta ja. Wɛ́ɛ ɛ he kapɛrɛ konee, lɔr aa he biirii kpo o ta kpa.

english_verse: It's true that you have been accused of not producing enough food and of letting your people starve.
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ bol he be ŋɔ he dɛ kpoo he ɡbaɡba nɛra, a ɡel bechale toole he harɛ ta.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord Will Be Honored
translation_verse: Maa ɡel he no harɛre ta nɛra loro baa dɛ di heya, ne mama baa dɛ mamɛ heyaa la, kɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he harɛ la paɡre kpa. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own country, they made the land unclean by the way they behaved, just as a woman's monthly period makes her unclean.
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Israel tena fa aa soɡe ba harɛ ta la, ba cheɡɛ ba da ne ba we-ɛɛla ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ la dɛ chɔɡo. Ba we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ haah waa le dahara n be.

english_verse: They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people
translation_verse: Anomanta, n kpɔ n bandia kohona ta ba nɛ, nɛra baa kpoora harɛ la ta, dɛ tomɛ voɡa, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ la wa.

english_verse: Wherever they went, my name was disgraced, because foreigners insulted my people by saying I had forced them out of their own land.
translation_verse: Harɛre ta bobɛlbwa baa la la, ba chɔɡ n sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛkalkɛ nɛra dɛ bol ba waa ŋɔ, ‘Korowii nɛraa nɔ, kɛ o doŋ ba o harɛ ta.’

english_verse: so tell the Israelites that I am saying: You have disgraced my holy name among the nations where you now live. So you don't deserve what I'm going to do for you. I will lead you home to bring honor to my name
translation_verse: Anomanta, ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ‘He waa laa mɛɛ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ. N sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ he chɔɡo tɛ harɛre nɛra, bela bwa haa laŋa la waa.

english_verse: and to show foreign nations that I am holy. Then they will know that I am the Lord God. I have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ n sɔnjen la aa do ɡoroŋ, n sɔn haa chɔɡo tɛ harɛre nɛra la. Ásɛ harɛre nɛra la bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Nemenɛ Korowii. He nɛɛ mɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ chaɡle kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ ba siwi ta.

english_verse: I will gather you from the foreign nations and bring you home.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lawɛ heyaa dɛ́ boa he nyoa le harɛre la ta, dɛ́ ba he ne he ɡbaɡba harɛ ta.

english_verse: I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɛ nedɛɛɡaa merɛ he nɛ, dɛ́ laa doŋa haa kaah la kpɔ he nɛ. Mɛɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwaa kpɔ he nɛ, dɛ́ le heyaa le voɡa toma ɡe ta.

english_verse: I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa bambifale ne liifalaa, ásɛ he won dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta. Mɛɛ laa he bambile waa do kɛ bwe laanee kpɔ, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bambile waa pwɛra.

english_verse: because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ n domaa ba so he nɛ, ásɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare, ne waa maa baɡle heyaa la ta kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ he naawa laanee n berɛ dɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ heyaa hé so o ta, ásɛ he ɛ n nɛra, ń ɡe ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛ heyaa le waa aa ɡela hɛɛ kah doŋa la ta, dɛ́ ɡel mea bu, dɛ́ doŋi lɔr le harɛ la ta, ásɛ he bɛ lɔr na.

english_verse: Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo he daa nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ koo kondikwaa ɡe ɛ kohona, ásɛ sihiih bɛ heyaa kpo harɛre ta nɛra be kondikwaa wa.

english_verse: You will remember your evil ways and hate yourselves for what you've done.
translation_verse: Belaa hɛ́ɛ ba he wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre ne he nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla bwa liira, ásɛ he baah di he ɡbaɡba nɛɛ wechɔɡa ne kii waa haa ɛa la.

english_verse: People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Israel tena, n dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ he waa laa mɛɛ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ. N dɛ nyin kɛ sihiih kpo heyaa we-ɛɛla haa dɛ ɛ la wa!’ ”

english_verse: After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola maa ba laa he doŋa bwa kpɔ he nɛɛ la, mɛɛ berɔ ɡel he ba so he bwɛɛre la ta, dɛ́ berɛ kwaa vɔrɔwe anɔ la aa ɛ dimɡbeeni la bwa.

english_verse: Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren.
translation_verse: Harɛ waa chɔ pɛɛ la ɛɛ berɛ harɛparee, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ kpɔ o ta la na kɛŋɔ o ta pɛɛ chɔe kpa.

english_verse: Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people.
translation_verse: Baa ŋɔɔ, ‘Harɛ waa chɔ pɛɛ laanee bera do kɛŋɔ Korowii Eden bodɛɛɡe la, bwɛjena a fa aa paɡra, dɛ chɔ pɛɛ laanee ba berɛ kwaa ma danjwɛɛre bara nɛra so a ta la.’

english_verse: Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Belaa harɛre aa kaa dɛ bar heyaa cheme la ɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ, menee bera ba vɔrɔwe bwɛjena a fa aa paɡra dɛ chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ berɛ ɡel harɛ la ɛ harɛpare la. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola, mɛɛ ɛo ɡe.”

english_verse: I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ berɔ no Israel tena wesoŋa ja, ásɛ dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa la tɛɛ ba. N dɛ ba ɡela ba warɛ kɛŋɔ peera ken.

english_verse: The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Baa warɔɔ kɛŋɔ peera baa teɡa dɛɛ kaa dɛ́ ka kpoo ɛ saraha Jerusalam tɔpejena dii ta ken. Bwɛjena a fa aa paɡra la, nɛra ɛɛ ba su a binii, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”

english_verse: Some time later, I felt the Lord's power take control of me, and his Spirit carried me to a valley full of bones.
translation_verse: Korowii kpeɡri ba men Ɛsekeɛl nɛ, asɛ o Doma kpɔ mɛ le ka che fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, dɛ hoɡa su o ta bwa.

english_verse: The Lord showed me all around, and everywhere I looked I saw bones that were dried out.
translation_verse: Doma la tɔ n sie la sie, dɛ ba n ne habɔɔ hoɡa la bini, asɛ n na hoɡa a warɛ chɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini, dɛ a bwara loɡao kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: He said, “Ezekiel, son of man, can these bones come back to life?” I replied, “Lord God, only you can answer that.”
translation_verse: O bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, hoɡa nɔ ɛɛ won berɛ ba ɛ nɛra dɛ́ dɔ mkpa ja aa?” Belaa n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, he ɡboo dɛ́ won jemɛ.”

english_verse: He then told me to say: Dry bones, listen to what the Lord is saying to you,
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bol hoɡa la be, waa aa dɛ ba a nɛɛ bala. Ŋɔ á cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no men Korowii wa.

english_verse: “I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live.
translation_verse: Men Nemenɛ Korowii, n dɛ bol hoɡa la be ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa hweeraa hé berɛ dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo dɛɛhne ba he nɛ, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bo-ol, dɛ́ kpɔ tɔn bɔle, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa hweera hé dɔ mkpa. Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ”

english_verse: I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together!
translation_verse: Anomanta, n bol waa aa dɛ ba a nɛɛ bala ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ la. N nyoa ta aa lɔ wobol la ta la, asɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ n no ɡbɔɡa ane kohona, asɛ hoɡa la pa mun baa choŋri dɔŋa nɛ.

english_verse: I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ nyiŋi la, n nao kɛŋɔ dɛɛhne ne bo-ol aa ba a ta, asɛ bɔtɔn bɔla, kɛ dɛ hweera toole a ta.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, now say to the wind, “The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.”
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, yerɛ peu dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba bala, dɛ́ ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Peu, le bobɛlbwa dɛ́ ba jo nɛra baa kpoo ba bil nɔ bini, ásɛ ba dɔ hweera dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.’ ”

english_verse: As soon as I said this, the wind blew among the bodies, and they came back to life! They all stood up, and there were enough to make a large army.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n bol waa la ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ la, asɛ hweera ba ba bini ba won hweera, dɛ dɔ mkpa dɛ ir che. Ba warɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ laa tena.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are like dead bones. They complain that they are dried up and that they have no hope for the future.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Israel tena bwa do kɛ hoɡa nɔ. Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ ya hoɡa bwa loɡao, ya ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe, ya toole wobɛlbwa bini.

english_verse: So tell them, “I, the Lord God, promise to open your graves and set you free. I will bring you back to Israel,
translation_verse: Anomanta, bol waa aa dɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala dɛ́ ŋɔ, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘N nɛra Israel tena, n dɛ ba he ŋwama pila, dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa le, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne Israel harɛ ta.

english_verse: and when that happens, you will realize that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: N nɛra, maa ba pili he ŋwama dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa le a bini la, a taa hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord, have spoken.” Judah and Israel Together Again
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ n Domaa ba so he nɛɛ hé dɔ mkpa, ásɛ n kpɔ heyaa kaa he ɡbaɡba harɛ ta ka so. Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowii, waa maa bola la, n ɛa. Men Korowiirii bola.’ ” Juda ne Israel harɛre bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Judah.” Then get another stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Israel.”
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kpɔ da ásɛ dɛ chwerɛ o ta ŋɔ, ‘Kon nɔ ɛ Juda ne Israel tena baa ja o nɛɛ la kon.’ Berɛ kpɔ danɛɛte dɛ́ chwerɛ o ta ŋɔ, ‘Kon nɔ ɛ Efrem kon, dɛ che tɛ Josef ne Israel tena baa ja o nɛɛ la kon.’

english_verse: Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick.
translation_verse: Kpɔa pɛ á do kɛ daa beŋkpoŋii lɔ he nɔn ta.

english_verse: And when your people ask you what this means,
translation_verse: He bwɛɛ tena bɔɔre ŋɔ he baɡ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ mun aa,

english_verse: tell them that I, the Lord, will join together the stick of Israel and the stick of Judah. I will hold them in my hand, and they will become one.
translation_verse: he ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kpɔ daa waa ɛ Josef kon dɛ do Efrem nɔn ta dɛ ɛ Israel deene baa ja o nɛɛ laanee, dɛ́ kpɔ pɛ daa waa ɛ Juda kon la ta, á do n nɔn ta dɛ́ ɛ daa beŋkpoŋ.’

english_verse: Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone
translation_verse: Kpɔ daa haa chwerɛ a ta la kpoŋe ba siwi ta,

english_verse: and then say: I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live.
translation_verse: dɛ́ ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ lawɛ n nɛra Israel tenaa le harɛre baa chwaa ka so a ta laanee. Mɛɛ boa ba nyoa le bela bwa baa lole, dɛ́ berɛ ba ba ne ba ɡbabir harɛ ta.

english_verse: I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɔ baa pɛ bá ɛ harɛ beŋkpoŋ nɛra, dɛ́ so Israel bwejena dor. Kooro beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ, ásɛ ba bini aa pere dɛ́ ɛ harɛ anɛ nɛra kpa.

english_verse: They will no longer worship idols and do things that make them unacceptable to me. I will wash away their sin and make them clean, and I will protect them from everything that makes them unclean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Baa voɡaa tomɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa maa kia dɛ kah doŋa, kɛɛ dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa kpa, dɛkalkɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ baa le wechɔɡa bwa aa ɡela ba le habɔɔ la taa, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛ. Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ɛ n nɛra, n ɡe ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ.

english_verse: Their king will always come from the family of my servant King David and will care for them like a shepherd. The people of Israel will faithfully obey my laws. They and their descendants will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ n bonɔɔ Jekɔb la taa baa ba soɡa, harɛ ba naawa fa aa soɡe o ta la. Ba ne ba bii ne naanar, dɛ ba ɡe bii ɛɛ so o taa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, ásɛ kooro waa do kɛ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devid ɛ ba kooro saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I solemnly promise to bless the people of Israel with unending peace. I will protect them and let them become a powerful nation. My temple will stand in Israel for all time,
translation_verse: N ne baa fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔwee o do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba do kpeɡri ba mun ya kohona, ásɛ n kpɔ n Dea la ba cheɡ ba harɛ ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: and I will live among my people and be their God.
translation_verse: Ba baahnee mɛɛ ba soɡa, dɛ́ ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.
translation_verse: N kpɔ n Dea la ba cheɡ ba harɛ la ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la naa, anee dɛ́ ɡel harɛre nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee le Israel tena tɛ n te.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog, that wicked ruler of the kingdoms of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Tell him:
translation_verse: “Nɛwɛnyini bie, eɡle sie ta koonomoa Gɔɡ waa lɔ Maɡɔɡ harɛ ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi Mɛsɛk ne Tubal harɛre ta. Bol waa aa dɛ ba o nɛɛ bala

english_verse: I, the Lord God, am your enemy,
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii, n ne o dɔɔ.

english_verse: and I will make you powerless! I will put a hook in your jaw and drag away both you and your large army. You command cavalry troops that wear heavy armor and carry shields and swords.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ sɔɔh o nyoa, dɛ́ kpɔ ɡoŋre do o nyoa ta, dɛ́ tɛɡro, dɛ́ kpɔ o ne o laa tena bwa kaa. O nɛra baa vɔwɛ ntoa dɛ so jaɡre ta, ne laa tena baa kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe, ba bwa ɛɛ beɡre ba keri bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: as well as from Gomer and Beth-Togarmah in the north. Your army is enormous!
translation_verse: Laa tena bwa baa le Goma, ne Bɛt Toɡama waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr bwa baa ja o nɛ, ɡɛɛ harɛre kɛrɛdɛ bwa laa tena ɡe ba ja.

english_verse: because in a few years, I will command you to invade Israel, a country that was ruined by war. It was deserted for a long time, but its people have returned from the foreign nations where they once lived. The Israelites now live in peace in the mountains of their own land.
translation_verse: Bene ane habɔɔ la, mɛɛ ɡeloo o nyin dɔmkwa, dɛ́ ka bar Israel harɛ ba fa aa yoo o chɔ pɛɛ la. O nɛraa ba boa ba nyoa le harɛre ta, ba ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta la.

english_verse: But you and your army will attack them like a fierce thunderstorm and surround them like a cloud.
translation_verse: O ne o laa tena ne harɛre ta nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la ɛɛ warɔɔ, dɛ́ ba harɛ la ta kɛ peukpeɡ, dɛ́ ba tɔ harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ bam ken.

english_verse: to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ ŋɔɔ hɛɛ ka yo Israel harɛ ta bwɛɛre baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, baa wola danjwɛjena mae bara, a ba ɛ kɛ aa dɔ doonyoo ba kpɔ bune dɛɛ kaɡra laanee.

english_verse: You will rob the people in towns that were once a pile of rubble. These people lived as prisoners in foreign nations, but they have returned to Israel, the most important place in the world, and they own livestock and property.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ pa nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjena a bwa fa aa paɡra dɛ ɛ dimɡbeeni la laalaa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa. Gɛ nɛra nɔ nyoa ba boa le harɛre ane ta la. Taraken, ba dɔ kondɛɛra ne laala tenten dɛ so harɛ la baah ta.’ ”

english_verse: The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Seeba ne Dedan, dɛ bonadiire baa le Taases ne o bwɛjeɡre ta ɛɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, ‘Hɛɛ boa he laa tena nyoa, dɛ́ ba yo dɛ́ pa suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa, kondɛɛra ne laala kɛŋɔ laa ta kwaa dɛ́ kaa kɛɛ?’ ”

english_verse: You will attack my people like a storm-cloud that covers their land. I will let you invade my country Israel, so that every nation on earth will know that I, the Lord, am holy. Judgment on Gog
translation_verse: Hɛɛ ba tɔ n nɛra Israel tena nɛɛ kɛŋɔ bam yon tɔ harɛ ta la. Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo hen nomonjen Gɔɡ ba yo n nɛra Israel tena, ásɛ harɛre ta nɛra jem mɛ, maa ba che he nɛɛ dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ ba siwi ta la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Gog: Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming.
translation_verse: He waa laa n faa che n bonɔɔna baa ɛ Israel keamere nɛɛ dɛ bol la aa? A ɡɛ saŋ la, n bol waa aa dɛ ba bala biɡri kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ɡeloo nomonjen Gɔɡ ba yoo ba.

english_verse: and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel.
translation_verse: N siwi aa beɡre n baah di kohona awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ jiɡri kohona Israel harɛ ta.

english_verse: Every living thing on earth will tremble in fear of me—every fish and bird, every wild animal and reptile, and every human. Mountains will crumble, cliffs will fall, and cities will collapse.
translation_verse: Pɛŋa aa lɔ mpo ta, ne jumbii aa dɛ ɡah, ne kpɔɡ bini ola, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta bwa bwara ɛɛ sa n siee. Bwejena bwa ɛɛ huɡruu, diŋɡoŋni kuuɡi, ásɛ bwɛjena danjwɛɛre bwa ɡe choɡli.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other.
translation_verse: Wenaale bɛlbwa soo siwii mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta nomonjen Gɔɡ nɛ. Ba bini bɛlbwa ɛɛ berɛ o keree ba o dɔŋ nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Weechɔɡa ne nɛŋkpoaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba tɛr ba deŋne. Bwaalajen ɛɛ nɛo kohona, ásɛ dombwea ne jebɔrɔwe nii lee nomonjen Gɔɡ ne o laa tena, dɛ harɛre laa tena baa ja o nɛɛ bwa nɛ.

english_verse: I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord, am holy.
translation_verse: Gɛ taa mɛɛ ba ɡela harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra na ɡɛ maa kana dɛ do ɡoroŋ. Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him: You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol waa aa dɛ ba koonomoa Gɔɡ waa ɛ koonomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Mɛsɛk ne Tubal be ŋɔ, n ne o dɔɔ. Kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii bol,

english_verse: I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel.
translation_verse: ‘Mɛɛ sɔɔh he nyoa dɛ́ tuuɡi harɛ le he ne bojaŋ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr le, dɛ́ kpɔe ka ta Israel bwejena la dor.

english_verse: I will knock the bow out of your left hand and the arrows out of your right hand,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɔ he to waa lɔ he nɔŋɡal taa ta, ásɛ dɛ ɡel he hɛma le he diɡ ta lee.

english_verse: and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh
translation_verse: Israel bwejena taa hɛɛ ba sewa, he ne he laa tena bwa, ne harɛre ta laa tena baa ja he nɛɛ bwa. Mɛɛ kpɔe tɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa aa di konlala, he ɛ a kondikwa.

english_verse: of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Kpɔɡ binii hɛɛ ba sewa chɔ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ niinii ba fuh Maɡɔɡ harɛ ne nɛra baa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta mpo nyoo, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.

english_verse: My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo n nɛra Israel tena jemɛ kɛ n sɔn do ɡoroŋ, dɛ bɛ doŋa kpɔ kah n sɔn kpa. Ásɛ harɛre ta nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la.

english_verse: The day is coming when these things will happen, just as I have promised.
translation_verse: Tɔpere la ta dɛ ba, wɛɛ bao kpela. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: When that day comes, the people in the towns of Israel will collect the weapons of their dead enemies. They will use these shields, bows and arrows, spears, and clubs as firewood, and there will be enough to last for seven years.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa soɡe Israel bwɛɛre ta la ɛɛ leo ka pa dɔmkwaa la, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ damara. Dɔmkwaa kɛŋɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta, anjena ne anjeɡre, tori ne hɛma, ne koŋkwaa baa dɛ yo a ne laa bwa soo siwi, dɛ lampeare. Bene anuanɛ dɛ ba ta dɛ mara.

english_verse: They will burn these weapons instead of gathering sticks or chopping down trees. That's how the Israelites will take revenge on those who robbed and abused them. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Burial of Gog The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aa hiah kɛŋɔ ba la kpɔɡ bini ka nyin daa kɛɛ dɛ́ ka teŋni daa kɔr bini ba mar kpa, dɛkalkɛ baa dɛɛ mar dɔmkwaa laanee. Ba ɡe ɛɛ ka pa nɛra baa pa ba laala laa ta la laalaa. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: After Gog has been destroyed, I will bury him and his army in Israel, in Travelers' Valley, east of the Dead Sea. That graveyard will be so large that it will block the way of anyone who tries to walk through the valley, which will then be known as “The Valley of Gog's Army.”
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ tɛ nomonjen Gɔɡ lala huɡribɔree Israel harɛ ta, fɛlembɔjen waa lɔ wee leebɔr ŋwɛnɛ nɛra aa kpɔ o ta baa kaa mpo ta la. Huɡribɔr la ɛɛ tɔ bela nɛra aa kpɔa baa kaa la ŋwɛnɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ belaa baa ba nomonjen Gɔɡ ne o laa tena bwa huɡa. Anomanta, baa yerɛ belaa Hamɔn Gɔɡ Fɛlembɔjen.

english_verse: The Israelites will spend seven months burying dead bodies and cleaning up their land.
translation_verse: Korobie anuanɛ dɛ Israel tena ta dɛ huɡ ba ɡɛ, dɛ́ won laa doŋa kpɔ harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Everyone will help with the burial, and they will be honored for this on the day the brightness of my glory is seen.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ la ta la ɛɛ jao dɛɛ huɡ ba. Awola tɔpere la, baa tɛ mɛ jirimaa, ásɛ o ɛ tɔpere baa kpɔ dɛɛ lii a ɡɛ waa nɔ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: After those seven months, the people will appoint a group of men to look for any dead bodies left unburied. This must be done for seven months to make sure that the land is no longer unclean.
translation_verse: Korobie anuanɛ habɔɔ la, baa le baalaa ba ɡaaɡe harɛ la ta bwa dɛ huɡe banɔ la baa wola ban nae huɡe la bwa, ásɛ dɛ laa harɛ la ta doŋa kpɔ.

english_verse: Whenever they find a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it. Then the gravediggers will bury it in “The Valley of Gog's Army”
translation_verse: Ba dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛ ka le hoɡ la bɛl nɛ aa, baa kpɔ konee pa bela, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ kwi lalbɔɔne la ba kpɔ ka huɡe Hamɔn Gɔɡ Fɛlembɔjen la bini.

english_verse: near the town of “Gog's Army.” After that, the land will be pure again.
translation_verse: Bwɛɛ bɛl ɛɛ bɛne belaa ba kpɔ o sɔn pa laa tena la, dɛɛ yerɔ Hamona. Gɛɛ baa ba doŋa laa kpɔ harɛ la ta.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to hold a feast on Israel's mountains and offer sacrifices there. So invite all the birds and wild animals to come from every direction and eat the meat of sacrifices and drink the blood. The birds and animals
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, yerɛ jumbii bwa soo siwi, dɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa bwa ŋɔ, ‘Hé bwa le ba boa nyoa, dɛ́ di saraha maa dɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ. O ɛ sarahajen Israel bwejena dor. Hɛɛ di olaa dɛ́ nyɔ chal.

english_verse: will feast on the bodies of warriors and foreign rulers that I will sacrifice like sheep, goats, and bulls.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ di laa tena olaa, dɛ́ nyɔ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta chale kɛŋɔ pebala ne pebiiri, kɛɛ boohna ne nabala a bwa aa dɔ bo-ola kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le Basan harɛ ken.

english_verse: I want the birds and animals to eat until they are full and drink until they are drunk.
translation_verse: Saraha maa dɛ ba ɛɛ tɛ heyaa la, hɛɛ di ola aa dɔ noo a ba pe heya, dɛ́ nyɔ chal kohona a dɛɛ heya.

english_verse: They will come to my table and stuff themselves with the flesh of horses and warriors of every kind. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Israel Will Be Restored The Lord said:
translation_verse: N tiɡ ta, hɛɛ di jaɡre ne nɛra ba dɛ so a ta, ne banyoola, dɛ laa tena bwa soo siwii olaa, dɛ́ vaɡre ɡɛ bwa haa dɛ nyin. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The people of Israel will know from then on that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Le awola dɛɛ kaa la, mɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.

english_verse: Foreign nations will realize that the Israelites were forced to leave their own land because they sinned against me. I turned my back on my people and let enemies attack and kill them.
