translation_verse: Harɛre ta nɛra ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ, Israel tena wechɔɡa baa ɛa laanee ɡela ba dɔma laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, dɛkalkɛ ba le n habɔɔ. N laa sie kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ ba do ba dɔma nɔn ta, ba kpoo ba keri ne.

english_verse: Their lives were wicked and corrupt, and they deserved to be punished.
translation_verse: Ba wedoŋa ne wechɔɡa kohona nomanta, n laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba dɔ deŋnetɛra ɡɛ aa chɛa.’ ”

english_verse: Now I will show mercy to the people of Israel and bring them back from the nations where they are living. They are Jacob's descendants, so I will bless them and show that I am holy.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ berɔɔ lawɛ Jekɔb naanar baa ɛ Israel tena laanee le bojaŋ harɛfale la ta, dɛ́ sune ba nɛ, ásɛ n sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la bɛ chɔɡ.

english_verse: They will live safely in their own land, but will be ashamed when they remember their evil ways and how they disgraced me.
translation_verse: Baa soh ba sihihwaa ne kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe dɛ tɛ mɛ ɡɛ saŋ baa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta ba harɛ ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola ban aah la.

english_verse: Foreign nations will watch as I take the Israelites from enemy lands and bring them back home, and those nations will see that I am holy.
translation_verse: Maa laɡ ba le harɛre ta, ba dɔma harɛre baa soɡe a ta dɛ́ ba boa ba nyoa la, mɛɛ che ba nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel harɛre ta nɛra jemɛ kɛ n do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: My people will realize that I, the Lord their God, sent them away as prisoners and now will bring them back to their own land.
translation_verse: Belaa baa ba jema kɛŋɔ, menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la. A lole kɛŋɔ n doŋ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta te, kɛ mɛɛ boa ba nyoaa, dɛ́ ba ba ne ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta, maa bɛlbwa habɔɔ ta.

english_verse: Never again will I turn my back on the people of Israel, and my Spirit will live in them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Maa sie laa kpɔ ba nɛɛ kpa, mɛɛ kpɔ n Domaa ba so Israel tena nɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Twenty-five years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, and
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ mɛ kaa Israel harɛ ta ka chɔŋɛ bwejen bɛl waa kaa nyundua kohona doa chaahna ta. Bwejen la weekaŋle harɛbɔr, n na deene ane bela kɛŋɔ bwɛjen bɛl ken.

english_verse: He measured the entrance room at the far end of the passageway, and it was ten meters wide.
translation_verse: O maɡɔ le dea waa lɔ tia la dɛ ba Korowii Dea dembaah la ta, o lɔ naɡale fifraanuanaarɛ.

english_verse: In my vision the Lord took me closer, and I saw a man who was sparkling like polished bronze. He was standing near one of the gates and was holding a tape measure in one hand and a measuring stick in the other.
translation_verse: O la n ne bela, asɛ n na baa bɛl waa cheɡɛ deene la doonyoa dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ ayaawa. O kpoŋe ŋwɛmpoŋ ne daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwa.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay close attention to everything I'm going to show you—that's why you've been brought here. Listen carefully, because you must tell the people of Israel what you see.” The East Gate
translation_verse: Baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ cheɡ deŋne no waa maa dɛ ba he be bola nɔ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛ a waa n ba he ne bonɔ. Ásɛ dɛ ka bol wobɛlbwa haa naa Israel tena be.” Doonyoa waa lɔ wee leebɔr

english_verse: Then he went to the east gate, where he walked up steps that led to a long passageway. On each side of this passageway were three guardrooms, which were three meters square, and they were separated by walls two and a half meters thick. The man measured the distance between the opening of the gate and the first guardroom, and it was three meters, the thickness of the outer wall. At the far end of this passageway, I saw an entrance room that faced the courtyard of the temple itself. There was also a distance of three meters between the last guardroom and the entrance room
translation_verse: Dejeɡre atoro lɔ bela nɛra che a bini dɛɛ daah bɔr. A bɛlbwa paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ, asɛ a jaŋne ɡe lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ. Ba ma danjwɛɛ o bare aa ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama dɛ teŋni a baahna. Baa la maɡɛ bɔr waa chɔa kaa dejeɡre la doonyoa, asɛ o ɛ naɡale anuanaarɛ.

english_verse: at the end of the passageway. The man measured this room: It was four meters from the doorway to the opposite wall, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one meter.
translation_verse: o lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anɛ, o doonyoa daa la ɡe bare lɔ naɡale atoro. Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la sie chaɡɛ Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway were the same size, and the walls that separated them were the same thickness.
translation_verse: Wee leebɔr doonyoa la bini bela, dejeɡre atoro lɔ baŋ bɛlbwa ta, a bwa kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ danjwɛɛre aa lɔ a baŋ bɛlbwa ta la ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Next, the man measured the width of the passageway, and it was six and a half meters, but the two doors of the gate were only five meters wide.
translation_verse: Ate, baa la berɛ maɡɛ bɔr baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ kaa doonyoa la ta paɡri. O lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue, asɛ o jaŋne ka tama o ɛ naɡale fifraanɛ.

english_verse: The man measured the distance from the back wall of one of these rooms to the same spot in the room directly across the passageway, and it was twelve and a half meters.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ berɛ maɡɛ le dea la habɔɔ danjwɛɛ la ta, dɛ ba ɡale bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, asɛ a ka tama a ɛ naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.

english_verse: Finally, he measured the total length of the passageway, from the outer wall to the entrance room, and it was
translation_verse: Le doonyoa waa lɔ Dea la habɔɔ, dɛ kaa doonyoa waa lɔ nyoa ta dea la ta ɡe lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.

english_verse: The three walls in the guardrooms had small windows in them, just like the ones in the entrance room. The walls along the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. The Outer Courtyard
translation_verse: Bɔjeɡre lɔ dejeɡre la habɔɔ danjwɛɛ ne bini danjwɛɛ la ta. Ba ɛ bambie daa maɡre bini danjwɛɛre aa chaɡɛ bɔr waa chɔa kaa la ta. Habɔɔ dembaah

english_verse: The man then led me through the passageway and into the outer courtyard of the temple, where I saw
translation_verse: Baa la kpɔ mɛ jo habɔɔ dembaah la bini. Bela la, n na deene fifraatoro baa maa pɛl danjwɛɛ la, ne ŋwɛnɛ bɛl baa mao bwea ne o ir nyundua, dɛ bar dembaah la cheme.

english_verse: In fact, everything along the passageway was also the same size, including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, the entrance room at the far end, and the windows. This gate, like the others, was
translation_verse: Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo doonyoo aa lɔ bini dembaah la ta bwa la paɡri ka tama o tel naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro. He joɔ dɛɛ kaa bini ɡe aa, a lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama.

english_verse: This was known as the lower sidewalk, and it was
translation_verse: Gɛ ŋwɛnɛ la chɔɔ bar dembaah la. Habɔɔ dembaah la lɔ harɛ dɛ ɡwaa bini dembaah la.

english_verse: I saw the gates that led to the inner courtyard of the temple and noticed that they were higher than those leading to the outer courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gates, and it was
translation_verse: O maɡɔ le bini doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba harɛbɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba bini dembaah la baŋ. O wee leebɔr la ne o weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanunue. Weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa

english_verse: Next, the man measured the north gate that led to the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Baa la maɡɛ doonyoa o sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr paɡri ne o jaŋne. Belaa ba che dɛɛ jo habɔɔ dembaah la ta.

english_verse: This gate also had three guardrooms on each side of a passageway. The measurements of these rooms, the walls between them, and the entrance room at the far end of the passageway were exactly the same as those of the east gate. The north gate was also
translation_verse: Dejeɡre la, atoro lɔ baŋ bɛl, atoro ɡe do baŋ bɛl. A danjwɛɛre ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la bwa jaŋne ne a paɡri kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ doonyoloɡle la ken. O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, o paɡri ɡe ka tama o tel naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.

english_verse: and the windows, the entrance room, and the carvings of palm trees were just like those in the east gate. The entrance room also faced the courtyard of the temple and had seven steps leading up to it.
translation_verse: Dea la bɔjeɡre ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, dɛ bambie daa baa ɛa dawɛ danjwɛɛ la ta o do wer la bwa, ba maɡa a ɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛŋɔ doonyoa waa chaɡɛ wee leebɔr la. Kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta anuanɛ lɔ bela, a sie chaɡɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la.

english_verse: Directly across the outer courtyard was a gate that led to the inner courtyard, just as there was for the east gate. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was
translation_verse: Dɛ doonyoa bɛl lɔ bini dembaah la ta, dɛ chaɡɛ doonyoa waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ɡɛ tenten wee leebɔr doonyoa la aa doa la. O maɡɔ le doonyoa bɛl ta, dɛ kaa bɛl o ɡe sie aa chaɡɔ ta, asɛ a baah la ɛ naɡale lafa fifraanue. Weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa

english_verse: The man then took me to the south gate. He measured the walls and the entrance room of this gate, and the measurements were exactly the same as those of the other two gates.
translation_verse: Baa la kpɔ mɛ kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera, asɛ n na doonyoa bɛl o sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr. O maɡɛ doonyoa daa la ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, a bwa ne anɔ la maɡa ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Seven steps led up to the gate; the entrance room was at the far end of the passageway and faced the courtyard of the temple. Carvings of palm trees decorated the walls along the passageway.
translation_verse: Kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta anuanɛ lɔ bela. A sie chaɡɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, asɛ ba ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la baŋ bɛlbwa ta a do wer.

english_verse: And directly across the outer courtyard was a gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was also
translation_verse: Bini dembaah la dɔ doonyoa o sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ o che doonyoa la ta maɡɛ kaa doonyoa waa lɔ habɔɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr la ta, o ɛ naɡale lafa fifraanue. Doonyoo aa dɛ kaa dembaah bini bela

english_verse: We then went into the inner courtyard, through the gate on the south side of the temple. The man measured the gate, and it was the same size as the gates in the outer wall.
translation_verse: Ate, baa la kpɔ mɛ kpɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba n ne bini dembaah la ta. O maɡɛ doonyoa waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr la, asɛ o ne anɔ la bwa ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The entrance room of this gate faced the outer courtyard, and carvings of palm trees decorated the walls of the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo o ta la sie chaɡɛ habɔɔ dembaah la, asɛ ba ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre aa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ la ta la ta. Ba ma kwaa anuatoro bela baa che a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta. Wee leebɔr doonyoa waa lɔ bini dembaah

english_verse: Next, we went through the east gate to the inner courtyard. The man measured this gate, and it was the same size as the others.
translation_verse: Baa la berɔ laɡ mɛ ba bini dembaah la ta, wee leebɔr pera, dɛ ba maɡɛ bela doonyoa la, o maɡa a ne anɔ la bwa ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The guardrooms, the walls separating them, and its entrance room had the same measurements as the other gates. The guardrooms and the entrance room had windows, and the gate was
translation_verse: O dejeɡre ne o bini danjwɛɛre, dɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo, ne anɔ la bwa maɡa kɛrɛdɛ. Doonyoa la ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, bɔɔne lɔ a bwa ta. A jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, a paɡri ɡe ka tama o ɛ naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.

english_verse: The entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and the walls in the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo o ta la sie chaɡɛ habɔɔ dembaah la, asɛ ba ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre aa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ la ta. Ba do kwaa anuatoro bela baa che a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta.

english_verse: Then the man took me to the north gate. He measured it, and it was the same size as the others,
translation_verse: Ate, o berɛ laɡ mɛ ba weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba maɡɔ. O ne anɔ la bwa, ba maɡa a ɛ kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, and the entrance room. There were also windows in this gate. It was
translation_verse: ɡɛɛ o dejeɡre ne bini danjwɛɛre, dɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, bɔɔne do a bwa ta. O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, o paɡri ɡe ka tama o ɛ naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.

english_verse: and like the other inner gates, its entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and its walls were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate. The Rooms for Sacrificing Animals
translation_verse: Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la sie chaɡɛ habɔɔ dembaah la, asɛ ba ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la bɛlbwa ta, a do wer. Kwaa anuatoro do bela ba che a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta. Deene baa dɛ kwaa saraha kwaa a bini

english_verse: Inside the entrance room of the north gate, I saw four tables, two on each side of the room, where the animals to be sacrificed were killed. Just outside this room was a small building used for washing the animals before they were offered as sacrifices to please the Lord or sacrifices for sin or sacrifices to make things right.
translation_verse: Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo doonyoa ta la, teeburre anɛ cheɡɛ baŋ bɛlbwa ta. A taa baa kpoo saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha kwa.

english_verse: Four more tables were in the outer courtyard, two on each side of the steps leading into the entrance room.
translation_verse: Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo danjwɛɛ la habɔɔ, weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa, teeburre anɛ cheɡɛ baŋ bɛl dɛ bɛne kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ teeh la, asɛ anɛ ɡe che a baŋ bɛl.

english_verse: So there was a total of eight tables, four inside and four outside, where the animals were killed,
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do asɛ teeburre anaarɛ che doonyoa la baŋ bɛlbwa ta, a bwa ɛ teeburre anuatoro, baa kpoo kwaa baa kpɔa baa ɛ saraha a ta.

english_verse: and where the meat was placed until it was sacrificed on the altar. Next to the tables in the entrance room were four stone tables
translation_verse: Ba ɡoŋe bune a nyoo ɛ anɛnɛ pɛ danjwɛɛ la ta dɛ bar, a jaŋne do kɛ nɔmpaa del. Dɛ kpɔ saraha ola la dɛɛ dawɛ teeburre la ta. Sɔfore deene

english_verse: The man then took me to the inner courtyard, where I saw two buildings, one beside the inner gate on the north and the other beside the inner gate on the south.
translation_verse: Baa la berɔ kpɔ mɛ ba bini dembaah la ta. Deene anɛ lɔ bela. Bɛl lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa la jwɛh, o sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, onɔ la ɡe do weekaŋle harɛbɔr, o sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.

english_verse: He said, “The building beside the north gate belongs to the priests who serve in the temple,
translation_verse: O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Dea o sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr la ɛ sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea toma la kon,

english_verse: and the building beside the south gate belongs to those who serve at the altar. All of them are descendants of Zadok and are the only Levites allowed to serve as the Lord's priests.” The Inner Courtyard and the Temple
translation_verse: asɛ onɔ la o ɡe sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la ɛ sɔfore baa dɛ nyiŋi kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la kon. Banee Sadɔk naanar, ba ɡboo ɛ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ ba wona la Korowii sie dɛ́ kaa tomɔ.”

english_verse: We walked to the porch of the temple, and the man measured the doorway of the porch: It was seven meters long, two and a half meters wide, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one and a half meters.
translation_verse: Baa la kpɔ mɛ ba bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo Korowii Dea la, dɛ ba maɡɛ bela doonyoa daa la. A baŋ bɛlbwa paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama. O doonyoa la paɡri ɡe lɔ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ, asɛ danjwɛɛ waa lɔ bini la baŋ bɛlbwa bare lɔ naɡale anaarɛ ne tama.

english_verse: The porch itself was ten meters by six meters, with steps leading up to it. There was a column on each side of these steps.
translation_verse: Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la paɡri lɔ naɡale fifraatoro, le o nyoa ta kaa o tia ɡe lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anuatoro. Kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛ teeh dɛɛ kaa lɔ o ta, asɛ pilare do doonyoa daa la jwɛh.

english_verse: Next we went into the main room of the temple. The man measured the doorway of this room: It was
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, baa la laɡ mɛ ba Korowii Dea la bini waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛ ba maɡɛ o doonyoa daa la. Baŋ bɛlbwa paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ.

english_verse: and the nearest buildings ten meters away.
translation_verse: ne sɔfore deene la baah paɡri lɔ naɡale fifraatoro dɛ bar Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: Then the man walked to the far end of the temple's main room and said, “Beyond this doorway is the most holy place.” He first measured the doorway: It was one meter wide,
translation_verse: O maɡɛ Korowii Dea la bini tenten jaŋne, o ɛ naɡale fifraatoro, asɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fifraatoro dɛ kaa dea waa lɔ bini la ta. Asɛ o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bonɔ ɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten.”

english_verse: The walls of the temple were thicker at the bottom than at the top, which meant that the storage rooms on the top level were wider than those on the bottom level. Steps led from the bottom level, through the middle level, and into the top level.
translation_verse: Danjwɛɛre aa bar Korowii Dea la harɛbɔr bare kɛrɛdɛ. Anomanta, nyundua deene baa dɛ cheɡ kwaa a bini la, paɡri ɡwaa harɛbɔr deene la. Ba ma kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh le harɛ dɛɛ kaa nyundua. Ba maa le mun ta deene la ta, dɛ kpɔ baah deene la ta, dɛ kaa nyundua kwaa la ta.

english_verse: The temple rested on a stone base three meters high, which also served as the foundation for the storage rooms.
translation_verse: N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii Dea la chɔŋɛ bela waa daŋa dɛ baro, ba ma dejeɡre aa lɔ Korowii Dea la keŋkeŋna chɔŋɛ bela. Bela daŋa ne daa waa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ la bwa kɛrɛdɛ. O ɡwaa naɡale anuanaarɛ.

english_verse: The outside walls of the storage rooms were two and a half meters thick; there was nothing between these walls
translation_verse: Dejeɡre la danjwɛɛ waa lɔ habɔɔ la bare lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama. Baah waa chɔ dejeɡre aa lɔ Korowii Dea la

english_verse: One door led into the storage rooms on the north side of the temple, and another door led to those on the south side. The stone base extended two and a half meters beyond the outside wall of the storage rooms. The West Building and the Measurements of the Temple
translation_verse: Doonyoo lɔ dejeɡre la ta dɛ le baah la ta. Beŋkpoŋ lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, asɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡe do weekaŋle harɛbɔr. Bela waa daŋa ba ma dejeɡre chɔŋɛ o ta la teŋɛ baah la ta. O bare lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama dɛ bar.

english_verse: The distance across the front of the temple, including the open space on either side, was also
translation_verse: Korowii Dea la dembaah wee leebɔr pera ne o sie bwa paɡri lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue.

english_verse: were paneled with wood all the way from the floor to the windows, while the doorways, the small windows, and the three side rooms were trimmed in wood.
translation_verse: ne daa baa kpɔa tɔ a ta le harɛ kaa tokorore ta la, ba kpɔ daa la tɔ tokorore la ta.

english_verse: The doorframe to the temple's main room was in the shape of a rectangle. The Wooden Altar In front of the doorway to the most holy place was something that looked like
translation_verse: Dea la bini doonyoa daa la ɛ baŋne anaarɛ, baŋne anɛ jaŋne ɡwaa baŋne anɛ ɡe. Gɛɛ onɔ la waa lɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten doonyoa ta ɡe do.

english_verse: a wooden altar. It was one and a half meters high and one meter square, and its corners, its base, and its sides were made of wood. The man said, “This is a reminder that the Lord is constantly watching over his temple.” The Doors in the Temple
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ daa kwaa kon baa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta. O daŋa lɔ naɡale anaarɛ ne tama, dɛ dɔ baŋne anaarɛ. Bɛlbwa lɔ naɡale atoro. Asɛ baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Teebur waa cheɡɛ Korowii sie laanee la.”

english_verse: Both the doorway to the main room of the temple and the doorway to the most holy place had two doors,
translation_verse: Korowii Dea la bini ne Boɡoroŋ Tenten la bwa dɔ ɡbeni anɛnɛ.

english_verse: and each door had two sections that could fold open.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ ya bɛlbwa baŋne anɛ, ɡbeni la bɛlbwa dɔ njinasoɔ anɛnɛ.

english_verse: The doors to the main room were decorated with carvings of winged creatures and palm trees just like those on the walls, and there was a wooden covering over the porch just outside these doors.
translation_verse: Korowii Dea la bini la, ba ɛ Kerobim ne bambie daa dawɛ a ɡbeni ta kɛŋɔ anɔ la baa ɛa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la ta la ken, asɛ daa bɛl saɡɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la sie.

english_verse: The walls on each side of this porch had small windows and were also decorated with carvings of palm trees.
translation_verse: Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo danjwɛɛre la baŋ bɛlbwa ta la, ba do tokorojeɡre, dɛ ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la baŋ bɛlbwa ta. Deene aa lɔ Korowii Dea la keŋkeŋni ɡe ta, ba saɡɛ daa a ta.

english_verse: After the man and I left the temple and walked back to the outer courtyard, he showed me a set of rooms on the north side of the west building. This set of rooms was
translation_verse: Dea o doonyoa aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la jaŋne lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue, asɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.

english_verse: and at the east end of this wall was the door leading from the courtyard to these rooms. There was also a set of rooms on the south side of the west building.
translation_verse: Habɔɔ dembaah weekaŋle harɛbɔr la, danjwɛɛ le bela dɛ ba Korowii Dea dembaah la ta. O lɔ danjwɛɛ waa lɔ o habɔɔ la baŋ bɛl, asɛ deene do bela,

english_verse: with doors that opened toward the north, and in front of them was a walkway five meters wide and
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛ chɔ deene la sie bini bela. O paɡri lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue, o jaŋne ɡe lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue. A doonyoo sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.

english_verse: The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the middle level, and the rooms on the middle level were narrower than those on the bottom level.
translation_verse: Deene aa lɔ nyundua la aa paɡe kɛŋɔ anɔ la aa lɔ baah ta ne harɛ bɔr kwaa la, dɛkalkɛ a chɔŋre dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛ le habɔɔ.

english_verse: The rooms on the bottom level supported those on the two upper levels, and so these rooms did not have columns like other buildings in the courtyard.
translation_verse: Deene aa lɔ nyundua la ta pilare dɔe kɛ dembaah kwaa la, anomanta, a bini aa kanɛ kɛŋɔ baah ta ne harɛ bɔr kwaa la.

english_verse: These rooms were exactly like those on the north side, and they also had a walkway in front of them.
translation_verse: ŋwɛnɛ chɔ a sie. A do kɛŋɔ deene aa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la ken. A jaŋne ne a paɡri bwa beŋkpoŋ, dɛ dɔ bela baa kpɔa dɛɛ le, dɛ bwa le dɔŋa. Doonyoo aa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr

english_verse: The door to these rooms was at the east end of the wall that stood in front of them.
translation_verse: ne doonyoo aa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr la le dɔŋa. Ŋwɛnɛ bɛl pa mun le wee leebɔr pera dɛ fɛrɛ danjwɛɛ la doonyoa a sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa, nɛn won che o ta dɛ jo deene la bini.

english_verse: The man then said to me: These rooms on the north and south sides of the temple are the sacred rooms where the Lord's priests will eat the most holy offerings. These offerings include the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices for sin, and the sacrifices to make things right.
translation_verse: Baa la ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Deene aa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne anɔ la aa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr a sie chaɡɛ Korowii Dea dembaah bela la, ɛ sɔfore deene. Belaa sɔfore baa dɛ ba men Korowii sie la ɛɛ ba saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona la dɛɛ dii. Deene la aa do ɡoroŋ kohona nomanta, a binii baa ba saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona kɛŋɔ mea sarahare, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare, dɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha kwaa kpɔe dɛɛ cheɡ.

english_verse: When the priests are ready to leave the temple, they must go through these rooms before they return to the outer courtyard. They must leave their sacred clothes in these rooms and put on regular clothes before going anywhere near other people. The Size of the Temple Area
translation_verse: Sɔfore la baa jo Korowii Dea dɛ ɛ ba toma tonaa, ba bɛ le kaa habɔɔ dembaah bela. Bá foo laala baa doa ɛ toma la bil deene la bini, dɛkalkɛ a do ɡoroŋ. Bá do laala pɛɛne mɔɔ dɛ́ le kaa nɛra la bini.”

english_verse: After the man had finished measuring the buildings inside the temple area, he took me back through the east gate and measured the wall around this area.
translation_verse: Waa maɡɛ Korowii Dea la bini bɔr bela tonɛ la, o tɔ n sie kpɔ mɛ le wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ maɡɛ bela bwa bar.

english_verse: He used his measuring stick to measure the east side of this wall; it was
translation_verse: O kpɔ daa la maɡɛ wee leebɔr pera, o ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.

english_verse: Then he measured the north side, the south side, and the west side of the wall, and they were each
translation_verse: Belaa o berɛ sie chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr pera ɡe dɛ maɡɛ. O ɡe ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.

english_verse: and so the temple area was a perfect square. The wall around this area separated what was sacred from what was ordinary.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ o maɡɛ baŋne anaarɛ la bwa. Danjwɛɛ baro, asɛ o jaŋne ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue, o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue, dɛ pere bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ la le bɔr waa wola ɡoroŋ doe la ta.

english_verse: The man took me back to the east gate of the temple,
translation_verse: Baa la kpɔ men Ɛsekeɛl ba Korowii Dea wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta,

english_verse: meters high, was the place where sacrifices were burned, and the four corners of the top section looked like the horns of a bull. The steps leading up to the altar were on the east side. The Dedication of the Altar
translation_verse: asɛ n na Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la jirima o le wee leebɔr dɛɛ ba. O taa do kɛŋɔ chuubu sii ken, asɛ o jirima chaah kohona harɛ la ta bwa.

english_verse: This vision was like the one I had seen when God came to destroy Jerusalem and like the one I had seen near the Chebar River. I immediately bowed with my face to the ground,
translation_verse: Wepila la do kɛŋɔ anɔ la Korowii aa baa chɔɡ bwɛjen Jerusalam, ne Keba Moo nyoa kwaa maa naa la, asɛ n ba harɛ dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.

english_verse: and the Lord's glory came through the east gate and into the temple.
translation_verse: Korowii jirima la cheɡɛ wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba su o Dea la bini.

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit lifted me to my feet and carried me to the inner courtyard, where I saw that the Lord's glory had filled the temple.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii Doma la kpɔ mɛ ir, dɛ ba n ne bini dembaah la ta, asɛ Korowii jirima su o Dea bela.

english_verse: But if the people and their kings stop worshiping other gods and tear down those memorials, I will live among them forever.
translation_verse: Bá ɡel jwamane la, dɛ́ pa ba voɡare ne ba koranar voɡare mkpa aa wola toole a ta la ta, ásɛ n ba so ba baah ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: The people of Israel must suffer shame for sinning against me, so tell them about my holy temple. Let them think about it,
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, baɡle ɡɛ n Dea la wa aa doa Israel tena be, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa. Gel ba nyiŋi o mar,

english_verse: then if they are truly sorry, describe for them the design and shape of the temple, the gates, the measurements, and how the buildings are arranged. Explain the regulations about worshiping there, then write down these things, so they can study and obey them.
translation_verse: dɛ sihiih kpo ba ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa aa, baɡ ba ɡɛ n Dea la mar aa doa. Gɛ o bini mar ne o doonyoo baa cheɡɛ a ta jo dɛɛ le, dɛ́ baɡ ba o waa bwa. Chwerɛ waa nɔ bwa bil ba, ásɛ ba won na ɡɛ Dea la wobɛlbwa aa doa, ásɛ ba jemɛ dɛ́ won dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare la bwa ta.

english_verse: The temple area on my holy mountain must be kept sacred! This is the most important law about the temple. The Altar
translation_verse: Mmara waa chɔ le dɛ tɛ Korowii Dea laanee teŋa nɔ. Bwejen la doa ne bɔr waa baro bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do ɡoroŋ kohona. Kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta

english_verse: Each day for the next seven days, you must offer a goat and a bull and a ram as sacrifices for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Berɛ lawɛ bombal ne nabale dɛ pebal, a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii, le he kondɛɛra bini ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɔpere bɛlbwa tɔpera anuanɛ tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, after the altar is built, it must be dedicated by offering sacrifices on it and by splattering it with blood. Here is what you must do:
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, dɛ ba ɛ saraha kon la tonaa, ŋwɛnɛre baa che a ta dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa dɛ́ kpɔ a chale dɛɛ merɛ o ta laanee teŋa nɔ.

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe from the family of Zadok the priest are the only ones who may serve in my temple—this is my law. So give them a young bull to slaughter as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ he lawɛ nabale ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore dɛ ɛ Sadɔk naanar. Banee dɛɛ ba n sie dɛ baa tom mɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Take some of the animal's blood and smear it on the four corners of the altar, some on the corners of the middle section, and some more on the rim around its edge. That will purify the altar and make it fit for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ o chal la ane ɛ kwaa anaarɛ aa do kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare dɛ paaɡe saraha kon la loŋkoni ta la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɛ o doa bela waa kana la, ne kon waa bar o nyoo ta bwa bar. Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ saraha kon la ta, ó do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Then take the body of the bull outside the temple area and burn it at the special place.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nabale la ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ fuuh bela baa lea cheɡ Korowii Dea la dahara bela.

english_verse: The next day, a goat that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Tɔɔ perɔ aa, a chɛ kɛ he lawɛ bombal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ o chal laa doŋa kpɔ saraha kon la ta, ɡɛ haa kpɔ nabale la ɛ la.

english_verse: Then choose a young bull and a young ram that have nothing wrong with them,
translation_verse: Haa laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ saraha kon la ta tonɛ la, kpɔ nabale ne pebal a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii le he kondɛɛra bini ba tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: and bring them to my temple. The priests will sprinkle salt on them and offer them as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Kpɔa ba n sie, ásɛ sɔfore la ɛ yar merɛ a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ saraha baa fuah tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: The priests will purify the altar during those days, so that it will be acceptable to me and ready to use.
translation_verse: Tɔpera anuanɛɛ sɔfore la kpɔ soŋe men Korowii, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ saraha kon la ta kpɔ tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ do n nɔn ta dɛ́ pilu.

english_verse: From then on, the priests will use this altar to offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices to ask my blessing. Then I will be pleased with the people of Israel. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Tɔpera anuanɛ nɔ ba a jaɡa aa, tɔpenuatoro wee la, sɔfore la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ saraha kwaa haa fuah, ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare la ba saraha kon la ta, ásɛ n lɛ heyaa do. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The man took me back to the outer courtyard, near the east gate of the temple area. I saw that the doors to this gate were closed.
translation_verse: Belaa baa la lawɛ men Ɛsekeɛl ba Korowii Dea la wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ o tɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said: I, the Lord God of Israel, came through this gate, so it must remain closed forever! No one must ever use it.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Den ɡel doonyoa nɔ tɔ ɡɛ. Bɛ on pili, nomɛlbwa ɡe bɛ o ta kpɔ, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la, n kpɔ o ta.

english_verse: The ruler of Israel may come here to eat a sacrificial meal that has been offered to me, but he must use only the entrance room of this gate. People Who Are Not Allowed in the Temple
translation_verse: Kooro ɡboo dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ jo ka di kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ n sie bela. Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo laanee chɛ kɛ o che jo, dɛ́ berɛ che o ta le.”

english_verse: Then the man took me through the north gate to the front of the temple. I saw that the brightness of the Lord's glory had filled the temple, and I immediately bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Baa la kpɔ mɛ kpɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa ta, dɛ ba n ne Korowii Dea la sie. Asɛ n na kɛŋɔ Korowii jirima baa su o Dea la bini bwa, asɛ n ba harɛ dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to give you the laws for my temple. So pay attention and listen carefully to what kind of people are allowed to come in the temple, and what kind are not.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ no n mmarare ne waa bwa aa chɔ le tɛ n Dea la. Do sie dɛɛ nyiŋi doonyoo ne bɔra baa cheɡɛ a ta jo dɛɛ le a ta bwa.

english_verse: Tell those rebellious people of Israel: I, the Lord God, command you to stop your evil ways!
translation_verse: Ŋɔ Israel lwɛmkpeɡ tena la be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii dɛ bol kɛŋɔ, ‘Israel tena, waa maa kia hɛɛ ɛ la maɡre ɡɛ.

english_verse: My temple has been disgraced, because you have let godless, stubborn foreigners come here when sacrifices are being offered to me. You have sinned and have broken our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: A bwa habɔɔ, he ɡelɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola ba pena teŋe, baa wola men duu, ba jo n Dea la ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh, ɡɛ saŋ haa kpɔ kondikwaa ne ola noorare, dɛ a chale ba ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ. A cheɡɛ a ta he chɔɡ n ne he fɔo la.

english_verse: Instead of following the proper ways to worship me, you have put foreigners in charge of worship at my temple.
translation_verse: Heyaa chɛ kɛ he nyiŋi n waa aa do ɡoroŋ ta n Dea bela, kɛ he berɔ kpɔ do nɛŋhɔɔhra nɔn ta.

english_verse: And so I, the Lord God, say that no godless foreigner who disobeys me will be allowed in my temple. This includes any foreigner living in Israel. The Levites Are Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola ba pena teŋe, baa wola men duu, ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá jo n Dea la bini, hale nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe he Israel tena bini.’ ”

english_verse: Some of the Levites turned their backs on me and joined the other people of Israel in worshiping idols. So these Levites must be punished!
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɛr Lewi dea tena ba ne Israel tena aa le n habɔɔ dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa la deŋnee.

english_verse: They will still be allowed to serve me as temple workers by guarding the gates and by killing the animals to be sacrificed and by helping the worshipers.
translation_verse: Ba ken ɛɛ dɔ bɔree dɛɛ daah n Dea doonyoo la, dɛɛ ɛ toma bela. Baa kpo saraha kwaa baa fuah, ne nɛra la kwaa baa kpoora, dɛɛ cha ba.

english_verse: But because these Levites served the people of Israel when they worshiped idols, I, the Lord God, promise that the Levites will be punished. They did not stop the Israelites from sinning,
translation_verse: Baa tomɛ voɡa dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa nomanta, n ir nɔn dɛ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ba dɔ deŋnetɛra ba wechɔɡa la wa. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: and now I will no longer let the Levites serve as my priests or come near anything sacred to me. They must suffer shame and disgrace for their disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Ba bɛ n sie ba, dɛ́ ba tom mɛ kɛŋɔ sɔfore, kɛɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ baa tuuhnu tel kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ, ne saraha aa do ɡoroŋ kohona la bɛlbwa. A chɛ kɛ sihiih kpo ba, baa dɔ deŋnetɛraa waa maa kia ba ɛ la wa.

english_verse: They will be responsible for all the hard work that must be done in the temple. Rules for Priests The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, mɛɛ kpɔ tomkpeɡa aa chɛ kɛ baa ɛ n Dea bela la bwaa do ba nɔn ta.

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe who are descendants of Zadok the priest were faithful to me, even when the rest of the Israelites turned away. And so, these priests will continue to serve as my priests and to offer the fat and the blood of sacrifices.
translation_verse: Kɛ Sadɔk naanar baa ɛ Lewi dea sɔfore dɛ kpɔ kasinteŋ ba tom mɛ n Dea bela, ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena aa le n habɔɔ la, banee ba n sie bela dɛ ba tom mɛ. Kɛ taraken, bá ba che n sie dɛ́ kpɔ ola noorare ne a chale ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ mɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: They will come into my temple, where they will offer sacrifices at my altar and lead others in worship.
translation_verse: Ba ɡboo dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ jo n Dea la ta, banee dɛ́ suuh tel n saraha kon la, dɛ́ɛ ɛ n Dea bela toma bwa.

english_verse: When they come to the inner courtyard, they must wear their linen priestly clothes. My priests must never wear anything made of wool when they are on duty in this courtyard or in the temple.
translation_verse: Ba cheɡɛ dembaah doonyoo la ta jo n Dea la bini naa, a chɛ kɛ bá do yapondɛɛɡa laala. A ta chɛ kɛ bá do komɛlbwa baa kpɔ olpona ɛo ba jo bini dembaah kɛɛ n Dea bela, dɛ́ ɛ toma.

english_verse: Even their turbans and underwear must be made of linen to keep my priests from sweating when they work.
translation_verse: Bá kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa baa vɔwa nyuune ne a yapebori. A ta chɛ kɛ bá do komɛlbwa aa ɡel bɔwɔb laɡ ba.

english_verse: And before they leave to join the other people in the outer courtyard, they must take off their priestly clothes, then place them in the sacred rooms and put on their regular clothes. That way, no one will touch their sacred clothes and be harmed.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ba le ka jo habɔɔ dembaah la ta bela nɛra aa lole la, bá foo laala baa doa ɛ toma la bil deene aa do ɡoroŋ la bini. Bá kpɔ laala pɛɛne do, ásɛ a bɛ waa kpɔ ba ta nɛra la nɛ.

english_verse: Priests must never shave their heads when they are mourning. But they must keep their hair properly trimmed and not let it grow too long.
translation_verse: Sɔfore bɛ ba nyumpona paa ta, ba bɛ ɡel a moɡɛ kohona ɡe. Bá fona a ba harɛ.

english_verse: They must not drink wine before going to the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Sɔfo bɛlbwa dɛ ba Dea la bini dembaah la ta joe yaa, o bɛ sen nyɔ.

english_verse: A priest must not marry a divorced woman; he can marry only a virgin from Israel or the widow of another priest.
translation_verse: Sɔfo ta chɛ kɛ ó mo luhaah kɛɛ haah o jaa aa vɛoh. Wɛɛ won mo Israel bihaah waa wola baa jemɛ, kɛɛ luhaah sɔfo aa sewa ɡelo.

english_verse: Priests must teach my people the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary, and between what is clean and what is unclean.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ sɔfore la chaɡle n nɛra wa, dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ ne kwaa aa wola ɡoroŋ doe, dɛ́ pere kwaa doŋa aa lɔ a ta le kwaa doŋa aa wola toole a ta.

english_verse: They will make decisions in difficult legal cases, according to my own laws. They must also observe the religious festivals my Law requires and must always respect the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Nomɛl ne o dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, sɔfore laanee dɛ́ nyiŋi a ta, dɛ́ bola, ɡɛ aa lɔ me Mmarare ta la. A chɛ kɛ baa teŋɛ me Mmarare ne n waa maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba bwa ta, n tɔpejena maa lea cheɡ bwa, ásɛ dɛɛ di n Ona Tɔpera la, dɛ́ ɡel a do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Touching a dead body will make a person unclean. So a priest must not go near a dead body, unless it is one of his parents or children, or his brother or unmarried sister.
translation_verse: Sɔfo bɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ o leɡe nɛn waa sewa dɛ́ kah doŋa, nemenɛ o nya ne mɛɛ, bibaa kɛɛ bihaah, o nime kɛɛ dɔɔ kɛɛ nimambie waa wola yalɛ mɔɔ.

english_verse: he must go to the inner courtyard of the temple and offer a sacrifice for sin. After that, he may once again serve as my priest. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Awola waa ba jo Korowii Dea, o bini dembaah la ta bela dɛ́ ba ɛ toma la, ó ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha tɛ o te. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I myself will provide for my priests, and so they won't receive any land of their own.
translation_verse: Menee dɛ́ tɛ sɔfore la komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin. He bɛ ban Israel harɛ la pera tɛ. Menee ba kondɔɔh.

english_verse: Instead, they will receive part of the grain sacrifices, as well as part of the sacrifices for sin and sacrifices to make things right. They will also be given everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Banee dɛ́ di mea sarahare, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ sarahare, ne bolchɔɡe dii sarahare, dɛ komɛlbwa Israel tena aa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ la. A bwa ɛ ba kwa.

english_verse: The first part of every harvest will belong to the priests. They will also receive part of all special gifts and offerings the Israelites bring to me. And whenever any of my people bake bread, they will give their first loaf as an offering to the priests, and I will bless the homes of the people when they do this.
translation_verse: He koo kondikonloɡla aa wera, ne komɛlbwa haa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ la ɛɛ ɛ sɔfore la kwaa. He kpɔ menloɡla ba tɛɛ ba, ásɛ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heyaa he deremi.

english_verse: Priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies a natural death or that has been killed by a wild animal.
translation_verse: Sɔfore ta chɛ kɛ ba di jumbie kɛɛ ol bɛlbwa waa sewa ta baŋa, kɛɛ onɔ la kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa aa kpoo.”

english_verse: So from now on, you must use honest weights and measures.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ kwaa aa chɛa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa tɔɡre ne a wara.

english_verse: The Festival of Shelters will begin on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and will continue for seven days. On each day of this festival, the ruler will provide the same number of animals that he did each day during Passover, as well as the same amount of grain and olive oil for the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Kukure Tɔpejen dii, tɔpenuanɛ wee waa dɛ pa mun korobie anuanɛ, tɔpera fi dɛ anue ta la, a chɛ kɛ kooro la ɛ ɡɛ tenten tɔpera anuanɛ ja wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare, ne saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne mea sarahare, dɛ noo waa kpɔ ba la ta.”

english_verse: kilometers wide. This will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem. Land for Israel's Ruler The Lord said:
translation_verse: Bɔne harɛ la bini, dɛ maɡɛ bɔr o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, ásɛ o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue. Belaa n Dea waa ɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ɛɛ ba cheɡa.

english_verse: The Lord God said: You leaders of Israel have cheated and abused my people long enough! I want you to stop sinning and start doing what is right and fair. You must never again force my people off their own land. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel koranar, he wechɔɡa la ɡwaalɔ to. Hé ɡel naɡrenyin, ne fiiɡa haa dɛ fiiɡi nɛra la, dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera dɛ toɡre. He bɛ n nɛra doŋi le ba harɛ ta dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ he kon. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The same ceremony must also be done on the seventh day of the month, so that anyone who sins accidentally or without knowing it will be forgiven, and so that my temple will remain holy.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ he berɛ ɛ ɡɛ tenten korobie la tɔpenuanɛ wee ta tɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola saahnɛ, kɛɛ waa wola jemɛ dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa. Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba soŋa le n be dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ n Dea la ta ó do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: Leaders of Israel, the people must bring you one sixtieth of their grain harvests as offerings to me.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Koŋkɛɛla aa wera hé kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ laanee, mea kuruware anumɛl dɛ le kuruware lafa bɛlbwa ta, ásɛ mea ane soo siwi ta ɡe, he ɛ ɡɛ tenten.

english_verse: They will also bring one percent of their olive oil. These things will be measured according to the bath, and ten baths is the same as one homer or one cor.
translation_verse: Hé bɔne noo ɡalɔŋre anue bini bɔre fi aa, n bɔr lɔ o ta bɔrbeŋkpoŋ. Gɛɛ a do noo ɡalɔŋre fifraanue bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: The people of Israel will bring you these offerings.
translation_verse: Harɛ la ta nɛra bwa kpɔ koŋkɛɛla ba tɛ kooro waa lɔ Israel harɛ ta ó ɛ saraha.

english_verse: But during New Moon Festivals, Sabbath celebrations, and other religious feasts, you leaders will be responsible for providing animals for the sacrifices, as well as the grain and wine. All these will be used for the sacrifices for sin, the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices to please me, and those to ask my blessing. I will be pleased and will forgive the sins of my people. The Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: A ɛ kooro la toma kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah, ne mea sarahare, dɛ sen sarahare tɛ tɔpejena ne Korobifala dɛ Ona Tɔpera dii ta. Wɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare, ne mea sarahare, ne sarahare baa dɛ fuah, dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraharee ba soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa n be, ń kpɔ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Each day of the festival he is to bring seven bulls and seven rams as sacrifices to please me, and he must bring a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Tɔpejen la dii tɔpera anuanɛ ta la, tɔpere bɛlbwa a chɛ kɛ o lawɛ nabali anuanɛ, ne pebala anuanɛ bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii, dɛ́ ba ɛ saraha baa fuah tɛ mɛ. Tɔpere bɛlbwa, ó berɛ lawɛ bombal ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.

english_verse: The Lord God said: On the first day of the first month, a young bull that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to purify the temple.
translation_verse: Waa Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. Korobiloɡle la tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta, a chɛ kɛ he lawɛ nabale waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii dɛ́ kpo, dɛ́ ba laa doŋa kpɔ n Dea la ta.

english_verse: The priest will take some blood from this sacrifice and smear it on the doorposts of the temple, as well as on the four corners of the altar and on the doorposts of the gates that lead into the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Sɔfo la kpɔ nabale baa kpɔa ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha la chal la ane ba ɛ n Dea doonyoa daa la ta, ne saraha kon la loŋkoni anaarɛ ta, dɛ doonyoo daa aa lɔ bini dembaah la ta.

english_verse: Beginning on the fourteenth day of the first month, and continuing for seven days, everyone will celebrate Passover and eat bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Korobiloɡle la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta, a chɛ kɛ he di Galekaa Tɔpejen tɔpera anuanɛ. Hɛ́ɛ di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta.

english_verse: On the first day, the ruler will bring a bull to offer as a sacrifice for his sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Tɔpeloɡle ta la, kooro la lawɛ nabale ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ o te, ne harɛ la ta nɛra bwa.

english_verse: He will also provide nine kilograms of grain and three liters of olive oil to be offered with each bull and each ram.
translation_verse: Nabali la bɛlbwa ta la, ó kpɔ men kuruware fi dɛ́ ba ɛ mea saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ men kuruware fi ja pebala la bɛlbwa ɡe ta, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anumɛl ja men kuruware fi bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: The Lord said: The east gate of the inner courtyard must remain closed during the six working days of each week. But on the Sabbath and on the first day of the month, this gate will be opened.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Doonyoa waa lɔ bini dembaah o sie chaɡɛ wee leebɔr la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó tɔ tɔpera anumɛl baa dɛ ɛ toma la, kɛ Ona Tɔpere ne Korobifale Tɔpejena dii ta te, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé pilu.

english_verse: Israel's ruler will go from the outer courtyard into the entrance room of this gate and stand in the doorway while the priest offers sacrifices to ask my blessing and sacrifices to please me. The ruler will bow with his face to the ground to show that he has worshiped me. Then he will leave, and the gate will remain open until evening.
translation_verse: Kooro la chɛ kɛ ó che habɔɔ dembaah bela jo, dɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ jo, dɛ́ ba che doonyoa ɡbera la jwɛh. Ásɛ sɔfore la kpɔ o saraha kwaa baa fuah, ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha kwaa ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ. Ó tomɛ men Korowii doonyoa bela, dɛ́ berɛ le kaa. A ta chɛ kɛ ba tɔ ɡbera la nemenɛ jɔmɔra.

english_verse: Each Sabbath and on the first day of each month, the people of Israel must also come to the east gate and worship me.
translation_verse: Ona Tɔpera ne Korobifala Tɔpejena dii ta, harɛ la ta nɛra bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá ba doonyoa la ta bela, dɛ́ ba tom mɛ.

english_verse: On the Sabbath, the ruler will bring six lambs and one ram to be offered as sacrifices to please me. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Ona Tɔpere ta la, kooro la chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ pebali anumɛl ne pebal a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii ba fuah ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii.

english_verse: With the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Mea saraha waa kpɔ ja pebal la ta la chɛ kɛ á ɛ mea kuruware fi, mea saraha waa kpɔ ja pebali la ta la te, ó kpɔ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anumɛl koo men kuruwa bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: The ruler is to bring six lambs, a bull, and a ram to be offered as sacrifices at the New Moon Festival. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Korobifale Tɔpejen dii ta, kooro la lawɛ nabale ne pebiiri anumɛl, dɛ pebal a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ saraha.

english_verse: With the bull and the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ mea kuruware fi ja nabale la ta ɛ mea saraha, men kuruware fi ja pebal la ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mea la ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin ja pebiiri la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anumɛl ja men kuruware fi bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: The ruler must come through the entrance room of the east gate and leave the same way.
translation_verse: Kooro la kpɔ doonyoa la ta jo aa, ó berɛ che bela le.

english_verse: When my people come to worship me during any festival, they must always leave by the opposite gate from which they came: Those who come in the north gate must leave by the south gate, and those who come in the south gate must leave by the north gate.
translation_verse: Harɛ la ta nɛra dɛ ba n sie dɛ ba tomɛ tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ la ta naa, nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa la ta jo dɛ ba tom mɛ la, ó ka che o weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa la ta le. Bɛlbwa ɡe waa che weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa ta dɛ́ jo la, ó che o weekaŋle nyundua doonyoa la ta le. Bela bɛlbwa aa che dɛ́ jo la, ó che baŋ bɛl le.

english_verse: Their ruler will come in at the same time they do and leave at the same time they leave.
translation_verse: Kooro la chɛ kɛ ó ja ba nɛɛ jo, ba dɛ le ɡe aa, bá bwa pɛ le.

english_verse: At all other festivals and celebrations, nine kilograms of grain will be offered with a bull, and nine kilograms will be offered with a ram. The worshipers can offer as much grain as they want with each lamb. Three liters of olive oil must be offered with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Tɔpejena dii, ne tɔpera baa lea cheɡ dɛ́ di kwaa dɛɛ lɛ sie ta, mea saraha la chɛ kɛ a ɛ mea kuruware fi dɛ ja nabale ta, men kuruware fi ja pebal ta, ásɛ pebiiri la ɡe ó kpɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anumɛl ja mea kuruware fi bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: If the ruler voluntarily offers a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing, the east gate of the inner courtyard will be opened for him. He will offer his sacrifices just as he does on each Sabbath; then he will leave, and the gate will be closed.
translation_verse: Kooro la dɛ ba ba ɛ saraha aa le o bambile ta, dɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah kɛɛ dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare dɛ kpoa tɛ mɛ naa, bá pili doonyoa o sie aa chaɡɛ wee leebɔr la tɛo ó jo. A chɛ kɛ ó ɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah kɛɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha kwaa la ɡɛ waa dɛ ɛ Ona Tɔpere ta la. Ásɛ dɛ o baa le kaa laa, ba laa ɡbera la tɔ. Tɔpere bɛlbwa saraha

english_verse: Each morning a year-old lamb that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Tɔpere te bɛlbwa chɔɔbɔr, a chɛ kɛ he lawɛ pebie waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii dɛ di benanyoa ba ɛ saraha dɛ́ kpoo, dɛ́ fuuh tɛ men Korowii.

english_verse: Along with it, two kilograms of fine flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice. This law will never change—
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ mea kuruwa beŋkpoŋ ne tama ja a ta chɔɔbɔr bɛlbwa, ásɛ a ɛ mea saraha dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anɛ koo a ta a pweh. Mea saraha kpɔe ba tɛ mɛ chɛ kɛ á chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord God said: If the ruler of Israel gives some of his land to one of his children, it will belong to the ruler's child as part of the family property.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ kooro la pere o harɛ pera tɛ o bibaa bɛl aa, dɛ harɛ la berɛ o bie la ɡe ne o naanar kon. Ó ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon dɛ́ do ba luɡe ta.

english_verse: But if the ruler gives some of his land to one of his servants, the land will belong to the servant until the Year of Celebration, when it will be returned to the ruler. Only the ruler's children can keep what is given to them.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o kpɔ o harɛ la pera tɛ o bonɔɔ bɛl aa, bonɔɔ la kpɔ ka tel benanyoa baa berɛ kwaa dɛɛ tɛ a tena, ásɛ o berɛ kon la tɛ kooro la ó berɛ ɛ o kon, o ne o bii ɡboo dɛ won dɔɔ pi.

english_verse: The man who was showing me the temple then took me back to the inner courtyard. We walked to the south side of the courtyard and stopped at the door to the sacred rooms that belonged to the priests. He showed me more rooms at the western edge of the courtyard
translation_verse: Baa la berɔ kpɔ men Ɛsekeɛl jo deene aa sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ bɛne weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa, bini dembaah la bɔr. A ɛ deene aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ sɔfore la. O baɡ mɛ bobɛl waa lɔ deene aa lɔ wee cholibɔr pera.

english_verse: Around the inside of these smaller courtyards was a low wall of stones, and against the wall were places to build fires.
translation_verse: Dembaahna la bini bɛlbwa, ba kpɔ bwea ma danjwɛɛre bar. Ba berɔ ma bɔra baa mar nii a ta bar a lɔɡa.

english_verse: The man said, “These are the kitchens where the temple workers will boil the meat that worshipers offer as sacrifices.”
translation_verse: Baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔ Korowii Dea tom-ɛɛra la ɛɛ ba saraha kwaa nɛra aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba la daala.”

english_verse: The man took me back to the temple, where I saw a stream flowing from under the entrance. It began in the south part of the temple, where it ran past the altar and continued east through the courtyard.
translation_verse: Baa la berɔ kpɔ men Ɛsekeɛl ba Korowii Dea doonyoa la ta, asɛ n na nee aa pala le doonyoa bela dɛɛ kaa wee leebɔr pera, bela Korowii Dea la sie aa chaɡa la. Dɛ nee la palɔ le Korowii Dea la lɔɡa weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera, dɛɛ kaa saraha kon la weekaŋle harɛbɔr.

english_verse: We walked out of the temple area through the north gate and went around to the east gate. I saw the small stream of water flowing east from the south side of the gate.
translation_verse: Baa la cheɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa, dɛ kpɔ mɛ le ba dahara doonyoa o sie aa chaɡɛ wee leebɔr la ta, dɛ nee la palɔ le weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera baa kaa.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay attention to what you've seen.” We walked to the riverbank,
translation_verse: O bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na waa nɔ kenɛ?” Asɛ dɛ berɛ tɔ n sie dɛ kpɔ mɛ le ba moo la nyoa.

english_verse: where I saw dozens of trees on each side.
translation_verse: Maa tel bela la, n na daa a warɛ kohona che moo la baŋ bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: The man said: This water flows eastward to the Jordan River valley and empties into the Dead Sea, where it turns the salt water into fresh water.
translation_verse: Baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Gɛ moo nɔ palɔ kpɔ wee leebɔr harɛ ta dɛ wili jo Jɔɔdan Felembɔjen ta, dɛ ka jo Yar Mpo ta. O palɔ ka jo mpo la ta naa, mpo nee la dɛ́ do wer.

english_verse: From En-Gedi to Eneglaim, people will fish in the sea and dry their nets along the coast. There will be as many kinds of fish in the Dead Sea as there are in the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ pɛŋa toma ɛɛ ba che o nyoaa, dɛ́ le Ɛn Gedi dɛ́ nyenɛ ba asauri ba Ɛn Eɡlaim. Pɛŋa bwa soo siwii dɛɛ ba o ta doe kɛŋɔ Mɛdetereenea Mpo pɛŋa ken.

english_verse: But the marshes along the shore will remain salty, so that people can use the salt from them.
translation_verse: Kɛ o nyoo aa do kɛ chɛɡbɔra la nee la te aa won do wer, aa chɔɔ bá dɔ yar dɛɛ le a ta.

english_verse: Fruit trees will grow all along this river and produce fresh fruit every month. The leaves will never dry out, because they will always have water from the stream that flows from the temple, and they will be used for healing people. The Borders of the Land
translation_verse: Daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ bwa soo siwi ɛɛ le nee la nyoa baŋ bɛlbwa taa. A papooni aa hola ba, aa nɔnaa ɡel. Korobie bɛlbwa taa aa ba nɔna, dɛkalkɛ nee le Korowii Dea bela palɛ dɛɛ ba bela. A nɔna la ɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa, ásɛ ba kpɔ a papooni ɡe dɛɛ chah weela.” Harɛ la jwɛhre

english_verse: The Lord God said to the people of Israel: When the land is divided among the twelve tribes of Israel, the Joseph tribe will receive two shares. Divide the land equally, because I promised your ancestors that this land would someday belong to their descendants. These are the borders of the land:
translation_verse: Bɔno kɛrɛdɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o kon, dɛkalkɛ n ir nɔn dɛ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ he naawaa n kpɔ harɛ nɔ tɛ. Harɛ nɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean Sea, then continue eastward to Hethlon, to Lebo-Hamath, then across to Zedad,
translation_verse: Kenii harɛ la jwɛh ɛɛ ba doe. O weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh la, le Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta, dɛ́ kpɔ bwɛjen Hɛtlɔn ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ ɡale kaa bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ kaa bwɛjen Hamat, dɛ́ kaa Sedad,

english_verse: Berothah, and Sibraim, which is on the border between the two kingdoms of Damascus and Hamath. The border will end at Hazer-Hatticon, which is on the border of Hauran.
translation_verse: ne bwɛjena Bɛrɔta ne Sibraim aa lɔ bwɛjena Damaskɔs ne Hamat jwɛh ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Hasa Hatikon, o ɡe aa lɔ Hauran jwɛh ta.

english_verse: So the northern border will run between the Mediterranean Sea and Hazar-Enon, which is on the border between Damascus and Hamath.
translation_verse: Jwɛh la ɛɛ le Mɛdetereenea Mpo taa dɛ́ kaa Hasar Enan, dɛ́ kpɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh waa lɔ bwɛjen Damaskɔs, ásɛ jwɛh waa lɔ bwɛjen Hamat la do o weekaŋle nyunduabɔr. Onɔɔ dɛ ɛ weekaŋle nyundua jwɛh la.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin on the border between the two kingdoms of Hauran and Damascus. It will run south along the Jordan River, which separates the territories of Gilead and Israel, and it will end at the Dead Sea near the town of Tamar.
translation_verse: O wee leebɔr jwɛh la ɛɛ chɔɔ le Hauran ne bwɛjen Damaskɔs baah ta, dɛ́ kpɔ Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa, Gelead ne Israel harɛ baah ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Yar Mpo ta, dɛ́ kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Taama. Onɔ ɡee wee leebɔr jwɛh la.

english_verse: The southern border will begin at Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and will end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh la ɛɛ le Taamaa, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le neerare aa lɔ Mɛreba Kades, dɛ́ ka kpɔ fɛlembɔjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Wadi waa lɔ Ijipt harɛ jwɛh, dɛ́ kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta. Weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh laanee la.

english_verse: The western border will run north along the Mediterranean Sea to a point just west of Lebo-Hamath.
translation_verse: O wee cholibɔr jwɛh la, Mɛdetereenea Mpo laanee dɛ́ ɛ jwɛh, dɛ́ kaa bobɛl o ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ kaa bwɛjen Hamat sie aa chaɡɛ dɔŋa. Wee cholibɔr jwɛh laanee la.

english_verse: That is the land to be divided among the tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ he bɔne harɛ nɔ tɛ dɔŋa Israel denaa ta.

english_verse: It will belong to the Israelites and to any foreigners living among them whose children were born in Israel. These foreigners must be treated like any other Israelite citizen, and they will receive
translation_verse: Hé bɔna á ɛ kapɛrɛ tɛ he ne nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe he bini dɛ dɔ bii la. Hé kpɔ ba kɛŋɔ bwɛɛlembii baa lol ba Israel harɛ ta, he ne ba bwaa dɛ́ pɛ dɔ kapɛrɛ Israel harɛ deene bini.

english_verse: a share of the land given to the tribe where they live. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Dea bɛlbwa hɔɔhra aa ba so o ta la, belaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé tɛo o kapɛrɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: South of Judah's territory will be a special section of land. Its length will be twelve and a half kilometers, and its width will run from the eastern border of Israel west to the Mediterranean Sea. My temple will be located in this section of land.
translation_verse: Harɛ o ne Juda dea tena kon aa do jwɛh, dɛ́ le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr la, bá le cheɡ mɛ o korɛ. O paɡri ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, o jaŋne dɛ le o wee leebɔr teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr pera ɡe do kɛŋɔ deene la kwaa baa dɔa la dɔŋa, ásɛ n Dea la che o baah ta.

english_verse: An area in the center of this land will belong to me. It will be twelve and a half kilometers long and ten kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Harɛ la pera waa kora he le cheɡ mɛ la chɛ kɛ o jaŋne ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give half of my sacred land to the priests. Their share will be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide, and my temple will be right in the middle.
translation_verse: Belaa dɛ́ ɛ bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ sɔfore. O weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jaŋne ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, wee cholibɔr paɡri ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue. O wee leebɔr paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue, ásɛ o weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera jaŋne ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue. O baah taa chɛ kɛ n Dea la che.

english_verse: Only priests who are descendants of Zadok will receive a share of this sacred land, because they remained faithful to me when the Levites and the rest of the Israelites started sinning.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɛ sɔfore la konee, Sadɔk naanar baa tom mɛ kasinteŋ ne, ba ta n ŋwɛnɛ ta leɛ, kɛŋɔ Lewi dea tena la bane aa ɛa ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena aa berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ la.

english_verse: The land belonging to the priests will be the most sacred area and will lie south of the area that belongs to the Levites.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ harɛ laanee dɛ́ ɛ ba dibɔr maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba ó korɛ le harɛ la ta. O ɛ harɛ waa do ɡoroŋ kohona dɛ do ba ne Lewi dea tena jwɛh ta.

english_verse: I will give the other half of my sacred land to the Levites. Their share will also be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide,
translation_verse: Sɔfore harɛ jwɛh ta bela la, Lewi dea tena la ɛɛ dɔ harɛ o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanuee, o paɡri ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue.

english_verse: South of my sacred land will be a section twelve and a half kilometers long and three kilometers wide. It will not be sacred, but will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem, together with its houses and pastureland.
translation_verse: Harɛ la kabora o paɡri aa ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa anuanɛ lafraanue, o jaŋne ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue la ɛ nomɛlbwa bɔr harɛ la ta tena aa do deene, ne bela ba kondɛɛra aa dɛɛ di, ásɛ bwɛjen la do baah ta.

english_verse: The city will be a square: Each side will be two kilometers long,
translation_verse: Gɛ bwɛjen la aa dɛ ba doe laanee nɔ. O baŋne anaarɛ la bɛlbwa lɔ naɡale kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.

english_verse: The land on the east and west sides of the city limits will be farmland for the people of Jerusalem; both sections will be five kilometers long and three kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Harɛ waa ka o ne n Dea la jwɛh ta jaŋne chɛ kɛ ó ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue wee leebɔr pera, ásɛ wee cholibɔr ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue. O taa kondikwa ɛɛ ba lee dɛ́ tɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta bwa.

english_verse: People from the city will farm the land, no matter which tribe they belong to.
translation_verse: Israel dea bɛlbwa ta nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la taa dɛɛ ba kooni harɛ la ta para.

english_verse: And so the center of this special section of land will be for my sacred land, as well as for the city and its property. The land will be a square, twelve and a half kilometers on each side.
translation_verse: Harɛ la bwa ɛ fɔɔskwɛɛ. Naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue baŋ bɛlbwa ta. A chɛ kɛ bá le n Dea la harɛ ó korɛ ja bwɛjen la kon ta.

english_verse: The regions east and west of this square of land will belong to the ruler of Israel. His property will run east to the Jordan River and west to the Mediterranean Sea. In the very center of his property will be my sacred land, as well as the temple,
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa waa ka baŋ bɛlbwa ta n Dea la ne bwɛjen la bɔr la ta bwa ɛ kooro la kwa. Le bela dɛ́ kaa wee leebɔr ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, dɛ́ teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr jwɛh ta, naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue dɛ́ kaa wee cholibɔr jwɛh la ta. Gɛ bɔra anɛ nɔ bwa ɛ́ kooro la kwa, ásɛ n Dea la che baah ta.

english_verse: together with the share belonging to the Levites and the city of Jerusalem. The northern border of the ruler's property will be the land that belongs to Judah, and the southern border will be the land that belongs to Benjamin. The Division of Land among Tribes in the South The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Lewi dea tena harɛ ne bwɛjen la harɛ la ɛɛ ba baah ta chɔe, dɛ́ do kooro la kon la baah ta. Bɔr waa ɛ kooro la kon la ɛɛ chɔ jwɛh waa lɔ Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene jwɛh la baah taa.

english_verse: Gad's southern border is also the southern border of Israel. It will begin at the town of Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Gad dea tena harɛ ɛɛ le weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh taa dɛ́ le Taama, dɛ́ ba neerare aa lɔ Mɛreba Kades, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa nenabɔɔ waa lɔ Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta, dɛ́ kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta.

english_verse: That's how the land of Israel will be divided among the twelve tribes. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Gates of Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Gɛɛ harɛ baa dɛ ba bɔna tɛ Israel deene á ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwaa la waa do, ásɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o kon. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Bwɛjen la doonyoo

english_verse: and so the total length of the wall will be ten kilometers. The new name of the city will be “The-Lord-Is-Here!”
translation_verse: Harɛ la bwa jaŋne dɛ bar la ɛɛ ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛɛ. Dɛ le awola dɛ kaa la, baa yerɛ bwɛjen la, ‘korowii lɔ bela.’ ”

english_verse: In the third year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kooro Jehoiakim aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bentooro te ta la, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena la ka chɔ bar bwɛjen Jerusalam dɛ yo bwɛɛ la tena.

english_verse: The Lord let Nebuchadnezzar capture Jehoiakim and take away some of the things used in God's temple. And when the king returned to Babylonia, he put these things in the temple of his own god.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ o pɔ Juda Kooro Jehoiakim nɛ, dɛ pa laala baa kpɔa cheɡ Korowii Dea la ane kaa Babelɔn harɛ ka cheɡ o voɡ dea bini, bela baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.

english_verse: One day the king ordered Ashpenaz, his highest palace official, to choose some young men from the royal family of Judah and from other leading Jewish families.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Nebukadnesa ŋɔ Aspenas waa chɔ o koodem nomonome nyoa be ŋɔ, ó kpɔ Israel koodem bonɔɔna bane baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa Babelɔn, ne banɔ la baa le nomonjena deremi ta ba.

english_verse: The king said, “They must be healthy, handsome, smart, wise, educated, and fit to serve in the royal palace. Teach them how to speak and write our language
translation_verse: Ba bini bonɔɔna baa wola kirihiah dii dɛ do wer, dɛ́ dɔ bambile hweli komɛlbwa waa hweli, dɛ dɔ lem dɛ́ won dɛɛ no waa mun warane, dɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ bá won ɛ toma koodem. Ásɛ Aspenas baɡ ba Babelɔn tena wobol ne o chwera.

english_verse: and give them the same food and wine that I am served. Train them for three years, and then they can become court officials.”
translation_verse: Babelɔn kooro ŋɔ báa tɛɛ ba o kondikwaa ne sen waa dɛ nyɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa la dɔŋa. Dɛ ŋɔ bá baɡ ba waa la bene atoro, ásɛ mɔɔ ba baa ɛ toma koodem bela.

english_verse: Four of the young Jews chosen were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, all from the tribe of Judah.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kaa lee ba le Juda dea tena bini la banee, Daneɛl ne Hanania ne Mesael dɛ Asaria.

english_verse: But the king's chief official gave them Babylonian names: Daniel became Belteshazzar, Hananiah became Shadrach, Mishael became Meshach, and Azariah became Abednego.
translation_verse: Babelɔn koodem nomoa la tɛɛ ba sɔnfala. Daneɛl sɔne Bɛltesasa, Hanania sɔne Sadrak, Mesael sɔne Mesak, asɛ Asaria ɡe sɔne Abɛdnɛɡo.

english_verse: Daniel made up his mind to eat and drink only what God had approved for his people to eat. And he asked the king's chief official for permission not to eat the food and wine served in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Kooro kondikwaa ne sen waa ŋɔa ba kpɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba la, Daneɛl ɛ o liire kɛŋɔ waa ɡɛ kondikwaa la ne sen laanee nyɔ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ o te kah doŋa. Asɛ dɛ soŋe Aspenas waa ɛ koodem nomoa la a wa, dɛ bɛ doŋa kah.

english_verse: God had made the official friendly and kind to Daniel.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ koodem nomoa la na Daneɛl sum dɛ chao,

english_verse: But the man still told him, “The king has decided what you must eat and drink. And I am afraid he will kill me, if you eat something else and end up looking worse than the other young men.”
translation_verse: kɛ Aspenas ŋɔ Daneɛl be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ɔmɛ n dɔɔ kooro waa ŋɔa ń tɛ heyaa kondikwaa ne sen la. A ta chɛ kɛ o ba na he ɡwaŋa dɛ he bala la te bwadabii wer. A ba ɡɛ naa, o ken ɛɛ koh he waa dɛ́ kpo mɛ.”

english_verse: The king's official had put a guard in charge of Daniel and his three friends. So Daniel said to the guard,
translation_verse: Asɛ Daneɛl ŋɔ nɛn koodem nomoa la aa leo ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi o ne Hanania ne Mesael dɛ Asaria nɛɛ la be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “For the next ten days, let us have only vegetables and water at mealtime.
translation_verse: “N poori, tɛ yaa dɔkpɔɡa komɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta, ne nee ɡbo tɔpera fi, dɛ́ kpɔ daah yaa na.

english_verse: When the ten days are up, compare how we look with the other young men, and decide what to do with us.”
translation_verse: Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ yaa maɡɛ yabala baa dɛ di kooro dem kondikwaa la, dɛ́ che a ta na ɡɛ haa ɛ yaa.”

english_verse: Ten days later, Daniel and his friends looked healthier and better than the young men who had been served food from the royal palace.
translation_verse: Tɔpera fi la aa tela la, dɛ Daneɛl ne o bala batoro la dɔ bokpeɡa kohona, ba bwadabii ɡe do wer ɡwaa banɔ la baa dɛ di kooro dem kondikwaa la.

english_verse: God made the four young men smart and wise. They read a lot of books and became well educated. Daniel could also tell the meaning of dreams and visions.
translation_verse: Korowii tɛ ɡɛ bonɔɔna banaarɛ la wejema ne waa mun noe, ba won kure tɔne dɛ jemɛ chwera ɡe kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ Daneɛl berɔ won wepila ne deera bwa soo siwi mun baɡla.

english_verse: At the end of the three-year period set by King Nebuchadnezzar, his chief palace official brought all the young men to him.
translation_verse: Bene atoro kooro la aa doa ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba ba o be la, koodem nomoa Aspenas kpɔ bonɔɔna la bwa la Kooro Nebukadnesa be.

english_verse: The king interviewed them and discovered that none of the others were as outstanding as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they were given positions in the royal court.
translation_verse: Kooro la ne ba bol wa, asɛ o na kɛŋɔ ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛ Daneɛl ne Hanania ne Mesael dɛ Asaria, anomanta, ba kpɔ ba do koodem toma ta.

english_verse: From then on, whenever the king asked for advice, he found their wisdom was ten times better than that of any of his other advisors and magicians.
translation_verse: Le ɡɛ saŋ dɛɛ kaa la, wobɛlbwa kooro la aa dɛ nyin a wejema ne waa mun noe waa la, o dɛ bɔɔ ba, asɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ Daneɛl ne o bala batoro la wejema ɡwaa voɡra ne dobodobo tena baa lɔ o harɛ ta bwa kerafi.

english_verse: Daniel served there until the first year of King Cyrus.
translation_verse: Daneɛl soɡe koodem bela dɛɛ tomɛ, ka tel Pɛɛsea Koojen Saeros aa baa yo Babelɔn harɛ tena dɛ di kora.

english_verse: During the second year that Nebuchadnezzar was king, he had such horrible nightmares that he could not sleep.
translation_verse: Kooro Nebukadnesa aa di kora bennɛɛte ta la, awola bɛl o deero, asɛ o liire chɔɡ o ta wone chɔ.

english_verse: and said, “I am disturbed by a dream that I don't understand, and I want you to explain it.”
translation_verse: o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N liire chɔɡ n deera ane maa deera wa, asɛ mɛɛ nyin a mun dɛ́ jemɛ.”

english_verse: They answered in Aramaic, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever! We are your servants. Please tell us your dream, and we will explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba kpɔ Aram tena wobol chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ saŋ bɛlbwa! Bol he deera la baɡle he bonɔɔna, ásɛ ya baɡle a mun.”

english_verse: But the king replied, “No! I have made up my mind. If you don't tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be chopped to pieces and your houses will be torn down.
translation_verse: Anee Kooro Nebukadnesa ŋɔ wejerema baa jemɛ weweela waa la be ŋɔ, “Waa maa liira laanee kɛŋɔ, dɛ he ta wone na n deera nɔ dɛ baɡ mɛ a mun aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá chɛwɛ he ola, dɛ́ kuuɡi he deremi a berɛ dimɡbeeni.

english_verse: However, if you do tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be greatly rewarded and highly honored. Now tell me the dream and explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he wono baɡ mɛ deera la ne a mun aa, mɛɛ kɛ heyaa kwaa a su he siwi, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa sɔn ɡe taeh. Anomanta, hé baɡ mɛ deera la ne a mun.”

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” they said, “if you will only tell us your dream, we will interpret it for you.”
translation_verse: Ate, ba berɛ chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, baɡle yaa deera la, ásɛ ya ɡe baɡle a mun.”

english_verse: because you know what's going to happen if you don't come up with the answer. You've decided to make up a bunch of lies, hoping I might change my mind. Now tell me the dream, and that will prove that you can interpret it.”
translation_verse: dɛ he ta deera la bolɛ baɡ mɛ naa, deŋnetɛraa dɛ́ chɔ le tɛ heya. He vɔrɔwɔ kɛŋɔ he dɛ ba n be dɛ́ ba teŋe nyosone, dɛ́ neɡre mɛ, ásɛ n charɛ n liire. Hé baɡ mɛ deera la, ásɛ n jemɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ won baɡ mɛ a mun.”

english_verse: His advisors explained, “Your Majesty, you are demanding the impossible! No king, not even the most famous and powerful, has ever ordered his advisors, magicians, or wise men to do such a thing.
translation_verse: Asɛ wejerema baa jemɛ weweela waa la chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, nomɛlbwa toole harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ́ won ɛ waa hen kooro aa bola nɔ. Kooro bɛlbwa waa lɛ sɔn kɛɛ dɛ dɔ kpeɡri ta ɡɛ waa nɔ bɔɔrɛ le dobodobo te, kɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla, kɛɛ wejereme be bwa.

english_verse: It can't be done, except by the gods, and they don't live here on earth.”
translation_verse: Waa kooro aa dɛ bɔɔ la kpeɡri kohona to. Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won pili a bini tɛ kooro nemenɛ voɡa, a ɡɛ voɡa la ɡe toole harɛ nɔ ta.”

english_verse: This made the king so angry that he gave orders for every wise man in Babylonia to be put to death, including Daniel and his three friends. God Tells Nebuchadnezzar's Dream to Daniel
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba ɛ mmara kɛŋɔ bá kpoo wejerema la, asɛ ba tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ka ɡaaɡe Daneɛl ne o bala la bɔr, dɛ́ ba kpoo ba.

english_verse: Arioch was the king's official in charge of putting the wise men to death. He was on his way to have it done, when Daniel very wisely went to him
translation_verse: Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Areɔk, onee chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah kooro la nyoa. Waa laŋa dɛɛ la ka kpoo Babelɔn harɛ ta wejerema la, Daneɛl kpɔ wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ bol wobodɛɛɡa nomoa la be.

english_verse: and asked, “Why did the king give such cruel orders?” After Arioch explained what had happened,
translation_verse: Daneɛl bɔɔ nomoa Areɔk la ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa kooro do mmara kpeɡ nɔ ken?” Asɛ o bol waa la Daneɛl be.

english_verse: Daniel rushed off and said to the king, “If you will just give me some time, I'll explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Ate, Daneɛl den la kooro be dɛ ka soŋo tɔpere, ásɛ o ɛ dɛ ba baɡlo deera la mun.

english_verse: Then he said, “Pray that the God who rules from heaven will be merciful and explain this mystery, so that we and the others won't be put to death.”
translation_verse: Daneɛl ŋɔ bá soŋe Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ó na ba sum waa aa do ɔma nɔ ta, ásɛ ba bɛ o ne o daamanar la bwa pɛ kpoo ja Babelɔn harɛ ta wejerema baa kaa la nɛ.

english_verse: In a vision one night, Daniel was shown the dream and its meaning. Then he praised the God who rules from heaven:
translation_verse: Awola jwaana la, Korowii pili waa la bini baɡle Daneɛl. Asɛ o kpɛɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua.

english_verse: “Our God, your name will be praised forever and forever. You are all-powerful, and you know everything.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, onee dɔ wejema ne kpeɡri.

english_verse: You control human events— you give rulers their power and take it away, and you are the source of wisdom and knowledge.
translation_verse: Onee dɛɛ beɡre tɔpera ne saŋ, onee dɛɛ chiɡ nɛn kora ta, dɛ́ berɛ iru kora ta. Onee dɛɛ tɛ wejerema wejema, dɛɛ tɛ lem ne waa mun noe.

english_verse: You are the God who was worshiped by my ancestors. Now I thank you and praise you for making me wise and telling me the king's dream, together with its meaning.” Daniel Interprets the Dream
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii ya naawa aa tomɛ, n dɛ jaame dɛɛ kpɛɛre. He tɛ mɛ wejema ne kpeɡri, dɛ pili waa yaa soŋe bini baɡ mɛ, he ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kooro deera.” Daneɛl deera mun baɡla

english_verse: Daniel went back to Arioch, the official in charge of executing the wise men. Daniel said, “Don't kill those men! Take me to the king, and I will explain the meaning of his dream.”
translation_verse: Ate, Daneɛl la Areɔk Kooro Nebukadnesa aa leo ŋɔ ó kpoo Babelɔn harɛ ta wejerema la be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Bɛ Babelɔn harɛ wejerema la kpoo. Kɛ kpɔ mɛ la kooro be, ásɛ n ka baɡlo o deera la mun.”

english_verse: Arioch rushed Daniel to the king and announced, “Your Majesty, I have found out that one of the men brought here from Judah can explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Ate, Areɔk den ɛ warane kpɔ Daneɛl la kooro la be dɛ ŋɔ, “N na nɛra yaa kaa laɡ ba laa ta le Juda harɛ ta la bɛl ó won baɡle hen kooro deera la mun.”

english_verse: The king asked Daniel, “Can you tell me my dream and what it means?”
translation_verse: Belaa kooro bɔɔ Daneɛl baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Bɛltesasa ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ won jemɛ n deera la dɛ́ baɡ mɛ a mun aa?”
