english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, not even the smartest person in all the world can do what you are demanding.
translation_verse: Anee Daneɛl chaŋe ŋɔ, “Wejereme kɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla kɛɛ dobodobo te kɛɛ voɡre bɛlbwa aa won baɡle a mun.

english_verse: But the God who rules from heaven can explain mysteries. And while you were sleeping, he showed you what will happen in the future.
translation_verse: N naa kooro, haa chɔa la, dɛ he liire dawɛ waane aa dɛ ba bala kerekere ta, asɛ Korowii waa won waa aa sɔah bini pila la ɡel he na waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa.

english_verse: However, you must realize that these mysteries weren't explained to me because I am smarter than everyone else. Instead, it was done so that you would understand what you have seen.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ɡela n won baɡle waa aa do ken dɛ sɔh nɔ mun, n ɡbaɡba wejema aa ɡwaa nomɛlbwa ta laa a che, kɛ ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ hen n naa kooro, he jemɛ waa haa naa he deera bini la, ń baɡle a mun tɛɛ.

english_verse: Your Majesty, what you saw standing in front of you was a huge and terrifying statue, shining brightly.
translation_verse: N naa kooro, kon haa nao he deera la ta laanee komɛl baa mao kɛŋɔ nɛn o do kan dɛ do ɔma kohona, dɛɛ nyɛɡle al-al ken.

english_verse: Its head was made of gold, its chest and arms were silver, and from its waist down to its knees, it was bronze.
translation_verse: Kon la nyu ɛ suuɡaswɛm tenten, o bambile ne o nɔɔra ɛ suuɡapoŋ, asɛ o tea ne o hwie ɛ ayaawa,

english_verse: From there to its ankles it was iron, and its feet were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: o nakpale ɛ buni, asɛ o napaala pera ɛ buni, o pera ɛ choh.

english_verse: As you watched, a stone was cut from a mountain—but not by human hands. The stone struck the feet, completely shattering the iron and clay.
translation_verse: Haa dɛ nyiŋu la, bwekuŋi bɛl waa wola nɛn nɔn ta leɛ kuu, dɛ ba lɔ kon baa mao kɛŋɔ nɛn la napaala aa ɛ buni ne choh la, dɛ kuuɡa burbur ken.

english_verse: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were crushed and blown away without a trace, like husks of wheat at threshing time. But the stone became a tremendous mountain that covered the entire earth.
translation_verse: Belaa buni la, ne choh, ne ayaawa, ne suuɡapoŋ, dɛ suuɡaswɛm la bwa den kuuɡi buɡ la ta, dɛ do kɛŋɔ baa lɔ kwaa pɛla ta lɔmɔɡa saŋ a pɛɡa chɔ la ken. Asɛ peu ta dɛ kpɔa kaa, bɛlbwa ta kae. Kɛ bwekuŋi waa baa lɔ kon waa do kɛ nɛn la, baa ɛ bwejen tenten dɛ tɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa.”

english_verse: That was the dream, and now I'll tell you what it means.
translation_verse: Daneɛl ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he deera haa deera laanee la. Namee mɛɛ ba ń baɡle a mun.

english_verse: Your Majesty, you are the greatest of kings, and God has highly honored you with power
translation_verse: N naa kooro, he ɛ koranar bwa kooro. Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ɛɛ koojen dɛ ɡel he do kan, dɛ tɛɛ kpeɡri ne jirima.

english_verse: After you are gone, another kingdom will rule, but it won't be as strong. Then it will be followed by a kingdom of bronze that will rule the whole world.
translation_verse: He kora la habɔɔ, kora bɛl ɡe ɛɛ bao dɛ́ che tɛ suuɡapoŋ la, kɛ waa hen tel. Ásɛ toorote ɡe ba, dɛ́ che tɛ ayaawa la. Onee dɛ́ ba di kora harɛ nɔ bwa ta.

english_verse: This fourth kingdom will be divided—it will be both strong and brittle, just as you saw that the feet and toes were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: Gɛ o nanie pera aa ɛ buni o pera ɛ choh la, ɡɛɛ kora la pera ɛɛ ba kpeɡri doe, ásɛ o pera ɡe do pwɛre.

english_verse: This kingdom will be the result of a marriage between kingdoms, but it will crumble, just as iron and clay don't stick together.

english_verse: During the time of those kings, the God who rules from heaven will set up an eternal kingdom that will never fall. translation_verse: Waa nyundua torome la aa ŋɔa aa chiɡ Kooro Nebukadnesa nɛɛ la ɛ kpela. A chiɡ o nɛɛ buɡ la ta, asɛ ba doŋu le nɛra bini, asɛ o chwe kpɔɡa kɛŋɔ nao ken. Mɛn ta o nɛ, o nyumpona do kɛŋɔ kee kena ken, o nonie ɡe kpeɡ kɛŋɔ jumbie nanie ken.

english_verse: Finally, I prayed to God in heaven, and my mind was healed. Then I said: “I praise and honor God Most High. God lives forever, and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: Kooro Nebukadnesa ŋɔ, “Bene anuanɛ la aa baa kaa la, n ha sie nyiŋi nyundua, ate dɛ n sie chole harɛ, asɛ n kpɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii, dɛ kpɛɛro dɛ tɛo jirima kɛŋɔ onee lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Wɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la, o kora ɛɛ cheo saŋ te bɛlbwa.

english_verse: To him the nations are far less than nothing; God controls the stars in the sky and everyone on this earth. When God does something, we cannot change it or even ask why.”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta waa ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ o be. Gɛ waa dɛ nyin laanee wɛɛ ɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ nɛra nɛ. Nomɛlbwa aa won tɔŋlo kɛɛ dɛ́ bɔɔro waa waa ɛa.

english_verse: At that time my mind was healed, and once again I became the ruler of my glorious kingdom. My advisors and officials returned to me, and I had greater power than ever before.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ n sie aa chole harɛ la. Korowii berɔ tɛ mɛ duure ne jirima n kora kan waa doa la wa. Nɛra baa dɛ ja mɛ ne n nomonome nyin n bɔr, dɛ berɛ kpɔ mɛ cheɡ kora ta, asɛ n berɛ dɔ kpeɡri waa ɡwaa wubwa kon la.

english_verse: That's why I say: “Praise and honor the King who rules from heaven! Everything he does is honest and fair, and he can shatter the power of those who are proud.”
translation_verse: Name, men Kooro Nebukadnesa, n dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii waa dɛ di kora nyundua, dɛɛ tɛo sɔn ne jirima dɛkalkɛŋɔ, o waa toɡrɔ o wobɛlbwa ɡe do wer. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɡɔɔ o te la, o won naate ne harɛ bala.”

english_verse: One evening, King Belshazzar gave a great banquet for a thousand of his highest officials, and he drank wine with them.
translation_verse: Awola jwaana bɛl, Kooro Bɛlsasa ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikonjena, o ta nɔn yerɛ o nomonjena nɛra kaɡboŋ, asɛ o ne baa di kwaa la dɛɛ nyɔ sen.

english_verse: He got drunk and ordered his servants to bring in the gold and silver cups his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem. Belshazzar wanted the cups, so that he and all his wives and officials could drink from them.
translation_verse: Ba ta aa dɛ nyɔ sen la, Kooro Bɛlsasa tomɛ o bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa numoli o mɛɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa fa aa paa le Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la ba, ásɛ o ne o nomonjena ne o haahna dɛ o sɛnanar kpɔ nyɔ sen.

english_verse: When the gold cups were brought in, everyone at the banquet drank from them and praised their idols made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.
translation_verse: Baa dɛ nyɔ sen la, dɛ ba dɛ kpɛɛ voɡa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm, ne suuɡapoŋa, ne bune, ne ayaawa, ne daa dɛ bwea ɛa la.

english_verse: Suddenly a human hand was seen writing on the plaster wall of the palace. The hand was just behind the lampstand, and the king could see it writing.
translation_verse: Buɡ la ta, dɛ nɛn nɔn ba dɛ chwerɛ koodem danjwɛɛ baa maalo ta, dɛ kandea cheɡɛ bela dɛɛ chaah. Asɛ Kooro Bɛlsasa ɛɛ nyiŋi ɡɛ nɔn la aa doa dɛɛ chwerɛ la.

english_verse: He was so frightened that his face turned pale, his knees started shaking, and his legs became weak.
translation_verse: O siebɔr ɡwaŋɔ, o liire chɔɡ, asɛ ɔmee lawɔ kohona o natuune ɛɛ sa dɛɛ lɔ dɔŋa.

english_verse: The king called in his advisors, who claimed they could talk with the spirits of the dead and understand the meanings found in the stars. He told them, “The man who can read this writing and tell me what it means will become the third most powerful man in my kingdom. He will wear robes of royal purple and a gold chain around his neck.”
translation_verse: Ate, kooro kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla, ne wejerema baa jemɛ weweela wa dɛ voɡra, ŋɔ bá ba. Baa bala la, Kooro la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ bɛlbwa wono kure kwaa baa chwera nɔ, dɛ baɡ mɛ a mun aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá tɔɔ yakɔl, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm jɔɡrɔre do o baŋa, ásɛ n habɔɔ ó ɛ nɛn waa teŋa tooro, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri kohona n kora harɛ nɔ ta.”

english_verse: All of King Belshazzar's highest officials came in, but not one of them could read the writing or tell what it meant,
translation_verse: Ate, kooro wejerema la bwa laŋɔ, kɛ ba ta wone kure kwaa baa chwera la, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa wonoo baɡle a mun.

english_verse: and they were completely puzzled. Now the king was more afraid than ever before, and his face turned white as a ghost.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɔmee kohona lawɛ Kooro Bɛlsasa, o siebɔr ɡe foo kohona. O nomonjena liire chɔɡɔ, ba ta ɡɛ baa ɛ nae.

english_verse: When the queen heard the king and his officials talking, she came in and said: Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! Don't be afraid or look so pale.
translation_verse: Kooro nya aa no kooro ne o nomonjena ɡbɔɡa la, asɛ o ir la dea baa di kondikonjena o ta la, dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Korowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ saŋ bɛlbwa! Bɛ ɡel a hae ásɛ he siebɔr foo ɡɛ!

english_verse: In your kingdom there is a man who has been given special powers by the holy gods. When your father Nebuchadnezzar was king, this man was known to be as smart, intelligent, and wise as the gods themselves. Your father put him in charge of all who claimed they could talk with the spirits or understand the meanings in the stars or tell about the future.
translation_verse: Baa bɛl lɔ he harɛ nɔ ta voɡa aa wola nɛwɛnyina ɛɛ tɛo kpeɡri ane. He mɛɛ kora dii saŋ la, o nao kɛŋɔ o ɛ wejereme, dɛ jemɛ waa kɛŋɔ voɡa ken. He mɛɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa ɡbaɡba kpɔɔ ɛ dobodobo tena, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla, ne wejerema baa jemɛ weweela waa dɛ voɡra bwa nomoa.

english_verse: He also changed the man's name from Daniel to Belteshazzar. Not only is he wise and intelligent, but he can explain dreams and riddles and solve difficult problems. Send for Daniel, and he will tell you what the writing means.
translation_verse: Gɛ baa la sɔne Daneɛl, dɛ he mɛɛ dɛ yerɔ Bɛltesasa. He mɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ o liire wer o dɔ wejema dɛɛ no waa mun, dɛ won deera mun baɡla. O won waa aa kpeɡa ne sɛɡla ɡe bwa mun baɡla. Gel ba la ka yerɛ Daneɛl, ásɛ o ba baɡle a mun.”

english_verse: When Daniel was brought in, the king said: So you are Daniel, one of the captives my father brought back from Judah!
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba laŋɔ ka kpɔ Daneɛl ba kooro sie, asɛ o pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Henee Daneɛl, haa ja nɛra n mɛɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa aa laɡ ba le Juda harɛ ta dɛ ba Babelɔn nɛɛ la aa?

english_verse: I was told that the gods have given you special powers and that you are intelligent and very wise.
translation_verse: N noɔ kɛŋɔ voɡa aa wola nɛwɛnyina ɛɛ tɛɛ kpeɡri ane, he dɔ wejema dɛ dɔ liire ɡa.

english_verse: Neither my advisors nor the men who talk with the spirits of the dead could read this writing or tell me what it means.
translation_verse: Ba ba nɛra baa dɔ wejema ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla ne n be ŋɔ, bá kure kwaa baa chwera dawɛ bonɔ nɔ, dɛ́ baɡ mɛ a mun, kɛ ba ta wone baɡle a mun.

english_verse: But I have been told that you understand everything and that you can solve difficult problems. Now then, if you can read this writing and tell me what it means, you will become the third most powerful man in my kingdom. You will wear royal purple robes and have a gold chain around your neck.
translation_verse: Taraken, n noɔ kɛŋɔ he won waa mun baɡla, waa a mun noe aa kpeɡa ɡe la, he won a mun baɡla. Dɛ he wono kure kwaa baa chwera nɔ dɛ baɡ mɛ a mun aa, mɛɛ tɔe yakɔlee, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm jɔɡrɔre do he baŋa, ásɛ n habɔɔ henee dɛ́ teŋɛ tooro, dɛ́ dɔ kpeɡri n kora ta harɛ nɔ ta.”

english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, I will read the writing and tell you what it means. But you may keep your gifts or give them to someone else.
translation_verse: Anee Daneɛl chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ɡel koŋkɛɛla la do he be, kɛɛ kpɔ tɛ nomɛl. Ane a bwa, mɛɛ kure kwaa baa chwera dawɛ nɔɔ tɛɛ, dɛ́ baɡle a mun.

english_verse: Sir, the Most High God made your father a great and powerful man and brought him much honor and glory.
translation_verse: N naa kooro, Nemenɛ Korowii ɛ he mɛɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa koojen, dɛ tɛo jirima ne nyanyini dɛ kpeɡri kohona.

english_verse: God did such great things for him that people of all nations and races shook with fear. Your father had the power of life or death over everyone, and he could honor or ruin anyone he chose.
translation_verse: Kpeɡri waa tɛo nomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa ne harɛre ta nɛra ne wobol bɛlbwa tena dɛ ɔmɔ dɛɛ chel. Nɛra waa dɛ nyin ba kpoora la, o kpoo ba. Banɔ la waa wola ba kpoora nyin la, o ɡel ba. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o ɡɔɔ o sɔn la, o dɛ ɛo ɡɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o ba o ne harɛ ɡe la, o dɛ ɛo ɡɛ.

english_verse: But when he became proud and stubborn, his glorious kingdom was taken from him.
translation_verse: Kɛ waa baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ o nyu bini do kpeɡri wɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la, Korowii iru kora ta, jirima waa dɔa la paŋɔ.

english_verse: His mind became like that of an animal, and he was forced to stay away from people and live with wild donkeys. Your father ate grass like an ox, and he slept outside where his body was soaked with dew. He was forced to do this until he learned that the Most High God rules all kingdoms on earth and chooses their kings.
translation_verse: Korowii doŋu le nɛra bini asɛ o liire do kɛŋɔ ol liire ken. O ne kpɔɡ bini keeɡore kaa so, wɛɛ chwe kpɔɡa kɛŋɔ nao ken. Mɛn ta o nɛɛ o bwara pweh, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa na kɛŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɔ kora nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ di la kpeɡri, dɛɛ kpɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: King Belshazzar, you knew all of this, but you still refused to honor the Lord who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen, n naa Kooro Bɛlsasa, haa ɛ n naa Kooro Nebukadnesa bibaa la, he jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, kɛ he ta he te pwɛrɛ.

english_verse: Instead, you turned against him and ordered the cups from his temple to be brought here, so that you and your wives and officials could drink wine from them. You praised idols made of silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone, even though they cannot see or hear or think. You refused to worship the God who gives you breath and controls everything you do.
translation_verse: He ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Korowii waa dɛ di kora nyundua nɛ, dɛ ka kpɔ numoli aa lɔ o Dea he ne he nomonjena, ne he haahna dɛ he sɛnanar kpɔ nyɔ sen. He kpɛɛ voɡa baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa, ne suuɡaswɛm, ne ayaawa, ne bune, ne daa dɛ bwea ɛa aa wola na, aa wola waa no kɛɛ dɛɛ no waa mun la. Kɛ Korowii he mkpa ne he wobɛlbwa aa lɔ o nɔn ta la te, he ta duure kpɔe tɛo.

english_verse: That's why he sent the hand to write this message on the wall.
translation_verse: A waa Korowii ɡel nɔn la ba chwerɛ danjwɛɛ la ta la.

english_verse: Belshazzar gave a command for Daniel to be made the third most powerful man in his kingdom and to be given a purple robe and a gold chain.
translation_verse: Ate, buɡ la ta, Kooro Bɛlsasa ɡel ba ka kpɔ yakɔl ba tɔ Daneɛl, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm jɔɡrɔre do o baŋa, asɛ dɛ ɛo nɛntoorote waa dɔ kpeɡri o kora ta harɛ la ta.

english_verse: That same night, the king was killed.
translation_verse: Awola jwaana la tentenee ba kpo Babelɔn Kooro Bɛlsasa,

english_verse: In order to make sure that his government was run properly, Darius put three other officials in charge of the governors. One of these officials was Daniel.
translation_verse: o le nomonjena batoro ɡe ba chɔ ba nyoa, dɛ́ nyiŋi na kɛŋɔ nomonome la dɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa aŋwɛnɛ ta, ásɛ wobɛlbwa won kaa ɡɛ kooro aa dɛ nyin. Daneɛl ne nɛra banɛ banee o le.

english_verse: The other men tried to find something wrong with the way Daniel did his work for the king. But they could not accuse him of anything wrong, because he was honest and faithful and did everything he was supposed to do.
translation_verse: Anee o bala nomonjena la ne nomonome baa lee ba baa nyiŋi harɛ la bamperi la, ɛɛ nyin Daneɛl bwara wechɔɡa dɛ́ le kora la be pera, kɛ ba ta wone. Ba ta o bwara wechɔɡe bɛlbwa nae, dɛkalkɛ o waa wer dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: Finally, they said to one another, “We will never be able to bring any charge against Daniel, unless it has to do with his religion.”
translation_verse: Anee nomonome ne nomonjena la ŋɔ, “Yaa Daneɛl nɔ wechɔɡe bɛlbwaa dɔ, atane Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la waa ta.”

english_verse: They all went to the king and said: “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Ate, ba bwa la Kooro Dareɔs be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la!

english_verse: Order this to be written and then sign it, so it cannot be changed, just as no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed.”
translation_verse: N naa kooro, do ɡɛ mmara la dɛ́ ɡel ba chwerɔ, ásɛ he kpɔ nɔn ɛɡɛ o ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won berɔ ɡɛ baa wola won Midia ne Pɛɛsea tena mmara berɛ la.”

english_verse: So King Darius made the law and had it written down.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Kooro Dareɔs ɡelɔ ba chwerɛ mmara la.

english_verse: Daniel heard about the law, but when he returned home, he went upstairs and prayed in front of the window that faced Jerusalem. In the same way that he had always done, he knelt down in prayer three times a day, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Daneɛl aa noa kɛ ba chwerɛ mmara la la, o la dem dɛ teeh kaa o abrɔsane doa dea bini. Dɛ dea la tokorore pilo dɛ chaɡɛ Jerusalam. O dɛ ɡuŋi dɛɛ soŋe Korowii keraatoro tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ kpɛɛro. Dɛ ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ɛ wubwa.

english_verse: The men who had spoken to the king watched Daniel and saw him praying to his God for help.
translation_verse: Belaa nɛra baa la kooro be o do mmara la pɛ, dɛ la ka na kɛŋɔ Daneɛl ɡuŋo dɛɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ ó chao.

english_verse: The men then told the king, “That Jew named Daniel, who was brought here as a captive, refuses to obey you or the law that you ordered to be written. And he still prays to his god three times a day.”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl waa ja nɛra baa laɡ ba le Juda harɛ bojaŋ ba la aa hen duu, waa mmara haa doa la ɡe ta teŋɛ. O ta dɛ soŋe Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa keraatoro.”

english_verse: The king was really upset to hear about this, and for the rest of the day he tried to think how he could save Daniel.
translation_verse: Kooro la aa no ɡɛ la, a we o nɛɛ kohona. Dɛ o siwi beɡrɔ wɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ waa che o ta dɛ́ lɛ Daneɛl ta. O lii a waa ka tel kɛŋɔ wee aa joa.

english_verse: At sunset the men returned and said, “Your Majesty, remember that no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed, not even by the king.”
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra la berɛ pɛ dɛ la kooro be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, lii kɛŋɔ Midia ne Pɛɛsea tena mmara bini la, dɛ kooro do mmara aa, baa won on berɛ.”

english_verse: So Darius ordered Daniel to be brought out and thrown into a pit of lions. But he said to Daniel, “You have been faithful to your God, and I pray that he will rescue you.”
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Dareɔs ɡel ba lawɛ Daneɛl ba, dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta nyujentena be a bɔɔ bini. Kooro la ŋɔ Daneɛl be ŋɔ, “Kórowii haa dɛ tomɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa la lɛɛ.”

english_verse: A stone was rolled over the pit, and it was sealed. Then Darius and his officials stamped the seal to show that no one should let Daniel out.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ bwe bɛl ba tɔ bɔɔ la nyoa, asɛ kooro la kpɔ o noniseɡ ne o nomonjena la noniseɡa ka pɛl bwe la ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won ka lɛ Daneɛl ta.

english_verse: All night long the king could not sleep. He did not eat anything, and he would not let anyone come in to entertain him.
translation_verse: Kooro la berɔ kaa o dem, o ta wone di kondikwaa jwaana la bwa, o sie ta lɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ silɛɛ waane bɛlbwa o dem ɡe. O ta wone chɔ dom.

english_verse: At daybreak the king got up and ran to the pit.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, kooro la iro dɛ ɛ warane la nyujentena bɔɔ la ta.

english_verse: He was anxious and shouted, “Daniel, you were faithful and served your God. Was he able to save you from the lions?”
translation_verse: Waa dɛ bɛne bɔɔ la la, o bambile chɔɡɔ o kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ yerɛ Daneɛl ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la bonɔɔ, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ kasinteŋ ne tɔpere bɛlbwa la wono ba lɛɛ le nyujentena la be naa?”

english_verse: Daniel answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Anee Daneɛl ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: My God knew that I was innocent, and he sent an angel to keep the lions from eating me. Your Majesty, I have never done anything to hurt you.”
translation_verse: Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la ɡelɔ o torome ba dɛ ba tɔ nyujentena la nyoo. A ta wone do mɛ bol, dɛkalkɛ Korowii nao kɛŋɔ n di bole, asɛ hen n naa kooro ɡe, n ta hen wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ.”

english_verse: The king was relieved to hear Daniel's voice, and he gave orders for him to be taken out of the pit. Daniel's faith in his God had kept him from being harmed.
translation_verse: Kooro sie lɛo kohona, o ŋɔ bá ka lawɛ Daneɛl le bɔɔ la bini. Asɛ ba la ka lawɔ le bɔɔ la bini, dɛ komɛlbwa ta o bobɛlbwa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ o yarada Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: And the king ordered the men who had brought charges against Daniel to be thrown into the pit, together with their wives and children. But before they even reached the bottom, the lions ripped them to pieces.
translation_verse: Ate, Kooro Dareɔs ɡel ba ka kpɔ nɛra baa haŋɛ Daneɛl nyoa la ba tɛo, asɛ o ɡel ba kpɔ ba ne ba haahna, ne bii bwa ka do nyujentena bɔɔ la bini. Baa wola bɔɔ la mun ta tele mɔɔ kwara la, dɛ nyujentena la toɡri ba bini, dɛ paɡre ba hoɡa bwa.

english_verse: King Darius then sent this message to all people of every nation and race in the world: “Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Asɛ Kooro Dareɔs chwerɛ tɔne ka tɛ wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛre ne o harɛ ta bwa. O ŋɔ, “N dɛ na he bwa!

english_verse: I command everyone in my kingdom to worship and honor the God of Daniel. He is the living God, the one who lives forever. His power and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: N do mmara harɛ maa dɛ di kora o ta la kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa ɛɛ ɔmɛ dɛɛ duu Korowii Daneɛl aa dɛ tomɔ la. O ɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, o lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. O kora aa ɡu bwa, o kpeɡri waa dɔa ta jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: He rescues people and sets them free by working great miracles. Daniel's God has rescued him from the power of the lions.”
translation_verse: Onee dɛɛ lɛ nɛn dɛ ɡel o dɔ o nyu dɛɛ di, dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowa, o we-ɛɛla ɡe do kan nyundua ne harɛ bwa. Onee lɛ Daneɛl nyujentena nɔn ta aa wola on kpoe.”

english_verse: All went well for Daniel while Darius was king, and even when Cyrus the Persian ruled.
translation_verse: Daneɛl wobɛlbwa wer tɛo ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Dareɔs aa soɡe kora ta, ne ɡɛ saŋ Pɛɛsea Kooro Saeros aa di kora.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the first year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had some dreams and visions while I was asleep one night, and I wrote them down. The four winds were stirring up the mighty sea,
translation_verse: N deera la ta la, n nao kɛŋɔ peu bele anaarɛ tao le baŋ bɛlbwa kpɔ nyundua dɛ baa ta mpo ta.

english_verse: when suddenly four powerful beasts came out of the sea. Each beast was different.
translation_verse: Asɛ mpo bini oljena anaarɛ ɛɡɛ le mpo la ta, bɛlbwa korɛ o dɔŋ ta.

english_verse: The first was like a lion with the wings of an eagle. As I watched, its wings were pulled off. Then it was lifted to an upright position and made to stand on two feet, just like a human, and it was given a human mind.
translation_verse: “Oljen waa tɔ sie la do kɛŋɔ nyujente, dɛ dɔ kena kɛŋɔ kee ken. Maa nyiŋa na la, ba tu o kena la le o nɛɛ dɛ lawɔ ir, o che o nakpale anɛ ta kɛŋɔ nɛn ken, asɛ o dɔ nɛn liire ɡe.

english_verse: The second beast looked like a bear standing on its hind legs. It held three ribs in its teeth, and it was told, “Attack! Eat all the flesh you want.”
translation_verse: N berɔ na oljen nɛɛte o do kɛŋɔ sisire ken. O iro joŋi o habɔɔ nakpale anɛ ta, dɛ kuɡlambii atoro lɔ o nyoa o kpɔ nyena nyɛwa. Asɛ taa bɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Ir ka chwe ola ɡɛ bwa haa won.’

english_verse: The third beast was like a leopard—except that it had four wings and four heads. It was given authority to rule.
translation_verse: Onɔ habɔɔ, n berɔ na oljen bɛl ɡe o do kɛŋɔ noniete, kena anaarɛ lɔ o nyaŋ ta kɛŋɔ jumbie ken. Gɛ oljen nɔ dɔ nyuune anaarɛ, ba tɛo kora dii kpeɡri.

english_verse: The fourth beast was stronger and more terrifying than the others. Its huge teeth were made of iron, and what it didn't grind with its teeth, it smashed with its feet. It was different from the others, and it had horns on its head—ten of them.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, n na oljen waa teŋa naarɛ. O ɔma o waa dɔ nyokpoa o do kpeɡri ɡe kohona. O nyena ɛ bune dɛ do kan, komɛlbwa waa lawɛ la, o dɛ di o ola, dɛ́ tiɡri o kabora do harɛ. O korɛ oljena la bwa bini, dɛ dɔ nyeɡlare fi.

english_verse: Just as I was thinking about these horns, a smaller horn appeared, and three of the other horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had the eyes of a human and a mouth that spoke with great arrogance. Judgment Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Maa dɛ nyiŋi nyeɡlare la la, nyeɡlejeɡaa bɛl berɔ ba le pa a baah ta, asɛ wubwa kwaa atoro la tu le onjeɡa la sie. Nyeɡlejeɡa la dɔ sibie kɛŋɔ nɛn ken, o dɔ nyoa dɛɛ bol mbarafo wobol.

english_verse: Thrones were set up while I was watching, and the Eternal God took his place. His clothing and his hair were white as snow. His throne was a blazing fire with fiery wheels,
translation_verse: Men Daneɛl berɔ na kɛŋɔ kookane aa baa che, asɛ Nɛn Waa Lole Saŋ La Bwa ba so kane la bɛl ta. O tɔ yal o to kɛŋɔ yabi, asɛ o nyumpona to kpelkpel kɛŋɔ pee pona. Ninlao ɡboo o kookara la, asɛ kara la nakpale do kɛŋɔ saaker nakpale dɛɛ hɔ.

english_verse: and flames were dashing out from all around him. Countless thousands were standing there to serve him. The time of judgment began, and the books were opened.
translation_verse: Asɛ nii do kɛŋɔ moo dɛɛ palɛ o sie. Nɛra kaɡboŋa bele kaɡboŋa ɛɛ tomɔ, nɛra kaɡboŋa fi bele kaɡboŋa fi ɡe che o sie. Saŋ telo kɛŋɔ nɛra so dɛ bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole, asɛ ba pili tɔne.

english_verse: I watched closely to see what would happen to this smaller horn because of the arrogant things it was saying. Then before my very eyes, the fourth beast was killed and its body destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: N ta aa dɛ nyiŋi la, dɛ nyeɡlejeɡa la dɛ bol mbarafo wobol. N nyiŋo ka tel kɛŋɔ baa kpo oljen waa teŋa naarɛ la, dɛ chɔɡ o ol, dɛ ɡɔɔ ta nii aa dɛ hɔ la ta.

english_verse: The other three beasts had their authority taken from them, but they were allowed to live a while longer.
translation_verse: Oljena aa kaa la, ba lɛ a kpeɡri a be, dɛ tɛa ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ á do le ka tel saŋ bɛl tama.

english_verse: As I continued to watch the vision that night, I saw what looked like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven, and he was presented to the Eternal God.
translation_verse: Wepila la ta jwaana la ne la, n na nomɛl kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bie ken, o le nyundua baama bini dɛɛ ba. O baa tel Nɛn Waa Lole Saŋ La Bwa la jwɛh, asɛ dɛ ba che o sie.

english_verse: He was crowned king and given power and glory, so that all people of every nation and race would serve him. He will rule forever, and his kingdom is eternal, never to be destroyed. The Meaning of Daniel's Vision
translation_verse: Nɛn Waa Lole Saŋ La Bwa la tɛ nɛwɛnyini bie la kpeɡri, ne jirima dɛ kora dii, asɛ harɛre ne nɛra bwa soo siwi, dɛ wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra ɛɛ tomɔ. Wɛɛ di kpeɡrii saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la, o kora aa ɡu bwa. Deera la mun baɡla

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was terrified by these visions, and I didn't know what to think.
translation_verse: Wepila men Daneɛl aa naa la ha mɛ taeh, doma ne liire bini bwa.

english_verse: “The four beasts are four earthly kingdoms.
translation_verse: ‘Oljena anaarɛ la cheɡɔ tɛ koojena anaarɛ aa dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta bala.

english_verse: But God Most High will give his kingdom to his chosen ones, and it will be theirs forever and ever.”
translation_verse: A bwa habɔɔ la, Nemenɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra laanee wɛɛ ba kora la kpɔe tɛ, ó ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’

english_verse: I wanted to know more about the fourth beast, because it was so different and much more terrifying than the others. What was the meaning of its iron teeth and bronze claws and of its feet that smashed what the teeth and claws had not ground and crushed?
translation_verse: Asɛ n berɛ dɛɛ nyin ń jemɛ oljen waa teŋa naarɛ, o waa korɛ o bala bini dɛ do ɔma kohona, o nyena ɛ bune o nanie ɛ ayaawa la. O lawɛ komɛlbwa naa, o dɛ chweo dɛ diu, dɛ tiɡri o kabora do harɛ la mun.

english_verse: I also wanted to know more about all ten of those horns on its head. I especially wanted to know more about the one that took the place of three of the others—the horn that had eyes and spoke with arrogance and seemed greater than the others.
translation_verse: N berɔ dɛɛ nyin ń jemɛ nyeɡlare fi aa paaɡe o nyu ta, ne nyeɡle bɛl o ɡe aa lea pa asɛ nyeɡlare atoro tu la mun. O dɔ sibie ne nyoa dɛɛ bol mbarafo wobol. A ɡɛ nyeɡle laanee do ɔma ɡwaa o bala bwa la.

english_verse: While I was looking, this horn attacked God's chosen ones and was winning the battle.
translation_verse: N ta aa dɛ nyiŋi la, n nao kɛŋɔ ɡɛ nyeɡle la yo Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra laa dɛ pɔ ba nɛ,

english_verse: Then God Most High, the Eternal God, came and judged in favor of his chosen ones, because the time had arrived for them to be given the kingdom.
translation_verse: mɔɔ Nɛn Waa Lole Saŋ La Bwa la ba, dɛ́ ba pa Nemenɛ Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra la boldɛɛɡe, asɛ saŋ tel kɛŋɔ ba kpɔ ba kora di name.

english_verse: Then I was told by the one standing there: “The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom to appear on earth. It will be different from all the others— it will trample the earth and crush it to pieces.
translation_verse: O baɡ mɛ oljen waa teŋa naarɛ la waa mun. ‘Oljen waa teŋa naarɛ la cheɡɔ tɛ kora waa teŋa naarɛ, dɛ́ ba harɛ nɔ ta bwa. O kora ɛɛ korɛ kora bɛlbwa taa, dɛ́ lɛ harɛ nɔ bwa dɔɔh, dɛ́ tiɡri o ta.

english_verse: All ten of those horns are kings who will come from this kingdom, and one more will follow. This horn will be different from the others, and it will conquer three other kings.
translation_verse: Nyeɡlare fi la cheɡɔ tɛ koranar fi baa dɛ ba oljen waa teŋa naarɛ la kora ta la lee. Ba habɔɔ la, koofale bɛl ɛɛ bao dɛ́ korɛ banɔ la nɛ, dɛ́ ir koranar batoro.

english_verse: “This king will speak evil of God Most High, and he will be cruel to God's chosen ones. He will try to change God's Law and the sacred seasons. And he will be able to do this for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ bol waa yaɡɛ Nemenɛ Korowiirii, ásɛ dɛ fiiɡi Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra, dɛ́ takapɔ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ beɡre Korowii nɛra mmarare baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ne tɔpejenaa. Ásɛ Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra la do o lɔɡa bene atoro korobie anumɛl.

english_verse: But he will finally be judged, and his kingdom completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Nomonome ɛɛ soo dɛ́ bol o wa, dɛ́ laa kpeɡri waa dɔa la lɛ o be, dɛ́ chɔɡo kwaraa a tonɛ.

english_verse: “Then the greatest kingdom of all will be given to the chosen ones of God Most High. His kingdom will be eternal, and all others will serve and obey him.”
translation_verse: Kpeɡri ne kan harɛ nɔ ta kora aa dɔa la ɛɛ berɔɔ ba ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra la kon. Korowii Kora la kpeɡri aa ɡu bwa, ásɛ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ no o wa.’

english_verse: That was what I saw and heard. I turned pale with fear and kept it all to myself.
translation_verse: Waa la jaɡaa la. Men Daneɛl aa naa la, n ɔmɔ kohona n siebɔr ɡwaŋɛ, kɛ n kpɔ wobɛlbwa do n nyu bini.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the third year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had a second vision
translation_verse: Kooro Bɛlsasa aa di kora bene atoro ta la, men Daneɛl na wepila ja anɔ la n fa aa naa la habɔɔ.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw a ram standing there with two horns on its head—both of them were long, but the second one was longer than the first.
translation_verse: asɛ n na pebal bɛl o dɔ nyeɡlejaŋa anɛ. A habɔɔ la, nyeɡle la bɛl berɔ ba kpeɡ dɛ do jaŋne ɡwaa o dɔŋ la.

english_verse: The ram went charging toward the west, the north, and the south. No other animals were strong enough to oppose him, and nothing could save them from his power. So he did as he pleased and became even more powerful.
translation_verse: N na pebal la kɛŋɔ waa chuɡri ola le wee cholibɔr ne weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr. Ol bɛlbwa ta wone che o sie kɛɛ dɛ won sɔɔh o kpeɡri nyoa. O ɛ ɡɛ a too o tea dɛ dɔ kpeɡri taeh.

english_verse: I kept on watching and saw a goat come from the west and charge across the entire earth, without even touching the ground. Between his eyes was a powerful horn,
translation_verse: N ta aa dɛ lii dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ mun la, dɛ booh bɛl le wee cholibɔr ba, dɛɛ chwa wɔrɔbe nɛɛ bobɛlbwa, kɛ dɛ o nakpale ɡe aa harɛ leɡe. O dɔ nyeɡlejen beŋkpoŋ o pa o sibie baah ta.

english_verse: and with tremendous anger the goat started toward the ram that I had seen beside the river.
translation_verse: O ba pebal n fa aa nao o dɔ nyeɡlare anɛ dɛ che moo nyoa la be, dɛ ba chuɡru o bokpeɡa bwa ne.

english_verse: The goat was so fierce that its attack broke both horns of the ram, leaving him powerless. Then the goat trampled on the ram, and no one could do anything to help.
translation_verse: N nao kɛŋɔ o kpɔ bandia kohona ka pu pebal la, asɛ dɛ chuɡo dɛ laa o nyeɡlare anɛ la kuuɡi. Pebal la sɔɔhnɔ o ta wone pu booh la yo, asɛ o chuɡo ɡo harɛ dɛ tiɡri o nɛ. Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ won lɛ pebal la.

english_verse: After this, the goat became even more powerful. But at the peak of his power, his mighty horn was broken, and four other mighty horns took its place—one pointing to the north and one to the east, one to the south and one to the west.
translation_verse: Booh la baa dɔ kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ o ta aa dɛ di kpeɡri la, o nyeɡlejen la kuu asɛ nyeɡlare anaarɛ aa kana le paaɡe o buɡ ta. Bɛl chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyundua, bɛl chaɡɛ wee leebɔr, bɛl chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ bɛl chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr.

english_verse: A little horn came from one of these, and its power reached to the south, the east, and even to the holy land.
translation_verse: Nyeɡlejeɡa bɛl leɔ pa nyeɡlare la bɛl ta, dɛ di kpeɡri kohona chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr ne wee leebɔr, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Israel Harɛdɛɛɡe la ta.

english_verse: It became so strong that it attacked the stars in the sky, which were heaven's army. Then it threw some of them down to the earth and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Nyeɡlejeɡa la wono kpeɡ kohona, dɛ ka tel nyundua laa kwaa aa wara dɛ ɛ weweela la be, asɛ dɛ taɡɛ a bini ane ta harɛ, dɛ tiɡri a nɛ.

english_verse: It humiliated heaven's army and dishonored its leader by keeping him from offering the daily sacrifices. In fact, it was so terrible that it even disgraced the temple and wiped out true worship. It also did everything else it wanted to do.
translation_verse: Nɛra fe aa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare tɔpere bɛlbwa la, wechɔɡaa ba berɛ dɛɛ ɛ. A che a ta Korowii waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la nyoɡre. Wobɛlbwa nyeɡle la aa ɛa la chiɡu kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Then one of the holy angels asked another, “When will the daily sacrifices be offered again? What about this horrible rebellion? When will the temple and heaven's army no longer be trampled in the dust?”
translation_verse: Asɛ n no kɛŋɔ nyundua torome bɛl aa dɛ bɔɔ o dɔŋ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo waa baa naa wepila la ta ɛɛ ba a jaɡa bala ɔ? Bɛweeree wechɔɡa aa do ɔma dɛ ba chiɡ tɔpere bɛlbwa sarahare naa ta nɔ ɛɛ ba ɡela ɔ? Saŋ besoo bá tiɡri Korowii dɔm baa wara ne Korowii Dea nɛɛ ka tel ɔ?”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was trying to figure out the meaning of the vision, when someone suddenly appeared there beside me.
translation_verse: Men Daneɛl aa na wepila la dɛ ta ɛɛ nyin a mun dɛ jemɛ la, n den na komɛl o ba che n sie kɛŋɔ nɛn,

english_verse: And from beside the Ulai River, a voice like that of a human said, “Gabriel, help him understand the vision.”
translation_verse: asɛ n no nomɛl taa Ulai Moo la nyoa o ŋɔ, “Gebreɛl, baɡle baa nɔ o wepila waa naa la mun.”

english_verse: Gabriel came over, and I fell to the ground in fear. Then he said, “You are merely a human, but you need to understand that this vision is about the end of time.”
translation_verse: Ate, Gebreɛl ba che bɛne bela maa cheɡa la, asɛ n ɔmɛ kohona dɛ chole kpɔ sie pi harɛ. Anee o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, n dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ wepila nɔ mun dɛ baɡle waa bwa jaɡa saŋ wa.”

english_verse: While he was speaking, I fell facedown in a deep sleep. But he lifted me to my feet
translation_verse: O ta aa dɛ bol waa n be la, n sie bir mɛ n chole, asɛ o laɡ mɛ ir che chiŋ.

english_verse: and said: Listen, and I will tell you what will happen at the end of time, when God has chosen to show his anger.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba waa aa dɛ ba Korowii bandia kohona la habɔɔ bala he be bola. Wepila la dɛ baɡle waa bwa jaɡa saŋ wa.

english_verse: The two horns of the ram are the kings of Media and Persia,
translation_verse: Pebal haa nao o dɔ nyeɡlare anɛ la cheɡɔ tɛ Midia ne Pɛɛsea koranar.

english_verse: the goat is the kingdom of Greece, and the powerful horn between his eyes is the first of its kings.
translation_verse: Asɛ booh la che tɛ Grik tena harɛ kooro. Nyeɡlejen waa pa o sie baah la cheɡɔ tɛ kooro waa tɔ sie.

english_verse: When these rulers have become as evil as possible, their power will end, and then a king who is dangerous and cannot be trusted will appear.
translation_verse: Koranar banaarɛ kora dii la aa dɛɛ ba a jaɡa la, baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ kohonaa dɛ́ chɛ deŋnetɛra. Ásɛ kooro o nyu bini aa kpeɡa dɛɛ neɡre nɛra ba.

english_verse: He will gain strength, but not on his own, and he will cause terrible destruction. He will wipe out powerful leaders and God's people as well.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ dɔ kpeɡrii taeh, kɛ o ɡbaɡba kpeɡri laa. Wɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa á ɛ nyokpoa, o wobɛlbwa waa ɛ do wer tɛo, dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛnjena ne Korowii nɛra bwa.

english_verse: His deceitful lies will make him so successful, that he will think he is really great. Suddenly he will kill many people, and he will even attack God, the Supreme Ruler. But God will crush him!
translation_verse: Wɛɛ che kasinteŋ bɛ bola taa dɛ́ do wer. Wɛɛ dɛɛ liiruu kɛŋɔ o ɡwaa nomɛlbwa, dɛ che a ta chɔɡ nɛra ɡalɡa ɡɛ saŋ baa so dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna lole. Wɛɛ muɡli koranar bwa kooro baahnee, kɛ a bwa habɔɔ la, wɛɛ chɔɡoo dɛ nɛn kpeɡri ta laa.

english_verse: This vision about the evenings and mornings is true, but these things won't happen for a long time, so don't tell it to others.
translation_verse: Chɔɔ ne jɔmɔre sarahare wepila baa baɡle a mun tɛɛ la ɛɛ ɛ kpelaa. Anomanta, marɛ wepila la nyoa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ aa la sie tama mɔɔ á chiɡ.”

english_verse: After this, I was so worn out and weak that it was several days before I could get out of bed and go about my duties for the king. I was disturbed by this vision that made no sense to me.
translation_verse: Men Daneɛl, dɛ n ɡwɛɡrɔ, n bwara wee mɛ la sie tama mɔɔ n ta won ba ir dɛ ɛ toma tɛ kooro. N ta wepila la mun noɛ, dɛ a ɡwaa n liire ta.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: Some years later, Darius the Mede, who was the son of Xerxes, had become king of Babylonia. And during his first year as king, I found out from studying the writings of the prophets that the Lord had said to Jeremiah, “Jerusalem will lie in ruins for
translation_verse: A bena waa di kora la, men Daneɛl nyiŋi tɔne bini, dɛ na waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Jeremia nɛɛ bol ŋɔ, Jerusalam ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbia, dɛ́ ka tel bene fifraanuanɛ.

english_verse: Then, to show my sorrow, I went without eating and dressed in sackcloth and sat in ashes. I confessed my sins and earnestly prayed to the Lord my God: Our Lord, you are a great and fearsome God, and you faithfully keep your agreement with those who love and obey you.
translation_verse: N soŋe Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ bol n nɛra wechɔɡa ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he kan dɛ do ɔma kohona. He dɛ teŋɛ he fɔo ta, dɛɛ baɡle he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe nɛra baa dɛ nyini nɛ. Ba dɛ teŋɛ waa haa dɛ do ba ta la ta.

english_verse: But we have sinned terribly by rebelling against you and rejecting your laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ koni, dɛ ɛ nyubinikpeɡ, dɛ le he habɔɔ. Ya bɛɡɔ le waa haa do yaa a ta ne he Mmarare ta.

english_verse: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Ya ta waa he bonɔɔna baa ɛ he keamere la aa cheɡɛ he sɔn ta, dɛ bol ya koranar ne nomonome, ne ya naawa dɛ ya harɛ nɔ nɛra be la noɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, you are merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against you
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ ya ɛ deŋnekpeɡ he nɛ, he dɛ sune nɛn nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ,

english_verse: Everyone in Israel has stubbornly refused to obey your laws, and so those curses written by your servant Moses have fallen upon us.
translation_verse: Ya Israel tena bwa koni he Mmara la, dɛ vɛh kɛŋɔ yaa no he waa. Asɛ he ɡel taahna waa baa ŋwɛɛ ntam dɛ chwera he bonɔɔ Mosis Mmara la ta la ba ya nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ.

english_verse: You warned us and our leaders that Jerusalem would suffer the worst disaster in human history, and you did exactly as you had threatened.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ waa he fa aa bola dawɛ ya nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, hɛɛ kpɔ deŋnetɛraa ba ya ne ya koranar nɛɛ la ɛ ɡɛ. Harɛ nɔ ta bwa, he ta nɛra deŋne tɛrɛ ɡɛ haa tɛr bwɛjen Jerusalam tena deŋne nɔ bwa.

english_verse: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
translation_verse: Gɛ tenten baa chwera Mosis Mmara la ta la, ɡɛ deŋnetɛra la bwaa ba ya nɛ. Kɛ ya ta Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la bɔr nyine ó cha yaa ya le ya wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ dɛ no o kasinteŋ waa la.

english_verse: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ deŋnetɛra ba ta ya nɛɛ warane, dɛkalkɛ o waa toɡrɔ wobɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ ta. Kɛ ane a bwa, ya ta o waa noɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, henee cheɡɛ he kpeɡri ta lɛ he nɛra le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ lɛ sɔn tɛ he te a ta chɔ le ba le fini, kɛ ya ɡarɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.

english_verse: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, ɡɛ aa cheɡɛ he we-ɛɛla aa toɡra ta he cha yaa wubwa la, laa he bwaawee ne bandia kohona la kpɔ he bwɛjen Jerusalam, he Saayɔn Bwejen la ta. Ya ne ya naawa wechɔɡaa ɡela nɛra baa soɡa bar yaa la ɛɛ mamɛ Jerusalam ne he nɛra.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, no he bonɔɔ waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ bil he sie ne n wesoŋa nɔ name. He sɔn nomanta, na ya sum chɔe he Dea nɔ aa chɔ pɛɛ nɔ wa.

english_verse: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself. The Seventy Weeks Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii no. N Naa Korowii kpɔ kɛ yaa. N Naa Korowii, cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ ɛ waane. Bɛ ɡel a biɡri, ɡɛ aa ɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he cheɡɛ he nɛra ne bwɛjen nɔ nɛɛ dɛ lɛ sɔn tɛ he te.” Nyundua torome Gebreɛl baɡle wepila la mun

english_verse: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
translation_verse: N ta teŋɔ dɛɛ soŋe, dɛɛ bol n ne n nɛra Israel tena wechɔɡa wa, dɛ kpɔ bil Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ sie ŋɔ, ó berɛ kwaa o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la cheɡ.

english_verse: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision,
translation_verse: N ta aa lɔ n wesoŋa ta la, nyundua torome Gebreɛl n fa aa nao wepila aa tɔ sie ta la iro kpɔ nyundua wɔrɔbe nɛɛ dɛ ba n be. Dɛ jɔmɔr saraha saŋ telo.

english_verse: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, taraken n balɔ dɛ́ ba baɡle hé no wepila la mun.

english_verse: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
translation_verse: Nomoa la ne nɛra baa wara ɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee bene anuanɛ. Bene anuanɛ la baah ta la, wɛɛ ɡeloo ba ɡel kwaa baa kpoora dɛɛ ɛ saraha, ne koŋkɛɛla baa dɛ ba a ne Korowii Dea la ne bala. Ásɛ o kpɔ konchɔɡechɔɡe waa dɛ paɡre bwɛɛ la ka pa Korowii Dea doa bobɛl waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua, ásɛ o do bela ka tel kɛŋɔ chɔɡa aa dɛ ba o nɛɛ bala aa bala, ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.”

english_verse: In the third year of Cyrus the king of Persia, a message came to Daniel from God, and it was explained in a vision. The message was about a dreadful war, and it was true.
translation_verse: Kooro Saeros aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ bentooro te ta la, Korowii pili waane bini baɡle Daneɛl, baa bera dɛ yerɔ Bɛltesasa. Dɛ waa la ɛ kpela dɛ ɛ laajen wa. Wepila la taa o che dɛ no waa la mun.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ la, men Daneɛl, n tea bini chɔɡɔ yawanyoa atoro.

english_verse: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
translation_verse: N ta kondikonsoma dii, ol kɛɛ sen ta n nyoa joɛ. N ta noo bɛlbwa ɡe fɔɡlɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ yawanyoa atoro la aa ba a jaɡa.

english_verse: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
translation_verse: A ɡɛ bena la korobiloɡle tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ ta, dɛ men Daneɛl, n cheɡɛ Tiɡris Mojen nyoa.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
translation_verse: N ha sie nyiŋi, dɛ na baa bɛl waa do laalapoŋa, asɛ kiriso baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛo vɔwɛ o chara.

english_verse: His body was like a precious stone, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming fires, his arms and legs like polished bronze, and his voice like the roar of a crowd.
translation_verse: O bwara do kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane aa dɛ nyɛɡle baa yera kresolɛt, o siebɔr do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ nyɛɡle ken, o sibie do kɛŋɔ kapɛle aa dɛ hɔ, o nɔɔra ne nakpale do kɛŋɔ ayaawa baa looru ken, asɛ o taa do kɛŋɔ nɛnlaa aa bol waa dɛɛ nyɛɡ ken.

english_verse: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.
translation_verse: Men Daneɛl ɡboo na wepila la, dɛ baala bane ja n nɛ, ba te ta kon la nae, kɛ ɔmee laɡ ba kohona asɛ ba chwa ka sɔh.

english_verse: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.
translation_verse: N noɔ kɛŋɔ baa la dɛ bol wa, asɛ mɛɛ no, n sie den bir mɛ, n chole kpɔ sie pi harɛ.

english_verse: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
translation_verse: Baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, Korowii dɛ nyin he waa taeh. Ir che dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ ba he be bola nɔ kɛrɛdɛ. He bee ba tom mɛ.” Waa bol waa la n be la, n iro che dɛ n bwara ta dɛ sa.

english_verse: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.
translation_verse: Ate, o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, le awola haa ɛ he liire kɛ he pwɛr he te tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ no waa nɔ mun la taa o no he wa. N balɔ dɛ́ ba chae he wesoŋa la wa.

english_verse: I will tell you what is written in The Book of Truth. But first, you must realize that no one except Michael, the guardian angel of Israel, is on my side.
translation_verse: kɛ anɔ la aa tɔ sie la, mɛɛ baɡle waa aa lɔ Kasinteŋ Tɔn la binii. Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ che n habɔɔ n ne o yo, atane nyundua torome Maekel waa dɛ di kpeɡri Israel harɛ la ɡbo.”

english_verse: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
translation_verse: Taraken, n balɔ dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ waa aa dɛ ba he harɛ ta nɛra nɛɛ chiɡa kerekere, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ wepila nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ waane a ta aa dɛ ba saŋ bɛl.”

english_verse: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
translation_verse: O ta aa dɛ bol waa n be la, n kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ bol waa kahonɛ.

english_verse: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
translation_verse: Asɛ nyundua torome waa do kɛŋɔ nɛn kpɔ nɔn ba leɡe n nyoa, mɔɔ n pa mun pili nyoa dɛ bol wa. N ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n na weweele taeh wepila nɔ ta, asɛ a ɡel n bwara yɔr.

english_verse: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath?”
translation_verse: Nomoa, ɛrɛɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ ne hɛɛ ba wona bol waɔ? N bokpeɡa bwa tonɔ maa wola won hwee kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
translation_verse: O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Korowii dɛ nyini, anomanta, dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, bɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa hae ɡe.” Waa bol waa nɔ n be la, n berɔ dɔ bokpeɡa, asɛ n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, bol waa bwa haa dɛ nyin kɛ he bol, taraken te he ɡelɔ n dɔ bokpeɡa.”

english_verse: Then the angel said: Now do you understand why I have come? Soon I must leave to fight against the guardian angel of Persia. Then after I have defeated him, the guardian angel of Greece will attack me.
translation_verse: Anee o bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “He jemɛ waa aa ba n ne he be nɔ naa? Aa biɡri ń berɛ ba kaa nyundua torome waa dɛ di kpeɡri Pɛɛsea harɛ dɛ́ ka yoo laa, a habɔɔ mɔɔ nyundua torome waa dɛ di kpeɡri Grik tena harɛ ɡe ba,

english_verse: You also need to know that I protected and helped Darius the Mede in his first year as king. The Angel's Message to Daniel Part One: The Four Kings and Their Successors
translation_verse: Midia Kooro Dareɔs kora dii benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta la, n cheɡɛ o habɔɔ dɛ chao. Ijipt ne Siiria harɛre kora wa

english_verse: What I am going to tell you is certain to happen. Four kings will rule Persia, one after the other, but the fourth one will become much richer than the others. In fact, his wealth will make him so powerful that he will turn everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome Maekel waa dɛ daah Israel harɛ la ŋɔ, “Namee mɛɛ ba kasinteŋ la he be bola. Koranar batoro ɛɛ ir Pɛɛsea harɛ taa, ásɛ naarɛte ɡe ba dɛ́ ba dɔ suuɡa ɡwaa banɔ la bwa. O baa dɔ kpeɡri dɛ le o kondɔɔh la ta naa, wɛɛ di nomɛlbwa liiree ba yo Grik tena harɛ kooro.

english_verse: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.
translation_verse: Ásɛ kooro bɛl ɡe waa do kpeɡri ba ir, dɛɛ di kora kpeɡri ne ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.
translation_verse: Gɛ kooro la balaa, o harɛre waa dɛ di kora a ta la dɛ ba peɡra, dɛ bɔne bɔre anaarɛ. O naanar aa koraa dɔ di. Gɛ kooro la aa kpeɡrii dɔ kpa, dɛkalkɛ o kora la ɛɛ ɡuu, dɛ́ berɛ bane kon.

english_verse: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.
translation_verse: Ijipt kooro ɛɛ do kpeɡrii, kɛ o laa sitɔɔ bɛl ɛɛ do kpeɡrii ɡwaalo, dɛ́ di o kora kpeɡri kohona ne.

english_verse: Years later the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom will make a treaty, and the daughter of the king of the south will marry the king of the north. But she will lose her power. Then she, her husband, their child, and the servants who came with her will all be killed. After this,
translation_verse: Aa ba la sie la, Ijipt kooro ne Siiria kooro ɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee, ásɛ Ijipt kooro kpɔ o bihaah tɛo ó mo. Kɛ ba darame la aa biɡri, ásɛ haah la ne o jaa, ne o bie, dɛ toli baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ kaa la, bá kpoo ba bwa.

english_verse: one of her relatives will become the ruler of the southern kingdom. He will attack the army of the northern kingdom and capture its fortresses.
translation_verse: Aa biɡri bɛlbwa ásɛ Ijipt kooro bihaah la lole bɛl ba iru, dɛ́ ba so o buɡ ta. Wɛɛ kpɔ laa tenaa ka yo Siiria kooro, dɛ́ jo o koodem dekpeɡ bini, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later
translation_verse: Wɛɛ pa ba voɡa baa loɡa, ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ́ kaa a bwa ne Ijipt harɛ. A habɔɔ deŋnesɔɔhna aa ba tama la,

english_verse: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.
translation_verse: Siiria kooro ɛɛ kpɔ o laa tenaa ka lɔ tɔ Ijipt kooro ne o nɛra nɛ, kɛ waa won, dɛ́ berɛ kaa o harɛ ta.

english_verse: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
translation_verse: Siiria kooro la bii ɛɛ boa laa tena damanta nyoa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te, dɛ́ ka yoo ba. Baa su harɛ la ta bobɛlbwaa kɛŋɔ nee yon su dɛ́ palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ bobɛlbwa la, dɛ́ yo ka tel dekpeɡ waa lɔ ba dɔma bwɛjen doonyoa.

english_verse: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.
translation_verse: Ijipt kooro ɛɛ kpɔ bandiaa kpɔ o laa tena, dɛ́ ka yo Siiria kooro, dɛ́ pɔ o ne o laa tena damanta la nɛ.

english_verse: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long,
translation_verse: Ijipt kooro la ɛɛ maŋkura o te pɔe waa pɔ ba nɛɛ la waa, ne laa tena waa kpoo ba warɛ la, kɛ waa won teŋɛ dɛɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.
translation_verse: Siiria kooro la ɛɛ berɛ habɔɔ ka kpɔ laa tena baa ɡwaa wubwa tena la, ásɛ tɔpedɛɛɡe ta la, ó kpɔ laa tena baa dɔ dɔmkwaa warɛ ka yo Ijipt kooro.

english_verse: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, nɛra ɡalɡa ɛɛ ɛ Ijipt kooro deŋnekpeɡii, ásɛ hen Daneɛl, he harɛ ta nɛra bane baa ɛ naɡrenyine ɡe ɛ deŋnekpeɡ wepila baa naa la wa, kɛ baa horɔɔ.

english_verse: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Siiria kooro ɛɛ kpɔ o laa tenaa ba chɔ bar bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛjen baro la, dɛ́ pɔ o nɛra nɛ. A ba ɡɛ naa, Ijipt laa tena aa won yo kpa, hale ba laa tena baa jemɛ yoi aa bokpeɡaa dɔ, dɛ́ won che a nyoa.

english_verse: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.
translation_verse: Siiria kooro waa ka lɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ la, wɛɛ ɛɛ baa ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin, nomɛlbwa aa wola won tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ. Wɛɛ ka che Israel Harɛdɛɛɡe la taa, ásɛ dɛɛ di kpeɡri o ta.

english_verse: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
translation_verse: Siiria kooro ɛɛ dɛɛ nyinuu kɛ o kpɔ o harɛ ta laa tena bwa ba. Waa dɛ nyin o chɔɡ o dɔma harɛ nomanta, o ne Ijipt kooro la ɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee, ásɛ o kpɔ o bihaah tɛo ó mo, kɛ ane a bwa, aa on cha.

english_verse: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, wɛɛ berɔ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ mpo nyoa harɛre nɛra nɛ. Wɛɛ yoo baa, dɛ́ pɔ ba ɡalɡa nɛ, kɛ laa nomoa bɛl ɛɛ le harɛfale bɛl taa, dɛ́ ba pɔ o nɛɛ dɛ́ sɔɔh o nyoa, ásɛ maŋkurae waa dɛ maŋkura o te la ɡure o nyu ta.

english_verse: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
translation_verse: Anɔ ɡe habɔɔ, wɛɛ berɔ kaa o ɡbaɡba harɛ dekpeɡa taa, kɛ baa pɔ o nɛɛ, o waa bwa ba a jaɡa.

english_verse: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
translation_verse: Kooro waa ba chiɡ o naa ta la ɛɛ tomɛ nɛnee ó ɛɡre nɛra lɛ toɔ, dɛ́ ɡel suuɡa ba o kara mun. Kɛ a ba dɛ la sie naa, baa kpo kooro laanee, nɛra baah ta laa, laa ɡe ta laa.”

english_verse: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome la berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛmpɛɛ bɛl waa wola kora la ta jae ɛɛ ba chiɡ Siiria kooro naa taa, dɛ́ di kora. Wɛɛ kpɔ laalee ba ta harɛ la ta nɛra nɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna lole. Ásɛ dɛ che neɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ di kpeɡri.

english_verse: Then he will destroy armies and remove God's chosen high priest.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa tɔŋlo la, hale dɛ Sɔfonomoa Korowii aa leo yoo, wɛɛ chɔɡoo.

english_verse: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
translation_verse: Kooro la ne harɛre ane nɛra ɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee, dɛ́ che a ta neɡre harɛre ane nɛra dɛɛ di kpeɡri kohona, a lole kɛŋɔ o harɛ aa kanɛ.

english_verse: Without warning, he will successfully invade a wealthy province, which is something his ancestors never did. Then he will divide among his followers all of its treasures and property. But none of this will last very long.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kpɔ laalee lɔ ka tɔ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ waa wera dɛ won kondikwaa ɛɛ nɛ a piɡ ba, dɛ ɛ waa o naawa bɛlbwa aa wola ane ɛɛ bwa. Ásɛ dɛ bɔne laala baa paa laa taa tɛ o nɛra baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la. Wɛɛ dɛɛ vɔrɔwoo kɛŋɔ ó ka yo bwɛɛre aa dɔ dekpeɡa, kɛ aa biɡri bɛlbwa o waa la ba a jaɡa.

english_verse: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed
translation_verse: Siiria kooro ɛɛ lɔ bambilee, dɛ́ kpɔ laa tena baa wara bá ba yo Ijipt kooro, ásɛ o ɡe kpɔ laa tena baa wara dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ́ ba yoo laa. Kɛ baa neɡre Ijipt kooroo, dɛ́ le o habɔɔ o yo kahonɛ.

english_verse: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: O ɡbabir nɛra baa dɛ jao laanee dɛɛ ba o chɔɡa. Baa kpoo o laa tena ɡalɡaa, ásɛ ba bwa tonɛ.

english_verse: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.
translation_verse: Gɛ koranar banɛ baa dɔ liichɔɡa tɛ dɔŋa nɔ ɛɛ pɛo so tiɡ ta dɛɛ neɡre dɔŋa, kɛ aa tɔnɔ bɛlbwaa dɔ tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ saŋ baa lea cheɡ la ta dɛ ba.

english_verse: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
translation_verse: Siiria kooro ɛɛ kpɔ laala waa paa laa ta la bwaa kaa o harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ sibeɡra dɛɛ nyin o chɔɡ Korowii ne o nɛra fɔo waa do ɡoroŋ la. Wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyinii, ásɛ dɛ berɛ kaa o ɡbaɡba harɛ ta.

english_verse: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, wɛɛ ba yo Ijipt harɛ tenaa, kɛ ate ɛɛ korɛ wubwa yoi la taa waa won pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Rom tena ɛɛ kpɔ stiimaeree le mpo nyoa wee cholibɔr harɛre taa, dɛ́ ba yoo, ásɛ o bambile chɔɡ. Wɛɛ berɔ kpɔ bandia dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ chɔɡ Korowii fɔo waa do ɡoroŋ la. Wɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ nɛra baa wola fɔo la ta teŋɛ la nɛɛ.

english_verse: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo o laa tena kpɔ doŋa kah Korowii Dea dekpeɡ la, dɛ́ ɡel ba ɡel sarahare baa dɛ ɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ konchɔɡechɔɡe waa dɛ paɡre bwɛɛ la pa.

english_verse: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
translation_verse: Siiria kooro la ɛɛ neɡre nɛra baa koni fɔo baa fɔwa laanee, kɛ banɔ la baa jemɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ cheo kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ yoo.

english_verse: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
translation_verse: Nomonome baa jemɛ waa la ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra ɡalɡa jemɛ wa, kɛ aa biɡri ba kpoo bane keri ne, kɛɛ dɛ́ fuh bane, dɛ́ lawɛ bane laa ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ pa ba laala laa ta kaa.

english_verse: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
translation_verse: Baa dɛɛ kpoo wejerema la ɡɛ la, Korowii nɛra ɛɛ dɔ nɛraa ba cha ba tama, ásɛ nɛra ba wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe la ɡe ba ja ba nɛɛ kwaane baa dɔ le a ta la wa.

english_verse: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
translation_verse: Baa kpoo ba bini wejerema la banee, ásɛ a che a ta Korowii laa doŋa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ ba, ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ waa lea cheɡ ŋɔ wɛɛ bao la. Kooro waa dɛ ɡɔɔ o te wa

english_verse: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
translation_verse: Siiria kooro la ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyinii, dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo, dɛɛ ɡɔɔ o te ŋɔ o ɡwaa voɡ bɛlbwa, hale Nemenɛ Korowii waa kana la. Wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwaa ka tel saŋ Korowii aa tɛr o deŋne. Korowii ɛɛ ɛ waa waa bola ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo laanee.

english_verse: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
translation_verse: Kooro la aa duuree kpɔ tɛ voɡa o naawa aa toma la, ne onɔ la haahna aa dɛ nyinu la. Kasinteŋ, waa voɡ bɛlbwaa duu, dɛkalkɛ wɛɛ maŋkura o tenee ŋɔ o ɡwaa komɛlbwa.

english_verse: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kpɔ duuree tɛ voɡ waa dɛ nyiŋi dekpeɡa ta, ne voɡ o naawa aa wola on jemɛ la. Wɛɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm, ne suuɡapoŋa, ne bwedɛɛɡa dɛ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwaa tɛo.

english_verse: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
translation_verse: Wɛɛ kpɔ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡhɔɔh baa nyiŋi o dekpeɡa ta. Wɛɛ kpɔ duuree tɛ banɔ la baa sɛah kɛ o ɛ kooro la, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba sobɔrjena báa nyiŋi nɛndamanta nɛ, dɛ́ bɔne harɛ tɛɛ ba ó ɛ ba kembɔr.

english_verse: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
translation_verse: Aa ba ka tama Siiria kooro waa ba a jaɡa la, Ijipt kooro ɛɛ ba yoo laalee, ásɛ Siiria kooro la kpɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, ne laa tena baa soɡe jaɡre ta, ne stiimaere aa wara, o kpeɡri bwa ne dɛ́ ka puu yo. Wɛɛ lɔɔ ka tɔ harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nee yon su dɛɛ kpɔ bobɛlbwa la ken, dɛ́ ba lɛ harɛre dɔɔh.

english_verse: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ba Israel Harɛdɛɛɡe la taa, harɛre ta nɛra ɛɛ serewoo, kɛ Edom ne Moab harɛre ta nɛra dɛ Amɔn harɛ ta nomonome te ɛɛ le a nyoaa.

english_verse: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
translation_verse: Wɛɛ che o kpeɡri taa dɛ́ lɛ harɛre la, hale baa Ijipt harɛ ɡba ɡela ba.

english_verse: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ pa Ijipt suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaare dɛ kondɔɔh bɛlbwaa, dɛ́ le bela ka yo Lebya ne Itiopia harɛre tena, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
translation_verse: Kɛ wɛɛ ba no waa aa chiɡ wee leebɔr ne weekaŋle nyunduabɔr nɔɔ, ásɛ o jum jah, á ɡel o ir kpɔ sibeɡra kohona ka yo dɛ́ kpoo nɛra warɛ.

english_verse: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, wɛɛ baŋre tɛnte dedɛɛɡa aa kana á ɛ o koodem, Mɛdetereenea Mpo ne bwejen bela Korowii Dea aa cheɡa la baah ta. Kɛ wɛɛ ba sewɔɔ, dɛ nomɛlbwa toole bela dɛ́ chao.”

english_verse: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɡalɡa baa serewa ɛɛ berɔ ir, ásɛ bane kaa mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ta, bane ɡe kaa weweele aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ne sihiih ta.

english_verse: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
translation_verse: Nomonome baa ɛ wejerema la ɛɛ chaahnoo kɛŋɔ nyundua, ásɛ banɔ la baa baɡle nɛra bane waa a che a ta ba waa toɡre la, baa doo kɛŋɔ weweela dɛɛ chaah saŋ bɛlbwa.”

english_verse: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
translation_verse: Ate, nyundua torome la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, laa tɔn la tɔ dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa marɛ o nyoa ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ. Nɛra ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ la dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ nyin Korowii waa la dɛ́ jemɛ, ásɛ wejema warɛ taeh.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.
translation_verse: Asɛ men Daneɛl nyiŋi dɛ na baala banɛ ba che nee bɛl nyoa, bɛl lɔ o baŋ le, bɛl ɡe do o baŋ bonɔ.

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
translation_verse: Ate, bɛl pɛɛ nyundua torome waa do laalapoŋa la, dɛ o cheɡɛ nee la nyunduabɔr dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ́ ka tel saŋ besoo ɡɛ nyokpowaa nɔ ɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?”

english_verse: The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
translation_verse: Nyundua torome la ir nɔɔra anɛ bwa nyundua, asɛ n no ɡɛ waa ŋwɛɛ Korowii Waa Lole Saŋ Bɛlbwa sɔn ta ŋɔ, “Aa ɛ bene atoro ne faah. Gɛ saŋ nɛra baa teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ bonyɛɡa aa ba a jaɡa la, dɛ waa nɔ bwa ɡe chiɡo.”

english_verse: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
translation_verse: N no waa waa bola, kɛ n ta a mun noɛ. Anomanta, n bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ba chiɡa ka tonɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, kaa taraken, dɛkalkɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ waa aa chɛ kɛ ba laa tɔ, dɛ marɛ o nyoa ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ.

english_verse: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
translation_verse: Baa laa doŋaa kpɔ nɛra ɡalɡa nɛɛ bá waa toɡre wechɔɡa aa ba nɛɛ do, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ nyubinikpeɡ. Nyubinikpeɡ te bɛlbwa aa a munii no, kɛ wejerema te ɛɛ no a munii.

english_verse: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_verse: Kɛ hen Daneɛl, he te kaa, di kasinteŋ ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ. Hɛɛ sewɔɔ kɛ hɛɛ iruu, dɛ́ dɔ he kembɔr waa bwa jaɡa saŋ.”

english_verse: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me. Hosea's Family
translation_verse: Korowii pili o waa bini baɡle Beeri bibaa Hosia. A ɡɛ saŋee koranar bane kɛŋɔ Ussia, ne Jotam, ne Ahas dɛ Hɛsɛkea di kora Juda harɛ ta teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ. Dɛ Jehoas bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam di kora Israel harɛ ta. Hosia haah ne o bii

english_verse: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Hosia kaa mo Diblaem bihaah Goma, o ne o lolɛ bibaa.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Hosia be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ bwɛjen Jesreel sɔn pa he bie la. Aa biɡri ń ba tɛr Israel kooro deŋne, kpoe o naa Kooro Jehu aa kpoo nɛra Jesreel la wa, dɛ́ teŋe Jehu luɡe tena kora ta, Israel harɛ.

english_verse: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ sɔɔh Israel laa tena nyoa Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen binii.”

english_verse: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ, Goma berɔ lolɛ bihaah, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Hosia be ŋɔ, “Pa o sɔn Lo Ruhama, dɛkalkɛ maa nyin kɛ ń baɡle nyina Israel tena nɛ, maa ba wechɔɡa ɡee kpɔ kɛ ba kpa.

english_verse: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
translation_verse: Kɛ Juda harɛ ta tena te, mɛɛ nyin baa, mɛɛ lɛɛ baa. Dɔmkwaa aa do kɛ to ne hɛma, ne tokobie dɛ jaɡre nɛra aa kpɔa dɛɛ la laa ne laa mɛɛ ba kpɔe lɛɛ ba. Men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la kpeɡri nee mɛɛ ba ba lɛɛ.”

english_verse: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
translation_verse: Goma aa teŋe Lo Ruhama el tonɛ la, o berɔ lolɛ bibaa bɛl,

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.” Hope for Israel
translation_verse: asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Hosia be ŋɔ, “Pa bie la sɔn Lo Ami, dɛkalkɛ Israel tena ta n nɛra ɛɛ, baa men Korowii tomɛ.”

english_verse: Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.”
translation_verse: Israel tena ɛɛ warɔɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken, baa wola won kur ba. Korowii ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘He ta n nɛra ɛɛ’, kɛ tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba ó yer ba ‘Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa bii’.

english_verse: Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
translation_verse: Juda ne Israel tena ɛɛ berɔ pɛ, ásɛ dɛ le nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ó ɛ ba sitɔɔ. Ba harɛ la ɛɛ do werii ba dɔ ba te, awola ɛɛ ɛ tɔpejenii tɛ Jesreel tena.

english_verse: So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.” The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Hosia yerɛ o bala Israel tena la ‘Korowii nɛra’ ne ‘Korowii nɛnnyina.’ Korowii tɛr Israel tena deŋne dɛ berɛ lɛɛ ba

english_verse: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord, am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful,
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “N bii, hé soŋe he bala baa do kɛŋɔ haah o jwamane nomanta, n haah naa wola on ɛɛ, o ɡe jaa laa men la, ó ɡel o bannyin la, dɛ́ ɡel jwamanwaa la.

english_verse: or I will strip her naked like the day she was born. I will make her barren like a desert, and she will die of thirst.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛ laa, mɛɛ wuruu o che muŋɡbal kɛŋɔ awola baa lolɔ la ken. Mɛɛ ɡeloo ó do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ harɛ waa hola, ásɛ nyɔɡre kpoo ó sewɛ.

english_verse: You children are the result of her unfaithfulness, and I'll show you no pity.
translation_verse: Maa o bii waa nyin, dɛkalkɛ sɛmbiirii ban.

english_verse: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, “I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.”
translation_verse: Ba nya le n habɔɔ, dɛ ka di sɛm lolɛ sihihbii. O ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ teŋɛ banfala nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ n te tɛɛ ba, ásɛ ba tɛ mɛ kondikwaa ne ne, ne pee pona yale ne yapondɛɛɡa, ne ɔleve noo dɛ sen.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ sɔɔhnee tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ. Mɛɛ tɔɔ do waa wola won dɔ bɔr le.

english_verse: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, “I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.”
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ti baala laanee, kɛ waa ban pu, wɛɛ nyin ba bɔree, kɛ waa ban na. Ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ berɔɔ kaa n jaloɡle be, belaa wera tɛ mɛ ɡwaa taraken.’

english_verse: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: O ɡbabir ta liire kɛŋɔ menee tɛo kwaa kɛŋɔ mea, senfala ne ɔleve no, ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ suuɡaswɛm kohona, o kpɔ kaa tomɛ voɡ Baal la.

english_verse: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mea koma telaa, mɛɛ ba lɛa, dɛ́ ba lɛ n sen senfala saŋ. Dɛ ba lɛ n pee pona yale, ne yapondɛɛɡa maa kpɔa tɛo o tɔ o mumɡbal ta la.

english_verse: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ wuruu ó che mumɡbal o sɛnanar la sie, nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛo le n nɔn ta.

english_verse: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo o tɔpejena dii ba a jaɡa. Benanyoa ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, ne Ona Tɔpera dii dɛ tɔpejena waa lea cheɡ bwa.

english_verse: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ o ɡrepo ne fiɡ daa waa ŋɔa o sɛnanar la kpɔɔ bɔɔ kem la. Mɛɛ ɡeloo o daa kooni baah moɡɛ kohona, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini ola ba di a nɔna.

english_verse: I'll punish her for the days she worshiped Baal and burned incense to him. I'll punish her for the times she forgot about me and wore jewelry and rings to attract her lovers. I, the Lord, have spoken! The Lord Will Help Israel
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr o deŋnee, tɔpera waa fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ voɡa Baalre la, ne suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa, ne baŋa kwa dɛ noniseɡa waa doa dɛ teŋɛ o sɛnanar nɛɛ dɛ soh n waa la wa. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ lawɔɔ, dɛ́ kpɔɔ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpɔ sɛmwobol ɡbɛɡbɛo.

english_verse: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say “Yes” to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɛ o daa kooni laanee tɛo, ásɛ dɛ berɛ Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen la bela hwɛɡa aa lole. Belaa wɛɛ ba yela ɡoe silɛɛ ne kɛŋɔ o toli saŋ, ne ɡɛ awola tɔpere waa le Ijipt harɛ ta la ken.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, wɛɛ yer mɛ ‘n jaa’, waa men ‘n dɔɔ’ yerɛ kpa.

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: Maa ɡel ó yerɛ voɡa Baalre sɔna, waa a waa bol kpa.

english_verse: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ hen Israelee ɛ kɛŋɔ n haah saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, mɛɛ di kasinteŋii, maa he habɔɔ le. N nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe he nɛɛ aa tona ba bwa, mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛɛ, ásɛ he ɛ n haah saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ teŋɛ n nyobaɡa taa, dɛ́ kpɔe ɛ n haah, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛ menee Korowii.

english_verse: I will command the sky to send rain on the earth,
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ no n nɛra Israel tena wesoŋaa, ásɛ dɛ ɡel bwaala nɛ harɛ la ta,

english_verse: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
translation_verse: ásɛ mea ne ɡrepo ne ɔleve do wer Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen bini.

english_verse: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ n nɛra Israel tenaa, ásɛ ba ba so harɛ la ta, nɛra n fa aa ŋɔa ‘Maa ban nyin la,’ ń berɛ nyin ba wa. Nɛra maa ŋɔa ‘Ba ta n nɛra ɛɛ la’, ń berɛ ŋɔ ‘Hé ɛ n nɛra’, ásɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ la.’ ”

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ men Hosia be ŋɔ, “Berɛ la he haah be, á baɡle kɛ he dɛ nyinu. A lole kɛŋɔ baa bɛl dɛ nyinu te, kɛ bɛ an dawɛ. Nyinu ɡɛ men Korowii aa dɛ nyin Israel tena baa berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ kpɔ daa nɔna aa hola kaa tɛ voɡa n ɡarɛ dɛɛ nyin ba la.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: Asɛ n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gel n ne he so la sie, bɛ jwamane bɔ kpa, bɛ baa bɛlbwa nyin kpa.”

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
