translation_verse: Gɛɛ Israel tena ɛɛ ba soɡa biɡri baa wola kooro kɛɛ nomoa bɛlbwaa dɔ. Baa saraharee ɛ, dɛ paaɡe bwea dɛɛ duura, ba sɔfore aa batakaareborii do, baa voɡaa cheɡ dɛɛ toma kpa.

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba bala, ásɛ Israel tena berɛ ba Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ, ne kooro waa ɛ Kooro Devid naa be. Bochela nee baa ba Korowii be bala, ásɛ o swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ o ne Israel tena dɔɔ, dɛ ŋɔ bá no waa waa dɛ bol. O ŋɔ, “He waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, he ta nyina ɡe dɔe, haa men jemɛ harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nomanta, harɛ la holɔ dɛ chɔɡ, ásɛ kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa serewe. Kpɔɡ bini ola ne jumbii dɛ mpo bini pɛŋa bwa dɛ serewe.”

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ bɛ dɔ, bɛlbwa bɛ o dɔŋ pwah. He do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ pwah sɔfore.

english_verse: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.
translation_verse: Chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa hɛɛ lɔ na, he ne Korowii keamere bwa. Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba Israel waa ɛ he nya la chɔɡa.

english_verse: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
translation_verse: N nɛra aa wola men Korowii jemɛ nomanta, ba dɛ serewe. He sɔfore, haa wola n waa ta teŋɛ nomanta, n ɡe vɛh heya. Haa vɛh men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ webaɡla ta teŋa nomanta, n ɡe ɛɛ vɛh he biirii.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: He sɔfore, haa dɛ warɛ la, dɛ he dɛ ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa kohona. Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he jirima berɛ sihiih.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: N nɛra wechɔɡa taa he sɔfore che dɛɛ dɔ he te, anomanta, he dɛ nyin ba na dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Gɛ maa dɛ ba nɛra la ɛɛ laanee mɛɛ ba he sɔfore ɡe ɛɛ. Men Korowii ɛɛ tɛr he bwa deŋnee, dɛ bɔ heyaa kem a wa.

english_verse: Their food won't satisfy, and having sex at pagan shrines won't produce children. My people have rebelled
translation_verse: Hɛɛ di kondikwaa, kɛ haa vaɡɛ, dɛ́ bɔ jwamane, kɛ he mun aa ya bwa, dɛkalkɛ he vɛh men Korowii dɛ kpɔ he te tɛ voɡa ane.

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: Daa baa teŋa ɛ voɡa taa baa la dɛ kaa bɔɔ ba nyuune wa, ásɛ daa la ɛɛ bol waa ba be. Ba laa ba te kpɔ men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ nɛ, kɛŋɔ hanjwamane dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa ane.

english_verse: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.
translation_verse: Bwejena doree baa ɛ sarahare, dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa deŋɡarere ta, ne dajena bwa soo siwi a chunchule aa soma lɔɡre. A cheɡɛ a ta he bihaahna kpɔ ba te do jwamane ta, asɛ he bibaala haahna ɡe ɛɛ chɔɡ yal.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: Maa he bihaahna baa dɛ bɔ jwamane la deŋnee tɛr, ɡɛɛ maa wola he bibaala haahna ɡe deŋnee tɛr ba yal chɔɡa wa. He baala nɔ ɡbabir deŋnee mɛɛ ba tɛra, dɛkalkɛ he ne haahna la dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛ kaa ɛ saraha voɡa ta, nɛra baa wola waa mun no la ɛɛ heo!

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ he Israel tena le n habɔɔ, he bɛ ɡel Juda tena ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ di a bolchɔɡe. He bɛ Gelɡal la, he bɛ Bɛt Avɛn ɡe la. He bɛ men dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ men Korowii ta aa lole!

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Israel tena deŋne kpeɡri, kɛŋɔ naneenanar a deŋne aa kpeɡa ken. Ɛrɛɛ men Korowii ɛɛ ba wona kpɔa la dibɔr kɛŋɔ baa teɡɛ pebiiri dɛɛ la dibɔr ɔ?

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Israel tena kpɔ ba te jo voɡa toma ta, hé ɡel ba.

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: Ba nyɔ sen tonaa, ba ka dɛ bɔ ba jwamane la ja. Ba sie dɛ lɛ sihihwaa ta ɡwaa anɔ la aa tɛɛ ba jirima.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Kawulewule ɛɛ tao kpɔ ba kaa, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba sarahare baa dɛ ɛ voɡa ta la wa.”

english_verse: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Sɔfore, hé no! Israel tena, hé cheɡ deŋne! Koobii ɡe, hé no! N dɛ ba he waa bola dɛ́ pa bole. He do kɛŋɔ baa harɛ bel Mispa, dɛ do kɛŋɔ asau baa taa bɔle Tabɔ Bwejen ta.

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: Deŋnekpeɡ ne nɛŋkpoa tena kohona, mɛɛ tɛr he bwa deŋnee.

english_verse: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
translation_verse: Israel, n jemɛ he waa bwa a chɔ n sie. He nɛra waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, baa men Korowii tomɛ kpa.

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: Ba we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ baa won berɛ ba men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ be. Jwaman we-ɛɛla ɡboo su ba liire ta. Baa men Korowii jemɛ.

english_verse: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
translation_verse: Israel tena mbarafo ɛ danseɛ kɛ ba di bolchɔɡe. Ba wechɔɡa ɡelɔ ba lɔ naa dɛ chole, Juda tena ɡe ja ba nɛɛ lɔ naa dɛ chole.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ ba peera ne nae ɛ saraha dɛɛ nyin men Korowii bɔr aa, baa men na. N laa n te kpɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ mɛ, ba le n habɔɔ, sɛmbii ɡboo baa loɡle. Ba Korobifala Tɔpejena dii, ɛɛ chɔɡ ba ne ba kooni bwaa.

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: Hé hoh laa bɛla Gebea, dɛ́ hooh Rama ɡe. Hé do laa lɔŋɔ Bɛt Avɛn. Bɛnjamen dea tena, hé ir dɛ́ tɔ sie.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Israel harɛ ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ, awola maa ba tɛr o nɛra deŋne la. Israel deene bwa bee mɛɛ bol waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ aa dɛ ba bala.

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: Juda sitɔɔla do kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛra baa dɛ huɡri harɛre jwɛh bwea. N baah ɛɛ di ba nɛɛ kohonaa, kɛŋɔ nee aa sua dɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa la ken.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ fiiɡi Israel tena, ba pa ba bolchɔɡe dɛ tiɡ ba do harɛ, hwɛɡa baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ voɡsale ta la wa.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ Israel tenaa kɛ koŋɡaahla aa dɛ chɔɡ kwaa la, dɛ́ ɛ Juda tena ɡe kɛŋɔ kon waa pɔah.

english_verse: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
translation_verse: Israel tena na ba weela, asɛ Juda tena ɡe na ba ŋwɛra, asɛ Israel la Asiiria koojen be ŋɔ ó ba cha ba. Kɛ o ta wone chah ba weela, o ta wone chah ba ŋwɛra ɡe.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ nyujente ken Israel harɛ ne Juda tena bini. Mɛɛ toɡri ba olaa, dɛ́ che ba kaa nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: Ásɛ n berɛ kaa n buɡ ta bela maa lole ka tel kɛŋɔ baa sɛh ba chɔɡre. Baa dɛɛ nyin n sie dɛ na, ásɛ a noo ba aa, bá ɡaaɡe n bɔr sibeɡra ne.”

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: Israel tena berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya berɛ kaa Korowii be. Onee toɡri ya ola, wɛɛ berɔ chah yaa. O do yaa bola, kɛ wɛɛ vɔrɔwe ya ŋwɛraa.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Tɔpera anɛ habɔɔ la wɛɛ lawɛ yaa ir, tɔpetooro wee la, wɛɛ berɔ ba ya ne ya buɡ ta, ásɛ ya do o sie.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya takapɔ dɛ́ jemɛ Korowii, ya do sie dɛɛ yaradao. Wɛɛ ba ya bee kɛŋɔ chɔɔlen wee ken. Wɛɛ bao kɛ bwaala, kɛŋɔ yoo saŋ bwaala aa wola vɛh la.”

english_verse: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Ń ɛ heyaa ɛrɔɔ, Israel ne Juda tena? He nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ la do kɛŋɔ chɔɔbɔr kɔɔla, ne chɔɔlen mɛn aa wola biɡri la ken.

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: A waa n tomɛ n keamere he be, waa bola dɛ́ pa bole ne he kpoora wa. N waa bola dɛ́ pa bole do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa nyɛɡla ken he nɛ.

english_verse: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: He dɛ na dɔŋa sum aa, anee mɛɛ nyin dɛ ɡwaa kɛ haa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ. Men Korowii jema hiah mɛ ɡwaa sarahare ɛɛ dɛ́ fuah.

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: Ba chɔɡ n ne ba fɔo la kɛŋɔ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ Adam ken. Ba le n habɔɔ harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡa ne nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra ɡboo su bwɛjen Gelead bwa.

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: Sɔfore la do kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛra dɛ sɔh kpɔɡ bini. Ba dɛ kpoo nɛra Sɛkem ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa ɛ sihihwaa bwa soo siwi.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: N na wedoŋa ane Israel tena bini, ba dɛ tomɛ voɡa, ba kah doŋa.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: He Juda tena ɡe, n do tɔpere dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne waa haa dɛ ɛ la wa.”

english_verse: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛlbwa men Korowii aa ŋɔ ń chah n nɛra Israel tena dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔ kwaa ja la, ba nyubinikpeɡ ne ba wechɔɡa ɡboo mɛɛ na. Ba dɛ faah dɔŋa, dɛ jo deene dɛɛ ŋwɛ, dɛɛ ŋwɛ nɛra kwaa fɔɡbaahna.

english_verse: No one realizes that I have seen their sins surround them like a flood.
translation_verse: Baa lii kɛŋɔ n jemɛ ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la bwa. Ba wechɔɡa ɡwaa ba nɛ, a bwa chɔ n sie.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Ba nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla dɛ lɛ kooro sie, ba nomonome ɡe sie ɛɛ lɛ nyosone baa dɛ teŋe ta.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kooro tɔpejen bɛl dii ta la, nomonome la nyɔ sen dɛɛ, asɛ kooro ne sennyɔɔra la dɛɛ, dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛnewa.

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: Ba bandia la do kɛŋɔ fononoo bini nii ken, ba kpɔ kpoo ba koranar. Ba koranar bwa serewɔ, kɛ nomɛlbwa aa men soŋe ŋɔ ń chao.

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Israel tena kpɔ ba te dɛɛ koo harɛre aa bar ba nɛra bini. Ba do kɛŋɔ paanoo o baŋ pera ɡbo aa bea.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Nɛŋhɔɔhraa dɛɛ di kpeɡri ba nɛ, kɛ baa jemɛ. Ba nyumpona pa mun dɛɛ to, kɛ baa jemɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel tena mbarafo dɛ di danseɛ ba wechɔɡa wa, kɛ anɔ bwa habɔɔ, baa berɛ dɛɛ ba men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la be, kɛɛ dɛ́ nyin n bɔr.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ta asawii dɛ́ laɡ ba, kɛŋɔ baa dɛ lawɛ jumbii ken, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Bá bwɛɛlɛ! Ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ. Waa dawɛ ba nɛ, ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ n nɛ. N pɛla lole kɛŋɔ n fee lɛɛ ba, kɛ ba teŋe nyosone dawɛ n nɛ.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Baa men soŋe kasinteŋ ne, ba chɔ harɛ dɛɛ wi kɛŋɔ voɡtoroma. Ba boa nyoa dɛɛ soŋ mɛ mea ne senfala, kɛ dɛ laa ba te kpɔ n nɛɛ kɛ voɡtoroma. Deŋnekpeɡ tena bane le!

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Menee dɛɛ ba, dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri, kɛ ba dɛ vɔrɔwe n wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Ba teŋɔ berɛ habɔɔ dɛɛ kpo men Nemenɛ Korowii, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡ waa wola kpeɡri dɔe, ba do kɛŋɔ to waa sɔɔhna ken. Laa taa baa ba ba nomonome kpoora, ba mbarafo wobol wa, ásɛ Ijipt tena mam ba.”

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Hé hoh laa bɛla. He dɔma dɛ ba he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kee aa le nyundua dɛɛ tu la, chɔɡa haa chɔɡ n ne he fɔo, ne deŋnekpeɡ haa ɛa men Mmarare ta la wa.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Kɛ ane a bwa, Israel tena wio dɛɛ yer mɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, ya jemɛ.’

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Israel tena vɛh waa aa wera, anomanta, ba dɔma ɛɛ ti ba a waa.

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: Ba cheɡ koranar maa wola a waa jemɛ, dɛ le nomonome le n habɔɔ. Ba kpɔ ba ɡbaɡba suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ɛ voɡa dɛ kpɔ chɔɡ ba te.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Suuɡaswɛm Samaria tena aa kpɔa ɛ nabale la ɡelɔ n baah di ba nɛ, bá kpɔ viɡri. Saŋ besoo baa ba voɡa toma ɡela ɔ?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Israel harɛ taa voɡ la le, Israel tee loɡɔ, men Korowii laa. Samaria nabale la, baa kuuɡu buruburu ken.

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Ba du peu dɛ ɡel mea, anomanta, kawulewulee baa ba koma. Mea aa wola bie dɔe ta kondikwaa dɔe. Dɛ a dɔ bie kwaraa naa, nɛŋhɔɔhraa dɛɛ ba a dii.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Israel tena waa tonɔ, ba do kɛŋɔ konsala harɛre nɛra bini.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Ba joɔ kaa Asiiria harɛ ta, kɛŋɔ keeɡo kpaŋi waa pere o te dɛɛ ɡaaɡe ken, dɛ yoɡ ba te tɛ Asiiria ne harɛre tena bane bá cha ba.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Ba yoɡ ba te tɛ ɡɛ te, kɛ taraken mɛɛ berɔ boa ba nyoa. Baa na hɔhɔrɔwa kohonaa Asiiria koojen nɔn ta.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: Israel tena aa ɛ kwaa baa ɛ saraha a ta aa warɛ la, dɛ ɡɛɛ ba wechɔɡa ɡe ɛɛ warɛ.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: N chwerɛ waa taeh, dɛ le me Mmara la bini tɛɛ ba, kɛ ba liira harɛ bɛl ta wa.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ dɛɛ chwe a ola, men Korowii, n sie aa a ta lɛ. Mɛɛ lii ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ laanee, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne a wa. Baa berɔ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: Israel tena ma kooderemi, dɛ soh men Korowii maa ta ba wa. Juda tena ma dekpeɡa bwɛjena ta taeh. Kɛ mɛɛ kpɔ niinii ba ta ba bwɛjena ta, ásɛ a fuh ba dekpeɡa bwa.”

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Hosia ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ harɛre ane nɛra. Dɛkalkɛ he le Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la habɔɔ. Mea pɛla bɛlbwa haa cheme o ta la, he sie dɛ lɛ jwamansuuɡa ta.

english_verse: But you will run short of grain and wine,
translation_verse: Mea ne sen aa heyaa tela ba, ásɛ senfala ɡe aa lee do.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Korowii aa ɡel Israel tena so o harɛ la ta, baa berɔɔ ka so Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka di kwaa baa kia Asiiria harɛ ta.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Baa won kpɔ sen ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii kpa, kwaa baa kpoo dɛ́ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo la aa o sie lɛɛ ba. Ba kondikwaa baa dɛ ba a dii la bwa ɛɛ ɡeloo bá kah doŋa kɛŋɔ lwe mun kondikwa. Nomɛlbwa waa dia la kah doŋa. Ba ɡboo dɛ́ dia, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá ba a ne Korowii Dea.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Tɔpejena dii Korowii aa lea cheɡ la telo aa, ɛrɛɛ baa ba ɛɛ yɔ?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Dɛ wekpeɡa chiɡo asɛ ba lɔ peɡre aa, Ijipt tena ɛɛ boa ba nyoaa, ásɛ dɛ ba sewɔ aa, bá huɡ ba bwɛjen Mɛmfes. Jabalnadaŋɛre ɛɛ kpeɡuu tɔ ba kondɔɔh aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa la bwa ta, ásɛ sɔɔhne ne kpɔɡa moɡɛ tɔ bela ba deene fa aa cheɡa la.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Tɔpera Korowii aa tɛr ba deŋne la dɛ tel, tɔpere waa bɔ ba kem la telo. Gel Israel tena jemɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ. Ba wechɔɡa warɔ, ba ɡaeh we-ɛɛla ɡe do kan nomanta, ba ŋɔ Korowii keame la ɡɛnɔ, nɛn Korowii Doma aa lɔ o nɛɛ la ɛ choɡla te.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ men Hosia keame dɛ tom mɛ ŋɔ ń bol waa baɡle o nɛra Israel tena. Kɛ bobɛlbwa maa la la, ba dɛ har mɛ bela kɛŋɔ jumbie ken. Korowii Dea kwara, banee n dɔma.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Ba nɛra sen yawa lɛ ba liire to, kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ ba fa aa lɔ bwɛjen Gebea la. Korowii ɛɛ lii ba nyubinikpeɡ laanee, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne a wa.”

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ saŋ maa na he Israel tena la, n sie lɛo kɛŋɔ maa na ɡrepo nɔna pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken. Maa na he naawa la, a do kɛŋɔ maa na fiɡ nɔnloɡle waa swɛɛra ken. Kɛ baa bera ka tomɛ voɡ Baal Bwejen Peɔ la, ba waa doŋo kɛ voɡ la ken.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Israel tena jirima ɛɛ le ba nɛɛ kaa kɛŋɔ jumbie aa ira kaa la ken, baa biirii loɡle tɛɛ ba kpa, haahna aa teenee kpoŋe, baa teene ɡee jo kpa.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Ba loɡlɔ kwaraa naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo ba di biseo, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa aa wola ka. Dɛ n laa n te kpɔ ba nɛ aa, bá bwɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ maa na Israel tena la, dɛ ba do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa soɡe Taaya harɛ waa do wer la ta ken. Kɛ taraken, ba le ba bii tɛ ŋɔ bá kpoo.”

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Ate, Hosia ŋɔ, “Korowii, bɔkwaa ń soŋe tɛɛ baɔ? Bɛ ɡel ba haahna lolɛ, bɛ ɡel ba dɔ elnee ba bii ɔr.”

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Ba nyubinikpeɡ la pa mun Gelɡal, belaa n le hah ba. Ba wechɔɡa nomanta, mɛɛ doŋ baa le n Dem. Maa ba waa nyin kpa, ba nomonome bwa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Israel tena do kɛŋɔ daa o lune bwa aa hola waa wola nɔnɛ. Ba loɡle bii dɛɛ nyin ba kohona kwaraa naa, mɛɛ kpoo baa.”

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la vɛɛh ba, dɛkalkɛ ba ta o waa ta teŋɛ. Baa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe harɛre taa, baa bɔree dɔ so.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Israel tena fa do kɛŋɔ ɡrepo da, asɛ nɔna su o bwa. Ba kondɔɔh do kɛŋɔ ɡrepo nɔna ken, aa dɛ warɛ la, dɛ ba dɛ ɛ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta aa warɛ. Harɛ la dɛ ɛ kondikwaa kohona naa, ɡɛɛ ba ɡe ɛɛ paaɡe bwea aa wera kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ duura.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Nyosone ɡboo su ba bwa a chɛ kɛ bá di bolchɔɡe a wa. Korowii ɛɛ paɡre ba saraha kwaa, dɛ́ chɔɡ bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura laanee.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Belaa baa ba ŋɔe ŋɔ, “Ya ta kooro dɔe, dɛkalkɛ ya ta Korowii duure. Ya dɔ kooro kwaraa naa, bɔkwaa o fe ɛɛ ba ɛɛ tɛ yaa ɔ?”

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Ba baɡɛ nyoo taeh, dɛ teŋe nyosone dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ ba ne nɛra pɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa. Anomanta, kasinteŋ berɛ nyosone, kɛŋɔ koo baa parɔ kpɔɡchɔɡa ta che o ta.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjen Samaria ɛɛ ɔmɛ suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔa loɡɛ nabale o do bwɛjen Bɛt Avɛn la waa. Ba ne sɔfore baa dɛ tomɔ la bwa ɛɛ wiu kɛrɛdɛ, ba sie aa o we-ɛɛla taa lɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba laa kpɔ le ba be kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Baa cheo kaa Asiiria harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ka bɔ toɔ tɛ koojen waa lɔ bela la. Sihiih ɛɛ kpo Israel tenaa, baa di sihiih voɡa baa sɛah la waa.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ Samaria tena ne ba kooroo kaa, kɛŋɔ nee aa palɛ daa dɛɛ kaa la ken.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Voɡa aa lɔ bwea dor bwɛjen Bɛt Avɛn, bela Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la, dɛ ba chɔɡa. Sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛre ɛɛ leo tɔ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡa bwa. Ásɛ ba ŋɔ bwejena ne deŋɡarere be ŋɔ, “Hé choɡli tɔ ya nɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena ta wechɔɡa baa ɛɛ mɛ la ɡelɛ. Gɛ saŋ baa lea ɛ wechɔɡa bwɛjen Gebea la. Anomanta, laa taa baa ba serewa Gebea.

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, ásɛ harɛre ta nɛra pɛ dɛ́ ba tɛr ba deŋne ba wechɔɡa kohona la wa.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: Israel tena do kɛŋɔ nalor baa baɡlo mea lɔe, o sie ɛɛ lɛ a ta. Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ daa dawɛ o baŋa ta wɛɛ parɛ. Mɛɛ teŋɛ Israel tena nɛɛ ásɛ Juda tena ɛɛ parɛ. Israel tena bwa ɡe ɛɛ buɡli harɛ.

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he waa toɡre, ásɛ dɛ dɔ nyina waa wola jaɡa dɔe. Hé pwɛr he bambile waa kpeɡa, kɛŋɔ harɛ waa hola. Saŋ telo kɛ hé nyin men Korowii bɔr mɔɔ n bala tel, ásɛ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heyaa kohona.

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Kɛ a ɛo kɛŋɔ haa du wechɔɡa dɛ komɛ wechɔɡa. He di he nyosone la nɔna. Haa kpɔ he te dawɛ he bokpeɡa ta, ne he laa tena baa wara dɛ jemɛ yoi nɛɛ nomanta,

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: he nɛra ɛɛ no laa ɡbɔɡaa, ásɛ he dekpeɡa bwa chɔɡ. Aa doo kɛŋɔ Kooro Salman aa kpɔ laa ba chɔɡ bwɛjen Bɛt Aabɛl, dɛ kpoo haahna ne ba bii bil la.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba he Bɛtel tena nɛɛ chiɡa, dɛkalkɛ he wechɔɡa kan kohona. Awola tɔpere laa la aa pa mun la, baa ba kpo Israel kooroo.”

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel fa aa do kɛ bechala la n nyinu, dɛ yerɔ le Ijipt harɛ ta kɛŋɔ n bie.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Kɛ maa teŋa dɛɛ yerɔ la, dɛ ɡɛɛ o teŋɛ dɛ jo dɛɛ kaa. N nɛra kpoo kwaa tɛ voɡa Baalre, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ voɡa.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Menee chaɡle Israel tena ba jemɛ vala, dɛ laɡ ba n nɔɔra ne ba ir che, kɛ ba ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee nyiŋi ba nɛ.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: Nyinaa n kpɔ laɡ ba ba n be, dɛ kpɔ ba chwaa. N laa koeh aa dawɛ ba nɛɛ la kpɔ, asɛ dɛ ba harɛ dɛ pa ba kondikwa.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: Ba vɛh ba liire chara dɛ́ ba n be, anomanta, a chɛ kɛ bá berɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka do Asiiria tena lɔɡa.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: N nɛra siwi beɡrɔ kɛ bá berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ. Baa wiu, dɛkalkɛ wejena dawɛ ba nɛ, kɛ nomɛlbwa aa laa kpɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: Israel tena, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona ɡel heya ɔ? Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona le heyaa tɛɔ? Mɛɛ won chɔɡ heyaa kɛŋɔ Adma tena aa? Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona chɔɡ heyaa kɛŋɔ Seboiim tena ɔ? N liire aa men ɡɛ baɡle, nyina maa dɛ nyin heyaa la kan taeh.

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: Maa n bandia kohona laanee kpɔ ba tɛr he deŋne, kɛɛ dɛ́ berɛ ba chɔɡ heyaa kpa. Korowiirii men, nɛwɛnyini laa men. N ɡboo Korowii Maa Do Goroŋ dɛ do he baah ta, maa n bandia ne he bee ba.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: Dɛ n kɔr n nɛra dɔma nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyujente aa, baa teŋɛ n nɛɛ. Baa le wee cholibɔree dɛ́ ba n be warane.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Baa kpɔ bochelaa dɛ́ ba kɛŋɔ Ijipt harɛ ta jumbii ken, kɛŋɔ Asiiria harɛ ta kwehre ken. Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ba so ba deremi ta ja. Men Korowiirii bola.” Israel tena wechɔɡa

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Nyosone ɡboo Israel tena teŋe dɛɛ tɛ mɛ, tɔpere bwaa baa neɡ mɛ. Juda tena ta dɛ ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ, men Korowii Maa Do Goroŋ dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ la.”

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: Israel tena wobɛlbwa ɛ wepɛɛ dɛɛ chɔɡ wa tɔpere te bɛlbwa. Ba chwao dɛɛ ti nyosone, asɛ naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla ɡe su ba bwa. Ba ne Asiiria tena fɔwɛ fɔo, ba ne Ijipt tena ɛɛ di bona.

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Korowii ne Juda tena dɔɔ, wɛɛ tɛr Israel tena deŋnee ɡɛ ba wechɔɡa aa doa wa, dɛ́ bɔ ba kem ɡɛ ba we-ɛɛla aa doa.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Ba nabaa Jekɔb ta aa lɔ o nya tea bini la, dɛ o lawɛ o kpar dɔŋ Esɔ nalume baa vuuɡi dɔŋa. Waa baa kpeɡ la, o ne Korowii su luɡe.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: Jekɔb ne nyundua torome su luɡe asɛ Jekɔb pɔ o nɛ, o wio dɛ soŋe nyundua torome la ŋɔ ó sweero andɛɛɡa. Korowii ba o be Bɛtel dɛ bol waa o be bela.

english_verse: So return to your God. Patiently trust him, and show love and justice.
translation_verse: Kɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ Jekɔb naanar, hé berɛ ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la be, hé kpoŋe nyina ne kasinteŋ, dɛɛ no o be saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Israel tena dɛ ɛ mbarafo dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔ suuɡa, dɛ ɛ dɔɔhna. Ya kondɔɔh bwa habɔɔ baa wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ya nɛɛ na.’

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la. Mɛɛ berɔɔ ɡel he so tɛnte deene bini ja, kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ he fa aa soɡe a bini tɔpejena dii maa lea cheɡ ta la.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: N bol waa keamere la be, dɛ ɡel ba na wepila taeh, dɛ che ba nɛɛ kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa he be dɛ ja heya.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Ane a bwa, Gelead tena dɛ tomɛ voɡa. Banɔ la baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la ɛɛ serewoo. Ba dɛ kpoo nabala dɛɛ ɛ saraha Gelɡal. Kwaa baa dɛ ɛ sarahare a ta la, ɛɛ chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ bwea aa dawɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ harɛ baa parɔ ta.”

english_verse: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.
translation_verse: Ya nabaa Jekɔb chwao kaa Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta. Waa dɛ nyin haah dɛ́ mo la, o kaa teɡɛ baa bɛl peera.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Korowii cheɡɛ o keame Mosis nɛɛ dɛ lawɛ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ɡel o nyiŋi ba nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I will make you pay for your violent crimes and for insulting me.
translation_verse: Kɛ Israel tena ɡelɔ o baah di kohona, Korowii baa dɛ tomɛ ɛɛ ɡeloo ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nɛ, dɛ́ bɔ ba kem waa baa ɛa wa.

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Efrem dea tena fa bol wa aa, Israel deene aa kaa la dɛ ɔmɛ, banee Israel tena ɛɛ duu. Kɛ Efrem dea tena tomɛ voɡ Baal, anomanta, baa serewoo.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: Ba ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa kohona, ba kpɔ ba suuɡapoŋa dɛɛ ɛ voɡa, ba ɛa a do wer kɛrɛdɛ, a bwa ɛ kwaa nɛra baa dɔ a wejema aa ɛa. Ba bol ɡɛ nɛra nɔ waa ŋɔ, “Ba kpoo nɛra dɛɛ ɛ saraha, dɛɛ mo voɡ baa ɛo kɛŋɔ nabale la lwɛɛma.”

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nomanta, baa nyoɡroo warane kɛŋɔ kɔɔla aa tɔa chɔɔbɔr, kɛŋɔ mɛn aa wola biɡri dɛ a leo la, kɛŋɔ haahra peu aa taa dɛ kpɔa le pɛla ta kaa la, dɛ do kɛŋɔ chuu aa kpɔ tokoro ta dɛɛ le.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ la. He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa yarada ka ja n nɛ. Lɛɛ bɛlbwa toole ka ja n nɛ.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: N nyiŋi he nɛɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, harɛ o ta aa do wɔrɔbe kohona.

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: Maa tɛ heyaa kondikwaa he di la, he vaɡrɔ, haa vaɡra la, he ɛ mbarafo asɛ dɛ soh n wa.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ ba he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyujente ken, kɛŋɔ noniete waa pɛl ŋwɛnɛ nyoa dɛɛ nyin kon dɛ́ lawɛ.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ba yo heyaa kɛŋɔ sisire bii aa nyoɡra wɛɛ ɛ la, dɛ́ ba peeɡe he bini. Dɛ́ di he ola buɡ la ta kɛŋɔ nyujente ken, dɛ́ toɡri he bini kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa aa dɛ ɛ la.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: Israel tena, he serewɔ, dɛkalkɛ he ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ.

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Hé ŋɔ ń tɛ heyaa kooro ne nomonome, asɛ n tɛ heya, kɛ ɛrɛɛ baa ba wona lɛ heya ɔ?

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Bandia nee n tɛ heyaa kooro, dɛ berɛ che bandia ta dɛ le o ne.

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ di bolchɔɡe, ba chwera do tɔn bini dɛ kwaara cheɡ.

english_verse: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.
translation_verse: Ba nyu som kɛ baa dɔ bɔr dɛ́ so, kɛ dɛ ɡɛn dɛ vɛh waa la. Ba do kɛ bechala baa dɛ ba o lola waa wola bala nyin.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛɛ ba le lalbɔɔ bini, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa. Seo, leperaa he weechɔɡa dɔɔ jaɔ? Lalbɔɔ, leperaa chɔɡa haa dɛ ba yaa chɔɡa dɔɔ? Maa tedomaa dɔ tɛ he Israel tena,

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: a lole kɛŋɔ he wer he bala bini. Mɛɛ ɡeloo peuchɔɡe ta le wee leebɔr, dɛ́ ta le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta. Nee aa won palɛ le neerare nyuune ta, ásɛ buli hweeh. Mɛɛ pa he kondɛɛɡaa le bela haa dɛ cheɡa la kaa.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: Samaria tena chɛ kɛŋɔ ba bolchɔɡe ɡure ba nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la deŋnekpeɡ. Laa taa baa ba ba kpoora, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ba bechale cha harɛ dɛ́ ya ba tekpoŋra teene.”

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé berɛ ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ be. He wechɔɡa ɡelɔ he choɡli!

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ he wesoŋa, dɛ́ berɛ ba Korowii be. Hé soŋo ŋɔ, “Kpɔ ya wechɔɡa bwa kɛ yaa, dɛ́ sune ya nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛ yaa, ásɛ ya kpɛɛre, ɡɛ yaa baɡɛ nyoa la.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiiria tena aa won lɛ yaa, ya jaɡre yaa dɛ la ane laa la aa won lɛ yaa. Yaa berɛ yerɛ kwaa ya ɡbabir aa kpɔ nɔɔra ɛ la, ya voɡa kpa, dɛkalkɛ hen Korowiirii dɔ tedoma tɛ bilalbii.”

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ berɔ lawɛ n nɛra ba n be, dɛ́ nyin ba waa n bambile bwa ne, dɛkalkɛ n bandia toole ba nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Baa kpeɡuu dɛ́ so le, ásɛ dɛ do wer kɛŋɔ ɔleve daa ken. Ba sɔɔh ɛɛ do somee kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn peleme daa ken.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Baa berɔ so ásɛ n kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛ. Israel tena ɛɛ parɛ mea, ásɛ ba wobɛlbwa do wer kɛŋɔ ɡrepo daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ kohona la. Ba sɔn ɛɛ leo kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta sen ken.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Israel tena aa voɡaa tomɛ kpa. Mɛɛ no ba wesoŋaa ásɛ dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ. N do kɛŋɔ daa waa wola chure ken, n chunchule ɛɛ tɔ ba nɛɛ, ba wer doe bwa le n be.”

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Umee wejereme ɔ? Naate ɛɛ jemɛ waa nɔɔ. Umee dɛɛ pese waɔ? Naate ɛɛ no a munii. Korowii ŋwɛnɛre toɡrɔ, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ teŋɛ a ta, kɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena dɛ lɔ naa a ta.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: Waa aa le Korowii be dɛ ba Pɛtoɛl bibaa Joel be laanee nɔ. Tontombɛ ane wa

english_verse: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
translation_verse: Nomonome, hé cheɡ deŋne no, hé no, he nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa. Waa nɔ dɔŋa chiɡ he bere saŋ kɛɛ he naawa bere saŋ ta ka aa?

english_verse: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.
translation_verse: Hé bola he bii be, ásɛ ba bola ba ɡe bii be, ba bii la ɡe bola ba naanar baa ka ba be.

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Sennyɔdɛɛra, hé ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ hɛɛ wi, hɛɛ wi senfala wa, dɛkalkɛ ɡrepo nɔna baa harama dɛɛ ɛ sen la bwa chɔɡɔ.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Tontombɛ la do kɛ laa tena dɛ ba yo n nɛra, a kpeɡri dɛ warɛ, aa wola nyoa dɔe, a nyena do kɛŋɔ nyujente nyena ken.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ wi kohona kɛŋɔ bitolo aa liɡe lweyal dɛɛ wi o bechajaa waa sewa la ken.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Mea ne sen sarahare toole Korowii Dea kpa. Sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la bwa dɛ wi a wa.

english_verse: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
translation_verse: Kooni bwa chɔ pɛɛ, asɛ harɛre bwa hol, mea ɡe bwa chɔɡ, ɡrepo nɔna bwa ɡe hol, ɔleve daa bwa chɔɡɔ.

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Paara, hɛ́ɛ di suna, hé nɛra haa dɔ ɡrepo daa kooni ɡe ɛɛ wi, mea bwa soo siwi chɔɡɔ, kondikwaa bwa chɔɡɔ kwaraa.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Grepo ne fiɡ daa bwa holɔ, ɡɛɛ daa bɛlbwa waa dɛ nɔnɛ sewɛ. Kasinteŋ, nomɛlbwa ta silɛɛ dɔe kpa. Liire chara wa

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Sɔfore, hé kpɔ lweyale tɔ dɛɛ wi, heyaa dɛɛ ɛ toma saraha kon la ta. Hé la Korowii Dea ka so jwaana bwa dɛɛ wi, dɛkalkɛ mea kɛɛ sen sarahare aa Korowii Dea ba kpa.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Hé yerɛ nɛra bwa ba cheme, bá vɔwɛ nyoa. Hé yerɛ harɛ la nomonome bwa ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ Dea, dɛ́ ba wi noo bela.

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Ya kondikwaare dɛ chɔɡ yaa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa, silɛɛ bɛlbwa toole Korowii Dea kpa.

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Harɛ holɔ anomanta, kondwee bwa pɔɔh. Deene baa dɛ cheɡ kondikwaa a bini bwa kuuɡo, dɛkalkɛ mea toole bá kpɔ do a bini.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Ya nae bwa dɛ wi dɛɛ di suna, a ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ ɡaaɡe ka di, hale peera bwa bwara dɛ nyɛɡ.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, henee n wi dɛɛ no, nii fuh kondɛɛra dibɔra, dɛ fuh kpɔɡ bini daa bwa.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Hale kpɔɡ bini ola wio dɛɛ noe, dɛkalkɛ nenabɔɔne hweehrɔ, asɛ nii fuh kondɛɛra dibɔra.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Hé hoh bɛla kohona Saayɔn, Korowii bwe waa do ɡoroŋ la ta. Hé nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa hé ɡel he bwara ɛɛ chel, Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la dɛ ba, o telo tonɛ.

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Bɔr dɛ ba bira a ɡɛ saŋ, ásɛ baama tɔ bobɛlbwa. Tontombɛ ɛɛ wuruu ba tɔ bwejena ta, kɛŋɔ laa tena baa kpeɡa kohona ken. A dɔŋa ta chiɡe bwa, aa chiɡ saŋ bɛlbwa ɡe bwa.

english_verse: Fiery flames surround them; no one escapes. Before they invaded, the land was like Eden; now only a desert remains.
translation_verse: A dɛ chɔɡ kwaa kɛŋɔ nii yon fuh kwaa dɛ chɔɡa la. Harɛ waa chɔ a sie do kɛ Korowii bodɛɛɡe Eden ken, asɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ chɔ a habɔɔ, komɛlbwa aa won chwa le a be.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: A ɡbɔɡa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore sii ken, dɛ ɡah dɛɛ ɡale bwejena, a kena ɛɛ si kɛŋɔ nii aa dɛ fuh kpɔɡ ɛɛ parame la. A do kɛŋɔ laa tena baa kpeɡa kohona, dɛ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ la ka yo laa ken.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: A dɛ yo kɛŋɔ laa tena aa dɛ yo nɛra ken, dɛɛ teeh danjwɛɛre. A bwa dɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, aa berɛ dɛɛ le a ŋwɛnɛ ta.

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: Aa dɔŋa taɡɛ, bɛlbwa pa sie dɛɛ kaa. A dɛ jo bela waa kpeɡa dɛ́ le, wobɛlbwa aa wola an ɛ.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: A iro kpɔ bwɛjen la danjwɛɛre ta dɛ ka jo deene bini, kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛra yon kpɔ tokorore ta dɛɛ jo deene bini la.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: A dɛ ba naa, dɛ harɛ dɛ jiɡri, nyundua ɡe ɛɛ yiiɡi. Biro dɛ tɔ wee ne korobie ta, weweela ɡe aa won chaah kpa.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Korowii tɔ o laa tena sie dɛ nyɛɡ, a do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra ken, o laa tena la ta nyoa dɔe, ba ɛ banyoola dɛɛ no o deŋna wa. Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la ɔma kohona. Umee dɛ́ won che a nyoa ɔ? Liire chara wa

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “A ta mun kae, hé charɛ he liire, dɛ́ kpɔ he bambile bwa tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ wi kohona.

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: He bɛ he laala kɛɛ á baɡle he suna dii, hé ɡel he suna dii baɡle kɛ he bambile chɔɡɔ.” Hé charɛ he liire dɛ́ berɛ ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ be, o bambile too dɛ dɔ tedoma tɛ nɛn. O baah aa di warawara, o nyina ta jaɡa dɔe. O kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ ba saŋ bɛlbwa, waa wola ba deŋne tɛr.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: O ken ɛɛ na ya sumii dɛ́ charɛ o liire, dɛ́ swee yaa andɛɛɡa, ásɛ ya dɔ mea ne sen kohona dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ sarahare tɛo.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Hé hoh bɛla Saayɔn Bwejen ta, dɛ́ boa nɛra nyoa, bá vɔwɛ nyoa á baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna.

english_verse: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.
translation_verse: Hé boa nɛra la nyoa, dɛ́ laa ba doŋa kpɔ ba nɛ. Hé boa nomonome nyoa, dɛ́ yerɛ bechale bá ba cheme, hale bechasɔɔhne baa dɛ ɔr. Hanfale ne o jaa le ba dea baa soɡe o bini ba.

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Hé sɔfore haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii o Dea doonyoa ne saraha kon baah ta la, hé wi dɛ́ soŋo ŋɔ, “Ya Naa Korowii, sune yan yaa ɛ he nɛra nɛ, bɛ ɡel harɛ nɛra bane mamɛ yaa dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ?’ ” Korowii berɔ ɡel harɛ la do som

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Anee ɡela Korowii sie ba o nɛra nɛ, dɛ sune ba nɛ harɛ la ta.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Korowii chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa mea ne senfala ne ɔleve noo kohonaa a maɡre he ne. Maa ɡel harɛre ta nɛra mamɛ heyaa kpa.

english_verse: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
translation_verse: Harɛ, bɛ ɔmɛ, ɡel he sie lɛ he hɛɡre. Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛ wejena.

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Kpɔɡ bini ola, he bɛ ɔmɛ, ola dibɔra kpɔɡa dɛ moɡɛ. Daa ɡe ɛɛ nɔnɛ, fiɡ ne ɡrepo nɔna ɡe warɛ.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: Saayɔn tena, hé ɡel he sie lɛ, hɛɛ hɛɡre Korowii haa dɛ tomɛ nɛ yoo bwaala ne bwaala loɡla waa tɛ heya kɛrɛdɛ wa. O ɡelɔ bwaala nɛ heyaa kohona.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Mea lɔbɔra bwa ɛɛ su meaa, ásɛ ɔleve noo ne senfala su vɛɛhna dɛ́ɛ ta.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ dɔ kondikwa kohonaa di dɛ́ vaɡre, ásɛ dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la, o ɛ nyokpowaa tɛ heya, sihiih aa n nɛraa kpo kpa.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Anee dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ kɛ n ja he nɛɛ Israel harɛ, menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, nomɛlbwa toole kpa. Sihiih aa n nɛraa kpo bwa.” Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “A habɔɔ la, mɛɛ tɛ nɛra bwa soo siwii n Doma la kohonaa, ásɛ he bibaala ne bihaahna bwa bol n waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa kerekere la, ásɛ he bonɔɔna na chaahna, ásɛ he banjeni dee deera.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ la, mɛɛ ɡeloo n Doma ba so n bonɔɔna ne toli bwa nɛ.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa nyundua ne harɛ taa, ásɛ nɛra na chal ne nii ne ninchuu kohona.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Wee dɛ ba bira, ásɛ korobie swɛɛ kɛŋɔ chal ken, mɔɔ Korowii Tɔpejen waa do ɔma la ba.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa wi yerɛ men Korowii la, mɛɛ lɛo. Saayɔn Bwejen ne Jerusalam taa nɛra ɛɛ ba ba nyu dɔe, ɡɛ men Korowii aa bola ŋɔ, ‘Ba bini bane ɛɛ chwao le Jerusalam, kɛ banɔ la maa lee ba tɛ n te la ɛɛ dɔ ba nyuu.’ ”

english_verse: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Saŋ maa lea cheɡ la telo aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam tena wobɛlbwa berɛ do wer tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
translation_verse: Mɛɛ boa harɛre nɛra nyoa dɛ́ ba bane Jehosafat Fɛlembɔjen bini. Belaa mɛɛ ba ń ba bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole, waa bwa baa kpɔa ɛ n nɛra Israel tena la, dɛkalkɛ ba lɔ ba peɡre harɛre nɛra bini dɛ bɔne n harɛ.

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: Ba ta bie n nɛra nɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ nɛra baa dɔ bá ɛ ba yoma, ba yoɡ ba bibaala ne bihaahna, dɛ kpɔ ba suuɡa bɔ hanjwamanere ne sen kem.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: Nɛra haa lɔ bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon dɛ harɛre aa lɔ Filisti bwa, bɔkwa waa n ne he dɔɔ? He dɛ bɔ mɛ waane maa ɛ heyaa kem kɛɛ? Dɛ kemee hɛɛ bɔ mɛ tenaa, mɛɛ ɡeloo a berɛ ba ɡure he nyu ta warane.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ n suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ n kondɛɛɡa kaa ka cheɡ he voɡa deene bini.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: He lawɛ Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam tena le ba harɛ ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta, dɛ ka yoɡ ba tɛ Grik tena.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba n laɡ ba le harɛre haa yoɡ ba tɛ la ta, ásɛ waa haa ɛɛ ba la ɡure he nyu ta.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: Mɛɛ yoɡ he bibaala ne bihaahnaa tɛ Juda harɛ ta tena, ásɛ ba ɡe yoɡ ba tɛ Seba tena baa soɡe bojaŋ harɛ ta la.” Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “Hé bol harɛre nɛra be ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ka yo laa! Bá yerɛ banyoola la bwa, dɛ́ boa laa tena la bwa nyoa bá ba yo!

english_verse: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.”
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he para loɡɛ tokobie dɛ́ beɡre he ɡoori lampeare. Asɛ nɛra baa ɡwɛɡra ɡe ŋɔ, ‘Ya bwara kpeɡri!’

english_verse: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
translation_verse: Harɛre aa bara cheme bwa nɛra, hé le ba ka boa nyoa warane fɛlembɔjen la bini.” N Naa Korowii, ba he banyoola ne dɛ́ ba yoo ba.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Ba nyu bini kpeɡri kohona. Teŋ ba ta kɛŋɔ mea koma saŋ ba yon teŋni a daa la. Tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba yon tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ a nee yon su kwa, hale dɛɛ ta la.

english_verse: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
translation_verse: Nɛra kaɡboŋa baa wola nyoa dɔe, lɔ Jehosafat Fɛlembɔjen bini. Dɛkalkɛ, Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la telo tonɛ, fɛlembɔjen la bini.

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Korobie ne wee aa lɔ, ásɛ bɔr bir, weweela ɡe aa chaah kpa.

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ kɔroo le Saayɔn Bwejen ta, o taa do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ kɔɡre ken, o le Jerusalam dɛɛ ba, nyundua ne harɛ ɛɛ jiɡri. Korowii ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ ken, ásɛ o nɛra chwa kaa marɔ. Korowii ɛɛ swee o nɛra andɛɛɡaa

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: “Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, n soɡe n Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta. Jerusalam ɛ bwɛjen maa lea cheɡ o do ɡoroŋ, nɛŋhɔɔhra aa won ba yo dɛ́ pɔ n nɛra nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: Saŋ la telo aa, daa kooni ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ tɔ bwejena ta, nae warɛ do deŋɡarere bwa ta, ásɛ Juda harɛ nenabɔɔne bwa ɡe su ne. Nenapale bɛl ɛɛ palɔɔ le Korowii Dea dɛ́ kaa Akaasia Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ́ sɔɔh bela harɛ la bwa.

english_verse: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
translation_verse: Ijipt harɛ dɛ ba pɛɛ chɔe, ásɛ Edom harɛ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, yoi baa kaa yo Juda harɛ ta tena, dɛ kpoo nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ la wa.

english_verse: I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpoora maa wola kpɔe kɛ ba la, mɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛ ba, ásɛ dɛ ka so Saayɔn Bwejen ta.”

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Baa bɛl sɔne Emɔs, dɛ o ɛ peteɡre dɛ so Tekoa. Korowii pili waane aa dɛ ba Israel harɛ ta bala baɡlo chaahna ta, bene anɛ mɔɔ harɛ jiɡra bɛl chiɡ Israel harɛ ta. Gɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Ussia di kora Juda harɛ ta, asɛ Jehoas bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam ɡe di kora Israel harɛ ta.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Damaskɔs tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne. Ba lɔɔ Gelead tena nyubinikpeɡ ne, kɛŋɔ baa lɔ mea pɛla ta ken.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ba fuh koodem Kooro Hasael aa doo laanee, dɛ́ ba fuh Kooro Bɛn Hadad dekpeɡa la, dɛ́ chɔɡa.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kuuɡi bwɛjen Damaskɔs doonyoa ɡbenii, dɛ́ ir nɛra baa soɡe Bɛn Avɛn Fɛlembɔjen, ne kooro waa dɛ di kora Bɛt Eden. Baa lawɛ Siiria tena laa taa kaa Kir harɛ ta. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Gasa tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne. Ba lawɛ harɛbir nɛra laa ta, dɛ ka yoɡ ba yoma tɛ Edom tena.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh danjwɛjena aa bar bwɛjen Gasa la, dɛ́ fuh o dekpeɡa bwa, dɛ́ chɔɡa.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ir koranar baa lɔ bwɛjena Asdɔd ne Askɛlɔn kora taa. Mɛɛ tɛr bwɛjen Ekron tena deŋnee, ásɛ Filisti tena baa kaa la bwa serewe. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Taaya tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne. Ba lawɛ harɛbir nɛra laa ta kaa bojaŋ Edom harɛ ta, ba ta beŋkpoŋri fɔo ba ne baa fɔwa la ta teŋɛ.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh danjwɛjena aa bar bwɛjen Taaya, dɛ́ fuh o dekpeɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Edom tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne. Ba kpɔ keri kpoo ba lolanar Israel tena, ba ta tedoma dɔe tɛɛ ba, ba bandia ta jaɡa dɔe, waa sɔɔh bwa.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh bwɛjen Teman, dɛ́ fuh bwɛjen Bosra dekpeɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡa.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Amɔn tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne. Ba yo laa dɛɛ nyin ba harɛ do kan, anomanta, ba kpoo Gelead tekpoŋra, dɛ ya ba teene.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh danjwɛjena aa bar bwɛjen Raba dɛ́ chɔɡ ba dekpeɡa. Dɔma ɛɛ do lɔŋɔree dɛ́ ba yoo ba awola, kɛŋɔ kawulewule aa dɛ ta ken.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ Raba kooro ne o nomonome laa taa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Moab tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne. Ba ta Edom kooro bui, ba huɡri o hoɡa, dɛ fuah a berɛ tɔɔ.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh Moab harɛ, dɛ́ fuh dekpeɡa aa bar bwɛjen Kereɔt. Moab tena ɛɛ serewoo, a ɡɛ saŋ laa tena aa dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa dɛɛ hoh laa bɛle la.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpo Moab kooro ne o nomonome baa ja o nɛɛ bwaa. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Juda tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne a wa. Ba vɛh me Mmarare la, ba ta waa maa do ba a ta teŋɛ, dɛ le n waa ta, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa ba naawa fa aa toma la.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh Juda harɛ, dɛ́ fuh Jerusalam dekpeɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡa.” Korowii pa Israel tena bolchɔɡe

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne a wa. Ba yoɡ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛ di kema baa wola won bɔ la. Ba lɛ suuɡapoŋa ba ka ɛ yoma, dɛ yoɡ nyaara baa di kema, kema la suuɡa aa wola won yawɛ naŋɡawa ɡba.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Ba tiɡri nyaara dɛɛ do harɛ kɛŋɔ teera ken, dɛ vɛh nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba waa bola dɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta. Mɛɛ ne o bie bwa pɛ hahbeŋkpoŋ, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah men Korowii sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Bobɛlbwa baa dɛ tom mɛ la, ba pa yale baa lɛa cheɡ awɔba la dɛɛ chɔ a ta. Ba cheme n Dea aa, suuɡa baa faah nɛra dɛ lɛ le ba be la, a nee baa nyɔ sene.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: Israel tena siwi taa n chɔɡ Amɔre tena kwaraa, dɛ ba kpekpeɡo ba bwara do kpeɡri, kɛŋɔ peleme daa ne dajena ken, asɛ n chɔɡ a nɔna ne a lune.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Menee lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ heyaa kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bene fifraanaarɛ, dɛ ba kpɔ Amɔre tena harɛ tɛ heya.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: N berɔ le he bibaala la bini bane ba ɛ n keamere, ba bini bonɔɔna la bini bane ɡe ɛ Nasiri tena. Israel tena, n teŋe nyosone naa? Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: Kɛ he ɡelɔ Nasiri tena nyɔ sen, dɛ do n keamere ŋɔ ba bɛ n waa aa dɛ ba bala la ka bol.

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: Taraken, mɛɛ tiɡrii do harɛ kɛŋɔ torɔɡo yon che bone kohona dɛ tire kon ta la.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa won chwae la aa won le a nyoa, bokpeɡa tena ɛɛ ɛo kahonɛ, banyoo bɛlbwa ɡe aa won lɛ o nyu.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa jemɛ hɛm tae ɡba aa won che a nyoa, laa te bɛlbwa waa won chwae aa won le a nyoa, nɛn waa soɡe jaaɡɔ ta ɡba aa won lɛ o nyu.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Hale banyoola ba bambile aa kpeɡa, ɛɛ chwao ɡel ba dɔmkwaa awola tɔpere, Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, he no waa aa le n be dɛɛ ba he harɛbir nɛra maa lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la nɛ.

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: He ɡboo ɛ nɛra maa le heya tɛ n te harɛre nɛra bwa bini, a waa a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr he deŋne he wechɔɡa bwa waa la.” Korowii keame toma

english_verse: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
translation_verse: Nɛra banɛ nyoa ta pɛɛ yaa baa wono pɛ dɛ́ valaa?

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Nyujente dɛ si kɔr bini dɛ ol laa o dɔ lawaa? Wɛɛ do o bɔɔ binii dɛɛ ŋoo dɛ komɛl laa o lawɛ dɛɛ di aa?

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Ba ta bel harɛ aa jumbie ɛɛ ba le o taa o lawɔ waa? Bel won tae pɛɛ dɛ waane laa ɛo waa?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Laa bɛla sio bwɛjen bɛl ta naa, o nɛra aa ɔmaa? Wechɔɡa ane chiɡ bwɛjen bɛl nɛra nɛ aa, dɛ Korowii laa ɡela a ba ɡɛ naa?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii aa waanee ɛ, dɛ o ta a bini pile baɡle o bonɔɔna baa ɛ o keamere.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Nyujente kɔraa, umee wola ɔmɔɔ? Nemenɛ Korowii bol wa aa, umee wola la ka bol o waa aa dɛ ba bala laɔ?

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Emɔs ŋɔ Samaria nomonome be ŋɔ, “Hé la ka bol nɛra baa soɡe Asdɔd ne Ijipt dekpeɡa bini la be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ka cheme Samaria bwejena dor, dɛ́ na yoi we-ɛɛla ne fiiɡa baa dɛ fiiɡi nɛra bela.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Baa jemɛ waa aa wera la ɛ. Ba cheɡɛ laa ta, dɛ che laala su ba dekpeɡa bini.”

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɔma ɛɛ ba bar ba harɛɛ cheme, dɛ́ kuuɡi dekpeɡa, dɛ́ pa ba dejena bini laala kaa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ peteɡre yon yo lɛ pee le nyujente nyoa, dɛ o nakpale anɛ ɡbo kɛɛ o deŋnekera ɡboo kaa la, ɡɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba Israel tena lɛɛ, banɔ la baa lɔ Samaria ne Damaskɔs dɛ yale ba kanedɛɛɡa ta bwa.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: No ɡɛ waa nɔ, ásɛ dɛ kah Jekɔb naanar.” Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ laanee bola.

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: “Awola maa ba tɛr Israel tena deŋne ba wechɔɡa waa la, mɛɛ paɡre kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta Bɛtel bwaa, dɛ́ kuuɡi kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare dɛ paaɡe a ta bwaa bil harɛ.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mɛɛ paɡre ba dejena ne ba dejeɡre bwaa. Mɛɛ chɔɡ deene baa kpɔ bala nyena ɛ kwaa cheɡ a bini a do wer la bwaa. Dejena bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo kwaraa, Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
translation_verse: Hé no, haahna haa lɔ Samaria dɛ do bwara kɛ nae aa lɔ Basan harɛ ta, he dɛ fiiɡi nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra, dɛɛ ŋɔ he jaranar be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ sen baa tɛ yaa.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii waa do ɡoroŋ ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, “Tɔpera ane ɛɛ bao ásɛ ba lawɛ heyaa ɡoŋri ne kaa. Baa tɛɡre bɛlbwaa kaa kɛŋɔ pɛŋe ken.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Baa lawɛ heyaa kpɔ danjwɛɛ waa pera ta, dɛ́ tɛɡre heyaa kaa bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Haamɔn.” Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé kpɔ paanoo iisi aa lɔ a ta ɛ saraha ba jam mɛ, dɛɛ baɡle he te saraha aa le he bambile la ta, dɛkalkɛ anee hɛɛ nyin ɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: Menee ɡela lɔr chole he bwɛjena bwa ta, asɛ he paŋɛ kondikwa bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta, kɛ he ta berɛ ba n be.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: Menee ɡela bwaala ɡel nɛɛ, ɡɛ saŋ aa ka korobie atoro he komɛ koo koŋkwaare. N ɡelɔ bwaala nɛ bwɛɛ beŋkpoŋ ta, dɛ ɡel o ta bɛl te ta nɛɛ. O nɛ koo bɛl ta, bɛl ta bwaala dɔe, harɛ hol.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Nyɔɡre kpo bwɛjena nɛra ɡalɡa bane ba ɡwɛɡre, dɛ ɡaaɡe la bwɛjen bɛl ta dɛ́ ka nyin nee nyɔ, ba ta dɔe. Ane a bwa, he ta berɛ ba n be. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa n ɡel he koo koŋkwaare chɔɡ, weela anee n kpɔ chɔɡa. Tontombɛ di he fiɡ ne ɔleve daa, kɛ he ta berɛ ba n be. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: N kpɔ weechɔɡa ba ta he nɛ, ɡɛ n fa aa ɛ Ijipt harɛ ta la. N kpoo he bonɔɔna laa ta, dɛ lawɛ he jaɡre kaa. Dɛ ɡel nɛra baa serewa chɔ sɔɔh kpo heya, bela haa soɡa, kɛ he ta berɛ ba n be.

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: N chɔɡ he bini bane, ɡɛ maa chɔɡ Sodom ne Gomoora tena la. Dɛ he do kɛŋɔ nindaa waa lɔ nii ta n kee heyaa le, kɛ he ta berɛ ba n be. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Korowiirii ta bwejena dɛ ta peu ɡe, dɛ ɡel nɛn jemɛ o liire. Onee ɡela webaŋa won jwaana bera, bwejena dor ɛ o natiɡribɔr, o sɔne Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ.

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: Emɔs ŋɔ, “Israel tena, hé no wiile maa taara dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ.

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: ‘Israel harɛ waa do kɛŋɔ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ la paɡrɔ waa wola werii do kpa, harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ kwaa vɔrɔwo.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen bɛl lɔ Israel harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ laa tena kaɡboŋ la laa, kɛ nɛra lafa ɡboo dɛ́ berɛ ba. Bwɛɛ bɛl ɡe kpɔ laa tena lafa la, kɛ ba nɛra fi ɡboo dɛ́ berɛ ba.”

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ ba n be, ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu.

english_verse: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
translation_verse: He bɛ Bɛtel la ka tom mɛ, he bɛ Gelɡal la, he bɛ Beɛseeba ɡba la. Kasinteŋ, baa lawɛ Gelɡal tena laa taa kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta, ásɛ Bɛtel paɡre kwaraa.”

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: Emɔs ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ ba Korowii be dɛ́ dɔ he nyu, ɡɛ laa aa, wɛɛ ba he Israel tena nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nii, dɛ́ ba fuh heya, dɛ́ fuh Bɛtel tena ɡe, nomɛlbwa aa wola won dima.

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: He berɛ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ sie, dɛ tɔ waa aa toɡra ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
