translation_verse: Korowiirii ta Baŋɡaana ne weweela bwa so siwi, dɛ berɛ ɡel bɔr ɛɛ beɡre, dɛ ɡel bɔr bir dɛɛ chaah, bɔr chaah dɛɛ bir. Dɛ ta mpo o ba bɔle harɛ ta. O sɔne Korowii.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: Onee dɛɛ chɔɡ ba dekpeɡa, dɛ ɡel bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛɛ baro ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbia.

english_verse: You people hate judges and honest witnesses;
translation_verse: Hé hah nomɛlbwa waa wola nyosone teŋe, dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ kɔɔto dea.

english_verse: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
translation_verse: He fiiɡi nyaara dɛ ɛɡre ba dɛɛ lɛ mea. Anomanta, haa deene haa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa maa la binii so, kɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ sen nyɔ le he daa kodɛɛɡa haa para la ta.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
translation_verse: N jemɛ ɡɛ he wechɔɡa aa kana, dɛ jemɛ wedoŋa bwa haa ɛa. He ɛɡre nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛ ɡel baa yawɛ heyaa sen, haa nyaara waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta kɔɔto.

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nɛn waa jemɛ waa la tɔ nyoa, a ɡɛ wechɔɡa saŋ nɔ waa aa do ɡɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Hé nyin wedɛɛɡa, dɛ́ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu. Anee dɛ́ ɡel Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ja he nɛ, ɡɛ haa bol o waa la.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Hé hah wechɔɡa, dɛ́ nyin wedɛɛɡa, hé ɡel kasinteŋ ɛɛ ɛ toma kɔɔto deene. Nemenɛ Korowii ken ɛɛ sune Josef dea nɛra baa kaa nɛɛ.”

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Nɛra ɛɛ wi fɔɡbaahnaa, ásɛ lokua wii do bela nɛra aa dɛ cheme bwa. Baa yerɛ paara bwaa cheme ba wi tɛ nɛra baa serewa, dɛ́ ka kpɔ nɛra bá ba wi.

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ wi daa kooni ta bwaa. Gɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ bao, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ba ba tɛr he deŋne. Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii Tɔpere waa lea cheɡ

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Emɔs ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o na tɔpere Korowii aa dɛ ba ba bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole la, ó bwɛɛlɛ. Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he na Korowii Tɔpere waa lea cheɡ laɔ? Biro ɡboo awola, bɔr aa o ta chaahna ba.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ chwa nyujente dɛ ka cheme sisire ken. Aa doo kɛŋɔ nɛn aa jo o dea dɛ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ danjwɛɛ ta, asɛ harɛkon domɔ.

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔpere waa lea cheɡ la, biro kpirkpir ɡboo, wee aa lee do kwara, dɛ́ chaah bɔr.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “N hah he tɔpejena haa dɛ di la, n sie aa a ta lɛ kwaraa.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he ɡbɔɡa yela le n nɛ. Maa he janjela yela nyin dɛ́ no.

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Kɛ, hé ɡel kasinteŋ do le saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛŋɔ moo aa dɛ palɛ, waa aa toɡra ɡe do kɛŋɔ nenabɔɔ waa wola hweeh bwa.

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Israel tena, n ta sarahare ne kwaa lɛɛ le he be bene fifraanaarɛ haa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Hé dɛ tomɛ voɡ Sakut haa ɛo kooro, ne Kaiwan haa ɛo kɛŋɔ wewee. Hɛɛ che ɡɛ voɡa nɔɔ,

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: ɡɛ saŋ maa lawɛ heyaa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, Damaskɔs baŋ le la. Men Korowii Maa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.”

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Saayɔn tena haa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa aa heyaa ha, ne Samaria Bwejen dor tena haa dɛ lii kɛ he soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta la, hé bwɛɛlɛ! Nomonjena haa dɛ tɔ Israel harɛ waa sie, Israel tena ɛɛ ba he be hɛɛ cha ba la bwa, hé bwɛɛlɛ!

english_verse: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
translation_verse: Hé la bwɛjen Kalne ka na, dɛ́ le bela la bwɛjen Hamat, dɛ́ berɛ kaa Filisti tena bwɛjen Gat. Ba ɡwaa he harɛre anɛ nɔ naa? Ba harɛ la kan ɡwaa he kon aa?

english_verse: You are cruel, and you forget the coming day of judgment.
translation_verse: Haa lii kɛŋɔ tɔpechɔɡe bɛl dɛ ba, kɛ he we-ɛɛla ɡbo ɛɛ ɡeloo ó ba warane.

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: Mpare baa ɛa dɛ kpɔ bala nyena mɛɛ a taa hɛɛ chɔ, dɛɛ yale he kanedɛɛɡa ta. Hé kpoo pebiiri aa wera, ne nabali aa do bwara dɛɛ chwe.

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: Hé dɛ nyin yela kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid ken, dɛɛ lɔa he janjelare ne.

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: He dɛ nyɔ numojena ne sen, dɛ kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma aa wera dɛɛ ɛ he te, kɛ haa chɔɡa Israel aa dɛ ba chɔɡa te waa wi.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii, Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ŋwɛɛ o ɡbaɡba ŋɔ, “N hah mbarafo Israel tena aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ ki ba dekpeɡa baa soɡe a bini. Mɛɛ kpɔ bwɛjen la ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ o taa do ba dɔma nɔn ta.”

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Baala fi ka dembeŋkpoŋ ta kwaraa naa, ba ɡe ɛɛ serewoo.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa serewa la lole bɛl ɛɛ bao, dɛ́ ba pa lala la le dem bela, dɛ́ bɔɔ nomɛlbwa waa ka dem bela ŋɔ, “Nomɛl ta lɔ he be bonɔ kɛɛ?” Ásɛ taa bɛl chaŋe ŋɔ “Ɔɔhɔh!” Ásɛ lole la ŋɔ, “Hel! Ya nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ Korowii sɔn yerɛ.”

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ ba taɡɛ demjena ne demjeɡre bwa ɡooɡe aa, baa taɡɛ a bwaa ɡooɡe, á paɡre buruburu ken.

english_verse: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
translation_verse: Jaɡre won bwea dor chwae yaa? Nɛn ɛɛ kpɔ nae ka parɛ bela aa? Kɛ he ɡelɔ kasinteŋ do kɛ tɛɡchɔɡa, asɛ waa aa toɡra berɛ do kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa ken.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: He dɛ maŋkura he te kɛŋɔ haa kaa yo lɛ Lo Debar dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya cheɡɛ ya bokpeɡa ta dɛ ka yo lɛ Kanaim.”

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ŋɔ, “Israel tena, mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ bɛl nɛra ba yo heya, dɛ́ ba fiiɡi heyaa le Lebo Hamat ŋwɛnɛ weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ́ ba weekaŋle harɛbɔr Jɔɔdan Moo ta.”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ɡelɔ men Emɔs na waane wepila ta. N nao kɛŋɔ waa dɛ boa tontombɛ nyoa, ɡɛ saŋ dɛ ba teŋe kpɔɡa ba kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ kooro jaɡre tonɛ, kpɔɡa pa mun dɛɛ moɡɛ, asɛ nɛra pa mun dɛɛ du konfala.

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Tontombɛ la balɔ, dɛ ba chɔɡ konlwɛɛ te bɛlbwa harɛ la ta, asɛ n ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, ɡel kɛ he nɛra! Ɛrɛɛ he nɛra ɛɛ ba wona so nɔ? Ba nɔn ta kao!”

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ. Dɛ ŋɔ, “Maa ɡela ba a chiɡ kpa.”

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ɡelɔ n na waane wepila ta ja. N nao kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ nii dɛɛ ba ba fuh harɛ la, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛr o nɛra deŋne. Nii la fuoh dɛ hweeh viljena bwa, dɛ fuh dɛɛ ba ba chɔɡ harɛ ɡe.

english_verse: Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
translation_verse: Belaa n ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, ɡel! Ɛrɛɛ he nɛra ɛɛ ba wona so nɔ? Ba nɔn ta kao!”

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ɡelɔ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Maa ɡela ba a chiɡ kpa.”

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ men Emɔs na waane wepila ta ja. Dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ danjwɛɛ bɛl baa mao jwɛh, dɛ kpoŋe ŋwɛn baa kpɔa dɛɛ toɡre danjwɛ.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Korowii bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Emɔs, bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” Asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛn baa kpɔa dɛɛ toɡre danjwɛɛ.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ, “N kpɔɔ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ n nɛra do kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ waa ɡola. Maa ba deŋnetɛraa kpɔ kɛ ba kpa.

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ bɔra Aesek naanar aa ka dɛ tomɛ bwaa, ásɛ Israel harɛ bɔra aa do ɡoroŋ ɡe chɔɡ, dɛ́ ka yo Kooro Jɛroboam dem nɛra laa.” Emɔs ne sɔfo Amasea

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Belaa sɔfo Amasea waa lɔ Bɛtel la kpɔ kala tɛ Israel Kooro Jɛroboam ŋɔ, “Emɔs dɛ vɔrɔwe he vɔrɔwa Israel harɛ ta bonɔ. O waa waa dɛ bol la ɡwaalɔ to.

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Waa Emɔs aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Baa kpo Kooro Jɛroboam laa taa, ásɛ ba lawɛ Israel tena laa ta kaa, ba le ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.’ ”

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Belaa Amasea ŋɔ Emɔs be ŋɔ, “Korowii keame, ir kaa Juda harɛ ta kaa bol Korowii waa la, dɛ́ so bela baa bɔe a kem.

english_verse: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
translation_verse: Bɛ Korowii waa la bol Bɛtel bonɔ kpa, dɛkalkɛ bonɔɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ne kooro bwa ba dɛ baa tomɛ.”

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Emɔs chaŋo ŋɔ, “N ta Korowii keame ɛɛ, kɛɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii keame bie. Dɛ peteɡree men, asɛ n berɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi fiɡ daa ta.

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ n ɡel peera teɡa, dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń ba bol o waa la baɡle o nɛra Israel tena.

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Anomanta, waa Korowii aa dɛ bol sɔfo Amasea be laanee nɔ. ‘He haah ɛɛ valɛ bwɛjen nɔ taa dɛɛ bɔ jwamane. Baa kpoo he bibaala ne bihaahna laa taa. Baa lɛ he harɛ peraa, dɛ́ bɔne tɛ nɛra, ásɛ he ka sewɛ voɡtoroma harɛ ta. Kasinteŋ, baa lawɛ Israel tena laa taa le ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.’ ”

english_verse: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
translation_verse: Asɛ o bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” N chaŋe ŋɔ, “N na wɛɡrɛ daa nɔna aa bea do o bini.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “N nɛra Israel tena tɔpere telo kɛ n tɛr ba deŋne, maa ba bwaraa kpɔ kɛ ba kpa.

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, yela baa ɡo n Dea la ɛɛ berɛ wii. Nɛra ɛɛ serewoo kohona chɔ bobɛlbwa, ásɛ bɔr hel.” Israel tena bwɛɛlɛ

english_verse: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.
translation_verse: Hé no, he nɛra haa dɛ fiiɡi nyaara dɛɛ chɔɡ nɛŋɡwɛɡra harɛ la ta,

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo Korobifala Tɔpejena dii ɛɛ ba a jaɡa bala ásɛ ya yoɡ mea ɔ? Saŋ besoo Ona Tɔpere ɡe ba kaa ásɛ ya ka yawɛ kwa ɔ? Ásɛ ya kpɔ kwaa aa wola chɛ kɛ ya kpɔ maɡɛ kwa, dɛ́ dawɛ a yoɡ, dɛ́ faah nɛra a maɡa ta,

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa aa wola naŋɡawa ɡba yoɡ tele yawɛ nyaara yoma, dɛ́ kpɔ yoɡ dawɛ mea ta.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
translation_verse: Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, “Maa ba waa baa ɛa bɛlbwaa soh bwa.

english_verse: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.
translation_verse: Harɛ la ɛɛ jiɡruu a waa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa soɡe harɛ la ta di suna. Harɛ la dɛ́ ba dɛɛ beɡre kɛŋɔ Nael Moo yon su, ásɛ dɛ berɛ hweeh ka chɔ o buɡ ta la ken.”

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo bɔr jo webaŋa ásɛ bobɛlbwa bir.

english_verse: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo he Tɔpejena dii berɛ lwe, ásɛ he yela ɡoe berɛ wii. Mɛɛ ɡeloo he bwa tɔ lweyale dɛ́ fonɛ he nyuune. Mɛɛ ɡeloo awola do kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa dɛ wi o bibambeŋkpoŋ la, dɛ́ ɛ tɔpechɔɡe ka tonɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
translation_verse: Tɔpera ane dɛ ba, ásɛ men Nemenɛ Korowii ɡel lɔr chole harɛ nɔ ta. Kondikwaa kɛɛ nyɔɡre laa, men Korowii waa la bɛ dɔe dɛ́ no la waa. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ ɡaaɡoo le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ́ ba kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ne wee leebɔr dɛ́ ba kaa wee cholibɔr, dɛɛ nyin Korowii waa la dɛ́ no, kɛ baa dɔ no.

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, toli ne bonɔɔna ba bwara aa kpeɡa sie ɛɛ bir baa bá choɡli, nyɔɡre wa.

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ Samaria voɡa, kɛɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ Dan dea voɡ, kɛɛ voɡ waa lɔ Beɛseeba bwa dɛ́ ba choɡla, baa wola won ir kpa.”

english_verse: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
translation_verse: N na Korowii kɛŋɔ waa cheɡɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la jwɛh, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kpɔ kon lɔ pilare la doa ásɛ Dea la doonyoa danjwɛɛre yiiɡi. Ásɛ a peri kuuɡi le nyundua ba le nɛra la nɛɛ ba serewe. Ba bini banɔ la baa ka la, mɛɛ kpoo ba laa taa. Ba bɛlbwa aa won le, beŋkpoŋ ɡba aa bɔree dɔ chwa.

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: Hale ba kwi bɔɔ ka le lalabwɛɛ kwaraa naa, mɛɛ ta nɔnee laɡ ba. Ba teehnɔ ir kaa nyundua ɡe kwaraa naa, mɛɛ le ba ne belaa ba harɛ.

english_verse: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
translation_verse: Ba chwao ka sɔh Kaamɛl Bwejen doa aa, mɛɛ nyin ba bɔree, dɛ́ laɡ ba. Ba chwao le n sie ka sɔh mpo bini naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo mpo bini oljen laɡ ba chwe.

english_verse: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
translation_verse: A lole kɛŋɔ ba dɔma laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpoo ba laa ta. N siwi swɛɛ ba nɛ, ba wedɛɛɡa te waa laa, ba kpoora waa.”

english_verse: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.
translation_verse: Korowii, onee Koranar Bwa Kooro, onee kpɔ nɔn leɡe harɛ wɛɛ mwɛɛ, asɛ nɛra baa lɔ o ta bwa ɛɛ wi. Harɛ la bwa ɛɛ beɡre kɛŋɔ Nael Moo yon su, dɛ́ berɛ hweeh ka chɔ o buɡ ta la.

english_verse: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
translation_verse: Korowii ma o dobɔr o do nyundua, dɛ ta nyundua o bɔle harɛ bwa ta, dɛ ɡel mpo ba bɔle harɛ nɔ ta bwa. O sɔne Korowii.

english_verse: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, n dɛ nyin he waa kɛŋɔ maa dɛ nyin Itiopia tena waa la. Gɛ maa lawɛ he Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta la, ɡɛɛ n lawɛ Filisti tena le ekwi harɛ Kret ta, dɛ lawɛ Siiria tena le Kir. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Men Nemenɛ Korowii, n dɛ nyiŋi Israel harɛ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ. Mɛɛ chɔɡoo le harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ maa Jekɔb naanaree chɔɡ kwaraa.

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bol waa ásɛ dɛ yiiɡi Israel tena harɛre nɛra bwa bini, kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɡboo boyu beŋkpoŋ ɡba aa wola harɛ le la.

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa lɔ n nɛra bini bwa, baa kpoo ba laa taa. Banee dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Korowii aa ɡel wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ba ya nɛ.’ ” Israel kwaara dɛ́ vɔrɔwe wa

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ n berɛ kwaa cheɡ Kooro Devid kora waa ɡua la. Mɛɛ kwaaroo vɔrɔwe bɔra aa paɡra ne dimɡbeeni bwa, dɛ́ kwaa maa a do ɡɛ a fa aa doa wubwa la,

english_verse: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
translation_verse: Israel tena ɛɛ ka yo nɛra baa ka Edom harɛ taa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ harɛre ta nɛra ba fa aa ɛ n nɛra la jemɛ kɛ menee ɡela a ba ɡɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpera la dɛ ba, ásɛ nɛn waa dɛ parɛ tɔ nɛn waa dɛ komɛ sie, onɔ la waa dɛ du ɡe tɔ nɛn waa dɛ tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna sie. Senfala ɛɛ koruu le bwejena dor dɛ́ palɛ kpɔ deŋɡarere ta.

english_verse: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔ ba n nɛra Israel tena baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta la nee, bá ba kwaa vɔrɔwe dimɡbeeni dɛ́ so a bini. Baa parɛ daa koonii, dɛ́ nyɔ a sen, dɛ́ parɛ bodɛɛɡa, dɛ́ di kondikwa baa parɛ la.

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lawɛ Israel tenaa ba so ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola won ba doŋ ba le harɛ maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la ta. Men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ laanee bola.”

english_verse: The Lord God gave Obadiah a message about Edom, and this is what we heard: “I, the Lord, have sent a messenger with orders for the nations to attack Edom.”
translation_verse: Waa aa dɛ ba Edom harɛ ta chiɡa Nemenɛ Korowii kpɔ baɡle Obadia laanee nɔ. Ya noɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa bol Edom harɛ wa. O tomɛ o torome bɛl harɛre nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé ir, ya kpɔ ya te ka pu Edom tena yo.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ Edom tena be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo he ɡwɛɡre harɛre nɛra bwa bini, ásɛ ba hah heya, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyubaahna.

english_verse: You live in a mountain fortress, because your pride makes you feel safe from attack, but you are mistaken.
translation_verse: He mbarafo neɡre heya. He soɡe bɔɔne bini bwejena dor, dɛ yon ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ won ba n ne harɛ nɔ?’

english_verse: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: A lole kɛ he soŋnibɔr lɔ nyundua, kɛŋɔ kee yon ka sɔh o kɔr nyundujaɡla la, kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo he le bela ba harɛ. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
translation_verse: Ŋwɛɛra dɛ ba jwaana aa, anɔ la baa dɛ nyin ɡboo baa kpɔ. Nɛra dɛ pa daa nɔna aa, ba dɛ ɡel beŋkpoŋa ane. Kɛ he Edom tena te, he dɔma kpoo he bwa.

english_verse: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.
translation_verse: He Esɔ naanar, he dɔma pa he kondɔɔh haa kpɔa sɔh bwa kaa.

english_verse: Your allies can't be trusted. They will force you out of your own country. And your best friends will trick and trap you, even before you know it.
translation_verse: Nɛra he ne baa fɔwɛ fɔo ɛɛ le he ne he harɛ taa. Baa neɡre heyaa, dɛ́ pɔ he nɛ. Daamanar he ne baa pɛ nɔn di kwaa ɛɛ harɛ heyaa belii haa wola jemɛ.”

english_verse: Edom, when this happens, I, the Lord, will destroy all your marvelous wisdom.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ tɛr Edom wejerema deŋnee, nɛra baa dɛ no waa mun dɛ so bwejaŋa dor bwaa mɛɛ ba chɔɡa.

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Teman laa tena bwa ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ kohona. Baa kpoo ba bwaa Edom harɛ la taa.

english_verse: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.
translation_verse: Edom tena, haa cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta kpoo he lolanar baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar nomanta, chɔɡaa hɛɛ ba chɔɡa, dɛ́ di ncho saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.
translation_verse: Awola Jekɔb naanar dɔma aa lɔa ka tɔ Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la, he Edom tena cheɡɔ nyiŋi ba pa ba kondɔɔh bɔne dɔŋa. He ɡe ɛ nɛnchɔɡa kɛ ban.

english_verse: Why did you celebrate when such a dreadful disaster struck your relatives? Why were you so pleased when everyone in Judah was suffering?
translation_verse: A fe ta chɛɛ kɛ he sie lɛ he lolanar baa lɔ Juda harɛ wenaale wa. A ta chɛɛ kɛ he hɛɡre ba chɔɡa wa, kɛɛ dɛ mam ba ba sibeɡra tɔpere wee.

english_verse: They are my people, and you were cruel to them. You went through their towns, sneering and stealing whatever was left.
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛ he jo n nɛra be bwɛjen la ta he sie lɛ ba wenaale wa, dɛ́ kpɔ kpeɡri pa ba kondɔɔh kaa ba chɔɡa tɔpere wee.

english_verse: In their time of torment, you ambushed refugees and handed them over to their attackers. The Lord Will Judge the Nations
translation_verse: A ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he ka che ŋwɛnɛ chɛchɛre ta lawɛ banɔ la baa dɔ bɔr chwa le dɛɛ kaa la. A ta chɛ kɛ he kpɔ ba ka do ba dɔma nɔn ta ba sibeɡra tɔpere wee.

english_verse: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
translation_verse: Tɔpere men Korowii aa kpɔ bol harɛre ta nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la telo tonɛ. Gɛ haa ɛa nɔɔ mɛɛ ba kpɔa ɛ he Edom tena ɡe, he we-ɛɛla bwa ɛɛ ɡure he nyu taa.

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ n nɛra nyɔ n danana nee Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ ta. Kɛ harɛre aa bara cheme nɔ nɛra ɡe ɛɛ nyɔ danana nee á ɡwaa a nɔ ka tel saŋ baa serewe.

english_verse: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
translation_verse: Kɛ Jekɔb dea bii bane ɛɛ dɔ ba nyuu Saayɔn Bwejen la ta, ásɛ o ɛ bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ, bá berɛ dɔ harɛ waa ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon wubwa la.

english_verse: Israel will be a fire, and Edom will be straw going up in flames. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Jekɔb ne Josef nɛra ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nii, dɛ́ chɔɡ Esɔ dea bii ɡɛ nii yon dɛɛ fuh haahra la. Esɔ naanar bini bɛlbwa aa kae ba. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa soɡa bɛne Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ɛɛ ba so Edom harɛ bwejaŋa doree, ásɛ banɔ la baa le deŋɡarere lɔɡre ba lɛ Filisti tena harɛ so. Israel tena ɛɛ ba so Efrem ne Samaria harɛre taa, ásɛ Bɛnjamen dea bii ɡe ba lɛ Gelead harɛ so.

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Israel laa tena baa chwaa ka so Keenan harɛ ɛɛ berɔɔ ba lɛ Foniisia harɛ, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le Sarefat, dɛ́ so o ta, ásɛ banɔ la ɡe baa le Jerusalam dɛ do Sɛfarad la ka lɛ bwɛɛre aa lɔ Nɛɡɛv, dɛ́ so a ta.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Jerusalam baala baa yoa dɛ le la ɛɛ ka yo Edom tenaa, dɛ́ kpɔ harɛ la dɛɛ nyiŋi o ta. Asɛ Korowii ɡbabir ɛ ba kooro.”

english_verse: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
translation_verse: Baa bɛl fa lole baa yerɔ Jona, o mɛɛ sɔne Amitai. Awola bɛl, Korowii ŋɔ Jona be ŋɔ,

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: “Le he harɛ ta, dɛ́ la bwɛjen Niniwe ta, dɛ́ ka di ba kasinteŋ ŋɔ ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la le n mee.”

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Anee Jona vɛh Korowii toma waa dɛ tomɔ Niniwe la, dɛ chwa dɛɛ kaa Taases. Anomanta, o la Jopa, bela stiimaere aa dɛ chuɡe, asɛ dɛ ka dɔ bɛl waa dɛ kaa Taases. O bɔ o suuɡa dɛ jo dɛ fe ɛɛ kaa Taases ásɛ Korowii bɛ on na.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ɡel peujen bɛl ta mpo la ta. Peu la nyoa kpeɡri kohona, dɛ ir nehɛma baa lɔ dɛɛ beɡre nee la, stiimae la fe ɛɛ ba pera.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Aa ba ɡɛ la, ɔmee lawɛ nɛra baa lɔ stiimae la bini bwa, asɛ bɛlbwa wi dɛɛ yerɛ o voɡ waa dɛ tomɛ. Ba pa laala aa lɔ stiimae la bini la dɛɛ ta nee ta, ásɛ o do fɛɡre. A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa aa dɛ chiɡ la, jaah dɛ Jona te lɔ stiimae la lɔɡa bobɛl, dɛ te chɔ dom kwaraa.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi stiimae la ta la, la Jona be dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ o chɔ dom kwaraa. Asɛ o chumu dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔree he te dɔ dɛ chɔ aa? Ir, dɛ́ wi yerɛ he voɡ haa dɛ tomɔ, o ken ɛɛ na ya sumii, dɛ́ lɛ yaa le waa nɔ nyoa, ásɛ ya dɔ ya nyu.”

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra la bwa baa lɔ stiimae la bini la ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ ɡel ya bil daa, dɛ́ na naate aa cheɡɛ o nɛɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ba ya nɛɛ nɔ.” Ba bil daa la, asɛ a lawɛ Jona.

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Anee ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Baɡle nɛn aa cheɡɛ o nɛɛ wekpeɡa nɔ ba ya nɛɛ nɔ.” Ba berɔ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Tombesoo hɛɛ ɛɔ? Bwɛ besoo taa he leɔ? Harɛ besoo ta nɛnee hen ɔ? Wobobesoo tee hen ɔ?”

english_verse: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Jona ŋɔ, “Hibru tee men, Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua waa ta nyundua ne harɛ ne mpo laanee mɛɛ tomɛ.”

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: Ate, dɛ ɔmee tenten lawɛ nɛra la bwa. Asɛ ba berɛ bɔɔro ja ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?” dɛkalkɛŋɔ, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ Korowii tomɔ asɛ o vɛh dɛɛ chwa.

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Dɛ nae peu la nyoa na dɛɛ do kpeɡri mpo la ta kwara. Asɛ ba bɔɔ Jona ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yá ɛ peu nɔ ɡel tae ásɛ nee nɔ nyoa sɔɔh tɛ yaa ɔ?”

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Belaa o ŋɔ, “Hé ɡɔɔ mɛ ta nee ta, o nyoa ɛɛ sɔɔhnoo. N ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ n nɛɛ a che ɡɛ peukpeɡ nɔ ɛɛ ta nɔ.”

english_verse: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.
translation_verse: Ba ne o ɡɔɔra dɛ ta nee ta la, ba takapɔ kɛŋɔ ba kaa stiimae la ne ka chuɡe baŋ, kɛ ba ta wone, dɛkalkɛ dɛ nae peu la ne mpo nehɛma la na dɛɛ do kpeɡri kohona ɡwaa wubwa la kwara.

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Belaa ba wi yerɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, anɔ bwa haa ɡela a chiɡ nɔ ɛ he tetoora. Ya dɛ soŋe, yaa dɛ ba baa nɔ kpɔe dɛ́ viɡri mpo ta nɔ, bɛ yaa ba kpoo.”

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Ate, ba ɡɔɔ Jona viɡri nee ta ken tuuu. Buɡ la ta, mpo la hel kerker ken.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Asɛ ɔmee lawɛ nɛra la bwa kohona Korowii wa, ba kpo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛo, dɛ baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ baa tomɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii te le pɛŋejen bɛl ó ba kpɔ Jona lile, asɛ o do o tea bini tɔpebire atoro, chɔɔ ne jwaana.

english_verse: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
translation_verse: Jona aa lɔ pɛŋe la tea bini la, o soŋe Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la.

english_verse: When I was in trouble, Lord, I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, maa lɔ wekpeɡa ta dɛ do lɔŋɔ tɛɛ la, he no n wesoŋa. Maa lɔ lalabwɛɛ dɛ do lɔŋɔ tɛɛ la, he no n wii.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: He ɡɔɔ mɛ viɡri mpo vil ta, n chɔ nee bini, wɛɛ kile n ne, asɛ nehɛma bwa bɔle n nɛ.

english_verse: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
translation_verse: N liiro kɛ he doŋ mɛ le he sie, dɛ ŋɔ maa he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ laanee na kpa.

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Nee bɔle n nɛ, n hweera pi, n do vil bini, asɛ mpo bini kpɔɡa laa n nyu bwa.

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: N sirimo ka chɔ bwejena lɔɡre, a do kɛŋɔ baa huɡ mɛ maa wola bɔree dɔ le dɛ́ dɔ n nyu. Kɛ n Naa Korowii le n ne seo ta.

english_verse: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.
translation_verse: N naa Korowii, maa naa kɛŋɔ n fe dɛ ba sewa la, n lii he wa, n siwi swɛɛ he soŋa ta, a tel he be, he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.

english_verse: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa daŋre voɡsale toma ne, ba siwi ɛɛ sua la, ba paŋɛ chae he fe aa cha ba la.

english_verse: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord. I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.
translation_verse: Kɛ n te, mɛɛ jaame yel nee, anee dɛɛ ba saraha ɛɛ. Nyoo maa baɡa bwa, mɛɛ chuɡraa. Korowiirii dɛɛ lɛ nɛwɛnyini.”

english_verse: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii bol waa pɛŋe la be, asɛ o ka uɡe Jona ta nee la nyoa.

english_verse: Once again the Lord told Jonah
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Jona be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
translation_verse: “Ir kaa bwɛjen Niniwe, dɛ́ ka bol waa n fa aa bol he be la bela tena be.”

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: Ate, Jona ta vɛɛh kpa, dɛ ir kpɔ waa la kaa Niniwe. Bwɛjen la kan taeh. Tɔpera atoroo nɛn ɛɛ ba wona valɛ dɛ ɡaaɡe bwɛɛ la bini bwa.

english_verse: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
translation_verse: Jona jo bwɛjen la bini dɛ valɛ tɔpebir. Waa waa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, “Bonɔ tɔpera fifraanaarɛ Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ Niniwee.”

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Niniwe tena la aa no waa la la, ba yarada Korowii dɛ ŋɔ, nomoa oo, bechala oo, bɛlbwa vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ́ kpɔ lweyal tɔ á baɡle kɛ ba charɛ ba liire dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Hale bwɛɛ la kooro aa no o bwɛɛ la chɔɡa waa la, o fuɡro ir o kookara ta, dɛ wur o yal waa tɔɔ la ta, dɛ kpɔ lweyal tɔ dɛ ka so tɔɔ ta.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii aa naa kɛ ba charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre ta la, o tea domɛ ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel chɔɡa waa ŋɔa wɛɛ chɔɡ baa la.

english_verse: Jonah was really upset and angry.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ ta Jona som doe kwaraa. O baah diu

english_verse: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
translation_verse: asɛ o soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, waa maa lɔ n bwɛɛ dɛ bol la laa nɔ naa? A waa n fee chwa dɛɛ kaa Taases la. N jemɔ kɛ he dɛ na nɛn sum, he tea dɛ domɛ nɛn nɛ, he baah aa di warawara. Nɛnnyin ɡboo he bwa. He won he liire chara dɛ́ le nɛwɛnyina deŋne tɛra ta.

english_verse: Now let me die! I'd be better off dead.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n poori den kpo mɛ. N sewɔ bɔ n be kɛŋɔ maa soɡe le.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ŋɔ, “He ɡe dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ he baah di waa nɔ ta naa?”

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ate, Jona le Niniwe bela dɛ kaa o wee leebɔr, dɛ ka do kuku, dɛ so o lɔɡa dɛɛ nyiŋi waa aa pu Niniwe tena.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii ɡel juɡ bɛl o papooni aa paɡa le, dɛ tɔ Jona nɛɛ dɛ tɛo chunchule, asɛ o bwara sɔɔhno kohona. Aa ba ɡɛ la, o sie lɛo.

english_verse: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
translation_verse: Tɔɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Korowii ɡelɔ dudul bɛl ba chwe juɡ waa ɡela o le dɛɛ tɛ Jona chunchule la, o sewɛ.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Wee aa baa baŋɛ la, Korowii ɡelɔ peuwɔb bɛl ta le wee leebɔr, wee ɡe do nyɛɡre dɛɛ lɔ Jona nɛɛ kohona, o fe ɛɛ ba sewa dɛ ŋɔ, “N sewɔ bɔ kɛŋɔ maa soɡe le.”

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Anee Korowii ŋɔ Jona be ŋɔ, “He dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ he baah di juɡ nɔ wa aa?” Ate, Jona ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh. N baah diu kohona kɛŋɔ n sewɛ kwara.”

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Juɡ nɔ, jwaana beŋkpoŋii o le, he ta o ta koɛh, he laa ɡela o kpeɡ, dɛ o sewɔ jwaana beŋkpoŋ aa, ɡɛɛ o waa ɛɛ we he nɛ aa?

english_verse: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah. Judgment on Samaria
translation_verse: Baa bɛl sɔne Maeka dɛ le Mɔresɛt. Korowii pili waane aa dɛ ba bwɛjena Samaria ne Jerusalam chiɡa baɡlo. Dɛ ɡɛ saŋee Juda koranar bane baa dɛ yer ba Jotam ne Ahas dɛ Hɛsɛkea di kora teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ Juda harɛ ta.

english_verse: Listen, all of you! Earth and everything on it, pay close attention. The Lord God accuses you from his holy temple.
translation_verse: Hé no, nɛra haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa, ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta. Nemenɛ Korowii le o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ nyundua dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba bol waa bɔ heya. Korowii bol Samaria ne Jerusalam chɔɡa wa

english_verse: And he will come down to crush underfoot every pagan altar.
translation_verse: Hé na! Korowii le o dobɔr waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛ tu baa valɛ bwejena dor.

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Asɛ bwejena bwa mwɛɛ o lɔɡa, kɛŋɔ tohkel aa chɔŋɛ nii ta, dɛ palɛ dɛɛ jo fɛlembɔjena bini kɛŋɔ bɔchuubu ken.

english_verse: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.
translation_verse: Israel tena baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar wechɔɡa baa ɛ Korowii waa a bwa ba ɡɛ. Bamewaa ɡela Israel tena ɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɔ? Samaria koobwɛɛ nɛra laa aa? Bamewaa dɛ́ di bolchɔɡe voɡa baa dɛ tomɛ Juda harɛ ta waɔ? Jerusalam tenaa.

english_verse: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo Samaria berɛ dimɡbia, baa parɛ ɡrepo daa koonii, dɛ́ kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen bela, dɛ́ taɡɛ o danjwɛɛ bwea bwa ka do fɛlembɔjen ta, ásɛ o mumpar bwea bwa chɔ baŋ.

english_verse: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes. Judah Is Doomed
translation_verse: Samaria tena voɡa bwa ɛɛ paɡroo burbur ken, ásɛ nii fuh saraha kwaa bwa aa lɔ bela. Mɛɛ chɔɡ ba voɡa bwaa. Baa lɛ kwaa haahna aa bɔ jwamane dɛ dɔ, dɛ boa a nyoa nomanta, ba dɔma ɛɛ paa ka tɛ jwamane tena bane ɡe bobɛl.” Wii ne suna dii

english_verse: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.
translation_verse: Men Maeka ŋɔ, “Anɔ nomanta mɛɛ wiu dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre, á baɡle kɛ n dɛ di suna. Mɛɛ valɛ nakpapɛɛ ne mumɡbalee, dɛ́ si kɛŋɔ kalampoŋa, dɛɛ si kɛŋɔ kwiu ken.

english_verse: Don't tell it in Gath! Don't even cry. Instead, roll in the dust at Beth-Leaphrah.
translation_verse: He bɛ a waa bol baɡle ya dɔma Gat tena, hé bɛ wi kwaraa ɡe. Hé ɡbili bomboɡ ta Bɛt Ofra, á baɡle kɛ he bambile chɔɡɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Marɔt tena, he lɔ bonyɛɡa ta, dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ he dɔ bosɔɔhna, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ chɔɡa ba ta he nɛ, hale a tel bwɛjen Jerusalam doonyojen tonɛ.

english_verse: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.
translation_verse: Lakes tena ɡe, hé vɔrɔwe kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore pɛl jaɡre. He chaa Israel tena wechɔɡa baa ɛa, a che a ta Jerusalam tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
translation_verse: Juda harɛ tena, hé kal Mɔresɛt Gat tena dɛ́ le bwɛɛ la ta, Israel koranar aa chae bɛlbwaa dɔ le Aksib tena be.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo dɔm ba yo he nɛra haa lɔ Maresa, dɛ́ pɔ he nɛ. Ásɛ Israel nomonome chwa ka sɔh Adulam bwebɔɔ bini.

english_verse: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Juda tena, hé fonɛ he nyuune, á baɡle kɛ he dɛ di suna, dɛ́ wi tɛ he bii haa dɛ nyin ba la. Hé paa he nyuune, á do kɛŋɔ kɔkɔsaki nyu, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa laɡ baa le he be kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa, dɛ chɔ ba chɔɔbɔra dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wedoŋa la, bá bwɛɛlɛ. Tɔɔ perɔ chɔɔ aa, dɛ ba ɛ ba wechɔɡa la, dɛkalkɛ kpeɡri baa dɔa nomanta, bɛlbwa aa won tɔ ba ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ nyin nɛra kooni kɛɛ deene aa, ba dɛ lɛa kpeɡri ne. Ba won nɛra deremi, kɛɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwaa ɡe lɛɛ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “N dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛ ń kpɔ wahala ba ta he nɛ, haa wola won chwa dɛ le a nyoa. Wenaale la dɛ ba he nɛɛ ɡwaala kohona, haa wola won valɛ dɛɛ ɡu kpa.

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, ɡɛ wiile aa teŋa nɔɔ, baa ba kpɔe muɡli he baah ŋɔ, ‘Ya na waa kɛrɛdɛ. Korowii ɡelɔ ba lɛ ya harɛ, dɛ kpɔ yaa tɛ nɛnchɔɡa.’ ”

english_verse: And so you will never again own property among the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Anomanta, bɛlbwa toole Korowii nɛra bini dɛ́ dɔ harɛ la le bie tae bini. Keame nyosonteŋna

english_verse: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
translation_verse: Ba keamere ŋɔ, “He bɛ Korowii waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la bol. Hɛ́ɛ berɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ bola, sihiih bɛlbwa aa won di yaa.”

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: Israel tena, a chɛ kɛ ya ŋɔ, “Korowii Doma baah di ya nɛɛ kɛɛ? Wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔɔ yaa?” Nomɛlbwa o wa aa toɡra la Korowii swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo.

english_verse: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “A ta biɡre n nɛra ɛ deŋnekpeɡ n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ n dɔma. Hé lɛ laaladɛɛɡa le nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa, wobɛlbwa aa wola ban hiaih be, ba do kɛ baala baa le laa ta dɛɛ ba ken.

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: He dɛ doŋi n nɛra haahna dɛɛ le ba deremi aa wera ta. He laa wedɛɛɡa maa sweera tɛ ba bii saŋ bɛlbwa la dɛɛ kpɔ.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Hé ir dɛ kaa, bonɔ ta bɔr haa so onɛ ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɡelɔ harɛ la kah doŋa. O chɔɡɔ baa wola won kwaaro kpa.

english_verse: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, “Drink and get drunk!” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Nɛra nɔ dɛ nyin keame waa teŋe nyosone ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo sene bwa soo siwi bu he nyɔ dɛ́ dɛɛ.’ Lɛɛ nyobaɡa

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
translation_verse: Israel tena, mɛɛ boa he bwa nyoa, kasinteŋ, mɛɛ boa he nɛra haa kaa la bwa nyoaa. Mɛɛ boa he nyoa kɛŋɔ peera yon pɛ do leɡ ta, kɛɛ kondɛɛra yon warɛ do dibɔr la. Gɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba ɡela nɛra su harɛ la ta kohona.”

english_verse: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
translation_verse: he hah waa aa wera dɛɛ nyin wechɔɡa, he dɛ pee n nɛra ola ne ba bɔtɔne kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa.

english_verse: break their bones, cook it all in a pot, and gulp it down.
translation_verse: He dɛ chwe ba ola dɛɛ swe ba bɔtɔne, dɛ chɛwɛ ba hoɡa jeɡrejeɡre, kɛŋɔ ba yon chɛwɛ ola do vii bini la ken.”

english_verse: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao nomonome nɔ wi yerɛ Korowii kɛ waa ban chaŋe, waa ba wesoŋaa no wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa.

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. “Keame nyosonteŋna ɡelɔ n nɛra nyoɡre, ba dɔ komɛl dɛ́ le nɛra be dɛ di aa, ba soŋe deŋnesɔɔhna dɛɛ tɛɛ ba. Ba ta komɛlbwa dɔe le ba be tenaa, ba dɛ kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ka yoo ba laa.

english_verse: “You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.
translation_verse: Anomanta, keame nyosonteŋna, a dɛ ba doe kɛŋɔ bɔr aa joa ta he nɛ, haa won dɛɛ na chaahna kɛɛ dɛɛ voɡɛ ɡe kpa.

english_verse: You prophets and fortunetellers will all be disgraced, with no message from me.”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ na waa chaahna ta, ne voɡra bwa dɛ ba sihiih dii. Ba bwa ɛɛ kpɔ nɔɔraa tɔ sie, dɛkalkɛ Korowii aa ban chaŋe.”

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Kɛ n te, Korowii ɡelɔ o Doma ba so n nɛ, asɛ n dɔ kasinteŋ ne kpeɡri dɛ́ bol Israel tena wechɔɡa wa.

english_verse: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.
translation_verse: Hé no, Israel sitɔɔla, he hah waa aa toɡra, dɛɛ berɛ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ sie.

english_verse: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɛŋkpoa ne kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe taa he che dɛɛ ma Korowii bwɛjen Jerusalam.

english_verse: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, “The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.”
translation_verse: Jerusalam sitɔɔla sɛoh baa yaɡ ba sen, sɔfore bol Korowii waa dɛɛ lɛ suuɡa, keamere ɡe baɡle waa baa naa chaahna ta dɛɛ lɛ suuɡa. Kɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii nɛɛ ya kpɔ ya te dawɛ, yaa wenaale bɛlbwaa na.”

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: He nomanta, Saayɔn ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ koo baa parɔ dɛ du kwaa o ta ken, Jerusalam bwa ɛɛ kuuɡuu dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ Korowii Bwejen Dea aa chɔŋɛ o ta la berɛ kɔr.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Tɔpera ane dɛ ba, ásɛ Korowii Bwejen Dea aa chɔŋɛ o ta la do jaŋne ɡwaa bwejena bwa. Wɛɛ kpeɡuu ɡwaa deŋɡarere bwa, ásɛ nɛra warɛ le harɛre ta dɛɛ ba o ta.

english_verse: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra ɡalɡa ɛɛ bao dɛ́ ba ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya kaa Korowii Bwejen la ta, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la Dea. Wɛɛ chaɡle yaa o ŋwɛnɛree, ásɛ ya won dɛɛ kpɔ a ta.” Korowii Mmara ɛɛ le Saayɔn Bwejen taa, ásɛ o kpɔ bol waa o nɛra be Jerusalam.

english_verse: He will settle arguments between distant and powerful nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never again make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ bol harɛre nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ kwaa harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa baah. Baa beɡre ba kerii a ɛ para, dɛ́ beɡre ba lampeare ɡe ɡoori. Harɛre nɛra aa dɔŋaa yo, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa hweli laa waa kpa.

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Bɛlbwa ɛɛ so deŋnesɔɔhna taa, asɛ daa kooni ne fiɡ daa kooni baro cheme, nomɛlbwa aa wola won ba aah ba kpa. Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡaree, kɛ ya te, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ waa taa yaa ba teŋa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Korowii liire waa dɔa

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ n boa nɛra maa tɛr ba deŋne nyoa, nɛra maa ɡela ba laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta la.

english_verse: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo boobie ka, dɛ́ le nɛra baa doŋ ba le harɛfale ta ba la, berɛ warɛ kohona dɛ́ do kpeɡri. Men Korowii ɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ le awola, ne saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la Saayɔn Bwejen waa lɔ Jerusalam.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Bɔkwa waa bala hɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre nɔɔ? He ta kooro dɔe kpa kɛɛ? Nɛn waa bol waa dɛɛ ja heyaa sewɔ, a kpɔ weweele ta he nɛɛ hɛɛ pɛmɛ kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ waa?

english_verse: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, hé ɡbaɡre dɛ́ɛ pɛmɛ kohona, kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ. A chɛ kɛ he le bwɛjen nɔ ta, dɛ́ ka so kpɔɡ bini. A chɛ kɛ he dɔma lawɛ heya kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn, ásɛ mɔɔ Korowii ba lɛ heyaa le ba nɔn ta.

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Taraken, harɛre nɛra pɛ nyoa dɛ́ ba yo heya. Ba ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ Jerusalam paɡre dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia, ásɛ ya sie lɛ a wa.”

english_verse: But they don't know that I, the Lord, have gathered them here to grind them like grain.
translation_verse: Kɛ baa Korowii liire jemɛ, baa jemɛ kɛŋɔ o boa ba nyoa dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne, kɛŋɔ ba yon boa mea nyoa dɛɛ ba a lɔe la.

english_verse: Smash them to pieces, Zion! I'll let you be like a bull with iron horns and bronze hoofs. Crush those nations and bring their wealth to me, the Lord of the earth.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam tena, hé ir ka yo he dɔma, mɛɛ ɡeloo he do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nabal waa dɔ bune nyeɡlare, o nafikokore ɡe do kɛŋɔ ayaawa ken. Hɛɛ yo harɛre ɡalɡa nɛraa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kondɔɔh baa yo nɛra dɛ lɛa la, ba tɛ men Korowii maa ɛ harɛ nɔ bwa dɔɔ la.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, enemy troops have surrounded you; they have struck Israel's ruler in the face with a stick.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, hé boa he laa tena nyoa, laa tena chɔɔ bar bwɛjen la dɛ́ ba yo yaa. Baa kpɔ daa lɔ Israel kooro kaŋe sihiih kpoo o jirima tonɛ.

english_verse: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Juda harɛ bwɛjeɡa Bɛtlɛham, Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bini bwɛsala laa hen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he taa kooro ɛɛ ba lee, dɛ́ nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will abandon Israel only until this ruler is born, and the rest of his family returns to Israel.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ vɛh o nɛra Israel tenaa tɛ ba dɔma, ka tel kɛŋɔ haah la loltea aa lɔɔ aa lolɛ o bie. Israel tena baa lɔ bojaŋ harɛfale ta ɛɛ berɔ ba ja ba bala Israel tena nɛ.

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: O balaa, wɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ kɛ peteɡre, Korowii kpeɡri ne o sɔn waa kana ne, ásɛ o nɛra bwara sɔɔh ba. Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ na kan Korowii aa doa ɡɛ saŋ.

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: Onee dɛ́ ba tɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna. Lɛɛ ne deŋnetɛra wa Dɛ Asiiria tena baa yo ya harɛ, dɛ won jo ya dekpeɡa yaa sɔh a bini ta naa, yaa le nomonome baa wara kohonaa bá ka yoo ba.

english_verse: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
translation_verse: Nomonome la ɛɛ ka yo Asiiria tena baa ɛ Nimrod harɛ ta tena laalee, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ. Baa lɛ yaa le Asiiria laa tena nɔn taa awola baa ba che ya nɛɛ dɛ́ valɛ kaa ya harɛ jwɛhre ta la.

english_verse: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
translation_verse: Israel tena baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar baa ka la ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ mɛn aa le Korowii be, dɛ koo harɛre nɛra bini, kɛŋɔ bwaala aa wir kpɔɡa ta, aa wola nɛn siwi ta nyiŋi mɔɔ la.

english_verse: At present they are scattered, but later they will attack, as though they were fierce lions pouncing on sheep. Their enemies will be torn to shreds, with no one to save them;
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa kaa dɛ peɡre ka do harɛre ta la, ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nyujente aa lɔ kpɔɡ bini, dɛɛ kpaah ola kɛɛ peera dɛ́ pee a ola, baa wola lɛɛ dɔ.

english_verse: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
translation_verse: Gɛɛ he Israel tena ɛɛ ba yoi, dɛ́ pɔ he dɔma nɛ, ásɛ dɛ chɔɡ ba kwaraa.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ chɔɡ jaɡre haa dɛ la ane laa, ne kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛla bwa.

english_verse: as well as your cities and your fortresses.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ he harɛ bwɛjenaa, dɛ́ kuuɡi he dekpeɡa ɡe bwa.

english_verse: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ he voɡra ne sɔm we-ɛɛla bwaa, ásɛ haa won dɛɛ voɡɛ kpa.

english_verse: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔɔ chɔɡ voɡa haa sɛah, ne bwea haa paaɡa dɛɛ duura bwaa, ásɛ haa kwaa he ɡbabir aa kwaara laanee tomɛ kpa.

english_verse: together with the sacred poles and even your towns.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ fuɡri voɡhaah Asera dajaŋaa le he bini, dɛ́ paɡre he bwɛjena.

english_verse: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia kohonaa ba ta harɛre nɛra baa wola n waa ta teŋɛ la nɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.”

english_verse: The Lord said to his people: Come and present your case to the hills and mountains.
translation_verse: Israel tena, hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol. “Hé ir, dɛ́ kpɔ he waa ka bil bwejena ne deŋɡarere sie.

english_verse: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
translation_verse: Bwejena ne kwaa bwa haa le saŋ la bwa do le dɛ lawɛ harɛ kpoŋe ɡe, hé no. Korowii ne o nɛra Israel tena dɔɔ, wɛɛ ba ba waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: N nɛra Israel tena, bɔkwa waa n ɛ heya ɔ? N ɛ heyaa waane dɛ jo he nɛɛ kɛɛ? Hé chaŋ mɛ.

english_verse: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
translation_verse: He fa ɛ yoma Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ n lawɛ heyaa le bela. N tomɛ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Miriam, bá ba tɔ he sie.

english_verse: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord, saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal. True Obedience
translation_verse: N nɛra, hé lii wechɔɡa Moab Kooro Balak fa aa vɔrɔwa, asɛ Beɔ bibaa Balam chaŋo la wa. Hé berɛ lii ŋwɛnɛ haa vala le Sitim dɛ ba Gelɡal, dɛ́ na ŋwɛnɛre maa cheɡɛ a ta lɛ heya.”

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba Korowii waa dɛ di kora nyundua sie ba tomɔ wɔ? Ń kpɔ nabiiri aa di benanyoa ba fuah ɛ saraha o sie naa?

english_verse: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
translation_verse: Ń kpɔ pebala kaɡboŋa ne ɔleve noo aa wara dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ moo ba tɛ Korowii aa? O sie ɛɛ lɛ n nɛɛ yaa? Kɛɛ ń lawɛ n biloɡle, ba bɔ n wechɔɡa maa ɛa kem ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: “See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.” Cheating and Violence
translation_verse: Akai, waa aa weraa Korowii chaɡle yaa, wáa waa dɛ nyin dɛ́ le ya be laanee kɛŋɔ, ya di kasinteŋ dɛɛ sune dɔŋa nɛ, dɛ́ pwɛr ya te tɛo. Israel tena bolchɔɡe dii ne deŋnetɛra wa

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: A ɛ wejemwa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii. O dɛ yerɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen Jerusalam ŋɔ, “Hé no, he nɛra haa baa cheme bwɛjen la bini!

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ won kpɔ nɛra baa maɡɛ kwaa dɛɛ faah nɛra bwara kɛ ba aa?

english_verse: You rich people are violent, and everyone tells lies.
translation_verse: He nɛra haa dɔ suuɡa dɛɛ ɛɡre nyaara, nyosonteŋna ɡe ɡboo he bwa.

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n pa mun dɛ́ chɔɡ heya, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa la wa.

english_verse: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ di kwaa kɛ haa vaɡɛ, a do kɛ he ta komɛlbwa dii. Hɛɛ dɛɛ cheɡ kwaa, kɛ aa le he nɔn taa, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba chea laa ta kaa.

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ du koo kwaa kɛ haa komɛlbwaa na komɛ, hɛɛ harame ɔleveree dɛ dɔ a no, kɛ haa dɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa, dɛ harame ɡrepo nɔna ɛ sen, haa dɔ nyɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
translation_verse: He teŋɛ Kooro Omri mmarare, ne o bibaa Kooro Ahab dem tena wedoŋa baa ɛa ta, ba we-ɛɛla la taa hɛɛ teŋɛ. Anomanta, mɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa, ásɛ harɛre nɛra mamɛ heya.”

english_verse: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.
translation_verse: Ba doŋi nɛra baa dɛ duu Korowii bwa le harɛ la ta, nomɛlbwa ta kae o waa toɡre kpa. Nɛra bwa chɔɔ dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ bá kpoo nɛra, bɛlbwa dɛ harɛ o dɔŋ bel dɛ́ dɔɔ lawɛ.

english_verse: The most honest of them is worse than a thorn patch. Your doom has come! Lookouts sound the warning, and everyone panics.
translation_verse: Ba bini nɛndɛɛɡe kwaraa do kɛŋɔ jabalnadaŋɛ. Onɔ la o wa aa toɡra ɡe do kɛŋɔ sɔɔh daa ken. Tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ Korowii tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ waa cheɡɛ keamere baa dɛ daah ba nɛɛ kah ba la, ba wilo taraken kwara.

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ berɛ he dɔŋ yaradae ka tonɛ, bɛ he dam ɡba nɛɛ hwɛɡɛ. Hale he haah he ne waa pɛa dɛɛ chɔ kalaŋ ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyoa wobol ta kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: Bibaa ne o mɛɛ ɛɛ dɔmoo, bihaah ne o nya dɔm, ásɛ bihaah ne o helahaah ɡe dɔm, ásɛ nɛn lolanar berɛ o dɔma.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Kɛ n te, n dɛ hwɛɡɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii ŋwɛnɛ. Korowii waa ɛ n Lɛɛ laanee mɛɛ kpa, wɛɛ no n bee. Israel ɛɛ iruu

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: Ya dɔma, he bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ. A lole kɛ ya cholo te, yaa iruu. Ya lɔ biro ta te, Korowiirii dɛ́ do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah yaa bɔr.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: Ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, anomanta, a chɛ kɛ yá na o bandia tama mɔɔ. Wɛɛ lɛ yaa dɛ́ le chɔɡre baa kpɔa ɛ yaa la ta. Wɛɛ lawɛ yaa ba bɔchaah ta, ásɛ ya na toɡra o wa aa toɡra.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: Belaa ya dɔma ɛɛ ba a nae ásɛ sihiih kpo ba. Banee fa muɡli ya baah ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ tenɔ?” Yaa soo dɛ́ na ba chola, baa tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ tiɡri kpechɛɡre ta ken fɔɡbaahna.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena, tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ he berɛ kwaa ma he bwɛjen danjwɛɛre la, dɛ́ paɡri he harɛ jwɛhre kaa sie.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Kɛ harɛ bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, o nɛra we-ɛɛla wa, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken. Korowii suna waa sune Israel tena nɛ

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: Ya Naa Korowii, nyiŋi he nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre aa dɛ nyiŋi peera, nɛra haa lee ba tɛ he te la. Ya do kɛ peera aa pere a te, dɛ ka do kpɔɡbaah dɛɛ di. Gel he nɛra ka do harɛpare ondɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ Basan ne Gelead ta, dɛɛ di kɛ saŋ la.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Gel ya na he nyokpowe-ɛɛla, ɡɛ haa ɛa dɛ fa le ya ne Ijipt harɛ ta ba la.

english_verse: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ nao sihiih kpo ba, ba kpeɡri bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ. Ba bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, bá kpɔ nɔɔra tɔ nyoo, dɛ́ tɔɔɡe ba deŋna.

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Baa di teeraa kɛŋɔ harɛkon, kɛŋɔ kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta ken. Baa le ba dekpeɡa taa bochela ne ɔmee ne, dɛ́ berɛ ba hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ sie.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, nomɛlbwa ta do kɛŋɔ hen, he kpɔ he nɛra baa kaa wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ ba, he nɛra baa ɛ he kapɛrɛ nɛra la. He baah diu waa, aa biɡri, he sie dɛ lɛ kɛ hɛɛ na ya sum.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ berɔɔ dɔ tedoma ya nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ naa tire ya wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ kpɔa ka ta mpo vile ta.

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ ne he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe taa, dɛ́ sune Jekɔb ne Abraham naanar nɛ, ɡɛ haa baɡɛ ya naawa nyoa saŋ la.

english_verse: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ bwɛjen Niniwe, Korowii bol baɡle Neehum waa le Ɛlkɔs chaahna ta, asɛ o chwerɛ bil laanee nɔ. Korowii baah di Niniwe tena nɛ

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: Korowii baah aa di warawara, o dɔ kpeɡri kohona. Waa wechɔɡ-ɛɛ bɛlbwaa ɡel dɛ o ta o deŋne tɛrɛ. Bobɛlbwa Korowii aa dɛ valɛ la, belaa kawulewule ne dompeu ɛɛ ta, asɛ baama ɛ o nakpale tutuɡ.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.
translation_verse: O dɛ bol wa mpo hweeh, dɛ́ ɡel neerare bwa hweeh. Basan harɛdɛɛɡe ne Kaamɛl Bwejen bwa dɛ hol, asɛ Lɛbanɔn daa fee bwa ɡe ɛɛ serewe.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Bwejena dɛ jiɡri o sie, deŋɡarere ɛɛ mwɛɛ. Korowii leɔ dɛɛ ba naa, harɛ bwa ne nɛra baa lɔ o ta bwa dɛ chel.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: O baah diu waa, umee dɛ́ won che a nyoa ɔ? Umee dɛ́ won ba o sie o bandichɔɡe ta nɔ? O baah diu kohona naa, a do kɛŋɔ baa fuɡe nii ta ken, bwea bwa dɛ peɡri burbur ken o sie.

english_verse: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Korowii wer, o kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra nɛɛ ba wenaale tɔpere, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ yaradao nɛ.

english_verse: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
translation_verse: Kɛ Niniwe te, wɛɛ chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ nee waa sua dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa, ásɛ dɛ doŋi o dɔma ta biro ta.

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Korowii vɔrɔwa bɛlbwa dɔma aa vɔrɔwa la, wɛɛ chɔɡ a bwaa, wekpeɡa bɛlbwa aa berɛ ba nɛɛtena kpa.

english_verse: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
translation_verse: He sennyɔɔra, nii ɛɛ fuh heyaa kɛŋɔ sɔɔhne aa kaɡre dawii baah ken.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Niniwe, he taa nɛnchɔɡe le dɛɛ vɔrɔwe Korowii vɔrɔwa, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: Anomanta, kenii Korowii ɛɛ bol o nɛra Juda tena be, “A lole kɛŋɔ Asiiria tena kpeɡri, dɛ warɛ dɛ dɔ nɛra bá ba cha ba, kɛ mɛɛ chɔɡ baa le harɛ nɔ ta bá he kwaraa. Juda tena, menee ɡela he fa na wahala, kɛ maa berɛ ɡel he na ɡɛ kpa.

english_verse: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ teŋe kpeɡri Asiiria tena aa dɛ di he nɛɛ la taa, dɛ́ chaa jɔɡrɔre aa vɔrɔwe heyaa la.”

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Kenii Korowii bol he Asiiria tena waa bil, “Haa naanaree dɔ dɛ́ kpɔ he sɔna pa ba. Mɛɛ chɔɡ voɡa haa sɛah daa nee, dɛ anɔ la haa loɡa a do he voɡa deene bini la. Mɛɛ kwi he lalbɔɔ bil, dɛkalkɛ he waa ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe.”

english_verse: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
translation_verse: Hé ha sie nyiŋi bwejena dor! Nɛn waa kpoŋe amanesoma dɛ valɛ bela, dɛɛ bol deŋnesɔɔhna wa. Juda tena, hé di he tɔpejena la, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa haa baɡɛ Korowii nyoa la ba tɛo. Nyubinikpeɡ tena aa heyaa ba yo he harɛ ta kpa. Mɛɛ chɔɡ ba bwaa kwaraa.

english_verse: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!
translation_verse: Niniwe tena, nomɛl dɛ ba ba yo heya. Hé daah he dekpeɡ la! Hé ta sie ŋwɛnɛ ta! Hé che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ kpɔ he te ka yo!

english_verse: Judah and Israel are like trees with branches broken by their enemies. But the Lord is going to restore their power and glory. *
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ dɛɛ ba Jekɔb jirima kpɔe tɛo, kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ Israel tena jirima tɛɛ ba la. A lole kɛŋɔ nɛnchɔɡa chɔɡ ba bwa, harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ chɔɡ ɡrepo daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen bwa.

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Niniwe laa nomoa le o laa tena baa kpeɡa, kɛ ba lɔ nakpale ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ ba. Ba chwao dɛ ka marɛ bwɛjen la danjwɛ, dɛ kpɔ kon tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe.

english_verse: The river gates fly open, and panic floods the palace.
translation_verse: Gbeni baa kpɔa tɔ nee la nyoa la pilo, asɛ koodem la bwa kuuɡi.

english_verse: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ Niniwe chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ ba lawɛ o nɛra laa ta kaa. O toli ɛɛ wiu kɛŋɔ kwehre ken, dɛɛ lɔ ba bambile á baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna.

english_verse: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!” can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.
translation_verse: Nɛra le Niniwe dɛɛ kaa kɛŋɔ nee aa pala le tam ta ken. Ba bala dɛ yer ba ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel! Hé ɡel!” Kɛ nomɛlbwa aa habɔɔ berɛ.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Hé pa ba suuɡapoŋa ne ba suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa. Kondɔɔh su bwɛɛ la bwa, a ta nyoa dɔe.

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Bɔkwa waa pu bwɛɛ o fa aa do kɛŋɔ nyujentena sobɔr laɔ? Niniwe tena fa aa lɔ ba bwɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyujente ombal ne onnee, dɛ so bela dɛɛ dɛ́ɛ a bii, a ne a biirii ba dɛɛ ka, aa wola komɛlbwa ɔmɛ.

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Ba do kɛŋɔ nyujente aa kpo ol, dɛ peeɡe o bini tɛ o haah ne bii, dɛ che ol la su o bɔɔ bini.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “N cheɡɛ he nɛ. Mɛɛ fuh torɔɡore haa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre laanee. Baa kpoo he laa tena laa taa, dɛ́ pa laala haa paa le bane be la. Baa he toroma taa no kpa bwa.”

english_verse: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery,
translation_verse: Bwɛjen nɛŋkpoa ne nyosonteŋna aa su o ta la tena bwɛɛlɛ. Kondɔɔh su he bwa, he dɔma ɛɛ ba a pae kaa.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Niniwe, n cheɡɛ he nɛ. Mɛɛ laa he yalee kpɔ he mun ta, dɛ́ ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa nae, ásɛ sihiih kpoe ba siwi ta.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpɔ doŋaa ta he nɛ, n siwi aa hen su, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra bwa kpɔ sie pa he nɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa nae la ɛɛ le habɔɔ dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Niniwe chɔɡɔ kwaraa. Umee dɛ́ wi tɛo wɔ? Leperaa ń dɔ nɛn ó larawe o bwara ɔ?’ ”

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: He ɡwaa bwɛjen Tebes waa chɔ Nael Moo nyoa nee bar o bwa la kɛɛ? Nee laanee tɔɔ ɡbemɡbe, dɛ do kɛŋɔ danjwɛ.

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Onee dɛɛ nyiŋi Itiopia ne Ijipt harɛre ta, o kpeɡri ta nyoa dɔe, Put ne Lebya harɛre nɛra bwa ɡe jao dɛɛ chao.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Kɛ ba wono ba yo he nɛra, dɛ laɡ ba kaa harɛfale bɛl ta. Ba lawɛ bechale dɛ kpɔ ba cha harɛ ba bini toɡri chɔ fɔɡbaahna. Ba lawɛ nomonjena dɛ bil daa ba nyuune ta, dɛ kpɔ jɔɡrɔre do sitɔɔla.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ he Niniwe tena ɡe ɛɛ ba dɛɛra dɛ́ chwa ka sɔh, dɛ́ nyin bɔr ka marɛ he dɔma bɛ heyaa na.

english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: Dekpeɡa aa tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe la bwa do kɛŋɔ fiɡ daa aa nɔnɛ a nɔnloɡla, dɛ ba yiiɡi daa la aa, o nɔna yon ba lee naate waa dia la nyoa bini.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: He laa tena bwa berɛ haahna. He bwɛjena doonyoo pilo paɡri nɛɛ tɛ he dɔma, a doonyoo ɡbeni bwa fuoh.
