english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Belaa nii ɛɛ ba heyaa fuih, ba kpoo heyaa laa ta, dɛ́ he heyaa kɛŋɔ tontombɛ yon di kwaa la. Hé ɡel he nɛra warɛ kɛ hɔɔhre, kɛɛ tontombɛ.

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ he bonadiire warɛ dɛ ɡwaa weweela. Kɛ ba do kɛŋɔ tontombɛ ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ kwaa bwa kwaraa dɛ́ ir kaa.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ daah heya, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma koodem bela la, ba do kɛŋɔ tontombɛ aa wura ba maɡre danjwɛɛre ta waa saŋ, dɛ wee baa le aa, a yon ir kaa la, nomɛlbwa aa wola bela aa ira kaa jemɛ.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Asiiria koojen, nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi he harɛ ta kɛ peteɡra la bwa chɔɔɡɔ. He nomonjena bwa serewɔ. He nɛra la bwa peɡrɔ dɛ do bwea dor, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ boa ba nyoa.

english_verse: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa aa won ɡel he ŋwɛra tonɛ, bola baa do heyaa la ɛɛ kpoo heyaa. Nomɛlbwa waa no he waa sie ɛɛ lɛo dɛ́ lɔ kpaŋa ta he nɛɛ a wa. Umee wola he nyubinikpeɡ haa ɛa aa wola nyoa dɔe la nyoŋwaara nae ba nɔ?

english_verse: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa pila baɡle o keame Habakuk chaahna ta laanee nɔ. Habakuk wenaɡra

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: “N Naa Korowii, kera aŋwɛnɛɛ ń yerɛ ŋɔ hé cha mɛ mɔɔ he no, kɛɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le naɡrenyine we-ɛɛla ta nɔ?

english_verse: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ he ɡel mɛɛ na we-ɛɛla aa wola toɡrɛ ɡbo nɔɔ? Ɛrɛɛ he laa sie kpɔ nɛra nɛɛ baa ɛ wechɔɡa nɔɔ? Kwaa chɔɡa ne naɡrenyin we-ɛɛlaa chɔ n sie. Yoi ne nyopɛo bɛ dɔe bar mɛ cheme.

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Mmara bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ di nɛn, anomanta, kasinteŋ toole kpa. Nɛnchɔɡa dɛ tɔ nɛndɛɛɡa ŋwɛnɛ, dɛɛ berɛ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ sie.” Waa Korowii aa chaŋa

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Ba waa dɔ ɔmee ne hundam, ba ɡbaɡba mmara taa baa teŋɛ, baa nomɛlbwa waa no.

english_verse: Their cavalry troops are faster than leopards, more ferocious than wolves hunting at sunset, and swifter than hungry eagles suddenly swooping down.
translation_verse: Ba jaɡre ɡbaŋre ɡwaa nonietena, dɛ do ɔma ɡwaa ɡboli lɔr aa dɛ kpoa jɔmɔra. Ba nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta ɡe le bojaŋa, dɛ chwa kohona dɛɛ ba, kɛŋɔ kokosakire yon ir le nyundua ba harɛ baa di ol la.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ wur kaa kɛŋɔ peu yon ta dɛ kpɔ haahra kaa la. A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ, ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ ba bokpeɡa ta kɛŋɔ nɛn aa kpɔ sie dawɛ o voɡ ta la.” Habakuk wenaɡra nɛɛtena

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: He do ɡoroŋ kohona, haa soɡee dɛɛ nyiŋi waa aa ɛ wechɔɡa. Haa wechɔɡa nyin. Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba nyoa tɔe, dɛ́ nyiŋi nɛnchɔɡa bá chɔɡ nɛra ba wechɔɡa aa wola doe kɛ ban ɔ?

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ nɛwɛnyina do kɛŋɔ mpo bini pɛŋa, ne mpo bini koŋkwaa aa wola nomoa dɔe wɛɛ nyiŋi a nɛ.

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: Ba dɔma Babelɔn tena kpɔ ɡoŋri dɛɛ laɡ ba kɛŋɔ pɛŋa ken, dɛ kpɔ dɔɔne tɛɡ ba dɛɛ le baŋ, asɛ ba sie lɛ baa hɛɡre a ta.

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ ba dɔɔne, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛa dɛɛ toma, dɛkalkɛ a ɡɛ kwaa laanee dɛɛ tɛɛ ba ba kondɛɛɡa, ne kondikondɛɛɡa tenten bwa.

english_verse: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?
translation_verse: Baa ɡeloo ba teŋɛ dɛ́ kpoo harɛre nɛra kɛŋɔ pɛŋa baa wola ba sumii na naa?

english_verse: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ iruu che n jɛŋla doa, dɛ́ nyiŋi dɛ́ no waa Korowii aa dɛ ba n be bola. Dɛ o chaŋ mɛ naa, ń na ɡɛ maa dɛ ba o be bola. Waa Korowii aa chaŋa

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ waa maa pili a bini baɡle chaahna ta la dawɛ bwepɛle ta, ɡɛ baa dɛ ba wona naa dɛ́ kure.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛl ta dɛ ba ásɛ waa maa pili a bini baɡle la tel. A dɛ baɡle ɡɛ waa bwa jaɡa saŋ aa dɛ ba doe. A ɛ kasinteŋ. Hale a biɡro kwaraa naa, hé so kpaa. Kasinteŋ, aa bao. Aa biɡri bɛlbwa.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Wepila laanee nɔ, Babelɔn tena baa ɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena aa ba nyuu dɔ, kɛ naate o waa aa toɡra dɛɛ su Korowii siwi la, wɛɛ yaradao dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Kondɔɔh neɡre Babelɔn tena dɛ ɡel ba nyoɡre. Ba ɛ kafonyine, ba siwi aa kwaa su bwa. Ba jenu dɛɛ ɛ sikpeɡ kɛŋɔ seo waa wola vaɡɛ bwa la. A waa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ pɔ harɛre nɛra nɛ, dɛɛ laɡ ba laa ta.

english_verse: But they will be mocked with these words: You're doomed! You stored up stolen goods and cheated others of what belonged to them.
translation_verse: Nɛra Babelɔn tena aa pɔ ba nɛɛ la ɛɛ mam baa dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Hé bwɛɛlɛ, kɛ haa cheɡ kwaa aa wola he kwaa ɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ nɛnfaah kwaa ɛ kondɔɔh nɔ. Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ka jaɡɔɔ?’

english_verse: But without warning, those you owe will demand payment. Then you will become a frightened victim.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa di he kema la dɛ ba ira kerabeŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ do heyaa sibeɡra he bwara ɛɛ sa. A ba ɡɛ naa, baa pa he laala kpeɡri nee.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta dɛɛ nyin kondɔɔh dɛ́ tɛ o nɛra, dɛɛ nyin bodɛɛɡe dɛ́ so, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won tel o be dɛ́ chɔɡo la, ó bwɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: He vɔrɔwɔ dɛ chɔɡ harɛre nɛra kohona, dɛ ɡel sihiih kpo he ɡbaɡba dem tena, dɛ berɛ ba waane ba dawɛ he nɛ.

english_verse: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
translation_verse: Bwea haa kpɔa ma dea la ɛɛ do lɔŋɔree kɛŋɔ nɛra ken, ásɛ doli haa kpɔa tɔɔ la ɡe sɛh.

english_verse: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ nɛŋkpoa kɛɛ wechɔɡa ta dɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛjen la, ó bwɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛa kɛŋɔ harɛre nɛra toma baa ɛa dɛ koh la bwa dɛ ba fuih. A bwa ɛ koeh pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Gɛ nee aa su mpo ta la, ɡɛɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɛɛ ba Korowii kpeɡri ne o jirima kohona jema.

english_verse: You're doomed! You get your friends drunk, just to see them naked.
translation_verse: Babelɔn tena, he bwɛɛlɛ! He tɛ he bala sen ba nyɔ dɛɛ, dɛ chɔ mumɡbal dɛ di sihiih.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.
translation_verse: Jirima he fe aa dɔ la ɛɛ berɛ sihiih. He saŋ telo name, hé nyɔ dɛ́ chɔ mumɡbal! Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he ɡbaɡba nyɔ o danana nee aa su numol, ásɛ ncho dii tɔ jirima he fe aa dɔ la ta.

english_verse: You destroyed trees and animals on Mount Lebanon; you were ruthless to towns and people everywhere. Now you will be terrorized. Idolatry Is Foolish
translation_verse: Gɛ haa teŋe Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta daa la, ɡɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba he ɡe chɔɡa. Gɛ haa kpo kpɔɡ bini ola la, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ba a waa nae. He kpoo nɛra dɛ fuɡe ba chal ta harɛ la ta, he chɔɡ harɛre ne bwɛjena ne a nɛra bwa.

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ voɡ nɛwɛnyini aa kpɔ nɔn sɛoh la dɔɔ? O waa bwa ɛ nyosone. Nɛn waa kwaaro la dɔ yarada o ta. O dɛ kwaa voɡa aa wola won waa bol.

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Nɛn waa ŋɔ dakpul be ŋɔ ó dɔ mkpa, kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ bwe waa wola hweera dɔe be ŋɔ ó ir la, ó bwɛɛlɛ! Wɛɛ won baɡle wa aa? Suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋee ba kpɔ fɔɡle o bwa, o ta hweera bɛlbwa dɔe.

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Korowii lɔ o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ bini. Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta, hé bwa hel o sie.”

english_verse: This is my prayer:
translation_verse: Korowii keame Habakuk waa waa soŋe Korowii nɔ.

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, n no he waa haa ɛa la. He we-ɛɛla nomanta, n cheɡɔ n bwara ɛɛ chel. Berɛ ɛ a ɡɛ wejena la ya saŋ nɔ ta, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ya jemɛ a wa, ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa yaa ɛ he baah di la, hé sune ya nɛ.

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, he le Teman harɛ ta ba. He ɛ Korowii Haa Do Goroŋ dɛ le Paran Bwejen ta. He jirima tɔ nyundua, asɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ kpɛɛre harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: He wer do kɛŋɔ wee aa dɛ le chɔɔbɔr la. He nɔmpaa bini dɛ nyɛɡle al-al ken, belaa he kpeɡri sɔh.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: Weechɔɡa tɔ he sie, asɛ he ŋɔ seo be ŋɔ ó teŋɛ he nɛ.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: He iro che asɛ harɛ jiɡri, he ta sie nyiŋi harɛre nɛra aa, dɛ ba dɛ chel. Bwejena aa lole le saŋ la bwa kuuɡo, asɛ deŋɡarere a ɡe aa lole le saŋ la bwa ɡe bur. He te ŋwɛnɛre ta jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: N na Kusan tena tɛnte deene bini baa ɔmɛ taeh, ɡɛɛ Midian tena ɡe bwara ɛɛ sa ba tɛnte deene bini.

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: He harɛ he to kpa, dɛɛ nyin he ta he hɛma. He kpɔ bwaala nyɛɡla pere harɛ bini.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Bwejena nae dɛɛ chel, asɛ bwaala nɛ, nee su dɛ palɛ baa kaa dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa, dɛɛ ta nehɛma kohona.

english_verse: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
translation_verse: Wee ne korobie cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ nyundua, dɛkalkɛ he dɛ ta he hɛma ne he lampea, aa nyɛɡle al-al ken dɛ baa kaa.

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: He leɔ ba kɛŋɔ he ba lɛ he nɛra, ne nɛn haa leo o ɛ kooro. He chɔɡ harɛ baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa o ta nomoa, dɛ lɛ o kpeɡri bwa.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: He hɛma yaɡɛ o laa sitɔɔ, ɡɛ saŋ o laa tena aa wura ba tɔ ya nɛɛ dɛ lɔ yaa peɡre la. Ba sie lɛɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa sɔah dɛɛ fiiɡi nɛŋɡwɛɡra.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: He kpɔ he jaɡre ka do mpo ta aa valɛ, dɛɛ vuuɡi nehɛma aa dɛ ta kohona la.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: N noɔ asɛ n bambile teŋe, n nyoa kpo a ɡɛ ɡbɔɡa la wa, n bwara yɔrɔ, n nakpale bwa ɛɛ sa. Kɛ n sɔɔh bwara dɛɛ kpa tɔpechɔɡe wee Korowii aa ba tɛr nɛra baa dɛ yo yaa deŋne.

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Hale dɛ fiɡ daa ta feɛ, ɡrepo daa ɡe ta nɔnɛ, ɔleve daa ɡe vɛh nɔna, kondikwaa ta ɛɛ, peera toole leɡ bini, asɛ nae ɡe toole a leɡ ta naa,

english_verse: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
translation_verse: Korowii nomanta, mɛɛ hɛɡroo, n sie lɛ Korowii waa ɛ n Lɛɛ la nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowiirii n kpeɡri, o ɡelɔ n nakpale do kɛŋɔ chwae kwaa ken, n won bwejena dor vala. N chwerɛ waa nɔ ka tɛ yela nomoa ó kpɔ o janjela ne kwaa aa do ɡɛ la lɔa.

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡle Sefania, ɡɛ saŋ Amɔn bibaa Josia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta laanee nɔ. Sefania mɛɛ sɔne Kusi, asɛ Kusi mɛɛ sɔne Gedalia, Gedalia mɛɛ sɔne Amaria, asɛ Amaria ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Hɛsɛkea. Korowii Tɔpere waa bol waa dɛ́ pa bole

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba komɛlbwa chɔɡa le harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ nɛwɛnyina ne ola bwaa, ne jumbii aa dɛ ɡah nyundua, ne mpo bini pɛŋa bwa. Nɛnchɔɡa ɛɛ daŋɔɔ chɔ kɛŋɔ dea aa chola chɔ ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛwɛnyina bwa, nomɛlbwa aa wola ka. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛr Juda harɛ, ne nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam la bwa deŋnee. Mɛɛ chɔɡ voɡ Baal ne o komɛlbwaa kwaraa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa o kerekpoŋra la waa lii kpa.

english_verse: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ chɔɡ nɛra baa teehna kaa deene dor kaa tomɛ wee, ne korobie dɛ weweela, ne banɔ la baa ŋwɛɛra ŋɔ ba dɛ tom mɛ kɛ dɛ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡ Molɛk ɡe ja laanee.

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: Bɛ́lbwa hel men Nemenɛ Korowii sie. Tɔpere maa lea cheɡ dɛ́ bol n nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole la telo tonɛ. N dɛ ba n nɛra Juda tena kpoora ɛ saraha, dɛ́ le ba dɔma bá ba yoo ba dɛ́ pa ba laala.

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Korowii saraha Tɔpere la, mɛɛ tɛr nomonome ne koobii dɛ nɛra baa kpɔ harɛfale bɛl nawee waa do ba te la deŋnee.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ tɔpere la, hɛɛ no wii le bwɛjen Jerusalam Pɛŋa Doonyoa bela, dɛ́ no wii le bwɛɛ la bwɛfala pera, ásɛ ɡbɔɡa kohona ɛɛ le deŋɡarere aa bɛne bwɛɛ la dor.

english_verse: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
translation_verse: He nɛra haa soɡe bwɛɛ la yawa ta bɔr pera, hɛ́ɛ wi kohona, he bonadiire ne banɔ la baa dɛ peɡri suuɡapoŋa la bwa dɛ́ ba serewa.

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ mɛɛ kpɔ kandeaa ɡaaɡe Jerusalam bwa, dɛ́ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa ta ban hiaeh, ba nyu bini do ba som la deŋne, dɛɛ lii ŋɔ, ‘Wobɛlbwa aa ɛ wedɛɛɡa kɛɛ anchɔɡa la, Korowii waane laa.’

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Ba dɔma ɛɛ pa ba kondɔɔh bwaa kaa, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba deene. Baa ma deenee, kɛ baa a binii so, dɛ́ parɛ ɡrepo daa kooni, baa a nɔnaa dɔ ɛ sen nyɔ.” Korowii Tɔpejen waa lea cheɡ

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔpejen waa lea cheɡ o do ɔma la telo tonɛ, o dɛ ba warawara, o pu yaa tonɛ. A ɡɛ tɔpere la ɛɛ ɛ sibeɡraa taeh, banyoola ɛɛ do lɔŋɔre kohonaa.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: A ɡɛ tɔpere la, Korowii bwaawee ɛɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ taeh, suna ne wenaale tɔperee, wahala nae ne chɔɡa ɡbosoroo, ásɛ baama tɔ, bɔr ɛ jumaa ken. Bɔr dɛ ba bira kohona a ɡɛ tɔpere,

english_verse: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.
translation_verse: wɛɛ ɛ laa bɛle hoeh tɔperee, ásɛ laa tena lɔŋɔre tɔ. Baa yo bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, a dɔ dejaŋaa.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ a ɡɛ wenaale nɔɔ ba ta nɛra baa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ, ásɛ baa laɡre bɔr kɛŋɔ nyoŋa ken. Baa ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa nomanta, mɛɛ fuɡe ba chalee ta kɛŋɔ nee ken, ásɛ ba lala chɔ dɛ́ pɔh.”

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Korowii bwaawee Tɔpere la, ba suuɡaswɛm kɛɛ suuɡapoŋa aa won lɛɛ ba. O bwaawee dɛ ba harɛ nɔ bwa fuih kɛŋɔ nii ken. Nomɛlbwa waa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta waa ɛɛ ba a jaɡaa buɡ ta.

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: mɔɔ Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ o do ɔma, dɛ́ kpɔ heya kɛŋɔ peu aa taa dɛ́ kpɔ haahra kaa la tel, mɔɔ Korowii bandia saŋ la ba, ásɛ o bwaawee bɛ he nɛɛ ir kohona.

english_verse: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: He nɛra haa pwɛr he te dɛ do harɛ nɔ ta, hé charɛ he liire dɛɛ no Korowii wa. Hé ɡel he waa toɡre, dɛ́ ba he te ne harɛ o sie, o ken ɛɛ lɛ heyaa, waa wola he deŋnee tɛr kpa, awola o bwaawee aa ir nɛra nɛɛ la. Filisti tena bolchɔɡe pae

english_verse: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ chwao le Gasa, ásɛ Askɛlɔn chɔ pɛɛ. Wee ne ŋɔ o ba che nyufala, dɛ Asdɔd tena bwa chwao le kaa, ásɛ Ekron tena bwa le kwaraa.

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Filisti tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ. He nɛra haa soɡe mpo nyoa bwa, Korowii dɔɔ vɔrɔwe he deŋnetɛra waa bil tonɛ, dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa aa wola ka.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Juda tena baa ka la ɛɛ ka so belaa, ó berɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔr, ásɛ jɔmɔra telo aa, bá ka chɔ bwɛjen Askɛlɔn deene bini. Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɛ́ nyiŋi ba nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba do wer, ɡɛ ba fa aa doa wubwa la. Moab ne Amɔn bolchɔɡe pae

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N no chɛɡra ne bammuɡli wa Amɔn ne Moab tena aa dɛ ɛ n nɛra, dɛɛ aah ba ŋɔ baa lɛ ba harɛɛ.

english_verse: And so, I swear by my very life that Moab and Ammon will end up like Sodom and Gomorrah— covered with thornbushes and salt pits forever. Then my people who survive will take their land.
translation_verse: Men Koranar Bwa Kooro Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ, Moab dɛ ba chɔɡa kɛŋɔ bwɛjen Sodom, ásɛ Amɔn ɡe chɔɡ kɛŋɔ bwɛjen Gomoora ken. Aa berɛ yar kwibɔraa, kpɔɡa le a ta, á chɔ pɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. N nɛra baa ka laanee dɛ́ pa ba laala, dɛ́ ka kpɔ ba harɛ la so.”

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Anɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ kembɔr tɛ Moab ne Amɔn tena, mbarafo ne chɛɡra dɛ bammuɡli waa baa kpɔa ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro nɛra la wa.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia

translation_verse: Pɛɛsea Koojen Dareɔs kora dii bennɛɛte korobinumɛl tɔpeloɡle habɔɔ la, Korowii cheɡɛ o keame Haɡae nɛ, dɛ bol waa Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl waa dɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta, ne Jehosadak bibaa Sɔfonomoa Josua be.
