translation_verse: “Awola jwaana la, men Sekaria na baa bɛl wepila ta o so jaaɡɔswɛm ta. Dɛ o cheɡɛ daa ane baa dɛ yera mɛtel baah ta fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, asɛ nɛra bane ɡe so jaaɡɔswɛɛma, ne jaaɡɔkɔla dɛ jaaɡɔpoŋa ta o habɔɔ.

english_verse: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, “Sir, who are these riders?” “I'll tell you,” the angel answered.
translation_verse: Ate, n bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘N dɔɔ, nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?’ Korowii nyundua torome la n ne waa dɛ bol waa la chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ chaɡle a munii.’

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Belaa baa waa soɡe jaaɡɔswɛm ta dɛ che daa la baah ta la ŋɔ, ‘Banee banɔ la Korowii aa toma ŋɔ bá ka ɡaaɡe harɛ nɔ bwa ta dɛ́ na waa aa dɛ chiɡ.’

english_verse: Then the riders spoke to the Lord's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, “We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.”
translation_verse: Ba balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ Korowii nyundua torome la waa cheɡɛ daa la baah ta la be ŋɔ, ‘Ya laŋɔ ka ɡaaɡe harɛ nɔ ta bwa, dɛ na kɛ harɛ la sɔɔhnɔ o nɛra bwa ɡwɛɡre.’

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: kɛ n baah di harɛre a nɛra aa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta la nɛɛ kohona. Dɛ n fe dɛ na n nɛra sum, kɛ ɡɛ harɛre la nɛra ɡelɔ n nɛra wahala ɡwaa kohona.

english_verse: And so, I will have pity on Jerusalem. The city will be completely rebuilt, and my temple will stand again.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ sune Jerusalam tena nɛɛ, dɛ́ berɛ ba bela, ásɛ ba kwaa ma n Dea ne bwɛjen la bwa. Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.’

english_verse: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion. Second Vision: Animal Horns
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome berɔ ŋɔ kenii Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ bol, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo n bwɛɛre la berɛ dɔ a te, ásɛ dɛ larawe n nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam bwara, dɛ́ kpɔ bwɛjen la ɛ n kon.’ Nyeɡlare ane wa

english_verse: Next, I saw four animal horns.
translation_verse: Wepila ane ɡe ta, n na nabal nyeɡlare anaarɛ ane.

english_verse: The angel who was sent to explain was there, and so I asked, “What do these mean?” His answer was, “These horns are the nations that scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem, and took away their freedom.” Then the Lord showed me four blacksmiths, and I asked, “What are they going to do?” He replied, “They are going to terrify and crush those horns.”
translation_verse: N bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwaa baala nɔ ɛɛ ba ba ɛɔ?’ Asɛ Korowii nyundua torome la chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Ba balɔ dɛ́ ba aah, dɛ́ doŋi harɛre a nɛra aa kpeɡa, dɛ ba chɔɡ Juda harɛ dɛ lɔ o ta nɛra bwa peɡre kaa harɛre ta la.’ ”

english_verse: This time I saw someone holding a measuring line,
translation_verse: Wepila ane ɡe ta, men Sekaria na bonɔmbii bɛl waa kpoŋe ŋwɛn baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ bɔr.

english_verse: and I asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” was the answer. “To find out how wide and long it is.”
translation_verse: N bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa hɛɛ kaalɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɛ la ka maɡɛ Jerusalam dɛ́ na ɡɛ o paɡri ne o jaŋne aa doa.”

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii nyundua torome la n ne waa bol waa la le dɛɛ kaa, asɛ o dɔŋ ba chemo,

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Chwa la ka ŋɔ bonɔmbii la be ŋɔ bɔr toole bá ma danjwɛɛ bar Jerusalam kpa, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ne kondɛɛra warɛ o ta.

english_verse: The Lord himself has promised to be a protective wall of fire surrounding Jerusalem, and he will be its shining glory in the heart of the city.” A Call to Action
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ nii, dɛ́ bar bwɛjen la kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ ken, dɛɛ daah bwɛjen la, ásɛ dɛ so o baah ta o jirima ne.”

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé ba warane. Hé chwa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛ la ta ba, dɛkalkɛ menee lɔ heyaa peɡre harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa. Men Korowiirii bola.

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: He waa hiah mɛ kɛŋɔ n siwinyiŋi ken, anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa leɡe heyaa kɛɛ dɛ ɛ heyaa waane aa, dɛ menee o ɛ la.

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Men Korowii ɡbabirii dɛ́ yoo ba, ásɛ n nɛra ba fa aa ɛɛ ba yoma la pa ba laala kɛ laa ta kwaa kaa.” Anɔ bwa chiɡaa, hɛɛ jemɔ kɛŋɔ Koranar Bwa Kooroo tomɛ men Sekaria.

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam tena, hé ɡel he sie lɛ hɛɛ ɡo yela! N dɛ ba dɛ́ ba so he baah ta.”

english_verse: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra ɛɛ ba Korowii bee a ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ́ ba ɛ o nɛra. Wɛɛ so he baah taa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Koranar Bwa Kooroo tom mɛ he be.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ berɔ ba kpɔ Juda harɛ ɛ o kon waa dɛ nyinu kohona, harɛ waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, dɛ́ nyin bwɛjen Jerusalam ɡwaa bwɛɛ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyina bwa hel Korowii sie, dɛkalkɛ o iro le o boɡoroŋ bela waa lole.

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: Wepila ane ɡe ta, Korowii baɡle men Sekaria Sɔfonomoa Josua o che Korowii nyundua torome bɛl sie. Asɛ Bɔnsam ɡe ba che Josua diɡ ta dɛɛ ba waa kpɔe dawɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ Bɔnsam be ŋɔ, “Bɔnsam, Korowiirii dɛ́ pae bolchɔɡe! Korowii waa le Jerusalam tɛ o te la, onee dɛ́ pae bolchɔɡe! Baa nɔ do kɛŋɔ nindaa baa keero le nii ta.”

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ o bala baa cheɡɛ o sie la be ŋɔ, “Hé laa baa nɔ laaladoŋa la foo.” Dɛ ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Na, n laa he wechɔɡa kpɔ he nɛ, mɛɛ kpɔ laaladɛɛɡaa doe.”

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: Belaa o ŋɔ bá kpɔ yal baa kpɔa dɛɛ vɔwɛ nyu la ondɛɛɡe vɔwɔ, asɛ ba kpɔ vɔwɔ, dɛ doo laaladɛɛɡa, dɛ Korowii nyundua torome la cheɡɛ bela.

english_verse: After this, the angel encouraged Joshua by telling him that the Lord All-Powerful had promised:
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii nyundua torome la bol Josua be ŋɔ

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa taa, dɛɛ ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin tenaa, mɛɛ kpɔ n Dea wobɛlbwaa do he nɔn ta, ásɛ hɛɛ nyiŋi o dembaahna bwa ta. Mɛɛ no he wesoŋaa, ɡɛ maa dɛ no nyundua toroma baa cheɡɛ he sie nɔ wesoŋa.

english_verse: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.
translation_verse: Sɔfonomoa Josua, he ne he bala sɔfore baa ja he nɛɛ la, hé no. He cheɡɔɔ tɛ wedɛɛɡa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere. N dɛ ba n bonɔɔ baa dɛ yerɔ Daa Kpale ne.

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: Hé na bwe maa kpɔa bil Josua sie. Baŋne anuanɛ lɔ bwe beŋkpoŋ la ta. Mɛɛ di ɡwinee dawɛ o taa, dɛ́ laa wechɔɡa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta kpɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo. Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, he bini bɛlbwa ɛɛ yerɛ o dɔŋee he so deŋnesɔɔhna ta, ásɛ he ɡrepo ne he fiɡ daa kooni bar heya.”

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome la o ne men Sekaria fa aa bol waa la berɔ ba chum mɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn yon chɔ dom ba chumu la.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: O bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa he na nɔ?” Asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N na kandea daa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛo, asɛ loɡ baa dɛ do noo o ta chɔŋɛ o doa. Kandere anuanɛ lɔ o ta, asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ bɔɔne anuanɛ baa do ŋwɛɛra a ta.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: Ɔleve daa anɛ cheɡɛ kandea daa la jwɛh, bɛl cheɡɛ loɡ la diɡ-bɔr, asɛ bɛl ɡe che ɡalbɔr.”

english_verse: Then he asked, “Don't you know?” “No sir,” I replied.
translation_verse: Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Haa kwaa nɔ jemaa?” N ŋɔ “N dɔɔ, akai, maa jemɛ.”

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń bol Korowii waa Sɛrobabɛl be ŋɔ, “He wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii, he kpeɡri ne laa yoi ne laa, kɛ n Doma kpeɡri taa. Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa aa kana dɛ do kɛŋɔ bwejen aa won tɔ hen Sɛrobabɛl ŋwɛnɛ. Hɛɛ kpɔ bwe la mamaala aa kpɔa do n Dea o lawɔ kpoŋe laanee ba, ásɛ nɛra moo dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘O wer, o wer!’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa men Sekaria be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Sɛrobabɛl pa n Dea la mun, o tentenee dɛ́ mao tonɛ. Anee dɛ ɡel n nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooroo tomɛ ba be.

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Bame waa nyiŋi Korowii Dea la mumpar toma la dɛɛ vaɔh? Ba sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ ŋwɛn baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ danjwɛɛ la aa lɔ Sɛrobabɛl nɔn ta, ba berɛ dɛɛ pa Dea la mun.” Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Kandere anuanɛ nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii sibie anuanɛ waa kpɔa dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ nɔ bwa.”

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Asɛ n bɔɔ Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Ɔleve daa anɛ aa cheɡɛ kandea daa nɔ diɡ ne ɡal nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?”

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: N berɔ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɔleve daa kpala anɛ aa lɔ suuɡaswɛm paapore anɛ jwɛɛh suuɡaswɛm noo palɛ dɛɛ le a bini nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?”

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Haa ɡɛ kwaa nɔ mun jemaa?” N ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, akai, maa jemɛ.”

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: Ate o ŋɔ, “Kpala anɛ nɔɔ cheɡa tɛ baala banɛ, Korowii waa ɛ harɛ nɔ bwa Dɔɔ aa lee ba, dɛ fuɡe noo do ba nyuune ta baa tomɔ la.”

english_verse: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll,
translation_verse: Men Sekaria berɔ na tɔn waa dɛ kile nyundua wepila ta!

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii nyundua torome la bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa he na nɔ?” N chaŋe ŋɔ, “N na tɔn waa lɔ nyundua. O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraatoro, asɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fi dɛ anue.”

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: Anee o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ba chwerɛ nyotaahna waa do o ta aa kaa harɛ nɔ bwa ta. O baŋ bɛl dɛ baɡle kɛ nomɛlbwa waa ŋwɛ la, baa leo harɛ la taa, baŋ bɛl ɡe waa ɛɛ baɡle ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa teŋe nyosone dɛ ŋwɛɛ la, baa le o ɡee le harɛ la ta.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tomɛ tɔn nyotaahna aa lɔ o ta laanee o kaa dem bɛlbwa baa dɛ ŋwɛ ta, ne dem bɛlbwa baa teŋe nyosone dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ n sɔn ta. Wɛɛ ka do dem la taa dɛ́ taɡɔ ɡo, dɛ́ kuuɡi o daa bwa kwaraa.” Haah bɛl waa lɔ wɛɡrɛ bini wepila

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii nyundua torome n ne waa dɛ bol waa la, balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ha sie nyiŋi nyundua, dɛ́ na kon waa dɛ ba nɔ.”

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: Asɛ n bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa konee yɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “O ɛ wɛɡrɛ baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwa,” o berɛ ŋɔ, “o cheɡɔ tɛ harɛ nɔ ta bwa nɛra wechɔɡa.”

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: Dɛ wɛɡrɛ la dɔ tɔ, kpana nee ba ɛo. N nao kɛŋɔ waa pila, asɛ haah bɛl so o bini.

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Haah nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ nyubinikpeɡ.” Asɛ o berɛ taɡɔ do wɛɡrɛ la bini dɛ kwaa o tɔ la tɔ.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Ate, n berɛ ha sie nyiŋi, dɛ na haahna banɛ baa dɔ kena kɛŋɔ nyeŋɡboŋ dɛ ir dɛɛ ba n be, dɛ ba kpɔ wɛɡrɛ la ir kaa nyundua.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Ate, n bɔɔ Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Leperaa haahna la kpɔ wɛɡrɛ la dɛɛ kaa lɔ?”

english_verse: “To Babylonia,” he answered, “where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.”
translation_verse: O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ba dɛ kaa o ne Babelɔn harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka ma dea dɛ́ kpɔ cheɡ o bini. Ba ma dea la tonaa, baa kpɔɔ cheɡ o bini dɛɛ tomɔ.”

english_verse: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
translation_verse: N berɔ na wepila ane ɡe aa ɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore anaarɛ a le ayaawa bwejena anɛ ane baah ta dɛɛ ba.

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ sitɔ torɔɡo la vɔwɛ jaaɡɔswɛɛma aa tɛɡro, dɛ kpɔ nɛɛte vɔwɛ jaaɡɔbiŋere aa tɛɡro,

english_verse: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.
translation_verse: dɛ kpɔ toorote vɔwɛ jaaɡɔpoŋa aa tɛɡro, dɛ kpɔ naarɛte ɡe vɔwɛ jaɡre a bwara aa lɛɡra aa tɛɡro.

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: O chaŋ mɛ ŋɔ, “A ɛ peu bele anaarɛ aa le nyundua Korowii waa ɛ harɛ nɔ bwa Dɔɔ be.

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Kon baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔbiŋere la sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, Babelɔn harɛɛ a tɛɡre dɛɛ kaa. Onɔ la baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔpoŋa la sie chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr, asɛ onɔ la baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre a bwara aa lɛɡra la ɡe sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr a bwa tɛɡre dɛɛ kaa.”

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii nyundua torome la yer mɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Jaɡre aa kpɔ sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr Babelɔn harɛ dɛ kaa la, kaa sɔɔh Korowii bandia nyoa.” Josua kooɡbɛrɛ wa

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Korowii bol waa n be ŋɔ,

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Onee dɛ́ do n Dea la, ásɛ dɛ dɔ jirima dɛ́ so kookara ta di kora. Sɔfo bɛl ɡe ɛɛ che o kookara la jwɛɛh o ne wɛɛ ɛ toma. Ba bwa dɔ nyopɛo deŋnesɔɔhna do ba nɛra banɛ bwa baah ta.’

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ he kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ nɔ cheɡ n Dea bela, bá kpɔ dɛɛ lii Hɛldae, ne Tobija, ne Jedaya dɛ Sefania bibaa Josia.

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɛɛ le bojaŋaa ba, dɛ́ ba cha bá kwaa ma Korowii Dea la. Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛ Koranar Bwa Kooroo tom mɛ he be. Dɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa do heyaa a ta kɛrɛdɛ tenaa, ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ɛo.”

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora bene anaarɛ ta, korobie anuanaarɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Keslɛv ta, tɔpenaarɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Sekaria be.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: dɛ́ bɔɔ sɔfore baa lɔ bela ne Korowii keamere ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ yá wi chɔɡa baa chɔɡ Korowii Dea la, dɛ́ vɔwɛ nyoa korobinuete la ta ɡɛ yaa ɛa bene aa baa kaa bwa ta la aa?”

english_verse: It was then that the Lord All-Powerful told me to say to everyone in the country, including the priests: For
translation_verse: “Bɔɔ harɛ la ta nɛra bwa ne sɔfore la ŋɔ, ‘Haa vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ wi korobinuete ne korobinuanɛte ta bene fifraanuanɛ aa baa kaa ta la, dɛ n waa he koh vɔwɛ nyoa aa?

english_verse: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?
translation_verse: Haa di kwaa dɛɛ nyɔ sene la, dɛ he ɡbaɡba silɛɛ waa laa hɛɛ ɛ aa?

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔɔ Korowii che o keamere baa tɔ sie nɛɛ dɛ bol a saŋ la. Jerusalam ne bwɛɛre aa baro nɛra fa aa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta dɛ dɔ ba te, nɛra su o ta, ne bwɛɛre aa baro bwa ta dɛ do Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ dɛ harɛre aa lɔ wee cholibɔr deŋɡarere harɛ ta bwa la.’ ”

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: ń bol o nɛra be ŋɔ “Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi dɔŋa nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne, dɛ́ dɔ tedoma dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: He bɛ luhaahna kɛɛ bilalbii kɛɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra kɛɛ nyaara dɛɛ fiiɡi. He bɛ dɔŋa liichɔɡa dɔ.

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: Ba ɡelɔ ba bambile do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwe ken, dɛ vɛh waa maa cheɡɛ n Doma ta dɛ bol baɡle n saŋ la keamere la ta teŋa. Anomanta, men Koranar Bwa Kooro baah di ba nɛɛ taeh.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: Gɛ maa bola ba ta noɛ la, ɡɛɛ ba ɡe soŋ mɛ naa, maa wola no.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
translation_verse: N lɔ ba peɡre harɛfala ta kɛŋɔ kawulewule aa lɔ haahra dɛɛ peɡre la ken, bela ba fa aa kaa ɛ hɔɔhra la. Harɛdɛɛɡe la chɔ pɛɛ, nomɛlbwa toole o ta.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me:
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro bol waa men Sekaria be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: I love Zion so much that her enemies make me angry.
translation_verse: “N dɛ nyin Jerusalam waa taeh, n sie beɡrɔ kohona mɛɛ mee o wa.

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔɔ ba Jerusalam, bela n Saayɔn Bwejen aa lole dɛ́ ba so. Baa yerɛ Jerusalamee Kasinteŋ Bwɛjen, ásɛ dɛɛ yerɛ men Koranar Bwa Kooro Bwejen la Bwejen Waa Do Goroŋ.”

english_verse: Very old people with walking sticks will once again sit around in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Banjeni ne hanjeni ta ɛɛ kpoŋe daŋɡbalee, dɛ́ so Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna.

english_verse: while boys and girls play in the streets.
translation_verse: Bibaala ne bihaahna ɛɛ su bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahnaa, dɛɛ hɛlɛ.

english_verse: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ba ka ɡɛ saŋ la ɛɛ ŋɔɔ aa won maɡre, n te be te, aa kpeɡe.

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ lɛ n nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr harɛre ta laanee.

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔ ba bane ba so Jerusalam, ásɛ ba ɛ n nɛra, n ɡe ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ n nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡra ne.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: He banɔ haa lole taraken nɔ, waa haa dɛ no nɔ ɛ waa n keamere fa aa bola ɡɛ saŋ baa pa n Dea la mun la, he do ɡbemba, ásɛ dɛ ma n Dea la.

english_verse: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ba ɛ men Korowii Dea la toma la, dɛ nɛn ɛ toma kɛɛ ba kpɔ kondɛɛre ɛ toma aa, kembɔr toole. Dɛ dɔma nomanta, deŋnesɔɔhna toole, menee ba yoi ne nɛn ne o dɔŋ baah ta.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken te, ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ba bini bane aa kaa nɔ, maa ban ɛ ɡɛ n fa aa ɛ banɔ la kpa.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Koo kondikwa ɛɛ do werii kɛrɛdɛ, ɡrepo daa ɛɛ nɔnɔɔ kohona, komɛlbwa do wer harɛ la ta, ásɛ bwaala nɛ kohona. Gɛ kwaa nɔ bwaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ he nɛra haa kaa la kɛ kapɛrɛ kwa.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Gɛ baa taah he Juda ne Israel tena harɛre ta la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba heyaa lɛɛ, ásɛ nɛra che he nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ wedɛɛɡa. He bɛ ɔmɛ, hé dɔ ɡbemba.”

english_verse: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Gɛ he naawa fa aa ɡela n baah di n lii kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ɛɛ baa wechɔɡaa maa wola ba nɛɛ sune la,

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: ɡɛɛ taraken n lii kɛŋɔ ń swee Jerusalam ne Juda tena bwa andɛɛɡa. He bɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Waa aa chɛ kɛ he ɛ laanee nɔ, hé bol kasinteŋ dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ nomɛl ne o dɔŋ dɔ waa kɔɔto aa, hé bol a kasinteŋ a ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne,

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: he bɛ wechɔɡa lii dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, he bɛ ɡel he sie ɛɛ lɛ ŋwɛɛra aa wola kasinteŋ ɛɛ ta. N hah a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa. Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro bol waa men Sekaria be ja ŋɔ,

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: “Nyoa haa dɛ vɔwɛ korobinaarɛ, ne korobinue, ne korobinuanɛ dɛ korobifi ta la, hé kpɔ ɛ tɔpejena dii silɛɛ aa lɔ a ta, dɛ́ tɛ Juda tena. Anomanta, hɛɛ nyin kasinteŋ ne deŋnesɔɔhna.”

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro berɔ bol ja ŋɔ, “Nɛra ɡalɡa ne nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjena ta ɛɛ bao tɔpebɛl,

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: ásɛ bwɛjen bɛl nɛra la bwɛjen bɛl tena be ka ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel ya kaa warane ka tomɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, dɛ́ soŋo ó swee yaa andɛɛɡa. Hé ɡel ya pɛ kaa.’

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Nɛra ɡalɡa ne harɛre a nɛra baa dɔ kpeɡri ɛɛ ba Jerusalamee, dɛ́ ba tomɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, dɛ́ soŋo ó swee ba andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, baala fi ɛɛ le harɛre wobol bɛlbwa binii, dɛ́ ba lawɛ Juu te beŋkpoŋ batakaare nyoa dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Gel ya ne he kaa, ya noɔ kɛ Korowii ja he nɛ.’ ”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: Waa aa le Korowii bee nɔ. O dɛ ba ba chɔɡ Hadrak harɛ ne bwɛjen Damaskɔs. Nɛra ne Israel deene bwa sie lɔ Korowii nɛ,

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: ne Hamat o ne Damaskɔs aa do jwɛh, ne bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon tena baa dɔ wejema la jao.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Taaya tena do dekpeɡa tɛ ba te, dɛ boa suuɡapoŋa nyoa kɛŋɔ teera, ne suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ doŋa aa chɔ fɔɡbaahna.

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii ɛɛ laa Taaya kondɔɔh bwaa kpɔ, dɛ́ paa ka ta mpo ta, ásɛ nii fuh o bwa dɛɛboo ken.

english_verse: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen Askɛlɔn tena ɛɛ nao dɛ́ ɔmɛ, bwɛjen Gasa tena ɡe na ba bambile wee ba, ásɛ Ekron tena ɡe hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ. Gasa tena kooro ɛɛ le ba nɔn taa, ásɛ Askɛlɔn chɔ pɛɛ.

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Hɔɔhraa dɛ́ ba kpɔ Asdɔd so, ásɛ n sɔɔh Filisti tena mbarafo nyoa.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Baa ol chal aa lɔ o ta, kɛɛ kondikwaa maa kia di. Banɔ la baa ka la, ɛ berɔ ɛ men Korowii nɛra, dɛ́ ɡe dɔ ba dea Juda harɛ ta, ásɛ Ekron tena ɡe berɛ ɛ n nɛra kɛ Jebus tena ken.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Kɛ mɛɛ daah n harɛɛ le laa tena nɔn ta, ba bɛ won ba bela. Nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi nɛra aa won ba yo n nɛra kpa, dɛkalkɛ n ta dɛ daah ba. Saayɔn kooro bala

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: Saayɔn tena, hé hɛɡre kohona, Jerusalam tena, hé moo ɡa. Hé nyiŋi na! He kooro dɛ ba he be, o waa toɡrɔ dɛ won nɛra lɛɛ, o pwɛre, o soɡe keeɡo bie ta, keeɡo bale taa o so.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ le laa torɔɡore nee Israel harɛ ta, dɛ́ le laa jaɡre ne Jerusalam, ásɛ dɛ kuuɡi laa tori bwa. He kooro ɛɛ bol deŋnesɔɔhna waa harɛre nɛra bee. Wɛɛ di koraa le mpo bɛl taa ba kaa bɛl ta, dɛ́ le Yufretis Moo ta kaa harɛ jaɡa.”

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Kɛ he te, kwaa haa kpoora dɛ ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ la, a chal nee n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, anomanta, mɛɛ lawɛ he nɛraa le bɔɔ baa kaa do ba o bini nee aa wola toole bela la ta.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡure Juda harɛɛ kɛŋɔ to ken, dɛ́ kpɔ Efrem ɛ hɛma. Dɛ́ kpɔ Saayɔn baala ɛ keri, dɛ́ ka yo Grik tena harɛ baala.” Korowii ɛɛ bao

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ le nyunduaa dɛ́ ba o nɛra be, ásɛ o hɛm nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwaala nyɛɡla ken. Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ hoh laa bɛlaa, dɛ́ valɛ peujen bini kpeɡri ne le weekaŋle harɛbɔr ba.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ tɔ o nɛra ɡbemɡbee. Baa chɔɡ ba dɔma vamtor bwea nee, dɛɛ moo laa ta kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛra ken. Baa kpoo ba dɔmaa, ásɛ ba chal ɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ baa kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha, dɛ kpɔ a chale dɛɛ merɛ saraha kwaa loŋkoni ta la ken.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Tɔpere la telaa, Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ lɛɛ baa, kɛŋɔ peteɡre aa lɛ peera le wahala ta. Baa dɛɛ nyɛɡle o harɛ taa, kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa aa pɛɡle kooɡbɛrɛ ta la.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Na ɡɛ harɛ la aa dɛ ba wer doe dɛ́ dɔ pɛla! Kondikwaa ne sen aa lɔ harɛ la ta la ɛɛ ɡeloo bonɔɔna ne toli kpeɡ, dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Hé soŋe Korowii o fel nɛ bwaala. Korowiirii dɛɛ ɛ baama aa nɛ bwaala. Onee ɡela bwaala nɛ dɛɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyina, koo kwaa ɛɛ do wer dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Voɡa dɛ teŋe nyosone, voɡra waa baa dɛ na ɛ nyosone, deera mun baa dɛ baɡle la ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ, bolarawa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra ɛ wesale. Anomanta, ba ɡelɔ nɛra nyoɡre kɛŋɔ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe, asɛ nɛra ɛɛ fiɡ ba.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “N baah di nɛra baa do kɛ peteɡra la nɛ. Mɛɛ tɛr sitɔɔla la deŋnee, dɛkalkɛ, mɛɛ nyiŋi Juda dea tena baa do kɛ n peera la nɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba do kɛ jaaɡɔ waa kpeɡa laa ta.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Ba bwa ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ banyoola, dɛ́ɛ tiɡri ba dɔma nɛɛ fɔɡbaahna laa ta. Men Korowii ja ba nɛɛ nomanta, baa yoo dɛ́ pɔ ba dɔma baa soɡe jaɡre ta, laa ta nɛ.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo Juda dea tena do kpeɡri dɛ́ lɛ Josef dea tena. Mɛɛ berɔɔ ba ba ne bela ba fa aa lole, dɛkalkɛ n dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba. Baa doo kɛŋɔ nɛra n fa aa wola ban vɛɛh ken, dɛkalkɛ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la. Mɛɛ dɛɛ chaŋ baa ba wesoŋa taa.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel tena ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ banyoola, ásɛ ba sie lɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra aa nyɔ sen ba sie ɛɛ lɛ la. Ba bii ɛɛ nao ba sie lɛ, ásɛ ba hɛɡre waa Korowii aa ɛa wa.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ yer baa, dɛ́ boa ba nyoa. Kasinteŋ, mɛɛ lɛɛ baa dɛ́ ɡel ba warɛ ɡɛ ba fa aa doa wubwa la.

english_verse: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—
translation_verse: A lole kɛ n lɔ ba peɡre harɛre nɛra bini, kɛ báa ba lii n waa bojaŋ harɛre taa. Ba ne ba bii ɛɛ dɔ ba nyuu, ásɛ dɛ bwa berɛ ba dem.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ berɔɔ le ba ne Ijipt harɛ taa ba, dɛ́ boa ba nyoa le Asiiria harɛ ta. Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ba Gelead ne Lɛbanɔn harɛre ta, ásɛ ba warɛ harɛre la ta baa wola a taa jo.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: Wekpeɡa kohona bɛlbwa aa do kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma dɛ ba ba nɛɛ aa, men Korowii ɛɛ sɔɔh a nyoaa, ásɛ Nael Moo vile bwa hweeh. Asiiria tena mbarafo nyoa ɛɛ sɔɔhnoo, ásɛ Ijipt harɛ kora kpeɡri nyoa ba harɛ.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɛ n nɛra kpeɡrii, ásɛ baa tom mɛ dɛɛ no n wa. Men Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Lɛbanɔn harɛ, pili he ɡbeni ásɛ nii ba fuh he peleme daa bwa dɛ́ chɔɡa.

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Dadɛɛɡa, hé wi, dɛkalkɛ peleme cholo, dajena kwaraa bwa chɔɡɔ. Basan harɛ dajena, hé wi, ba teŋni kɔr la daa aa farɛ o bini bwa.

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Hé no koranar baa do kɛ peteɡra la wii baa dɛ wi, ba jirima baa dɔa bwa tonɔ. Hé no nyujentena sii aa dɛ si kohona, kɔr o daa aa fara a do o bini Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa bwa chɔɡɔ. Peteɡra banɛ bane wa

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Kenii Korowii men Sekaria aa dɛ tomɔ la bol n be, “Ɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre waa dɛ nyiŋi peera baa lea cheɡ dɛ́ ka kpoora la.

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ yawa dɛɛ kpoora la aa deŋnetɛraa dɔ. Nɛra baa dɛ yoɡa dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔ suuɡa, Kórowii jam!’ Hale nɛra baa dɛ teɡa la aa a nɛɛ sune.”

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Maa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta bɛlbwa sumii na. Mɛɛ le bɛlbwaa tɛ o dɔŋ ne o kooro. Baa fiiɡi ba harɛ la ta nɛraa, kɛ maa ban lɛ.”

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, men Sekaria nyiŋi peera baa lea cheɡ dɛ́ ka kpoora la nɛ, dɛ teɡa kaa dibɔr, anɔ la baa dɛ fiiɡa la fanfa. Asɛ dɛ kpɔ daŋɡbale anɛ, dɛ pa bɛl sɔn ‘Sum Nae’, asɛ bɛl ɡe ‘Nyopɛo’, dɛ nyiŋi peera la nɛ.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Korobibeŋkpoŋ ɡbo ta, n doŋi peteɡra batoro bane baa hah mɛ. Peera la chwao le n be, n mee le a wa.

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: Ate, n ŋɔ peera la be ŋɔ, “Maa won ɛ he teɡre kpa. Anɔ la aa sewɛ la, a sewɛ, anɔ la baa kpo la, ba kpoora, ásɛ anɔ la aa ka la di a bala ola.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Ate, n kpɔ daŋɡbala maa pa o sɔn ‘Sum Nae’ la dɛ kuu, a baɡle kɛŋɔ n chɔɡ fɔo Korowii ne harɛre nɛra bwa aa fɔwa la.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Fɔo la chɔɡɔ awola tɔpere, asɛ peera baa dɛ fiiɡa la ɛɛ nyiŋ mɛ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ Korowiirii bol ɡɛ waa maa ɛa la.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ do kon baa kpɔ suuɡa dɛɛ do o bini n Dea bela la bini.” Asɛ n kpɔ suuɡapoŋa fifraatoro baa kpɔa tɛ mɛ, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ a kan kohona la ta kon la bini.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Ate, n berɛ ku daŋɡbanɛɛte maa pa o sɔn ‘Nyopɛo’ la, a baɡle kɛ n chɔɡ beŋkpoŋri waa lɔ Juda harɛ ne Israel harɛ baah la.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Berɛ ɛ ɡɛ peteɡre ɡɛne aa dɛ ɛ o toma ja.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: N dɛ ba peteɡre bɛl ne harɛ la ta. Waa peera aa nyoɡra la bɔree ɡaaɡe, waa a bii nɛɛ nyiŋi, waa anɔ la baa doa bola laanee chah, waa anɔ la aa dɔ bokpeɡa la ɡe kondikwaa tɛ. Anɔ la aa do bwara la, wɛɛ kpoora dɛɛ chwe, hale dɛ́ teŋni a nafikokore dɛɛ ta.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: Peteɡre ɡɛne waa chwa ɡel peera la, ó bwɛɛlɛ! Baa kpɔ keree ŋwɛnɛ o nɔn ne o diɡ siwi. O nɔn ɡe sewɛ, o diɡ siwi ɡe tɔ kwaraa.”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Israel waa aa le Korowii bee nɔ. Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ, dɛ ta nɛwɛnyini la ŋɔ,

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: “N dɛ ba ɡela Jerusalam do kɛ numol sen aa lɔ o bini tɛ harɛre aa baro la nɛra, ásɛ ba kpɔ nyɔ dɛ́ dɛɛ, dɛɛ yɛɛɡe. Dɛ ba tɔ Jerusalam do aa, bá tɔ Juda ɡe do ja.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo Jerusalam do kɛŋɔ bwe, waa yiiɡi. Harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa aa pɛ nyoa dɛ́ ba yoo ba la, bɛlbwa waa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡɔɔ bwe laanee la, wɛɛ doo bolii.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔma jaɡre ɔmɛ, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra baa dɛ so a ta la we choɡla. Mɛɛ nyiŋi Juda dea tena nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔma jaɡre nyoŋe.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Ásɛ Juda nomonome bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, ‘Jerusalam tena kpeɡri, dɛkalkɛ Koranar Bwa Kooroo baa tomɛ.’

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo Juda nomonome do kɛŋɔ koropɔɔto ninhɔla aa suu dɛ́ do dahola baah dɛɛ hɔ, kɛɛ kapɛle aa lɔ mea baah ta dɛɛ lawɛ nii. Baa chɔɡ harɛre aa bar ba la nɛra bwaa, kɛ Jerusalam tena te ɛɛ so ba buɡ taa deŋnesɔɔhna ne.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ tɔ sie lɛ Juda dea tena mɔɔ, ɡɛ aa ɛ Kooro Devid naanar ne nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam la jirima bɛ Juda tena ɡwaa.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ tɔ nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam ɡbemɡbee, hale ɡwɛɡre kwaraa waa lɔ ba bini kpeɡri do kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Kooro Devid fa aa doa la. Ásɛ Kooro Devid naanar tɔ ba sie kɛŋɔ Korowii nyundua torome kɛɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ chɔɡ harɛre aa dɛ yo Jerusalam tena laanee. Nɛn baa yaɡɔ kere ne wiile

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɡeloo sum nae ne Korowii soŋa Doma ba so Kooro Devid naanar, ne Jerusalam tena bane nɛ. Baa dɛɛ nyiŋi naate baa yaɡɔ lampea ne o sewɛ laanee, dɛɛ wiu kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ wi ba bibeŋkpoŋ waa sewa, kɛɛ baa dɛ wi ba bibanloɡle waa sewa la ken.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, wii waa do Jerusalam la ɛɛ do kanee, kɛŋɔ Hadad Remɔn tena wii baa wi Meɡido deŋɡare doa harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta la.

english_verse: Everyone of each family in the land will mourn, and the men will mourn separately from the women. This includes those from the family of David, and the families of Nathan,
translation_verse: Harɛ la tena bwa ɛɛ wiu, dea bɛlbwa nɛra ne ba haahna ɛɛ wiu. Kooro Devid dea, ne Netan dea,

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao, ásɛ nee bule dɛɛ le harɛ bini tɛ Kooro Devid ne o naanar, ne bwɛjen Jerusalam tena. Belaa baa ba laŋa, dɛ́ ka sɔ ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa, ne doŋa baa kaah bwa ta.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ le voɡa aa lɔ harɛ la ta la nee awola, baa wola a sɔnaa lii kpa. Mɛɛ le keame nyosonteŋna la nee, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ba pɛla le voɡa toma ta.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl dɛ teŋe nyosone ŋɔ waane ɛɛ chiɡuu kerekere aa, naate nya ne o mɛɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé sewɛ, dɛkalkɛ he teŋe nyosone Korowii sɔn ta.’ O ta teŋɔ dɛɛ bol aa, o nya ne o mɛɛ ɡbaɡba tɔɡɔ kere kpo.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, sihiih ɛɛ kpo keame bɛlbwa waa ŋɔa o dɛ na chaahnaa. Waa keamere batakaaree do dɛ́ neɡre nɛra kpa.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ŋɔɔ, ‘N ta keame ɛɛ, paaree men, n bonɔɔne saŋ bwaa n le dɛɛ parɛ.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl bɔɔ bɛlbwa kon la aa ɡela pɛl dawɛ o bwara ta naa, wɛɛ chaŋoo ŋɔ, bolii ba doo o damanar dem.” Ba kpo peteɡre la asɛ peera la lɔ peɡre

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ir n keree dɛ́ kpo n peteɡre waa dɛ tom mɛ la. Kpo peteɡre la ásɛ peera la lɔ peɡre ń dɔ bɔr kpoo a bii la.”

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛ la ta bwa ba bɔne ba bini bɔre atoro naa, baa kpɔ kerii kpoo bɔre anɛ nɛra á ba ka bɔrbeŋkpoŋ nɛra.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Bɔrbeŋkpoŋ nɛra nɔɔ mɛɛ ba kpɔe kpɔ nii ta kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm do nii ta dɛ laa a doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ a ta la. Baa yerɛ n sɔnee, ásɛ n ɡe sɛh ba be. Mɛɛ ŋɔɔ, ‘N nɛraa ban,’ ásɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔɔ laanee la.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ dɛ́ bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole la dɛ ba. He dɔma ɛɛ ba pa he Jerusalam tena laala kɛ laa ta kwa, dɛ́ bɔna he siwi ta.

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ boa harɛre nɛra nyoa bá ba yo bwɛjen Jerusalam tena, dɛ́ lɛ bwɛjen la dɔɔh. Baa jo ba deene, dɛ́ pa ba laala, dɛ́ ɡuɡri ba haahna chɔ. Baa lawɛ bwɛjen la pera nɛraa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba kar bwɛjen la ta.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛɛ leo, dɛ́ ka yo a ɡɛ harɛre la nɛra ɡɛ waa dɛ yo saŋ la.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, wɛɛ ka che Ɔlevere Bwejen la taa, Jerusalam wee leebɔr. Ásɛ Bwejen la bini bɔne anɛ le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr, dɛ́ ɡel fɛlembɔjen chɔ baah ta, ásɛ Bwejen la pera do weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, o pera ɡe do weekaŋle harɛbɔr.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ chwao kpɔ fɛlembɔjen waa bɔne Bwejen la binii kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Asɛl ta. Hɛɛ chwao ɡɛ he naawa fa aa chwaa ɡɛ saŋ harɛ aa jiɡra dɛ Juda Kooro Ussia di kora la. Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ bao, o nyundua toroma bwa ja o nɛ.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, wee aa lɔ, waa aa ba, kwaa aa sɔɔh dɛ hel kɛŋɔ dombwea.

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, nedɛɛɡe ɛɛ palɔɔ le Jerusalam, o pera kaa Yar Mpo ta, o pera berɛ kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta bɔwɔb ne waa saŋ bwa.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛ́ ɛ kooro awola tɔpere la harɛ nɔ bwa ta. Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛɛ tomɔɔ, dɛ́ jemɔ dɛɛ yerɛ o ɡbo sɔn.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Weechɔɡa Korowii aa dɛ ba kpɔe ba ta harɛre a nɛra aa ba yo Jerusalam tena laanee nɔ. Ba bwadabii ne ba sibie ne ba nyondoŋa ɛɛ pɔɔh, dɛ ba ta serewɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other,
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ ɔmee kohonaa ba ta ba nɛ, á ɡel ba lawɛ dɔŋa nɔɔra, dɛɛ yo dɔŋa.

english_verse: until even the people of Judah turn against those in Jerusalem. This same terrible disaster will also strike every animal nearby, including horses, mules, camels, and donkeys. Finally, everything of value in the surrounding nations will be collected and brought to Jerusalem—gold, silver, and piles of clothing.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ weechɔɡa la siwi ɛɛ ba jaɡre ne keeɡore, ne nyoɡmare dɛ kondɛɛra aa lɔ bela ba dɔma aa soɡa la bwa nɛɛ.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Harɛre ta nɛra baa ba yo Jerusalam tena ásɛ ba bini bane ka la, baa di Kukure Tɔpejen la Jerusalam benanyoa bɛlbwaa, dɛɛ tomɛ Kooro waa ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro la.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Dɛ harɛ la bɛlbwa nɛra ta Jerusalam laŋɛ ka tomɛ Kooro Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro la aa, bwaala aa ban nɛ.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Waa nɔɔ dɛɛ ba deŋnetɛra ɛɛ, dɛ́ tɛ Ijipt tena ne harɛre nɛra la bwa baa wola la ka di Kukure Tɔpejen la.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Vii bɛlbwa waa lɔ Jerusalam ne Juda ɛɛ do ɡoroŋee tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, ásɛ nɛra baa ba ɛ saraha la kpɔ viine la daa ba saraha kwa. Keenan tena bonadiire bɛlbwa aa Koranar Bwa Kooro Dea belaa do awola tɔpere.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa pila baɡle o keame Malakae chaahna ta ŋɔ ó bol baɡle Israel tena laanee nɔ. Korowii nyina waa nyin Israel tena

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ o nɛra Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Men Korowii, saŋ bɛlbwaa mɛɛ nyin heya.” Kɛ he dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa chaɡla kɛ he dɛ nyin yaa ɔ?” Asɛ Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, “Jekɔb dɔɔree Esɔ, kɛ n nyin Jekɔb ne o naanar,

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: dɛ hah Esɔ ne o naanar baa ɛ Edom tena. A habɔɔ Esɔ aa baa dɔ deŋɡarere harɛ ta so la, asɛ n chɔɡ bela bwa o berɛ kalampoŋare sobɔr.”

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Edom tena la ŋɔ, “A lole kɛ Korowii chɔɡ ya harɛ te, kɛ yaa berɔ kwaa vɔrɔwe bwɛɛre la.” Asɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Ba ken ɛɛ won berɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛɛre la te, kɛ mɛɛ chɔɡaa ja. Baa yerɛ harɛ la ‘Nyubinikpeɡ Tena Harɛɛ’, n bandia aa o nɛra nɛɛ le bwa.”

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Israel tena siwi ɛɛ na ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Korowii kan, hale dɛɛ di kpeɡri harɛfala aa bar Israel harɛ bwa!” Saraha kwaa aa di kirihiah

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Bie dɛɛ tɛ o mɛɛ jirima, asɛ bonɔɔ ɡe ɛɛ tɛ o nomoa duure. Menee he mɛɛ, ɛrɛɛ haa wola jirima kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ mɛ nɔ? N ɛ he dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ haa wola duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ mɛ nɔ? He sɔfore, heyaa wola duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ n sɔn, kɛ he dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ yaa wola duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ he sɔn ɔ?’ ”

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “He kpɔ kondikwaa aa kah doŋa dɛɛ ba n saraha kon ta. He berɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa ya kpɔ doŋa kah he saraha kon laɔ?’ He ŋɔ Korowii saraha kon la ta jirima kon ɛɛ.”

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “He kpɔ kondɛɛra aa nyoŋa, ne anɔ la aa wola won valɛ, dɛ anɔ la bwara aa dɛ wea ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ yaa? He kpɔ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ ka tɛ he harɛ nomoa aa, aa do o somee yaa? O sie ɛɛ lɛ he nɛɛ dɛ ɛ he wesoŋa tɛ heya aa?

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Taraken, dɛ he sɔfore dɛ soŋ mɛ ŋɔ ń kpɔ kɛ heya aa, mɛɛ no he wesoŋaa yaa? Maa he wesoŋaa no. Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.”

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: O berɔ ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ he sɔfore la bini bɛl fee tɔɔɡe men Korowii Dea ɡbeni, bela haa joa dɛ kaa ɛ saraha la, ásɛ he bɛ won jo ka choŋi nii saraha kon la ta ɛ sarahasale. N sie aa he nɛɛ lɛ, maa he nɔn ta saraha kon bɛlbwa ɡee lɛ.

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ duu mɛ kohonaa, le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr. Baa fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa somaa, dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa aa wera le harɛ bɛlbwa ta ba, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ duu mɛ.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Kɛ he sɔfore dɛ chɔɡ n sɔn dɛ ŋɔ n saraha kon la kah doŋa. He ŋɔ kondikwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ba o ta la ɡe ta jirima dɔe, dɛ ɛ konsale.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: He ŋɔ he mee leɔ, dɛ laa sie kpɔ saraha kwaa aa wera kɛŋɔ he kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ la ta. Kɛ he kpɔ kondɛɛra bola aa lɔ a nɛ, ne anɔ la aa wola won valɛ kɛɛ weela tena ba ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ. Mɛɛ lɛa yaa?

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ pedɛɛɡe do o peera bini, dɛ baɡ mɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ ba tɛ mɛ, dɛ berɛ kpɔ onɔ la waa di kirihiah ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ la, o neɡ mɛ. Nyotaahna lɔ o nɛ. N ɛ koojen, a chɛ kɛ harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔm mɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Hé no, waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa laanee kɛŋɔ,

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: dɛ he vɛh n waa nɔ noe, dɛ vɛh jirima kpɔe dɛ́ tɛ n sɔn he bambile bwa ne naa, taahnaa mɛɛ ba heyaa taahna, dɛ́ ɡel kɛ n fe aa swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heya. N dɔɔ taah heya, dɛkalkɛ he ta he liire ɛɛ kɛŋɔ he kpɔ jirima tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: He we-ɛɛla nomanta, mɛɛ tɛr he naanar deŋnee, dɛ́ kpɔ kondɛɛra haa kpoora ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ tɔpejena ta la bena fɔɡle he sie, ásɛ ba kpɔ he ne loŋɡboŋbena la ɡɛ kaa.

english_verse: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Anee dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee kah heyaa dɛɛ le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, ásɛ fɔo n ne Lewi dea tena aa fɔwa la won do le dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: N ne Lewi dea tena fɔo la ɛ mkpa ne deŋnesɔɔhna n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba. Gɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel baa ɔm mɛ kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ duu mɛ.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Waa aa ɛ kasinteŋii ba baɡle, ba ta nyosone teŋe bwa. N ne ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta. Waa aa toɡra ɡbo laa ba ɛ, kɛ a cheɡɛ ba nɛɛ nɛra ɡalɡa ɡe charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ sɔfo bɛlbwa dɔ wejema kɛrɛdɛ le men Korowii be, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle nɛra wa, ásɛ nɛra la ba be kaa hweli n waa la. Banee men Koranar Bwa Kooro tomɛ.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Kɛ he sɔfore le ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ta, he webaɡla ɡelɔ nɛra ɡalɡa lɔ naa dɛ nyoɡre, dɛ chɔɡ fɔo n ne Lewi dea tena aa fɔwa la.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ɡelɔ haa jirimaa dɔ, ásɛ sihiih kpo heyaa Israel tena siwi ta, dɛkalkɛ he ta n waa ta teŋɛ. Nɛra siebɔraa he nyiŋi dɛɛ bol wa.” Juda tena Korowii habɔɔ lee

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Mɛɛ beŋkpoŋ laa ya dɔ aa? Korowii beŋkpoŋ laa ta ya bwa naa? Ɛrɛɛ ya waa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, yaa chɔɡ fɔo Korowii ne ya naawa aa fɔwa la nɔɔ?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Juda tena ta ba nyobaɡa ta teŋɛ, dɛ chɔɡ ba ne men Korowii fɔo la. Ba ɛ waa maa kia Israel harɛ ta bwa, ne bwɛjen Jerusalam. Baala mo nɛŋhɔɔhra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa bihaahna, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Kórowii le baa te bɛlbwa waa dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ le Israel tena bini, hale dɛ naate sɛoh ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro kwaraa noo.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Waane ɡe lole hɛɛ ɛa ja. He wio dɛ kpɔ sinii su kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ta bwa, dɛ wi dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre lɛɛ waa wola he saraha kwaa lɛ silɛɛ ne kpa la wa.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: He dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛ waa Korowii vɛh yaa nɔɔ?’ A kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ he ne he bonɔɔne saŋ haah Korowii aa ɛ danseɛ a ta ken, dɛkalkɛ he chɔɡ fɔo haa ŋwɛɛra Korowii sie ŋɔ o ɛ he haah la.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Korowii ta ɡelɛ haah ne baa ɛ beŋkpoŋ bwadabii ne doma ta naa? Bɔkwa waa o ɛa ɡɛ nɔɔ? O dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he bii baa teŋɛ o waa la ta. Anomanta, bɛlbwa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel nyobaɡa aa lɔ o ne o bonɔɔne saŋ haah baah la chɔɡ.

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: He ɡelɔ Korowii mee le he wobol ta. He dɛ pɛɛ ŋɔ “Ɛrɛɛ ya ɡel o mee leɔ?” He ŋɔ, “Korowii sie dɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa nɛ, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ leperaa Korowii o waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la dɔɔ?”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro bolɔ ŋɔ, “Hé no, mɛɛ tomɛ n toromee ó tɔ n sie dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ mɛ ń ba. Ásɛ Dɔɔ haa dɛ nyiŋu ŋwɛnɛ la ba piɡri heyaa o Dea, onee hɛɛ nyiŋi ŋwɛnɛ ó ba dɛ́ ba baɡle fɔo la wa.”

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won che o sie o bala tɔpere la ta nɔ? Umee dɛ́ won le a nyoa ɔ? Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ nii baa kpɔa dɛɛ mwɛɛ bune dɛ laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ a ta, kɛɛ simina waa nyɛɡa ken.

english_verse: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord,
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ba sɔ Lewi dea tena doŋaa ta kɛŋɔ ba yon mwɛɛ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ laa doŋa kpɔ a ta la ken. Gɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɔe, ásɛ ba kpɔ saraha kwaa aa wera baa tɛo,

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: mɔɔ Korowii sie lɛ dɛ́ lɛ Juda ne bwɛjen Jerusalam nɛra saraha kwaa baa kpɔ baa tɛo la, ɡɛ a fa aa doa saŋ la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: Men Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ bao warane dɛ́ ba bol he waa dɛ́ pa bole. Mɛɛ ba bol voɡra ne nɛra baa dɛ chɔɡ yal, ne dansewea tena ne nɛra baa dɛ faah ba tom-ɛɛra ba kembɔr ta, ne nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi luhaahna ne bilalbii, ne nɛra baa wola nɛŋhɔɔhra waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta, baa wola men ɔmɛ bwa waa.”

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii, maa charɛ bwa, a waa ɡela he Jekɔb naanar ta do le la.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: He ne he naawa bwaa berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ vɛh me Mmarare ta teŋa. Hé berɛ ba n be, ásɛ n ɡe do sie he be. Kɛ he dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ ya ɛ dɛ́ berɛ won ba he be nɔ?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: N dɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ a wer kɛŋɔ nɛn ŋwɛ men Korowii aa? Kɛ he dɛ ŋwɛɛ mɛ. He dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa taa yaa ŋwɛɛ nɔ?’ Kwaa haa bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ baa tɛ mɛ, ne saraha kwaa taa hɛɛ ŋwɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Nyotaahna lawɛ he Israel tena bwa, dɛkalkɛ he dɛ ŋwɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Kwaa haa bɔne a bini bɔre fi la, hé kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ba tɛ men Korowii n Dea, ásɛ kondikwaa warɛ n Dea bela. Hé daah mɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta dɛ́ na, ásɛ n ɡel bwaala nɛ kohona, dɛ́ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa, dɛ́ ɡel kondikwaa warɛ he deremi kohona.

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: Maa ɡel kwaa ba chɔɡ he koo kondikwaa kpa, dɛ́ ɡel he ɡrepo daa ɡe nɔnɛ kohona.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Anee dɛ́ ɡel harɛre ta nɛra bwa yerɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna tena, dɛkalkɛ he soɡe harɛdɛɛɡe ta. Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.” Kasinteŋ tena kembɔr

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: Korowii ŋɔ, “He bol wedoŋa tɛ mɛ. Kɛ he berɔ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Wedoŋa besoo ya bol tɛɛ nɔ?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: He bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii toma ɛ wepuu. Tɔnɔ besoo ya dɔ dɛɛ le waa waa kpɔa tɛ yaa ŋɔ yaa teŋɛ a ta, asɛ a berɛ do kɛŋɔ ya tea bini chɔɡɔ Koranar Bwa Kooro sie nɔɔ?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken nɔ, ya dɛ yerɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ jenu bosɔɔhna tena. Kasinteŋ, waa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ ɛ la, a dɛ do wer dɛɛ chiɡ ba kɛrɛdɛ, hale banɔ la baa dɛ tɔŋle Korowii dɛ vɛh o waa la aa deŋnetɛra bɛlbwa dɔ.’ ”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Kɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii bol waa dɔŋa be, asɛ Korowii do deŋne ba be, dɛ no waa bwa baa bola. Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ dɛɛ tɛ o sɔn jirima la, ba chwerɛ ba sɔna do tɔn bini bil o sie, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii ba wa.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Awola maa ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, mɛɛ kpɔ baa ɛ n bii maa dɛ nyin ba kohona. N tea ɛɛ domɛ ba nɛɛ ń lɛɛ ba, kɛŋɔ mɛɛ yon dɔ tedoma tɛ o bie waa dɛ tomɔ dɛɛ lɛo la ken.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Hɛɛ berɔ na ɡɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra waa aa korɛ banɔ la ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa waa ta, ne ɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ men Korowii waa aa korɛ banɔ la baa wola men tomɛ waa ta.”

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Hé no, tɔpere men Korowii aa dɛ ba ba bol nɛra baa dɛ baɡle ba te, ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa la dɛ ba kpela. Baa fuuh kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken, ba komɛlbwa aa wola ka.

english_verse: But for you that honor my name, victory will shine like the sun with healing in its rays, and you will jump around like calves at play.
translation_verse: Kɛ he banɔ la haa dɛ duu mɛ la, kpeɡri maa kpɔ lɛ heyaa la ɛɛ ba he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ wechɛn yon le dɛɛ tɛ bokpeɡa la. Ásɛ he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ ba yon ya nae bii leɡ ta a sie lɛ aa jah la ken.

english_verse: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Awola tɔpere maa ba ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ la, hɛ́ɛ tiɡri nyubinikpeɡ tenaa do harɛ kɛŋɔ tɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't ever forget the laws and teachings I gave my servant Moses on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Hé lii Mmarare ne webaɡla maa cheɡɛ n bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ he Israel tena bwa ŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɛ a ta Sinai Bwejen ta la.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to send the prophet Elijah before that great and terrible day comes.
translation_verse: Hé no, mɛɛ tomɛ n keame Elaeja he bee, mɔɔ men Korowii Tɔpejen waa do ɔma kohona la ba.

english_verse: He will lead children and parents to love each other more, so that when I come, I won't bring destruction to the land.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ berɔ ɡel nyopɛo ba mɛɛnanar ne ba bii baah ta, dɛ ɡɛ laa tenaa, mɛɛ ba taah harɛ laanee ó chɔɡ.”

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: “Bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ bwa ɛɛ kpoŋe teaa dɛ́ lolɛ bibaa, ásɛ ba yerɔ Imanoɛl.” O munii kɛŋɔ, “Korowii ne ya lole.”

translation_verse: Asɛ Tɔnjerema la ne Farisii tena baa soɡe bela la lii ba nyu bini ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ o do dɛɛ bol nɛnhɛlwaa ɡɛ nɔɔ? Dɛ Korowii laa aa, umee dɛ́ won kpɔ nɛn wechɔɡa kɛo wɔ?”

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Maa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ n kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo nɔ, ne kɛŋɔ maa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ir dɛ́ valɛ, a bini umee kpeɡa ɔ?

english_verse: But now you will see that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” Jesus then said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk home.”

english_verse: At once the man stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and went home, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Asɛ baa la ir buɡ la ta, dɛ kpɔ o kalaŋ nɛra la bwa siwi ta bela, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii dɛɛ kaa.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
translation_verse: Anɔ habɔɔ la, Yeesu valɔ baa kaa dɛ na nomɛl waa soɡe o toma ta dɛɛ lɛ toɔ. Dɛ o sɔne Lewi. Yeesu aa nao la, o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir ba teŋɛ n nɛ.”

translation_verse: Lewi ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikonjena o dem dɛ hɔɔh Yeesu, asɛ o ne Yeesu ne toɔ lɛɛra pirim ne nɛra bane ka so dɛɛ di kwaa la.

english_verse: The Pharisees and some of their teachers of the Law of Moses grumbled to Jesus' disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with these tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Belaa Farisii tena ne ba bini Tɔnjerema la pwah o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ne toɔ lɛɛra baa dɛ bɔ nɛra apoo ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra pɛ dɛɛ di kwaa nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Yeesu aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Weela tenaa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe tɛɛɡa te bɔr, bokpeɡa tena laa.”

english_verse: I didn't come to invite good people to turn to God. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Matthew
translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa dɛ lii ba te nɛndɛɛɡa waa laa n ba. Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa n ba, ásɛ ba charɛ ba liire.” Nyoa vɔwa wepɛɛre (Mat

english_verse: Some people said to Jesus, “John's followers often pray and go without eating, and so do the followers of the Pharisees. But your disciples never go without eating or drinking.”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa Jɔn habɔteŋra la ne Farisii tena la yon vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, asɛ he habɔteŋra nɔ te aa wola ɡɛ ɛ nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.
translation_verse: Anee Yeesu sɛɡ ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Baa aa lawɛ hanfale dɛ yerɛ o daamanar ŋɔ bá ba lɛ ba sie nɔ, baa berɔɔ so lɔr aa? Baa lɔree so.

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.”
translation_verse: Kɛ tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ hanfale jaa laanee le ba bini. Gɛ saŋ la te, baa vɔwɛ nyoaa.”

english_verse: Jesus then told them these sayings: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and make the hole even bigger.
translation_verse: Belaa o berɛ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Baa yafale mɔnɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tɔ yabene bɔɔ. Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he chɔɡ onfale la, o ne ombene la ɡe aa dɔŋaa le.”

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined.
translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Baa senfala kpɔe dɛɛ do loŋbena aa kɔɔhna bini dɛɛ tɔ a nyoo. Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, senfala la baa peraa, aa do kpeɡrii dɛ́ pere loŋa la á chɔɡ, ásɛ sen la fuɡe.

english_verse: No one wants new wine after drinking old wine. They say, “The old wine is better.”
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa sen aa peraa nyɔ, dɛ́ berɛ kaa nyin anɔ la aa wola pere bɔr kpa, dɛkalkɛ ampera la wer tɛo.”

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he told the man to stand up where everyone could see him. And the man stood up.
translation_verse: Dɛ Yeesu te jemɛ waa baa dɛ lii, anee o yerɛ baa la o nɔndiɡ aa sewa la, dɛ ŋɔ ó ir ba che ba sie. Asɛ o ir dɛ ba che ba sie.

english_verse: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.
translation_verse: Dɛ a ba ɡɛ naa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ kohona ásɛ he hɛɡre, dɛkalkɛ he kembɔr warɔ taeh Korowii be. Gɛ tentenee ba naanar ɛ Korowii keamere ba fa aa lole la.

translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ tɛ dɔŋa kwa, ásɛ Korowii ɡee tɛ heya a do kan kohona. Korowii dɛ ba he tɛɛ yaa, wɛɛ maɡaa, dɛ́ jwiira, dɛ́ ɛɡra a jo kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ su porrr ken dɛɛ ta. Kon haa kpɔa maɡɛ kwaa tɛ he dɔŋ la tentenee baa ba kpɔe maɡɛ tɛ he ɡe.”

translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Nyoŋe ɛɛ wonoo lawɛ o dɔŋ nyoŋe daa a maɡre aa? Ba bwa aa bɔɔ taa ka le dɛ́ choɡli aa?

translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ hweli toma la ta o dɔɔ ɡwaalɛ, kɛ dɛ o dɔɔ hweli toma dɛ jemɛ tonɛ kwaraa naa, o ne o dɔɔ ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye? You show-offs! First, get the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye. A Tree and Its Fruit (Matthew
translation_verse: A do kɛŋɔ dabor aa lɔ he siwi ta haa wola on kpɔe, dɛ ŋɔ he dɔŋ be ŋɔ, ‘N dam, ɡel n laa dapuɡri kpɔ he siwi ta.’ Nɛn haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa! Tɔ sie laa dabor la kpɔ he siwi ta mɔɔ, dɛ́ won na kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ laa dapuɡri waa lɔ he dɔŋ siwi ta la kpɔ.” Daa ne o nɔna (Mat
