translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Dadɛɛɡe aa won nɔnɛ nɔnchɔɡa, ɡɛɛ dachɔɡe ɡe aa wola won nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡa.

english_verse: You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces. You cannot pick figs or grapes from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Daa bɛlbwa nɔna waa nɔna la taa ba che dɛɛ jemɔ. Sɔɔh da aa ɡbal nɔna nɔnɛ, ɡɛɛ kontromoo ɡe aa wola lomporo nɔnɛ.

english_verse: Good people do good things because of the good in their hearts, but bad people do bad things because of the evil in their hearts. Your words show what is in your heart. Two Builders (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɛndɛɛɡe wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ taa a che baa jemɛ wedɛɛɡa aa lɔ o bambile bini. Gɛɛ ba che nɛnchɔɡe ɡe wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta dɛɛ jemɛ wechɔɡa damanta aa lɔ o bambile bini, dɛkalkɛ waa aa lɔ nɛn bambile ta laanee o nyoa ɛɛ bol. Demamaala banɛ bane wa (Mat

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, hɛɛ nao nyundua aa pila, ásɛ nyundua toroma che bela tu dɛɛ ba Men Nɛn Bie be, dɛ berɛ teeh dɛɛ kaa.”

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ tɔpetooro wee la, dɛ ba dɛ ɛ hanfalwaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Keena o do Galilia harɛ ta la. Dɛ Yeesu nya Mɛɛre lɔ bela.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: Ba yerɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la bane ɡe hanfale waa la bɔr bela.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɛ tɛ nɛra la aa cheme bela la sen, asɛ a bo. Belaa Yeesu nya ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ba sen bwa tonɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Anee Yeesu bɔɔ o nya ŋɔ, “N nya, aah ɛrɛ waa he berɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi n te siwi ta nɔɔ? Gɛ saŋ maa dɛ ba n toma ɛɛ la ta tele mɔɔ.”

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: O nya berɔ ŋɔ bonɔɔna baa dɛ do sene la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ o baa ŋɔ hé ɛ wobɛlbwa naa, hé ɛ.”

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Dɛ vɛɛhna anumɛl cheɡɛ bela asɛ ba kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ ba nawee bɛl. Ba yon ɛ nee do a bini ásɛ nɛra yon dɛɛ sarame ba sarama bɛl soo mɔɔ dɛɛ di kwa. Dɛ vɛɛhna la bɛlbwa won nee haŋkorɔ fah lɛɛ.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá do nee vɛɛhna la bini á su, asɛ ba do nee a su laɡlaɡ ken.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: Baa do nee vɛɛhna la bini la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɛ ane la ka tɛ hanfale dea nomoa la.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, ba la nee la ne ka tɛo. Baa tɛo la, dɛ senee.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: Nomoa la aa daɡɛ nee aa berɛ sen la na la, o ta wone jemɛ bela aa lea ba, kɛ dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ do sen la te jemɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Dɛ Yeesu ɡbaɡba bwadabii waa wɛɛ bol dɛ kpɔ maɡɛ Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dɛ Juu tena tɔpejen baa dɛ yerɔ Galekaa la joɔ tonɛ, anomanta, Yeesu la Jerusalam.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu pɛrɛ bampɔrɔ ŋwɛɛra, dɛ kpɔ doŋi peera ne nae ne kondɛɛra la bwa bela. O taɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ peɡri suuɡare la teeburre piiɡi, dɛ lɔ ba suuɡare merɛ,

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Bela la, o habɔteŋra la liiro kɛŋɔ ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini bobɛl kɛŋɔ, “Korowii Dea waa swɛɛ n siwi taeh” la.

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “He kuuɡi Korowii Dea nɔ naa, n ɡe ɛɛ kpɔ tɔpera atoroo doo.”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: Bela la, o nao kɛŋɔ nɛra bane aa dɛ yoɡ nae ne peera ne borɔnomare Korowii Dea bobɛl. Dɛ nɛra baa dɛ peɡri suuɡare ɡe soɡe ba teeburre ta dɛɛ ɛ ba toma.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: dɛ kɔr banɔ la baa dɛ yoɡ borɔnomare la ŋɔ bá le a ne bela, dɛ ŋɔ ba bɛ o Mɛɛ dem kpɔ berɛ bonadibɔr.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Belaa Juu tena nomonome la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa nyokpowaa hɛɛ ba wona ɛ dɛ́ chaɡle kɛŋɔ he dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ won ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔɔ?”

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii aa ir Yeesu seo ta la, belaa o habɔteŋra la lii kɛŋɔ Yeesu fa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ. A ɡelɔ ba yarada waa baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la, ne waa Yeesu aa bola la.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Kɛ Yeesu ta ban yaradae kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ o te tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o jemɛ nɛwɛnyini da kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: A ta hiaih kɛ nɛn baɡlo ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa doa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba jemɛ waa aa lɔ nɛn bambile bini.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Dɛ Juu tena nomoa bɛl lole baa yerɔ Nikodeemɔs. Dɛ o ɛ Farisii te.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Awola bɛl jwaana, o ba Yeesu be dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii tomɛ ŋɔ hé ba baɡle nɛra wa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowii ta nɛn habɔɔ cheɡaa, waa won ɛ nyokpowaa nɔ haa dɛ ɛ nɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin Korowii Kora la ta dɛ́ ja la, nemenɛ bá berɛ lolɔ ja.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, dɛ ba ta nomɛlbwa lolɛ nee ne Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ne naa, waa Korowii Kora ta jae ba.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini lola lole, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡe lola do le. Nɛwɛnyini lola ɛ bwadabii wa, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe lola ɡe ɛ lileo wa.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel waa maa bola ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ba berɛ lolɛ heyaa la kpo he nyoa.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Bela peu aa dɛ nyin laanee o ta dɛɛ kaa. O dɛ ta aa, he dɛ no o ɡbɔɡa kɛ haa on na, haa won jemɛ bela waa lea ne bela waa dɛ kaa. Gɛɛ nomɛlbwa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa lolɔ la do. Dɛ o we-ɛɛla laa aa, komɛlbwa toole dɛɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe lolɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ Juu tena nomonjen dɛɛ baɡle Korowii Wa, haa wola ɡɛ waa nɔ jemɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, waa yaa jema la, ne waa ya sie aa naa la, anee yaa bol, kɛ haa ya be no.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Aah dɛ maa dɛ bol waa aa lɔ harɛ ta bonɔɔ haa wola men yarada nɔ, dɛ n bol waa aa lɔ Korowii doa aa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ won yarada a te nɔ?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Dɛ Men Nɛn Bie laa aa, nomɛlbwa ta Korowii be nyundua laŋɛ mɔɔ. N ɡboo le o be nyundua dɛ tu ba harɛ.

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba baa ɡɔɔ mɛ ɡɛ naa, nomɛlbwa waa yarada n waa la, wɛɛ dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa laanee.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyin nɛwɛnyini taeh. A waa o ɡel men maa ɛ o Bibeŋkpoŋ ɡbo waa dɔɔ la ba harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa yarada n waa la bɛ sewɛ, kɛ ó dɔ o mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Korowii aa tom mɛ harɛ la, o ta ŋɔe ŋɔ ń ba bol he waa dɛ́ pa heyaa bolchɔɡe. Kɛ o tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba nyin ŋwɛnɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ o won lɛ heya.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa yarada n waa la, Korowii aa o waa bol á ba ɛ kɛ wɛɛ di bolchɔɡee. Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola n waa yaradae la, Korowii pao bolchɔɡe tonɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta o Bibeŋkpoŋ la waa yaradae.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Ba bolchɔɡe pae munii kɛŋɔ nii waa dɛ chaah bɔr la ba harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ nɛwɛnyini berɔ dɛɛ nyin biro ɡwaa nii la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba wobɛlbwa ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, waa bochaah nyin, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o le bochaah ta naa, nɛra ɛɛ na o wechɔɡa laanee.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Naate waa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la te, waa bochaah lee ɔmɛ. Wedɛɡ-ɛɛ bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ o waa bochaah ta ásɛ nɛra bwa na dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ o jemɛ Korowii.” Yeesu ne Jɔn

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la la Juda harɛ ta, asɛ o ka di tɔpera anɛ ba be dɛɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee bela.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ Jɔn nɛɛ la ne Juu te bɛl dɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa ba bela Korowii toma waa aa ɛ nɔɔra ne naa sarama ne nee sɔe wa.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Ba la Jɔn be dɛ ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he dɛ lii kɛ he ne baa bɛl fa aa cheɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr pera la aa? O waa he faa bol la. O dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii ne, asɛ nɛra bwa chwa dɛɛ kaa o be.”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Belaa Jɔn ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won dɔ komɛl dɛ Korowii laa tɛo.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Maa ŋɔa ŋɔ n laa Kristo la, dɛ ŋɔ tomaa ba tom mɛ ŋɔ ń tɔ o sie la, he ta noɛ yaa?

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Hanfale jaaree dɔ o haah. Kɛ, dɛ hanfale jaa la dam lɔ hanfale la waa bɔr dɛ no o nyoa bela aa, dɛ o sie lɛo. Gɛɛ n ɡe bwara sɔɔh mɛ kohona.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ o sɔn ɛɛ le kohona asɛ n te sɔn ɛɛ ba harɛ.

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa le nyundua la ɡwaa nomɛlbwa. Nɛn waa le harɛ bonɔ la, harɛ waa o jemɛ, a waa ɡee o won bola. Kɛ nɛn waa le Korowii be nyundua la te ɡwaa nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: Waa o siwi aa naa ne waa waa noa Korowii be laanee wɛɛ bol, kɛ nɛwɛnyini aa o be no.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa sɛh Korowii wa aa, o ɡbaɡba wono dɛɛ jemɛ kɛ Korowii waa dɔ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɛn Korowii aa tomɔ la, Korowii wobolee wɛɛ bol, dɛkalkɛ Korowii tɛo o Domadɛɛɡe la tɛɛ tenten.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Korowii nyin o Bie la taeh, dɛ kpɔ wobɛlbwa kpeɡri do o nɔn ta.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa yarada Korowii Bie la waa la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwaa. Nomɛlbwa waa wola Korowii Bie la waa yaradae la, waa mkpa dɔe ba. Korowii bandia ɛɛ do o nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa.”

english_verse: But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself. Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, dɛ Yeesu ɡbaɡba aa nɛra Korowii nee sɔ. Dɛ o habɔteŋra laanee dɛɛ sɔ ba Korowii ne.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Dɛ Samaria harɛ taa chɛ kɛ o kpɔ dɛ́ won kaa Galilia harɛ ta.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Belaa haah la nyoa kpo, o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Fini te Juu te dɛ soŋe Samaria haah ne aa?” Dɛ Juu tena dɛ kɔɡɛ Samaria tena taeh, dɛ baa sɛh ba ne baa pɛ numoli ne loɡa kwara.

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Belaa haah la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, bule nɔ aa luŋa, asɛ haa wola kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ ta kɔlɔŋ dɔe nɔ, lee hɛɛ ba a ɡɛ nee aa dɛ tɛ mkpa nɔ dɔe yɔ?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: He dɛ lii kɛ he ɡwaa ya naa Jekɔb waa tɛ yaa a ɡɛ bule nɔ la kɛɛ? O ne o bii ne o kondɛɛra bwaa fa dɛ nyɔ nee bule nɔ ta.”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa nyɔ nee maa dɛ tɛo la te, nyɔɡre aa on kpo bwa. Nee maa tɛo la ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ bule aa lɔ naate bini dɛɛ bule nee aa dɛ tɛ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Belaa haah la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, amɔ te, tɛ mɛ a ɡɛ nee la ane ásɛ nyɔɡre bɛ men kpo kpa, ásɛ n bɛ bonɔ ba ba dɔ nee kpa.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ka yerɛ o jaa ba.

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: He yalɛ baala banue bwa, kɛ onɔ la he ne waa lole taraken la, he jaa laa on, anomanta, kpelaa he ŋɔ.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Asɛ haah la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, maa naa nɔ, Korowii keamee hen.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Bwe nɔ taa ya Samaria tena naawa faa tomɛ Korowii saŋ la. Aah ɛrɛ waa he Juu tena ŋɔ Jerusalamee chɛ Korowii toma nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, aa ba tel saŋ bɛlee nɛra aa wola Korowii tomɛ bwe nɔ ta, baa on tomɛ Jerusalam ɡe.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: He Samaria tena te, ɛɛ he ɡee ɛ te, kɛ haa kon haa dɛ tomɛ jemɛ. Kɛ ya Juu tena te jemɛ kon yaa dɛ tomɛ, dɛkalkɛ ya nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa ásɛ Korowii lɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Korowii toma te lɔ bambile bini. Aa ba tel saŋ bɛlee, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii kpela kpela la che o Domadɛɛɡe la ta dɛɛ tomɔ bambile bini, dɛɛ tomɔ kasinteŋ ne, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛɛ wɛɛ nyin kɛ baa tomɔ. A ɡɛ tɔpere la telo tonɛ.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛ lileo. Anomanta, dɛ ya dɛ tomɔ waa, yá che o Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛ́ kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ tomɔ bambile bini.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Anee haah la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya Lɛɛ la baa dɛ yerɔ Kristo la ɛɛ bao. O balaa, wɛɛ baɡle yaa wobɛlbwaa.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Onee he ne wɛɛ bol waa la. Kristo laanee men.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Belaa o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, paanoo la he dɛ aa dia vaɡɛ la waa hɛɛ ɡaaɡe n bɔr la. Menɛkɛsɛ he no nyokpowaa la bɛlbwa mun.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Anee ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ ásɛ dɛ won ɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Gɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin laanee kɛ nómɛlbwa yarada o Bibeŋkpoŋ waa tomɔ la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo.”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Ya naawa fa di kondikwaa ane soo aa le nyundua baa yera maana ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛ valɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la. Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini kɛŋɔ, ‘O tɛɛ ba kondikwaa aa le nyundua ba asɛ ba di la.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, Mosis laa tɛ heyaa kondikwaa aa le nyundua la. N Mɛɛ ɡboo won kondikwaa tenten aa le nyundua la kpɔe dɛ tɛ.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Kondikwaa la Korowii aa tɛ yaa laanee nɛn waa le o ɡbaɡba be nyundua dɛ ba mkpa ne ba tɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa la.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Anee nɛnlaa la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, tɛ yaa ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa yaa di.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Menee kondikwaa aa dɛ tɛ Korowii mkpa la. Nomɛlbwa waa ba n be la, lɔr aa on kpo. Asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa yarada mɛ dɛ́ kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ la, nyɔɡre ɡba aa o kpoe ba bwa.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: N ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he na mɛ, kɛ he ta men yaradae dɛ kpɔ he te tɛ mɛ mɔɔ.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa n Mɛɛ Korowii aa kpɔ tɛ mɛ la ɛɛ ba n bee dɛ́ ba teŋɛ n nɛ. Maa nomɛlbwa ɡe waa ba n be laanee doŋi ta bwa,

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba tetoowa waa laa n le nyundua ba. Naate waa tom mɛ la tetoowa waa n ba.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: N Mɛɛ Korowii waa tom mɛ la tetoowaa kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la bɛ n nɔn ta le, asɛ tɔpera bwa jaɡa wee la, ń iru seo ta.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ n Mɛɛ la aa dɛ nyin laanee kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa na men maa ɛ o Bie la dɛ yarada mɛ dɛ kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ásɛ n iru seo ta, tɔpera bwa jaɡa wee.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Menee kondikwaa waa dɛ tɛ Korowii mkpa la.

translation_verse: He naawa fa di kondikwaa ane soo baa yera maana aa le nyundua, kɛ ba serewɔ.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Menee kondikwaa aa le nyundua ba dɛ dɔ mkpa la. Nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ la ɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe. Asɛ kondikwaa maa kpɔ tɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa bá di dɛ́ dɔ mkpa laanee n bo-ol.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: N bo-olii kondikwaa tenten, asɛ n chal ɡee nee tenten.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa di n bo-ol asɛ dɛ nyɔ n chal la, n ne wɛɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋii, waa wola won daɡre o te n nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Kondikwaa aa le nyundua ba dɛɛ tɛ mkpa laanee nɔ, o ta do kɛŋɔ he naawa kondikwaa baa dɛ yera maana baa dia mkpa aa wola toole a ta ba serewe la. Nomɛlbwa waa di kondikwaa nɔ la ɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.”

translation_verse: Kapeeneɔm cheremi deaa Yeesu do dɛɛ baɡle nɛra waa dɛ bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ. Mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe

translation_verse: Yeesu aa naa kɛ o habɔteŋra la dɛ naɡre a ɡɛ waa la, o pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Gɛ waa nɔ kpeɡri tɛ heyaa kɛɛ?

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Dɛ he fe na Men Nɛn Bie la n berɛ dɛɛ kaa nyundua bela maa lea ba la ɡe sɛ?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡbosoroo dɛɛ tɛ mkpa. Nɛwɛnyini bokpeɡa te ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ. Waa maa dɛ bol he be nɔ dɛ ba Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ne, asɛ dɛɛ tɛ heyaa mkpa.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Kɛ he bini bane ta yaradae.” Mumpar la bwa dɛ Yeesu te jemɛ ba bini banɔ la baa wola yaradae dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo, ne naate waa leo tɛ bá kpoo la.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Anɔ waa n ŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa won ba n be nemenɛ n Mɛɛ Korowii leo tɛ mɛ la.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ taa a che nɛra ba fa aa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la kɛrɛdɛ le mumur dɛ ɡel o nɛɛ teŋa.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Anee o bɔɔ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la ŋɔ, “He ɡe dɛ nyin kaala kɛɛ?”

translation_verse: Asɛ Seemɔn Pita ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, dɛ ya le he be naa, ume bee yaa ba kaala ɔ? He wobol taa mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe do.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”

translation_verse: Dɛ Seemɔn Eskareɔt bie Judas waa wɛɛ bol la. O habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la bɛlee, kɛ onee dɛ́ ba leo tɛ.

translation_verse: Anɔ habɔɔ la, dɛ Galilia harɛ ta ɡboo Yeesu do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe. Dɛ waa nyin kɛ o la Juda harɛ te ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ bela nomonome la dɛ nyin o bɔr dɛ́ kpoo.

translation_verse: Anee Yeesu nimanar ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Le bonɔ dɛ́ kaa Juda harɛ ta, ásɛ he habɔteŋra baa lɔ bela la ka na he nyokpowaa haa dɛ ɛ nɔ.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛ nɛra jemɛ o waa la, waa o waa ɛɛ dɛɛ sɔh. Anomanta, ɡel nɛra bwa na he we-ɛɛla nɔ.”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: O nimanar la ɡbabir ta on yaradae.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He te, tɔpere bɛlbwa wer tɛ heyaa kɛ he la bela, kɛ n te tɔpere ta tele mɔɔ.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”

translation_verse: Waa bol ɡɛ la, o kwaarɔ so Galilia harɛ ta. Yeesu la Kukure Tɔpejen dii bɔr

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Dɛ Juu tena nomonome la dɛ ɡaaɡe o bɔr tɔpejen la dii ta asɛ dɛɛ pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Leperaa baa la doɔ?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛnlaa la kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ŋwalɛ o wa. Bane ŋɔ, “O ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.” Bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Akai, nɛra ɡboo wɛɛ neɡre.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Bɛlbwa ta bolɛ asɛ a le baŋ nɛra no, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ Juu tena nomonome la.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Baa di Kukure tɔpera la tel baah ta la, Yeesu kaa jo Korowii Dea dɛ pa mun dɛɛ baɡle nɛra Korowii Wa.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: O webaɡla la ɛ Juu tena la nyokpoa kohona, asɛ baa bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ɡɛ baa nɔ won jemɛ anɔ bwa, dɛ o ta tɔnjereme ɛɛ nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Belaa o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waa maa dɛ baɡle nɔ ta n ɡbaɡba be leɛ, a bwa le Korowii waa tom mɛ la be.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa sɛoh kɛ wɛɛ ɛ Korowii tetoowaa te naa, wɛɛ won jemɛ kɛŋɔ kasinteŋ waa aa le Korowii bee mɛɛ bol la. N ɡbaɡba webaɡla laa.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn kpɔ o kpeɡri dɛɛ baɡle wa aa, o nyin sɔn dɛɛ tɛ o ɡbaɡba. Nɛn waa nyin sɔn dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa tomɔ la te la, o waa dɔ kasinteŋ, waa nɛra neɡre.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Mosis ta heyaa Korowii Mmara la tɛɛ yaa? Asɛ he bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ teŋɛ a ta. Aah dɛ ɛrɛɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo nɔɔ?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Belaa nɛnlaa la bane ŋɔ, “Dɛ kpoe nɛ? Jamɔ komɛl ɡale he sie. Umee dɛɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Webeŋkpoŋ ɡboo n ɛ asɛ he nyoa kpo ɡɛ la.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Mosis bee he dɔ penteŋa Mmara la. O be laa penteŋa le te, he naawaa pa a mun. Anomanta, he won bie pen teŋa Ona Tɔpere kwaraa ta.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Dɛ he lolɛ bie o yawanyoa chiɡ Ona Tɔpere ta naa, he dɛ teŋe o pen, dɛkalkɛ haa nyin he chɔɡ Mosis Mmara la. Dɛ ɡɛɛ te naa, ɛrɛɛ he baah berɛ di n nɛɛ kɛ maa chah nɛn Ona Tɔpere ta nɔ?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Bela la, dɛ Jerusalam tena bane dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ laa baa nyin o bɔr dɛ́ kpo la kɛɛ?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Na, onee cheɡɛ nɛra baah ta dɛɛ bol waa asɛ ba bwa tɔ nyoa che la. Nomonome ken nao kɛŋɔ onee Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la.

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Akai! Baa nɔ te, ya jemɔ dɛ jemɛ o leebɔr, kɛ Kristo la te, dɛ o balaa, nomɛlbwa aa o leebɔree jemɛ.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Dɛ Yeesu cheɡɛ Korowii Dea bela dɛɛ bol wa. Aa ba ɡɛ la o kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “He jem mɛ dɛ jemɛ bela maa lea. N ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ne laa n ba. Korowii waa ɛ kasinteŋ te laanee tom mɛ. Haa on jemɛ.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: N te jemɔ, dɛkalkɛ o bee n le, on tom mɛ n ba nɔ.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Anɔ nomanta, ba fe dɛ lawɔ, asɛ ba ta wone, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o tɔpere ta tele mɔɔ.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Nɛnlaa la kɛrɛdɛ bwa yaradao, asɛ dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, “Amɔ dɛ Kristo la baa ba naa, wɛɛ won dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa kohona dɛ́ ɡwaa anɔ baa nɔ aa dɛ ɛ nɔ kenɛ?” Ba tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ka lawɛ Yeesu

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farisii tena la aa noa kɛŋɔ nɛnlaa la dɛ ŋwalɛ Yeesu waa dɔŋa be la, ba ne Sɔfonomonome la tomɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea la ŋɔ bá ka lawɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Dɛ Yeesu dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Tɔpera anɛ bɛlee mɛɛ ba he be bonɔ soɡa. Maa biɡri ásɛ dɛ berɛ kaa naate waa tom mɛ la be.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Hɛɛ baa nyin n bɔree, kɛ haa men na, dɛkalkɛ bela maa do la, haa won ba bela.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Anee Juu tena nomonome la bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Amɔ leperaa baa nɔ ɛɛ nyin kaala ásɛ yaa wola on ba na kpa nɔɔ? O ken ɛɛ kaa Juu tena baa jo pua ka so Grik tena harɛ ta la bee, dɛ́ kaa chaɡle Grik tena o waa la kɛɛ?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: O ŋɔ, yaa ba nyin o bɔree kɛ yaa on na, bela waa dɛ kaa ɡe la, bɛlbwa aa won ba o be. Aah dɛ ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ chaɡle nɔɔ?”

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Ba Kukure tɔpera la dii ta tɔpere waa baa ka mun dɛ ɛ tɔpejen tenten la, Yeesu iro che dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpoo la, ó ba n be ń tɛo nee ó nyɔ.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada mɛ la, mɛɛ ɛo ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡla laanee. Dɛ, ‘Nee waa dɔ mkpa la ɛɛ dɛɛ le o nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa kɛŋɔ moo aa dɛ palɛ la.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Nee nɔ waa bol o waa nɔ, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa ba kpɔ do nɛra baa yaradao la nɛɛ la waa o bol la. Gɛ saŋ la dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ta balɛ mɔɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Yeesu ta o jirima dɔe mɔɔ.

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Nɛnlaa la bini bane no o waa waa bola la, dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii keame laanee baa nɔ kpela.”

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ Kristo la ɛɛ ɛ Devid naanar la bɛlee dɛ le o bwɛɛ Bɛtlɛham aa?”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nyopɛo ta ba bini balɛ kpa, Yeesu ɡbosoroo wa.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Asɛ bane ɛɛ nyin dɛ́ lawɔ, kɛ nomɛlbwa ta wone kpɔ nɔn leɡo. Juda nomonome yarada bɛ dɔe

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Belaa nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea la berɛ kaa Sɔfonomonome ne Farisii tena la be dɛ ka bol, asɛ ba ɡe bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta on lawɛ ba nɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Anee ba ŋɔ, “Baa la waa waa dɛ bol la, nomɛlbwa ta o wobol dɔŋa bolɛ bwa.”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Asɛ Farisii tena la berɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Jamɔ o wono neɡre he ɡe kɛɛ?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: He na ya nomonome nɔ bini bɛl kɛŋɔ waa dɛ yaradao wa aa? Kɛɛ he na Farisii tena la bɛl kɛ waa dɛ yaradao?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛnlaa nɔ te la, baa Mosis Mmara la jemɛ. Dɛ Korowii nyotaahna laɡ ba.”

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Belaa Nikodeemɔs waa ɛ Farisii te dɛ faa la Yeesu be ka la bɔɔ ba ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Mosis Mmara ta, yaa wonoo pa nɛn bolchɔɡe dɛ ya ta on yerɛ dɛ bɔɔro dɛ jemɛ waa waa ɛa mɔɔ naa?”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Anee ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Jamɔ he ɡe le Galilia harɛ kɛɛ? Dɛ he pese Korowii Tɔn la bini dɛ na naa, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ Korowii keame aa Galilia harɛ taa le ba bwa.”

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Belaa ba bwa ir kaa ba deremi.

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu kaa Ɔlevere Bwejen la ta.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Bɔr aa dɛ chaah chɔmbibi la, o berɛ kaa Korowii Dea. Belaa nɛnlaa ba o be dɛ ba baro cheme, asɛ o so harɛ dɛɛ chaɡ ba Korowii Wa.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Asɛ Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena lawɛ haah bɛl waa dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛ ba o ne Yeesu be, dɛ ɡel o ba che ba bwa baah ta.

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: Asɛ ba ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya lawɛ haah nɔ dɛ o ne baa bɛl waa wola o jaa ɛɛ chɔɔ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Mosis Mmara dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ haah waa do ken la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá foɡro bwea kpo. Amɔ taraken ɛrɛɛ he ɡe ŋɔɔ?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Ba pɛɛro ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ́ kpɔ daahno na kɛŋɔ wɛɛ bol waanee ásɛ ba fee dɔ o nyoa lawɛ. Belaa Yeesu joŋi asɛ dɛ kpɔ o nonii dɛɛ chwerɛ harɛ.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Ba taa cheɡa dɛɛ pɛɛro waa ɡɛ la, o iro che asɛ dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé bini bɛlbwa waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ bwa la, ó tɔ sie ta bwe forɔ.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ berɛ kwaa joŋi dɛɛ chwerɛ harɛ ja.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu ir che, dɛ pɛɛ haah la ŋɔ, “Leperaa ba kaalɔ? Ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ pae bolchɔɡe kpa aa?”

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Anee o ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n Dɔɔ, bɛlbwa toole.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ate, n ɡe aa hen bolchɔɡee pa kpa. Kaa, kɛ bɛ wechɔɡa ka ɛ kpa.” Yeesu ɛ harɛ nɔ ta kandea

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Yeesu bol waa baɡle Farisii tena la ja, dɛ ŋɔ, “N ɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah harɛ nɔ ta nɛra. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ la aa biro taa valɛ bwa, wɛɛ valɛ bochaah taa dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Belaa Farisii tena la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Henee bol he waa dɛ ɡbaɡba berɛ di he te danseɛ, anomanta, nyosonee hɛɛ teŋe.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Anee o ŋɔ, “Akai. A lole kɛ n dɛ di n ɡbaɡba danseɛ te, kɛ kasinteŋii mɛɛ bol, dɛkalkɛ n jemɛ bela maa lea ne bela maa dɛ kaa. Haa n leebɔr ne n kaabɔr jemɛ.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta liiree he kpɔ nyiŋi nɛn dɛɛ bol wa, kɛ n te aa bole pa.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Dɛ mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ kwaraa yaa, mɛɛ ɛa á toɡre, dɛkalkɛ n ɡbo laa, n Mɛɛ waa tom mɛ la ja n nɛ.

english_verse: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.
translation_verse: He mmarare la dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ webeŋkpoŋ nɛra banɛ bwa aa bol la ɛ kpela.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: N ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ di n te danseɛ, asɛ n Mɛɛ la waa tom mɛ la ɡe ɛ danseɛ dɛ ja n nɛɛ wobɛlbwa maa dɛ ɛ ta.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Leperaa he mɛɛ nɔ doɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa wola men jemɛ nɔ, ɡɛɛ haa wola n Mɛɛ la ɡe jemɛ,” dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he fe jem mɛ naa, he fe jemɛ n Mɛɛ la ɡe.”

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Korowii Dea suuɡa tae dakare bɔr belaa Yeesu do dɛɛ baɡle waa dɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ. Bɛlbwa ta wone lawɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o tɔpere ta tele mɔɔ. Yeesu ŋɔ, haa won la bela maa dɛ kaa

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu berɛ bol waa baɡle nɛra la ja ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ba kaaloo he ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin n bɔr, kɛ haa men na. He wechɔɡa taa hɛɛ ba sewa. Bela maa kaa la, haa won ba bela.”

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Anee Juu tena nomonome la bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “O ŋɔ yaa won la bela waa dɛ kaa! Jamɔ wɛɛ kpo o tenee kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Harɛ nɔ ta nɛraa heya, asɛ n ɡe le nyundua. He le harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ n te, harɛ nɔ ta laa n le.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: A waa n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, hɛɛ sewɛ he wechɔɡa taa la. Dɛ nomɛlbwa ta men yaradae kɛŋɔ Menee Men te naa, hɛɛ sewɛ he wechɔɡa taa.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Belaa ba bɔɔro ja ŋɔ, “Henee ume o?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Anee n ŋɔ he be chɔɔ bwa la.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: N fe dɔ he waa dɛ bol kohona he di bolchɔɡe a ta, kɛ maa bol. Naate waa tom mɛ la waa dɔ kasinteŋ nomanta, n wobɛlbwa maa bol nɛra be la ɛ waa aa le o be.”

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, ba ta o waa la mun noɛ kɛŋɔ o Mɛɛ Korowii waa wɛɛ bol.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: Anomanta, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Awola haa ɡɔɔ Men Nɛn Bie nyundua la, belaa hɛɛ ba n nae kɛŋɔ Menee Men kpela, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ne laa mɛɛ ɛ wa, kɛ anɔ la n Mɛɛ la aa ŋɔ n be laanee mɛɛ bol.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Naate waa tom mɛ la ja n nɛ, o ta men tae, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ɛ anɔ la aa dɛ too o tea.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Nɛra baa no Yeesu waa la kɛrɛdɛ yaradao. Kasinteŋ jema ɛɛ ɡeloo ya dɔ ya te

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Asɛ o ŋɔ Juu tena baa yaradao la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ɡelɔ n waa maa baɡle heyaa la do he bambile bini hɛɛ teŋɛ a ta te naa, dɛ he ɛ n habɔteŋra kpela,

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: dɛ won jemɛ kasinteŋ la, asɛ kasinteŋ la ɡel he dɔ he te.”

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Anee ba ŋɔ, “Abraham naanaree ya te, nomɛlbwa nɛndɔɔla laa yan. Aah, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ yaa dɔ ya tenee yaa wola nɛndɔɔlaa ɛ kpa nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!

translation_verse: Dɛ Judasee chɔ ba suuɡa bwa nyoa. Anomanta, dɛ ba bini bane dɛ lii kɛ Yeesu ken dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ka nyin tɔpejen la kondikwa. Dɛ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, amɔ o ken ŋɔ ó ka tɛ nyaara suuɡa.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Judas aa lɛ paanoo la dɛ di tonɛ la, o den le ba be bela kaa. Dɛ jwaanaa. Yeesu bol ɡɛ Pita aa le o habɔɔ

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: N bii, maa he be bonɔɔ biɡri bɛlbwa. Hɛɛ baa nyin n bɔree. Gɛ maa bol Juu tena nomonome be laanee mɛɛ bol he be la. Anee kɛŋɔ haa won ba bela maa dɛ kaa la.

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Anee Seemɔn Pita pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, leperaa hɛɛ kaalɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Taraken nɔ, haa won teŋɛ n nɛɛ la bela maa dɛ kaa nɔ, kɛ he ta ɛɛ ba ti mɛɛ.”

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Belaa o pɛɛro ja ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, ɛrɛ waa maa wola won teŋɛ he nɛɛ taraken ɔ? Dɛ seo kwaraa yaa, mɛɛ koh he waa sewɛ.”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Anee Yeesu berɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Kpelaa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ won koh n waa sewaa? Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, jabal loɡle ne sii dɛ he tɔɔh kera atoro ŋɔ haa men jemɛ kwaraa.”

translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ! Hɛ́ɛ yarada Korowii ásɛ dɛɛ yarada n ɡe.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Deene lɔ n Mɛɛ Korowii dem taeh. Dɛ ɡɛ laa a do aa, n fe aa he bee ŋɔ n dɛ la ka kwaa sobɔr cheɡ heyaa bela.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Anee Tɔmas pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, aah yaa wola bela haa dɛ kaa jemɛ nɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ ba he be bela ɔ?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Belaa o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Menee ŋwɛnɛ, menee kasinteŋ, menee mkpa. Dɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ la n Mɛɛ la bee yaa, nemenɛ ó che n nɛ.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: He fe jem mɛ kɛrɛdɛ naa, he fe jemɛ n Mɛɛ la ɡe. Taraken he jemɔ. Onee he na la.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Anee Felep ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, baɡle yaa he Mɛɛ la, ásɛ ya baah sɔɔh yaa.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ne haa lole le saŋ la bwa nɔ, amɔ he ta wone jem mɛ mɔɔ naa, Felep? Nomɛlbwa waa na mɛ la, dɛ n Mɛɛɛ o na la. Ɛrɛɛ he berɛ ŋɔ ń baɡle heyaa n Mɛɛ la nɔɔ?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Haa yarada kɛŋɔ n ne n Mɛɛ la pɛo dɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ, o joo mɛ n ɡe joo kɛɛ? N waa maa bol la bwa ta n ɡbabir be leɛ. N Mɛɛ laanee joo mɛ asɛ mɛɛ ɛ o toma.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ yarada mɛ kɛ maa ŋɔa ŋɔ, n jo n Mɛɛ asɛ o ɡe joo mɛ la. Dɛ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, hé yarada mɛ n nyokpowe-ɛɛla la wa.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa yarada mɛ la, wɛɛ ɛ n we-ɛɛla dɔŋa bwa soo siwii. Wɛɛ won dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa ɡwaa n kwaa nɔ kwaraa, dɛkalkɛ mɛɛ berɔɔ kaa n Mɛɛ be.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Ásɛ komɛlbwa haa che n sɔn ta dɛ́ soŋe la, mɛɛ ɛo. Anɔ taa aa ba cheɡa ń lɛ jirima tɛ n Mɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He dɛ nyin n wa aa, hɛ́ɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la taa.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ soŋe n Mɛɛ Korowiirii ó berɛ tɛ heyaa Habɔchekpaa ja wɛ́ɛ cha heya, dɛ́ soŋe dɛɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ he ne o so saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee. Wɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ Korowii kasinteŋ waa la. Nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire aa won yarada o Domadɛɛɡe wa, dɛkalkɛ baa won nao ásɛ dɛ jemɔ. Kɛ he te jemɔ, dɛkalkɛ o ne heyaa lole, asɛ o so he nɛ.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: N baa kaa laa, maa heyaa ta kɛ bilalbii, mɛɛ berɔɔ ba he be.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: A ka tama, nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire aa men na kpa, kɛ he te ɛɛ na mɛɛ. Maa dɔ mkpa nomanta, he ɡee dɔ mkpaa.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Tɔpere la telaa, hɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ n ne n Mɛɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ, bɛl aa wola won daɡre o te o dɔŋ nɛ, ásɛ n ne he ɡe ɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡɛ tenten.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa lɛ n waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta la, onee dɛɛ nyin mɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin mɛ la, n Mɛɛ la ɛɛ nyinuu, ásɛ n ɡe nyin naate, dɛ́ kpɔ n te baɡlo.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Belaa Judas pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba he te kpɔe baɡle ya ɡbosoo, asɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin mɛ la, wɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ n webaɡla la taa. N Mɛɛ ɛɛ nyinuu, n ne o bwa ba o be ya ne o so.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa wola men nyin la, waa n webaɡla ta teŋɛ. Waa haa dɛ no nɔ ta n be leɛ, a bwa le n Mɛɛ waa tom mɛ la be.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: N ta aa lɔ he be nɔɔ mɛɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ he be.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa ɛ Habɔchekpaa la, onee n Mɛɛ ɛɛ ba toma ó che n sɔn ta ba dɛ ba baɡle heyaa wobɛlbwa, dɛɛ lii heyaa anɔ la bwa n fa aa bol he be la.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: Deŋnesɔɔhnaa n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, n ɡbabir deŋnesɔɔhnaa. Harɛ nɔ ta deŋnesɔɔhna laa, anomanta, he bɛ ɡel he bambile teŋe ásɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: N bol he be he no kɛŋɔ ‘Mɛɛ kaaloo ásɛ dɛ berɛ ba he be.’ Dɛ he fe dɛ nyin mɛ naa, he sie fe ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ maa kaa n Mɛɛ be, dɛkalkɛ o ɡwaa mɛ.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: N pu sie dɛɛ bol he be mɔɔ a ba ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ a ɛ ɡɛ naa, hé yarada mɛ.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: N ne haa won bol waa kohona kpa, dɛkalkɛ harɛ nɔ ta kooro dɛ ba. O ta kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe n nɛ,

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: kɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛ n dɛ nyin n Mɛɛ la, a waa mɛɛ ɛ anɔ la bwa waa do mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ la. Hé ir, yá le bonɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Menee ɡrepo daa tenten waa dɛ nɔnɛ, asɛ n Mɛɛ ɡee paa la.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: N kpale bɛlbwa waa wola nɔnɛ la, o teŋo dɛɛ ta, kɛ n kpale waa won nɔna la te, o dɛ kuu o nyoo ó won nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: A cheɡɛ waa maa baɡle heyaa la ta he do kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ kpala baa kuu a nyoo a won nɔna kɛrɛdɛ la.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he te pɛl mɛ ásɛ n ɡe lawɛ heyaa pɛl n te. Grepo da kpale aa won nɔnɛ dɛ o ta o tenten ta choŋe. Gɛ tentenee dɛ he ta he te kpɔe pɛl mɛ naa, haa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: Menee ɡrepo daa la, asɛ he ɡee o kpala. Dɛ he bɛlbwa choŋi n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ asɛ n ɡe lawɔ pɛl n te naa, anee ó won nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ he ta n nɛɛ cheɡɛ te naa, haa won ɛ wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Dɛ he bɛlbwa ta o te kpɔe pɛl mɛ naa, wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ daa kpale baa teŋo ta asɛ o hol la. Kpala aa do ken la, pae ba paa dɛɛ do nii ta, aa fuh.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he te pɛl mɛ asɛ n webaɡla ɡe do he liire bini naa, he dɛ soŋe komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin aa, hɛɛ dɔɔ.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Gɛ n Mɛɛ la aa dɛ nyin mɛ laanee n ɡee nyin heya. Anomanta, he bɛ he te laa kpɔ n nyina maa dɛ nyin heyaa la ta bwa.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: N baɡle heyaa waa nɔ ásɛ he dɔ n silɛɛ dɔŋ, ásɛ he sie lɛ ka tonɛ.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa laanee la. Hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin heyaa la.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Nyina bɛlbwa toole dɛ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ nɛn aa wona koh o daamanar waa dɛ sewɛ.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: He dɛ teŋɛ n waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta te naa, amɔ dɛ n daamanaree heya.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Maa heyaa n bonɔɔna yerɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛ bonɔɔ naa won jemɛ o nomoa waa bini. N daamanaree mɛɛ yerɛ heyaa name te, dɛkalkɛ n ɡelɔ he jemɛ wobɛlbwa maa noa dɛ le n Mɛɛ be.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: He laa lee mɛ, menee le heya. Gɛ kpaldɛɛɡe aa dɛ nɔnɛ la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ nyin kɛ he do, dɛɛ ɛ n Mɛɛ tetoowa, dɛ bɛ an ɡel bwa. Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, komɛlbwa haa soŋe n sɔn ta la, wɛɛ tɛ heyaa.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa laanee kɛŋɔ, hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa.” Haeh nɛra aa hah Yeesu habɔteŋra

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire ɡbo hah heya aa, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee ba tɔ sie hah.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Dɛ he fe ɛ ba bini bane aa, ba fe ɛɛ nyin heyaa. Kɛ maa le heyaa le ba bini he ɛ n nɛra la waa ba hah heyaa la.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ lii ɡɛ n fa aa bol he be ŋɔ, yom ta o dɔɔ ɡwaalɛ la. Dɛ ba ɛɛ mɛ hɔhɔrɔwa aa, ɡɛɛ baa ba he ɡe ɛɛ. Dɛ ba teŋɛ n webaɡla ta naa, baa teŋɛ he ɡe kwaa ta ɡɛɛ.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwaa baa ba n waa koeh dɛɛ ɛ heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa naate waa tom mɛ la jemɛ.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: N fe ta balɛ dɛ ba bol waa chaɡ ba aa, ba fe aa bolchɔɡee di. Kɛ taraken baa noa dɛ laa ba liire kpɔ a ta nomanta, ba ta nyoa dɔe dɛ́ bol le kpa.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Bɛlbwa waa hah mɛ la, dɛ o hah n Mɛɛ la ɡe.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Dɛ n fe ta waa nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa aa wola ɛɛ ka ɛ ba siwi ta te naa, ba fe aa bolchɔɡee di. Kɛ ba na n nyokpowe-ɛɛla bwa, dɛ ɡarɛ hah n ne n Mɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Anɔ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ waa baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ, ‘Ba hah mɛ pɛɛ.’

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tomɛ Habɔchekpaa laanee o le n Mɛɛ be dɛ́ ba he be. Onee Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa dɛ baɡle Korowii kasinteŋ waa la. Dɛ o balaa, onee dɛ́ ɛ n danseɛ.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: He ɡe ɛɛ bol n waa baɡle nɛra, dɛkalkɛ chɔɔ bwaa n ne he do le.”

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: “N baɡle heyaa waa nɔ bwa, ásɛ wobɛlbwa bɛ won ɡel he le habɔɔ.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwaa baa ba heyaa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa n ne n Mɛɛ jemɛ.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: N bol waa nɔ he be, ásɛ dɛ a baa ba ɡɛ naa, he won lii dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ n fa bol he be. N ta aa lɔ he be la waa maa wola he be bolɛ chɔɔ bwa la.” Toma Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa dɛ ɛ

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Taraken mɛɛ berɔ kaa Naate waa tom mɛ la be, kɛ he bini bɛlbwa ta men bɔɔrɛ bela maa dɛ ba kaala.

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔ chiɡo ásɛ nɛra jemɛ kɛ Yeesu waa waa bola dɛ baɡle seo la soo waa dɛ ba sewa la ɛ kpela.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Asɛ Paelet berɛ jo o koodem bela, dɛ yerɛ Yeesu ba o be, dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Henee Juu tena kooro ɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Belaa o chaŋo ŋɔ, “He ɡbaɡbaa na waa nɔ dɛɛ bɔɔ mɛ kɛɛ nɛra banee bol n waa he be nɔ?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Anee Paelet ŋɔ, “Haa na mɛ nɔ, Juu tee men aa? He ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ tena ne he Sɔfonomonomee ba he ne n be. Bɔkwa wechɔɡaa he ɛɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Harɛ ta bonɔ laa mɛɛ di kora. Dɛ harɛ ta bonɔɔ mɛɛ di kora aa, n nɛra fe aa sɛh bá kpɔ mɛ tɛ Juu tena, ba fe ɛɛ yoo lɛɛ mɛ. Kɛ harɛ ta bonɔ kora laa mɛɛ di.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Yeesu aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, anee Paelet bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Amɔ kooroo hen kpela kenɛ?” Asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Henee ŋɔa kooroo men. Kasinteŋ bola waa ba lol mɛ. A waa n ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ba bol kasinteŋ la nɛra bwa be. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kasinteŋ la, on dɛɛ no n be.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Anee Paelet ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa ɡee kasinteŋ nɔɔ?” Ba ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ bá kpo Yeesu (Mat

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: kɛ ɡɛ he Juu tena yon ɡel n foo wechɔɡ-ɛɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ ta he Galekaa Tɔpejen dii ta la, ń foo Juu tena kooro nɔ ta ɡɛ kɛɛ?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Belaa ba bwa nyɛɡ kohona ŋɔ, “Bɛ on foo! Foo Barabas!” Dɛ ɡɛ Barabas nɔ, ŋwɛɛree.

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Belaa Paelet ɡel o soojare ka lawɛ Yeesu, dɛ lɔɔro bampɔrɔ ŋwɛɛra ne.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Ba koh o baah muɡla waa dɛ kpɔ sɔɔhne sɔh kooɡbɛrɛ piu, dɛ kpɔ yaswɛm bɛl o do kɛŋɔ ba bela koranar wur ken dɛ doo.

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɛ ba o be dɛɛ si, “Woowo, Juu tena kooro!” dɛɛ kpaa o lwɛrɛme.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Baa ɛo ɡɛ la, Paelet le buse ja dɛ ba ŋɔ Juu tena la be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no bonɔ, mɛɛ le o ne busee tɛ heya, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛ n ta wobɛlbwa o nɛɛ nae dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ pao bolchɔɡe.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Anomanta, o ɡelɔ Yeesu le buse, dɛ sɔɔhne kooɡbɛrɛ piu, asɛ o do wurswɛm la. Asɛ Paelet ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Onee la.”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Sɔfonomonome ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea la aa nao la, ba kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Gel ba kpoo! Gel ba kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta!” Anee Paelet chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Hé ɡbaɡba ba kpɔɔ ka kpaa pɛl daɡaɡre ta. N te ta wobɛlbwa o nɛɛ nae dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ ɡel ba kpoo.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Belaa Juu tena la berɛ chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ya dɔ Mmara bɛl waa dɛ baɡle kɛ o chɛ kpoe, dɛkalkɛ o dɛ yerɛ o te Korowii Bie.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Paelet aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, a taa o berɛ ɔmɛ kohona kwara.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Anomanta, o berɔ jo koodem bela, asɛ dɛ ka bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Lepetenee he leɔ?” Kɛ o ta on chaŋɛ.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Anee o berɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Haa men chaŋe kɛɛ? Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ n dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won ɡel ba foori ta, dɛ́ berɛ won ɡel ba kpaare pɛl daɡaɡre ta kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Korowiirii sɛah dɛ ɡel he dɔ kpeɡri n nɛ. O fe ta sɛɛh yaa, he fe ta kpeɡri dɔe n nɛ. Nɛn waa lee mɛ tɛ dɛ ɡel he dɔɔ mɛ la wechɔɡa ɡwaa he kwa.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Paelet aa no ɡɛ la, dɛ o dɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ bɛl dɛ́ fee kpɔ Yeesu ta ó kaa. Ate, nɛnlaa la kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yerɛ o te kooro la ɛ Rom Koojen Siisa dɔm! Anomanta, dɛ he kpɔ baa nɔ ta aa, amɔ dɛ Rom Koojen la dɔmee hen!”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Paelet aa no ɡɛ la, o kpɔ Yeesu le buse dɛ ba so bela waa soɡa dɛɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la. Bwea nee ba mao o ir nyundua. Juu tena wobol ta, baa dɛ yerɛ bela ‘Gabata’.

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Ate, Paelet kpɔ Yeesu tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ka kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta. Asɛ soojare la kpɔɔ kaa. Ba kpaa Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta (Mat

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Baa soŋe ŋwɛnɛ la, soojare la kaa kuuɡi nɛra la baa kpaa ba ne Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta la nakpale.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Anomanta, Juu tena Sɔfonomonome la ŋɔ Paelet be ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa chwera ŋɔ, ‘Juu tena kooroo on’ nɔ aa were. Chwerɛ ŋɔ ‘Onee ŋɔa Juu tena kooroo on.’ ”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Yeesu aa na o nya ne o habɔteŋre waa dɛ nyinu kohona la kɛŋɔ baa cheɡɛ dɔŋa jwɛh, asɛ o ŋɔ o nya be ŋɔ, “N nya, he biee la,”

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Baa tel bela la, ba kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre la ta. Ba kpaa nɛra banɛ ja o nɛ, bɛl do o diɡ ta, asɛ bɛl ɡe do o ɡal ta, asɛ o do ba bwa baah ta.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Belaa Paelet ɡel ba chwerɛ waane ka pɛl Yeesu daɡaɡre la nyundua. Waa baa chwera laanee kɛ, juu tena kooro yeesu waa le nasarɛt laanee la.

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Dɛ bela ne bwɛjen Jerusalam aa jaŋɛ, anomanta, Juu tena kɛrɛdɛ bwa na ɡɛ waa la dɛ kura. Ba chwera Juu tena wobol ne Rom tena wobol ne Grik tena wobol ta.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Anee Paelet chaŋe ŋɔ, “N te dɔɔ chwerɛ tonɛ.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Anomanta, soojare la ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel ya kɛɛro. Hé ɡel ya ta chacha, naate waa di la ó kpɔ.” Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Baa kpɔ n laalaa bɔne dɔŋa, dɛ́ ta chacha dɛ́ na naate waa di n batakaare.” Gɛ baa chwera laanee soojare la ɛ, dɛ ɡel a ɛ kpela.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Dɛ Yeesu nya ne Yeesu nyajen ne Klopas haah Mɛɛre ne Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la cheɡɛ Yeesu daɡaɡre la jwɛɛh bela.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Baa tel Yeesu be la, ba nao kɛŋɔ o te dɔɔ sewɛ, anomanta, ba ta o te nakpale kuuɡe.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Bela baa kpo Yeesu la, dɛ bodɛɛɡe bɛl baa du daa lɔ bela, asɛ ba forɛ lalbɔɔ bwe bɛl ta kɛŋɔ dea ken. Dɛ ba ta nomɛlbwa o bini huɡe bwa.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: A habɔɔ Yeesu aa naa kɛŋɔ o wobɛlbwa tonɔ la, o ŋɔ, “Nyɔɡre dɛ kpo mɛ,” ásɛ waa aa lɔ Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛ kpela.

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Dɛ vii bɛl ne sennyɛɡa cheɡɛ bela, asɛ ba kpɔ konjɔɡɔjɔɡɔ bɛl waa won nee lɛɛ vɔwɛ daa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ hesɔp dajaŋ ta, dɛ kpɔ li sennyɛɡa la dɛ kpɔ su o nyoa ó nyɔ.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Yeesu aa nyɔa tonɛ la, o ŋɔ, “A tonɔ,” asɛ dɛ ɡure o nyu dɛ ɡel o doma le, o sewɛ.

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Dɛ awola tɔpere la ɛ tɔpere Juu tena aa dɛ kpɔ ba te, dɛkalkɛ tɔɔ peraa dɛ ba jo Ona Tɔpere waa ɛ ba tɔpejen tenten la ta. Dɛ baa nyin kɛŋɔ Yeesu ne nɛra la saɡɛ ka tel tɔpejen la ta. Anomanta, ba kaa soŋe Paelet ŋɔ ó ɡel soojare kuuɡi ba nakpale bá sewɛ warane, ásɛ ba dɔ bɔr laa ba kpɔ daɡaɡre la ta.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Kɛ soojare la bɛl kpɔ lampea dɛ yaɡɛ Yeesu loŋi ta. Buɡ la ta, chal ne nee le.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Naate waa di waa nɔ danseɛ la naa siwi ne, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kasinteŋii, dɛɛ bola ásɛ he ɡe no dɛ́ yarada.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Anɔ ɡelɔ waa baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Baa o hoɡ beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ku” la ɛ kpela.

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn la bobɛl ɡe ŋɔ, “Baa nyiŋi nɛn baa yaɡɔ lampea ne laanee.” Yeesu huɡa wa (Mat

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Dɛ lalbɔɔ la bɛne bela, asɛ ba Ona Tɔpere ɡe telo tonɛ, anomanta, ba denɔ kpɔ Yeesu ka huɡe o bini.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, baa bɛl waa le Arimatea baa yerɔ Josef la Paelet be dɛ ka soŋo Yeesu lale. Dɛ a ɡɛ Josef nɔ dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ, kɛ o koh Juu tena ɔma waa dɛɛ sɔh o te a ɡɛ bɔr. Paelet tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ ó ka kpɔ lale la kaa, asɛ o ka kpɔɔ kaa.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Ba nɛra banɛ la kpɔ Yeesu lale la, dɛ kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma la fɔɡlo, dɛ kpɔ yapoŋ vɔrɔwo, ɡɛ Juu tena aa dɛ ɛ ba lala dɛɛ huɡ ba la.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Asɛ Tɔmas ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, n Korowii!”

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Tomun aa dɛ kpɔ Kwasiara waa ɛ tɔpeloɡle la, Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la la bela baa huɡe Yeesu la, dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ bwe baa kpɔa tɔ bɔɔ la nyoa la le o nyoa.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu habɔteŋre waa tɔ sie tel bela la ɡe berɛ jo lalbɔɔ la bini, dɛ na a bwa. Waa naa la, o den yarada.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Dɛ Tɔmas baa dɛ yerɔ Kpar o ɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la bini bɛl la toole o bala la be ɡɛ saŋ Yeesu aa ba bela la.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ na nyundua toroma banɛ. Ba do kompoŋa so bela baa kpɔ Yeesu lale bil la. Bɛl soɡe o nyu bɔr, asɛ bɛl so o nakpale bɔr.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Waa na ɡɛ la, o chwao la Seemɔn Pita ne o dɔŋ Yeesu aa dɛ nyinu kohona la be dɛ ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ba laa ya Dɔɔ kpɔ lalbɔɔ la bini, yaa jemɛ bela baa kpɔɔ bil.”

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Pita ne o dɔŋ habɔteŋre la iro dɛ la bela baa huɡe Yeesu la.

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: Dɛ chwae baa chwa, asɛ Pita dɔŋ la chwa warane dɛ felu tel bɔɔ la ta.

english_verse: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.
translation_verse: O boŋɔ haah dɛ na yapoŋ la chɔe, kɛ o ta lalbɔɔ la bini tenten joɛ.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Belaa Pita waa ka mun la ba dɛ ba jo bɔɔ la bini, dɛ na yapoŋ la bela,
