english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: dɛ na yapoŋ baa kpɔa vɔwɛ o nyu la kɛŋɔ waa ɡula chɔ pera.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene stood crying outside the tomb. She was still weeping, when she stooped down
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ Mɛɛre te ta cheɡɛ bɔɔ la nyoa dɛɛ wi. Waa dɛ wi la, o boŋɔ dɛ haah lalbɔɔ la bini,

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Belaa nyundua toroma la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N nya, bɔkwa waa hɛɛ wi ken nɔ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Ba kpɔ n Dɔɔ kaa. Maa jemɛ bela baa kpɔɔ ka bil.”

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “N nya, bɔkwa waa bala hɛɛ wi ken nɔ? Ume bɔree hɛɛ nyin ɔ?” Dɛ Mɛɛre dɛ lii kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi bodɛɛɡe baa du daa bela laanee, anomanta, o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, dɛ henee baa kpɔ n Dɔɔ kaa laa, hé ɡel n jemɛ bela haa kpɔɔ ka bil, ásɛ dɛ la ka kpɔɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kpɔ mɛ ta, n ta n Mɛɛ be laŋɛ mɔɔ. Kaa ka ŋɔ n nimanar be ŋɔ, ‘N berɔ dɛɛ kaa nyundua n ne he bwa Mɛɛ waa ɛ ya bwa Korowii la be.’ ”

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: Waa bol ɡɛ la, o kpɔ o nɔɔra ne o loŋi baɡ ba, asɛ ba sie lɛ kohona kɛŋɔ baa na ba Dɔɔ la.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Awola Kwasiara la jwaana la, Yeesu habɔteŋra la cheme dea bɛl bini. Dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ Juu tena, anomanta, ba tɔɔɡe ɡbeni la dɛ laa karɛ ba nɛ. Belaa ba ŋɔ ba nyiŋi, dɛ Yeesu baa che ba baah dɛ ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.”

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ bol ja ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ heyaa bambisɔɔhna. Gɛ n Mɛɛ aa tom mɛ la, ɡɛɛ n ɡe ɛɛ tomɛ heya.”

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o hweero ta ba nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé lɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la.

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Dɛ he ŋɔ Korowii kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa kɛ ba aa, wɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛ ba, kɛ dɛ he ŋɔ Korowii bɛ nɛra wechɔɡa kpɔ kɛ ba aa, aa do ba nɛɛ.” Yeesu ne Tɔmas

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ ba dɛ bol o be ŋɔ, “Ya na ya Dɔɔ la.” Asɛ o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ n te ta dadowɛre la buɡe aa lɔ o nɔɔra ta la nae, dɛ kpɔ n nonii do bela, dɛ berɛ kpɔ n nɔn do o loŋi bela baa kpɔ lampea yaɡɛ la aa, maa waa nɔɔ yarada.”

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: A yawanyoa la, Yeesu habɔteŋra la berɔ ba cheme dea la bini ja, dɛ Tɔmas ja ba nɛ. Ba kaɡre dea la ɡbeni, kɛ Yeesu baa jo che ba baah, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ heyaa bambisɔɔhna!”

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Tɔmas be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he nonii ba do n nɔɔra bɔɔne la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ he nɔn do n loŋi bɔɔ la ɡe ta, dɛɛ yarada mɛ, dɛ́ ɡel aahna aahna la haa dɛ ɛ la.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Haa na mɛ nɔ waa he yarada mɛ nɔ kɛɛ? Nɛra baa wola men nae dɛ yarada mɛ la, ba na som.”

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Nyokpowaa Yeesu aa ɛa o habɔteŋra la siwi ta warɔ taeh. A bwa laa n chwerɛ do tɔn nɔ bini.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Kɛ n chwerɛ anɔ ásɛ he che a ta dɛ́ yarada kɛŋɔ Yeesuu Kristo Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ bao la, onee Korowii Bie la, ásɛ a che he yarada haa dɛ yaradao la ta he dɔ Korowii mkpa.

english_verse: Jesus later appeared to his disciples along the shore of Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Yeesu kpɔ o te ba baɡle o habɔteŋra la Tibeerias Moo la ta ja. Kenii a ɛ ba nao.

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Dɛ o habɔteŋra Seemɔn Pita ne Tɔmas baa dɛ yerɔ Kpar la, ne Nataaneɛl waa le Keena waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta, ne Sebedii bii, dɛ ba bini banɛ pɛo so.

english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Asɛ Seemɔn Pita ŋɔ o bala la be ŋɔ, “N dɛ la ń ka ta asau.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Amɔ te ya ne hɛɛ lao.” Asɛ ba bwa ka jo ɡbera bini dɛ ka ɛ toma tɔɔ ba per, dɛ ba ta komɛlbwa dɔe.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, dɛ Yeesu cheɡɛ nee nyoa bela, kɛ o habɔteŋra la aa nao la, ba ta jemɛ kɛ onee.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Friends, have you caught anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: Belaa o yer ba ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛla, he ta pɛŋa dɔe yaa?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, ya ta komɛlbwa dɔe.”

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé ta asau la ta ɡbera la diɡ bɔr, hɛɛ dɔ anee.” Belaa ba ta do bela, asɛ asau la lawɛ pɛŋa kohona, ba ta wone tɛro do ɡbera la bini.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Anee Yeesu habɔteŋre waa dɛ nyinu kohona la ŋɔ Pita be ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔree.” Dɛ Seemɔn Pita foo o batakaare bil. Waa noa kɛŋɔ ba Dɔɔree la, o berɛ kpɔ do, dɛ le nee la ta.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Baa baa chuɡe la, ba na hɔla nii asɛ pɛŋe dawɛ a doa, asɛ paanoo chɔ bela.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ pɛŋa haa lawa la ane ba.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé ba chɔɔ nyoa.” O habɔteŋra la bɛlbwa ta wone lɔ bambile dɛ pɛɛro o nɛnsoo, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ ba Dɔɔree.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Asɛ Yeesu ka kpɔ paanoo la tɛɛ ba, dɛ kpɔ pɛŋe la tɛɛ ba ɡɛ tenten.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Korowii aa iru seo ta la, anɔɔ jaa tooro waa kpɔ o te baɡle o habɔteŋra la. Yeesu ne Pita

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Belaa baa di kwaa tonɛ la, o bɔɔ Seemɔn Pita ŋɔ, “Jɔn bie Seemɔn, he dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ ɡwaa banɔ nɔ naa?” Anee Pita ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n Dɔɔ, he jemɔ kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin he wa.” Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ nyiŋi n pebiiri nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: O berɔ pɛɛro nɛɛtena ŋɔ, “Jɔn bie Seemɔn, he dɛ nyin mɛ naa?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n Dɔɔ, he jemɔ kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin he wa.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ nyiŋi n peera nɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Yeesu berɔ kwaa pɛɛro toorotena ŋɔ, “Jɔn bie Seemɔn, he dɛ nyin n waa aa?” Waa nɔ ɡelɔ Seemɔn Pita bambile chɔɡ kohona kɛ waa bera bɔɔro toorotena ŋɔ, “He dɛ nyin n waa” la. Asɛ o ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, he jemɛ wobɛlbwa, he ɡbabir jemɔ kɛ n dɛ nyin he wa.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ dɛɛ n peera.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, he fa aa ɛ bonɔɔ la, he won kiriso vɔwa dɛ́ kaa bela bwa haa dɛ nyin. Kɛ dɛ he baa hwɛɛhraa, hɛɛ tɛr nɔɔraa ásɛ nomɛl vɔrɔwe dɛ́ kaa he ne bela haa wola nyin laŋa.”

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: O bol anɔ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle seo la soo Pita aa dɛ ba sewa, á che a ta Korowii dɔ jirima. Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o ŋɔ Pita be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛ.” Yeesu ne o habɔteŋne waa dɛ nyinu kohona

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Baa dɛ kaa la, Pita keo nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ o dɔŋ habɔteŋre Yeesu aa dɛ nyinu kohona la teŋɛ ba nɛ. Onee fa soɡa kpaɡɛ Yeesu ɡɛ saŋ o ne o habɔteŋra la aa chema tiɡ ta, asɛ dɛ bɔɔro naate waa dɛ ba o lee tɛ la.

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Pita aa nao la, o bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, aah baa nɔ ɡe sɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Belaa o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Dɛ n dɛ nyin kɛ o so le dɛ ka tel saŋ maa ba kwaraa naa, he waanee yaa? He te ɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛ!”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ la, dɛ o habɔteŋra la dɛ bol bobɛlbwa ŋɔ, amɔ ba dɔŋ habɔteŋre la aa sewɛ bwa. Kɛ ɡɛ laa Yeesu ŋɔ. Waa waa bolaa kɛŋɔ, dɛ o dɛ nyin o habɔteŋre la so ka tel ɡɛ saŋ waa ba naa, Pita waane laa.

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ habɔteŋre nɔɔ baɡle ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ chwerɛ a bwa bil. Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ a ɛ kpela.

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Waa Yeesu aa ɛa warɔ taeh. A bwa laa ba chwerɛ do tɔne ta. Dɛ ba fe wono chwerɛ a bwa do tɔne ta naa, a ɡɛ tɔne la fe aa bɔr dɔe ba dɛ́ jo harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: Theophilus, I first wrote to you about all that Jesus did and taught from the very first
translation_verse: Nomoa Teɔfelɔs, n tɔn la maa tɔ sie chwerɛ la, n le Yeesu toma la mumpar dɛ baɡle o we-ɛɛla ne o webaɡla waa bwa

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: ka tel awola Korowii aa kpɔɔ kaa nyundua la. O cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ta dɛ baɡle baala la waa kpɔ ba ŋɔ bá ɛ o toroma la waa baa dɛ ba ɛɛ la, asɛ Korowii kpɔɔ kaa nyundua.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Ba ne waa bera ba cheme ja la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ Jerusalam le mɔɔ. Hé so kpa koŋkɛɛle la maa ŋɔa n Mɛɛ baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tɛ heyaa la.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Nee nee Jɔn sɔ nɛra Korowii ne, kɛ aa tɔpere bɛlee di ásɛ Korowii kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe la sɔ heya. Anomanta, hé so kpao.”

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Ba ne waa baa cheme la, ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ, taraken te hɛɛ ɡeloo ya Israel tena berɛ di ya kora la ɡba ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ nɔn taa wobɛlbwa ne a tɔpere bwa do. He ta kpeɡri dɔe kɛŋɔ he jemɛ tɔpere la waane aa dɛ ba chiɡa.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la baa so he nɛ aa, wɛɛ tɛ heyaa kpeɡrii ásɛ he di danseɛ tɛ mɛ Jerusalam fɔɡbaah, ne Juda harɛ kabora bwa ta, ne Samaria harɛ ta, ne harɛ jaɡa bwa.”

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Waa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ ba ta che dɛɛ nyiŋu la, dɛ Korowii baa kpɔɔ dɛɛ kaa nyundua, asɛ baama ba tɔ o nɛɛ nyundua bela, ba ta on nae kpa.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Waa dɛ kaa, dɛ ba sie ta pa nyundua haah ken. Buɡ la ta, baala banɛ bane baa do laalapoŋa baa che ba jwɛh,

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Galilia tena, ɛrɛɛ he che bonɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi nyundua haah ɡɛ nɔɔ? Yeesu nɔ Korowii aa baa kpɔɔ le he be kaa nɔ, wɛɛ berɔɔ ba ɡɛ tenten haa nao wɛɛ kaa nyundua nɔ.” Ba le Matayas o chiɡ Judas naa ta

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɔ dea abrɔsane bɛl doa Jerusalam. Ba la Jerusalam dɛ ka jo o bini. Ba nɛra baa jo dea la bini laanee, Pita ne Jɔn, ne Jems ne Andriu, ne Felep ne Tɔmas, ne Batolomeo ne Matiu, ne Alfeɔs bie Jems, ne Seemɔn Sɛlɔt, dɛ Jems bie Judas.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba ne haahna la ne Yeesu nya Mɛɛre ne Yeesu nimanar la pɛo cheme dɛ yon dɛɛ soŋe Korowii warawara.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: Waa yoɡ Yeesu la, o kpɔ o tonchɔɡa la suuɡa dɛ ka yawɛ harɛ bɛl. A ɡɛ harɛ nɔ taa o chole, o tea pere, o looni le, asɛ o sewɛ.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena bwa no o seo la wa. Anomanta, ba pa a ɡɛ harɛ la sɔn ba wobol ta Akɛldama. O munii Chal Harɛ.

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: Pita ŋɔ, “Ba chwerɛ Korowii Kpɛɛra Tɔn la bini ŋɔ, ‘Gel o sobɔr chɔ pɛɛ, nomɛlbwa bɛ o ta do.’ Dɛ berɛ chwerɛ ŋɔ, ‘Berɛ o toma tɛ nomɛl.’

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: dɛ kpoŋe le ɡɛ saŋ la Jɔn fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la dɛ ba le saŋ la Korowii aa baa kpɔ ya Dɔɔ le ya be kaa nyundua la, a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bɛlee dɛ won ja ya nɛɛ dɛ́ di o seo ta ira la danseɛ.”

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ, hen jemɛ nomɛlbwa nyu bini. Anomanta, baɡle yaa nɛra banɛ nɔ bini onɔ la haa dɛ nyin

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: kɛŋɔ o chiɡ Judas naa ta dɛɛ ɛ he toma Judas aa vɛah dɛ kaa bela aa chɛ kɛ o do la.”

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Baa ta bie la, Matayasee dia, asɛ ba kpɔɔ ja Yeesu toroma fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la nɛ.

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Ba tɔpejen baa dɛ yerɔ Pɛntekɔs la telo, asɛ ba bwa cheme bobeŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ komɛl dɛ ɡbɔɡre nyundua dɛɛ si kɛŋɔ peujen bɛl aa dɛ ta ken. Asɛ a ɡɛ ɡbɔɡa la tɔ dem la baa lɔ o ta la bwa.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Ate, dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe baa so ba bwa nɛɛ kpeɡri ne dɛ ir ba nɛ, asɛ baa bol wobofala. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee ɡela ba won dɛɛ bol a ɡɛ wobofala la.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ ɡɛ Juu tena aa dɛ tomɔ la le harɛ ta bobɛlbwa dɛ ba su Jerusalam bwa.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Baa no ɡbɔɡa la la, ba bwa baa cheme bela, asɛ a ɛɛ ba anebɛlbwa kɛŋɔ nɛra la aa dɛ bol waa ba bɛlbwa bwɛɛ wobol ta la.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Belaa ba nyoa aa kpoa kohona la, baa bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Galilia tena laa nɛra nɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Aah ɛrɛɛ ba ɛ dɛ won dɛɛ bol ya bɛlbwa wobol nɔɔ?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Ya bwa harɛre kokoɡrɔ. Ya bane le Paatea, bane le Midia ne Elam, bane ɡe le Mɛsopoteemea ne Juda, ne Kapadoosia. Ya bane ɡe le Pɔntos ne Eesia,

english_verse: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, parts of Libya near Cyrene, Rome,
translation_verse: bane le Frejea ne Pamfilia, bane le Ijipt ne Lebya harɛ, Sairini jwɛɛh bela. Ya bane le Rom.

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Ba lolɛ ya bane Juu tena harɛ, bane ɡe ɛ hɔɔhra, kɛ ya bwa ɡe dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ Juu tena aa dɛ tomɔ la. Ya bane ɡe le Kret ne Arab harɛre ta. Kɛ ya bwa dɛ no kɛŋɔ baa dɛ bol waa ya ɡbaɡba wobol ta dɛɛ baɡle wejena Korowii aa ɛa!”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba nyoa kpo kohona, baa bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Aah bɔkwa soo waa nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Asɛ bane ɡe ɛɛ mamɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la ŋɔ senee ba nyɔ. Pita bol waa baɡle nɛra

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Belaa Pita ne o bala Yeesu toroma fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la ir che, asɛ Pita ɛɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne dɛ ŋɔ, “Yabala Juu tena ne he nɛra haa cheme Jerusalam bwa, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa nɔ aa dɛ ɛ nɔ mun.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Gɛ haa dɛ lii ŋɔ senee nɛra nɔ nyɔ nɔ, sen laa ba nyɔ. Chɔɔ laa ta naa?

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Waa Korowii keame Joel fa aa bola laanee hɛɛ na chɔɔ nɔ ne la. O bolɔ ŋɔ,

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: ‘Korowii ŋɔ, Harɛ chɔɡa tɔpera aa ka mun ta la, mɛɛ tɛ nɛra bwa soo siwi n Domadɛɛɡe la kohonaa, ásɛ he bibaala ne bihaahna bwa bol n waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa kerekere la, ásɛ he bonɔɔna na chaahna, ásɛ he banjeni dee deera.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ la, mɛɛ ɡeloo n Doma ba so n bonɔɔna ne toli bwa nɛ, ásɛ ba bol n waa la.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa nyundua ne harɛ taa, ásɛ nɛra na chal ne nii ne ninchuu kohona.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Wee dɛ ba bira, ásɛ korobie swɛɛ kɛŋɔ chal ken mɔɔ Korowii jirima Tɔpejen la ba.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, nomɛlbwa waa yerɛ men Korowii sɔn la, mɛɛ lɛo.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: N bala Israel tena, hé no waa nɔ. Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la fa ɛ nɛn bɛl Korowii aa ɡela o won dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowa, asɛ he na dɛ won jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii kpeɡri nee wɛɛ ɛ o toma kpela. A ɡɛ waa nɔ ta heyaa wehɔɔhra ɛɛ.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Korowii jemɛ Yeesu waa bwa wubwa dɛ cheɡa ken mɔɔ a tel nɔ. O ɛa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ do he nɔn ta, ásɛ he ɡel wechɔɡ-ɛɛra kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta dɛ́ kpoo.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii lɛo seo nɔn ta dɛ iru seo ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ seo ta kpeɡri dɔe o nɛɛ dɛ́ lawɔ o bɛ won ir.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: O waa Devid bol ŋɔ, ‘N ne Korowii lole saŋ bɛlbwa. Maa ɔmɛ bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o cheɡɛ n habɔɔ.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n sie lɛo, n wobol ɡe bwa ɛ bansɔɔhna wobol. Maa n bwadabii waa jare, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n sie dawɛ Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, haa he Biɡoroŋ waa soeh ba lalabwɛ. Haa ɡel o chɔ bɔɔ bini pɔh.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: He baɡ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa kpɔ dɛ́ dɔ mkpa saŋ bɛlbwa maa na he siwi la, n bwara ɛɛ sɔɔh mɛɛ.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: Yabala, mɛɛ wonoo bol n naa Devid wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya bwa jemɛ o waa kɛrɛdɛ. O sewɔ, ba huɡo, hale o ŋwam ta lole fini nɔ.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Kɛ o ɛ Korowii keame, dɛ berɛ jemɛ nyoa Korowii aa ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo Devid naa bɛl ba di o kara la.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: Devid na chaahna dɛ won jemɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ ba ɛɛ kerekere. Anomanta, Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ásɛ o ba lɛ yaa la seo ta ira waa o faa bol ŋɔ Korowii ta o waa soɛh lalabwɛ, o ta bɔɔ bini chɔe pɔh la.

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Yeesu nɔɔ Korowii ir seo ta la. Ya bwa kpɔ ya sie nao dɛɛ diu danseɛ.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: O Mɛɛ Korowii aa kpɔɔ kaa nyundua dɛ ɡel o so nomombɔr o diɡ ta la, o tɛo o Domadɛɛɡe la ɡɛ o fa aa baɡɛ nyoa la, asɛ Yeesu ɡe berɛ kpɔ tɛ yaa. O tomaa hɛɛ na dɛɛ no la.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: He jemɔ kɛŋɔ Devid ɡbaɡba laa ira kaa nyundua, kɛ waa waa bola laanee nɔ. O ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii ŋɔ n Dɔɔ be ŋɔ ó so nomombɔr o diɡ ta bela

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: ásɛ o ba o dɔma ne harɛ dɛ́ tiɡri ba nɛ.’

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Anomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ Israel tena bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesu laanee Korowii ɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa dɔɔ la. Onee Kristo la. Kɛ o laa he kpaa pɛl daɡaɡre ta dɛ kpoo la aa?”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Nɛra la aa no a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba nao kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa, asɛ ba tea bini chɔɡ, ba bɔɔ Pita wa ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ yɔ, yabala?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Anee Pita ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé bini bɛlbwa charɛ o liire dɛ́ le wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba sɔɔ Korowii nee ásɛ o teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛ, ásɛ Korowii kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, Korowii ɛɛ tɛ heyaa o Domadɛɛɡe laanee,

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ne he naanar ne bojaŋ tena Korowii aa dɛ yer ba ŋɔ bá ba o be la bwa waa o baɡɛ nyoa la la.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: O bol waa kohona dɛ ja ba, dɛ ɡbɛɡbɛ ba ŋɔ, “Fini nɛra wechɔɡa kan ɡa. Hé takapɔ dɛ́ laa he te le nɛnchɔɡa la Korowii aa dɛ ba ba wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ bɔ ba kem la bini.”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛra la balɔ dɛ baa hweli Korowii waa Yeesu toroma la be warawara. Dɛ ba ne Yeesu toroma laanee pɛa dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa, dɛɛ di kwaa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ Yeesu toroma la nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ tomkpeɡa, asɛ nɛra bwa nyoa kpo baa ɔmɛ.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra baa yarada Yeesu waa dɛ ɛ asɔre tena la bwa pɛo dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa, dɛɛ bɔne komɛlbwa baa dɔa.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɛ yoɡ ba koŋkwaare ne harɛre dɛ kpɔ a suuɡa la dɛɛ bɔne dɔŋa ɡɛ bɛlbwa aa hiah, ásɛ bɛlbwa won yawɛ o konnyina.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Tɔpebii te bɛlbwaa baa cheme Korowii Dea, dɛ pɛ dɛɛ di kwaa ba deremi silɛɛ ne tepoŋ ne.

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɛ jam Korowii, dɛ nɛra dɛ kpɛɛ ba taeh. Asɛ Korowii lɛ nɛnfala tɔpebii te bɛlbwa ba baa ja o nɛra la nɛ.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, Pita ne Jɔn la Korowii Dea wekee saŋ. A ɡɛ saŋ nɔɔ nɛra la bwa cheme dɛɛ soŋe Korowii webaŋa.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Baa kaa tel dea la doonyoa la baa dɛ yerɔ Doonyodɛɛɡe la ta la, dɛ baa bɛl soɡe bela. Dɛ a ɡɛ baa la soɡe boobi o bechale saŋ bwa. Asɛ tɔpere bwa ba yon cheo ka so a ɡɛ doonyoa bela o kaa soŋe suuɡa nɛra baa dɛ jo Korowii Dea bela la be.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Pita ne Jɔn aa dɛ ba dea bela joe la, o soŋ ba ŋɔ bá tɛo komɛl.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Belaa ba pa sie o be, asɛ Pita ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi yaa!”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Anee o nyiŋ ba dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ baa tɛo komɛlee.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Belaa Pita ŋɔ, “N ta suuɡa dɔe dɛ tɛɛ, kɛ mɛɛ tɛɛ kon n ɡe aa dɔa laanee. Yeesu Kristo waa le Nasarɛt la sɔn ta, ir dɛ́ valɛ!”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Asɛ Pita lawɛ boobi la nɔndiɡ dɛ ɡɔɔro ir. Buɡ la ta, dɛ baa la nakpale ne o nalurumi denɔ do kpeɡri,

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: o chuɡri ir che o naa anɛ la ta dɛɛ valɛ, asɛ o ne ba jo Korowii Dea bela. O kpɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ valɛ dɛɛ sa, dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ bela la bwa nao kɛŋɔ waa dɛ valɛ dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: Baa naa kɛŋɔ boobi la o fa aa dɛ soŋe kwaa Doonyodɛɛɡe la ta laanee dɛɛ valɛ la, ba nyoa kpoo ba chara jeɡre kɛŋɔ waa bera won ir che dɛɛ valɛ la. Pita bol waa baɡle nɛra Korowii Dea

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Baa la toɔh pɛl Pita ne Jɔn, asɛ ba ne o ka tel Korowii Dea la bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Solomɔn Pato la, asɛ nɛra la aa nao la, ba nyoa kpoo, asɛ ba bwa chwa biribiri ken dɛ ba Pita ne Jɔn ne baa la be bela.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Pita aa na nɛra la, o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Yabala Israel tena, ɛrɛɛ waa nɔ kpo he nyoa hɛɛ nyiŋi yaa ɡɛ nɔɔ? He dɛ lii ŋɔ ya ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ta kɛɛ ya nɛndɛɛɡa ɛɛ kohona waa baa nɔ won ir che dɛɛ valɛ nɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Gɛ laa. Korowii ya nabaala Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɔ la, on tɛ o bonɔɔ Yeesu sɔn ɡɛ la. Onee he kpɔ tɛ nomonome ŋɔ bá bol o waa dɛ kpoo la. Harɛ nomoa Paelet aa ŋɔa ó tao la, he ta ŋɔe ŋɔ haa sɛah?

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ, wedɛɛɡa ɡboo o ɛ. Kɛ he ŋɔ haa on nyin, dɛ ŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ kpo nɛra laanee hɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ Paelet foo ta dɛ́ ɡelo.

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛn nɛwɛnyini aa che o nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ mkpa la, onee he kpo la, asɛ Korowii lawɔ ir seo ta. Ya na a ɡɛ waa nɔ. A danseɛ yaa di la.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: O sɔnee ya yerɛ asɛ baa nɔ ɡbaŋre la. Yarada yaa dɛ yarada Yeesu la, a taa a che waa nɔ haa naa nɔ won ɛ la. O waa la yaa dɛ yarada la, a ɡbosoroo chah baa nɔ he bwa aa jemɔ nɔ la. He bwa ɡee naa kɛŋɔ o ɡbaŋrɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: Yabala, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ bɛ jemaa ɡela he ne he nomonome ɛ Yeesu waa haa ɛo la.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ berɔɔ tomɛ Yeesu waa ɛ Kristo la he be. Onee o le ŋɔ ó ba lɛ heyaa la.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesu do nyundua dɛ́ ka tel tɔɔ la wee Korowii aa ɛ wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ ken, ɡɛ waa ɡela o keamere la baɡle la.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Mosis baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii ɛɛ tomɛ o keamee ó ba bol o waa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa ɡɛ waa tom mɛ la. He ɡbaɡba dwee binii wɛɛ ba o lee. A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no o wobol, dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ baɡle.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa wola o wobol noɛ la, baa pero le Korowii nɛra binii dɛ́ kpoo!’

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: Korowii keamere baa dɛ baɡle Korowii waa la, le Samoɛl bere saŋ ne banɔ la baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ bwa, ba bwaa baɡle waa aa dɛ ɛ fini nɔ wa.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Korowii nyoa la waa baɡa dɛ ɡel o keamere bol la, heyaa o baɡɛ tɛ. Fɔo la Korowii ne he naawa aa fɔwa la laworomɛɛ hɛɛ di la. O ŋɔ Abraham be ŋɔ, ‘He naanar nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa n swee andɛɛɡa tɛ harɛ ta nɛra bwa.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: A waa Korowii le o Bonɔɔ la dɛ tɔ sie tomɔ he be, ásɛ o ba swee heyaa andɛɛɡa dɛ́ ɡel bɛlbwa charɛ o liire dɛ́ le o wechɔɡa ta la.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Pita ne Jɔn aa cheɡa dɛɛ bol waa nɛra la be la, sɔfore bane ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea la nomoa ne Saduki tena bane balɔ. Dɛ Saduki tena la aa yarada kɛŋɔ nɛra bwa ɛɛ ir seo taa tɔpebɛl.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Ba baah diu kɛŋɔ Pita ne Jɔn aa dɛ bol nɛra la be ŋɔ Yeesu ir seo ta la. A ɡɛ la baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ serewa ɛɛ ba ir seo taa.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba lawɛ Pita ne Jɔn ka do dea ásɛ bɔr chaah mɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ baa laɡ ba la, dɛ jɔmɔraa.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛɛ no waa la dɛ yaradaa warɔ. Dɛ baala baa yarada waa la lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa banue.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, Juu tena nomonome, ne bwɛɛ nomonome, ne Tɔnjerema bwa cheme Jerusalam.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Ba ne Sɔfonomoa Anas ne Kaefas, ne Jɔn, ne Alɛksanda ne Sɔfonomoa dea nɛra la bwaa chema.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba kpɔ Pita ne Jɔn ba che nɛra la baah ta, dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Kpeɡri besoo he dɔ dɛ ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ? Ume sɔn taa he che ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ir Pita nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ, asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛla sitɔɔla ne nomonome,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: dɛ bɔɔraa hɛɛ bɔɔ yaa dɛ́ jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta aa cheɡa ya won ɛ boobi nɔ wedɛɛɡe nɔ dɛ won chaoh weela aa,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: amɔ te hé no, ásɛ Israel tena bwa no, kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo waa le Nasarɛt, haa kpoo daɡaɡre ta asɛ Korowii iru seo ta la, o sɔn kpeɡri taa a che baa nɔ waa cheɡa nɔ dɔ bokpeɡa la.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Yeesu nɔ bwara waa ba baɡle Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, ‘Bwe la he mamaala aa vɛoh dɛ liiru konsala laanee bera ba lawɛ dea la kpoŋe la.’

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Dɛ Yeesu laa aa, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won lɛ yaa. Nomɛlbwa toole harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa yá yerɔ o won lɛ yaa ka ja Yeesu nɛ.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Dɛ Pita ne Jɔn aa tɔn jemɛ kohona bɛlbwa, dɛ ɛ nɛmpɛɛne baa wola Korowii waa hwele kohona bɛlbwa. Nomonome la aa na bambile la soo baa wona kpoŋe dɛɛ bol waa la, dɛ a ɛɛ ba anebɛlbwa. Belaa ba sie chaah ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba fa teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ dɛɛ hwelu. An ɡela ba jemɛ waa dɛ dɔ bambile ɡɛ la.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Nomonome la ta berɛ won bol wobɛlbwa kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba ɡbabir na baa la baa chaoh la. Dɛ o cheɡɛ Pita ne Jɔn be.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Asɛ ba ŋɔ Píta ne Jɔn le dea la bini ka che dahara. Dɛ ba dɛ bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ,

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: “Aah ɛrɛ tenee yaa ba baala nɔ ɛɛ yɔ? Jerusalam tena bwa nao dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ nyokpowaa ba ɛ ɡɛ nɔ. A te ta tɔŋla dɔe.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya aah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ wobɛlbwa bol Yeesu sɔn ta bobɛlbwa kpa, ásɛ waa nɔ bɛ won kaa bojaŋ kpa.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Asɛ ba berɛ yer ba jo dea dɛ aah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ too bol wobɛlbwa bobɛlbwa Yeesu sɔn ta kpa!

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Anee Pita ne Jɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé ɡbabir di kasinteŋ. He ɔma ne Korowii ɔma, amee maɡra Korowii be nɔ?

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Waa ya ɡbaɡba aa naa dɛ no la, yaa won ɡel a bola bwa!”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa la baa chaoh la ɡwaa bene fifraanaarɛ o weela la ta, asɛ nɛra la bwa na ɡɛ baa chaoh la dɛɛ kooɡa dɛɛ jam Korowii. Asɔre tena la wesoŋa

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Baa ɡel Pita ne Jɔn la, ba la ba bala la be dɛ ka baɡle ɡɛ Sɔfonomoa ne nomonome la aa bola la.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Ba bala la aa no waa la, ba bwa pɛo soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii haa ɛ komɛlbwa dɔɔ, hen ta nyundua ne harɛ ne mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ a ta bwa!

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: He cheɡɛ he Domadɛɛɡe ta dɛ ɡel ya naa Devid waa ɛ he bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ harɛre nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la lɛ ɡaeh, dɛɛ le jina dɛɛ koh ba te pɛɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Ba koranar kpɔ ba te, dɛ ir che dɛɛ vɔrɔwe Korowii ne o Kristo la vɔrɔwa.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Kpela ɡe, Hɛrɔd, ne Pɔnteɔs Paelet ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, ne Israel tena bwa cheme bwɛjen nɔ ta. Ba yo Yeesu, he ɡbaɡba bonɔɔ waa wola wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔe la. Onee he ɛ he Kristo la.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: Ba bwa chemo dɛ ɛ waa he ɡbaɡba aa kpɔ he kpeɡri ne he tetoora vɔrɔwe ŋɔ aa ɛo la.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii, berɛ na ɡɛ baa dɔa aah he bonɔɔna, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri bá won bol he waa bansua bwa ne.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Tɛɛ ba kpeɡri bá won dɛɛ chah weela, dɛ́ ɡel ba che he ɡbaɡba bonɔndɛɛɡe Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ́ ɛ wekpeɡa ne nyokpowa.”

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Baa soŋe Korowii tonɛ la, dea baa lɔ o bini la jiɡro. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe baa so ba nɛ, asɛ baa bol Korowii Waa la bansua bwa ne. Yeesu toroma nyina dɔe tɛ dɔŋa

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra baa yarada Yeesu waa la dɛ ɛ asɔre tena la bwa dɔ nyopɛo ba liire bwa ɡe ɛ beŋkpoŋ. Bɛlbwa ta o ɡbaɡba kondɔɔla kpɔe ɛ o ɡbo kwa. Dɛ bɛlbwa dɔ kon aa, o dɔŋ konee.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Kpeɡri tenten nee Yeesu toroma la di o seo ta ira la danseɛ. Asɛ Korowii cha ba, dɛ ɡel o nyanyini ba so ba nɛ kohona.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Dɛ ba bɛlbwa toole aa noo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ banɔ la baa dɔ deene ne harɛre la dɛ yoɡa,

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: dɛ kpɔ a suuɡa dɛɛ ba Yeesu toroma la be, asɛ baa bɔna ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa dɔ.

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Ananias, o haah ɡe sɔne Safaera. O ne o haah yoɡ ba harɛ bɛl,

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: asɛ ba nyoa pɛ o kpɔ suuɡa la ane sɔh, dɛ kpɔ a kabora ba tɛ Yeesu toroma la.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Belaa Pita bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ananias, ɛrɛɛ he ɡel Bɔnsam won neɡre dɛ ɡel he ba neɡre Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, dɛ kwaa he suuɡa la pera sɔh nɔɔ?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Haa wola harɛ la yoɡe mɔɔ la, dɛ hen dɔ he kon. Haa yoɡu tonɛ la ɡe la, dɛ suuɡa la ɡe ɛ he kwa. Aah dɛ bɔkwaa ɡela he ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ? Nɛwɛnyini laa he neɡre nɔ. Korowiirii he neɡre la!”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Ananias aa dena no waa nɔ la, o den chole, dɛ sewɛ ɡe. Nɛra baa no a ɡɛ waa nɔ la bwa ɔmɔ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Belaa bonɔɔna bane ir dɛ ba vɔrɔwo, dɛ cheo le buse, dɛ ka huɡo.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: A ta biɡre o haah ɡe den ba, dɛ waa jemɛ kɛŋɔ waane ɛ o jaa.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Anee Pita bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He ne he jaa harɛ la haa yoɡa la, o suuɡa bwaa nɔ naa?” Asɛ haah la sɛh ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, a bwaa.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Belaa Pita pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ne he jaa nyoa pɛ asɛ he daah Korowii Domadɛɛɡe dɛɛ na nɔɔ? Bonɔɔna baa kaa huɡe he jaa laanee tel doonyoa la. Baa che he ɡee le buse.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Buɡ la ta, o ɡe den chole chɔ Pita sie bela, dɛ ɡe sewɛ. Bonɔɔna la aa bala dɛ o ɡe sewɔ, asɛ ba cheo le buse dɛ ka huɡo o jaa jwɛh.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: A ɡelɔ asɔre tena la bwa ne nomɛlbwa waa no a waa ɔmɛ taeh. Gɛ Yeesu toroma aa ɛ wekpeɡa ne nyokpowa

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Dɛ Yeesu toroma la dɛ ɛ wekpeɡa ne nyokpowaa nɛra la bini. Dɛ asɔre tena la dɛ cheme Korowii Dea la dahara bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Solomɔn Pato la ta.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra baa wola Yeesu waa yarada la dɛ kpɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ. Kɛ dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ bá ba puu ba dɛɛ so Solomɔn Pato ta bela.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Nɛra koh Yeesu toroma la toma baa dɛ ɛ la wa, dɛ che weela tena ne ba mpare ne ba kalaŋre ba bil ŋwɛnɛ nyoa, ásɛ dɛ Pita ba dɛ kaa laa, o lileo dawɛ bane nɛɛ ásɛ ba ɡbaŋre.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra le Jerusalam bwɛjeɡre la ta dɛ ba pirim, dɛ che weela tena ne nɛra kwaa aa dɛ ir ba nɛɛ bwa ba, asɛ ba bwa dɔ bokpeɡa. Ba lawɛ Yeesu toroma do dea

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Kɛ Sɔfonomoa la ne o nɛra baa ɛ Saduki tena la bwa aa na toma Yeesu toroma la aa dɛ tomɛ la, a ɛɛ ba bɔweela kohona,

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: asɛ ba ir kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl dɛ lawɛ Yeesu toroma la do dea, bela baa dɛ do nɛra bwa la.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Awola jwaana la, Korowii nyundua torome bɛl baa ya dea la ɡbera, dɛ le Yeesu toroma la ne buse, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Hé la ka che Korowii Dea la bini dɛ́ ka bol Yeesu ŋwɛnɛfale nɔ waa bwa nɛra be.”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Yeesu toroma la no nyundua torome la waa la, asɛ tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi ne la, ba ka jo Korowii Dea la bini dɛɛ bol Yeesu waa la. Awola chɔɔ ne la, Sɔfonomoa la ne o nɛra yerɛ Juu tena nomonome la bwa dɛ ba cheme, dɛ tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá la dea la baa lawɛ Yeesu toroma la do la bini, dɛ́ ka lee ba ba.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Toroma la aa la dea la bini la, ba ta Yeesu toroma la ka nae, dɛ berɛ ba nomonome la be dɛ ba ŋɔ,

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “Yaa la bela dɛ koŋkarɛre baa kpɔa karɛ ɡbeni la ta lɔ a ta, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi doonyoone la ta la ɡe cheɡɛ bela. Kɛ yaa ya ɡbeni la la, ya ta nomɛlbwa nae dea la bini!”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Sɔfonomonome la ne nomoa waa chɔ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea doonyoo nyoa la aa no a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, a ɛɛ ba anebɛlbwa. Ba ta wone jemɛ waa la mun.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Belaa baa bɛl ba dɛ ba ŋɔ. “Hé no bonɔ! Nɛra la haa do ba dea laanee lɔ Korowii Dea dɛɛ baɡle nɛra Korowii Waa la!”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Asɛ nomoa waa chɔ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea doonyoo nyoa la ne o nɛra la dɛ ka lawɛ Yeesu toroma la ba. Dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ ba kpɔ kpeɡri laɡ ba aa, ba bwɛɛ tena la baah ɛɛ diu bá ta bwea foɡ ba. Anomanta, ba laɡ ba kaa jeiih ken.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Ba ba Yeesu toroma la ne dɛ ba ɡel ba che Juu tena nomonome la baah ta, asɛ Sɔfonomoa la bɔɔ ba ŋɔ,

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: “Yaa kah heyaa ŋɔ he bɛ too ɡel ya na heyaa hɛɛ bol baa nɔ waa la, ɛrɛɛ he berɛ dɛɛ ɛ ja nɔɔ? Hé nyiŋi na kɛŋɔ haa bol o waa a perɛ Jerusalam bwa ɡɛ! Ɛrɛɛ he chaa o seo waa dɛɛ choɡ yaa ŋɔ yan ɡela ba kpoo nɔɔ?”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Belaa Pita ne o bala troma la ŋɔ, “Korowii chɛ kɛŋɔ ya ɔmɛ ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Korowii la ya naawa aa dɛ tomɔ laanee ir Yeesu la haa kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta dɛ kpoo la.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Korowii iru seo ta dɛ kpɔɔ ka so nomombɔr o diɡ ta, dɛ ɛo nɛra bwa Sitɔɔ ne ba Lɛɛ, asɛ dɛ koh o waa dɛ kpɔ Israel tena baa charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta la wechɔɡa kɛ ba.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Nae yaa na waa nɔ la waa yaa di a danseɛ la. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa kpɔa tɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o ŋwɛnɛ ta la ɡe cheɡɛ ya nɛɛ dɛɛ di waa nɔ danseɛ.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Nomonome la aa no Yeesu toroma la waa nɔ la, ba bwaawee iro kohona, ba fe ɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ba kpoo ba.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Dɛ Farisii te bɛl lɔ bela baa yerɔ Gamaleɛl. Dɛ o dɛ baɡle nɛra Mosis Mmara, nɛra bwa ɡe ɛɛ tɛo duure. O iro che ba baah dɛ ŋɔ bá le Yeesu toroma la ne buse tama.

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: Anee o ŋɔ nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Yabala Israel tena, hɛ́ɛ do nɛra nɔ dɛɛɡɔ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Galilia te baa dɛ yerɔ Judas la fa ta leɛ a ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛ kure nɛra la, dɛ ɡe ba yo Abane nomonome dɛ dɔ nɛnlaa kohona naa? Ba ta o ɡe kpoe asɛ o nɛra la ɡe bwa peɡre aa?

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n poo heya, he bɛ nɛra nɔ wobɛlbwa ɛ. Hé ɡel ba jeiih ken. Dɛ ba ɡbaɡba liire ne ba bokpeɡa binii baa ɛ ba waa nɔ naa, ba waa nɔ ɛɛ sɔɔhnoo.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ Korowii be ɡee a le aa, ate haa won sɔɔh ba waa nɔ nyoa. He ta kɛrɛdɛ nyiŋaa, Korowiirii hɛɛ yo laa la oo!” Nomonome la teŋɛ Gamaleɛl waa la ta.

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Ba yerɛ Yeesu toroma la jo dea, dɛ lɔɔ ba chweremi ne, dɛ kwaa aah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ too kpɔ Yeesu sɔn bol waa kpa, dɛ kpɔ ba ta.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Baa le nomonome la be, dɛ ba sie lɛo kohona kɛŋɔ Korowii aa tɛɛ ba sɔn dɛ ɡel ba ɡe maɡa nɔ dɔŋ won koh Yeesu waa dɛ di sihiih ne weweele la.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Anomanta, tɔpere te bɛlbwaa baa bol Amanesoma la Korowii Dea la bini, ne nɛra deremi kɛŋɔ Yeesuu Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ásɛ o ba lɛ o nɛra la.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Yeesu habɔteŋra aa ba dɛ warɛ la, naɡra baa chole Juu tena baa ɛ hɔɔhra dɛɛ bol Grik wobol la, ne banɔ la baa dɛ bol Juda wobol la baah ta. Dɛ ba dɛ bɔne suuɡa dɛɛ tɛ asɔre tena la tɔpere bɛlbwa. Asɛ Juu tena baa dɛ bol Grik wobol la ŋɔ baa ba te luhaahna tɛ.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu toroma fi dɛ banɛ la yerɛ asɔre tena la bwa cheme, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “A ta maɡrɛ kɛŋɔ yá ɡel Korowii Waa baɡla dɛɛ nyiŋi suuɡa waa ta.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Anomanta, yabala, hé nyiŋi dɛ le he bini nɛra banuanɛ nɛra bwa aa jema kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, asɛ ba we-ɛɛla ɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la soɡe ba nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛɛ dɛ ɡel ba ɛ wejerema la, ásɛ ya kpɔ suuɡa waa nɔ do ba nɔn ta,

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: ásɛ ya te won dɔ bɔr dɛ́ kpɔ Korowii soŋa ne o Waa bola ɡbo ɛ ya toma.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Nɛra la bwa sie lɛ waa la Yeesu toroma la aa bola la ta, dɛ le baa bɛl Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa soɡe o nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛɛ wɛɛ yarada Korowii, dɛɛ tomɔ kasinteŋ ne baa yerɔ Steeven la. Nɛra baa jaa la ɡe sɔnaa Felep, ne Prokɔrɔs, ne Nikenɔ, ne Taemɔn, ne Paamenas, dɛ Nikolas. Dɛ Anteɔk tee Nikolas nɔ, asɛ wɛɛ tomɛ Korowii Juu tena ŋwɛnɛ baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la ta.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Nɛra la kpɔ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ baɡle Yeesu toroma la, asɛ ba kpɔ ba nɔɔra darawe ba nɛɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Korowii waa la perɛ bela. Dɛ nɛra baa yarada waa la dɛ baa ja Yeesu habɔteŋra la nɛɛ Jerusalam la dɛ warɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Hale sɔfore la kɛrɛdɛ bwaa yaradaa dɛ baa teŋɛ Yeesu ŋwɛnɛ la ta. Steeven lawa wa

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii cha Steeven kohona, dɛ tɛo kpeɡri o won dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowa, ne waa aa kpeɡa nɛra baah ta.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Belaa Juu tena baa dɛ cheme cheremi dea bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Libetines la, ir dɛɛ tɔŋle Steeven. Dɛ Juu tena nɔ le Sairini ne Alɛksandrea, bane ɡe le Silisia harɛ ne Eesia harɛ ta.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Baa dɛ tɔŋlo la, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la tɛ Steeven wejema kohona, dɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa waa bola la, baa wechɔɡe bɛlbwa na a ta. O bol waa la bwa bɔ ba.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba sɔh kpɔ suuɡa tɛ nɛra bane dɛ do ba ŋɔ, “Hé ŋɔ he na baa nɔ kɛŋɔ waa dɛ bol Mosis ne Korowii nɛnhɛlwobol.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Kenii a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛ dɛ won berɛ ba bwɛɛ tena ne Juu tena nomonome ne Tɔnjerema la bwa liire, dɛ ɡel ba baah di Steeven nɛ. Asɛ ba lawɔ la ba nomonome baa dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole sie.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ba ɡelɔ nɛra bane ɡe ba teŋe nyosone, dɛ bol waa baa wola nae bwa dawɛ Steeven nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛlbwaa baa nɔ bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ ya Korowii Dea nɔ ne Mosis Mmara la.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: Ya noɔ waa ŋɔa ŋɔ Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la ɛɛ paɡre Korowii Dea nɔɔ, dɛ beɡre ya mmarare ne ya waa Mosis aa baɡle ya naawa la bwa.”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Nomonome la ne nɛra baa lɔ bela la bwa kpɔ sie pa Steeven nɛ. Dɛ o siebɔr dɛ nyɛɡle al-al kɛŋɔ nyundua torome siebɔr ken.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Belaa Sɔfonomoa la bɔɔ Steeven ŋɔ, “Kpelaa ba ŋɔ nɔ naa?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Anee Steeven chaŋe ŋɔ, “N mɛɛwa ne n dɔɔranar, hɛ́ɛ no waa nɔ maa dɛ ba bola nɔ! A ɡɛ saŋ la ya naa Abraham aa wola Haran kaalɛ mɔɔ la, Korowii waa ɛ jirima bwa dɔɔ la ba o be Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta,

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Gel he lolanar, dɛ́ le he harɛ haa lɔ o ta nɔ ta, dɛ́ ka so harɛ maa dɛ ba he baɡla la ta.’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Asɛ Abraham ir le o harɛ ta dɛ ka so Haran. O mɛɛ aa sewa habɔɔ laanee Korowii ɡel o ba so harɛ nɔ haa soɡe o ta fini nɔ ta.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii ta harɛ la pera teŋe tɛ Abraham kɛŋɔ ó ɛ o ɡe kon nɔ. O ta naɡale beŋkpoŋ del kwara teŋe tɛo. Kɛ Korowii baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛo, ásɛ harɛ la ɛ o ne o naanar kon. A ɡɛ saŋ la Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa nɔ la, dɛ o ta bii dɔe mɔɔ.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa bol Abraham be laanee kɛŋɔ o naanar ɛɛ ka berɛ hɔɔhra harɛ bɛl taa, ásɛ bela tena kpɔ ba ɛ yoma, dɛ́ fiɡ ba kohona bene lafraanaarɛ.

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ bol a ɡɛ harɛ la tena waa dɛ́ pa ba bole, dɛ bɔ ba a kem, ásɛ a habɔɔ la o nɛra ba bonɔ dɛ baa tomɔ.

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii baɡle Abraham ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ teŋe o bii pena, ásɛ a ɡɛ waa la ɛ nawee dɛ́ che tɛ o ne Abraham fɔo la baa fɔwa la wa. A waa Abraham aa lolɛ o bie Aesek o dɔ yawanyoa beŋkpoŋ la, ba teŋe o pen. Aesek ɡe aa baa lolɛ o bie Jekɔb la, o teŋe o pen. Asɛ Jekɔb ɡe teŋe o bii fi dɛ banɛ baa ɛ ya deene nomonome la bwa pena.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: Dɛ Jekɔb bii la aa ba nime Josef la waa nyin, dɛ kpɔ bɔweela yoɡu tɛ Ijipt tena, asɛ ba ka kpɔɔ ɛ ba yom. Dɛ Korowii teŋɛ Josef nɛ,

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: anomanta, wobɛlbwa ta on ɛɛ o wahala waa naa la bwa ta. A balɔ kɛŋɔ Josef la Ijipt harɛ kooro be, Korowii tɛo jirima ne liire, asɛ o waa too kooro la tea kohona. Anomanta, o ɛ Josef o harɛ la bwa ne o dem tena bwa nomoa.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Belaa lɔr ba chole Ijipt ne Keenan harɛ bwa ta, asɛ baa na wahala kohona. Dɛ ya naawa ta kondikwaa dɔe dɛ di.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Belaa Jekɔb ba no kɛŋɔ kondikwaa lɔ Ijipt harɛ, dɛ tomɛ o bii baa ɛ ya naawa la ŋɔ bá la bela ka yawɛ ane ba. Dɛ ba loɡla laŋa baa dɛ la bela bwaa la.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Baa bera ba la bela nɛɛtena la, Josef kpɔ o te baɡ ba, asɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba nime Josef laanee on. Ijipt harɛ kooro la ɡe baa jemɛ ba wa.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Asɛ Jekɔb ir kaa Ijipt harɛ dɛ ka so bela. Belaa o ne o bii la bwa ka serewe.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Baa serewa la, ba kpɔ ba kaa Sɛkem, dɛ ka huɡ ba lalbɔɔ la Abraham fa aa yawa Hamɔ dea tena be la ta.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: Korowii nyobaɡa waa baɡɛ Abraham kɛ wɛɛ lee ba Ijipt harɛ taa dɛ tɛɛ ba harɛfale la aa tela la, ya naawa baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ la warɔ kohona.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Koofale waa wola Josef waa jemɛ baa di Ijipt kora.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Dɛ o dɛ neɡ ba dɛɛ ɛɛ ba nyubinikpeɡ, dɛɛ fiɡ ba, dɛ ɡel ba kpɔ ba bechasɔɔhne kaa ta baa serewe.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ nɔɔ ba lolɛ Mosis. Dɛ o wer bonɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ. O nya nyiŋi o nɛɛ korobie atoro mɔɔ dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Baa tao la, a ɡɛ kooro la bihaahnee nao dɛ kpɔɔ dɛ nyiŋu kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba bie.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Mosis hweli Ijipt tena waa bwa dɛ dɔ ba wejema bwa. Dɛ o wobol dɛ jo deŋne, o berɛ won wejena ɡe ɛɛ ja.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Waa baa na Ijipt tena la bɛl wɛɛ fiiɡi o bwɛɛ te awola bɛl la, o lɛ o bwɛɛ te la nyoa dɛ kpo Ijipt te la bɔ kem.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: Dɛ Mosis dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o bwɛɛ tena la ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyin a che o nɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ ba ta, kɛ ba ta ɡɛ jemɛ.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, o na Israel tena banɛ baa yo, dɛ la ŋɔ ó ka larawe ba yoi la. O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Nɛmbeŋkpoŋii heya. Bɔkwaa dɔ heyaa hɛɛ yo ken ɔ?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: Asɛ ba bini onɔ la waa dɛ weɡre o dɔŋ nyoa la taɡɛ Mosis dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘Umee cheɡe kora ta ŋɔ hé baa nyiŋi ya nɛɛ dɛ́ bol ya waa dɛɛ pa bole ɔ?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: He dɛ nyin he kpo mɛ ɡɛ haa kpo Ijipt te la kɛɛ?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Mosis aa no a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o ɔmɔ, dɛ chwa le Ijipt harɛ dɛ ka so Midian harɛ ta. O lolɛ bibaala banɛ bela.

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Menee Korowii he naawa Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tom mɛ la.’ Mosis ɔmɔ dɛɛ chel, o ta berɛ dɔ bambile dɛ nyiŋu.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Foo he naŋɡawa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n siee he che la.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: N na fiiɡa Ijipt tena aa dɛ fiiɡi n nɛra Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ no ba wii baa dɛ wi la bwa ɡe. A balaa n ba ŋɔ ń ba lɛɛ ba ta la. Anomanta, n dɛ ba he toma Ijipt harɛ.’

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: Mosis la Israel tena fa aa vɛoh dɛ ŋɔ, ó baɡle naate waa cheɡo kora ta ŋɔ ó baa nyiŋi ba nɛɛ dɛ́ɛ bol ba waa la, onee Korowii tomɛ ŋɔ ó ba tɔ ba sie dɛ́ lɛɛ ba ta. Nyundua torome la Mosis aa nao dawii nii ta la nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ tomɔ.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Mosis ɛ nyokpowaa Ijipt harɛ ta mɔɔ dɛ kpɔ o nɛra le bela, dɛ ɛ nyokpowaa Mposwɛm la ta bene fifraanaarɛ baa dia pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la bwa ta.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Mosisii ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ tomɛ o keame bɛlee ba be ɡɛ waa tomɔ la, dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ le ba dwee taa.

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Mosis nɔ ne ya naawa ne nyundua torome waa bol waa o be Sinai Bwejen ta laanee fa dɛ cheme pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta. Belaa Korowii kpɔ o waa aa wola ɡarɛ, aa wola tonɛ ɡe la, tɛo ŋɔ ó ba ŋɔ ya be.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: Kɛ ya naawa ŋɔ baa o waa no, dɛ vɛh o nɛɛ teŋa dɛɛ wi Ijipt harɛ wa.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Belaa ba ma voɡ bɛl kɛŋɔ nabii ken, dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛo, dɛ koh kon la ba ɡbaɡba aa maa la waa di kwa, dɛ sa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii berɛ habɔɔ kpo ba, dɛ ɡel baa ɛ ba tetoowaa dɛɛ tomɛ wee ne korobie ne weweela aa lɔ nyundua la. Gɛɛ ba chwerɛ Korowii Keamere Tɔn ta la ŋɔ, ‘Israel tena, he fa aa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bene lafraanaarɛ la, menee he fa kpoo kondɛɛra dɛɛ tɛ la aa?

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Voɡ Molɛk la dea ne wewee haa mao dɛɛ tomɔ dɛɛ yerɔ Refan la laa he che dɛɛ ɡaaɡe la aa? He ɡbaɡbaa fa ma a ɡɛ voɡa nɔ dɛɛ toma. Anomanta, mɛɛ lawɛ heyaa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta dɛ́ kaa he ne bojaŋ.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: Ya naawa aa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, dɛ ba dɔ tɔne ane baa dɛ baŋra kɛŋɔ dea ken, asɛ a ɡɛ dea la ɛ Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr. Gɛ Korowii aa baɡle Mosis laanee ba kwaaro.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea nɔ baa kpɔ tɔne baŋro nɔ baa di ya naawa nɔn ta saŋ bɛl. Ba ɡe naanaree serewa dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba. Ba ne Josua aa dɛ valɛ la bwa, dɛ ba cheɡɛ a ɡɛ debaŋre la tɔne. Baa dɛ kaa la bwa dɛ Korowii dɛ doŋi nɛra baa lɔ ba sie bwɛɛre la ta la asɛ baa so a ta. Gɛɛ dea la do ba be ka tel saŋ la Devid aa baa di kora la.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Korowii ta on a ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ. Devid bie Solomɔnee bera ba ma Korowii Dea la.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii keame la aa baɡla la, Nemenɛ Korowii aa deene nɛwɛnyini aa maa la ta so. Korowii keame baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: ‘Nyunduaa n kara, asɛ harɛ ɡee n natiɡribɔr. Debesoo siwii hɛɛ ba wona ma ń jo o ta nɔ? Debesoo taa ń won jo dɛ́ chɔ onɔɔ?

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Korowii keamere la bini ume nɛɛ he naawa aa wola cheɡɛ dɛ ɛo saɡasaɡa nɔ? Ba ta nɛra Korowii aa toma ŋɔ bá ba bol o Bonɔɔ la bala waa la kpooraa? Waa bala la, he ɡe ta on yoɡe dɛ kpoo wa aa?

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: He nɔn taa nyundua toroma kpɔ Korowii Mmarare la ba do, kɛ he ta a ta teŋɛ!” Ba foɡre Steeven bwea

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Nomonome la aa no ɡɛ Steeven aa bola la, dɛ ba baah diu, baa pwee dɛɛ chwee bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa soɡe Steeven nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛɛ nomanta, o nyiŋi nyundua dɛ na kɛŋɔ bɔr aa chaahna werwer ken Korowii be. Asɛ o na Yeesu cheɡa nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta bela,

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé na! N na nyundua aa pila asɛ Nɛn Bie la che nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta bela!”

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: dɛ tuuɡu le bwɛɛ la dahara. Nɛra baa no o wobol la foo ba laala bil bonɔɔ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sɔɔl sie mɔɔ, dɛ la ka foɡre Steeven bwea.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Baa dɛ foɡro bwea la, dɛ o yerɛ Yeesu, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ Yeesu, n kpɔ n lileo dɛɛ do he nɔn ta dɛ́ sewɛ!”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Belaa o ɡuŋi harɛ dɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, bɛ ɡel a ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ ɡure ba nɛ.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ tonɛ, o den sewɛ.

translation_verse: Sɔɔl ɡe ɛ wobɛlbwa waa won dɛ́ chɔɡ asɔre tena la waa bwa, dɛ jo bela deremi bwa ta dɛ tɛɡre ba bini baala ne haahna bwa kaa do dea. Felep Korowii waa bola Samaria harɛ ta
