translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ Leda ne Sarɔn bwa na baa la dɛ charɛ ba liire, dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah bɛl lɔ Jopa dɛ ɛ asɔre te baa yerɔ Tabita. Grik tena ɡe dɛ yerɔ Dɔkas. Dɛ haah la dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa taeh dɛɛ cha nyaara.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ Pita aa lɔ Leda la, Tabita bwara weo o sewɛ, asɛ ba sɔɔ ne dɛ kpɔɔ bil abrɔsane bɛl doa.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Dɛ Jopa ne Leda aa jaŋɛ, anomanta, asɔre tena baa lɔ Jopa la aa noa kɛŋɔ Pita lɔ Leda la, ba tomɛ baala banɛ o be dɛ ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ba dɛ soŋo kɛ ó ɡel wobɛlbwa dɛ́ ba ba be warane.

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Toroma la aa laŋa la, Pita kpɔ o te dɛ puu ba kaa. Waa laŋa la, ba kpɔɔ deeh abrɔsane la. Dɛ luhaahna baa lɔ bela la bwa baa chwa baro dɛɛ wi, dɛ kpɔ batakaani ne yale Tabita aa sɔah ɡɛ saŋ waa wola sewɛ mɔɔ la dɛɛ baɡle Pita.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Pita doŋi ba bwa le buse dɛ ɡuŋi harɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii, dɛ berɛ sie lale la be dɛ ŋɔ, “Tabita, ir!” Haah la pili o sie. Waa na Pita la, o iro so.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Belaa Pita tel o be dɛ lawɔ ir che, dɛ ka yerɛ asɔre tena ne ba bini luhaahna la bwa dɛ kpɔ haah la waa iru la tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ perɛ Jopa bwa, asɛ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ che a ta dɛ yarada Yeesu waa la.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Pita soɡe Jopa bela biɡri. Dɛ ɡbansabate bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Seemɔn la deaa o do.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Dɛ baa bɛl lɔ Sisaaria baa yerɔ Kɔnɛɛleɔs. Itali harɛ soojare bane nomoaa on.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: O ne o dem tena bwa dɛ tomɛ Korowii. Dɛ o dɛ cha Juu tena baa ɛ nyaara la taeh, dɛɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, o na wepila ane wekee saŋ. O nao kɛŋɔ nyundua torome bɛl aa baa jo o be dɛ yerɔ ŋɔ, “Kɔnɛɛleɔs!”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Asɛ o ha sie nyiŋu ɔmee ne dɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yɔ? A som aa, n Dɔɔ?” Asɛ nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “He soŋa haa dɛ soŋe Korowii, ne he chae haa dɛ cha nɛra la lɛ o sie, o dɛ ba he chae.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Tomɛ nɛra ba la Jopa dɛ́ ka yerɛ Seemɔn Pita ba.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: O ɛ hɔɔh dɛ do ɡbansaba te bɛl waa soɡe mpo nyoa baa yerɔ Seemɔn la dem.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome la aa bol waa tonɛ la, o kaalɔ, asɛ Kɔnɛɛleɔs yerɛ o bonɔɔna banɛ ne sooja bɛl waa dɛ tomɛ Korowii kohona dɛɛ teŋɛ o Kɔnɛɛleɔs nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa la,

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: dɛ bol waa la bwa chaɡ ba, dɛ tom ba Jopa. Pita wepila waa naa

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera baa kaa dɛ ka tel bwɛjen Jopa la, Pita teeh sal dea webaŋa dɛɛ ba Korowii soŋa. Dɛ wee cheɡɛ nyufala.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Dɛ lɔr lawɔ, asɛ wɛɛ nyin kwaa dɛ́ di, kɛ dɛ ba ta dɛ ɛ o kondikwa. Belaa o na wepila ane.

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: O nao kɛŋɔ nyundua aa pera, asɛ ba lawɛ komɛl kɛŋɔ yajen o nyoo bɔre anaarɛ bwa, kwaane do o ta a saɡɛ jɛɛhjɛɛh dɛ le nyundua dɛɛ ba harɛ.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Belaa Pita no kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Pita! Ir dɛ́ kpo chwe!”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Pita ŋɔ, “Ei! N Dɔɔ, ɡɛ aa won maɡre. N ta a ɡɛ koŋkiila dii bwa.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Anee naate berɛ ŋɔ o be nɛɛtena ŋɔ, “Kon Korowii aa laa o doŋa kpɔ o nɛɛ la, bɛ on kondoŋ yerɛ kpa.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛo kera atoro mɔɔ kon la berɛ kaa nyundua.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Pita aa wola waa la mun jemɛ dɛ so sakaa la, kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ nɛra Kɔnɛɛleɔs aa tom ba la balɔ. Ba bɔɔ Seemɔn dem dɛ ka che dem la doonyoa,

translation_verse: dɛ yerɛ nomɛl dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Seemɔn la baa dɛ yerɔ Pita la lɔ dem nɔ ta kɛɛ?”

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: anomanta, bɛ ɔmɛ. La ba be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ menee tom ba.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Anee Pita ir la nɛra la be dɛ ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Men nɔ, a som aa?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Soojare nomoa Kɔnɛɛleɔs laanee tomɛ yaa. O ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe waa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, asɛ Juu tena bwa ɛɛ duuru. Nyundua torome bɛlee ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó yerɛ ba o dem dɛ no waa haa dɛ ba o be bola.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Belaa Pita ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá chɔ o be, ásɛ tɔɔ per ba kaa. Tɔ aa pera la, Pita bala asɔre tena baa lɔ Jopa la bane ja o nɛɛ asɛ ba ne toroma la kaa.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Baa lea la, tɔɔ perɔ mɔɔ ba tel Sisaaria. Dɛ Kɔnɛɛleɔs yerɛ o lolanar ne o daamanar cheme dɛ so dɛɛ kpa Pita.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Waa tel Kɔnɛɛleɔs dem bela dɛɛ ba dem la bini joe la, Kɔnɛɛleɔs baa chemo dɛ ɡuŋi harɛ.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Anee Pita lawɔ ir dɛ ŋɔ, “Ir harɛ, he nɛwɛnyini dɔŋee men.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Pita ne o bol waa ka jo dem bela. Belaa Pita na kɛŋɔ nɛra cheme bela pirim,

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya Juu tena aa nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bini jo. Kɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ n bɛ nomɛlbwa nɛndoŋ yerɛ.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: A waa he yer mɛ n ba warane la. N dɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ ɛrɛɛ he ŋɔ ń ba ɛɔ?”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Belaa Kɔnɛɛleɔs ŋɔ, “Tɔpera anaarɛɛ nɔ, maa lɔ n dem saŋ nɔ bɔr tenten dɛɛ soŋe Korowii wekee saŋ la, kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ baa bɛl waa do laalapoŋa kpelkpel cheɡɛ n sie

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Kɔnɛɛleɔs! Korowii no he soŋa haa dɛ soŋo dɛ na he chae haa dɛ cha nyaara la bwa.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Tomɛ nomɛl Jopa baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Seemɔn Pita la be ó ka yerɔ ba. O ɛ hɔɔh dɛ do ɡbansaba te bɛl waa soɡe mpo nyoa baa yerɔ Seemɔn la dem.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: A waa n tomɛ nɛra he be warane la. He ɡe ɛ waa kɛŋɔ haa bala nɔ. A waa ya bwa cheme Korowii sie bonɔ la. Ya dɛ nyin waa Korowii aa ŋɔa hé ba bol ya be la dɛ́ no.”

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Belaa Pita pa o wobol mun dɛ ŋɔ, “Taraken te n nao kɛŋɔ kpela, nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa ta o dɔŋ ɡwaalɛ Korowii be.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Kɛ harɛ bɛlbwa ta la, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ jemɔ la, Korowii sie dɛ lɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: He jemɛ waa waa ŋɔa bá ka bol Israel tena be dɛ baɡle Yeesu Amanesoma aa dɛ tɛ bosɔɔhna la. Yeesuu komɛlbwa Dɔɔ.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la toma la habɔɔ Yeesu waa che, dɛ perɛ Juda harɛ bwa la. Galilia harɛɛ a pa mun.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: He jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe ne o kpeɡri tɛ Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la wa. Dɛ Korowii teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ, asɛ o valɛ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ chah nɛra Bɔnsam aa lɔ ba bil la.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: O waa waa ɛa Juda harɛ ta ne Jerusalam la bwaa ya na dɛɛ di a danseɛ. Ba kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta dɛ kpoo.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Asɛ o seo habɔɔ tɔpetooro wee la ta la, Korowii iru seo ta, dɛ ɡel o kpɔ o te ba chaɡle yaa.

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: Korowii ta ɡelɛ o kpɔ o te chaɡle nomɛlbwa ka ja ya nɛra waa le yaa ŋɔ yá di o danseɛ nɔ nɛ. Ya ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ne o pɛ nɔn di kwaa o seo ta ira la habɔɔ.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Onee le yaa dɛ ja yaa ŋɔ yá bol o waa baɡle nɛra bwa, dɛ́ di danseɛ kɛŋɔ onee Korowii le ŋɔ ó ba di weera ne lala bwa wa.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Korowii keamere la bwa bol Yeesu waa ŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa yarada o waa la, o nomanta, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ naate wechɔɡaa kɛo.”

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Pita ta aa dɛ bol waa la, dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe baa so nɛra baa dɛ no o wobol la bwa nɛ.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Juu tena baa ɛ asɔre tena ba ne Pita le Jopa ba aa na ɡɛ la, ba nyoa kpoo kɛŋɔ Korowii aa ɡela o Domadɛɛɡe la ba so nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɡba nɛ,

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel baa bol wobofala dɛɛ jam Korowii la. Belaa Pita ŋɔ,

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: “Gɛ tenten Korowii aa tɛ yaa o Domadɛɛɡe laanee o tɛ nɛra nɔ ɡe la. Aah aa do ɡɛ nɔ, umee dɛ́ won vɔm ba Korowii nee sɔe yɔ?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Belaa Pita ŋɔ bá sɔ ba nee Yeesu Kristo sɔn ta. Baa sɔ nɛra la nee tonɛ la, ba ɡelɔ Pita so ba be tɔpera anɛ.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Pita aa la Jerusalam la, ba bala Juu tena baa dɛ maŋkura penteŋ waa la pwaoh ŋɔ,

translation_verse: “Ɛrɛ waa he ka choɡ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, baa wola ba pena teŋni dem dɛ saah di kwaa bela nɔɔ?”

translation_verse: O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Jopaa n do dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, dɛ na wepila ane. N nao kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ komɛl kɛŋɔ yajen nyoo bɔre anaarɛ bwa, kwaane do o ta, a saɡɛ jɛɛhjɛɛh dɛ le nyundua dɛɛ ba harɛ.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Asɛ n no kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Pita, ir dɛ́ kpo chwe.’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Belaa n ŋɔ, ‘Aa maɡre, n Dɔɔ! N ta a ɡɛ koŋkiila nɔ dii bwa. A ɛ doŋa tɛ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Asɛ naate berɛ kwaa ŋɔ n be nyundua bela ŋɔ, ‘Kon Korowii aa laa o doŋa kpɔ o nɛɛ la, bɛ on kondoŋ lii kpa.’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛo kera atoro, asɛ kon la berɛ kaa nyundua kwaraa.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Buɡ la ta, dɛ baala batoro bane baa le Sisaaria ba tom ba n be denɔ ba jo dem maa lɔ o ta la ta.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ n bɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ń teŋɛ ba nɛɛ kaa. Yabala banumɛl nɔ baa le Jopa nɔ ɡe teŋɛ n nɛɛ la Sisaaria, asɛ ya bwa ka jo Kɔnɛɛleɔs dem.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Belaa o ɡe baɡle ɡɛ o ɡe aa na nyundua torome o dem, asɛ o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Tomɛ nɛn Jopa, ásɛ o la Seemɔn Pita be.

translation_verse: Wɛɛ bol waa he bee ásɛ he ne he dem tena bwa che a ta dɛ́ dɔ he nyu.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?

translation_verse: Baa no ɡɛ la, ba nyoa sɔɔhnɔ, asɛ ba jam Korowii dɛ ŋɔ, “Amɔ te Korowiirii tɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɡe ŋwɛnɛ, ásɛ ba charɛ ba liire, dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu!” Asɔre tena baa lɔ Anteɔk

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii dɛ cha ba o kpeɡri ne, asɛ nɛra no Yeesu waa la dɛ yaradaa, dɛ charɛ ba liire, dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛ Yeesu. A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ warɔ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Asɔre tena baa lɔ Jerusalam la baa no a ɡɛ waa nɔ, dɛ tomɛ Banabas ŋɔ ó la Anteɔk asɔre tena la be, dɛ́ ka na ɡɛ ba Korowii toma aa doa.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Waa la bela dɛ ka na ɡɛ Korowii aa nyin ba dɛɛ cha ba la, o sie lɛo. Anomanta, o ja ba dɛ do ba ɡbemba ŋɔ báa teŋɛ Yeesu ŋwɛnɛ ta ba bambile bwa ne.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ Banabas ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡe so o nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ. Dɛ o dɛ yarada Yeesu taeh dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo. Anomanta, nɛra charɛ ba liire pirim dɛ ba tomɛ Yeesu.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Banabas la Taasos dɛ ka ɡaaɡe Sɔɔl bɔr.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: Waa nao la, o kpɔɔ kaa Anteɔk. Baa lɔ bela la, ba benanyobir bwa, dɛ ba ne bela asɔre tena dɛ cheme. Ba baɡle nɛra pirim Yeesu waa bela. Anteɔk belaa ba tɔ sie yerɛ nɛra baa yarada Yeesu la Kristo tena.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii keamere bane le Jerusalam la Anteɔk.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba bini bɛl sɔne Aɡabus. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ir o nɛ, asɛ o ir che dɛ na chaahna dɛ ŋɔ lɔrchɔɡe bɛl dɛ́ ba ba harɛ la ta bala. Kpela, a ɡɛ waa nɔ balɔ Klɔdeɔs kara dii saŋ.

english_verse: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu habɔteŋra la ŋɔ baa pu siee ta suuɡa ɡɛ ba bɛlbwa aa wona laanee, dɛ́ ka tɛ ba bala asɔre tena baa lɔ Juda harɛ la mɔɔ lɔr la ba.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba ta a ɡɛ suuɡa la, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Banabas ne Sɔɔl ba ka tɛ Juda harɛ asɔre tena la nomonome.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ Juu tena kooro bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Hɛrɔd la larawe asɔre tena bane dɛɛ fiɡ ba.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ ba teŋe Jɔn dɔɔ Jems nyu.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Waa ɛ ɡɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ a lɛ Juu tena sie la, belaa o ɡel ba lawɛ Pita ɡe. Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen dii taa a ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡ.

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛrɔd aa lawɛ Pita la, o doo dea dɛ ɡel soojare bananaarɛ bele banaarɛ ɛɛ daahno. Dɛ o fe dɛ lii kɛ dɛ ba di Galekaa Tɔpejen la tonaa, o fee bol Pita waa nɛnfuuh baah ta dɛ́ pa bole ásɛ nomɛlbwa na.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do ba do Pita dea. Kɛ dɛ o bala asɔre tena la pɛpɛo dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛo tenten.

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛrɔd fe lawɛ tɔpere bɛl, dɛ́ fe bol Pita waa la dɛ́ pa bole. Jwaana la tɔɔ aa per ásɛ tɔpere la tel la, dɛ Pita chɔ soojare baa dɛ daahno la banɛ baah ta dɛɛ chɔ dom, asɛ jɔɡrɔre anɛ do o nɔɔra. Dɛ soojare banɛ lɔ dea la doonyoa dɛɛ daah bela.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ Korowii nyundua torome cheɡɛ dea la bini, asɛ bela chaah. O baa lɔ Pita dɛ chumu, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir warane!” Buɡ la taa, Pita nɔɔra jɔɡrɔre la foo le.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Asɛ nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Do he laala ne he naŋɡawa.” Pita aa ɛ ɡɛ nyundua torome la aa ŋɔa la, o berɔ kwaa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he yal tɔ, dɛ́ teŋɛ n nɛ.”

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Ba baa ɡarɛ boloɡle soojare aa dɛ daah la, dɛ ba ɡarɛ nɛɛte ɡe ja, dɛ ba tel doonyoa o ɡbera aa ɛ buni asɛ ba che o ta le buse dɛɛ jo bwɛjen la bini la. Baa dɛ tel ɡbera la bɔr, dɛ o ɡbo yao, asɛ ba le dɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl ta dɛɛ kaa. Buɡ la taa, nyundua torome la den nyoɡre.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Belaa Pita ta na waa aa ɛo la, dɛ ŋɔ, “Namee n ta jemɛ kɛ N Naa Korowiirii ɡela o nyundua torome nɔ ba lɛɛ mɛ le Kooro Hɛrɔd nɔn ta, dɛ lee mɛ waa Juu tena bwa fe aa dɛ lii kɛ mɛɛ nao la ta.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Waa na ɡɛ la, o la haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Mɛɛre la dem. A ɡɛ Mɛɛre nɔ biee Jɔn Mak. Dɛ nɛra cheme bela pirim dɛɛ soŋe Korowii.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Pita lɔ dem la ɡbera, asɛ tolo bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Roda ba dɛ fe ba yao.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: Waa no taa la kɛŋɔ Pitaa la, silɛɛ kohona ɡelɔ o ta berɛ ya ɡbera la, dɛ berɛ chwa la ka ŋɔ asɔre tena la be ŋɔ Pita cheɡɛ buse.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Ate, ba ŋɔ, “Choɡlaa hɛɛ we kɛɛ?” Baa dɛ tɔŋlo la bwa, dɛ o nyoa kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ wɛɛ baɡle kɛ kpelaa wɛɛ bol la. Anee ba ŋɔ, “Amɔ te o lalee.”

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Ate, dɛ Pita ta dɛ lɔ ɡbera la. Baa yaa dɛ nao la, ba nyoa kpoo.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Anee Pita kpɔ nɔn ɛɡ ba ŋɔ bá bwa tɔ nyoa, asɛ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa leo o dea doe la ta bwa. O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá ŋɔ Jems ne ba bala la kar la be, dɛ le kaa bobɛl.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, sibeɡra chole soojare baa dɛ daah bela la nɛɛ taeh, asɛ baa nyin Pita bɔr yalayala ken, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta wone jemɛ bela waa kpɔa.

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛrɔd aa baa no kɛŋɔ Pita nyoɡrɔ la, o ɡelɔ ba nyin o bɔr, kɛ ba ta on nae. Anomanta, o ɡelɔ ba bɔɔ soojare la waa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ŋɔ bá kpoo ba. Kooro Hɛrɔd seo wa A habɔɔ la, Kooro Hɛrɔd le Juda harɛ dɛ ka so Sisaaria tama.

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Dɛ o baah di bwɛɛre baa dɛ yera Taaya ne Sidon la tena nɛɛ taeh. Bela bwɛɛre nɔ tena nyoa pɛo, asɛ ba ba dɛ ba na Kooro bonɔɔna nomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Blastus la ŋɔ ó cha ba, dɛ́ larawe Kooro ásɛ ba ne o pɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Kooro Hɛrɔd harɛ taa a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛɛ yawɛ ba kondikwa.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛrɔd tɛɛ ba tɔpere báa berɛ kpɔ ba o be ja. A ɡɛ tɔpere la aa tela la, o do o koolaala dɛ so o kookara ta, dɛ bol waa baɡle nɛra la.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Waa bol waa la, nɛra la kooɡaɔ, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini laa bol waa nɔ. Voɡee berɛ nɛn dɛ bol waa la.”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Kooro Hɛrɔd aa wola ɡelɛ ba kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛ lɛ kpɛɛra la tɛ o te la, kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ Korowii nyundua torome baa lɔɔ bil, asɛ kpaloɡlare diu o sewɛ.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Banabas ne Sɔɔl aa ɛ toma baa tom ba ŋɔ bá la Jerusalam ka ɛ tonɛ la, ba ne Jɔn Mak kaa Anteɔk.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii keamere ne nɛra baa dɛ chaɡle nɛra Korowii waa ɡe lɔ Anteɔk asɔre tena la bini. Banee Banabas ne Semeon baa dɛ yerɔ Nɛmbiŋi la, ne Lusias waa le Sairini la, ne Manaen baa dɛɛro Kooro Hɛrɔd mɛɛ dem la, dɛ Sɔɔl.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ aa vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe baa ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé le Banabas ne Sɔɔl tɛ mɛ, ásɛ ba ɛ toma maa lee ba ŋɔ bá ba ɛ la.”

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ soŋe Korowii, dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra darawe nɛra banɛ la nɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba do Korowii nɔn ta, dɛ ɡel ba kaa. Banabas ne Sɔɔl la Saepros harɛ ta

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa tom ba la, ba la Sɛluusia, dɛ ka che bela kpɔ ɡbera kaa Saepros harɛ ta. Dɛ ekwii a ɡɛ harɛ nɔ.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Baa tel Saepros bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Salamis ta la, ba bol Korowii Waa baɡle nɛra bela Juu tena cheremi deene bini. Dɛ ba dɔ Jɔn Mak wɛɛ cha ba ba toma ta.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Ba ɡaaɡe Saepros harɛ la bwa ta, dɛ bol Korowii Waa baɡle nɛra, dɛ ka le o nyoa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Pafɔs la ta. Baa tel Pafɔs la, ba kaa na Juu te dobodobo te bɛl. Dɛ o sɔne Baa Jesɛs. Dɛ Grik tena ɡe dɛ yerɔ Ɛlemas. O koh o dobodobo la waa dɛɛ yerɛ o te Korowii keame.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: Dɛ ekwi la nomoa baa dɛ yerɔ Sɛɛjos Pɔɔlos la bee o do. A ɡɛ nomoa nɔ jemɛ waa taeh, dɛɛ nyin Korowii Waa dɛ́ no. Anomanta, o yerɛ Banabas ne Sɔɔl ba o be.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ dobodobo te la aa nyin kɛŋɔ nomoa la no Yeesu wa, dɛɛ tɔ Banabas ne Sɔɔl ŋwɛnɛ, dɛɛ tɔŋ ba.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ir Sɔɔl Grik tena aa dɛ yerɔ Pɔɔl la nɛ, asɛ o pa sie baa la nɛɛ dɛ nyiŋu dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: “Bɔnsam nɛn kohona, he hah wedɛɛɡa bwa kɛrɛdɛ! He lambaara kan ɡa. Bɛ he wechɔɡa la kpɔ tɔ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ no bonɔ. Korowii ɛɛ baɡle o kpeɡri he nɛɛ, ásɛ he nyoŋe, ásɛ a biɡri tama mɔɔ he berɛ won dɛɛ na bɔr.” Kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ o sie ɛo jumaa kɛŋɔ kɔɔla ken, o den nyoŋe, dɛɛ laɡre bɔr dɛɛ nyin nɛn ó lawɔ da.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Nomoa la aa na a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o yarada Yeesu waa dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Yeesu waa la baa dɛ chaɡle la kpo o nyoa. Pɔɔl ne o bala la bwɛjen Anteɔk waa lɔ Pisidia harɛ ta

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne nɛra o ne baa dɛ valɛ la jo ɡbera ta le Pafɔs bela, dɛ ba Pɛɛɡa waa lɔ Pamfilia harɛ ta. Jɔn Mak ɡel ba bela dɛ berɛ kaa Jerusalam.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne o nɛra la le Pɛɛɡa dɛ la bwɛjen Anteɔk waa lɔ Pisidia harɛ la ta. Ona Tɔpere la aa baa tel la, ba kaa jo bela Juu tena cheremi dea bini dɛ so.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Baa soɡe bela la, nɛra bane kure waane le Mosis Mmara Tɔn bini ne Korowii Keamere Tɔn bini, asɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi cheremi dea la bini waa ta la ŋɔ Pɔɔlwa be ŋɔ, “Yabala, dɛ he dɔ waane dɛ́ bol dɛ́ ja yaa aa, ŋwɛnɛ chɔ le.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Belaa Pɔɔl ir che dɛ kpɔ nɔn ɛɡ ba ŋɔ bá tɔ nyoa, dɛ ŋɔ, “N bala Israel tena ne he nɛra haa baa ja ya nɛɛ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii, hé no n be.

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Korowii ya Israel tena nɔ aa dɛ tomɛ la fa le ya naawa ŋɔ bá ɛ o nɛra nɛwɛnyina bwa bini. A ɡɛ saŋ baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ la, o ɡelɔ ba warɛ, asɛ ba sɔn ɡe le kohona. Belaa o ba kpɔ ba le Ijipt harɛ o kpeɡri ne,

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ do dɛɛɡɔ ásɛ waa Korowii keamere la aa bola la bɛ heyaa ɛ. Ba baɡlɔ ŋɔ,

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: Harɛre bele anuanɛ bwa nɛraa o doŋi ba harɛre ta Keenan harɛ ta, dɛ ɡel a ɡɛ harɛre la ɛ ba kwaa bene lafraanaarɛ fifraanue.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Korowii leo kora la ta, dɛ kpɔ Devid so. Korowii bol Devid waa ŋɔ, ‘Jese bie Devid waa too n tea, dɛkalkɛ onee n na kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɛ n tetoowaa bwa maa dɛ nyin kɛ o ɛ.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Gɛ Devid nɔ dea taa Korowii le Yeesu waa baɡɛ Israel tena nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo ó ba lɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Yeesu aa wola balɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ Jɔn dɛ baɡle Israel tena bwa ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ o sɔ ba Korowii ne.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Jɔn toma aa dɛ tonɛ la, o bɔɔ nɛra bane ŋɔ, ‘Nɛn besoo hɛɛ lii mɛ nɔ? Nɛn haa dɛ kpao la laa men. O ta lɔ habɔɔ. Maa o napaa tee kwaraa dɔ.’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: Yabala, Abraham naanar ne he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii bwa, ya bee waa aa dɛ ba nɛwɛnyini lɛɛ nɔ ba.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Jerusalam tena ne ba nomonome ta jemɛ kɛ Yeesuu nɛwɛnyini Lɛɛ la. Korowii waa o keamere aa chwera asɛ ba kure dɛɛ baɡ ba Ona Tɔpera bwa ta la, dɛ baa a mun no. A waa ba bol o waa dɛ pao bolchɔɡe, dɛ kpoo ɡɛ Korowii keamere aa baɡla ŋɔ baa ɛo la.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii berɛ iru seo ta.

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: O kpɔ o te baɡle nɛra o ne baa le Galilia harɛ kaa Jerusalam la kera aŋwɛnɛ bwa. A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ dɛɛ diu danseɛ Juu tena bwa be.

english_verse: God made a promise to our ancestors. And we are here to tell you the good news
translation_verse: Amanesoma nee ya ba he be. Gɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ ya naawa nyoa la,

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: ɡɛɛ o ɛ tɛ ya nɛra yaa ɛ ba naanar la. Anee kɛ o ir Yeesu seo ta. Ba chwerɛ o waa Korowii Yel Tɔn yel nɛɛte la bini ŋɔ, ‘N Biee hen, fini n berɛ he Mɛɛ.’

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa baɡle o waa o Tɔn bini ŋɔ wɛɛ iru seo taa ásɛ o bɛ bɔɔ bini chɔ pɔh laanee nɔ. ‘Mɛɛ ɛɛ wedɛɛɡa maa baɡɛ Devid nyoa kasinteŋ bwa ne laanee.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: A waa ba berɛ chwerɛ a ɡɛ tɔn la bobɛl ŋɔ, ‘Haa ɡel he Biɡoroŋ chɔ bɔɔ bini pɔh’ la.

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ Devid aa lole la, o ɛ Korowii tetoowaa kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo o naawa chɔɔbɔr, o bwadabii pɔh.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Kɛ nɛn la Korowii aa iru seo ta la te ta pɔeh.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya dɛ nyin kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesu waa waa ɛa la waa ya won dɛɛ bol he be ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ he wechɔɡaa kɛ heyaa la.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: ‘He nɛra haa nyiŋi nɛra dɛɛ vah dɛɛ mamɛ nɛra la, hé nyiŋi waa maa dɛ ɛ nɔ kɛrɛdɛ. Aa ba kpo he nyoa he serewe. Waa maa dɛ ɛ fini nɔ ɛ waane, dɛ nɛn baɡle a bini tɛ heyaa kwara naa, haa wola yarada!’ ”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl aa bol waa tonɛ la, o ne Banabas iro dɛɛ le cheremi dea la bini. Belaa nɛra baa bol waa baɡ ba la ŋɔ Pɔ́ɔlwa berɛ ba Ona Tɔpere waa ba ja la ta, dɛ́ ba bol waa la baɡ ba ja.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nɛra la aa le cheremibɔr bela la, Juu tena ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛ baa ja Juu tena nɛɛ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ Juu tena aa dɛ tomɔ la teŋɛ Pɔɔl ne Banabas nɛɛ pirim. Yeesu toroma la bol waa baɡ ba, dɛ ja ba ŋɔ báa teŋɛ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta ásɛ wɛɛ cha ba.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ona Tɔpere la aa bala ja la, bwɛɛ la tena kɛrɛdɛ bwa la cheremi dea bela dɛ ka no Korowii Wa.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Juu tena la aa na nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la aa wara kohona la, a ɛɛ ba bɔweela taeh, asɛ baa tɔŋle Pɔɔl ne Banabas dɛɛ ɛɛ ba nɛnhɛla.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Baa dɛ ɛ Pɔɔl ne Banabas nɛnhɛla la, ate ta kwaraa baa bol waa bansua ne dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Aŋwɛnɛ taa ya tɔ sie bol Korowii Amanesoma waa la he be la. Kɛ he ɡbaɡba aa vɛah dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he te ta Korowii mkpa la chɛɛ nɔ te naa, yaa ɡel heyaa dɛ́ la nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la be,

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ ya Dɔɔ ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ, ‘N le heyaa ŋɔ hé ɛ nii dɛɛ chaah nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bwa, ásɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa che he nɛɛ dɛ́ no Korowii Waa aa dɛ ba ba lɛɛ la he be.’ ”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la aa no waa nɔ la, ba sie lɛo taeh. Anomanta, ba jam Korowii kɛŋɔ waa ɡela ba no o waa la. Ásɛ nɛra Korowii aa ŋɔa baa dɔ o mkpa laanee la yarada Yeesu waa la, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te tɛo.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: O waa la perɛ bela bwɛɛre la bwa ta.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ bela Juu tena la ir bela bwɛjen nomonjena ne haahna bane baa ɛ nɛnjena dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la bwaawee, asɛ ba baah di Pɔɔl ne Banabas nɛ, ba hah ba dɛ doŋ ba le ba bela bwɛɛre la ta.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne Banabas pee ba napaala teera ta bela, dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ ba kpɔ Korowii Waa ba ba be, asɛ ba vɛah, dɛ kaa Ikooniam.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa aa dɛ ɛ la, bɔhwaah ta asɔre tena baa lɔ bela la lawɛ. Dɛ ba sie lɛo kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ɡe so ba nɛɛ taeh.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Kɛ bela Juu tena baa wola Yeesu waa yarada la te chɔɡ Pɔɔl ne Banabas sɔn, dɛ ir nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bwaawee, asɛ ba baah di nɛra baa yarada Yeesu waa la nɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne Banabas soɡe bela biɡri. Baa lɔ bela la, dɛ ba dɛ bol Yeesu waa bansua ne, dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ waa dɛ sune nɛwɛnyini nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba. O cha ba asɛ ba won dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa ne wekpeɡa, asɛ nɛra na dɛ jemɛ kɛ o waa baa dɛ bol la ɛ kpela.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen la tena baah peɡro, bane teŋɛ Juu tena la nɛ, bane ɡe teŋɛ Yeesu toroma la nɛ.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Juu tena la bane ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ne ba bela nomonome fe vɔrɔwɔ ŋɔ bá ɛ Yeesu toroma la hɔhɔrɔwa dɛ foɡ ba bwea ɡe.

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Dɛ baa bɛl lɔ Lestra dɛ so boobi le o bechale saŋ bwa, waa wola wone valɛ bwa.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol waa la bwa dɛ boobi la soɡe bela, dɛ cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no o be. Pɔɔl nao kɛ boobi la yarada waa waa dɛ bol la, dɛ na kɛ wɛɛ wonoo che o yarada la ta dɛ́ chaoh. Belaa o pa sie boobi la be,

english_verse: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
translation_verse: dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Ir che!” Asɛ boobi la fuɡri ir che chiŋ, dɛɛ valɛ.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Nɛra aa na waa nɔ la, ba bol waa ba Laikoonia wobol la ne kpeɡri nɛɛ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ya voɡaa berɛ nɛra dɛ ba ya be la!”

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Dɛ Seus voɡ dea cheɡɛ bwɛjen la ŋwɛnɛ ta, dahara nyoa tenten. Seus voɡ te kpɔ nae ne kwaa ba ɡe aa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ nɛra woowo le bwɛɛ la ŋwɛnɛ ta, dahara nyoa tenten, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin kɛ o ne o bwɛɛ tena kpo tɛ Yeesu toroma la kɛ voɡa ken.

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: “Bwɛɛla, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ ken nɔɔ? Nɛraa yan kɛ heyaa ken. Amanesoma nee ya ba he be, ásɛ he no dɛ́ ɡel konsale nɔ ne komɛlbwa toma, dɛ́ɛ tomɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ ta nyundua ne harɛ ne mpo, dɛ kwaa aa lɔ a ta bwa la.

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: A saŋ la, dɛ Korowii ɡelɔ he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɛɛ ɛ he tetoowa.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o cheɡɛ wedɛɛɡa waa dɛ ɛ la ta, dɛ ɡel he jemɛ kɛ o lole. Dɛ o dɛ tɛ heyaa bwaala ne, dɛ ɡel kondikwaa ɡee ɛ, asɛ he di dɛɛ vaɡɛ he bwara ɛɛ sɔɔh heya.”

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Juu tena bane baa le Ikooniam ne Anteɔk waa lɔ Pisidia harɛ ta la ba bela, dɛ ba bol waa dɛ berɛ Lestra tena la liire, asɛ ba baah di Pɔɔl nɛ. Ba foɡro bwea dɛ tuuɡu le bwɛjen la ta. Dɛ ba dɛ lii kɛ o sewɔ.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Nɛra baa yarada Yeesu waa la ba Pɔɔl be dɛ ba baro cheme, asɛ o ir dɛ berɛ jo bwɛjen la bini. Tɔ aa pera la, o ne Banabas la Dɛɛbe. Pɔɔl ne Banabas bera ba kaa Anteɔk

english_verse: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔlwa do ɡɛ bwɛɛre nɔ asɔre tena la ɡbemba ŋɔ báa teŋɛ Yeesu ŋwɛnɛ la ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ba nyoɡre, dɛ ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa na wahala kohona mɔɔ dɛ dɔ Korowii Kora la bini jo.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Bwɛɛre nɔ bɛlbwa ta asɔre tena aa lole la, Pɔɔl ne Banabas le ba bini bane ba ɛ ba nomonome. Nyoa vɔwa ne Korowii soŋa nee ba yon kpɔ nomoa la do Korowii baa kpɔ ba yarada bwa do o nɛɛ la nɔn ta.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Ba ɡaaɡe Pisidia harɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ che bela ba Pamfilia harɛ ta.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Ba bol Korowii waa Pɛɛɡa, dɛ che bela la Ataalia.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Belaa ba che kpɔ ɡbera dɛ laa berɛ ba Anteɔk. Anteɔkee ba fa kpɔ Pɔɔl ne Banabas do Korowii nɔn ta kɛŋɔ ó cha ba, asɛ ba ɛ toma baa tona taraken nɔ la.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Baa ba Anteɔk la, ba yerɛ asɔre tena la bwa cheme, dɛ baɡ ba ɡɛ Korowii aa kpɔ ba ɛ toma bwa, ne ɡɛ waa pili ŋwɛnɛ tɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ba ɡe jemɛ Yeesu waa dɛ yaradao la bwa.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Ba ne asɔre tena la soɡo biɡri.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Baala bane le Juda harɛ ba Anteɔk dɛ baa baɡle nɛra baa yarada Yeesu waa la dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ta he pena teŋe ɡɛ Mosis Mmara la aa baɡla la aa, haa Korowii mkpa dɔe ba.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne Banabas ne ɡɛ nɛra la tɔŋle dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ. Anomanta, ba tomɛ o ne Banabas ne Anteɔk asɔre tena la bane Jerusalam ŋɔ bá ka na Yeesu toroma la ne asɔre tena nomonome la a ɡɛ waa la wa.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Baa tom ba la, ba kaalɔ. Baa dɛ kaa la, ba kaa kpɔ harɛre ane baa dɛ yera Finiisia ne Samaria ta dɛɛ kaa, dɛɛ bol bela asɔre tena be ɡɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la aa bera dɛɛ yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo. Ba ɡe aa no ɡɛ la, ba sie lɛo taeh.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Baa tel Jerusalam la, Yeesu toroma la ne bela asɔre tena ne ba nomonome lɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ. Pɔɔlwa baɡle toma Korowii aa cheɡɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ ɛ bwa.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Dɛ asɔre tena la bane ɛ Farisii tena. Ba iro dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛ baa yarada Yeesu taraken la ɛɛ teŋe ba pena dɛɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara ɡe ta.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu toroma la ne asɔre tena nomonome la cheme dɛ nyiŋi waa la ta.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Ba bol waa dɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa la sie, asɛ Pita ir che dɛ ŋɔ, “Yabala, he jemɔ kɛ Korowiirii fa lee mɛ he bini ŋɔ ń bol o Amanesoma la baɡle banɔ la baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ásɛ ba ɡe no o waa dɛ yarada.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Korowiirii jemɛ nomɛlbwa nyu bini, dɛ tɛɛ ba o Domadɛɛɡe ɡɛ waa tɛ yaa la, dɛ baɡle kɛ o nɛraa ba ɡe.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: O ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ ba korɔ ya korɛ. Baa yarada Yeesu waa la waa Korowii laa ba wechɔɡa kpɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Aah dɛ ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ nyin kɛ he daah Korowii dɛ na nɔɔ? Dɛ bontɔɡa ya ne ya naawa bwa fa aa wola wone che la laa hɛɛ nyin he kpɔ choɡ ba nɔ naa?

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Aa maɡre! Yarada yaa yarada ya Dɔɔ Yeesu la waa o na ya sum dɛ cha yaa, dɛ lɛ yaa. Gɛ tentenee ba ɡe yaradao o lɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa cheme bela la bɛlbwa ta berɛ tɔŋle kpa, dɛ tɔ nyoa dɛɛ no Pɔɔl ne Banabas be. Pɔɔl ne Banabas baɡle nyokpowaa ne wekpeɡa Korowii aa kpɔ ba ɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bini.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Baa bol waa tonɛ la, Jems ɡe bol waa ŋɔ, “Yabala, hé no n be!

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Seemɔn Pita baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa tɔ sie ɛ dɛ baɡle kɛ o dɛ nyin nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la taeh. O baɡlɔ ŋɔ Korowii le ba bini bane ŋɔ ba ɛ o nɛra.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: ‘A habɔɔ la, mɛɛ berɔɔ ba nyiŋi Devid kora waa ɡua kɛŋɔ dea waa kua chole la ta. Mɛɛ berɔɔ ir ba kora la kɛŋɔ dea waa chola ba kwaa mao la, dɛ́ tɛ ba naa bɛl kpeɡri ásɛ o di kora ja,

english_verse: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
translation_verse: ásɛ harɛ ta nɛra baa kaa baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bwa ba nyin n bɔr, dɛ́ tom mɛ. Men lee ba ŋɔ ba ɛ n nɛra. N Naa Korowiirii ŋɔ ɡɛ.

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: Gɛ n te aa naa laanee kɛ, ya bɛ Mosis Mmara nɔ kpɔ dɛɛ ha nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛ charɛ ba liire dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta la,

english_verse: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: kɛ yá chwerɛ ba tɔn ŋɔ ba bɛ voɡa kwaa dɛɛ di, dɛ laa ba te kpɔ jwamane waa ta, dɛ bɛ kon baa wola o baŋa teŋe o sewɛ la dɛɛ di, dɛ bɛ chal dɛɛ di,

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ Mosis Mmara nɔ yaa baɡle a waa nɔ, bwɛɛre bɛlbwa taa nɛra baa dɛ baɡla la do. Ona Tɔpere te bɛlbwa taa baa kure Mosis Mmara waa nɔ cheremi deene ta, dɛ le saŋ la bwa ba le fini.” Tɔn baa chwera ka tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa yarada Yeesu la

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Belaa Yeesu toroma la ne asɔre tena la ne ba nomonome bwa ɛ ba liire kɛŋɔ, baa le ba bini banee, ásɛ dɛ tomɛ ba ne Pɔɔl ne Banabas Anteɔk. Judas baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Basabas la ne Silasee ba le. Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛ asɔre tena la nomonome baa dɛ tɔ ba sie la bane.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Asɛ ba chwerɛ tɔn tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá kpɔ kaa. Tɔn la bini waa nɔ, “Yabala haa lɔ Anteɔk ne Siiria harɛ ne Silisia harɛ haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, Yeesu toroma la ne ya asɔre tena ne ya nomonome yaa ɛ he bala Jerusalam la bwa dɛ na heya.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: Ya noɔ kɛ ya bini bane ba dɛ baɡle heyaa waane, asɛ he liire ɛ heyaa sakaa ken. Ya laa tom ba.

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya chemo ya nyoa pɛ, asɛ ya ŋɔ yaa le nɛraa ásɛ ba ne Banabas ne Pɔɔl ba wa aa too ya tea kohona la ba he be.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Ya ŋɔ Júdas ne Silas ɡe ja ba nɛɛ dɛ ba bol tɔn nɔ bini waa tenten hé no.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit has shown us that we should not place any extra burden on you.
translation_verse: Waa ya ne Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa naa laanee kɛ, aa were kɛ ya ɡel hɛɛ ki komɛlbwa ka ja anɔ aa dɛ ba wona cha heyaa nɔ ta.

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Anee kɛ, he bɛ voɡa kwaa dɛɛ di, he bɛ chal dɛɛ di, he bɛ ol baa wola o baŋa teŋe o sewɛ dɛɛ di, hé laa he te kpɔ jwamane waa ta. Dɛ he wono dɛɛ ki anɔ bwa naa, he wobɛlbwa ɛɛ maɡroo tɛ heya. Kórowii cha heya.”

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ tɔn la do Pɔɔl ne Banabaswa nɔn ta, dɛ ta ba ŋwɛnɛ, asɛ ba kaa Anteɔk. Ba kaa yerɛ bela asɔre tena bwa cheme, dɛ kpɔ tɔn la tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Baa kure tɔn la, ba sie lɛo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tɔn la do ba ɡbemba.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii keameree Judas ne Silas. Ba bol waa taeh dɛ kpɔ do ba ɡbemba, dɛ ja ba.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne Banabas te soɡe Anteɔk tama, asɛ ba ne ba bala bane ɛɛ bol Amanesoma la dɛɛ baɡle ya Dɔɔ Yeesu waa nɛra be. Pɔɔl ne Banabas dɔŋa baah peɡra

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Pɔɔl ŋɔ Banabas be ŋɔ ó ɡel ba berɛ la bwɛɛre baa baɡle nɛra Yeesu waa a ta la bwa ta, dɛ́ ka na ɡɛ ba bala baa baɡ ba Yeesu waa la aa doa.

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Dɛ Banabas dɛ nyin kɛ Jɔn Mak ja ba nɛɛ dɛ la.

english_verse: But Paul did not want to, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had stopped working with them.
translation_verse: Dɛ Pɔɔl ɡe be la, a ta maɡrɛ kɛ Jɔn Mak la bɛl, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o fa teŋɛ ba nɛɛ toma la ta, dɛ ka tel baah ta, dɛ chwa ɡel ba Pamfilia.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne Banabas beɡre wa, dɛ a nyoa kpeɡri, asɛ ba peɡri. Banabas kpɔ Jɔn Mak ja o nɛɛ ba jo ɡbera ta kaa Saepros,

english_verse: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.
translation_verse: asɛ Pɔɔl ɡe kpɔ Silas. Baa dɛ ba kaala la, asɔre tena la kpɔ ba do Korowii nɔn ta ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl baa le Dɛɛbe ne Lestra dɛ ba na asɔre te bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Timoti la bela. Dɛ o nya ɛ Juu te dɛɛ yarada Yeesu wa. Asɛ o mɛɛ te ɛ Grik te.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Dɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Lestra ne Ikooniam la bwa dɛ yerɛ Timoti sɔndɛɛɡe taeh.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl sie lɛ Timoti nɛ, asɛ wɛɛ nyin kɛ o teŋɛ o nɛ, dɛ koh Juu tena baa lɔ bela la waa dɛ teŋe Timoti pen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba jemɔ kɛ Grik tee o mɛɛ.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Baa valɛ bwɛɛre la ta dɛɛ kaa la, ba bol koŋkiila Yeesu toroma la ne Jerusalam asɔre tena nomonome la aa baɡla kɛ nɛ́ra ɛɛ ki la waa bela asɔre tena be.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Gɛɛ ba ɛ dɛ won cha bela asɔre tena ba do kpeɡri Yeesu waa baa dɛ yarada la ta, asɛ nɛnfala ɡe baa ja ba nɛɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa. Pɔɔl wepila waa naa

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: Ba valɔ dɛ ka kpɔ harɛre baa dɛ yera Frejea ne Galaasia la ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ta ban ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ bá bol Yeesu waa la Eesia harɛ.

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: Baa dɛ kaa dɛ ka tel Maesea harɛ jaɡa la, ba fe ŋɔ bá jo Bitiinia harɛ ta, kɛ Yeesu Domadɛɛɡe ta ban ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ,

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: asɛ ba berɛ kpɔ Maesea harɛ ta kaa Troas.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Awola jwaana ne la, Pɔɔl na wepila ane. O nao kɛ Makidoonia harɛ te bɛl aa cheɡa dɛɛ soŋo dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ba Makidoonia dɛ ba lɛ yaa.”

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Pɔɔl aa na wepila la, men maa dɛ chwerɛ tɔn nɔ ne o kpɔ ya te dɛ kaa Makidoonia harɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya jemɔ kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyin kɛ ya la ka bol Amanesoma la bela tena be. Liidia liire chara dɛ́ yarada Korowii

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya cheɡɛ Troas jo ɡbera ta, dɛ pa sie kaa Samotres. Tɔ aa pera la, ya la Neapolis,

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: dɛ ka che bela kpɔ harɛ kaa Felepae. Dɛ Felepae nɔɔ ɛ Makidoonia be pera bwɛɛre la bwa bwɛjen. Dɛ koojen waa dɛ nyiŋi Rom harɛ laanee dɔ bela. Ya biɡri bela tama.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Ona Tɔpere la ta la, ya le dem dɛ la bwɛɛ la moo nyoa. Dɛ ya dɛ lii kɛ Juu tena ɛɛ dɛɛ cheme belaa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii. Dɛ haahna bane cheme bela, asɛ ya so harɛ dɛ bol waa ba be.

english_verse: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛ no waa yaa bola la, bɛl sɔne Liidia. Yale aa kɔlaa wɛɛ yoɡ, dɛ do bwɛjen Tiatra dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii. Waa dɛ no waa Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol la, Korowii pili o liire, asɛ o noa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: Ya sɔ o ne o dem tena bwa Korowii ne, asɛ o soŋe yaa ŋɔ, “Dɛ he jemɔ ŋɔ n dɛ tomɛ Korowii kɛrɛdɛ naa, amɔ hé ba so n be.” O soŋe yaa, asɛ ya kaa o dem. Ba lawɛ Pɔɔl ne Silas do dea

english_verse: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, ya dɛ la Korowii soŋebɔr moo nyoa bela dɛ ka na bitolo bɛl. Dɛ nɛra bane yomii, asɛ kwaa ɡe ɛɛ ir o nɛ, asɛ o yon dɛɛ voɡɛ. Dɛ o voɡa la ɡelɔ nɛra baa dɔɔ la ɛɛ dɔ suuɡa taeh.

english_verse: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.”
translation_verse: A ɡɛ bitolo la do lɔŋɔre teŋɛ ya ne Pɔɔl nɛɛ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii tomɛ nɛra nɔ he be la! Waa haa ɛ ásɛ Korowii lɛ heyaa laanee baa bol la!”

english_verse: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone!” At once the evil spirit left her.
translation_verse: Tɔpera aŋwɛnɛ bwa dɛ ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ɛ, anomanta, a baa pe Pɔɔl, asɛ o berɛ habɔɔ dɛ kpɔ bandia ŋɔ kwaa la aa dɛ ir yomhaah la nɛɛ la be ŋɔ, “Yeesu Kristo sɔn ta, hé le o nɛ!” Buɡ la ta, dɛ kwaa la le o nɛ.

english_verse: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.
translation_verse: Kwaa la aa lea la, dɛ yomhaah la aa wone dɛɛ voɡɛ kpa. Nɛra baa dɔɔ la aa naa kɛŋɔ o bɛ won voɡa la tɔ ba suuɡa dɔe ŋwɛnɛ la, ba lawɛ Pɔɔl ne Silas dɛ tɛɡ ba kaa ba bela Rom nomonome be bombaah ta.

english_verse: They are telling us to do things we Romans are not allowed to do.”
translation_verse: Wefala aa wola toole ya mmara ta kɛ ya Rom tena teŋɛ a ta laanee baa baɡle.”

english_verse: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛnlaa bane lɔ bela dɛɛ chɛɡre Pɔɔl ne Silas, asɛ Rom nomonome la wur Pɔɔl ne Silas laala, dɛ ɡel ba lɔɔ ba chweremi ne.

english_verse: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.
translation_verse: Ba ɡelɔ ba lɔɔ ba kohona dɛ tɔ ba dea, dɛ ŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa tɔ ba dea nɛɛ la be ŋɔ ó nyiŋi ba nɛɛ ba bɛ ba chwa.

english_verse: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.
translation_verse: Rom nomonome la aa bol ɡɛ la, nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa tɔ ba dea nɛɛ la kpɔ Pɔɔl ne Silas ka do loŋ ta, dɛ do daa ba nakpale ta.

english_verse: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.
translation_verse: Harambaŋa la, dɛ Pɔɔl ne Silas dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, asɛ nɛra baa do ba dea ja ba nɛɛ la ɛɛ no ba be.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.
translation_verse: Kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ harɛ jiɡro kohona, asɛ deene la jiɡri le mun ta ka le nyundua. Kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ deene la ɡbeni bwa pilo, asɛ jɔɡrɔre baa do nɛra la bwa cha le ba nɔɔra ta.

english_verse: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.
translation_verse: Nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa do ba dea la iro, dɛ na kɛ ɡbeni la aa pila. Waa na ɡɛ la, o te ŋɔ nɛra la bwa chwao, dɛ laa o kere kpɔ ŋɔ ó kpo o te.

english_verse: But Paul shouted, “Don't harm yourself! No one has escaped.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Pɔɔl do lɔŋɔ kpeɡri nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Bɛ he te kpo! Ya bwa lole!”

english_verse: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.
translation_verse: Belaa nomoa la ŋɔ bá tɛo kandea. Baa ba kandea ne la, o chwao jo Pɔɔl ne Silas be. Dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ ɔma tenten, asɛ o bwara ɛɛ sa, asɛ o ba ɡuŋi ba sie.

english_verse: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, “What must I do to be saved?”
translation_verse: O laɡ ba le buse dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Nomonome, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ ásɛ Korowii lɛɛ mɛ nɔ?”

english_verse: They replied, “Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.”
translation_verse: Belaa ba ŋɔ, “Yarada ya Dɔɔ Yeesu dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛo. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, wɛɛ lɛ he ne he dem tena bwaa.”

english_verse: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba bol Yeesu waa la baɡle o ne nɛra baa lɔ o dem la bwa.

english_verse: While it was still night, the jailer took them to a place where he could wash their cuts and bruises. Then he and everyone in his home were baptized.
translation_verse: Awola harambaŋa la ne la, nomoa la yaɡle chal la aa ɛ Pɔɔlwa bwara la. Dɛ lɔɔraa Rom nomonome baa dɛ bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole la ɡel ba lɔɔ ba, asɛ chal ɛ ba bwara. O ne o dem tena bwaa ba sɔ Korowii nee awola,

english_verse: They were very glad they had put their faith in God. After this, the jailer took Paul and Silas to his home and gave them something to eat.
translation_verse: asɛ o kpɔ ba ba o dem, dɛ ba tɛɛ ba kondikwaa ba di. Ate, o ne o dem tena bwa sie lɛ kɛŋɔ baa yarada Korowii dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo la.

english_verse: The next morning the officials sent some police with orders for the jailer to let Paul and Silas go.
translation_verse: Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ ne la, Rom nomonome la tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ba ŋɔ nomoa la be ŋɔ ó ɡel Pɔɔl ne Silas kaa.

english_verse: The jailer told Paul, “The officials have ordered me to set you free. Now you can leave in peace.”
translation_verse: Belaa o ŋɔ Pɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Rom nomonome tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ba le he ne Silas dea. Anomanta, hé le, dɛ́ kaa. Kórowii ka do heya.”

english_verse: But Paul told the police, “We are Roman citizens, and the Roman officials had us beaten in public without giving us a trial. They threw us into jail. Now do they think they can secretly send us away? No, they cannot! They will have to come here themselves and let us out.”
translation_verse: Anee Pɔɔl ŋɔ toroma la be ŋɔ, “Rom tenaa ya bwa, kɛ ba lɔɔ yaa pɛɛpɛɛ bombaah ta dɛ tɔ yaa dea, dɛ ba ta ya waa bolɛ dɛ na wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ya nɛ. Aah taraken nɔ sɔeh ba berɛ dɛɛ nyin dɛ sɔh ta yaa nɔ naa? Aa maɡre! Hé ɡel Rom nomonome la ɡbaɡba ba lawɛ yaa le!”

english_verse: When the police told the officials that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, the officials were afraid.
translation_verse: Toroma la kaa bol Pɔɔl waa waa bola la Rom nomonome la be. Nomonome la aa noa kɛŋɔ Pɔɔl ne Silas ɛ Rom tena la, ba ɔmɔ.

english_verse: So they came and apologized. They led them out of the jail and asked them to please leave town.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba baa do ba jaŋɡbare, dɛ laɡ ba le bela baa do ba dea la, dɛ soŋ ba ŋɔ bá le bwɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: But Paul and Silas went straight to the home of Lydia, where they saw the Lord's followers and encouraged them. Then they left.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne Silas aa le bela la, ba la Liidia dem. Ba kaa na bwɛɛ la asɔre tena la bela, dɛ bol waa baɡ ba, dɛ do ba ɡbemba dɛ kaa.

english_verse: After Paul and his friends had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they went on to Thessalonica. A synagogue was in that city.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne Silas aa ira dɛɛ kaa la, ba kaa kpɔ bwɛɛre ane baa dɛ yera Amfepɔles ne Apolonia ta dɛ ka le Tesalonika. Dɛ Tesalonika Juu tena dɔ cheremi dea bela.

english_verse: So as usual, Paul went there to worship, and on three Sabbaths he spoke to the people. He used the Scriptures
translation_verse: Pɔɔl la cheremi dea bela ɡɛ o yon dɛɛ ɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta la. Waa lɔ bela la, o yawanyoa atoro bwa dɛ o ne Juu tena la dɛ bol waa dɛɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa Korowii waa baa chwera la ta.

english_verse: Some of them believed what Paul had said, and they became followers with Paul and Silas. Some Gentiles and many important women also believed the message.
translation_verse: Bane yarada Pɔɔl waa la, dɛ ba ja o ne Silas nɛ. Bela haahna baa ɛ nɛnjena la ɡalɡa, ne bela Grik tena baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la ɡalɡa ɡe baa ja ba nɛ.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders were jealous and got some troublemakers who hung around the marketplace to start a riot in the city. They wanted to drag Paul and Silas out to the mob, and so they went straight to Jason's home.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa yarada Pɔɔlwa waa la, dɛ baa ja asɔre tena la nɛɛ la aa dɛ warɛ la, dɛ aa somɛ Juu tena la be, asɛ ba ka nyin nɛŋkasale baa wola toma dɔe dɛ yon do dembaah dɛɛ ɡaaɡe ɡbo la, dɛ ir ba bwaawee, asɛ ba ne ba valɛ dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa bwɛɛ la bwa. Ba la Jasen dem ŋɔ bá fe ka lawɛ Pɔɔl ne Silas ba tɛ bwɛɛla la.

english_verse: But when they did not find them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the Lord's followers. They took them to the city authorities and shouted, “Paul and Silas have been upsetting things everywhere. Now they have come here,
translation_verse: Baa wola ban dɔe lawɛ la, ba tɛɡre Jasen ne asɔre tena la bane ka tɛ bwɛɛ la nomonome, dɛ nyɛɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ, ban chɔɡ nɛra liire bobɛlbwa dɛɛ valɛ dɛ ɡel bobɛlbwa ɛɛ ɛ yeŋyeŋ la. Taraken ba ba ya bwɛɛ nɔ ta,

english_verse: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. All of them break the laws of the Roman Emperor by claiming that someone named Jesus is king.”
translation_verse: asɛ Jasen ɡe lɛɛ ba do o dem. Waa ya Koojen Siisa aa wola nyin laanee baa ɛ. Ba ŋɔ Koojen bɛl ɡe berɔ do le ja ya Koojen nɔ nɛ. Dɛ o sɔne Yeesu.”

english_verse: The officials and the people were upset when they heard this.
translation_verse: Bwɛɛ la tena ne ba nomonome aa no waa nɔ la, a ɡelɔ ba liire ɛ sakaa.

english_verse: So they made Jason and the other followers pay bail before letting them go. People in Berea Welcome the Message
translation_verse: Nomonome la ɡelɔ Jasen ne asɔre tena la kpɔ suuɡa cheɡ ajinamuu kɛŋɔ baa wobɛlbwaa ɛ kpa. Jasenwa waa baa ɛa laanee ba nyiŋi dɛ lɛɛ ba suuɡa dɛ ta ba. Pɔɔl ne Silas Bɛrea laŋa

english_verse: That same night the Lord's followers sent Paul and Silas on to Berea, and after they arrived, they went to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Bɔr aa baa jo la, asɔre tena la kpɔ Pɔɔl ne Silas kaa Bɛrea. Baa la bela la, ba kaa jo bela cheremi dea bini.

english_verse: The people in Berea were much nicer than those in Thessalonica, and they gladly accepted the message. Day after day they studied the Scriptures to see if these things were true.
translation_verse: Dɛ bela Juu tena la waa do kɛrɛdɛ ɡwaa Tesalonika Juu tena, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba lɛ Yeesu waa la silɛɛ ne, dɛ won dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Tɔn bini tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ́ɛ na, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ waa Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol la, kpelaa kɛɛ nyosonee yɔ.

english_verse: Many of them put their faith in the Lord, including some important Greek women and several men.
translation_verse: Nɛra la kɛrɛdɛ yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo. Grik haahna baa ɛ nɛnjena la kɛrɛdɛ ne ba baala bwa yarada Yeesu.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders in Thessalonica heard that Paul had been preaching God's message in Berea, they went there and caused trouble by turning the crowds against Paul.
translation_verse: Juu tena baa lɔ Tesalonika aa noa kɛŋɔ Pɔɔl kaa bol Korowii Waa Bɛrea ɡe la, ba ba bela dɛ ba do ba, asɛ ba bwaawee ir Pɔɔlwa nɛ.

english_verse: At once the followers sent Paul down to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.
translation_verse: Belaa asɔre tena la ɡel Pɔɔl kaa mpo nyoa buɡ ta, asɛ Silas ne Timoti te so Bɛrea.

english_verse: Some men went with Paul as far as Athens, and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible. Paul in Athens
translation_verse: Nɛra la baa tɔ Pɔɔl sie dɛɛ kaa o ne la, ba la o ne ka tel Atens, dɛ berɛ kaa Bɛrea. Baa dɛ kaa la, Pɔɔl ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ Silas ne Timoti be ásɛ ba ba o be warane. Pɔɔl ne Silas bwɛjen Atens laŋa

english_verse: While Paul was waiting in Athens, he was upset to see all the idols in the city.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl aa soɡe bwɛjen Atens bela dɛɛ kpa Silas ne Timoti la, o nao kɛ voɡa su bwɛɛ la bwa. Waa na ɡɛ la, o tea bini chɔɡɔ.

english_verse: He went to the synagogue to speak to the Jews and to anyone who worshiped with them. Day after day he also spoke to everyone he met in the market.
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ o dɛ la bela cheremi dea o ne Juu tena, ne Grik tena baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ Juu tena aa dɛ tomɔ la kaa nyiŋi Korowii waa la bini. Dɛ tɔpere bɛlbwaa wɛɛ so bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaah, asɛ dɛɛ bol waa nɛra baa dɛ ba bela la be, asɛ o ne baa nyiŋi Korowii waa la bini.

english_verse: Some of them were Epicureans and some were Stoics, and they started arguing with him. People were asking, “What is this know-it-all trying to say?” Some even said, “Paul must be preaching about foreign gods! That's what he means when he talks about Jesus and about people rising from death.”
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra bane hweli bela wejema baa dɛ yera Epikuria ne Stoik la, dɛ ɡe ɛ ɡɛ wejema la chachaɡla bela. Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɡe dɛ tɔŋlo dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ wobobala te nɔ ɡee bol nɔɔ?” Asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Jamɔ harɛ bɛl voɡa waa wɛɛ bol nɔ.” Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol Yeesu ne seo ta ira waa ba lii ɡɛ la.

english_verse: They brought Paul before a council called the Areopagus, and said, “Tell us what your new teaching is all about.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ba kpɔ Pɔɔl kaa bela nomonome baa dɛ yer ba Areɔpaɡos tena la, dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baɡle he wefala haa kpoŋa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe la bini yá no.

english_verse: We have heard you say some strange things, and we want to know what you mean.”
translation_verse: Ya ta he waa nɔ te dɔŋa noɛ bwa, anomanta, ya dɛ nyin kɛ he baɡle yaa a mun.”

english_verse: More than anything else the people of Athens and the foreigners living there loved to hear and to talk about anything new.
translation_verse: Dɛ Atens tena ne ba hɔɔhra tomaa wefala bola ne wefala pɛɛra dɛ́ no.

english_verse: So Paul stood up in front of the council and said: People of Athens, I see that you are very religious.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl aa cheɡɛ nomonome la sie la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N nao kɛŋɔ he Atens tena dɛ tomɛ voɡa kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: As I was going through your city and looking at the things you worship, I found an altar with the words, “To an Unknown God.” You worship this God, but you don't really know him. So I want to tell you about him.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ maa dɛ ɡaaɡe he bwɛɛ nɔ ta dɛ na bɔra haa dɛ tomɛ la, n na kon haa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, dɛ na kɛŋɔ baa chwerɛ bobɛl ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɛ tomɔ, kɛ yaa on jemɛ.’ Kon haa wola on jemɛ dɛ ɡee tomɔ la, o waa mɛɛ bol he be la. O sɔne Korowii.

english_verse: This God made the world and everything in it. He is Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ta harɛ ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa. On dɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa. O waane laa chɔɔbɔra nɛwɛnyini aa maa tɛo la wa.

english_verse: He doesn't need help from anyone. He gives life, breath, and everything else to all people.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini kondikwaa waa laa o do le, waa nɛwɛnyini komɛlbwa nyin, dɛkalkɛŋɔ on dɛɛ tɛ yaa mkpa ne hweera ne komɛlbwa.

english_verse: From one person God made all nations who live on earth, and he decided when and where every nation would be.
