english_verse: Day and night our twelve tribes have earnestly served God, waiting for his promised blessings. King Agrippa, because of this hope, some of our leaders have brought charges against me.
translation_verse: Ya Juu tena deene fi dɛ anɛ tena la bwaa dɛɛ yarada Korowii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa baɡɛ yaa nyoa laanee, dɛ koh a waa dɛɛ tomɔ sibeɡra ne chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa. N Naa kooro, webeŋkpoŋ nɔ ya bwa aa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o ta nɔ, onee ba kpɔ dawɛ n nɛɛ ŋɔ n ɛ wechɔɡa la. Na nɔ!

english_verse: I did this first in Jerusalem, and with the authority of the chief priests I put many of God's people in jail. I even voted for them to be killed.
translation_verse: Maa lɔ Jerusalam la, dɛ ɡɛ toma nɔɔ mɛɛ ɛ. N soŋe Sɔfonomonome ba tɛ mɛ kpeɡri, asɛ n larawe Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra do deene pirim. Gɛ saŋ la, dɛ ba bol ba waa dɛ pa ba bolchɔɡe ŋɔ bá kpoo ba aa, ɡɛɛ n ɡe sɛh teŋɛ ba kpoora la ta.

english_verse: I often had them punished in our synagogues, and I tried to make them give up their faith. In fact, I was so angry with them, that I went looking for them in foreign cities.
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɛ la cheremi deene bini saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ kaa ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa taeh, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ba bol Korowii nɛnhɛlwaa ásɛ n laɡ ba. Ba waa aa dɛ di n baah kohona nomanta, n ti ba dɛɛ la bwɛɛre aa wola Juu tena bwɛɛre ɛɛ kwaraa ta, dɛ kaa ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa.

english_verse: King Agrippa, one day I was on my way to Damascus with the authority and permission of the chief priests.
translation_verse: Gɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ bɛlee n soŋe Sɔfonomonome be, asɛ ba tɛ mɛ kpeɡri ŋɔ ń la Damaskɔs.

english_verse: About noon I saw a light brighter than the sun. It flashed from heaven on me and on everyone traveling with me.
translation_verse: N Naa kooro, yaa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la, ɡɛ saŋ wee aa cheɡɛ nyufala la, n ne nyiŋa dɛ nii le nyundua dɛ chaah bɔr ɡwaa wee, dɛ chaah bɔr bar n ne nɛra yaa dɛ valɛ la.

english_verse: We all fell to the ground. Then I heard a voice say to me in Aramaic, “Saul, Saul, why are you so cruel to me? It's foolish to fight against me!”
translation_verse: Belaa ya bwa choɡli harɛ, asɛ n no kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa kpɔ ya bwɛɛ Juu tena wobol dɛɛ bol waa n be, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Oo, Sɔɔl! Ɛrɛɛ he che n nɛɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ? He ɡbaɡbaa hɛɛ ɛ la. He ne nao baa doo ŋwɛn dɛɛ teɡɔ o ta naa dɛɛ yaɡre o dɔɔ da bwa beŋkpoŋ.’

english_verse: “Who are you?” I asked. Then the Lord answered, “I am Jesus! I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Anee n ŋɔ, ‘Henee umeo, n Dɔɔ?’ Asɛ o ŋɔ, ‘Menee Yeesu haa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ la.

english_verse: Now stand up. I have appeared to you, because I have chosen you to be my servant. You are to tell others what you have learned about me and what I will show you later.”
translation_verse: Ir che! N dɛ nyin n lee ásɛ he ɛ n bonɔɔ dɛ valɛ dɛɛ bol waa haa naa fini nɔ, ne anɔ la haa naa kerekere la nɛra be. A waa n kpɔ n te chaɡle la.

english_verse: The Lord also said, “I will protect you from the Jews and from the Gentiles that I am sending you to.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tomɛɛ Juu tena ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bwa bee, dɛɛ kisii wechɔɡe ba be.

english_verse: I want you to open their eyes, so they will turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God. Then their sins will be forgiven, and by faith in me they will become part of God's holy people.”
translation_verse: Hen dɛ́ ka pili ba sie, ásɛ ba le biro ta dɛ́ ba bochaah ta bela nii aa lole, dɛ́ le Bɔnsam nɔn ta dɛ́ ba Korowii be, ásɛ o kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, ásɛ ba ba ja nɛra baa yarada mɛ n sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta ba ɛ n bii la nɛ.’

english_verse: First I preached to the people in Damascus, and then I went to Jerusalem and all over Judea. Finally, I went to the Gentiles and said, “Stop sinning and turn to God! Then prove what you have done by the way you live.”
translation_verse: N tɔ sie la Damaskɔs, dɛ la Jerusalam, dɛ ɡaaɡe Juda harɛ la te bwa, dɛ la harɛre a nɛra aa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɡe ta. Maa dɛ ɡaaɡe la bwa, dɛ n dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire, dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ ba Korowii be, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ba we-ɛɛla chaɡle kɛ ba charɛ ba liire dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: That is why some men grabbed me in the temple and tried to kill me.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔ waa Juu tena laɡ mɛ ɡɛ saŋ maa lɔ Korowii Dea la, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin n kpoe.

english_verse: But all this time God has helped me, and I have preached both to the rich and to the poor. I have told them only what the prophets and Moses said would happen.
translation_verse: Dɛ le ɡɛ saŋ nɔ bwa ba le fini nɔ, n dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii alaworomɛɛ n ta do le, dɛ won che he sie dɛɛ di waa nɔ danseɛ nomonjena ne bechale bwa be nɔ. Waa Korowii keamere ne Mosis fa aa dɛ bol ŋɔ aa ɛo laanee n ɡe ɛɛ bol.

english_verse: Before Paul finished defending himself, Festus shouted, “Paul, you're crazy! Too much learning has driven you out of your mind.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol waa ken la, Koojen Fɛstɔs kɔro ŋɔ, “Pɔɔl, choɡlaa dɛɛ wee kɛɛ? He tɔn jema kohona laanee dɛɛ wee choɡla la!”

english_verse: But Paul replied, “Honorable Festus, I am not crazy. What I am saying is true, and it makes sense.
translation_verse: Anee Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Nomoa, choɡla laa mɛɛ we! Kasinteŋ torodoo mɛɛ bol la.

english_verse: None of these things happened off in a corner somewhere. I am sure that King Agrippa knows what I am talking about. That's why I can speak so plainly to him.”
translation_verse: N Naa kooro Aɡrepa te jemɛ waa maa dɛ bol nɔ bwa. A waa maa wola waa bola o sie ɔmɛ la. N jemɔ kɛŋɔ a bɛlbwa ta o habɔɔ leɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a bɛlbwa ta waa baa sɔah ɛ ɛɛ.

english_verse: Then Paul said to Agrippa, “Do you believe what the prophets said? I know you do.”
translation_verse: N Naa kooro, he yarada waa Korowii aa ɡela o keamere la bol la aa? N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he yaradaa.”

english_verse: Agrippa asked Paul, “In such a short time do you think you can talk me into being a Christian?”
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Aɡrepa ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛ hɛɛ wonoo ɡel n berɛ asɔre te buɡ nɔ ta kɛɛ?”

english_verse: Paul answered, “Whether it takes a short time or a long time, I wish you and everyone else who hears me today would become just like me! Except, of course, for these chains.”
translation_verse: Anee Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Dɛ buɡ nɔ taa yoo, dɛ kerekeree yoo, n te waa maa dɛ soŋe Korowii laanee kɛŋɔ, he ne nɛra baa dɛ no n waa fini nɔ fe do kɛŋɔ maa doa nɔ. Kɛ maa soŋe kɛ ba doe jɔɡrɔre kɛ baa do mɛ nɔ te.”

english_verse: Then King Agrippa, Governor Festus, Bernice, and everyone who was with them got up.
translation_verse: Belaa Kooro Aɡrepa ne Nomoa Fɛstɔs ne Bɛnes, ne nɛra baa lɔ bela la bwa ir,

english_verse: But before they left, they said, “This man isn't guilty of anything. He doesn't deserve to die or to be put in jail.”
translation_verse: asɛ baa le bela la, baa ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ wobɛlbwa ta baɡlɛ kɛ o chɛ kpoe, kɛɛ ba doo dea.”

english_verse: Agrippa told Festus, “Paul could have been set free, if he had not asked to be tried by the Roman Emperor.”
translation_verse: Kooro Aɡrepa ŋɔ Nomoa Fɛstɔs be ŋɔ, “Dɛ ken laa o soŋe ŋɔ hé la o ne Rom Koojen Siisa be ó ka bol o waa dɛ́ pa bole nɔ naa, n fe ɛɛ ŋɔɔ hé kpɔɔ ta wɛɛ la.”

english_verse: When it was time for us to sail to Rome, Captain Julius from the Emperor's special troops was put in charge of Paul and the other prisoners.
translation_verse: Ba vɔrɔwɔ ŋɔ yá kpɔ nee ta kaa Itali harɛ bela Rom Koojen aa soɡa la. Anomanta, ba kpɔ Pɔɔl ne nɛra bane baa do ba ɡe dea ja o nɛɛ la tɛ Rom Koojen soojanomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Juleɔs la.

english_verse: We went aboard a ship from Adramyttium that was about to sail to some ports along the coast of Asia. Aristarchus from Thessalonica in Macedonia sailed on the ship with us.
translation_verse: Stiimae bɛl le Adramitium ba, asɛ ya jo o ta dɛɛ kaa. Dɛ o dɛ kaa Eesia harɛ mpo nyoa bwɛɛre ta. Dɛ baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Aristakus ja ya nɛ. Makidoonia harɛ bwɛɛ Tesalonika la taa o le.

english_verse: The next day we came to shore at Sidon. Captain Julius was very kind to Paul. He even let him visit his friends, so they could give him whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera laanee ya jo Sidon. Juleɔs kpoŋe Pɔɔl kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó ka na o daamanar, ásɛ ba tɛo kwaa aa chɛ kɛ o dɔ o ŋwɛnɛ la ta.

english_verse: When we left Sidon, the winds were blowing against us, and we sailed close to the island of Cyprus to be safe from the wind.
translation_verse: Ya cheɡɛ bela dɛɛ kaa, asɛ peu ka ta dɛɛ cheme yaa. Anomanta, ya berɔ kaa Saepros waa ɛ ekwi la baŋ bobɛl peu la aa wola bela te ta la dɛ kaa.

english_verse: Then we sailed south of Cilicia and Pamphylia until we came to the port of Myra in Lycia.
translation_verse: Ya kpɔ mpo ta ɡɛ dɛɛ la dɛ ka fɛrɛ Silisia ne Pamfilia jwɛh, dɛ ka chuɡe Maera waa lɔ Lisia harɛ ta la.

english_verse: There the army captain found a ship from Alexandria that was going to Italy. So he ordered us to board that ship.
translation_verse: Belaa sooja nomoa la na Alɛksandrea tena stiimae bɛl waa dɛ kaa Itali harɛ, dɛ kpɔ yaa do o ta.

english_verse: We sailed along slowly for several days and had a hard time reaching Cnidus. The wind would not let us go any farther in that direction, so we sailed past Cape Salmone, where the island of Crete would protect us from the wind.
translation_verse: Ya kaalɔ tama tama ken tɔpera anɛ, mɔɔ dɛ ta ba tel Kenaedes, dɛkalkɛ dɛ peu aa yaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ. Peu la aa wola ŋwɛnɛ tɛ la, ya pa sie Kret ne Salmone a bwa aa ɛ ekwie la baah ta, dɛ fɛrɛ Kret baŋ bela peu la aa wola bela te ta la dɛɛ kaa.

english_verse: We went slowly along the coast and finally reached a place called Fair Havens, not far from the town of Lasea.
translation_verse: Yaa fɛrɛ Kret harɛ baŋ pera bela kaa la, a no yaa kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ ya ba le leebɔɔ bɛl o ne Lasea aa wola jaŋɛ, baa yerɛ bela Leebɔdɛɛɡe la.

english_verse: By now we had already lost a lot of time, and sailing was no longer safe. In fact, even the Great Day of Forgiveness was past.
translation_verse: Yaa biɡri ŋwɛnɛ ta kohona la nomanta, ya ne leebɔdɛɛɡe tela dɛ ya Juu tena tɔpejen yaa dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa o ta la ɡarɔ. Gɛ tɔpere nɔ ɡe ɡaraa, dɛ ɡɛ mpo la ta vala aa were. Anomanta, Pɔɔl ja ba ŋɔ,

english_verse: Then Paul spoke to the crew of the ship, “Men, listen to me! If we sail now, our ship and its cargo will be badly damaged, and many lives will be lost.”
translation_verse: “Bwɛɛla, n nao kɛ le bonɔ dɛɛ kaa la, ya ŋwɛnɛ nɔ aa werii do tɛ yaa. Ya dɛ la naa, yaa ka na siswɛmee, asɛ ya ne ya stiimae nɔ ne ya bone nɔ ka nee ta.”

english_verse: But Julius listened to the captain of the ship and its owner, rather than to Paul.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl aa bol ɡɛ la, sooja nomoa la ta o be noɛ. O teŋɛ nɛn waa dɛ valɛ stiimae la ne, ne stiimae te la nyoa wobol ta.

english_verse: The harbor at Fair Havens wasn't a good place to spend the winter. Because of this, almost everyone agreed that we should at least try to sail along the coast of Crete as far as Phoenix. It had a harbor that opened toward the southwest and northwest, and we could spend the winter there. The Storm at Sea
translation_verse: Leebɔdɛɛɡe leebɔɔ bela aa were ne stiimae la cheɡa peujena la saŋ. Ba ŋɔ stiimae leebɔdɛɛɡe lɔ Kret harɛ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Finiks la ta, anomanta, ba kɛrɛdɛ ŋɔ bá takapɔ so stiimae la bini tama tama dɛɛ la bela dɛ́ ka so bela, ásɛ peujena la saŋ kaa mɔɔ. Dɛ Finiks leebɔɔ la chɔɔ kɛ korobifale ɡuri aa do ɡɛ la, asɛ o harɛ la nyoa bɛl sie chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr diɡ pera, asɛ bɛl ɡe chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr ɡal pera. Peuchɔɡe aa ta mpo sie wa

english_verse: When a gentle wind from the south started blowing, the men thought it was a good time to do what they had planned. So they pulled up the anchor, and we sailed along the coast of Crete.
translation_verse: A ta biɡre dɛ peujeɡa bɛl tao le weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛɛ ba, asɛ ba lii kɛ baa wonoo kaa ɡɛ ba fe aa liira wubwa la. Ba laa ba stiimae la buni baa kpɔa do nee bini dɛ ɡel stiimae la ɛɛ che la kpɔ dɛ fɛrɛ Kret harɛ dɛɛ kaa.

english_verse: The wind struck the ship, and we could not sail against it. So we let the wind carry the ship.
translation_verse: Peu la aa taa dɛ ba lɔ yaa la, ya lawɛ ya stiimae la nyoa kahonɛ. Dɛ stiimae la aa wone dɛɛ kaa sie kpa, dɛ den dɛɛ kaa bela peu la aa taa chaɡɛ la.

english_verse: We went along the island of Cauda on the side that was protected from the wind. We had a hard time holding the lifeboat in place,
translation_verse: Ya baa tel ekwi bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kaoda la weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ o tɔ yaa bɔr peu la be tama, kɛ dɛ o ta dɛ vuuɡi yaa te.

english_verse: but finally we got it where it belonged. Then the sailors wrapped ropes around the ship to hold it together. They lowered the sail and let the ship drift along, because they were afraid it might hit the sandbanks in the gulf of Syrtis.
translation_verse: Ya bwara nyɛɡɔ mɔɔ ba ta won ɡɔɔ ɡberjeɡa waa pɛl ya stiimae la do ya stiimae la bini, dɛ kwaa stiimae la ŋwɛɛra vɔrɔwe kɛrɛdɛ. Ba chweeh stiimae la ŋwɛɛra aa lɔ o keŋkeŋni la, asɛ a hamɛ kiŋkiŋ. Dɛ kechɛ bɛl lɔ bela baa yerɔ Sirtis, asɛ baa ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ peu la ɛɛ taɡ baa kaa bela ásɛ ba ka bela. Anomanta, ba ba stiimae la yajen la aa lɔ o doa la ne harɛ, asɛ peu la taɡ ba dɛɛ kaa.

english_verse: The storm was so fierce that the next day they threw some of the ship's cargo overboard.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, dɛ peu la ta dɛ ta kohona. Anomanta, ba pa stiimae la bini bone ane viɡri, ásɛ o fɛɡre.

english_verse: Then on the third day, with their bare hands they threw overboard some of the ship's gear.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera ja la, ba ɡbaɡba pa stiimae la laala ane ta.

english_verse: For several days we could not see either the sun or the stars. A strong wind kept blowing, and we finally gave up all hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Tɔpera aŋwɛnɛ bwa dɛ yaa wee na, yaa weweela ɡe na, asɛ peu la ɡe na dɛɛ ta kpeɡri nɛɛ ɡɛ. Ate, dɛ yaa ya nyuune te waa lii kɛŋɔ yaa ɛ nɛraa kpa.

english_verse: Since none of us had eaten anything for a long time, Paul stood up and told the men: You should have listened to me! If you had stayed on in Crete, you would not have had this damage and loss.
translation_verse: Baa lɔ ɡbera la bini biɡri baa wola kondikwaa dii la, Pɔɔl iro che dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Yabala, maa ŋɔa ya bɛ Kret le la, a chɛ kɛ he fe no n kon ta. Laala aa chɔɡa ne anɔ la haa paa ta nɔ, a fe ta ɡɛ balɛ.

english_verse: But now I beg you to cheer up, because you will be safe. Only the ship will be lost.
translation_verse: Kɛ he bɛ ɔmɛ. He bɛlbwa aa sewa ba. Stiimae nɔ ɡboo dɛɛ ba chɔɡa.

english_verse: I belong to God, and I worship him. Last night he sent an angel
translation_verse: Waa aa ɡela n ŋɔ ɡɛ laanee kɛ, dɛ jwaana ne la, Korowii waa dɔɔ mɛ dɛ ɡel mɛɛ ɛ o toma la, o torome ba n be,

english_verse: to tell me, “Paul, don't be afraid! You will stand trial before the Emperor. And because of you, God will save the lives of everyone on the ship.”
translation_verse: dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Pɔɔl, bɛ ɔmɛ! Hɛɛ la Koojen Siisa bee. Nɛra la bwa he ne baa dɛ valɛ nɔ, Korowii noɔ tɛɛ. Wɛɛ lɛɛ baa.’ ”

english_verse: But we will first be shipwrecked on some island.
translation_verse: Kɛ peu nɔ ɛɛ taɡɛ yaa ka ta ekwi harɛ bɛl ta.”

english_verse: They cut the anchors loose and let them sink into the sea. At the same time they untied the ropes that were holding the rudders. Next, they raised the sail at the front of the ship and let the wind carry the ship toward the beach.
translation_verse: Ba chaa stiimae la bune la do mpo la bini. Dɛ ba fe vɔwɛ stiimae la ŋwandaa ɡe dɛɛ pɛlo, kɛ ba pur a ɡe, dɛ paɡri stiimae la sie yatɔɡ waa saɡɛ nyundua la, asɛ peu taɡɛ stiimae la dɛɛ kaa bela o sie aa chaɡa la, dɛ taɡɔ ka chuɡe.

english_verse: The sailors wanted to escape from the ship. So they lowered the lifeboat into the water, pretending that they were letting down some anchors from the front of the ship.
translation_verse: Ate, dɛ stiimae tom-ɛɛra la fe dɛ nyin bɔr dɛ́ le o bini dɛ́ chwa. Ba pur o ɡberjeɡa la do nee ta, dɛ teŋe nyosone ŋɔ ba fe dɛ la ka kpɔ stiimae la sie dɛ́ ka tɛr o bune ŋwɛɛra ane do nee ta.

english_verse: The sailors were afraid that we might hit some rocks, and they let down four anchors from the back of the ship. Then they prayed for daylight.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ ya stiimae la ɛɛ chuɡe bwea anee dɛ́ peɡri, dɛ koh a waa ɡɔɔ o bune anaarɛ bwa do nee ta stiimae la mun ta. Dɛ ba dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ bɔ́r chaah warane.

english_verse: But Paul said to Captain Julius and the soldiers, “If the sailors don't stay on the ship, you won't have any chance to save your lives.”
translation_verse: Belaa Pɔɔl ŋɔ soojanomoa la ne soojare la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ stiimae tom-ɛɛra nɔ ta o bini soɡaa, he bɛlbwa aa he nyuu dɔ.”

english_verse: The soldiers then cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it fall into the sea.
translation_verse: Asɛ soojare la chaa ŋwɛɛra aa vɔwɛ ɡberjeɡa la pɛl stiimae la, dɛ ɡel o kaa.

english_verse: I beg you to eat something. Your lives depend on it. Do this and not one of you will be hurt.”
translation_verse: N poo heya, hé di kwaa tama, dɛ́ won yo lɛ he nyuune. Haa waa nɔ nyoa kae ba. Wobɛlbwa aa he bɛlbwa ɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: After Paul had said this, he took a piece of bread and gave thanks to God. Then in front of everyone, he broke the bread and ate some.
translation_verse: Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o kpɔ paanoo dɛ jam Korowii ba bwa siwi ta, dɛ mɔn dɛ di.

english_verse: They all felt encouraged, and each of them ate something.
translation_verse: Waa ɛ ɡɛ la, ba bambile ba harɛ, asɛ ba dɔ ɡbemba dɛ won di kwa.

english_verse: and after everyone had eaten, they threw the cargo of wheat into the sea to make the ship lighter. The Shipwreck
translation_verse: Yaa di kwaa vaɡre ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyin la, ba ɡɔɔ men baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ paanoo la ta mpo la ta, ásɛ stiimae la do fɛɡre.

english_verse: Morning came, and the ship's crew saw a coast they did not recognize. But they did see a cove with a beach. So they decided to try to run the ship aground on the beach.
translation_verse: Tɔ aa pera la, stiimae tom-ɛɛra ta wone jemɛ harɛ la yiso baa tel o ta. Ba na leebɔjen bɛl, dɛ na o nyoa bwea ne hɛŋle, dɛ ɛ ba liire kɛŋɔ dɛ aa maɡroo waa, baa kpɔ stiimae laanee chaɡɛ leebɔɔ la ta.

english_verse: But it ran aground on a sandbank. The front of the ship stuck firmly in the sand, and the rear was being smashed by the force of the waves.
translation_verse: Stiimae la kaa chuɡe hɛŋle ane ta asɛ o sie la karɛ che a ta dɛ kaa kahonɛ. Waa cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ ɡɛ la, dɛ nehɛma dɛ lɔ o habɔɔ la kohona. Nehɛma la paɡre o habɔɔ la bwa.

english_verse: The soldiers decided to kill the prisoners to keep them from swimming away and escaping.
translation_verse: Soojare la fe vɔrɔwɔ ŋɔ baa kpoo nɛra baa do ba dea dɛɛ kaa ba ne laanee, dɛ ŋɔ a waa laa aa, baa wa nee le dɛ chwa kaa.

english_verse: But Captain Julius wanted to save Paul's life, and he did not let the soldiers do what they had planned. Instead, he ordered everyone who could swim to jump into the water and head for shore.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba nomoa la aa Pɔɔl kpoe nyin dɛ koh o waa ŋɔ bá ɡel ba. O ɡelɔ nɛra baa jemɛ nee la tɔ sie le nee dɛ wa kaa baŋ,

english_verse: Then he told the others to hold on to planks of wood or parts of the ship. At last, everyone safely reached shore.
translation_verse: asɛ ba kar la dawɛ dapɛɡre ne stiimae la puɡrere ta dɛ wa le. Kenii ya bwa ɛ dɛ le.

english_verse: When we came ashore, we learned that the island was called Malta.
translation_verse: Ya le nee la baŋ, dɛ le ya siswɛm la nyoa mɔɔ dɛ ta no kɛŋɔ ɡɛ ekwi harɛ la sɔne Mɔlta.

english_verse: The local people were very friendly, and they welcomed us by building a fire, because it was rainy and cold.
translation_verse: Bela tena nyiŋi yaa kɛrɛdɛ. Yaa dena jo bela dɛ bwaala dɛ nɛ asɛ waa do le kohona, asɛ ba mar nii tɛ yaa ya ŋwee.

english_verse: After Paul had gathered some wood and had put it on the fire, the heat caused a snake to crawl out, and it bit him on the hand.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl nyin daa ane ŋɔ ó kpɔ ba do nii la ta. Jaah harɛkon lɔ daa la ta. Waa doa nii ta bɔwɔb lawɛ harɛkon la, o leɔ dɛ choɡo, dɛ ka saɡɛ o nɔn ta.

english_verse: When the local people saw the snake hanging from Paul's hand, they said to each other, “This man must be a murderer! He didn't drown in the sea, but the goddess of justice will kill him anyway.”
translation_verse: Bela tena la aa na harɛkon la Pɔɔl nɔn ta saɡa la, dɛ ba dɛ bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ maɡaa kpo nɛn! Na waa le seo nyoa mpo ta asɛ o wechɔɡa taa ti o luɡe ɡɛ!”

english_verse: Paul shook the snake off into the fire and wasn't harmed.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl mer harɛkon la ta nii la ta. O choɡa la ta on wobɛlbwa ɛɛ.

english_verse: The people kept thinking that Paul would either swell up or suddenly drop dead. They watched him for a long time, and when nothing happened to him, they changed their minds and said, “This man is a god.”
translation_verse: Dɛ bela tena la te soɡo dɛɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ Pɔɔl nɔn la ɛɛ ɔrɔɔ, dɛ ŋɔ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, wɛɛ choloo buɡ ta dɛ́ sewɛ. Baa soɡa dɛɛ nyiŋu kɛŋɔ wɛɛ sewɔɔ waa wola sewɛ wobɛlbwa aa wola on ɛɛ la, ba berɔ ŋɔ voɡ bɛlee ken berɛ nɛn ba ba be la.

english_verse: The governor of the island was named Publius, and he owned some of the land around there. Publius was very friendly and welcomed us into his home for three days.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi bela harɛ la ta sɔne Publius. Dɛ on dɔ harɛre aa lɔ ba jwɛɛh bela la te bwa. O lɛ yaa dɛ nyiŋi yaa kɛrɛdɛ tɔpera atoro.

english_verse: His father was in bed, sick with fever and stomach trouble, and Paul went to visit him. Paul healed the man by praying and placing his hands on him.
translation_verse: Dɛ Publius mɛɛ bwara wɔrɔbɔ asɛ o chɔ. Dɛ o dɛ feeɡe ɡe. Pɔɔl jo o be dea dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii tɛo, asɛ o ɡbaŋre.

english_verse: After this happened, everyone on the island brought their sick people to Paul, and they were all healed.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔ aa ɛa la, bela tena ba bwara aa dɛ wee ba la ba Pɔɔl be, asɛ o soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba ba ɡbaŋre.

english_verse: The people were very respectful to us, and when we sailed, they gave us everything we needed. From Malta to Rome
translation_verse: Ba kɛ yaa kwaa pirim. Yaa dɛ ba stiimae ta joe dɛ kaa la, ba tɛ yaa laala aa chɛ kɛ ya dɔ mɔɔ dɛ́ le la bwa. Pɔɔlwa kaa tel Rom

english_verse: Three months later we sailed in a ship that had been docked at Malta for the winter. The ship was from Alexandria in Egypt and was known as “The Twin Gods.”
translation_verse: Ya di korobie atoro bela mɔɔ dɛ dɔ Alɛksandrea tena stiimae bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Voɡkpara la bini jo. Peujen saŋ la aa tela la, stiimae la tena baa so Mɔlta, ásɛ peujena la tonɛ mɔɔ ba le.

english_verse: We arrived in Syracuse and stayed for three days.
translation_verse: Yaa lea la, ya kaa choɡ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Serakius la, dɛ di tɔpera atoro.

english_verse: From there we sailed to Rhegium. The next day a south wind began to blow, and two days later we arrived in Puteoli.
translation_verse: Ya le bela dɛ la bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Rɛɡeɔm la. Tɔ aa pera la, dɛ peu bɛl tao le weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛɛ ba. Tɔpera anɛɛ ya di ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ tel bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Puteoli.

english_verse: There we found some of the Lord's followers, who begged us to stay with them. A week later we left for the city of Rome.
translation_verse: Dɛ asɔre tena bane lɔ bela dɛ ŋɔ yá di yawanyoa ba be mɔɔ dɛ kaa. Belaa ya le dɛ ba Rom.

english_verse: Some of the followers in Rome heard about us and came to meet us at the Market of Appius and at the Three Inns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and was encouraged. Paul in Rome
translation_verse: Rom asɔre tena aa no ya waa la, ba baa cheme yaa Apius Yawa ta ne bela baa dɛ yerɛ Deene Atoro la bɔr. Pɔɔl aa na ba la, o bambile ba harɛ, asɛ o jam Korowii.

english_verse: We arrived in Rome, and Paul was allowed to live in a house by himself with a soldier to guard him.
translation_verse: Waa ba Rom la, ba tɛo o ɡbo dea, dɛ ɡel sooja beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ daahno.

english_verse: Three days after we got there, Paul called together some of the Jewish leaders and said: My friends, I have never done anything to hurt our people, and I have never gone against the customs of our ancestors. But in Jerusalem I was handed over as a prisoner to the Romans.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl aa di tɔpera atoro Rom la, o yerɛ bela Juu tena nomonome bwa cheme dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Yabala, n ta ya bwɛɛ tena wobɛlbwa ɛɛ, n ta ya naawa waa baa dɛ ɛ la bɛlbwa nɛɛ joɛ, asɛ ba laɡ mɛ Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔ mɛ tɛ Rom tena ba tɔ mɛ dea la.

english_verse: They looked into the charges against me and wanted to release me. They found that I had not done anything deserving death.
translation_verse: Ba ɡe aa nyiŋi n waa bini la, dɛ ba fe dɛ nyin n tae, dɛkalkɛ dɛ wobɛlbwa ta chaɡlɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpo mɛ ɡɛ ya bwɛɛ tena aa chaɡla la.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders disagreed, so I asked to be tried by the Emperor. But I don't have anything to say against my own nation.
translation_verse: Baa ŋɔa bá ta mɛ la, ya bwɛɛ tena ta sɛɛh kwaraa, asɛ n koh a waa ŋɔ amɔ te bá tel n ne Rom Koojen Siisa sie ó ka nyiŋi a ta. Kasinteŋ, dɛ anɔ laa aa, n ne ya bwɛɛ tena ta wobɛlbwa dɔe.

english_verse: I am bound by these chains because of what we people of Israel hope for. This is why I have called you here to talk about this hope of ours.
translation_verse: A waa n ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ n na heya, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bil he sie, dɛkalkɛ nɛn Juu tena bwa aa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ba lɛ yaa la waa ba laɡ mɛ dɛ do mɛ jɔɡrɔre n nɔɔra nɔ.”

english_verse: The leaders replied, “No one from Judea has written us a letter about you. And not one of them has come here to report on you or to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Anee Juu tena la ŋɔ, “Ya bwɛɛ Juda harɛ tena ta yaa tɔn bɛlbwa chwerɛ dɛ baɡle he wobɛlbwa ya be. Yabala baa le ya bwɛɛ dɛɛ ba bonɔ nɔ ɡe bɛlbwa ta he wechɔɡe bɛlbwa bolɛ ya no.

english_verse: But we would like to hear what you have to say. We understand that people everywhere are against this new group.”
translation_verse: Yaa no he nyoa wobolee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ he ŋwɛnɛfale nɔ haa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii nɔ te, baa o waa nyin bobɛlbwa.”

english_verse: They agreed on a time to meet with Paul, and many of them came to his house. From early morning until late in the afternoon, Paul talked to them about God's kingdom. He used the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets to try to win them over to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba tɛo tɔpere baa kpɔ ba no o nyoa wobol. Tɔpere la aa tela la, ba ba o be pirim o dea bela. Pɔɔl le chɔɔ dɛ baɡ ba Korowii Kora waa ka tel jwaana. O bol Yeesu wa, dɛ lii ba waa Mosis ne Korowii keamere faa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la bwa, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin kɛ ba sɛh ŋɔ Yeesu waa ba faa chwerɛ la.

english_verse: Some of the leaders agreed with what Paul said, but others did not.
translation_verse: Nɛra la bane yarada o waa la, bane ɡe ta an yaradae.

english_verse: Since they could not agree among themselves, they started leaving. But Paul said, “The Holy Spirit said the right thing when he sent Isaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Pɔɔl bol waa tonɛ asɛ baa ba peɡra. Dɛ ba bwa liire ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ, baa tɔŋle dɔŋa. O berɔ bol webeŋkpoŋ ja, mɔɔ ba bwa peɡre. O waa waa bola laanee kɛŋɔ, “Korowii Domadɛɛɡe cheɡɛ o keame Aesaya nɛɛ bol waa ya naawa be, dɛ kpelaa o ŋɔ. O bolɔ ŋɔ,

english_verse: to tell our ancestors, ‘Go to these people and tell them: You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.
translation_verse: ‘Ka ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ noo kohona, kɛ haa a mun noe ba, hɛɛ nyiŋuu kohona, kɛ haa a jema ba.

english_verse: All of you have stubborn hearts. Your ears are stopped up, and your eyes are covered. You cannot see or hear or understand. If you could, you would turn to me, and I would heal you.’ ”
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra nɔ bambile kpeɡri, ba kpɔ nɔɔra tɔɔɡe deŋna, dɛ tɔɔɡe ba sibie ɡe. A waa laa aa, ba sie fe ɛɛ nao, ásɛ ba deŋna no, ásɛ ba jemɛ a mun, dɛ́ charɛ ba liire ásɛ n lɛɛ ba.” ’ ”

english_verse: Paul said, “You may be sure that God wants to save the Gentiles! And they will listen.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl aa bol waa tonɛ la, ba leɔ dɛɛ kaa dɛɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa kohona.

english_verse: For two years Paul stayed in a rented house and welcomed everyone who came to see him.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl hane dea dɛ so o bini bene anɛ. Dɛ nɛra dɛ ba o be. O ta ba bɛlbwa berɛ.

english_verse: He bravely preached about God's kingdom and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, and no one tried to stop him.
translation_verse: Dɛ o dɛ baɡle nɛra Korowii Kora wa, dɛ kpɔ bansua dɛɛ baɡle ya Dɔɔ Yeesu wa. Nomɛlbwa ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɔe.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle, and he appointed me to preach the good news
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ. Korowiirii lee mɛ dɛ ɡel n ɛ Yeesu torome, dɛ kpɔ o Amanesoma tɛ mɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ bol nɛra be.

english_verse: that he promised long ago by what his prophets said in the holy Scriptures.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Amanesoma nɔ waa o che o keamere waa lee ba nɛɛ dɛ baɡɛ nɛwɛnyina nyoa a saŋ la. A waa ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la.

english_verse: This good news is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ! As a human, he was from the family of David. But the Holy Spirit proved that Jesus is the powerful Son of God, because he was raised from death.
translation_verse: asɛ o Korowii ɛɛ ɡe be pera la, Korowii cheɡɛ o seo ta ira la ta, dɛ baɡle kpeɡri ne kɛŋɔ o Korowii Biee on.

english_verse: Jesus was kind to me and chose me to be an apostle, so that people of all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: O nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ sune n nɛ, dɛ cha mɛ, dɛ ɡel mɛɛ ɛ Yeesu toma dɛɛ baɡle nɛwɛnyina te bwa o waa ásɛ ba yaradaa dɛɛ ɛa, ásɛ o dɔ sɔn.

english_verse: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you and has chosen you to be his very own people. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: He Rom tena Korowii aa dɛ nyin heyaa dɛ le heyaa ŋɔ hé ba ɛ o nɛra he wa aa toɡra la, he bwaa mɛɛ chwerɛ tɔn nɔ. Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bwa na he sum, dɛ́ cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Korowii soŋa ne o jaama

english_verse: First, I thank God in the name of Jesus Christ for all of you. I do this because people everywhere in the world are talking about your faith.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ tɔ sie che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ jam N Naa Korowii he waa kɛŋɔ haa yarada Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ kohona, asɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ bol he waa nɔ.

english_verse: God has seen how I never stop praying for you, while I serve him with all my heart and tell the good news about his Son.
translation_verse: Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ n bambile bwa ne, dɛɛ bol o Bie la Amanesoma waa la, o jemɔ kɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa n soŋo dɛɛ tɛ heya. Onee n danseɛ te.

english_verse: In all my prayers, I ask God to make it possible for me to visit you.
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋo kɛŋɔ dɛ o sɛoh waa, ń fe won ba na heyaa taraken te.

english_verse: I want to see you and share with you the same blessings that God's Spirit has given me. Then you will grow stronger in your faith.
translation_verse: N sie cheɡɛ chiŋ mɛɛ nyin kɛ n na heyaa dɛ́ cha heyaa waane Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa tɛ mɛ ne, ásɛ he do kpeɡri he teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: What I am saying is that we can encourage each other by the faith that is ours.
translation_verse: Ya bwaa dɛɛ ba dɔŋa chae. Gɛ maa yarada Yeesu Kristo la, aa do heyaa ɡbembaa, ásɛ ɡɛ he ɡe aa yaradao la do n ɡe ɡbemba.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that I have often planned to come for a visit. But something has always kept me from doing it. I want to win followers to Christ in Rome, as I have done in many other places.
translation_verse: Yabala, n dɛ nyin kɛ hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ saŋ bɛlbwaa n fe ɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ba he be, asɛ waa yon dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ. N dɛ nyin ń dɔ he bane dɛ tɛ Yeesu Kristo kɛŋɔ maa dɔ bane le nɛra ba ɡe aa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bini la.

english_verse: I am proud of the good news! It is God's powerful way of saving all people who have faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Sihiih aa men kpo Yeesu Amanesoma nɔ bola ta. A taa Korowii che dɛɛ baɡle o kpeɡri, dɛɛ lɛ nɛra bwa baa yarada o waa la. Juu tenaa ó tɔ sie lɛ, nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɡe jao.

english_verse: The good news tells how God accepts everyone who has faith, but only those who have faith. It is just as the Scriptures say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.” Everyone Is Guilty
translation_verse: Yeesu Amanesoma laanee dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini do ásɛ ya waa su o siwi. Le waa la mumpar ka tel a jaɡa bwa, o waa yaradae waa ɡboo a bwa. Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ, “Naate o wa aa toɡra dɛ su Korowii siwi la, wɛɛ yaradao dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.” Korowii baah diu kohona nɛwɛnyina wechɔɡa wa

english_verse: From heaven God shows how angry he is with all the wicked and evil things that sinful people do to crush the truth.
translation_verse: Korowii baah di nɛra ba wechɔɡa aa tɔ o kasinteŋ waa la ŋwɛnɛ asɛ a sɔɔh ba la nɛ. O baah dɛ di ba wechɔɡa la ta kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: They know everything that can be known about God, because God has shown it all to them.
translation_verse: Korowii wobɛlbwa nɛwɛnyini aa wona jemɛ la, o ɡelɔ ba naa chasee ken. O ɡbaɡbaa pili a bini baɡ ba.

english_verse: God's eternal power and character cannot be seen. But from the beginning of creation, God has shown what these are like by all he has made. That's why those people don't have any excuse.
translation_verse: Dɛ́ le ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa ta harɛ la, o bwara waa nɛwɛnyini aa wola wone dɛɛ na siwi ne, kɛŋɔ o kpeɡri aa wola jaɡa dɔe ne o dor bwa, o ɡelɔ nɛwɛnyini na a bwa. Nɛwɛnyini wono che Korowii kwaa waa taa ta, dɛ na o kpeɡri ne ɡɛ waa doa. Anomanta, nɛwɛnyini aa won ŋɔ baa jemɛ kɛ Korowii lole.

english_verse: They know about God, but they don't honor him or even thank him. Their thoughts are useless, and their stupid minds are in the dark.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii lole, kɛ baa on duu ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ baa duuru. Baa jam kpɔe dɛɛ tɛo. Nɛwɛnyini wechɔɡa ɡelɔ ba wili, ba ta liire dɔe kpa.

english_verse: They claim to be wise, but they are fools.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ yerɛ ba te wejerema, kɛ ɡɛna ɡee ban.

english_verse: They don't worship the glorious and eternal God. Instead, they worship idols that are made to look like humans who cannot live forever, and like birds, animals, and reptiles.
translation_verse: Korowii te aa sewɛ bwa. Kɛ ba vɛh o toma, dɛɛ tomɛ kwaa ba ɡbaɡba aa kwaara a do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini, kɛɛ jumbii, kɛɛ konaatena, kɛɛ kontuuɡa la.

english_verse: So God let these people go their own way. They did what they wanted to do, and their filthy thoughts made them do shameful things with their bodies.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ta ba waa tɛɛ ba, asɛ baa ɛ wedoŋa ba bambile aa lawa, dɛɛ chɔ baala ne haahna aa wola Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ.

english_verse: They gave up the truth about God for a lie, and they worshiped God's creation instead of God, who will be praised forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Ba ɡel Korowii kasinteŋ la toma, dɛɛ tomɛ kwaa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe. Kwaa Korowii aa taa la, anee baa tomɛ, dɛ ɡel Korowii ɡbaɡba. On chɛ kɛ yaa kpɛɛro saŋ bɛlbwa. Aamen.

english_verse: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.
translation_verse: Ba ken ɛɛ nomanta, Korowii ta ba waa tɛɛ ba, asɛ baa ɛ ba pɛla waa aa ɛ sihiih kohona. Ba haahna kwaraa ne baala aa chɔ kpa, ba ne ba dɔŋa haahnaa dɛɛ chɔ baa ne haah.

english_verse: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ ba baala ɡe ne haahna aa wola chɔ kpa, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ pɛlɛ ba bandɔŋa nɛɛ kɛŋɔ haahna ken. Ba ne ba dɔŋa baalaa dɛɛ chɔ baa ne haah. Ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la nomanta, ba dɛ dɔ a kembɔr aa chɔɡ ba nɛndaa.

english_verse: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.
translation_verse: Baa wola sɛɛh kɛŋɔ bá jemɛ Korowii waa nomanta, o ta ba waa tɛɛ ba, asɛ ba liire bwa ɛ anchɔɡa, asɛ baa ɛ waa aa wola chɛɛ kɛ baa ɛ.

english_verse: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip,
translation_verse: Harɛ bini wechɔɡa nɔ bwaa baa ɛ, mur ne sibeɡra ne meesɔɔh, ne bɔweela ne nɛŋkpoa, ne naɡra ne dɔŋa neɡra, ne dɔŋa haeh dɛ nɛra ŋwala.

english_verse: say cruel things about others, and hate God. They are proud, conceited, and boastful, always thinking up new ways to do evil. These people don't respect their parents.
translation_verse: Baa dɔŋa wedɛɛɡa bol, ba hah Korowii, ba siwi aa nɛn tɔɡɛ, ba jenu, ba mbarafo. Saŋ bɛlbwaa baa nyin ŋwɛnɛfala dɛ́ ɛ wechɔɡa. Ba siwi aa ba mɛɛnanar ne ba nyare su.

english_verse: They are stupid, unreliable, and don't have any love or pity for others.
translation_verse: Ba nya nfɛrɛ, ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, ba chal toole dɔŋa nɛ, ba tea aa nɛn nɛɛ domɛ.

english_verse: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.
translation_verse: Ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ken la, ba chɛ kpoe, kɛ dɛ ɡe ta na dɛɛ ɛa, dɛ ɡarɛ dɛɛ kpɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛa la.

english_verse: Some of you accuse others of doing wrong. But there is no excuse for what you do. When you judge others, you condemn yourselves, because you are guilty of doing the very same things.
translation_verse: He naate haa dɛ pwah he dɔŋ la, he ta wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ bol dɛ́ lɛ he te kpa. Henee ume noo, haa dɛ pwah he dɔŋ dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ɛ o wechɔɡa waa dɛ ɛ la dɔŋa la, dɛ he ɡbaɡbaa hɛɛ pa bolchɔɡe la.

english_verse: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.
translation_verse: Nɛn ɛ wechɔɡa nɔ dɔŋa aa, Korowii dɛ pao bolchɔɡe. O te, aŋwɛnɛ taa wɛɛ pa nɛwɛnyini bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: Do you really think God won't punish you, when you behave exactly like the people you accuse?
translation_verse: Kɛ he te, waa haa dɛ pwah nɛra a waa la, anee he ɡee ɛ. He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii aa he te waa bola ba dɛ́ pa bole kɛɛ?

english_verse: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?
translation_verse: Waa nɔ bwaa Korowii ta tea dɛɛ ɛ heya, dɛɛ tɛ heyaa sisɔna dɛɛ lawɛ bambile nɔ bwa, ásɛ he charɛ he liire dɛ́ le he wechɔɡa ta. Kɛ haa o wedɛɛɡa nɔ bu, dɛɛ nyiŋa pɛɛ.

english_verse: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.
translation_verse: He deŋne kpeɡri. Haa ɡelɛ he tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡ he wechɔɡa wa. He ɡelɔ Korowii bwaawee ɛɛ do kan he nɛɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa. Awola waa ba pa bole kasinteŋ ne la, o baah ɛɛ di he nɛɛ taeh.

english_verse: God will reward each of us for what we have done.
translation_verse: Gɛ nomɛlbwa we-ɛɛla aa doa la, anee wɛɛ ba nyiŋa dɛ́ bol o waa dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ nyin jirima Korowii be, dɛɛ nyin kɛ Korowii kpɛɛ ba, dɛɛ nyin mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe, dɛ koh a waa dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa la, Korowii ɛɛ tɛɛ baa mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.

english_verse: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ba tetoowa, baa wola Korowii waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ ta teŋɛ, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, Korowii bwaawee ɛɛ ir ba nɛɛ taeh.

english_verse: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡoo taeh, aa noo baa taeh. Juu tenaa dɛ tɔ sie na bonyɛɡa a noo ba, nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɡe jao.

english_verse: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔ jirima, dɛ́ kpɛɛ ba, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba bambisɔɔhna. Juu tenaa dɛ́ tɔ sie na anɔ bwa, nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɡe jao.

english_verse: God doesn't have any favorites!
translation_verse: Korowii aa nomɛl waa nyin ɡwaa bɛl.

english_verse: Those people who don't know about God's Law will still be punished for what they do wrong. And the Law will be used to judge everyone who knows what it says.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa wola Mmara Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Mosis la jemɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, baa sewɔɔ. Kɛ Mosis Mmara la ta laa Korowii ɛɛ ba nyiŋa, dɛ́ bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole. Banɔ la baa jemɛ Mmara la, Mmara la taa Korowii ɛɛ ba nyiŋa dɛ́ bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: when God appoints Jesus Christ to judge everyone's secret thoughts, just as my message says. The Jews and the Law
translation_verse: Waa nɔ bwaa dɛɛ ba ɛɛ awola Korowii aa dɛ ba nɛra wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛɛ sɔh la ne bochaah lee, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo pa ba bole. Gɛɛ me Amanesoma la ɛɛ baɡle. Juu tena ne Korowii Mmara wa

english_verse: Some of you call yourselves Jews. You trust in the Law and take pride in God.
translation_verse: Asɛ he naate haa dɛ yerɛ he te Juu te, dɛ kpɔ he sie dawɛ Mosis Mmara la ta dɛ kpɔ Korowii dɛɛ ta nyoa la ɡe sɛ?

english_verse: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.
translation_verse: He jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin kɛ hɛɛ ɛ, dɛ jemɛ Mmara la, dɛ jemɛ waa aa wera bwa.

english_verse: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.
translation_verse: Kɛ he dɛ yerɛ he te nɛn waa jemɛ waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ. Kɛ he ŋɔ henee ɛ nii dɛɛ chaah nɛra baa lɔ biro ta.

english_verse: And since there is knowledge and truth in God's Law, you think you can instruct fools and teach young people.
translation_verse: Wejema bwa ne Korowii wobɛlbwa lɔ Mmara la bini, anomanta, he kpɔ he te kɛ wejereme dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛna ne bamuɡe wa.

english_verse: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?
translation_verse: Haa dɛ baɡle he dɔŋa waa nɔ, ɛrɛɛ haa wola won baɡle he te ɡbaɡba ɔ? Haa dɛ ŋɔ nɛra be ŋɔ ba bɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛ, asɛ dɛ te dɛɛ ŋwɛ nɔ sɛ?

english_verse: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.
translation_verse: Hé tenten nɔ, he ŋɔ nɛra bɛ ba bala haahna ne ba bala jaranar dɛɛ nyin. Hé ɡbaɡba, haa ɡɛ ɛa? Hé ŋɔ he kii voɡa, hen ɡee bera dɛɛ ŋwɛ kwaa a deene bini.

english_verse: You take pride in the Law, but you disobey the Law and bring shame to God.
translation_verse: Hen kpɔ Mmara la dɛɛ ta nyoa, he ɡee wola a ta teŋɛ, asɛ nɛra koh he we-ɛɛla waa dɛɛ ɛ Korowii nɛnhɛla.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, “You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.”
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “He Juu tena aa ɡela nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la siwi sa Korowii la.”

english_verse: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.
translation_verse: He dɛ teŋɛ Mmara la ta naa, dɛ he pena teŋa nɔ dɔ mun. Kɛ dɛ haa Mmara la ta teŋaa, ate he fe ɡel he pena teŋa bɔ.

english_verse: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.
translation_verse: He Juu tena te jemɛ Mmara nɔ dɛɛ teŋe he pena, kɛ he bane aa Mmara la ta teŋɛ. Asɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɡe, baa ba pena teŋe, kɛ ba bini bane dɛ teŋɛ Mmara la ta. Ba we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ɡeloo Korowii pa heyaa bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: Just because you live like a Jew and are circumcised doesn't make you a real Jew.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa ɛ Juu te, wobɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛɛ baɡle kɛ o ɛ Juu te, dɛ ja o pen teŋa ɡbo ta la, Juu te tenten laa on. Penteŋa dɔ mun.

english_verse: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.
translation_verse: Waa aa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ nɛn ɛ Juu te tenten la, bambile binii a do. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee dɛɛ ba toma ɛɛ he bambile bini, ásɛ he won ɛ Juu te tenten. Mmara bɛlbwa aa ɡɛ bambile nɔ tɛ. Nɛn Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa chao asɛ o bambile bini waa ɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o ɛ Korowii nɛn la, nɛwɛnyini laa dɛɛ ba o kpɛɛra, Korowiirii dɛɛ ba o kpɛɛra.

english_verse: What good is it to be a Jew? What good is it to be circumcised?
translation_verse: Dɛ kenii a do aa, dɛ ɛrɛ ɡwaalaa ya Juu tena ɡwaa he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ yɔ? Dɛ bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ lɔ ya penteŋa ta nɔ?

english_verse: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.
translation_verse: Ya Juu tena na som taeh dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa kaa la ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta. Anɔ la aa tɔ sie laanee kɛŋɔ yanee Korowii tɔ sie kpɔ o waa do ya nɔn ŋɔ ya baɡle nɛra.

english_verse: It is true that some of them did not believe the message. But does this mean that God cannot be trusted, just because they did not have faith?
translation_verse: Amɔ dɛ ya bini bane ta Korowii yaradae yaa, wɛɛ koh a waa ásɛ o waa aa yaradaa dɔ aa?

english_verse: No, indeed! God tells the truth, even if everyone else is a liar. The Scriptures say about God, “Your words will be proven true, and in court you will win your case.”
translation_verse: Akai! Dɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa ɛ nyosonteŋna kwara naa, Korowii te wa ɛɛ dɔ kasinteŋii saŋ bɛlbwa. Anee Korowii Tɔn la bol la. O baɡle Korowii waa ŋɔ, “He wobol ɛɛ baɡloo kɛŋɔ he dɔ kasinteŋ, hɛɛ dɛɛ di bole he waa taa.”

english_verse: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini te ɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Dɛ a cheɡɛ ya wechɔɡa ta asɛ nɛra na kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe aa, amɔ ya ta wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ kɛɛ? Dɛ Korowii tɛr ya deŋne aa, dɛ o waa toɡraa?” Nɛwɛnyini liiree nɔ!

english_verse: But the answer is, “No.” Otherwise, how could God judge the world?
translation_verse: Kɛ ɡɛ laa a do. Dɛ Korowii waa ta toɡraa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ te won bol nɛwɛnyini waa dɛ́ pa bole ɔ?

english_verse: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.
translation_verse: Nomɛl ɡee pɛɛroo ŋɔ, “Aah dɛ a cheɡɛ n nyosone ta asɛ nɛra na kɛŋɔ Korowii dɔ kasinteŋ, o dɔ sɔn aa, dɛ n nyosone la ɛ wechɔɡa ja aa?”

english_verse: You might as well say, “Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it!” Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well. No One Is Good
translation_verse: Amɔ yáa ɛ wechɔɡa ásɛ wedɛɛɡa le a ta kɛɛ? Nɛra bane chɔɡ n sɔn, ba haŋɛ n nyoa ŋɔ n dɛ ŋɔ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ. Korowii ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, dɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta ɡee. Nomɛlbwa toole o waa toɡre

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.
translation_verse: Taraken nɔ, ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa ya Juu tena ɡwaa he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ yɔ? Ya ta heyaa ɡwaalɛ. N fa baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ ya Juu tena ne he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ya bwa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.

english_verse: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ jemɛ wa, nomɛlbwa toole dɛɛ nyin o Korowii bɔr dɛ́ tomɔ.

english_verse: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa berɛ habɔɔ kpoo, nɛndɛɛɡe bɛlbwa toole ba bini, Bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole.

english_verse: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake,
translation_verse: Ba nyoa wobol doŋo, a sɔɔh nyosone ɡboo ba bwa. A do kɛ domkpuli aa choɡe nɛn, dɛ berɛ do kɛ tɛɡchɔɡa aa dɛ kpo ken.

english_verse: and they say nothing but bitter curses.
translation_verse: Wobochɔɡa ɡboo su ba nyoo.

english_verse: These people quickly become violent.
translation_verse: Ba ɡbaŋre nɛŋkpoa waa ta.

english_verse: Wherever they go, they leave ruin and destruction.
translation_verse: Bobɛlbwa baa dɛ la la, waa ɡboo baa chɔɡ, dɛɛ ɛ nɛra hɔhɔrɔwa.

english_verse: They don't know how to live in peace.
translation_verse: Waa aa ɡela nɛn bambile ɛɛ sɔɔhno la te, baa an jemɛ.

english_verse: They don't even fear God.”
translation_verse: Baa Korowii ɡe ɔmɛ.”

english_verse: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ waa Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle la, nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Mmara la ta laanee Mmara la ɛɛ baɡle, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won dɔ wobɛlbwa bol Korowii sie, ásɛ o won bol nomɛlbwa waa dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin. God's Way of Accepting People
translation_verse: Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, Mmara ta teŋa aa won ɡel nomɛlbwa we-ɛɛla su Korowii siwi bwa. Mmara la toma bwaa kɛŋɔ ó ɡel nɛwɛnyini jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya ɛ wechɔɡa. Yarada taa a che nɛn waa won toɡre

english_verse: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ ya jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta aa cheɡa ya wa ɛɛ su o siwi. Mmara ta teŋa ta laa a che. Mosis Mmara la ne Korowii keamere tɔne di danseɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini bwa ɛ wechɔɡa, ya bɛlbwa ta ɡɛ Korowii fe aa dɛ nyin o maŋkura yaa la chɛɛ.

english_verse: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo yawɛ yaa o chal ne. A waa ya wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi. O nɛn sum nae kohona waa o ɛ ɡɛ tɛ yaa pɛɛpɛɛ la.

english_verse: God sent Christ to be our sacrifice. Christ offered his life's blood, so by faith in him we could come to God. And God did this to show that in the past he was right to be patient and forgive sinners. This also shows that God is right when he accepts people who have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Taraken waa ɡela Yeesu Kristo koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ sewɛ nɔ, o baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ o waa toɡrɔ. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo la, Korowii ɡelɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su o siwi.

english_verse: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.
translation_verse: Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, ya dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ya ta nyoa aa? Ya ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe. Ɛrɛ taa a che yaa wola won ta nyoa nɔɔ? Mmara ta teŋa ta laa a che. Yeesu Kristo yaradae laanee tɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ŋwɛnɛ,

english_verse: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya sɛoh kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo yaradae taa a che Korowii ɡel nɛn ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su o siwi. Mmara ta teŋa aa ɡelɛ nɛn ɛɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi bwa.

english_verse: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!
translation_verse: Juu tena ɡbo laa Korowii che tɛ. Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ba bwa waa o do le.

english_verse: Do we destroy the Law by our faith? Not at all! We make it even more powerful.
translation_verse: Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, dɛ ya dɛ yarada Yeesu aa, dɛ ya tɔ Mmara la ŋwɛnɛ kɛɛ? Akai! Yeesu yaradae nɔ te kwaraa dɛɛ ba ɡela ya won teŋɛ Mmara la ta.

english_verse: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.
translation_verse: O we-ɛɛla taa a che o waa su Korowii siwi aa, ate o fe dɔ waa dɛ kpɔ ta nyoa. Kɛ dɛ he nyiŋi Korowii Tɔn bini na naa, waa won ta nyoa Korowii sie.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.”
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Abraham yarada taa a che Korowii lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi.

english_verse: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.
translation_verse: Nɛn ɛ toma ba bɔɔ kem aa, dɛ kemee ba bɔɔ. Dɛ kɛɛ laa ba kɛo.

english_verse: But you cannot make God accept you because of something you do. God accepts sinners only because they have faith in him.
translation_verse: Kɛ nɛn waa wola wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ kpɔ o yarada do Korowii ɡbo nɛɛ kɛŋɔ o won wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛndɛɛɡa ɛɛ la, a cheɡɛ o yarada la ta asɛ Korowii lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su o siwi.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: Gɛɛ ya Juu tena nabaa Devid faa baɡle nomɛlbwa Korowii aa wola o we-ɛɛla nyiŋe, asɛ dɛ lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi la waa kɛŋɔ o na som la.

english_verse: “What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.”
translation_verse: Nyusom tee naate Korowii aa wola o wechɔɡa waa lii kpa bwa la.”

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ som nae nɔ Devid aa bol o waa nɔ, dɛ Juu tena aa dɛ teŋe pena nɔ, ba ɡboo dɛɛ ba som nae yaa, kɛ nɛra baa wola pena teŋe bwaa o ŋɔ? Too, baa baɡla Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Abraham yarada taa a che asɛ o waa su Korowii siwi” nɔ,

english_verse: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.
translation_verse: a ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡo mɔɔ Korowii ɡel Abraham teŋe o pen kɛɛ o teŋo mɔɔ nɔ? A chiɡo mɔɔ Abraham teŋe.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: O pen teŋa la ɛ we-ɛɛle bɛl waa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o yarada waa o won ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su Korowii siwi, dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ waa wola teŋe mɔɔ la, dɛ o waa su Korowii siwi. Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, baa wola pen teŋe dɛɛ yarada Korowii asɛ o lɛɛ ba kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi la, ba mɛɛɛ Abraham.

english_verse: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised. The Promise Is for All Who Have Faith
translation_verse: Nɛra baa teŋe ba pena la, Abraham biirii ba ɡe. Ba pena waa laa ba ɛ o bii. Dɛ ba dɔ yarada Abraham aa dɔa mɔɔ ba teŋe o pen la aa, anee bá ɛ o bii.

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Korowii nyoa la o fa aa baɡɛ Abraham ne o naanar ŋɔ harɛ nɔ bwa ɛɛ ba ɛ ba konee la, Mmara ta teŋa waa laa o baɡɔ ɡɛ nyoa la. Dɛ Abraham dɛ yarada Korowii, asɛ a che a ta o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su Korowii siwi, a waa Korowii baɡɔ nyoa.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Nyoa Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham ne o naanar la, dɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ Mmara ta laanee wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ tɛ aa, ate dɛ yarada nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ yarada Korowii nɔ ta mun dɔe. Dɛ Korowii nyobaɡa la ɡe fe ɛ pɛɛ.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Mmara laanee dɛɛ ba Korowii bandia ne nɛra nɛ. On lole nɛra ɡee konu waa Korowii baah ɛɛ di nɛra nɛ. Dɛ Mmara fe toole naa, nɛra fe aa on koni.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Nyoa Korowii aa baɡa la, yarada taa a che. A chɛ kɛ á ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ kon Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa la, o ɛ kon waa kpɔa tɛ pɛɛpɛɛ. O ɛ kon Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Abraham naanar bwa pɛɛpɛɛ waa wola nsana lee ba. Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara la ta la, ba ɡbo laa Korowii baɡɛ ɡɛ nyoa la. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada Yeesu waa la kɛŋɔ Abraham aa yarada Korowii la, wɛɛ di nyobaɡa la tɔnɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya bwa mɛɛɛ Abraham.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii waa baa chwera ŋɔ, “N ɡelɔ he ɛ nɛnfuuh bwa mɛɛ” la baɡle la. A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ kasinteŋ Korowii be. Onee Abraham faa yarada la. On won nɛra baa serewa kwaraa chuma, dɛ won dɛɛ bol waa aa wola chiɡe bwa kɛŋɔ aa chiɡa ka la.

english_verse: God promised Abraham a lot of descendants. And when it all seemed hopeless, Abraham still had faith in God and became the ancestor of many nations.
translation_verse: Dɛ Abraham dɛ yarada Korowii dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ ɡe. Dɛ waa nɛn aa wola Korowii yarada a ta la, dɛ o te dɛ yaradao. A taa a che o ɛ nɛnfuuh bwa mɛɛ, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He naanar ɛɛ warɔɔ” la.

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: O ta tɔŋlɛ tamaa bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ Korowii aa won ɛ waa waa baɡɔ nyoa laanee. O ta Korowii yaradae ɡelɛ bwa. Dɛ name kwaraa o ta dɔ yarada kohona, dɛɛ jam Korowii.

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: Dɛ Abraham jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ wonoo ɛ ɡɛ waa baɡɔ nyoa la.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa la baa chwera do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi” la, Abraham ɡbo laa ba chwerɛ tɛ.

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: Ya nɛra yaa dɛ yarada Korowii waa ir ya Dɔɔ Yeesu seo ta la, ya bwaa ba chwera tɛ. Ya bwaa Korowii ɛɛ ba lɛɛ kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, ya waa su o siwi.

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ya wechɔɡa waa Korowii leo ŋɔ ó ba sewɛ, asɛ Korowii berɛ iru seo ta, ásɛ a che o nɛɛ Korowii lɛ yaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Taraken nɔ, ya yarada aa ɡela Korowii lɛ yaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi nɔ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ a che asɛ ya ne Korowii pɛ.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: Yaa yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ ya te tɛo la, a taa a che o ɡel Korowii ɛɛ na ya sum dɛɛ cha yaa ɡɛ waa dɛ cha yaa nɔ. Anomanta, ya sie lɛo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ bela Korowii aa lole o waa dɔ jirima kohona la, ya ɡee do belaa.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: A ɡbo ta laa ya dɔ silɛɛ. Ya sie dɛ lɛ ya wahala yaa dɛ na nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ anee dɛɛ ba ɡela ya dɔ bambile.

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: Hwɛɡa yaa dɔa nɔ, aa pɛɛ ɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii tɛ yaa o Domadɛɛɡe la ásɛ ya jemɛ o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa kohona.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: A kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nɛn lɛ nɛndɛɛɡe kwaraa seo dɛ́ sewɛ. Nɛn waa dɛ nyin nɛn la te, bɛl lole nomɛl ken ɛɛ wonoo lɔ bambile lɛ o seo dɛ́ sewɛ.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, hé na ɡɛ Korowii tea aa dɛ domɛ nɛwɛnyini nɛ. Gɛ saŋ ya taa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la, a taa Yeesu Kristo lɛ ya seo sewɛ.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo seo taa a che asɛ Korowii ɡel ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi. Aah dɛ Korowii bwaawee baa ir nɛra nɛ aa, a te taa Yeesu Kristo aa wola won lɛ yaa aa?

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya ne Korowii fa dɔmɔ, asɛ o che o Bie Yeesu seo la ta dɛ ɡel ya ne o pɛ aa, ya ne Korowii aa pɛa taraken nɔ, a te ta kwaraa laa wɛɛ ba o Bie Yeesu seo ta ira, ne o le doe nɔ waa koeh dɛ́ lɛ yaa aa?

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: A ɡbo laa. Ya sie lɛ Korowii nɛɛ kohona ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nomanta. O nɛɛ a che ya ne Korowii pɛ. Adam ne Yeesu Kristo

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ nɛɛ a che wechɔɡa ba harɛ nɔ ta, asɛ a che o wechɔɡa ta seo ba harɛ ta. A waa seo bu nɛwɛnyini bwa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bwa ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Korowii aa wola Mosis Mmara la ne balɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ wechɔɡa lole. Kɛ bela Mmara aa wola toole la, baa wechɔɡa nkontaa bu.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Kɛ le Adam bere saŋ la ba le Mosis bere saŋ la, dɛ seo chɔ le tɛ nomɛlbwa. Hale nɛra ba fa aa wola Korowii nyoa vɛɛh kɛ Adam la bwaa fa dɛ serewe. Adam chaaree naate ba fa aa ŋɔa o dɛ ba bala la. Onee Yeesu Kristo.

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Kɛ Adam ne Yeesu waa ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ chae Korowii aa na ya sum dɛ cha yaa la, a ne Adam wechɔɡa ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ. A ɡwaala kohona. Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ wechɔɡa taa a che seo ba nomɛlbwa nɛ. Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ alaworomɛ ɡee nɛra bwa di. Onee Yeesu Kristo. O nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ sune nomɛlbwa nɛ, dɛ cha yaa kohona a ɡwaa Adam wechɔɡa la.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: A berɔ do kɛŋɔ chae Korowii aa cha yaa la ne waa aa le nɛmbeŋkpoŋ la wechɔɡa ta la ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ. Wechɔɡe beŋkpoŋ taa a che Korowii pa ya bwa bolchɔɡe. Asɛ wechɔɡa aa wara la, Korowii na ya bwa sum, dɛ cha yaa dɛ lɛ yaa kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ wechɔɡa taa seo che dɛɛ di kora nɛwɛnyina bwa nɛ. Gɛɛ a che nɛmbeŋkpoŋ nɛɛ asɛ Korowii na nɛwɛnyina sum kohona kwaraa dɛ cha yaa ya won ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi pɛɛpɛɛ dɛ di kora mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta. Onee Yeesu Kristo.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Gɛ Adam wechɔɡe beŋkpoŋ aa lɛ chɔɡre tɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa la, ɡɛɛ Yeesu Kristo wedɛɛɡe beŋkpoŋ waa ɛa ɡel Korowii lɛ yaa kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi, asɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa won dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ deŋnekpeɡ aa ɡela nɛra bwa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la, ɡɛɛ a che nɛmbeŋkpoŋ pwɛre waa doa ta, asɛ Korowii lɛ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Mmara balɔ dɛ ɡel wechɔɡa warɛ. Kɛ, wechɔɡa aa dɛ dawɛ la, a taa Korowii na nɛwɛnyina sum, dɛ cha yaa kohona.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Gɛ wechɔɡa aa cheɡɛ seo nɛɛ dɛɛ di kpeɡri la, ɡɛɛ Korowii suna waa dɛ sune nɛwɛnyina nɛɛ la ɡe che ɡɛ Korowii aa ɛ yaa nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi la ta dɛɛ di kpeɡri, asɛ ya won dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ɡelɔ nɛra ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su Korowii siwi.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Taraken nɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ŋɔe yɔ? A chɛ kɛ ya na dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ Korowii ɛɛ na ya sum, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ kɛ yaa tɔpere bɛlbwa kɛɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: He soɔh kɛŋɔ baa sɔ yaa Korowii nee yáa teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la, ya ne onee pɛa sewɛ kɛɛ?

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Baa sɔ yaa Korowii nee la nomanta, a kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ ya ne Yeesu Kristoo ba pɛ huɡe. Ya ne waa pɛa sewɛ la nomanta, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o kpeɡri a dɔŋ aa wola toole la ta dɛ iru seo ta la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba ya ɡe chae ya kwaa so sofale waa wera, dɛ́ charɛ dofale waa wera.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya ne o pɛo dɛ sewaa, ya ne wɛɛ pɛo ir seo ta.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya dobene la ne Yeesuu ba pɛ saɡɛ o daɡaɡre ta. Ya dobene la ne o wechɔɡa bwaa ba kpo, ásɛ o bɛ won di kpeɡri ya nɛɛ kpa, ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛ won yawɛ yaa yoma kpa.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa sewa la, o fooro le wechɔɡa kpeɡri aa dɛ di la be pera.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa sewɛ la nomanta, ya dɔ yarada kɛŋɔ yaa dɔ mkpaa ya ne o pɛ so.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo ir seo ta waa wola sewɛ kpa bwa, seo ta kpeɡri dɔe o nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: O seo waa sewa la, kerabeŋkpoŋii o sewɛ dɛ pɔ kpeɡri wechɔɡa aa dɔa la nɛ. Taraken soɡa waa soɡa nɔ, o soɡoo tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a chɛ kɛ he kpɔ he te kɛŋɔ he ne wechɔɡa toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa kɛ nɛn aa sewa la. He ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la nomanta, a chɛ kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii he do le tɛ.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ di kpeɡri he nɛ, ásɛ hɛɛ ɛ he bwadabii waa wola lee do saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ tetoowa.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: He bɛ he bwadabii bobɛlbwa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa. A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ nɛra baa sewa dɛ ir, dɛ charɛ ba soɡa ne ba dor. Hé kpɔ he bwadabii bobɛlbwa tɛ Korowii, dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Wechɔɡa aa kpeɡri dɔe ba he nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii suna waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ la lɔɡaa he do. He toole Mmara lɔɡa kpa. Yá kpɔ ya te do wedɛɛɡa ta dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Yaa lɔ Korowii suna waa sune ya nɛɛ lɔɡa yaa wola toole Mmara lɔɡa nɔ, a chɛ kɛ yaa ɛ wechɔɡa kɛɛ? Akai!

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Kɛ he jemɔ kɛŋɔ dɛ he kpɔ he te do nomɛl nɔn ta ŋɔ on dɔ heya aa, dɛ on dɔ heyaa kenɛ? He kpɔ he te tɛ wechɔɡa aa, hɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡaa ásɛ dɛ sewɛ. He kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii dɛɛ no o be naa, wɛɛ lɛ heyaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, ásɛ he waa su o siwi.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Korowii jam! Wechɔɡa fa aa yawɛ heyaa yom, asɛ taraken nɔ he no o waa baa chaɡle heyaa dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo he bambile bwa ne nɔ,

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Korowii le heyaa wechɔɡa yawa a fa aa yawɛ heyaa yom la ta. Taraken nɔ, he berɛ yoma dɛ tɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: He waa mun noe jaŋne, a waa n kpɔ waa haa dɛ noa tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛɛ baɡle heyaa waa la. Gɛ he fa aa teŋa dɛ kpɔ he te do wedoŋa ta wubwa dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé berɛ kpɔ he te do wedɛɛɡa ta, ásɛ he waa do ɡoroŋ.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Wubwa la, dɛ wechɔɡa yawɛ heyaa yoma. Dɛ he ne wedɛɛɡa toole wobɛlbwa bini.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Dɛ wechɔɡa ɡboo hɛɛ ɛ. Taraken nɔ, a waa dɛ ɛ heyaa sihiih. A ɡɛ waa nɔ, dɛ tɔnɔ besoo a dɔ tɛ heya ɔ? Waa aa lɔ ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ habɔɔ laanee seo.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken nɔ, Korowii le heyaa wechɔɡa ta. On dɔ heya. He tɔnɔ haa dɔa laanee kɛŋɔ he soɡa bini aa toɡra Korowii be. A taa aa ba cheɡa ásɛ he dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡa dɔ a kembɔr. A kembɔree seo. Asɛ kon Korowii ɡe aa dɛ tɛ laanee mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa. Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ o che dɛɛ tɛ a ɡɛ mkpa nɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Yabala, he jemɛ mmara wa, anomanta, he jemɔ kɛ harɛ ta ɡboo mmara dɔ kpeɡri nɛra nɛ.

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Haah waa yala la, dɛ o jaa ta sewaa, hahmor mmara vɔrɔwo, o ɛ o jaa la ɡbo haah. O jaa sewɔ te naa, dɛ hahmor mmara ta on vɔrɔwɛ kpa.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o jaa ta soɡe le, asɛ o ne banfale ɡe berɛ do le ja aa, baa yerɔ hanjwamanee. Dɛ o jaa sewɔ te naa, dɛ hahmor mmara ta on vɔrɔwe kpa. O yalɛ banfale aa, dɛ o ta jwamane bɔe.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Yabala, Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa la, a ɛo kɛŋɔ he ne onee pɛa sewɛ. Anomanta, he toole Mmara lɔɡa. Mmara la aa kpeɡri di he nɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ haah jaa sewaa, waa wola toole hahmor Mmara lɔɡa kpa la. He berɔ ɛ Yeesu Kristo waa ir seo ta la nɛra, ásɛ dɛ won ɛ Korowii toma, he waa dɔ tɔnɔ o be.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Saŋ la yaa lɔ wechɔɡa ya nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ aa dɛ nyin la ta dɛɛ ɛ la, dɛ Mmara la dɛ ir ya bambile wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, asɛ wobɛlbwa yaa dɛ ɛ la, aa kaa ya ne seo ta.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Taraken te ya fooro, Mmara la ta yaa dɔe kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya ne a ɡɛ Mmara nɔ o fa aa kpɔ yaa berɛ yoma la toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa. Ya ɛo kɛ yaa serewa. Yaa Mmara ŋwɛnɛ ta kpɔe dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii kpa. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee dɛɛ baɡle yaa ŋwɛnɛfale yaa tomɛ Korowii taraken. Mmara ne wechɔɡa wa

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, dɛ Mmara la aa were kɛɛ? O wer, kɛ on ɡela n jemɛ kɛŋɔ komɛl lole baa yerɔ wechɔɡa. Dɛ Mmara la fe ta ŋɔe ŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bɛ ɡel o sie beɡre o dɔŋ kon aa, n fe aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ sibeɡra aa were.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Liichɔɡa nao kɛŋɔ aa wonoo che Mmara Korowii aa doa la ta, dɛ́ ɡel n ɛ wechɔɡa. Liichɔɡa aa na ɡɛ la, a cheɡɛ Mmara la ta dɛ ɡel n sie ɛɛ beɡre komɛlbwa ta. Dɛ mmara toole naa, wechɔɡa ta kpeɡri dɔe.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Mmara aa wola toole la, dɛ wobɛlbwa toole n baŋa n so. Kɛ mmara aa bala la, belaa liichɔɡa ɡe ir, asɛ n na kɛŋɔ n sewɔ.

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: Mmara o fe aa chɛ kɛ ó ba mkpa ne la, seo nee o ba.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Liichɔɡa nao kɛŋɔ a dɔ bɔr name. Mmara taa a che dɛ neɡ mɛ, dɛ taɡ mɛ do seo ta.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Mmara la ɛ kondɛɛɡe, asɛ o bini wobɛlbwa ɡe toɡre dɛ do wer.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Aah dɛ kon waa wera nɔ, o taa a berɛ che mɛɛ ba seo dɔe yaa? O ta laa. Liichɔɡaa cheɡɛ kon waa wera ta dɛ ɡel n dɔ seo, dɛ baɡle o dor ásɛ n jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ. Mmara la taa a che asɛ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ liichɔɡa doŋo, aa wola were kwaraa.

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe bee Mmara la le dɛ do wer. Kɛ n te, nɛwɛnyinii men, anomanta, wechɔɡa yaɡ mɛ.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Waa maa dɛ ɛ kwaraa la nɔ, n ta wone jemɛ waa aa ɡela mɛɛ ɛa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ maa waa n fe aa dɛ nyin ɛɛ la ɛ. Waa maa wola nyin laanee mɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Maa wola waa maa dɛ ɛ nyin dɛ ɡee ɛa la nɔ, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ n sɛoh kɛŋɔ Mmara la wer.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ɡbaɡba laa dɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ. Liichɔɡa aa lɔ n bini la, an ɡela mɛɛ ɛa.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ liidɛɛɡa bɛlbwa toole n bini. N nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔɔ n ŋɔ nɔ. Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, n dɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ, kɛ maa won an ɛ.

english_verse: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.
translation_verse: Wedɛɛɡa maa dɛ nyin ɛɛ la, a laa mɛɛ ɛ. Wechɔɡa maa wola a ɛɛ nyin la, anee mɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Dɛ waa maa wola ɛɛ nyin la, dɛ anee mɛɛ ɛ aa, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba laa dɛɛ ɛa kpa, dɛ liichɔɡa aa lɔ n bini laanee dɛɛ ɛa.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Waa maa naa laanee kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ yaa, dɛ komɛl ŋɔ n bɛ ɛ.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: N bambile fe lawɛ Korowii Mmara la ta teŋa,

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: kɛ n bwadabii ɡe berɔ do dor bɛl. O dɛ vuuɡi n bambile. N bwadabii aa Korowii Mmara la aa lɔ n bambile bini la ta teŋa nyin. Liichɔɡaa ɡela n bwadabii aa wola Korowii Mmara la ta teŋa nyin nɔ. A ɡɛ liire nɔ yaɡ mɛ yom.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Akwe! Bɔkwa waa na mɛ ken ɔ? Umee dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ bwadabii nɔ waa dɛ kaa n ne seo ta nɔ nɔn ta nɔ?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
