translation_verse: Korowii jam. Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo alaworomɛ, Korowiirii dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ. Anomanta, n bambile bini te, Korowii Mmara taa mɛɛ teŋɛ. Kɛ n nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ be pera te, wechɔɡa taa mɛɛ teŋɛ.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Taraken nɔ nɛra ba ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la te aa bolchɔɡe dii ba ba tɛr ba deŋne.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe lɔɡa maa lole dɛ dɔ mkpa nɔ taa Yeesu Kristo che dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡa ne seo lɔɡa n fa aa lole la ta.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini mar aa do ɡɛ, waa wola kpeɡe dɛɛ tɔ Mmara ŋwɛnɛ, asɛ Mmara lɛ nɛwɛnyini kahonɛ la, Korowii te wono lɛ nɛwɛnyini. O ɡelɔ o Bie tenten kpɔ nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ dɔŋ, dɛ ba chɔɡ liichɔɡa kpeɡri o fa aa dɔa nɛwɛnyini nɛɛ la dɛ laa wechɔɡa kpɔ,

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: ásɛ ya waa do sweih kɛŋɔ Mmara la aa baɡla ŋɔ yá do la. Yaa nɛwɛnyini mar liichɔɡa aa suu nɔ waa ta teŋɛ, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa taa yaa teŋɛ.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ nɛwɛnyini mar liichɔɡa aa suu nɔ tetoowaa ta la, a taa ba ɡe liire do. Nɛra ba ɡe aa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa ta la, a taa ba liire do.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: He kpɔ liire do nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ liichɔɡa waa ta naa, he ne sewee. Kɛ he kpɔ liire do Korowii Domadɛɛɡe tetoowaa ta naa, he dɔ mkpa dɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: He te la, he ta he nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ som kpɔe ɡwaa wobɛlbwa. Dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe lɔ he nɛ aa, ɡɛ waa dɛ baɡle heyaa laanee hɛɛ ba dɛɛ ɛɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa wola Domadɛɛɡe Yeesu Kristo aa dɛ tɛ la dɔe la, dɛ Yeesu nɛn laa on.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Dɛ Yeesu Kristo Domadɛɛɡe la lɔ he nɛ aa, wechɔɡa nomanta, he bwadabii ɛɛ sewɔɔ te. Kɛ Korowii aa lɛ heyaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa he waa su o siwi nomanta, he lileore ɛɛ dɔ mkpaa.

english_verse: Yet God raised Jesus to life! God's Spirit now lives in you, and he will raise you to life by his Spirit.
translation_verse: Korowii waa ir Yeesu Kristo seo ta la, dɛ o Domadɛɛɡe lɔ he nɛ aa, ɡɛ Korowii aa iru seo ta la, wɛɛ che o Domadɛɛɡe la taa, dɛ́ tɛ he bwadabii aa dɛ ba pɔeh kerekere nɔ mkpa.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ nɛn teŋɛ nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ pɛla waa ta naa, waa mkpa dɔe ba. Kɛ dɛ nɛn cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la nɛɛ dɛ vɛh o bwadabii pɛla wobɛlbwa naa, wɛɛ dɔ mkpaa.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te tɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe wɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ la, Korowii biirii ban.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡee yon ɡel ya jemɛ ya bambile bini kɛŋɔ Korowii biirii yaa.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Yaa ɛ Korowii bii nomanta, dɛ ya sɛoh dɛ na wahala Yeesu Kristo aa naa la aa, ya ɡee di o kapɛrɛɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo aa dɛ di la, ásɛ Korowii kpɛɛ yaa ɡɛ waa kpɛɛ Yeesu Kristo la. Kerekere jirima wa

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Wahala nɔ yaa dɛ na taraken nɔ, he nyiŋi som yaa dɛ ba nae kerekere la aa, a ta wahala ɛɛ kwaraa.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Korowii kontaala bwa siwi swɛɛrɔ aa kpa tɔɔ la wee Korowii aa baɡle nɛra baa ɛ o bii la.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: A dɛ yo dɛ yo kaahonɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ta a te dɔe. Korowiirii taa o tetoora ta kɛŋɔ a bɛ kpeɡri dɔ. Kɛ a dɛ hwɛɡɛ

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: kɛŋɔ tɔpebɛl Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo a foo dɛ́ le kpeɡri bɛ dɔe nɔ ta, aa wola pɔh kpa, dɛ́ ja Korowii bii nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡe na som kɛŋɔ baa foora la.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ba le fini, Korowii kontaala bwa bwara dɛ nyɛɡ, aa pɛmɛ kɛŋɔ lol tea aa lɔ haah o yon dɛɛ pɛmɛ la.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, Korowii kontaala ɡbo bwara laa dɛɛ nyɛɡ. Ya nɛra yaa dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ kwaa Korowii aa ba tɛ yaa la bini konloɡle la, ya ɡba bwara dɛ nyɛɡ. Ya dɛ nyiŋi Korowii ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ba ɛ yaa o biirii, dɛ́ lɛ ya bwadabii le wechɔɡa ne seo nɔn ta.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Korowii aa lɛ yaa la, dɛ ɡɛ hwɛɡa nɔɔ ya dɔ. Kon nɛn aa dɔa la, waa berɛ dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ o waa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ dɔɔ kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ kon waa wola nɛn nɔn ta joɛ la, o waa baa hwɛɡɛ.

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Ya te la, kon waa wola ya nɔn ta joɛ mɔɔ la, o waa yaa hwɛɡɛ. Yaa too.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Gɛ ya hwɛɡa yaa dɔa la aa lawɛ yaa ya wahala bwa bini la, ɡɛɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡee cha yaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya yarada aa kanɛ. Yaa jemɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ yaa soŋe Korowii kwara. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe soŋɔ dɛɛ tɛ yaa sum ne, nɛn aa wola won baɡle kwara.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Korowii te jemɛ nɛn bambile bini waa bwa, dɛ jemɛ o Domadɛɛɡe la nyu bini, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin la, ɡɛɛ o Domadɛɛɡe la soŋo dɛɛ tɛ o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ nyin Korowii la, wobɛlbwa aa puu ba la, o ɡelɔ a ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba. O tetooraa o lee ba ba ɛ o bii.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Nɛra Korowii aa jemɛ ba waa cheɡ wubwa la, waa wola ban tae mɔɔ la, dɛ o tɔ sie lee ba ŋɔ bá ba do kɛŋɔ o Bie la ken, ásɛ ba bwa ɛ o Bie la nimanar, ásɛ o ɡe ɛ ba Dɔɔ.

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Ya ta sie nyiŋi anɔ bwa na naa, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ŋɔe yɔ? Dɛ Korowii teŋɛ ya nɛ aa, umee dɛ́ won ɛ yaa waane ɔ?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Nɛn waa wola yaa o Bie kwaraa vɔmɛ, dɛ koh ya bwa waa kpɔɔ do nɛwɛnyina nɔn ta ba kpoo la, bɔkwaa bala waa wola tea ta dɛ́ tɛ yaa komɛlbwa dɛ ja o Bie la nɛɔ?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won na Korowii bii waa lee ba nɔ bwara wechɔɡe bɛl dɛ bolɔ? Korowii kwara waa dɛ pa bole la, o ŋɔ ba waa wer dɛɛ su o siwi.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Aah dɛ umee dɛ́ won pa ba bolchɔɡe ɔ? Yeesu Kristo kɛɛ? Sewaa o te koh ya waa sewɛ, kɛ a ɡbo laa. O berɔ ir seo ta dɛ ka so nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta, dɛ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ yaa.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa dɛ won pere ya ne Yeesu Kristo baah waa wola ya waa nyina ba kpaɔ? Noe aa dɛ no yaa kɛɛ wahala yaa dɛ na, kɛɛ cheɡa nɛra aa cheɡɛ ya nɛ, kɛɛ lɔr, kɛɛ nyaa, kɛɛ dɛ ya cheɡɛ seo nyoa o, kɛɛ sewɔ?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii Tɔn aa dɛ baɡle la, “He nomanta, ya cheɡɛ seo nyoa saŋ bɛlbwa. Saŋ bɛlbwaa baa ɛ yaa kɛŋɔ peera baa dɛ la ka kpoa la ken.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa sekwaraa ta la, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ yaa yoo le. Yeesu Kristo waa nyin yaa la nɛɛ yaa ba cheɡa dɛ le.

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa toole dɛ do nyundua kɛɛ harɛ bobɛlbwa dɛ́ won tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ. Korowii kontaala bini komɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won pere yaa le Korowii nyina aa cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ wɛɛ nyin yaa la ta.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Kasinteŋii mɛɛ ba bola la. Maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛn la nomanta, maa nyosone teŋe. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ɡelɔ n jemɛ n bambile bini kɛŋɔ maa nyosone teŋe.

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: N tea bini chɔɡɔ, n bambile ɡe aa n wee ɡel bwa.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: N ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ tena baa ɛ n nɛraa ɡela n bambile bwa wee mɛ ɡɛ nɔ. Dɛ Korowii taah mɛ asɛ n ne Yeesu Kristo baah pere kwaraa ásɛ o lɛɛ ba aa, n dɛ nyin ɡɛ.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Israel tena maa dɛ bol ba waa nɔ, Korowii ɛɛ ba o bii dɛ baɡ ba o jirima. O ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo, asɛ o tɛɛ ba o Mmara, dɛ baɡ ba ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ baa tomɔ, dɛ baɡ ba nyoa bele aŋwɛnɛ bwa.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ba nabaala la nɛra bwa aa jemɛ ba waa la naanaree ban. Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛɛ ba la, o nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ be pera la, ba dwee on. Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyini bwa nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa. Onee chɛ kpɛɛra. Aamen.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ Korowii vɛh o nyobaɡa la ta teŋa, kɛ Israel tena bwa laa Korowii le kɛ o nɛra.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Abraham dwee la te bwa waa lol ba ɡɛ nɛra bwa aa dɛ lolɛ la, Korowii nɛra laa ban. Abraham bie la Korowii aa baɡɔ nyoa la, o dweee Korowii jemɛ kɛŋɔ Abraham naanaree ban,

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa la, waa waa bola laanee kɛŋɔ, “Benanyoa saŋ nɔ mɛɛ berɔɔ ba. N ne bala dɛ Saara lolɛ bibaa.”

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Anɔ ɡbo laa. Rebɛka aa kpoŋe o kpara la tea la, ba bwa mɛɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ. Ya nabaa Aesekee ba mɛɛ.

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: “Bii nɔ, bechala la ɛɛ lɛ nomonome o dɔɔ bee, ásɛ o dɔɔ la berɛ dɛɛ tomɔ.” A ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ lee Korowii aa le Jekɔb la, o tetooraa o leo. Jekɔb we-ɛɛla laa o nyiŋi dɛ leo.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii Tɔn la baɡle ŋɔ, “N nyin Jekɔb dɛ hah Esɔ” la.

english_verse: Are we saying God is unfair? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Amɔ yaa wonoo ŋɔ Korowii waa ta toɡrɛ kɛɛ? O waa toɡrɔ.

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: Waa nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ nyin ne anɔ la yaa dɛ ɛ la, Korowii te aa an nyiŋi. O te suna waa sune nɛwɛnyina nɛɛ la, anee wɛɛ nyiŋi.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ɡɛ Korowii fa aa ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be la. Anee kɛŋɔ, “N ɡelɔ he ɛ kooro ásɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa che he nɛɛ dɛ na ɡɛ maa dɔ kpeɡri, asɛ dɛ yerɛ n sɔn harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Naate Korowii tea aa toora kɛŋɔ ó sune o nɛɛ la, o nɛɛ wɛɛ sune. Naate ɡe o tea aa toora kɛŋɔ ó ɡel o deŋne do kpeɡri la, onee o ɡel o deŋne ɛɛ do kpeɡri.

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Nomɛl ɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Dɛ kenii a do aa, Korowii ɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ nomɛl deŋne kpeɡri nomanta, o ɛ wechɔɡa aa? Umee dɛ́ won ŋɔ Korowii we-ɛɛla bɛ won ɛɔ?”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Dɛ henee ume kɛŋɔ Korowii bol waa he chaŋe bɛl ɔ? Vii ɡee wonoo bɔɔ mamaa waa aa bala o mao ɡɛ waa mao wa aa?

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do Korowii be. Nɛwɛnyina ɛ o viine waa maa. Bane chɛ chɔɡa. O ma bane ɡe ásɛ ba ba na som o be. Dɛ o fe dɛ nyin o baɡle o bandia nɛra baa chɛ chɔɡa la nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel nɛra na o kpeɡri, kɛ o lawɛ bambile,

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: ásɛ nɛra waa sune ba nɛɛ dɛ cheɡ ba kɛŋɔ bá ba na som la won jemɛ ɡɛ o som la aa doa dɛ dɔ jirima kohona.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Kenii o ŋɔ o keame Hosia tɔn bini. “Nɛra ba fa aa wola n nɛra ɛɛ n fa aa wola ban nyin la, mɛɛ yer baa n nɛra ne n nɛnnyinaa.”

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Aah dɛ bɔkwaa ɡela a ba ɡɛ nɔ? Baa wola sie kpɔe dawɛ Korowii yaradae ta, dɛ kpɔ sie dawɛ ba we-ɛɛla ta kɛŋɔ anee dɛ́ ɡel Korowii siwi su ba la, a waa. Anomanta, ba lɔ naa Bwe nɛra aa lɔ naa o ta dɛɛ chole la ta.

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: O waa ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la. Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ Bwee cheɡ Saayɔn, ásɛ nɛra ɛɛ lɔ naa o ta dɛɛ choɡli. Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa yaradao la, sihiih aa o kpoe ba.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Yabala, Korowii fe lɛ Israel tena aa, a fe som n be noo! N soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛɛ ba ɡa.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Baa ɡɛ Korowii aa ɛa dɛɛ lɛ nɛra kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba wa ɛɛ su o siwi jemɛ, anomanta, ba ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛɛ baa kpɔ, dɛ vɛh Korowii ŋwɛnɛ waa cheɡɛ o ta dɛ ɡel nɛra wa ɛɛ su o siwi la ta teŋa.

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Kenii Mosis bol nɛra baa dɛ nyin ba che Mmara ta teŋa ta ásɛ ba waa su Korowii siwi la wa. O ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ waa aa lɔ Mmara la bwa ta la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpaa le Mmara la ta teŋa ta.”

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Kenii Korowii Tɔn baɡle nɛra baa che yarada ta, ásɛ ba waa su o siwi ɡe wa, “Bɛ he nyu bini lii ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ la nyundua?’ dɛ́ kpɔ Yeesu Kristo tu harɛ,

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: ‘kɛɛ dɛ tu bɔluŋ bini dɛ ka nyinu ba nɔ?’ dɛ ka nyinu le lala bini ba.”

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii Tɔn aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, “Korowii waa la pu heyaa tonɛ a lɔ he nyoo ne he bambili ta kwara.” Yeesu Kristo yaradae waa yaa dɛ bol he be laanee Korowii waa nɔ.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Dɛ he nɛn kpɔ nyoa ŋɔ komɛlbwa Dɔɔree Yeesu, dɛ yarada he bambile bini kɛŋɔ Korowii iru seo ta naa, Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ,

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa yaradao la, sihiih aa o kpoe ba.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Juu tena ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ba bwa kɛrɛdɛ Korowii be. Komɛlbwa Dɔɔree Korowii. Nomɛlbwa waa wia dɛɛ yerɔ la, o dɛ chao kohona.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii Tɔn bol la, “Nomɛlbwa waa wi yerɛ ya Dɔɔ la, wɛɛ lɛo.”

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Aah dɛ nɛn ta on yaradae dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo waa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won yerɛ o sɔn ó lɛo wɔ? Dɛ nɛn ta o waa noɛ yaa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won yaradao dɛ́ kpɔ o te tɛo wɔ? Dɛ nɛn ta o waa la bolɛ nɛn be naa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ ó noɔ?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii ta nɛn tomaa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ bol o waa laɔ? Anee kɛŋɔ Korowii Tɔn aa ŋɔa la. O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ toroma baa kpoŋe Amanesoma dɛɛ valɛ la, hé no ba bala wa aa, he bambile ɛɛ sɔɔh heyaa taeh!”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Amanesoma la balɔ, kɛ Israel tena bwa laa sɛh a ta teŋa. Korowii keame Aesaya ɡbaɡba fa bolɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, umee yarada waa yaa bol ba be laɔ?”

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bɔɔ heyaa webeŋkpoŋii. Kpelaa kɛŋɔ ba ta noɛ yaa? Ba noɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Ba waa baa dɛ bol la la harɛ ta bobɛlbwa nɛra aa lole, a tel harɛ jaɡa bwa.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: N berɔ dɛɛ bɔɔ ja. Israel tena fa ta noɛ yaa? Mosis tɔ sie chwerɛ waa Korowii aa bola, dɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ bɔweela nɛra baa wola ban kure dɛɛ ja n nɛra nɛɛ la nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he bwaawee ir harɛ o nɛra aa ɡɛna nɛ.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Korowii keame Aesaya te kwaraa chwerɛ Korowii wobol ane a ɡwaa ɡɛ. O chwerɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra ba fa aa wola n bɔr ɡaaɡe la, ban na mɛ, banɔ la ba fa aa wola n waa bɔɔ la, banee n kpɔ n te chaɡle.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Kenii o baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa bol Israel tena ɡe wa, “Saŋ bɛlbwaa n paɡri n nɔɔra kɛŋɔ ń lɛ n nɛra kɛ baa men yarada. Ba deŋne kpeɡri, baa waa ɡe no.”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: N dɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, Korowii vɛh o nɛra Israel tena kɛɛ? Akai! N ɡbabir nɔ, Israel tee men. N ɛ Abraham naa dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Korowii ta nɛra o fa aa lee ba cheɡ wubwa ba ɛ o nɛra la vɛɛh. Kɛ he jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa bol Korowii keame Elaeja waa ŋɔ o chɔɡ Israel tena tɛ Korowii laɔ?

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: O bolɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ba kpoo he keamere dɛ huɡri bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛɛ bwa. N ɡboo kaa, dɛ ba dɛ nyin n ɡba kpoe.”

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ŋɔe yɔ? Gɛ Israel tena aa dɛ nyin kɛ ba waa su Korowii siwi la, ba ta ɡɛ dɔe. Nɛra tama Korowii aa lee ba ba ɛ o nɛra la, ba waa su o siwi. Ba kar taŋ deŋne Korowii be.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do taraken. Nɛra tama bane ta lole Korowii aa na ba sum dɛ lee ba ba ɛ o nɛra.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ba we-ɛɛla ta laa a che o lee ba. Ba sumii o na dɛ lee ba ba ɛ o nɛra. Dɛ ba we-ɛɛla taa a fe che o lee ba ba ɛ o nɛra aa, dɛ suna baa ŋɔa Korowii dɛ sune nɛwɛnyini nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba la ta mun dɔe.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii saa ba liire, dɛ tɛɛ ba sie aa wola kasinteŋ laanee na, ne deŋna aa wola kasinteŋ laanee no, dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini tɔpere nɔ” la.

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Gel ba nyoŋe, ásɛ dɛɛ na wahala saŋ bɛlbwa.” Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ lɛɛ wa

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ bɔɔ webeŋkpoŋii ja. Israel tena aa lɔ naa dɛ chole la, ba denɔ chole baa wola won ir kpa aa? Akai! Baa iruu, kɛ ba wechɔɡa la taa a che Korowii lɛɛ waa lɛ nɛwɛnyina la maa nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ, ásɛ Israel tena na ba bwara wee ba.

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: He nɛra haa wola Israel tena ɛɛ la, he bee mɛɛ bol waa nɔ. Korowii aa lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ Yeesu torome he be nɔ, mɛɛ maŋkura n toma nɔɔ.

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: Bɛl lole n bwɛɛ tena na ɡɛ naa, baa meeroo, asɛ a che a ta ba bane lɛ Yeesu waa nɔ.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Aa cheɡɛ Israel tena ne Korowii baah chɔɡa ta asɛ nɛwɛnyina kabora ne Korowii baah kwaa nɔ, dɛ Korowii berɔ lɛ Israel tena dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ o bii aa, bɔkwa nee aa ba bala ɔ? Aa ba silɛɛ nee kohona, kɛŋɔ lala bwa aa ir seo ta.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Dɛ kon pera wer dɛ chɛ Korowii aa, dɛ o kar la bwa ɡe wer. Dɛ daa lune wer dɛ chɛ Korowii aa, dɛ o ne o kpala bwaa.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Moo laa pala dɛɛ kaa nyundua la aa? Israel tena do kɛ kobaah ɔleve da. Ba teŋe o kpala ane ta, dɛ kpɔ hen haa wola Israel te ɛɛ dɛ do kɛ kpɔɡ baah ɔleve daa kpale, dɛ ba vɔrɔwe marɛ kobaah kon la bɛl buɡ ta, asɛ hɛɛ nyɔ o nedɛɛɡa dɛ di, dɛ dɛɡ.

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, bɛ kena dɛɛ kpaɡri daa kpala la baa kɛa ta la nɛ. He mbarafo mun ɔ? Daa kpale laa hen kɛɛ? Hen ɡela daa la lune do le kɛɛ an ɡela he do le nɔ?

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: He te ɛɛ ŋɔɔ he waa ba kɛ daa la kpala la ta asɛ dɛ vɔrɔwe marɛ.

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: He ŋɔ ɡɛ naa, kpelaa he ŋɔ. Baa wola Yeesu waa la yaradae waa ba teŋ ba ta. He ɡe aa yarada Yeesu waa la, a waa he ta che la. Anomanta, bɛ mbarafo dɛɛ ɛ. Pwɛr he te dɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Israel tena kwaraa baa ɛ daa la tenten pera la, Korowii kɛ ba ta. He tenee dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, waa wola heyaa kɛ ta aa?

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: He nyiŋo na naa, dɛ he jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii tea som, kɛ o waa ɡe kpeɡri taeh. Nɛra ba deŋne aa kpeɡa baa wola o ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋɛ la, o dɛ nyiŋ ba sinyɛɡa ne. Kɛ dɛ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o ŋwɛnɛ taa te naa, wɛɛ ta tea tɛ he te. Kɛ dɛ he ta o ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋaa, wɛɛ kɛ he ɡee ta.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Dɛ Israel tena berɔ yarada Yeesu waa la te naa, Korowii ɛɛ berɔɔ lɛɛ ba do ba buɡ ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ aa kpeɡe o be.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Korowii laa ɡela ba teŋe he nɛra haa do kɛ kpɔɡ baah ɔleve daa kpala, dɛ ba vɔrɔwe marɛ kobaah ɔleve daa muŋkpul ta nɔ naa, ba fe aa an ɡɛ ɛ wubwa. Korowii ɛɛ lɛ Israel tena bwaa

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Yabala, wesɔɔhla anee mɛɛ nyin kɛ he jemɛ, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa laa he den jemɛ. Anee kɛŋɔ Israel tena nɔ bane deŋnekpeɡ baa dɛ ɛ nɔ, ken laa aa ba kae. Nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ nyin kɛ o lɛɛ ba la, ba tel ɡɛ del waa dɛ nyin la aa, Israel tena ɛɛ ɡel ba deŋnekpeɡ nɔɔ.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ lɛ Israel tena bwaa ba ɛ o bii, kɛŋɔ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡla la. O baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyina Lɛɛ la ɛɛ le Saayɔnee ba, dɛ́ ba le Israel tena waa aa ɡela baa wola Korowii waa ta teŋɛ bwa la ta.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Fɔo n ne báa fɔwɛ laanee kɛŋɔ mɛɛ lee baa ba wechɔɡa taa.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Israel tena aa vɛh Yeesu Amanesoma la nomanta, ba berɛ Korowii dɔma, asɛ a le wedɛɛɡa tɛ heya. Kɛ baa ɛ nɛra Korowii aa chal ba la nomanta, o ta dɛ nyin ba taeh. Nyoa waa baɡɛ ba naawa la, a waa o taa nyin ba la.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Korowii te dɔɔ ŋɔ o nɛnee nɛn, dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo wedɛɛɡaa yaa, waa nsana le.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Gɛ he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ fa aa wola Korowii waa ta teŋɛ, asɛ o koh kɛ Israel tena vɛh o waa ta teŋa, asɛ dɛ sune he nɛɛ la,

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: ɡɛ tenten Israel tena aa vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa la, wɛɛ koh suna waa sune he nɛɛ la waa dɛ́ sune ba ɡe nɛ.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyina bwa taŋ deŋne Korowii be, asɛ o koh a waa dɛ pa nɛra bwa bolchɔɡe. Ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa toole yá che o ta dɛ́ le a ɡɛ bolchɔɡe nɔ ta. A ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ Korowii na ya bwa sum. Korowii kpɛɛra

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Ei! Korowii liire ne o wejema kan te! Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ Korowii waa mun ɔ? Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ o waa bini bwa nɔ?

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Anee Korowii Tɔn baɡle la. O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Umee jemɛ Korowii nyu bini nɔ? Umee dɛ́ won baɡlo waɔ?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Ume komɛlee Korowii kemɛ ka a ɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii di o kem dɛ ba bɔɔ wɔ?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: O ta nomɛlbwa kem dii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ on ta kon te bɛlbwa. O nɛɛ komɛlbwa che dɛ do le, o waa ɡee a do le. O chɛ jirima saŋ bɛlbwa. Aamen.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: He bɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire la da kpɔ. Hé ɡel Korowii tɛ heyaa liifala, dɛ́ berɛ heyaa ásɛ he won jemɛ waa waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa wera o be dɛɛ too o tea, ne waa aa toɡra.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: N cheɡɛ suna Korowii aa sune n nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ o toma do n nɔn ta nɔ ta, dɛɛ ja heyaa kɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa haa doa la, ɡel ba nae ɡɛ. Bɛ́lbwa pwɛr o te, dɛ́ won jemɛ waa Korowii aa tɛo yarada ŋɔ ó kpɔ ɛ.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Ya bwadabii ɛ kombeŋkpoŋ, dɛ dɔ nyu, ne nɔɔra, ne nakpale, dɛ amesoore bwa. A bwa ɡe ne a tomaree.

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ ya ɡba do. Ya warɔ te, kɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa nɔ, ya bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, ya bɛlbwa ɡe lole tɛ ya dɔŋa.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Kpeɡri Korowii aa cha ya bwa ya dɔ kokoɡrɔ. A chɛ kɛ ya bɛlbwa kpɔ kpeɡri Korowii aa sune o nɛɛ dɛ tɛo la ɛ toma. Dɛ Korowii Waa bola kpeɡrii o kpɔ tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ bola ɡɛ del he yarada aa doa.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔŋa toma kpeɡrii Korowii tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ. Dɛ waa baɡla kpeɡri ɡee o tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ baɡle.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra ɡbemba doe kpeɡrii Korowii tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ. Dɛ dɔŋa kwaa kɛɛ kpeɡrii o tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛa bambile bwa ne. Dɛ waa sie tɔe kpeɡrii o tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛa tea bwa ne. Dɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ kpeɡrii o tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛa tepoŋ ne.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa bambile bwa ne. Hé hah wechɔɡa te bɛlbwa, dɛ́ lawɛ wedɛɛɡa te bɛlbwa bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Hé lawɛ dɔŋa kɛ nyabii, dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa duure ɡwaa ɡɛ haa dɛ lii he te ɡbaɡba.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Hé laa bɔhwaah kpɔ he waa bini, dɛ́ do ɡbemba dɛɛ tomɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Haa dɔ hwɛɡa nomanta, hé ɡel he sie lɛ. Wobɛlbwa pu heya aa, hé lawɛ bambile. Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Hé soŋe andɛɛɡa Korowii be dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa cheɡɛ he nɛ. Hé soŋe andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, he bɛ wechɔɡa soŋe dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Nɛra lɔ silɛɛ bini naa, hé puu ba he ne ba lɛ sie. Ba dɛ wi ɡe aa, hé ne ba wi.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Hé ne he dɔŋa so sodɛɛɡa. He bɛ jenu dɛɛ ɛ, he bɛ he te pere dɛɛ le nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra bini. He bɛ he te wejerema kohona dɛɛ lii.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: He bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ dɛɛ bɔ wechɔɡa kem. Hɛ́ɛ ɛ waa aa wera nomɛlbwa be.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Dɛ aa maɡroo waa, hɛɛ wonoo waa, hé takapɔ ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa bɛ he ne nomɛlbwa baah do.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Yabala, nɛra ɛ heyaa wechɔɡa aa, he bɛ ane ɛ dɛɛ bɔ kem. Hé kpɔ tɛ Korowii. O baah dɛ di ba nɛɛ taeh. On dɛ bɔ ba kem, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ tɔ a peɡee, mɛɛ bɔ ba a kemee.’ ”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: He bɛ waa kem dɛɛ bɔ. Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa ŋɔa hɛ́ɛ ɛ la. “He dɔm chɔ lɔr aa, tɛo kondikwaa ó di. Nyɔɡre dɛ kpoo waa, tɛo nee ó nyɔ. He ɛ ken aa, sihiih dɛ ba o kpoe o baŋa ɡole.”

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel liichɔɡa lɛ he lem. Hé kpɔ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɔ wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa siwi su o harɛ nomonome dɛɛ teŋɛ ba mmara ɡe ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ta ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ yaa, nomonome aa lee do. Korowiirii cheɡ ba.

english_verse: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh o harɛ nomonome mmara ta teŋa la, dɛ waa Korowii aa cheɡaa o vɛh. Wɛɛ di bolchɔɡee.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la, baa nomonome ɔmɛ. Wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa dɛɛ ɔm ba. Haa nyin kɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ nomonome sie cheɡa aa, amɔ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa. He dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa, baa kpɛɛree,

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii bonɔɔnaa ban. He kɛrɛdɛ waa baa ɛ ba toma la. Dɛ he dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa te naa, dɛɛ ɔmɛ nomonome, dɛkalkɛŋɔ pɛɛpɛɛ laa ba dɔ kpeɡri baa kpoŋa la. Korowiirii tɛɛ ba kpeɡri ásɛ ba tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne dɛɛ tɛo.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: A waa a do wer kɛŋɔ hɛɛ bɔ toɔ ɡe la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomonome baa do toɔ lɛɛ mmara nɔ la, Korowii tomaa baa ɛ ɡɛ la.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Korowii Mmara aa chaɡla kɛŋɔ, “Bɛ jwamane bɔ, bɛ nɛn kpo, bɛ ŋwɛ, bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre he dɔŋ kon la,” a ne anɔ la aa kaa la bwa lɔ a ɡɛ Mmara beŋkpoŋ nɔ waa dɛ baɡle kɛ, “Nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he ɡbaɡba” nɔ ta.

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Nɛn haa dɛ nyinu la, haa on wechɔɡaa ɛ bwa. Naate waa dɛ nyin o dɔŋ la, dɛ o dɛ teŋɛ Korowii Mmara la bwa ta.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he jemɔ kɛŋɔ tɔpere la telo. He jemɔ kɛŋɔ a telo kɛŋɔ dɛ chɔe he chɔ a, he ir! Ya lɛɛ tɔpere la joɔ tonɛ taraken dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ saŋ yaa kpɔ ya te tɛ Yeesu dɛ pa mun dɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ la.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Tɔpere waa kaa bɔr chaah la aa kanɛ kpa. Tɔɔ perɔ tonɛ. Hé ɡel ya ɡel waa aa ɛ biro bini waa ɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ bochaah laala do dɛ́ won yo biro bini wa.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya lawɛ ya te kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ do kɛ nɛra bɔr aa chaah ba nɛ. Dɛ warɛ dɛ valɛ dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa ne sennyɔdɛɛ waa toole kpa, hanyin ne banyin ne wedoŋa toole kpa, naɡrenyin ne bɔweela toole kpa.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ dɔmkwa, dɛ́ laa sie kpɔ he nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ tetoowaa ta.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Dɛ Kristo te bɛl lole, o yarada aa wola kanɛ wɛɛ nyin o jo he bini naa, hé lɛo do he bini. He bɛ o we-ɛɛla aa korɛ he kwaa ta la dɛɛ tɔŋle.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Bɛl yarada ɡelɔ o won komɛlbwa dii, asɛ naate o yarada aa wola kanɛ la, o ɡee di papooni ne taŋna ɡbo, waa ol di.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Henee umeo he won pwah nomɛl bonɔɔ nɔ? O dɔɔ ɡbaɡbaa dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ó won baɡle kɛ o bonɔɔ dɛ ɛ waa kɛɛ waa waa ɛ. Waa ɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ la nomanta, wɛɛ ɛ waa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ wɛɛ wonoo chao o ɛ wa.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Nomɛl ɛɛ dɛɛ liiruu kɛŋɔ tɔpere bɛl ɛ onjen ɡwaa bɛl, ásɛ bɛl ɡee lii kɛŋɔ tɔpera bwa kɛrɛdɛ. A chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa jemɛ anɔ la aa wera kɛŋɔ o ɛ ne anɔ la aa wola were o nyu bini.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Ya bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ so le dɛ tɛ o ɡbo, bɛlbwa ɡe toole o seo ɛ o ɡbo wa.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Yaa lɔ mkpa ta nɔ, dɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu waa ya do le. Dɛ ya baa sewɛ ɡe aa, dɛ onee ya sewɛ tɛ. Anomanta, ya lɔ mkpa ta noo, sewaa ya sewoo, ya Dɔɔ Yeesuu dɔ yaa.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa dɛ ir la, o ɛ ɡɛ dɛ ɛ weera ne lala bwa dɔɔ.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Aah dɛ bɔkwaa ɡela he nɛra haa wola ol di ɛɛ pwah he bala baa dɛ di komɛlbwa nɔɔ? He banɔ la haa dɛ di komɛlbwa ɡe la, bɔkwaa ɡela hɛɛ lii he bala baa wola ol di nɛndoŋa nɔɔ? Ya bwa ɛɛ che Korowii siee, ásɛ o bol ya waa dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɡuŋ mɛ harɛɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa di kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii men.’ ”

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya bɛlbwa ɛɛ baɡle o toma waa ɛa Korowii siee.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Pɛɛ n ne n Dɔɔ Yeesu aa pɛa nɔ ɡelɔ n jemɛ kaih kɛŋɔ, kondikwaa bɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ kondikondoŋa. Kɛ dɛ nomɛl lii o nyu bini kɛŋɔ kondikwaa ane ɛ kondikondoŋa aa, dɛ a ɛ doŋa dɛ tɛo.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Dɛ he koh he kondikwaa waa dɛ ɡel he dɔŋ ɛ wechɔɡa o tea bini chɔɡ aa, dɛ he dɛ nyinu wa aa? O waa Yeesu Kristo koh dɛ sewɛ, anomanta, bɛ ɡel he kondikwaa haa dɛ di la chɔɡo.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel nɛra dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ yerɛ waa haa dɛ liira wedɛɛɡa la wedoŋa.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Kondikwaa yaa dɛ di ne anɔ la yaa dɛ ki la ta wejena bɛlbwa ɛɛ Korowii Kora waa bini. Waa aa ɛ wehiah laanee kɛŋɔ ɡɛ yaa ɛ ya waa su Korowii siwi, ne waa aa dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne ya ne ya dɔŋa baah ta, ne silɛɛ aa le Korowii Domadɛɛɡe be.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Nɛn a ɡɛ waa nɔ aa hiaoh Yeesu Kristo toma bini la, Korowii sie dɛ lɛ o nɛ, asɛ o wa ɛɛ su nɛwɛnyina ɡe siwi.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ ya ɡel ya siwi swɛɛ waa aa dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne, ne waa aa dɛ ba ɡela ya dɔŋa che kiŋkiŋ ta.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Bɛ kondikwaa waa koh dɛ́ chɔɡ waa Korowii aa ɛa. Ya won kondikwaa bɛlbwa dii, kɛ aa were kɛŋɔ ya di kondikwaa aa dɛ ba nɛn ne wechɔɡa ta laŋa.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Waa aa toɡra kɛ hɛɛ ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ ol dii ne sen nyɔe, ne wobɛlbwa aa dɛ ba wona ɡel he dɔŋ lɔ naa chole la, a chɛ kɛ he laa he te kpɔ a ta.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Gɛ he liire aa dɛ ɛɛ kondikwaa dii be pera la, kpoŋe a bini ɡɛ, ásɛ a do he ne Korowii ɡbo baah ta. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ aŋwɛnɛ taa wɛɛ ɛa, aa wola o liire bini aahna aahna ɛ la, o na som!

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Ya nɛra ya yarada aa kana la, a chɛ kɛ yaa lawɛ bambile banɔ la ba yarada aa wola kanɛ la nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba. A ta chɛɛ kɛ yaa ɛ ya ɡbo tetoowa.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ya bɛlbwa ɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera dɛɛ tɛ ya dɔŋa, ásɛ a cha ba, ásɛ ba won che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo aa lɔ harɛ ta la, dɛ o tetoowaa laa wɛɛ ɛ. Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii, chɛɡa baa chɛɡɛ la, anee ba kpɔ tɛ mɛ.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Korowii waa dɛ tɛ nɛn bambile dɛɛ do ɡbemba la, on dɛ tɛ heyaa nyopɛo teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la ta,

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: ásɛ he pɛ dɛ́ kpɔ nyopɛo kpɛɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé lɛ nɛra dɛɛ ja he nɛɛ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa lɛ heyaa la, ásɛ nɛra na dɛ tɛ Korowii jirima,

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo wono ɛ toma Juu tena bini, asɛ dɛ chaɡle kɛ Korowii waa dɔ kasinteŋ. Anee Korowii ɛ dɛ chuɡri o nyobaɡa waa baɡɛ Israel tena naawa la,

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: ásɛ a che a ta nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɡe kpɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ kohona. Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bobɛl ŋɔ, “Anomanta, mɛɛ yerɛ he sɔn nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ baahnee, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛre.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ chaɡle bobɛl ɡe ŋɔ, “He nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, hé pu Israel tena hɛɡre.”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Dɛ berɛ chwerɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, hé bwa jam N Naa Korowii, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛro.”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Asɛ Aesaya ɡe bol ja, dɛ ŋɔ, “Jese naa bɛl ɛɛ bao. On dɛ́ ir dɛ́ di kora nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ nɛ. O nɛɛ baa ba hwɛɡa dɔe.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Korowii waa ɡela ya dɔ hwɛɡa Yeesu nɛɛ la, ó tɛ heyaa silɛɛ ne bansɔɔhna he yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii la ta, ásɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡe cha heyaa, ásɛ he won dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ Yeesu nɛɛ kohona. Pɔɔl bol waa baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Yabala, n ɡbabir jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa taeh. He jemɛ waa kohona, dɛ won dɔŋa waa baɡla ɡe.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: He nyiŋo na naa, n tɔn nɔ maa chwerɔ nɔ, n di heyaa kasinteŋ waane ta dɛɛ lii heya. Korowii aa sune n nɛɛ

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: N ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa nomanta, n won n te maŋkurae toma maa ɛa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɔ ta.

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: ne wekpeɡa ne nyokpowaa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri aa ɡela mɛɛ ɛ la bwa ɡelɔ he yarada Korowii waa nɔ. Taraken nɔ, le Jerusalam ka le Ilirikum le bwa, n bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma nɔ bela.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: N ɛ n liire wubwa kɛŋɔ mɛɛ bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma nɔɔ. Kɛ harɛre baa bol o waa a ta la, a ta laa mɛɛ bola. A waa laa aa, dɛ nomɛl toma waa pa a mun cheɡ la taa n kpɔ dɛɛ choŋi la.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Nɛra nomɛlbwa aa wola o waa bolɛ ba be ka la, baa no o waa, dɛ́ jemɔ.”

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Anɔ waa maa wola bɔr dɔe dɛ ba he be kera aŋwɛnɛ bwa la.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken nɔ maa tonɛ n toma bonɔ nɔ, asɛ n sie che chiŋ bene aŋwɛnɛ nɔ bwa kɛŋɔ ń ba na heyaa nɔ,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ n ba dɛ kaa Speen harɛ ta naa, ń na heya. N jemɔ kɛŋɔ n baa so he be tɔpera anɛ, dɛ le bela dɛɛ kaa Speen harɛ ta naa, hɛɛ cha mɛɛ.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Ba bala baa lɔ Makidoonia ne Akaya harɛre ta koŋkwaare ane ŋɔ ń kpɔ ka tɛ Jerusalam Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ba soɡa bini do kpeɡri tɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ba sie lɛo kɛŋɔ baa ta kwaa la. Kasinteŋ, baa won jam Jerusalam Korowii nɛra la ka tonɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa cha Israel tena asɛ nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ di ba tɔnɔ la, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛ dɛ nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ la ɡe dɔ harɛ bonɔ kwaa aa, Israel tena ɡe di ba tɔnɔ.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Dɛ n kpɔ ba suuɡa bwa ka do ba nɔn ta tonaa, mɛɛ ba kaa Speen harɛ taa. Kɛ mɛɛ che he bee.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ dɛ n ba he be naa, mɛɛ soŋe Yeesu Kristo ó swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Yabala, n kpɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ne nyina Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa ɡela yaa nyin dɔŋa la, dɛɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ he cha mɛ dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: Hé soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ ásɛ o kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛɛ Juda harɛ tena baa wola Yeesu yarada la bini, ásɛ waa maa dɛ la ka ɛ Jerusalam Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bini la, bá sie lɛ a ta,

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ Korowii sɛoh waa, ń ba he be silɛɛ ne, dɛ́ ba onɛ tama.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Korowii waa dɛ tɛ yaa deŋnesɔɔhna la, ó cha he bwa. Aamen.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Yɔɔ. Ya nimambie nɔ sɔne Fiibi. Asɔre tena baa lɔ Keŋkrea la binii o do dɛɛ ɛ toma.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Hé lɛo ja he nɛɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ Korowii nɛra lɛ ba dɔŋ la ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nomanta. Komɛlbwa waa dɛɛ nyin dɛ le he be la, hé chao, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɡba cha Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra taeh. N ɡbabir nɔ, o cha mɛ ka.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: N dɛ na Presela ne Akwela n ne ba bwa aa dɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo toma nɔ la.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Ba fa koh n waa dɛ kpɔ ba nyuune charɛ seo. N ne asɔre tena baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bwaa dɛɛ jam ba.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: N dɛ na asɔre tena baa cheme ba dem dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la bwa. N dɛ na n chamenate Epaenitus waa tɔ sie yarada Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ Eesia harɛ ta bwa la.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: N dɛ na Mɛɛre waa dɛ ɛ toma he bini ɡa la.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Hé ŋɔ n bwɛɛ tena Andronikus ne Junias ba fa aa do n ne ba dea ka la be ŋɔ n dɛ na ba. Ba ɛ nɛra bane ba sɔn aa lea Yeesu toroma bini. Ba tɔ sie ɛ asɔre tena n nɛ.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: N dɛ na Ampelatos waa ɛ n chamenate ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nɛɛ teŋa ta la.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: N dɛ na Ɔrbanus ya ne o bwa aa dɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo toma nɔ la, ne n chamenate Stakes.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: N dɛ na Apeles wekpeɡa aa puu o ta che kiŋkiŋ Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ ta la. N dɛ na Aristobulus dem tena bwa.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: N dɛ na n bwɛɛ te Herodion. N dɛ na Nasesos dem tena la baa ɛ asɔre tena la bwa.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: N dɛ na Rufus o sɔn aa lea ya Dɔɔ Yeesu toma nɔ ta la, ne o nya waa nyiŋ mɛ kɛ n ɡbaɡba nya la.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: N dɛ na Asiŋkritus, ne Fleɡɔn, ne Hɛɛmes ne Patrobas, ne Hɛɛmas, dɛ yabala baa jaa la bwa.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: N dɛ na Faelolɔɡɔs, ne Julia, ne Nɛreɔs ne o nimambihaah, ne Ɔlempas, dɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bane ba do bela la bwa.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nyabii. Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la bwa dɛ na heya.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Yabala, n dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ, hɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa ɡela he baah ɛɛ peɡri, dɛɛ baɡle waa a ne Yeesu Kristo waa baa baɡle heyaa nɔ aa wola jo, asɛ dɛɛ vuuɡi heyaa la. Hé jem ba dɛɛ ke he te ba nɛ.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo laa baa tomɛ. Waa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta la, anee baa ɛ. Nyotor ne nyosone nee baa neɡre nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ la.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Nɛra bwa dɛ bol he teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu waa la ta waa bobɛlbwa, anomanta, n sie lɛ he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Kɛ n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he ɛ wejerema wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ bɔr, asɛ dɛ ɛ nɛra haa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ be pera.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Korowii waa dɛ tɛ yaa deŋnesɔɔhna la aa biɡri chɔɡ Bɔnsam ne o toma, ásɛ he tiɡri o nɛ. Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Timoti n ne waa dɛ ɛ toma la dɛ na heya. Lusias ne Jasen, dɛ Sosipata ba bwa aa ɛ n bwɛɛ tena la dɛ na heya.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Men Tɛɛseɔs Pɔɔl aa ɡela n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ tɛo la, n ɡe dɛ na heyaa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn ta.

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya jam Korowii. Wɛɛ wonoo ɡel he che kiŋkiŋ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma maa dɛ bol he be la ta. Korowii pili a ɡɛ waa nɔ bini. Anee fa ɛ wesɔɔhla saŋ la bwa la,

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: kɛ taraken te, o cheɡɛ o keamere waa baa chwera la ta, dɛ le a bwa ne baŋ. Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la tɛ ŋwɛnɛ taraken ŋɔ nɛ́ra bol o waa la. O ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ ba bola dɛɛ baɡle nɛra bwa ásɛ ba yaradaa dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ jam Korowii o ɡbo aa ɛ Korowii, dɛ ɡbo jemɛ wobɛlbwa la. O jirima aa tonɛ bwa! Aamen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Menee Pɔɔl aa too Korowii tea asɛ o lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ba ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la. N ne n dɔŋ Sɔɔstenes bwaa chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he asɔre tena haa lɔ Kɔrent dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la.

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: Korowiirii le heya, dɛ koh pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la waa dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ he nɛɛ dɛ ɡel he ɛ o nɛra. Ya dɛ chwerɛ he ne nɛra baa lɔ bobɛlbwa dɛɛ tomɛ ya ne ba bwa Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo dɛ́ cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Korowii jaama

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: N dɛ jam Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa kɛ waa koh pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la waa dɛ sune he nɛɛ dɛɛ cha heyaa nɔ.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo waa la ya fa aa bol he be la jo he bambile bini kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: Anomanta, taraken haa kpɔ hwɛɡa dɛɛ kpa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bala nɔ, wobɛlbwa kpeɡri ta heyaa nyae le Korowii be.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Korowii ɛ kasinteŋ te. Onee le heyaa ŋɔ hé ne o Bie la do som. O Bie laanee ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la. Asɔre tena dɔŋa baah peɡra wa

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Yabala, n kpɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo dɛɛ soŋe heyaa kɛ hé bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ. He bɛ dɔŋa baahna peɡri, hé ɡel he nyoa pɛ he we-ɛɛla ne he liire ta.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Yabala, nɛra bane le Kloi dem dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, webeɡra chole he bini bane baah ta, a waa n bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ la.

english_verse: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
translation_verse: N noɔ kɛ bane ŋɔ ba teŋɛ men Pɔɔl nɛ, bane ɡe ŋɔ ba teŋɛ Apolos nɛ, asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ Pita nɛɛ ba te teŋɛ, bane ɡe ŋɔ ba teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛ.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Hé na! Yeesu Kristo binii he bɔne la! Men Pɔɔlee ba koh he waa kpaa pɛl daɡaɡre ta la aa? Kɛɛ n sɔn nee ba sɔ heyaa Korowii nee ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ la? Akai!

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: N dɛ jam Korowii kɛ ɡɛ saŋ n fa aa lɔ he be la, n ta nomɛlbwa Korowii nee sɔe ka ja Krispus ne Gayos nɛ.

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ŋɔ n sɔ heyaa Korowii nee ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ n nɛ.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Dɛ Stɛfanas ne o dem tena ɡe laa n berɛ sɔ Korowii ne aa, maa lii kɛŋɔ n sɔ nomɛl nee kpa.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo fe ta men tomɛ ŋɔ ń baa sɔ nɛra Korowii ne. O ŋɔ ń ba bol Amanesoma la nɛra be, kɛ n bɛ n ɡbaɡba wejema ne nyotor kpɔ dɛɛ bol waa la, ásɛ Yeesu sewa waa sewɛ daɡaɡre ta la bɛ pɛɛpɛɛ ɛ. Yeesu dɔ wejema ne kpeɡri le Korowii be

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: O daɡaɡre la ta seo la yaa dɛ bol a waa la ɛ wesale tɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyoɡre. Kɛ ya banɔ la Korowii aa dɛ lɛ yaa la te, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii kpeɡri lɔ a ta.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra wejema ne tɔn jema ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.”

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: A ba ɡɛ naa, dɛ lee wejerema ne tɔnjerema wejema dɔɔ jaɔ? Nɛra baa dɔ wobol wejema ɡe, dɛ lee ba dɔɔ? Korowii ɡelɔ nɛwɛnyini wejema ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Ba ɡbaɡba wejema ɡelɔ baa Korowii jemɛ. Korowii kpɔ o wejema ɛa ɡɛ, dɛ ŋɔ a ɛo silɛɛ kɛ wɛɛ lɛ nɛra baa yarada Amanesoma yaa bola dɛɛ baɡle nɛra asɛ baa liira wesale la.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: Juu tena dɛ nyin ya ɛ nyokpowaa baɡ ba, Grik tena ɡe ɛɛ nyin kɛ ya baɡ ba wejema mɔɔ ba yarada.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Ya te, Yeesu Kristo sewa daɡaɡre ta la waa yaa bol. A ɛ waa Juu tena aa dɛ lɔ naa a ta dɛɛ vɛah, asɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɡe la, a ɛ wesale ba be.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Kɛ Juu tena ne Grik tena Korowii aa lee ba ŋɔ bá ba ɛ o nɛra la, Yeesu Kristo waa la ɛ Korowii kpeɡri ne o wejema ba te be.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Waa nɛra aa dɛ lii kɛ a ɛ Korowii wesale la, a ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini wejema, o ɡwɛɡra ɡe ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini kpeɡri.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé lii ɡɛ haa doa asɛ Korowii le heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ la. He ɡalɡa ta wejerema ɛɛ nɛra be. He ɡalɡa ɡe ta nɛnjena ɛɛ nɛra be. He bwa ɡe laa ɛ koobii.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Korowiirii saahna le waa nɛra aa dɛ liira wesale dɛ́ ɡel sihiih kpo wejerema, asɛ dɛ saah le ɡwɛɡra ɡe dɛ ɡel sihiih kpo kpeɡnɛra,

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: dɛ kpɔ waa nɛra aa haah, ne anɔ la baa dɛ liira wepuu, ne anɔ la baa wola a waa jemɛ ŋɔ á ba chɔɡ anɔ la nɛra aa dɛ maŋkuraa la,

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: ásɛ nɛn bɛ won ɡɔɔ o te Korowii sie.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn la aa ŋɔa la. “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o te maŋkurae la, wɛɛ maŋkura o te waa Korowii aa ɛa ta.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Yabala, a ɡɛ saŋ n fa aa ba he be dɛ ba di Korowii waa danseɛ he be la, nyotor ne nɛwɛnyini wejema laa n kpɔ bol waa baɡle heya.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Maa lɔ he be la, dɛ maa nyin kɛ n kpɔ wejema ane ja n wobol ta, nemenɛ Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa daɡaɡre la ta la wa.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: N webaɡla bini la, n ta wejema kpɔe bol waa baɡle heyaa ásɛ he sie lɛ. Kɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee di n wobol la danseɛ dɛ ɡel a do kpeɡri.

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nɛn wejema ta laa a che hɛɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo dɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛ. Korowii kpeɡri la taa a che. Wejema aa le Korowii Domadɛɛɡe be

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ bol wejema waa te dɛɛ baɡle nɛra ba sie aa chaah Korowii waa ta kɛrɛdɛ. Wejema yaa dɛ baɡle a waa nɔ ta harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ne ba nɛnjena wejema ɛɛ. Ba te, ɛɛ baa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Korowii wejema waa yaa baɡle. A fa sɔɔh, nɛwɛnyini fa aa wola a waa jemɛ. A ɛ waa Korowii aa ɛa cheɡ yaa mɔɔ dɛ ta harɛ nɔ, ásɛ a ba cha yaa ya dɔ jirima.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta nomonjena fa ta a ɡɛ wejema nɔ mun noɛ. Dɛ ba fe no a mun aa, ba fe ta ɡelɛ ba kpo ya Dɔɔ la waa dɔ jirima la daɡaɡre ta.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ waa ba faa chwerɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Waa nomɛlbwa aa wola a dɔŋa nae, nomɛlbwa aa wola a waa noɛ, nomɛlbwa ɡe aa wola an liire laanee Korowii ɛ cheɡ nɛra baa dɛ nyin o wa.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o Domadɛɛɡe la ta dɛɛ baɡle yaa a waa ásɛ ya won no a mun. O Domadɛɛɡe la dɛ na wobɛlbwa bini kɛrɛdɛ, hale dɛ jemɛ Korowii wesɔɔhla ɡba.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa aa o dɔŋ nyu bini jemɛ, nemenɛ naate ɡbaɡba. Gɛɛ a do nɛwɛnyini aa wola waa aa lɔ Korowii be jemɛ. O Domadɛɛɡe ɡbosoroo jemɛ o nyu bini.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Ya te, liire yaa dɔa ta harɛ nɔ ta liire ɛɛ. Korowiirii kpɔa tɛ yaa. O kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe tɛ yaa o do ya nɛ. Anee ɡela ya jemɛ kwaa waa tɛ yaa la.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Yaa dɛ bol waa nɔ, yaa nɛwɛnyini wejema ta cheɡɛ dɛɛ bola. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee dɛɛ baɡle yaa waa yaa bol. Anɔ la waa bol la, anee ya ɡe kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle o wa.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa wola toole o nɛɛ la, o dɛ vɛh o Domadɛɛɡe la wa. A ɛ wesale tɛ naate, waa a mun no, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡboo ɡela nɛn ɛɛ no Korowii waa mun.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Nɛn Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa lɔ o nɛɛ la jemɛ wobɛlbwa ŋwɛnɛre. Kɛ nɛn waa wola toole o nɛɛ la aa won jemɛ naate waa lɔ o nɛɛ la ŋwɛnɛre.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn bini ba pɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo dɛ won jemɛ Korowii liire o? Umee dɛ won baɡlo waɔ?” Kɛ ya te dɔ Yeesu Kristo liire.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Yabala, n fa ta wone bol waa baɡle heyaa kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ baɡle nɛra Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa chaah ba sie la. N bola tɛ heyaa kɛ nɛra ba taa dɛ teŋɛ ba nɛwɛnyini mar waa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he do kɛŋɔ bechale ken Yeesu Kristo waa la ta.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Wobopwɛra nee n faa baɡle heyaa waa kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɔr bechala waa wola tele ne kondikwaa dii la. Hale taraken kwara he ta tele mɔɔ,

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ta dɛ teŋɛ nɛwɛnyini mar waa ta. Bɔweela ne naɡra aa lɔ he baah ta nɔ, nɛwɛnyini mar nɛɛ laa hɛɛ teŋɛ nɔ naa? Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ he dɔ ɡɛ da nɔ naa, he ja nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire nɛɛ kɛɛ?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Dɛ he bane ŋɔ he dɛ teŋɛ men Pɔɔl nɛ, asɛ he bane ɡe ŋɔ ba dɛ teŋɛ Apolos nɛ aa, amɔ dɛ he ne nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ ba nɛwɛnyini mar ta la da beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Bamewaa Apolos ne Pɔɔl hɛɛ maŋkura ba ɡɛ nɔɔ? Tom-ɛɛra ɡboo yaa. Korowiirii tomɛ yaa he be, ásɛ he no Yeesu waa dɛ́ yaradaa dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛo. Toma Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ ya bini bɛlbwa laanee yaa ɛ.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ du kwaa ne onɔ la waa dɛ do nee a ta la te bɛlbwa ta korɛ. Korowii dɛ bɔ bɛlbwa kem ɡɛ aa chɛa.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɔ yaa, ya ne o pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma. Asɛ he ɡe do kɛŋɔ o koo waa dɛ parɛ, ne o dea waa dɛ do.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Korowiirii cha mɛ n won ɛ toma kɛŋɔ nɛn waa jemɛ dea mae kɛrɛdɛ la, dɛ pa dea la mun, asɛ nomɛl ɡe ba ma dɛɛ chɔŋɛ. Kɛ bɛlbwa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ waa maa dɛɛ chɔŋɛ.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii Tɔpere waa dɛ ba nɛra bwa waa bola dɛ́ pa bole la telaa, belaa baa ba nae ɡɛ bɛlbwa toma aa doa. Awola tɔpere la, niinii dɛɛ ba toma nomɛlbwa aa ɛa la wer bini baɡla.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ nomɛl toma fuoh waa, Korowii ɛɛ lɛ naatee, kɛ wɛɛ paŋɛ komɛlbwaa. Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ kon baa keeru le nii ta ken.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii Dea asɛ o Domadɛɛɡe la so he bini kɛɛ?

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: He bɛ he te dɛɛ neɡre. Dɛ he bini bɛl lole dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ o dɔ harɛ nɔ ta wejema aa, ó ɛ o te ɡɛne ásɛ dɛ dɔ Korowii wejema tenten.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta wejema ɛ wesale Korowii be. Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini dɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra kpɔ wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, kɛ Korowii dɛ laɡ ba.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ o bobɛl ɡe ŋɔ, “Korowii jemɛ harɛ nɔ ta wejerema liire kɛŋɔ a ɛ wepuu.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ne Apolos ne Pita, nyundua ne harɛ, mkpa ne seo, kwaa aa lole fini ne kerekere oo, heyaa dɔ a bwa.

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo ɡee dɔ heya, asɛ Korowii ɡe dɔ Yeesu Kristo.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: A wer kɛ hɛɛ yerɛ yaa Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔna. Korowii baɡle yaa o wesɔɔhla dɛ kpɔ do ya nɔn ta ŋɔ yáa baɡle nɛra.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Waa aa chɛ nɛn baa kpɔ waa do o nɔn ta laanee kɛŋɔ o ɡel o waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
