english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ kpɛɛ mɛ kɛɛ he dɛ chɔɡ mɛ noo, n waane laa. Nɛwɛnyini laa dɛ won bol n waa dɛ pa mɛ bole. N ɡbabir aa won kpɛɛ n te dɛ́ chɔɡ n te.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: N ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa nae n waa bini te, kɛ a ta baɡlɛ kɛ mɛɛ di bolee. N Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo dɛɛ ba n waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he bɛ nomɛlbwa kpɛɛ kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡo ka tel kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo aa ba. Dɛ o balaa, wobɛlbwa aa sɔah la ɛɛ le bochaahnee, wedɛɛɡa oo, wechɔɡa oo, a bwa ɛɛ leo, ásɛ wobɛlbwa aa sɔah dɛ do nɛwɛnyini bambile bini la chɔ baŋ, ásɛ Korowii kpɛɛ nomɛlbwa ɡɛ aa chɛo.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Yabala, n kpɔ toma n ne Apolos aa ɛa la dɛ che a ta dɛ baɡle waa nɔ, ásɛ he no a mun dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa wera kɛŋɔ he ɛ. Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, He bɛ ɛ ɡarɛ ɡɛ baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la. He bɛ bane kpɔ ɡwaa bane dɛ́ɛ maŋkura he te.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Umee ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he ɡwaa bane ɔ? Wobɛlbwa haa jema la, Korowiirii tɛɛ. Bɛ nyoa dɛɛ ta a do kɛŋɔ Korowii laa kpɔ waa haa jema la kɛɛ.

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he dɔ komɛlbwa a maɡre he ne, he ɛ dɔɔhna. He berɔ ɡarɛ yaa dɛɛ di kora. Dɛ he fe dɛ di kora kpela te naa, a fe bɔ. Ya ne he bwa fe ɛ koranar.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: N te be, Korowii ɡelɔ ya banɔ nɔ yaa ɛ Yeesu toroma nɔ ka mun, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa laɡ ba dɛɛ la ka kpoo ba, asɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ nyiŋ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nyundua toroma ne nɛra bwa dɛ nyiŋi yaa.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo nomanta, ya ɛ ɡɛna nɛra be, kɛ he dɛ yerɛ he te wejerema o waa ta. Ya ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra nɛra be, kɛ he ɛ he te o kpeɡnɛra. Ba dɛ duu heya, dɛ lawɛ ya te sie dɛɛ teɡɛ harɛ.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Lɔr ne nyɔɡre dɛ kpo yaa, yakwanee yaa tɔ, nɛra ɛɛ lɔɔ yaa, ya ta sobɔr dɔe dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Ya bokpeɡa taa yaa di. Nɛra hah yaa dɛɛ chɛɡre yaa, kɛ ya te soŋe andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba. Ba dɛ ɛ yaa hɔhɔrɔwa, kɛ ya te sɔɔh bwara dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ chɔɡ ya sɔn, kɛ ya te dɛ kwaa ba sɔn. Ya do kɛŋɔ puldoa haahra nɛra be, hale ba le fini.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: N ta ɡɛ waa nɔ chwerɛ ba tɛ heyaa dɛ́ ɡel sihiih kpo heya, kɛ jae mɛɛ ja heya, haa ɛ n bidɛɛɡa maa dɛ nyin heyaa la nomanta.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔ nɛra ba warɛ pirim, dɛ won cha heyaa Yeesu Kristo ŋwɛnɛ ta naa, n ɡboo ta he mɛɛ. Menee tɔ sie bol Amanesoma la he be. A taa n che ɛ he mɛɛ Yeesu Kristo waa ta.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dɛ soŋe heya, hé kpɔ n da.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: A waa ɡela n tomɛ Timoti he be la. O ɛ n bie maa dɛ nyinu, wɛɛ no n deŋna waa Yeesu Kristo toma nɔ ta. Wɛɛ lii heyaa ɡɛ maa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo waa la ta. Gɛ maa dɛ baɡle asɔrere ta bobɛlbwa laanee wɛɛ ba heyaa liira.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: He bane dɛ baɡle he te dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ maa ba dɛ ba na heyaa kpa.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii sɛoh waa, aa biɡri mɛɛ ba he bee, dɛ ɡbaɡba ba na kpeɡri nɛra baa dɛ baɡle ba te la aa dɔa. Ba wobol ɡbo ta laa n ŋɔ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Korowii Kora bini doe ta nyoa wobol pɛɛpɛɛ ɛɛ. O kpeɡri dɔe waa.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Ɛrɛ balaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ n ba he be nɔ? Hɛɛ charɛ he daa, ásɛ n nyin he waa dɛ́ ba bambisɔn ne kɛɛ, ń kpɔ chweema ba, dɛ́ ba tɛr he deŋne ɔ?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: N dɛ no kɛ he bini bane dɛ bɔ jwamane aa wola were, hale nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ kwara aa wola ɡɛɛ ɛ. Ba ŋɔ he bini bɛl lawɛ o mɛɛ haah kwaraa dɛɛ chɔ.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: A fe chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡel he tea bini chɔɡ waa nɔ wa, asɛ hɛɛ maŋkura he te la. Aa were kɛŋɔ ɡɛ nɛn la ta ja he bini kpa!

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: hé kpɔ naate bwadabii do Bɔnsam nɔn ta ó chɔɡo, ásɛ awola tɔpere ya Dɔɔ aa ba la, ó ɡe ba lɛ o doma te.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Aa were kɛŋɔ hɛɛ maŋkura he te. Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ iisi tama wono ɡel men damanta ɛɛ uɡe aa?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé laa ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la kpɔ he bini, ásɛ o wechɔɡa aa do kɛŋɔ iisi la bɛ heyaa bu, ásɛ he do wer kɛŋɔ paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe, dɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la. He do ɡɛ kpela. Yeesu Kristo koh ya waa dɛ sewɛ kɛŋɔ baa kpo peebie Galekaa tɔpere ta la.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ɡel ya kpɔ ya te kɛŋɔ yaa dɛ ba Galekaa kondikwaa dii ken, anee kɛŋɔ yá laa meesɔɔh ne wechɔɡa bɛlbwa soo siwi kpɔ ya bini, ɡɛ baa laa iisi kpɔ paanoo baa kpɔa dɛɛ di Galekaa ta la. Hé ɡel ya kpɔ kasinteŋ ne tepoŋ dɛ́ teŋɛ Korowii nɛ.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: N tɔn n fa aa chwerɛ heyaa la, n baɡlɔ kɛ he ne nɛra jwamane aa lɔ ba sie ta la bɛ pɛ.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa wola Korowii tomɛ dɛɛ bɔ jwamane, ba sie ɛɛ beɡre kwa, baa tomɛ voɡa la, ba te laa n ŋɔ hé laa he te kpɔ ba nɛɛ nɔ, dɛkalkɛ ba te lɔ bobɛlbwa. Haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɔ, haa won laa he te kpɔ ba nɛ!

english_verse: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ɛ asɔre tena la te, heyaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole. Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ “Hé doŋi wechɔɡ-ɛɛ le he bini.”

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Umee ŋɔ he be ŋɔ dɛ he bini bɛl ne o dɔŋ asɔre te dɔ waane aa, ó ɡel Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛ́ kpɔɔ la nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ be bá ka bola ɔ? Korowii nɛra laa dɛ bola aa?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ kerekere Korowii nɛraa dɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole kɛɛ? Dɛ heyaa dɛ́ ba bol ba waa te naa, ɛrɛɛ haa wola won bol wejeɡre aa do ken nɔɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ yan dɛ́ ba bol nyundua toroma waa dɛ́ pa bole kɛɛ? Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa yaa wola won bol aa?

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Dɛ he ne he dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, ɛrɛɛ he kpɔ dɛɛ do nɛra asɔre tena aa wola ban kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa la nɔn ta ŋɔ bá bola ɔ?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: A dɔ sihiih tɛ heya. Amɔ wejereme beŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole he bini dɛ́ won bol he baah wa,

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: asɛ hɛɛ samane dɔŋa dɛ ɡel nɛra baa wola asɔre tena ɛɛ kaa bol he waa nɔ naa? A ta ɡɛ chɛɛ.

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Haa dɛ samane dɔŋa nɔ ɡba kwara baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ he dɔɔ di bolchɔɡe. Dɛ he ne he dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, lawɛ bambile. Dɛ o ŋwɛɛ kwaraa naa, kpɔ kɛo. A wer ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa samano.

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa Korowii Kora la taa ja kɛɛ? He bɛ he nyu neɡre. Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɛnwa, ne voɡtoroma, ne nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamane, ne baala ba ne ba bandɔŋa aa dɛ chɔ haah ne baa,

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: He bini bane fa kpoŋe ɡɛ da nɔ. Kɛ taraken Korowii koh ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ne Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la toma la waa dɛ sɔ he wechɔɡa bwa ta, dɛ ɡel he ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa he waa su o siwi. Jwamane bɔe wa

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Nomɛl te kompɛɛ, “N dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ n ɛ wobɛlbwa.” Kpelaa, kɛ a bwa laa wera tɛ yaa. N fe jemɔ kɛ maa komɛlbwa ki, kɛ maa ɡel komɛlbwa ɡwaa n nɛ.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Bɛl ɡee ŋɔɔ, “Tea waa kondikwaa do le, asɛ kondikwaa ɡe che dɛ tɛ tea.” Kpelaa, kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ a bwa dɔ jaɡa dɛ chɔɡ. O ta nɛn bwadabii ɛɛ tɛo ŋɔ ó kpɔ ɛ jwamanwa, kɛ o ɛo tɛo kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ tomɔ. Anomanta, nɛn bwadabii ɛ Korowii kon, wɛɛ tɛo komɛlbwa.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa kpɔ o kpeɡri ir ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo seo ta la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba o kpeɡri la kpɔe dɛ́ ir ya ɡe seo ta.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he bwadabii ɛ Yeesu Kristo bwadabii pera kɛɛ? Dɛ ɡɛɛ a do te naa, amɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ ń kpɔ n bwadabii waa ɛ Yeesu bwadabii pera la ka bɔ jwamane aa? Akai! He bɛ ɡel a ba ɡɛ.

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa bɔ jwamane la, o ne haah la pɛo dɛ ɛ bwadabii beŋkpoŋ aa? Korowii Tɔnee baɡla ŋɔ, “Nɛra banɛ la ɛ beŋkpoŋ.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te pɛl ya Dɔɔ la ɡe, o ne o bwa dɔ Doma beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé laa he te dɛɛ kpɔ jwamane ta. Wechɔɡa bɛlbwa nɛn aa dɛ ɛ la, aa o bwara bini so. Kɛ nɛn waa dɛ bɔ jwamane la, o ɡbaɡba bwadabii wɛɛ do wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he bwadabii ɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la sobɔr kɛɛ? Korowii kpɔɔ tɛ heya, o so he nɛ. Anomanta, he laa dɔ he te. Korowiirii dɔ heya,

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kpɔ Yeesu Kristo chal yawɛ heya. Anomanta, hé nyiŋi he bwadabii ta kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ tomɛ Korowii dɛ́ tɛo sɔn.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: He fa chwerɛ tɔn dɛ ba bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, dɛ baa ŋɔ waa haahnee mo aa, a wer aa? Baa ŋɔ waa haahnee mo aa, a wer.

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: Kɛ jwamane aa wara la nomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ baa bɛlbwa dɔ o haah, ásɛ haah bɛlbwa ɡe dɔ o jaa.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa bɛ ŋɔ o ne o haah naa chɔ, ɡɛɛ haah ɡe bɛ ŋɔ waa sɛh o ne o jaa chɔ.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Haah ta o bwadabii kpeɡri dɔe chɔe bɔr, o jaaree dɔ kpeɡri. Gɛɛ baa ɡe aa wola o bwadabii kpeɡri dɔe, o haahnee dɔ kpeɡri.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Anomanta, bɛlbwa bɛ o te kpɔ sɔh o dɔŋ chɔe be pera, atane kɛŋɔ he bwa sɛoh kɛŋɔ he dɛ nyin kɛ hé kpɔ bambibeŋkpoŋ soŋe Korowii tɔpere bɛl tama mɔɔ. Gɛ te wer. Kɛ dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ tonaa, hé berɛ pɛ ja. Dɛ he ta pɛɛ yaa, haa wola won lawɛ he te la, Bɔnsam ɛɛ ɡeloo hé ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Waa nɔ maa baɡla nɔ ta denɛ dɛɛ do heyaa ŋɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé mo haahna. Kɛ n dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, dɛ he mo haah naa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Waa maa dɔa dɛ tɛ nɛra baa wola haahna dɔe, ne haahna baa wola jaranar dɔe, ne nɛra ba jaranar aa serewa laanee kɛ, bá fee so ɡɛ n ɡbo aa soɡa nɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Dɛ bɛlbwa nao kɛŋɔ waa won haŋre dɛ́ ɡbo so te naa, amɔ ó mo haah kɛɛ ó yalɛ. A bɔ kɛŋɔ haah kɛɛ baa pɛla aa dɔe aa we he nɛɛ kohona.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Anɔ la maa bera dɔ dɛɛ tɛ hahmoola ne jadɔɔhnaa nɔ. N ɡbaɡba laa dɛɛ bol. Ya Dɔɔree ŋɔa ŋɔ haah bɛ o jaa vɛh.

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o vɛh o jaa aa, o bɛ baa bɛlbwa yalɛ kpa, atane kɛŋɔ o berɛ la o jaa la be, ásɛ ba ka pɛ dɛ́ so ja. Baa ɡe bɛ o haah vɛh.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: N ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ bol anɔ te dɛɛ tɛ he kar la. Ya Dɔɔ laa bola. Dɛ he ɛ asɔre te dɛ mo haah waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ, a too o tea o ŋɔ wɛɛ soo waa, bɛ on vɛh.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah ɡe ɛ asɔre te dɛ yalɛ baa waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ, dɛ o tea toorɔ kɛŋɔ o ne wɛɛ soo waa, haah la bɛ on vɛh.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Dɛ onɔ la waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ vɛh o dɔŋ waa ɛ asɔre tee yaa, tɛo ŋwɛnɛ wɛɛ la. A ba ɡɛ naa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ. Korowii dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii ɛɛ che haah haa ɛ asɔre te nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛ he jaa aa, he jemaa? Gɛɛ a do baa haa ɛ asɔre te la, dɛ Korowii ɛɛ che he nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛ he haah naa, he jemaa?

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Korowiirii tɛ bɛlbwa o we-ɛɛla wɛɛ ɛ. Anomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa leo dɛ tɛo ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ ɛ la. Gɛɛ mɛɛ bol asɔre tena baa lɔ bobɛlbwa la be.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ kere chɔɡɛ noo, a ta waane ɛɛ, ba ta kere kpɔe chɔɡɛ noo, a ta waane ɛɛ. Kɛ Korowii Waa la ta teŋaa ɛ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, do ɡɛ haa doa mɔɔ Korowii lee he ba ɛ asɔre te la.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ɛ yom dɛ ba ɛ asɔre te aa, bɛ ɡel a we he nɛ. Kɛ dɛ ba tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ hé le he yom ɛɛ la ta naa, bɛ vɛh.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ yom dɛ ɛ asɔre te la, o dɔ o te Korowii be. Gɛɛ a do, nomɛlbwa waa dɔ o te dɛ ba ɛ asɔre te la, o ɛ Yeesu Kristo yom.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Korowiirii kpɔ Yeesu Kristo chal la yawɛ heya, anomanta, he bɛ lii kɛŋɔ nɛraa dɔ heya.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Korowii ta men nɛra baa wola yalɛ la waa baɡlɛ, kɛ o dɛ cha mɛ asɛ mɛɛ ɛ o toma kɛrɛdɛ. Anomanta, mɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ maa jemaa.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Waa lole dɛ dawɛ ya nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, n te be te, a wer kɛ ɡɛ haa soɡa la, hé ta so ɡɛ.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔ haah naa, bɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ vɛoh. Dɛ he ta bɛl dɔe ɡe aa, bɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ nyin bɛlee.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: He mo haah naa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ. Dɛ haah ɡe yalaa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ. Kɛ waa lɔ a ta he soɡa bini, a waa mɛɛ nyin n lɛ heyaa le a ta la.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Maa ŋɔ ɡɛ nɔ, yabala, yaa harɛ nɔ taa biɡri bɛlbwa. Anomanta, le fini dɛɛ kaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ he banɔ la haa dɔ haahna la ɛ kɛŋɔ he ta haahna dɔe ken,

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: Asɛ he banɔ la ɡe haa dɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta la bɛ ɛ a ɡwaa kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ne o waa dɔ jaɡa. Waa biɡri bɛlbwa.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ta waa bɛ heyaa ha kohona. Baa waa wola haah dɔe la, o siwi dɛ swɛɛ Korowii toma ta, wɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ Korowii sie lɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Kɛ baa waa dɔ haah la te sie dɛ beɡre harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta, ásɛ o haah sie ɛɛ lɛ o nɛ. Webele anɛɛ yon do o baŋa.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Haah waa wola yalɛ, kɛɛ tolo waa wola baa jemɛ mɔɔ la, o sie dɛ beɡre Korowii toma ta, o kpɔ o te ne o liire bwa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii toma. Asɛ haah waa yala la ɡe sie ɛɛ beɡre harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta, ásɛ o jaa sie lɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ n cha heya, a waa ɡela mɛɛ bol waa ɡɛ la. Maa nyin kɛŋɔ he ŋwɛnɛ tɔ. N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he ɛ anɔ la aa wera, ásɛ he liire bwa won do Korowii toma ta.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Dɛ baa bɛlbwa dɔ o bihaah waa kpeɡa ne yala, o ŋɔ waa ɡel o yalɛ, dɛ berɛ na kɛŋɔ a wer kɛŋɔ bie la yalaa, ó ɛ ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ nyin. Ó ɡel o yalɛ. A ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah yalɔ, o jaa ta do le naa, baa laanee dɔ haah la kpeɡri. Kɛ dɛ baa la sewaa, o ta haah la kpeɡri dɔe kpa. Haah la won kaala, dɛ́ ka yalɛ baa waa dɛ nyinu ja. Kɛ o bɛ baa waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ yalɛ.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: A ka n waa aa, dɛ o fe ta yalɛ kpa kwaraa fe wer tɛo ɡwaa kɛŋɔ waa yala. N ɡbaɡba liire te, kɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la soɡe n nɛ.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: A ka kwaa baa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ voɡa wa. A waa jema te, ya bwa jemɛ a wa. Kɛ nɛwɛnyini wejema ɡelɔ wɛɛ nyin sɔn. Asɛ nɛnnyin ɡe ɛ chae.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o ɛ wejereme la, o ta wejema aa chɛ kɛ o jemɛ la dɔe mɔɔ.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Naate waa dɛ nyin Korowii la te, Korowii ɡba jemɔ.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Anomanta, voɡ kwaa dii maa dɛ bol a waa nɔ, ya jemɔ kɛ voɡa ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta, Korowii beŋkpoŋii lole.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Kwaa nɛra aa kpɔa ɛ Korowii dɛɛ yera ba dɔɔranar la warɔ, dɛ do nyundua ne harɛ.

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: Kɛ ya te be, Korowii lɔ beŋkpoŋ. Onee N Naa Korowii waa ta komɛlbwa, asɛ ya do le dɛɛ tomɔ la. Ya Dɔɔ ɡe lɔ beŋkpoŋ. Onee ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo. O nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ ta komɛlbwa, asɛ ya ɡe che o nɛɛ dɛ dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa laa jemɛ ɡɛ. Bane duu ɡɛ voɡa nɔ biɡri a man ba. Hale ba le fini, dɛ ba di kwaa baa kpoora tɛ voɡa nɔ naa, dɛ ba liire dɛ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ voɡa laanee dɔ kwaa la. Ba yarada aa wola kanɛ Yeesu waa la ta nomanta, dɛ ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Ya kondikwaa yaa dɛ dia laa dɛ́ ɡel ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa Korowii be. Dɛ ya dɛ dia oo, ya dɛ kia oo, aa wobɛlbwa baɡle.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Kɛ ane abwa, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ dɛ he ta an kie, he dɛ dia aa, he bɛ ɡel he we-ɛɛla neɡre nɛra ba yarada aa wola kanɛ Yeesu waa ta ba kia la.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Nɛn o yarada aa wola kanɛ Yeesu waa ta la, o na he nɛn haa jemɛ Yeesu waa la kɛrɛdɛ soɡe voɡ mun dɛɛ di kwa aa, aa ɡeloo o ɡe di.

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ ɛ he bala ba yarada aa wola kanɛ Yeesu waa ta la wechɔɡa ken asɛ ba tea bini chɔɡ aa, Yeesu Kristoo hɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Dɛ n nao kɛ kondikwaa maa dɛ di la ɛɛ ɡeloo n dɔŋ ɡe di a kaa o ne wechɔɡa ta naa, amɔ te mɛɛ ɡel a dii, ásɛ n dɔŋ ɡe bɛ di dɛ́ ba kaa wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: N ta n te dɔe dɛɛ di n nyu aa? N ta Yeesu torome ɛɛ yaa? N ta ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nae yaa? He teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ nɔ le toma maa ɛa he bini ya Dɔɔ kpeɡri ta la.

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Dɛ bane ta sɛɛh kɛŋɔ Yeesu toromee men aa, he te jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ n ɛ o torome, dɛkalkɛŋɔ pɛɛ he ne waa pɛa la dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ n ɛ o torome kpela.

english_verse: When people question me, I tell them
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra dɛ pwaah mɛ naa, kenii mɛɛ ŋɔ.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ cha yaa kondikwaa ta naa, dɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta laa aa?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo nimanar ne Pita ne Yeesu toroma la bwa mo haahna ba ne baa valɛ. Ya te ta ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ya mo haahna baa ɛ asɔre tena ya ne baa valaa?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Kɛɛ n ne Banabas ɡboo chɛ kɛ ya koh mɔɔ dɛɛ di?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Dɛ he ɛ sooja dɛɛ kaa laa laa, toma la ta laa hɛɛ di aa? He parɛ koo aa, haa koo la kondikwaa di aa? Nateɡre besoo wola o nae elnee nyɔɔ?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Mosis chwerɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ nabal waa dɛ ɛ toma he koo ta la nyoa vɔwɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ o bɛ kwaa di.” Korowii ŋɔ ken aa, kondɛɛra ɡboo o ŋɔ aa?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini waa o koh ŋɔ ɡɛ, ɡɛ aa cha yaa la waa o chwera, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ parɛ, ne nomɛlbwa waa dɛ komɛ kwaa la dɔ hwɛɡa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ kwaa la anee.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya bol Korowii Waa he be asɛ he dɔ Korowii mkpa aa, dɛ a ta maɡrɛ kɛ ya lɛ kondikwaa le he be, dɛ́ won dɔ harɛ nɔ ta bokpeɡa aa?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: He dɛ tɛ bane ɡɛ. Dɛ ɡɛ nɛra la dɔ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ aa, amɔ dɛ ya te ta pɔeh yaa? Kɛ ya te aa ɡɛ kpeɡri la baɡle he nɛ, dɛ dɔ bambile wobɛlbwa ta dɛ bɛ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la ŋwɛnɛ tɔ.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la, a taa ba dɔ kwaa dɛɛ di, asɛ banɔ la ɡe baa dɛ kpoo kwaa baa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii o Dea bini la, a taa ba ɡee di kɛɛ?

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee ya Dɔɔ ɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ bol Amanesoma la dɛ ŋɔ báa di a ta.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: N dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ n ɛ a bwa, kɛ n ta nomɛlbwa be ŋɔe ŋɔ ó tɛ mɛ komɛlbwa bwa. Maa chwerɛ dɛɛ nyin kɛ he tɛ mɛ a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ. N sewɔ bɔ n be kɛŋɔ waa maa koh a waa maŋkura n te la le n nɔn ta.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Maa won koh Amanesoma nɔ bola waa dɛɛ baɡle n te, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛɛ do mɛ asɛ mɛɛ bol. Dɛ n ta bolaa, mɛɛ dɔ waa.

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Dɛ n tetoora nee mɛɛ ɛa aa, a fe maɡrɔ kɛ n fe ɛɛ lɛ a kembɔr. Kɛ Korowiirii kpɔ o Amanesoma la do n nɔn ta ŋɔ ń bol nɛra be. Anomanta, n ɡbaɡba tetoora laa mɛɛ ɛa.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Kembɔr besoo mɛɛ dɔɔ? N kembɔree kɛŋɔ ń won bol Amanesoma la baɡle nɛra pɛɛpɛɛ dɛ bɛ kpeɡri maa dɔa la baɡle ba nɛ.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: N fe dɛ di n nyu, nomɛlbwa laa dɔɔ mɛ, kɛ n ɛ n te yom dɛɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa, dɛ́ fee dɔ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee dɛ n koo nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola Mosis Mmara la ta teŋɛ nɛ aa, n yon ɛ n te kɛ ban, ásɛ dɛ dɔɔ ba tɛ Korowii. Kɛ aa baɡle kɛ n dɛ vɛh Korowii nyoa wobol. N dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa ŋɔa yá teŋɛ la ta.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Dɛ n kaa koo nɛra bini, dɛ ba yarada aa kanɛ Yeesu Kristo waa ta naa, n ɡe dɛ ɛ n te kɛŋɔ ba bini bɛl, ásɛ dɛ won dɔɔ ba. Gɛ nomɛlbwa aa doa la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ɛ n te, ásɛ dɛ che ŋwɛnɛ bɛl ta, dɛ́ won dɔ bane, ásɛ Korowii lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Amanesoma nɔ waa mɛɛ teŋɛ anɔ bwa ta la, ásɛ dɛ won na som maa dɛ bol a waa la ane.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra dɛ ba chwae dɛ lɛ komɛl aa, ba bwa dɛ chwa te, kɛ ba bini beŋkpoŋii dɛɛ dɔ kon la. Anomanta, hé chwa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ dɔ kon la.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dɛ chwa n sie dawɛ komɛl ta. Maa chwa pɛɛ. N do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ yo, maa nɔɔra ta pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: N dɛ lawɛ n te, dɛɛ haŋre kɛrɛdɛ kɛ, n ɡbaɡba maa dɛ bol Amanesoma nɔ dɛɛ baɡle nɛra nɔ, n bɛ ba koni dɛ́ horɛ.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Yabala, n dɛ nyin kɛ ń lii heya, ya naawa bwa nɛɛ Korowii bam la faa tɔ. Moo la aa teŋa la, ba bwaa kpɔ o baah kaa.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Ba bwa dɔ kondikwaa le Korowii kpeɡri ta dɛ di.

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: A berɔ che Korowii kpeɡri ta ba dɔ nee dɛ nyɔ. Bwe taa ba dɔ nee la le. Kristoo bwe la, dɛ faa teŋɛ ba nɛɛ ba kaa.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii sie ta ba ɡalɡa nɛɛ lɛɛ, asɛ ba serewe perɛ kpɔɡ la baah bobɛla.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛo dɛ ɡel ya jemɛ wa, ásɛ wechɔɡa pɛla bɛ yaa dɔ ɡɛ a pɛla fa aa dɔɔ ba la.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Ya bɛ voɡa dɛɛ tomɛ ɡɛ ba bini bane fa aa dɛ ɛ la. Mosis chwerɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra la soɡo dɛ kwaa ba voɡa, dɛ di kwa, dɛ nyɔ sen, dɛ ir sa sachɔɡa.”

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Ya bɛ jwamane bɔ ɡɛ nɛra la bane fa aa ɛa asɛ Korowii kpoo ba bini kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ batoro tɔpebeŋkpoŋ la.

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Nomɛl te kompɛɛ, “N dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ń ɛ wobɛlbwa,” kɛ a bwa laa wera tɛ mɛ, a bwa ɡe laa dɛɛ cha mɛ.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Ya bɛ Korowii daah dɛɛ na ɡɛ bane fa aa daahno na, asɛ o ɡel harɛ kpɔ ba ba serewe la.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Ya bɛ waa naɡre ɡɛ bane fa aa naɡre waa asɛ nyundua torome ba kpoo ba la.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Waa aa pu a ɡɛ nɛra la ɛo dɛ ɡel ba jemɛ wa. Mosis chwerɛ a wa, dɛ ɡel ya nɛra yaa lɔ harɛ nɔ aa ka tɔpera tamaa o chɔɡ nɔ ta nɔ jemɛ wa.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ ta la, wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ naa ba lɔ.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa dɛ na wekpeɡa. Anomanta, dɛ he dɛ na wekpeɡa aa, he laa bɔ bere. Korowii waa dɔ yarada. Waa ɡel wekpeɡa bɛlbwa ɡwaa he nɛɛ ásɛ he horɛ. Wɛɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ dɛ́ won lawɛ bambile ka tel kɛŋɔ haa le a nyoa. Kondikwaa baa dia dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Yeesu

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n daamanar, hé laa he te kpɔ voɡa waa ta.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: He ɛ wejerema, anomanta, hé nyiŋi waa nɔ maa bola nɔ bini dɛ́ na.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa yaa pɛ so dɛɛ di kwaa dɛɛ lii Yeesu Kristo seo la, sen la yaa dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii dɛɛ nyɔ la ɡelɔ ya ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ o chal la waa ta. Paanoo yaa mɔna dɛɛ di la ɡelɔ ya ne o pɛ o bwadabii waa ta.

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Ya warɔ, kɛ paanoo beŋkpoŋ la yaa pɛa di la nomanta, ya ɛ beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Hé ta sie dɛ́ na Juu tena wa. Nɛra baa dɛ di kwaa baa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la, ba ta ɡɛ we-ɛɛla la ta jae yaa?

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: N dɛ baɡle kɛ kwaa baa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ voɡa la, a ne voɡa ɡbaɡba ɛ kwaane kɛɛ? Akai!

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: N dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛɛ kpoo kwaa la, ba kpoorɔ dɛɛ tɛ Bɔnsam toroma yaa wola an na la. Korowii laa ba ɛ dɛɛ tɛ. Maa nyin kɛŋɔ he ne Bɔnsam toroma pɛ komɛlbwa.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Haa won nyɔ sen la yaa dɛ nyɔ dɛɛ lii ya Dɔɔ waa la, dɛ́ berɛ ka nyɔ Bɔnsam toroma la kwa. He ne ya Dɔɔ aa won pɛ nɔn di kwa, ásɛ he ne Bɔnsam toroma la ɡe berɛ pɛ nɔn di kwa. Aa ɡɛɛ maɡre!

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Hei! He dɛ nyin he muɡli ya Dɔɔ baah o mee raa? Ya kpeɡri ɡwaalo wa aa?

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɛ yoɡ ola ol yoɡribɔr aa, yawɛ dɛ́ di. Bɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ ane ken aa were. Hé yawɛ di,

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ “Korowiirii dɔ harɛ ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ yerɛ ŋɔ hé ba di kwaa he sɛh aa, kondikwaa bɛlbwa waa tɛɛ la, bɛ dɛɛ lii ŋɔ a ken aa were kɛŋɔ he di. Lɛ dɛ di.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: A ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ tɛɛ. Naate la waa n ŋɔ he bɛ di la, ásɛ o liire bɛ on aahna-aahna ɛ. Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba nomɛl nyu bini liire waa koeh dɛ́ ɡel waa maa dɛ ɛɔ?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Dɛ n jam Korowii kondikwaa maa dɛ ba dii wa aa, nomɛlbwa bɛ men pwah kɛ maa di a ɡɛ kwaa la.

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Anomanta, wobɛlbwaa hɛɛ ɛ oo, kwaa hɛɛ di oo, komɛlbwaa hɛɛ nyɔ oo, hé ɛ dɛ́ kpɔ jirima dɛɛ tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa daŋre he ne dɛ́ ba nyoɡre. Juu tee yoo, Grik tee yoo, asɔre tee yoo, he bɛ ba bini bɛlbwa ɡɛ ɛ.

english_verse: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ mɛɛ ɛ, ásɛ n waa lɛ nomɛlbwa sie. N ɡbo waa laa hiah mɛ. Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa hiah mɛ, ɡɛ maa ɛ dɛ́ won dɔɔ ba tɛ Korowii ó lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé kpɔ n da ɡɛ maa kpɔ Yeesu da la. Haahna kwaa kpɔe dɛ́ bɔle nyu asɔre ɛɛ bɔra

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: N dɛ kpɛɛ heyaa liira haa dɛ lii n waa bwa wobɛlbwa ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa baɡ mɛ asɛ n ɡe baɡle heyaa la ta.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristoo baa bɛlbwa nomoa, asɛ baa ɛ haah nomoa, Korowii ɡe ɛ Yeesu Kristo nomoa.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Baa bɛlbwa waa dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛɛ dɛ che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol Korowii Wa, kɛ dɛ kpɔ kon bɔle o nyu la, waa duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ Yeesu Kristo.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Dɛ haah ɡe dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛɛ dɛ che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol waa o ta kon kpɔe bɔle o nyu aa, waa duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ baa. O do kɛŋɔ nɛn baa fonɛ o nyu ken.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Dɛ waa sɛh dɛ́ kpɔ kon bɔle o nyu ta naa, amɔ te bá fonɛ o nyu ta. A ta maɡrɛ kɛ ba fonɛ o nyu ta ɡe aa, amɔ te ó kpɔ kon dɛɛ bɔle o nyu ta.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Aa were kɛŋɔ baa ɡe kpɔ kon bɔle o nyu, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o do ɡɛ Korowii aa doa, dɛɛ baɡle Korowii jirima. Kɛ haah te dɛ baɡle baa jirima.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Haah waa laa Korowii ta baa, kɛ baa waa Korowii ta haah.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ ne nyundua toroma nyiŋa baa dɛ nyiŋi heyaa nomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ haah kpɔ kon dɛɛ bɔle o nyu á baɡle kɛŋɔ baa dɔ kpeɡri o nɛ.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Ya Korowii toma waa bini te, baa ne haah bwa sie dawɛ dɔŋa nɛ.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Baa binii haah le mumpar la, kɛ taraken te haahnee dɛɛ lolɛ baa, asɛ Korowii ɡe ta komɛlbwa.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Hé bwa nyiŋi ɡɛ waa nɔ kɛrɛdɛ. A wer kɛŋɔ haah ɛɛ soŋe Korowii dɛ o ta kon kpɔe bole o nyu ta naa?

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ haah nyu moɡɔ dɛ kpeɡ aa, a dɛ tɛo jirima wɛɛ do wer, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii tɛɛ ba nyumpona ŋɔ á tɔ ba nyuune ta.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl dɛ tɔŋle ɡɛ waa nɔ naa, ó jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ ya ne asɔre tena bwa ɛɛ ɛ. Kondikwa baa dia dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Yeesu (Mat

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Waane ɡe lole maa wola heyaa kpɛɛ dɛɛ ba he be bola. He chemaa, he dɛ chɔɡ dɔŋa, haa dɔŋa cha.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Waa aa tɔ sie laanee kɛŋɔ, n noɔ kɛŋɔ dɛ he chemo dɛɛ soŋe Korowii aa, haa nyopɛo dɔ. N dɛ lii kɛŋɔ kpelaa ba ŋɔ.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Aa ba ɡɛɛ. Dɛ a ta ɡɛ balaa, nɛra aa won jemɛ banɔ la baa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa he bini.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: He bini bane dɛ di ɡɛ kondikwaare la warane, haa cheɡɛ dɛɛ kpa he bala. Bane yon dɔ di dɛ́ nyɔ sen kohona dɛ́ berɛ dɛ́ɛ dɛɛ, dɛ bane ta komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ di.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ wobol nɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, saŋ bɛlbwa háa di paanoo nɔ dɛ́ kpɔ numol nɔ nyɔ sen nɔ la, ya Dɔɔ seo waa hɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ la, ka tel saŋ waa berɛ ba ja.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ di ɡɛ kwaa nɔ o ta liire kɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ bo-olii yaa, amɔ dɛ o dɛ muɡli Korowii baah dɛɛ do o te wahala ta.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Baa dia tonɛ la, o laa numol ne sen ane kpɔ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Sen nɔɔ cheɡa dɛ tɛ n chal. Aa ɛ fɔofalee dɛ́ chɔ Korowii ne nɛwɛnyina baah ta. Hɛ́ɛ nyɔ dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ lii mɛ.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu baɡ mɛ waa nɔ n ɡe baɡle heyaa kɛŋɔ o fa ɛ waane jwaana baa leo tɛ la. O kpɔ paanoo,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: asɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii do o ta, dɛ kuuɡu dɛ ŋɔ, “N bo-olii nɔ, maa kpɔa dɛ tɛ heya. Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ lii mɛ.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ paanoo nɔ, dɛ kpɔ numol nɔ nyɔ sen nɔ, waa wola an aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ la, dɛ Yeesu bo-ol ne o chalee o kpɔ doŋa dɛɛ leɡe la.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó nyiŋi o waa bini kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ di a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: A waa he ɡalɡa ɛɛ we weela dɛɛ ɡwɛɡre, asɛ bane ɡee serewe la.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ aa dɛ nyiŋi ya waa bini taraken nɔ, o dɛ tɛr ya deŋne ásɛ ya ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ, ásɛ ya bɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire wɛɛ ba ban bolchɔɡe pae la nɛɛ ja.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Anomanta, yabala, he pɛo dɛɛ di a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ naa, he bɛ a dii dɛɛ too. Hé so dɛɛ kpa dɔŋa dɛ́ bwa cheme mɔɔ dɛɛ di.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Dɛ lɔr dɛ kpo bɛl aa, ó di kwaa dem mɔɔ dɛ ba. He bɛ ya Dɔɔ kwaa la di ɡɛ aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he dia. Gɛ laa, Korowii baah ɛɛ di he nɛɛ. Anɔ la aa kaa la, n balaa, mɛɛ baɡle heyaa.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: He na kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ he fa aa wola Korowii tomɛ la, dɛ he nyoɡrɔ dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa aa wola waa bol, kɛ dɛ a dɔ kpeɡri he nɛɛ hɛɛ toma.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ bol waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ne la, waa won taah Yeesu. Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa dɛ bol ŋɔ Yeesuu ya Dɔɔ la, dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡrii ɡela wɛɛ ŋɔ ɡɛ la.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa cha nɛra ba dɔ la koɡrɔ, kɛ Doma beŋkpoŋ laanee tɛ a bwa.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Toma ya Dɔɔ aa bɔna tɛ yaa la koɡrɔ, kɛ Dɔɔ beŋkpoŋ tomaa yaa ɛ.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Wejema Korowii aa bɔna tɛ yaa la koɡrɔ, kɛ Korowii beŋkpoŋii cheɡɛ ya bwa nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡee tɛ nomɛlbwa kpeɡri ŋɔ ó kpɔ dɛɛ cha o bala.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: O tɛ nɛra bane wejema, dɛ tɛ bane ɡe sipila. O Doma beŋkpoŋ laanee tɛ ba bwa a ɡɛ kpeɡri la, bá won bol waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra,

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel bane che o kpeɡri la ta dɛ dɔ yarada kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ dɛ tɛ bane ɡe kpeɡri weela chaeh ta.

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: O tɛ bane kpeɡri ba won nyokpowaa ɛɛ, asɛ bane ɡe won che o kpeɡri la ta, dɛ́ won bol Korowii Wa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere. O ɡelɔ bane won jemɛ kon la soo waa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ ba che o ta dɛɛ ɛ wa, dɛ ɡel bane ɡe won bol wobofala, asɛ dɛ ɡel bane ɡe won wobofala mun baɡla dɛɛ baɡle nɛra.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe beŋkpoŋ laanee tɛ nomɛlbwa kpeɡri o kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ la. Gɛ aa too o teaa o tɛ nomɛlbwa. Yeesu bwadabii aa ɛ kombir kɛ dɛ dɔ peɡra wa

english_verse: The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does.
translation_verse: Hé ta sie nyiŋi he bwadabii na, o ɛ kombir, kɛ o dɔ peɡra, asɛ a bwa pɛ dɛ ɛ bwadabii beŋkpoŋ. Gɛɛ Yeesu Kristo do.

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Juu tena o, Grik tena o, yoma o, nɛra baa dɔ ba te noo, Korowii kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe la sɔ ya bwa ne, asɛ ya ɛ beŋkpoŋ. O tentenee o ɡel ya bwa dɔ dɛ nyɔ do ya bini.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini bwadabii ta konsiwi beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ. O peɡra warɔ.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Dɛ he nakpala ŋɔ o ta nɔn ɛɛ nomanta, o ta bwara ta jae yaa, dɛ nyosonee. O ta nɔn ɛɛ te, kɛ o ɡe ja bwadabii ta.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Dɛ deŋne ɡe ŋɔ o ta siwi ɛɛ nomanta, o ta bwadabii ta jae yaa, dɛ nyosonee. O ta siwi ɛɛ, kɛ o ja bwadabii ta.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Dɛ bwadabii fe dɔ siwi ɡbo, deŋne ta jae yaa, ɛrɛɛ o fe ɛɛ ba waa noe yɔ? Dɛ bwadabii fe ɛ deŋne ɡbo o ta mee dɔe yaa, ɛrɛɛ o fe ɛɛ ba sɔɔh noe yɔ?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Gɛ laa Korowii ta yaa. O do bwadabii peɡra nɔ bwa, bɛlbwa ne o dobɔr. Onee saahna ɛa ɡɛ.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Dɛ bwadabii fe ɛ konsiwi beŋkpoŋ ɡbo, peɡra bɛlbwa toole o ta naa, o fe ɛ bwadabii aa? Akai.

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Ya bwadabii peɡra la koɡrɔ, kɛ bwadabii la te ɛ kombeŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Siwi aa won ŋɔ nɔn be ŋɔ, “He ta n nɛɛ jae yaa, n ɡbo ɛɛ wonoo ɛ toma.” Gɛɛ nyu ɡe aa wola won ŋɔ nakpala be ŋɔ, “He ta n nɛɛ jae yaa, n ɡbo ɛɛ wonoo ɛ toma.”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Bwadabii bobɛla yaa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ aa kpeɡe la dɔ tɔnɔ.

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: Bwadabii bobɛla yaa wola lii kɛŋɔ a wer laanee yaa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ. Anɔ la sihiih aa dɛ kpo yaa a waa yaa wola nyin kɛŋɔ nɛn na la, anee yaa tɔ a ta kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa wera te, a ta hiaih kɛŋɔ ya nyiŋi a ta kpa. Gɛɛ Korowii ɛ ya bwadabii ásɛ yaa heeh a ɡɛ bɔra yaa wola lii kɛŋɔ a waa hiaoh la.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Korowii ɛa ɡɛ ásɛ bwadabii la bini bɛ peɡri, ásɛ a bwa ɛɛ cha dɔŋa.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Dɛ bwadabii bobɛl dɔ weela aa, dɛ bwadabii bwaa weela lawɛ la. Dɛ ba kpɛɛ bwadabii bobɛl aa, a dɛ do bwadabii la bwa som.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: He bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ Yeesu Kristo bwadabii ta. He bwa pɛo dɛ ɛ o bwadabi.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: He bwaa ɛ Yeesu toroma aa? He bwaa won Korowii kpeɡri la ta cheɡa dɛ́ bol wa aa? He bwaa won Korowii waa la baɡla aa? He bwaa won nyokpowaa ɛɛ yaa?

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: He bwaa won weela tena chaeh yaa? He bwaa won wobofala bola aa? He bwaa won wobofala mun baɡla aa?

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he sie beɡre, ásɛ hɛɛ nyin kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe be, ásɛ dɛ won cha nɛra ŋwɛnɛre aa wera kohona la ta. Mɛɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ waa wera ɡwaa a bwa.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Dɛ n wono dɛɛ bol nɛra bwa ne nyundua toroma wobol, kɛ dɛ maa nɛn nyin aa, dɛ ɡbɔɡaa mɛɛ do kɛŋɔ baa dɛ lɔ dawuro waa pera wɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa la.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Dɛ n wono kpɔ n komɛlbwa kɛ nyaara ba lɛ di, asɛ n berɛ koh Yeesu waa la waa dɛ sɛh ŋɔ mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpɔ nii fuuh mɛ, dɛ maa nɛn nyin aa, dɛ a ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Waa waa saɡasaɡa ɛ o bala be. Waa o ɡbo nyin, o dɛ nyin nomɛlbwa. O baah aa nɛra nɛɛ di warawara. Waa nɛn waa lɛɛ dɛɛ do o bini.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋii dɛɛ lɛ o sie. O sie aa wechɔɡa ta lɛ.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Nɛnnyin ta jaɡa dɔe. Korowii waa baa cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol bwa ɛɛ tonɔɔ tɔpebɛl wee. Wobofala baa cheɡɛ Korowii kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol bwa ɛɛ teŋoo tɔpebɛl wee. Wejema ɡee ba tonɔɔ.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa wera ka tonɛ la saŋ telaa, tama yaa dɔa taraken nɔ bwa ɛɛ tonɔɔ.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ n fa aa ɛ bechala la, dɛ n dɛ bol bechawobol, dɛɛ ɛ bechawa, dɛɛ lii bechaliire. Kɛ maa baa kpeɡ dɛ ɛ nomoa la, n ɡel n bechawaa la bwa.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee ya waa do taraken. A do kɛŋɔ yaa dɛ nyiŋi diɡi waa wola na kɛrɛdɛ ta ken. Dɛ tɔpere bɛl telaa, yaa naa kɛrɛdɛɛ kɛŋɔ a chɔ ya sie. Anɔ la bwa yaa jema taraken nɔ, anjena ta lɔ mun ta. Kɛ tɔpere la telaa, mɛɛ jemɛ wobɛlbwa ɡɛ Korowii aa jem mɛ la.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Anomanta, webele atoroo lole, yarada, hwɛɡa ne nɛnnyin. Kɛ nɛnnyinii ɡwaa a bwa.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ naate waa dɛ bol wobofala la, nɛra laa o bol dɛɛ tɛ. Korowiirii o bol dɛɛ tɛ. O cheɡɛ Korowii kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol waa aa sɔah. Nɛra aa a waa no.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Naate waa cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ta, dɛɛ bol waa la te bolɔ dɛɛ baɡle nɛra dɛɛ cha ba bá jemɛ Korowii Wa. O dɛ do ba ɡbemba dɛɛ larawe ba bwara.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa dɛ bol wobofala la, o bolɔ dɛɛ tɛ o ɡbaɡba. Naate waa cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol Korowii Waa la ɡe, asɔre tena la bwaa wɛɛ cha.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: Dɛ he bwa won wobofala bola aa, n dɛ nyin ɡɛ. Kɛ dɛ he won Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta cheɡa dɛ́ bol wa aa, ɡɛɛ dɛ́ do n som kohona. Naate waa dɛ bol Korowii Waa la ɡwaa nɛn waa dɛ bol wobofala, atane kɛ nomɛl won a mun baɡla dɛɛ tɛ asɔre tena á cha ba.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Yabala, dɛ n ba he be dɛ baa bol wobofala dɛ haa a mun no aa, tɔnɔ besoo he dɔ le n be nɔ? Dɛ n ta Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri la ta cheɡɛ, dɛ dɔ waa aa sɔah dɛ baɡle heya aa, kɛɛ dɛ n ta wejema ane dɔe, kɛɛ maa Korowii nyoa wobol kɛɛ o ŋwɛnɛre baɡla jemaa, tɔnɔ besoo hé dɔ le n be nɔ?

english_verse: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
translation_verse: Hé ta sie na kwaa baa dɛ hɛlɛ a ne. Dɛ a sii aa chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, ɛrɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ no a bini nɔ?

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɛ hoh laa bɛla ásɛ nɛra no dɛ́ ka yo, dɛ baa on hoh kɛrɛdɛ naa, umee dɛ́ won jemɛ dɛ́ kpɔ o te nɔ?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do, dɛ he wobol bini noe kpeɡri aa, ɛrɛɛ baa ba ɛɛ dɛ no a mun ɔ? A do kɛŋɔ he ɡbo aa soɡa dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nɛn dɛ bol waa maa a mun no aa, dɛ n berɛ deŋnebire te naate be. Dɛ o ɡe aa n kon no aa, o ɡe berɛ deŋnebire te n be.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: He siwi aa beɡra hɛɛ nyin kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe be ó cha heyaa Korowii toma ta nɔ, hɛ́ɛ nyin anɔ la aa won cha asɔre tena kohona.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Naate waa cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol wobofala la, ó soŋe Korowii ásɛ o chao ó won dɛɛ baɡle a mun.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɛ soŋe Korowii wobofale ne naa, dɛ n lilewee dɛɛ soŋo la, kɛ n liire te aa wobɛlbwa ɛ.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Amee jaɔ? Mɛɛ soŋe Korowii n lileo nee, ásɛ dɛɛ soŋo n liire ɡe ne. Mɛɛ kpɔ n lilewee ɡo yela, dɛ́ kpɔ n liire ɡe ɡo ja.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, he dɛ jam Korowii he lileo ne naa, ɛrɛɛ naate waa wola yarada dɛ ɛ nɛmpɛɛ la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ no a mun dɛ́ sɛh he nyoa ŋɔ “Aamen” dɛ́ teŋɛ waa haa jaamo a waa la ta nɔ? Waa won no waa haa dɛ bol la mun.

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: He te jam Korowii kɛrɛdɛ kwaraa ɡba aa, a ta tɔnɔ dɔe tɛo.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: N dɛ jam Korowii kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ waa ɡela n ɡe won wobofala bola, hale dɛ won a bola ɡwaa heyaa nɔ.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ n lɔ asɔre, dɛ bol n bwɛɛ wobol tama asɛ nɛra won no aa, a bɔ kɛŋɔ maa kpɔ wobofala bol waa kohona nɛra ta a mun noɛ.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé ɡel bechaliire. A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé dɔ nomonliire. Wechɔɡa ɛɛ te, hé ɛ he te bechasɔɔhne a bɔr. He bɛ ɡel he liire kpeɡ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra nɔ no n waa wobofala ta. Hɔɔhraa mɛɛ ba ɡela ba bol baɡ ba, kɛ baa no. Korowiirii ŋɔa.”

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ nɛra ɛɛ bol wobofala, dɛɛ baɡle o kpeɡri dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa wola on yarada. Nɛra baa dɛ yaradao la waa laa. O waa baɡla Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ta la, banɔ la baa dɛ yaradao la waa.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Dɛ asɔre tena chemo, asɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ bol wobofale, asɛ nɛra baa wola yarada dɛ ɛ nɛmpɛɛne ba ja he nɛ aa, baa ŋɔ he dɛ we choɡla aa?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he bwa chemo dɛ che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri la ta dɛɛ bol o wa, asɛ nɛn waa wola yarada dɛ ɛ nɛmpɛɛ ba ja aa, wɛɛ noo dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ o dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa. Waa haa dɛ bol la bwa ɛɛ jo o nyu binii, ásɛ o nyoa kpo.

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: O tea bini waa bwa ɛɛ chɔ baŋee, ásɛ o ɡuŋi Korowii harɛ dɛ́ soŋo, ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ nɛra be ŋɔ Korowii ja he nɛɛ kpela. Korowii toma aŋwɛnɛ ta

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Yabala, amee jaɔ? Saŋ bɛlbwa haa cheme la, bɛl dɛ tɛ yel, bɛl dɔ sipila waa haa dɛ hwela, bɛl ɡe dɔ waane Korowii aa baɡlo, bɛl ɡee bol wobofala, bɛl ɡee baɡle a mune. Hé ɡel waa haa dɛ ɛ la dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ bol wobofala la, hé ɡel ba ɛ nɛra banɛ kɛɛ batoro ɡbo. A chɛ kɛ bá bol kaa tɛ dɔŋa, ásɛ bɛl ɡee baɡle a mun ásɛ nɛra no ɡɛ waa bola.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won baɡle wobofale la mun aa, amɔ te náate waa ira dɛ fee bol waa la tɔ nyoa dɛ́ so. Kɛ o ne Korowii ɛɛ bol waa o bambile bini.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Dɛ bɛl soɡo Korowii Domadɛɛɡe baɡlo waane aa, a chɛ kɛ naate waa dɛ bol waa la tɛo bɔr ó bol.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Hé bwa ɛɛ bol Korowii waa beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, ásɛ a dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ he bwa, dɛ́ do heyaa ɡbemba.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Nɛra Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa tɛɛ ba kpeɡri bá bol o waa la, bá won ba te lawa,

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa wesaɡasaɡare nyin. Deŋnesɔɔhnaa wɛɛ nyin. Gɛ baa dɛ ɛ asɔrere ta bobɛlbwa laanee.

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɛ asɔre aa, hé ɡel haahna hel. A ta maɡrɛ kɛŋɔ baa bol waa bela. Gɛ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡla la, hé ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ báa no he baala la be.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Dɛ haahna la dɛ nyin waane bɔɔra aa, bá la dem mɔɔ dɛ́ ka bɔɔ ba jaranar. A ta maɡrɛ kɛŋɔ haah bol waa asɔre dea bela.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: He bee Korowii waa la che dɛ ba naa? He ɡboo no waa la aa?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa dɛ bol ŋɔ he won Korowii kpeɡri ta cheɡa dɛ́ bol o waa la, kɛɛ he dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ waa maa chwera ba tɛ heyaa la ɛ Korowii Mmara.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa wola nyin kɛŋɔ o no la, hé ɡelo.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé ɡel he sie beɡre hɛɛ nyin kpeɡri Korowii be, ásɛ dɛ won kpɔ bol o wa, dɛ bɛ banɔ la baa dɛ bol wobofala la ŋwɛnɛ tɔ.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa ŋwɛnɛ aa maɡra ta dɛ bɛ wesaɡasaɡare dɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé ɡel n lii heyaa Amanesoma la n fa aa bola baɡle heyaa asɛ he no dɛ taa teŋɛ a ta,

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa baɡ mɛ laanee n baɡle heyaa la. O baɡle waane aa ɛ wejena kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ sewɛ ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡle o waa mɔɔ a ɛ la.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ba huɡo, asɛ a tɔpetooro wee la Korowii iru seo ta. Gɛɛ Korowii Tɔn baɡle mɔɔ a ɛ.

english_verse: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
translation_verse: Pitaa tɔ sie nao, mɔɔ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la bwa nao,

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: mɔɔ o habɔɔ nɛra lafraanue la ɡe nao kerabeŋkpoŋ. Ba ɡalɡa ta lole ba le fini, bane ɡe serewe.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, Jems nao, asɛ Yeesu toroma bwa nao.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Menee ka mun nao. N do kɛŋɔ bechala o nya aa kpoŋe o tea o ta beɛ kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ ba lolɔ la.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Menee Yeesu toroma la bwa bechala n waa aa wola hiaih. N ta chɛɛ kwaraa kɛ ba yer mɛ o torome, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ n fa aa hah asɔre tena dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la aa were.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii sune n nɛ, dɛ cha mɛ. Chae waa cha mɛ laanee ɡela n do ɡɛ maa doa nɔ la. O suna waa sune n nɛɛ la ta pɛɛ ɛɛ. N iro, asɛ dɛɛ ɛ o toma la kohona hale dɛ ɡwaa n bala toroma la kwara. N ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ne laa mɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ. Korowiirii sune n nɛɛ dɛ cha mɛ, asɛ mɛɛ ɛa ɡɛ la.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Dɛ menee bol Amanesoma la baɡle heya o, nɛra banee yoo, webeŋkpoŋii ya bwa ɛɛ baɡle, anee he ɡee yarada. Nɛra seo ta ira

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Dɛ ya baɡle Yeesu Kristo waa ŋɔ Korowiirii iru seo ta naa, ɛrɛɛ he bini bane berɛ dɛɛ ŋɔ Korowii aa nɛraa ir seo ta nɔɔ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii aa nɛraa ir seo ta naa, amɔ te Yeesu Kristo ɡba ta seo ta ire.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii ta Yeesu Kristo ire seo ta te naa, amɔ te waa yaa dɛ baɡle heyaa la, ne yarada haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛɛ te naa, amɔ te Korowii danseɛ yaa dɛ di la ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya dɛ baɡle heyaa ŋɔ Korowiirii ir Yeesu Kristo le seo ta. Dɛ nɛra aa seo taa ir te naa, amɔ ya teŋe nyosone.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra aa seo taa ir aa, amɔ te Korowii ta on ire seo ta.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii ta Yeesu Kristo ire seo ta naa, amɔ te he dɛ yaradao pɛɛpɛɛ, dɛ he wechɔɡa ta lɔ he nɛ.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: A berɔ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ nɛra ba fa aa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo mɔɔ dɛ serewe la, Korowii aa ban lɛ.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya soɡa yaa soɡa nɔ ɡbo taa ya dɔ hwɛɡa Yeesu Kristo be naa, amɔ te ya waa sum ɡwaa nɛra bwa wa.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɡɛ laa a do. Korowiirii ir Yeesu Kristo seo ta. Onee tɔ sie ir seo ta nɛra baa serewa la nɛɛ mɔɔ ba ɡe baa ir.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Nɛmbeŋkpoŋii ba seo ne. Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ɡee ba seo ta ira ne.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Kɛ ya bwa ne ya tɔperaa ya ir. Yeesu Kristoo tɔ sie ir mɔɔ, ásɛ ya banɔ la ya ne waa ɛ beŋkpoŋ la ɡe ir ɡɛ saŋ waa ba ja la.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Belaa wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba a jaɡa bala. A taa Yeesu Kristo ɛɛ ba kpeɡri dɔe, dɛ́ pɔ konchɔɡa aa bea yaa wola an na bwa soo siwi nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ kora la do o Mɛɛ Korowii nɔn ta ó di.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo chɛ kɛŋɔ ó di kpeɡri komɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa pɔ o dɔma bwa nɛ.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Dɛ o baa pɔ ba bwa nɛɛ tonaa, o dɔm muŋkaa waa pɔ o nɛɛ laanee seo.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii ɡelɔ o dɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri.” Dɛ ba ŋɔ, “O ɡelɔ o dɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri” aa, a ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ o dɔ o Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri la dɛ kpɔ tɛo o di la ɡe kpeɡri.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii baa ɛ ɡɛ tonaa, o Bie ɡee kpɔ o tenee do o Mɛɛ Korowii waa kpɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri tɛo la lɔɡa, ásɛ Korowii ɡbo ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Nɛra bane cheɡɛ lala naa ta dɛ ɡel baa sɔ ba Korowii ne. Bɔkwa waa baa ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ? Dɛ lala aa seo taa ir aa, bɔkwa waa ɡela ba ɡel ba ɛ ɡɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ baɔ?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Bɔkwa waa ya ɡee jo siswɛm waa ta saŋ bɛlbwa nɔɔ?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Yabala, kpelaa mɛɛ ŋɔ, dɛ maa siswɛm ta jo tɔpere bɛlbwa naa, amɔ te dɛ n laa yon dɛɛ kpɛɛ heyaa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ teŋa ta la.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ neɡre heya. Danchɔɡe kpɔe dɛ chɔɡ dadɛɛɡe.

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ir dɛ́ ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ hɛɛ ɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ bɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ ɛ. He bini bane aa Korowii waa jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ. A ta sihiih ɛɛ tɛ heya aa? Gɛ ya bwadabi aa dɛ ba doe seo ta ira habɔɔ

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: He bini bɛl ɛɛ bɔɔroo ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ lala ɛɛ ba wona ir seo ta nɔ? Ɛrɛɛ ba bwara ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?”

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Gɛne! Komɛlbwa haa du la, o dɛ pɔh mɔɔ dɛ́ le.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛɛ beɡra ɡɛ a bwa soo siwi aa doa ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Bwadabii bwa ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ. A bwa ne a soo siwii. Nɛwɛnyini bwadabii korɛ ola kwaa ta. Asɛ pɛŋa ɡe kwaa korɛ jumbii kwaa ta.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Korowii doa kwaa lole, asɛ harɛ ta ɡe kwaa do le, kɛ a wer korɛ dɔŋa ta.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Wee wer korɛ korobie wer ta. Weweela ɡe wer korɔ. Hale weweela bini kwara, ane dɛ chaah ɡwaa ane.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
