translation_verse: Gɛɛ nɛra seo ta ira ɛɛ ba doe. Bwadabii yaa dɔa nɔ, dɛ ya baa serewe aa, o bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, kɛ bwadabii yaa dɔ dɛ ir seo ta la, o te aa chɔɡ bwa.

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Bwadabii yaa dɔɔ harɛ nɔ ta laanee baa ba huɡa, kɛ onɔ la Korowii aa dɛ ba ira seo ta la te ɛɛ korɔɔ. Gɛ harɛ nɔ ta bwadabii aa lole la, ɡɛɛ Korowii doa kon ɡe do le.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii ta nɛnloɡle, dɛ yerɔ Adam, asɛ o dɔ mkpa dɛ do le.” Kɛ muŋkaa Adam la te ɛ Korowii doa nɛn dɛɛ tɛ mkpa. Onee Yeesu Kristo.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Korowii doa bwadabii laa ya tɔ sie dɔ. Harɛ nɔ ta konee ya tɔ sie dɔ mɔɔ dɛ dɔ Korowii doa kon la.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛnloɡle la, ba mao tee ne o ɛ harɛ nɛn. Asɛ nɛɛte la ɡe le nyundua.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Gɛ onɔ la baa mao tee ne fa aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o nɛra ɡe do. Asɛ ɡɛ onɔ la waa le nyundua aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o ɡe nɛra do.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Gɛ yaa le onɔ la waa le harɛ nɔ ta la, ɡɛɛ yaa ba onɔ la waa le nyundua la ɡe lee.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé ɡel n ŋɔ he be, harɛ nɔ ta bwadabii aa won la Korowii be. Kon waa dɛ pɔh la ne onɔ la waa wola pɔh aa won pɛ.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no, mɛɛ baɡle heyaa wesɔɔhle bɛlee. Ya bwa laa dɛɛ ba serewa. Hale dɛ ya serewɔ oo, ya ta serewɛ oo, Korowii ɛɛ beɡre ya bwa bwadabii kerabeŋkpoŋii.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Aa ɛo wɔrɔbe nɛɛ kilo, ɡɛ saŋ Korowii bɛla aa ba si, dɛ́ baɡle waa bwa jaɡa la. Dɛ o sio waa, Korowii ɛɛ ir serewa laanee seo ta, ásɛ ba dɔ bwadabii waa wola pɔh, dɛ beɡre ya banɔ la yaa wola sewɛ dɛ ta so le la bwara,

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Dɛ onɔ la waa wola sewɛ, waa wola pɔh la baa chiɡ onɔ la waa dɛ sewɛ, dɛɛ pɔh la naa ta naa, belaa waa baa chwera do Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛɛ ba kpela ɛɛ. Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “O kpɔ kpeɡri pɔ seo nɛ.”

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡaa ɡela seo ɛɛ do yaa weweele ta. Mmara yaa wola o ta teŋɛ la ɡe ɡelɔ seo dɔ kpeɡri ya nɛ.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Korowii chɛ jam kohona. O tɛ yaa kpeɡri dɛ le ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo be ásɛ ya pɔ seo nɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Anomanta, yabala maa dɛ nyin he wa, hé lawɛ waa la bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛ bɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa ha heyaa ásɛ he berɛ habɔɔ. Hé lawɛ ya Dɔɔ toma bini bambile bwa ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he koeh aa pɛɛ ɛɛ ba.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: A ka suuɡa yaa dɛ nyin ya ta tɛ Korowii nɛra la. Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ n fa aa ŋɔ asɔre tena baa lɔ Galaasia harɛ ta be ŋɔ báa ɛ la.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Kwasiara bɛlbwa, hé bini bɛlbwa ɛɛ kpɔ suuɡa, ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa wona dɛ le anɔ la Korowii aa chao o dɔ la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ cheɡ. Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ n balaa, he bɛ suuɡa dɛɛ ta kpa.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Dɛ n balaa, mɛɛ chwerɛ tɔn aa dɛ baɡle n waa, he kpɔ ka tɛ nɛra haa dɛ yarada ba, dɛ́ tom ba bá kpɔ a ne kwaa haa tɛ Korowii nɛra la la Jerusalam.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Dɛ a chɛ kɛ n ne ba la naa, mɛɛ tɔ ba siee ya la. Pɔɔl baɡle ɡɛ waa berɛ ba Makidoonia tena be

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ n la Makidoonia harɛ ta. Dɛ n baa le bela aa, mɛɛ ba he bee,

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: dɛ́ ba so he be dɛ́ biɡri tama. N ken ɛɛ so he bee alalawo saŋ, ásɛ alalawo saŋ kaa mɔɔ he ta mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń kaa bela bwa maa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Dɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ ba na heyaa tarakenii yaa, maa won biɡri he be. Kɛ dɛ Korowii sɛoh n ba won ba naa, mɛɛ biɡri he bee.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Mɛɛ so Ɛfesos bonɔɔ ka tel kɛŋɔ Pɛntekɔs Tɔpejen la aa tel,

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ n dɔ bɔr bonɔ dɛ́ won ɛ Korowii toma kohona, ásɛ a le tɔnɔ dɛ tɛo. Nɛra baa dɛ nyin ba tɔ n toma ŋwɛnɛ la warɔ te.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Timoti ba he be naa, hé lɛo kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ o sie lɛ. Korowii toma maa dɛ ɛ la, anee o ɡee ɛ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he bɛ o sie lawɛ teɡɛ harɛ. Hé doo ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ o kpɔ bambisɔɔhna dɛ berɛ ba n be. N dɛ nyiŋi o ne yabala la ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: N soŋe ya dɔŋ Apolos ŋɔ ó ja yabala la nɛɛ ba ba he be, kɛ a ta o som doe kɛ ó la bela taraken. Dɛ o baa dɔ bɔr aa, wɛɛ bao.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ nɛnnyin dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Yabala, he jemɔ kɛŋɔ Stɛfanas ne o dem tenaa tɔ sie yarada Yeesu waa la Akaya harɛ nɛra la bwa bini, dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo dɛ swɛɛ siwi dɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra.

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dɛ soŋe heya, hɛ́ɛ no nomɛlbwa waa do ken ne nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ dɛɛ koh toma nɔ ta la deŋna wa.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Stɛfanas ne Fɔtonaatos ne Akaekus balɔ, asɛ a do n som taeh, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɡbabir ta wone ba ásɛ n na heya, kɛ ba chiɡ he naa ta dɛ ba,

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: dɛ ba do mɛ ɡbemba taeh, dɛ do he ɡe ɡbemba. Hɛ́ɛ duu nɛra baa do ken nɔ.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɔre tena baa lɔ Eesia harɛ la dɛ na heyaa taeh. Akwela ne Presela ne asɔre tena baa dɛ cheme ba dem la ɡe dɛ na heyaa Yeesu sɔn ta.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Yabala bwa baa lɔ bonɔ dɛ na heya. Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nyabii.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa wola ya Dɔɔ nyin la, Korowii nyotaahna lɔ o nɛ. Ya Dɔɔ, ba!

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl aa too Korowii tea asɛ o lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, n ne ya dɔŋ Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ. Ya chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ asɔre tena baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii Kɔrent, ne Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa baa lɔ Akaya harɛ ta.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Pɔɔl Korowii jaama

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii. Onee ya Mɛɛ o tea aa dɛ domɛ ya nɛɛ kohona, dɛ ɛ Korowii waa wona dɛɛ larawe nɛn bwara.

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: On dɛɛ larawe ya bwara ya wenaale bwa ta, ásɛ ya ɡe won che bambisɔɔhna waa tɛ yaa la ta dɛɛ larawe yabala baa lɔ wenaale bɛlbwa soo siwi ta la bwara.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Gɛ yaa ja Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ na wahala kohona la, ɡɛ tentenee a che o nɛɛ ya dɔ bɔlarawa ɡe kohona.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya dɛ na wahala aa, he chae waa yaa naa, ásɛ dɛ won larawe he bwara, ásɛ Korowii won lɛ heya. Dɛ Korowii berɔ larawe ya bwara ɡe aa, dɛ he chae waa o ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ ya won cha heya, he won lawɛ bambile ɡɛ saŋ haa ba na ya wahala yaa naa la dɔŋ la.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya hwɛɡa yaa dɔa he nɛɛ la aa pɛɛ ɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ na ya wahala la dɔŋ nɔ, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ba ya bɔlarawa Korowii aa ba tɛ yaa la ane dɔe.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ wahala yaa naa Eesia harɛ la wa. Dɛ a kan dɛ ɡwaa ya nɛɛ kohona. Dɛ yaa lii kɛŋɔ yaa le a nyoa bokpeɡa binii.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Ya te fe jemɔ kɛŋɔ yaa sewɔɔ, kɛ ya ta sewɛ. Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ ásɛ ya bɛ ya ɡbaɡba bokpeɡa ta dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ hwɛɡa do on waa dɛ ir nɛra seo ta la nɛ.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: O lɛ yaa le siswɛm a fe aa chɛ kɛ ya sewɛ a ta la ta. O ta dɛ lɛ yaa. Ya kpɔ ya sie dawɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ lɛ yaa.

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: Hé cha yaa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, ásɛ dɛ o baa no he wesoŋa dɛ cha yaa aa, nɛra won kpɔ jam tɛo pirim dɛ́ tɛ yaa kɛŋɔ waa no nɛndamanta wesoŋa baa soŋa tɛ yaa la. Gɛ aa ɛa Pɔɔl charɛ o liire

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Webeŋkpoŋii ɡela ya baŋa pa. Anee kɛŋɔ yaa wonoo ŋɔ bambile bwa ne kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa yaa ɛa harɛ bonɔ la, tepoŋ ne bambile bwa nee ya ɛa Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta, a laa kɛ waa yaa ɛa he be la. Korowiirii sune ya nɛɛ dɛ cha yaa ya ɛa. Harɛ bonɔ wejema ne laa ya ɛa.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Waa yaa chwerɛ heyaa asɛ he kure dɛ no a mun la, anee ya chwerɛ. Wobɛlbwa toole a bini he no a mun kahonɛ.

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: Taraken haa jemɛ ya waa tama nɔ, n dɛ lii kɛŋɔ hɛɛ jemɛ ya waa bwaa, ásɛ awola tɔpere ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa ba la, he baŋa pa ya waa kɛŋɔ ya baŋa aa pa he waa la.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Maa jemɛ he waa ken la, a waa n faa ɛ kɛ mɛɛ ba cha heyaa kera anɛ bwaa la.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: N fa ɛo kɛ n Makidoonia harɛ kaala ta la, ń kpɔ he be, ásɛ n le bela dɛɛ ba ɡe aa, ń ba so he be tama, ásɛ he ta mɛ ŋwɛnɛ n kaa Juda harɛ.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Maa lii ken la, dɛ n le nɛn o liire aa dɛ ɛo aahna-aahna kɛɛ? N dɛ maɡle maɡla aa, n ɡbo kɛrɛdɛɛ mɛɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ ɛ, ásɛ a wer tɛ mɛ naa, n ŋɔ ɔɔh, dɛ buɡ ta n berɔ na kɛ aa were tɛ mɛ naa, n ŋɔ ɔɔhɔh kɛɛ?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: N nyoa maa baɡɛ heyaa la, aahna-aahna toole a ta. A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ Korowii wa aa ɛ kasinteŋ nyosone aa wola toole a ta la.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Korowii Bie Yeesu Kristo la n ne Silvanos ne Timoti aa baɡle o waa he be la dɔ kasinteŋ. O ta dɔe kɛŋɔ o ŋɔ ɔɔh, dɛ berɛ le habɔɔ dɛ ŋɔ ɔɔhɔh. O te bol wa aa, dɛ o bolɔ.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Nyoo bwa Korowii aa baɡa la, Yeesu nɛɛ ya che dɛ jemɛ kɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ. O waa ya won Aamen la sii, ásɛ Korowii won dɔ sɔn.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Korowiirii ɡela ya ne he bwa won lawɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ teŋa la kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ le yaa tɛ o toma,

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Kpeɡri laa yaa baɡle heyaa he Korowii yaradae ta. Yaa ɡɛ lii kwaraa. Ya jemɔ kɛ he cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ he yarada ta. Ya dɛ nyin kɛ ya cha heyaa ásɛ he sie lɛ.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ maa he bee ba ásɛ dɛ ba ɡel he tea bini chɔɡ kpa.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ he tea bini chɔɡ aa, umee dɛ́ lar mɛ bwara jaɔ? Nɛn toole, nemenɛ he tenten maa chɔɡ he tea bini la.

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: A waa n chwerɛ heyaa tɔn la. Dɛ maa nyin kɛ he nɛra haa chɛ kɛ he ɡel n sie lɛ la, n ba he be ásɛ he berɛ ba ɛɛ mɛ tebinichɔɡ wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n jemɛ he bwa waa kɛ n silɛɛ he silɛɛ.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Tɔn la n fa aa chwerɛ heyaa la, dɛ a dɛ we n nɛɛ taeh, asɛ n tea bini chɔɡ mɛɛ wi siniire dɛɛ chwerɔ. N fa ta on chwerɛ dɛ́ ɡel he tea bini chɔɡ, kɛ n chwerɔ ásɛ he na ɡɛ del maa dɛ nyin he bwa. Wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Nɛn o fa aa ba tebinichɔɡ ne la, n ɡbo tea bini laa o chɔɡ. He bwa tea binii o chɔɡ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl ta. Maa nyin kɛ n do naate siswɛm, a waa n bola ken la.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Gɛ he kɛrɛdɛ nyoa aa pɛa he tɛr naate deŋne nɔ, a maɡrɔ. He bɛ ane ɛ ja kpa.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ he kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo name, dɛɛ doo ɡbemba. Gɛ laa, o tea bini chɔɡɔ kohona aa, wɛɛ horɔɔ.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ he ɡel o jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ nyinu kohona.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ń ɛ heyaa dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ hɛɛ no n waa ta wobɛlbwa taa kɛɛ haa no la, a waa n chwerɛ heyaa tɔn la.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa haa kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo la, n ɡe kpɔɔ kɛo. Nomɛl ɛɛ mɛ waane a chɛ kɛ ń kpɔ kɛo waa, n koh he waa dɛ kpɔ kɛo Yeesu Kristo siwi ta,

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: ásɛ Bɔnsam bɛ ŋwɛnɛ ba dɔ dɛ́ chɔɡ ya wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya jemɛ o ŋwɛnɛre waa kpɔa dɛɛ neɡre nɛn. Sibeɡra Pɔɔl aa kpɔa bol Korowii wa Troas

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Maa baa tel Troas ŋɔ ń bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la, n nao kɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ pili ŋwɛnɛ tɛ mɛ kɛ ń ɛ toma bela.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Kɛ maa wola ya dɔŋ Taetos ka pue bela la, n baah ta men sɔɔhnɛ. Anomanta, n kal bela tena dɛ kaa Makidoonia harɛ.

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Korowii jam kɛ waa cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ ɡel ya yo dɛɛ le nɔ. Korowii cheɡɛ ya nɛɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ no Yeesu Kristo waa la bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, konsɔɔhsoma sɔɔh aa dɛ le nomɛlbwa ɛɛ no la.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa dɛ nyoɡre la ɛɛ no sɔɔh laanee dɛ́ serewe, ásɛ banɔ la Korowii aa dɛ lɛɛ ba la ɡe no dɛ́ dɔ mkpa. Umee dɛ won ɛ ɡɛ toma nɔɔ?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Nɛra kɛrɛdɛ kpɔ Korowii waa la berɛ bona dii dɛ yoɡ dɛɛ di. Ba laa yan. Korowiirii tɛ yaa waa nɔ ŋɔ yáa bola, ásɛ yaa bola o siwi ta bambile bwa ne, pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la nomanta.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Yaa dɛ ŋɔ ken nɔ, kpɛɛraa yaa kpɛɛ ya te ja kɛɛ? A hiaoh kɛŋɔ ya kpoŋe tɔne aa baɡle ya nɛnsoo ne ɡɛ ya toma aa doa mɔɔ he lɛ yaa aa? Kɛɛ a hiaoh kɛ ya dɔ ane le he be ásɛ nɛra won yarada yaa aa?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: He ɡbaɡbaa ya tɔn waa dɛ baɡle tondɛɛɡa yaa ɛa. Ya bambile taa Korowii chwerɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa na heya, dɛɛ pese heyaa kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ kure tɔn la.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: He we-ɛɛla dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he ɛ Yeesu Kristo tɔn waa cheɡɛ ya nɛɛ dɛ chwerɛ. Iŋki ne laa o chwerɔ, Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la Domadɛɛɡee o kpɔ chwerɛ. Bwe ta laa o chwerɔ, bambile taa o chwerɔ.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Ya won ɡɛ bola, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛɛ yarada Korowii a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: A ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ ya dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ya won waane ɛɛ ya ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ta. Korowii bee ya dɔ kpeɡri dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la bwa yaa dɛ ɛ.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ ya won dɛɛ ɛ o fɔofale la toma. A ɡɛ fɔofale nɔ ta mmara baa chwera waa ɛɛ, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa. Mmara baa chwera la dɛ ba seo ne, kɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la te dɛ ba mkpa ne.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Bwe taa Korowii faa chwerɛ Mosis Mmara la dawɛ. Bela Korowii aa kpɔ Mmara la tɛ Mosis la, Korowii jirima ba bela, bela bwa chaah, dɛ chaah Mosis nɛɛ o siebɔr ɛɛ nyɛɡle. Mosis aa la Israel tena be la, dɛ nyɛɡla o siebɔr aa dɛ nyɛɡle la nyoa sɔɔhnɔ tonɛ. Kɛ Israel tena aa nao la, ba ŋɔ o siebɔr dɛ nyɛɡle kohona to, ba ta wone nyiŋu. Mosis Mmara kwara waa dɛ la nɛn ne seo ta la wono ba jirima nɔ dɔŋ ne naa,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: dɛ ɛrɛɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la wa ɛɛ ba doe yɔ? Aa ɡɛɛ ɡwaa la aa?

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Waa aa ɡela nɛra ɛɛ di bolchɔɡe Korowii sie la dɔ jirima ken aa, dɛ anɔ la aa ɡela nɛra ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba wa ɛɛ su o siwi la, ɛrɛɛ a jirima ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Waa a fa aa dɔ jirima kohona la, taraken a ta jirima dɔe kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ anfala jirima tɔɔɡe a nɛ.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Waa aa ɛa tɔpera anɛ dɛ tonɛ la, dɛ a dɔ jirima aa, dɛ anɔ la aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la, a jirima ta ɡwaalaa?

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Ya dɔ hwɛɡa ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, anomanta, yaa ɔmɛ.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Ya ta do kɛ Mosis o fa aa wola nyin kɛ Israel tena na kɛŋɔ o siebɔr nyɛɡla nyoa dɛ sɔɔh, dɛ koh a waa kpɔ yachaahne tɔ sie la.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Israel tena fa aa waa la mun no. Taraken ɡba, ɡɛɛ ba ta do. Baa dɛ kure fɔobene la waa la, a ta do kɛ baa kpɔ yachaahne tɔ ba sie. Ba ta Yeesu Kristo waa lɛɛ yaa, yachaahne la aa ba sie lee ba.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛ, saŋ bɛlbwa nɛwɛnyini aa charɛ o liire dɛ́ berɛ ba Yeesu be la, yachaahne la ɛɛ leo.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ Yeesuu Domadɛɛɡe la. Bobɛlbwa ɡe o Domadɛɛɡe la aa lole la, nomɛlbwa dɔ o te, o toole Mmara lɔɡa.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Anomanta, komɛlbwa ta ya te sie tɔe. Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu jirima chaah ya nɛ, dɛɛ beɡre yaa asɛ yaa do ɡɛ waa doa, jirima yaa dɔa la ɛɛ ja. Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu waa ɛ Domadɛɛɡe la bee a bwa le.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Korowiirii sune ya nɛɛ dɛ tɛ yaa toma nɔ, anomanta, ya bwara aa yaa hwah.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ya ɡel waa baa ɛa dɛɛ sɔh ne sihihwaa bɛlbwa. Yaa nɛra neɡre, yaa Korowii waa yaa dɛ baɡle la sie berɛ. Kasinteŋ ɡboo yaa di Korowii sie. A taa ya che dɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ jemɛ ya da.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma nɔ yaa dɛ bol nɔ, dɛ a sɔɔh kwaraa naa, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyoɡre la bee a sɔh.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Bɔnsam baa dɛ maŋkurao harɛ nɔ ta kɛŋɔ Korowii la, o chɔɡ nɛra baa wola Yeesu yarada la liire. Waa nyin kɛŋɔ Amanesoma nii aa le Yeesu Kristo o wa aa dɔ jirima kohona be la chaah ba. Yeesu do ɡɛ Korowii aa doa.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Ya ɡbaɡba waa laa yaa baɡle nɛra nɔ. Yeesu Kristo waa yaa baɡle kɛŋɔ onee komɛlbwa Dɔɔ, dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o nomanta, he bonɔɔnaa yan.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Korowii waa pere bochaah le biro ta, dɛ ɡel bɔr chaah la, onee ɡela o nii chaah ya bambile ne ya sie, asɛ ya won jemɛ ɡɛ o jirima yaa naa Yeesu Kristo be la aa doa.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ ha yaa kohona, kɛ baa ya nɛɛ pɔ. Waa dɛ hiah yaa ya nyiŋi ɡɛ yaa ɛ kahonɛ, kɛ ya bwara aa yɔr, yaa ɡel.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: Nɛra cheɡɛ ya nɛ, kɛ Korowii te ta ya habɔɔ leɛ. Ba ɡo yaa bil te, kɛ ba ta wone kpo yaa.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Yaa soɡe le nɔ, Yeesu nomanta, saŋ bɛlbwaa ya so seo nyoa, ásɛ nɛra na o mkpa ya bwadabii waa won sewa nɔ aa dɔa.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, a kaa ɛ kɛ ya te dɛ sewɛ, asɛ he te ɛɛ dɔ mkpa dɛ le ya seo la ta.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Maa yaradaa waa n bol.” Gɛɛ ya ɡee yarada. Yaa yaradaa waa yaa bol.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii waa ir ya Dɔɔ Yeesu seo ta la, onee dɛɛ ba ya banɔ la ya ne Yeesu aa pɛa la seo ta ira, dɛ́ kpɔ ya ne heyaa kaa o be.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: He waa Korowii ɛ anɔ bwa. Waraa nɛra Korowii aa na ba sum den na dɛɛ warɛ. Baa kpɔ jam kohonaa tɛ Korowii ásɛ o dɔ jirima.

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Ken nɔ nomanta, bɔhwaah aa yaa lawɛ. Tɔ aa dɛ per nɔ bwaa ya bwadabii ɡwɛɡre dɛɛ la. Kɛ ya bini te la, kpeɡrii ya yarada do dɛɛ la.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Wahala tama nɔ yaa dɛ na tɔpera anɛ bɛl nɔ ɛɛ ɡeloo ya dɔ jirima aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ásɛ a ɡwaa wahala nɔ kwaraa ken.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Kwaa baa dɛ naa siwi ne la ta laa ya te sie dawɛ. Anɔ la baa wola an na la taa ya sie dawɛ. Kwaa baa dɛ naa la te, tɔpera anɛ bɛlee aa di. Asɛ anɔ la baa wola an na ɡe la, a ta jaɡa dɔe bwa.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Ya harɛ nɔ ta bwadabii nɔ do kɛ pata ya do o ta. Ya jemɔ kɛ dɛ o chɔɡaa, Korowii ɛɛ tɛ yaa defale o ɡbaɡba aa doa waa wola chɔɡ bwa nyunduaa.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Ya bwadabii nɔ te pe yaa. Ya sie cheɡɛ chiŋ yaa hime, dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ ya Korowii doa bwadabii la do yaa,

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Ya taa lɔ ya bwadabii aa do kɛ patare ta nɔ, ya bwara dɛ nyɛɡ, yaa hime. Ya bwadabii nɔ kpɔe dɛ le ya nɛɛ waa laa dena swɛɛ ya siwi. Ya Korowii doa bwadabii la doe waa swɛɛ ya siwi kohona, ásɛ o chiɡ bwadabii waa won sewa nɔ naa ta ya dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Korowiirii cheɡ ɡɛ waa nɔ tɛ yaa, dɛ kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe tɛ yaa a baɡle kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ba tɛ yaa o mkpa laanee.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya bwara aa yaa hwah bwa. Ya jemɔ kɛ ya lɔ ya bwadabii nɔ bini naa, ya toole ya Dɔɔ be,

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ waa yaa dɛ na la ne laa ya so. Waa yaa dɛ yarada a waa la nee ya so.

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: Ya bwara aa yaa hwah tamaa bɛlbwa. Dɛ ya ɡel ya bwadabii nɔ waa do kɛ dea nɔ dɛ ka do ya Dɔɔ be naa, ɡɛɛ yaa nyin.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya bwadabii nɔ binii ya do oo, ya Dɔɔ bee ya do oo, ya dɛ nyin ya waa bwa won su o siwi,

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya bwa ɛɛ ba che Yeesu Kristo sie o bol ya waa dɛ́ pa bole, ásɛ bɛlbwa dɔ waa o fa aa soɡe le dɛɛ ɛ la kembɔr. Dɛ bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla wer oo, aa were oo, wɛɛ dɔ a kembɔree. Yeesu nɛɛ cheɡa ya ne Korowii kpɔ darame

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Yaa jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do ɔma la waa ya bol waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra ásɛ ba jemɛ kasinteŋ la. Korowii jemɛ ya bambile bini bwa. N dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ɡe jemɛ ya nɛnsoore he bambile bini.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Anɔ dɛ baɡle kɛ kpɛɛraa ya kpɛɛ ya te dɛɛ baɡle heyaa ja kɛɛ? Akai! Ya dɛ nyin ya baɡle heyaa wa, ásɛ he che a ta dɛ́ won dɛɛ maŋkura yaa nɛra baa dɛ chɔɡ yaa la be. Waa nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ naa laanee baa maŋkura. Baa nɛn bambile bini waa nyiŋi.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya nyu toole naa, Korowii waa a ba ɡɛ. Ya sie chɔ harɛ ɡe aa, he wesomee a ba ɡɛ.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa laanee dɛɛ do yaa ya we-ɛɛla bwa ta. Gɛ yaa naa laanee kɛŋɔ dɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ lɛ nɛra bwa seo sewaa, a kaa chaa kɛ nɛra la bwa sewɔ.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: O sewɔ tɛ nɛra bwa. Anomanta, nɛra baa soɡe le la ta chɛ kɛ ba so ba ɡbaɡba soɡa kpa. Bá so tɛ naate waa sewa tɛɛ ba asɛ Korowii iru seo ta la.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Anomanta, fini habɔɔ, yaa nɛra nyiŋi ɡɛ nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ nyiŋ ba la. Ya fa dɛ nyiŋi Yeesu Kristo ɡba ɡɛ, kɛ yaa on ɡɛ nyiŋi kpa.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa o ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la, o berɛ nɛnfale. O ɡel o webena o fa aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ charɛ dafale.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ɛ a bwa. Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ o che, dɛ kwaa ya ne o baah ya ne o pɛ, dɛ tɛ yaa toma nɔ ŋɔ yá nyin nɛra dɛɛ tɛo, ásɛ ba ne o baah kwaa bá won pɛ.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Korowii cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ kwaa o ne nɛwɛnyina baah, dɛ laɡ ba dɛɛ pɛl o te, waa wola ba wechɔɡa nyiŋi. Yanee o kpɔ o waa tɛ ŋɔ yá baɡle ɡɛ waa kwaa o ne ba baah, dɛ́ laɡ ba ásɛ o ne ba pɛ.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Taraken nɔ, Yeesu Kristoo tomɛ yaa ŋɔ yá bol waa dɛɛ tɛo la. A kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii cheɡɛ ya nɛɛ dɛɛ bol waa nɛra be la. Ya cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo naa ta dɛɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ, hé ɡel he ne Korowii baah kwaa he pɛ.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ya ne Korowii bwa aa pɛa dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ, ya dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ Korowii aa na he sum dɛ cha heyaa nɔ, he bɛ ɡel a ɛ pɛɛ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, “Saŋ aa tela kɛŋɔ ń na he sum la, n no he be. N ta he chae vɛɛh a ɡɛ saŋ, n lɛ heya.” Hé no! Tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ he no Korowii be ó na he sum. Finii he lɛɛ tɔpere. Wekpeɡa aa pu Pɔɔl

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Yaa nyin kɛ nomɛlbwa dɔ ya toma wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɛ bol, anomanta, waa aa ɡel nɛra lɔ naa la, yaa an kpɔe dɛɛ ɛɛ ba.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ ɛ ya wobɛlbwa ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ nɛra Korowii aa tom ba ɛɛ ɛ. Wekpeɡa dɛ pu yaa, ya lawɛ bambile dɛɛ so a ne. Ya dɛ na bambiwɔrɔbe wa, a won yaa hiaih kohona. Ya dɛ na sibeɡrewaa ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ lɔɔ yaa, dɛɛ do yaa deene, dɛ lɛ ɡaeh ya nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ yaa saɡasaɡa. Ya dɛ ɛ tomkpeɡa dɛɛ koh. Tɔpebɛl yaa dom dɔe dɛɛ chɔ. Tɔpebɛl yaa kondikwaa dɔe dɛɛ di.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: Ya cheɡɛ ya ɡoroŋ yaa doa la ta, ne Yeesu Kristo ŋwɛnɛ la waa yaa jema, ne bambile yaa dɔa, ne ya tesom ta dɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii bonɔɔnaa yan. Ya cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la yaa dɔa, ne ɡɛ yaa nyin nɛra tea bwa ne,

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: ne kasinteŋ bola ta, ne Korowii kpeɡri waa kpɔa cha yaa ta, dɛɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii bonɔɔnaa yan. Waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi laanee ya dɔmkwa. A nee yaa yo diɡ ne ɡal ne, a nee yaa tɔ ya te ɡbemɡbe.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Bane dɛ pena yaa, bane ɛɛ yoo yaa. Bane dɛ chɛɡre yaa, bane ɛɛ kpɛɛ yaa. Ba dɛ yerɛ yaa nyosonteŋna, kɛ kasinteŋ ɡee yaa bol.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: Baa yaa komɛlbwa yerɛ, kɛ nɛra bwa ɡe jemɛ yaa. A fe chɛ kɛ ya sewɛ, kɛ yan soɡe le la. Ba ɛ yaa hɔhɔrɔwa, kɛ ba ta yaa kpoe.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ ɛ yaa tebinichɔɡ wa, kɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ ya lɔ silɛɛ ta. Ya ɛ nyaara, kɛ ya won nɛra chae kohona. Ya ta komɛlbwa dɔe, kɛ yan ɡee komɛlbwa.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Yabala Kɔrent tena, bambile bwa nee ya bol waa he be. Ya dɛ nyin he waa taeh.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Ya laa wola heyaa nyin, heyaa wola yaa nyin. Ya waa toole he bambile ta.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: N dɛ bol waa nɔ dɛɛ baɡle heyaa kɛŋɔ n ne n bii ken. Ya dɛ nyin heya, anomanta, hé ɡe ta tea dɛɛ nyin yaa! Korowii nɛra ne voɡtoroma bɛ pɛɛ wa

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel he ne nɛra baa wola Korowii waa lɛɛ la pɛ dɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛ darame bɛlbwa toole wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa baah. Ɛrɛɛ bochaah ne biro ɛɛ ba wona pɛ a maɡre ɔ?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo ne Bɔnsam ɛɛ wonoo pɛ a maɡre aa? Nɛra baa yarada Yeesu Kristo ne banɔ la baa wola on yaradae aa won pɛ a maɡre!

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Voɡa ɛɛ wonoo che Korowii Dea a maɡre aa? Ya bwadabii nɔɔ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la dea. Anee Korowii ɡbabir bol la. O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ba so n nɛra bee, dɛ́ do ba baah, dɛ́ ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Anomanta, n bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Hé le ba bini! Hé pere he te le ba nɛɛ kwara! He bɛ komɛlbwa waa kah doŋa leɡe, ásɛ n lɛ heya,

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: dɛ́ ɛ he Mɛɛ, ásɛ he ɛ n bii.’ Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡa, yanee Korowii baɡɛ a ɡɛ nyoa nɔ bwa. Anomanta, hé ɡel ya do kaih. Yá laa ya bwadabii ne ya bambile kpɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ta. Hé ɡel ya swɛɛ siwi dɛ do ɡoroŋ, ɔma yaa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii nomanta. Pɔɔl silɛɛ wa

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ he bambile tɛ yaa dɛɛ no ya wa. Ya ta he bɛlbwa wechɔɡa ɛɛ. Ya ta bɛlbwa chɔɡɛ, ya ta bɛlbwa neɡrɛ di ɡe bwa.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Waa maa bola nɔ, pwaeh laa mɛɛ pwah heya. Anee n faa bol la, ya dɛ nyin heyaa taeh. Seo taa yoo, bokpeɡa taa yoo, ya ne heyaa.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: He waa dɔ kasinteŋ n be. He ɡelɔ n baŋa ɛɛ pa taeh. Ya wenaale yaa dɛ na bwa habɔɔ la, n bwara ta hwaeh. N sie ta dɛ lɛ taeh.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Yaa ba Makidoonia harɛ ta habɔɔ kwaraa la, ya bwara ta yaa sɔɔhnɛ. Bobɛlbwa yaa kpɔ la, ya ne wahalaa. Dɛ yoi laa nɛra ɛɛ yo yaa kwara naa, dɛ ya ne bambiwɔrɔbaa.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii aa dɛ larawe tebinichɔɡ te bwara la nomanta, Taetos bala la ɡelɔ ya dɔ bɔlarawa.

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: O bala la ɡbo laa larawe ya bwara. O baa baɡle ɡɛ waa baa na heyaa o ɡbabir bambile sɔɔhno he wa. O bolɔ ŋɔ n waa dɛ ɛ heya, dɛ ŋɔ waa n fa aa bola la ɡelɔ he tea bini chɔɡ. O baɡle ɡɛ haa cheɡɛ n habɔɔ dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛ mɛ. Anomanta, name kwaraa n sie lɛ kohona.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: N fa aa chwerɛ heyaa tɔn he tea bini chɔɡ la, a we n nɛ. Kɛ aa berɛ dɛɛ we n nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he tea bini ta chɔɡɛ la sie.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken te n sie lɛo. He tea bini aa chɔɡa waa laa n sie lɛ. He tebinichɔɡ la aa ɡela he charɛ da la, a waa n sie lɛ. Gɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ nyin kɛ nɛwɛnyini tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡ. Anomanta, ya ta heyaa wechɔɡe bɛlbwa ɛɛ.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini tea bini chɔɡɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin kɛ wɛɛ ɛ aa, a ɡelɔ wɛɛ charɛ o liire. A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛɛ ba Korowii mkpa ne. Anomanta, a ta chɛ kɛ ya ɡel ya tea bini chɔɡ a ta. Kɛ harɛ bonɔ tebinichɔɡ te, seo nee aa ba.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Maa chwerɛ heyaa tɔn la la, a ta ɛɛ kɛ naate waa ɛ o dɔŋ wechɔɡa, kɛɛ naate o dɔŋ aa ɛo wechɔɡa waa n chwerɔ. Korowii ɡba nao kɛ n chwerɔ ásɛ he won jemɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin yaa.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Anee larawe ya bwara. A ɡbo laa. Yaa na ɡɛ haa cha Taetos o dɔ silɛɛ la, a ɡelɔ ya sie lɛ.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: N fa bol he waa Taetos be, dɛ kpɛɛ heya. He ta ɡelɛ sihiih kpo mɛ. Waa yaa bol he be la bwa ɛ kasinteŋ. Gɛɛ waa yaa bol Taetos be dɛ kpɛɛ heyaa la bwa ɛ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: O lii ɡɛ he bwa fa aa dɛ no o waa ne ɡɛ he fa aa dɛ tɛo duure dɛɛ ɛ yalayala la aa, dɛ o nyina waa dɛ nyin heyaa la, dɛ jae a na dɛɛ ja.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: N sie lɛo kohona kɛŋɔ maa dɔ heyaa dɛ won kpɔ hwɛɡa do he nɛɛ wobɛlbwa ta nɔ.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa sune Makidoonia asɔre tena nɛɛ dɛ cha ba ba dɔ bonya kohona.

english_verse: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
translation_verse: Ba na wahala kɛrɛdɛ. A lole kɛ nyaaraa ban kohona, kɛ ba sie aa lɛ Yeesu lɛɛ waa lɛɛ ba la ta kohona nomanta, ba wono ta suuɡa kohona asɛ ba kpɔ cha nɛra.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ ba ta tea tɛ yaa kwaa ɡɛ ba bokpeɡa aa tela, hale ba tɛo ɡwaa ba bokpeɡa del kwara. Ba ɡbaɡba tetooraa ba ɛ ɡɛ, nɛn laa do ba.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Ba ɡbaɡbaa soŋe yaa sibeɡra ne ŋɔ yá ɡel ba ja Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la nɛ.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: Ba ɛ waa dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ ya te fe aa dɛ lii. Ba tɔ sie kpɔ ba te do N Naa Korowii nɔn ta, mɔɔ dɛ kpɔ ba te do ya ɡe nɔn ta ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya ŋɔ Taetos be ŋɔ tondɛɛɡa nɔ soo waa pa a mun la, ó den ba choŋi a ta, ásɛ dɛ cha heyaa he ɛ wedɛɛɡa haa dɛ ɛ kwaa kɛɛ bɔr la ka tonɛ.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɛ waa Yeesu waa bwa ta, yarada ta, waa bola ta, wejema ta, ne nyina haa dɛ nyin nɛra chae ta, ne nyina haa dɛ nyin yaa la ta. Anomanta, ya dɛ nyin kɛ hɛɛ ɛ waa kwaa kɛɛ ɡe ta.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: N ta bolɛ dɛɛ bil a ɛ lao kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ kɛ. N dɛ nyin n jemɛ kɛŋɔ he nɛnnyin la ɛ nɛnnyin kasinteŋ. A waa n baɡle ɡɛ bane siwi aa swɛɛ kwaa kɛɛ ta la.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Kɛ he na ɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa sune ya nɛɛ dɛ cha yaa kenɛ? He nao kɛŋɔ o fa dɔ kwaa nɔ bwa, dɛ koh he waa dɛ berɛ nya, ásɛ a che o nyae ta he berɛ dɔɔhna.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Gɛ n te aa naa kɛŋɔ hé den tonɛ waa haa pa a mun bena ken la. Heyaa tɔ sie dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he dɛ nyin nɛra chae.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛ tonɛ warane. Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛ tonɛ ɡɛ haa vɔrɔwa la. Hé tɛ anɔ la haa dɔa.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Dɛ he bambile lawɔ kɛ hɛɛ tɛ suuɡaa yaa, ɡɛ bwa haa dɔa dɛ tɛ la, aa su Korowii siwii. Waa ŋɔ hé tɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ haa dɔa.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Koeh laa n laa dɛɛ kpɔ bane nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ baa dawɛ he nɛ.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Haa dɔa kohona taraken nɔ, a wer kɛŋɔ he cha banɔ la aa kpeɡa tɛɛ ba. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, a baa do kpeɡri tɛ heyaa asɛ ba ɡe dɔ aa, baa cha heyaa. Dɛ he bwa kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la. “Naate waa pa kondikwaa kohona la, kondikwaa ta o nɛɛ ɡwaalɛ. Naate waa wola kondikwaa pae kohona la, o ta kondikwaa nyae.” Taetos toma bwɛjen Kɔrent

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ jam Korowii kohona kɛŋɔ waa ɡela Taetos siwi swɛɛ wɛɛ cha heyaa kɛŋɔ ya siwi aa swɛɛ he nɛɛ la.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: Waa yaa ŋɔa Táetos ɛ la, o sɛoh ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo. Dɛ o siwi swɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ o cha heya, anomanta, o tetooraa o ba he be la.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Ya dɔŋ la asɔre tena bwa aa dɛ kpɛɛro Amanesoma la bola ta la, o ne Taetosee yaa tomɛ he be la.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: A ɡbo laa, asɔre tena la bwaa leo ŋɔ ó ja ya nɛɛ ya kpɔ koŋkɛɛla nɔ kaa Jerusalam, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu dɔ sɔn. Ya dɛ ɛ toma nɔ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ ya dɛ nyin Korowii nɛra chae.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ waane ba dɔ bol dɛ́ le ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyiŋi koŋkɛɛla damanta nɔ ta.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Waa aa swɛɛ ya siwi kɛŋɔ yaa ɛ laanee waa aa toɡra. Waa aa toɡra Korowii be ɡbo laa yaa ba ɛɛ. Yaa ɛ waa aa toɡraa nɛwɛnyini ɡe be.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: A waa ya tomɛ ya dɔŋ ŋɔ ó ne ba ba la. Ya daahno na kera aŋwɛnɛ bwa, dɛ na kɛŋɔ saŋ bɛlbwa la, o siwi swɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ o cha toma nɔ. Taraken te kwaraa la, o siwi beɡrɔ kɛŋɔ ó cha heyaa kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o dɛ yarada heyaa kohona.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Taetos te la, n ne onee dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ dɛɛ cha heya. Yabala baa ja o nɛɛ la ɡe la, asɔre tenaa lee ba. Ba nɛɛ Yeesu Kristo che dɔ sɔn.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ɡel ba na ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin nɛn, ásɛ asɔre tena bwa no, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ yaa koh he waa dɛɛ maŋkura ya te la, pɛɛ laa.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: A ta hiaih kwaraa kɛŋɔ n chwerɛ heyaa chae asɔre tena aa dɛ cha Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ do Juda harɛ la wa.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he te dɛ nyin ba chae. Anomanta, n kpɔ heyaa maŋkura n te Makidoonia tena be taeh. N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Bena ken bwaa yabala baa lɔ Akaya harɛ la swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ nyin nɛra chae.” He siwi aa swɛɛra hɛɛ nyin nɛra chae la, a ɡelɔ ba kɛrɛdɛ ɡee nyin nɛra chae.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: N dɛ tomɛ yabala nɔ he be. N dɛ nyin kɛ he kpɔ he te dɛ ta suuɡa ɡɛ maa ŋɔa he dɛ ɛ la, ásɛ nɛra maa kpɔ heyaa dɛɛ maŋkura n te ba be la jemɛ kɛŋɔ pɛɛ laa mɛɛ maŋkura n te.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Makidoonia harɛ tena teŋɛ n nɛɛ ba dɛ ba na kɛŋɔ he ta he te kpɔe mɔɔ naa, dɛ sihiih ta he te kpoe yaa, sihiih ɛɛ kpo ya tenee, dɛ le ɡɛ yaa dɛ maŋkura heyaa la nomanta.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: A waa n na kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ n soŋe yabala nɔ ásɛ ba tɔ sie n nɛɛ dɛ́ ba he be, dɛ́ ba lɛ koŋkɛɛla la haa ŋɔa hɛɛ tɛo la bwa cheɡ, ásɛ ya ne bala la, dɛ a bwa chemo, ásɛ a baɡle kɛ nyinaa hɛɛ nyin dɛ tɛ, lao laa.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ he du tama aa, tamaa hɛɛ ba koma, he du kohona ɡe aa, kohonaa hɛɛ ba koma.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Anomanta, bɛ́lbwa tɛ ɡɛ aa maɡra o bambile ta. Bɛlbwa nao kɛŋɔ o tɛo aa we o nɛɛ yaa, ó ɡel tɛɛ. Bɛl dɛ lii kɛ doe ba doo ŋɔ o tɛ aa, ó ɡel, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tɛ kwaa bambile bwa ne la, Korowii sie dɛ lɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛ won tɛ heyaa kwaa a ɡwaa ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin, ásɛ he dɔ kohona saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ won kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa kohona.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la. “Waa nɔn nyore, o dɛ tɛ nyaara tɛɛ tenten. O wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta jaɡa dɔe.”

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyina kondwee baa du, dɛɛ tɛ kondikwa. On dɛ tɛ heyaa kondwee haa dɛ nyin bwa, dɛ́ ɡel a le dɛ́ nɔnɛ kohona, dɛ́ ɡel he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ɡe won dɛɛ ja.

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ́ won ta tea dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ nɛra warɛ pirim dɛ́ jam Korowii he koŋkɛɛla la yaa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la wa.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya kpɔ he koŋkɛɛla nɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra aa hiah ba aa, dɛ chae ɡbo laa hɛɛ cha ba. Dɛ a cheɡɛ a ta nɛra kpɔ silɛɛ ɡee jam Korowii kohona.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: He we-ɛɛla nɔ ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra na he yarada haa dɔa, dɛ́ jam Korowii a wa. Baa jam Korowiirii kɛŋɔ haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la haa ŋɔa he yaradaa la ta. Nɛra ɛɛ jam Korowiirii kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa wola heyaa doe, asɛ he ɡbaɡba ta tea dɛ tɛ ba ne nomɛlbwa kwaa haa dɔa nɔ.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: He waa ɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ nɛra laanee, ásɛ ba dɛ soŋe Korowii aa, ba soŋe dɛɛ tɛ heya, he bonya Korowii aa ɡela he dɔ la nomanta.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Ya dɛ jam Korowii kohona. Yaa won jemɛ baɡle o koŋkɛɛle damanta waa kɛ yaa la wa.

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl, n dɛ soŋe heya. Ba ŋɔ n lɔ he be naa, n pwɛre, kɛ n le he be te naa, n waa kpeɡri. N dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ hé nyiŋi ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa pwɛra o tea do som la,

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ no n be. Mɛɛ baɡle kpeɡri nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ harɛ bonɔ waa ŋwɛnɛre taa ya teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ ya waa la nɛɛ. Maa nyin kɛ n baɡle a ɡɛ kpeɡri la he nɛ.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ harɛ bonɔɔ ya so. Kɛ harɛ bonɔ laa laa yaa yo.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Dɔmkwaa yaa dɛ yo a ne la, nɛwɛnyina kwaa laa. A ɛ Korowii dɔmkwaa o kpeɡri aa lɔ a ta, asɛ ya kpɔ dɛɛ paɡre dekpeɡa.

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: N kpɔ n te dɛ so dɛɛ kpa, ásɛ he te dɔɔ ba no n be ka tonaa, n tɛr nɛra baa vɛah la deŋne.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Haa waa kari kɛɛ? Nomɛlbwa dɛ lii kɛ o ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛn aa, ó jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ waa ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛn la, ɡɛɛ ya ɡe ɛ Yeesu nɛra.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɛ maŋkura kpeɡri ya Dɔɔ aa tɛ yaa ŋɔ yá kpɔ dɛɛ cha heyaa la aa, sihiih aa men kpo. O tɛ mɛ kpeɡri ń won cha heya. O ta men kpeɡri tɛɛ ń kpɔ chɔɡ heya.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: Maa nyin kɛ a ɛ kɛŋɔ aahraa n kpɔ tɔne dɛɛ aah heya.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Bane ɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Pɔɔl tɔne nyoa kpeɡri to. Kɛ he na o ɡbaɡba aa, waa kpeɡe. O wobol ɡba ta wale dɔe.”

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ tena nɔ, a chɛ kɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya toole he be naa, waa yaa chwera dɛɛ ha heyaa ta korɛ, asɛ waa yaa lɔ he be dɛɛ ɛ ɡe korɛ.

english_verse: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
translation_verse: Yanee bamewa ya kpɔ ya te maɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ lii ba te nɛnjena ɔ? Yaa ya nyu kpɔe dɛɛ bɔ ba. Ba yon nyiŋi ba bala we-ɛɛla dɛ kpɔ maɡɛ ba kwaa dɛ ŋɔ ba kwaa toɡrɔ. Ba ɡɛnɔ te!

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Waa aa wola toole anɔ la Korowii aa ɡela yaa ɛ ta la, ya te aa anee kpɔ maŋkura ya te. Anɔ la bwa waa maɡa tɛ yaa la, a ɡbo taa yaa ba ya te maŋkurae. Toma yaa dɛ ɛ he be la ɡba ja anɔ la waa tɛ yaa la ta.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: He be bala ja ya toma ta. Yaa ba he be la, dɛ ya ta ɛɛ ka ɡarɛ. Yaa kpɔ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la ba he be la, dɛ ya ta ɛɛ ka ɡarɛ ya toma jaɡa.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Yaa nyin kɛ ya ɡarɛ bela Korowii aa maɡa tɛ yaa. Toma yaa ɛa la, anee ya kpɔ dɛɛ maŋkura ya te. Toma nɛra bane aa ɛa la, yaa an kpɔe dɛɛ maŋkura ya te. Ya dɔ hwɛɡa kɛ he yarada ɛɛ kaa siee, ásɛ toma yaa dɛ ɛ he bini la ɛɛ ja dɛ kaa sie.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: A taa yaa ba wona bol Amanesoma la harɛre aa lɔ sie la ta, ásɛ dɛ bɛ waa nɛra bane aa ɛa kpɔ maŋkura ya te.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la. “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o te maŋkurae la, wɛɛ maŋkura o te waa Korowii aa ɛa ta.”

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Naate waa dɛ kpɛɛ o te la, o laa nɛndɛɛɡe. Naate Korowii aa dɛ kpɛɛro la, onee nɛndɛɛɡe.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin he lawɛ bambile dɛ́ no n ɡɛnewaa nɔ tama. Soŋaa mɛɛ soŋe heya.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Kɛ n dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ Bɔnsam bɛ bɔr ba dɔ che dɛ́ berɛ he liire, ásɛ he bɛ Yeesu Kristo dɛɛ nyin tepoŋ ne kpa, kɛŋɔ waa berɛ harɛkon dɛ kpɔ nyosone neɡre Hawa la.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Kɛ he dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛɛ no nɛra baa ba he be dɛ baa baɡle Yeesu waa a korɛ waa ya fa aa baɡle heyaa la ta nɔ? Kɛ ba dɛ baɡle kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ waa a korɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa soɡe he nɛɛ la ta, kɛɛ ba dɛ baɡle heyaa amanesoma a korɛ anɔ la ya fa aa baɡle heyaa la ta naa, he dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛɛ no ba be nɔ?

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Maa lii kɛ nɛra baa dɛ maŋkura ba te kɛ ba ɡwaa Yeesu Kristo toroma la ɡwaa mɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Bɛl lole n nyoa ken ta chaahnɛ wobol ta, kɛ wejema te, n dɔɔ. Wobɛlbwa yaa jema ɡe la, ya ɡelɔ a bini chaah he jemɛ a bwa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: N fa aa baɡle heyaa Korowii Amanesoma la, n ta heyaa komɛlbwa sese lɛɛ. Maa pwɛr n te ɡɛ asɛ nɛra siwi ɛɛ su heyaa la, dɛ wechɔɡaa n ɛ aa?

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ maa lɔ he be la, suuɡa waa hiah mɛ naa, maa n te kpɔe dɛɛ dawɛ he nɛ. Yabala baa le Makidoonia harɛ ba laanee baa tɛ mɛ kwaa maa dɛ nyin bwa. Gɛ n fa aa wola n te kpɔe dawɛ he nɛɛ wubwa la, ɡɛɛ maa wola n tenee kpɔ dawɛ he nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: N cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo kasinteŋ la waa ɡela n dɔ la ta dɛɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa toole Akaya harɛ bobɛlbwa dɛ́ tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa wola won maŋkura n te a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ ŋɔ ken nɔ, a ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ maa heyaa nyin. Korowii ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin heya.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Waa maa dɛ ɛ nɔ, maa a ɛɛ ɡela ba. Mɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛɛ, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ maŋkura ba te ŋɔ tombeŋkpoŋii ya ne baa ɛ la bɛ won dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ maŋkura ba te.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛra la, Yeesu Kristo toroma ɡbaɡba laa ban. Neɡraa baa neɡre nɛra, dɛ ɛ ba te kɛ Yeesu Kristo toromaa ban la.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: A ta nyokpowaa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ Bɔnsam ɡbabir won o te beɡra dɛ do kɛ Korowii nyundua torome tenten ken.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ Bɔnsam bonɔɔna ɡe beɡre ba te kɛŋɔ, banee dɛɛ chaɡle ŋwɛnɛ yaa kpɔ o ta dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi aa, dɛ a ta nyokpowaa ɛɛ. Korowii ɛɛ bɔ ba kemee ɡɛ ba toma aa doa. Pɔɔl dɛ maŋkura o te kɛ o ɛ Yeesu torome

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: N dɛ ŋɔ he be ja. Nomɛlbwa bɛ lii kɛŋɔ ɡɛnee men. N ɡɛnɔ ɡba kwara naa, hɛ́ɛ no n be ásɛ n ɡe won maŋkura n te tama.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛ waa maa dɛ bol taraken nɔ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu laa ŋɔa ń bola. Maŋkurae nɔ maa dɛ maŋkura n te nɔ, ɡɛnewaa mɛɛ ɛ la.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Bane aa koh harɛ bonɔ kwara waa dɛɛ maŋkura ba te nomanta, n ɡee maŋkura n tenee.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Haa jemɛ waa kohona nomanta, he dɛ lawɛ bambile, dɛ kpɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ no ɡɛna be.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Nɛra kpɔ heyaa berɛ yoma, dɛ neɡre heyaa dɛɛ di, dɛɛ faah heya, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyu baahna, dɛɛ kpaa he lwɛrɛme, kɛ he waane laa.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: A dɛ ɛɛ mɛ sihiih kɛ n bol waa nɔ. N ta jemɛ kɛ ya berɔ do pwɛre tɛ heyaa to. Ya ta an kɛrɛdɛ ɛɛ. Dɛ nomɛl dɔ wobɛl dɛ won koh a waa maŋkura o te naa, n ɡba ɛɛ wonoo maŋkura n te a ɡɛ waa la ta. Gɛnewaa mɛɛ bol nɔ te.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Dɛ Hibru tenaa ban aa, bɛlee n ɡe. Israel tena ɡee ban aa, bɛlee n ɡba. Abraham naanaree ban aa, bɛlee n ɡe.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔnaa ban kɛɛ? N dɛ bol choɡla wobol te, kɛ dɛ ba ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔna aa, n ɛ o bonɔɔ ɡwaa ba! N ɛ toma ɡwaa ba. Ba do mɛ dea ɡwaa ba, dɛ cha mɛ chweremi ɡwaa ba. Waa maa naa a yon ka jɛɛ n sewɛ warɔ.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Kera anue bwaa Juu tena cha mɛ ba chweremi fifraatoro dɛ anuanaarɛ la.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Kera atoroo Rom tena lɔɔ mɛ chweremi ne, dɛ foɡ mɛ bwea kera beŋkpoŋ. Kera atoroo stiimae morɛ n ne. N lɔ nee siebɔr bir dɛ chaah, dɛ kwaa bir a ɡɛ stiimae mora nɔ bɛl ta.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: N ɡaaɡebala nɔ ta la, neerare suuɡo dɛ tɔ mɛ do, n do siswɛm ta ka, asɛ ŋwɛɛra baa dɛ kpo nɛra dɛɛ kpɔ ba laala ɡe fe ɛɛ nyin n kpoe. N bala Juu tena ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bwa ɡe cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin n kpoe. Bwɛjena ta ne kpɔɡ baah ne mpo ta bwaa n na sibeɡrewa. N na sibeɡrewaa nɛra baa wola asɔre tena kpelakpela ɛɛ be.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: N ɛ toma dɛ koh kɛrɛdɛ. A kɛrɛdɛ ta, dɛ maa dom chɔ. Lɔr ne nyɔɡre ɡe kpo mɛ kɛrɛdɛ. N vala kɛrɛdɛ ta, dɛ teloɡaa mɛɛ chɔ, dɛ busee mɛɛ chɔ, dɛɛ chɔ waa.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Asɔre tena la bɛlbwa sɔɔhnaa, dɛ n ɡbabir bwara yɔrɔ. Dɛ Bɔnsam neɡre bɛlbwa kaa wechɔɡa ta naa, dɛ a ɛɛ mɛ bandia.

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Dɛ mɛɛ maŋkura n tenee yaa, waa aa dɛ chaɡle kɛ n ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre la taa mɛɛ ba n te maŋkurae.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Mɛɛ Korowii jemɔ kɛ nyosone laa mɛɛ teŋe. O chɛ kpɛɛra saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Maa lɔ bwɛjen Damaskɔs la, bwɛɛ la nomoa waa lɔ Kooro Aretas lɔɡa le nɛra ŋɔ báa daah doonyoone aa lɔ danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛɛ la bwa cheme ta la, ásɛ dɛ laɡ mɛ.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ n maŋkura n te. N jemɔ kɛ aa wobɛlbwa kwaa te. Mɛɛ baɡle chaahna Korowii aa ɡela n na, ne waa waa pila baɡ mɛ.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: N tooro tenaa nɔ maa kpɔ n te dɛɛ ba he be bala dɛ́ ba chɔɔ heya. Maa heyaa komɛlbwa bɔɔra ba. He waa hiah mɛ, he suuɡa laa hiah mɛ. Bechale ne ba mɛɛ, umee dɛɛ nyiŋi o dɔŋ ɔ?

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛ ba lawɔ kaa nyundua, kɛ anee n bol la, o nɛndaa ɡbabirii kaa bela oo, dɛ o lileo ɡboo kaa bela oo, Korowii ɡboo jema.

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: Korowii la o ne o be, o ka no waane nɛwɛnyini aa wola won bola. Korowii ta ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛ nɛwɛnyini bola.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: N ŋɔ n maŋkura n te naa, ɡɛ nɛn nɔɔ mɛɛ ba kpɔe maŋkura n te. Maa n ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛlaa kpɔ maŋkura n te, nemenɛ n nɛŋɡwɛɡre ɛɛ ɡbo ta.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Dɛ n ŋɔ ń kpɔ n ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla maŋkura n te kwaraa naa, ɡɛnewaa laa te, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɛ kasinteŋ. Menee ɡɛ nɛn la, kɛ maa nyin n kpɔ ɡɛ waa la maŋkura n te. Dɛ n waa maa dɛ ɛ nɛra ɛɛ na, ne anɔ la baa dɛ no ta laa aa, maa nyin kɛ nɛra kpɛɛ mɛ wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Korowii aa nyin kɛ n kpɔ wejena maa naa chaahna ta la dɛɛ maŋkura n te. Anomanta, o ɡelɔ Bɔnsam kpɔ waane do n nɛɛ aa ha mɛ, dɛɛ tɔɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ sɔɔh, n bɛ won dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Kera atoro bwaa n soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ o laa a ɡɛ waa nɔ kpɔ n nɛ,

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: asɛ o ŋɔ, “Chae maa sune he nɛɛ dɛ chae nɔ ɡbo maɡre he ne. Bela nɛn aa ɡwɛɡra la, belaa baa na n kpeɡri kohona.” Anomanta, a do n som kohona kɛ maa dɛ maŋkura n te n ɡwɛɡra ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a taa mɛɛ na Yeesu Kristo kpeɡri n nɛ.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: N sie dɛ lɛ n ɡwɛɡra maa ɡwɛɡra, ne chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, ne kpeɡri bɔr yon do tɛ mɛ, ne cheɡa nɛra aa cheɡɛ n nɛ, ne ɡɛ maa koh Yeesu Kristo waa aa noo mɛ bwa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ maa ɡwɛɡre la, a taa mɛɛ do kpeɡri. Gɛ Pɔɔl siwi aa swɛɛ Kɔrent tena nɛ

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: N bol waa kɛ ɡɛne, kɛ heyaa ɡela n ɛ ɡɛ. Heyaa chɛ kɛ hé fe ɛɛ tɛ mɛ sɔn. A lole kɛ n waa aa bobɛlbwa tel te, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ maŋkura ba te ɡwaa Yeesu Kristo toroma la, ba bɛlbwa ta men ɡwaalɛ wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: N fa aa lɔ he be la, n lawɛ bambile kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa aa chaɡla kɛŋɔ Yeesu toroma la bɛlee men. Wekpeɡa ne nyokpowaa bwaa n ɛ.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa n ɛ tɛ asɔre tena baa kaa la maa wola ɛɛ tɛ heya ɔ? Anɔ la maa wola heyaa ɛɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, n ta heyaa hae suuɡa waa ta. Hé kpɔ n wechɔɡa kɛ mɛ!

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: N sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ n chɔɡ n komɛlbwa he nɛ. N chɔɡ n bokpeɡa he nɛɛ kwara dɛ won cha heya aa, a som n be. Maa dɛ nyin heyaa kohona waa he te laa n waa kpɔ he bambile ta kɛɛ?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: He nao kɛŋɔ n ta n te kpɔe dawɛ he nɛɛ kenɛ? Kɛ nomɛl ɡee ŋɔɔ n sie pilo to mɛɛ neɡre heya.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Nɛra n fa aa tom ba he be la, n cheɡɛ ba bini bane nɛɛ dɛ neɡre heyaa di aa?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Men soŋe Taetos dɛ tomɛ o ne ya dɔŋ asɔre te la he be. Hɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ Taetos baa neɡre heyaa di aa? Dabeŋkpoŋ laa n ne o kpoŋaa? Ya bwa we-ɛɛla ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ yaa?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Yaa dɛ ŋɔ ken nɔ, he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ya sɔnee yaa kwaa he be kɛɛ? Akai! Korowii siee yaa bola, pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la nomanta. Yabala, wobɛlbwa yaa bol la, he wer waa yaa bola, ásɛ he won che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: N dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ n balaa, ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin kɛ he do la, maa heyaa ɡɛɛ na, ɡɛ he ɡe aa dɛ nyin kɛ n do la, haa men ɡɛɛ na. N dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛɛ ba na naɡra, ne bɔweela, ne bandisale, ne n ɡbo dɔ, ne dɔŋa chɛɡra, ne dɔŋa ŋwala, ne mbarafo dɛ wesaɡasaɡare ɛɛ he baahnee.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: Maa nyin kɛ ń ba ba he be ásɛ N Naa Korowii koh he wechɔɡa waa dɛ́ ɡel n fɛɡre. N balɔ dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ta warɛ he bini, ba tea bini ta chɔɡɛ ba charɛ ba liire ba wedoŋa, ne ba jwamane, ne ba pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla baa dɛɛ ɛ ta naa, n tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡoo.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
