translation_verse: N tooro tenaa nɔ maa dɛ ba ń ba chɔɔ heya. N balaa, wobɛlbwa nɛra banɛ kɛɛ nɛra batoro aa di danseɛ a ta la, anee mɛɛ ba noe kɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ, ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡla la.

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin n ŋɔ he banɔ la he fa aa ɛ wechɔɡa la, ne banɔ la baa kaa la be ŋɔ, n balɔ dɛ he ta ɡelaa, maa he ɡela ba, mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee. N fa aa ba he be nɛɛtena la, n bolɔ, n kwaarɔ dɛɛ bol.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: He fa dɛ nyin he na waane dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristoo soɡe n nɛɛ dɛɛ bol waa la. Too, hɛɛ nao. Kpeɡri ta on nyae. Wɛɛ baɡle o kpeɡri he nɛɛ.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Ba fa aa kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta o sewɛ la, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ o ɡwɛɡrɔ, kɛ Korowii kpeɡri nomanta, o iro. Ya ne o bwa fa pɛo ɡwɛɡre. Kɛ taraken, ya cheɡɛ Korowii kpeɡri ta dɛ dɔ mkpa, asɛ ya won do he be o kpeɡri la ta.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi he te dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ he yaradao kɛrɛdɛ kɛɛ he ta on yaradae yɔ? Hé pese he te dɛ́ na. He jemɛ kɛŋɔ he ne Yeesu Kristo pɛo kɛɛ? He nao kɛŋɔ he ne o ta pɛɛ te naa, ate dɛ he horɛ o waa yaradae ta.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: N dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he nyiŋi yaa na naa, hɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ yaa o waa yaradae ta horɛ.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Kɛ, ya dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ he bɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ ɛ. Nɛra nao kɛŋɔ ya ta horaa, a wer, kɛ a laa hiah. Waa aa hiah kɛŋɔ hé ɛ waa aa wera. Dɛ a ɡelɔ a do kɛŋɔ ya te horaa, a ta waane ɛɛ.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Yaa won ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ́ jo kasinteŋ la nɛ, chae a chɛ kɛ yaa chao.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Ya ɡwɛɡrɔ hé do kpeɡri aa, dɛ ya sie lɛo. Ya dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ he waa toɡre ka tonɛ.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: A waa n chwerɛ heyaa tɔn nɔ dɛ n ta he be balɛ mɔɔ la. N dɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ dɛ bɛ sinyɛɡa ba kpɔ dɛɛ bol waa he be kpeɡri ya Dɔɔ la aa tɛ mɛ la ne. Korowii ŋɔ ń kpɔ a ɡɛ kpeɡri nɔ cha heya, o ta ŋɔe ŋɔ ń kpɔ chɔɡ heya.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Too, yabala, n nyoa jaɡɛ bonɔ. Hé so kɛrɛdɛ. Hé swɛɛ siwi kɛ hɛɛ ɡeloo he wobɛlbwa toɡre ka tonɛ. Hé no n waa maa bola dɛ kpɔ ja heyaa la. Hé ɡel he nyoa pɛ, he bɛ dɛɛ yo. Korowii waa dɛ nyin nɛwɛnyini kohona dɛɛ tɛ bosɔɔhna la, ó cha heya.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nyabii.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ ɛ N Naa Korowii tetoowa kɛŋɔ, waa koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ sewɛ, dɛ lɛ yaa le taraken nɛra baa dɔ liichɔɡa bini nɔ.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Korowii chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ jirima tɛo saŋ te bɛlbwa. Aamen. Yeesu Kristo amanesoma bwa lɔ beŋkpoŋ

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: He waa ɛɛ mɛ anebɛlbwa. Korowiirii le heya. Yeesu Kristo aa sune he nɛɛ dɛ lɛ heyaa la waa Korowii le heya. Kɛ he deno dɛɛ vɛh Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la dɛɛ teŋɛ wefale ta.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma bɛlbwa toole, dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ, dɛ ja anɔ la yaa dɛ baɡle heyaa la ta. Nɛra bane dɛ wili heya, dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ berɛ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la, a waa n ŋɔ ɡɛ la.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya bini bɛl kɛɛ Korowii nyundua torome le nyundua dɛ ba bol Yeesu Kristo bwara wobɛlbwa a berɛ korɛ anɔ la yaa dɛ baɡle heyaa la ta naa, Kórowii fuuh!

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Gɛ ya fa aa bola la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ bol he be ja la. Dɛ nomɛlbwa bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma bɛlbwa a korɛ anɔ la he fa aa noa dɛ yarada la ta naa, Kórowii fuuh!

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Maa ŋɔ ken nɔ, dɛ nɛwɛnyini bee mɛɛ nyin sɔn kɛɛ Korowii be nɔ? Maa sɔn nyin nɛwɛnyini be, Korowii bee mɛɛ nyin sɔn. Dɛ nɛwɛnyini bee mɛɛ nyin sɔn te naa, n fe ta Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ ɛɛ. Gɛ Pɔɔl aa baa ɛ Yeesu torome

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé ɡel n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma nɔ maa dɛ bol he be nɔ, nɛwɛnyini be laa a le.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini laa tɛ mɛ ɡɛ wejema nɔ. Nɛwɛnyini laa baɡ mɛ. Yeesu Kristo ɡbaɡbaa pili a bini baɡ mɛ dɛ ɡel n jemɛ a wa.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: Dɛ n dɛ teŋɛ ya Juu tena Korowii toma ŋwɛnɛ la ta ɡwaa n nyudɔŋa baa ɛ Juu tena kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ ya Juu tena nawee waa ɡe ta ɡwaa nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: N ta Jerusalam laŋɛ dɛ ka na nɛra baa tɔ sie ɛ Yeesu toroma n nɛɛ la mɔɔ. Pae n den pa sie kaa Arab harɛ. Maa le bela la, n baa kaa Damaskɔs.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: A habɔɔ bene atoroo mɔɔ n la Pita be Jerusalam dɛ ka chɔɔro dɛ jemɔ. Maa la Pita chɔɔra la, n kaa so o be tɔpera fi dɛ anue.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋii mɛɛ chwerɛ la. Korowii ɡba jemɔ kɛ nyosone laa.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, n la Siiria harɛ ne Silisia harɛ bwɛɛre ane ta.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ Juda harɛ asɔre tena la ta men nae siwi ne mɔɔ.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Dɛ n waa nɛra aa dɛ bol la ɡboo baa no. N waa baa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, nɛn o fa aa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa laanee bera lɛ Yeesu Amanesoma ba fa aa yaradaa o koh a waa hah ba dɛɛ nyin ba kpoe la dɛɛ bol la.

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ba cheɡɛ a ta dɛ jam Korowii a wa.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ bene fi dɛ anaarɛ la, n berɔ la Jerusalam ja. N kpɔ Taetos ja n nɛ, asɛ ya ne Banabas la.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ɡela n jemɛ dɛ la ba be. N tɔ sie la asɔre tena nomonome be n ne ba ɡbo so, n baɡle Yeesu Amanesoma maa dɛ bol nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ be la bwa ásɛ ba jemɛ n wa, ásɛ n toma maa ɛa ne anɔ la n ta aa dɛ ba ɛɛ la bɛ pɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Dɛ Grik tee Taetos, anomanta, o ta pen teŋe. Kɛ nomɛlbwa ta on hɛɛ ŋɔ bá teŋe o pen.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra la bane tea bini laa ɡɛ baa ɡel Taetos la. Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ dɛ ɛ ba te kɛŋɔ asɔre tenaa ban ken dɛ sɔh jo ya bini, dɛ baa nyiŋi dɛ́ jemɛ ya asɔre tena dɔe yaa dɔ ya te Mosis Mmara aa wola yaa vɔrɔwe la bini, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo toma nomanta, ya ne o ɛ beŋkpoŋ. Dɛ ba dɛ nyin ba hɛ yaa yá berɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa yaa vɛah la.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Yaa wola nyin kɛ bá won berɛ Amanesoma la sie ásɛ kasinteŋ la do le tɛ heyaa la, ya ta ban sie tɛɛ kwaraa.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Nɛra la bini banɔ la baa dɛ lii ba nɛnjena la ta wone dɔ wobɛlbwa bol dɛ ja Amanesoma maa dɛ bol la ta. N te kwaraa waane laa ba nɛnjena ɛɛ wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa nɛnjena kɛɛ nɛnjeɡre nyiŋi.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Ba ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ Korowiirii kpɔ o waa la tɛ mɛ ŋɔ ń bol nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la be, ɡɛ waa kpɔ o waa tɛ Pita ŋɔ ó bol Juu tena be la.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡle o kpeɡri Yeesu torome Pita nɛɛ wɛɛ tomɛ Juu tena bini la, ɡɛɛ o baɡle o kpeɡri men maa ɛ Yeesu torome nɔ nɛɛ mɛɛ tomɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bini.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Jems ne Pita dɛ Jɔn nomɛlbwa aa dɛ yer ba asɔre tena nomonome la, ba ɡbabir sɛoh kɛŋɔ Korowiirii kpɔ ɡɛ toma nɔ do n nɔn ta, dɛ cha mɛ a ta. Anomanta, ba do nɔɔra n nɔn ta, dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋii ya bwa Korowii toma nɔ bini. Ya nyoa pɛo, asɛ ba sɛh kɛŋɔ n ne Banabas ɛɛ bol Yeesu waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, ásɛ ba ɡee baɡle Juu tena.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Waa baa bola ja bwaa kɛŋɔ yáa lii nyaara waa dɛ́ɛ cha ba. Dɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ waa n ɡe aa swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛa wubwa. Pɔɔl di Pita kasinteŋ

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Pita aa ba Anteɔk la, n diu kasinteŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɛ ɛ waa aa wola aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Maa naa kɛŋɔ ba nyoɡre Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la ŋwɛnɛ la, n di Pita kasinteŋ yabala la bwa siwi ta ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa a che he ɛ Juu te haa wola Juu tena nawee waa la ta teŋɛ, dɛ ŋɔ he hamɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ŋɔ báa teŋɛ a ta nɔ?

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Yaa dɛ nyin ya che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su Korowii siwi la, an ɡela ya vɛh Mmara ta teŋa dɛ berɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la. Dɛ a do ɡɛ naa, dɛ Yeesu Kristoo dɛɛ cha dɛ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ won dɛɛ kaa sie naa? Akai!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Mosis Mmara n ɡbaɡba fa aa ŋɔa o ta teŋa ta tɔnɔ dɔe la, dɛ n berɔ berɛ habɔɔ dɛ baa teŋɛ o ta naa, n ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ yaa?

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Mmara laanee pili n sie dɛ ɡel n jemɛ waa dɛ chwa o ta teŋa. Mosis Mmara la te be pera te naa, n do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa sewa. N ne Mmara la toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa, ásɛ n won do le tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Maa sɛh ɡel Korowii nɛra nɛɛ suna la ɛ pɛɛ. Dɛ Mosis Mmara ta teŋa taa a che nɛn ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su Korowii siwi aa, amɔ te dɛ pɛɛpɛɛ Yeesu Kristo sewɛ la.”

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Ee, Galaasia tena, he ɡɛnoo! Ya ta heyaa baɡlɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa Yeesu Kristo sewɛ daɡaɡre ta bwa naa? Aah bɔkwaa bera neɡre heyaa jaɔ?

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Hé ɡel n bɔɔ heyaa webeŋkpoŋ. Mosis Mmara ta teŋa taa a che he dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa, kɛɛ haa no Yeesu Kristo waa la dɛ yaradaa taa a che nɔ?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: He ɡɛnɔ ɡa! Korowii Domadɛɛɡee ɡela he won pa mun Yeesu nɛɛ teŋa ta. Ɛrɛɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he kpɔ he ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ɛ ka tonɛ nɔɔ?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Amɔ waa he sie aa naa ne anɔ la haa noa la bwa ɛ pɛɛ aa? Dɛ a ɛ pɛɛ te naa, dɛ aa were kwaraa!

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe nɔ waa tɛ heya, dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa he bini nɔ, dɛ Mosis Mmara ta teŋa waa o ɛ a bwa kɛɛ haa dɛ no o waa dɛ yaradaa la waa yɔ?

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ yarada Korowii la, banee Abraham naanar.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ yarada taa aa ba cheɡa ásɛ Korowii lɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi. Korowii fa bol Amanesoma la waa Abraham be dɛ ŋɔ, “He nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa Korowii swee nɛwɛnyina bwa andɛɛɡa.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Yaradaa Abraham yarada Korowii asɛ o swee andɛɛɡa tɛo. Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa yarada Korowii la, Korowii ɛɛ sweero andɛɛɡaa.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa kpɔ sie dawɛ Mosis Mmara ɡbo ta kɛŋɔ a taa ba che Kórowii lɛɛ ba la, bá bwɛɛlɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a lɔ Korowii Tɔn bini kɛŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa koni Mosis Mmara la bɛlbwa saŋ bɛlbwa wee la, ó bwɛɛlɛ.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo lɛ nyotaahna aa lɔ Mosis Mmara la ta bɛ won teŋa la dawɛ o nɛɛ dɛ lɛ yaa le a ta. Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa baa saɡɔ daa ta la, Korowii nyotaahna lɔ o nɛ.”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: Korowii fa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ sweero andɛɛɡaa. Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ dɔ a ɡɛ wedɛɛɡe nɔ la, a waa o lɛ nyotaahna la dawɛ o nɛɛ dɛ lɛ yaa le a ta la, ásɛ a che yarada ta Korowii tɛ yaa o Domadɛɛɡe la waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tɛ yaa la. Mosis Mmara ne Korowii nyobaɡa

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé ɡel n kpɔ harɛ bonɔ waane maɡɛ waa nɔ maa dɛ bol nɔ. Dɛ nɛra banɛ fɔwɛ fɔo o do kpeɡri aa, nɛmpɛɛ aa won puru ba habɔɔ, nomɛlbwa ɡe aa berɛ won berɔ ba habɔɔ.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn la baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii baɡɛ Abraham ne o naa nyoa. Korowii Tɔn la ta ŋɔe ŋɔ Korowii baɡɛ Abraham ne o naanar nyoa. Dɛ Abraham ne o naa. O baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Abraham naa beŋkpoŋ, onee kɛ Kristo.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Dɛ Mosis Mmara la ta teŋa taa aa ba cheɡa Korowii ɛ yaa o wedɛɛɡe la te naa, ate dɛ o nyoa waa baɡɛ Abraham la ɛ pɛɛ. Kɛ ɡɛ laa a do. Nyoa Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham la waa o sune o nɛɛ dɛ chao, dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo wedɛɛɡee la.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Aah dɛ bɔkwa waa Korowii tɛ yaa Mosis Mmara laɔ? Wechɔɡa jema waa o kpɔa ja yaa. Korowii ɛo kɛŋɔ Mmara la do le dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ Abraham naa la aa bala. Abraham naa nɔɔ Korowii baɡɛ nyoa la. Nyundua toromaa Korowii ɡel ba ba Mosis Mmara la ne ba tɛ yaa. Nɛn nɛɛ nyundua toroma la ba chiɡ dɛ kpɔ Mmara la tɛo, asɛ o ɡe kpɔ tɛ ya naanar.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa la ɡe la, o ɡbo waa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ waa ta keame hiaih.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn la baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa vɔrɔwe nɛwɛnyina bwa, ásɛ Korowii nyobaɡa waa baɡɛ yaa la ɛ nɛra baa yarada Yeesu Kristo la ɡbo kwa. Anomanta, nɛra baa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo laanee Korowii ɛɛ ba o nyobaɡa kwaa la kpɔe tɛ.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo yaradae waa nɔ aa wola balɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ Mosis Mmara la vɔrɔwe yaa kɛŋɔ nɛra baa do ba dea ken. Yeesu Kristo yaradae waa nɔɔ bala mɔɔ ya ta dɔ ya te.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Dɛ Mosis Mmara nɔɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi yaa mɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ba. Waa bala la, o yaradae taa aa ba cheɡa ásɛ ya waa su Korowii siwi, ásɛ o lɛ yaa kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo yarada waa nɔ aa tel ya be nɔ, Mosis Mmara la laa dɔ yaa kpa. Korowii bii ɛɛ

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: He ɡbabir na, haa yarada Yeesu Kristo la nomanta, he bwa ɛ Korowii bii.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: He banɔ la ba fa aa sɔ heyaa Korowii nee asɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo ɛ beŋkpoŋ la, Yeesu Kristo daa he kpɔ ɡɛ la.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Anomanta, peɡra bɛlbwa toole he baah kpa. Juu tena oo, nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ yoo, yoma oo, deheɛre oo, haahna oo, baala oo, he bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ Yeesu Kristo be pera.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛra te naa, ate Abraham naanaree heya. Kon Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa la, he ɡee dɔɔ.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: O ta ɛ bechala aa, o lɔ nɛra lɔɡa. Ban dɛɛ nyiŋi o komɛlbwa ta, dɛ ka tel tɔpere o mɛɛ aa doa la mɔɔ bá kpɔ komɛlbwa do o nɔn ta.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a fa do ya ɡba nɛ. Dɛ ya do kɛ bechale ken, asɛ koŋkwaa aa dɛ di kpeɡri harɛ bonɔ la ɛɛ di kpeɡri ya nɛ.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔpere La aa tela la, o tomɛ o ɡbaɡba Bie, asɛ nɛŋhaah lolɔ harɛ nɔ ta, asɛ o ɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara ta la bɛl.

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii aa ɛ dɛ won lɛ ya nɛra Mosis Mmara la fa aa vɔrɔwe yaa la waa o ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ won kpɔ yaa ɛ o bii.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Korowii aa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ o baɡle kɛŋɔ o biirii yaa la nomanta, o tɛ yaa o Bie la Domadɛɛɡe la o so ya nɛ, asɛ ya won dɛɛ yerɔ ‘n Mɛɛ, n Mɛɛ’, kɛŋɔ bie aa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ ɡɛ la.

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Taraken nɔ, nɛndɔɔla laa heyaa kpa, Korowii biirii heya. Haa ɛ Korowii bii la nomanta, wɛɛ tɛ heyaa kwaa waa dɛ tɛ o bii bwa laanee. Pɔɔl siwi swɛɛ Galaasia tena nɛ

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Wubwa la, dɛ haa Korowii jemɛ, anomanta, dɛ koŋkwaa aa wola Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ la ɔma vɔrɔwe heya.

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Kɛ he ta dɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara ta dɛɛ maŋkura tɔpejena ne korobie ane ne bene ane kenɛ?

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: He waa dɛ we n nɛ. Amɔ toma maa ɛa he be la bwa ɛ pɛɛ aa?

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Kɛ he dɛ lii waa aa ɡela n ba he be loɡla la dɛ ba bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la waa laɔ? Dɛ n bwara dɛ wee mɛ.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Dɛ n weela la ɡelɔ n kpoŋa do kpeɡri, kɛ he ta men haih-haih ɛɛ dɛ vɛɛh mɛ. Gɛ he fe aa lɛ nyundua torome Korowii aa tomɔ la, ɡɛɛ he lɛɛ mɛ. Gɛ he fe aa lɛ Yeesu Kristo ɡbaɡba la, ɡɛɛ he lɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: He sie fa aa lɛ n nɛɛ kohona la, taraken te bɔkwa waa bera ba nɔ? Mɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ la he fe wonaa, he fe foromi he sibie kwaraa tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Aah n kasinteŋ maa dɛ di heyaa nɔɔ ɡela n berɛ ɛ he dɔm taraken nɔ kɛɛ?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Nɛra maa bol ba waa ŋɔ ba dɛ wili heyaa la, ba swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ nyin he waa la, kɛ waa aa lɔ ba nyu bini la aa were. Ba waa baa dɛ nyin ɛɛ laanee kɛŋɔ bá pere n ne he baah, ásɛ dɛ fe berɛ he sie kaa ba be.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: N fe dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ n fe aa lɔ he be taraken, dɛ fe berɛ n nyoa. He waa ɛɛ mɛ anebɛlbwa! Heeɡa ne Saara wa

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa dɛ nyin kɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara la ta la, he ta noɛ ɡɛ Mosis Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle aa?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ bibaala banɛɛ Abraham dɔ aa? Dɛ bibaala banɛ nɔ bɛl nya ɛ yom, asɛ nɛɛte la te nya ta yom ɛɛ.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Gɛ baa ne haah naa dɛ lolɛ bie laanee Abraham ne o yomhaah la lolɛ o biloɡle la. Kɛ o binɛɛte la o nya aa wola yom ɛɛ la te, Korowiirii baɡɔ nyoa dɛ tɛo bie la.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Yaa kpɔ haahna banɛ nɔɔ maɡɛ Korowii ne nɛwɛnyini nyopɛo dɔe fɔo bele anɛ la. Ba bɛlbwa cheɡɔ tɛ fɔo la beŋkpoŋ. Heeɡa waa ɛ Abraham yomhaah la cheɡɔ tɛ fɔo la nɛwɛnyini ne Korowii aa fɔwa Sinai Bwejen ta bela Korowii aa kpɔ o Mmara la tɛ Mosis la. A ɡɛ fɔo la tenaa ɛ yoma la.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Heeɡaa cheɡa tɛ Sinai Bwejen waa lɔ Arab harɛ ta la. O tenten, on cheɡa tɛ fini Jerusalam bwɛjen nɔ o nɛra bwa aa ɛ yoma nɔ.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Haah waa wola yom ɛɛ la ɡe cheɡɔ tɛ Jerusalam la waa lɔ nyundua la. Onee ya nya nɔ,

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn la bini ŋɔ, “Hambara, ɡel he sie lɛ! Haah haa wola loltea weweele nae ka, ɡel he sie lɛ hɛɛ moo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haah la o jaa aa chwao la ɛɛ ba dɔ biirii ɡwaa onɔ la o jaa aa wola on chwae la.”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Yabala, ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa dɛ ɡel o lolɛ Aesek la, ɡɛɛ o baɡɛ nyoa ya ɡe ɛ o bii.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ Abraham bie la waa lolɔ ɡɛ baa ne haah naa dɛ lolɛ la, dɛ o cheɡɛ onɔ la Korowii aa cheɡɛ o Domadɛɛɡe nɛɛ dɛ tɛ Abraham la nɛɛ taeh. Gɛ waa nɔ ta lole fini nɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Kɛ a bwa habɔɔ la, ɛrɛɛ Korowii Tɔn la baɡle ɔ? O baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Doŋi yomhaah la ne o bie la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ yomhaah la bie la ne haah la waa wola yom ɛɛ la bie la aa won pɛ di ba mɛɛ kapɛrɛ a maɡre.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Anomanta, yabala, ya ta yomhaah bii ɛɛ. Haah waa wola yom ɛɛ la biirii yaa.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Ya di ya nyu. Yeesu Kristo foo yaa, anomanta, ya ta nɛndɔɔla ɛɛ kpa. Waa foo heyaa nɔ, hé che kiŋkiŋ. He bɛ ɡel ba kpɔ waa dɛɛ ha heyaa kpa.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa dɛ nyin he che Mosis Mmara ta teŋa ta ásɛ dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa he waa su Korowii siwi la, he pere he te le Yeesu Kristo be. He ta nɛra Korowii aa sune ba nɛɛ la nɛɛ jae.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Ya te ken nɔ, ya cheɡɛ yarada yaa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la ta dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɛɛ ɡeloo ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su Korowii siwi.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋa nɔ ta te, ba teŋe nɛn pen oo, ba ta o pen teŋoo, a laa ɛ wehiah. Waa aa hiah laanee kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo, asɛ ɡɛ yarada nɔ won ɡel wɛɛ nyin o dɔŋa.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: He fa dɛ teŋɛ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ta kɛrɛdɛ. Bɔkwaa bala haa wola berɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ la ta kpaɔ? Bɔkwaa tɔ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ɔ?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Korowii waa le heyaa he ba o be la, o be laa ɡɛ liire nɔ le.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ, “Iisi tama ken won paanoo damanta hoeh,” anomanta, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi liire aa do ken nɔ dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: N te ta dɛ yarada heya. Ya Dɔɔ la ya bwa aa dɛ tomɛ la nomanta, n dɛ yarada heyaa kɛŋɔ haa liifalee dɔ. Naate waa dɛ wili heyaa nɔ, ɡɛ bwa waa doa, Korowii ɛɛ bɔɔ kemee.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Yabala, dɛ n fe ta dɛ bol ŋɔ penteŋa hiaoh waa, nɛra fe cheɡɛ n nɛɛ ken aa? Dɛ n fe kpɔ penteŋa waa dɛ ja Yeesu Kristo daɡaɡre ta sewa la waa ta dɛɛ bol aa, nɛra fe dɛ vɛh n wobol nɔ naa?

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: A ka n te wa aa, nɛra baa dɛ wili heyaa ŋɔ hé teŋe he pena la, ba dɛ nyin aa, bá fɔɡɛ ba lure ɡe.

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Yabala, Korowiirii le heyaa tɛ o te, dɛ lɛ heyaa asɛ Mmara la bɛ heyaa vɔrɔwe kpa. Kɛ haa dɔ he te nɔ, he bɛ ɡel a do he som kohona, asɛ hɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la bwa he bwadabii aa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɛ. Hé kpɔ dɔŋa nyina dɛɛ tomɛ dɔŋa.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, webeŋkpoŋ bɛl lole dɛ he dɛ ɛ aa, dɛ he tonɛ Mosis Mmara la bwa. Onee kɛŋɔ, “Nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he ɡbaɡba.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Dɛ haa dɔŋa nyin, dɛɛ yo aa, amɔ te hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ. A waa laa aa, he dɛ ba dɔŋa baah chɔɡa kwaraa. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ne ya nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ wa

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ waa he nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu la aa dɛ nyin la, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa an nyin. Nɛwɛnyini mar wenyina ne Korowii Domadɛɛɡe wenyina aa jo. Anomanta, waa haa dɛ nyin ɛɛ la, haa wona ba dɛ ɛ.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Dɛ he kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la wɛɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ te naa, Mosis Mmara la aa won di kpeɡri he nɛ.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa jemɛ nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ tetoowa. Anee kɛŋɔ jwamane, ne wedoŋa, ne pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla te bwa soo siwi,

english_verse: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
translation_verse: ne voɡa toma, dɛ sɔm wa. A bini anee kɛŋɔ nɛra ne ba dɔŋa aa dɛ di dɔm dɛɛ yo, ne bɔweela kohona, ne bandisale ne sibeɡra, ne nɛra ne ba bala baah peɡra, dɛ nyopɛo bɛ dɔe,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: ne bɔweela, ne dɛɛra dɛ́ dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa kohona, dɛ wesale aa do ken nɔ. N fa ŋɔ he be wubwa ŋɔ hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ la, baa Korowii Kora la ta jae ba. N berɔ kwaa dɛɛ lii heyaa ja.

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: ne pwɛre doe, dɛ ɡel nɛn won o te lawa. Harɛ bɛlbwa toole dɛ ki a ɡɛ waa nɔ.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛra la, ba kpaa ba nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ wenyina ne ba liichɔɡa bwa pɛl Yeesu daɡaɡre la ta dɛ kpoa.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛ yaa ɛ jenu. A ta chɛ kɛ yaa ir dɔŋa bwaawee. A ta chɛ kɛ ya dɔ bɔweela dɔŋa nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Yabala, dɛ he lawɛ he bini bɛl wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ta naa, he banɔ la haa dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kɛrɛdɛ la, hé toɡro. Kɛ he bɛ o nɛɛ nyɛɡ te, hé toɡro sipwɛra ne. He ɡbaɡba ɡe la, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ Bɔnsam bɛ heyaa ba neɡre do wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Waa pu he dɔŋ dɛ ɛ bone tɛo waa, hé chao. He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ Yeesu Kristo mmara la taa hɛɛ teŋɛ la.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn ta nɛnjen ɛɛ dɛɛ lii o te nɛnjen aa, dɛ o dɛ neɡre o te.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Hé bɛlbwa nyiŋi o we-ɛɛla na. Dɛ a wer aa, ó ɡel o sie lɛ. Kɛ he bɛ he te kpɔ dɛɛ maɡɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ nyin sɔn,

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ne o bonee wɛɛ ba cheɡa.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa baa dɛ baɡlo Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ la, kondɛɛɡe bɛlbwa haa dɔ la, tɛ naate waa dɛ baɡle la.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: He bɛ he te dɛɛ neɡre. Haa jemɛ kɛ baa Korowii neɡre kɛɛ? Kwaa nɛn aa dua la, anee wɛɛ komɛ.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel ya bwara ɛɛ hwah ya wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta. Dɛ ya swɛɛ siwi a ta naa, Korowii Tɔpere La telaa, yaa komaa.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Anomanta, saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ ŋwɛnɛ lole naa, yáa cha nomɛlbwa, a laa kɛŋɔ nɛra ya ne baa dɛ di lola Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ teŋa nɔ ta nɔ. Jae ne kala aa ka mun

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: N ɡbaɡbaa chwerɛ bonɔ la. Hé na ɡɛ maa chwera a do bare ɡɛ!

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé teŋni he pena la, nɛra sie ta waa baa ɛ ɡɛ. Ba dɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ Juu tena na dɛ bɛ ba yaradae baa yarada Yeesu Kristo daɡaɡre ta sewa waa koh dɛ́ hah ba.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa sɛah ba teŋni ba pena la, ba ɡba aa Mosis Mmara la bwa ta teŋɛ. Ba dɛ nyin ba teŋni he pena ásɛ dɛ won kpɔ a waa dɛɛ ta nyoa.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: N te aa n te maŋkura wobɛlbwa ta, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo daɡaɡre ta sewa la waa taa n te ɛɛ jaaɡi. O seo la ɡelɔ harɛ ta bonɔ waa berɛ wepɛɛ n be, a ta kpeɡri dɔe n nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Penteŋa ne o bɛ teŋa te ta hiaih kwaraa. Waa aa hiah laanee kɛ Korowii aa charɛ ya liire ya ɛ nɛnfala.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ waa maa dɛ baɡle nɔ ta ba soɡa bini la, Kórowii na ba sum dɛ́ tɛɛ ba bambisɔɔhna. Banee o nɛra Israel tena la.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa bɛ men yɔna do kpa. Yeesu Kristo toma maa dɛ ɛ la, a ŋwɛra pɛla lɔ n nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Yabala, yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa. Aamen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl aa too n tea asɛ o lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, menee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ. N chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ do Ɛfesos, he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa ta kasinteŋ ne la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Som nae aa le Yeesu Kristo domadɛɛɡe be pera

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o cha yaa wedɛɛɡa la bwa aa le o Domadɛɛɡe be la ta, asɛ yaa na som o be nyundua, pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la wa.

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Korowii felo dɛ le yaa tɛ o te saŋ la o fa aa wola harɛ ɡba tae la, dɛ ŋɔ o dɛ ba ɡela ya ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ yá won do kaih dɛ bɛ doŋa bɛlbwa dɔ o be.

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa waa o fel jemɛ ya waa cheɡ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ́ kpɔ yaa ɛ o bii. O tetooraa o cheɡa ɡɛ.

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: O Binyini la waa o sune ya nɛɛ dɛ ta tea dɛ cha yaa ɡɛ, ásɛ nɛra won kpɛɛro ya sum waa dɛ na kohona la wa.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ saŋ la waa liira la. O cheɡa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo nyundua ne harɛ ta komɛlbwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo ɛ ba Dɔɔ.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: ásɛ nɛra won nyiŋi ya banɔ la yaa fela dɔ hwɛɡa Yeesu Kristo waa ta la, dɛ́ kpɛɛro, dɛ́ tɛo jirima.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Baa baɡle heyaa kasinteŋ dɛ le Amanesoma la aa dɛ lɛ heyaa la ta la, he ɡba sɛoh dɛ ja beŋkpoŋri ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa ɛa la ta. Haa yarada Korowii dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo la, o kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe tɛ heyaa ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la. O Domadɛɛɡe la lɔ ya nɛɛ dɛ ɛ nso kɛŋɔ ya ɛ Korowii nɛra.

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: O Domadɛɛɡe la taa a che ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ yaa dɔ kwaa Korowii aa baɡɛ o nɛra nyoa laanee. Anee baɡla kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ lɛ o nɛra bwaa ta, dɛ́ lɛ sɔn ne jirima tɛ o te. Pɔɔl wesoŋa

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: A waa ɡela maa no he yarada haa dɛ yarada ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo dɛɛ nyin Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa la,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: n ta ɛɛ jam Korowii he waa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ heya.

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: Ásɛ n soŋe ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii waa dɔ jirima kɛrɛdɛ ɡa la, ó ja heyaa wejema, dɛ́ chaah he sie ásɛ he won dɛɛ jemɛ o waa saŋ bɛlbwa,

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: dɛ́ pili he sie, dɛ́ ɡel he won jemɛ hwɛɡa Korowii aa le heyaa he dɔ a do kan kohona la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ wedɛɛɡa waa baɡɛ o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nyoa ŋɔ baa dɔɔ la kan taeh,

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: dɛ́ berɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kpeɡri Korowii aa dɔa dɛɛ cha ya banɔ la yaa yaradao la kan, a dɔŋa toole. Hé lii ɡɛ o fa aa cha Yeesu Kristo o kpeɡri ne la, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kpeɡri la tentenee ó kpɔ dɛɛ cha yaa.

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: O ir Yeesu Kristo seo ta, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa o be ka so nomombɔr o be nyundua bela,

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: o dɔ kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ ɡa, dɛ ɡwaa kpeɡri konchɔɡa aa bea yaa wola an na bwa soo siwi aa dɔa, dɛ dɔ sɔn ɡwaa komɛlbwa kɛɛ nomɛlbwa waa lole taraken ne nɛra baa dɛ ba bala tɔpere aa dɛ ba bala la ta.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Korowii kpɔ komɛlbwa ne nomɛlbwa bil Yeesu Kristo sie o tire ba nɛ, dɛ berɛ ɡel o ɛ asɔre tena bwa nyu,

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: asɛ ba ɡe ɛ o bwadabi. Onee kana ɡa dɛ won su harɛ nɔ bwa, kɛ asɔre tena laanee ɡela o waa dɔ nyɛl ka tonɛ.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: He fa do kɛŋɔ he sewɔ Korowii be. He wechɔɡaa ɡela he beɡre ɡɛ.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: He fa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire dɛɛ teŋɛ wechɔɡa ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ konchɔɡa bwa yaa wola an na la dɔɔ la nɛ. O tentenee dɛɛ ɛ toma deŋnekpeɡ tena bambili bini.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ ya bwa faa ɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa ya nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ aa dɛ nyin, asɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ ya bwadabii pɛla ne ya liichɔɡa ta. Ya ne nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire bwa nɛɛ Korowii baah faa di.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: o ir yaa seo la ya wechɔɡa nomanta yaa sewa la ta, dɛ berɛ koh pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la waa dɛ tɛ yaa mkpafale. Korowii suna waa sune he nɛɛ la taa a che dɛ lɛ heya.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ir ya ne Yeesu Kristo bwa seo ta, asɛ pɛɛ ya ne waa pɛa la nomanta, o berɛ tɛ ya bwa soŋnibɔra o be nyundua.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ kpɔ baɡle nɛra baa wola toole dɛ taa ba bala ásɛ ba na ɡɛ waa ɡara sune ya nɛɛ kohona dɛ cha yaa kɛrɛdɛ, ɡɛ waa cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ ta tea ɛ yaa waa nɔ bwa la. O nɛn nɛɛ suna kan kɛrɛdɛ. A ta dɔŋ dɔe.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Korowii aa lɛ heyaa ta la, o nɛn nɛɛ suna ne he yarada waa o ɛ ɡɛ. He ɡbaɡba be laa a le, pɛɛpɛɛ o lɛ heyaa ta dɛ tɛ heyaa mkpa.

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: Ya wedɛɛɡa ta laa a che o lɛ yaa, nomɛlbwa bɛ kpɔ dɛɛ maŋkura o te.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Korowiirii ta ya bwa. Waa ta yaa la, wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa o ta yaa ásɛ ya che Yeesu Kristo kpeɡri ta dɛɛ ɛa. O tɔ sie cheɡ yaa kɛ ya baa ɛ wedɛɛɡa. Ya ne Yeesu Kristo beŋkpoŋri ɛɛ

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ lii ɡɛ he fa aa doa la. He ta Juu tena ɛɛ, asɛ Juu tena baa dɛ maŋkura penteŋ la koh kɛ haa he pena teŋe dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyubaah. A ɛ nɛwɛnyini bwadabii we-ɛɛla.

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: He fa aa Kristo Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la waa jemɛ. He fa ta Juu tena Korowii aa lee ba dɛ ɡel ba ɛ o nɛra la nɛɛ jae. He fa aa nyoo Korowii aa baɡa dɛ kwaa o ne o nɛra fɔo dɔe la waa jemɛ. He fa ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe. He fa aa Korowii jemɛ ó won cha heya.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken he banɔ la he ne Korowii baah fa aa jaŋa la, Korowii koh Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa, asɛ he ne o won pɛ la wa, dɛ kpɔ heyaa ba o be.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: On ɡela nyopɛo ba, dɛ ɡel ya banɔ la ya fa aa hah dɔŋa la ɛ beŋkpoŋ. Haeh ya Juu tena ne he banɔ la haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ nɔ fa aa hah dɔŋa la do kɛ danjwɛɛ dɛ teŋe ya baah ta. Onee paɡre a ɡɛ danjwɛɛ la.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Waa la bwa a fa aa vɔrɔwe yaa ya hah dɔŋa la, o chɔɡ a bwa ta daɡaɡre la ta dɛ ɡel ya bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ berɛ lawɛ ya ne Korowii pɛ.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: O baa baɡle he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, he ne Korowii baah fa aa jaŋa la, ne Juu tena ba ne Korowii baah fa aa wola jaŋɛ la bwa amanesoma kɛŋɔ nyopɛo balɔ.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Onee ɡela ya bwa dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, dɛ che o nɛɛ dɛ won dɛɛ tel o Mɛɛ la be.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he ta hɔɔhra ɛɛ kpa. He ɛ bwɛɛlembii dɛ ja Korowii nɛra la nɛ, dɛ ɛ o ɡbaɡba lola,

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: Onee lawɛ banɔ la bwa ba ne waa pɛa la kpoŋe, asɛ dea la ɛɛ kpeɡ dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea, o nomanta.

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: Pɛɛ he ne waa pɛa la nomanta, he ɡba ja dea la Korowii aa dɛ ma o ɛ o dobɔr la ta. O Domadɛɛɡe la aa soɡe he nɛɛ la nomanta, he ɛ o dobɔr.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: He ken no ɡɛ Korowii aa sune n nɛɛ dɛ cha mɛ kɛrɛdɛ n won dɛɛ cha heyaa la.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: O ɡbaɡbaa pili o wesɔɔhla waa bini baɡ mɛ. N fa chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ tama dɛ tɛ heya.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Dɛ he kure ɡɛ n fa aa chwera la aa, hɛɛ wonoo jemɛ kɛŋɔ n jemɛ Yeesu Kristo wesɔɔhla la bini.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Korowii fa ta o wesɔɔhla bini pile baɡle saŋ la tena. Kɛ taraken o Domadɛɛɡe baɡle o nɛra baa ɛ o toromedɛɛɡa ne o keamedɛɛɡa la be,

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ pɛɛ banɔ la baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ne Yeesu aa pɛa la ne Amanesoma la baa noa la nomanta, ba ja Juu tena nɛɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii kwa, dɛ bwa ja Yeesu Kristo nɛ, dɛ bwa pɛ dɛɛ di Korowii nyobaɡa la ɡe tɔnɔ.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Amanesoma toma nɔɔ Korowii kpɔ tɛ mɛ. Sunaa o sune n nɛɛ kohona dɛ cha mɛ o kpeɡri ne, n won dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: N ɛ bechala o nɛra bwa bini n fe aa wola chɛɛ, kɛ menee o le ŋɔ ń bol o Amanesoma la baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe jemɛ wedɛɛɡa aa wola jaɡa dɔe dɛ le Yeesu Kristo waa bini.

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: Korowii aa ta komɛlbwa saŋ la ba le fini, o kpɔ waa nɔ ne ɡɛ a ŋwɛnɛre aa doa sɔh nɛwɛnyina. Kɛ o pili a bini baɡ mɛ ń bol baɡle nɛra bwa ba jemɛ.

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: O ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ nyundua toroma, ne kwaa aa dɔ kpeɡri bwa dɛ do Korowii be nyundua bwa pese asɔre tena waa dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ bwa Korowii wejema aa kana ne ɡɛ waa dɛ ɛ o toma.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa cheɡa wubwa la, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa bala la, a wono ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: Yaa dɛ yarada Yeesu ya ne o pɛ nɔ, yaa wonoo ba Korowii be yaa wola ɔmɛ.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Anomanta, waa maa dɛ soŋe heyaa laanee kɛ he bɛ ɡel he bwara hwah wahala maa koh he waa dɛɛ na nɔ ta. Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ dɔ sɔn n wahala nɔ ta. Pɔɔl Korowii soŋa dɛ́ tɛ Ɛfesos tena

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dɛ ɡuŋi N Naa Korowii harɛ.

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: Onee komɛlbwa waa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa Mɛɛ. O bee ba mɛɛnanar lɛ ba sɔn ne ba kpeɡri dɛɛ di.

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: dɛ́ won dɔ yarada kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ he won lawɛ Yeesu Kristo he ne o pɛ. N dɛ soŋo he bambile won do o nɛɛ dɛ́ lawɔ kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: ásɛ he ne Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la bwa won jemɛ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nyina aa kana dɛ do luŋri, aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa la ɡwaa ya liire ta. Kɛ n dɛ soŋe Korowii he won jema, dɛ́ won dɔ o ɡbaɡba da kɛrɛdɛ ɡa dɛ́ ka tonɛ.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl maa koh ya Dɔɔ waa la waa ba do mɛ dea la, n dɛ soŋe he bwa, hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ nɛra Korowii aa lee ba tɛ o te ɛɛ teŋɛ la.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ sɔɔh bwara dɛɛ pwɛr he te, dɛ́ koh dɔŋa nyina waa dɛ́ dɔ bambile dɔŋa nɛ,

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi hé ne he bala baah do wer saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ bɛ nyopɛo la Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa tɛ heyaa la chɔɡ.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Yeesu bwadabii lɔ beŋkpoŋ, o Domadɛɛɡe ɡe lɔ beŋkpoŋ, asɛ hwɛɡa Korowii aa le yaa ya bwa dɔ la ɡe ɛ beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Ya bwa Mɛɛɛ Korowii, o lɔ beŋkpoŋ. Onee dɔ ya bwa dɛɛ ɛ toma ya bwa bini, dɛ do ya bwa nɛ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “O teehnɔ kaa nyundua, dɛ lawɛ nɛra waa laɡ ba laa ta kaa, asɛ o kɛ nɛra kwa.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Baa ŋɔa ŋɔ o kaa nyundua la, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ o tɔ sie tu ba harɛ.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa tua la, o tentenee kaa nyundua dɛ ka do nyundujaɡla ásɛ dɛ won do bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ o ɛ dɛ cha nɛra bá ɡe won ɛ o toma dɛ́ cha dɔŋa Yéesu Kristo bwadabii la won do kpeɡri,

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: ásɛ ya bwa won dɔ nyopɛo yarada yaa yarada Korowii Bie ne jema yaa jemɔ la ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ka tonɛ, dɛ won kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nomonome o nɛɛ teŋa ta, ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa doa la. Onee ya kpɔ dɛɛ maɡɛ ya te dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ yaa kpeɡ.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya lawɛ kasinteŋ la bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ bola dɔŋa be nɛnnyin ne, ásɛ ya won kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ do ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa doa. Onee ya nyu.

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: Yan ɡee o bwadabi. Onee choŋri bwadabii la bwa, aa lawɛ dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ cha dɔŋa, ásɛ dɛ won kpeɡ tel ɡɛ o mar aa doa. Dɔŋa nyinaa ɡela Yeesu Kristo bwadabii won kpeɡ ɡɛ dɛ do kpeɡri la. Korowii mkpafale dɔe Yeesu be

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Ba sibie tɔɔɡɔ. Ba nya liire, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena. A waa ɡela baa wola Korowii mkpa dɔe la.

english_verse: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa aa ban sihiih ɛ. Anomanta, ba saahnɔ dɛɛ teŋɛ ba pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla ta, dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa ba siwi swɛɛ a ta.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: He no o wa, ba baɡle heyaa kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ la, asɛ he jemɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: Taraken hé ɡel he dabene la ne waa he fa aa dɛ teŋɛ a ta la. He pɛlchɔɡaa neɡre he bwa dɛɛ chɔɡ he da la. Hé ɡel webena la bwa,

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: dɛ́ ɡel Korowii kwaa he bambile ne he liire bwa á berɛ anfala.

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: O tɛ heyaa dafale bɛl soo siwi waa kwaara, o do kɛ o tenten la ásɛ he won ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa tenten, he waa bwa do kɛrɛdɛ o be. Anomanta, hé kpɔ dafale la.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Hé laa nyosone bɛlbwa laa kpɔ he waa ta, dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he bwa pɛ bwadabii beŋkpoŋ ta dɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel Bɔnsam dɔ bɔr dɛ́ neɡre heya.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: He fa dɛ ŋwɛ kɛɛ? Hé ɡel ɡɛ ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ he nɔɔra haa kpɔa dɛɛ ŋwɛ la dɛɛ ɛ tondɛɛɡa dɛ́ dɔ dɛɛ di, dɛ́ won dɔ ane dɛɛ tɛ nyaara ba ɡee di.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel wedoŋa bɛlbwa ɛɛ le he nyoo, kɛ hé ɡel he wobol ɛ waa aa wera dɛɛ do nɛra ɡbemba waa aa kpoŋ ba ta, dɛ won cha banɔ la baa dɛ noa la.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la tea bini chɔɡ. Korowiirii kpɔɔ do heyaa nso dɛ́ won jemɛ he banɔ la waa dɛ ba lɛɛ o lɛɛ tɔpere la.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel nyɛɡre doe, ne bandia, ne ɡaeh, ne wesaɡasaɡare, ne bahmuɡliwa, dɛ meesɔhwaa bwa,

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: dɛɛ ɛ dɔŋa wedɛɛɡa, dɛ́ dɔ dɔŋa chal. Dɛ he dɔŋ ɛɛ wechɔɡa aa, kpɔ kɛo kɛŋɔ Korowii aa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heyaa la.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: He ɛ Korowii bii waa dɛ nyin heya, anomanta, hé chaaro dɛ́ kpɔ o da.

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: A wer kɛŋɔ he so dɔŋa nyina ne kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo aa nyin yaa dɛ sewɛ lɛ yaa a ɛ sarahadɛɛɡe dɛ tɛ Korowii la.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Kɛ jwamane ne wedoŋa ne sibeɡra dɔe dɔŋa kwaa ta te, he bɛ a waa dɛɛ bol á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɛa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ aa were tɛ Korowii nɛra.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamane, dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa, ba sie ɛɛ beɡre kwaa ta la aa bɔr dɔe ba Yeesu Kristo ne Korowii Kora la bini. Sie beɡra kwaa ta do kɛŋɔ voɡ toma ken.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa kpɔ wepuu neɡre heya. A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa waa Korowii baah di deŋnekpeɡ tena nɛɛ wɛɛ ba ba deŋne tɛra la.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he ne ɡɛ nɛra la bɛ wobɛlbwa ta pɛ.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: He waa bwa fa ɛ biro bini wa, kɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nomanta, he ɛ bochaah ta nɛra. Anomanta, hé ɡel he soɡa bini wobɛlbwa do kɛŋɔ bochaah ta nɛra.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Bochaah ta we-ɛɛlaa wedɛɛɡa ne wekaih dɛ kasinteŋ wa.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé jemɛ waa haa ɛ aa lɛ Korowii sie,

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ ɡel biro bini waa ɛɛ. A ta tɔnɔ dɔe. Hé le a ne baŋ, ásɛ nɛra jemɛ ɡɛ aa doa.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Waa ba yon sɔh dɛ́ɛ ɛ la aa were. A waa baɡla ɡba dɔ sihiih.

english_verse: But the light will show what these things are really like.
translation_verse: Ba le komɛlbwa ne bochaah ta naa, o kon soo siwi won nae kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Kon la bwa bɔr aa chaah o ta la, o ɡbaɡba dɛ baɡle o te. A waa ba yon ŋɔ, “He banɔ la haa sewa chɔ la, hé ir, ásɛ Kristo chaah he nɛɛ” la.

english_verse: Act like people with good sense and not like fools.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he soɡa bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɛ wejerema dɛ bɛ ɡɛn.

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡa lole kɛrɛdɛ taraken. Anomanta, hé takapɔ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa taraken nɔ haa dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ɛa nɔ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he nfɛrɛ nyae la, dɛ́ jemɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin la kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: He bɛ sen nyɔ kohona dɛɛ dɛɛ. Gɛ dɛ chɔɡ nɛn. Kɛ hé ɡel Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la so he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: dɛ́ɛ yerɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn, dɛ́ɛ jam N Naa Korowii waa bwa ta.

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Haahna, hɛ́ɛ no he jaranar waa kɛŋɔ he Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa hɛɛ no la,

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ baalee ɛ o haah nyu te, kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo aa ɛ asɔre tena bwa nyu te la. Banee ɛ o bwadabi wɛɛ lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
translation_verse: Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ haahna ɛɛ no ba jaranar waa wobɛlbwa ta kɛŋɔ asɔre tena aa dɛ no Yeesu Kristo waa la.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Baala, hɛ́ɛ nyin he haahna kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa dɛ nyin asɔre tena dɛ koh ba waa sewɛ la.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: O sewɔ tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ ɡel ba won ɛ o nɛra, ásɛ ba doŋa bwa won le ba nɛ, o waa baa noa ne Korowii nee baa sɔ ba nomanta.

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ won kpɔ asɔre tena berɛ o handɛɛɡe, doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ, waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, o bobɛlbwa aa wola jweremɛ, dɛ do wer ka tonɛ.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ chɛ kɛ baala ɡee nyin ba haahna kɛŋɔ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin ba ɡbabir bwadabii la. Baa bɛlbwa waa dɔ haah dɛɛ nyinu ɡɛ la, o ɡbabirii wɛɛ nyin la.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Umee dɛ hah o ɡbabir ɔ? Nomɛlbwa dɛ nyiŋi o te kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyu ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa dɛ nyiŋi asɔre tena la.

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: Ya bwa ɛ o bwadabii la pera.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “Gɛ nomanta, baa ɛɛ ɡel o nya ne o mɛɛ, ásɛ o ne o haah ka pɛ, ba nɛra banɛ la ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ bini luŋri. N te be te, Yeesu Kristo ne asɔre tena waa ba baɡle ɡɛ la.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he bɛlbwa takapɔ dɛ́ nyin o haah kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba, háah ɡe kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ o jaa.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Bechale, hɛ́ɛ no he nyare ne he mɛɛnanar wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haa ɛ Kristo tena nɔ, anee chɛ kɛ hɛ́ɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Mɛɛnanar, he bɛ he bii sibeɡra dɛ́ɛ do, ásɛ ba baah ɛɛ di. Hé kpoŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛre ne waa la bwa aa wera ya Dɔɔ be. Bonɔɔna ne toli dɛ ba dɔɔranar

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: He banɔ la baa do heyaa bonɔɔna kɛɛ toli la, hɛ́ɛ no he dɔɔranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta wa, dɛ́ɛ duu ba, dɛ́ ta tea dɛ́ɛ tom ba kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristoo hɛɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: He bɛ sɔn waa koh dɛ́ kpɔ bokpeɡa dɛ́ɛ ɛ toma nɛra sie ta, kɛ hɛ́ɛ ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔndɛɛɡa ne toldɛɛɡa aa dɛ ɛ, dɛ́ɛ ɛ toma he bambile bwa ne á su Korowii siwi.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ɛ ɛ toma. Nɛn laa hɛɛ tomɛ. He Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo hɛɛ tomɛ.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Onee dɛɛ ba nomɛlbwa kem bɔe o tondɛɛɡa bwa waa ɛa ta. Dɛ bonɔɔ kɛɛ toloo ba doe noo, dɛ he nyuu hɛɛ di oo, he bwa dɛ ba tondɛɛɡa haa ɛa kembɔr dɔe Yeesu Kristo be.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Dɔɔranar, hɛ́ɛ ɛ he bonɔɔna ne toli ɡe kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba fiiɡa. He jemɔ kɛŋɔ he ne ba bwa Dɔɔ lɔ beŋkpoŋ nyundua. Waa bane nyine dɛɛ ɡwaa bane. Korowii laa laala bwa kpɔe dɛ́ do wa

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa kaa laanee kɛŋɔ hé ɡel he ne ya Dɔɔ pɛ, ásɛ he won dɔ kpeɡri waa dɔa kohona la.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Bɔnsam dɔ baradeɛre kɛrɛdɛ ɡa. Anomanta, hé kpɔ Korowii laa laala bwa do dɛ́ won yoo,

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛn laa ya ne wɛɛ yo. Ya ne konchɔɡa aa bea yaa wola an na a dɔ kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ dɛ do biro ta la nɛ, ne konchɔɡa bwa soo siwi aa wara kohona laanee dɛɛ yo la.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Anomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ Korowii laa laala bwa do kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ konchɔɡa la baa ŋɔ a yo heya aa, he won che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ yo ka tonɛ dɛ́ ta won che.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Kenii hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ won che. Hé kpɔ kasinteŋ ɛ kiriso, dɛ́ kpɔ waa aa toɡra ɛ laa batakaare,

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ Amanesoma la aa dɛ baɡle nyopɛo dɔe la do he nakpale,

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ kpɔ yarada tɔ he te ɡbemɡbe, dɛ́ won lɛ hɛma la Bɔnsam aa kpɔa su nii ta dɛɛ ta heyaa la bwa dɛɛ ta,

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ lɛɛ Korowii aa lɛ heyaa la ɛ buni ɡbɛrɛ dɛ́ kpɔ pi, dɛ́ kpɔ o waa la aa ɛ o Domadɛɛɡe tokobii la kpoŋe.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ soŋo harɛ bini soŋa nɔ bwa. Hé che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ɛ soŋo saŋ bɛlbwa. He bɛ dom dɛɛ chɔ. Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ́ɛ tɛ o nɛra la bwa.

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ n ɡe, ásɛ dɛ n dɛ ba waa bola aa, ń dɔ waa dɛɛ bol, dɛ́ dɔ bambile dɛ́ won pili o wesɔɔhla la le Amanesoma la bini.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Maa ɛ Yeesu nachiɡe dɛɛ bol Amanesoma nɔ ba koh a waa do mɛ dea nɔ. Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii ásɛ n ta dɔ bambile dɛɛ baɡla ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ mɛɛ baɡla. Kala aa ka mun

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo tɛ he ne yabala la bwa deŋnesɔɔhna, ne nɛnnyin ne yarada,

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: dɛ́ sune he nɛ, dɛ́ cha he banɔ la bwa haa dɛ nyin ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bambile bwa ne aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl ne Timoti yaa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔna la, yanee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra he wa aa toɡra, he ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ he do Felepae la, ne he nɛra baa tɔ asɔre tena sie ne nɛra baa chɔ tomare nyoo la bwa.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Korowii jaama ne o kpɛɛra

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa maa lii he waa la, n dɛ jam N Naa Korowii he wa,

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: dɛ́ yon kpɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ he bwa,

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: pɛɛ ya ne he bwa aa pɛa dɛɛ cha dɔŋa Amanesoma toma la ta le mumpar ba le fini la nomanta.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: N dɔ hwɛɡa kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa pa mun dɛɛ ɛ o tondɛɛɡa he bambile bini la, wɛɛ ja a taa ka tel awola Yeesu Kristo aa ba la.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Aŋwɛnɛ taa n dɔ he hwɛɡa ɡɛ la, dɛkalkɛ he bwa waa lɔ n bambile ta. Baa do mɛ dea la, ne yoi maa yoa lɛ Amanesoma la cheɡ dɛ bol kasinteŋ aa lɔ a ta dɛɛ baɡle nɛra la, n ne he bwa nɛɛ Korowii sune dɛ cha yaa a ta.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Korowii jemɔ kɛŋɔ he pɛla laɡ mɛ taeh, nɛnnyin Yeesu Kristo aa kpɔa do n bambile ta la nomanta.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ ó ɡel he dɔ nɛnnyin kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ ja, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ wejema ne nfɛrɛ dɛ́ ja a ta,

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ won jemɛ waa aa wera kohona. Anee dɛ́ ɡel he won do kaih, nomɛlbwa aa wola he wechɔɡa dɔe ba dɛ bol ka tel awola Yeesu Kristo aa ba la.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋo kɛ he che Yeesu Kristo kpeɡri la ta dɛ́ won dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ nɛra ɛɛ tɛ Korowii sɔn ne jirima. Jɔɡrɔre baa do Pɔɔl

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Yabala, n dɛ nyin kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ wedɛɛɡa le waa aa chiɡ n nɛɛ la ta, dɛ́ ɡel Amanesoma la won kaa sie.

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: Bonɔ koojen soojare baa dɛ daah o dem, ne nɛra baa lɔ bonɔ bwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ waa ba do mɛ dea.

english_verse: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
translation_verse: Asɛ n dea chɔe la berɛ ɡel yabala ɡalɡa ɡee yarada ya Dɔɔ Yeesu kohona, dɛ́ dɔ bambile dɛ́ɛ baɡle Korowii Waa la kɛrɛdɛ, baa wola ɔmɛ.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, bɔweela ne dɔŋa meera waa nɛra bane ɛɛ bol Kristo Amanesoma la, asɛ bane ɡee bola bambile bwa ne.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Ba te la, nɛnnyin waa baa ɛa, dɛkalkɛ ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii kpɔ toma nɔ tɛ mɛ ŋɔ ń yo lɛ Amanesoma la cheɡ.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Banɔ la ɡe, ba ɡbaɡba sɔn nyina waa baa bol Yeesu Kristo wa, ba tepoŋ ne laa. Ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba ɛ ɡɛ naa, baa wonoo ɡel n tea bini chɔɡ dɛ́ ja n dea chɔe nɔ ta.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Kɛ pɛɛpɛɛ. Dɛ liichɔɡa nee baa bola o, dɛ tepoŋ nee baa bola o, Yeesu Kristo waa baa bol la, n baah sɔɔh mɛ. Aa sɔɔh mɛɛ dɛɛ la,

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
