translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ n jemɔ kɛ Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ le waa aa chiɡ n nɛɛ nɔ ta, he Korowii soŋa ne Yeesu Kristo Domadɛɛɡe la alaworomɛ.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Waa maa dɛ nyin n siwi swɛɛ a ta laanee kɛŋɔ, n bɛ n toma ba ɛ kahonɛ sihiih kpo mɛ, kɛɛ n won dɔ bambile kɛrɛdɛ taraken kɛŋɔ n fa aa dɔ bambile la, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo won dɔ jirima n we-ɛɛla bini. Dɛ ba ɡelɔ n so le noo, ba kpo mɛ noo, Yéesu Kristo dɔ jirima a bwa bini.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: N soɡa nɔ maa soɡa nɔ, Yeesu Kristo waa n so. Dɛ n sewɔ ɡe aa, anee dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ mɛ kwara.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ n ta soɡe le naa, mɛɛ ba wonoo ɛ toma á won dɔ tɔnɔ kɛrɛdɛ. Anomanta, maa jemɛ onɔ la bwa waa wera n be ń kpɔ.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: N chinchaŋo. N dɛ nyin kɛ n sewɛ dɛ́ ka so Yeesu Kristo be. A bɔ kohona kɛ maa soɡe bonɔ.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ so he bee dɛ́ won cha he bwa he kpeɡ Yeesu Kristo waa la ta, dɛ́ dɔ silɛɛ he yarada ta,

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ n baa so he be ja aa, he won dɔ bɔr kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ jaaɡi n wa, dɛ́ɛ kpɛɛ Yeesu Kristo.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Waa aa hiaah laanee kɛŋɔ hé ɡel he we-ɛɛla bwa do wer ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ nɛra baa no Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la waa aa doa, ásɛ dɛ n baa ba he be noo, n ta ba wone ba noo, ń no he waa kɛŋɔ he bwa liire ɛ beŋkpoŋ, hé che kiŋkiŋ, he nyoa pɛ, hé che tɛ Amanesoma la haa yaradaa la, á won la sie,

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: dɛ́ berɛ dɔ bambile haa wola he dɔma ɔmɛ tamaa bɛlbwa bwa. He bambile dɔe la taa bá che jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ lɛ heyaa dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ he won yarada Yeesu Kristo, dɛ berɛ won koh o waa na hɔhɔrɔwa. Wejenaa o ɛ tɛ heyaa he won koh o waa na hɔhɔrɔwa la.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: He ɡba dɛ yo ɡɛ tenten he fa aa na mɛ mɛɛ yo la. Gɛ yoi laanee hɛɛ no kɛ n ta dɛ yo la.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: Haa dɔ ɡbemba pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la ta, o nyina ɡee larawe heyaa bwara, he dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡe wɛɛ cha heya, dɛ dɔ nɛnnyin he chal do dɔŋa nɛɛ nɔ,

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: amɔ hé ɛ waane dɛɛ ja, ásɛ n sie lɛ kohona ka tonɛ. N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he bwa dɔ nyopɛo, ásɛ he liire ne he dɔŋa nyina ne wobɛlbwa haa lii la bwa won ɛ beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: He bɛlbwa bɛ o ɡbo sɔn nyina kɛɛ jenu waa koh dɛɛ ɛ wa, kɛ hé pwɛr he te dɛ́ɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɡwaa he ɡbaɡba.

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel he ɡbo waa hiah heya. Hé ɡel he dɔŋa ɡe waa hiah heya.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Gɛ Yeesu Kristo aa doa la, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛ he do.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: O do ɡɛ Korowii aa doa, kɛ o ta ɡelɛ ɡɛ su o siwi kɛŋɔ o ne Korowii ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: O kpɔ o Korowii dor la bil, dɛ kpɔ o te kɛ somanji, dɛ do ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa doa.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: A waa Korowii tɛo nomonome kɛrɛdɛ ɡa, dɛ berɛ tɛo sɔn ɡwaa sɔna tena bwa.

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo sɔnjen la nomanta, nomɛlbwa ɛɛ ɡuŋi o siee dɛ́ kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛo. Banɔ la baa lɔ nyundua, ne banɔ la baa lɔ harɛ ta, ne banɔ la baa serewa bwa, ɛɛ kpɔ duuree dɛɛ tɛo,

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: ásɛ nomɛlbwa sɛh kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristoo nɛra bwa Dɔɔ, ásɛ o Mɛɛ Korowii dɔ jirima. Nɛra ɡel ba we-ɛɛla chaah kɛŋɔ weweela

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dandɛɛɡa, ɡɛ haa dɛ no n waa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta ɡɛ saŋ n fa aa lɔ he be la, a hiaoh kohona kɛŋɔ maa wola toole he be nɔ, hé ta kpoŋe ɡɛ. Korowii aa lɛ heyaa nɔ, hé kpɔ duure ne ɔmee dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ toma haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la ta,

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii soɡe he bɛlbwa nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma, dɛ ɡel he won sɛh dɛ won dɛɛ tomɔ kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ aa su o siwi.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ a wer kɛŋɔ he ɛ Korowii bii nomɛlbwa aa wola he wechɔɡa dɔe dɛ bol, he tea to, he do kaih. Fini nɛra baa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra kɛrɛdɛ baa wola ŋwɛnɛ la ta kpɔ baahnee he do. Gɛ weweela aa dɛ chaah jwaana biro ta la, ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛ he do ba baah dɛɛ chaah.

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel Korowii wa aa dɔ mkpa la do he bambile bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ la, ń won hɛɡre he waa Yeesu Kristo bala tɔpere la ta kɛŋɔ n ta koɛh ta pɛɛ.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ la do kɛŋɔ saraha, asɛ a chɛ kɛ n chal fuɡe a ta naa, n dɛ nyin ɡɛ. A ba ɡɛ naa, n sie ɛɛ lɛo, ásɛ he puu mɛ lɛ sie.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɡe sie lɛ, ásɛ n pu heyaa lɛ sie. Timoti ne Epafrodaetɔs

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu sɛoh waa, mɛɛ tomɛ Timoti he bee taraken ó ba na heya, dɛ́ ba bol he waa n be ásɛ n baah sɔɔh mɛ.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: N ne o ɡboo dɔ liire beŋkpoŋ he wa. Anomanta, n jemɔ kɛ onee he waa do o bambile bini wɛɛ nyin he ne andɛɛɡa.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Dɛ o laa aa, bɛlbwa sese dɛ dawɛ o ɡbaɡba wa, waa Yeesu Kristo waa dawɛ.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: He ɡba jemɛ ɡɛ o waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛ do wer. N ne o pɛo wɛɛ cha mɛ Amanesoma toma la ta kɛŋɔ bechala ne o mɛɛ.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ n baa na ɡɛ baa dɛ ba n cheɡa aa, mɛɛ tomɔ he bee.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: N dɔ hwɛɡa ya Dɔɔ nɛɛ kɛŋɔ aa biɡri bɛlbwa ásɛ n ɡbabir dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ba he be.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: N liiro kɛŋɔ a hiaoh kɛ ń tomɛ ya dɔŋ Epafrodaetɔs he be. N ne onee dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ, dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛ Korowii. Onee he faa tomɛ n be o ba cha mɛ la. N ɡee berɔɔ tomɔ he be,

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ, he pɛla lawɔ wɛɛ lii he bwa waa taeh. A dɛ hao kohona kɛŋɔ haa no o weela wa.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: O fa we weela dɛ chɔ fɔɡɛ taeh, dɛ fe ɛɛ ba sewa. Kɛ Korowiirii na o sum dɛ sune n ne o bwa nɛ. Dɛ o fe sewaa, n tea bini fe chɔɡɔ dɛ́ ja n wahala ta.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Ate waa n siwi swɛɛ mɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ń tomɔ he be ásɛ he nao he sie lɛ, ásɛ he waa bɛ men dɛɛ ha kohona.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Hé kpɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ lɛo, teŋa he ne o bwa aa dɛ teŋɛ ya Dɔɔ nɛɛ la nomanta. Hɛ́ɛ duu nɛra baa do kɛŋɔ on.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Yabala, waa aa kaa laanee kɛŋɔ, hé ɡel he sie lɛ he ne ya Dɔɔ pɛɛ la ta. Wesiwi beŋkpoŋii n berɛ chwerɛ dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la, kɛ aa men ha. A dɛ ba ɡela he won che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ do nɛnchɔɡa baa ɛ ba te manyare la dɛɛɡɔ. Nɛra baa dɛ maŋkura penteŋ dɛ ŋɔ nómɛlbwa mɔn o bɔtɔn mɔɔ dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii la waa mɛɛ bol la.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Ya banɔ la yaa dɛ tomɛ Korowii o Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛɛ tɛ Yeesu Kristo sɔn, yaa wola bɔtɔn mɔna waa maŋkura la, yanee jemɛ penteŋ tenten la.

english_verse: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
translation_verse: Dɛ bɔtɔn wa ɛɛ wonoo lɛ yaa aa, menee fe dɔ hwɛɡa kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ nomɛlbwa ŋɔ a cheɡɛ o waa waa ɛa ta o dɔ hwɛɡa aa, menee dɔ hwɛɡa dɛ ɡwaa naate.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Israel tee men. Baa lol mɛ n dɔ yawanyoa la taa ba teŋe n pen. Bɛnjamen deaa n le. Israel te kaiih men, dɛkalkɛ n mɛɛ ne n nya bwa ɛ Hibru tena. Dɛ ba dɛ bol Mmara ta teŋa wa aa, nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Mmara ta kohona baa yer ba Farisii tena la bɛlee men.

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ nyin nɛn o siwi fa aa swɛɛ a ta naa, menee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n fa cheɡɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la nɛɛ taeh. Dɛ ba berɔ dɛɛ nyin nɛndɛɛɡe Mmara la be pera ɡe aa, n waa bwa toɡrɔ.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Kɛ waa la bwa n fa aa lɔ a ta a ɛ tɔnɔ tɛ mɛ la, Yeesu Kristo nomanta, n dɛ liira wepuu.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, komɛlbwa ne wobɛlbwaa n vɛh dɛɛ yera wepuu dɛ́ won jemɛ n Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo. O jemaa hiaah ɡwaa komɛlbwa. N koh o waa dɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa ta, dɛɛ liira puldoa haahra, dɛɛ nyin ń won dɔ Yeesu Kristo kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: N waa bwaa kɛ ń won jemɛ Yeesu Kristo, dɛ́ won jemɛ kpeɡri la soo waa ira seo ta dɛ dɔ, dɛ́ na wahala waa naa la dɔŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ n te ɛ kɛ n sewɔ ɡɛ waa sewa la,

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: ɡɛ aa ɛ ń won ir seo ta ɡɛ waa ira la. Siwi swɛɛra dɛ won tel waa jaɡa

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ n denɔ won do kaih dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe dɛ ka tonɛ. Akai! N ta swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ nyin ń won do ɡɛ bwa Yeesu Kristo aa lee mɛ ŋɔ ń do la.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Yabala, maa lii kɛŋɔ n tonɛ wobɛlbwa. Webeŋkpoŋii hiah mɛ. N ɡel waa aa lɔ habɔɔ, dɛ takapɔ dɛɛ la sie, dɛ́ won ka dɔ anɔ la aa lɔ sie la,

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ won tel a jaɡa dɛ́ won dɔ kembɔr. Korowiirii yer mɛ ŋɔ ń ba dɛ́ ba do o be, Yeesu Kristo nomanta. A waa n swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ nyin ń won dɔ kembɔr la.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: A wer kɛŋɔ ya banɔ la bwa yaa kpeɡa Korowii waa la ta la dɔ ɡɛ liire. Dɛ he bane ɡe liire korɔ waa nɔ ane ta naa, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo a bini chaah tɛ heya.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɡɛ bwa yaa wona dɛ jemɛ la, yá kpoŋe a bini dɛɛ la.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé kpɔ n da, dɛ́ɛ nyiŋi nɛra ɡe baa dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ yaa dɛ teŋɛ la,

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra warɔ baa wola ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta teŋɛ. N fa baɡle ba waa he be kera aŋwɛnɛ bwa, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ baɡle heyaa taraken sinii ne ŋɔ ba ɛ Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa daɡaɡre la ta la waa dɔm.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ aa kpɔ o ta la dɛ kaa ba ne seo ta. Ba kpɔ tea ne bwadabii waa ɡwaa Korowii. Waa aa ɛ sihihwaa la, a nee baa ta nyoa. Ba liire bwa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Kɛ harɛ nɔ ta ya bwɛɛ ɛɛ. Ya bwɛɛ lɔ nyundua. Yaa lɔ bonɔ nɔ, ya siwi swɛɛrɔ yaa kpa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ la ó le bela ba.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Yabala haa ɛ n nɛnnyina, he pɛla laɡ mɛ. He bee n silɛɛ do, he waa baa ba men tɔɔ dawa. Anomanta, n dandɛɛɡa, hé che kiŋkiŋ pɛɛ ya ne ya Dɔɔ aa pɛa la ta. Jae wa

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe Yoodia ne Sentiki kɛŋɔ bá kwaa ba baah dɛ́ ɛ beŋkpoŋ pɛɛ ya ne ya Dɔɔ aa pɛa la ta.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: N dɔŋdɛɛɡe, n dɛ soŋe, cha haahna la dɛ́ kwaa ba baah, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba cha mɛ Amanesoma nɔ bola ta ɡa. Klɛmɛnt ne n bala tom-ɛɛra la ɡe jao. Ba sɔna lɔ Korowii Mkpa Tɔn bini.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Hé che pɛɛ he ne ya Dɔɔ aa pɛa la ta dɛ́ ɡel he sie lɛ. Kasinteŋ, hé ɡel he sie lɛ.

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel nomɛlbwa jemɛ he waa kɛ he pwɛre. Ya Dɔɔ bala la pu yaa tonɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa ha heya, kɛ hé kpɔ wobɛlbwa dɛɛ do Korowii nɔn ta dɛɛ soŋo waa aa hiah heya, dɛ́ɛ jaamo kɛ waa dɛ no he wesoŋa.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Belaa ó ɡe tɛ heyaa o bambisɔn waa ɡwaa bambisɔn te bwa nɛwɛnyini be á cha heya, dɛ́ ɡel he bambile ne liire chɔ bobeŋkpoŋ pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la wa.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa haa hwela dɛ dɔ le n be, kɛɛ dɛ no dɛ na mɛɛ ɛ la, hé ɡee ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ Korowii waa dɛ tɛ nɛra bambisɔn la ja he nɛ. Koŋkɛɛla ane jaama wa

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: N sie lɛo kohona pɛɛ ya ne ya Dɔɔ aa pɛa nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he berɔ kwaa dɛɛ do n liire dɛ́ cha mɛ taraken. He fa cha mɛ ka. A ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ haa berɛ dɛɛ lii n waa kpa. Kɛ bɔree he fa aa wola dɔe dɛ́ nyiŋ mɛ.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ n nyao. Akai. N wono hweli wobɛlbwa maa lɔ a ta n soɡa bini a man mɛ, n sie lɛ a ta.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Dɛ n nyao waa, n jemɛ ɡɛ maa so. N berɔ dɔ ɡe aa, n jemɛ a ɡe ɡba soɡa. N hweli wobɛlbwa a man mɛ. Kondikwaa lole n di dɛ vaɡoo, kondikwaa toole n chɔ lɔr oo, n dɔɔ kohona kɛɛ nyae n nya oo, n won a bɛlbwa kpoŋa.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: N won Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ cha mɛ la kpeɡri ta cheɡa dɛ́ ɛ wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Kɛ haa kpɔ n waa berɛ he bwa wa, dɛ cha mɛ n wahala ta la, he ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: He ɡba jemɔ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ maa ba he be Makidoonia harɛ loɡle la dɛ bol Amanesoma la dɛɛ tɛ heyaa asɛ dɛ kpɔ bela dɛɛ kaa la, asɔre tena baa lɔ bwɛɛre la ta la bɛlbwa ta men chae. He Felepae tena ɡboo koh toma maa ɛa he bini la waa dɛ cha mɛ suuɡa ne.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Hale n fa aa lɔ Tesalonika la, he fa wono ha mɛ kwaa aa hiah mɛ. Kerabeŋkpoŋ kwara laa.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, a ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ komɛlee mɛɛ nyin he be, kɛ he tɔnɔ haa dɔ dɛ́ le chae haa cha mɛ la binii mɛɛ nyiŋi.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: N dɔ komɛlbwa maa dɛ nyin la bwa ka ɡarɛ. N dɔ he haala haa ha mɛ la le Epafrodaetɔs be. He haala la ɛ sarahadɛɛɡe o sɔɔh aa soma dɛ tɛ Korowii dɛɛ su o siwi.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii ɛɛ cha heyaa komɛlbwa haa nyaa la taa dɛ le o kondɔɔh tenten la ta, pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la wa.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ tɛ N Naa Korowii jirima saŋ bɛlbwa. Aamen. Kala aa ka mun

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Too, he banɔ la bwa he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa he ɛ Korowii nɛra he waa toɡre la, n dɛ na heya. He bala baa lɔ n be bonɔ la dɛ na heya.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la bwa dɛ na heya. Banɔ la baa lɔ Rom koodem laanee dena dɛɛ na heyaa kohona.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa. Aamen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Men Yeesu Kristo torome Pɔɔl ne ya dɔŋ Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ. Korowii tetooraa o tɛ yaa toma nɔ.

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Ya chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ yabala haa lɔ Kolosi dɛ ɛ Korowii nɛra, asɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ, hɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne la. Ń Naa Korowii cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Korowii jaama ne wesoŋa

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ jam ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii he waa ya wesoŋa bini saŋ bɛlbwa,

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya noɔ kɛŋɔ he dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo kɛrɛdɛ dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo, dɛɛ nyin Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa ɡe.

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: Amanesoma aa ɛ kasinteŋ la aa ba he be loɡla la, he no hwɛɡa aa dɛ tɛ la wa. He yarada ne nɛnnyin la le kwaa haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta la ta. Korowii ɡe kwaa a bwa cheɡ heyaa Korowii doa kɛrɛdɛ ken.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: Amanesoma la perɔ, nɛra ɛɛ noa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, aa ba hɛɛra ne. Gɛ tentenee aa ba hɛɛra ne he be dɛ le awola haa noa Korowii pili he sie he jemɛ suna waa sune he nɛɛ dɛ cha heyaa la.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Epafras bee he no Amanesoma la le. Ya ne o bwaa pɛa dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ. O ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ yaa nyinu kɛrɛdɛ. Ya naa taa o che dɛɛ cha heya.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: O bol ya be ɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa cha heyaa asɛ hɛɛ nyin dɔŋa.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya le awola yaa no he waa dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ ó Domadɛɛɡe baɡle heyaa o wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ berɛ dɛɛ pili he sie hé won jemɛ wobɛlbwa aa ɛ Korowii tetoora la,

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: dɛ́ won do ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ ya Dɔɔ torome do, he wobɛlbwa won su o siwi, he won dɛ́ɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi, dɛ́ won jemɛ Korowii kohona,

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: dɛ́ won dɔ kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ le o ɡbaɡba kpeɡri waa do kan dɛ dɔ jirima kɛrɛdɛ la ta. N dɛ soŋe Korowii ó cha heyaa ɡɛ hé won lawɛ bambile wobɛlbwa ta,

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: dɛ́ won kpɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ɛ jaamo waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ la wa. Onee ɡela ya chɛ kɛ ya ne o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa won dɔ kondɛɛɡa waa dɔa tɛ o bii baa ja o Kora waa ɛ Bochaah Kora la ta.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: O lɛ yaa le biro ta dɛ kpɔ yaa ka ja o Bie waa dɛ nyinu la Kora ta.

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Yaa won Korowii na. Gɛ Korowii aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o Bie ɡe do. O Bie la lole mɔɔ o ta komɛlbwa.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: O Bie la nɛɛ o che dɛ ta komɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ ta ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ nyundua, anɔ la yaa dɛ naa ne anɔ la yaa wola an na kɛŋɔ nyundua toroma ne konchɔɡa aa dɛ di kpeɡri bwa soo siwi. O Bie la nɛɛ o che dɛ taa, asɛ a do le tɛo.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ a bɛlbwa fa aa wola toole la, dɛ o te lole. Onee lawɛ komɛlbwa kpoŋe, a ta do le ba le fini nɔ la.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Onee asɔre tena bwa nyu, ba ɡee o bwadabi. Onee tɔ sie komɛlbwa nɛ, dɛ tɔ sie ir seo ta nomɛlbwa nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ on chɛ kɛ ó ɛ nomoa komɛlbwa nɛ.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Korowii tetooraa o Bie Yeesu ɛ o ɡbaɡba.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ che o Bie la nɛɛ dɛ kwaa o ne kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa baah. O ɡelɔ o Bie sewɛ daɡaɡre la ta o chal kwaa wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: He fa aa Korowii jemɛ dɛ ɛ o dɔma, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he fa dɛ lii liichɔɡa, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Kɛ name Yeesu Kristo aa baa ɛ nɛn dɛ sewɛ la, Korowii cheɡɛ o seo la ta dɛ kwaa he ne o baah, dɛ ɡel he won do kaih doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole he nɛ, nomɛlbwa aa wola he waa dɔe ba dɛ bol awola haa ba che Korowii sie la.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Dɛ he ta kpoŋe waa haa dɛ yaradaa la bini, he ta habɔɔ leɛ, dɛ dɔ hwɛɡa le Amanesoma la baa bola baɡle heyaa he no la ta kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa won chɔɡ he liire he bɛ dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kpa aa, amɔ hɛɛ wonoo che o sie. Ba dɛ bol Amanesoma nɔ bobɛlbwa. N ɡbabir dɛ bola, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii lee mɛ. Gɛ Pɔɔl aa ɛ toma tɛ asɔre tena

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Taraken a do n som kɛ maa lɛ he wahala dɛɛ na. Wahala lole ń che Yeesu Kristo naa ta dɛ́ na tɛ asɔre tena baa ɛ o bwadabii la. Anomanta, a do n som kɛ maa dɛ ba wona na wahala aa kaa la ane, ásɛ a won tonɛ.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: N ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ o asɔre tena. Korowiirii koh he chae waa dɛ tɛ mɛ a ɡɛ toma nɔ, dɛ ŋɔ mɛɛ baɡle o waa la bwa ásɛ nɛra bwa no.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Korowii waa la fa sɔɔh saŋ la bwa, nɛra ta a mun jemɛ. Kɛ taraken te, o pili a bwa bini dɛ tɛ o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra,

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: bá na dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin kɛ ó ɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la baah. O waa waa pili a bini la ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa ɛ wejena dɛɛ kpo nyoa. Anee kɛ Yeesu Kristo Doma soɡe he nɛ, he dɔ hwɛɡa o be kɛ tɔpebɛl hɛɛ dɔ jirima o bee.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Ya waa yaa dɛ baɡle bwaa Yeesu Kristo la. Ya dɛ ja nomɛlbwa, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra bwa wejema bwa ne, ásɛ dɛ ba won kpɔ bɛlbwa ba Korowii be kɛ ba kpeɡ Yeesu Kristo waa ta, pɛɛ ba ne waa pɛa la nomanta.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: A waa ɡela n swɛɛ siwi dɛ takapɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma la. Yeesu Kristoo tɛ mɛ kpeɡri ɡa n won dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ toma la.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin he jemɛ ɡɛ n siwi aa swɛɛra mɛɛ koh n te he ne Laodisia tena ne nɛra baa wola men jemɛ la wa,

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: dɛ́ do he bwa ɡbemba he won nyin dɔŋa dɛ́ ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ won jemɛ Korowii wesɔɔhla waa pili a bini tɛ heyaa la kɛrɛdɛ, he bɛ aahna-aahna tamaa bɛlbwa ɛ, dɛ́ dɔ tɔnɔ le o waa la bini kɛrɛdɛ. O waa laanee Yeesu Kristo.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: N dɛ baɡle heyaa ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won kpɔ nyotor neɡre heya.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: N toole he be, kɛ n liire te lɔ he be. Anomanta, a do n som kɛ he bwa aa pɛa, asɛ dɛ lawɛ yaradae haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ la. Kpɔ he te pɛl Yeesu dɛ́ kpeɡ o waa la ta

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Haa dɔa kpɔ he te tɛ Yeesu Kristo kɛ he Dɔɔ nɔ, hé ne o pɛ wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: A taa aa ba cheɡa he won che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ kpeɡ o waa la ta, dɛ́ won yarada o waa bwa kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ baa baɡle heyaa la, dɛ́ɛ jam Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Webaɡla ane lole bane ɛɛ baɡle dɛɛ yera wejema. Hé nyiŋa kɛrɛdɛ. A ɛ nyosone kɛɛ wepuu ba kpɔ dɛɛ neɡre nɛra. Nɛwɛnyini nawee waa, ne koŋkwaa aa dɛ di kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta wejema waa baa baɡle la. Yeesu Kristo be laa a le.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: He ne waa pɛa la, he dɔ komɛlbwa. Onee dɔ sɔn waa ɡwaa kwaa yaa wola an na bwa soo siwi sɔn.

english_verse: Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body.
translation_verse: He ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la, o teŋe he dobene la ta. O ɡe penteŋaa la. He te teŋa nɔ ta ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ teŋe la ɛɛ.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Korowii nee ba fa aa sɔ heyaa la, anee baɡla kɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo bwaa ba pɛ huɡe. Asɛ a berɛ che yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii ne kpeɡri waa kpɔa ir Yeesu seo ta la ta, he ne o bwa pɛ ir dɛ dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: He wechɔɡa ne he dobene Korowii fa aa wola teŋe ta la ɡelɔ he fa do kɛŋɔ he serewɔ. Kɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la, Korowii kpɔ he bwa wechɔɡa kɛ heya, dɛ tɛ he bwa mkpafale.

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: Teŋa haa ŋɔa ŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmara taa dɛ berɛ horɛ a bar heyaa la, a bwa taa o le heya. Waa a waa pɛɛ kpa. Korowii kpaa a bwa pɛl Yeesu daɡaɡre la ta a tonɛ.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Yeesu seo waa sewa la, o chɔɡ kwaa aa dɔ kpeɡri bwa kpeɡri, dɛ lɛ a kpeɡri dɔɔh. O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ ɡel sihiih kpoa nɛra bwa siwi ta, bá jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ɡelɔ koŋkpeɡa la bwa kpeɡri ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ pwah heyaa kwaa ane haa dɛ di, ne kwaa haa dɛ nyɔ, ne he tɔpejena dii benanyoa ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, ne Ona Tɔpera ta naa, he bɛ on dawɛ.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ pwah heyaa ŋɔ haa ɡɛ waa teŋe nyosone ŋɔ pwɛraa wɛɛ pwɛr o te dɛɛ tomɛ nyundua toroma la ta teŋaa, he bɛ on dawɛ. Gɛ nɛn nɔ dɛ maŋkura o te kɛŋɔ o dɛ na waa deera ta, dɛɛ yerɛ o te nɛnjen, kɛ pɛɛpɛɛ. Nɛwɛnyini liire taa wɛɛ teŋɛ,

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: dɛ vɛh o te kpɔe dɛ́ do Yeesu Kristo lɔɡa. Onee ya nyu, asɛ ya ɛ o bwadabii dɛɛ dɔ bokpeɡa o be, bɛlbwa lawɛ o dɔŋ kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ ya ne o ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ che pɛɛ yaa pɛa la ta dɛ ɡel yaa kpeɡ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: He ne Yeesu Kristo pɛo dɛ sewɛ, anomanta, he ne koŋkwaa aa dɛ di kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa. Aah bɔkwa waa he ta kpɔ he te dɛɛ do harɛ nɔ ta kii ta dɛ ɡel a vɔrɔwe heyaa ŋɔ,

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “He bɛ onɔ lawɛ, dɛ bɛ onɔ daɡɛ, dɛ bɛ onɔ leɡe” nɔɔ?

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Gɛ kwaa nɔ ɛ kwaa dɛ he ɛa aa, dɛ a waa tonɔ. Nɛwɛnyini kii ne ba nawee waa a te.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Kpela, nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ duu nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta la kɛ ba ɛ wejerema, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba Korowii toma aa swɛɛ ba siwi kohona waa baa pwɛr ba te dɛɛ ha ba bwadabii la. Kɛ a bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ. Aa won ɡel nomɛlbwa lawɛ o te dɛ́ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo bwaa pɛa ir seo ta te naa, amɔ te hé swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ ɡel he bambile che kwaa aa lɔ nyundua la ta. Belaa Yeesu do dɛ so nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he liire bwa do kwaa aa lɔ nyundua la ta, dɛ́ ɡel kwaa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta,

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ he do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa a bɔr, he toole a ta kpa. He mkpa lɔ Yeesu Kristo be, o ɡe do Korowii be.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Awola Yeesu Kristo he mkpa aa lɔ o be aa ba harɛ ta la, he ne o bwa ɛɛ pɛo dɛ ba ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ ba dɔ jirima o bala la ta. Dabene ne dafale

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ɡel he harɛ nɔ ta dor bwa ta kwaraa. He bɛ he bwadabii kpɔ do jwamane, ne wedoŋa, ne kayɛɡlɛ, ne pɛlchɔɡa, dɛ kwaa ta sibeɡra ta. Kwaa ta sibeɡra do kɛŋɔ voɡa toma ken.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: He ne ba bwaa fa lɔ a ta dɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Kɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɡel a bwa sekwaraa taraken te. Hé laa bandia kpɔ he waa ta, he baah bɛ dɛɛ di saɡasaɡa, hé ɡel meesɔhwa, he bɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ chɛɡre, he bɛ ɡel wobochɔɡa ɛɛ le he nyoo.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: He bɛ nyosone teŋe dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he laa he dabene la ne o we-ɛɛla la bwa kpɔ he nɛ,

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: dɛ́ charɛ dafale. Korowiirii ɡela he do ɡɛ la. Onee dɛɛ kwaa he dafale la saŋ bɛlbwa ásɛ he do kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ waa doa la, dɛ́ won jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nɛra Korowii aa ɡela ba do ɡɛ dofale nɔ la, ba ta dɔe kɛ ba peɡri dɔŋa bini kpa kɛŋɔ onɔ ɛ Juu te kɛɛ onɔ nɔ ta Juu te ɛɛ nɔ. Nɛra bini peɡra toole kpa, kɛŋɔ onɔ teŋe o pen, kɛɛ onɔ nɔ ta o pen teŋe nɔ. Hɔɔh kɛɛ daamun te kɛɛ yom kɛɛ nɛn waa dɔ o te toole kpa, ba bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ. Yeesu Kristo ɡbo waa hiah o nɛra.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Dɛ he bini bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ dɔ waa aa, ó lawɛ bambile dɛ́ kpɔ kɛo. Gɛ Korowii aa kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heyaa la, ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛ he ɡe kpɔ dɔŋa kwaa dɛ́ɛ kɛ ba.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Anɔ nɔ habɔɔ, hɛ́ɛ nyin nɛn. Nɛnnyinii dɛ́ won ɡel he dɔ nyopɛo dɛ́ ɛ anɔ bwa kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel nyopɛo waa aa le Yeesu Kristo be la do he bambile bini wobɛlbwa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii yerɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛ́ dɔ nyopɛo. Hé ɡel he sie ɛɛ su waa waa ɛa tɛ heya, hɛ́ɛ jaamo.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel Yeesu Kristo waa la do he bambile bini kɛrɛdɛ hɛ́ɛ baɡle dɔŋa, dɛ́ɛ ja ba wejema bwa ne, dɛ́ ɡo wesoŋa yela ne kpɛɛra yela dɛ́ɛ jam Korowii he bambile bwa.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ ne anɔ la bwa haa dɛ bol la, hɛ́ɛ ɛa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu sɔn ta, dɛ́ che o nɛɛ dɛ́ɛ jam o Mɛɛ Korowii. Mmarare aa chɔ le tɛ Kristo tena deremi

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Haahna, hɛ́ɛ no he jaranar wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra ba ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu aa pɛa ɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: He baala ɡe, hɛ́ɛ nyin he haahna kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ban dɛ́ɛ panya.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Bechale, hɛ́ɛ no he nyare ne he mɛɛnanar waa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ dɛɛ lɛ Korowii sie.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Mɛɛnanar, he bɛ he bii dɛ́ɛ do bandia ne, ásɛ ba bambile ba chɔɡ.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Bonɔɔna ne toli ɡe, hɛ́ɛ no nɛra haa dɛ tom ba harɛ nɔ ta la waa saŋ bɛlbwa. He bɛ ba siebɔr na mɔɔ dɛ́ɛ tom ba dɛ́ɛ nyin baa kpɛɛ heya. Hé ta tea dɛ́ɛ tom ba ɔma haa dɛ ɔmɛ he Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nomanta.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa haa dɛɛ ɛ la, hɛ́ɛ ɛa bambile bwa ne kɛŋɔ he Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo he ɛ dɛɛ tɛ. Nɛn laa he ɛ dɛɛ tɛ.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: He Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo he ɛ dɛɛ tɛ. He jemɛ kɛŋɔ o bee hɛɛ ba kembɔr waa kpɔa cheɡ o nɛra la dɔe.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, wɛɛ dɔ o wechɔɡa kembɔree. Korowii aa bane siwii nyiŋi ɡwaa bane.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: He banɔ la haa dɔ bonɔɔna ne toli la, hɛ́ɛ ɛɛ ba waa aa toɡra dɛ do wer, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɡba lɔ nomɛl lɔɡa, o do Korowii doa. Wejaala ane ɡe wa

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Hé soŋe Korowii dɛ́ɛ tɛ ya ɡba, ásɛ o tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ ya won bol o Waa dɛ́ baɡle o wesɔɔhla aa ɛ Yeesu Kristo waa la. A waa ba koh do mɛ dea nɔ.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ soŋo ń won dɛɛ bola kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ ń bol a bwa a bini chaah la.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he wobol do som dɛ́ɛ lɛ sie saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ ba pɛɛ heyaa wobɛlbwa naa, hé won jemɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ he bol. Kala aa ka mun

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Yɔɔ, ya dɔŋ Tichikos yaa dɛ nyinu o waa dɔ kasinteŋ, wɛɛ cha yaa, ya ne o bwa ɛɛ ɛ ya Dɔɔ toma nɔ la, wɛɛ ba baɡle n waa bwa he bee.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: A waa mɛɛ tomɔ he be ó ba bol ya waa bwa, ásɛ he baah sɔɔh heyaa la.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: O ne ya dɔŋ Onisemɔs o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ yaa nyinu la bwaa mɛɛ tomɛ, ásɛ ba ba bol waa aa dɛ chiɡ bonɔ bwa he be. Onisemɔs te ɛ he bwɛɛ te.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Aristakus baa do n ne on dea la, ne Banabas nime Mak dɛ na heya. A ɡɛ Mak nɔ waa n faa bol he be la. O ba he be naa, hé lɛo silɛɛ ne.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Jeses baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Jastos la ɡe dɛ na heya. Juu tena baa yarada Yeesu la bini, nɛra batoro nɔ ɡboo dɛɛ cha mɛ, n ne baa ɛ Korowii Kora la toma. Ba dɛ cha mɛ taeh.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epafras waa ɛ he bwɛɛ te la dɛ na heya. O dɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo toma, dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛrɛdɛ ɡa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ o ɡel he won che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ jemɛ o waa kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo waa bɛ heyaa aahna-aahna ɛ, he won ɛ Korowii tetoowaa bwa.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: N ɡbabir na ɡɛ Epafras aa dɛ tomɛ he ne banɔ la baa lɔ Laodisia ne Heɛrapɔles la kohona.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Tɛɛɡa te Luk ya bwa aa dɛ nyinu la ne Demas ɡe dɛ na heya.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Hé ŋɔ yabala baa lɔ Laodisia la ne Nimfa ne asɔre tena baa dɛ cheme Nimfa dem la be ŋɔ n dɛ na ba.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Dɛ he baa kure tɔn nɔ tonaa, hé ɡel ba ka kuro baɡle asɔre tena baa lɔ Laodisia la. Tɔn maa tɛ ba ɡe la, hé lɛ dɛ́ ka kure.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Hé ŋɔ Akipus be ŋɔ ó do sie dɛ́ ɛ toma ya Dɔɔ Yeesu aa kpɔa tɛo la bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl ɡbaɡbaa chwerɛ bonɔ la, n dɛ na heya. Hɛ́ɛ lii n waa kɛ ba ta aa do mɛ jɔɡrɔre n chɔ dea, dɛ́ soŋe Korowii dɛ́ɛ tɛ mɛ. Kórowii sune he nɛ dɛ́ cha heya.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl ne Silas ne Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he nɛra haa ɛ asɔre tena dɛ do Tesalonika dɛɛ tomɛ N Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la. Kórowii cha heya, dɛ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Tesalonika asɔre tena yarada ne ba we-ɛɛla

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Ya dɛ jam Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ yon dɛɛ yerɛ he sɔna ya Korowii soŋa bini.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya jemɔ kɛ Korowii dɛ nyin heya, dɛ le heyaa ŋɔ hé ba ɛ o bii,

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ Amanesoma la yaa baɡle heyaa la, wobol ɡbo ta laa a che dɛ ba he be. Awola haa no waa la, Korowii kpeɡri la ne o Domadɛɛɡe la ɡelɔ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ɛ kpela. He jemɛ ɡɛ yaa koh he waa dɛ kpoŋe ya te ɡɛ saŋ ya ne haa soɡa la.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi yaa dɛ́ kpɔ ya ne ya Dɔɔ da la. Haa no Korowii Waa la dɛ yaradaa la, he na wahala ɡa, kɛ he wono lɛ Korowii Waa la silɛɛ aa le Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la be ne.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: Gɛ haa ɛa laanee chɔa dɛ tɛ nɛra baa yaradaa Makidoonia harɛ ne Akaya harɛ bwa, baa nyiŋi dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: He bee ya Dɔɔ la waa che dɛ perɛ baah bela bwa. Bela tena ɡbo laa noa, kɛ yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii la tel bobɛlbwa. Anomanta, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ yá bol he waa nɛra be kpa.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Ba ɡbabir dɛ bol he wa, ɡɛ haa kpoŋe yaa dɛ no ya be, dɛ charɛ he liire le voɡa aa wola mkpa dɔe la ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ dɔ mkpa la,

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: dɛ so kpa o Bie Yeesu waa dɛ ba nyundua lee dɛ ba la. Onee o chum seo ta la. Onee lɛ yaa le Korowii bandia waa dɛ ba bala la ta.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Yabala, he ɡbabir jemɔ kɛ chɔɔra yaa chɔɔ heyaa la ta pɛɛ ɛɛ.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: He jemɔ kɛ ba tɔ sie ɛ yaa hɔhɔrɔwa Felepae dɛ chɛɡre yaa taeh mɔɔ ya ba he be Amanesoma la ne la. Kɛ Korowii tɛ yaa bansua ya won bol o waa la.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Jae yaa dɛ ja nɛra la, kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ taa, neɡra laa yaa neɡre nɛra, wedoŋa ɡe laa ya lii.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Gɛ haa jema la, he kpɛɛra waa laa ya koh ba he be. Ya ta balɛ dɛ ba bol waa dɛ neɡre heyaa dɛ lɛ kwaane ɡe. Korowii ɡboo jema.

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: Ya ta sɔn nyine dɛ le he ne nomɛlbwa be.

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Ya ɛ Yeesu Kristo toroma, dɛ fe dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ya lɛ komɛl le he be. Kɛ ya tɛ heyaa sisɔna kɛŋɔ haah naa ta tea dɛɛ dɛɛ o bechasɔɔhna la.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Ya nyin he waa ya bambile bwa ne. Korowii Amanesoma la ɡbo ne laa ya ba he be. Yaa nyin he waa ɡɛ la, a ɛ yaa silɛɛ kɛŋɔ ya kpɔ ya te ja wobol la ta dɛ tɛ heya.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Yabala, haa ya toma ne ya koeh la waa lii kɛɛ? Ya ɛ toma chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa, ásɛ ya bɛ he bɛlbwa koeh do ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ he be dɛ bol Korowii Amanesoma la dɛɛ baɡle heyaa la.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: He nɛra haa yaradaa ne Korowii bwa ɛ ya danseɛ tena, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he nao kɛ ya we-ɛɛla wer, ya waa toɡre dɛ lɛ Korowii sie, doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: He nao ɡɛ yaa do he bini bɛlbwa ɡbemba ɡɛ baa yon dɛɛ ɛ o bii la.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Ya do heyaa ɡbemba dɛ larawe he bwara dɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé so sodɛɛɡa, ásɛ he waa lɛ Korowii sie. Onee le heyaa he ba ɛ o bii, dɛ kpɔ o Kora la ne o nyanyini la pera tɛ heya.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ jam Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ yaa bol Korowii Waa la he be la, he noa kɛŋɔ Korowii Wa. He ta an noɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn wa. Gɛɛ a do kpela. A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma he nɛra haa yaradaa nɔ bini la.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Yabala, he ne Korowii nɛra baa lɔ Juda harɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ wahala baa naa Juu tena be la, he ɡe na a dɔŋa he bwɛɛ tena be.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Juu tena nɔɔ kpo ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ne Korowii keamere la, dɛ hah yaa, dɛ doŋi yaa la. Gɛ nɛnchɔɡa nɔ aa Korowii siwi su. Ba ɛ nɛra bwa dɔm,

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba dɛ tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ ya bɛ Korowii Waa la bol chaɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ásɛ Korowii bɛ ban lɛ. Anomanta, ba wechɔɡa dɛ warɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ Korowii bwaawee ir ba nɛ. Pɔɔl aa dɛ nyin o berɛ ka na Tesalonika asɔre tena

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Ya te la, yabala, baa doŋi yaa le he be tɔpere tamaa nɔ la, ya ta he waa soɛh. Kɛ nae yaa wola heyaa na. Yaa le he be la, dɛ he be bala swɛɛ ya siwi, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ sikii lawɛ yaa taeh.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Ya sie beɡra aa beɡra nɔ, he bee ya hwɛɡa ne silɛɛ do. He waa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɛɛ ba yaa tɔɔ dawa, ya hɛɡre awola waa ba ya ba che o sie la.

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: He nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa ya dɔ sɔn ne silɛɛ.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Ya haŋrɔ kahonɛ, yaa wola he waa no la, ya liiro kɛŋɔ aa do werii kɛ ya tomɛ Timoti he be ásɛ a ka ya nɛra banɛ ɡbo Atens.

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: Timoti ɛ ya dɔŋ dɛ ɛ Korowii torome dɛɛ bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la wa. Ya tomɔ ó ba do heyaa ɡbemba dɛ́ ja heyaa he yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii la bɔr,

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: he bini bɛlbwa bɛ wahala nɔ waa koh dɛ́ chwa. He bwa jemɔ kɛ ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛ ya na.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Ya ne haa lole la, ya bol wahala nɔ waa dɛ ba bala nɔ waa he be he jemɛ wubwa. Asɛ ɡɛ yaa ŋɔa laanee bala la.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: A waa ɡela n haŋre kahonɛ dɛ tomɛ Timoti, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ he yarada bini kɛŋɔ Bɔnsam ken baa neɡre heyaa dɛ ɡel ya toma yaa baa ɛ la ken ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ. Gbemba wobol aa le Timoti be

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken Timoti aa le he be ba la, o ba amanesoma ne kɛŋɔ he dɛ yarada Korowii dɛɛ nyin nɛra ɡe. O ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ he dɛ lii ya waa kɛrɛdɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ nyin kɛ he na yaa ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyin heyaa dɛ na la.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya wahala ne ya wenaale yaa dɛ na nɔ, ya ɡel a bwa. He yarada ɡelɔ ya baah sɔɔh yaa he wa.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: Dɛ he lawɛ Korowii waa la kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ naa, dɛ ya dɔ bokpeɡa.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Bɔkwa jaamee yaa ba wona kpɔ tɛ Korowii he waɔ? Silɛɛ yaa dɔa le Korowii be nɔ kan. He waa ɡela ya sie lɛ la.

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ soŋe Korowii chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa, ásɛ dɛ na he siebɔr ja, dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba wona cha heyaa he yarada bini, ásɛ he do kpeɡri ja.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowii ɡbabir waa bera ɛ ya Mɛɛ la ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɛɛ chaɡle yaa ŋwɛnɛɛ ya ba he be.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu ja heyaa dɔŋa nyina kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ hɛɛ nyin nomɛlbwa ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyin heyaa la.

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɡeloo he do kpeɡri, dɛ bɛ wechɔɡa dɔ, dɛ́ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa N Naa Korowii waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ la be, awola o ne o toromedɛɛɡa la bwa aa ba la.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa jaa la, yabala, waa la haa hwela ya be ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ he so ásɛ Korowii sie lɛ he nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ la. Ya cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu naa ta dɛɛ ja heyaa ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ he ɛ dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: He jemɛ waa yaa cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ bol baɡle heyaa la.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyin kɛ he ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa dɛ laa he te kpɔ jwamane ta.

english_verse: Respect and honor your wife.
translation_verse: Báa bɛlbwa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛ wɛɛ mo haahnee ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: He bɛ siyala ne sibeɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta kpɔ kɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ baa wola Korowii tomɛ la.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa bɛ o dɔŋ nɛɛ jo a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɛɛ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ la deŋnee, ɡɛ yaa ja heyaa loɡla la ŋɔ hé nyiŋi a ta kɛrɛdɛ la.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa wola a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta teŋɛ la, dɛ nɛwɛnyini waa laa o vɛh, dɛ Korowii waa tɛ heyaa o Domadɛɛɡe la waa o vɛh.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Too. Ane ɡee la. A ta hiaih kɛ ya berɛ baɡle heyaa dɔŋa nyina waa kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii baɡle heyaa ŋɔ hé nyin dɔŋa.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, he dɛ nyin he bala baa lɔ Makidoonia harɛ la bwa. Yabala, ya dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛ he bɛ waa nɔ ɡel, kɛ hé ɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Hé takapɔ dɛ́ ɛ he te nɛŋɡwɛɡra dɛ bɛ nɛra waa ta dɛɛ jo. Hé kpɔ he bokpeɡa ɛ toma, dɛ bɛ he te kpɔ dɛɛ dawɛ nɛra nɛ, ɡɛ yaa ŋɔ he be wubwa la.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: He dɛ ɛ ken aa, hɛɛ dɔ jirima nɛra baa wola asɔre tena ɛɛ la bee, haa he tenee kpɔ dawɛ nɛra nɛ. Ya dɔɔ la bala

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya dɛ nyin kɛ ya bol yabala baa serewa la wa, ásɛ he tea bini bɛ chɔɡ kohona kɛŋɔ nɛra baa kaa, baa wola hwɛɡa dɔe kɛŋɔ yaa ir seo taa la.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Ya yaradao kɛ Yeesu sewɔ dɛ ir. Gɛ tentenee yaa yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ ba banɔ la baa yarada Yeesu mɔɔ dɛ serewe la kpɔe dɛ́ ja Yeesu nɛɛ ba ne o ba ɡɛ saŋ waa ba la.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ la waa waa bolaa nɔ. Ya banɔ la yaa so le dɛ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ ya Dɔɔ la aa ba la, yaa yabala baa serewa la siee tɔ kaa ya Dɔɔ be,

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ la ɡbabir ɛɛ le nyundua dɛ́ tu ba, dɛ́ ba yerɛ o nɛra takpeɡ ne, ásɛ o nyundua toroma nomoa ɡe yerɛ, Korowii bɛla si tɔ o sie, ásɛ banɔ la baa yarada Yeesu Kristo mɔɔ dɛ serewe la ir,

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: ásɛ Korowii kpɔ ba ne ya banɔ la ɡe ya ta aa soɡe le ɡɛ saŋ la bwa kaa nyundua baama bini, dɛ́ ka cheme ya Dɔɔ bela, ásɛ ya ne o so saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé kpɔ waa nɔ dɛɛ larawe dɔŋa bwara.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Yabala, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ń chwerɛ dɛ́ baɡle heyaa tɔpere la waa nɔ aa dɛ ba chiɡa,

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ he bwa jemɔ kpela kɛŋɔ tɔpere ya Dɔɔ la aa ba la ɛɛ piɡruu kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ aa dɛ piɡri nɛn jwaana la.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ nɛra aa ba ŋɔ, “Bobɛlbwa sɔɔhnɔ, ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna name te” la, belaa dɛ harɛchɔɡ la ɛɛ ba ba piɡra. Wɛɛ piɡruu kɛŋɔ haah naa kpoŋe tea asɛ lol tea lɔɔ la ken. Gɛ saŋ la, baa bɔree dɔ dɛ chwa ka sɔh.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Kɛ yabala, he te toole biro ta, he sie chaah waa nɔ ta. Anomanta, Yeesu bala la aa heyaa piɡri kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: He bwa sekwara ɛ nɛra he sie aa chaah Korowii waa ta. Biro bini nɛra laa yan, bochaah ta nɛraa yan.

english_verse: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya bɛ bɔhwaah ɛ kɛŋɔ bane aa dɛ ɛ la, kɛ hé ɡel ya sie chɔ harɛ yaa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Bɔhwaahra ne nɛra baa dɛ dɛɛ te bwa ɛ biro bini nɛra.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Ya te yaa ɛ bochaah ta nɛra nɔ, hé ɡel ya sie chɔ harɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ yarada ne nɛnnyin ɛ ya laa batakaare kɛŋɔ baa do laa batakaare dɛɛ yo laa la, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ hwɛɡa yaa dɔa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu be kɛŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ yaa la ɛ buni ɡbɛrɛ dɛ́ kpɔ pi.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Korowii ta yaa tae ŋɔ yá ba di bolchɔɡe o sie. O ta yaa ŋɔ yá che ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ ya nyu.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: Onee sewa tɛ yaa, ásɛ awola o balaa, dɛ ya soɡe mkpa ta noo, sewaa ya sewɛ oo, yá ne Korowii won pɛ.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ do dɔŋa ɡbemba dɛɛ cha dɔŋa, ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛ nɔ. Jae ne kala aa ka mun

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ duu nɛra baa ɛ he nomonome dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma nɔ dɛɛ ja heyaa la.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Ba toma la nomanta, hɛ́ɛ duu ba kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ nyin ba wa. Hé ɡel he bwa nyoa pɛ.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛ hɛ́ɛ ja banɔ la baa ɛ bɔhwaahra la, dɛɛ do ɔmeera la ɡbemba, dɛ lawɛ banɔ la baa wola cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta la kpoŋe, dɛ́ dɔ bambile tɛ nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ bɔ wechɔɡa kem, kɛ hé ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ he dɔŋa ne nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: dɛɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ jam Korowii wobɛlbwa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ Korowii che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛɛ baɡle o tetoowaa he be.

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Kɛ hé nyiŋi ba webaɡla, ásɛ dɛ lawɛ anɔ la aa wera la bini.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Hé laa he te kpɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Korowii waa dɛ tɛ yaa bosɔɔhna la, ó ɡbabir laa doŋa bwa kpɔ he nɛ, dɛ ɛ heyaa nɛndɛɛɡa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta ka tel kɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa ba.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Korowii waa le heyaa he ba ɛ o bii la, o ɛ kasinteŋ te. Onee dɛɛ ba heyaa nɛndɛɛɡa ɛɛ.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ yaa.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nyabii.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: N kpɔ ya Dɔɔ dɛɛ do heyaa kɛ hé kure tɔn nɔ baɡle yabala la bwa sekwaraa.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl ne Silvanos ne Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he nɛra haa ɛ asɔre tena haa lɔ Tesalonika dɛ ɛ N Naa Korowii waa bera ɛ ya Mɛɛ la ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛra la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Korowii jaama ne wesoŋa

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya koh he waa dɛ yon dɛɛ jam Korowii. He chɛ ɡɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii la dɛ kaa sie saŋ bɛlbwa. Nyina haa dɛ nyin dɔŋa la ɡe ɡba dɛ do kan ja.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Ya ɡbaɡba dɛ bol he waa dɛɛ baɡle asɔre tena baa cheme bobɛlbwa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la, dɛɛ kpɛɛ heya. Ya dɛ ŋɔ ba be ɡɛ nɛra aa dɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa, aa no heyaa saŋ bɛlbwa, asɛ he dɔ bambile haa wola habɔɔ le dɛ ta teŋɛ dɛɛ yarada Yeesu la.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: He we-ɛɛla baɡlɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii bole waa pa heyaa la toɡrɔ. Haa koh o Kora waa dɛɛ na hɔhɔrɔwa nɔ, anee dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ he chɛ o Kora la ta jae.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Kɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa la te, Korowii ɛɛ bɔ ba a kemee. O we-ɛɛla toɡrɔ. Ó ɛɛ ba ɡɛ hɔhɔrɔwa la,

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel he bwara sɔɔh heya. Ya ne he bwaa dɛɛ ba bosɔɔhna la dɔe ɡɛ saŋ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa forɛ le nyundua o ne o nyundua toroma baa dɛ di kpeɡri ne nii nɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: O balaa, wɛɛ bol nɛra baa wola Korowii jemɛ, baa wola Amanesoma aa dɛ baɡle ya Dɔɔ Yeesu waa noɛ la waa, dɛ́ bɔ ba a kem,

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: dɛ́ per ba le o be. Baa o kpeɡri aa ɡela o dɔ jirima laanee na kpa, ásɛ o kpɔ hɔhɔrɔwa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ta ba nɛ.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Awola waa ba o tɔpejen la ta ásɛ o nɛra tɛo duure la, nɛra baa yaradao la bwa ɛɛ nao dɛ́ kpɛɛro. He ɡba jao, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya fa aa baɡle heyaa o waa la, he noɔ dɛ teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Yeesu bala la waa ya yon dɛɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ o cha heyaa he soɡa bini won maɡre dɛ́ chɛ lee waa le heyaa dɛ tɛ o te la, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa kpeɡri he won ɛ wedɛɛɡa la bwa aa lɔ he bambile bini ne wobɛlbwa haa ŋɔ hé ɛ, yarada haa yaradao la nomanta.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ soŋe Korowii ɡɛ, ásɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu sɔn won dɔ jirima dɛ́ le he we-ɛɛla ta, ásɛ he ɡe ɡba won dɔ jirima dɛ́ le o be. N Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo suna waa dɛ sune ya nɛɛ dɛɛ cha yaa la nomanta, á bwa won ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Yabala, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bala waa ne ɡɛ ya bwa aa dɛ ba o be chema la, n dɛ soŋe heya,

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: hɛ́ɛ lii a waa kɛrɛdɛ. Maa nyin nomɛlbwa bol wetamaa ane, ásɛ he den ɔmɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ balɔ kaa. Dɛ ba ŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe baɡ ba ɡɛ baa bol, kɛɛ dɛ he na tɔn bɛl o neɡre heyaa kɛŋɔ yanee chwerɔ waa, he bɛ no dɛ́ ɡel a ɛ heyaa waane.

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ ɛ o tenee dɛ́ ɡwaa komɛlbwa nɛra aa dɛ toma dɛɛ yera ba dɔɔranar, hale wɛɛ kpɔ Korowii Dea berɛ sobɔr dɛ́ ŋɔ onee Korowii.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Haa lii kɛŋɔ n fa aa lɔ he be la dɛ n dɛ baɡle heyaa ɡɛ waa nɔ naa?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ komɛlee tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ o le kahonɛ la, nemenɛ o saŋ tel.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Wechɔɡa dɔɔ ba taraken, kɛ aa won dɔ bɔr kohona, nemenɛ kon la waa tɔa ŋwɛnɛ la le mɔɔ.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Dɛ kon waa tɔa ŋwɛnɛ la baa le aa, belaa Wechɔɡa Te la ɛɛ ba bochaah lee nɛra jemɔ. Kɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bala jirima ne o nyoa peu ɡbo kwara ɛɛ won kpoo buɡ ta.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa bwa soo siwi aa lole, dɛ́ won dɛɛ neɡre nɛra baa nyoɡra dɛɛ ba chɔɡa la. Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ baa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba vɛh kasinteŋ waa aa dɛ ba wona lɛɛ ba la, ba ta o waa nyine.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Anomanta, o ɡelɔ nyosone o nyoa aa kpeɡa ɛɛ ba ba be dɛ ba tɔɔɡe ba sie, asɛ baa yarada waa aa ɛ nyosone,

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: ásɛ o won pa nomɛlbwa waa wola sɛɛh dɛ teŋɛ o kasinteŋ waa la ta kɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa o sie lɛ a ta la bolchɔɡe. Kiŋkiŋ cheɡa wa

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Anomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ yá jam Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa he wa, yabala. O dɛ nyin heyaa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ le harɛ mumpar la bwa le heyaa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ heyaa. O Domadɛɛɡe aa ɡela he doŋa bwa le he nɛɛ la, ne ɡɛ haa no o kasinteŋ waa dɛ yaradaa la, a waa o lɛ heyaa la.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Yanee fa bol Amanesoma la baɡle heyaa he no la, asɛ Korowii che a ta le heyaa ásɛ he ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo won pɛ dɔ jirima.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Anomanta, yabala, hé lawɛ kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ teŋɛ waa la bwa yaa kpɔ nyoa dɛ baɡle heya, ne anɔ la yaa chwera tɔn ta dɛ tɛ heyaa la ta. Hé ɡel a bwa do he nyu bini kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ɡbaɡba ne N Naa Korowii waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ dɛɛ nyin yaa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ sune ya nɛɛ dɛ cha yaa, dɛ tɛ yaa hwɛɡa aa wera ne ɡbemba aa wola tonɛ bwa la,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: bá tɛ heyaa ɡbemba dɛ ɡel he che kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ dɛ won ɛ wedɛɛɡa te bɛlbwa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ bola ɡe.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa kaa la, yabala, hé soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ ya ɡba, ásɛ ya Dɔɔ waa la won perɛ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ won dɔ jirima, ásɛ nɛra no kɛŋɔ ɡɛ he ɡe fa aa noa la.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Hé soŋo o lɛ yaa dɛɛ le meesɔɔh tena ne nɛnchɔɡa be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa laa dɛ́ no waa yaa dɛ bol la dɛ yaradaa.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii waa dɔ kasinteŋ la, wɛɛ ɡeloo hɛɛ kpeɡ waa la ta teŋa ta, dɛ́ lɛ heyaa le Bɔnsam nɔn ta o bɛ heyaa dɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
