translation_verse: Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, ásɛ he won jemɛ nyina Korowii aa nyin heya, ne bambile Yeesu Kristo aa lawa o hɔhɔrɔwa la bini la. Sie doe dɛɛ ɛ toma

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Yabala, ya cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn ta dɛɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, he bini bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ bɔhwaah o ta sɛɛh dɛɛ ɛ toma ɡɛ yaa baɡla la aa, hé ɡelo, he ne o bɛ pɛ.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Ya fa aa lɔ he be la, dɛ ya ta bɔhwaahra ɛɛ. Anomanta, he jemɛ ɡɛ haa ɛ dɛ́ teŋɛ ya nɛ.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: Ya ta nomɛlbwa kondikwaa dii pɛɛpɛɛ. Ya ɛ toma chɔɔ ne jwaana dɛɛ koh kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ bɛ heyaa ha ya kondikwaa wa.

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ no he waa kɛŋɔ he bane ta sɛɛh dɛɛ ɛ toma, dɛ valɛ pɛɛpɛɛ dɛ kpɔ nyoa dɛɛ do nɛra waa ta.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Ya cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn ta dɛɛ ŋɔ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ be ŋɔ bá do sie dɛɛ ɛ ba ɡbaɡba toma dɛɛ di ba koeh ta.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ la, dɛ bɛ ŋɔ he koɔh.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa ta sɛɛh kɛ wɛɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ yaa ŋɔa tɔn nɔ bini nɔ taa yaa, hé nyiŋu kɛrɛdɛ. He ne o bɛ pɛ dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa, ásɛ sihiih kpoo.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ hé kpɔɔ berɛ he dɔm te, kɛ hé jao kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ ja he nimanar. Kala aa ka mun

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la ɡbaɡba waa dɔ bambisɔn kɛrɛdɛ la, ó tɛ heyaa bambisɔn saŋ bɛlbwa, wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ ja he bwa nɛ.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome laanee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ. Korowii waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ ne Yeesu Kristo yaa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ laanee do mɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ bol o waa nɔ.

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: N bie Timotii n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ. Menee bol Korowii Waa he no dɛ yarada, dɛ berɛ n bie a ta la. Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo chae dɛ́ na he sum, dɛ́ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna. Korowii dɛ kah nyosonteŋna o waa baɡla ta

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ ba bɛ ɡel nyosone la ne ɡɛ baa dɛ baɡle ba naanar leebɔra baa wola a nyoa na bwa la lɛ ba liire. Wetɔŋla ɡbo nee ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ba. Korowii toma ŋwɛnɛre laa baa baɡle la, dɛkalkɛ yarada ɡbo taa a che baa jemɛ Korowii toma ŋwɛnɛre.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Waa maa koh a waa doe waa nɔ ta laanee kɛŋɔ bá won dɔ nɛnnyin. Nɛn waa dɔ nɛnnyin nɔ soo la ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa dɔe, o tea too, o dɔ yarada kasinteŋ.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Nɛra bane ɡel ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ ka teŋɛ wesale aa wola mun dɔe bola ta.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ nyin kɛ ba ɛ ba te kɛ nɛra baa dɛ chaɡle nɛra Korowii Mmara la, kɛ waa ba siwi yon swɛɛ a ta baa bol la, ba ɡba aa a mun jemɛ.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Ya bwa jemɔ kɛ dɛ nɛn wono ɛ ɡɛ Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle la aa, Mmara la wer tɛo.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa waa laa ba koh dɛɛ do mmara, kɛ nɛra baa wola mmara ta teŋɛ la, ne deŋnekpeɡ tena, ne nɛra baa vɛh Korowii la, ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, ne nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ, baa wola on duu la, ne nɛra baa dɛ kpoo ba mɛɛnanar ne ba nyare, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ kpo nɛra bwa,

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: ne jwamane tena, ne baala ba ne ba bandɔŋa aa dɛ chɔ haah ne baa, ne nɛra baa lawɛ nɛra dɛɛ yoɡ ba kɛ yoma, ne nyosonteŋna, ne nɛra ba yon jemɛ kɛ nyosonee baa teŋe dɛ ɡarɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ Korowii la, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ we-ɛɛla te bɛlbwa a ne webaɡla aa toɡra la aa wola kaa la, ba waa ba koh dɛɛ do mmara.

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: N dɛ jam ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa tɛ mɛ o kpeɡri la kɛ waa yarada mɛ dɛ kpɔ o toma nɔ do n nɔn ta nɔ.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: A lole kɛ n fa dɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo la nɛnhɛla, dɛɛ ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa, n siwi sao mɛɛ yoo. Kɛ Korowii na n sum, dɛkalkɛ maa wola Korowii yarada dɔe n bini la, dɛ maa jemɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: O sune n nɛɛ kohona dɛ cha mɛ taeh n dɔ yarada ne nɛnnyin yaa dɔa le pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la ta.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Waa nɔ ɛ kasinteŋ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé lɛa kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa Yeesu Kristo koh ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ba lɛɛ ba. N wechɔɡaa kana ɡwaa nomɛlbwa kwa.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii sune n nɛ, asɛ Yeesu Kristo dɔ bambile tɛ mɛ n wechɔɡa damanta nɔ bwa ta, ásɛ nɛra baa ba no Korowii waa dɛ yaradao la jemɛ ɡɛ Yeesu aa dɔ bambile kohona, dɛ́ won yaradao dɛ́ dɔ o mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Yá kpɔ duure tɛ Koojen la o Kora dii aa wola jaɡa dɔe, waa wola sewɛ bwa, baa wola won on na, o ɡbo aa ɛ Korowii la, dɛɛ ɡuŋu harɛ fini ne tɔpere bɛlbwa. Aamen.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: N bie Timoti, n dɔ waane dɛ́ bol he be, ásɛ he lawɛ a bini he Korowii toma ta. Gɛ ba fa aa cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛ bol o toma waa tɛɛ kpeɡri hɛ́ɛ ɛ nɔ waa la, ɡɛ waa la tenten taa mɛɛ doe la. Anomanta, ɡel ɡɛ waa la doe ɡbemba ásɛ he won yo kɛrɛdɛ,

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ kpoŋe Korowii yarada bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛɛ ɛ waa haa jema kɛ a toɡrɔ. Gɛɛ bane aa wola ɛɛ, asɛ ba ta wone yarada Korowii ka tonɛ dɛ horɛ la.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa hora la bini banee Haemenayɔs ne Alɛksanda. N kpɔ ba do Bɔnsam nɔn ta, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ baa Korowii nɛnhɛla ɛ.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa tɔ sie mɛɛ ja asɔre tena kɛŋɔ báa teŋɛ a ta laanee kɛ hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa. Hɛ́ɛ soŋo dɛɛ jaamo wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: Hé soŋo dɛɛ tɛ koranar ne nɛra baa dɛ di nomonome bwa, ásɛ ya bwa so bosɔɔhna ta jeih ken, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ aa chɛa, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera o be.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ wera, dɛɛ lɛ ya Lɛɛ Korowii sie.

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: O te dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa dɔ o nyu, ásɛ dɛ ba jemɛ kasinteŋ waa la.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Anee kɛ Korowii beŋkpoŋii lole, dɛ dɔ nachiɡe beŋkpoŋ do o ne nɛwɛnyini baah ta, o ɡe ɛ nɛn. Onee Yeesu Kristo

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Anɔ waa Korowii lee mɛ ŋɔ ń lɔ a dawuro baɡle nɛra, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ Yeesu torome ɡe la. Kasinteŋii mɛɛ bol la, maa nyosone teŋe. Onee ɡela mɛɛ baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ásɛ ba yarada Yeesu dɛ́ jemɛ kasinteŋ la.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ bobɛlbwa baala baa ɛ asɔre tena la laa ba te kpɔ bandisale ne wetɔŋla ta, ásɛ dɛ won ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa dɛ́ ir nɔɔra soŋe Korowii.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee mɛɛ nyin kɛ dɛ haahna dɛ ba laala doe yaa, ba bɛ jwamanlaala ne laala a waa aa do bola dɛɛ do. Bá kpɔ laala aa maɡre ba ne, dɛ bɛ ba te kpɔ do nyuune ɛɛ aa dɛ ba kem ne, ne suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare doe, ne yale a yoɡ aa kpeɡa liɡa ta.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Kɛ báa ɛ wedɛɛɡa kɛ haahna baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii. Ba wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ laanee dɛ́ ɡel ba do wer toli.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: A wer kɛŋɔ haahna ɛɛ pwɛr ba te, dɛ cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no Korowii Waa baa dɛ baɡ ba la.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: N ta ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛŋɔ haahna di nomonome baala nɛɛ dɛɛ baɡle wa. A chɛ kɛŋɔ bá tɔ ba nyoa dɛɛ no,

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ Adamee Korowii tɔ sie ta mɔɔ dɛ ta o haah Hawa.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Adam ɡe kwaraa laa Bɔnsam neɡre la. Hawaa o neɡre dɛ ɡel o ɛ wechɔɡa la.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ dɛ nɛn ŋɔ wɛɛ tɔ asɔre tena siee yaa, dɛ tondɛɛɡa tentenee naate ɛɛ nyin la.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛn la, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra dɔ o wechɔɡe bol. A chɛ kɛ o haah ɛ beŋkpoŋ. A chɛ kɛ o won o te lawa, dɛ dɔ nfɛrɛ, o we-ɛɛla ɛɛ lɛ nɛra sie. A chɛ kɛ o ɛ nɛn waa won hɔɔhra kpoŋa, dɛ won Korowii Waa baɡla.

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ sennyɔdɛɛ, ó bɛ naɡrenyini ɛ. Kɛ ó ɛ nɛn waa pwɛra, waa wola o bwara ne waa nyin. A ta chɛ kɛ o siwi beɡre suuɡa.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ó won o haah ne bii nyiŋa, asɛ o bii ɛɛ no o deŋna waa dɛɛ tɛo duure.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn aa won o haah ne bii nyiŋi aa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won nyiŋi asɔre tena nɛɔ?

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ ó ɛ nɛn nɛra baa wola asɔre tena ɛɛ kwara aa dɛ yerɛ o sɔndɛɛɡe, asɛ o bɛ sihiih waane ba ɛ dɛ́ le Bɔnsam bel ta.

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ bá kpoŋe Korowii wesɔɔhla waa waa ɡela ya jemɛ la bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛɛ ɛ waa baa naa kɛ a toɡrɔ.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: A wer kɛŋɔ hé nyiŋi ba waa bini, dɛ́ na dɛ ba waa wer mɔɔ he tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ bá ɛ ɡɛ toma la.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ba haahna chɛ kɛ baa ɛ waa aa dɔ duure, dɛ bɛ nɛra dɛɛ ŋwalɛ. A chɛ kɛ bá won ba te lawa, dɛ́ kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa waa chɔ asɔre tomare nyoa la haah ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ won o haah ne bii nyiŋa kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ ba toma kɛrɛdɛ la dɛ dɔ sɔn, dɛɛ do kpeɡri yarada baa dɔa dɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛ n wonaa, ń ba nae. Kɛ n tɔ sie chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ,

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ n baa biɡri aa, tɔ́n nɔ baɡle ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ yá banɔ la Korowii aa kpɔ yaa ɛ o dem tena nɔ so dɛɛ ɛ ya wa. Yanee Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la toroma, o kpɔ o kasinteŋ waa la tɛ ŋɔ yá lawɛ a bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ, kɛ pila yon lawɛ dea kpoŋe la.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Ŋwɛnɛ yaa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii nɔ, tɔŋla toole kɛ wesɔɔhla aa lɔ o ta, asɛ Korowii ɡel ya jemɛ la ɛ wejena kohona. Waa yaa lawɛ a bini kpoŋe laanee, Korowii baa berɛ o te nɛwɛnyini. O Domadɛɛɡe la ɡelɔ nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛ o waa toɡrɔ. Nyundua toroma nao. Nɛra bol o waa baɡle harɛ nɔ ta nɛra baa lɔ bobɛlbwa. Ba no o waa harɛ nɔ ta dɛ yaradao, asɛ Korowii kpɔɔ kaa nyundua o ka dɔ jirima.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la pili waa nɔ bini chasee ken baɡle heyaa ŋɔ, kerekere la nɛra bane ɛɛ vɛh Yeesu waa nɔɔ dɛ́ kaa yarada koŋkwaa aa dɛ neɡ ba, ásɛ dɛɛ no a be.

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra nɔɔ vala dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra ŋɔ aa were kɛ baa mo haah kɛɛ haah yalɛ la, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ kondikwaa ane aa were kɛŋɔ nɛra di la. Kɛ Korowiirii ta ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ ŋɔ bánɔ la baa jemɛ kasinteŋ waa la dɛɛ yaradao la kpɔ jam tɛo dɛ́ dia.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Korowii kontaala te bwa wer. Dɛ ya kpɔ jam tɛo mɔɔ dɛ lɛa te naa, ate dɛ komɛlbwa ta vɛɛh doe,

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ haa jam Korowii la ne Korowii ɡbaɡba wobol la won ɡela a do wer Korowii be ásɛ nɛn di.

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Dɛ he kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡle he bala aa, anee dɛɛ ba chaɡla kɛŋɔ he ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome tenten haa teŋɛ Korowii waa haa yaradaa ne kasinteŋ la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ kpeɡ dɛ́ do kpeɡri.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Laa he te kpɔ wobosale aa wola Korowii waa ɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ nyin a bola la ta, dɛ swɛɛ siwi hweli ɡɛ haa dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa la ta.

english_verse: As the saying goes, “Exercise is good for your body, but religion helps you in every way. It promises life now and forever.” These words are worthwhile and should not be forgotten.
translation_verse: Gɛ waa nɔ ɛ kpela tɔŋla aa wola toole a ta kwaraa. Anomanta, no dɛ́ lawɛ a bini kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Koeh yaa dɛ swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ o toma nɔ bwa, Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la nɛɛ ya sie dawɛ. Onee dɛɛ lɛ nɛn te bɛlbwa. Nomɛlbwa waa yaradao dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo la, o dɛ lɛo.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ chaɡ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa dɛɛ ja ba báa teŋɛ a ta.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel nɛra koh kɛ he ɛ bechala nomanta, dɛɛ ɛɛ sisawa, kɛ ɡel nɛra baa yarada Yeesu la na ɡɛ haa dɛ bol wa, ɡɛ he da aa doa, ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin nɛn, ɡɛ haa yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo, ne ɡɛ haa laa he te kpɔ wedoŋa ta, ásɛ dɛ hweli waa le a ta.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Do sie kure Korowii Tɔn dɛɛ baɡ ba cheremibɔra, dɛɛ bol Korowii Waa la dɛɛ chaɡ ba a bini ka tel ɡɛ saŋ maa ba.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa chae he dɔ dɛ le awola nomonome la aa kpɔ nɔɔra darawe he nɛɛ dɛ che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛ bol a waa la, bɛ ɡel a ɛ pɛɛ.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ ɛa, ásɛ nɛra bwa na ɡɛ he toma aa dɛ kaa kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ he soɡa bini ne he webaɡla bini. Kpoŋe a bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ baɡle nɛra la. Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, hɛɛ lɛ he ɡbaɡba ne nɛra baa dɛ no he be la bwaa.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Dɛ baa waa ɡwaale nomoa ɛ waane aa wola weraa, bɛ o nɛɛ nyɛɡ, kɛ bol waa baɡlo kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba mɛɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ ɛ bibaala haa ɛ nomoa ka tɛɛ ba la ɡe kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba nimanar,

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: dɛ́ kpɔ haahna baa ɡwaale nomonome la ɛ he nyare. Ásɛ bihaahna haa ɡwaa ba la ɡe, hɛ́ɛ ɛɛ ba kɛ he nimambii, wedoŋa bɛlbwa bɛ he ne ba baah ta do.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Haahna ba jaranar aa serewa baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la, dɛɛ duu ba dɛɛ cha ba.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ luhaah bɛl lole dɛ dɔ bii kɛɛ naanar aa, a chɛ kɛ ba jemɛ ɡɛ ba ne waa so, ba nyiŋu, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a wer kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta la ɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ nyiŋi ba lolanar ɡɛ ba ɡe fa aa koh ba nɛɛ la. Gɛɛ dɛɛ su Korowii siwi.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Luhaah waa nyaa o ta nɛn dɔe ó nyiŋi o nɛɛ la te, Korowii nɛɛ o sie dawɛ wɛɛ soŋo chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa ó chao.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Kɛ luhaah bodia wa aa dɛ lɛ o sie la, o soɡe le te, kɛ o do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa sewa.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Ja ba ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, ásɛ nɛra bɛ ba bwara wechɔɡe dɔ bol.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl lole, waa o nya ne o mɛɛ kɛɛ o dem tena nyiŋi aa, naate Korowii toma ɛ pɛɛ. Naate waa wola Korowii yarada ɡba bɔɔ.

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: nɛra bwa jemɛ o wedɛɛɡa waa ɛa wa, kɛŋɔ waa wona dɛɛ o bii ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta ba ɛ bechadɛɛɡa, dɛ won dɛɛ kpoŋe hɔɔhra kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ pwɛr o te ɛ toma tɛ asɔre tena, dɛ won cha nɛra wa aa puu ba, asɛ dɛ won kpɔ o te bwa tɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ɡbo la waa mɛɛ bol he be ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Bɛ luhaahna ba taa ɛ toli kure ja luhaahna maa bol ba waa nɔ nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba pɛla ɛɛ ba lawɛ yalee, ba ɡel Yeesu Kristo toma la dɛ́ ka yalɛ,

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Luhaahna nɔ dɔŋa, baa wedɛɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe dɛɛ ɛ ka ja kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ valɛ deremi ta pɛɛpɛɛ. A ɡbo laa. Ba kpɔ nyoa dɛɛ do nɛra waa ta, dɛɛ ŋwalɛ nɛra, asɛ dɛɛ bol waa aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba bol bwa.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ luhaahna ba taa ɛ toli la yalɔ dɛ loɡle bii, dɛ won ba deremi ta nyiŋa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ya dɔma bɛ wedoŋa bɛlbwa dɔ bol yaɡɛ yaa aa, ɡɛɛ n fe ɛɛ nyin.

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: Taraken ɡba, luhaahna bane dɔɔ le Yeesu Kristo habɔɔ dɛ ka teŋɛ Bɔnsam nɛɛ tonɛ.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Haah bɛlbwa waa ɛ asɔre te asɛ luhaahna do o dem la, ó takapɔ kɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi luhaahna laanee, ásɛ dɛ bɛ koeh la bwa kpɔ dawɛ asɔre tena nɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ asɔre ɡe won nyiŋi luhaahna la baa wola nɛra dɔe bá nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Asɔre nomonome la baa dɛ tɔ asɔre tena sie kɛrɛdɛ la chɛ kembɔr bele anɛ. Banee kɛŋɔ banɔ la ba sie aa dɛ beɡre Korowii Waa la bola ne a chaɡla ta la,

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ a lɔ Korowii Tɔn la bini kɛ, “He bɛ nao waa dɛ ɛ toma he koo ta la nyoa vɔwɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ o bɛ kwaa di.” Dɛ berɛ chwerɛ do o bini ja ŋɔ, “Tom-ɛɛ bɛlbwa kembɔr chɛo.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl ba he be dɛ ba kpɔ waa dɛ dawɛ asɔre nomoa bɛl aa, bɛ no nemenɛ nɛn nɛɛte ne toorote baa di danseɛ kɛ waa la ɛ kasinteŋ mɔɔ he no dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wa.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Dɛ bɛl ɛ wechɔɡa aa, yerɔ cheme asɔre tena la bwa sie dɛ́ kaoh. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛ na la ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ dɛ laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: N cheɡɛ Korowii ne Yeesu Kristo ne nyundua toroma la bwa sie dɛ kpɔ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, ásɛ he we-ɛɛla bwa ta la, he bɛ ɡel nɛra bane waa su he siwi dɛ ɡwaa bane, kɛ dɛɛ ɛ ba bwa kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Bɛ totoo kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ nomɛlbwa nɛɛ dɛ leo ŋɔ ó ɛ Korowii toma, ásɛ dɛ naate ta ba wone kpoŋe tom la bini dɛ ka ɛ wechɔɡa aa, a ba maali. Nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel wedoŋa bɛlbwa maali.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: He tea la ne ɡɛ he bwara yon dɛɛ wee warawara la nomanta, bɛ nee ɡbo dɛɛ nyɔ kpa. He ɛo waa, hɛ́ɛ nyɔ sen ɡe tama.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Nɛra bane lole, ba te ne wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ nɛra bwa nao, a yon che a ta ba la ba ne kɔɔto ka pa ba bolchɔɡe. Kɛ nɛra bane ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa aa, waa la peu dɛ kaa kwaraa mɔɔ nɛra jemɛ.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ɡe aa wola won sɔh. Dɛ nɛn ɛ wedɛɛɡa sɔh ɡba aa, aa le baŋee.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ɛ nɛndɔɔla la chɛ kɛŋɔ baa ɔmɛ ba dɔɔranar dɛɛ duu ba, ásɛ nɛra bɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɔ bol wechɔɡa yaɡɛ Korowii ne waa nɔ yaa dɛ chaɡle nɔ.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Nɛndɔɔla ba ne ba dɔɔranar bwa aa dɛ yarada Yeesu la bɛ koh kɛ ba ne ba bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ nomanta, ba siwi ɛɛ sa ba. Ba tenee chɛ kɛ bá tomɛ ba dɔɔranar kɛrɛdɛ kwara, dɛkalkɛ ba dɔɔranar la bwa ɡe yarada Yeesu dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa. Bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡ ba, dɛ́ chaɡ ba a bini. Neɡra webaɡla ne kondɔɔh tenten wa

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ chaɡle Korowii Wa, asɛ a korɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo kasinteŋ waa la ta, ne ɡɛ yaa dɛ chaɡle nɛra ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la ta la,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: naate dɛ maŋkura o te pɛɛpɛɛ. Waa wobɛlbwa jemɛ. Wetɔŋla dɛ weo choɡla, asɛ wetama bɛlbwa dɛ o dɛ vuuɡa. Gɛ waa nɔɔ dɛɛ ba bɔweela ne naɡra ne dɔŋa chɛɡra ne liichɔɡa ne la.

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: Gɛ te la ne nɛra baa wola wedɛɛɡa lii, baa wola ya kasinteŋ waa la jemɛ la, ba dɛ saɡɛ wetɔŋla aa wola mun dɔe ta, dɛ yon dɛɛ lii kɛ Korowii toma ɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ nyin suuɡa.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Nɛn haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, he siwi ɛɛ su komɛlbwa Korowii aa tɛɛ la, he ɛ kondɔɔh tenten.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Baa lolɛ yaa la, ya ta komɛlbwa ne harɛ nɔ ta balɛ. Gɛɛ a do ya seo tɔpere ɡe, yaa wola won kpɔ komɛlbwa le bonɔ kaa.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ ya dɔ kwaa yaa di, dɛ dɔ yale dɛɛ tɔ aa, hé ɡel a maɡre ya ne.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba siwi aa swɛɛ suuɡa ta la dɛ́ chole. Suuɡa sibeɡra dɛ neɡ ba dɛɛ do pɛlchɔɡa ta, dɛ ɡel baa na wa, dɛɛ pɛlɛ konsale ne waa aa dɛ ba waa ne nɛ, dɛ yon ɡel ba chɔɡ kwaraa.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Suuɡa nyin kohona taa wechɔɡa bwa soo siwi ɛɛ le. Bane teŋɛ suuɡa nɛɛ kohona dɛ nyoɡre Korowii ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ ɡel suna dii berɛ ka ba name. Pɔɔl doe waa do Timoti

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Hei, Timoti! Haa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ nɔ, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ke he te ɡɛ waa la te bwa ta, dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi, dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ yaradao, dɛɛ nyin nɛn, dɛ́ won bambile lawa wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ do pwɛre.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii nɔ, yodɛɛɡee hɛɛ yo ɡɛ la. Anomanta, yo kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la. A ɡɛ mkpa nɔɔ Korowii lee ŋɔ he ba dɔ ɡɛ saŋ haa cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ dɛ bol ɡɛ haa yarada Yeesu Kristo baɡle nɛnlaa la.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Korowii waa tɛ komɛlbwa mkpa la, ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la waa wona dɛ che Pɔnteɔs Paelet sie dɛ bol kasinteŋ la sɔn taa n che dɛɛ jae

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: kɛ hé lawɛ waa nɔ bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɡel a toɡre, ásɛ nɛra bɛ a wobɛlbwa dɔ bol dɛ́ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa berɛ ba ja.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Dɛ o tɔpere baa telaa, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ó berɛ ba. Korowiirii chɛ kpɛɛra. O ɡboo ɛ komɛlbwa nyu. Koranar Bwa Kooroo on, asɛ dɔɔranar bwa ɡe Dɔɔree on.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: O ɡboo dɔ mkpa waa wola sewɛ bwa, dɛ so bela aa chaahna kohona nomɛlbwa aa wola won tel o jwɛh. Nomɛlbwa ta on nae ka, asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe aa won nao bwa. Onee chɛ duure ne kpeɡri bwa dɔe saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Aamen.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Bol waa nɔ nɛra baa ɛ dɔɔhna harɛ nɔ ta la be ŋɔ, ba bɛ ɡel ba nyu bini do ba som kohona, dɛ bɛ hwɛɡa kpɔ do a ɡɛ kondɔɔh aa won tona dɛ won hee la ta. Kɛ bá kpɔ ba hwɛɡa do Korowii waa ta tea dɛɛ tɛ yaa komɛlbwa asɛ ya won kpɔ dɛɛ lɛ ya sie la nɛ.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ ba be báa ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ wedɛɛɡa berɛ ba kondɔɔh, bá won ba tea tae dɛɛ kɛ nɛra bwa kwa.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, an dɛɛ ba kerekere kondɔɔh aa wola chɔɡ bwa nyina cheɡ ba nyundua. A taa baa ba wona dɔ mkpa tenten la.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ taa bane teŋɛ dɛ nyoɡre Korowii kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ la. Ń Naa Korowii sune he nɛ, dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ. A too Korowii tea o lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ka bol mkpa waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ yá che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɔ la wa.

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: N bidɛɛɡe Timoti, n dɛ nae. Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo chae, dɛ́ na he sum, dɛ́ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna. Jaama ne ɡbemba doe wa

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: N dɛ jam Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ tepoŋ ne ɡɛ tenten n naawa fa aa dɛ tomɔ la he wa. N Korowii soŋa ta bwaa mɛɛ jaamo he waa chɔɔ ne jwaana.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: N lii wii awola haa wia la aa, ɡɛɛ n sie che chiŋ mɛɛ nyin n ba nae ásɛ n sie lɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: N dɛ lii ɡɛ haa kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ yarada Korowii ɡɛ he naa Lowis ne he nya Yunis fa aa dɛ yaradao la. N jemɔ kɛ ɡɛ ba fa aa yarada Korowii dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo la, ba luɡe taa he den teŋɛ la.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: A waa ɡela mɛɛ liiri kɛŋɔ hé ir nyu ne dɛ́ kpɔ Korowii kpeɡri awola maa kpɔ nɔn dawɛ he nɛɛ dɛ swee tɛɛ o kpɔ tɛɛ la ɛ toma,

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ Korowii Doma waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ta ɡelɛ ya ɛ ɔmeera. O ɡelɔ ya dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ dɔ dɔŋa nyina, dɛ won ya te lawa.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɡel a ɛɛ sihiih kɛ haa dɛ bol ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra. Bɛ ɡel n ɡe waa dɔe sihiih kɛ baa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ do mɛ dea la. Kɛ hé ɡe che Korowii kpeɡri waa kpɔa tɛɛ la ta, dɛɛ na waa Amanesoma la wa.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Onee lɛ yaa, dɛ le yaa ŋɔ yá ba ɛ o nɛra dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ tɛo. Ya tondɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa laa o le yaa, kɛ o liire waa dɔa tɛ yaa, ne ɡɛ waa na ya sum dɛ cha yaa waa o le yaa. Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ o che dɛ na ya sum, dɛ cha yaa dɛ le yaa mɔɔ dɛ ta komɛlbwa.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Kɛ tarakenii ya ta che ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo bala waa ba harɛ bonɔ la ta, dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ. O ɡelɔ seo ta kpeɡri dɔe kpa, dɛ berɛ che Amanesoma la ta baɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa dɛ ba o mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa dɔe.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Amanesoma nɔ waa Korowii lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol, dɛ́ ɡel n ɛ o torome ɡe dɛɛ baɡle nɛra o wa.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: A waa mɛɛ na waa maa dɛ na nɔ la. Sihiih ɡe aa men kpo, dɛkalkɛ n jemɛ naate maa yaradao dɛ kpɔ n te tɛo, asɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ wonoo kpoŋe n ne toma waa kpɔa do n nɔn ta la sɔnɔnɔɔ ken dɛ́ ka tel o bala tɔpere.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Lawɛ kasinteŋ waa maa chaɡle la bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta, dɛ́ so Korowii yarada ne nɛnnyin yaa dɔa le pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa ta la ta.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Kpɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa lɔ ya nɛɛ la kpeɡri lawɛ wedɛɛɡa Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ la bini kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: He jemɔ kɛ nɛra baa lɔ Eesia harɛ ta bwa chwa mɛ, hale Fejelas ne Hɛmojenes ɡba jao.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: N Naa Korowiirii dɛ na Oniseforɔs ne o dem tena sum, dɛkalkɛ dɛ on dɛɛ cha mɛ. Dɛ sihiih aa on kpo kɛ baa do mɛ dea la.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: Waa dena tel Rom laanee o ɡaaɡe n bɔr aaa dɛ ka tel kɛ waa na mɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ laanee dɛ na o sum o bala tɔpere la ta. Henee jemɛ koeh damanta waa koh n nɛɛ Ɛfesos.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: N bie Timoti, che kiŋkiŋ kpeɡri ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa chae he dɔ le pɛɛ he ne waa pɛa la ta.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Waa la nɛra aa chema warɛ asɛ n bol he be la, bola baɡle nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛ jemɛ kɛ ba ɡe ɛɛ wonoo kpɔ bol baɡle nɛra bane ɡe la.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Dɛ wekpeɡa pui toma nɔ ta naa, ɡel he bwara nyɛɡ kɛ Yeesu Kristo sooja ɡbaɡba.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Sooja bɛlbwa dɛ nyin kɛ o toma su o nomoa siwi. Anomanta, waa o te kpɔe dɛɛ koo nɛmpɛɛne waa ta.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Paa waa dɛ swɛɛ siwi o koo toma ta laanee chɛ kɛ o di koo la kondikonloɡla.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Gel waa maa bola nɔ do he liire bini. Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ a bwa mun kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Lii Yeesu Kristo waa kɛŋɔ o iro le seo ta. Kooro Devid Naa on. Gɛ waa nɔɔ mɛɛ bol Amanesoma maa dɛ baɡle nɛra la ta,

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: dɛ koh a waa dɛɛ na wa, hale nɛra koh a waa dɛ kpɔ jɔɡrɔre vɔɡ mɛ, dɛ do mɛ dea kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ. Kɛ Korowii waa te, nɛn aa won kpɔ jɔɡrɔre vɔwa.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n koh nɛra Korowii aa lee ba la waa dɛ lawɛ bambile wobɛlbwa ta, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo lɛ ba ɡe, dɛ berɛ tɛɛ ba jirima aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ wobolee nɔ. Ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ ya ne onee sewaa, ya ne wɛɛ berɔɔ ir dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya lawɛ bambile wobɛlbwa ta naa, ya ne wɛɛ di koraa. Dɛ ya ŋɔ ya ne o laa aa, o ɡe ɛɛ ŋɔɔ o ne ya laa.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Dɛ ya ta kasinteŋ tena ɛɛ yaa, o te ta ɛ kasinteŋ te, waa won beɡre o te.” Tom-ɛɛ o siwi aa su Korowii siwi wa

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Dɛɛ lii nɛra ɡɛ waa nɔ, dɛ kah ba sibeɡra ne Korowii sie ŋɔ ba bɛ waa dɛɛ tɔŋle. Wetɔŋla ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe. Nɛra liiree aa chɔɡ.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Takapɔ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii, ásɛ he waa su o siwi kɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ o Korowii toma kɛrɛdɛ sihiih aa wola hen kpo, dɛ́ lawɛ kasinteŋ waa la bini kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Ba webaɡla dɛ yɛɛ dɛɛ chɔɡ nɛra, ɡɛ ŋwɛrchɔɡe yon yɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛn bwadabii la. Haemenayɔs ne Faeletɔs ja ɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ nɛ.

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: Banee nyoɡre kasinteŋ waa la ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ kaa baɡle nɛra ŋɔ seo ta ira tɔpere la ɡarɔ, dɛɛ chɔɡ nɛra baa yarada Amanesoma la bane liire waa baa yaradaa la ta.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Kɛ a ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii Dea waa pa o mun la cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ ken. Ba chwerɛ o ta ŋɔ, “Korowii jemɛ nɛra baa ɛ o kwa,” dɛ berɛ chwerɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔa o ja Yeesu Kristo nɛra nɛɛ la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó laa o te kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.”

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Dem waa kana la, konsiwi beŋkpoŋ ɡbo laa lɔ o ta. Suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa kwaa lɔ o ta. Ane lole, daa nee ba sɛah, dɛ kpɔ choh ma ane ɡe. Ane lole, wejena ta ɡboo baa le a ne, asɛ ane ɡe ba kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ wesale bɛlbwa.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa laa o te kpɔ wedoŋa ne wechɔɡa bwa ta naa, naate la do kɛŋɔ kwaa baa dɛ le a ne wejena ɡbo ta la. O do kaih dɛ do le tɛ o Dɔɔ, dɛ dɔ tɔnɔ tɛo, dɛ che le kɛ ó kpɔɔ ɛ tondɛɛɡa te bwa.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Laa he te kpɔ wedoŋa bonɔɔna aa dɛ pɛlɛ a ta la ta, ásɛ he ne nɛra baa dɛ soŋe Korowii tepoŋ ne la siwi swɛɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ aa dɛ su Korowii siwi, ne Korowii yaradae, ne nɛnnyin, dɛ waa aa dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne la ta.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Bɛ he te kpɔ dɛɛ jo ɡɛnewaa ne wesale tɔŋla ta. He ɡbabir jemɔ kɛ naɡra nee aa ba.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa ɛ ya Dɔɔ bonɔɔ ta chɛ kɛŋɔ o ne nɛn naɡre. A chɛ kɛ ó pwɛr o te tɛ nomɛlbwa, dɛ́ won nɛra kwaa baɡla kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ nɛn jo o nɛ aa, ó won lawɛ bambile,

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: dɛɛ baɡle nɛra o ne ba liire aa wola beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ la waa taa ne. Bɛl lole naa, Korowii ɛɛ na ɡɛ nɛra la sumii, dɛ́ ɡel ba charɛ ba liire, ásɛ ba won jemɛ kasinteŋ waa la,

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: ásɛ ba sie ba harɛ bá chwa le Bɔnsam bel waa laɡ ba dɛ ɡel baa ɛ o waa waa dɛ nyin la ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔ ba te.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Jemɛ kɛŋɔ tɔpera aa ba ka mun ba la, aa do kpeɡrii tɛ nɛra,

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ nyin ba ɡbaɡbaa ɡwaa komɛlbwa, dɛɛ nyin suuɡa sibeɡra ne, dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo, dɛɛ ɛ jenu, dɛ bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ nɛra, dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena baa wola ba eehnanar waa no, dɛ ɛ boniayɛ tena, dɛ ɛ ba te nɛndoŋa.

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: Ba chal aa dɔŋa nɛɛ doe ba, baa wechɔɡaa kpɔ dɛɛ kɛ dɔŋa. Baa dɛɛ haŋɛ dɔŋa nyooree, baa haŋraa dɔ ba pɛla kwaa ta, baa dɛɛ ɛ ɡaeeh, baa hah wedɛɛɡaa.

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: Baa ɛ bwɛpaɡre nɛraa, ba sie ɛɛ do wɔrɔbee, dɛɛ maŋkura ba te. Baa kpɔ silɛɛ kwaa ɡwaa Korowii.

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: Baa dɛɛ ɛ ba we-ɛɛlaa kɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii ken, kɛ dɛɛ vɛh kpeɡri waa lɔ Korowii toma ta la te. Laa he te kpɔ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra nɔ bini banee yon kpɔ ŋwɛnɛre ane ta dɛ́ sɔh jo deremi ta, ásɛ dɛɛ dɔ haahna ba wechɔɡa aa ɡwaa ba nɛɛ ba sie ɛɛ yal ba ba pɛlchɔɡa ta la, ba yon dɛɛ teŋɛ ba nɛ.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ haahna la dɛ hweli waa tɔperee te bɛlbwa, kɛ kasinteŋ waa aa lɔ waa la bini la te, baa won an jemɛ bwa.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Gɛ Janes ne Jambɛs aa vuuɡi Mosis la, ɡɛɛ a ɡɛ baala nɔ ɡe ɛɛ vuuɡi kasinteŋ waa la. Ba liire aa were. Baa vɛh kasinteŋ waa la yaradae nomanta, Korowii vɛɛh ba.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Ba we-ɛɛla aa won tel sie bobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ a saŋ la tena aa na Janes ne Jambɛs ɡɛna la, ɡɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ na ba ɡe ɡɛna ɡɛ. Pɔɔl ɡbemba waa do Timoti

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: He Timoti te, he jemɛ waa maa dɛ baɡle la bwa, dɛ jemɛ n da, ne kon la waa maa dɛ koh, ne ɡɛ maa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo, ne ɡɛ maa won bambile lawa, ne ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin nɛn, ne ɡbemba maa dɔa.

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: Fiiɡa baa fiɡ mɛ ne n wenaale maa naa Anteɔk, Ikooniam ne Lestra, n lawɛ bambile a bwa ta la, he jemɛ a bwa. Kɛ ya Dɔɔ la cha mɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ a ɡɛ waa la bwa ta.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛ o ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ o soɡa bini o waa su Korowii siwi la, baa ɛo hɔhɔrɔwaa.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Nɛnchɔɡa ne nɛra baa neɡre nɛra dɛɛ do wechɔɡa ta la ɡe ɛɛ kao saɡɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta dɛɛ la, dɛɛ neɡre nɛra, ásɛ nɛra ɛɛ neɡre ba ɡe.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Kɛ he te, dɛɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ webaɡla haa hwela dɛ jemɛ kɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ la ta. Bɛ ɡel bwa. He jemɛ nɛra baa baɡle ɡɛ waa la, dɛɛ yarada ba ɡe.

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: He bechale saŋ bwaa he le jemɛ Korowii Tɔn bini waa aa dɛ ba wona ɡel he dɔ wejema, dɛ che yarada haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la ta Korowii lɛɛ.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn bini waa bwa, Korowiirii kpɔa do nɛra liire ta ba chwera. A wer kɛ ba kpɔa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra wa, dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ kah nɛra ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ toɡre nɛra, dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi.

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Anee dɛ won cha Korowii nɛn ó won ɛ wedɛɛɡa bwa ka tonɛ.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: N cheɡɛ N Naa Korowii ne Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ ba ba bol weera ne lala waa dɛ́ pa bole la sie, dɛ koh kora waa dɛ ba ba di la waa dɛɛ ŋɔ he be sibeɡra ne ŋɔ,

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: hé bol Amanesoma la baɡle nɛra. A som oo, aa somoo, kpɔ he te kɛ saŋ te bɛlbwa hɛɛ bolaa. Eɡle sie ta ba nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ ja ba. Lawɛ bambile dɛɛ chaɡ ba.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao ásɛ nɛra aa kasinteŋ waa la baɡlaa no, dɛkalkɛ baa an nyin. Baa dɛɛ nyin waa aa dɛ do ba somee dɛ́ no, dɛ́ ka nyin nɛra pirim bá baa chaɡ ba waa ba pɛla aa lɔ a ta la,

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: dɛ́ laa ba deŋne kpɔ kasinteŋ waa la ta, dɛ́ kaa no nyosonwa.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Kɛ he te, dɛɛ lawɛ he te wobɛlbwa ta. Wekpeɡa pui naa, lawɛ bambile. Dɛɛ lɔ Amanesoma la dawuro, ásɛ dɛɛ ɛ he toma bwa kɛ Korowii bonɔɔ.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: N te, n seo tɔpere telo, n do kɛ sen baa dɔa dɛɛ ta dɛ ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: N yo yodɛɛɡe la dɛ tonɛ, dɛ chwa chwae la ɡe tonɛ. Amanesoma maa dɛ yaradaa la ta ɡe, n ta habɔɔ leɛ.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Kon waa ka mɛ taraken laanee kompoŋ Korowii aa dɛ́ ba nɛndɛɛɡa baa yoa le, ba waa su o siwi la vɔwa. N Dɔɔ waa kpɔ kasinteŋ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole laanee dɛɛ ba n tɛɛ, awola waa ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la. N ɡbo laa dɛɛ ba ɡɛ kembɔr la dɔe. Nɛra baa dɛ pɛlɛ o nɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋu ŋwɛnɛ la bwa ɛɛ dɔɔ. Waane Pɔɔl ɡbabir aa bola

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Takapɔ ba n be warane,

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ Demas koh harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ waa dɛ chwa mɛ. O chwao kaa Tesalonika. Krɛsɛns kaa Galaasia harɛ ta, asɛ Taetos ɡe kaa Dalmatia harɛ ta.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luk ɡboo lɔ n be bonɔ. He dɛ ba naa, kpɔ Mak ja he nɛɛ he ne o ba, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ nɛn bɛl waa won n chae n toma nɔ ta ɡa.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: N tomɛ Tichikos Ɛfesos.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ ba naa, kpɔ Kaapus be Troas dɛ lɛ n batakaare dɛɛ baa mɛ. Lɛ n tɔne la ɡe ja dɛɛ baa mɛ. Anɔ la baa kpɔ ol tɔn ɛa la waa dena hiah mɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Loɡre bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Alɛksanda la ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa taeh. Korowii ɛɛ bɔɔ o waa waa ɛa la kemee.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Hé ɡe nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ ke he te o nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta yaa sie tɛɛ ya webaɡla ta kwaraa.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Baa yer mɛ cheme ŋɔ ń ba tɔh n nyoa loɡla la, n ta nomɛlbwa dɔe ó ba che n habɔɔ. Nɛra bwa chwa mɛ. Korowii bɛ ɡel a ɛ wechɔɡa ɡure ba nɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Kɛ ya Dɔɔ la cheɡɛ n habɔɔ dɛ tɛ mɛ kpeɡri n won bol Amanesoma la bwa, asɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bwa no. Korowii lɛɛ mɛ le siswɛm ta kɛŋɔ nɛn baa lɛo le nyujente nyoa ta ken.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ la ɛɛ lee mɛ wobɛlbwa taa, dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ sɔnɔnɔɔ ken kaa o nyundua koobwɛɛ la ta. Onee chɛ kɛ ya tɛo jirima tɔpere bɛlbwa aa wola jaɡa dɔe. Aamen. Kala aa ka mun

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: N dɛ na Presela ne Akwela ne nɛra baa lɔ Oniseforɔs dem bwa.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erastos ta lɔ Kɔrent. Trɔfemos bwara dɛ weo nomanta, n ɡelo Maeletus.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Takapɔ dɛ́ ba mɔɔ alalawo saŋ tel. Yubilus ne Pudens ne Laenos ne Klɔdea dɛ he bala asɔre tena baa kaa la bwa dɛ nae.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Yá Dɔɔ ja he nɛ. Ń Naa Korowii sune he nɛ dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl maa ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ dɛ berɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ. Korowiirii lee mɛ dɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ cha nɛra waa lee ba tɛ o te la, ásɛ ba yarada kaa sie ba won jemɛ o kasinteŋ la, dɛ́ che a ta tomɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la hwɛɡaa n dɔ. Korowii waa wola nyosone teŋe laanee baɡɛ ɡɛ mkpa nɔ nyoa bil mɔɔ dɛ ta komɛlbwa.

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: Tɔpere o tea aa toora la, o ɡelɔ mɛɛ bol a waa nɛra jemɛ. Ya Lɛɛ Korowiirii kpɔa do n nɔn ta dɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ baɡle nɛra.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: N bie Taetos, henee n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ. Waa ya bwa aa dɛ yarada la taa a che he ɛ n bie tenten. Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo chae dɛ́ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna. Toma aa chɛ kɛ Taetos ɛ Kret

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: N ɡele Kret harɛ ásɛ he tonɛ waa aa hiah kɛ he ɛ la bwa, dɛ́ cheɡ nomonome asɔrere aa lɔ bwɛɛre la bɛlbwa ta ɡɛ maa baɡle la.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: He dɛ nyin he le asɔre nomoa aa, kpɔ onɔ la nomɛlbwa aa wola o wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔe dɛɛ bol, ó dɔ hahbeŋkpoŋ, o bii ɡe ɛɛ yarada Yeesu, nɛra aa wola ba waa bol ŋɔ ba chɔɡɔ dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena,

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ o ɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin hɔɔhra lɛɛ, dɛɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa, dɛ dɔ nfɛrɛ kɛrɛdɛ, o waa do kaih, wedoŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ, wɛɛ lawɛ o te kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Deŋnekpeɡ tena lole taraken taeh, dɛ kpɔ wepuu dɛɛ neɡre nɛra. Juu tena baa lɔ he bini dɛɛ maŋkura penteŋ laanee dena dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ kohona.

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: A chɛ kɛ he kah ba ba tɔ nyoa. Ba dɛ chɔɡ dembir nɛra liire ba yon vɛh kasinteŋ waa la ta teŋa. Ba koh suuɡa waa dɛɛ chaɡle waa aa wola chɛɛ.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Kret tena la bɛl baa dɛ liiru kɛŋɔ o jemɛ wobol kɛrɛdɛ fa bolɔ ŋɔ, “Ya Kret tena bwa ɛ nyosonteŋna, ya we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ola ken. Ya ɛ bɔhwaahra dɛɛ di kwaa kohona.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Kpelaa o bol, anomanta, di ba kasinteŋkpeɡ ba jemɛ, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ɡɛ da la, dɛ́ baa teŋɛ Korowii waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ la ta.

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ ba bɛ deŋne cheɡ dɛɛ no Juu tena waa aa ɛ nyosone la, ne waa nɛra baa vɛh kasinteŋ waa la aa ŋɔa báa ɛ la.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: He tea too waa, komɛlbwa wer tɛɛ, haa an kondoŋa lii. Kɛ nɛra wechɔɡa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ baa wola yarada la, komɛlbwa ɛ kondoŋ tɛɛ ba. Ba liire ne ba bambile bwa doŋo.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ ba jemɛ Korowii, kɛ ba we-ɛɛla dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ baa Korowii jemɛ. Ba we-ɛɛla doŋo Korowii be kohona, ba deŋne ɡe kpeɡri. Baa won ɛ wedɛɛɡe bɛlbwa bwa.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: He te, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ baɡle Korowii waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ aŋwɛnɛ ta kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ banjeni be báa lawɛ ba te, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɔ duure, dɛ́ dɔ nfɛrɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ kɛrɛdɛ la ta, dɛɛ nyin nɛn kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ dɔ bambile ɡe.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Ŋɔ hanjeni ɡe be báa ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ́ ɡel ba we-ɛɛla do kaih, dɛ bɛ nɛra dɛɛ ŋwalɛ, dɛ bɛ ɡel sen lɛ ba liire. Báa baɡle waa aa wera.

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, anee dɛ́ baɡle han-yala báa nyin ba jaranar ne ba bii,

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: dɛ́ dɔ nfɛrɛ kɛrɛdɛ, wedoŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole ba nɛ, dɛ́ won ba dem tomare ɛɛ, dɛɛ ɛ nɛra wedɛɛɡa, dɛɛ no ba jaranar wa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ Korowii waa la wechɔɡe dɔ bol.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ bonɔɔna ɡe be ŋɔ bá dɔ nfɛrɛ wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
translation_verse: Henee chɛ kɛ he ɡel he we-ɛɛla do wer wobɛlbwa ta, ásɛ ba nyiŋi dɛɛ hweli. Dɛɛ baɡle waa kasinteŋ ne, dɛɛ swɛɛ siwi a ta.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Gel a toɡre kɛrɛdɛ, nɛra bɛ a wobɛlbwa dɔ dɛ́ bol, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ tɔŋle heyaa bɛ ya wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔ dɛ́ bol, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Gel nɛra baa lɔ bane nɔn ta kɛŋɔ bonɔɔna kɛɛ toli la no kɛŋɔ báa no ba dɔɔranar wa. Bá ɡel ba wa ɛɛ lɛ ba sie wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ bɛ waa beɡre dɛɛ do ba nyoa,

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: dɛ bɛ ba kwaa dɛɛ ŋwɛ. Kɛ bá ɡel ba we-ɛɛla dɔ yarada kɛrɛdɛ ba dɔɔranar be. Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba ɡela ya Lɛɛ Korowii waa nɔ yaa dɛ baɡle nɔ che ba nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ sɔn wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Korowii pili suna waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ taraken asɛ nɛra bwa jemɛ, o lɛɛ ba.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡɛ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ a wer kɛ ya laa sie kpɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ne harɛ nɔ ta pɛlchɔɡa la bwa ta, dɛ́ dɔ nfɛrɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra, dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii ya bere nɔ ta,

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: dɛɛ kpa ɡɛ saŋ Yeesu Kristo aa ba o jirima ne ya nao la. Onee Korowijen ne ya Lɛɛ la. O bala taa ya dɔ hwɛɡa ne silɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: O koh ya waa dɛ sewɛ dɛ won lɛ yaa le wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ta, dɛ laa ya doŋa bwa kpɔ ya nɛ, dɛ kpɔ yaa ɛ o ɡbo nɛra yaa swɛɛ siwi wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Baɡ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, dɛ́ kpɔ he kpeɡri do ba ɡbemba, dɛ́ ja ba, dɛ́ bɛ ɡel ba bɛlbwa nyiŋi he nyubaah.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Lii ba ŋɔ báa pwɛr ba te dɛɛ tɛ nomonome baa dɛ di kpeɡri te bɛlbwa, dɛɛ no ba deŋna wa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te kɛ baa dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera bwaa.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ ba be ba bɛ nɛra bwara wechɔɡe dɛɛ bol, ba bɛ dɛɛ naɡre, báa pwɛr ba te, dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa duure kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Ya ɡbabir fa ɡɛnɔ. Ya fa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena. Ba fa neɡre yaa, pɛlchɔɡa bwa soo siwi ne bodia kpɔ yaa berɛ yoma. Meesɔɔh ne bɔweela bwa nee ya faa so. Nɛra fa hah yaa, ya ɡe hah dɔŋa.

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: o lɛ yaa ta. Ya te wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa laa o lɛ yaa ta. Sunaa o sune ya nɛɛ dɛ lɛ yaa ta, dɛ sɔ yaa nee ya won do kɛ baa bera kwaa lolɛ yaa. O Domadɛɛɡe waa kpɔa tɛ yaa o kwaa yaa la nɛɛ ya che dɛ dɔ mkpafale la.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: O Domadɛɛɡe waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la, ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo waa o koh tɛ yaa kohona,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: asɛ Korowii suna la ɡel ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi, ásɛ ya won dɔ hwɛɡa kɛ o mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la ɛɛ ɛ ya konee.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Waa nɔ bwa ɛ kpela. Anomanta, dɛɛ berɛ a baɡla ɔma, ásɛ nɛra baa no Korowii waa dɛ yarada la swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa. Gɛɛ wera dɛ dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ nomɛlbwa.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Kɛ laa he te kpɔ ɡɛne wetɔŋla ne ɡɛ he naawa aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ waa bini baɡla ta, ne naɡrenyin, ne Mmara ŋwɛnɛre waa tɔŋla ta. A ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe. A ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa do ɡɛ la vɛh kasinteŋ waa la. O ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ o dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa ɡba, kɛ dɛ ɡe taa ɛ. Webaɡla aa ka mun

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Dɛ n tomɛ Aatemas kɛɛ Tichikos he be naa, takapɔ dɛ́ ba n be Nikopolis warane. N ɛ n liire kɛ ń ka so bela alalawo saŋ.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Takapɔ dɛ́ cha Sɛnos waa ɛ mmara jereme la ne Apolos bá won la ba ŋwɛnɛ la. Bɛ ɡel komɛlbwa baa kpɔ la ŋwɛnɛ la waa hiah ba.

english_verse: Our people should learn to spend their time doing something useful and worthwhile.
translation_verse: Gel yabala bwa hweli wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ, dɛɛ cha nɛra aa hiah ba, dɛ bɛ nɛra baa wola tɔnɔ dɔe ɛ.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Nɛra n ne baa lɔ bonɔ la bwa dɛ nae. N dɛ na nɛra baa dɛ nyin yaa ya ne baa yarada Yeesu la. N Naa Kórowii sune he nɛ dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Men Pɔɔl baa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ do mɛ dea la, ne ya dɔŋ Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ ya dandɛɛɡe Faelemɔn waa bera ɛ ya dɔŋ tom-ɛɛ ɡe la,

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: ne ya nimambie Afia, ne ya dɔŋ Akipus ya ne waa cheɡa dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o toma nɔ ta la, ne asɔre tena baa dɛ cheme he dem la bwa.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Jaama ne wesoŋa

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: N Korowii soŋa bini te bɛlbwa, n dɛ yerɛ he Faelemɔn sɔn dɛ kpɔ jam dɛɛ tɛ Korowii,

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ n no he nyina haa dɛ nyin Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa, ne ɡɛ haa dɛ yarada ya Dɔɔ Yeesu la wa.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: N dam, he nyina haa dɛ nyin Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la dɛ do mɛ ɡbemba dɛ ɡel n sie ɛɛ lɛ taeh, dɛkalkɛ he dɛ nyiŋ ba dɛɛ do ba ɡbemba. Pɔɔl soŋɔ tɛ Onisemɔs

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: Nyina haa dɛ nyin nɛra la taa n che dɛɛ soŋe, nyiŋi ɡɛ men Pɔɔl aa ɛ banjena, ne dea baa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ do mɛ nɔ ta dɛ no n waa nɔ.

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: He nɛndɔɔle Onisemɔs waa ɛ n bie Yeesu Kristo be pera la naa taa n che dɛɛ soŋe waa nɔ. Gɛ saŋ baa do mɛ dea la taa n bol Yeesu waa baɡlo o kpɔ o te tɛo.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: Wubwa la dɛ o ta tɔnɔ dɔe tɛɛ, kɛ taraken te o dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ ya bwa.

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: N ɡelɔ wɛɛ ba he be kɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba bie maa dɛ nyinu n bambile bwa ne la.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: N fe dɛ nyin kɛ o do n be bonɔ, dɛ́ che he naa ta dɛɛ cha mɛ n dea doe nɔ baa koh Amanesoma la waa dɛ do mɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Kɛ maa nyin n ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ́ le he habɔɔ dɛ n ta he be ŋɔe, ásɛ a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ n dɛ di kpeɡri he nɛ. N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ wedɛɛɡe haa ɛ la le he ɡbabir bambile bini.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Bɛl lole naa, Korowiirii ŋɔa o ken le he nɔn ta tama mɔɔ dɛ berɛ ba he ne ó so ka tonɛ.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: O ta he yom ɡbo ɛɛ kpa. O ɛ he nimedɛɛɡe ya Dɔɔ Yeesu be pera. Gɛ n kwara aa dɛ nyin o waa nɔ, n jemɔ kɛ he te ɛɛ nyin o waa ɡwaa ɡɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɛ he yom ne he nime tenten ya Dɔɔ Yeesu be pera.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Dɛ he jemɔ kɛŋɔ n ne he bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ aa, lɛo kɛŋɔ haa dɛ ba n lɛɛ ken.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Dɛ o fa ɛɛ wechɔɡa ane, kɛɛ dɛ he kem bɛlee o dio, kpɔ pɛɛ mɛ.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: N Pɔɔl ɡbaɡbaa chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bonɔ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ bɔe kemee la. Kɛ jemɛ kɛ he ɡba di n kem Korowii mkpa la haa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ dɔ la ta.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dam, ɡel n ɡe dɔ tɔnɔ dɛ́ le nyopɛo n ne haa cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ dɔ la ta, ásɛ n baah sɔɔh mɛ.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ no n waa nɔɔ dɛ ɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ kwara. A waa n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ la.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Anɔ la ɡe aa jaa laanee kɛŋɔ nyin dea dɛɛ cheɡ mɛ. N dɔ hwɛɡa kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ no he wesoŋa haa dɛ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ mɛ laanee ásɛ dɛ berɛ kpɔ mɛ ba tɛ heyaa ja.

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafras baa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ do n ne on dea la dɛ nae.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Mak ne Aristakus ne Demas dɛ Luk baa ɛ n bala tom-ɛɛra la ɡe ɛɛ nae.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sune he nɛ, dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa. Aamen.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Fini tɔpera nɔ aa ka mun nɔ te, o Bie nɛɛ o che dɛɛ bol waa ya be. Korowii Bie nɔɔ o kpɔ cheɡ kɛŋɔ o toole naa, onee lole dɛ dɔ komɛlbwa. O nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ ta komɛlbwa.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: He na o jirima waa dɔa aa, dɛ he na jirima Korowii aa dɔa. Gɛ Korowii aa doa o ɡe den do kati. O wobol dɔ kpeɡri. A kpeɡrii lawɛ komɛlbwa kpoŋe. Korowii Bie la aa laa ya wechɔɡa kpɔ ya nɛɛ tonɛ la, o kaa so nomombɔr nyundua Nemenɛ Korowii diɡ ta,

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: dɛ ɡwaa nyundua toroma bwa, ɡɛ sɔn Korowii aa tɛo la aa ɡwaa ba sɔn la.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Korowii ta o nyundua toroma la bɛlbwa be ŋɔe ŋɔ, “N Biee hen, fini n berɛ he Mɛɛ” bwa. O ta ba bɛlbwa waa bolɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɛ o Mɛɛ, ásɛ o ɛ n Bie” bwa.

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Korowii aa dɛ ba o Bie waa lɔ o be loɡla la harɛ ta toma la, o bolɔ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ nyundua toroma bwa ɛɛ tomɔ.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: O bol nyundua toroma la ɡe waa ŋɔ, “O ɡelɔ o nyundua toroma do kɛŋɔ peu ne ninlao.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: O bol o Bie la waa ja, dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii, he kora ɛɛ cheo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Kasinteŋii hɛɛ ba kpoŋa dɛɛ di kora he nɛra nɛ.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: He dɛ nyin waa aa toɡra dɛ ki wechɔɡa. A waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ lee cheɡ he bala koranar bwa bini, dɛ fuɡe noo do he nyu ta dɛ tɛɛ silɛɛ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, wobɛlbwa mumpar la, henee ta harɛ. Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ɡe, he nɔn tomaa a bwa.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: A bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, aa wola lee do kpa, kɛ he te ɛɛ do lee dɛɛ la. A bwa ɛɛ ba ɛ kombenaa kɛŋɔ yal yon hɛh la.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Hɛɛ kpɔa bil kɛŋɔ yal hɛoh waa, ba yon kpɛrɛwo bil la. Aa beɡroo, aa wola won do wer kɛ konfala saŋ bɛlbwa wee kpa. Kɛ he te ɛɛ do ɡɛ haa doa saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ he bene ɡe aa jaɡaa dɔ bwa.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
