translation_verse: Korowii ta nyundua toroma la bɛlbwa be ŋɔe ŋɔ, “So nomombɔr n diɡ ta ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba he dɔma ne harɛ he tiɡri ba nɛ.”

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do te naa, a chɛ kɛ ya do sie dɛ nyiŋi waa yaa noa la kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ba koni dɛ́ nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii fa aa kpɔa tɛ o nyundua toroma ba bol la ɛo kɛ mmarakpeɡ bɛl. Nomɛlbwa waa wola a ta teŋɛ la, bá tɛr o deŋne ɡɛ aa chɛa.

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: A do ɡɛ naa, ya lɛɛ waa nɔ aa ɡwaa nyundua toroma waa la kohona nɔ, dɛ ya vɛah aa, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ leɔ? Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɡbaɡba fa tɔ sie bol ya lɛɛ waa nɔ, asɛ nɛra baa noa ɡe di danseɛ ya be kɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Korowii ɡbaɡba cheɡɛ nyokpowaa ne wekpeɡa ɛɛ ta, ne o Domadɛɛɡe waa kpɔa bɔne nɛra ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin la ta dɛ di a danseɛ. Yeesu baa kpɔ nɛwɛnyini bwadabi

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ba le doe yaa dɛ bol ba waa nɔ, o ta ban kpɔe do nyundua toroma lɔɡa.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini bobɛl ŋɔ, “Korowii, nɛwɛnyini ɡee bɔkwa asɛ hɛɛ lii o waɔ? Nɛwɛnyini ɡee bɔkwa hɛɛ dawɛ o waɔ?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Tamaa kenii he ɡel nyundua toroma ɡwaalo. He ɡelɔ o dɔ jirima, asɛ komɛlbwa ɛɛ tɛo duure,

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: dɛ kpɔ komɛlbwa do o lɔɡa.” Waa kpɔ komɛlbwa do nɛwɛnyini lɔɡa nɔ, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ komɛlbwa toole waa wola o kpeɡri dɔe. Kɛ ya ta nae kɛŋɔ kwaa bwa lɔ nɛwɛnyini lɔɡa mɔɔ.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Kɛ ya dɛ na Yeesu te kɛŋɔ Korowii aa ba o ne harɛ, asɛ nyundua toroma ɡwaalo tama, asɛ waa na wahala dɛ sewɛ la, o tɛo jirima dɛ ɡel komɛlbwa ɛɛ tɛo duure. Korowii alaworomɛɛ o sewɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa la.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Korowiirii ta komɛlbwa, asɛ a che o kpeɡri ta komɛlbwa ɡe do le. Waa ɡela Yeesu na wahala la, maɡraa a maɡre kɛrɛdɛ. Waa dɛ nyin o lɛ nɛndamanta dɛ ɡel ba ɛ o bii, dɛ do o be dɛ dɔ jirima la waa o ɡel Yeesu waa ɛ ba Sitɔɔ la ɡbaɡba kpɔ a ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta, dɛ na wahala dɛ won ɛ ba Sitɔdɛɛɡe kaih ka tonɛ dɛ lɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Yeesuu laa nɛwɛnyini doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ ɡel ba ɛ Korowii nɛra. O ne nɛra waa laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ la bwa Mɛɛ beŋkpoŋ. A waa aa wola on sihiih ɛ kɛŋɔ o yer ba o nimanar la.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: O ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ bol he waa haa ɛa n nimanar bee. Mɛɛ kpɛɛree ba chema binii.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: O toolo berɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ n hwɛɡaa do Korowii nɛ.” O berɔ ŋɔ, “N ne bechale Korowii aa tɛ mɛ laanee la.”

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: Yeesu ɛ ken ásɛ dɛ won lɛ nɛra baa koh seo ɔma waa dɛ ɛ yoma ba soɡa bini bwa la.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ kasinteŋ, nyundua toroma laa o cha nɔ, Abraham naanaree o cha.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Dɛ a chɛ kɛ Yeesu do ɡɛ o nimanar la aa doa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta. Gɛɛ ó ɛ dɛ́ won tomɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ ba Sɔfonomoa kasinteŋ ne dɛɛ na ba sum, dɛ́ won dɛɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ kwaa ba ne Korowii baah.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Bɔnsam daahno na dɛ ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa ó fe ɛ wechɔɡa, kɛ o ta on wone. Anomanta, wɛɛ wonoo cha nɛra Bɔnsam aa dɛ daah ba dɛɛ na la.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Anomanta, n bala Korowii nɛra waa le ya ne he bwa tɛ o te, hé ta sie nyiŋi Yeesu na. Korowiirii tomɔ ŋɔ ó ba ɛ ya waa yaa dɛ yarada nɔ Sɔfonomoa.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: O waa dɔ kasinteŋ Korowii waa kpɔɔ ŋɔ ó ɛ o toma la be kɛŋɔ Mosis fa aa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii nɛra nɛɛ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ wobɛlbwa ta la.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Nɛn do dem aa, nɛra dɛ kpɛɛro dɛ ɡwaa dem la. Gɛɛ Yeesu ɡe do. A chɛ kɛ ba kpɛɛro ɡwaa Mosis,

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ dem bɛlbwa waa ɛ dem la, dɛ nɛnee doo. Korowii ɡee ta komɛlbwa.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Kɛ Yeesu Kristo te kasinteŋ waa dɔa la, Korowii Bie on, asɛ o ɛ Korowii nɛra bwa nomoa. Ya yarada yaa dɔa Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ, ne hwɛɡa yaa dɔa ya sie lɛ a ta la, ya lawɛ a bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ naa, Yeesu Kristo nɛraa yan. Nɛra baa vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa jae

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe bolɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he no Korowii waa fini naa,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: he bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kɛŋɔ he naawa fa aa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh o waa noe dɛ jo o nɛɛ la.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: He naawa bene fifraanaarɛ baa dia kpɔɡ baah la, ba daah mɛ na dɛ na waa maa ɛa bwa.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Anomanta, n baah di ɡɛ nɛra la nɛ, asɛ n ŋɔ ba bambile ta n waa lawɛ bwa, asɛ ba vɛh n waa ta teŋa.

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: N baah aa dia la, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, ‘Baa ona maa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ onɛ la dɔe ba bwa.’ ”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Anomanta, yabala, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ he bini bɛlbwa bɛ liichɔɡa ba dɔ kɛŋɔ waa Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa laanee yarada, dɛ́ ba vɛh o waa ta teŋa.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ ja dɔŋa tɔperee bwa mɔɔ tɔpere la o Domadɛɛɡe aa bol o waa dɛ ŋɔ “fini” la ɡarɛ, ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛ heyaa ba neɡre, he deŋne ba do kpeɡri.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Gɛ ya yarada aa doa le mumpar la, dɛ ya wono che ɡɛ kiŋkiŋ ka tel wobɛlbwa jaɡa aa, dɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo pɛo wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he no Korowii waa fini naa, he bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kɛŋɔ he naawa fa aa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh o waa noe dɛ jo o nɛɛ la.”

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Dɛ lepetenaa no Korowii waa dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh o waa noe dɛ jo o nɛɛ nɔɔ? Nɛra Mosis aa tɔ ba sie dɛ le Ijipt harɛ la bwaa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ la.

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Korowii aa ŋwɛɛra ŋɔ baa ona waa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ la dɔe ba la, dɛ lepetena bee o ŋɔ ɡɛ nɔɔ? Nɛra baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ la bee o ŋɔ ɡɛ.

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: He ta nae kɛŋɔ ba yarada bɛ dɔe waa Korowii aa wola ban ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba dɔ ona waa dɔa tɛɛ ba la aa?

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Korowii nyoa waa baɡɛ nɛra ona waa ŋɔa bá ba onɛ la ta lole. Anomanta, hé ɡel ya nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ he bɛlbwa bɛ a ɡɛ nyobaɡa la ba paŋɛ.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Gɛ yaa dɛ no Korowii Amanesoma nɔ, ɡɛɛ ba ɡe noa. Kɛ ba te aa noa la, a ta tɔnɔ leɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta an yaradae.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Ya te nɔ, ya dɛ yarada Korowii waa la, anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ya onɛ ona waa dɛ onɛ la bɛl. Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “N baah aa dia la, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ baa ona maa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ onɛ la dɔe ba bwa.” A ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ ona toole kpa. Gɛ saŋ Korowii aa ta harɛ la, dɛ o ɛ o wobɛlbwa tonɛ dɛ te onɛ.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn bobɛl bol tɔpenuanɛ wee la waa ŋɔ, “Korowii aa tonɛ o toma bwa la, o onɔ tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta,”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: asɛ bela yaa dɛ bol o waa nɔ baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ, “Baa ona maa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ onɛ la dɔe ba bwa.”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: A baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra bane ta lole dɛɛ ba a ɡɛ ona la dɔe. Aa cheɡɛ a saŋ la tena baa no Korowii Amanesoma nɔ deŋnekpeɡ ta asɛ ba paŋɛ Korowii ona la,

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Korowii berɔ kwaa do tɔpefale, dɛ pa o sɔn “fini.” A habɔɔ aa biɡra la, Korowii cheɡɛ Devid nɛɛ dɛ bol ɡɛ tɔpere nɔ wa. Anee n faa bol la. “Dɛ he no Korowii waa fini naa, he bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Josua aa ba a saŋ la tena ne ba harɛ ta la, dɛ ba fe dɔ ona Korowii aa bol o waa la aa, Korowii fe ta berɛ bol tɔpefale waa kpa.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: He nyiŋo na naa, ona Korowii aa kwaara cheɡ o nɛra la ta lole bá ba onɛ, kɛŋɔ Korowii aa Ona Tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta la.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ onɛ ona Korowii aa dɛ onɛ la, dɛ o onɛ o toma bwa ta kɛŋɔ Korowii aa onɛ o toma ta tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta la.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ɡel ya swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ dɔ ɡɛ ona la. A ta chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa ɛ a saŋ la tena deŋnekpeɡ la dɔŋ dɛ́ ba paŋɛ ɡɛ ona nɔ.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Korowii waa waa bola do kɛ kon o siwi aa lole, dɛɛ ɛ toma. A nyɛɡre ɡe ɡwaa naŋɡɔse bɛlbwa, hale dɛ́ fe won pere hweera le lileo ta, dɛ́ won jo sema bini, hale dɛ́ fe won pere hoɡa ne fɔɔla baah. A wono dɛɛ jemɛ nɛwɛnyini liire ne o wesɔɔhla bwa.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Korowii kontaale bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won kpɔ o te sɔɔh. Wobɛlbwa chɔ baŋ o be wɛɛ nao. Onee dɛ pɛɛ yaa waa bwa yaa baa ɛa harɛ nɔ ta. Yeesu ɛ Sɔfonomonjen

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Ya dɔ Sɔfonomonjen waa wona la Korowii sie tenten. Onee Korowii Bie Yeesu la. Anomanta, hé ɡel ya lawɛ o waa la yaa dɛ yarada la bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Ya Sɔfonomonjen yaa dɔa la ta nɛn waa wola ya nɛɛ sune ya ɡwɛɡra nɔ ta ɛɛ. Daahna bɛlbwa soo siwi toole Bɔnsam aa wola on daahnɛ kɛŋɔ waa dɛ daah yaa nɔ. Kɛ o cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ, o ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ɡel ya lɔ bambile dɛ́ tel Korowii waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba la sie. Wɛɛ na ya sumii dɛɛ cha yaa ɡɛ saŋ aa hiah yaa.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Sɔfonomoa nɔ ɛɛ wonoo dɛɛ sune nɛra baa wola waa jemɛ dɛɛ koni la nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɡba kwaraa ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ won dɛɛ vɛh wechɔɡa ɛɛ.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Gɛ o yon kpo kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ nɛra ba wechɔɡa waa la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛɛ tɛ o tenten, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɡba ɡe dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Sɔfonomoa ɛɛ nɔ ɛ wejena. Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ ɡbaɡba won le o te dɛ ɛ a ɡɛ toma nɔ, nemenɛ Korowii aa leo kɛŋɔ waa le Arɔn o ɛ bɛl la.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do Yeesu Kristo ɡe aa wola o te ɡbaɡba leɛ Sɔfonomoa toma aa ɛ wejena nɔ ta. Korowiirii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N Biee hen, fini n berɛ he Mɛɛ.”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Korowii bol bobɛl ɡe ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ ɛ Sɔfoo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Yeesu aa lɔ harɛ ta la, dɛ wii ne siniire nee wɛɛ soŋe komɛlbwa dɛɛ le Korowii be. Dɛ Korowii dɔ kpeɡri dɛ leo seo ta. Waa pwɛra dɛɛ no Korowii deŋna waa la nomanta, dɛ Korowii dɛ no o wesoŋa.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Yeesu ɛ Korowii Bie, kɛ o na wahala, dɛ che a ta dɛ won pwɛr o te dɛ no o Mɛɛ deŋna wa.

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: Korowii bol o waa dɛ ɛo Sɔfonomoa kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk fa aa ɛ Sɔfo la. Habɔɔ bera jae wa

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Waa yaa dɔa dɛ bol he be dɛ le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta la warɔ, kɛ a bini baɡla kpeɡri, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haa waa mun no.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa o ta aa dɛ ɔr Korowii waa ta la, bechalaa on. Waa waa jemɛ, waa wedɛɛɡa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi jemɛ.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Nomonomee dɛɛ di kondikwaa tenten. Banee ɛ waa biɡri, dɛ jemɛ wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Yaa jemɛ Yeesu Kristo weloɡla la nomanta la, siee a chɛ kɛ yaa kaa, dɛɛ la nomonome bini. Yaa berɛ pa mun bol ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ ya charɛ liire le ya wechɔɡa aa dɛ kaa ya ne seo ta la ta, ne ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ ya yarada Korowii dɛ kpɔ ya te tɛo waa kpa.

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: Yaa berɛ bol Korowii nee sɔe wa, ne nɔɔra kpɔe dɛ dawɛ nɛra nɛ, ne ɡɛ lala bwa aa ba ir seo ta, ne ɡɛ Korowii aa ba bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole dɛ́ bɔ ba ba wechɔɡa kem aa wola jaɡaa dɔ waa kpa.

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii sɛoh waa, yaa ɡel anɔ bwa waa baɡlaa, dɛ́ kaa sie.

english_verse: But what about people who turn away after they have already seen the light and have received the gift from heaven and have shared in the Holy Spirit? What about those who turn away after they have received the good message of God and the powers of the future world? There is no way to bring them back. What they are doing is the same as nailing the Son of God to a cross and insulting him in public!
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, ba ɡel Korowii waa ba fa aa dɛ yarada la! A kpeɡri kɛ ba charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta dɛ berɛ ba yaradao, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ baa kwaara kpaa Korowii Bie la dɛɛ pɛl o daɡaɡre ta, dɛ ɡel sihiih kpoo nɛra baah ta. Ba ɛo dawɛ ba nyu ta.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Harɛ bɛlbwa bwaala aa dɛ nɛ o ta wɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ parɔ la, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ó ɛ harɛdɛɛɡe.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ harɛ bɛlbwa le kpɔɡa ne sɔɔhne aa, o ta tɔnɔ dɔe. O cheɡɛ Korowii taahna nyoa. Baa fuuh.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡa, yaa dɛ bol anɔ bwa nɔ, he te la, he wa aa yaa ɡwaŋɛ. Ya jemɔ kɛ he we-ɛɛla ɛɛ do werii a baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii lɛ heya.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Korowii ta nɛn waa wola waa ɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ soh he tondɛɛɡa haa dɛ ɛ, ne ɡɛ haa dɛ nyinu dɛ koh a waa cha o nɛra dɛ ta ɛɛ cha ba la waa.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he bɛlbwa swɛɛ siwi ɡɛ dɛ́ ka tonɛ, ásɛ dɛ won dɔ kon haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o ta la.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Yaa nyin kɛ he bwara hwah heya. Ya dɛ nyin he kpɔ nɛra baa lawɛ bambile dɛɛ yarada Korowii, ásɛ o tɛɛ ba kwaa waa baɡ ba nyoa la. Korowii aa o nyobaɡaa charɛ bwa

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Korowii baɡɛ Abraham nyoa. Waa baɡɔ nyoa la, komɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ ɡwaalo la, o ɡbaɡbaa o ŋwɛɛ, dɛ ŋɔ,

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ sweeree andɛɛɡaa, dɛ́ tɛɛ naanar kohona.”

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Abraham ɡe wono lawɛ bambile aaa, dɛ ba dɔ kon Korowii aa baɡɔ nyoa la.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn dɛ ba ŋwɛɛra aa, kon waa ɡwaaloo o yon ŋwɛɛ, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛ kasinteŋii wɛɛ bol, dɛ tɔŋla bɛlbwa teŋo.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii dɛ nyin o baɡle nɛra baa dɛ ba kon waa baɡ ba nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ ba la kɛŋɔ waa o liire chara ba bwa, a waa o ŋwɛɛ la.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Korowii baɡɛ nyoa dɛ ŋwɛɛ o tenten ja. Webele anɛ nɔ ɡelɔ nyobaɡa la do kpeɡri, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa won teŋe nyosone. Anee dɛ do ya nɛra yaa ba Korowii be ŋɔ ó lɛ yaa la ɡbemba, ásɛ ya won do kpeɡri ya hwɛɡa yaa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ hwɛɡa nɔɔ dɛ ɡel ya bambile won che bobeŋkpoŋ, ásɛ ya che kɛrɛdɛ. Hwɛɡa nɔ nomanta, a kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ yaa won jo Korowii Dea la bini tenten, bela pateesan fa aa tɔa nɛmpɛɛne aa wola bela jo la.

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Yeesu aa ɛ Sɔfonomoa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk la, o koh ya waa dɛ tɔ sie ya nɛɛ jo bela mɔɔ ya ɡe ba.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Mɛlkesɛdɛk nɔ, dɛ Salɛm kooroo on, asɛ o ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii Sɔfo. A saŋ la Abraham aa le laa waa kaa yo dɛ pɔ koranar banaarɛ bane nɛɛ dɛɛ ba la, Mɛlkesɛdɛk chemo dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Belaa Abraham bɔne kwaa waa dɔa laa la ta bwa bini bɔre fi dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛo. Mɛlkesɛdɛk sɔn la munii “Waa aa Toɡra Kooro.” Salɛm ɡe munii “bambisɔɔhna.” Anomanta, dɛ “Bambisɔɔhna Kooroo” on.

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Mɛlkesɛdɛk ta nya ne mɛɛ dɔe ya jemɛ. O ta lolanar dɔe. O ta lola tɔpere ne sewa tɔpere ɡba dɔe ya jemɛ. O ɛ Sɔfo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la aa wola jaɡa dɔe kɛŋɔ Korowii Bie la ken.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: He na ɡɛ waa ɛ nɛnjen kenɛ? Ya nabaa Abraham o sɔn aa lea kohona la, o ɡbabir bɔne kwaa waa dɔa o laa ta bwa bini fi dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛo.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Lewi naanar baa ɛ sɔfore la, Mosis Mmara la ŋɔ ba bwɛɛ tena la bɛlbwa ɛɛ bɔne o kwaa bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba. Kɛ Abraham naanaree ba bwa ɡe ɡba.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Lewi dea laa Mɛlkesɛdɛk le. Kɛ Abraham ɡe bɔne o kwaa bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛo, asɛ Mɛlkesɛdɛk swee andɛɛɡa tɛ o kwaraa Korowii aa baɡɔ nyoa la.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Ya bwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ nomoaa sweera dɛɛ tɛ bechala.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Lewi luɡe ta sɔfore baa dɛ lɛ kwaa fi bɛlbwa bɔrbeŋkpoŋa la, ba dɛ sewɛ. Mɛlkesɛdɛk te aa lɛa la, Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ o lole saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Lewi luɡe ta sɔforee dɛɛ lɛ kwaa fi bɛlbwa bɔrbeŋkpoŋa. Kɛ yaa wonoo ŋɔ o nabaa Abraham aa bɔne o kwaa bini bɔre fi dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ Mɛlkesɛdɛk la, Lewi ɡba tɛo.

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba ta Lewi lolɛ mɔɔ, kɛ yaa wonoo ŋɔ o ta ɛ o nabaa Abraham dwee dɛ ta ɛɛ ba bala a ɡɛ saŋ Mɛlkesɛdɛk aa cheme Abraham la. Yeesu do kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Gɛ saŋ Korowii aa tɛ o nɛra Mmara la, ɡɛ saŋee Lewi dea tena pa mun dɛɛ di sɔfore. Dɛ nɛra fe ɛɛ wonoo che saraha Lewi dea sɔfore la fa aa ɛa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba la ta dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ka tonaa, a fe ta hiaih kɛŋɔ Sɔfo waa do kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk berɛ ba, dɛ́ ɡel onɔ la waa le Lewi dea dɛ do kɛŋɔ Arɔn.

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Dea o tena aa dɛ di sɔfore la, o beraa, a chɛ kɛ mmara la ɡe berɛ.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ yaa dɛ baɡle nɔ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu waa yaa bol la. O ɡe dea waa le o ta la korɛ sɔfore dea ta. O dea waa le o ta la te bɛlbwa ta Sɔfo toma ɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ Juda deaa o le. Mosis ɡe fa ta bolɛ ŋɔ Juda dea tena dɛ di sɔfore bwa.

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Tarakenii waa la bini ta chaah, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Sɔfo bɛl balɔ dɛ do kɛ Mɛlkesɛdɛk ken kati.

english_verse: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini sɔfore dii mmara ta laa a che o ɛ Sɔfo. O mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la kpeɡri taa a che o ɛ Sɔfo.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, Korowii Tɔn di danseɛ o waa ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ ɛ Sɔfoo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk.”

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Mmarabene la aa wola kpeɡri ne tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe la waa Korowii laa kpɔ.

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ Mosis Mmara nɔ fa ta wone ɡel nɛwɛnyina ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ka tonɛ. Kɛ taraken te, ya dɔ wefala dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta a ɡwaa ambena la, dɛ che a ta dɛ́ won tuuh dɛɛ tel Korowii.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Yeesu te la, ŋwɛɛraa Korowii ŋwɛɛ dɛ cheɡo Sɔfo. Ba baɡle a waa Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii ŋwɛɛrɔ, waa nyoa bera ba. ‘Hɛɛ ɛ Sɔfoo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ ”

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa jaa laanee kɛŋɔ dɛ Lewi dea sɔfore la dɛ serewe. Anomanta, a ɡelɔ nɛra baa di sɔfore la warɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Kɛ Yeesu te, o lole saŋ bɛlbwa. O sɔfore toma la aa berɛ dɛɛ kaa nɛnfale bɛlbwa be bwa.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ tuuh dɛɛ tel Korowii la, Yeesu ɛɛ lɛo waa wola nyoɡre kpa bwa. O lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyina.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Maɡraa a den maɡre kɛŋɔ yaa dɔ Sɔfonomoa waa do kɛ Yeesu dɛɛ cha yaa. Doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ, o tea too, o ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ta pɛɛ. Korowii tɛo nomonome dɛ keeru kaa o be nyundujaɡla.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: O ta doe kɛŋɔ Lewi dea Sɔfonomonome la baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa saraha tɔpere bɛlbwa la. Ba te chɛ kɛ ba tɔ sie ɛ ba ɡbaɡba wechɔɡa saraha mɔɔ dɛ ɛ nɛra la ɡe wechɔɡa saraha. Saraha beŋkpoŋ ɡboo Yeesu ɛ, bɛl ta jae kpa. O kpɔ o te ɡbaɡba ɛ saraha.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Waa yaa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ ya dɔ Sɔfonomoa. O soɡe nomombɔr Korowijen kookara la jwɛɛh nyundua.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: Korowii Dea bini tenten la, belaa wɛɛ di sɔfore. O ɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea ɡbaɡba, nɛwɛnyini laa doo.

english_verse: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.
translation_verse: Sɔfonomoa bɛlbwa tomaa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ fuh kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, dɛɛ ɛ saraha ɡe. Anomanta, a hiaoh kɛŋɔ ya Sɔfonomoa nɔ ɡe dɔ kwaa waa kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Dɛ o fe lɔ harɛ bonɔ naa, o fe aa Sɔfo ɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ sɔfore lɔ harɛ ta dɛɛ ɛ saraha ɡɛ Mosis Mmara aa baɡla la.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Ba sɔfore toma baa dɛ ɛ la, chaaraa baa chaa ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛa Korowii doa la. A tenten laa. A waa Mosis fa aa dɛ ba Korowii Tɛnte Dea baa dɛ tomɔ o bini la ɛɛ la, Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi dɛ ɛ komɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ maa baɡle bwe la doa la.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Taraken nɔ, ba tɛ Yeesu sɔfore toma o ɡwaa harɛ bonɔ sɔfore. Fɔofale la waa cheɡɛ nɛwɛnyini ne Korowii baah ta dɛ fɔwɛ la ɡe ɡwaa ombene la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a cheɡɛ Korowii nyobaɡa aa do wer la ta.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Dɛ fɔobene la fe wer, waane toole o ta naa, onfale fe ta hiaih kpa.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii nao kɛŋɔ o nɛra chɔɡ fɔobene la, a waa o ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao, ásɛ n ne Israel ne Juu tena fɔwɛ fɔofale bɛl.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: O ne fɔo la n ne ba naawa aa fɔwa a ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la aa beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba naawa fa ta fɔo la ta teŋɛ. Anomanta, n ɡe laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Fɔo n ne Israel tena aa dɛ ba fɔwa kerekeree la. Mɛɛ kpɔ me Mmaraa do ba nyu bini, dɛ́ chwerɔ do ba bambile bini, ásɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Aa berɛ hiah kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa baɡle o dɔŋ kɛɛ o nime ŋɔ, ‘A wer kɛŋɔ he jemɛ Korowii’ kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba bechale ne nomonome bwa ɛɛ jem mɛɛ.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Mɛɛ sune ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ba waa aa wola toɡrɛ kɛ ba, maa ba wechɔɡa waa lii kpa.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Korowii aa dɛ bol fɔofale waa nɔ, onloɡle la berɛ ombene. Waa berɛ ombene nɔ, o kpeɡri tonɔ, wɛɛ ba nyoɡra.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: asɛ o do Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bini. Pateesan teŋe dea la doonyoa, asɛ bɛl ɡe bɔne dea la bini anɛ. Dea la boloɡle la sɔne Boɡoroŋ. A ɡɛ Boɡoroŋ la bɔr belaa kandea da ne teebur, dɛ paanoo baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheɡ Korowii sie la do.

english_verse: Behind the curtain was the most holy place.
translation_verse: Asɛ bela baa dɛ yerɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ɡe do pateesan nɛɛte la habɔɔ.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Korowii Boɡoroŋ Tenten la bɔr bela la, dɛ suuɡaswɛm kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma o bini la lɔ bela. Dɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ o bwara bwa, asɛ o che tɛ ba ne Korowii fɔo la lɔ bela. Dɛ suuɡaswɛm vii la baa kpɔ kondikwaa aa le nyundua baa yera maana do o bini la, ne Arɔn daŋɡbala waa moɡɛ papooni la, ne bwepɛle anɛ la ba fa aa chwerɛ o ne ba fɔobene la mmara fi la do a ta la lɔ Daka la bini.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Ba kwaa kena kwaa anɛ ane baa dɛ yera Kerobim la chɔŋɛ Daka la ta a paɡri kena tɔ o ta a sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa. Belaa ba laa Korowii bandia dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛra nɛɛ la, aa baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii jirima lɔ bela. Yaa won dɔ bɔr taraken dɛ baɡle kwaa nɔ waa bwa ka tonɛ.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Yoo, kenii dea la bini kwaa cheche, asɛ sɔfore la ɛɛ jo o boloɡle la bini tɔperee bwa dɛ kaa ɛ ba toma.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Dea la bonɛɛte la te la, Sɔfonomoa ɡboo dɛɛ jo o bini. O ɡba kwaraa la, kerabeŋkpoŋ ɡboo wɛɛ jo bela bena bɛlbwa. O ta chal kpoŋaa, waa bela jo. A nee o kaa soŋe o wechɔɡa ne nɛra la wechɔɡa baa ɛa baa wola jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa la.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe dɛ baɡle yaa waa dɛ le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta kɛŋɔ, dɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la ta lole naa, Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ŋwɛnɛ ta pile mɔɔ.

english_verse: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ cheɡɔ dɛ tɛ fini nɔ. A baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ saraha ɛɛ ne konaatena fuih dɛɛ tɛ Korowii aa won ɡel nɛn baa fuh kwaa la dɛɛ tɛo la tea to.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛ kondiile ne konnyɔɔla ne bwara sarama waa aa ɛ nawee wa. Bwadabii waa a bwa, aa wone ɡel nɛn tea ɛɛ to. Korowiirii kpɔa tɛ o nɛra ásɛ baa teŋɛ a ta dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ o ŋwɛnɛfale la aa bala. Yeesu chal la wa

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Taraken te, Yeesu Kristo balɔ dɛ ba ɛ Sɔfonomoa, dɛɛ ɛ wefala aa bala dɛ do wer ya jemɛ a waa taraken nɔ la toma. Korowii Tɛnte Dea waa dɛ ɛ toma o bini la dɔ jirima, dɛ do wer kɛrɛdɛ ɡwaa onɔ la. Nɛwɛnyini laa doo, harɛ bonɔ kon laa.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo jo Korowii Boɡoroŋ Tenten la. Waa jo bela la, boohna ne nabie chal laa o kpɔ jo bela. O ɡbaɡba chalee o kpɔ jo bela, dɛ lɛ yaa ta aa wola jaɡaa dɔ bwa. Kerabeŋkpoŋii o jo bela. A ta hiaih kɛŋɔ o jo bela kpa.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Nɛn waa kah doŋa la, dɛ baa won kpɔ boohna ne nabala chal dɛ naloni tɔɔ kpɔe dɛ́ merɛ o nɛɛ ásɛ dɛ laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛ Korowii peraa,

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: ɛrɛɛ a ɛ Yeesu Kristo chal aa wola won laa ya doŋa kpɔ ya nɛɛ kohona nɔ? Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la, on cha Yeesu Kristo o won kpɔ o te kɛŋɔ konaate waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii dɛ ɛ saraha dɛ tɛ Korowii. Yeesu chal ɛɛ laa ya wechɔɡa aa dɛ kaa ya ne seo ta la bwaa kpɔ ya nɛɛ ásɛ ya tea to, ásɛ a waa bɛ yaa hiah kpa, ásɛ ya won tomɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛn chwerɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ ba di o kapɛrɛ, dɛ o ta sewaa, nɛn aa won di.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ o sewɔ te naa, baa wonoo bɔne o kwaa name. Dɛ naate waa chwerɛ tɔn la ta lole te naa, ŋwɛnɛ toole kɛŋɔ nɛn bɔne o laala.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: A waa ɡela fɔobene la kwaraa ta la, chal ɛɛ fuɡe mɔɔ baa ɛ o we-ɛɛla la.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Mosis tɔ sie baɡle waa bwa Korowii aa ŋɔa ó nɛra la ɛ dɛ le Korowii Mmara Tɔn bini, mɔɔ dɛ kpɔ nabie ne boohna chale koo nee ta, dɛ kpɔ pee pona aa swɛɛra ne hesɔp ɛ chal ne nee la merɛ Korowii Mmara Tɔn la ne nɛra la bwa nɛ.

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee o yon ɛ chal la dɛ merɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la ne numoli ne koŋkwaare baa dɛ ɛ a ne toma bela la bwa ta.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Mmara la ta la, chal nee baa fee doŋa waa ne kwaa kɛrɛdɛ ta. Dɛ chal ta fuɡaa, Korowii aa wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛɛ kɛ.

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ kwaa la bwa, dɛ Korowii doa kwaa la chaaree a bwa. Dɛ ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛ ba fee doŋa a ta. Kɛ Korowii doa kwaa la te ɡbaɡba la, kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ fee a doŋa la ɡwaa anɔ.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Bela Yeesu Kristo aa joa la, Korowii Boɡoroŋ Tenten nɛwɛnyini aa mao o ɛ Korowii doa kon chaa la ɡbo bini laa o jo. Korowii doa ɡbaɡbaa o la, dɛ ka che Korowii sie ásɛ dɛ won cha yaa taraken.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: A ta hiaih kɛ o teŋɛ dɛɛ jo Boɡoroŋ Tenten la dɛ́ kpɔ o te ɛ saraha bena bɛlbwa ɡɛ Juu tena Sɔfonomoa aa dɛ jo ba kon ta chal aa wola o ɡbaɡba bwara chal ɛɛ ne la.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Dɛ bena bɛlbwaa wɛɛ jo bela dɛ kpɔ o te ɛ saraha aa, bena bɛlbwaa o fe ɛɛ ba wahala nae dɛ kpoŋe le harɛ mumpar ba le fini. Kɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ ɡboo o ba harɛ nɔ ta tɔpere tama waa kaa nɔ ta, dɛ ba kpɔ o te ɛ saraha dɛɛ laa nɛra wechɔɡa kpɔ, waa wola ɡɛɛ ɛ kpa.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Kerabeŋkpoŋii nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa ɛɛ ba sewa, ásɛ a habɔɔ la, Korowii bol o waa dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ ba kpɔ Yeesu Kristo ɡe ɛ saraha kerabeŋkpoŋ, ásɛ o che nɛndamanta wechɔɡa. Wɛɛ berɔɔ ba nɛɛtena ja. Wechɔɡa waa laa wɛɛ ba bala name te. Nɛra baa dɛ kpao siswɛm ne laanee wɛɛ ba ba lɛ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Tɔe Mosis Mmara la tɔ wedɛɛɡa a fa aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba bala la sie dɛ che tɛa. A fa ta wedɛɛɡa la tenten ɛɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn lileo aa wola o ɡbaɡba ɛɛ la. Anomanta, saraha Mmara la aa ɡela baa ɛ bena bɛlbwa la aa won ɡel nɛra baa dɛ ba a ne la ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ka tonɛ.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Dɛ saraha la fe wono ɡel ba le ba wechɔɡa ta kwaraa naa, ba fe ta a ɛɛ ɡelaa? Dɛ a fe wono dɛɛ fee ba wechɔɡa ba nɛ aa, ba liire fe aa ban ha a waa we ba nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ nae ne boohna chale aa won fee wechɔɡa nɛra nɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: A waa Yeesu aa dɛ ba harɛ ta bala la, o ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Konaatena ne koŋkwaa baa kpɔa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛɛ la, he sie aa a ta lɛ. Kɛ he ɛ bwadabii bɛl tɛ mɛ.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: He siwi aa konaatena baa dɛ fuah ambire dɛɛ tɛɛ ne saraha baa ɛa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ soŋe nɛra wechɔɡa la su.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Belaa n ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, menee la. N balɔ dɛ́ ba ɛ he tetoowaa ɡɛ baa chwerɛ n waa Mmara tɔn la bini la.’ ”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa tɔ sie la, o baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ konaatena ne koŋkwaare baa kpɔa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta o sie lɛɛ. O siwi ta konaatena baa fuah dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo, ne saraha baa ɛa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ soŋe wechɔɡa la sui, kɛ dɛ Mosis Mmara ɡe fe baɡle a bwa.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Belaa o ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, menee la, n balɔ dɛ́ ba ɛ he tetoowa.” A baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii teŋe sarahabena la bwa ta, dɛ kpɔ Yeesu Kristo saraha la chiɡ a naa ta.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Juu tena sɔfore te la, tɔpere bwaa ba che ba sɔfore toma ta dɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ saraha siwibeŋkpoŋ. Kɛ a ɡɛ saraha nɔ aa won laa nɛn wechɔɡa kpɔ o nɛɛ bwa.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Kerabeŋkpoŋ ɡboo Yeesu Kristo te ɛ nɛwɛnyini wechɔɡa saraha, a den maɡre, aa wola hiaih kɛŋɔ o ɛ bɛl kpa, dɛ ka so nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: Belaa o do dɛɛ kpa ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii aa ba o dɔma ne harɛ ásɛ o tiɡri ba nɛ.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Saraha beŋkpoŋ waa ɛa dɛ fee wechɔɡa nɛra nɛɛ la ɡboo ɡela ba do kaih saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡba di danseɛ baɡle yaa. O tɔ sie ŋɔ,

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “N Naa Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Fɔo n ne baa fɔwɛ tɔpera aa lɔ sie la ta laanee nɔ. Mɛɛ kpɔ me Mmaraa do ba bambile bini, dɛ́ chwerɔ do ba nyuune bini.’ ”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: O berɔ ŋɔ, “Maa ba wechɔɡa waa lii kpa bwa.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ Korowii dɔɔ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa aa, a ta berɛ hiah kɛŋɔ ba ɛ saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe ya wechɔɡa kpa.

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Yabala, Yeesu seo la nomanta yaa wonoo jo Boɡoroŋ Tenten la, yaa wola ɔmɛ.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: Yeesu pili ŋwɛnɛfale mkpa aa lɔ o ta tɛ yaa, asɛ ya won jo Korowii Boɡoroŋ la ta. O bwadabii ɛo kɛŋɔ pateesanjen o fa aa tɔ Korowii Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ŋwɛnɛ la. Waa sewa la, ŋwɛnɛ pilo tɛ yaa.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Ya dɔ Sɔfonomonjen wɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii bii.

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii aa sɔ ya wechɔɡa ta waa wola ɡelɛ ya liire ɛɛ ɛ yaa kɛŋɔ ya ɛ wechɔɡa kpa, dɛ kpɔ o nedɛɛɡa sɔ ya bwadabii nɔ, hé ɡel ya kpɔ tepoŋ ne yarada ba o be, ya bɛ tɔŋle tama bɛlbwa,

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: dɛ́ lawɛ hwɛɡa yaa dɔa la bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ bol baɡle nɛra yaa wola ɔmɛ tama bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ naate waa baɡɛ yaa nyoa la waa dɔ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya lii ɡɛ yaa ɛ, dɛ́ won dɛɛ do dɔŋa ɡbemba, ne dɔŋa nyina ne wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta,

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: ásɛ dɛ bɛ chema yaa dɛ cheme saŋ bɛlbwa la ɡel, kɛŋɔ bane aa ɡela la. Waa bwa jaɡa tɔpere la dɛ tel, anomanta, hɛ́ɛ do dɔŋa ɡbemba.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Korowii aa pili ya sie ya jemɛ o kasinteŋ nɔ, dɛ ya ta saahnɔ do wechɔɡa ta dɛɛ ɛ aa, saraha bɛlbwa toole bobɛlbwa dɛ fee ya wechɔɡa ya nɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Ɔmee taa yaa ba soɡa dɛɛ kpa Korowii Tɔpere waa dɛ ba nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ do banɔ la baa cheɡɛ o nɛɛ wechɔɡa nii aa dɛ lawɛ kohona la ta.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Nɛn koni Mosis Mmara, asɛ nɛra banɛ ne batoro di danseɛ tiao o waa waa ɛa la ta naa, baa o nɛɛ sune, kpoe baa kpoo.

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Naate waa ŋɔa ŋɔ, “Menee dɔ wechɔɡa kem bɔe, menee dɛ́ bɔ nɛra ba wechɔɡa kem” la, ya jemɛ o nɛnsoo. Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii ɛɛ bol o nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa toole dɛ do ɔma, kɛŋɔ haa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ dɛ jo Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la nɔn ta.

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Hé lii ɡɛ he fa aa doa ɡɛ saŋ Korowii waa la aa chaah he sie la. He na wahala ɡa, kɛ he ta habɔɔ leɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Ba chɛɡre heyaa dɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa nɛra baah ane ta. Dɛ he dɛ cha nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa ane ta.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: He na nɛra baa do ba dea la sum, dɛ cha ba ba wahala nae ta. Ba lɛ he kwaa haa dɔa bwa, kɛ he sie ta kie. He sie lɛo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he jemɔ kɛ he dɔ komɛl waa wola jaɡa dɔe dɛ ɡwaa anɔ la haa paŋa la.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ he yaradae haa dɛ yarada Korowii Bie la. A dɔ kembɔr kohona.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: A hiaoh kɛŋɔ he lawɛ bambile dɛ́ won ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin, ásɛ dɛ won dɔ kwaa waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii Tɔn baɡle la. “A ka tamaa ken ásɛ naate waa dɛ ba bala la ba. Waa biɡra ba.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ su n siwi la te la, wɛɛ yarada mɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ mkpa. Kɛ dɛ o le habɔɔ te naa, n sie aa o nɛɛ lɛɛ ba.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Ya ta nɛra baa dɛ le habɔɔ dɛɛ nyoɡre la ɛɛ. Nɛra baa dɛ yarada dɛɛ dɔ mkpa laanee yan.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa yarada ɔ? Yaradaa kɛŋɔ yaa jema kaih kɛŋɔ yaa wonoo dɔ kwaa yaa dɛ tamane a wa, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kwaa yaa wola an na siwi ne la bwa lole kpela.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Yarada taa a che Korowii pena a saŋ la tena.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Yarada taa a che ya no a mun kɛŋɔ nyoa wobol nee Korowii ta nyundua ne harɛ. Anomanta, nyundua ne harɛ yaa dɛ na nɔ, kwaa baa wola an na nee ba taa.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Yaradaa Ebel dɔ, asɛ o kwaa waa kpɔa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii won su siwi, dɛ ɡwaa o dɔɔ Keen kwa, asɛ Korowii lɛa dɛ penao kɛŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi. O fe sewɔ, kɛ o yaradae waa yarada Korowii nomanta, waa waa ɛa la chɔɔ ba le fini ba ta ɛɛ bola.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Yaradaa Enɔk yarada Korowii, asɛ Korowii kpɔɔ kaa o be nyundua, dɛ o ta sewɛ. Ba nyin o bɔr kahonɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Korowii kpɔɔ kaa nyundua. Ba chwerɛ o waa kɛŋɔ Korowii aa wola on kpɔe kaa o be mɔɔ la, dɛ Korowii sie lɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Nɛn ta yarada dɔe yaa, o waa aa won lɛ Korowii sie. Nomɛlbwa waa ba Korowii be la, a chɛ kɛ o dɔ yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii lole, dɛ́ yarada kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o jemɛ Korowii la, Korowii dɛ chao.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Yarada taa a che Korowii aa kah Nowa waa a ta aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba bala la, o no, dɛ o ta an nae mɔɔ. O noɔ dɛ kwaa daka o ne o haah ne bii jo o bini, ba ta serewɛ. Nowa te aa yaradaa, asɛ nɛwɛnyina baa kaa la aa wola yaradae la, a ɡelɔ nɛwɛnyina bwa di bolchɔɡe, asɛ dɛ ɡel o ɛ nɛra aa cheɡɛ ba yarada ta, asɛ ba waa su Korowii siwi la bɛl.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Yarada taa a che Korowii aa le Abraham ŋɔ ó kaa harɛ waa baɡɔ nyoa la ta la, o le dɛ kaa. Waa dɛ kaa la, dɛ waa bela waa dɛ kaa jemɛ.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Yarada nee o ka so harɛfale Korowii aa baɡɔ nyoa la ta kɛŋɔ hɔɔh ken. Tɛnte deene binii o so kɛŋɔ o bie Aesek ne o ɡe bie Jekɔb Korowii aa baɡɛ ba ɡe a ɡɛ nyoa nɔ tenten la.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Dɛ Abraham dɔ bwɛjen bɛl hwɛɡa. A ɡɛ bwɛɛ la, Korowii ɡbaɡbaa vɔrɔwo, o che kiŋkiŋ. Waa paɡre bwa.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Abraham yaradae waa dɛ yarada Korowii la taa a che o won lolɛ dɛ o hwɛɛhrɔ, asɛ o haah Saara ɡe ɛ hambara. Dɛ o jemɔ kɛŋɔ nyoa Korowii aa baɡɔ la, wɛɛ ɛo.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Abraham aa hwɛɛhra waa wola kpeɡe kpa la, o wono lolɛ, asɛ o naanar ɡe ya, dɛ warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela kɛɛ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Korowii yaradae taa a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa do dɛ ba serewe, dɛ ba ta waa Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa la nae siwi ne. Kɛ ba yarada nomanta, ba naa bojaŋ ba sie lɛ kɛŋɔ haa na hɔɔhra bojaŋ baa ba he sie lɛ la. Ba sɛoh kɛŋɔ ba ɛ hɔɔhra harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ bol ken aa, dɛ ba dɛ nyin ba chaɡle kɛŋɔ ba dɛ nyin ba ɡbaɡba harɛ dɛ so.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Dɛ harɛ baa le o ta ba la waa ba fee lii raa, ba fe ɛɛ wonoo berɛ kaa o ta.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɡɛ laa a do. Harɛdɛɛɡe waa wera ɡwaa bela baa lea la waa baa lii. Harɛ waa lɔ nyundua waa baa lii. Anomanta, a ta Korowii sihiih ɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ yerɔ ba Korowii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kwaa bwɛɛ bɛl cheɡ ba.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Korowii baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ, “Aesek nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa ásɛ n tɛɛ he naanar la maa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ tɛɛ la.”

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Dɛ Abraham jemɔ kɛŋɔ hale dɛ Aesek sewɔ kwaraa naa, Korowii dɔ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ó won iru seo ta. Yaa wonoo ŋɔ sewaa Aesek sewɛ dɛ berɛ ba Abraham nɔn ta ja.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Yaradaa Aesek yarada Korowii waa o won swee Jekɔb ne Esɔ andɛɛɡa ba kerekere soɡa bini.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Jekɔb aa dɛ ba sewa la, o swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Josef bii banɛ la bwa. Dɛ o kpoŋe daŋɡbala dɛ pi o ta dɛɛ duu Korowii. Jekɔb aa dɛ yarada Korowii waa o won ɛ anɔ bwa.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Josef aa dɛ ba sewa la, o ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ baa le Ijipt harɛ taa, dɛ baɡle ɡɛ baa kaa o hoɡa ne ka huɡe bwa. Waa dɛ yarada Korowii la waa o won ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Mosis nya ne o mɛɛ aa lolɔ la, ba kpɔɔ sɔh korobie atoro, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba nao kɛŋɔ o wer bonɔɔ o bwara do kpeɡri. Ba ta Ijipt kooro mmara waa doa la ɔmɛ. Baa dɛ yarada Korowii waa ba won ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Mosis aa kpeɡa la, o ta sɛɛh ba yerɔ Ijipt kooro bihaah bie. Waa dɛ yarada Korowii waa o won ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: O ta sɛɛh ɛ Ijipt tena bodia waa baa lɔ a ta la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɛ wechɔɡa, harɛ bonɔ ɡbo ɡee aa jaɡɛ. O sie lɛ Korowii nɛra la pui dɛ́ na wahala dɛ́ ɡwaa Ijipt tena bodia la.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: O nyiŋi sihiih waa koh Kristo waa dɛ di la kɛŋɔ a wer o be dɛ ɡwaa kondɔɔhkwaa a fa aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɛ nyiŋi tɔpere la Korowii aa ba bɔ nɛra bwa kem la ŋwɛnɛ.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Waa dɛ yarada Korowii la waa waa wola Ijipt kooro bandia ɔmɛ dɛ le bela, a do kɛŋɔ waa dɛ na Korowii baa wola on na la ken, o ta habɔɔ berɛ.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Mosis aa dɛ yarada Korowii waa o pa Galekaa Tɔpejen la dii mun, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɛ chal lɔ ba ɡbeni, ásɛ Korowii nyundua torome waa dɛ kpoo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla la na dɛ bɛ ba te bibanloɡla kpoo.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Korowiirii Israel tena yarada waa Mposwɛm la teŋe anɛ, ásɛ o nenabɔɔ sie hol kɛŋɔ harɛpɛɛ, ba won jo le. Ijipt tena aa ŋɔa ba ɡe le la, mpo la kaa ba ne.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Korowiirii Israel tena yarada waa ba bɔ nsara bar Jeriko tɔpera anuanɛ, asɛ danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛɛ la bwa cheme la kuuɡi.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Korowiirii hanjwamane Rahab yarada waa o lɛ Israel tena baa baa nyiŋi ba bwɛɛ la sɔh kɛrɛdɛ, Israel tena aa wola on kpoe ja nɛra baa wola Korowii waa noɛ la nɛ.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Too, ń baɡle ane ja aa? Maa bɔree dɔ baɡle Gedeɔn, ne Barak, ne Samsen, ne Jɛfta, ne Devid, ne Samoɛl, dɛ Korowii keamere la bwa wa.

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: Ba wono che nijena baah ta dɛ sɔɔh a nyoa, a ta wone fuuh ba, dɛ won lɛ ba te nɛra baa kpoŋe tokobie dɛɛ nyin ba kpoora nɔn ta. Ba wono dɔ bokpeɡa ɡɛ saŋ baa ɡwɛɡra, dɛ won yo laa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ won pɔ harɛre ane tena nɛɛ laa ta ba chwaaɡe.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Korowii yaradae nomanta, ba wono chum haahna bane nɛra baa serewa. Nɛra bane ɛ ba bini bane ɡe hɔhɔrɔwa kɛŋɔ bá fe vɛh Korowii nɛɛ teŋa, kɛ ba ta ba nyu dɔe waa koɛh dɛ vɛh, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba won ba ir seo ta dɛ́ dɔ bodɛɛɡe do.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Ba ɛ bane ɡe bahmuɡliwaa dɛ lɔɔ ba chweremi ne, dɛ do kpɛɛ bane ɡe nɔɔra, dɛ do ba dea.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Ba foɡre bane bwea dɛ kpoo ba, dɛ kpɔ seradaa teŋni bane bini anɛnɛ, dɛ kpoo bane ɡe tokobie ne. Dɛ booh tɔne ne pee tɔnee bane kpɔ berɛ laala dɛɛ do. Dɛ ba nyao kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ nɛra che ba nɛ, asɛ bane ɡe ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa aa wola were.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Dɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire ta chɛɛ kɛ ba ne a ɡɛ Korowii nɛra baa ɛ nɛnjena nɔ pɛ so. Ba ta soŋnibɔr dɔe, dɛ do pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ne bwea dor dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, dɛɛ so bwebɔɔne ne bɔpɛɛne bini.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Nɛra dɛ pena a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa yaradae baa yarada Korowii wa, kɛ ba bɛlbwa ta kon Korowii aa baɡɛ Israel tena nyoa la dɔe.

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: Korowii lii waa aa wera cheɡ ya fini nɔ tena, dɛ ŋɔ a ɡɛ nɛra la ɡbo aa won do kaih ka tonɛ, nemenɛ kɛŋɔ ya ne ba bwa aa pɛa dɛ do kaih.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Ya te aa dɔ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa waa baa yarada Korowii dɛ ɛ aa baɡle yaa waa nɔ, a chɛ kɛ ya ɡe lawɛ bambile dɛ chwa ya chwae waa chɔ ya sie nɔ siswɛm ne. A chɛ kɛ ya laa komɛlbwa waa ɡel ya lɔ naa ya chwae ta la kpɔ, dɛ ɡel wechɔɡa aa dɛ tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ bwa.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Yáa nyiŋi Yeesu waa ɛ ya Korowii yaradae bwa nyu te, dɛ ɛ a mumpar ne a jaɡa la. On koh bosɔɔhna waa ba dɔ waa asɛ ba ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa daɡaɡre ta la. O ta sihiih waa koɛh dɛ vɛh. Taraken o soɡe nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi ɡɛ nɛnchɔɡa fa aa haoh dɛɛ chɛɡro, asɛ o lawɛ bambile la, ásɛ bɔhwaah bɛ heyaa lawɛ, he le habɔɔ.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: He ne wechɔɡa aa dɛ yo nɔ, he ta yoi chal le he nɛɛ mɔɔ.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: He soh ɡɛ Korowii aa kpɔ heyaa ɛ o bii dɛ ja heyaa la aa? Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “N bie, dɛ Korowii dɛ tɛr he deŋne aa, bɛ an wesale lii. Dɛ o dɛ toɡre naa, bɛ ɡel a hwah he bwara,

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛn Korowii aa dɛ nyin la, o deŋnee wɛɛ tɛr, dɛɛ toɡre nɛn waa lɛo kɛ o bie.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Hé lawɛ bambile wahala haa dɛ na ta, dɛ nyiŋa kɛŋɔ he Mɛɛɛ dɛɛ tɛr he deŋne. He deŋnetɛra la chaɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ heyaa ɛ o bii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ bie bɛlbwa toole o mɛɛ aa wola o deŋnee tɛr bwa.

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Dɛ o ta he deŋne tɛrɛ kɛŋɔ waa dɛ tɛr o bii bwa deŋne la aa, amɔ dɛ o bii ɡbaɡba laa heya, dɛ kataborerii heya.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Ya mɛɛnanar baa lolɛ yaa la kwara, ba tɛr ya deŋne aa, ya dɛ no ba be. Aah dɛ ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua dɛ dɔ ya lileore la te sɛ, a ta chɛ kɛ ya no o be dɛ́ dɔ mkpa aa?

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Ya mɛɛnanar baa lolɛ yaa la, tɔpera anɛ bɛlee ba tɛr ya deŋne ɡɛ ba ɡe aa naa kɛ aŋwɛnɛ taa la. Kɛ Korowii te aa dɛ tɛr ya deŋne la, ya ɡbaɡba kɛrɛdɛ waa wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ ya do ɡoroŋ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ waa doa la.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ tɛr nɛn deŋne aa, buɡ la ta la, o tea bini dɛ chɔɡ, o sie aa lɛ. Kɛ dɛ o hweli waa name o deŋnetɛra la ta naa, o waa dɛ toɡre, asɛ o bwara ɛɛ sɔɔhno.

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé do banɔ la ba bwara aa yɔra ɡbemba, ba won che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Hé swɛɛ siwi kɛŋɔ he ne nɛra bwa baah ɛɛ do werii, dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi kɛŋɔ hɛɛ do ɡoroŋee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ nomɛlbwa ta ɡoroŋ doe yaa, waa Korowii nae ba.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Korowii dɔ chae waa dɛ nyin o cha yaa kohona. Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ a bɛ bɛlbwa ba paŋɛ. A waa laa aa, wechɔɡa ane ɛɛ ba jo he binii dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛndamanta kɛŋɔ koŋkpela yon jo kondikwaa ta dɛ chɔɡa la.

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: He bini bɛlbwa bɛ jwamane ba bɔ, dɛ bɛ vɛh kɛ hɛɛ kpɔ duure tɛ Korowii, kɛŋɔ Esɔ aa koh kerabeŋkpoŋ kondikwaa dii waa charɛ o nomonome tɛ o nime la.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Haa ba Korowii be nɔ, kon haa leɡe be laa he ba, kɛŋɔ Israel tena fa aa ba Sinai Bwejen ta la. A ɡɛ bwejen nɔ fa dɛ lawɛ nii jiɡijiɡi ken. Ba fa aa ba o mun la, bɔr bwa biro kpirikpiri ken, asɛ peu ɛɛ ta vuɡuvuɡu ken.

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: Dɛ bɛla bɛl dɛ si, asɛ nomɛl taa ɛɛ le. Nɛra la aa no taa la, ba soŋɔ ŋɔ anɔ la baa noa la maɡre ɡɛ,

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ waa naate aa dɛ bol la kpeɡri tɛɛ ba. O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ kondɛɛre kwaraa leɡe bwejen la aa, a chɛ kɛ bá foɡro bwea kpo.”

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: Waa aa chiɡ bela la, dɛ a ɔma kohona to, asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Ɔmee laɡ mɛ, n bwara dɛ sa!”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: He te aa ba Korowii be nɔ, Saayɔn Bwejen ne Jerusalam waa lɔ nyundua dɛ ɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa bwɛjen la, o taa he ba. Bela nyundua toroma kaɡboŋlafa aa chema silɛɛ ne laanee he ba.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: O binomonome o kapɛrɛ aa ku ba nɔn asɛ ba sɔna do tɔn la aa lɔ o be la ta la ɡba cheme bela. Ba ne Korowii waa dɛ ba nɛra bwa waa bola dɛ́ pa bole la, ne lala ba wa aa toɡra dɛ su o siwi, asɛ o ɡel ba ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ka tonɛ la bwa bee he ba.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Yeesu bee he ba. On cheɡɛ nɛwɛnyini ne Korowii baah ta dɛ fɔwɛ fɔofale la. Bela waa kpɔ o chal merɛ laanee he ba. O chal soŋe wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ yaa. A ta do kɛŋɔ Ebel chal aa ba taahna ne la.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ dɛ bɛ deŋne taŋ Korowii waa waa dɛ bol la ta. A saŋ la tena fa aa vɛh nɛn ba ne waa lɔ harɛ bonɔ waa waa bola dɛ kpɔ ja ba la, dɛ ba ta wone lɛ ba te naa, ya nɛra yaa vɛh naate waa lɔ nyundua waa waa kpɔa dɛɛ ja yaa la, ɛrɛɛ yá ɛ dɛ won lɛ ya te nɔ?

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Waa bol waa ɡɛ saŋ la, harɛ jiɡro. Kɛ taraken te, o baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ba jiɡri harɛɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ ja. Harɛ ɡbo laa mɛɛ ba jiɡra. Mɛɛ jiɡri nyundua ɡee ja.”

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa waa bola dɛ ŋɔ “kerabeŋkpoŋ ja” nɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o baa jiɡri nyundua ne harɛ naa, Korowii kontaala aa lɔ a ta dɛ́ won jiɡri la ɛɛ chɔɡoo, ásɛ kwaa la aa wola won jiɡri la do le dɛɛ la.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ yaa jam Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ waa ɡela ya do o Kora waa wola yiiɡi ta nɔ. A chɛ kɛ yaa tomɔ ɡɛ aa too o tea, dɛɛ tɛo duure dɛɛ ɔmɔ,

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya Korowii nɔ do kɛ nii aa wona dɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa kohona.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: He nya biirii dɔŋa Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ ta, anomanta, hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: He bɛ soh kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ lɛ hɔɔhra dɛɛ nyiŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ. Bane ɛ ɡɛ dɛ nyiŋi nyundua toroma, dɛ baa jemɛ.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ lii nɛra baa do ba dea waa kɛŋɔ he ne banee ba do dea ken. Hɛ́ɛ lii nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa ɡe waa kɛŋɔ he ɡe aa dɛ na weweele la bɛl ken.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel suuɡa waa swɛɛ he siwi kohona. Hé ɡel anɔ la haa dɔa la maɡre he ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, “Maa heyaa ta bwa, maa sie laa kpɔ he nɛɛ bwa.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Anomanta, yaa wonoo lɔ bambile ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii dɛ cha mɛ, anomanta, maa ɔmɛ. Ɛrɛɛ nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ mɛ nɔ?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi he nomonome ba fa aa bol Korowii waa dɛɛ baɡle heyaa la. Hé nyiŋi ɡɛ ba fa aa teŋɛ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ ba serewe, dɛɛ yarada Korowii ɡɛ ba fa aa dɛ yaradao la.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo aa beɡre. Gɛ waa doa a saŋ la, ɡɛɛ o ta do fini, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba doe saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: He bɛ ɡel wefala chɔɡ he liire ásɛ he le Korowii ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ta. He dɛ nyin he do kpeɡri Korowii nɛɛ teŋa ta naa, hé kpɔ sie dawɛ chae Korowii aa sune nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba la ta. He bɛ sie kpɔ dawɛ kondikwaare ane kii ne ane dii ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ta wone cha nɛra baa kpɔ sie dawɛ a ta la.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Juu tena sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Tɛnte Dea bini la ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ ba di ya saraha kwaa yaa dɛ di la ane.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Juu tena Sɔfonomoa dɛ ba chal ne saraha ɛɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la aa, o dɛ jo a ne bela dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe o nɛra wechɔɡa. Kondɛɛra la baa ɛ a chal la te la, ba dɛ le a ne dahara dɛ́ ka fuah.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee Yeesu ɡe na wahala dɛ sewɛ bwɛjen Jerusalam dahara, asɛ dɛ kpɔ o chal dɛ laa doŋa kpɔ nɛwɛnyina nɛɛ ásɛ ba ɛ Korowii nɛra.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ɡel ya la o be dahara bela, dɛ́ ka puu di o sihiih waa dia la,

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ, ya ta bwɛjen dɔe dɛ so o ta saŋ bɛlbwa harɛ bonɔ. Bwɛɛ o ta aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba la, o taa ya sie dawɛ.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: He bɛ dɔŋa wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ne dɔŋa chae waa soh, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ saraha a waa aa dɛ lɛ Korowii sie.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no nɛra baa dɛ tɔ he sie la nyoa wa, dɛɛ ɛ waa baa ŋɔa hɛ́ɛ ɛ la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ban dɛɛ nyiŋi heya. Ba dɔ nkontaa dɛ bu Korowii sie dɛ baɡle ɡɛ bwa baa nyiŋi heya.
