Hɛ́ɛ no ba nyoa wa, ásɛ ba won ɛ toma silɛɛ ne. Dɛ haa ba nyoa waa no aa, baa ɛa tebinichɔɡ nee, aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa lee ba dɛ́ tɛ heya.

english_verse: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
translation_verse: Hé soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ yaa. Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya tea bini too, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya dɛ nyin kɛ yaa ɛ waa aa toɡra saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe heyaa kohona, ásɛ he soŋe Korowii, ásɛ o ba n ne he be warane.

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: N dɛ soŋe Korowii waa ir ya Dɔɔ Yeesu seo ta la. Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɛ Peteɡrejen dɛɛ nyiŋi o peera ta. Seo o ɡbaɡba aa sɛah dɛ sewɛ la, a taa a che asɛ Korowii fɔwɛ fɔo waa wola pura dɔe bwa la.

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Kórowii waa dɛ tɛ bambisɔɔhna la tɛ heyaa dadɛɛɡe aa chɛ kɛ he dɔ, dɛ́ won dɛɛ ɛ o tetoora bwa. Ó che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin bwa ya bini. Yeesu Kristo chɛ jam saŋ te bɛlbwa! Aamen.

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Yabala, n dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ he lawɛ bambile, dɛ́ no waa nɔ maa chwera dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ja heyaa nɔ. He nyiŋo na naa, tɔn nɔ maa chwerɛ heyaa nɔ aa jaŋɛ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba le ya dɔŋ Timoti dea. O balɔ warane asɛ mɛɛ ba he be naa, n ne wɛɛ bao.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ na he nomonome la bwa, ne Korowii nɛra la bwa. Yabala Itali harɛ tena la ɡe dɛ na heya.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: N Naa Kórowii sune he nɛ, dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Men Jems maa ɛ Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ laanee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ tena haa lɔ bobɛlbwa la. N dɛ na heya. Yarada ne wejema

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Yabala, dɛ wobɛlbwa pu heyaa dɛ ɛ wekpeɡa aa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Hé dɔ bambile wobɛlbwa ta dɛ́ ka tonɛ, ásɛ dɛ won che a ta dɛ́ jemɛ wa, dɛ́ dɔ dadɛɛɡe, ásɛ wobɛlbwa bɛ heyaa nya harɛ nɔ ta.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Dɛ wobɛlbwa pu heyaa hɛɛ nyin a wejema aa, hé soŋe Korowii ásɛ o tɛ heya. O tea chɔ pɛɛ, waa nɛn kon tɛ o waa berɛ dɛɛ we o nɛ. Wɛɛ tɛ heyaa.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Kɛ hé kpɔ yarada dɛ́ɛ soŋo, dɛ bɛ dɛɛ tɔŋle. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɔŋle kɛ o ken aa o konnyinii dɔ la, o ta yarada dɔe. O liire won bera warawara kɛŋɔ peu yon ta dɛɛ beɡre mpo nee dɛɛ kaa bobɛlbwa la.

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Dɛ he nyao dɛ ɛ Yeesu habɔteŋre aa, ɡel he sie lɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɛ nɛnjen Korowii be.

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: Dɛ he ɛ dɔɔh ɡe aa, ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ he ne nyaa la bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre Korowii be. Haa biɡri sewɛ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa yon fe dɛ́ chure warane dɛ́ berɛ sewɛ la.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Gɛ wee yon le dɛ́ lɔ, ásɛ kpɔɡa sewɛ dɛ́ chure a fedɛɛɡa la ta, ásɛ a wer tonɛ la, ɡɛ tentenee dɔɔh ɡee ba sewa o kwaa nyina ta, ásɛ o kondɔɔh la bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: He bini bɛlbwa waa takapɔ lawɛ bambile dɛ́ɛ na wahala la, o na som. Dɛ wenaale la kpoŋee la sie dɛ ba horɛ, kɛ he ta teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ he bambile bwa ne naa, wɛɛ tɛɛ mkpa waa ŋɔa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyinu laanee, á ɛ kompoŋ haa yoa dɛ le ba vɔwɛ.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Dɛ waane pu nomɛl o ɛ wechɔɡa aa, o bɛ ŋɔ Korowiirii ɡela o ɛ wechɔɡa. Wobɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ɡel Korowii ɛ wechɔɡa. Waa waane ɡee kpɔ ta ya nɛɛ ya ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Dɛ waane pu nomɛl o ɛ wechɔɡa aa, o ɡbabir pɛla waa dɔa laanee ɡela o ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Pɛla waa wola were la dɛ́ lolɛ wechɔɡa, ásɛ wechɔɡa ɡe baa waraa, a yon lolɛ seo.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Yabala, he bɛ ɡel ba neɡre heya.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa waa wera la le Korowii be. Komɛlbwa waa ɛ kondɛɛɡe la, Korowiirii kpɔa kɛ yaa. Onee ya Mɛɛ waa ta kwaa bwa aa lɔ nyundua dɛɛ chaah harɛ. Gɛ kwaa nɔ dɛ chaah, ane ta ɡe aa chaah, kɛ Korowii te aa beɡre bwa.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: O ɡbaɡba tetooraa ya dɔ o waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ la dɛɛ no, dɛ che a ta ɛ o bii, ásɛ dɛ su o siwi kwaa waa taa la bwa bini. Korowii waa noe ne a ɛɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: Yabala, hɛ́ɛ lii waa nɔ aa teŋa nɔ. Hé ɡel he sie beɡre waa noe ta, dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛɛ bol wa, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel he baah ɛɛ di warawara.

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: Nɛwɛnyini bandia aa wobɛlbwa kwaa Korowii ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe teŋa ta.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé le wedoŋa ne wechɔɡa aa lɔ he bini dɛ ɡwaa he nɛɛ la ta, dɛ́ pwɛr he te, dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii waa la waa kpɔa do he bambili bini á won lɛ heyaa la.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa no waa nɔ, waa wola ɡɛ waa la aa baɡla la ɛ la, o do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi diɡi ta dɛɛ na o ɡbaɡba la.

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: Waa nyiŋi o te diɡi la ta dɛ na ɡɛ waa doa la, tamaa ken, dɛ o berɔ soh ɡɛ waa doa.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Korowii Mmara wer kɛrɛdɛ, o ɡelɔ yaa dɔ ya te, waa yaa vɔrɔwe. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no dɛɛ pese o bini, waa wola soh dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa baɡla la, Korowii ɛɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ naate o we-ɛɛla bwa ta.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl dɛ lii kɛ o ɛ Korowii torome, dɛ o ta nyotɔɡbom dɔe yaa, o dɛ neɡre o nyu. Naate Korowii toma la ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ aa dɛ nyin a do wer dɛ́ maɡre o toma bini laanee kɛŋɔ, yá cha bilalbii ne luhaahna ba wahala bini, ásɛ dɛ laa ya te kpɔ harɛ nɔ wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Yabala, haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ jirima Dɔɔ nɔ, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ he duu nɛra bane dɛ́ ɡwaa bane.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ne he bala chemo dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii, nɛra banɛ ba jo he bini, bɛl do suuɡaswɛm kwaa dɛ tɔ yadɛɛɡe, bɛl ɡe tɔ yadoŋ,

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: asɛ he tɛ onɔ la waa do suuɡaswɛm kwaa dɛ tɔ yadɛɛɡe la sobɔrdɛɛɡe, dɛ ŋɔ onɔ la waa tɔ yadoŋ la be ŋɔ, ó te che bela kɛɛ ó ba so harɛ he sie naa,

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: amɔ dɛ he dɛ duu bane dɛ ɡwaa bane. Nɛra siebɔree hɛɛ nyiŋi dɛɛ duu bane dɛɛ nyiŋi bane nyubaahna. Haa kɛrɛdɛ ɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé no! Korowii we-ɛɛlaa kɛŋɔ ó le harɛ nɔ ta nyaara baa yaradao kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ ba yarada la ɛɛ ba kondɔɔh, ásɛ ba dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ja o Kora waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra baa dɛ nyinu ja o ta la.

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Kɛ he te lawɛ nyaara sie teɡɛ harɛ. Dɔɔhna laa dɛɛ fiiɡi heya, dɛ lawɛ heyaa kaa che kɔɔto la aa?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ teŋɛ Korowii Kora Mmara baa chwera ŋɔ, “Nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he te ɡbaɡba la” ta naa, dɛ he dɛ ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Kɛ dɛ he dɛ duu nɛra bane dɛ ɡwaa bane aa, dɛ he dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa. Mmara baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ he di bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa teŋɛ Mmara la bwa ta kɛ dɛ koni o bini beŋkpoŋ la, dɛ o koni o bwa, dɛ di bolchɔɡe.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Korowiirii baɡla ŋɔ, “Bɛ jwamane bɔ.” O tentenee bera baɡle kɛ “Bɛ nɛn kpo.” Dɛ he ta jwamane bɔe dɛ kpo nɛn aa, dɛ he ɛ nɛn haa koni Mmara la.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa naate waa wola o dɔŋ sum na la sumii na awola waa dɛɛ bol ya waa la. Naate waa dɛ na o dɔŋ sum la aa o waa bola ɔmɛ. Yarada ne wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Yabala, dɛ nomɛl ŋɔ o dɛ yarada Korowii, dɛ o ta o yarada kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa, tɔnɔ besoo o yarada la dɔɔ? A ɡɛ yarada nɔ ɛɛ wonoo lɛo wa aa?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: He nao kɛŋɔ he dɔŋ baa kɛɛ haah dɛ chɔ waa, dɛɛ nyin yal dɛ́ tɔ, dɛɛ nyin kondikwaa ɡe dɛ́ di,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: asɛ he ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛɛ bokpeɡa dɛ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna,” dɛ vɔmɔ kwaa aa tɛo bokpeɡa la te naa, dɛ tɔnɔ besoo lɔ waa haa bola tɛo la ta nɔ?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Gɛɛ a do yarada ta kɛŋɔ dɛ nɛn ta wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛɛ ja o yarada ta naa, dɛ o yarada la ɛ wepuu.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Bɛl lole nomɛl ɛɛ ŋɔɔ yaradae ɡboo wɛɛ yarada Korowii, ásɛ bɛl ɡe ŋɔ wedɛɛɡaa o ɡee ɛ. Kɛ ɡɛ ɡe aa won maɡre. Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona baɡ mɛ he yarada dɛ he ta wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛɛ ja a ta nɔ? N te, mɛɛ che n wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ taa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛ n dɛ yarada Korowii.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: He dɛ yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii beŋkpoŋii lole naa? A wer ɡa! Kɛ he ne Bɔnsam toromaa soɡe dabeŋkpoŋ ta. Ba ɡba dɛ yarada Korowii ɔmee ne bochela ne.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Gɛne! He dɛ nyin n baɡle kɛŋɔ yarada wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ aa wola a ta jae la ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ aa?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Ya naa Abraham fe aa dɛ ba o bie Aesek kpoe dɛ tɛ Korowii la, a ta laa a che Korowii ŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi la aa?

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: He ta nae kɛŋɔ o yarada ne o wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ bwa aa pɛ aa? O wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ taa a che o yarada ɛ yarada kasinteŋ.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii Tɔn waa la ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ baa ŋɔa ŋɔ, “Abraham yarada Korowii, asɛ o yarada nomanta, Korowii ŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi” la. Dɛ ba dɛ yerɔ Korowii dam.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Kɛ he nao kenɛ, nɛn wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ne o yarada bwa taa a che wɛɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi, o yarada ɡbo ta laa.

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Anomanta, ɡɛ nɛn ta hweera dɔe yaa dɛ o sewɔ la, ɡɛɛ yarada wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ aa wola a ta jae la ɛ yaradapuu.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Yabala, he bwa laa chɛ kɛ he ɡel he sie beɡre Korowii waa baɡla ta, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ haa jema la, ya nɛra yaa dɛ baɡle Korowii waa la waa binii wɛɛ ba nyiŋa kɛrɛdɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa kaa la.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Ya bwa dɛ koni saŋ bɛlbwa. Dɛ nɛn aa wobɛlbwa waa dɛ bol la ta koni aa, dɛ o ɛ nɛn o wa a toɡra tenten. Nɛn waa won o wobol nyiŋa la, o won o te lawa wobɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Ya kpɔ bune dɛɛ do jaɡre nyoo asɛ aa no ya wa, asɛ ya won a bera dɛɛ kaa bela bwa yaa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Yá ta sie na ɡɛ stiimae aa kana, asɛ peukpeɡ yon ta dɛ kpɔɔ dɛɛ kaa, kɛ dajeɡa bɛlee lɔ o ta ba kpɔ dɛɛ menɛ o sie asɛ wɛɛ kaa bela bwa baa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Gɛɛ nyondoŋe do jeɡaa nɛn bini, kɛ dɛ won wejena ɛɛ. Hé na ɡɛ kɔr aa doa asɛ nihɔl won o fuih.

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Nyondoŋe do kɛŋɔ nihɔl ken, dɛ won wechɔɡa ɛɛ taeh ya bini, dɛ won yaa chɔɡa ya soɡa bini bwa. Bɔnsam niinii dɛɛ choŋu.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Kpɔɡ bini ola ne olchɔɡa ne jumbii ne kwaa aa dɛ huuh, dɛ mpo bini pɛŋa bwa, nɛn won a dɛɛra á do pwɛre.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Kɛ nyondoŋe te, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ won o nyiŋa. O ɛ konchɔɡe haa wola won toɡro. O dɛ kpo kɛŋɔ tɛɡchɔɡa ken.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Nyoa beŋkpoŋ la taa wobodɛɛɡa ne taahna bwa ɛɛ le. Yabala, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ aa ba ɡɛ!

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Nenabɔɔ ɛɛ wonoo palɛ, o nee ane do som ásɛ ane ɡe do nyɛɡre aa?

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Yabala, fig da ɛɛ wonoo nɔnɛ sombie aa, kɛɛ bambi ɛɛ wonoo nɔnɛ fiɡ nɔna aa? Gɛ tentenee nenabɔɔ o nee aa do nyɛɡre la aa wola won berɛ do som buɡ ta tenten. Wejema anɛ ane wa

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: He bini umee ɛ wejereme dɛɛ no waa mun ɔ? Gel o pwɛr o te dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ o da baɡle kɛ o ɛ wejereme.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɛ nyin kɛ he ɡbo dɔ, dɛ dɔ bɔweela ne sibeɡra he bambile bini naa, amɔ he bɛ sɔn dɛ́ɛ nyin dɛ́ɛ ŋɔ he dɔ wejema. Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he ta kasinteŋ dɔe.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Gɛ wejema nɔ ta Korowii doa wejema ɛɛ, a ɛ harɛ ta kwa. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe toole a ta. Bɔnsam liiree.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Anomanta, bela bɔweela ne n ɡbo dɔ aa lole la, belaa wesaɡasaɡare ne wedoŋa bwa do.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna la, nyopɛo nee baa ɛ ba wa, aa le wedɛɛɡa.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Bɔkwaa dɛɛ ba naɡra ne he baah ta nɔ? Kwaa haa dɛ pɛlɛ a nɛɛ laa dɛɛ ba a ne naa? Anee dɛɛ yo heya.

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Kwaa haa dɛ nyin haa wola dɔ la waa hɛɛ kpoo dɔŋa la. He dɛ nyin kwaa sibeɡra ne, kɛ haa dɔ, a waa ɡela hɛɛ naɡre dɛɛ yo la. Haa wola Korowii soŋe la waa haa wola he konnyina dɔ la.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: He dɛ soŋo, kɛ haa dɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ liire haa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ soŋo la aa were. He ɡboɡbo konnyina ne kwaa haa dɛ pɛlɛ a nɛɛ waa hɛɛ soŋo.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: He nɛnchɔɡa nɔ haa wola Korowii ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ hanchɔɡe waa dɛ nyin baala nɔ! Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyin harɛ nɔ ta kwaa la vɛh Korowii dɛ ɛ o dɔm kɛɛ? Nomɛlbwa waa daŋre harɛ nɔ ta kwaa nyina ne la vɛh Korowii.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Kɛ he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ pɛɛpɛɛ Korowii Tɔn la ŋɔ lileo Korowii aa kpɔa do ya bini la dɛ mee la?

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Kɛ chae Korowii aa na ya sum dɛɛ cha yaa la, on kpeɡa, ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn la aa baɡla ŋɔ, “Korowii dɛ ba nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔnnyin la ne harɛ, dɛɛ sune nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te nɛ.”

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii ásɛ dɛ no o be. Hé yo Bɔnsam. Wɛɛ chwao le he be.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Hé suuh tel Korowii, ásɛ o suuh ba he be. Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, hé charɛ he liire dɛ́ le he wechɔɡa ta. He banɔ la he liire aa ɛ anɛnɛ la, hé laa doŋa kpɔ he nɛ.

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he tea bini chɔɡ, hé wi. Hé ɡel he mama berɛ wii ásɛ he silɛɛ ɡe berɛ sum.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Hé pwɛr he te tɛ Korowii. Wɛɛ ɡɔɔ heyaa.

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Yabala, he bɛ he bala dɛɛ ŋwalɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa ŋwalɛ o dɔŋ kɛɛ dɛ́ pwaoh la, dɛ Mmara laanee o ŋɔ aa were dɛɛ pwah la. Dɛ he bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ Mmara la aa, amɔ te dɛ haa waa Mmara la aa baɡla la ɛ. Dɛ he dɛ ɡɔɔ he te dɛɛ pwah Mmara la.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Korowii ɡbosoroo dɛ́ won do Mmara dɛ́ won bol nɛn wechɔɡa wa, o ɡbosoroo dɛ́ won lɛ nɛra dɛ́ won chɔɡ bane ɡe. He ɡee umeo he won bol he dɔŋ bwara wechɔɡe ɔ? Mbarafo ɛɛ jae wa

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Hé berɛ dɛɛ no. He banɔ la haa dɛ lii he nyuune bini dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Fini kɛɛ tɔpere nɔ tɔpesoo yaa la bwɛɛ nɔ bwɛsoo taa, dɛ́ ka di benanyoa dɛɛ di bona dɛ́ nyin kwa,”

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: kɛ dɛ he ɡe aa jemɛ ɡɛ tɔɔ aa dɛ ba he pera la! Gɛ kɔɔla yon ta, kɛ aa biɡri dɛ yon kaa la, ɡɛɛ he mkpa do.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, a fe chɛ kɛŋɔ he ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii sɛoh dɛ tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ te naa, tɔɔ perɔ yaa ka ɛ kenii kɛɛ anɔɔ.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Kɛ taraken he dɛ ɛ mbarafo kɛ he ɡbo ɛɛ wonoo ɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin. A ɡɛ waa la bwa ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa jemɛ waa aa wera kɛŋɔ o ɛ, dɛ vɛh ɛɛ la, dɛ o ɛ wechɔɡa.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Kondɔɔhna ɡe, hé no n be! Waa aa dɛ ba heyaa pui la nomanta, hé dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛ́ɛ wi.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: He kondɔɔh chɔɡɔ, kwaa di he bwara laala bwa.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: He suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa bwa ɡe deero. Awola Korowii aa dɛ ba he waa bola la, he suuɡare aa deera la ɛɛ ɛ danseɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ́ we heyaa kɛŋɔ nii ken. Bɔkwaa hɛɛ cheɡ suuɡa tɔpera aa ka mun nɔ ta dɛ́ ɛɔ?

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no! Nɛra haa kpɔ ba, ba ɛ he kooni tomare he ta ban kem bɔe dɛ faah ba la, ba dɛ wi he tɛl. A ɡɛ nɛra la wii chole Korowii waa ɛ komɛlbwa Dɔɔ la deŋna ta.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: He dɔ sobɔrdɛɛɡe harɛ nɔ ta dɛ so, dɛɛ di he bwara. Gɛ haa dɛ di he bwara la, he do kɛŋɔ kondɛɛre baa ku kpɔɡa dɛɛ tɛo ó di dɛ́ je bá kpoo la.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: He pa nɛndɛɛɡa ba wa aa do kaih la bolchɔɡe dɛ kpoo ba, ba ta wone ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ lɛ ba te. Bambile lawa wenaale ta

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Kɛ yabala, hé lawɛ bambile, dɛ́ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ ya Dɔɔ la aa ba. Hé na ɡɛ paa yon so kpa bwaala loɡla á nɛ ó du o kwa, dɛ́ lawɛ bambile, ásɛ yoo ɡe yo mɔɔ o koo kwaa la yon ɛ la.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Gɛ tentenee chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡe lawɛ bambile dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he Dɔɔ la bala telo.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Yabala, he bɛ dɔŋa waa dɛɛ naɡre ásɛ dɛ ba di bolchɔɡe Korowii sie. Ya bole pae dɛ tel.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé nyiŋi Korowii keamere la baa cheɡɛ o sɔn ta dɛ bol waa baɡle nɛra la na, dɛ na ɡɛ baa na wa, kɛ dɛ won lawɛ bambile ba wahala ta la. Hé ɡe ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ yerɛ nɛra baa wona lawɛ bambile, dɛ che kiŋkiŋ la nɛra baa na som. He fa no Job wa, ɡɛ waa wona lawɛ bambile dɛ che kiŋkiŋ o wahala bini ka tonɛ, asɛ a habɔɔ Korowii chao. Nɛra waa dɛ domɛ Korowii tea wɛɛ sune ba nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: Yabala, anɔ la aa jaa dɛ ɛ siswɛm waa laanee kɛ, he bɛ Korowii kɛɛ harɛ kɛɛ komɛlbwa dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ. Ba dɛ bɔɔ heyaa waa dɛ a ɛ kpela aa, hé sɛh ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh,” dɛ nyosone ɡee yaa, hé ŋɔ, “Ɔɔhɔh.” He bɛ ŋwɛɛ ja, ásɛ a bɛ wechɔɡa ɛ dɛ́ tɛ heya. Korowii soŋa yarada ne

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Dɛ sibeɡrewaane pu bɛlbwa naa, wɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii. Dɛ silɛɛ waane ɡe pui naa, ɡo yela dɛ́ kpɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ he bini bɛlbwa ɡe bwara dɛ weo waa, ó tomɛ nɛn o ka yerɛ asɔre la bini nomonome, ásɛ ba ba kpɔ noo leɡe o tile Yeesu sɔn ta, dɛ́ soŋe Korowii tɛo.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba kpɔ yarada dɛ soŋe Korowii aa, weela te la ɛɛ dɔ bokpeɡaa. Ya Dɔɔ la ɛɛ ɡeloo o bwara do kpeɡri. Dɛ wechɔɡa anee o ɛ kwaraa naa, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛo.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Anomanta, a wer kɛŋɔ he bol he wechɔɡa dɛɛ baɡle he bala he ne baa teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ la, ásɛ ba ɡe won soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ o tɛ heyaa bokpeɡa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡe dɛ soŋe Korowii aa, o dɛ no dɛ ɛ dɛɛ tɛo.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Korowii keame Elaeja fa ɛ nɛn kɛŋɔ yan. O soŋe Korowii taeh dɛ ŋɔ ó ɡel bwaala nɛɛ, asɛ bwaala ta nɛɛ, hwel che bene atoro korobie anumɛl.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Asɛ o berɛ soŋe Korowii ja dɛ ŋɔ ó ɡel bwaala nɛ, asɛ nyundua pili, bwaala nɛ taeh, harɛ ta kwaa bwa le.

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa wona cha wechɔɡ-ɛɛ asɛ o ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ berɛ baa ɛ wedɛɛɡa ja la, dɛ naate lɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la mkpa, dɛ ɡel o wechɔɡa damanta bwa waa ɛa la, Korowii kpɔ kɛo.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Men Pita maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he Korowii nɛra haa peɡra dɛ ka ɛ hɔɔhra Pɔntos, ne Galaasia, ne Kapadoosia, ne Eesia dɛ Bitiinia harɛre ta la.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Korowii waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ cheɡɛ jema waa jemɛ heyaa wubwa la ta, dɛ le heyaa kɛŋɔ o nɛra dɛ tɛ o te. O Domadɛɛɡe laanee ɡela he do ɡoroŋ, dɛ ɡel hɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo waa ta, asɛ o chal yaɡle he doŋa he nɛ. Kórowii cha heyaa dɛ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna kohona. Ya kpɛɛ Korowii hwɛɡa waa kpɔa tɛ yaa

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii. Waa dɛ sune ya nɛɛ kohona nomanta, o cheɡɛ ira waa ir Yeesu Kristo seo ta la ta dɛ ɡel ya ɛ nɛnfala. Anɔ ɡelɔ ya dɔ hwɛɡa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ hwɛɡɛ kondɔɔh waa kwaara cheɡ yaa la ta kɛŋɔ aa ɛ ya kwaa. O kwaa a bwa cheɡ heyaa Korowii doa, belaa aa wola pɔh, aa wola chɔɡ, aa wola tu bwa.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: He cheɡaa a che. He yarada nomanta, Korowii kpɔ o kpeɡri tɔ he nɛ, wobɛlbwa aa wola won ɛ heyaa ka tel kɛŋɔ waa ba lɛ heya. O ɛ lɛɛ waa ba lɛ heyaa la wobɛlbwa tonɛ, dɛ lɛ heyaa waa bwa jaɡa saŋ.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he dɔ silɛɛ kohona, kɛ he tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡoo tama te, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Bɔnsam ɛɛ daah heyaa daahna bwa soo siwii na.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: A bwa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he yarada la ɛ yarada kasinteŋ. Suuɡaswɛm kwaraa nɔ, nii nee baa jemɛ a kasinteŋ, kɛ a dɛ chɔɡ. He yarada la ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm, anomanta, a chɛ kɛ ba daah heyaa na ásɛ he won che kiŋkiŋ. Belaa baa ba heyaa kpɛɛra, ásɛ he dɔ jirima, dɛ́ dɔ sɔn awola Yeesu Kristo aa ba ya nao la.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: He ta on nae ka, kɛ he dɛ nyinu. Taraken ɡba, haa on na, kɛ he dɛ yaradao. Anomanta, he sie dɛ lɛ kohona nɛn aa wola won baɡle a wa.

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: He yarada dɔ mun. A ɡelɔ Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heya, wɛɛ lɛ heyaa ka tonɛ.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: He lɛɛ nɔ, Korowii keamere fa dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ ba he nɛɛ suna dɛ lɛ heyaa la wa, asɛ dɛ swɛɛ siwi dɛ pese Korowii waa waa bola la dɛ jemɛ a bini kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Dɛ Kristo Doma soɡe ba nɛɛ dɛɛ baɡle wahala Kristo aa dɛ ba nae, dɛ baɡle jirima aa dɛ ba bala wahala la habɔɔ. Ba takapɔ kɛŋɔ bá fee won jemɛ tɔpere aa dɛ ba chiɡa, ne ɡɛ aa dɛ ba ɛɛ.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Korowii ɡelɔ a ɡɛ keamere la jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba koeh baa dɛ koh la, ba laa dɛ́ di a tɔnɔ, heyaa ba koh dɛɛ tɛ. Waa haa noa taraken dɛ le Amanesoma baa bola he be la ta la, ban fa bola. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa tomɔ ya be laanee cha ba ba bola he be la. Korowii nyundua toroma kwaraa dɛ nyin a ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ́ jemɛ. Goroŋ doe wa

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ir nyu ne dɛ́ ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ. Hé kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa do chae Yeesu Kristo aa cha heyaa awola waa ba nɛra bwa nao la ta.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Haa ɛ Korowii bii dɛɛ no o deŋna waa nomanta, he bɛ he pɛlchɔɡa waa he fa aa lɔ biro ta dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta la dɛɛ ɛ.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Gɛ Korowii waa le heyaa tɛ o te aa do ɡoroŋ la, hé ɡe do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ he we-ɛɛla bwa ta,

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Hé do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛ n do ɡoroŋ.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Korowii waa wola nɛn siebɔr nyiŋi dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la, onee he wi dɛɛ yerɔ he Mɛɛ la. Anomanta, hé kpɔ he te kɛ hɔɔhra he soɡa bini harɛ bonɔ, dɛɛ tɛo duure, dɛɛ ɔmɔ.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: He jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii aa lɛ heyaa le he naawa wesale he fa aa lɔ a ta la ta la, harɛ bonɔ kwaa aa dɛ chɔɡ kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm ne laa o yawɛ heya.

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo waa do kɛ saraha pebie doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ, waa wola kirihiah bobɛlbwa dii la, o ɡbaɡba chal nee Korowii yawɛ heya.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Korowii aa leo ŋɔ ó ɛ a ɡɛ toma nɔ, dɛ ba ta nyundua ne harɛ tae mɔɔ. Kɛ he waa o koh dɛ ɡel o ba harɛ nɛra nao, tɔpera aa ka mun nɔ ta la.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: O nɛɛ a che he yarada Korowii. Korowii ɡee iru seo ta dɛ tɛo jirima. Anomanta, he yarada ne he hwɛɡa haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ la, Korowii nɛɛ a bwa do.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Taraken nɔ haa sɛh kasinteŋ la ta teŋa, asɛ a che a ta he doŋa le he nɛɛ hɛɛ nyin dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ nɔ, hé den dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa kohona bambile bwa ne,

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bwa do kɛ kpɔɡa fee, ba jirima ɡe do kɛ kpɔɡa fee. Kpɔɡa dɛ sewɛ, a fee ɡe ɛɛ lee.

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Kɛ Korowii Waa te lole saŋ bɛlbwa.” A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ Amanesoma baa bola baɡle heyaa la.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé le wechɔɡa bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ dɔŋa neɡra bɛlbwa, ne nɛra sie nyiŋa dɛɛ ɛ wa, ne bɔweela dɛ nɛra waa bola bɛlbwa sese ta.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he siwi swɛɛ Korowii Waa la noe ta kɛŋɔ bechasɔɔhne siwi yon swɛɛ elnee ta la, a che a ta he won kpeɡ he lɛɛ waa la ta.

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: O te ɛ Bwe waa dɔ mkpa. Nɛwɛnyini liiru konsala dɛ vɛoh, kɛ onee Korowii te nyiŋi kɛ o ɛ Bwedɛɛɡe o wa aa hiah dɛɛ nyinu. Haa ba o be nɔ,

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: he ɡe do kɛ bwea aa dɔ mkpa. Hé ɡel o kpɔ heyaa ma Korowii Dea ásɛ he ɛ Korowii sɔfore haa do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ dɛ che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii bambile bwa ne a ɛ saraha dɛɛ su o siwi.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Na, n pɛne Bwedɛɛɡe o wa aa hiah, dɛ kpɔ pa n Dea mun Saayɔn o lawɔ kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yaradao la, waa sihiih di bwa.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: He nɛra haa dɛ yaradao ɡe be la, wɛɛ ɛ Bwedɛɛɡe o wa aa hiaah tɛ heya. Asɛ nɛra baa wola on yaradae ɡe la, wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini laanee ba be, kɛŋɔ, “Bwe la mamaala aa vɛoh dɛ liiru konsala laanee bera ba lawɛ dea kpoŋe la.”

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Kɛ he te la, Korowiirii le heya. O Kora sɔforee heya. He do ɡoroŋ. He ɛ o nɛra waa le heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ bol o nyokpowaa waa ɛa. On le he ne biro ta dɛ ba he ne o bochaah waa wera kohona la ta.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: He fa ta Korowii nɛra ɛɛ, kɛ taraken te, o nɛraa heya. O fa ta he sum nae, kɛ taraken te, o na he sum.

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡa, n dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ haa ɛ hɔɔhra bonɔ, bonɔ aa wola he bwɛɛ ɛɛ nɔ, hé laa he te kpɔ he bwadabii pɛlchɔɡa ta. Anee dɛɛ vuuɡi heyaa haa wola won ɛ waa Korowii aa kpɔa do he bambile bini la.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Haa lɔ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ baah nɔ, hé ɡel he wobɛlbwa toɡre, ásɛ dɛ ba dɛ bol he waa ŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa, a habɔɔ la, bá na he we-ɛɛla kɛŋɔ a wer, dɛ kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii awola waa ba ya ne o na dɔŋa la. Pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ koranar ne nomonome

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: Hé koh ya Dɔɔ la waa dɛ́ pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ nomonome baa cheɡ ba harɛ bonɔ bwa, he harɛ bwa nyu waa chɔ wobɛlbwa nyoa,

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: ne o ɡe nɛra waa lee ba ŋɔ báa tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne dɛɛ kpɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ waa aŋwɛnɛ ta la.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyin kɛ hɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ tɔ ɡɛna ŋwɛnɛ ba bɛ won bol ɡɛnewaa dɛɛ chɔɡ heya.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Hé so kɛŋɔ nɛra haa dɔ he te haa wola yoma ɛɛ. Kɛ he bɛ dɔe haa dɔ he te la kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa. Hé ɡel nɛra na kɛŋɔ Korowii bonɔɔna ne tolii heyaa he soɡa bini.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa duure, dɛɛ nyin he bala baa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la. Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ he harɛ bwa nyu te.

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: He banɔ la baa dɛ do heyaa bonɔɔna kɛɛ toli la, hé pwɛr he te, dɛɛ tɛ he dɔɔranar dɛɛ duu ba. He dɔɔranar ba tea aa soma ba do pwɛre ɡbo laa n ŋɔ. Hɛ́ɛ duu banɔ la ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa ɡba.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, naate baa dɛ fiiɡu aa wola aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ, asɛ o koh Korowii waa dɛ won lawɛ bambile la, a wer dɛɛ lɛ Korowii sie.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Haa ɛ wechɔɡa, asɛ dɛ lawɛ bambile ba lɔɔre a waa la, bɔkwa sɔnee lɔ he bambile lawa la ta nɔ? He ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ba ɡarɛ koh a waa dɛɛ ɛɛ hɔhɔrɔwa he lawɛ bambile aa, a ɛ sɔn dɛɛ tɛɛ Korowii be.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ Korowii le heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ na, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo koh he waa dɛ na wahala, asɛ a chɔ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ lawɛ bambile he wahala ta. Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ,

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: “O ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ bwa. Nyosonwaa ta o nyoa leɛ bwa.”

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Ba fa aa dɛ chɛɡro chɛɡtɔrɔ la bwa la, o ta nyoa pile chɛɡɛ nomɛlbwa. Ba fa aa dɛ ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa la bwa la, o ta nomɛlbwa aahrɛ. O kpɔ a bwa tɛ Korowii waa dɛ bol nɛra bwa waa dɛɛ pa bole kasinteŋ ne la.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: O ɡbaɡba lɛ ya wechɔɡa dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ na wahala daɡaɡre ta, ásɛ ya bɛ so tɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ́ so tɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ. Bola baa doo la taa a che he dɔ bokpeɡa.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: He fa do kɛ peera aa kpaŋa, kɛ taraken te, he ba he Dɔɔ waa dɛ nyin he nyu la be.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: He haahna ɡe, hé pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ he jaranar. Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, he banɔ la he jaranar aa wola Korowii waa yaradae la, he we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ɡeloo bá yarada. Haa nyoa kwaraa pili bol wa,

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ baa na ɡɛ he we-ɛɛla aa wera doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta, ne ɡɛ haa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Gɛ haa dɛ ɛ he nyumpona, ne suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare kɛŋɔ baŋa kwaa ne deŋna kwaa doe, ne laala haa dɛ do laa dɛ ɡel he do wer toli.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel nɛra na he wer waa aa lɔ bambile bini siwi aa wola an na la ta. Hé do pwɛre, dɛɛ ɛ waa bɔeh. Anee wera aa wola tu bwa, dɛ do wer kohona Korowii be.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: A saŋ la haahna ba fa aa dɛ tomɛ Korowii kasinteŋ ne dɛɛ yaradao la, dɛ ba pwɛr ba te dɛɛ tɛ ba jaranar. Anee ba ɡe wer.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Dɛ ɡɛɛ Abraham haah Saara ɡe do. O pwɛr o te tɛ o jaa dɛ faa yerɔ o dɔɔ. He waa toɡrɔ, haa ɔmɛ ɡe aa, ate Saara biirii heya.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Baala ɡe, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛ he dɔ liire he ne he haahna soɡa bini, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ baa kpeɡe kɛŋɔ heya. Hɛ́ɛ duu ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ne ba bwaa dɛɛ ba Korowii mkpa waa cha heyaa hɛɛ ba dɔe la dɔe. Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ken ásɛ wobɛlbwa bɛ he Korowii soŋa ŋwɛnɛ tɔ. Wenaale nae wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Waa maa dɛ nyin n bol laanee kɛŋɔ hé ɡel he nyoa pɛ, hé dɔ dɔŋa chal, hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa kɛŋɔ nyabii. Hé dɔ tedoma dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: He bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ dɛɛ bɔ wechɔɡa kem. He bɛ wobochɔɡa kpɔ dɛɛ bɔ wobochɔɡa kem. Nɛn ɛɛ wechɔɡa aa, soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛo. Korowii aa le heyaa la, dɛ hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ o tɛ heyaa hɛɛra.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin mkpajaŋ, dɛɛ nyin kɛ o bwara sɔɔhno la, wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi o nyoa kɛrɛdɛ. O bɛ wobochɔɡa dɛɛ bol, o bɛ nyosone dɛɛ teŋe.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Wɛ́ɛ ke o te wechɔɡa ta, dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa. Ó swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ ba nyopɛo ne.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: A do ɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛɛ su Korowii siwi la, Korowii dɛ nyiŋ ba, dɛɛ no ba wesoŋa. Kɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa te, o ne baa jo.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: He siwi swɛɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta naa, umee dɛɛ ba he hae yɔ?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa a che a ta hɛɛ na waa kwara naa, dɛ he ta som nae yaa? A ba ɡɛ naa, bɛ nɛra baa dɛ hae la ɔmɛ. Bɛ ɡel a hae.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ duu Yeesu Kristo dɛɛ ɔmɔ he bambile bini kɛŋɔ he Dɔɔree on. Hé kpɔ he te saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɔɔ heyaa he hwɛɡa haa dɔa nɔ wa aa, he won baɡlo a bini.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: He dɛ baɡla aa, hé kpɔ sisɔna ne taa dɛɛ baɡla. A chɛ kɛ he tea to he jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa he wobɛlbwaa dɔ dɛ bol. He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, nɛra baa koh he teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛ, ne he wedɛɛɡa haa dɛ ɛ waa dɛ bol wobochɔɡa dɛɛ yaɡɛ heyaa la, sihiih ɛɛ kpo baa.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ na wa aa, an wera kɛ haa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ na wa. Dɛ Korowii tetooraa kɛ he koh he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa dɛɛ na wa aa, a wer.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo ɡbaɡba sewɔ tɛ heyaa dɛ bɔ wechɔɡa kem. Kerabeŋkpoŋii o sewɛ, waa wola berɛ sewɛ kpa. O ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ bwa, kɛ o sewɔ tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra. Gɛ waa ɛ ya ne Korowii pɛ waa o ɛ ɡɛ. Baa kpoo la, o bwadabii sewa, kɛ o lileo te dɔ mkpafale.

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: O lileo la lala baa vɔɡ ba Lalabwɛɛ la be, dɛ ka bol Korowii Waa ba be.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nee nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii nee baa dɛ sɔ yaa aa lɛ yaa la. Korowii nee sɔe ta bwara doŋa yaɡla ɛɛ. Korowii nee sɔe munii kɛ ya soŋe Korowii ó tɛ yaa tepoŋ. A cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo seo ta ira ta, asɛ nee sɔe la won dɛɛ lɛ yaa.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: O kaa Korowii be nyundua, dɛ ka so nomombɔr o diɡ ta, dɛɛ di kora nyundua toroma ne konchɔɡa aa bea yaa wola an na bwa soo siwi nɛ.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo aa baa ɛ nɛwɛnyini la, o na bonyɛɡa. Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ he kpɔ he te, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ ɡɛɛ he ɡe bwara ɛɛ ba nyɛɡa. Nomɛlbwa waa wona lawɛ bambile dɛ na bonyɛɡa ka la, waa wechɔɡa ɛ.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Le fini dɛɛ kaa, hé kpɔ Korowii tetoora dɛɛ tɔ sie he soɡa bini harɛ bonɔ. He bɛ kwaa nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ pɛlɛ a ta la nɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ kpa.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Waa nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ aa dɛ ɛa asɛ he fa aa ɛa la, he ta a nyoa nae yaa? Dɛ he sie dɛ lɛ jwamane ne pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla ta. Dɛ he dɛ sɔ sen, dɛɛ ɛ saɡasaɡa, dɛ lawɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ nyɔ sennyɔbala. Dɛ he dɛ tomɛ voɡa dɛɛ jo Korowii kii nɛ.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la, a dɛ ɛɛ ba anebɛlbwa kɛŋɔ he ne baa wola pɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa ne wesaɡasaɡare baa dɛ ɛ la. A waa baa chɛɡre heyaa la.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa baa dɛ ɛ nɔ, baa ba tɔh ba nyoa Korowii siee. O kpɔ o te dɛɛ ba weera ne lala bwa waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa jaɡa tɔpere la telo. Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ, ásɛ dɛ won dɛɛ soŋe Korowii kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Waa aa ɛ wehiah kohonaa kɛ hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa bambile bwa ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɔŋa nyina dɛ tɔ wechɔɡa kɛrɛdɛ ta.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: He dɔŋ baa choɡe naa, lɛo, bɛ waa dɛɛ naɡre.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Kpeɡri bɛlbwa nomɛlbwa aa dɔa la, Korowiirii kpɔa chao ŋɔ ó kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ o Korowii toma. Anomanta, bɛ́lbwa nyiŋi o toma ta kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ cha o bala.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa Korowii aa chao o won dɛɛ bol o Waa la, wɛ́ɛ bola dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Waa wɛɛ bol la. Nomɛlbwa Korowii aa chao o won dɛɛ tomɛ o dɔŋ la, wɛ́ɛ tomɔ bokpeɡa Korowii aa tɛo bwa ne, ásɛ wobɛlbwa ta la, Korowii che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ sɔn. On chɛ kpeɡri ne jirima aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa. Aamen. Kristo te ɛɛ wenaale

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡa, he bɛ ɡel nii haa dɛ na taraken nɔ kpo he nyoa. Daahnaa Korowii kpɔa dɛɛ daah he yarada. He bɛ ɡel a ɛ heyaa wehɔɔhra.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ haa dɛ na Yeesu Kristo wenaale dɔŋa nɔ, ásɛ awola haa ba na o jirima waa dɔa la, he sie lɛ, he bwara sɔɔh heyaa kohona.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba koh he teŋa haa teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la waa dɛɛ chɛɡre heya aa, he na som. A ba ɡɛ naa, a dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe o wa aa dɔ jirima la soɡe he nɛ.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Dɛ he bini bɛl dɛ na wahala aa, a bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛnee o kpo, kɛɛ ŋwɛɛ o ŋwɛ, kɛɛ nɛnchɔɡee on, kɛɛ nyoaa o kpɔ do nɛra waa ta.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: Dɛ a cheɡɛ he Kristo te ɛɛ ta, asɛ hɛɛ na wahala aa, bɛ ɡel a ɛɛ sihiih. Jam Korowii kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn aa dawɛ he nɛ.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ Korowii bol nɛwɛnyina waa dɛ́ pa bole. Korowii nɛra nɛɛ wɛɛ ba mun pae. Waa dɛ ba ya kwaraa kpɔe pa mun nɔ, dɛ ɛrɛɛ nɛra baa wola Amanesoma la yaradae waa ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Anomanta, he nɛra aa ɛ Korowii tetoora kɛ he na wahala la, hɛ́ɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, dɛ kpɔ he te do Korowii waa ta heyaa la nɔn ta. O waa dɔ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin n bol waane he asɔre nomonome baa dɛ tɔ he sie la be. Asɔre nomoa la bɛlee n ɡe. N ɡbaɡba kpɔ siwi na wahala la soo Yeesu Kristo aa naa. Awola waa dɛ ba ɡela nɛra na o jirima la, n ɡe ɛɛ dɔ o jirima la bɛlee. N dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi Korowii nɛra baa ɛ o peera waa kpɔ ba tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la kɛrɛdɛ. He bɛ ɡel ba do heyaa mɔɔ hɛɛ nyiŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ, hé ɡel a ɛ he ɡbaɡba tetoowa. He bɛ suuɡa sibeɡra waa koh dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ toma nɔ, hé nyiŋi nyina haa dɛ nyin kɛ toma la kaa kɛrɛdɛ la dɛɛ ɛa.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: He bɛ kpeɡri dɛɛ di nɛra baa kpɔ ba do he nɔn ta la nɛ. Hé ɡel he we-ɛɛla do wer ásɛ ba nyiŋa dɛɛ chaara.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, Peteɡra Bwa Dɔɔ la balaa, wɛɛ tɛ heyaa jirima kon o wer aa wola tu bwa, o ɛ kompoŋ haa yoa dɛ le ba vɔwɛ heya.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: He bonɔɔna ɡe la, hɛ́ɛ tɛ he nomonome duure. Hé bwa pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛɛ cha dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii ne mbarafo tena aa jo, kɛ o dɛ sune nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba.”

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé pwɛr he te dɛɛ no Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri bwa la wa, ásɛ o ɡɔɔ heyaa ir tɔpere waa wera o be ta.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Wobɛlbwa aa dɛ ha heyaa la, hé kpɔa bil Korowii sie, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he waa lɔ o bambile ta.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ, hɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he dɔm Bɔnsam lole. Gɛ nyujente yon dɛɛ kɔɡre, dɛ́ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ́ lawɛ la, ɡɛɛ o ɡe ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin nɛra dɛ́ lawɛ.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé che kiŋkiŋ he yarada ta. He bɛ Bɔnsam ŋwɛnɛ tɛ. Hé jemɛ kɛ he bala baa dɛ yarada Yeesu bobɛlbwa la dɛ na a ɡɛ waa nɔ haa dɛ na nɔ dɔŋa.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Kɛ he baa na waa tama aa, Korowii waa dɛ na nɛra sum dɛɛ cha ba kohona la, o ɡbaɡba ɛɛ kwaa he wobɛlbwaa, dɛ́ ɡel he che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ do kpeɡri, dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa he bɛ chole. Onee le heyaa hé won che pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la ta, dɛ dɔ o jirima aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: On chɛ kpeɡri aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa. Aamen. Lea aa ka mun

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Silasee cha mɛ n chwerɛ heyaa tɔmbora nɔ la. N jemɔ kɛ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ ya teŋa yaa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ nɔ ta. N dɛ nyin he jemɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ n fa aa baɡle heyaa chae Korowii aa sune ya nɛɛ dɛ cha yaa la, a ɛ kasinteŋ. Hé den lawɛ a bini kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Asɔre tena baa lɔ Babelɔn, Korowii aa lee ba ɡɛ waa le heyaa la, ba dɛ na heya. N bie Mak ɡe dɛ na heya.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa nɛnnyin ne. He nɛra he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la, Kórowii tɛ he bwa bosɔɔhna.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Men Seemɔn Pita maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ dɛ ɛ o torome la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he nɛra haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ ya Korowii ne ya Lɛɛ la. O wa aa toɡra nomanta, o tɛ heyaa ya yarada waa wera nɔ dɔŋ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Kórowii che he jema haa jemɔ dɛ jemɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu la ta, dɛ́ cha heyaa kohona, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Korowii yerɛ o nɛra dɛ lee ba tɛ o te

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Yeesu dɔ Korowii kpeɡri la dɔŋ. Anee o kpɔ cha yaa, asɛ ya dɔ komɛlbwa yaa hiah dɛ won do le dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa. Yaa jemɛ Korowii waa le yaa ásɛ ya won dɔ o jirima ne o dadɛɛɡe la waa o ɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Waa ɛ ɡɛ nɔ, o cha yaa ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡa kohona ta, aa wola dɔŋ dɔe. O baɡɛ yaa nyoa a wa. Hɛ́ɛ che a taa dɛ́ le pɛlchɔɡa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta dɛɛ chɔɡ nɛra la nyoa, ásɛ dɛ do ɡɛ Korowii aa doa la.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Da waa wera tɛ heyaa la. He wono dɔ a ɡɛ da nɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, aa ɡeloo jema haa jemɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la dɔ tɔnɔ dɛ́ su siwi.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola a ɡɛ da nɔ dɔe la, o liire do toŋɡboŋ ken. Waa waa nyiŋe dɛɛ la sie. A ɡɛ te la soɔh kɛŋɔ Korowii laa o wechɔɡa o fa aa dɛ ɛ la fee o nɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Anomanta, yabala, Korowii aa le heyaa tɛ o te nɔ, hé takapɔ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɡeloo he we-ɛɛla baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii nɛra waa lee ba la banee heya. He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa naa lɔ Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ yaradae ta bwa.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: He dɛ ɛ ken nɔ naa, Korowii ɛɛ tɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ kohonaa, ásɛ he ja ya Dɔɔ waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo Kora waa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta. Korowii waa baa chwera do o keamere tɔne bini

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ waa la haa noa la, he dɔɔ jema kɛrɛdɛ dɛ che a ta kiŋkiŋ. Kɛ mɛɛ dɛɛ lii heyaa a waa saŋ bɛlbwaa.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: N dɛ lii kɛŋɔ maa wola sewɛ mɔɔ nɔ, a chɛ kɛ mɛɛ lii heyaa hé do wɔrɔbe waa nɔ ta.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ aa biɡri n wur n harɛ nɔ ta bwadabii nɔ ta. Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ɡelɔ n jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Mɛɛ takapɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ bwa maa won ɛ, ásɛ dɛ n ba toole kwaraa naa, he won dɛɛ lii waa nɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo kpeɡri waa dɔa ne o bala waa la yaa bol he be la, a ta waa yaa kpɔ liire dɛ teŋe nyosone ɛɛ. Ya ɡbaɡba kpɔ sie na ɡɛ o wa aa dɔ nyɛl kohona.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: O Mɛɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba aa tɛo duure ne jirima la, dɛ ya lɔ bela. Taa bɛl le o Mɛɛ Korowii waa dɔ jirima kohona la be kɛŋɔ, “N ɡbaɡba Bie maa dɛ nyinu o wa ɛɛ su n siwii nɔ.”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Taa la aa le Korowii doa ba la, ya noɔ. Dɛ ya ne Yeesu lɔ bwe la Korowii aa ɡela o do ɡoroŋ la ta.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Anɔ ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kpelakpela kɛŋɔ waa Korowii keamere la aa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ. A chɛ kɛ he cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ noa. Ba waa baa bola la do kɛ kandea waa dɛ chaah biro ta ka tel kɛŋɔ tɔ aa pera. Korowii Keamere Tɔne la ɛɛ chaah heyaa bɔree, ásɛ Korowii ɡel he liire chaah ɡɛ chɔmbibi wewee aa dɛ chaah bɔr la.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Hé jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ waa ba fa aa chwera Korowii Keamere Tɔne bini la, a bɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ nɛwɛnyini nyu bini liire.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Akai! Baa chwera la, ba ɡbaɡba liire ne laa ba chwera. Korowii Domadɛɛɡee ir Korowii nɛra nɛ, asɛ baa bol waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere Korowii aa kpɔa do ba nyoa.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: A saŋ la, nɛra bane teŋe nyosone ŋɔ Korowii keameree ban Israel tena bini. Gɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba bala dɛ ba teŋe nyosone ŋɔ ban dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra waa he bini. Baa dɛɛ chaɡle waa aa wola kasinteŋ ɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra nyoɡre. Gɛ ba wechaɡla aa doa la, haa won jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ. Baa vɛh ba Dɔɔ waa bɔ ba wechɔɡa kem la waa, dɛ́ ɡel Korowii chɔɡ ba, ba sewɛ seopiɡri.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Nɛndamanta ɛɛ teŋɛ ba wedoŋa baa dɛ ɛ la taa, ásɛ a che a ta nɛra bol kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ wobochɔɡa kɛ waa were.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Nyundua toroma ba fa aa ɛ wechɔɡa la, Korowii ta ban ɡelɛ. O kpɔ ba ta deŋnetɛra bɔr waa ɛ bɔluŋluŋ dɛ bir kpirikpiri la dɛ ka tel awola waa ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: O ta a saŋ la tena ɡelɛ. O ɡelɔ nee su tɔ nɛra baa wola on ɔmɛ la nɛ. Nɛra waa ɡel ba bwaa Nowa o fa aa dɛ chaɡle nɛra ŋɔ bá ɡel ba waa toɡre Korowii be la, ne nɛra banuanɛ.

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: Sodom ne Gomoora tena fa aa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, Korowii ŋɔ waa ɡel ba dwee ka, dɛ fuh ba ne ba bwɛɛre bwa dɛɛboo. Ba fuih chɔ le dɛɛ chaɡle waa aa ba chiɡ nɛra baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: Lɔt aa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su Korowii siwi dɛ do ba baah la, dɛ ba wedoŋa waa dɛ na ne anɔ la waa dɛ no tɔpebii bwa la ɡelɔ o bambile ɛɛ weo.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: He nyiŋo na naa, dɛ Korowii te jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ dɛɛ le Bɔnsam daahna ta, dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne, dɛ́ ka tel awola waa ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛra ba sie aa beɡre ba bwadabii nɔ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ pɛlchɔɡa ta, baa wola waa bu la, ba deŋnee Korowii ɛɛ ba tɛra kohona. A ɡɛ nɛra baa teŋe nyosone ŋɔ ba dɛ chaɡle waa nɔ, waa ba bambile aa lawaa baa ɛ. Ba bambile kpeɡri! Baa nyundua toroma bu. Wobochɔɡa kwaraa ba bol dɛɛ yaɡ ba!

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyundua toroma kpeɡri dɛ dɔ jirima ɡwaa a ɡɛ nyosonteŋna nɔ, kɛ baa ban chɔɡɛ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii sisa wobol ne.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Nɛra nɔ te do kɛ kpɔɡ bini ola Korowii aa taa ŋɔ báa kpoa la ken. Baa liire kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wa. Waa mun noe kpeɡri ba be naa, sisa wobolee ba bol dɛɛ yaɡa. Baa serewoo kɛŋɔ ola ken.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Wahala baa ɡela nɛra ɛɛ na la, ba ɡe ɛɛ na a dɔŋaa. Waa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a taa kɛŋɔ ba bodia waa baa dɛ ɛa bochaah la. He ne baa pɛa dɛɛ di kwaa nɔ, ba do kɛ doŋa dɛɛ chɔɡ he wer. Ba sɔɔh dɛɛ ɛ bodia waa he habɔɔ taeh.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Ba na haah bɛlbwa naa, ba dɛ nyinu. Ba nyina baa dɛ nyin wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta dɔŋ dɔe. Ba neɡre nɛra baa wola cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ Korowii waa ta dɛɛ kaa wechɔɡa ta. Ba sie dɛ beɡre kwaa taeh. Korowii taah ba!

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Ba ɡel ŋwɛnɛtoɡre la, dɛ nyoɡre. Ba kpɔ Beɔ bie Balam o fa aa ɛ Korowii keame la ŋwɛnɛ la. O sie aa beɡre suuɡa kohona nomanta, o kpɔ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta dɛ nyin suuɡa.

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: Korowii fa ɡelɔ keeɡo bol waa o be dɛ kaoh o wechɔɡa la ta. Keeɡo ɡe fe aa waa bol. Anomanta, Korowii keame nɔ ɡel o choɡla waa la.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: He dɛ hwɛɡɛ ba nɛ aa, he hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ. Ba do kɛ nenabɔɔ nee aa wola toole o ta, dɛ do kɛ baama peu aa ir a ne aa kaa ken. Biro kpirikpirii Korowii kwaa cheɡ ba.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Ba nyoa wobol kan taeh, kɛ ɡɛnewaa a bwa. Ba kpɔ bwadabii pɛlchɔɡa waa ne wedoŋa nɛra sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta, dɛ neɡre nɛra dɛɛ kaa wechɔɡa ta. Nɛra baa pa mun dɛɛ le wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bini baa wola cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ mɔɔ laanee ba neɡre dɛɛ kaa wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: Ba yon ŋɔ baa ɡeloo nɛra dɔ ba te, dɛ ba ɡbabir ɛ yoma. Ba wechɔɡa ɛɛ ba yoma, dɛkalkɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa aa wona lɛ nɛn liire la, a kpɔɔ berɛ yom.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Nɛra jemɛ ya Dɔɔ waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo waa la, dɛ won che a ta le waa aa dɛ la nɛn ne wechɔɡa ta harɛ bonɔ naa, a wer. Kɛ dɛ ba berɔ ba ɡel a ɡɛ wechɔɡa la dɔ bɔr vɔɡ ba ja aa, a te dɛ ba waa berɔ ɡbɔr dɛ ɡwaa mumpar la.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba fe ta Korowii ŋwɛnɛtoɡre la waa noɛ ka aa, a fe bɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ baa jemɛ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ la dɛ vɛh waa o ɡbaɡba aa ŋɔa báa ɛ la ɛɛ.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Ba waa nɔ ɡelɔ sɛɡla baa sɛɡla Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛ kasinteŋ. Ba sɛɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nyoate uɡaa, ɡɛɛ o berɛ dia,” dɛ sɛɡle ŋɔ, “He sɔ parakoo ne aa, wɛɛ berɔɔ ka ɡbili o kpechɛɡre ta.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he lii waa Korowii keamere la fa aa bola a saŋ la, ne waa Yeesu toroma la fa aa ŋɔa ya Dɔɔ waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ la ŋɔ hé ɛ la.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Anɔ la aa tɔ siee kɛŋɔ, a chɛ kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ tɔpera aa ka mun nɔ ta nɔ, nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ mamɛ heyaa. Ba sie ɛɛ dɛɛ lɛ ba pɛlchɔɡa taa.

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: Baa dɛɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, “Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ Yeesu ɛɛ berɔɔ ba ja la, lee o dɔɔ?” Dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya mɛɛnanar bwa serewɔ, dɛ o ta balɛ mɔɔ. Gɛ harɛ nɔ aa doa o mumpar la, ɡɛɛ o ta do.”

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Ba saahnɔ laa ba liire kpɔ ɡɛ Korowii fa aa kpɔ nyoa bol waa a saŋ la asɛ nyundua ne harɛ pa mun la ta. Nee nee Korowii ta harɛ, nee taa harɛ le.

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Nee Korowii ɡel o su bɔle harɛ bwa a saŋ la dɛ chɔɡo.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ nyundua kwaa bwa ne harɛ kwaa bwa aa lole taraken nɔ, á do le ɡɛ, ásɛ nii ɛrɛ ba fuah awola waa dɛ ba nɛra baa wola on tomɛ waa bola dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba la.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡa, he jemɛ kɛŋɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ne bene kaɡboŋ bwa beŋkpoŋ Korowii be. Beŋkpoŋii a bwa o te be.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Korowii aa o nyobaɡa ta too, ɡɛ bane aa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii biɡri o nyobaɡa waa baɡa ŋɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɛɛ bao la. Bambilee o dɔ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ waa nyin kɛ nomɛlbwa chɔɡ ta. O dɛ nyin kɛ nɛra bwa charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta mɔɔ o ba.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu bala tɔpere la, wɛɛ piɡruu kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ bala aa dɛ piɡri la ken. Awola tɔpere la, nyundua ɛɛ jiɡru kikikiki, dɛ́ nyoɡre nɛra siwi ta. Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa ɛɛ fuuh dɛ́ mwɛɛ, ásɛ harɛ ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa fuh.

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Kwaa nɔ bwa aa dɛ ba fuih ken nɔ, dɛ ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ he doɔ? A chɛ kɛ he do ɡoroŋ he soɡa bini, dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii,

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: dɛɛ kpa Korowii Tɔpere La nyundua aa fuh kwaraa ásɛ harɛ ɡe komɛlbwa fuh dɛ́ mwɛɛ kwaraa la. Hé swɛɛ siwi ásɛ Korowii Tɔpere La ba warane.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Ya dɛ nyiŋi nyoa Korowii aa baɡa la ŋwɛnɛ. Anee kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ta nyundua onfale ne harɛfalee. Belaa wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ba doe.

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
