translation_verse: Anomanta, n dandɛɛɡa, haa dɛ kpa awola tɔpere la, hé swɛɛ siwi kɛŋɔ hɛɛ do ɡoroŋee dɛ bɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa dɔ Korowii sie, ásɛ he ne o baah do wer.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Hé nyiŋi Korowii bambile waa lawa nɔ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛnɛɛ o tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ he charɛ he liire, ásɛ o lɛ heya. Anee ya dɔŋ Pɔɔl yaa dɛ nyin o waa la fa kpɔ o wejema Korowii aa tɛo la dɛ chwerɛ heyaa la.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl dɛ bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ o tɔne bwa bini. Ane ta Pɔɔl tɔne waane mun noe kpeɡri taeh. Anomanta, nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ baa wola cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ la, ba dɛ berɛ waa la sie. Gɛɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛɛ baɡle Korowii Tɔn bini waa la ane ɡe. Kɛ ba ɡbaɡba nyu taa ba ɛ dɛɛ dawɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n dandɛɛɡa, haa dɔa na ken nɔ, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ dɛ bɛ ba ɡel nɛra baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ ba neɡre heyaa he lɔ naa he yarada la ta, dɛ́ ba choɡli.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Kɛ hé swɛɛ siwi ásɛ ya Dɔɔ waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo suna waa sune he nɛɛ dɛɛ cha heyaa la ɛɛ ja kohona. Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ dɔ wejema o waa ta kohona. Hé ɡel ya tɛo jirima taraken ne saŋ bɛlbwa. Aamen.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Waa yaa dɛ ba a waa he be bola nɔ ɛ nɛn waa ɛ Korowii Nyoa Wobol dɛ dɔ mkpa dɛ do le le mumpar la bwa wa. Ya no o waa dɛ nao. Ya nyiŋu dɛ kpɔ ya nɔɔra leɡo.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: O fa lɔ Korowii be dɛ berɛ ba ɛ nɛn, asɛ ya nao. Anomanta, ya dɛ bol o waa he be kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ saŋ bɛlbwa mkpa dɛ faa do o Mɛɛ be la, o ba ya be ya jemɔ.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Anɔ la yaa naa dɛ no laanee yaa bol he ɡe be, ásɛ he no dɛ́ ba ja ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua ne o bie Yeesu Kristo beŋkpoŋri ɛɛ la ta.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Ya dɛ nyin kɛ ya bwa bwara sɔɔh yaa kɛrɛdɛ. A waa ya chwerɛ tɔn nɔ baa tɛ heyaa la. Korowii chaahnɔ kɛ kandea ken

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Waa yaa noa le Yeesu be dɛɛ bol he be laanee kɛŋɔ, Korowii do kɛŋɔ kon waa chaahna ken. Wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ ya ŋɔ ya ne o ɛ beŋkpoŋ, kɛ dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ɛ biro bini wa aa, ya teŋe nyosone. Ya we-ɛɛla dɛ baɡle kɛ ya waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Korowii waa aa chaahna la, dɛ ya dɛ ɛ ya waa bwa a chaah kɛ on aa, dɛ ya ne yabala pɛo dɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ. Dɛ Korowii Bie Yeesu chal la laa ya wechɔɡa bɛlbwa dɛɛ kpɔ ya nɛ.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya ŋɔ wechɔɡa toole ya nɛ aa, ya dɛ neɡre ya nyuune. Dɛ yaa kasinteŋ bol.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya bol ya wechɔɡa baɡle Korowii aa, o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ te dɛɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta. Wɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛ yaa, dɛ́ laa doŋa bwa kpɔ ya nɛ.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya ŋɔ ya ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ te naa, dɛ ya yerɛ Korowii nyosonteŋni. O waa la ɡe toole ya bini.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: N bidɛɛɡa, n chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ he bɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ ɛ. Kɛ dɛ nomɛlbwa ɡarɔ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, ya dɔ nomɛl o do ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la be, dɛ́ soŋe ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ tɛ yaa. Onee Yeesu Kristo la. O Waa Toɡrɔ.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Onee koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ sewɛ tɛ yaa dɛ kwaa ya ne Korowii baah. Ya ɡbo wechɔɡa waa laa o sewɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa jao.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Ya teŋɛ o waa ta naa, anee dɛɛ ba yaa baɡla kɛ ya jemɔ.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa ŋɔ o jemɛ Korowii, dɛ waa o waa ta teŋaa, ɡɛ nɛn la ɛ nyosonteŋni, dɛ kasinteŋ toole o be.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta la, onee dɛɛ nyin Korowii waa kɛrɛdɛ. Anɔ taa yaa ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ ya ne Korowii pɛo.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔa o ne Korowii pɛo la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ Yeesu Kristo da la.

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Yabala, waa nɔ maa dɛ chwerɛ heyaa nɔ ta wefala ɛɛ. Webena la yaa baɡle heyaa le mumpar la, anee ta.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Kɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl ɡe ta la, a ɛ wefala, dɛkalkɛ biro dɛ kaa. Bochaah tenten balɔ, asɛ bɔr ɛɛ chaah kɛrɛdɛ. Yeesu we-ɛɛla ne he ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla baɡle a ɡɛ waa nɔ mun.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔa o lɔ bochaah ta, kɛ dɛ hah o dɔŋ la, naate ta lɔ biro tenten ta.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o dɔŋ la do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa lɔ bochaah ta. Bochaah la nomanta, komɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ɡel ó lɔ nakpala dɛ́ chole.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa hah o dɔŋ la do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa lɔ biro ta. O dɛ valɛ, kɛ waa jemɛ bela waa dɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ biro la ɡelɔ o nyoŋe.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: N bidɛɛɡa, n chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ Korowii koh Yeesu waa dɛ kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heya.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Nomonome, n chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ heyaa jemɛ naate waa lole le mumpar bwa la. Bonɔɔna, n chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he ɡe, dɛkalkɛ he pɔ Bɔnsam nɛ.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: N bidɛɛɡa, n chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ he jemɛ ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la. Nomonome, n chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ he jemɛ naate waa lole le mumpar bwa la. Bonɔɔna, n chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ he bwaraa kpeɡa, Korowii waa la do he bambile bini. Heyaa wona pɔ Bɔnsam nɛ. He bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Bwadabii pɛlchɔɡa kwa, ne anɔ la aa ɛ siwi pɛla kwa, ne waa yaa nyina dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ maŋkura ya te la ɛ harɛ nɔ ta wa. A ta ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la be leɛ.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ne o pɛla kwaa bwa sekwaraa dɔ jaɡa. Naate waa dɛ ɛ anɔ la Korowii aa dɛ nyin la ɡbosoo dɛɛ ba le doe saŋ bɛlbwa. Yeesu Kristo dɔm la wa

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: N bidɛɛɡa, wobɛlbwa jaɡa saŋ telo. He noɔ kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo dɔm tenten la ɛɛ bao. Hale taraken o dɔma dɔɔ warɛ dɛ ba. Anomanta, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa jaɡa saŋ telo.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Dɛ bane fa ja ya nɛ, kɛ dɛ ba ta denɛ ɛ ya bini bane, dɛkalkɛ ba chwao. Dɛ ba fe ja ya nɛ aa, ya ne ba fe ta pɛo. Kɛ ba chwao, asɛ a den baɡle kɛŋɔ ba bini bɛlbwa ta ya nɛɛ jae.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: He te dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la he nɛɛ dɛ le Korowii Biɡoroŋ la be, dɛ jemɛ o kasinteŋ waa la bwa.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Kasinteŋ bɛ jema waa laa n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ baa tɛ heya. He jemɛ kasinteŋ la, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ nyosone ne kasinteŋ aa valɛ bwa.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Amɔ umee ɛ nyosonteŋni ɔ? Nyosonteŋnii naate waa ŋɔa Yeesu laa Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la. A ɡɛ nɛn la, onee Yeesu Kristo dɔm tenten. Onee vɛh ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua ne o Bie bwa.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tɔŋle kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo laa Korowii Bie la, waa won yerɛ Korowii o Mɛɛ. Gɛɛ a do, nomɛlbwa waa sɛah ŋɔ Yeesuu Korowii Bie la, o Mɛɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Hé kpoŋe anɔ la haa noa dɛ le mumpar la bini. Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, saŋ bɛlbwa he ne Yeesu ne o Mɛɛ bwa ɛɛ wonoo pɛ bá kpoŋe heya.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ ba dɛ fee baa neɡre heyaa la waa n chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la, ba bɛ won neɡre heya.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo aa dɔa tɛ heyaa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe o do he bini nɔ, haa nomɛlbwa nyin o baɡle heyaa waa kpa. O Doma la dɛ baɡle heyaa wobɛlbwa. O ɛ kasinteŋ te, waa nyosone teŋe. Hé no anɔ la waa dɛ baɡle heyaa la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ he te pɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛ. Korowii bii

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: N bidɛɛɡa, hé ɡel he ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ, ásɛ o baa forɛ le awola aa, ya bɛ ɔmɛ, ásɛ sihiih bɛ yaa kpo o sie awola waa ba la.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: He nao kɛŋɔ Korowii waa toɡrɔ, anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa su Korowii siwi la ɛ Korowii bie.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Hé na nyina ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua aa dɛ nyin yaa, dɛɛ yerɛ yaa o bii. Ya ɛ o bii kpela. A waa ɡela nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire aa wola yaa jemɛ la. Gɛ baa wola Korowii jemɛ la, ɡɛɛ baa wola ya ɡe jemɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Yabala, taraken ya ɛ Korowii bii. Yaa jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ yaa dɛ ba doe. Kɛ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ awola Yeesu Kristo aa forɛ le nɛra nao la, ɡɛ waa doa la, ɡɛɛ ya ɡe ɛɛ ba doe, dɛkalkɛ yaa nao dɛ́ na ɡɛ waa doa.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la di bolchɔɡe Korowii Mmara ta, dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡaa dɛɛ koni Mmara.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te pɛl Yeesu Kristo la aa berɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa kpa. Nomɛlbwa o taa teŋa dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, naate ta on pesee dɛ jemɔ.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: N bidɛɛɡa, he bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa neɡre heya. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa su Korowii siwi la ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe la.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa teŋa dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la ɛ Bɔnsam nɛn, dɛkalkɛŋɔ harɛ mumpar la bwaa Bɔnsam le dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa. A waa Korowii Bie la koh ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ba chɔɡ Bɔnsam toma bwa.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ Korowii bie la aa teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa kpa, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ Korowii dwee. Anomanta, waa won teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa kpa, dɛkalkɛ o mɛɛɛ Korowii.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Anɔ taa yaa ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ banɔ la baa ɛ Korowii bii ne banɔ la baa ɛ Bɔnsam kwa. Nomɛlbwa waa wola wedɛɛɡa aa su Korowii siwi ɛ, kɛɛ waa wola o dɔŋ nyin la, o ta o bie ɛɛ. Dɔŋa nyina wa

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Waa haa noa le mumpar laanee kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ yá nyin dɔŋa.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Ya bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ Keen, waa ɛ o te Bɔnsam bie dɛ kpo o nime Abɛl la. Bɔkwaa ɡela o kpoo wɔ? O we-ɛɛla waa ɛa la aa wola were asɛ o nime kwaa do wer la, anee ɡela o kpoo.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Yabala, dɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire hah heya aa, he bɛ ɡel a ɛ heyaa nyokpoa.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya le seo nɔn ta dɛ ba dɔ mkpa, dɛkalkɛ ya dɛ nyin dɔŋa. Nomɛlbwa waa wola o dɔŋ nyin la ta lɔ seo nɔn ta.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa hah o dɔŋ la do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ kpoo nɛra ken. He jemɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa dɛ kpoo nɛra la ta Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la dɔe.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Gɛ Yeesu Kristo aa koh ya waa dɛ kpɔ o te tɛ dɛ sewɛ la, a taa ya che dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ nyina aa doa. A chɛ kɛŋɔ ya ɡe koh yabala waa dɛ́ ɡe kpɔ ya te tɛ kɛŋɔ yaa sewɔɔ tɛɛ ba.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl dɔ harɛ nɔ ta kwaa bwa, dɛ na o dɔŋ waa nyaa, dɛ laa sie kpɔ o nɛ aa, amɔ dɛ o dɛ nyin Korowii aa?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: N bidɛɛɡa, he bɛ ɡel ya kpɔ wobol ne nyotor berɛ dɔŋa nyina. Kɛ hé ɡel ya we-ɛɛla baɡle kɛŋɔ ya nɛnnyin ɛ kasinteŋ nyina.

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Anɔ taa yaa ba wona jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya cheɡɔ tɛ kasinteŋ la. Anɔ taa yaa ba bambisɔɔhna dɔe Korowii sie.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya liire pa yaa bolchɔɡe aa, Korowii ɡwaa ya liire dɛ jemɛ komɛlbwa.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Anomanta, yabala, dɛ ya liire aa yaa bolchɔɡe pa te naa, amɔ ya dɔ bambile dɛ che Korowii sie, yaa wola ɔmɛ.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa yaa soŋo la, o dɛ tɛ yaa, dɛkalkɛ ya dɛ no o waa dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa dɛ su o siwi.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa dɛ ŋɔ ya be laanee kɛŋɔ, yá yarada o Bie Yeesu Kristo la, dɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa ɡɛ waa ŋɔ ya be la.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no Korowii waa la, o kpɔ o te dɛɛ pɛl Korowii, asɛ o ɡe lawɔ dɛɛ pɛl o nɛ. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Yabala, he bɛ nɛra baa ŋɔa ba dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, dɛ che o ta dɛɛ baɡle waa la dɛɛ yarada warawara. Hé pese ba, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ kpeɡri baa dɔa la le Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la be kɛɛ? Dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ neɡre nɛra kɛŋɔ ba ɛ Korowii keamere ba harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa pirim.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tɔŋle Yeesu nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ la ta Domadɛɛɡe la dɔe le Korowii be. Kpeɡri naate aa dɔa la le Yeesu Kristo dɔm tenten la be. He noɔ kɛ wɛɛ bao. Taraken, on bala la.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: N bidɛɛɡa, Korowii nɛraa heya. He pɔ keamere baa ɛ nyosonteŋna la nɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa lɔ he nɛɛ la, o kpeɡri ɡwaa kon waa lɔ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire la kpeɡri.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Ya te ɛ Korowii bii. Nomɛlbwa waa jemɛ Korowii la dɛ no ya wa. Nomɛlbwa waa wola Korowii jemɛ la aa ya waa no. Anɔ taa yaa ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ banɔ la baa dɔ kasinteŋ Doma waa ɛ Korowii kon ne banɔ la baa dɔ nyosone kon la. Korowii nyina ne dɔŋa nyina

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Yabala, hé ɡel ya nyin dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛ nɛnnyin le Korowii be. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin nɛn la, o ɛ Korowii bie dɛ jemɔ.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa wola nɛn nyin la aa Korowii jemɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowiirii nyina bwa Dɔɔ.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Kenii o baɡle o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa. O ɡelɔ o bibeŋkpoŋ la ba harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ ya che o nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Anɔɔ dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ nyina tenten aa doa. Ya te nyina yaa dɛ nyin Korowii la aa bobɛlbwa tel, kɛ o ɡe ɡarɔ dɛɛ nyin yaa. Hé na ɡɛ Korowii aa ɡela o Bibeŋkpoŋ la koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ sewɛ dɛ kwaa ya ne Korowii baah.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Yabala, dɛ kenii Korowii ɛɛ nyin yaa te naa, amɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ yá nyin dɔŋa.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa ta Korowii nae ka. Kɛ dɛ ya dɛ nyin dɔŋa aa, anee Korowii ɛɛ ba yaa lawɛ pɛl o nɛ, ásɛ o nyina la do ya be kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ kpela, yá kpɔ ya te pɛlo, ásɛ o ɡe lawɛ yaa pɛl o nɛ.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Ya na o Bie la dɛ di danseɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ɡela o ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ba ɛ nɛwɛnyini Lɛɛ.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa yarada Yeesu kɛŋɔ Korowii Biee on la, dɛ naate kpɔ o te pɛl Korowii, asɛ o ɡe lawɔ pɛl o te.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Anomanta, ya ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ nyin yaa, dɛ kpɔ siwi dawɛ o nyina la nɛ. Korowiirii nyina bwa Dɔɔ. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin nɛn la, o kpɔ o te dɛɛ pɛl Korowii, asɛ o lawɔ dɛɛ pɛl o nɛ.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Nɛn dɛ nyin o dɔŋ aa, waa ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ tɛr nɛra deŋne ɔmɛ. Nyina waa ɛ nyina tenten la dɛ doŋi ɔmee. Deŋne tɛra waa nɛn ɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii. Anomanta, naate waa dɛ ɔmɛ la ta nyina tenten dɔe o be.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Ya dɛ nyin dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii tɔ sie nyin yaa.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛl hah o dɔŋ dɛ ŋɔ o dɛ nyin Korowii aa, dɛ o teŋe nyosone. Dɛ nomɛl aa o dɔŋ o ne waa pɛa wɛɛ nao la nyin aa, ɛrɛɛ ó ɛ dɛ won nyin Korowii waa wola on na nɔ?

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Waa Yeesu Kristo aa kpɔa tɛ yaa laanee nɔ. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin Korowii la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó nyin o dɔŋ ɡe.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa yaradaa kɛŋɔ Yeesu ɛ Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ la, naate ɛ Korowii bie, dɛkalkɛ dɛ he dɛ nyin nomɛl waa aa, dɛ he dɛ nyin o bie ɡe wa.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya dɛ nyin Korowii dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa ta naa, a taa ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya dɛ nyin o bii.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya dɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ yaa ta naa, anee dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ ya dɛ nyinu. O waa la ta teŋa ɡe aa kpeɡe kohona tɛ yaa,

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ Korowii bie la won harɛ nɔ ta liire ne o komɛlbwa nɛɛ pɔe. Ya cheɡɛ yarada yaa dɛ yarada Yeesu la ta dɛ pɔ a nɛ.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Umee dɛ́ won pɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire ne o komɛlbwa nɛɔ? Nomɛlbwa toole, atane kɛŋɔ naate waa dɛ yarada kɛ Yeesu ɛ Korowii Bie la ɡbosoroo.

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Yeesu Kristo aa bala dɛ ba ɛ o toma la, nee ne chal taa o che dɛ ba. Korowii nee sɔe la ɡbo ta laa o toma la che. Kɛ o chal waa fuɡa ta la ne Korowii nee sɔe la bwa taa a che. Asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡee di danseɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ kasinteŋ te.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Kombele atoroo di danseɛ dɛɛ tɛ Yeesu.

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, ne Korowii nee baa sɔɔ la, ne o chal waa fuɡa ta la bwaa di danseɛ dɛɛ tɛo dɛɛ baɡle wesiwi beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya dɛ yarada nɛwɛnyini danseɛ aa, amɔ yaa Korowii kwaa yarada aa? O kwaa laanee kpeɡa ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini kwa. Korowii ɡbaɡbaa kpɔ waa nɔ di o Bie danseɛ.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa yarada Korowii Bie la, naate dɔ ɡɛ danseɛ nɔ o ɡbabir bambile bini, dɛ won jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ɛ kpela. Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola Korowii yarada la ɡelɔ Korowii waa la ɛ nyosone, dɛkalkɛŋɔ naate aa ɡɛ Korowii aa bol o Bie la waa la yarada.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Waa Korowii aa bola a ɛ danseɛ laanee nɔ. O tɛ yaa o mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la, asɛ o Bie la bee ɡɛ mkpa la ɡe le.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te pɛl Korowii Bie la dɔ a ɡɛ mkpa nɔ. Nomɛlbwa waa wola o te kpɔe pɛl Korowii Bie la ta mkpa la dɔe. Mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: N chwerɛ waa nɔ baa tɛ he banɔ la haa dɛ yarada Korowii Bie la, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Ya dɔ hwɛɡa Korowii be kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa yaa soŋo la, dɛ a ɛ o tetoowa aa, wɛɛ no ya bee.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ no ya be kwaa yaa dɛ soŋo la te naa, amɔ te dɛ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya dɔɔ dɔ kwaa yaa dɛ soŋe o be la.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Dɛ he na he dɔŋ wɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, soŋe Korowii tɛo. Wɛɛ tɛo mkpaa. N ŋɔ ɡɛ naa, banɔ la baa wola seo wechɔɡa ɛɛ laanee n ŋɔ hé soŋe tɛ. Wechɔɡa ane lole, dɛ he ɛa aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé sewɛ. N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ hé soŋe Korowii tɛ nɛn a te bɔr.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Waa aa wola were bwa ɛ wechɔɡa, kɛ wechɔɡa bwa laa ɛ seo wechɔɡa.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ Korowii bie la aa teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii Bie la dɛ nyiŋi naate nɛɛ ásɛ Bɔnsam bɛ won ɛo wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya bwa ɛ Korowii bii, asɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire, ne kwaa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɡe do Bɔnsam lɔɡa.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii Bie la balɔ, dɛ ba tɛ yaa liire yá kpɔ jemɛ Korowii tenten la. Korowii tenten la lawɛ yaa pɛl o nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kpɔ ya te pɛl o Bie Yeesu Kristo la nɛ. O ɛ Korowii tenten, dɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ kasinteŋ la lɔ ya bwa bambile bini. Wɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Ń Naa Korowii ne o Bie Yeesu Kristo sune ya bwa sekwara nɛ, dɛ́ cha yaa, dɛ́ tɛ yaa bosɔɔhna yá won jemɛ kasinteŋ la, dɛ́ dɔ nɛnnyin. Kasinteŋ ne dɔŋa nyina

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: N sie lɛo kohona kɛ maa na he bii la bane kɛ ba teŋɛ kasinteŋ waa la ta ɡɛ ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la aa ŋɔa yáa ɛ la.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Kɛ n bidɛɛɡe, taraken n dɛ soŋe, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa bola bil la ta. Wefala laa. Dɛ hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Dɛ ya dɛ nyin dɔŋa aa, dɛ ya dɛ teŋɛ o waa la ta. O waa laanee kɛŋɔ dɔŋa nyina, ɡɛ haa noa loɡla la. Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ ɛ he wobɛlbwa dɔŋa nyina ta.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Nyosonteŋna tenten balɔ taraken. Banee wola yarada kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo ba harɛ nɔ ta kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini la. Nomɛlbwa waa wola ɡɛ yarada la, o ɛ nyosonteŋni dɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo dɔm.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ bɛ ɡel he toma ɛ pɛɛ, ásɛ he won dɔ he tɔnɔ bwa dɛ́ le a ta.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ baɡle Yeesu Kristo waa la dɛ kpɔ o ɡbabir nyu bini liire dɛɛ ja la, amɔ dɛ Korowii ta naate nɛɛ teŋɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa jemɛ Yeesu Kristo webaɡla la dɛɛ baɡla ɡɛ aa doa la, dɛ Korowii ne o Bie la teŋɛ o nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa ba he be dɛ baa baɡle heyaa anɔ la aa wola Yeesu Kristo waa la ane ɛɛ yaa, he bɛ naate lɛ so he be, he bɛ o sie kwara lɛ.

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa lɛ ɡɛ te la sie la, o ɡe ɡba ja naate wechɔɡa la ta.

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: N dɔ waa taeh, dɛ́ bol he be, kɛ maa chwerɛ do tɔn ta. N dɛ nyin kɛ ń ba he be ya sie ɛ anɛ, ásɛ n bol he be. Belaa ya sie ɛɛ ba lɛɛ kohona.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: He nime la Korowii aa leo cheɡ tɛ o te la, o bii dɛ na heyaa kohona.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Men Nomoa Jɔnee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ, dɛɛ tɛ n dandɛɛɡe Gayos maa koh beŋkpoŋ ya bwa aa ɛa Korowii kasinteŋ waa la ta la, dɛɛ nyin he waa la.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡe, n dɛ soŋe Korowii ó chae he dɔ bokpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ, he waa bwa do wer kɛŋɔ he ne Korowii baah aa do wer la.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Yabala bane balɔ dɛ ba bol he waa n be ŋɔ he dɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ waa la ta. Dɛ he we-ɛɛla bwa dɛ baɡle ɡɛ. Anomanta, n baah sɔɔh mɛ taeh.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa maa no n bii waa kɛŋɔ ba dɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ la ta la, n baah dɛ sɔɔh mɛ ɡwaa komɛlbwa.

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡe, ɡɛ he yon lɛ asɔre tena haa wola ban jemɛ kwara, kɛ dɛ won kpɔ ba ka dawɛ he nɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋ ba la, he dɛ teŋɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta kɛrɛdɛ.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Ba bol he waa baɡle asɔre tena dɛ tɛɛ sɔn, dɛ baɡle ɡɛ haa nyin ba. Anomanta, dɛ ba dɛ ba kaala aa, cha ba ba ŋwɛnɛ la ta ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ Korowii nɛn ɛ,

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛ Yeesu toma waa ba koh dɛɛ valɛ. Baa suuɡa lɛɛ dɛɛ le nɛra baa wola Korowii waa yaradae la be.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Anomanta, a wer kɛŋɔ ya cha nɛra baa dɛ ɛ a ɡɛ toma nɔ. Dɛ ya wono dɛɛ cha dɔŋa ɡɛ naa, dɛ Korowii kasinteŋ waa la tomaa ya bwa ɛɛ ɛ la.

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: N fa chwerɛ waane dɛ tɛ asɔre tena bela, kɛ Dayɔtrafes aa dɛ nyin nomonome nomanta, o vɛh ya waa la.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Anomanta, dɛ n balaa, mɛɛ bol o waa, dɛ́ bol ɡɛ waa dɛ chɔɡ yaa dɛ kpɔ waa dɛɛ dawɛ yaa la. A ɡbo laa wɛɛ ɛ. O ta sɛɛh dɛɛ nyiŋi yabala baa vala dɛɛ bol Yeesu Kristo waa la. Dɛ bane ɡe dɛ nyin bá lɛɛ ba dɛ́ nyiŋ ba aa, waa ɡelɛ baa lɛɛ ba, dɛ yon doŋi ba bwa le ba bini.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡe, bɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la nɛɛ teŋɛ. Kɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la nɛ. Banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la ɛ Korowii bilola. Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la aa Korowii jemɛ.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Gasi toole Demetreɔs ɡe nɛ. Nomɛlbwa dɛ bol o waa ɡa. Kasinteŋ la waa dɛ teŋɛ o ta la ɡe dɛ diu danseɛ. Ya ɡba dɛ diu danseɛ ɡɛ. He jemɔ kɛŋɔ yaa nyosone teŋe.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: N dɔ waa taeh dɛɛ nyin n bol he be. Kɛ maa nyin kɛŋɔ n chwera do tɔn ta.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ n ba chɔɔre taraken bɔr, ásɛ ya sie ɡba dɔŋa ya bol wa.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Kórowii tɛɛ bosɔɔhna. He daamanar baa lɔ bonɔ la bwa dɛ nae. Ya dɛ na ya daamanar bwa.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Tɔn nɔ le men Jud maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ dɛ ɛ Jems nime la be. N chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ he nɛra N Naa Korowii waa bera ɛ ya Mɛɛ la aa dɛ nyin heya, dɛ le heyaa tɛ o te, asɛ Yeesu Kristo ɡee nyin heyaa la.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Kórowii na he sum kohona, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna kohona, dɛ́ cha heyaa hɛɛ nyin dɔŋa kohona. Nyosonteŋna baa dɛ chaɡle Korowii wa

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡa, n siwi fe swɛɛrɔ mɛɛ nyin kɛ ń chwerɛ heyaa tɔn dɛ baɡle lɛɛ Yeesu aa lɛ n ne he bwa la wa, asɛ n berɛ na kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ń chwerɛ heyaa buɡ nɔ ta dɛ́ do heyaa ɡbemba, ásɛ hɛɛ yo waa yaa dɛ yarada la wa. Korowiirii fa baɡle o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɡɛ baa dɛɛ tomɔ. Gɛ waa baɡ ba la aa berɛ bwa.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Nɛra bane sɔɔh dɛ ba koo he baah haa wola jemɛ. Baa Korowii tomɛ, dɛɛ bol ŋɔ nɛra ɛɛ wonoo dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii dɛ sune nɛra nɛ. Ba dɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ dɛ fe dɔ bɔr che dɛ́ɛ ɛ wedoŋa baa dɛ nyin. A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ vɛh ya Nomoa beŋkpoŋ Yeesu Kristo waa dɔ yaa la kɛŋɔ ba Dɔɔree on. Saŋ la bwaa Korowii Tɔn baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa pa ba bolchɔɡe dɛɛ ba ba deŋne tɛra.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he jemɔ, kɛ n dɛ nyin kɛ n lii heyaa ɡɛ Korowii fa aa lɛ Israel tena le Ijipt tena nɔn ta, asɛ a habɔɔ bane aa wola o waa yaradae, o kpoo ba la.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Nyundua toroma ɡe aa wola ɡelɛ bela Korowii aa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá di kpeɡri maɡre ba ne, dɛ́ le ba dobɔr la, ó tɔ ba do biro ta, dɛ́ do ba jɔɡrɔre waa wola ban foo ta bwa, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ o tɔpejen waa dɛ ba nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole la.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Gɛɛ Sodom ne Gomoora tena ne bwɛɛre a fa aa lɔ ba jwɛɛh la tena, ɡe fa aa chɔ dɔŋa baa ne haah ŋwɛnɛdoŋ ta, aa wola were ne bola, dɛɛ chɔɡ ba te. Baa ɛ ɡɛ la, Korowii ɡelɔ nii le ba nɛ, ásɛ nɛra bwa na dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛ deŋne nii aa wola dime bwa ne.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Gɛ a saŋ la tena fa aa ɛa Korowii hah ba la, ɡɛɛ nɛnchɔɡa baa lɔ he baah nɔ che ba deera baa dɛ dee ta, dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa ba bwadabii ne, dɛ vɛh Korowii ɔma, dɛɛ ɛ nyundua toroma nɛnhɛlwa.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Nyundua toroma bwa nomoa Maekel ɡba ta a dɔŋa ɛɛ bwa. O ne Bɔnsam aa dɛ yo dɛɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa Mosis lale waa dɛ́ jemɛ ba bini onɔ la waa dɔɔ la, Maekel kwaraa ta liire kɛ ó bol Bɔnsam wobochɔɡe. O waa waa bola bwaa kɛŋɔ, “Korowiirii dɛ́ dii kasinteŋ.”

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Waa nɛra nɔ aa wola a mun jemɛ la, wobochɔɡaa ba bol dɛɛ yaɡa. Ba ne ola bwa beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛ ola ta liire dɔe. Waa aa ɛ á bwara sɔɔhna la, anee aa ɛ. Gɛɛ ba ɡe do. An ɡee dɛɛ chɔɡ ba.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Bá bwɛɛlɛ! Ba teŋɛ Keen ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe la ta. Ba koh suuɡanyin waa dɛ kpɔ ba te jo wechɔɡa Balam fa aa ɛa la ta. Ba dɛ vuuɡi Korowii kɛŋɔ Kora fa aa dɛ ɛ la. Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ baa kɛŋɔ waa chɔɡ Kora la ken.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: He yon cheme dɛ pɛ dɛɛ di kondikwaa aa dɛ baɡle beŋkpoŋri ɛɛ haa dɔa he Dɔɔ tom nɔ ta la, a ɡɛ nɛra la lɔ he baah kɛŋɔ doŋa dɛɛ chɔɡ he wer. Ba ta sihiih dɔe. Ba ɡbo waa baa dawɛ, baa nɛra waa dawɛ. Ba waa ta hwɛɡa dɔe kɛŋɔ baama peu aa dɛ kaa a ne aa wola bwaala nee ne ba la. Ba do kɛŋɔ daa aa wola won a nɔna saŋ nɔnɛ, asɛ ba chuɡra ta a den serewe kwaraa la.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Adam natɛɛ ɡe naa Enɔk fa na ba waa dɛ bol ba waa ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ ɛɛ ba o nyundua toromedɛɛɡa kaɡboŋa nee,

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: dɛ́ ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole. Wɛɛ pa ba bolchɔɡe ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛ vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa la waa, dɛ́ pa nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ bolchɔɡe ba nɛnhɛlwobochɔɡa baa bola dɛɛ yaɡɔ la wa.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra nɔ, saŋ bɛlbwaa baa naɡre wa, wa aa ba siwi su. Wedoŋa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta laanee baa ɛ. Ba dɛ ta nyoa. Kwaane dɔe dɛ le nɛra be waa baa bol nɛra wedɛɛɡe. Wejaala ne webaɡla

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡa, hɛ́ɛ lii waa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo toroma la fa aa bol he be la.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Ba ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, “Tɔpera aa ka mun la ta la, nɛra ɛɛ leo dɛɛ mamɛ heya. A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ aa Korowii ɔmɛ. Wedoŋa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a taa baa ɛ.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ ɡela he ne he asɔre tena dɔŋa baah ɛɛ peɡri la. Harɛ bonɔ som lɛ ba liire bwa. Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la toole ba nɛɛ kwaraa.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: N dandɛɛɡa, hé te swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ɛ cha dɔŋa dɛ́ won che kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ he yarada haa dɔa Yeesu Kristo ŋwɛnɛɡoroŋ nɔ ta la do kan kohona. Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii o Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ne.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Korowii dɛ nyin heya, anomanta, hɛ́ɛ pɛlo, dɛ́ɛ kpa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ la, ásɛ o tɛ heyaa mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ba wechɔɡa ta joe kɛŋɔ baa dɛ to kon dɛ́ le nii ta la. Hɛ́ɛ sune bane ɡe nɛɛ dɛ́ɛ cha ba, kɛ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ ba wechɔɡa bɛ heyaa ba bu. Korowii kpɛɛra

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: o ɡboo Korowii ne ya Lɛɛ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nomanta. O chɛ jirima. O dɔŋ toole. Onee dɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri, dɛ ɛ komɛlbwa Dɔɔ dɛ le saŋ la bwa ba le fini, dɛ dɔ a bwa saŋ bɛlbwa! Aamen.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Waa nɔ aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔ, Korowiirii kpɔa baɡle Yeesu Kristo, ásɛ o kpɔ baɡle o bonɔɔna ne toli bá won jemɛ wa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ taraken. Yeesu Kristo ɡelɔ nyundua torome bɛl ba o bonɔɔ Jɔn be dɛ ba baɡlo a wa.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Jɔn baɡle waa waa naa bwa. Korowii waa ne Yeesu Kristo webaɡla ne waa waa naa dɛ no bwaa o chwerɛ.

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Men Jɔnee chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ asɔrere bele anuanɛ aa lɔ Eesia harɛ ta la. Korowii waa lole saŋ la dɛ ba le fini, dɛɛ ba le doe saŋ bɛlbwa la, o ne o Domare anuanɛ aa lɔ o kookara mun la,

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: ne Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ kasinteŋ te dɛ che tɛ Korowii, dɛ sewɛ, dɛ tɔ nɛra bwa sie ir seo ta, dɛ ɛ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa nomoa la, ó cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna. Hɛ́ɛ tɛ naate waa dɛ nyin yaa, dɛ sewɛ, dɛ kpɔ o chal lɛ yaa, a le yaa wechɔɡa ta la sɔn.

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ ya bwa ɛ o Kora ta nɛra, dɛ ɛ sɔfore dɛɛ tomɛ o Mɛɛ Korowii. Anomanta, hé tɛo sɔn. Onee dɔ kpeɡri saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Aamen.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no! Wɛɛ bao. Baama taa o che dɛɛ ba bala. Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ na o balaa. Nɛra ba fa aa yaɡɔ dɛ kpoo la, ba ɡba ɛɛ nao. Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ nao, dɛ́ koh o bala waa dɛ ba la waa dɛ́ wi. Aa ba ɡɛɛ. Aamen.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Nemenɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ dɛ do le saŋ la dɛ ba le fini, dɛɛ ba le doe saŋ bɛlbwa la, o ŋɔ, “Menee komɛlbwa Mumpar ne a Jaɡa.” Jɔn wepila ane waa naa

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Menee Jɔn maa ɛ he dɔŋ, dɛ koh pɛɛ ya bwa ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la waa dɛɛ na wahala, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii o Kora ta, dɛɛ lawɛ bambile wobɛlbwa ta la. N lɔ ekwi harɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Patmɔs la ta, bela baa koah kɛŋɔ n bol Korowii Waa dɛ ɛ Yeesu danseɛ dɛ laɡ mɛ ka ta la.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Awola bɛl, ya Dɔɔ Tɔpere ta, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ir n nɛ, n no takpeɡ bɛl n habɔɔ kɛŋɔ bɛla aa dɛ si ken.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ haa dɛ ba nae nɔ, chwera do tɔn bini, dɛ́ kpɔ ka tɛ asɔrere anuanɛ aa lɔ Ɛfesos ne Smɛɛna ne Pɛɛɡamɔm ne Tiatra ne Saades ne Feladɛlfea dɛ Laodisia la.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Belaa n ke nyiŋi kɛ mɛɛ na naate waa bol waa n be laanee, asɛ dɛ na suuɡaswɛm kandea daa anuanɛ,

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: dɛ na komɛl kɛŋɔ nɛn ken, o do batakaarejaŋ o tel o napaala ta, dɛ vɔwɛ suuɡaswɛm kiriso o bambile ta, dɛ do suuɡaswɛm kandea daa la baah ta.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: O nyumpona too kpelkpel kɛŋɔ yabi, o sibie ɡe ɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ ninlao ken.

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: O nakpale ɡe swɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ ayaawa do nii ta wɛɛ nyɛɡle la. Asɛ o taa ɡe do kɛŋɔ chuubu aa dɛ si la.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: O kpoŋe weweela anuanɛ o nɔndiɡ ta, asɛ tokobijen sie anɛ te waa nyɛɡa ɛɛ le o nyoa. O siebɔr ɡe dɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ wee aa dɛ lɔ kpeɡri nɛɛ la.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Maa nao la, n cholo chɔ o sie kɛŋɔ serewe ken. O kpɔ o nɔndiɡ dawɛ n nɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɔmɛ. Menee komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ ne a Muŋkaa bwa.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Men lole saŋ bɛlbwa la. N fa sewɔ, kɛ taraken n iro, maa wola sewɛ saŋ bɛlbwa kpa, dɛ dɔ seo ne Lalabwɛɛ safoone.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Chwerɛ waa haa naa nɔ, ne anɔ la aa lole taraken, ne anɔ la aa dɛ ba bala anɔ nɔ habɔɔ.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Weweela anuanɛ haa naa a do n nɔndiɡ ta la, ne suuɡaswɛm kandea daa anuanɛ la, n dɛ baɡle a mun dɛ tɛɛ. Weweela anuanɛ la ɛ nyundua toroma baa cheɡa tɛ asɔrere bele anuanɛ aa lɔ bwɛɛre anuanɛ la ta la. Kandea daa anuanɛ la ɡe cheɡɔ tɛ asɔrere anuanɛ la.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Ɛfesos la be. Kenii men maa kpoŋe weweela anuanɛ n nɔndiɡ ta, dɛɛ valɛ suuɡaswɛm kandea daa anuanɛ baah la ŋɔ,

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: N jemɛ he toma haa ɛa, ne he koeh, ne he bambile haa lawa, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ haa nɛnchɔɡa waa nyin. He fa kari nɛra ba fa aa dɛ yerɛ ba te n toroma la, dɛ na kɛŋɔ ba ta n toroma ɛɛ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nyosonteŋna.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: He lawɛ bambile dɛ koh n waa dɛ na wahala, kɛ dɛ ta lawɛ a bini.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Kɛ he webeŋkpoŋ maa dɔa laanee kɛŋɔ, nyina he fa aa dɛ nyin mɛ loɡla la ta ɡɛ doe kpa.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ lii ɡɛ he fa aa doa wubwa la, dɛ́ charɛ he liire, dɛ́ berɛ ka kpɔ he loɡla we-ɛɛla la ja. Gɛ laa aa, mɛɛ ba he bee dɛ́ ba laa he kandea daa la kpɔ le o buɡ ta.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Kɛ Nikolai tena we-ɛɛla la haa haah la te, he ɛ wa. Gɛɛ n ɡba hah ba we-ɛɛla.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la. Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ ɡeloo ó di mkpa daa la waa lɔ Korowii Eden bodɛɛɡe la ta nɔna.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Smɛɛna asɔre tena

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Smɛɛna la be. “Kenii men maa ɛ komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ ne a Muŋkaa, dɛ sewɛ, dɛ ir la ŋɔ,

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: N jemɛ he wahala ne he nyae wa, kɛ he ɛ dɔɔhna taeh. N jemɛ wechɔɡa nɛra baa dɛ yerɛ ba te Juu tena kɛ dɛ ɛ Bɔnsam habɔteŋra la aa bola dawɛ he nɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: He bɛ wahala bɛlbwa haa ba na la ɔmɛ. Hɛ́ɛ no! Bɔnsam ɛɛ ɡeloo bá larawe he bane do dea, dɛ́ daah heyaa na. Hɛɛ na wahalaa kohona tɔpera fi. Dɛ seo bini kwara, he cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ naa, mɛɛ tɛ heyaa mkpaa o ɛ kompoŋ haa yoa dɛ lɛ ba vɔwɛ heya.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la. Naate waa won yo le la, seo nɛɛte la aa won ɛo wobɛlbwa.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Pɛɛɡamɔm asɔre tena

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Pɛɛɡamɔm la be. “Kenii men maa dɔ tokobijen o sie aa ɛ anɛ dɛ do nyɛɡre la ŋɔ,

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: N jemɛ bela haa soɡa. Bɔnsam soŋnibɔree he do la, kɛ dɛ ta che kiŋkiŋ. Hale ɡɛ saŋ ba fa aa kpo Antipas waa ɛ kasinteŋ te dɛ che tɛ mɛ he bwɛjen Bɔnsam soŋnibɔr bela la, he ta tɔeh kɛŋɔ haa men yarada.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Kɛ n dɔ he waane tama. Bane lɔ he bini dɛɛ teŋɛ Balam webaɡla ta. Onee fa ɡela Balak neɡre Israel tena ba ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ di ola baa kpoa tɛ voɡa, dɛ kaa bɔ jwamane la.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Nikolai tena webaɡla ta ɡba lɔ he bini.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé charɛ he liire, dɛ́ le he wechɔɡa ta. Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, mɛɛ ba he be waranee, dɛ́ ba kpɔ tokobii la waa lɔ n nyoa la, dɛ́ yo he banɔ la haa dɛ teŋɛ Nikolai tena webaɡla la ta la.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la. Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ tɛo kondikwaa ane soo siwi baa dɛ yera maana nomɛlbwa aa wola an nae bwaa ó di, dɛ́ tɛo bwedɛɛɡe ompoŋ bɛl maa chwerɛ sɔnfale bɛl dawɛ o ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola sɔn la jemɛ, nemenɛ naate maa kpɔ tɛo la ɡbo.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Tiatra asɔre tena

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Tiatra la be. “Kenii men maa ɛ Korowii Bie, dɛ dɔ sibie a do kɛŋɔ ninlao, dɛ dɔ nakpale kɛŋɔ ayaawa la ŋɔ,

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: N jemɛ he we-ɛɛla ne he nɛnnyin wa, ne he Korowii yaradae, ne chae haa dɛ cha dɔŋa, ne he bambile haa dɛ lawɛ wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he taraken we-ɛɛla wer ɡwaa he loɡla kwaa la.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Kɛ n dɔ he waane dɛ́ bol. Hanchɔɡe Jɛsɛbɛl la waa dɛ yerɛ o te Korowii keame la, he ɡelɔ o do he be dɛɛ baɡle heya, dɛɛ neɡre n bonɔɔna ne n toli baa bɔ jwamane, dɛɛ di ola baa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ voɡa.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: N tɛo tɔpere ŋɔ ó ɡel ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ charɛ o liire le o wechɔɡa ta, kɛ waa no.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no! Mɛɛ do o ne nɛra o ne baa dɛ bɔ jwamane la weelaa bá chɔ, a noo ba kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ ba ta ɡelɛ dɛ charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛ ɡel ba tonchɔɡa la aa, ba bwa ɛɛ na wahalaa.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Mɛɛ kpoo o habɔteŋraa, ásɛ asɔre tena bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee jemɛ nɛwɛnyini nyu bini ne ba weliira bwa. Mɛɛ bɔ he bɛlbwa kemee ɡɛ o we-ɛɛla aa doa.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: Kɛ he Tiatra tena haa kaa, haa wola wechɔɡa waa baɡla la ta teŋɛ, haa wola Bɔnsam we-ɛɛla baa dɛ yera wesɔɔhla la jemɛ la, maa wekpeɡa ane bɛlbwaa kpɔ dawɛ he nɛ.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Kɛ waa la haa lawɛ a bini kɛrɛdɛ la, hé den lawɛ a bini ɡɛ ń ba.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Naate waa won yo le, dɛ́ won ɛ n toma ɡwɛeeh dɛ́ ka tel a tona bini la, mɛɛ tɛo kpeɡrii ó di harɛ nɔ ta nɛra nɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Saades la be. “Men maa dɔ Korowii Domare anuanɛ ne weweela anuanɛ la ŋɔ, N jemɛ he we-ɛɛla. Nɛra jemɔ kɛŋɔ he soɡe le bokpeɡa ta, kɛ he sewɔ. He kpeɡri haa dɔa dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ la nyoa dɛ sɔɔh.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Anomanta, hé ir nyu ne dɛ́ kwaa a ɡɛ waa a nyoa aa dɛ sɔɔh la, á won che kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n ta he we-ɛɛla bɛlbwa nae a do wer dɛ toɡre n Mɛɛ Korowii be.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ lii ɡɛ ba fa aa baɡle heyaa ne waa haa noa la, dɛ́ lawɛ a bini, dɛ́ charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ta. Dɛ he ta nyu ne iraa, mɛɛ piɡri heyaa kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ ken, haa wola jemɛ ɡɛ saŋ maa ba he be.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: He ta dɔ nɛra tama baa wola ɡelɛ a do kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa doŋa do ba nɛ. Mɛɛ tɛɛ ba yapoŋaa bá tɔ, n ne ba valɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba chɛ ɡɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ tɔɔ yapoŋee kɛ ban. Maa o sɔnee fee le Mkpa Tɔn la bini bwa. Mɛɛ bol o waa n Mɛɛ ne o nyundua toroma la bee, kɛŋɔ n nɛnee on.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Feladɛlfea asɔre tena

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Feladɛlfea la be. “Kenii men maa do kaih, dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ te, dɛ dɔ Devid safoa, dɛ o pili komɛl nomɛlbwa aa wola won tɔɔ, dɛ o tɔ komɛl ɡe aa, nomɛlbwa aa wola won pilu la ŋɔ,

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: N jemɛ he we-ɛɛla. Hɛ́ɛ no! N pili ŋwɛnɛ tɛ heya, nomɛlbwa aa won tɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he kpeɡri aa kanɛ. Kɛ he wono dɛɛ teŋɛ n webaɡla ta. He ta tɔeh kɛ n ne he laa. He ta n nɛɛ teŋa ɡelɛ.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no! Bɔnsam habɔteŋra baa dɛ teŋe nyosone, baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛɛ yerɛ ba te Juu tena la, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá ba ɡuŋi he sie, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin heya.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Haa noa tɛ mɛ, dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛ na wahala nomanta, mɛɛ lɛ heyaa le wahala aa dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛɛ dɛ́ ba daah ba la ta.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: N dɛ ba taraken. Hé lawɛ waa haa jema la bini kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa won neɡre heyaa he paŋɛ kompoŋ baa dɛ ba heyaa vɔwa he yoi dɛ le ta la.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ ɡeloo ó ɛ kɛŋɔ pila n Mɛɛ Korowii Dea bini, waa wola belaa le kpa bwa. Mɛɛ chwerɛ n Mɛɛ Korowii sɔn ne o bwɛjen Jerusalam sɔnee dawɛ o nɛ. Jerusalamfale waa dɛ ba n Mɛɛ Korowii be nyundua lee dɛ́ ba he be la sɔnee mɛɛ ba chwera dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ́ berɛ chwerɛ n sɔnfale dawɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Laodisia asɔre tena

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Laodisia la be. “Kenii men maa ɛ Aamen, dɛ che tɛ Korowii, n waa dɔ kasinteŋ, Korowii che n nɛɛ ta komɛlbwa la ŋɔ,

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: N jemɛ he we-ɛɛla. Haa wɔbɛ, haa sɔnɛ ɡe. Dɛ wɔrɔbe kɛɛ sɔnee he den do aa, a fe bɔ.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Kɛ haa do ywɛlɛywɛlɛ haa wola wɔbɛ, haa wola sɔnɛ ɡe la, mɛɛ poo heyaa ta.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: He ŋɔ he dɔ kwa, dɛ ɛ dɔɔhna, komɛlbwa ta heyaa nyae. Kɛ haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he waa dɔ sinyana, dɛ do sum. He ɛ nyaara, dɛ nyoŋe, dɛ che mumɡbal.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Hé ɡel n ŋɔ he be. A wer kɛ hé yawɛ suuɡaswɛm maa kpɔ nii laa o doŋa bwa kpɔ o ta la, ásɛ dɛ dɔ kwa, dɛ́ yawɛ yapoŋa n be dɛ́ tɔ, ásɛ dɛ laa sihiih kpɔ he nɛɛ he mumɡbal cheɡa ta. Hé ba yawɛ tɛɛɡa ɡe n be, dɛ́ ka do he sibie ta dɛ́ won dɛɛ na.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba la, n dɛ ja ba, dɛɛ tɛr ba deŋne. Anomanta, hé swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ta.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no! N cheɡɛ doonyoa dɛɛ lɔ ɡbera. Naate waa no n taa dɛ́ ba yaa mɛ la, mɛɛ jo o bee, n ne o pɛ nɔn di kwa.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ ɡeloo n ne o ka so n kookara ta, ɡɛ n fa aa yoa le dɛ ka so n Mɛɛ be o kookara ta la.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋne la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.”

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, n nao kɛŋɔ doonyoa bɛl pilo ta Korowii bwɛɛ la ta, dɛ no taa bɛl n fa aa noo kɛŋɔ bɛla la. Taa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Teeh ba bonɔ ń baɡle waa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ anɔ nɔ habɔɔ.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Buɡ la ta, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la den ir n nɛ, asɛ n na kɛŋɔ kookara bɛl cheɡɛ nyundua, nomɛl so o ta.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Naate waa soɡe o ta la dɛ nyɛɡle al-al kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡa answɛɛma aa dɛ nyɛɡle. Dɛ bwaala deŋɡare bɛl bar o kookara la, dɛ do kɛŋɔ bwelwɛɛne ane aa dɛ nyɛɡle.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: N na kookane fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ a bar o kookara la cheme. Nomonome fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ do laalapoŋa dɛ pi suuɡaswɛm kooɡbɛrɛre dɛ so a ta.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Dɛ kookara la waa lɔ baah ta la bɔr dɛ ɡbɔɡre kɛŋɔ, bwaala aa dɛ nyɛɡle dɛɛ jiɡri dɛɛ kɔɡre la. Kandere anuanɛ ɡe cheɡɛ kookara la sie dɛɛ hɔ. Korowii Domare anuanɛ laanee.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Kookara la sie la ɛo kɛ mpo aa chɔa dɛ do ɡereŋ kɛ diɡi ken. Hweera kwaa anaarɛ ane aa dɔ kena cheɡɔ bar kookara la, bɛlbwa cheɡɛ o bampera beŋkpoŋ ta. A dɔ sibie a siini bobɛlbwa ne a habɔɔne bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Hweera kwaa nɔ bɛl do kɛŋɔ nyujente, bɛl do kɛŋɔ nabal, bɛl siebɔr do kɛŋɔ nɛn, bɛl ɡe do kɛŋɔ kee aa paɡri o kena dɛɛ ir la ken.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Bɛlbwa dɔ kena anumɛl, dɛ dɔ sibie a bwara bobɛlbwa ne a kena lɔɡre ɡba. A lɔ o be chɔɔ ne jwaana dɛɛ kpɛɛro aa wola ɡel bwa, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii Haa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ dɛ do le saŋ la dɛ ba le fini, dɛɛ ba le doe saŋ bɛlbwa la, he do ɡoroŋ noo, he do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Saŋ bɛlbwa hweera kwaa anaarɛ la aa kpɔ jam dɛɛ tɛ naate waa soɡe kookara la ta dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa la, dɛɛ duuru, dɛɛ tɛo jirima la,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “N Naa Korowii haa dɔ komɛlbwa la, he chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra bwa tɛɛ jirima dɛ́ duuri, dɛ́ sɛh kɛŋɔ hen dɔ kpeɡri bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee ta komɛlbwa, he tetoora taa a che a do le.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Asɛ n nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ naate waa soɡe kookara la ta la kpoŋe tɔn bɛl o nɔndiɡ ta. Tɔn la sie ne habɔɔ bwa taa ba chwerɛ, dɛ ɡuɡru, dɛ marɔ kera anuanɛ.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: N na nyundua torome bokpeɡa te bɛl wɛɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “Umee ń dɔ ó laa kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la kera anuanɛ la swe, dɛ́ pilu wɔ?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa toole nyundua ne harɛ nɔ ta, ne nɛra baa serewa kwaraa bini dɛ́ won pili tɔn la, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi o binii.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Anomanta, n wio kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta nomɛlbwa nae o chɛ kɛŋɔ ó pili tɔn la dɛ́ nyiŋi o bini.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Asɛ nomonome la bɛl ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Gel wii. Na! Naate waa le Juda dea baa yerɔ ba Nyujente, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ yerɔ Devid Naa la, o wono yo le. Anomanta, wɛɛ wonoo swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la nyoa kera anuanɛ la dɛ́ pilu.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Belaa n nyiŋi dɛ na pebie bɛl waa cheɡɛ baah ta, kookara la bɔr, hweera kwaa la ne nomonome la baro. O le pee baa kpoo. O le nyeɡlare anuanɛ dɛ dɔ sibie ɡe anuanɛ. Sibie la cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii Domare anuanɛ la waa toma a la harɛ nɔ bwa ta la.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Pebie la kaa laa tɔn la lɛ naate waa soɡe kookara la ta la nɔndiɡ ta.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Ba ɡo yelfale bɛl ŋɔ, “He chɛ tɔn la kpɔe dɛ́ swe o nyoa kwaa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba fa kpoe, asɛ he kpɔ he chal yawɛ nɛra tɛ Korowii dɛ le wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa,

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: dɛ ɡel ba ɛ N Naa Korowii Kora nɛra, ne o sɔfore dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛ́ ba di kora harɛ nɔ bwa ta.”

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: N nyiŋo dɛ no kɛ bobɛlbwa dɛ ɡbɔɡre, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ nyundua toroma warɔ taeh, dɛ ba bar kookara la ne hweera kwaa ne nomonome la bwa dɛ cheme. Ba lɔ kaɡboŋa kaɡboŋa maa wola ba nyoa jemɛ,

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: dɛ bwa pɛ bol takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “Pebie la ba fa aa kpoo la, onee dɔ kpeɡri ne kondɔɔh ne wejema dɛ bokpeɡa, onee chɛ duure ne jirima ne kpɛɛra.”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Asɛ n berɛ no komɛlbwa Korowii aa taa a do nyundua, ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ne mpo bini bwa, ne nɛra baa serewa kwaara bwa aa dɛ ŋɔ, “Naate waa soɡe kookara la ta la ne Pebie la chɛ kpɛɛra ne duure ne jirima, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri bwa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Hweera kwaa anaarɛ la sio ŋɔ, “Aamen,” asɛ nomonome la ɡe ɡuŋi harɛ dɛ duuru.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Maa dɛ nyiŋi la, n na Pebie la aa swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la kera anuanɛ la bini sitɔ kon la. Asɛ n no hweera kwaa anaarɛ la bɛl taa kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ kɔɡre la. O ŋɔ, “Ba!”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: N nao kɛŋɔ jaaɡɔpoŋ bɛl aa lea, nɛn so o ta dɛ kpoŋe to. Ba kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ tɛo, asɛ o dɔ kpeɡri dɛ le kaa, dɛ ka yo laa dɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Asɛ Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn nɛɛte la. Waa sweo la, n noɔ kɛ hweera kon la waa jaa nɛɛ la aa ŋɔa, “Ba!”

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Belaa jaaɡɔ bɛl ɡe le, o bwa swɛɛrɔ peihpeihpeih ken. Dɛ ba tɛ naate waa soɡe o ta la kpeɡri ŋɔ ó chɔɡ beŋkpoŋri ɛɛ harɛ bwa ta, ásɛ nɛra kpoo dɔŋa. Tokobijen bɛlee ba tɛo o kpɔ kaa.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la toorote la, asɛ n no kɛ hweera kwaa toorote aa ŋɔa, “Ba!” N nyiŋo, dɛ jaaɡɔbiŋi bɛl ɡe leɔ. Nɛn waa soɡe o ta la kpoŋe kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa tɔɡre la bɛl.
