english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: N no taa bɛl hweera kwaa anaarɛ la baah ta kɛŋɔ, “Tɔpebir kembɔree bá kpɔ yawɛ mea lakaja dela anɛ la, ásɛ anɔ la a yoɡ aa wola kpeɡe ɡe, tɔpebir kembɔree dɛɛ yawɛ lakaja dela anumɛl. Kɛ noo ne sen te, ɡel a chɔɡa.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Belaa Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la naarɛte la. Waa sweo la, n noɔ kɛŋɔ hweera kwaa naarɛte aa ŋɔa, “Ba!”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: Asɛ n nyiŋi dɛ jaaɡɔkɔl bɛl leɔ, asɛ nɛn so o ta baa yerɔ Seo. Bɛl ɡe le teŋɛ o nɛ, o ɡe sɔne Lalabwɛ. Ba tɛɛ ba kpeɡri bá kpɔ laa ne lɔr ne weechɔɡa ne kpɔɡ bini ola kpoo harɛ nɔ ta nɛra. He bɔne harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa bini bɔre anaarɛ naa, banɔ la baa tɛɛ ba kpeɡri bá kpo la ɛɛ tel bɔre anaarɛ la bini beŋkpoŋ nɛraa.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Asɛ Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn nuete la. Waa sweo la, n nyiŋi Korowii Dea bela baa dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la harɛbɔr, dɛ na lala baa koh Korowii Waa la wa, ne cheɡa baa cheɡa tɛo waa dɛ kpoo ba la.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: Ba kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii haa do ɡoroŋ dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta nɔ waa bola dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ bɔ ba ya kpoora nɔ kem ɔ?”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Dɛ ba tɛ bɛlbwa yapoŋ ó tɔ, dɛ ŋɔ báa onɛ tama ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bala Korowii bonɔɔna ne toli baa dɛ ba ba ɡe kpoora kɛŋɔ ban la nyoa aa chiɡa.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: N berɔ na Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn numɛlte la. Waa sweo la, harɛ jiɡro kohona, asɛ wee bir kɛŋɔ birisie ken, asɛ korobie swɛɛ kɛŋɔ chal.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Weweela chuɡro lee harɛ kɛŋɔ peujen yon ta, daa nɔŋhuuhne yon lee harɛ la.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii doa nyoɡre n siwi ta kɛŋɔ baa ɡuɡri kalaŋ la. Bwejaŋa ne ekwie ɡe chuɡri le a buɡe ta kaa.

translation_verse: Dɛ ba dɔm bɛlbwa ŋɔ o ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa aa, nii ɛɛ le Korowii danseɛ tena la nyooree, dɛ́ kpo naate. A ɡɛ seo nɔɔ nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔ ó ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa la ɛɛ ba sewa.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Ba dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ lawɛ bwaala o ɡel nɛɛ ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛɛ bol Korowii Waa la bwa, dɛ́ berɛ won ɡel nee berɛ chal. Ba dɔ kpeɡri kɛ bá kpɔ harɛchɔɡ waa bɛlbwa ta harɛ nɔ ta saŋ bɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Dɛ danseɛ tena la bol waa la tonaa, olchɔɡe bɛl ɛɛ le Bɔnsam Bɔluŋ la taa, dɛ́ ba yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba,

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: ásɛ ba lala chɔ bwɛjen la ba fa aa kpo ba Dɔɔ daɡaɡre ta la fɔɡbaah. Baa wonoo dɛɛ yerɛ bela Sodom, dɛ́ berɛ won dɛɛ yerɛ bela Ijipt.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa ɛɛ nyiŋi ba lala laanee tɔpera atoro ne fah, baa wola sɛh ba huɡ ba.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɛɛ koh ba seo la waa ba sie lɛ ba baah sɔɔh ba. Baa chemoo dɛ́ lɛ sie, dɛ́ kɛ dɔŋa kwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɡɛ Korowii toroma banɛ la fa kpɔ wahala ta ba nɛɛ taeh.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Asɛ tɔpera atoro ne fah habɔɔ la, hweera le Korowii be, dɛ jo ba nɛɛ ba dɔ mkpa dɛ ir, asɛ ɔmee lawɛ nɛra baa cheɡa dɛɛ nyiŋ ba la taeh.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Bela la, ɡɛ baala banɛ la no takpeɡ bɛl nyundua o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ir ba bonɔ!” Asɛ ba ir, bam bɛl kpɔ ba kaa nyundua asɛ ba dɔma che dɛɛ nyiŋ ba baa kaa.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Buɡ la ta, harɛ jiɡri kohona, asɛ bwɛjen la deene choɡli. Dɛ ba bɔne bwɛɛ la bini bɔre fi aa, deene aa choɡla la ɛɛ tel bɔr beŋkpoŋ deenee, nɛra kaɡboŋa banuanɛ serewɔ, asɛ ɔmee lawɛ banɔ la baa kaa la, asɛ ba kpɛɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua la.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Wekpeɡa aa teŋa nɛɛ la balɔ dɛ kaa. A ka toorotena aa ba bala taraken. Bɛla waa teŋa nuanɛ bɛl wa

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Nyundua torome waa teŋa nuanɛ la hoh o bɛla. Waa hoah la, asɛ n no takpeɡa kohona nyundua o ŋɔ, “Harɛ nɔ ta kora bwa berɛ N Naa Korowii ne o Kristo waa tomɔ la kora. Wɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwa.”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛ do le dɛ le saŋ la bwa ba le fini, ya dɛ jaame kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ he kpeɡri dɛɛ di kora komɛlbwa nɛɛ nɔ.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta baah diu, kɛ tɔpere baa nyɔ he danana nee la ɡe telo. He bole pae tɔpere telo, hɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba bol nɛra baa serewa la waa dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ bɔ he bonɔɔna baa ɛ he keamere ne he nɛra ne banɔ la baa dɛ ɔmɛ la kem, ba bini nɛnjena ne nɛmpɛɛne bwa, dɛ́ chɔɡ banɔ la baa dɛ chɔɡ harɛ la.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Asɛ Korowii Dea waa lɔ nyundua la pili, ba na Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la. Bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle pelɔpelɔ ken, dɛɛ kɔɡre, harɛ ɛɛ jiɡri, dombwea ɛɛ lee kohona.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Haah la tea beɔ, loltea lɔɔ wɛɛ ba lola dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Nyokpowaa ane ɡe aa dɛ baɡle waane berɔ ɛ nyundua bela ja. Kontuuɡi damanta bɛl waa le lɛŋɔ leɔ. O swɛɛrɔ dɛ dɔ nyuune anuanɛ dɛ nyeɡlare fi. Asɛ kooɡbɛrɛ pi o nyuune la bɛlbwa ta.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Asɛ o kpɔ o din ɡbaa weweela ta harɛ. Dɛ he bɔne a bini bɔre atoro naa, a bini beŋkpoŋii o ɡbaa. O baa che haah la waa dɛ ba lola la sie dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ dɛ o lolaa, ó kpɔ o bie la lile.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Haah la lolɛ bibaa waa dɛ ba kpeɡri kpɔe dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta. Waa lolɔ la, ba lao kee kaa Korowii be o do o kookara la bɔr.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Asɛ haah la ɡe chwa jo pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, bela Korowii aa ɛ bɔr tɛo ŋɔ bá nyiŋu tɔpera kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanumɛl bwa la.

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Asɛ laa chole Korowii doa. Maekel waa ɛ nyundua toroma la bwa nomoa la ne o dɔm kaa pu kontuuɡi damanta la ne o ɡe bala ba yo,

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: asɛ Maekel ne o dɔm pɔ ba nɛ. Belaa ba ta bɔr dɔe dɛ so Korowii doa kpa,

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: asɛ Korowii kpɔ kontuuɡi damanta waa ɛ harɛkon la yaa jemɛ o waa mumpar bwa, baa yerɔ Baradeɛre Te ne Bɔnsam, wɛɛ neɡre nɛra bwa baa nyoɡre la, ne o bala bwa ta harɛ.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: N berɔ no takpeɡ bɛl Korowii doa o ŋɔ, “Taraken N Naa Korowii lɛɛ waa dɛ ba dɛ́ ba lɛ nɛra la telo. O kpeɡri ne o kora dii saŋ telo. Taraken o Kristo waa tomɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la lɛ kpeɡri dɛɛ di, dɛkalkɛŋɔ naate waa chɔɡ yabala dɛɛ tɛ Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa la, Korowii kpɔɔ ta.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Ba cheɡɛ Pebie la chal la ne Korowii Waa baa bola la ta dɛ pɔ o nɛ. Ba ta ɡelɛ ba mkpa waa swɛɛ ba siwi, ba sɛh seo kwara.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Anomanta, Korowii doa tena, hé ɡel he sie lɛ. He banɔ la haa lɔ harɛ ta ne mpo ta ɡe la, hé bwɛɛlɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Baradeɛre Te la tuo ba he be. O baah diu kɛrɛdɛ, o jemɔ kɛ o tɔpere aa kanɛ kpa.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Korowii aa kpɔ kontuuɡi damanta la ta harɛ la, o iro dɛɛ ti haah la waa lolɛ bibaa la.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Anee ba tɛ haah la kee kena anɛ o kpɔ dɛ ir kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, bela baa ɛa tɛo dɛ nyiŋu bene atoro ne fah la, ásɛ kontuuɡi damanta la bɛ won ɛo wobɛlbwa.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Kontuuɡi damanta la aa ti haah la, o pili o nyoa dɛ uɡe nee a ɛ kɛŋɔ nepale dɛ́ fee palɛ haah la kaa.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Kɛ harɛ cha haah la, dɛ pere, dɛ kpɔ nee la bwa nyɔ.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Asɛ kontuuɡi damanta la baah di haah la nɛɛ kohona, o kpɔ ka tɔ haah la naanar baa kaa dɛɛ no Korowii Waa dɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu danseɛ waa ba dɛ di la ta la nɛ.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ ka che mpo nyoa dɛɛ kpa.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: A habɔɔ la, n na olchɔɡe bɛl wɛɛ le mpo ta. O dɔ nyuune anuanɛ dɛ nyeɡlare fi. Kooɡbɛrɛ pi o nyeɡlare la bɛlbwa ta, ba chwerɛ sɔnchɔɡe ɡe dawɛ nyuune la bɛlbwa ta, a ɛ chɛɡa tɛ Korowii.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Olchɔɡe la maa nao la le noniete, o nakpale ɡe le sisire nakpale, asɛ o nyoa ɡe le nyujente nyoa. Asɛ kontuuɡi damanta la kpɔ o kpeɡri ne o kora ne o nomonome kohona waa dɔa la bwa tɛ olchɔɡe la.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Olchɔɡe la nyuune la bɛl ɛo kɛŋɔ ba fa aa doo bol o sewɛ dɛ ir, asɛ bol la tonɛ. O waa ɛ nɛra bwa nyokpoa ba teŋɛ o nɛ.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa tomɛ kontuuɡi damanta la, dɛkalkɛ o kpɔ o kpeɡri tɛ olchɔɡe la. Ba duu o ne olchɔɡe la bwa kɛ Korowii ken, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ume dɔŋee olchɔɡe nɔɔ? Umee dɛ́ won puu yo laa lɔ?”

english_verse: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for
translation_verse: Korowii ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɔe. O ɡelɔ wɛɛ bol wejena ne nɛnhɛlwa, dɛ ɡel o dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won ɛa korobie fifraanaarɛ dɛ anɛ.

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: O pili nyoa dɛ bol Korowii nɛnhɛlwa, dɛ chɔɡ o ne bela waa lole ne nɛra baa lɔ o be bwa sɔn.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Korowii tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó yo o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel o dɔ kpeɡri wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa nɛ.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra baa wola ba sɔna chwerɛ Pebie la baa kpoo la Mkpa Tɔn la bini harɛ mumpar bwa la, ba bwa ɛɛ duu olchɔɡe laanee kɛŋɔ Korowii ken.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no.

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ bá lawɛ nomɛlbwa laa ta naa, baa lawɔɔ. Dɛ nomɛlbwa kweh kere dɛ kpɔ kpo nɛn aa, kere nee baa ba o ɡe kpoe. Anɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɔ bambile, dɛ́ lawɛ waa baa dɛ yaradaa la bini kiŋkiŋ. Olchɔɡe bɛl waa le harɛ bini

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Belaa n berɛ na olchɔɡe bɛl kɛŋɔ onɔ la, o ɛɡɛ dɛɛ le harɛ bini. O dɔ nyeɡlare anɛ kɛŋɔ pebale ken, o taa do kɛŋɔ kontuuɡi damanta taa ken.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Loɡle olchɔɡe la kpɔ o kpeɡri bwa tɛo, o che o naa ta dɛɛ ɛ wejena, dɛ ɡel nɛra bwa baa lɔ harɛ ta la ɛɛ duu loɡle olchɔɡe la ba fa aa doo bol o sewɛ dɛ berɛ ir o bol la tonɛ la.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: O wono dɛɛ ɛ wejena ne nyokpowa, dɛ ɡel nii le nyundua lee harɛ, nɛra na.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Waa cheɡɛ loɡle olchɔɡe la naa ta dɛɛ ɛ wejena la nomanta, o wono neɡre nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ŋɔ bá ma komɛl kɛŋɔ olchɔɡe la ba fa aa kpɔ kere doo bol o sewɛ dɛ ir la.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Baa mao tonɛ la, Korowii tɛ olchɔɡe la waa teŋa nɛɛ la ŋwɛnɛ o tɛ kon la baa mao la hweera o won dɛɛ bol wa. Olchɔɡe nɛɛte la ŋɔ bá kpoo nɛra baa wola sɛh dɛ́ tomɛ kon la baa mao la bwa.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: O ɡelɔ ba do nomɛlbwa, ne nɛmpɛɛne ne nɛnjena, ne dɔɔhna ne nyaara, ne yoma dɛ nɛra baa wola yoma ɛɛ, nso ba nɔndiɡ ta kɛɛ ba tili ta.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa ta nso la dɔe yaa, o ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ ó yawɛ kon kɛɛ ó yoɡ komɛlbwa. Nso la ɛ namba waa cheɡa tɛ olchɔɡe la sɔn.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Dɛ he dɔ wejema aa, no. Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ liire dɛ́ won jemɛ olchɔɡe la namba la mun la, ó lii. Onee

english_verse: , and it stands for a person.
translation_verse: , o ɛ nɛn sɔn.

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Asɛ n no ɡbɔɡa nyundua kɛŋɔ chuubu aa dɛ si ken, a berɛ do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra kohona la. Dɛ o dɛ si kɛŋɔ baa dɛ lɔ janjela la.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Nɛra la cheɡɛ Korowii kookara ne hweera kwaa anaarɛ la ne nomonome la be dɛɛ ɡo yelfale bɛl, nomɛlbwa aa wola won hweli yel la, nemenɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banaarɛ Korowii aa lɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa bini la ɡbo.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Gɛ nɛra nɔ do kɛŋɔ baala baa wola haah jemɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba lawɛ ba te dɛ do kaih. Ba dɛ teŋɛ Pebie la nɛɛ bobɛlbwa waa dɛ la. Banee nɛnloɡla Korowii aa lɛɛ ba nɛra waa dɛ ba ba lɛɛ la bwa bini, dɛ́ kpɔ ba tɛ o te ne Pebie la.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Ba ta nyosone teŋe bwa. Wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɡe toole ba nɛ. Nyundua toroma batoro bane wa

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Belaa n na nyundua torome bɛl waa ira kpɔ nyundua, dɛ kpoŋe Amanesoma aa wola tonɛ bwa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ la ka bol wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa be.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: O kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ́ɛ tɛo jirima, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tɔpere la telo kɛŋɔ ó bol nomɛlbwa waa dɛ́ pa bole. Hɛ́ɛ duu Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ, ne mpo ne neerare bwa aa lɔ harɛ ta la.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Nyundua torome nɛɛte ɡe iro teŋɛ onɔ la nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “O paɡrɔ! O paɡrɔ! Babelɔn bwɛjen la waa ɡela pɛlchɔɡa ne wedoŋa dɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta bwa nɛra kɛŋɔ sen asɛ ba waa fuh Korowii baah la paɡrɔ.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Toorote ɡe iro teŋɛ banɛ la nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa sɛoh dɛɛ tomɛ olchɔɡe la ne o chaa la baa mao la, dɛ ɡel ba doo nso o tile ta kɛɛ o nɔn ta naa,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: onee dɛɛ ba Korowii danana nee a nyoa aa kpeɡa kohona kɛŋɔ sen baa wola komɛlbwa a ta pule la nyɔe. Wɛɛ na hɔhɔrɔwa kɛrɛdɛɛ jebɔrɔwe ninlao ta, nyundua toroma ne Pebie la sie,

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: ásɛ chuu le bela baa dɛ na hɔhɔrɔwa la dɛɛ kaa nyundua saŋ bɛlbwa. Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ olchɔɡe la ne kon la baa mao la, ne nɛra baa kpɔ o sɔn do ba nso la, baa hɔhɔrɔwa la taa le bwa, dɛ́ɛ na waa chɔɔ ne jwaana.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Anɔ dɛ baɡle kɛ a chɛ kɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta dɛɛ yarada Yeesu la lawɛ bambile dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: N berɔ no taa bɛl nyundua o ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ waa nɔ. Le fini dɛɛ kaa, nɛra baa yarada ya Dɔɔ la dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo la, dɛ ba sewaa, ba na som.” Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la bolɔ ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, ba onɔ. Ba lee ba ba koeh ta. Ba sɔndɛɛɡe ɛɛ teŋɛ ba nɛɛ kaa.” Kwaa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta koma wa

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Asɛ n nyiŋi dɛ na bampoŋ bɛl, nomɛl so o ta kɛŋɔ nɛn, dɛ pi suuɡaswɛm kooɡbɛrɛ, dɛ kpoŋe kerenyɛɡ.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Anee nyundua torome bɛl le Korowii Dea bini, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ onɔ la waa soɡe bam ta la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he kere la dɛ́ komɛ. Kwaa koma saŋ telo. Harɛ ta kondikwaa beɔ ne koma.”

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Asɛ onɔ la waa soɡe bam ta la ta o kere la, dɛ komɛ kwaa aa lɔ harɛ ta la.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome bɛl ɡe le Korowii Dea waa lɔ nyundua la bini, dɛ ɡe kpoŋe kerenyɛɡ.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Bɛl ɡe waa dɔ nii kpeɡri le konsɔɔhsoma fuih bɔr, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ kerenyɛɡ te la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he kerenyɛɡ la, dɛ́ chaa harɛ ta daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen la nɔna. A beɔ!”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Asɛ o ta o kerenyɛɡ la harɛ ta dɛ chaa a nɔna, dɛ pa do kon ba yon pa nɔna la do dɛɛ sa a ta a nee le dɛɛ do o bini la. A ɡɛ kon la cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii bandia.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Nɔna baa sa a ta la cheɡɔ tɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra. Bwɛjen la daharaa ba sa ba nɛ, ba chal palɛ kaa kɛ kwansini lafraanɛ, a luŋri ɡe tel naɡale anɛ.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: N berɔ na wejena ane Korowii doa, a do kan dɛ baɡle waane. A ɛ nyokpoa taeh. N na nyundua toroma banuanɛ ba kpoŋe hɔhɔrɔwa bele anuanɛ. Anee hɔhɔrɔwa aa ka mun ba ɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ anee dɛɛ ba ɛɛ mɔɔ Korowii baah sɔɔh.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: N na bobɛl o do kɛŋɔ mpo aa chɔa dɛ do ɡereŋ asɛ nii do o ta. Asɛ nɛra baa pɔ olchɔɡe la ne kon la baa mao la nɛɛ dɛ vɛh o namba waa cheɡa tɛ o sɔn la kpoŋe Korowii janjelare dɛ che nee la jwɛh,

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: dɛɛ ɡo Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis ne Pebie la yel ŋɔ, “Oo, Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, he we-ɛɛla kan ɡa. Harɛ nɔ bwa Kooro, he ŋwɛnɛre toɡrɔ dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ.

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: Oo, n Naa Korowii, umee lole waa wola hen ɔmɔɔ? Umee wola hen sɔnee tɛɔ? He ɡboo do ɡoroŋ ka tonɛ. Harɛ ta nɛn te bɛlbwa ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi he siee dɛ́ tomɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ waa haa ɛa la toɡrɔ nomɛlbwa jemɛ.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Anɔ habɔɔ la, n berɔ na Korowii Dea waa lɔ nyundua la baa pilu cheɡ. Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr baa baŋro wɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii lɔ o nɛra bini laanee.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Asɛ nyundua toroma banuanɛ baa kpoŋe hɔhɔrɔwa bele anuanɛ la le Korowii Dea la bini. Ba laala baa doa la wer dɛɛ nyɛɡle. Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kirisore vɔrɔwe ba bambile.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Asɛ hweera kwaa anaarɛ la bɛl kpɔ suuɡaswɛm loɡa anuanɛ tɛɛ ba. Korowii waa lole saŋ te bɛlbwa la bandia su a bwa.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Korowii jirima ne o kpeɡri ɡelɔ chuu su o Dea la bini, nomɛlbwa aa wola won jo bela, atane kɛŋɔ hɔhɔrɔwa bele anuanɛ nyundua toroma banuanɛ la aa kpoŋa la aa ɛa tonɛ mɔɔ.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: N berɔ no takpeɡ bɛl o le Korowii Dea la bini, dɛ ŋɔ nyundua toroma banuanɛ la be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa dɛ́ ka fuɡe Korowii bandia la aa lɔ loɡa anuanɛ bini la ta harɛ.”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome waa tɔ sie la kaalɔ, dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa ta harɛ. Asɛ ŋwɛrchɔɡa aa dɛ we kohona lee nɛra baa dɔ olchɔɡe la nso dɛɛ tomɛ kon la baa mao la nɛ.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Asɛ nɛɛte ɡe ka fuɡe o kwaa do mpo ta. Asɛ mpo nee chɔɡ, dɛ do kɛŋɔ lale chal, asɛ kwaa aa lɔ mpo ta bwa serewe.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Asɛ toorote ɡe le dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa do moo bɛlbwa ne neerare bwa ta, a beɡre chal.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Asɛ n no nyundua torome la waa chɔ neerare nyoa la kɛ waa ŋɔa, “Hen haa lole saŋ la bwa dɛ ba le fini, henee ɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ dɛ ka tonɛ la, he waa haa bola dɛ pa nɛra bolchɔɡe la toɡrɔ,

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba fa ɡelɔ he nɛra ne he keamere chal fuɡe. Anomanta, he tɛɛ ba chal ba nyɔ. Gɛɛ ba chɛ.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Asɛ n no taa bɛl konsɔɔhsoma fuih bɔr, o ŋɔ, “Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro la, he waa haa ɛa dɛ tɛr ba deŋne toɡrɔ dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ.”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome naarɛte la ɡe leɔ, dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa ta wee ta, asɛ a tɛo kpeɡri wɛɛ nyaa kɛŋɔ nii ken,

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: dɛɛ nyaa nɛra, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o nyɛɡre taeh, asɛ baa bol Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri hɔhɔrɔwa la nɛɛ nɛnhɛlwa. Ba ta ba liire charɛ dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta. Ba ta on jirima tɛɛ.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Onɔ la waa teŋa nue la ɡe leɔ, dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa ta olchɔɡe la kookara ta, asɛ bɔr bir nɛra waa dɛ di kora ba nɛɛ la bwa nɛ, asɛ baa menɛ nyoa ba bonyɛɡa la wa,

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: dɛɛ chɛɡre Korowii waa lɔ nyundua ba bonyɛɡa ne ŋwɛra aa lɔ ba nɛɛ la wa. Ba ta liire charɛ dɛ le ba tonchɔɡa ta.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome waa teŋa numɛl ɡe leɔ, dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa ta Yufretis Moo ta, asɛ o bwa hweeh dɛ chɔ ŋwɛnɛ tɛ koranar baa le wee leebɔr dɛɛ ba la.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: N berɔ na kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ atoro a do kɛŋɔ sapone ken, bɛl le kontuuɡi damanta la nyoa, anɛ aa kaa la ɡe le olchɔɡe la ne keamechɔɡe la nyoa bini.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Bɔnsam kwaa, asɛ a won dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowa. A leɔ dɛɛ kaa harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa be, dɛ́ ka lawɛ ba bwa cheme bá yo Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ laa o tɔpejen la ta.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: Hɛ́ɛ no. Mɛɛ piɡri heyaa kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ ken. Naate waa wola dom chɔ dɛ do o laala dɛ so dɛɛ kpa la na som. N balaa, waa mumɡbalee valɛ nɛra nao ásɛ sihiih kpoo.

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ la lawɛ koranar bwa cheme bobɛl Hibru tena aa dɛ yerɛ bela Amaɡɛdɔn la.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Asɛ nyundua torome waa teŋa nuanɛ la ɡe fuɡe o kwaa do peu ta. N no takpeɡ bɛl le kookara la te be Korowii Dea bela, o ŋɔ, “A tonɔ.”

english_verse: There were flashes of lightning, roars of thunder, and the worst earthquake in all history.
translation_verse: Asɛ bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle pelɔpelɔ bobɛlbwa, dɛɛ jiɡri, dɛɛ kɔɡre, asɛ harɛ jiɡri kohona. Korowii aa ta nɛwɛnyini bwa, harɛ ta ɡɛ jiɡre bwa. O jiɡra la ɔma.

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Bwɛjen la peɡri atoro, asɛ harɛ nɔ ta bwɛɛre bwa paɡre. Korowii lii Babelɔnjen tena wechɔɡa la wa, dɛ ɡel ba nyɔ o danana nee a nyoa aa kpeɡa kohona kɛŋɔ seŋkpeɡa la.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Ekwie aa lɔ neerare baahna, ne bwejena nyoɡrɔ, ba nyin a bɔr kahonɛ.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Belaa nyundua toroma banuanɛ baa kpoŋe loɡa anuanɛ la bɛl ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ba ń baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ ba jwamane te tenten la deŋne tɛra. O soɡe neerare nyoo.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: O ne harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa di sɛm. O wedoŋa la ɛo kɛŋɔ sen, asɛ o kpɔ tɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ba nyɔ dɛ dɛɛ.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Belaa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ir n nɛ, asɛ nyundua torome la kpɔ mɛ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, asɛ n na haah bɛl o so olchɔɡe bɛl nɛ. Olchɔɡe la swɛɛrɔ dɛ dɔ sɔnchɔɡa o bwa, a bwa ɛ chɛɡa dɛɛ yaɡɛ Korowii. O dɔ nyuune anuanɛ, o nyeɡlare ɡe ɛ fi.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Haah la di toli dɛ do laaladɛɛɡa, ane swɛɛ a sie do ɡimeɡime, ane ɡe swɛɛ peihpeih dɛ do wer. O do baŋa kwaa ne deŋna kwaa ne nɔnloɡa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne bwedɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi ɛa, dɛ kpoŋe suuɡaswɛm luwee, wedoŋa ne jwamane we-ɛɛla suu.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Ba chwerɛ sɔn bɛl pɛl haah la tile ta. O ɛ sɔn o mun aa sɔah. Sɔn laanee babelɔnjen, jwamane tena ne harɛ nɔ ta wedoŋa bwa nya.

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: N na haah la kɛ waa dɛɛra. Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ ba koh a waa kpoo ba la chalee o nyɔ dɛ dɛɛ. Maa nao la, n nyoa kpoo taeh.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome la pɛɛ mɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he nyoa kpo nɔɔ? Mɛɛ pili haah nɔ ne olchɔɡe la waa soɡe o ta o dɔ nyuune anuanɛ ne nyeɡlare fi la waane aa sɔah binii baɡle.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Olchɔɡe la haa nao la, o siwi fa lole. Kɛ taraken te o siwi toole kpa. O dɛ ba teehna dɛ́ le Bɔnsam Bɔluŋ la bini, dɛ́ la Korowii ka chɔɡo. Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta Korowii aa wola ba sɔna chwerɛ do Mkpa Tɔn la bini nyundua ne harɛ mumpar bwa la, ba nyoa ɛɛ kpoo ɡɛ saŋ baa na olchɔɡe la kɛŋɔ o fa aa lole waa wola berɛ do le kpa dɛ berɛ le la.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: Dɛ he ta wejema dɔe yaa, haa won no waa nɔ mun. Olchɔɡe la nyuune anuanɛ la cheɡɔ tɛ bwejena anuanɛ. A taa haah la so. A berɔ che tɛ koranar banuanɛ ɡe.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Ba bini banue toole kpa. Bɛl ta dɛ di o kora. Bɛl ɡe ta lole, o ta dii mɔɔ. Dɛ o baa di aa, waa kora taa biɡri.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Olchɔɡe la o fa aa lole waa wola berɛ do le kpa la, o ɡe ɛ kooro nuatorote dɛ ja banuanɛ la nɛ. O dɛ ba kaala Korowii ka chɔɡo.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: Nyeɡlare fi haa naa la cheɡɔ tɛ koranar fi baa wola kora dii mɔɔ. Ba tɔpere telaa, baa di koraa dɔŋhwere beŋkpoŋ ɡbo. Ba ne olchɔɡe la bwaa dɛɛ ba pɛɛ di kora.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Koranar la bwa ɛɛ ɛ liire beŋkpoŋii, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kpeɡri bwa tɛ olchɔɡe la.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Ba ne Pebie la ɛɛ yo laalee, ásɛ Pebie la ne nɛra waa lee ba, dɛ kpɔ ba teŋɛ o nɛɛ ba waa dɔ kasinteŋ la pɔ ba nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee Dɔɔranar Bwa Dɔɔ dɛ ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ “Neerare la haa naa kɛŋɔ jwamane te la soɡe a nyoo la cheɡɔ tɛ wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Nyeɡlare fi la haa naa a che tɛ koranar fi la ne olchɔɡe la ɛɛ hah hanjwamane laanee, dɛ́ foo o bwara komɛlbwa, dɛ́ ɡelo dakpaŋ ɡɛ. Baa chwe o olii, ásɛ dɛ fuh o kabora,

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii kpɔ ɡɛ do ba bambile bini kɛŋɔ bá ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ ɡel ba ɛ liire beŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kpeɡri tɛ olchɔɡe la ó di ka tel kɛŋɔ waa Korowii aa bola la aa ɛa.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa ka mpo ta la leɔ, asɛ nɛra baa sewɛ seo bwa soo siwi la ɡe le, asɛ Korowii che ɡɛ ba fa aa ɛa ta, dɛ bol ba waa dɛ pa bole.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Belaa ba kpɔ seo ne Lalabwɛɛ bwa ta nidamanta aa yɛɛra chɔ kɛŋɔ moo la ta. Gɛ nii nɔɔ seo nɛɛte la.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa baa nyiŋi Mkpa Tɔn la bini dɛ nyin o sɔn kahonɛ la, dɛ ba kpɔɔ ka ta nii la ta.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Belaa n na nyundufale ne harɛfale bɛl. Dɛ nyundua ne harɛ la a fa aa lole la te nyoɡrɔ, asɛ mpo ɡe nyoɡre.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: Asɛ n no takpeɡ bɛl o le kookara la ta, dɛ ŋɔ “Hɛ́ɛ no! Taraken Korowii dobɔree nɛwɛnyini bini. O ne banee dɛ́ so, bá ɛ o nɛra ásɛ o ɡe ɛ ba Korowii, ba ne o so.

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: Wɛɛ fee ba sinii bwaa ta baa wola wi kpa. Seo aa lee do kpa. Lokua ne wii ne bwadabii wee aa lee do kpa, dɛkalkɛ webena la bwa toole kpa.”

english_verse: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
translation_verse: Anee naate waa soɡe kookara la ta la ŋɔ, “Taraken n ɡelɔ wobɛlbwa berɛ anfala.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n wobol nɔ ɛ kpela, neɡra toole a ta.”

english_verse: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
translation_verse: Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “A tonɔ! Menee komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ ne a Muŋkaa, menee wobɛlbwa Mumpar ne a Jaɡa. Dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ wi nyɔɡre aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo o la bela mkpa nee aa bula dɛɛ le, dɛ́ ka nyɔ ane pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Naate waa wona yo le la ɛɛ dɔ kwaa nɔ bwaa. Mɛɛ ɛ Korowii waa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ o ɡe ɛ n bie.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Kɛ ɔmeera ne nɛra baa wola men yarada, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ waa maa kia, ne nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra, ne nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamane, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ bebeewa, ne voɡtoroma dɛ nyosonteŋna. Ba bwa bɔree nii ne jebɔrɔwe aa yɛɛra chɔ kɛŋɔ moo dɛɛ fuh la ta. Anee seo nɛɛtena la.”

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Belaa nyundua toroma banuanɛ la ba fa aa kpoŋe loɡa hɔhɔrɔwa bele anuanɛ aa ka mun la aa su a bwa la bɛl ba, dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ba ń baɡle Pebie la hanfale la.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Anee Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ir n nɛ, asɛ nyundua torome la kpɔ mɛ kaa bwejen bɛl doa. O kpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ. Belaa o baɡ mɛ Korowii bwɛjen Jerusalam la kɛ waa le Korowii be nyundua dɛɛ ba harɛ.

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: Dɛ Korowii jirima ɡelɔ o bwa ɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡe baa dɛ yerɔ jasepa o do wer kohona dɛ do ɡereŋ la.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Danjwɛjen bɛl waa kpeɡa kohona baro cheme. O doonyoone lɔ fi dɛ anɛ, asɛ nyundua toroma fi dɛ banɛ ɡe cheche a ta. Ba chwerɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la sɔna dawɛ doonyoone la ta.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: O doonyoone la, atoro lɔ wee leebɔr, atoro do weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, atoro do wee cholibɔr, asɛ atoro ɡe do weekaŋle harɛbɔr.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Bwea baa ma danjwɛɛ la chɔŋɛ a ta la lɔ fi dɛ anɛ, asɛ Pebie la toroma fi dɛ banɛ la ɡe sɔna dawɛ bwea la ta.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Nyundua torome waa bol waa n be la kpoŋe suuɡaswɛm daa baa dɛ maɡɛ o ne kwa, dɛɛ ba bwɛɛ la ne o doonyoone dɛ danjwɛɛ la maɡa.

english_verse: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
translation_verse: Bwɛjen la ɛ fɔɔskwɛɛ. O paɡri ne o jaŋne bwa kɛrɛdɛ. O kpɔ daa la dɛ maɡɛ bwɛɛ la, o jaŋne lɔ kwansini kaɡboŋ lafraanue. O paɡri ne o jaŋne, ne o nyundua kpeɡa bwa beŋkpoŋ.

english_verse: Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about
translation_verse: O maɡɛ danjwɛɛ la. O kpeɡa del ɡe lɔ naɡale lafraanɛ dɛ fi dɛ anumɛl. Gɛ nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ maɡɛ kwaa la, ɡɛɛ o maɡa.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Bwɛɛ la danjwɛɛ la, bwedɛɛɡa baa yera jasepa la ɡboo ba kpɔ mao. Asɛ bwɛɛ la tenten ɡe, suuɡaswɛm tenten aa do ɡereŋ kɛŋɔ diɡii ba kpɔ mao.

english_verse: Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald,
translation_verse: Bwea fi dɛ anɛ baa ma danjwɛɛ la chɔŋɛ a ta la ɛ bwedɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi a yoɡ aa kpeɡa. A ɡelɔ o do wer. Bweloɡle la sɔne jasepa, nɛɛte la ɡe sɔne safaya, asɛ toorote la ɡe sɔne aɡat. Onɔ la waa teŋa naarɛ la ɡe sɔne ɛmeral.

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
translation_verse: Onɔ la waa teŋa nue la sɔne onis, numɛlte la sɔne kanɛɛleɔn, nuanɛte la ɡe sɔne kwats, nuatorote la ɡe bɛrel, nuanaarɛ topas, asɛ onɔ la waa teŋa fi la sɔne chalsedone, fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ te la ɡe sɔne tɛɛkoes, asɛ fi dɛ anɛ te la ɡe sɔne ametes.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Doonyoone fi dɛ anɛ la ɡe la, bwedɛɛɡa baa dɛ yera pɛɛlre laanee ba kpɔ kwaa a bwa ɡbeni, bɛlbwa di ombir. Bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaah ɡe ɛ suuɡaswɛm tenten dɛ do ɡereŋ kɛŋɔ diɡi ken.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: Korowii Dea baa cheme o bini dɛɛ tomɔ toole bela. Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la ne Pebie laanee cheɡa tɛ dea la.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: A ta hiaih kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie chaah bela. Korowii jirima dɛ chaah bela, asɛ Pebie la ɡe ɛ kandea bela.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ɛɛ ba valɛ o bochaah la taa, ásɛ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡe kpɔ ba jirima baa dɔa la ba jo o ta.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: O doonyoone yao che, aa wola tɔ saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ bɔr aa bela jo.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ɛɛ kpɔ ba jirima baa dɔa, ne ba kondɛɛɡa bwaa jo bela.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Kɛ komɛlbwa doŋa te bɛlbwa aa lɔ o nɛɛ la aa won jo bela, ɡɛɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa dɛ ɛ sihihwaa dɛɛ teŋe nyosone la bɛlbwa ɡe aa wola won jo bela. Nɛra baa chwerɛ ba sɔna do Pebie Mkpa Tɔn la bini la, banee dɛ́ won jo bela.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Belaa nyundua torome la baɡ mɛ moo bɛl waa pala dɛɛ le Korowii ne Pebie la kookara la ta. Nee la dɔ mkpa dɛ do ɡereŋ ken,

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: dɛ palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaah tenten. Mkpa daa anɛ che o baŋne anɛ bwa ta, fɔɡbaah bela. Mkpa daa la dɛ nɔnɛ kera fi dɛ anɛ benanyoa, korobie bɛlbwa kera beŋkpoŋ. O papooni ɡe wono chah nɛra bwa weela.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Komɛlbwa Korowii aa taahno la aa bwɛɛ la taa do. Korowii ne Pebie la kookara la chebɔree bela, ásɛ o bonɔɔna ne toli ɛɛ tomɔ,

english_verse: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
translation_verse: dɛ́ɛ nao, ásɛ o sɔn ɡe dawɛ ba tili ta.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Bɔr aa belaa dɛɛ jo, baa kandea ne weeree hiah, dɛkalkɛ N Naa Korowii ɛɛ dɛɛ chaah ba nɛɛ, ásɛ baa di koraa saŋ te bɛlbwa. Yeesu bala wa

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Belaa nyundua torome la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ ɛ kpela, nyosone bɛlbwa toole a ta. N Naa Korowii o fa aa ir keamere nɛɛ la, onee tom mɛ ásɛ n ba baɡle waa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ taraken la, ásɛ o bonɔɔna ne toli jemɛ.”

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no! N dɛ ba taraken. Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ waa nɔ aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini, dɛɛ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la bini kpoŋe la na som.”

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Men Jɔn, menee no waa nɔ dɛ naa. Maa noa dɛ naa la, n ɡuŋi nyundua torome waa baɡ mɛ waa nɔ la sie, dɛ fee ŋɔ ń duuru,

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: asɛ o ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡɛ ɛ. N ɡba ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ la bɛl kɛŋɔ he ne he bala keamere la ne nɛra la bwa baa dɛ no tɔn nɔ bini waa nɔ. Korowiirii chɛ kɛŋɔ hé duu.”

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, ó te ɛ dɛɛ la. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wedoŋa la, ó te ɛ dɛɛ la. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la, wɛ́ɛ ɛ o wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe wa aa toɡra la teŋɛ dɛ́ do ɡɛ dɛɛ la.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: Yeesu bolɔ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no bonɔ! N dɛ ba taraken. N dɛ ba kembɔr maa dɛ ba nɛra tɛɛ la ne. Gɛ nomɛlbwa toma aa doa laanee mɛɛ ba on kem bɔe.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Menee komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ, menee a Muŋkaa. Menee wobɛlbwa Mumpar ne a Jaɡa.

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: Nɛra baa chɛɡɛ ba laala a do wer la na som, dɛkalkɛŋɔ banee dɛ́ won dɔ Mkpa Daa la nɔna di, dɛ́ won kpɔ doonyoone la ta ba tetoora dɛ́ɛ jo bwɛjen la ta.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Nɛndoŋa, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ bebeewa, ne jwamane tena, ne nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra, ne voɡtoroma, ne banɔ la bwa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ nyosone teŋa, ne nɛra neɡra la te, ba ka bwɛɛ la dahare.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: Menee Yeesu, men tomɛ n torome ŋɔ ó ba baɡle waa nɔ, ásɛ he ka baɡle asɔre tena. Devid Dwee men. O Naa men. Menee Chɔmbibi Wewee waa dɛ chaah kɛrɛdɛ la.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ne hanfale la dɛ yerɛ ŋɔ, “Ba!” Nomɛlbwa waa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ó ɡe ŋɔ, “Ba!” Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ wi nyɔɡre la, wɛ́ɛ ba. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin nee aa dɛ tɛ mkpa la dɛ́ nyɔ la, wɛɛ dɔɔ nyɔ pɛɛpɛɛ.

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: N dɛ kah nomɛlbwa waa no waa nɔ aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini dɛɛ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la kɛŋɔ, dɛ nomɛlbwa kpɔ waane ja a ta naa, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ wahala maa baɡle a waa tɔn nɔ bini laanee ta o nɛ.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Dɛ nomɛlbwa laa waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere nɔ bini ane tamaa bɛlbwa kpɔ a ta naa, Korowii aa on mkpa daa maa baɡle o waa tɔn nɔ bini la nɔnaa tɛ ó di. Waa on bɔree tɛ o bwɛjen waa do ɡoroŋ la maa baɡle o waa la ta.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Naate waa ɛ waa nɔ bwa danseɛ la ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, n dɛ ba taraken!” Aamen. N Dɔɔ Yeesu, ba warane!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu cha he bwa sekwaraa haa ɛ Korowii nɛra la. Aamen.
